`extras/graphics/mihawk_submission_timeline.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#pragma once
// Strictly host-testable R08 Vulkan history lifetime model.
// The owning renderer supplies *completed* and *submitting* GPU timeline
// serials observed on the SAME graphics queue. CPU frame IDs are NOT fences.
// No work is submitted by this class; normal real-frame presentation never
// depends on a plan being accepted.
#include "framegen_present_gate.h"
#include "mihawk_native_surface_contract.h"
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
#include <algorithm>
#include <limits>

namespace Eden::FeatureLab {
enum class MihawkPlanStatus : std::uint8_t {
    CaptureOnly, GenerateAndCapture, Disabled, UnsafeResources,
    InvalidSerial, SubmissionPending, GpuBusy, RejectedCadence, Quarantined
};
struct MihawkSubmitRequest {
    FrameGeneration mode = FrameGeneration::Off;
    GraphicsCapabilities graphics{};
    MihawkSurfaceCapabilities surface{};
    PresentGateInput source{};
    std::uint64_t completed_gpu_serial = 0;  // actual fence/timeline completed
    std::uint64_t reserved_gpu_serial = 0;   // future submission serial
};
struct MihawkSubmissionPlan {
    MihawkPlanStatus status = MihawkPlanStatus::Disabled;
    std::uint64_t reserved_gpu_serial = 0;
    std::uint8_t capture_slot = 0;
    std::uint8_t previous_slot = 0;
    bool reset_history = false;
    constexpr bool CanCapture() const noexcept {
        return status == MihawkPlanStatus::CaptureOnly ||
               status == MihawkPlanStatus::GenerateAndCapture;
    }
    constexpr bool CanGenerate() const noexcept {
        return status == MihawkPlanStatus::GenerateAndCapture;
    }
};

class MihawkSubmissionTimeline {
public:
    // Externally pause/discard source history without lying about the GPU
    // completion of resources still being read. Busy serials stay untouched.
    constexpr void InvalidateHistory() noexcept {
        gate_.Reset();
        previous_valid_ = false;
    }

    // Scheduler::IsFree(tick) can safely poll these already-submitted ticks
    // without blocking CPU presentation. Never invent a completed GPU tick.
    template<typename IsFree>
    std::uint64_t PollCompleted(IsFree&& is_free) noexcept {
        const std::array<std::uint64_t, 3> serials{
            busy_until_[0], busy_until_[1], output_busy_until_};
        for (const auto tick : serials) {
            if (tick > last_completed_ && tick != std::numeric_limits<std::uint64_t>::max() &&
                is_free(tick))
                last_completed_ = tick;
        }
        return last_completed_;
    }

    // A reservation is a minimum guarantee, not a guessed exact Vulkan tick.
    // The actual tick returned by Scheduler::Flush must be passed to Commit.
    constexpr std::uint64_t NextReservation(std::uint64_t completed) const noexcept {
        const auto lower_bound = std::max(completed, latest_submitted_);
        return lower_bound == std::numeric_limits<std::uint64_t>::max()
                   ? 0 : lower_bound + 1;
    }
    constexpr MihawkSubmissionPlan Prepare(const MihawkSubmitRequest& request) noexcept {
        if (pending_) return {MihawkPlanStatus::SubmissionPending};
        if (quarantined_) return {MihawkPlanStatus::Quarantined};
        if (request.mode != FrameGeneration::MihawkGen) {
            InvalidateHistory();
            return {MihawkPlanStatus::Disabled};
        }
        if (CheckNativeMihawkSurface(request.surface) != NativeMihawkReject::None) {
            InvalidateHistory();
            return {MihawkPlanStatus::UnsafeResources};
        }
        // The graphics queue may submit unrelated work between R08 frames;
        // completed can exceed the last *R08* serial. Only require globally
        // monotonic completion and reservation with completed < reserved.
        // Serials come from a real fence/timeline, not CPU frame counts.
        if (!request.reserved_gpu_serial ||
            request.reserved_gpu_serial <= latest_submitted_ ||
            request.completed_gpu_serial < last_completed_ ||
            request.reserved_gpu_serial <= request.completed_gpu_serial) {
            InvalidateHistory();
            return {MihawkPlanStatus::InvalidSerial};
        }
        last_completed_ = request.completed_gpu_serial;
        const PresentGateDecision decision = gate_.OnRealFrame(
            request.mode, request.graphics, request.source);
        if (decision.reset_history) previous_valid_ = false;
        if (decision.reason != PresentGateReason::Eligible &&
            decision.reason != PresentGateReason::NoStablePair &&
            decision.reason != PresentGateReason::NoDisplayHeadroom) {
            InvalidateHistory();
            return {MihawkPlanStatus::RejectedCadence};
        }
        if (request.source.width != request.surface.width ||
            request.source.height != request.surface.height) {
            InvalidateHistory();
            return {MihawkPlanStatus::UnsafeResources};
        }
        const std::uint8_t slot = next_capture_slot_;
        // Never overwrite a snapshot referenced by a queued GPU dispatch.
        if (busy_until_[slot] > last_completed_) {
            InvalidateHistory();
            return {MihawkPlanStatus::GpuBusy};
        }
        const bool eligible_pair =
            previous_valid_ && previous_slot_ != slot &&
            decision.eligible() &&
            busy_until_[previous_slot_] <= last_completed_ &&
            output_busy_until_ <= last_completed_;
        MihawkSubmissionPlan plan{};
        plan.status = eligible_pair ? MihawkPlanStatus::GenerateAndCapture
                                    : MihawkPlanStatus::CaptureOnly;
        plan.reserved_gpu_serial = request.reserved_gpu_serial;
        plan.capture_slot = slot;
        plan.previous_slot = previous_slot_;
        plan.reset_history = decision.reset_history;
        pending_ = true;
        pending_plan_ = plan;
        return plan;
    }

    // Commit only AFTER commands have successfully been placed on a real GPU
    // queue with the declared completion serial. If no queue submission was
    // made, call Abort(). An aborted recording must not be submitted later.
    constexpr bool Commit(const MihawkSubmissionPlan& plan,
                          std::uint64_t actual_gpu_serial) noexcept {
        if (!pending_ || !plan.CanCapture() ||
            plan.reserved_gpu_serial != pending_plan_.reserved_gpu_serial ||
            plan.capture_slot != pending_plan_.capture_slot ||
            plan.previous_slot != pending_plan_.previous_slot ||
            plan.status != pending_plan_.status)
            return false;
        pending_ = false;
        if (actual_gpu_serial < plan.reserved_gpu_serial ||
            actual_gpu_serial <= last_completed_ ||
            actual_gpu_serial <= latest_submitted_) {
            // Commands may already have been submitted; never reuse the
            // resource until owner waits VkDeviceIdle and recreates them.
            quarantined_ = true;
            busy_until_.fill(std::numeric_limits<std::uint64_t>::max());
            output_busy_until_ = std::numeric_limits<std::uint64_t>::max();
            InvalidateHistory();
            return false;
        }
        latest_submitted_ = actual_gpu_serial;
        busy_until_[plan.capture_slot] = latest_submitted_;
        if (plan.CanGenerate()) {
            // Both snapshots are bound to the dispatch until this GPU serial
            // has actually completed, even if the next frame is queued early.
            busy_until_[plan.previous_slot] = latest_submitted_;
            output_busy_until_ = latest_submitted_;
        }
        previous_slot_ = plan.capture_slot;
        previous_valid_ = true;
        next_capture_slot_ = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(plan.capture_slot ^ 1U);
        return true;
    }

    constexpr bool Quarantined() const noexcept { return quarantined_; }
    // Only after the owning VkDevice is idle AND the private resources have
    // been destroyed/recreated. Never call in a render-loop fallback.
    constexpr void ResetAfterDeviceIdle() noexcept {
        *this = MihawkSubmissionTimeline{};
    }

    constexpr void Abort() noexcept {
        pending_ = false;
        InvalidateHistory();
    }
    constexpr std::uint64_t LastSubmittedSerial() const noexcept { return latest_submitted_; }
    constexpr std::uint64_t SlotBusyUntil(std::uint8_t index) const noexcept {
        return busy_until_[index & 1U];
    }
    constexpr std::uint64_t OutputBusyUntil() const noexcept { return output_busy_until_; }
    constexpr bool Pending() const noexcept { return pending_; }

private:
    FramegenPresentGate gate_{};
    std::array<std::uint64_t, 2> busy_until_{};
    std::uint64_t output_busy_until_ = 0;
    std::uint64_t latest_submitted_ = 0;
    std::uint64_t last_completed_ = 0;
    std::uint8_t previous_slot_ = 0;
    std::uint8_t next_capture_slot_ = 0;
    bool previous_valid_ = false;
    bool pending_ = false;
    bool quarantined_ = false;
    MihawkSubmissionPlan pending_plan_{};
};
} // namespace Eden::FeatureLab

```

`extras/graphics/mihawk_vulkan_history_barriers.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#pragma once
// Explicit barriers for copying a composited REAL frame into privately
// allocated history. This helper does not own or recycle Vulkan images.
// Caller must keep history alive until all GPU work referring to it is done.
// Caller must record vkCmdCopyImage between the Before/After barriers.
#include <vulkan/vulkan.h>

namespace Eden::FeatureLab {

struct HistoryBarriers {
    VkImageMemoryBarrier source;
    VkImageMemoryBarrier history;
    VkPipelineStageFlags src_stage;
    VkPipelineStageFlags dst_stage;
};

constexpr VkImageMemoryBarrier MakeImageBarrier(
    VkImage image, VkAccessFlags src_access, VkAccessFlags dst_access,
    VkImageLayout old_layout, VkImageLayout new_layout) noexcept {
    VkImageMemoryBarrier b{};
    b.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER;
    b.srcAccessMask = src_access;
    b.dstAccessMask = dst_access;
    b.oldLayout = old_layout;
    b.newLayout = new_layout;
    b.srcQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
    b.dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
    b.image = image;
    b.subresourceRange.aspectMask = VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT;
    b.subresourceRange.levelCount = 1;
    b.subresourceRange.layerCount = 1;
    return b;
}

// Encore's active WindowAdaptPass finishes in GENERAL. Never use UNDEFINED
// for a rendered source (it would discard the pixels). A reused snapshot
// remains SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL after the prior interpolation.
constexpr HistoryBarriers BeforeHistoryCopy(
    VkImage real_image, VkImage history_image, bool history_initialized) noexcept {
    return {
        MakeImageBarrier(real_image,
                         VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT,
                         VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT,
                         VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL,
                         VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL),
        MakeImageBarrier(history_image,
                         history_initialized ? VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT : 0U,
                         VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT,
                         history_initialized ? VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL
                                             : VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED,
                         VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL),
        static_cast<VkPipelineStageFlags>(
            VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT |
            (history_initialized ? VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COMPUTE_SHADER_BIT : 0U)),
        VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT
    };
}

constexpr HistoryBarriers AfterHistoryCopy(
    VkImage real_image, VkImage history_image) noexcept {
    return {
        MakeImageBarrier(real_image,
                         VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT,
                         VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT |
                             VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT |
                             VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT,
                         VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL,
                         VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL),
        MakeImageBarrier(history_image,
                         VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT,
                         VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT,
                         VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL,
                         VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL),
        VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT,
        VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COMPUTE_SHADER_BIT | VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT |
            VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT
    };
}

// A generated RGBA8 intermediate is *owned* by this backend; it must not
// alias PresentManager's image (potentially BGRA). Convert it by supported
// vkCmdBlitImage before asking PresentManager to present the synthetic frame.
// On first use its content is undefined. On reuse, the previous blit left it
// in TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, and this barrier must precede the compute pass.
constexpr VkImageMemoryBarrier BeforeNeuralOutput(
    VkImage rgba_storage, bool previous_blit_completed) noexcept {
    return MakeImageBarrier(
        rgba_storage,
        previous_blit_completed ? VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT : 0U,
        VK_ACCESS_SHADER_WRITE_BIT,
        previous_blit_completed ? VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL
                                : VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED,
        VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL);
}

// Assumes fg_record_generate wrote RGBA8 storage in GENERAL earlier on the
// same queue. Synthetic target is fully overwritten by a format-aware blit.
constexpr HistoryBarriers BeforeGeneratedBlit(
    VkImage rgba_storage, VkImage synthetic_present_image) noexcept {
    return {
        MakeImageBarrier(rgba_storage,
                         VK_ACCESS_SHADER_WRITE_BIT,
                         VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT,
                         VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL,
                         VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL),
        MakeImageBarrier(synthetic_present_image,
                         0U, VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT,
                         VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED,
                         VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL),
        VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COMPUTE_SHADER_BIT,
        VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT
    };
}

constexpr VkImageMemoryBarrier AfterGeneratedBlit(VkImage synthetic_present_image) noexcept {
    return MakeImageBarrier(synthetic_present_image,
                            VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT,
                            VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT |
                                VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT |
                                VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT,
                            VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL,
                            VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL);
}
} // namespace Eden::FeatureLab
```

`extras/graphics/msaa_force_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#pragma once
// R24 — candidate policy for manually forced MSAA; NOT a renderer.
//
// Guest sample count is part of image memory layout and framebuffer identity.
// Forcing 2x/4x/8x/16x requires *additional native shadow attachments*
// and explicit resolves to the unchanged guest targets. Merely replacing
// rasterizationSamples or ImageInfo::num_samples would corrupt guest memory.
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>

namespace Eden::Graphics::MsaaForce {

enum class Requested : std::uint8_t { Auto=0, X2=2, X4=4, X8=8, X16=16 };

enum class Decision : std::uint8_t {
    NativeAuto,
    NativeGuestSamplesAlreadySatisfy,
    GuestMultisampleTopologyConflict,
    UnsupportedRequest,
    RequiresVulkan,
    UnsupportedFrameFormat,
    UnsupportedDimensions,
    UnsupportedBudget,
    UnsupportedMultisampleRead,
    ShadowRendererNotImplemented,
    CandidateOnly, // candidate, NEVER proof of active MSAA
};

// Bit masks correspond to the Vulkan sample-count bits, without requiring
// Vulkan headers in unit tests: x1=0x1, x2=0x2, ... x16=0x10.
[[nodiscard]] constexpr std::uint32_t Bit(Requested requested) noexcept {
    switch (requested) {
    case Requested::X2: return 0x2;
    case Requested::X4: return 0x4;
    case Requested::X8: return 0x8;
    case Requested::X16: return 0x10;
    default: return 0;
    }
}
struct Limits {
    bool vulkan{};
    std::uint32_t framebuffer_color_sample_bits{};
    std::uint32_t framebuffer_depth_sample_bits{};
    std::uint32_t color_format_sample_bits{}; // vkGetPhysicalDeviceImageFormatProperties
    std::uint32_t depth_format_sample_bits{}; // specific format & usage
    std::uint32_t max_framebuffer_width{};
    std::uint32_t max_framebuffer_height{};
    std::uint64_t free_transient_bytes{}; // safe application budget; 0 = unknown
};
struct GuestPass {
    std::uint32_t width{}, height{};
    std::uint32_t guest_samples{1};
    std::uint32_t color_bytes_per_pixel{4};
    std::uint32_t depth_bytes_per_pixel{4};
    std::uint32_t render_target_count{1};
    bool uses_depth{true};
    bool multisample_guest_reads{}; // unsupported until proven safe
    bool storage_or_alias_attachments{}; // no valid shadow resolve path
};
// Native draw eligibility is independent of guest image memory. The
// graphics pipeline MUST have been built against the exact native shadow
// render pass and its rasterization sample count. Never bind the ordinary
// 1x guest pipeline to a 4x/8x/16x shadow framebuffer.
struct NativeDrawBinding {
    std::uint64_t shadow_renderpass{};
    std::uint64_t graphics_pipeline_renderpass{};
    std::uint32_t shadow_samples{};
    std::uint32_t graphics_pipeline_samples{};
    bool guest_clear_verified{};
    bool shader_read_aliases_target{};
};
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool CompatibleNativeDraw(
    const NativeDrawBinding& binding) noexcept {
    return binding.shadow_renderpass != 0 &&
           binding.graphics_pipeline_renderpass == binding.shadow_renderpass &&
           (binding.shadow_samples == 2 || binding.shadow_samples == 4 ||
            binding.shadow_samples == 8 || binding.shadow_samples == 16) &&
           binding.graphics_pipeline_samples == binding.shadow_samples &&
           binding.guest_clear_verified && !binding.shader_read_aliases_target;
}

struct Implementation {
    bool native_shadow_color{};
    bool native_shadow_depth{};
    bool resolve_color_to_guest{};
    bool resolve_depth_to_guest{};
    bool guest_layout_preserved{};
    bool sampled_guest_reads_coherent{};
};

struct Result {
    Decision decision;
    std::uint64_t estimated_attachment_bytes;
};
[[nodiscard]] constexpr Result Evaluate(Requested request,
                                         const GuestPass& guest,
                                         const Limits& hw,
                                         const Implementation& backend={}) noexcept {
    if (request==Requested::Auto) return {Decision::NativeAuto,0};
    const auto bit=Bit(request);
    if (!bit) return {Decision::UnsupportedRequest,0};
    if (guest.guest_samples!=1 && guest.guest_samples!=2 &&
        guest.guest_samples!=4 && guest.guest_samples!=8 &&
        guest.guest_samples!=16)
        return {Decision::GuestMultisampleTopologyConflict,0};
    // The guest already requested at least as many *real* samples.
    // Do not replace or downsample its rasterization state.
    if (guest.guest_samples >= static_cast<unsigned>(request))
        return {Decision::NativeGuestSamplesAlreadySatisfy,0};
    // Raising a multisampled guest render target further requires a
    // special multisample-to-multisample resolve path not yet available.
    if (guest.guest_samples!=1)
        return {Decision::GuestMultisampleTopologyConflict,0};
    if (!hw.vulkan) return {Decision::RequiresVulkan,0};
    if (!guest.width || !guest.height || guest.width>hw.max_framebuffer_width ||
        guest.height>hw.max_framebuffer_height ||
        guest.width>8192 || guest.height>8192 ||
        !guest.color_bytes_per_pixel || guest.color_bytes_per_pixel>16 ||
        guest.render_target_count==0 || guest.render_target_count>8)
        return {Decision::UnsupportedDimensions,0};
    if ((hw.framebuffer_color_sample_bits & bit)==0 ||
        (hw.color_format_sample_bits & bit)==0 ||
        (guest.uses_depth && (
            (hw.framebuffer_depth_sample_bits & bit)==0 ||
            (hw.depth_format_sample_bits & bit)==0)))
        return {Decision::UnsupportedFrameFormat,0};
    // Per-attachment allocation scales with sample count; conservative,
    // excludes tiling, alignment and backing single-sample guest surfaces.
    const auto bytes_per_pixel=static_cast<std::uint64_t>(
        guest.color_bytes_per_pixel)*guest.render_target_count +
        (guest.uses_depth ? guest.depth_bytes_per_pixel : 0U);
    const auto estimated=static_cast<std::uint64_t>(guest.width) * guest.height *
        bytes_per_pixel * static_cast<unsigned>(request);
    if (!hw.free_transient_bytes || estimated>hw.free_transient_bytes)
        return {Decision::UnsupportedBudget,estimated};
    if (guest.multisample_guest_reads || guest.storage_or_alias_attachments)
        return {Decision::UnsupportedMultisampleRead,estimated};
    if (!backend.native_shadow_color || !backend.resolve_color_to_guest ||
        !backend.guest_layout_preserved || !backend.sampled_guest_reads_coherent ||
        (guest.uses_depth &&
         (!backend.native_shadow_depth || !backend.resolve_depth_to_guest)))
        return {Decision::ShadowRendererNotImplemented,estimated};
    return {Decision::CandidateOnly,estimated};
}

} // namespace Eden::Graphics::MsaaForce
```

`extras/graphics/nr_display_capture_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// R09: accept only an actual, full-frame model-resolution sampled texture.
// The GPU texture cache may return a scaled view of a smaller guest image.
// Its view is already sampled in GENERAL by the existing Vulkan presenter.
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
namespace Eden::Graphics {
struct NRDisplayCapture {
    bool accelerated{},live_image{};
    std::uint32_t native_width{},native_height{};
    std::uint32_t sampled_width{},sampled_height{};
    float crop_left{},crop_top{},crop_right{},crop_bottom{};
    bool single_sample{true};
};
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool CanR09CaptureDisplay(
    NRDisplayCapture s) noexcept {
    constexpr std::uint32_t model_width=1920u,model_height=1080u;
    if(!s.live_image||!s.single_sample||
       !s.native_width||!s.native_height||
       s.native_width>16384u||s.native_height>16384u||
       s.sampled_width!=model_width||s.sampled_height!=model_height||
       s.crop_left!=0.0f||s.crop_top!=0.0f||
       s.crop_right!=1.0f||s.crop_bottom!=1.0f)return false;
    // Raw uploads always use the guest framebuffer's own extent.
    // Accelerated views may have been resolution-scaled to the exact
    // 1920x1080 physical image and need not have 1080p guest dimensions.
    if(!s.accelerated &&
       (s.native_width!=model_width||
        s.native_height!=model_height))return false;
    return true;
}
} // namespace Eden::Graphics
```

`extras/graphics/rdna2_nr_bottleneck_route_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Fail-closed native GPU bottleneck route: Split0 -> ViT8 -> decoder -> Split1.
// A decoded 152/76-step schedule alone is not executable inference.
#pragma once
#include "rdna2_nr_split_native_routes_policy.h"
#include "rdna2_nr_vit_native_route_policy.h"
namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2 {
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool CanLinkNativeNrBottleneckRoutes(
    const NativeSplitRoutes& split,
    const NativeVitRoute& vit) noexcept {
    if(split.run_count!=2u||split.count==0u||
       vit.count!=8u||vit.tokens==0u||
       !vit.raster_width||!vit.raster_height)return false;
    const auto& a=split.runs[0];
    const auto& b=split.runs[1];
    if(!a.count||!b.count||a.start+a.count>split.count||
       b.start+b.count>split.count||a.start!=0u||
       b.start!=a.start+a.count||b.start+b.count!=split.count)
        return false;
    const auto& before=split.blocks[a.start+a.count-1u];
    const auto& after=split.blocks[b.start];
    if(!before.plan.has_pooled_projection||
       before.block!=a.terminal_block||
       before.block!=vit.input_split_block||
       before.plan.final_head_tokens==0u||
       !after.block||
       after.source_block!=vit.decoder_block||
       b.entry_block!=vit.decoder_block||
       vit.decoder_block!=vit.blocks[7].block+1u||
       vit.blocks[0].input_block!=before.block||
       vit.raster_width!=before.raster_width||
       vit.raster_height!=before.raster_height||
       !split.blocks[b.start+b.count-1u].output_view)
        return false;
    for(std::uint32_t i=0u;i<8u;++i){
        if(vit.blocks[i].block!=vit.blocks[0].block+i||
           vit.blocks[i].tokens!=vit.tokens||
           vit.blocks[i].input_block!=(i==0u?before.block:
                                          vit.blocks[i-1u].block))
            return false;
    }
    return true;
}
} // namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2
```

`extras/graphics/rdna2_nr_decoder_projection_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// RDNA2 decoder learned 1024->512 GEMM + lossless FP32->FP16 tensor ABI.
// Preserve 4x4 tile token order; use only model-provided weights/skip gain.
#pragma once
#include "rdna2_nr_projection_policy.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>
namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2 {
[[nodiscard]] constexpr std::uint64_t DecoderTileTokens(
    std::uint32_t width,std::uint32_t height) noexcept {
    return ((std::uint64_t(width)+3u)/4u)*
           ((std::uint64_t(height)+3u)/4u)*16u;
}
struct DecoderFp32ToFp16 {
    // Each batch reads contiguous FP32 tokens but scatters FP16 output
    // into padded 4x4 spatial tiles. No raster/tile alias is permitted.
    std::uint32_t elements{},input_offset_floats{},output_offset_halfwords{};
    std::uint32_t width{},height{};
};
struct DecoderFp32ToFp16Storage {
    std::uint64_t input_bytes{},output_bytes{};
};
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool CanDecoderFp32ToFp16(
    const DecoderFp32ToFp16& p,
    const DecoderFp32ToFp16Storage& b) noexcept {
    constexpr std::uint64_t kChannels=512u;
    if(!p.elements||(p.elements%kChannels)||
       (p.input_offset_floats&1u)||
       (p.output_offset_halfwords%kChannels)||
       !p.width||!p.height||
       p.width>4096u||p.height>4096u)return false;
    const auto pixels=std::uint64_t(p.width)*p.height;
    const auto first=std::uint64_t(p.output_offset_halfwords)/kChannels;
    const auto count=std::uint64_t(p.elements)/kChannels;
    if(!count||pixels>4096u||first>=pixels||count>pixels-first)
        return false;
    const auto input_end=(std::uint64_t(p.input_offset_floats)+
                          p.elements)*4u;
    const auto output_end=DecoderTileTokens(p.width,p.height)*
                          kChannels*2u;
    constexpr std::uint64_t kLimit=256ull<<20;
    return input_end<=b.input_bytes&&output_end<=b.output_bytes&&
           input_end<=kLimit&&output_end<=kLimit&&
           (std::uint64_t(p.elements)+255u)/256u<=65535u;
}
struct DecoderProjectionCapacity {
    std::uint64_t linear_input{},weights{},fp32_scratch{},fp16_projected{};
};
struct DecoderProjectionBatch {
    Projection projection{};
    Storage storage{};
    DecoderFp32ToFp16 convert{};
    DecoderFp32ToFp16Storage conversion_storage{};
};
struct DecoderProjectionBatches {
    std::array<DecoderProjectionBatch,16> slices{};
    std::uint32_t count{},pixels{},tokens{};
    std::uint32_t width{},height{};
};
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool BuildDecoderProjectionBatches(
    std::uint32_t width,std::uint32_t height,
    const DecoderProjectionCapacity& buffers,
    DecoderProjectionBatches& output) noexcept {
    output={};
    if(!width||!height||width>4096u||height>4096u)return false;
    constexpr std::uint32_t channels=512u,inner=1024u;
    const auto pixels=std::uint64_t(width)*height;
    const auto tiled_tokens=DecoderTileTokens(width,height);
    if(pixels>4096u||tiled_tokens>4096u||
       buffers.linear_input<pixels*inner||
       buffers.weights<channels*inner||
       buffers.fp16_projected<tiled_tokens*channels*2u)
        return false;
    const auto per_batch=std::min<std::uint64_t>({
        std::uint64_t(1024u),pixels,
        buffers.fp32_scratch/(std::uint64_t(channels)*4u),
        kMaxProducts/(std::uint64_t(channels)*inner)});
    if(per_batch==0u||pixels>per_batch*16u)return false;
    DecoderProjectionBatches plan{};
    plan.width=width;
    plan.height=height;
    plan.pixels=static_cast<std::uint32_t>(pixels);
    plan.tokens=static_cast<std::uint32_t>(tiled_tokens);
    for(std::uint32_t done=0;done<pixels;){
        const std::uint32_t take=static_cast<std::uint32_t>(
            std::min(per_batch,pixels-done));
        DecoderProjectionBatch slice{
            .projection={take,channels,inner,inner,inner,
                         done*inner,0u},
            .storage={buffers.linear_input,buffers.weights,
                      buffers.fp32_scratch,buffers.fp32_scratch},
            .convert={take*channels,0u,done*channels,width,height},
            .conversion_storage={buffers.fp32_scratch,
                                 buffers.fp16_projected}};
        if(!CanDispatch(slice.projection,slice.storage)||
           !CanDecoderFp32ToFp16(slice.convert,slice.conversion_storage))
            return false;
        plan.slices[plan.count++]=slice;
        done+=take;
    }
    output=plan;
    return true;
}
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool ValidDecoderProjectionBatches(
    const DecoderProjectionBatches& plan) noexcept {
    if(!plan.count||plan.count>16u||
       plan.pixels!=std::uint64_t(plan.width)*plan.height||
       plan.tokens!=DecoderTileTokens(plan.width,plan.height))
        return false;
    std::uint64_t done=0u;
    for(std::uint32_t i=0;i<plan.count;++i){
        const auto& b=plan.slices[i];
        if(!b.projection.tokens||b.projection.tokens>1024u||
           b.projection.channels!=512u||b.projection.inner!=1024u||
           b.projection.lda_bytes!=1024u||
           b.projection.ldw_bytes!=1024u||
           b.projection.a_base_bytes!=done*1024u||
           b.projection.w_base_bytes!=0u||
           b.convert.elements!=b.projection.tokens*512u||
           b.convert.input_offset_floats!=0u||
           b.convert.output_offset_halfwords!=done*512u||
           b.convert.width!=plan.width||b.convert.height!=plan.height||
           !CanDispatch(b.projection,b.storage)||
           !CanDecoderFp32ToFp16(b.convert,b.conversion_storage))
            return false;
        done+=b.projection.tokens;
    }
    return done==plan.pixels;
}
} // namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2
```

`extras/graphics/rdna2_nr_decoder_tile_to_linear_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Native ViT C1024 E4M3FN tile-major -> raster-major input for RDNA2 GEMM.
// The ViT output's 4x4 token order is not compatible with row-major GEMM.
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2 {
struct DecoderTileToLinear {
    std::uint32_t width{},height{};
};
struct DecoderTileToLinearStorage {
    std::uint64_t tiled_bytes{},linear_bytes{};
};
[[nodiscard]] constexpr std::uint64_t DecoderTileCount(
    const DecoderTileToLinear& p) noexcept {
    return ((std::uint64_t(p.width)+3u)/4u)*
           ((std::uint64_t(p.height)+3u)/4u)*16u;
}
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool CanDecoderTileToLinear(
    const DecoderTileToLinear& p,
    const DecoderTileToLinearStorage& buffers) noexcept {
    if(!p.width||!p.height||p.width>4096u||p.height>4096u)
        return false;
    const auto pixels=std::uint64_t(p.width)*p.height;
    const auto padded=DecoderTileCount(p);
    constexpr std::uint64_t kBytes=256ull<<20;
    constexpr std::uint64_t kChannelBytes=1024u;
    const auto src=padded*kChannelBytes;
    const auto dst=pixels*kChannelBytes;
    return pixels<=4096u&&src<=kBytes&&dst<=kBytes&&
           src<=buffers.tiled_bytes&&dst<=buffers.linear_bytes&&
           (pixels*256u+127u)/128u<=65535u;
}
} // namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2
```

`extras/graphics/rdna2_nr_decoder_upsample_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// RDNA2 native neural decoder: 512-channel FP16->FP8 nearest + skip/gain.
// Native W/H are often 33x60 (partial 4x4 tiles), NOT 8-padded sizes.
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>
namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2 {
struct DecoderUpsample {
    std::uint32_t src_base_bytes, skip_base_bytes, dst_base_bytes, gain_base_bytes;
    std::uint32_t input_width, output_width, output_height;
};
struct DecoderStorage {
    // Source projection, previous Split skip, destination, learned gains
    // are four distinct GPU buffers (no aliasing or offset tricks).
    std::uint64_t projected_bytes, skip_bytes, output_bytes, gain_bytes;
};
[[nodiscard]] constexpr std::uint64_t DecoderOutputTileTokens(
    const DecoderUpsample& p) noexcept {
    return ((std::uint64_t(p.output_width)+3u)/4u)*
           ((std::uint64_t(p.output_height)+3u)/4u)*16u;
}
[[nodiscard]] constexpr std::uint64_t DecoderInputTileTokens(
    const DecoderUpsample& p) noexcept {
    // The decoder reads nearest x/2,y/2 in a 4x4 tile-major FP16 source.
    // The source row stride is input_width; only ceil(output_height/2)
    // source rows are sampled, irrespective of the higher-level plan.
    const auto sampled_height=(std::uint64_t(p.output_height)+1u)/2u;
    return ((std::uint64_t(p.input_width)+3u)/4u)*
           ((sampled_height+3u)/4u)*16u;
}
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool CanDecoderUpsample(
    const DecoderUpsample& p,const DecoderStorage& s) noexcept {
    if(!p.input_width||!p.output_width||!p.output_height||
       p.input_width>4096u||p.output_width>4096u||
       p.output_height>4096u)return false;
    // Older padded shapes can use a 2x wide output; the native
    // FinalHead/ViT plan at 1080p uses IW=OW=33 and OH=60.
    if(p.output_width!=p.input_width&&
       std::uint64_t(p.input_width)*2u!=p.output_width)return false;
    if((p.src_base_bytes|p.skip_base_bytes|
        p.dst_base_bytes|p.gain_base_bytes)&3u)return false;
    constexpr std::uint64_t kLimit=256ull<<20;
    constexpr std::uint64_t kChannels=512u;
    const auto source_tiles=DecoderInputTileTokens(p);
    const auto output_tiles=DecoderOutputTileTokens(p);
    if(!source_tiles||!output_tiles)return false;
    const auto src_bytes=source_tiles*kChannels*2u; // FP16
    const auto act_bytes=output_tiles*kChannels; // E4M3FN, incl. border
    const auto gain_bytes=kChannels*2u; // FP16
    if(src_bytes>kLimit||act_bytes>kLimit)return false;
    const auto src_end=std::uint64_t(p.src_base_bytes)+src_bytes;
    const auto skip_end=std::uint64_t(p.skip_base_bytes)+act_bytes;
    const auto dst_end=std::uint64_t(p.dst_base_bytes)+act_bytes;
    const auto gain_end=std::uint64_t(p.gain_base_bytes)+gain_bytes;
    if(src_end>s.projected_bytes||skip_end>s.skip_bytes||
       dst_end>s.output_bytes||gain_end>s.gain_bytes)return false;
    if(src_end>kLimit||skip_end>kLimit||dst_end>kLimit||
       gain_end>kLimit)return false;
    return (output_tiles+63u)/64u<=65535u;
}
} // namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2

```

`extras/graphics/rdna2_nr_ffwd3_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// RDNA2 grouped 3-projection FFWD: 8 groups, 64/256/64 hidden channels.
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>
namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2 {
struct FFWD3 {
    std::uint32_t x_base_bytes,w1_base_bytes,w2_base_bytes;
    std::uint32_t w3_base_bytes,out_base_bytes,tokens;
};
struct FFWD3Storage {
    std::uint64_t input_bytes,w1_bytes,w2_bytes,w3_bytes,output_bytes;
};
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool CanFFWD3(const FFWD3& p,const FFWD3Storage& s) {
    if(!p.tokens||p.tokens>65535u) return false;
    if((p.x_base_bytes|p.w1_base_bytes|p.w2_base_bytes|
        p.w3_base_bytes|p.out_base_bytes)&3u)return false;
    constexpr std::uint64_t kMaxBytes=256ull<<20;
    const auto bytes=std::uint64_t(p.tokens)*512u;
    constexpr std::uint64_t w1_bytes=8u*64u*512u;
    constexpr std::uint64_t w2_bytes=8u*256u*64u;
    constexpr std::uint64_t w3_bytes=8u*64u*256u;
    if(bytes>kMaxBytes) return false;
    const auto end_x=std::uint64_t(p.x_base_bytes)+bytes;
    const auto end_1=std::uint64_t(p.w1_base_bytes)+w1_bytes;
    const auto end_2=std::uint64_t(p.w2_base_bytes)+w2_bytes;
    const auto end_3=std::uint64_t(p.w3_base_bytes)+w3_bytes;
    const auto end_out=std::uint64_t(p.out_base_bytes)+bytes;
    constexpr auto max=std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max();
    if(end_x>max||end_1>max||end_2>max||end_3>max||end_out>max)return false;
    if(end_x>s.input_bytes||end_1>s.w1_bytes||end_2>s.w2_bytes||
       end_3>s.w3_bytes||end_out>s.output_bytes)return false;
    // All five bindings must refer to live nonaliasing storage ranges.
    return true;
}
} // namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2
```

`extras/graphics/rdna2_nr_float_quantize_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// GPU FP32 projection output -> packed E4M3FN features; Vulkan 1.1.
// Exactly four independently rounded FP32 source elements per uint word.
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2 {
struct FloatQuantize {
    std::uint32_t elements{};
    std::uint32_t input_offset_floats{};
    std::uint32_t output_offset_bytes{};
    std::uint32_t flags{}; // must be zero
};
struct FloatQuantizeStorage {
    std::uint64_t input_bytes{},output_bytes{};
};
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool CanFloatQuantize(
    const FloatQuantize& p,const FloatQuantizeStorage& s) noexcept {
    constexpr std::uint64_t kMaxStorage=256ull<<20;
    constexpr std::uint64_t kMaxGroups=65535u;
    constexpr std::uint64_t kInvocations=64u;
    constexpr std::uint64_t kElementsPerInvocation=4u;
    if(p.elements==0u||(p.elements&3u)!=0u||p.flags!=0u||
       (p.output_offset_bytes&3u)!=0u||s.input_bytes==0u||
       s.output_bytes==0u)return false;
    const std::uint64_t input_end=
        (std::uint64_t(p.input_offset_floats)+p.elements)*4u;
    const std::uint64_t output_end=
        std::uint64_t(p.output_offset_bytes)+p.elements;
    const std::uint64_t words=p.elements/kElementsPerInvocation;
    const std::uint64_t groups=(words+kInvocations-1u)/kInvocations;
    return groups>0u&&groups<=kMaxGroups&&
           input_end<=kMaxStorage&&output_end<=kMaxStorage&&
           input_end<=s.input_bytes&&output_end<=s.output_bytes;
}
[[nodiscard]] constexpr std::uint32_t FloatQuantizeGroups(
    const FloatQuantize& p) noexcept {
    return (p.elements/4u+63u)/64u;
}
} // namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2
```

`extras/graphics/rdna2_nr_fswin_chain_layout_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// RDNA2 FSwin multi-layer window-layout contract.
// Positions are in 4x4-token tiles relative to an 8x8-token window.
#pragma once
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <span>

namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2 {
struct FSwinWindowLayout {
    std::uint32_t windows_x{};
    std::uint32_t windows_y{};
    std::int32_t shift_x{};
    std::int32_t shift_y{};
};
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool FSwinNeedsWindowRepack(
    const FSwinWindowLayout& from,
    const FSwinWindowLayout& to) noexcept {
    return from.shift_x!=to.shift_x || from.shift_y!=to.shift_y;
}
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool CanFSwinChainWindowLayouts(
    std::span<const FSwinWindowLayout> layouts,
    std::uint32_t windows) noexcept {
    if(layouts.empty()||layouts.size()>160u||windows==0u||
       windows>65535u)return false;
    const auto first=layouts.front();
    const bool has_grid=first.windows_x!=0u||first.windows_y!=0u;
    if(has_grid &&
       (!first.windows_x||!first.windows_y||
        std::uint64_t(first.windows_x)*first.windows_y!=windows))
        return false;
    for(const auto& l:layouts) {
        if(l.shift_x<-1||l.shift_x>1||
           l.shift_y<-1||l.shift_y>1)return false;
        if(has_grid) {
            if(l.windows_x!=first.windows_x||
               l.windows_y!=first.windows_y)return false;
        }else if(l.windows_x||l.windows_y||l.shift_x||l.shift_y) {
            // Legacy chains without explicit grid are unshifted only.
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}
} // namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2
```

`extras/graphics/rdna2_nr_fswin_dense_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>
namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2 {
struct FSwinDense {
    std::uint32_t x_base_bytes,w_base_bytes,residual_base_bytes;
    std::uint32_t scale_base_floats,out_base_bytes,windows,channels,stage;
};
struct FSwinDenseStorage {
    std::uint64_t input_bytes,weight_bytes,residual_bytes,scales_bytes,output_bytes;
};
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool CanFSwinDense(
    const FSwinDense& p,const FSwinDenseStorage& s) noexcept {
    if(!p.windows||p.windows>65535u||p.stage>3u||
       (p.stage==1u&&p.channels==32u)||
       (p.channels!=32u&&p.channels!=64u&&
        p.channels!=128u&&p.channels!=256u))return false;
    if((p.x_base_bytes|p.w_base_bytes|
        p.residual_base_bytes|p.out_base_bytes)&3u)return false;
    const std::uint64_t C=p.channels;
    const std::uint64_t tokens=std::uint64_t(p.windows)*64u;
    const std::uint64_t xbytes=tokens*(
        p.stage==1u||(p.stage==2u&&C==32u)?4u*C:C);
    const std::uint64_t wbytes=p.stage==0u?4u*C*C:
        p.stage==1u?C*128u:
        (p.stage==2u&&C==32u)?4u*C*C:C*C;
    const std::uint64_t obytes=tokens*(p.stage==0u?4u*C:C);
    constexpr auto max=std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max();
    if(xbytes>(256ull<<20)||wbytes>(256ull<<20)||obytes>(256ull<<20))
        return false;
    const auto xe=std::uint64_t(p.x_base_bytes)+xbytes;
    const auto we=std::uint64_t(p.w_base_bytes)+wbytes;
    const auto oe=std::uint64_t(p.out_base_bytes)+obytes;
    if(xe>max||we>max||oe>max)return false;
    if(xe>s.input_bytes||we>s.weight_bytes||oe>s.output_bytes)return false;
    if(p.stage>=2u){
        const auto re=std::uint64_t(p.residual_base_bytes)+tokens*C;
        const auto se=std::uint64_t(p.scale_base_floats)+C;
        if(re>max||se>max||re>s.residual_bytes||
           se*4u>s.scales_bytes)return false;
    }
    return true;
}
[[nodiscard]] constexpr std::uint32_t FSwinDenseGridX(
    const FSwinDense& p) noexcept {
    return p.stage==0u?(p.channels+63u)/64u:1u;
}
} // namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2
```

`extras/graphics/rdna2_nr_fswin_downsample_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// RDNA2 scalar FSwin _ds epilogue contract: shifted 2x2 feature pooling,
// 2C x C learned matrix, half-size E4M3FN raster output.
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>
namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2 {
struct FSwinDownsample {
    std::uint32_t width,height,windows_x,windows_y,channels;
    std::int32_t shift_x,shift_y;
    std::uint32_t input_base_bytes,weight_base_bytes,output_base_bytes;
};
struct FSwinDownsampleStorage{
    std::uint64_t input_bytes,weight_bytes,output_bytes;
};
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool CanFSwinDownsample(
    const FSwinDownsample& p,const FSwinDownsampleStorage& s) noexcept {
    if(p.width<2u||p.height<2u||
       p.width>16384u||p.height>16384u||
       (p.channels!=32u&&p.channels!=64u&&
        p.channels!=128u&&p.channels!=256u)||
       p.shift_x<-1||p.shift_x>1||
       p.shift_y<-1||p.shift_y>1||
       (p.input_base_bytes|p.weight_base_bytes|p.output_base_bytes)&3u)
        return false;
    const auto wx=(std::uint64_t(p.width)+7u)/8u;
    const auto wy=(std::uint64_t(p.height)+7u)/8u;
    const auto W=wx*wy;
    if(W==0u||W>65535u||p.windows_x!=wx||p.windows_y!=wy)
        return false;
    const std::uint64_t C=p.channels;
    const auto input=W*64u*C;
    const auto weights=2u*C*C;
    const auto output=(std::uint64_t(p.width)/2u)*
        (std::uint64_t(p.height)/2u)*(2u*C);
    constexpr auto limit=256ull<<20;
    constexpr auto max=std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max();
    if(input>limit||weights>limit||output>limit)return false;
    const auto ie=std::uint64_t(p.input_base_bytes)+input;
    const auto we=std::uint64_t(p.weight_base_bytes)+weights;
    const auto oe=std::uint64_t(p.output_base_bytes)+output;
    return ie<=max&&we<=max&&oe<=max&&
           ie<=s.input_bytes&&we<=s.weight_bytes&&oe<=s.output_bytes;
}
[[nodiscard]] constexpr std::uint32_t FSwinDownsampleGridX(
    const FSwinDownsample& p) noexcept {return p.channels/8u;}
} // namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2
```

`extras/graphics/rdna2_nr_fswin_graph_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Host-validated six-pass RDNA2 FSwin forward path.
// Caller binds all descriptor ranges to the corresponding intermediate output.
#pragma once
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
#include "rdna2_nr_fswin_dense_policy.h"
#include "rdna2_nr_fswin_qkv_policy.h"
#include "rdna2_nr_window_attention_policy.h"
namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2 {
struct FSwinGraph {
    std::array<FSwinDense,4> dense{};
    std::array<FSwinDenseStorage,4> dense_storage{};
    FSwinQkv qkv{};
    FSwinQkvStorage qkv_storage{};
    WindowAttention attention{};
    AttentionStorage attention_storage{};
};
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool CanFSwinGraph(const FSwinGraph& p) noexcept {
    const auto C=p.dense[0].channels;
    const auto windows=p.dense[0].windows;
    if(!windows||!C)return false;
    for(std::uint32_t i=0;i<4u;++i){
        // C32 skips the middle group; its contraction consumes 4C.
        if(i==1u&&C==32u){
            if(p.dense[1].windows!=0u||p.dense[1].channels!=0u)
                return false;
            continue;
        }
        if(p.dense[i].stage!=i||p.dense[i].channels!=C||
           p.dense[i].windows!=windows||
           !CanFSwinDense(p.dense[i],p.dense_storage[i]))return false;
    }
    if(p.qkv.windows!=windows||p.qkv.channels!=C||
       p.qkv.heads!=C/32u||
       !CanFSwinQkv(p.qkv,p.qkv_storage))return false;
    if(p.attention.windows!=windows||
       p.attention.heads!=C/32u||
       !CanWindowAttention(p.attention,p.attention_storage))return false;
    // This proves shape, ABI ranges and sequence only.
    // The renderer still has to ensure actual descriptor identity:
    // C32: dense0.out -> dense2.in; C>=64: dense0.out -> dense1.in -> dense2.in;
    // dense2.out -> qkv.in;
    // qkv.{q,k,v} -> attention.{q,k,v};
    // attention.out -> dense3.in; dense2.out -> dense3.residual.
    return true;
}
} // namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2

```

`extras/graphics/rdna2_nr_fswin_level_link_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Checked GPU FSwin downsample -> next-resolution input-view edge.
#pragma once
#include "rdna2_nr_fswin_chain_layout_policy.h"
#include <cstdint>
namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2 {
struct FSwinLevelLink {
    std::uint32_t source_width{},source_height{};
    std::uint32_t source_channels{},destination_channels{};
    FSwinWindowLayout source_grid{};
    FSwinWindowLayout destination_grid{};
};
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool CanFSwinLevelLink(
    const FSwinLevelLink& p,std::uint64_t raster_capacity,
    std::uint64_t destination_input_capacity) noexcept {
    if(!p.source_width||!p.source_height||
       p.source_width>16384u||p.source_height>16384u||
       (p.source_channels!=32u&&p.source_channels!=64u&&
        p.source_channels!=128u)||
       p.destination_channels!=p.source_channels*2u)return false;
    const std::uint64_t W=p.source_width,H=p.source_height;
    const auto sx=(W+7u)/8u,sy=(H+7u)/8u;
    const auto tw=W/2u,th=H/2u;
    if(!tw||!th)return false;
    const auto tx=(tw+7u)/8u,ty=(th+7u)/8u;
    if(p.source_grid.windows_x!=sx||p.source_grid.windows_y!=sy||
       p.destination_grid.windows_x!=tx||
       p.destination_grid.windows_y!=ty||
       p.source_grid.shift_x<-1||p.source_grid.shift_x>1||
       p.source_grid.shift_y<-1||p.source_grid.shift_y>1||
       p.destination_grid.shift_x||p.destination_grid.shift_y)
        return false;
    if(sx*sy>65535u||tx*ty>65535u)return false;
    const auto C=std::uint64_t(p.source_channels);
    constexpr auto lim=256ull<<20;
    const auto source_bytes=sx*sy*64u*C;
    const auto raster_bytes=tw*th*2u*C;
    const auto destination_bytes=tx*ty*64u*2u*C;
    return source_bytes<=lim&&raster_bytes<=lim&&
           destination_bytes<=lim&&
           raster_bytes<=raster_capacity&&
           destination_bytes<=destination_input_capacity;
}
} // namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2
```

`extras/graphics/rdna2_nr_fswin_qkv_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// FSwin QKV 64-token projected FP8, supports 32/64/128/256 channels.
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>
namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2 {
struct FSwinQkv {
    std::uint32_t a_base_bytes,w_base_bytes,scale_base_floats;
    std::uint32_t q_base_bytes,k_base_bytes,v_base_bytes;
    std::uint32_t windows,channels,heads;
};
struct FSwinQkvStorage {
    std::uint64_t activation_bytes,weight_bytes,scale_bytes;
    std::uint64_t q_bytes,k_bytes,v_bytes;
};
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool CanFSwinQkv(
    const FSwinQkv& p,const FSwinQkvStorage& s) noexcept {
    if(!p.windows || p.windows>65535u ||
       (p.channels!=32u && p.channels!=64u &&
        p.channels!=128u && p.channels!=256u) ||
       p.heads!=p.channels/32u)return false;
    if((p.a_base_bytes|p.w_base_bytes|p.q_base_bytes|
        p.k_base_bytes|p.v_base_bytes)&3u)return false;
    constexpr auto max=std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max();
    const auto C=std::uint64_t(p.channels);
    const auto a=std::uint64_t(p.windows)*64u*C;
    const auto w=std::uint64_t(p.heads)*96u*C;
    const auto out=std::uint64_t(p.windows)*p.heads*64u*32u;
    if(a>(256ull<<20)||w>(256ull<<20)||out>(256ull<<20))return false;
    const auto ae=std::uint64_t(p.a_base_bytes)+a;
    const auto we=std::uint64_t(p.w_base_bytes)+w;
    const auto qe=std::uint64_t(p.q_base_bytes)+out;
    const auto ke=std::uint64_t(p.k_base_bytes)+out;
    const auto ve=std::uint64_t(p.v_base_bytes)+out;
    const auto se=std::uint64_t(p.scale_base_floats)+p.heads;
    if(ae>max||we>max||qe>max||ke>max||ve>max||se>max)return false;
    return ae<=s.activation_bytes&&we<=s.weight_bytes&&
        qe<=s.q_bytes&&ke<=s.k_bytes&&ve<=s.v_bytes&&
        se*4u<=s.scale_bytes;
    // Caller verifies distinct, nonaliasing descriptors and finite weights.
}
} // namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2
```

`extras/graphics/rdna2_nr_fswin_raster_layout_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// RDNA2 2D feature raster <-> 8x8 FSwin window transform ABI.
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2 {
struct FSwinRasterLayout {
    std::uint32_t width,height,windows_x,windows_y,channels,direction;
};
struct FSwinRasterLayoutStorage {
    std::uint64_t input_bytes,output_bytes;
};
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool CanFSwinRasterLayout(
    const FSwinRasterLayout& p,
    const FSwinRasterLayoutStorage& storage) noexcept {
    if(!p.width||!p.height||
       (p.channels!=32u&&p.channels!=64u&&
        p.channels!=128u&&p.channels!=256u&&
        p.channels!=512u)||
       p.direction>1u)return false;
    const auto wx=(std::uint64_t(p.width)+7u)/8u;
    const auto wy=(std::uint64_t(p.height)+7u)/8u;
    if(p.windows_x!=wx||p.windows_y!=wy||
       wx*wy>65535u)return false;
    const auto raster=std::uint64_t(p.width)*p.height*p.channels;
    const auto padded=wx*wy*64u*p.channels;
    constexpr std::uint64_t max=256ull<<20;
    if(raster>max||padded>max)return false;
    if(p.direction==0u)
        return raster<=storage.input_bytes&&
               padded<=storage.output_bytes;
    return padded<=storage.input_bytes&&
           raster<=storage.output_bytes;
}
[[nodiscard]] constexpr std::uint32_t FSwinRasterLayoutGridX(
    const FSwinRasterLayout& p) noexcept {
    return p.channels/4u;
}
} // namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2
```

`extras/graphics/rdna2_nr_fswin_upsample_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Portable FSwin _upsample: [H/2,W/2,2C] projection -> nearest 2x
// with [H,W,C] skip/gain -> [H,W,C] feature raster.
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>
namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2 {
struct FSwinUpsample {
    std::uint32_t width,height,windows_x,windows_y,channels;
    std::uint32_t low_base_bytes,skip_base_bytes,weight_base_bytes;
    std::uint32_t gain_base_floats,out_base_bytes;
};
struct FSwinUpsampleStorage {
    std::uint64_t low_bytes,skip_bytes,weight_bytes,gain_bytes,out_bytes;
};
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool CanFSwinUpsample(
    const FSwinUpsample& p,const FSwinUpsampleStorage& s) noexcept {
    if(!p.width||!p.height||p.width>16384u||p.height>16384u||
       (p.channels!=32u&&p.channels!=64u&&
        p.channels!=128u&&p.channels!=256u)||
       (p.low_base_bytes|p.skip_base_bytes|
        p.weight_base_bytes|p.out_base_bytes)&3u)return false;
    const auto wx=(std::uint64_t(p.width)+7u)/8u;
    const auto wy=(std::uint64_t(p.height)+7u)/8u;
    if(wx*wy>65535u||p.windows_x!=wx||p.windows_y!=wy)return false;
    const std::uint64_t C=p.channels;
    // Native U-Net downsample emits FLOOR(W/2) × FLOOR(H/2).
    // The final odd-edge pixel reuses the last valid low-res sample.
    const auto low=(std::uint64_t(p.width)/2u?p.width/2u:1u)*
        (std::uint64_t(p.height)/2u?p.height/2u:1u)*(2u*C);
    const auto high=std::uint64_t(p.width)*p.height*C;
    const auto weight=2u*C*C;
    const auto gain=C;
    constexpr std::uint64_t limit=256ull<<20;
    constexpr auto max=std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max();
    if(low>limit||high>limit||weight>limit)return false;
    const auto le=std::uint64_t(p.low_base_bytes)+low;
    const auto se=std::uint64_t(p.skip_base_bytes)+high;
    const auto we=std::uint64_t(p.weight_base_bytes)+weight;
    const auto ge=std::uint64_t(p.gain_base_floats)+gain;
    const auto oe=std::uint64_t(p.out_base_bytes)+high;
    return le<=max&&se<=max&&we<=max&&ge<=max&&oe<=max&&
           le<=s.low_bytes&&se<=s.skip_bytes&&we<=s.weight_bytes&&
           ge*4u<=s.gain_bytes&&oe<=s.out_bytes;
}
[[nodiscard]] constexpr std::uint32_t FSwinUpsampleGridX(
    const FSwinUpsample& p) noexcept {return p.channels/4u;}
} // namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2
```

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>
namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2 {
struct FSwinWindowRepack {
    std::uint32_t windows_x,windows_y,channels;
    std::int32_t src_shift_x,src_shift_y,dst_shift_x,dst_shift_y;
};
struct FSwinWindowRepackStorage {
    std::uint64_t input_bytes,output_bytes;
};
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool CanFSwinWindowRepack(
    const FSwinWindowRepack& p,const FSwinWindowRepackStorage& s) noexcept {
    const auto valid=[](std::int32_t v){return v>=-1&&v<=1;};
    if(!p.windows_x||!p.windows_y||
       std::uint64_t(p.windows_x)*p.windows_y>65535u||
       (p.channels!=32u&&p.channels!=64u&&
        p.channels!=128u&&p.channels!=256u&&
        p.channels!=512u)||
       !valid(p.src_shift_x)||!valid(p.src_shift_y)||
       !valid(p.dst_shift_x)||!valid(p.dst_shift_y))return false;
    const auto bytes=std::uint64_t(p.windows_x)*p.windows_y*64u*p.channels;
    constexpr auto max=std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max();
    return bytes<=max&&bytes<=(256ull<<20)&&
           bytes<=s.input_bytes&&bytes<=s.output_bytes;
}

    const FSwinWindowRepack& p) noexcept {
    return p.channels/4u;
```

`extras/graphics/rdna2_nr_hdr_proxy_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
#pragma once
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2 {
struct NRHDRProxyShape {
    std::uint32_t width{},height{};
    float paper_white{1.0f};
    std::uint32_t reserved{};
};
[[nodiscard]] inline bool CanNRHDRProxy(
    NRHDRProxyShape s,std::array<std::uint64_t,2> caps) noexcept {
    if(!s.width||!s.height||s.width>524280u||s.height>524280u||
       !std::isfinite(s.paper_white)||s.paper_white<0.05f||
       s.reserved)return false;
    const auto bytes=std::uint64_t(s.width)*s.height*16u;
    constexpr auto max=256ull*1024u*1024u;
    for(const auto cap:caps)if(cap<bytes||cap>max)return false;
    return true;
}
[[nodiscard]] inline float HDRProxyReference(float input,float paper_white) noexcept {
    const float v=(!std::isfinite(input)||input<0.0f)?
        0.0f:input/std::max(paper_white,0.05f);
    const float shoulder=v>0.75f?
        0.75f+0.25f*(1.0f-std::exp(-5.770780f*(v-0.75f))):v;
    const float x=std::clamp(shoulder,0.0f,1.0f);
    return std::clamp(x<=0.0031308f?12.92f*x:
        1.055f*std::pow(x,1.0f/2.4f)-0.055f,0.0f,1.0f);
}
}
```

`extras/graphics/rdna2_nr_image_feature_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Learned NRMODEL1 image-boundary feature matrices. Intentionally accepts
// prepared 16-channel FP16 data, NOT raw RGB/depth/motion/textures.
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2 {
struct ImageFeatureShape {
    std::uint32_t width{},height{},direction{};
};
struct ImageFeatureCapacity {
    std::uint64_t input_bytes{},weights_bytes{},output_bytes{};
};
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool CanImageFeatureStage(
    const ImageFeatureShape& p,
    const ImageFeatureCapacity& buffers) noexcept {
    if(!p.width||!p.height||p.width>8192u||p.height>8192u||
       p.direction>2u)return false;
    constexpr std::uint64_t kLimit=256ull<<20;
    const auto pixels=std::uint64_t(p.width)*p.height;
    const auto output_bytes=pixels*32u;
    // Stage 2 reads the pre-quantization FSwin result as FP16[32].
    // Stage 0/1 inputs are 32 bytes/pixel, stage 2 is 64 bytes/pixel.
    const auto input_bytes=pixels*(p.direction==2u?64u:32u);
    return input_bytes>0u&&input_bytes<=kLimit&&
           output_bytes<=kLimit&&
           buffers.input_bytes>=input_bytes&&
           buffers.output_bytes>=output_bytes&&
           buffers.weights_bytes>=1024u&&
           buffers.weights_bytes<=kLimit&&
           (std::uint64_t(p.width)+63u)/64u<=65535u&&
           p.height<=65535u;
}
} // namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2
```

`extras/graphics/rdna2_nr_nohistory_compose_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// R09 portable first-frame feature-head compositor contract and CPU oracle.
#pragma once
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2 {
struct NRNoHistoryComposeShape {
    std::uint32_t width{};
    std::uint32_t height{};
    float intensity{1.0f};
    std::uint32_t reserved{};
};
[[nodiscard]] inline bool CanNRNoHistoryCompose(
    NRNoHistoryComposeShape shape,
    std::array<std::uint64_t,3> capacities) noexcept {
    if(!shape.width||!shape.height||
       shape.width>524280u||shape.height>524280u||
       shape.reserved!=0u||!std::isfinite(shape.intensity)||
       shape.intensity<0.0f||shape.intensity>1.0f)return false;
    const auto pixels=std::uint64_t(shape.width)*shape.height;
    constexpr std::uint64_t max_bytes=256ull*1024u*1024u;
    const std::array<std::uint64_t,3> needed{
        pixels*16u,pixels*32u,pixels*16u};
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<needed.size();++i)
        if(!capacities[i]||capacities[i]<needed[i]||
           capacities[i]>max_bytes)return false;
    return true;
}
// Mirrors the head's first-frame RGB rule. Inputs are already normalized.
// The learned out_project's first THREE of 16 channels are the RGB residual.
[[nodiscard]] inline std::array<float,4> NRNoHistoryComposeReference(
    std::array<float,4> proxy,std::array<float,3> residual,
    float intensity) noexcept {
    std::array<float,4> output{};
    bool valid=true;
    for(float r:residual)valid=valid&&std::isfinite(r);
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<3u;++i){
        const float base=std::isfinite(proxy[i])?
            std::clamp(proxy[i],0.0f,1.0f):0.0f;
        const float neural=valid?
            std::clamp(base+residual[i]*0.25f,0.0f,1.0f):base;
        output[i]=std::clamp(base+(neural-base)*intensity,0.0f,1.0f);
    }
    output[3]=std::isfinite(proxy[3])?
        std::clamp(proxy[3],0.0f,1.0f):1.0f;
    return output;
}
} // namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2
```

`extras/graphics/rdna2_nr_noise_field_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Host-side validation for the RDNA2 neural noise-field pass.
// Output: 2 uint32 per padded pixel, containing 3 FP16 noise features and 0.
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>

namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2 {
struct NoiseField {
    std::uint32_t base_words, width, height, seed;
    float gain;
};
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool CanNoiseField(const NoiseField& p,
                                            std::uint64_t arena_bytes) {
    // Network working dimensions are padded to whole 8x8 blocks.
    if (!p.width || !p.height || p.width % 8u || p.height % 8u)
        return false;
    if (!(p.gain >= -64.f && p.gain <= 64.f)) return false; // reject NaN/Inf
    constexpr std::uint64_t kMaxOutputBytes = 256ull << 20;
    const std::uint64_t pixels = std::uint64_t(p.width)*p.height;
    const std::uint64_t words = pixels*2ull;
    if (words*4ull > kMaxOutputBytes) return false;
    const std::uint64_t end_words = std::uint64_t(p.base_words)+words;
    // Shader address arithmetic is 32-bit, prohibit offset wrap.
    if (end_words > std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max()) return false;
    if (end_words*4ull > arena_bytes) return false;
    return p.width/8u <= 65535u && p.height/8u <= 65535u;
}
} // namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2
```

`extras/graphics/rdna2_nr_postblock_mix_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Spatial 2x C32 skip fusion before postblock Swin, not RGB presentation.
#pragma once
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/nr_rdna2_native_plan_bridge.h"
#include <cstdint>
#include <span>
namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2 {
struct PostblockMixShape {std::uint32_t width{},height{};};
struct PostblockMixCapacity {
    std::uint64_t low_bytes{},skip_bytes{},gains_bytes{},output_bytes{};
};
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool CanPostblockMix(
    PostblockMixShape s,PostblockMixCapacity c) noexcept {
    if(!s.width||!s.height||(s.width&1u)||(s.height&1u)||
       s.width>8192u||s.height>8192u||c.gains_bytes!=128u)
        return false;
    const std::uint64_t full=std::uint64_t(s.width)*s.height*32u;
    constexpr std::uint64_t limit=256ull<<20;
    return full<=limit&&c.low_bytes>=full/4u&&
           c.low_bytes<=limit&&c.skip_bytes>=full&&
           c.skip_bytes<=limit&&c.output_bytes>=full&&
           c.output_bytes<=limit;
}
[[nodiscard]] inline bool CanNativePostblockMixBoundary(
    std::span<const NativePlanStep> steps,PostblockMixShape s) noexcept {
    if(steps.size()<3u)return false;
    const auto& pre=steps.front();
    const auto& previous=steps[steps.size()-2u];
    const auto& post=steps.back();
    if(pre.block!=0u||pre.layer!=0u||
       pre.type!="CCTinlayoutFusedPreBlockSwin1H"||
       pre.height!=s.width||pre.width!=s.height||
       post.type!="CCTinlayoutFusedPostBlockSwin1H"||
       post.kernel!="cc_tinlayout_fused_post_block_swin_1h_32_fp8"||
       (post.block!=70u&&post.block!=30u)||
       post.layer!=0u||post.div!=2u||
       std::uint64_t(post.width)*2u!=s.height||
       std::uint64_t(post.height)*2u!=s.width||
       post.inputs!=2u||post.input0<0||post.input1!=0||
       previous.block!=static_cast<std::uint32_t>(post.input0)||
       previous.channels!=32u||
       !previous.kernel.ends_with("_outview_fp8")||
       previous.width!=post.width||previous.height!=post.height||
       post.input_channels!=32u||post.output_channels!=3u||
       post.grid_z!=1u||
       post.grid_x!=(s.width+7u)/8u||
       post.grid_y!=(s.height+7u)/8u)return false;
    return CanPostblockMix(s,{
        std::uint64_t(post.width)*post.height*32u,
        std::uint64_t(s.width)*s.height*32u,128u,
        std::uint64_t(s.width)*s.height*32u});
}
} // namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2
```

`extras/graphics/rdna2_nr_preblock_boundary_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Model-native preblock -> half-resolution C32 contract.
// This only checks the recovered plan. It neither supplies texture guides
// nor claims that the fused, learned PreBlock Vulkan kernel is implemented.
#pragma once
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/nr_rdna2_unet_skip_map.h"
#include <cstdint>
#include <span>
namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2 {
[[nodiscard]] inline bool CanNativePreblockBoundary(
    std::span<const NativePlanStep> rows,
    const NativeUNetSkipMap& graph,
    std::uint64_t half_c32_bytes) noexcept {
    if(rows.size()<3u||graph.count!=4u)return false;
    const auto& pre=rows[0];
    const auto& first=rows[1];
    if(pre.block!=0u||pre.layer!=0u||
       pre.type!="CCTinlayoutFusedPreBlockSwin1H"||
       pre.kernel!="cc_tinlayout_fused_pre_block_swin_1h_32_1_ds_fp8"||
       pre.div!=1u||pre.channels!=3u||pre.heads!=0u||
       pre.input_channels!=3u||pre.output_channels!=32u||
       pre.inputs!=0u||pre.input0!=-1||pre.input1!=-1||
       pre.shifted||pre.shift_x!=0||pre.shift_y!=0||
       !pre.width||!pre.height||pre.width>8192u||pre.height>8192u||
       (pre.width&1u)||(pre.height&1u)||
       pre.grid_z!=1u||
       pre.grid_x!=(pre.height+7u)/8u||
       pre.grid_y!=(pre.width+7u)/8u||
       pre.tokens!=std::uint64_t(pre.width)*pre.height)
        return false;
    if(first.block!=1u||first.layer!=0u||first.div!=2u||
       first.type!="CCTinlayoutFusedSwin1H"||
       first.kernel!="cc_tinlayout_fused_swin_1h_32_1_inpview_fp8"||
       first.width!=pre.width/2u||first.height!=pre.height/2u||
       first.channels!=32u||first.heads!=1u||
       first.input_channels!=32u||first.output_channels!=32u||
       first.inputs!=1u||first.input0!=0||first.input1!=-1||
       first.grid_z!=1u||
       first.grid_x!=(first.height+7u)/8u||
       first.grid_y!=(first.width+7u)/8u||
       first.tokens!=std::uint64_t(first.grid_x)*first.grid_y*64u)
        return false;
    // Don't silently permit a second preblock or an unrelated C32 U-Net
    // skip entry to masquerade as this model's downscaled boundary.
    for(std::size_t i=2u;i<rows.size();++i)
        if(rows[i].type.starts_with("CCTinlayoutFusedPreBlock"))
            return false;
    const NativeUNetSkipEdge* c32=nullptr;
    for(const auto& edge:graph.edges)
        if(edge.channels==32u){
            if(c32)return false;
            c32=&edge;
        }
    if(!c32||c32->down_block<=first.block||
       c32->skip_width!=first.width||
       c32->skip_height!=first.height||
       c32->skip_windows_x!=first.grid_x||
       c32->skip_windows_y!=first.grid_y)
        return false;
    const auto needed=std::uint64_t(first.width)*first.height*32u;
    constexpr auto limit=256ull<<20;
    return needed<=limit&&half_c32_bytes>=needed&&half_c32_bytes<=limit;
}
} // namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2
```

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Exact 2x2 native preblock pooling boundary:
// full-res RAW FP16 C32 -> half-res E4M3FN C32.
// Input may NEVER be the already quantized preblock skip.
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2 {
struct PreblockPoolShape {std::uint32_t width{},height{};};

           v.half_fp8>=output&&v.half_fp8<=limit;
```

`extras/graphics/rdna2_nr_projection_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Eden Encore R09 — independent host safety contract for the RDNA2
// FP8→FP32 Vulkan GEMM building block, not a DLSS feature.
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>

namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2 {
struct Projection {
    std::uint32_t tokens, channels, inner;
    std::uint32_t lda_bytes, ldw_bytes;
    std::uint32_t a_base_bytes, w_base_bytes;
};
struct Storage {
    std::uint64_t activation_bytes, weight_bytes, output_bytes;
    std::uint64_t free_transient_bytes;
};
constexpr std::uint32_t kLocal = 16;
constexpr std::uint64_t kMaxTemp = 256ull << 20;
constexpr std::uint64_t kMaxProducts = 8ull * 1024ull * 1024ull * 1024ull;

[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool CanDispatch(const Projection& p, const Storage& s) {
    if (!p.tokens || !p.channels || !p.inner || !p.lda_bytes || !p.ldw_bytes) return false;
    // Canonical 1x1 projections are far below this bound. Without it,
    // (K+15) in the uint32 shader dispatch can overflow.
    if (p.inner > 8192u) return false;
    if (p.lda_bytes < p.inner || p.ldw_bytes < p.inner) return false;
    // Plain Vulkan 1.1 tiled 16x16, no cooperative matrices or FP8 extension.
    const auto t = std::uint64_t(p.tokens), n = std::uint64_t(p.channels);
    const auto k = std::uint64_t(p.inner);
    if (t * n > kMaxProducts / k) return false;
    const auto a_end = std::uint64_t(p.a_base_bytes) + (t - 1) * p.lda_bytes + k;
    const auto w_end = std::uint64_t(p.w_base_bytes) + (n - 1) * p.ldw_bytes + k;
    // Shader byte addressing is 32-bit; refuse arithmetic wrap, even if
    // an oversize host allocation nominally covers the memory.
    if (a_end > std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max() ||
        w_end > std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max()) return false;
    // Every source is uint32 packed. The caller must allocate enough
    // storage for the last partial word accessed by the shader.
    const auto a_rounded = (a_end + 3ull) & ~3ull;
    const auto w_rounded = (w_end + 3ull) & ~3ull;
    if (a_rounded > s.activation_bytes || w_rounded > s.weight_bytes) return false;
    const std::uint64_t output_size = t * n * sizeof(float);
    if (output_size > s.output_bytes || output_size > s.free_transient_bytes ||
        output_size > kMaxTemp) return false;
    // GPU dispatch limits are renderer-owned. No dispatch issued here.
    return (n + kLocal - 1u) / kLocal <= 65535u &&
           (t + kLocal - 1u) / kLocal <= 65535u;
}
} // namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2

```

`extras/graphics/rdna2_nr_projection_quantized_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Prepare the complete GPU FP8 GEMM -> FP32 transient -> E4M3FN edge.
// The caller must bind matching, independent STORAGE buffer descriptors.
#pragma once
#include "rdna2_nr_projection_policy.h"
#include "rdna2_nr_float_quantize_policy.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>
namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2 {
struct QuantizedProjectionPlan {
    FloatQuantize quant{};
    std::uint64_t fp32_bytes{};
    std::uint64_t fp8_bytes{};
};
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool PrepareQuantizedProjection(
    const Projection& gemm,const Storage& storage,
    std::uint64_t quantized_output_bytes,
    QuantizedProjectionPlan& result,
    std::uint32_t output_offset_bytes=0u) noexcept {
    result={};
    const auto elements=std::uint64_t(gemm.tokens)*gemm.channels;
    if(!gemm.tokens||!gemm.channels||
       elements>std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max()||
       (elements&3u)!=0u||!CanDispatch(gemm,storage))return false;
    QuantizedProjectionPlan prepared{
        .quant={static_cast<std::uint32_t>(elements),0u,output_offset_bytes,0u},
        .fp32_bytes=elements*4u,
        .fp8_bytes=elements,
    };
    if(!CanFloatQuantize(
        prepared.quant,{storage.output_bytes,quantized_output_bytes}))
        return false;
    result=prepared;
    return true;
}
// Wide ViT FFN 2560x4096x1024 exceeds the single GEMM product budget.
// Split by TOKENS, not by channels: existing weight/activation ABI, one
// reused FP32 transient, packed FP8 output at disjoint byte offsets.
struct QuantizedProjectionBatch {
    Projection gemm{};
    QuantizedProjectionPlan prepared{};
};
struct QuantizedProjectionBatches {
    std::array<QuantizedProjectionBatch,16> batches{};
    std::uint32_t count{};
    std::uint32_t total_tokens{};
};
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool BuildQuantizedProjectionBatches(
    const Projection& full,const Storage& shared,
    std::uint64_t quantized_output_bytes,std::uint32_t max_tokens_per_batch,
    QuantizedProjectionBatches& result) noexcept {
    result={};
    if(!full.tokens||!full.channels||!full.inner||
       !max_tokens_per_batch||max_tokens_per_batch>65535u)return false;
    if(std::uint64_t(full.tokens)*full.channels>quantized_output_bytes||
       std::uint64_t(full.tokens)*full.channels>std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max())
        return false;
    QuantizedProjectionBatches staged{};
    std::uint32_t done=0u;
    while(done<full.tokens){
        if(staged.count>=staged.batches.size())return false;
        const std::uint32_t take=std::min(max_tokens_per_batch,full.tokens-done);
        const auto input_base=std::uint64_t(full.a_base_bytes)+
            std::uint64_t(done)*full.lda_bytes;
        const auto output_base=std::uint64_t(done)*full.channels;
        if(input_base>std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max()||
           output_base>std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max())return false;
        Projection part=full;
        part.tokens=take;
        part.a_base_bytes=static_cast<std::uint32_t>(input_base);
        QuantizedProjectionPlan prepared{};
        if(!PrepareQuantizedProjection(part,shared,quantized_output_bytes,
            prepared,static_cast<std::uint32_t>(output_base)))return false;
        staged.batches[staged.count++]={part,prepared};
        done+=take;
    }
    staged.total_tokens=done;
    result=staged;
    return true;
}
} // namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2

```

`extras/graphics/rdna2_nr_proxy_feature_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// No-history, display-referred RGBA32F proxy -> learned preblock FP16[16].
// MIT 16-lane reference: maanHimself/OpenDLSS-NR (310.8 Original only).
// This is a standalone tensor builder, NOT an HDR/readback/presenter hook.
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2 {
struct NeuralProxyFeatures {
    std::uint32_t full_width{},full_height{},valid_width{},valid_height{};
    std::uint32_t source_width{},source_height{},seed{};
    float auto_mask{},local_tone{},local_structure{},skin_structure{},style{};
};
struct NeuralProxyStorage {
    std::uint64_t proxy_bytes{},feature_bytes{};
};
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool CanNeuralProxyFeatures(
    const NeuralProxyFeatures& p,const NeuralProxyStorage& buffers) noexcept {
    if(!p.full_width||!p.full_height||
       p.full_width>8192u||p.full_height>8192u||
       !p.valid_width||!p.valid_height||
       p.valid_width>p.full_width||p.valid_height>p.full_height||
       p.full_width>2u*p.valid_width-1u||
       p.full_height>2u*p.valid_height-1u||
       !p.source_width||!p.source_height||
       p.source_width>8192u||p.source_height>8192u)
        return false;
    // All conditional lanes must be finite and within bounded UI-range.
    // Comparisons reject NaN without depending on C++23 constexpr isfinite.
    if(!(p.auto_mask>=0.0f&&p.auto_mask<=1.0f)||
       !(p.local_tone>=-2.0f&&p.local_tone<=2.0f)||
       !(p.local_structure>=-2.0f&&p.local_structure<=2.0f)||
       !(p.skin_structure>=-2.0f&&p.skin_structure<=2.0f)||
       !(p.style>=0.0f&&p.style<=128.0f))return false;
    const auto source=std::uint64_t(p.source_width)*p.source_height*16u;
    const auto output=std::uint64_t(p.full_width)*p.full_height*32u;
    constexpr auto budget=256ull<<20;
    return source<=budget&&output<=budget&&
           buffers.proxy_bytes>=source&&
           buffers.feature_bytes>=output&&
           (p.full_width+7u)/8u<=65535u&&
           (p.full_height+7u)/8u<=65535u;
}
} // namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2
```

`extras/graphics/rdna2_nr_qkv_projection_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// RDNA2 QKV 512->(3*32*heads) projection: strict row-major buffer ABI.
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>
namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2 {
struct QkvProjection {
    std::uint32_t a_base_bytes,w_base_bytes,scale_base_floats;
    std::uint32_t q_base_bytes,k_base_bytes,v_base_bytes;
    std::uint32_t windows,heads;
};
struct QkvStorage {
    std::uint64_t activation_bytes,weight_bytes,scale_bytes;
    std::uint64_t q_bytes,k_bytes,v_bytes;
};
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool CanQkvProjection(
    const QkvProjection& p,const QkvStorage& s){
    if(!p.windows || p.windows>65535u ||
        (p.heads!=1u && p.heads!=2u && p.heads!=4u &&
         p.heads!=8u && p.heads!=16u))return false;
    if((p.a_base_bytes|p.w_base_bytes|p.q_base_bytes|
        p.k_base_bytes|p.v_base_bytes)&3u)return false;
    constexpr std::uint64_t kMaxBytes=256ull<<20;
    const auto a=std::uint64_t(p.windows)*64u*512u;
    const auto w=std::uint64_t(p.heads)*96u*512u;
    const auto o=std::uint64_t(p.windows)*p.heads*64u*32u;
    if(a>kMaxBytes||w>kMaxBytes||o>kMaxBytes)return false;
    const auto ae=std::uint64_t(p.a_base_bytes)+a;
    const auto we=std::uint64_t(p.w_base_bytes)+w;
    const auto qe=std::uint64_t(p.q_base_bytes)+o;
    const auto ke=std::uint64_t(p.k_base_bytes)+o;
    const auto ve=std::uint64_t(p.v_base_bytes)+o;
    const auto se=std::uint64_t(p.scale_base_floats)+p.heads;
    if(ae>std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max()||
       we>std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max()||
       qe>std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max()||
       ke>std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max()||
       ve>std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max()||
       se>std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max())return false;
    if(ae>s.activation_bytes||we>s.weight_bytes||
       qe>s.q_bytes||ke>s.k_bytes||ve>s.v_bytes||
       se*4u>s.scale_bytes)return false;
    // Caller must verify distinct nonaliasing descriptor ranges, finite
    // scales and finite/valid E4M3FN model tensors before recording.
    return true;
}
} // namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2
```
