`extras/graphics/rdna2_nr_split_block_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Preflight native Split-Swin16H, optionally ProjPool + FinalHead.
// FFWD3 -> FFWDProj(residual from input) -> QKV/attention ->
// transpose head->token -> Proj(residual from FFWDProj).
// ProjPool's second output and FinalHead are explicit, never skipped.
#pragma once
#include "rdna2_nr_ffwd3_policy.h"
#include "rdna2_nr_projection_policy.h"
#include "rdna2_nr_projection_quantized_policy.h"
#include "rdna2_nr_vit_epilogue_policy.h"
#include "rdna2_nr_split_context_repack_policy.h"
#include "rdna2_nr_fswin_window_repack_policy.h"
#include "rdna2_nr_split_projection_pool_policy.h"
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/nr_rdna2_split_window_link_policy.h"
#include <cstdint>
namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2 {
struct SplitBlockPlan {
    std::uint32_t windows{};
    bool has_pooled_projection{};
    std::uint32_t pool_width{},pool_height{};
    std::uint32_t pool_windows_x{},pool_windows_y{};
    std::uint32_t pool_output_tokens{};
    std::uint32_t final_head_tokens{}; // optional 512->1024 projection
    // Native QKV 4x4-tile shift in a 2x2-tile window grid.
    std::uint32_t window_grid_x{},window_grid_y{};
    std::int32_t attention_shift_x{},attention_shift_y{};
};
struct SplitBlockCapacity {
    std::uint64_t input{},ffwd{},ffwd_projected{},context_heads{};
    std::uint64_t context_tokens{},projected{};
    std::uint64_t query{},key{},value{},fp32_scratch{};
    std::uint64_t pooled{};
    std::uint64_t final_fp32{},final_fp8{};
    std::uint64_t shifted_input{},unshifted_context{};
};
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool CanSplitBlock(
    const SplitBlockPlan& p,const SplitBlockCapacity& c) noexcept {
    if(!p.windows||p.windows>1023u||
       p.attention_shift_x<-1||p.attention_shift_x>1||
       p.attention_shift_y<-1||p.attention_shift_y>1)
        return false;
    const bool needs_shift=
        p.attention_shift_x!=0||p.attention_shift_y!=0;
    if((p.window_grid_x||p.window_grid_y||needs_shift)&&
       (!p.window_grid_x||!p.window_grid_y||
        std::uint64_t(p.window_grid_x)*p.window_grid_y!=p.windows))
        return false;
    if(needs_shift){
        const FSwinWindowRepack forward{
            p.window_grid_x,p.window_grid_y,512u,0,0,
            p.attention_shift_x,p.attention_shift_y};
        const FSwinWindowRepack reverse{
            p.window_grid_x,p.window_grid_y,512u,
            p.attention_shift_x,p.attention_shift_y,0,0};
        if(!CanFSwinWindowRepack(forward,{
              c.ffwd_projected,c.shifted_input})||
           !CanFSwinWindowRepack(reverse,{
              c.context_tokens,c.unshifted_context}))
            return false;
    }
    if(p.has_pooled_projection){
        if(!p.pool_windows_x||!p.pool_windows_y||
           std::uint64_t(p.pool_windows_x)*p.pool_windows_y!=p.windows)
            return false;
        const SplitProjectionPool secondary{
            p.pool_width,p.pool_height,p.pool_windows_x,p.pool_windows_y,
            0u,0u,0u,0u,p.pool_output_tokens};
        // The same GEMM scratch + learned skip gain must produce the
        // secondary half-res output, including padded zero tail.
        if(!CanSplitProjectionPool(secondary,{
              c.fp32_scratch,c.ffwd_projected,1024u,c.pooled}))
            return false;
    }
    if(p.final_head_tokens){
        if(!p.has_pooled_projection||
           p.final_head_tokens>SplitPoolOutputTokens({
               p.pool_width,p.pool_height,p.pool_windows_x,p.pool_windows_y,
               0u,0u,0u,0u,p.pool_output_tokens}))return false;
        const Projection final{p.final_head_tokens,1024u,512u,
                               512u,512u,0u,0u};
        const Storage final_storage{
            c.pooled,1024u*512u,c.final_fp32,c.final_fp32};
        QuantizedProjectionPlan final_plan{};
        if(!PrepareQuantizedProjection(
              final,final_storage,c.final_fp8,final_plan))return false;
    }
    const std::uint32_t tokens=p.windows*64u;
    const auto rowbytes=std::uint64_t(tokens)*512u;
    const FFWD3 ffwd{0u,0u,0u,0u,0u,tokens};
    const FFWD3Storage ffwd_storage{
        c.input,262144u,131072u,131072u,c.ffwd};
    if(!CanFFWD3(ffwd,ffwd_storage))return false;
    const Projection proj{tokens,512u,512u,512u,512u,0u,0u};
    const Storage fwd_storage{
        c.ffwd,512u*512u,c.fp32_scratch,c.fp32_scratch};
    if(!CanDispatch(proj,fwd_storage))return false;
    const VitResidual residual{tokens,512u,0u,0u,0u,0u};
    if(!CanVitResidual(residual,{
        c.fp32_scratch,c.input,1024u,c.ffwd_projected}))return false;
    const SplitWindowLink window{
        {0u,0u,0u,0u,0u,0u,p.windows,16u},
        {0u,0u,0u,0u,0u,p.windows,16u}};
    const SplitWindowLinkStorage storage{
        {needs_shift?c.shifted_input:c.ffwd_projected,
         786432u,64u,c.query,c.key,c.value},
        {c.query,c.key,c.value,c.context_heads,262144u}};
    if(!CanSplitWindowLink(window,storage))return false;
    const SplitContextRepack repack{p.windows,16u,0u,0u};
    if(!CanSplitContextRepack(repack,{
        c.context_heads,c.context_tokens}))return false;
    const Storage proj_storage{
        needs_shift?c.unshifted_context:c.context_tokens,
        512u*512u,
        c.fp32_scratch,c.fp32_scratch};
    if(!CanDispatch(proj,proj_storage))return false;
    if(!CanVitResidual(residual,{
        c.fp32_scratch,c.ffwd_projected,1024u,c.projected}))
        return false;
    // All intermediate windows must have a complete, contiguous row-major
    // tensor. The GPU buffer identity and nonaliasing checks are in Vulkan.
    return c.input>=rowbytes&&c.ffwd>=rowbytes&&
           c.ffwd_projected>=rowbytes&&c.context_heads>=rowbytes&&
           c.context_tokens>=rowbytes&&c.projected>=rowbytes&&
           (!needs_shift||(c.shifted_input>=rowbytes&&
                            c.unshifted_context>=rowbytes));
}
} // namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2
```

`extras/graphics/rdna2_nr_split_context_repack_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// WindowAttention output [window][head][token][dim32] must be transposed
// to the following GEMM's [window][token][head][dim32] FP8 row-major.
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>
namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2 {
struct SplitContextRepack {
    std::uint32_t windows{},heads{},input_base_bytes{},output_base_bytes{};
};
struct SplitContextRepackStorage {
    std::uint64_t source_bytes{},target_bytes{};
};
[[nodiscard]] constexpr std::uint32_t SplitContextRepackGridX(
    const SplitContextRepack& p) noexcept {
    return static_cast<std::uint32_t>(
        (std::uint64_t(p.windows)*p.heads*64u*8u+255u)/256u);
}
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool CanSplitContextRepack(
    const SplitContextRepack& p,
    const SplitContextRepackStorage& s) noexcept {
    if(!p.windows||p.windows>1024u||p.heads!=16u||
       ((p.input_base_bytes|p.output_base_bytes)&3u)!=0u)return false;
    const auto bytes=std::uint64_t(p.windows)*p.heads*64u*32u;
    const auto src=std::uint64_t(p.input_base_bytes)+bytes;
    const auto dst=std::uint64_t(p.output_base_bytes)+bytes;
    constexpr auto max=std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max();
    return src<=max&&dst<=max&&
           src<=s.source_bytes&&dst<=s.target_bytes&&
           src<=(256ull<<20)&&dst<=(256ull<<20)&&
           SplitContextRepackGridX(p)<=65535u;
}
} // namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2
```

`extras/graphics/rdna2_nr_split_decoder_skip_repack_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Convert the Split-Swin16H primary ProjPool residual (padded window-major
// FP8[512]) to the real decoder's 4x4-tile / 16x16-channel packed skip.
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>
namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2 {
struct SplitDecoderSkipRepack {
    std::uint32_t width{},height{},windows_x{},windows_y{},channels{};
};
struct SplitDecoderSkipStorage {
    std::uint64_t source_bytes{},destination_bytes{};
};
[[nodiscard]] constexpr std::uint64_t SplitSkipInputTokens(
    const SplitDecoderSkipRepack& p) noexcept {
    return std::uint64_t(p.windows_x)*p.windows_y*64u;
}
[[nodiscard]] constexpr std::uint64_t SplitSkipOutputTokens(
    const SplitDecoderSkipRepack& p) noexcept {
    return ((std::uint64_t(p.width)+3u)/4u)*
           ((std::uint64_t(p.height)+3u)/4u)*16u;
}
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool CanSplitDecoderSkipRepack(
    const SplitDecoderSkipRepack& p,
    const SplitDecoderSkipStorage& buffers) noexcept {
    if(!p.width||!p.height||
       p.width>4096u||p.height>4096u||
       p.channels!=512u||
       p.windows_x!=(std::uint64_t(p.width)+7u)/8u||
       p.windows_y!=(std::uint64_t(p.height)+7u)/8u||
       !p.windows_x||!p.windows_y||
       std::uint64_t(p.windows_x)*p.windows_y>1023u)
        return false;
    const auto source=SplitSkipInputTokens(p)*p.channels;
    const auto destination=SplitSkipOutputTokens(p)*p.channels;
    constexpr std::uint64_t kLimit=256ull<<20;
    return source<=kLimit&&destination<=kLimit&&
           source<=buffers.source_bytes&&
           destination<=buffers.destination_bytes&&
           SplitSkipOutputTokens(p)<=65535u;
}
} // namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2
```

`extras/graphics/rdna2_nr_split_native_routes_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Derive native Split-Swin16H block plans from BOTH real model schedules.
// No per-game routing, no guessed manual shifts or silently dropped pool.
#pragma once
#include "rdna2_nr_split_block_policy.h"
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/nr_rdna2_native_graph_schedule.h"
#include <array>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <span>
namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2 {
enum class SplitNativeRoutesError : std::uint8_t {
    Ok, InvalidSchedule, NoSplit, TooMany, InvalidLayers,
    InvalidShape, InvalidShift, BadPredecessor, BadBoundary
};
struct NativeSplitBlockRoute {
    SplitBlockPlan plan{};
    std::uint32_t block{},first_row{},layer_count{},source_block{};
    std::uint32_t native_compute_tokens{}; // 4x4 tile domain, not padded windows
    bool input_view{},output_view{};
    // Real XY feature raster orientation, upstream gemmpool p.W=s.H.
    std::uint32_t raster_width{},raster_height{};
};
struct NativeSplitRun {
    std::uint32_t start{},count{},entry_block{},terminal_block{};
};
struct NativeSplitRoutes {
    std::array<NativeSplitBlockRoute,32> blocks{};
    std::array<NativeSplitRun,2> runs{};
    std::uint32_t count{},run_count{};
};
[[nodiscard]] inline SplitNativeRoutesError BuildNativeSplitRoutes(
    std::span<const NativePlanStep> rows,NativeSplitRoutes& out) {
    out={};
    NativeNrSchedule schedule;
    if(BuildNativeNrSchedule(rows,schedule)!=NativeNrGraphError::Ok)
        return SplitNativeRoutesError::InvalidSchedule;
    NativeSplitRoutes built{};
    for(std::uint32_t i=0u;i<rows.size();++i){
        const auto op=schedule.instructions[i].operation;
        if(!IsNativeNrSplitOp(op))continue;
        if(op!=NativeNrOp::SplitFfwd)
            return SplitNativeRoutesError::InvalidLayers;
        if(built.count>=built.blocks.size())
            return SplitNativeRoutesError::TooMany;
        const auto& first=rows[i];
        if(first.layer!=0u||first.input0<0)
            return SplitNativeRoutesError::InvalidLayers;
        const std::uint32_t block=first.block;
        if(i+3u>=rows.size())return SplitNativeRoutesError::InvalidLayers;
        constexpr std::array<NativeNrOp,3> kRequired{
            NativeNrOp::SplitFfwdProjection,NativeNrOp::SplitQkvAttention,
            NativeNrOp::SplitProjection};
        const auto& ffproj=rows[i+1u];
        const auto& qkv=rows[i+2u];
        const auto& last=rows[i+3u];
        if(schedule.instructions[i+1u].operation!=kRequired[0]||
           schedule.instructions[i+2u].operation!=kRequired[1]||
           (schedule.instructions[i+3u].operation!=kRequired[2]&&
            schedule.instructions[i+3u].operation!=NativeNrOp::SplitProjectionPool))
            return SplitNativeRoutesError::InvalidLayers;
        const bool pooled=
            schedule.instructions[i+3u].operation==NativeNrOp::SplitProjectionPool;
        const std::uint32_t layer_count=pooled?5u:4u;
        if(i+layer_count>rows.size())return SplitNativeRoutesError::InvalidLayers;
        for(std::uint32_t layer=1u;layer<layer_count;++layer){
            const auto& s=rows[i+layer];
            if(s.block!=block||s.layer!=layer||
               s.width!=first.width||s.height!=first.height||
               s.tokens!=first.tokens||s.input0!=static_cast<std::int32_t>(block))
                return SplitNativeRoutesError::InvalidLayers;
        }
        if(pooled&&schedule.instructions[i+4u].operation!=
                      NativeNrOp::SplitFinalHead)
            return SplitNativeRoutesError::InvalidLayers;
        if(!pooled&&i+4u<rows.size()&&
           rows[i+4u].block==block)
            return SplitNativeRoutesError::InvalidLayers;
        const std::uint32_t wx=(first.height+7u)/8u;
        const std::uint32_t wy=(first.width+7u)/8u;
        const std::uint64_t total=std::uint64_t(wx)*wy;
        const std::uint64_t compute=
            std::uint64_t((first.width+3u)/4u)*
            ((first.height+3u)/4u)*16u;
        if(!total||total>1023u||compute>65535u||
           std::uint64_t(first.tokens)!=total*64u||
           qkv.grid_x!=wx||qkv.grid_y!=wy||
           qkv.grid_z!=4u||first.channels!=512u||
           ffproj.channels!=512u||last.channels!=512u)
            return SplitNativeRoutesError::InvalidShape;
        // Never accept missing optional native shift fields (sentinel 100).
        if(qkv.shift_x<-1||qkv.shift_x>1||
           qkv.shift_y<-1||qkv.shift_y>1||
           ((qkv.shift_x!=0||qkv.shift_y!=0)!=qkv.shifted))
            return SplitNativeRoutesError::InvalidShift;
        SplitBlockPlan p{};
        p.windows=static_cast<std::uint32_t>(total);
        p.window_grid_x=wx;
        p.window_grid_y=wy;
        p.attention_shift_x=qkv.shift_x;
        p.attention_shift_y=qkv.shift_y;
        p.has_pooled_projection=pooled;
        if(pooled){
            p.pool_width=first.height; // upstream gemmpool p.W=s.H
            p.pool_height=first.width; // and p.rows=s.W
            p.pool_windows_x=wx;
            p.pool_windows_y=wy;
            // Upstream GEMM domain is 4x4 tiles; the side buffer MUST
            // include zero-filled tail up to the FinalHead read extent.
            p.pool_output_tokens=static_cast<std::uint32_t>(compute);
            p.final_head_tokens=static_cast<std::uint32_t>(compute);
        }
        const bool input_view=first.kernel.find("_inpview_")!=
                              std::string::npos;
        const bool output_view=last.kernel.find("_outview_")!=
                               std::string::npos;
        if(output_view&&pooled)return SplitNativeRoutesError::BadBoundary;
        if(built.count==0u||
           first.input0!=static_cast<std::int32_t>(
                              built.blocks[built.count-1u].block)){
            if(built.run_count>=built.runs.size())
                return SplitNativeRoutesError::BadBoundary;
            built.runs[built.run_count++]={
                built.count,0u,static_cast<std::uint32_t>(first.input0),block};
        } else if(built.runs[built.run_count-1u].terminal_block!=
                  built.blocks[built.count-1u].block) {
            return SplitNativeRoutesError::BadPredecessor;
        }
        auto& run=built.runs[built.run_count-1u];
        ++run.count;
        run.terminal_block=block;
        built.blocks[built.count++]={
            p,block,i,layer_count,static_cast<std::uint32_t>(first.input0),
            static_cast<std::uint32_t>(compute),input_view,output_view,
            first.height,first.width};
        i+=layer_count-1u;
    }
    if(!built.count||built.run_count!=2u)
        return built.count?SplitNativeRoutesError::BadBoundary:
                           SplitNativeRoutesError::NoSplit;
    // Native 152 and 76 models each cross FSwin->Split, Split->ViT
    // and ViT->Split->FSwin exactly once; their block IDs differ.
    const auto& r0=built.runs[0];
    const auto& r1=built.runs[1];
    if(!built.blocks[r0.start].input_view||
       !built.blocks[r0.start+r0.count-1u].plan.has_pooled_projection||
       !built.blocks[r1.start+r1.count-1u].output_view||
       built.blocks[r0.start+r0.count-1u].output_view||
       built.blocks[r1.start].input_view)
        return SplitNativeRoutesError::BadBoundary;
    std::uint32_t pools=0u,finals=0u,ins=0u,outs=0u;
    for(std::uint32_t k=0u;k<built.count;++k){
        pools+=built.blocks[k].plan.has_pooled_projection;
        finals+=built.blocks[k].plan.final_head_tokens!=0u;
        ins+=built.blocks[k].input_view;
        outs+=built.blocks[k].output_view;
    }
    if(pools!=1u||finals!=1u||ins!=1u||outs!=1u)
        return SplitNativeRoutesError::BadBoundary;
    out=built;
    return SplitNativeRoutesError::Ok;
}
} // namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2
```

`extras/graphics/rdna2_nr_split_projection_pool_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Split-Swin ProjPool: pool FP16 residual-projection values BEFORE FP8.
// Source [window8x8][quadrant4x4][slot][512]; destination half-res
// raster in 4x4 tile order, including zeroed padding and optional tail.
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>
namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2 {
struct SplitProjectionPool {
    std::uint32_t width{},height{},windows_x{},windows_y{};
    std::uint32_t scratch_base_floats{},residual_base_bytes{};
    std::uint32_t gain_base_halfwords{},pool_base_bytes{},output_tokens{};
};
struct SplitProjectionPoolStorage {
    std::uint64_t scratch_bytes{},residual_bytes{},gain_bytes{},pool_bytes{};
};
[[nodiscard]] constexpr std::uint64_t SplitPoolAlign4(
    std::uint64_t n) noexcept {return (n+3u)&~std::uint64_t(3u);}
[[nodiscard]] constexpr std::uint32_t SplitPoolWidth(
    const SplitProjectionPool& p) noexcept {
    return static_cast<std::uint32_t>(SplitPoolAlign4(
        (std::uint64_t(p.width)+1u)/2u));
}
[[nodiscard]] constexpr std::uint32_t SplitPoolHeight(
    const SplitProjectionPool& p) noexcept {
    return static_cast<std::uint32_t>(SplitPoolAlign4(
        (std::uint64_t(p.height)+1u)/2u));
}
[[nodiscard]] constexpr std::uint32_t SplitPoolLiveTokens(
    const SplitProjectionPool& p) noexcept {
    return SplitPoolWidth(p)*SplitPoolHeight(p);
}
[[nodiscard]] constexpr std::uint32_t SplitPoolOutputTokens(
    const SplitProjectionPool& p) noexcept {
    return p.output_tokens?p.output_tokens:SplitPoolLiveTokens(p);
}
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool CanSplitProjectionPool(
    const SplitProjectionPool& p,
    const SplitProjectionPoolStorage& s) noexcept {
    if(!p.width||!p.height||!p.windows_x||!p.windows_y||
       p.windows_x>1023u||p.windows_y>1023u||
       (std::uint64_t(p.width)+7u)/8u!=p.windows_x||
       (std::uint64_t(p.height)+7u)/8u!=p.windows_y||
       (p.residual_base_bytes|p.pool_base_bytes)&3u)return false;
    const std::uint64_t windows=
        std::uint64_t(p.windows_x)*p.windows_y;
    if(!windows||windows>1023u)return false;
    const std::uint64_t in_bytes=windows*64u*512u;
    const std::uint64_t pool_tokens=
        std::uint64_t(SplitPoolWidth(p))*SplitPoolHeight(p);
    const std::uint64_t out_tokens=SplitPoolOutputTokens(p);
    if(!pool_tokens||pool_tokens>65535u||
       out_tokens<pool_tokens||out_tokens>65535u)return false;
    const std::uint64_t src_end=
        (std::uint64_t(p.scratch_base_floats)+in_bytes)*4u;
    const std::uint64_t resid_end=
        std::uint64_t(p.residual_base_bytes)+in_bytes;
    const std::uint64_t gain_end=
        ((std::uint64_t(p.gain_base_halfwords)+513u)/2u)*4u;
    const std::uint64_t out_end=
        std::uint64_t(p.pool_base_bytes)+out_tokens*512u;
    constexpr std::uint64_t limit=256ull<<20;
    constexpr auto u32=std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max();
    return src_end<=u32&&resid_end<=u32&&gain_end<=u32&&
           out_end<=u32&&src_end<=limit&&resid_end<=limit&&
           gain_end<=limit&&out_end<=limit&&
           src_end<=s.scratch_bytes&&
           resid_end<=s.residual_bytes&&
           gain_end<=s.gain_bytes&&
           out_end<=s.pool_bytes;
}
} // namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2
```

`extras/graphics/rdna2_nr_temporal_compose_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Full native-raster temporal compositor resource/shape boundary.
// Motion is current -> previous in UV units with an independent valid flag.
// No synthesized history or guessed neural blend coefficient is permitted.
#pragma once
#include <array>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2 {
struct NRTemporalComposeShape {
    std::uint32_t width{},height{};
    float intensity{},blend_scale{};
    std::uint32_t history_valid{},reserved0{},reserved1{},reserved2{};
};
[[nodiscard]] inline bool CanNRTemporalCompose(
    NRTemporalComposeShape s,
    std::array<std::uint64_t,6> buffers) noexcept {
    if(!s.width||!s.height||s.width>16384u||s.height>16384u||
       !std::isfinite(s.intensity)||s.intensity<0.0f||s.intensity>1.0f||
       !std::isfinite(s.blend_scale)||s.blend_scale<0.0f||
       s.blend_scale>1.0f||s.history_valid>1u||
       s.reserved0||s.reserved1||s.reserved2)return false;
    const auto n=std::uint64_t(s.width)*s.height;
    const std::array<std::uint64_t,6> required{
        n*16u,n*32u,n*16u,n*16u,n*16u,n*16u};
    for(std::size_t i=0u;i<6u;++i)
        if(buffers[i]<required[i]||buffers[i]>(256ull<<20))
            return false;
    return true;
}
} // namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2
```

`extras/graphics/rdna2_nr_token_repack_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>

namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2 {
struct TokenRepack {
    std::uint32_t src_base_bytes, dst_base_bytes;
    std::uint32_t width, height, channels;
    std::uint32_t inverse;
};
constexpr std::uint64_t kMaxTokenRepack = 256ull << 20;
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool CanRepack(const TokenRepack& p, std::uint64_t arena_bytes) {
    if (!p.width || !p.height || !p.channels || p.inverse > 1) return false;
    if (p.width % 4u || p.height % 4u || p.channels % 16u) return false;
    if ((p.src_base_bytes & 15u) || (p.dst_base_bytes & 15u)) return false;
    const auto w=std::uint64_t(p.width), h=std::uint64_t(p.height);
    const auto c=std::uint64_t(p.channels);
    const auto tokens=w*h;
    const auto copy=tokens*c;
    if (copy > kMaxTokenRepack || !copy) return false;
    const auto src_end=std::uint64_t(p.src_base_bytes)+copy;
    const auto dst_end=std::uint64_t(p.dst_base_bytes)+copy;
    if (src_end>arena_bytes || dst_end>arena_bytes) return false;
    if (src_end>std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max() ||
        dst_end>std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max()) return false;
    // Both regions share one VkBuffer; no read/write overlap across invocations.
    if (p.src_base_bytes < dst_end && p.dst_base_bytes < src_end) return false;
    const auto invocations=tokens*(c/16u);
    return (invocations+63u)/64u <= 65535u;
}
} // namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2
```

`extras/graphics/rdna2_nr_unet_bottleneck_link_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// R09: native C512 down -> Split/ViT bottleneck -> C512 up boundary.
// This checks model geometry/graph order/capacities, NOT GPU execution.
#pragma once
#include "rdna2_nr_bottleneck_route_policy.h"
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/nr_rdna2_unet_skip_map.h"
#include <cstdint>
namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2 {
[[nodiscard]] inline bool CanNativeUNetBottleneckLink(
    const NativeUNetSkipMap& graph,
    const NativeSplitRoutes& split,
    const NativeVitRoute& vit,
    std::uint64_t down_c512_bytes,
    std::uint64_t split_input_bytes,
    std::uint64_t split_output_bytes) noexcept {
    if(graph.count!=4u||!CanLinkNativeNrBottleneckRoutes(split,vit))
        return false;
    const NativeUNetSkipEdge* last_down=nullptr;
    std::uint32_t found=0u;
    for(const auto& edge:graph.edges){
        const auto c=edge.channels;
        const auto index=c==32u?0u:c==64u?1u:c==128u?2u:
                         c==256u?3u:4u;
        if(index==4u||(found&(1u<<index)))return false;
        found|=(1u<<index);
        if(index==3u)last_down=&edge;
    }
    if(found!=15u||!last_down)return false;
    const auto& entry=split.runs[0];
    const auto& exit=split.runs[1];
    const auto& first=split.blocks[entry.start];
    const auto& final=split.blocks[exit.start+exit.count-1u];
    const std::uint32_t width=last_down->skip_height/2u;
    const std::uint32_t height=last_down->skip_width/2u;
    if(!width||!height||entry.entry_block!=last_down->down_block||
       exit.terminal_block!=last_down->up_input_block||
       !first.input_view||!final.output_view||
       first.raster_width!=width||first.raster_height!=height||
       final.raster_width!=width||final.raster_height!=height||
       last_down->up_input_width!=height||
       last_down->up_input_height!=width||
       vit.raster_width!=width||vit.raster_height!=height)
        return false;
    const auto needed=std::uint64_t(width)*height*512u;
    constexpr auto kLimit=256ull<<20;
    return needed<=kLimit&&needed<=down_c512_bytes&&
           needed<=split_input_bytes&&needed<=split_output_bytes&&
           down_c512_bytes<=kLimit&&split_input_bytes<=kLimit&&
           split_output_bytes<=kLimit;
}
} // namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2
```

`extras/graphics/rdna2_nr_unet_down_sequence_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// R09 native four-depth U-Net descent: C32,C64,C128,C256 -> C512.
// Only validates raster shapes, level ordering and buffer capacities.
// It does not claim the preblock, bottleneck or post-image is integrated.
#pragma once
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/nr_rdna2_unet_skip_map.h"
#include "rdna2_nr_fswin_level_link_policy.h"
#include "rdna2_nr_fswin_downsample_policy.h"
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2 {
[[nodiscard]] inline bool CanNativeUNetDownSequence(
    const NativeUNetSkipMap& map,
    const std::array<FSwinWindowLayout,4>& input_windows,
    const std::array<FSwinWindowLayout,4>& output_windows,
    std::uint64_t first_raster_capacity,
    const std::array<std::uint64_t,4>& down_raster_capacity) noexcept {
    if(map.count!=4u)return false;
    std::array<const NativeUNetSkipEdge*,4> edges{};
    for(const auto& edge:map.edges){
        std::size_t index=4u;
        switch(edge.channels){
        case 32u:index=0u;break;
        case 64u:index=1u;break;
        case 128u:index=2u;break;
        case 256u:index=3u;break;
        default:return false;
        }
        if(edges[index]||edge.down_block>=edge.up_block)return false;
        edges[index]=&edge;
    }
    for(std::size_t i=0u;i<4u;++i){
        if(!edges[i])return false;
        const auto& e=*edges[i];
        const std::uint64_t w=e.skip_height,h=e.skip_width;
        const auto channels=32u<<i;
        if(w<2u||h<2u||w>16384u||h>16384u||
           (i&&edges[i-1u]->down_block>=e.down_block)||
           e.skip_windows_x!=(w+7u)/8u||
           e.skip_windows_y!=(h+7u)/8u||
           input_windows[i].windows_x!=e.skip_windows_x||
           input_windows[i].windows_y!=e.skip_windows_y||
           input_windows[i].shift_x||input_windows[i].shift_y||
           output_windows[i].windows_x!=e.skip_windows_x||
           output_windows[i].windows_y!=e.skip_windows_y||
           output_windows[i].shift_x<-1||
           output_windows[i].shift_x>1||
           output_windows[i].shift_y<-1||
           output_windows[i].shift_y>1)return false;
        if(i==0u&&w*h*32u>first_raster_capacity)return false;
        if(i<3u){
            const auto next_capacity=
                std::uint64_t(input_windows[i+1u].windows_x)*
                input_windows[i+1u].windows_y*64u*(channels*2u);
            if(!CanFSwinLevelLink(
                   {static_cast<std::uint32_t>(w),
                    static_cast<std::uint32_t>(h),channels,channels*2u,
                    output_windows[i],input_windows[i+1u]},
                   down_raster_capacity[i],next_capacity))
                return false;
        }else{
            const FSwinDownsample last{
                static_cast<std::uint32_t>(w),
                static_cast<std::uint32_t>(h),
                e.skip_windows_x,e.skip_windows_y,channels,
                output_windows[i].shift_x,output_windows[i].shift_y,
                0u,0u,0u};
            const FSwinDownsampleStorage capacities{
                std::uint64_t(e.skip_windows_x)*e.skip_windows_y*
                    64u*channels,
                256ull<<20,down_raster_capacity[i]};
            if(!CanFSwinDownsample(last,capacities))return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}
} // namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2
```

`extras/graphics/rdna2_nr_unet_up_sequence_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// R09: checked four-edge U-Net ascent from C512 into C32 raster.
// Validates the Original/Compact native skip geometry, not GPU parity.
#pragma once
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/nr_rdna2_unet_skip_map.h"
#include "rdna2_nr_fswin_chain_layout_policy.h"
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2 {
[[nodiscard]] inline bool CanNativeUNetUpSequence(
    const NativeUNetSkipMap& graph,
    const std::array<FSwinWindowLayout,4>& inputs,
    const std::array<FSwinWindowLayout,4>& outputs,
    std::uint64_t initial_c512_bytes,
    const std::array<std::uint64_t,4>& raster_bytes) noexcept {
    if(graph.count!=4u)return false;
    std::array<const NativeUNetSkipEdge*,4> edges{};
    for(const auto& e:graph.edges){
        std::size_t i=4u;
        switch(e.channels){
        case 256u:i=0u;break;
        case 128u:i=1u;break;
        case 64u:i=2u;break;
        case 32u:i=3u;break;
        default:return false;
        }
        if(edges[i]||e.down_block>=e.up_block||
           e.up_input_block>=e.up_block)return false;
        edges[i]=&e;
    }
    constexpr auto limit=256ull<<20;
    for(std::size_t i=0u;i<4u;++i){
        if(!edges[i])return false;
        const auto& e=*edges[i];
        const std::uint64_t w=e.skip_height,h=e.skip_width;
        const auto C=256u>>i;
        if(w<2u||h<2u||w>16384u||h>16384u||
           e.skip_windows_x!=(w+7u)/8u||
           e.skip_windows_y!=(h+7u)/8u||
           e.up_input_width!=e.skip_width/2u||
           e.up_input_height!=e.skip_height/2u||
           (i&&(e.up_block<=edges[i-1u]->up_block||
                 e.up_input_block<=edges[i-1u]->up_block)))
            return false;
        const auto a=inputs[i],b=outputs[i];
        if(a.windows_x!=e.skip_windows_x||
           a.windows_y!=e.skip_windows_y||
           b.windows_x!=e.skip_windows_x||
           b.windows_y!=e.skip_windows_y||
           a.shift_x<-1||a.shift_x>1||
           a.shift_y<-1||a.shift_y>1||
           b.shift_x<-1||b.shift_x>1||
           b.shift_y<-1||b.shift_y>1)return false;
        // The 2C low raster is the prior full-resolution C raster.
        const auto needed_low=(w/2u)*(h/2u)*(C*2u);
        const auto present_low=i?raster_bytes[i-1u]:initial_c512_bytes;
        const auto needed_high=w*h*C;
        if(needed_low>limit||needed_high>limit||
           needed_low>present_low||needed_high>raster_bytes[i])
            return false;
    }
    return true;
}
} // namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2

```

`extras/graphics/rdna2_nr_upsample_view_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Validated arena access contract for the RDNA2 upsample-view permutation.
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>

namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2 {
struct UpsampleView {
    std::uint32_t src_base_bytes,dst_base_bytes,tokens,channels;
    std::uint32_t width,height,resized_width,resized_height;
};
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool CanUpsampleView(const UpsampleView& p,
                                              std::uint64_t arena_bytes) {
    if (!p.width || !p.height || !p.resized_width || !p.resized_height ||
        !p.channels || !p.tokens) return false;
    if (p.width%4u || p.height%4u ||
        p.resized_width%4u || p.resized_height%4u ||
        p.channels%16u) return false;
    if ((p.src_base_bytes&15u) || (p.dst_base_bytes&15u)) return false;
    // Protect the workgroup->token coordinate mapping. In the generic
    // upstream kernel tokens may be a subrange; this first port supports
    // a complete padded view only, keeping all source/dest bounds provable.
    const auto r=std::uint64_t(p.resized_width)*p.resized_height;
    if (p.tokens!=r || p.resized_width<p.width || p.resized_height<p.height)
        return false;
    const auto src=std::uint64_t(p.width)*p.height*p.channels;
    const auto dst=r*p.channels;
    constexpr std::uint64_t kMaxBytes=256ull<<20;
    if (src>kMaxBytes || dst>kMaxBytes) return false;
    const auto se=std::uint64_t(p.src_base_bytes)+src;
    const auto de=std::uint64_t(p.dst_base_bytes)+dst;
    if (se>arena_bytes || de>arena_bytes) return false;
    if (se>std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max() ||
        de>std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max()) return false;
    if (p.src_base_bytes<de && p.dst_base_bytes<se) return false;
    const auto invocations=r*(p.channels/16u);
    return (invocations+63u)/64u<=65535u;
}
} // namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2
```

`extras/graphics/rdna2_nr_vit_attention_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// RDNA2 scalar 32-head ViT attention on E4M3FN row-major Q/K/V tensors.
// The native 1920x1080 model uses 2560 tokens; its real size must pass.
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>
namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2 {
struct VitAttention {
    std::uint32_t q_base_bytes,k_base_bytes,v_base_bytes;
    std::uint32_t out_base_bytes,tokens;
};
struct VitAttentionStorage {
    std::uint64_t q_bytes,k_bytes,v_bytes,out_bytes;
};
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool CanVitAttention(
    const VitAttention& p,const VitAttentionStorage& s){
    if(!p.tokens || p.tokens>4096u)return false;
    if((p.q_base_bytes|p.k_base_bytes|
        p.v_base_bytes|p.out_base_bytes)&3u)return false;
    const auto extent=std::uint64_t(p.tokens)*32u*32u;
    constexpr auto max=std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max();
    const auto q=std::uint64_t(p.q_base_bytes)+extent;
    const auto k=std::uint64_t(p.k_base_bytes)+extent;
    const auto v=std::uint64_t(p.v_base_bytes)+extent;
    const auto o=std::uint64_t(p.out_base_bytes)+extent;
    if(q>max||k>max||v>max||o>max)return false;
    if(q>s.q_bytes||k>s.k_bytes||v>s.v_bytes||o>s.out_bytes)return false;
    // Caller verifies all four buffers are live, distinct/nonaliasing;
    // Q/K must already be normalized/scaled and all values finite.
    return true;
}
} // namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2
```

`extras/graphics/rdna2_nr_vit_epilogue_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Shared portable Vulkan FP32->E4M3FN activation and half residual policies.
// Width 512 supports Split-Swin residual projections, 1024/4096 ViT.
// No opaque model state, output buffers must be caller-owned/nonaliasing.
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>
namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2 {
struct VitActivation {
    std::uint32_t tokens{},channels{},input_offset_floats{},output_offset_bytes{};
};
struct VitResidual {
    std::uint32_t tokens{},channels{},input_offset_floats{};
    std::uint32_t output_offset_bytes{},residual_offset_bytes{};
    std::uint32_t gain_offset_halfwords{};
};
struct VitEpilogueStorage {
    std::uint64_t source_bytes{},residual_bytes{},gain_bytes{},output_bytes{};
};
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool VitValidExtent(
    std::uint32_t tokens,std::uint32_t channels) noexcept {
    return tokens>0u&&tokens<=4096u&&
       (channels==512u||channels==1024u||channels==4096u);
}
[[nodiscard]] constexpr std::uint32_t VitEpilogueGroups(
    std::uint32_t tokens,std::uint32_t channels) noexcept {
    return static_cast<std::uint32_t>(
        (std::uint64_t(tokens)*channels+511u)/512u);
}
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool CanVitActivation(
    const VitActivation& p,const VitEpilogueStorage& s) noexcept {
    if(!VitValidExtent(p.tokens,p.channels)||
       (p.output_offset_bytes&3u)!=0u)return false;
    const std::uint64_t n=std::uint64_t(p.tokens)*p.channels;
    const std::uint64_t source_end=
        (std::uint64_t(p.input_offset_floats)+n)*4u;
    const std::uint64_t output_end=
        std::uint64_t(p.output_offset_bytes)+n;
    constexpr std::uint64_t max=256ull<<20;
    if(source_end>max||output_end>max||
       source_end>std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max()||
       output_end>std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max())
        return false;
    return source_end<=s.source_bytes&&output_end<=s.output_bytes&&
           VitEpilogueGroups(p.tokens,p.channels)<=65535u;
}
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool CanVitResidual(
    const VitResidual& p,const VitEpilogueStorage& s) noexcept {
    if(!VitValidExtent(p.tokens,p.channels)||
       ((p.output_offset_bytes|p.residual_offset_bytes)&3u)!=0u)
        return false;
    const std::uint64_t n=std::uint64_t(p.tokens)*p.channels;
    const std::uint64_t source_end=
        (std::uint64_t(p.input_offset_floats)+n)*4u;
    const std::uint64_t residual_end=
        std::uint64_t(p.residual_offset_bytes)+n;
    const std::uint64_t output_end=
        std::uint64_t(p.output_offset_bytes)+n;
    const std::uint64_t gain_halfwords=
        std::uint64_t(p.gain_offset_halfwords)+p.channels;
    const std::uint64_t gains_end=((gain_halfwords+1u)/2u)*4u;
    constexpr std::uint64_t max=256ull<<20;
    constexpr auto u32=std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max();
    if(source_end>max||residual_end>max||output_end>max||
       gains_end>max||source_end>u32||residual_end>u32||
       output_end>u32||gain_halfwords>u32)return false;
    return source_end<=s.source_bytes&&
           residual_end<=s.residual_bytes&&
           gains_end<=s.gain_bytes&&
           output_end<=s.output_bytes&&
           VitEpilogueGroups(p.tokens,p.channels)<=65535u;
}
} // namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2
```

`extras/graphics/rdna2_nr_vit_gpu_tensors_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// VMA-owned GPU scratch for the ViT QKV/attention subgraph.
// Input activation arrives from the preceding graph on the GPU.
#pragma once
#include "rdna2_nr_vit_qkv_batches_policy.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2 {
struct VitQkvTensorLayout {
    // FP32 scratch, Q, K, V and attention context.
    std::array<std::uint64_t,5> sizes{};
    std::uint32_t batch_tokens{};
    std::uint64_t total_bytes{};
};
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool BuildVitQkvTensorLayout(
    std::uint32_t tokens,std::uint64_t max_storage_range,
    VitQkvTensorLayout& result) noexcept {
    result={};
    if(!tokens||tokens>4096u||!max_storage_range)return false;
    constexpr std::uint64_t kMaxPerBuffer=256ull<<20;
    constexpr std::uint64_t kMaxCombined=512ull<<20;
    const std::uint64_t output_bytes=std::uint64_t(tokens)*1024u;
    constexpr std::uint64_t kFp32PerToken=3072u*4u;
    const std::uint64_t slice_tokens=std::min({
        std::uint64_t(tokens),std::uint64_t(2048u),
        max_storage_range/kFp32PerToken,
        kMaxPerBuffer/kFp32PerToken});
    if(!slice_tokens||std::uint64_t(tokens)>slice_tokens*16u||
       output_bytes>max_storage_range||output_bytes>kMaxPerBuffer)
        return false;
    VitQkvTensorLayout staged{};
    staged.sizes={slice_tokens*kFp32PerToken,
                  output_bytes,output_bytes,output_bytes,output_bytes};
    for(auto bytes:staged.sizes){
        if(!bytes||bytes>max_storage_range||bytes>kMaxPerBuffer||
           staged.total_bytes>kMaxCombined-bytes)return false;
        staged.total_bytes+=bytes;
    }
    staged.batch_tokens=static_cast<std::uint32_t>(slice_tokens);
    // The scalar GEMM can have a tighter product budget than the scratch
    // budget: validate the actual downstream plan as a final preflight.
    const VitQkvBuffersCapacity capacity{
        output_bytes,3072ull*1024u,staged.sizes[0],128u,
        output_bytes,output_bytes,output_bytes,output_bytes};
    VitQkvBatches batches{};
    if(!BuildVitQkvBatches(tokens,capacity,batches))return false;
    result=staged;
    return true;
}
} // namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2
```

`extras/graphics/rdna2_nr_vit_native_route_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// ViT graph routing from the complete native 152/76-row MIT model plans.
// Exactly eight blocks with five real operations each, no silent skips.
#pragma once
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/nr_rdna2_native_graph_schedule.h"
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
#include <span>
namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2 {
enum class NativeVitRouteError:std::uint8_t {
    Ok,MissingVit,InvalidOrder,InvalidShape,InvalidSource,
    MissingInput,MissingDecoder,Incomplete
};
struct NativeVitBlockRoute {
    std::uint32_t block{},first_row{},tokens{},input_block{};
};
struct NativeVitRoute {
    std::array<NativeVitBlockRoute,8> blocks{};
    std::uint32_t count{},input_split_block{},decoder_block{},tokens{};
    std::uint32_t raster_width{},raster_height{};
};
[[nodiscard]] inline NativeVitRouteError BuildNativeVitRoute(
    std::span<const NativePlanStep> rows,NativeVitRoute& output) {
    output={};
    NativeNrSchedule schedule;
    if(BuildNativeNrSchedule(rows,schedule)!=NativeNrGraphError::Ok)
        return NativeVitRouteError::InvalidOrder;
    NativeVitRoute staged{};
    constexpr std::array<NativeNrOp,5> expected{
        NativeNrOp::VitFfwdExpand,NativeNrOp::VitFfwdContract,
        NativeNrOp::VitQkv,NativeNrOp::VitAttention,
        NativeNrOp::VitProjection};
    for(std::uint32_t i=0u;i<rows.size();++i){
        if(!IsNativeNrVitOp(schedule.instructions[i].operation))
            continue;
        if(staged.count>=staged.blocks.size()||i+5u>rows.size())
            return NativeVitRouteError::Incomplete;
        const auto& first=rows[i];
        if(first.layer!=0u||first.inputs!=1u||first.input0<0||
           first.tokens>4096u||first.tokens==0u)
            return NativeVitRouteError::InvalidShape;
        if(staged.count==0u){
            if(i==0u||
               schedule.instructions[i-1u].operation!=
                   NativeNrOp::SplitFinalHead||
               rows[i-1u].block!=static_cast<std::uint32_t>(first.input0))
                return NativeVitRouteError::MissingInput;
            staged.input_split_block=static_cast<std::uint32_t>(first.input0);
            staged.tokens=static_cast<std::uint32_t>(first.tokens);
            if(first.width<=0||first.height<=0||
               static_cast<std::uint64_t>(first.width)*first.height>staged.tokens)
                return NativeVitRouteError::InvalidShape;
            // Native plan W/H refer to launch axes. FinalHead's actual
            // 4x4-tiled raster (p.W=s.H, p.rows=s.W) is transposed.
            // Never infer it from the 2160-token buffer size: both
            // orientations have the same size but incompatible token order.
            if(first.width!=rows[i-1u].width||
               first.height!=rows[i-1u].height||
               first.tokens!=rows[i-1u].tokens)
                return NativeVitRouteError::InvalidShape;
            staged.raster_width=static_cast<std::uint32_t>(first.height);
            staged.raster_height=static_cast<std::uint32_t>(first.width);
        } else if(first.block!=staged.blocks[staged.count-1u].block+1u||
                  first.input0!=static_cast<std::int32_t>(
                      staged.blocks[staged.count-1u].block))
            return NativeVitRouteError::InvalidSource;
        if(first.tokens!=staged.tokens||
           first.width!=staged.raster_height||
           first.height!=staged.raster_width)
            return NativeVitRouteError::InvalidShape;
        for(std::uint32_t j=0u;j<5u;++j){
            const auto& s=rows[i+j];
            if(schedule.instructions[i+j].operation!=expected[j]||
               s.block!=first.block||s.layer!=j||s.tokens!=first.tokens||
               s.width!=first.width||s.height!=first.height||
               s.inputs!=1u||s.input1!=-1||
               (j!=0u&&s.input0!=static_cast<std::int32_t>(first.block)))
                return NativeVitRouteError::InvalidShape;
        }
        staged.blocks[staged.count++]={
            first.block,i,staged.tokens,
            static_cast<std::uint32_t>(first.input0)};
        i+=4u;
    }
    if(!staged.count)return NativeVitRouteError::MissingVit;
    if(staged.count!=8u)return NativeVitRouteError::Incomplete;
    const auto last=staged.blocks.back();
    const std::uint32_t after=last.first_row+5u;
    if(after>=rows.size()||
       schedule.instructions[after].operation!=
          NativeNrOp::DecoderUpsample)
        return NativeVitRouteError::MissingDecoder;
    const auto& decoder=rows[after];
    if(decoder.input0!=static_cast<std::int32_t>(last.block)||
       decoder.input1!=static_cast<std::int32_t>(
           staged.input_split_block)||decoder.inputs!=2u)
        return NativeVitRouteError::InvalidSource;
    staged.decoder_block=decoder.block;
    output=staged;
    return NativeVitRouteError::Ok;
}
} // namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2
```

`extras/graphics/rdna2_nr_vit_projection_stage_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Complete preflight of each 1x1 ViT FFN projection and its FP16 residual
// or cubic activation, in sequential GPU token batches. No dropped tails.
#pragma once
#include "rdna2_nr_projection_policy.h"
#include "rdna2_nr_vit_epilogue_policy.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>
namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2 {
enum class VitProjectionKind:std::uint8_t {
    Expand,Contract,ResidualProjection
};
struct VitProjectionStageCapacity {
    std::uint64_t input_bytes{},weights_bytes{},scratch_bytes{};
    std::uint64_t residual_bytes{},gain_bytes{},output_bytes{};
};
struct VitProjectionStageBatch {
    Projection gemm{};
    Storage gemm_storage{};
    VitActivation activation{};
    VitResidual residual{};
    VitEpilogueStorage epilogue_storage{};
};
struct VitProjectionStageBatches {
    std::array<VitProjectionStageBatch,16> slices{};
    std::uint32_t count{},tokens{};
    VitProjectionKind kind{};
};
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool VitStageShape(
    VitProjectionKind kind,std::uint32_t& N,
    std::uint32_t& K) noexcept {
    switch(kind) {
    case VitProjectionKind::Expand:N=4096u;K=1024u;return true;
    case VitProjectionKind::Contract:N=1024u;K=4096u;return true;
    case VitProjectionKind::ResidualProjection:N=1024u;K=1024u;return true;
    }
    return false;
}
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool BuildVitProjectionStage(
    VitProjectionKind kind,std::uint32_t tokens,
    const VitProjectionStageCapacity& b,
    VitProjectionStageBatches& output) noexcept {
    output={};
    std::uint32_t N=0u,K=0u;
    if(!VitStageShape(kind,N,K)||!tokens||tokens>4096u||
       !b.scratch_bytes)return false;
    const std::uint64_t max_by_products=kMaxProducts/
        (std::uint64_t(N)*K);
    const std::uint64_t max_by_scratch=b.scratch_bytes/
        (std::uint64_t(N)*4u);
    const std::uint64_t stride=std::min({
        std::uint64_t(tokens),std::uint64_t(1024u),
        max_by_products,max_by_scratch});
    if(!stride||std::uint64_t(tokens)>stride*16u)return false;
    VitProjectionStageBatches ready{};
    ready.tokens=tokens;
    ready.kind=kind;
    for(std::uint32_t done=0u;done<tokens;){
        if(ready.count>=ready.slices.size())return false;
        const auto take=static_cast<std::uint32_t>(
            std::min<std::uint64_t>(stride,tokens-done));
        const std::uint64_t a_base=std::uint64_t(done)*K;
        const std::uint64_t out_base=std::uint64_t(done)*N;
        if(a_base>std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max()||
           out_base>std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max())
            return false;
        VitProjectionStageBatch step{
            .gemm={take,N,K,K,K,
                   static_cast<std::uint32_t>(a_base),0u},
            .gemm_storage={b.input_bytes,b.weights_bytes,
                           b.scratch_bytes,b.scratch_bytes},
            .activation={take,N,0u,static_cast<std::uint32_t>(out_base)},
            .residual={take,N,0u,
                       static_cast<std::uint32_t>(out_base),
                       static_cast<std::uint32_t>(out_base),0u},
            .epilogue_storage={b.scratch_bytes,b.residual_bytes,
                               b.gain_bytes,b.output_bytes}};
        if(!CanDispatch(step.gemm,step.gemm_storage)||
           (kind==VitProjectionKind::Expand?
            !CanVitActivation(step.activation,step.epilogue_storage):
            !CanVitResidual(step.residual,step.epilogue_storage)))
            return false;
        ready.slices[ready.count++]=step;
        done+=take;
    }
    output=ready;
    return true;
}
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool ValidateVitProjectionStage(
    const VitProjectionStageBatches& p) noexcept {
    std::uint32_t N=0u,K=0u;
    if(!VitStageShape(p.kind,N,K)||!p.tokens||
       p.tokens>4096u||p.count==0u||p.count>p.slices.size())
        return false;
    std::uint64_t done=0u;
    for(std::uint32_t i=0u;i<p.count;++i) {
        const auto& step=p.slices[i];
        const auto expected_a=done*K,expected_out=done*N;
        if(step.gemm.channels!=N||step.gemm.inner!=K||
           step.gemm.lda_bytes!=K||step.gemm.ldw_bytes!=K||
           step.gemm.a_base_bytes!=expected_a||
           step.gemm.w_base_bytes!=0u||
           !CanDispatch(step.gemm,step.gemm_storage)||
           step.gemm.tokens==0u||step.gemm.tokens>1024u)
            return false;
        if(p.kind==VitProjectionKind::Expand) {
            if(step.activation.tokens!=step.gemm.tokens||
               step.activation.channels!=N||
               step.activation.input_offset_floats!=0u||
               step.activation.output_offset_bytes!=expected_out||
               !CanVitActivation(step.activation,step.epilogue_storage))
                return false;
        } else {
            if(step.residual.tokens!=step.gemm.tokens||
               step.residual.channels!=N||
               step.residual.input_offset_floats!=0u||
               step.residual.output_offset_bytes!=expected_out||
               step.residual.residual_offset_bytes!=expected_out||
               step.residual.gain_offset_halfwords!=0u||
               !CanVitResidual(step.residual,step.epilogue_storage))
                return false;
        }
        done+=step.gemm.tokens;
    }
    return done==p.tokens;
}
} // namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2
```

`extras/graphics/rdna2_nr_vit_qkv_batches_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Whole native ViT QKV edge: prevalidate all sequential GEMM/normalize
// slices BEFORE recording the first Vulkan command. No partial tensor reuse.
#pragma once
#include "rdna2_nr_projection_policy.h"
#include "rdna2_nr_vit_qkv_norm_policy.h"
#include "rdna2_nr_vit_attention_policy.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2 {
struct VitQkvBuffersCapacity {
    std::uint64_t input{},weights{},fp32{},temperatures{};
    std::uint64_t query{},key{},value{},context{};
};
struct VitQkvBatch {
    Projection gemm{};
    Storage gemm_storage{};
    VitQkvNorm normalize{};
    VitQkvNormStorage normalize_storage{};
};
struct VitQkvBatches {
    std::array<VitQkvBatch,16> slices{};
    std::uint32_t count{},total_tokens{};
    VitAttention attention{};
    VitAttentionStorage attention_storage{};
};
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool BuildVitQkvBatches(
    std::uint32_t tokens,const VitQkvBuffersCapacity& capacity,
    VitQkvBatches& output) noexcept {
    output={};
    if(!tokens||tokens>4096u||!capacity.fp32)return false;
    constexpr std::uint64_t kMatrixWidth=3072u;
    constexpr std::uint64_t kInner=1024u;
    const std::uint64_t temp_tokens=capacity.fp32/(kMatrixWidth*4u);
    const std::uint64_t compute_tokens=
        kMaxProducts/(kMatrixWidth*kInner);
    const std::uint64_t per_batch=std::min({
        std::uint64_t(tokens),temp_tokens,compute_tokens});
    if(!per_batch||std::uint64_t(tokens)>per_batch*16u)return false;
    const VitAttention attn{0u,0u,0u,0u,tokens};
    const VitAttentionStorage attn_storage{
        capacity.query,capacity.key,capacity.value,capacity.context};
    if(!CanVitAttention(attn,attn_storage))return false;
    VitQkvBatches prepared{};
    std::uint32_t done=0u;
    while(done<tokens){
        if(prepared.count>=prepared.slices.size())return false;
        const std::uint32_t take=std::min(
            static_cast<std::uint32_t>(per_batch),tokens-done);
        const auto input_base=std::uint64_t(done)*kInner;
        const auto output_base=std::uint64_t(done)*1024u;
        if(input_base>UINT32_MAX||output_base>UINT32_MAX)return false;
        VitQkvBatch batch{
            .gemm={take,3072u,1024u,1024u,1024u,
                   static_cast<std::uint32_t>(input_base),0u},
            .gemm_storage={capacity.input,capacity.weights,
                           capacity.fp32,capacity.fp32},
            .normalize={take,0u,0u,
                        static_cast<std::uint32_t>(output_base),
                        static_cast<std::uint32_t>(output_base),
                        static_cast<std::uint32_t>(output_base)},
            .normalize_storage={capacity.fp32,capacity.temperatures,
                                capacity.query,capacity.key,capacity.value}};
        if(!CanDispatch(batch.gemm,batch.gemm_storage)||
           !CanVitQkvNorm(batch.normalize,batch.normalize_storage))
            return false;
        prepared.slices[prepared.count++]=batch;
        done+=take;
    }
    prepared.total_tokens=done;
    prepared.attention=attn;
    prepared.attention_storage=attn_storage;
    output=prepared;
    return true;
}
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool ValidVitQkvBatches(
    const VitQkvBatches& p) noexcept {
    if(!p.count||p.count>p.slices.size()||
       !p.total_tokens||p.total_tokens!=p.attention.tokens||
       !CanVitAttention(p.attention,p.attention_storage))return false;
    std::uint64_t done=0u;
    for(std::uint32_t i=0u;i<p.count;++i){
        const auto& s=p.slices[i];
        if(!CanDispatch(s.gemm,s.gemm_storage)||
           !CanVitQkvNorm(s.normalize,s.normalize_storage)||
           s.gemm.tokens!=s.normalize.tokens||
           s.gemm.channels!=3072u||s.gemm.inner!=1024u||
           s.gemm.a_base_bytes!=done*1024u||
           s.normalize.src_base_floats!=0u||
           s.normalize.scale_base_floats!=0u||
           s.normalize.q_base_bytes!=done*1024u||
           s.normalize.k_base_bytes!=done*1024u||
           s.normalize.v_base_bytes!=done*1024u)return false;
        done+=s.gemm.tokens;
    }
    return done==p.total_tokens;
}
} // namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2
```

`extras/graphics/rdna2_nr_vit_qkv_norm_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// RDNA2 ViT 32-head Q/K normalization and V quantization after FP32 GEMM.
// Input FP32 row-major [tokens,3072] (Q|K|V, each 1024 channels).
// Output 3 independent packed E4M3FN [tokens,32,32] row-major buffers.
// The source temperatures MUST be finite as verified by model loader.
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>
namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2 {
struct VitQkvNorm {
    std::uint32_t tokens{};
    std::uint32_t src_base_floats{};
    std::uint32_t scale_base_floats{};
    std::uint32_t q_base_bytes{};
    std::uint32_t k_base_bytes{};
    std::uint32_t v_base_bytes{};
};
struct VitQkvNormStorage {
    std::uint64_t input_bytes{},scale_bytes{},q_bytes{},k_bytes{},v_bytes{};
};
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool CanVitQkvNorm(
    const VitQkvNorm& p,const VitQkvNormStorage& s) noexcept {
    constexpr std::uint64_t kMax=256ull<<20;
    if(p.tokens==0u||p.tokens>4096u||
       ((p.q_base_bytes|p.k_base_bytes|p.v_base_bytes)&3u)!=0u)
        return false;
    if(s.input_bytes==0u||s.scale_bytes==0u||
       s.q_bytes==0u||s.k_bytes==0u||s.v_bytes==0u)
        return false;
    const std::uint64_t input_floats=
        std::uint64_t(p.src_base_floats)+std::uint64_t(p.tokens)*3072u;
    const std::uint64_t scales=
        std::uint64_t(p.scale_base_floats)+32u;
    const std::uint64_t tensor=std::uint64_t(p.tokens)*1024u;
    const std::uint64_t qe=std::uint64_t(p.q_base_bytes)+tensor;
    const std::uint64_t ke=std::uint64_t(p.k_base_bytes)+tensor;
    const std::uint64_t ve=std::uint64_t(p.v_base_bytes)+tensor;
    constexpr auto u32=std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max();
    if(input_floats>u32||scales>u32||
       qe>u32||ke>u32||ve>u32)return false;
    return input_floats*4u<=kMax&&scales*4u<=kMax&&
           qe<=kMax&&ke<=kMax&&ve<=kMax&&
           input_floats*4u<=s.input_bytes&&
           scales*4u<=s.scale_bytes&&qe<=s.q_bytes&&
           ke<=s.k_bytes&&ve<=s.v_bytes;
}
} // namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2
```

`extras/graphics/rdna2_nr_window_attention_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Validated dispatch for unfused RDNA2 attention/context on preprojected
// Q/K/V with 64 tokens x 32 channels per head and shared relative bias.
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>
namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2 {
struct WindowAttention {
    std::uint32_t q_base_bytes,k_base_bytes,v_base_bytes,out_base_bytes;
    std::uint32_t bias_base_floats,windows,heads;
};
struct AttentionStorage {
    std::uint64_t q_bytes,k_bytes,v_bytes,out_bytes,bias_bytes;
};
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool CanWindowAttention(
    const WindowAttention& p,const AttentionStorage& s) {
    if(!p.windows || !p.heads || p.windows>65535u ||
       (p.heads!=1u && p.heads!=2u && p.heads!=4u &&
        p.heads!=8u && p.heads!=16u))return false;
    if((p.q_base_bytes|p.k_base_bytes|p.v_base_bytes|p.out_base_bytes)&3u)
        return false;
    // 64 token rows, 32 packed E4M3FN channels, 64x64 float bias per head.
    constexpr std::uint64_t kMaxBytes=256ull<<20;
    const auto tensor=std::uint64_t(p.windows)*p.heads*64u*32u;
    const auto bias_words=std::uint64_t(p.heads)*64u*64u;
    if(tensor>kMaxBytes || bias_words*4u>kMaxBytes)return false;
    const auto qe=std::uint64_t(p.q_base_bytes)+tensor;
    const auto ke=std::uint64_t(p.k_base_bytes)+tensor;
    const auto ve=std::uint64_t(p.v_base_bytes)+tensor;
    const auto oe=std::uint64_t(p.out_base_bytes)+tensor;
    const auto be_words=std::uint64_t(p.bias_base_floats)+bias_words;
    // Shader addresses are 32-bit, and each byte stream is uint32 packed.
    if(qe>std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max() ||
       ke>std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max() ||
       ve>std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max() ||
       oe>std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max() ||
       be_words>std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max())return false;
    if(qe>s.q_bytes || ke>s.k_bytes || ve>s.v_bytes ||
       oe>s.out_bytes || be_words*4u>s.bias_bytes)return false;
    // Caller must supply five distinct nonaliasing storage ranges and
    // keep the VkDescriptorSet live until scheduler submission.
    return true;
}
} // namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2
```

`extras/graphics/sgsr_sharpness_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#pragma once
#include <algorithm>

namespace Eden::Graphics {
// The launch process has already mapped UI percentage to RCAS internal
// 200 - (percentage*2). SGSR uses a different 0..2 intensity scale.
// This maps 0% to 0, 50% to 1, and 100% to 2 for BOTH SGSR shaders.
[[nodiscard]] constexpr float SgsrEdgeIntensityFromInternal(int raw) noexcept {
    return 2.0f - static_cast<float>(std::clamp(raw,0,200))/100.0f;
}
static_assert(SgsrEdgeIntensityFromInternal(200)==0.0f);
static_assert(SgsrEdgeIntensityFromInternal(100)==1.0f);
static_assert(SgsrEdgeIntensityFromInternal(0)==2.0f);
}
```

`extras/graphics/test_aa_source_extent.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#include "aa_source_extent.h"
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <initializer_list>
using Eden::Graphics::AaExtent;
using Eden::Graphics::AaSourceExtent;
using Eden::Graphics::AaValid;
using Eden::Graphics::AaExtentChanged;
static_assert(AaValid({1280, 720}));
static_assert(!AaValid({0, 720}));
static_assert(!AaValid({8193, 720}));
static_assert(AaSourceExtent(false, {1280,720}, {1920,1080}).width == 1280);
static_assert(AaSourceExtent(true, {1280,720}, {1920,1080}).width == 1920);
static_assert(AaSourceExtent(true, {1280,720}, {0,0}).width == 0);
static_assert(AaExtentChanged({1280,720},{1920,1080}));
static_assert(!AaExtentChanged({1920,1080},{1920,1080}));
int main() {
    for (std::uint32_t w: {0u,1u,1280u,1920u,3840u,8192u,8193u}) {
        for (std::uint32_t h: {0u,1u,720u,1080u,2160u,8192u,8193u}) {
            const auto raw=AaSourceExtent(false,{w,h},{8192,8192});
            const auto scaled=AaSourceExtent(true,{8192,8192},{w,h});
            if (w==0 || h==0 || w>8192 || h>8192) {
                assert(!AaValid(raw));
                assert(!AaValid(scaled));
            } else {
                assert(raw.width==w && raw.height==h);
                assert(scaled.width==w && scaled.height==h);
            }
        }
    }
    // Change detected independent of upstream source selector. A dynamic
    // resolution adjustment MUST rebuild AA images and descriptors.
    AaExtent last{1920,1080};
    AaExtent next{1600,900};
    assert(AaExtentChanged(last,next));
    last=next;
    assert(!AaExtentChanged(last,next));
    return 0;
}
```

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// R01 native header is used by actual Vulkan renderer/presenter and reports.
#include "../../headless/frame_metrics.h"
#include <cassert>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>
using namespace Eden::FrameMetrics;

int main() {
    ResetForTitle(false, 1'000'000'000ULL);
    for (int i=0; i<10; ++i) {
        OnSourceComposite(); OnRealQueued(); OnGeneratedQueued();
        OnSwapchainPresentReturned(); OnLoadingQueued(); OnSourceSkipped();
    }
    assert(!Enabled());
    assert(!Sample(2'000'000'000ULL).valid);
    assert(source_composites.load() == 0);
    ResetForTitle(true, 1'000'000'000ULL);
    assert(Enabled());
    for (int i=0; i<30; ++i) {
        OnSourceComposite();
        OnRealQueued();
        OnGeneratedQueued();
        OnSwapchainPresentReturned();
        OnSwapchainPresentReturned();
    }
    OnLoadingQueued();
    OnSourceSkipped();
    auto window = Sample(2'000'000'000ULL);
    assert(window.valid && window.interval_ns == 1'000'000'000ULL);
    assert(window.source_composites == 30);
    assert(window.real_frames_queued == 30);
    assert(window.generated_frames_queued == 30);
    assert(window.loading_frames_queued == 1);
    assert(window.skipped_source_frames == 1);
    assert(window.present_calls_returned == 60);
    assert(Rate(window.source_composites, window.interval_ns) == 30.0);
    assert(Rate(window.present_calls_returned, window.interval_ns) == 60.0);
    assert(Rate(33, 0) == 0);
    // Atomics handle separate GPU and presenter workers without allocations.
    constexpr int n = 2048;
    std::thread real([] {
        for (int i=0; i<n; ++i) { OnSourceComposite(); OnRealQueued(); }
    });
    std::thread display([] {
        for (int i=0; i<n; ++i) OnSwapchainPresentReturned();
    });
    real.join();
    display.join();
    auto concurrent = Sample(4'000'000'000ULL);
    assert(concurrent.valid);
    assert(concurrent.source_composites == n);
    assert(concurrent.real_frames_queued == n);
    assert(concurrent.generated_frames_queued == 0);
    assert(concurrent.present_calls_returned == n);
    assert(Rate(n, 2'000'000'000ULL) == 1024.0);
    assert(!Sample(4'000'000'000ULL).valid);
    // New title cannot inherit previous window counters or an enabled state.
    ResetForTitle(false, 5'000'000'000ULL);
    assert(!Sample(6'000'000'000ULL).valid);
    ResetForTitle(true, 7'000'000'000ULL);
    auto clean = Sample(8'000'000'000ULL);
    assert(clean.valid && clean.source_composites == 0 &&
           clean.real_frames_queued == 0 &&
           clean.generated_frames_queued == 0 &&
           clean.present_calls_returned == 0);
}
```

`extras/graphics/test_framegen_present_gate.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#include "framegen_present_gate.h"
#include <cassert>
using namespace Eden::FeatureLab;

int main() {
    GraphicsCapabilities caps{};
    caps.native_vulkan = true;
    caps.mihawk_compute = true;
    caps.model_weights_verified_and_loaded = true;
    caps.game_fps = 30;
    PresentGateInput f{};
    f.real_frame_id = 1; f.timestamp_ns = 1'000'000'000;
    f.width = 1920; f.height = 1080; f.output_hz = 60;
    f.display_mode_verified = true;
    FramegenPresentGate gate;
    assert(gate.OnRealFrame(FrameGeneration::MihawkGen, caps, f).reason ==
           PresentGateReason::NoStablePair);
    ++f.real_frame_id; f.timestamp_ns += 33'333'333;
    assert(gate.OnRealFrame(FrameGeneration::MihawkGen, caps, f).eligible());
    ++f.real_frame_id; f.timestamp_ns += 33'333'333;
    f.overlay_changed = true;
    assert(gate.OnRealFrame(FrameGeneration::MihawkGen, caps, f).reason ==
           PresentGateReason::UnsafeOverlay);
    f.overlay_changed = false;
    ++f.real_frame_id; f.timestamp_ns += 33'333'333;
    assert(!gate.OnRealFrame(FrameGeneration::MihawkGen, caps, f).eligible());
    ++f.real_frame_id; f.timestamp_ns += 33'333'333;
    assert(gate.OnRealFrame(FrameGeneration::MihawkGen, caps, f).eligible());
    ++f.real_frame_id; f.timestamp_ns += 83'333'333;
    assert(gate.OnRealFrame(FrameGeneration::MihawkGen, caps, f).reason ==
           PresentGateReason::WrongCadence);
    f.real_frame_id += 2; f.timestamp_ns += 33'333'333;
    assert(!gate.OnRealFrame(FrameGeneration::MihawkGen, caps, f).eligible());
    ++f.real_frame_id; f.timestamp_ns += 33'333'333;
    assert(gate.OnRealFrame(FrameGeneration::MihawkGen, caps, f).eligible());
    f.scene_reset = true;
    assert(gate.OnRealFrame(FrameGeneration::MihawkGen, caps, f).reason ==
           PresentGateReason::Paused);
    f.scene_reset = false;
    caps.model_weights_verified_and_loaded = false;
    assert(gate.OnRealFrame(FrameGeneration::MihawkGen, caps, f).reason ==
           PresentGateReason::Unsupported);
    caps.model_weights_verified_and_loaded = true;
    caps.game_fps = 60; f.output_hz = 120; f.real_frame_id = 1;
    f.timestamp_ns = 2'000'000'000;
    assert(!gate.OnRealFrame(FrameGeneration::MihawkGen, caps, f).eligible());
    f.real_frame_id++; f.timestamp_ns += 16'666'667;
    assert(gate.OnRealFrame(FrameGeneration::MihawkGen, caps, f).eligible());
    f.output_hz = 60;
    assert(gate.OnRealFrame(FrameGeneration::MihawkGen, caps, f).reason ==
           PresentGateReason::NoDisplayHeadroom);
    caps.guest_motion_vectors = false;
    assert(gate.OnRealFrame(FrameGeneration::Fsr3Vulkan, caps, f).reason ==
           PresentGateReason::Unsupported);
    caps.fsr3_optical_flow = true;
    f.real_frame_id = 1;
    f.output_hz = 120;
    f.timestamp_ns = 3'000'000'000;
    assert(gate.OnRealFrame(FrameGeneration::Fsr3Vulkan, caps, f).reason ==
           PresentGateReason::NoStablePair);
    ++f.real_frame_id;
    f.timestamp_ns += 16'666'667;
    assert(gate.OnRealFrame(FrameGeneration::Fsr3Vulkan, caps, f).eligible());
    assert(gate.OnRealFrame(FrameGeneration::LosslessScaling, caps, f).reason ==
           PresentGateReason::Unsupported);
    assert(gate.OnRealFrame(FrameGeneration::Off, caps, f).reason ==
           PresentGateReason::Disabled);
}
```

`extras/graphics/test_fsr1_sharpness_policy.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#include "fsr1_sharpness_policy.h"
#include <cassert>
#include <cmath>
int main() {
    using Eden::Graphics::Fsr1SharpnessFromPercent;
    using Eden::Graphics::Fsr1SharpnessFromInternal;
    const auto off=Fsr1SharpnessFromPercent(0);
    const auto low=Fsr1SharpnessFromPercent(25);
    const auto mid=Fsr1SharpnessFromPercent(50);
    const auto high=Fsr1SharpnessFromPercent(75);
    const auto max=Fsr1SharpnessFromPercent(100);
    assert(!off.rcas_enabled);
    assert(low.rcas_enabled && mid.rcas_enabled &&
           high.rcas_enabled && max.rcas_enabled);
    assert(off.rcas_stops == 2.0f);
    assert(mid.rcas_stops == 1.0f);
    assert(max.rcas_stops == 0.0f);
    // SDK mapping FsrRcasCon -> exp2(-stops). The previous code
    // mistakenly used 0% => strongest and 100% => weaker.
    assert(std::exp2(-low.rcas_stops) < std::exp2(-mid.rcas_stops));
    assert(std::exp2(-mid.rcas_stops) < std::exp2(-high.rcas_stops));
    assert(std::exp2(-high.rcas_stops) < std::exp2(-max.rcas_stops));
    assert(Fsr1SharpnessFromPercent(-500).rcas_stops == 2.0f);
    assert(!Fsr1SharpnessFromPercent(-500).rcas_enabled);
    assert(Fsr1SharpnessFromPercent(800).rcas_stops == 0.0f);
    // Critically test the real launcher->shared-settings->Vulkan bridge.
    // Launch path writes internal 200 - user_percent*2, NOT user_percent.
    for (int percent=0; percent<=100; ++percent) {
        const auto ui=Fsr1SharpnessFromPercent(percent);
        const auto native=Fsr1SharpnessFromInternal(200-percent*2);
        assert(ui.rcas_enabled==native.rcas_enabled);
        assert(ui.rcas_stops==native.rcas_stops);
    }
    assert(!Fsr1SharpnessFromInternal(200).rcas_enabled);
    assert(Fsr1SharpnessFromInternal(100).rcas_stops==1.0f);
    assert(Fsr1SharpnessFromInternal(0).rcas_stops==0.0f);
    return 0;
}
```

`extras/graphics/test_fsr31_native_resource_contract.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#include <cassert>
#include "fsr31_native_resource_contract.h"
using namespace Eden::Graphics::Temporal;
int main() {
    Inputs meta{};
    meta.scene_color={11,21,1,1,Producer::GuestGpuVerified};
    meta.depth={12,22,1,1,Producer::GuestGpuVerified};
    meta.motion={13,23,1,1,Producer::GuestGpuVerified};
    NativeResources n{{11,21},{12,22},{13,23}};
    assert(ValidateNativeResources(meta,n)==Rejection::None);
    n.depth.view=0;
    assert(ValidateNativeResources(meta,n)==Rejection::MissingResource);
    n.depth.view=22; n.motion.image=100;
    assert(ValidateNativeResources(meta,n)==Rejection::MismatchedNativeResource);
    n.motion.image=13; n.motion.view=21;
    assert(ValidateNativeResources(meta,n)==Rejection::MismatchedNativeResource);
    // Duplicate guest handles are not distinct temporal semantics.
    n.motion.view=23;meta.motion.view=21;n.motion.view=21;
    assert(ValidateNativeResources(meta,n)==Rejection::MismatchedNativeResource);
    meta.motion.view=23;n.motion.view=23;
    // Three distinct views onto the *same* VkImage remain an invalid FSR3
    // input triple, even when declared and native resource IDs agree.
    n.depth.image=11;meta.depth.image=11;
    assert(ValidateNativeResources(meta,n)==Rejection::MismatchedNativeResource);
    n.depth.image=12;meta.depth.image=12;
    n.motion.image=11;meta.motion.image=11;
    assert(ValidateNativeResources(meta,n)==Rejection::MismatchedNativeResource);
    n.motion.image=12;meta.motion.image=12;
    assert(ValidateNativeResources(meta,n)==Rejection::MismatchedNativeResource);
    n.motion.image=13;meta.motion.image=13;
    assert(ValidateNativeResources(meta,n)==Rejection::None);
    meta.depth.image=99;
    assert(ValidateNativeResources(meta,n)==Rejection::MismatchedNativeResource);
    meta.depth.image=12;
    meta.output_width=1920;
    meta.output_height=1080;
    NativeDestination dst{.image=88,.width=1920,.height=1080,
                          .samples=1,.single_color_no_depth=true};
    assert(ValidateNativeDestination(meta,dst)==Rejection::None);
    dst.image=11;
    assert(ValidateNativeDestination(meta,dst)==Rejection::OutputAliasesInput);
    dst.image=12;
    assert(ValidateNativeDestination(meta,dst)==Rejection::OutputAliasesInput);
    dst.image=13;
    assert(ValidateNativeDestination(meta,dst)==Rejection::OutputAliasesInput);
    dst.image=88;
    dst.samples=4;
    assert(ValidateNativeDestination(meta,dst)==Rejection::InvalidResolution);
    dst.samples=1;
    dst.width=1280;
    assert(ValidateNativeDestination(meta,dst)==Rejection::InvalidResolution);
    dst.width=1920;
    dst.single_color_no_depth=false;
    assert(ValidateNativeDestination(meta,dst)==Rejection::InvalidResolution);
}
```

`extras/graphics/test_fsr31_temporal_contract.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#include "fsr31_temporal_contract.h"
#include <cassert>
#include <limits>
using namespace Eden::Graphics::Temporal;

static Inputs Verified(std::uint64_t frame=1) {
    auto resource=[&](std::uint64_t handle) {
        return Resource{.image=handle,.view=handle+100,
                        .frame_id=frame,.scene_id=7,
                        .producer=Producer::GuestGpuVerified};
    };
    return {.scene_color=resource(1),.depth=resource(2),.motion=resource(3),
            .render_width=1280,.render_height=720,
            .output_width=1920,.output_height=1080,
            .depth_convention=DepthConvention::Reversed,
            .motion_convention=MotionConvention::PixelOffsetToPreviousFrame,
            .jitter={0.25f,-0.25f},.motion_scale={1.0f,1.0f},
            .depth_to_view={0.0f,0.1f,1.0f,1.0f},
            .tan_half_fov=0.577350f,
            .elapsed_ms=33.3f,.native_hud_is_separate=true,
            .guest_hud_is_separate=true,.captured_gpu_work_complete=true,
            .vulkan_inputs_in_general_layout=true};
}
int main() {
    auto f=Verified();
    assert(Validate(f)==Rejection::None);
    FrameContinuity sequence;
    assert(sequence.Observe(f)==Rejection::None);
    assert(sequence.Observe(Verified(2))==Rejection::None);
    assert(sequence.Observe(Verified(4))==Rejection::NonConsecutiveFrame);
    assert(sequence.Observe(Verified(5))==Rejection::None);
    f=Verified(6);f.scene_color.scene_id=9;
    f.depth.scene_id=f.motion.scene_id=9;
    assert(sequence.Observe(f)==Rejection::SceneChanged);
    f=Verified(7); f.scene_color.scene_id=f.motion.scene_id=f.depth.scene_id=9;
    assert(sequence.Observe(f)==Rejection::None);

    f=Verified(); f.motion={};
    assert(Validate(f)==Rejection::MissingResource);
    f=Verified(); f.motion.producer=Producer::GuessedFromPresentation;
    assert(Validate(f)==Rejection::UntrustedProvenance);
    f=Verified(); f.depth.frame_id=2;
    assert(Validate(f)==Rejection::MixedFrame);
    f=Verified(); f.motion.scene_id=8;
    assert(Validate(f)==Rejection::MixedFrame);
    f=Verified(); f.depth_convention=DepthConvention::Unknown;
    assert(Validate(f)==Rejection::MissingDepthConvention);
    f=Verified(); f.motion_convention=MotionConvention::Unknown;
    assert(Validate(f)==Rejection::MissingMotionConvention);
    f=Verified(); f.depth_convention=DepthConvention::Forward;
    assert(Validate(f)==Rejection::UnsupportedDepthConvention);
    f=Verified(); f.motion_convention=MotionConvention::NormalizedOffsetToPreviousFrame;
    assert(Validate(f)==Rejection::UnsupportedMotionConvention);
    f=Verified(); f.render_width=1;
    assert(Validate(f)==Rejection::InvalidResolution);
    f=Verified(); f.guest_hud_is_separate=false;
    assert(Validate(f)==Rejection::MissingHudSeparation);
    f=Verified(); f.render_width=4000;
    assert(Validate(f)==Rejection::InvalidResolution);
    f=Verified(); f.jitter[0]=std::numeric_limits<float>::quiet_NaN();
    assert(Validate(f)==Rejection::InvalidJitter);
    f=Verified(); f.motion_scale[0]=-1;
    assert(Validate(f)==Rejection::InvalidMotionScale);
    f=Verified(); f.elapsed_ms=1000;
    assert(Validate(f)==Rejection::InvalidTiming);
    f=Verified(); f.vulkan_inputs_in_general_layout=false;
    assert(Validate(f)==Rejection::InvalidVulkanImageLayout);
    f=Verified(); f.tan_half_fov=0.0f;
    assert(Validate(f)==Rejection::InvalidProjection);
    f=Verified(); f.depth_to_view[0]=std::numeric_limits<float>::infinity();
    assert(Validate(f)==Rejection::InvalidProjection);
    f=Verified(); f.captured_gpu_work_complete=false;
    assert(Validate(f)==Rejection::MissingGpuCompletion);
    assert(sequence.Observe(f)==Rejection::MissingGpuCompletion);
    assert(sequence.Observe(Verified(8))==Rejection::None); // reset
    return 0;
}
```

`extras/graphics/test_fsr31_vram_budget.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#include "fsr31_vram_budget.h"
#include <cassert>
using namespace Eden::Graphics::Fsr31Budget;
int main() {
    const Memory ample{.device_local_bytes=8ULL*1024*MiB,
                       .used_bytes=2ULL*1024*MiB,.usage_is_known=true};
    const auto typical=Evaluate({1280,720,2560,1440},ample);
    assert(typical.decision==Decision::Allowed);
    assert(typical.nominal_bytes>80*MiB);
    assert(typical.required_bytes>typical.nominal_bytes);
    const auto near4k=Evaluate({2560,1440,3840,2160},ample);
    assert(near4k.decision==Decision::Allowed);
    assert(near4k.required_bytes>typical.required_bytes);
    assert(Evaluate({3840,2160,7680,4320},ample).decision==
           Decision::ExceedsAbsoluteLimit);
    assert(Evaluate({0,720,1920,1080},ample).decision==
           Decision::InvalidDimensions);
    assert(Evaluate({32,32,1920,1080},ample).decision==
           Decision::InvalidDimensions);
    assert(Evaluate({1280,720,3841,2160},ample).decision==
           Decision::InvalidDimensions);
    assert(Evaluate({9000,720,9000,1440},ample).decision==
           Decision::InvalidDimensions);
    assert(Evaluate({1920,1080,1280,720},ample).decision==
           Decision::InvalidDimensions);
    auto poor=ample;
    poor.used_bytes=poor.device_local_bytes-typical.required_bytes*2;
    assert(Evaluate({1280,720,2560,1440},poor).decision==
           Decision::InsufficientDeviceMemory);
    poor.used_bytes=0;
    poor.device_local_bytes=0;
    poor.usage_is_known=false;
    assert(Evaluate({1280,720,2560,1440},poor).decision==
           Decision::InsufficientDeviceMemory);
    return 0;
}
```

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#include "fxaa_quality_select.h"
#include <cassert>
#include <thread>
#include <atomic>
int main() {
    using namespace Eden::Graphics;
    SetEnhancedFxaa(false);
    assert(!EnhancedFxaa());
    SetEnhancedFxaa(true);
    assert(EnhancedFxaa());
    std::atomic<bool> run{true};
    std::thread toggle([&] {
        for (int n=0;n<10000;++n)
            SetEnhancedFxaa((n&1)!=0);
        run.store(false);
    });
    while (run.load()) (void)EnhancedFxaa();
    toggle.join();
    SetEnhancedFxaa(false);
    assert(!EnhancedFxaa());
    return 0;
}
```

```cpp
#include <cassert>

int main() {
    constexpr auto off=ResolveGraphicsPipeline({}, {});
    static_assert(off.resolution == ResolutionStage::Native);
    static_assert(off.frame_generation == FrameGeneration::Off);

    assert(p.frame_generation==FrameGeneration::Off);
    assert(p.neural==NeuralStage::Off);
    assert(p.textures==TextureStage::Original);

    caps.fsr_temporal_backend_ready=true;
    caps.neural_vulkan_spirv_ready=true;
    caps.neural_weights_redistributable=true;
```
