```cpp
    assert(p.generation_reason==Rejection::HudUnsafe);
    assert(p.resolution_reason==Rejection::MissingSceneData);
    assert(p.neural_reason==Rejection::HudUnsafe);
    caps.framegen.guest_motion_vectors=true;
    caps.framegen.guest_depth=true;
    caps.temporal_jitter_valid=true;
    caps.hud_separated=true;
    caps.neural_hdr_and_colorspace_checked=true;
    caps.neural_ui_exclusion_mask=true;
    caps.verified_hd_texture_pack=true;
    caps.output_120hz_negotiated=true;
    p=ResolveGraphicsPipeline(request,caps);
    assert(p.resolution==ResolutionStage::TemporalFsr3);
    assert(p.frame_generation==FrameGeneration::MihawkGen);
    assert(p.neural==NeuralStage::AMDCompute);
    assert(p.textures==TextureStage::VerifiedHdPack);
    assert(p.display_hz==120);
    assert(!p.runtime_qualified); // policy != actual shader/presenter integration
    caps.neural_weights_redistributable=false;
    p=ResolveGraphicsPipeline(request,caps);
    assert(p.neural==NeuralStage::Off);
    assert(p.neural_reason==Rejection::UnlicensedModel);
    request.frame_generation=FrameGeneration::DlssPcOnlyUnsupported;

    assert(p.frame_generation==FrameGeneration::Off);
    assert(p.generation_reason==Rejection::Unsupported);
    request.resolution=ResolutionStage::SpatialFsr;
    caps.fsr_spatial_backend_ready=true;
    p=ResolveGraphicsPipeline(request,caps);
    assert(p.resolution==ResolutionStage::SpatialFsr);
    request.display_hz=360;
    p=ResolveGraphicsPipeline(request,caps);
    assert(p.display_hz==60);
    assert(p.display_reason==Rejection::UnverifiedOutput);
    assert(p.resolution_reason==Rejection::None);
```

```cpp
    fs::create_directories(dir/"lossless");

    fs::rename(file,dir/"original");
    fs::create_symlink(dir/"original",file);
    assert(!Eden::Graphics::LosslessUserFileLooksValid(dir));
    fs::remove(file);
    fs::remove_all(dir);
```

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#include "mihawk_capture_fences.h"
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>

using namespace Eden::FeatureLab;
int main() {
    MihawkCaptureFences gate{};
    std::uint64_t completed = 0;
    auto is_free = [&](std::uint64_t serial) { return serial <= completed; };
    auto p = gate.Acquire(is_free);
    assert(p.valid && p.slot == 0 && p.previous_gpu_tick == 0);
    assert(!gate.Acquire(is_free).valid); // only one pending command buffer
    assert(gate.Commit(p, 1));
    assert(gate.BusyUntil(0) == 1 && !gate.Pending());
    p = gate.Acquire(is_free);
    assert(p.valid && p.slot == 1);
    assert(gate.Commit(p, 2));
    assert(gate.BusyUntil(1) == 2);
    assert(!gate.Acquire(is_free).valid); // GPU still reads snapshot slot 0
    completed = 1;
    p = gate.Acquire(is_free);
    assert(p.valid && p.slot == 0 && p.previous_gpu_tick == 1);
    gate.AbortUnsubmitted(); // not queued: does not take a GPU serial
    assert(gate.BusyUntil(0) == 1 && gate.LatestGpuTick() == 2);
    p = gate.Acquire(is_free);
    assert(p.valid && p.slot == 0);
    assert(gate.Commit(p, 4)); // unrelated GPU work may advance ticks
    assert(gate.BusyUntil(0) == 4 && gate.LatestGpuTick() == 4);
    assert(!gate.Acquire(is_free).valid); // slot 1 still not free
    completed = 2;
    p = gate.Acquire(is_free);
    assert(p.valid && p.slot == 1);
    assert(!gate.Commit(p, 3)); // GPU submission tick regressed
    assert(gate.Quarantined() && !gate.Acquire(is_free).valid);
    gate.ResetAfterDeviceIdle();
    assert(!gate.Quarantined() && gate.LatestGpuTick() == 0);
    p = gate.Acquire(is_free);
    assert(p.valid && p.slot == 0);
    assert(!gate.Commit(p, 0)); // missing actual tick is never accepted
    assert(gate.Quarantined());

    // Full sequence: generation holds old history + output until real
    // scheduler tick. Skipping a guest source frame invalidates the pair.
    gate.ResetAfterDeviceIdle();
    completed = 0;
    p = gate.Acquire(is_free);
    assert(p.valid && p.slot == 0);
    assert(!gate.CanGenerate(p, 1, is_free));
    assert(gate.Commit(p, 8, 1, false));
    completed = 8;
    p = gate.Acquire(is_free);
    assert(p.valid && p.slot == 1);
    assert(gate.CanGenerate(p, 2, is_free));
    assert(!gate.CanGenerate(p, 3, is_free)); // frame ID gap
    assert(gate.Commit(p, 9, 2, true));
    assert(gate.BusyUntil(0) == 9 && gate.BusyUntil(1) == 9);
    assert(gate.OutputBusyUntil() == 9);
    completed = 8;
    assert(!gate.Acquire(is_free).valid); // old history still sampled by GPU
    completed = 9;
    p = gate.Acquire(is_free);
    assert(gate.CanGenerate(p, 3, is_free));
    assert(gate.Commit(p, 10, 3, true));
    completed = 10;
    p = gate.Acquire(is_free);
    assert(!gate.CanGenerate(p, 5, is_free)); // dropped frame 4
    assert(gate.Commit(p, 11, 5, false));
    completed = 11;
    p = gate.Acquire(is_free);
    assert(gate.CanGenerate(p, 6, is_free));
    gate.AbortUnsubmitted();

}
```

```cpp
template<class T> static T H(std::uintptr_t p) { return reinterpret_cast<T>(p); }
int main() {

    const auto real = H<VkImage>(1);
    const auto history = H<VkImage>(2);
```

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#include "mihawk_session_resize.h"
#include <cassert>
using namespace Eden::FeatureLab;

int main() {
    constexpr auto bgra = VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM;
    constexpr auto rgba = VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
    const auto choose = [](bool ready, unsigned w, unsigned h, VkFormat old_fmt,
                           unsigned nw, unsigned nh, VkFormat new_fmt) {
        return ChooseMihawkSessionAction(ready, w, h, old_fmt, nw, nh, new_fmt);
    };
    assert(choose(false, 0, 0, bgra, 1920, 1080, bgra) ==
           MihawkSessionAction::Initialize);
    assert(choose(true, 1920, 1080, bgra, 1920, 1080, bgra) ==
           MihawkSessionAction::Keep);
    assert(choose(true, 1920, 1080, bgra, 2560, 1440, bgra) ==
           MihawkSessionAction::RecreateAfterGpuIdle);
    assert(choose(true, 1920, 1080, bgra, 1920, 1080, rgba) ==
           MihawkSessionAction::RecreateAfterGpuIdle);
    assert(choose(true, 2560, 1440, rgba, 1920, 1080, bgra) ==
           MihawkSessionAction::RecreateAfterGpuIdle);
    assert(choose(true, 1920, 1080, bgra, 0, 1080, bgra) ==
           MihawkSessionAction::InvalidTarget);
    assert(choose(false, 0, 0, bgra, 7680, 4320, rgba) ==
           MihawkSessionAction::InvalidTarget);
    assert(choose(false, 0, 0, bgra, 1920, 1080, VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED) ==
           MihawkSessionAction::InvalidTarget);
    assert(choose(true, 3840, 2160, rgba, 3840, 2160, rgba) ==
           MihawkSessionAction::Keep);
}
```

`extras/graphics/test_mihawk_submission_timeline.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#include "mihawk_submission_timeline.h"
#include <cassert>
using namespace Eden::FeatureLab;

static MihawkSubmitRequest StandardRequest() {
    MihawkSubmitRequest r{};
    r.mode = FrameGeneration::MihawkGen;
    r.graphics.native_vulkan = true;
    r.graphics.mihawk_compute = true;
    r.graphics.model_weights_verified_and_loaded = true;
    r.graphics.game_fps = 30;
    r.surface = {
        .enabled = true, .native_vulkan = true,
        .compute_and_storage = true, .model_verified_and_loaded = true,
        .blit_rgba_to_present = true, .owned_history_pair = true,
        .history_matches_source_format = true,
        .private_output_rgba8_storage = true,
        .present_image_transfer_dst = true,
        .history_descriptor_slots_fenced = true,
        .present_queue_ordered = true, .native_hud_absent = true,
        .available_present_frames = 3,
        .width = 1920, .height = 1080,
        .compositor_format = ColorFormat::Bgra8Unorm
    };
    r.source = {
        .real_frame_id = 1,
        .timestamp_ns = 1'000'000'000,
        .width = 1920, .height = 1080,
        .output_hz = 60,
        .display_mode_verified = true
    };
    r.reserved_gpu_serial = 1;
    return r;
}

int main() {
    MihawkSubmissionTimeline timeline{};
    auto r = StandardRequest();
    assert(timeline.Prepare(r).status == MihawkPlanStatus::CaptureOnly);
    assert(timeline.Pending());
    assert(timeline.Prepare(r).status == MihawkPlanStatus::SubmissionPending);
    timeline.Abort();
    assert(!timeline.Pending() && timeline.LastSubmittedSerial() == 0);
    auto p = timeline.Prepare(r);
    assert(p.CanCapture() && !p.CanGenerate() && p.capture_slot == 0);
    assert(timeline.Commit(p, p.reserved_gpu_serial));
    assert(!timeline.Commit(p, p.reserved_gpu_serial));
    assert(timeline.SlotBusyUntil(0) == 1);

    // GPU hasn't signaled serial 1 yet: second snapshot may be copied, but
    // generation is prohibited because history 0 is still in flight.
    ++r.source.real_frame_id;
    r.source.timestamp_ns += 33'333'333;
    r.reserved_gpu_serial = 2;
    p = timeline.Prepare(r);
    assert(p.status == MihawkPlanStatus::CaptureOnly && p.capture_slot == 1);
    assert(timeline.Commit(p, p.reserved_gpu_serial));
    assert(timeline.SlotBusyUntil(1) == 2);

    // Slot 0 still busy -> skip rather than overwrite the previous source.
    ++r.source.real_frame_id;
    r.source.timestamp_ns += 33'333'333;
    r.reserved_gpu_serial = 3;
    assert(timeline.Prepare(r).status == MihawkPlanStatus::GpuBusy);
    assert(!timeline.Pending());

    // Once completion arrives, re-prime safely with two new real pictures.
    r.completed_gpu_serial = 2;
    ++r.source.real_frame_id;
    r.source.timestamp_ns += 33'333'333;
    p = timeline.Prepare(r);
    assert(p.status == MihawkPlanStatus::CaptureOnly && p.capture_slot == 0);
    assert(timeline.Commit(p, p.reserved_gpu_serial));

    ++r.source.real_frame_id;
    r.source.timestamp_ns += 33'333'333;
    r.reserved_gpu_serial = 4;
    r.completed_gpu_serial = 3;
    p = timeline.Prepare(r);
    assert(p.CanGenerate() && p.capture_slot == 1 && p.previous_slot == 0);
    assert(timeline.Commit(p, p.reserved_gpu_serial));
    assert(timeline.OutputBusyUntil() == 4);
    assert(timeline.SlotBusyUntil(0) == 4);
    assert(timeline.SlotBusyUntil(1) == 4);

    // Synthetic output is still in flight: cannot overwrite even when one
    // source is somehow already free. Every slot remains busy until serial 4.
    ++r.source.real_frame_id;
    r.source.timestamp_ns += 33'333'333;
    r.reserved_gpu_serial = 5;
    assert(timeline.Prepare(r).status == MihawkPlanStatus::GpuBusy);

    r.completed_gpu_serial = 4;
    ++r.source.real_frame_id;
    r.source.timestamp_ns += 33'333'333;
    p = timeline.Prepare(r);
    assert(p.CanCapture() && !p.CanGenerate());
    assert(timeline.Commit(p, p.reserved_gpu_serial));

    // Scene change resets the source pair and never allocates a synthetic
    // image from a stale game / HUD / TV mode.
    ++r.source.real_frame_id;
    r.source.timestamp_ns += 33'333'333;
    r.reserved_gpu_serial = 6;
    r.completed_gpu_serial = 5;
    r.source.scene_reset = true;
    assert(timeline.Prepare(r).status == MihawkPlanStatus::RejectedCadence);
    r.source.scene_reset = false;

    ++r.source.real_frame_id;
    r.source.timestamp_ns += 33'333'333;
    assert(timeline.Prepare(r).status == MihawkPlanStatus::CaptureOnly);
    // Cancel the plan: the renderer must discard the unsent GPU command
    // buffer; no bytes or image lifetimes are claimed by this timeline.
    timeline.Abort();
    assert(!timeline.Pending());

    r.source.overlay_changed = true;
    assert(timeline.Prepare(r).status == MihawkPlanStatus::RejectedCadence);
    r.source.overlay_changed = false;
    r.surface.native_hud_absent = false;
    assert(timeline.Prepare(r).status == MihawkPlanStatus::UnsafeResources);
    r.surface.native_hud_absent = true;
    r.mode = FrameGeneration::Fsr3Vulkan;
    assert(timeline.Prepare(r).status == MihawkPlanStatus::Disabled);
    r.mode = FrameGeneration::Off;
    assert(timeline.Prepare(r).status == MihawkPlanStatus::Disabled);

    // Reject invented or regressed GPU serials, not just bad frame IDs.
    r.mode = FrameGeneration::MihawkGen;
    r.reserved_gpu_serial = 5;
    assert(timeline.Prepare(r).status == MihawkPlanStatus::InvalidSerial);
    r.reserved_gpu_serial = 6;
    r.completed_gpu_serial = 999;
    assert(timeline.Prepare(r).status == MihawkPlanStatus::InvalidSerial);
    // Global timeline can advance beyond the last R08 submission due to
    // ordinary renderer work. That is valid if reservation stays ahead.
    r.reserved_gpu_serial = 1000;
    r.source.real_frame_id++;
    r.source.timestamp_ns += 33'333'333;
    assert(timeline.Prepare(r).status == MihawkPlanStatus::CaptureOnly);
    timeline.Abort();
}
```

`extras/graphics/test_mihawk_vulkan_history_barriers.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#include "mihawk_vulkan_history_barriers.h"
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>

using namespace Eden::FeatureLab;
int main() {
    const auto src = reinterpret_cast<VkImage>(static_cast<uintptr_t>(0x1010));
    const auto dst = reinterpret_cast<VkImage>(static_cast<uintptr_t>(0x2020));
    const auto out = reinterpret_cast<VkImage>(static_cast<uintptr_t>(0x3030));
    auto before = BeforeHistoryCopy(src, dst, false);
    assert(before.source.oldLayout == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL);
    assert(before.source.newLayout == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL);
    assert(before.source.srcAccessMask == VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT);
    assert(before.history.oldLayout == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED);
    assert(before.history.dstAccessMask == VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT);
    assert(before.source.image != before.history.image);
    before = BeforeHistoryCopy(src, dst, true);
    assert(before.history.oldLayout == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL);
    assert(before.history.srcAccessMask == VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT);
    const auto after = AfterHistoryCopy(src, dst);
    assert(after.source.newLayout == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL);
    assert(after.history.newLayout == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL);
    assert(after.history.dstAccessMask == VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT);
    const auto init = BeforeNeuralOutput(dst, false);
    assert(init.oldLayout == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED);
    assert(init.newLayout == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL);
    const auto reinit = BeforeNeuralOutput(dst, true);
    assert(reinit.oldLayout == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL);
    assert(reinit.dstAccessMask == VK_ACCESS_SHADER_WRITE_BIT);
    const auto convert = BeforeGeneratedBlit(dst, out);
    assert(convert.source.oldLayout == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL);
    assert(convert.source.newLayout == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL);
    assert(convert.history.oldLayout == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED);
    assert(convert.history.newLayout == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL);
    assert(AfterGeneratedBlit(out).newLayout == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL);
    assert(AfterGeneratedBlit(out).srcAccessMask == VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT);
}
```

`extras/graphics/test_mihawk_vulkan_record.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Hermetic host test. Records the GPU command sequence with mocked Vulkan
// entry points; no device, real driver or controller is involved.
#include "mihawk_vulkan_stage.h"
#include "mihawk_vulkan_encoder.h"
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <type_traits>
#include <vector>

namespace {
std::vector<char> calls;
std::vector<VkImageMemoryBarrier> captured;
fg_frame_pair last_pair{};
bool neural_available = true;
template <typename T>
T H(std::uintptr_t x) {
    if constexpr (std::is_pointer_v<T>) return reinterpret_cast<T>(x);
    else return static_cast<T>(x);
}
}

bool fg_method_available(const fg_context*, fg_method method) {
    return neural_available && method == FG_METHOD_NEURAL;
}

void fg_record_generate(fg_context*, VkCommandBuffer, uint32_t slot,
                        fg_method method, const fg_frame_pair* pair,
                        VkImageView output) {
    assert(slot == 0 && method == FG_METHOD_NEURAL);
    assert(output == H<VkImageView>(0x12345));
    assert(pair && pair->t == 0.5f);
    calls.push_back('G');
    last_pair = *pair;
}

extern "C" VKAPI_ATTR void VKAPI_CALL vkCmdPipelineBarrier(
    VkCommandBuffer, VkPipelineStageFlags, VkPipelineStageFlags,
    VkDependencyFlags, std::uint32_t, const VkMemoryBarrier*,
    std::uint32_t, const VkBufferMemoryBarrier*,
    std::uint32_t count, const VkImageMemoryBarrier* barriers) {
    calls.push_back('B');
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) captured.push_back(barriers[i]);
}

extern "C" VKAPI_ATTR void VKAPI_CALL vkCmdCopyImage(
    VkCommandBuffer, VkImage src, VkImageLayout src_layout,
    VkImage dst, VkImageLayout dst_layout, std::uint32_t count,
    const VkImageCopy* regions) {
    calls.push_back('C');
    assert(src == H<VkImage>(0x2) && (dst == H<VkImage>(0x3) || dst == H<VkImage>(0x5)));
    assert(src_layout == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL);
    assert(dst_layout == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL);
    assert(count == 1 && regions && regions->extent.width == 1920);
}

extern "C" VKAPI_ATTR void VKAPI_CALL vkCmdBlitImage(
    VkCommandBuffer, VkImage src, VkImageLayout src_layout,
    VkImage dst, VkImageLayout dst_layout, std::uint32_t count,
    const VkImageBlit* regions, VkFilter filter) {
    calls.push_back('L');
    assert(src == H<VkImage>(0x8) && dst == H<VkImage>(0x9));
    assert(src_layout == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL);
    assert(dst_layout == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL);
    assert(count == 1 && regions && regions->srcOffsets[1].x == 1920);
    assert(filter == VK_FILTER_NEAREST);
}

int main() {
    using namespace Eden::FeatureLab;
    MihawkSourceRecord source{};
    source.cmd = H<VkCommandBuffer>(0x1);
    source.source_real = H<VkImage>(0x2);
    source.history_owned = H<VkImage>(0x3);
    source.width = 1920;
    source.height = 1080;
    assert(RecordOwnedSnapshot(source) == MihawkRecordResult::Recorded);
    assert((calls == std::vector<char>{'B','C','B'}));
    assert(captured.size() == 4);
    assert(captured[0].oldLayout == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL);
    assert(captured[1].oldLayout == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED);
    assert(captured[2].newLayout == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL);
    assert(captured[3].newLayout == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL);

    calls.clear(); captured.clear();
    source.history_initialized = true;
    assert(RecordOwnedSnapshot(source) == MihawkRecordResult::Recorded);
    assert(captured[1].oldLayout == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL);

    calls.clear(); captured.clear();
    source.history_owned = source.source_real;
    assert(RecordOwnedSnapshot(source) == MihawkRecordResult::DuplicateImages);
    assert(calls.empty());

    MihawkGenerateRecord r{};
    r.cmd = H<VkCommandBuffer>(0x1);
    r.context = H<fg_context*>(0x100);
    r.previous_owned = H<VkImage>(0x4);
    r.current_owned = H<VkImage>(0x5);
    r.previous_view = H<VkImageView>(0x456);
    r.current_view = H<VkImageView>(0x567);
    r.private_rgba_output = H<VkImage>(0x8);
    r.private_rgba_view = H<VkImageView>(0x12345);
    r.synthetic_present = H<VkImage>(0x9);
    r.width = 1920; r.height = 1080;
    r.context_slot_count = 3;
    r.capabilities = {
        .enabled=true, .native_vulkan=true, .compute_and_storage=true,
        .model_verified_and_loaded=true, .blit_rgba_to_present=true,
        .owned_history_pair=true, .history_matches_source_format=true,
        .private_output_rgba8_storage=true, .present_image_transfer_dst=true,
        .history_descriptor_slots_fenced=true,
        .present_queue_ordered=true, .native_hud_absent=true,
        .available_present_frames=3,
        .width=1920, .height=1080,
        .compositor_format=ColorFormat::Bgra8Unorm
    };
    assert(ValidateNativeMihawkPairInput(r) == MihawkRecordResult::Recorded);
    assert(RecordNativeMihawkPair(r) == MihawkRecordResult::Recorded);
    assert((calls == std::vector<char>{'B','G','B','L','B'}));
    assert(last_pair.prev_color == r.previous_view);
    assert(last_pair.next_color == r.current_view);
    assert(captured.size() == 4);
    assert(captured[0].newLayout == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL);
    assert(captured[1].newLayout == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL);
    assert(captured[2].oldLayout == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED);
    assert(captured[3].newLayout == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL);

    calls.clear(); captured.clear();
    r.output_was_blitted = true;
    assert(RecordNativeMihawkPair(r) == MihawkRecordResult::Recorded);
    assert(captured[0].oldLayout == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL);

    calls.clear(); captured.clear();
    r.capabilities.native_hud_absent = false;
    assert(RecordNativeMihawkPair(r) == MihawkRecordResult::Unsupported);
    r.capabilities.native_hud_absent = true;
    r.synthetic_present = r.previous_owned;
    assert(RecordNativeMihawkPair(r) == MihawkRecordResult::DuplicateImages);
    r.synthetic_present = H<VkImage>(0x9);
    r.descriptor_slot = 4;
    assert(RecordNativeMihawkPair(r) == MihawkRecordResult::InvalidSlot);
    r.descriptor_slot = 0;
    neural_available = false;
    assert(RecordNativeMihawkPair(r) == MihawkRecordResult::NotReady);
    assert(calls.empty()); // no half-recorded frame on error

    // End-to-end *recording* of a frame pair (still no GPU/PS5).
    neural_available = true;
    MihawkVulkanEncoder encoder{};
    MihawkEncoderInput input{};
    input.request.mode = FrameGeneration::MihawkGen;
    input.request.graphics.native_vulkan = true;
    input.request.graphics.mihawk_compute = true;
    input.request.graphics.model_weights_verified_and_loaded = true;
    input.request.graphics.game_fps = 30;
    input.request.surface = r.capabilities;
    input.request.source = {
        .real_frame_id = 1, .timestamp_ns = 1'000'000'000,
        .width = 1920, .height = 1080,
        .output_hz = 60, .display_mode_verified = true
    };
    input.request.reserved_gpu_serial = 1;
    input.commands = H<VkCommandBuffer>(0x1);
    input.real_composited_image = H<VkImage>(0x2);
    input.synthetic_present_image = H<VkImage>(0x9);
    input.neural_context = H<fg_context*>(0x100);
    input.descriptor_slots = 3;
    input.images.history[0] = H<VkImage>(0x3);
    input.images.history[1] = H<VkImage>(0x5);
    input.images.history_view[0] = H<VkImageView>(0x456);
    input.images.history_view[1] = H<VkImageView>(0x567);
    input.images.rgba_output = H<VkImage>(0x8);
    input.images.rgba_view = H<VkImageView>(0x12345);

    // Validating a source before the scheduler assigns a real command
    // buffer is a pure input check, NOT a forged Vulkan handle.
    MihawkSourceRecord preflight{};
    preflight.source_real = input.real_composited_image;
    preflight.history_owned = input.images.history[0];
    preflight.width = input.request.source.width;
    preflight.height = input.request.source.height;
    assert(ValidateOwnedSnapshotInput(preflight) == MihawkRecordResult::Recorded);
    assert(ValidateOwnedSnapshot(preflight) == MihawkRecordResult::InvalidHandles);
    preflight.history_owned = preflight.source_real;
    assert(ValidateOwnedSnapshotInput(preflight) == MihawkRecordResult::DuplicateImages);

    calls.clear(); captured.clear();
    auto encoded = encoder.Record(input);
    assert(encoded.IsRecorded() && !encoded.WillPresentSynthetic());
    assert((calls == std::vector<char>{'B','C','B'}));
    auto pending = encoder.Record(input);
    assert(pending.plan.status == MihawkPlanStatus::SubmissionPending);
    assert((calls == std::vector<char>{'B','C','B'}));
    assert(encoder.Commit(encoded, encoded.plan.reserved_gpu_serial));
    assert(!encoder.Commit(encoded, encoded.plan.reserved_gpu_serial));


    ++input.request.source.real_frame_id;
    input.request.source.timestamp_ns += 33'333'333;
    input.request.completed_gpu_serial = 1;
    input.request.reserved_gpu_serial = 2;
    calls.clear(); captured.clear();
    encoded = encoder.Record(input);
    assert(encoded.IsRecorded() && encoded.WillPresentSynthetic());
    assert((calls == std::vector<char>{'B','C','B','B','G','B','L','B'}));
    assert(last_pair.prev_color == input.images.history_view[0]);
    assert(last_pair.next_color == input.images.history_view[1]);
    assert(encoder.Commit(encoded, encoded.plan.reserved_gpu_serial));


    // Do not copy into a snapshot still referenced by neural work.
    ++input.request.source.real_frame_id;
    input.request.source.timestamp_ns += 33'333'333;
    input.request.reserved_gpu_serial = 3;
    calls.clear(); captured.clear();
    encoded = encoder.Record(input);
    assert(!encoded.IsRecorded());
    assert(encoded.plan.status == MihawkPlanStatus::GpuBusy);
    assert(calls.empty());

    ++input.request.source.real_frame_id;
    input.request.source.timestamp_ns += 33'333'333;
    input.request.completed_gpu_serial = 2;
    calls.clear(); captured.clear();
    encoded = encoder.Record(input);
    assert(encoded.IsRecorded() && !encoded.WillPresentSynthetic());
    assert((calls == std::vector<char>{'B','C','B'}));
    assert(encoder.Commit(encoded, encoded.plan.reserved_gpu_serial));

    // Before recording even the first copy, reject unavailable neural model.
    ++input.request.source.real_frame_id;
    input.request.source.timestamp_ns += 33'333'333;
    input.request.reserved_gpu_serial = 4;
    input.request.completed_gpu_serial = 3;
    neural_available = false;
    calls.clear(); captured.clear();
    encoded = encoder.Record(input);
    assert(!encoded.IsRecorded() && encoded.recording == MihawkRecordResult::NotReady);
    assert(calls.empty());
    neural_available = true;

    // A HUD that cannot be separated from the game image fails closed.
    input.request.surface.native_hud_absent = false;
    encoded = encoder.Record(input);
    assert(!encoded.IsRecorded() && encoded.plan.status == MihawkPlanStatus::UnsafeResources);
    assert(calls.empty());

    // Even if Vulkan recycles identical opaque VkImage handles, an allocation
    // generation change discards the encoder's old history and layouts.
    input.request.surface.native_hud_absent = true;
    ++input.images.resource_generation;
    ++input.request.source.real_frame_id;
    input.request.source.timestamp_ns += 33'333'333;
    calls.clear(); captured.clear();
    encoded = encoder.Record(input);
    assert(encoded.IsRecorded() && !encoded.WillPresentSynthetic());
    assert(captured[1].oldLayout == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED);
    encoder.Abort();
    assert(calls.size() == 3);
}
```

`extras/graphics/test_mihawk_vulkan_resources.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// No GPU: mocked allocation, format support, and lifetime failure paths.
#include "mihawk_vulkan_resources.h"
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <type_traits>

namespace {
int created = 0, views = 0, allocations = 0, bound = 0;
int destroyed = 0, destroyed_views = 0, freed = 0, waited = 0;
int fail_image_at = 0, fail_view_at = 0, fail_mem_at = 0, fail_bind_at = 0;
bool permit_format = true, permit_local = true;

template<typename T> T H(std::uintptr_t x) {
    if constexpr (std::is_pointer_v<T>) return reinterpret_cast<T>(x);
    else return static_cast<T>(x);
}
void Reset() {
    created = views = allocations = bound = 0;
    destroyed = destroyed_views = freed = waited = 0;
    fail_image_at = fail_view_at = fail_mem_at = fail_bind_at = 0;
    permit_format = permit_local = true;
}
}

extern "C" VKAPI_ATTR void VKAPI_CALL vkGetPhysicalDeviceFormatProperties(
    VkPhysicalDevice, VkFormat, VkFormatProperties* props) {
    *props = {};
    props->optimalTilingFeatures = permit_format ?
        VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_SAMPLED_IMAGE_BIT | VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT |
        VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT | VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_STORAGE_IMAGE_BIT |
        VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_BLIT_SRC_BIT | VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_BLIT_DST_BIT : 0U;
}
extern "C" VKAPI_ATTR void VKAPI_CALL vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties(
    VkPhysicalDevice, VkPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties* props) {
    *props = {};
    props->memoryTypeCount = 2;
    props->memoryTypes[0].propertyFlags = VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT;
    props->memoryTypes[1].propertyFlags =
        permit_local ? VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_DEVICE_LOCAL_BIT : VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT;
}
extern "C" VKAPI_ATTR VkResult VKAPI_CALL vkCreateImage(
    VkDevice, const VkImageCreateInfo* info, const VkAllocationCallbacks*, VkImage* image) {
    assert(info && info->extent.width == 1920 && info->extent.height == 1080);
    assert(info->format == VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM ||
           info->format == VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM);
    ++created;
    if (created == fail_image_at) {
        *image = H<VkImage>(0xdead); // failed output is untrusted
        return VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DEVICE_MEMORY;
    }
    *image = H<VkImage>(0x100 + created);
    return VK_SUCCESS;
}
extern "C" VKAPI_ATTR void VKAPI_CALL vkGetImageMemoryRequirements(
    VkDevice, VkImage, VkMemoryRequirements* r) {
    *r = {};
    r->size = 8u * 1024 * 1024;
    r->alignment = 256;
    r->memoryTypeBits = 3;
}
extern "C" VKAPI_ATTR VkResult VKAPI_CALL vkAllocateMemory(
    VkDevice, const VkMemoryAllocateInfo* info, const VkAllocationCallbacks*,
    VkDeviceMemory* memory) {
    assert(info && info->allocationSize == 8u * 1024 * 1024);
    assert(info->memoryTypeIndex == 1);
    ++allocations;
    if (allocations == fail_mem_at) {
        *memory = H<VkDeviceMemory>(0xbeef);
        return VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DEVICE_MEMORY;
    }
    *memory = H<VkDeviceMemory>(0x200 + allocations);
    return VK_SUCCESS;
}
extern "C" VKAPI_ATTR VkResult VKAPI_CALL vkBindImageMemory(
    VkDevice, VkImage, VkDeviceMemory, VkDeviceSize offset) {
    assert(offset == 0);
    ++bound;
    return bound == fail_bind_at ? VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DEVICE_MEMORY : VK_SUCCESS;
}
extern "C" VKAPI_ATTR VkResult VKAPI_CALL vkCreateImageView(
    VkDevice, const VkImageViewCreateInfo* info, const VkAllocationCallbacks*,
    VkImageView* view) {
    assert(info && info->subresourceRange.aspectMask == VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT);
    ++views;
    if (views == fail_view_at) {
        *view = H<VkImageView>(0xcafe);
        return VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DEVICE_MEMORY;
    }
    *view = H<VkImageView>(0x300 + views);
    return VK_SUCCESS;
}
extern "C" VKAPI_ATTR void VKAPI_CALL vkDestroyImageView(
    VkDevice, VkImageView v, const VkAllocationCallbacks*) {
    assert(v != H<VkImageView>(0xcafe));
    ++destroyed_views;
}
extern "C" VKAPI_ATTR void VKAPI_CALL vkDestroyImage(
    VkDevice, VkImage i, const VkAllocationCallbacks*) {
    assert(i != H<VkImage>(0xdead));
    ++destroyed;
}
extern "C" VKAPI_ATTR void VKAPI_CALL vkFreeMemory(
    VkDevice, VkDeviceMemory m, const VkAllocationCallbacks*) {
    assert(m != H<VkDeviceMemory>(0xbeef));
    ++freed;
}
extern "C" VKAPI_ATTR VkResult VKAPI_CALL vkDeviceWaitIdle(VkDevice) {
    ++waited;
    return VK_SUCCESS;
}
int main() {
    using namespace Eden::FeatureLab;
    const auto device = H<VkDevice>(0x1);
    const auto physical = H<VkPhysicalDevice>(0x2);
    Reset();
    {
        MihawkVulkanResources images;
        assert(images.Create(device, physical, 1920, 1080,
                             VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM) == MihawkAllocateError::None);
        assert(images.IsReady());
        assert(images.Generation() == 1);
        assert(images.SourceFormat() == VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM);
        assert(images.AllocatedBytes() == 24u * 1024 * 1024);
        assert(images.History(0).image != images.History(1).image);
        assert(images.RgbaOutput().image != images.History(0).image);
        assert(images.Create(device, physical, 1920, 1080,
                             VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM) == MihawkAllocateError::AlreadyAllocated);
        images.MarkInitialized(0);
        assert(images.Initialized(0) && !images.Initialized(1));
        images.ResetHistory();
        assert(!images.Initialized(0));
    }
    assert(created == 3 && destroyed == 3);
    assert(allocations == 3 && freed == 3 && views == 3 && destroyed_views == 3);
    assert(waited == 1);

    Reset();
    {
        MihawkVulkanResources images;
        permit_format = false;
        assert(images.Create(device, physical, 1920, 1080,
                             VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM) == MihawkAllocateError::UnsupportedFormat);
        assert(created == 0);
        permit_format = true;
        assert(images.Create(device, physical, 1920, 1080,
                             VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM, 16u*1024*1024) ==
               MihawkAllocateError::ExcessiveMemory);
        assert(!images.IsReady() && destroyed == 3 && freed == 2 && waited == 0);
    }

    Reset();
    permit_local = false;
    {
        MihawkVulkanResources images;
        assert(images.Create(device, physical, 1920, 1080,
                             VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM) == MihawkAllocateError::NoDeviceLocalMemory);
        assert(created == 1 && destroyed == 1 && freed == 0 && waited == 0);
    }

    Reset();
    fail_image_at = 2;
    {
        MihawkVulkanResources images;
        assert(images.Create(device, physical, 1920, 1080,
                             VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM) == MihawkAllocateError::ImageCreationFailed);
        assert(created == 2 && destroyed == 1 && freed == 1);
    }
    Reset();
    fail_mem_at = 2;
    {
        MihawkVulkanResources images;
        assert(images.Create(device, physical, 1920, 1080,
                             VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM) == MihawkAllocateError::AllocationFailed);
        assert(created == 2 && destroyed == 2 && freed == 1);
    }
    Reset();
    fail_view_at = 2;
    {
        MihawkVulkanResources images;
        assert(images.Create(device, physical, 1920, 1080,
                             VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM) == MihawkAllocateError::ViewCreationFailed);
        assert(created == 2 && destroyed == 2 && freed == 2 && destroyed_views == 1);
    }
}
```

`extras/graphics/test_msaa_force_policy.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#include "msaa_force_policy.h"
#include <initializer_list>

#include <cassert>
using namespace Eden::Graphics::MsaaForce;

int main() {
    const Limits ps5like{
        .vulkan=true,
        .framebuffer_color_sample_bits=0x1F,
        .framebuffer_depth_sample_bits=0x0F,
        .color_format_sample_bits=0x1F,
        .depth_format_sample_bits=0x0F,
        .max_framebuffer_width=8192,
        .max_framebuffer_height=8192,
        .free_transient_bytes=512ULL*1024*1024,
    };
    const GuestPass guest{.width=1920,.height=1080,
                          .guest_samples=1,.color_bytes_per_pixel=4,
                          .depth_bytes_per_pixel=4,.render_target_count=1,
                          .uses_depth=true};
    assert(Evaluate(Requested::Auto,guest,ps5like).decision==Decision::NativeAuto);
    for (const auto r : {Requested::X2,Requested::X4,Requested::X8}) {
        // Important: a GPU advertising MSAA != a working forced-MSAA path!
        assert(Evaluate(r,guest,ps5like).decision==
               Decision::ShadowRendererNotImplemented);
    }
    assert(Evaluate(Requested::X16,guest,ps5like).decision==
           Decision::UnsupportedFrameFormat); // depth lacks x16
    auto limits=ps5like;
    limits.framebuffer_depth_sample_bits|=0x10;
    limits.depth_format_sample_bits|=0x10;
    assert(Evaluate(Requested::X16,guest,limits).decision==
           Decision::ShadowRendererNotImplemented);
    auto guest4=guest;
    guest4.guest_samples=4;
    assert(Evaluate(Requested::X2,guest4,limits).decision==
           Decision::NativeGuestSamplesAlreadySatisfy);
    assert(Evaluate(Requested::X4,guest4,limits).decision==
           Decision::NativeGuestSamplesAlreadySatisfy);
    assert(Evaluate(Requested::X8,guest4,limits).decision==
           Decision::GuestMultisampleTopologyConflict);
    auto guest16=guest;
    guest16.guest_samples=16;
    assert(Evaluate(Requested::X16,guest16,ps5like).decision==
           Decision::NativeGuestSamplesAlreadySatisfy);
    auto noVulkan=limits;
    noVulkan.vulkan=false;
    assert(Evaluate(Requested::X4,guest,noVulkan).decision==
           Decision::RequiresVulkan);
    auto noFormat=limits;
    noFormat.color_format_sample_bits=0x3;
    assert(Evaluate(Requested::X4,guest,noFormat).decision==
           Decision::UnsupportedFrameFormat);
    auto budget=limits;
    budget.free_transient_bytes=1;
    assert(Evaluate(Requested::X2,guest,budget).decision==
           Decision::UnsupportedBudget);
    budget.free_transient_bytes=0;
    assert(Evaluate(Requested::X2,guest,budget).decision==
           Decision::UnsupportedBudget);
    auto readback=guest;
    readback.multisample_guest_reads=true;
    assert(Evaluate(Requested::X4,readback,limits).decision==
           Decision::UnsupportedMultisampleRead);
    auto aliased=guest;
    aliased.storage_or_alias_attachments=true;
    assert(Evaluate(Requested::X4,aliased,limits).decision==
           Decision::UnsupportedMultisampleRead);
    auto noSize=guest;
    noSize.width=0;
    assert(Evaluate(Requested::X4,noSize,limits).decision==
           Decision::UnsupportedDimensions);
    Implementation full{
        .native_shadow_color=true,.native_shadow_depth=true,
        .resolve_color_to_guest=true,.resolve_depth_to_guest=true,
        .guest_layout_preserved=true,.sampled_guest_reads_coherent=true,
    };
    // CandidateOnly must never be displayed as 'MSAA applied'.
    assert(Evaluate(Requested::X4,guest,limits,full).decision==
           Decision::CandidateOnly);
    auto missing=full;
    missing.resolve_depth_to_guest=false;
    assert(Evaluate(Requested::X4,guest,limits,missing).decision==
           Decision::ShadowRendererNotImplemented);
    auto noDepth=guest;
    noDepth.uses_depth=false;
    assert(Evaluate(Requested::X16,noDepth,ps5like,missing).decision==
           Decision::CandidateOnly);
    assert(Evaluate(static_cast<Requested>(3),guest,limits).decision==
           Decision::UnsupportedRequest);
    // Native Vulkan pipeline/renderpass compatibility is mandatory even
    // when the GPU format and transient allocation are eligible.
    NativeDrawBinding binding{
        .shadow_renderpass=17,.graphics_pipeline_renderpass=17,
        .shadow_samples=4,.graphics_pipeline_samples=4,
        .guest_clear_verified=true,
    };
    assert(CompatibleNativeDraw(binding));
    binding.graphics_pipeline_samples=1;
    assert(!CompatibleNativeDraw(binding));
    binding.graphics_pipeline_samples=4;
    binding.graphics_pipeline_renderpass=18;
    assert(!CompatibleNativeDraw(binding));
    binding.graphics_pipeline_renderpass=17;
    binding.shader_read_aliases_target=true;
    assert(!CompatibleNativeDraw(binding));
    binding.shader_read_aliases_target=false;
    binding.guest_clear_verified=false;
    assert(!CompatibleNativeDraw(binding));
    binding.guest_clear_verified=true;
    binding.shadow_samples=1;
    assert(!CompatibleNativeDraw(binding));
    binding.shadow_samples=4;
    binding.shadow_renderpass=0;
    assert(!CompatibleNativeDraw(binding));

    const auto usage=Evaluate(Requested::X16,guest,limits,full);
    assert(usage.estimated_attachment_bytes==1920ULL*1080*8*16);
}
```

`extras/graphics/test_nr_dll_launch_preflight.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Source-only R09 regression: Original user DLL admission is fail closed.
// No proprietary model bytes or console execution in this host test.
#include "nr_dll_launch_preflight.h"
#include <cassert>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <vector>
#include <string_view>
#include <cstdint>
namespace fs=std::filesystem;
int main(){
    using Eden::Graphics::PrepareR09UserModel;
    const auto root=fs::temp_directory_path()/
        "encore-r09-dll-launch-admission-regression";
    const auto user=root/"user",config=root/"config";
    std::error_code ec;
    fs::remove_all(root,ec);
    fs::create_directories(user/"dlssnr",ec);
    assert(!ec);
    fs::create_directories(config/"neural",ec);
    assert(!ec);
    constexpr int off=Eden::NeuralVideo::kOff;
    constexpr int a4k=Eden::NeuralVideo::kA4kDetail;
    constexpr int original=Eden::NeuralVideo::kDlssOriginal;
    constexpr int compact=Eden::NeuralVideo::kDlssCompact;
    assert(PrepareR09UserModel(off,user,config).ready);
    assert(PrepareR09UserModel(a4k,user,config).ready);
    assert(!PrepareR09UserModel(original,user,config).ready);
    assert(!PrepareR09UserModel(compact,user,config).ready);
    // A corrupted private .nrmodel is NOT a substitute for an authentic DLL.
    {
        std::ofstream bad(config/"neural/original.nrmodel",std::ios::binary);
        bad << "NRMODEL1";
    }
    assert(!PrepareR09UserModel(original,user,config).ready);
    // An index with all 599 canonical names and correctly sized
    // learned projections is NOT an authentic model. The exact tensor
    // digest gate must reject it before any guest/Vulkan initialization.
    {
        namespace NR=Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;
        auto& names=NR::R09OriginalManifest;
        std::size_t index_size=16u;
        for(const auto name:names)index_size+=4u+name.size()+16u;
        auto align=[](std::uint64_t v){
            return (v+255u)&~std::uint64_t(255u);
        };
        const auto put32=[](std::vector<unsigned char>& out,std::uint32_t n){
            for(unsigned i=0;i<4;++i)out.push_back(
                static_cast<unsigned char>(n>>(8*i)));
        };
        const auto put64=[](std::vector<unsigned char>& out,std::uint64_t n){
            for(unsigned i=0;i<8;++i)out.push_back(
                static_cast<unsigned char>(n>>(8*i)));
        };
        std::vector<unsigned char> image;
        for(char c:std::string_view("NRMODEL1"))
            image.push_back(static_cast<unsigned char>(c));
        put32(image,static_cast<std::uint32_t>(names.size()));
        put32(image,0u);
        std::uint64_t cursor=align(index_size);
        for(const auto name:names){
            put32(image,static_cast<std::uint32_t>(name.size()));
            for(char c:name)image.push_back(static_cast<unsigned char>(c));
            const bool projection=name.ends_with("input_lift.bin")||
                                  name.ends_with("out_project.bin");
            const std::uint64_t size=projection?1024u:1u;
            put64(image,cursor);
            put64(image,size);
            cursor=align(cursor+size);
        }
        assert(image.size()==index_size);
        image.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(cursor),0u);
        std::ofstream fakepack(config/"neural/original.nrmodel",
                               std::ios::binary|std::ios::trunc);
        fakepack.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(image.data()),
                       static_cast<std::streamsize>(image.size()));
        fakepack.close();
        assert(!Eden::Graphics::R09UsableCachedPack(
                   config/"neural/original.nrmodel",
                   NR::R09ModelVariant::Original));
    }
    // A plausible MZ header passes the menu-level metadata sniff but
    // cannot pass the native PE/resource cryptographic importer.
    const auto dll=user/"dlssnr/nvngx_dlssnr.dll";
    {
        std::ofstream fake(dll,std::ios::binary);
        fake << "MZ";
        const std::string zeros(2048,char(0));
        fake.write(zeros.data(),static_cast<std::streamsize>(zeros.size()));
    }
    const auto rejected=PrepareR09UserModel(original,user,config);
    assert(!rejected.ready&&!rejected.imported&&rejected.reason);
    // No false claim that Original bytes can satisfy Compact.
    const auto compact_result=PrepareR09UserModel(compact,user,config);
    assert(!compact_result.ready&&!compact_result.imported);
    fs::remove_all(root,ec);
    assert(!ec);
}
```

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Host regression: the user DLL is checked at menu time (no PE execution).

#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <string>

namespace fs=std::filesystem;
using Eden::Graphics::DlssNrUserFileLooksValid;

static void WriteFake(const fs::path& file,bool valid,std::size_t length=1024u) {
    std::ofstream out(file,std::ios::binary|std::ios::trunc);
    assert(out);
    out.write(valid?"MZ":"NO",2);
    std::array<char,1022> zeros{};

        out.write(zeros.data(),static_cast<std::streamsize>(length-2u));
    out.close();

int main() {
    const auto root=fs::temp_directory_path()/"eden-encore-r09-user-dll-alert-host";
    std::error_code ec;
    fs::remove_all(root,ec);
    const auto user=root/"user", config=root/"config";
    fs::create_directories(user/"dlssnr",ec);
    assert(!ec);
    fs::create_directories(config/"neural",ec);
    assert(!ec);
    const auto first=user/"dlssnr/nvngx_dlssnr.dll";
    const auto old=config/"neural/nvngx_dlssnr.dll";
    assert(!DlssNrUserFileLooksValid(user,config));
    WriteFake(first,true,100u);
    assert(!DlssNrUserFileLooksValid(user,config));

    assert(!DlssNrUserFileLooksValid(user,config));
    WriteFake(first,true);
    assert(DlssNrUserFileLooksValid(user,config));
    fs::remove(first,ec);
    assert(!DlssNrUserFileLooksValid(user,config));
    WriteFake(old,true);
    assert(DlssNrUserFileLooksValid(user,config));
    fs::remove(old,ec);
    assert(!DlssNrUserFileLooksValid(user,config));
    WriteFake(old,true);
    fs::create_symlink(old,first,ec);
    assert(!ec);
    // Do not follow a user-controlled symlink into a private model source.
    assert(DlssNrUserFileLooksValid(user,config)); // valid old path remains
```

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
#include "rdna2_nr_bottleneck_route_policy.h"
#include <cassert>

static void Check(const char* file,bool original){
    std::ifstream in(file,std::ios::binary);
    assert(in);
    const std::string text{std::istreambuf_iterator<char>{in},
                           std::istreambuf_iterator<char>{}};
    std::vector<NativePlanStep> rows;
    assert(ParseNativePlan(text,rows)==NativePlanError::Ok);
    NativeSplitRoutes split{};
    NativeVitRoute vit{};
    assert(BuildNativeSplitRoutes(rows,split)==SplitNativeRoutesError::Ok);
    assert(BuildNativeVitRoute(rows,vit)==NativeVitRouteError::Ok);

    assert(split.runs[1].count==(original?8u:2u));

    assert(vit.decoder_block==(original?39u:19u));
    assert(vit.raster_width==33u&&vit.raster_height==60u);
    auto bad=vit;bad.decoder_block++;
    assert(!CanLinkNativeNrBottleneckRoutes(split,bad));
    bad=vit;bad.input_split_block++;
    assert(!CanLinkNativeNrBottleneckRoutes(split,bad));
    bad=vit;bad.raster_width++;
    assert(!CanLinkNativeNrBottleneckRoutes(split,bad));
    bad=vit;bad.blocks[3].input_block++;
    assert(!CanLinkNativeNrBottleneckRoutes(split,bad));
    auto missing=split;missing.runs[1].count--;
    assert(!CanLinkNativeNrBottleneckRoutes(missing,vit));
    missing=split;missing.blocks[missing.runs[0].start+
                                 missing.runs[0].count-1u].
                       plan.has_pooled_projection=false;
    assert(!CanLinkNativeNrBottleneckRoutes(missing,vit));
}
```

`extras/graphics/test_rdna2_nr_decoder_model_loader.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Generated NRMODEL1 only: matrix [512,1024], finite FP16[512], fail-atomic.
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/nr_rdna2_decoder_model_loader.h"
#include <cassert>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
using namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;
namespace {
struct Entry{std::string name;std::vector<std::uint8_t> body;};
void U32(std::vector<std::uint8_t>& d,std::uint32_t n){
    for(unsigned k=0u;k<4u;++k)d.push_back(std::uint8_t(n>>(k*8u)));
}
void U64(std::vector<std::uint8_t>& d,std::uint64_t n){
    for(unsigned k=0u;k<8u;++k)d.push_back(std::uint8_t(n>>(k*8u)));
}
void PatchU64(std::vector<std::uint8_t>& d,std::size_t at,
              std::uint64_t n){
    for(unsigned k=0u;k<8u;++k)d[at+k]=std::uint8_t(n>>(k*8u));
}
void Save(const std::filesystem::path& file,const std::vector<Entry>& entries){
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> bytes{'N','R','M','O','D','E','L','1'};
    U32(bytes,std::uint32_t(entries.size()));U32(bytes,0u);
    std::vector<std::size_t> slots;
    for(const auto& entry:entries){
        U32(bytes,std::uint32_t(entry.name.size()));
        bytes.insert(bytes.end(),entry.name.begin(),entry.name.end());
        slots.push_back(bytes.size());
        U64(bytes,0u);U64(bytes,entry.body.size());
    }
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<entries.size();++i){
        bytes.resize((bytes.size()+255u)&~std::size_t(255u),0u);
        PatchU64(bytes,slots[i],bytes.size());
        bytes.insert(bytes.end(),entries[i].body.begin(),entries[i].body.end());
    }
    std::ofstream f(file,std::ios::binary|std::ios::trunc);
    assert(f.good());
    f.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(bytes.data()),
            static_cast<std::streamsize>(bytes.size()));
    assert(f.good());
}
}
int main(){
    const auto path=std::filesystem::temp_directory_path()/
        ("encore-decoder-model-"+std::to_string(
            std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch().count())+
         ".nrmodel1");
    const std::string prefix="unpacked-splitswin/block39.layer0.layer";
    std::vector<Entry> data{
        {prefix+".weight.bin",std::vector<std::uint8_t>(512u*1024u,0x38u)},
        {prefix+".skip_weight.bin",std::vector<std::uint8_t>(1024u,0u)}};
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<512u;++i)data[1].body[2u*i+1u]=0x3cu;
    data[0].body[0u]=0u;
    Save(path,data);
    NeuralModelFile model;
    assert(model.Open(path.string()));
    NativeDecoderModelWeights out;
    assert(PrepareNativeDecoderModelWeights(model,39u,out));
    assert(out.matrix.size()==512u*1024u);
    assert(out.matrix[0]==0x80u&&out.matrix[1]==0x38u);
    assert(out.skip_gain.size()==1024u);
    assert(out.skip_gain[0]==0u&&out.skip_gain[1]==0x3cu);
    assert(!PrepareNativeDecoderModelWeights(model,19u,out));
    assert(out.matrix.empty()&&out.skip_gain.empty());
    assert(!PrepareNativeDecoderModelWeights(model,512u,out));
    assert(out.matrix.empty());
    data[0].body[100u]=0x7fu;Save(path,data);
    assert(model.Open(path.string()));
    assert(!PrepareNativeDecoderModelWeights(model,39u,out));
    assert(out.matrix.empty()&&out.skip_gain.empty());
    data[0].body[100u]=0x38u;
    data[1].body[1u]=0x7cu; // FP16 +inf is rejected
    Save(path,data);assert(model.Open(path.string()));
    assert(!PrepareNativeDecoderModelWeights(model,39u,out));
    assert(out.matrix.empty()&&out.skip_gain.empty());
    data[1].body[1u]=0x3cu;
    data[1].body.pop_back();Save(path,data);
    assert(model.Open(path.string()));
    assert(!PrepareNativeDecoderModelWeights(model,39u,out));
    assert(out.matrix.empty()&&out.skip_gain.empty());
    std::filesystem::remove(path);
}
```

`extras/graphics/test_rdna2_nr_decoder_projection_policy.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Native Original/Compact decoder learned GEMM: 33x60 live pixels,
 // ViT 2160 padded FP8 tokens -> linear 1980 GEMM rows -> 2160 FP16 tiles.
#include "rdna2_nr_decoder_projection_policy.h"
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>
using namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;
int main(){
    static_assert(DecoderTileTokens(33u,60u)==2160u);
    static_assert(DecoderTileTokens(4u,8u)==32u);
    constexpr DecoderProjectionCapacity native{
        1980ull*1024u,512ull*1024u,1024ull*512u*4u,
        2160ull*512u*2u};
    DecoderProjectionBatches plan{};
    assert(BuildDecoderProjectionBatches(33u,60u,native,plan));
    assert(ValidDecoderProjectionBatches(plan));
    assert(plan.count==2u&&plan.pixels==1980u&&plan.tokens==2160u);
    assert(plan.slices[0].projection.tokens==1024u);
    assert(plan.slices[1].projection.tokens==956u);
    assert(plan.slices[1].projection.a_base_bytes==1024u*1024u);
    assert(plan.slices[1].convert.output_offset_halfwords==1024u*512u);
    assert(plan.slices[1].convert.elements==956u*512u);
    assert(plan.slices[1].convert.width==33u&&plan.slices[1].convert.height==60u);
    assert(CanDecoderFp32ToFp16(plan.slices[1].convert,
                               plan.slices[1].conversion_storage));
    auto invalid=native;invalid.linear_input--;
    assert(!BuildDecoderProjectionBatches(33u,60u,invalid,plan));
    invalid=native;invalid.weights--;
    assert(!BuildDecoderProjectionBatches(33u,60u,invalid,plan));
    invalid=native;invalid.fp32_scratch=511u*4u;
    assert(!BuildDecoderProjectionBatches(33u,60u,invalid,plan));
    invalid=native;invalid.fp16_projected--;
    assert(!BuildDecoderProjectionBatches(33u,60u,invalid,plan));
    assert(!BuildDecoderProjectionBatches(0u,60u,native,plan));
    assert(!BuildDecoderProjectionBatches(33u,4097u,native,plan));
    constexpr DecoderFp32ToFp16Storage cap{
        1024ull*512u*4u,2160ull*512u*2u};
    assert(!CanDecoderFp32ToFp16({512u,0u,1u,33u,60u},cap));
    assert(!CanDecoderFp32ToFp16({513u,0u,0u,33u,60u},cap));
    assert(!CanDecoderFp32ToFp16({512u,0u,0u,33u,60u},
                                 {2047u,cap.output_bytes}));
    assert(!CanDecoderFp32ToFp16({512u,0u,0u,33u,60u},
                                 {cap.input_bytes,cap.output_bytes-1u}));
    assert(!CanDecoderFp32ToFp16(
        {512u,0u,1980u*512u,33u,60u},cap));
    assert(BuildDecoderProjectionBatches(33u,60u,native,plan));
    plan.slices[1].projection.a_base_bytes=0u;
    assert(!ValidDecoderProjectionBatches(plan));
    assert(BuildDecoderProjectionBatches(33u,60u,native,plan));
    plan.slices[1].convert.output_offset_halfwords=0u;
    assert(!ValidDecoderProjectionBatches(plan));
    assert(BuildDecoderProjectionBatches(33u,60u,native,plan));
    plan.slices[1].convert.width=60u;
    assert(!ValidDecoderProjectionBatches(plan));
    // Every valid 33x60 raster pixel is written to one unique padded
    // 4x4 tile (plus its 256 independent FP16 pairs).
    std::vector<bool> occupied(2160u,false);
    for(std::uint32_t pixel=0u;pixel<1980u;++pixel){
        const auto x=pixel%33u,y=pixel/33u;
        const auto t=((y/4u)*9u+x/4u)*16u+
                     (y%4u)*4u+x%4u;
        assert(t<occupied.size()&&!occupied[t]);
        occupied[t]=true;
        assert(t*256ull+255u<cap.output_bytes/4u);
    }
    std::uint32_t live=0;
    for(bool filled:occupied)live+=filled;
    assert(live==1980u);
    constexpr DecoderProjectionCapacity legacy{
        32ull*1024u,512ull*1024u,32ull*512u*4u,
        32ull*512u*2u};
    assert(BuildDecoderProjectionBatches(4u,8u,legacy,plan));
    assert(ValidDecoderProjectionBatches(plan));
}
```

`extras/graphics/test_rdna2_nr_decoder_tile_to_linear_policy.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Uniqueness + capacity for all 1980 raster pixels of the native 33x60
// ViT tiles, including the non-multiple-of-four final column.
#include "rdna2_nr_decoder_tile_to_linear_policy.h"
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>
using namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;
static void Verify(std::uint32_t w,std::uint32_t h){
    const DecoderTileToLinear p{w,h};
    const auto pixels=std::uint64_t(w)*h;
    const auto tiles=DecoderTileCount(p);
    assert(CanDecoderTileToLinear(p,{
        tiles*1024u,pixels*1024u}));
    assert(!CanDecoderTileToLinear(p,{
        tiles*1024u-1u,pixels*1024u}));
    assert(!CanDecoderTileToLinear(p,{
        tiles*1024u,pixels*1024u-1u}));
    std::vector<bool> seen(tiles,false);
    const auto cols=(w+3u)/4u;
    for(std::uint32_t pixel=0u;pixel<pixels;++pixel){
        const auto x=pixel%w,y=pixel/w;
        const auto t=((y/4u)*cols+x/4u)*16u+
                     (y%4u)*4u+x%4u;
        assert(t<tiles&&!seen[t]);
        seen[t]=true;
        // The shader copies all 256 uint32 words of C1024.
        assert(pixel*256ull+255u<pixels*256u);
        assert(t*256ull+255u<tiles*256u);
    }
    std::uint32_t mapped=0u;
    for(auto yes:seen)mapped+=yes;
    assert(mapped==pixels);
}
int main(){
    static_assert(DecoderTileCount({33u,60u})==2160u);
    Verify(33u,60u);
    Verify(7u,13u);
    Verify(4u,8u);
    Verify(1u,1u);
    assert(!CanDecoderTileToLinear({0u,60u},{
        UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX}));
    assert(!CanDecoderTileToLinear({4096u,4096u},{
        UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX}));
    // Raster pixel 32,59 must be tiled token 2156; treating source
    // as linear would read token 1979, a silent wrong-image error.
    constexpr std::uint32_t t=((59u/4u)*9u+32u/4u)*16u+
                              (59u%4u)*4u+32u%4u;
    static_assert(t==2156u);
    static_assert(t!=59u*33u+32u);
}
```

`extras/graphics/test_rdna2_nr_decoder_upsample_policy.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Decoder upsample bounds, 512-channel tiled address, and FP8 reference values.
#include <cassert>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>
#include "rdna2_nr_decoder_upsample_policy.h"
using namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;
static std::uint32_t token(std::uint32_t x,std::uint32_t y,std::uint32_t w){
    return ((y/4)*((w+3)/4)+x/4)*16+(y%4)*4+x%4;
}
static std::uint32_t at(std::uint32_t t,std::uint32_t c){
    return ((t/16)*32+c/16)*256+(t%16)*16+c%16;
}
static std::uint32_t quant(float v) {
    unsigned sign=(std::signbit(v)?128u:0u);
    if(std::isnan(v))return sign|127u;
    float a=std::fmin(std::fabs(v),448.f);
    if(a<0.015625f) {
        auto q=static_cast<unsigned>(std::nearbyint(a*512.f));
        return sign|(q>=8u?8u:q);
    }
    int e=static_cast<int>(std::floor(std::log2(a)));
    auto m=static_cast<unsigned>(std::nearbyint((a/std::exp2(float(e))-1.f)*8.f));
    if(m==8u){++e;m=0;}
    unsigned ex=static_cast<unsigned>(e+7);
    if(ex>15u || (ex==15u && m>6u))return sign|126u;
    return sign|(ex<<3u)|m;
}
int main(){
    DecoderUpsample p{0,32768,65536,0,4,8,8};
    DecoderStorage s{16384,98304,131072,1024};
    assert(CanDecoderUpsample(p,s));
    assert(!CanDecoderUpsample(p,{16383,98304,131072,1024}));
    assert(!CanDecoderUpsample(p,{16384,65535,131072,1024}));
    assert(!CanDecoderUpsample(p,{16384,98304,98303,1024}));
    assert(!CanDecoderUpsample(p,{16384,98304,131072,1023}));
    p.dst_base_bytes=131072;
    assert(!CanDecoderUpsample(p,s));
    p={0,32768,65536,0,4,8,8};
    p.output_width=12;
    assert(!CanDecoderUpsample(p,s));
    p={0,32768,65536,0,4,8,8};
    p.input_width=3;
    assert(!CanDecoderUpsample(p,s));
    p={0,32768,65536,0,4,8,8};
    p.src_base_bytes=2;
    assert(!CanDecoderUpsample(p,s));
    p={0,32768,65536,0,4,8,8};
    p.gain_base_bytes=UINT32_MAX-3;
    assert(!CanDecoderUpsample(p,{UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX}));
    p={0,0,0,0,1024,2048,2048};
    assert(!CanDecoderUpsample(p,{UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX}));
    // Native 1080p decoder: upstream PushDecoderUps uses
    // IW=prev.H=33, OW=s.H=33, OH=s.W=60 (NOT OW=2*IW).
    // Both Original b39 and Compact b19 use this same shape.
    constexpr DecoderUpsample native{0u,0u,0u,0u,
                                     33u,33u,60u};
    constexpr std::uint64_t native_source=1152ull*512u*2u;
    constexpr std::uint64_t native_tile=2160ull*512u;
    static_assert(DecoderOutputTileTokens(native)==2160u);
    static_assert(DecoderInputTileTokens(native)==1152u);
    static_assert(CanDecoderUpsample(native,{
        native_source,native_tile,native_tile,1024u}));
    assert(CanDecoderUpsample(native,{
        native_source,native_tile,native_tile,1024u}));
    assert(!CanDecoderUpsample(native,{
        native_source-1u,native_tile,native_tile,1024u}));
    assert(!CanDecoderUpsample(native,{
        native_source,native_tile-1u,native_tile,1024u}));
    assert(!CanDecoderUpsample(native,{
        native_source,native_tile,native_tile-1u,1024u}));
    assert(!CanDecoderUpsample(
        {0u,0u,0u,0u,16u,33u,60u},
        {native_source,native_tile,native_tile,1024u}));
    // Exhaustively check that every live raster pixel occupies one unique
    // padded 4x4 token and its nearest source token is inside the budget.
    std::uint32_t live=0u,padded=0u;
    for(std::uint32_t t=0u;t<2160u;++t) {
        const auto tile=t/16u,local=t%16u;
        const auto x=(tile%9u)*4u+local%4u;
        const auto y=(tile/9u)*4u+local/4u;
        if(x>=33u||y>=60u){++padded;continue;}
        assert(token(x,y,33u)==t);
        assert(token(x/2u,y/2u,33u)<1152u);
        ++live;
    }
    assert(live==33u*60u&&padded==2160u-33u*60u);
    assert(token(32u,59u,33u)==2156u);
    // Four output pixels map to one 2x source pixel, never cross a 4x4 tile.
    assert(token(0,0,8)==0u);
    assert(token(1,0,8)==1u);
    assert(token(4,0,8)==16u);
    assert(token(0,4,8)==32u);
    assert(token(0,0,4)==0u);
    assert(token(1/2,1/2,4)==token(0,0,4));
    assert(at(0,0)==0u);
    assert(at(0,4)==4u);
    assert(at(0,16)==256u);
    assert(at(1,0)==16u);
    // E4M3FN nearest-even and saturation reference: zeros, normals,
    // subnormals, negative values and the largest finite number.
    assert(quant(0.f)==0x00u);
    assert(quant(-0.f)==0x80u);
    assert(quant(1.f)==0x38u);
    assert(quant(0.5f)==0x30u);
    assert(quant(-2.f)==0xc0u);
    assert(quant(448.f)==0x7eu);
    assert(quant(500.f)==0x7eu);
    assert(quant(1.f/512.f)==0x01u);
    assert(quant(1.f/1024.f)==0x00u); // tie to even
    assert(quant(3.f/1024.f)==0x02u); // tie to even
}
```

`extras/graphics/test_rdna2_nr_ffwd3_policy.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Scalar grouped-FFWD3 reference: 8 groups, 3 quantized dense stages.
#include <cassert>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>
#include <vector>
#include "rdna2_nr_ffwd3_policy.h"
using namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;
static float decode(unsigned r){
    unsigned e=(r>>3u)&15u,m=r&7u;
    float sign=(r&128u)?-1.f:1.f;
    if(e==15u&&m==7u)return std::numeric_limits<float>::quiet_NaN();
    if(e==0u)return sign*float(m)*std::exp2(-9.f);
    return sign*float(8u+m)*std::exp2(float(int(e)-10));
}
static unsigned quant(float v){
    unsigned sign=std::signbit(v)?128u:0u;
    if(std::isnan(v))return sign|127u;
    float a=std::fmin(std::fabs(v),448.f);
    if(a<0.015625f){
        auto m=static_cast<unsigned>(std::nearbyint(a*512.f));
        return sign|(m>=8u?8u:m);
    }
    int e=static_cast<int>(std::floor(std::log2(a)));
    auto m=static_cast<unsigned>(std::nearbyint((a/std::exp2(float(e))-1.f)*8.f));
    if(m==8u){++e;m=0u;}
    auto ex=static_cast<unsigned>(e+7);
    if(ex>15u||(ex==15u&&m>6u))return sign|126u;
    return sign|(ex<<3u)|m;
}
static float cubic(float x){
    float t=std::fmax(-4.f,std::fmin(x,4.f));
    float u=std::fma(-0.055908203125f,std::fabs(t),0.447265625f);
    return x*std::fma(t,u,0.89453125f);
}
static std::vector<uint8_t> reference(
    const std::vector<uint8_t>& x,
    const std::vector<uint8_t>& w1,
    const std::vector<uint8_t>& w2,
    const std::vector<uint8_t>& w3) {
    assert(x.size()==512u);
    std::vector<uint8_t> out(512,0u);
    for(unsigned group=0;group<8;group++){
        std::vector<uint8_t> a(64,0u),b(256,0u);
        for(unsigned c=0;c<64;c++){
            float sum=0.f;
            for(unsigned k=0;k<512;k++)
                sum=std::fma(decode(x[k]),decode(w1[(group*64+c)*512+k]),sum);
            a[c]=static_cast<uint8_t>(quant(sum));
        }
        for(unsigned c=0;c<256;c++){
            float sum=0.f;
            for(unsigned k=0;k<64;k++)
                sum=std::fma(decode(a[k]),decode(w2[(group*256+c)*64+k]),sum);
            b[c]=static_cast<uint8_t>(quant(cubic(sum)));
        }
        for(unsigned c=0;c<64;c++){
            float sum=0.f;
            for(unsigned k=0;k<256;k++)
                sum=std::fma(decode(b[k]),decode(w3[(group*64+c)*256+k]),sum);
            out[group*64+c]=static_cast<uint8_t>(quant(sum));
        }
    }
    return out;
}
int main(){
    FFWD3 p{0,0,0,0,0,1};
    FFWD3Storage s{512,262144,131072,131072,512};
    assert(CanFFWD3(p,s));
    assert(!CanFFWD3(p,{511,262144,131072,131072,512}));
    assert(!CanFFWD3(p,{512,262143,131072,131072,512}));
    assert(!CanFFWD3(p,{512,262144,131071,131072,512}));
    assert(!CanFFWD3(p,{512,262144,131072,131071,512}));
    assert(!CanFFWD3(p,{512,262144,131072,131072,511}));
    p.tokens=0;assert(!CanFFWD3(p,s));
    p.tokens=65536;assert(!CanFFWD3(p,{UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX}));
    p={1,0,0,0,0,1};assert(!CanFFWD3(p,{UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX}));
    p={0,UINT32_MAX-3u,0,0,0,1};
    assert(!CanFFWD3(p,{UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX}));

    std::vector<uint8_t> x(512,0),w1(262144,0),w2(131072,0),w3(131072,0);
    x[0]=0x38u;
    w1[0]=0x38u; // group 0 stage 1 output 0 receives +1
    w2[0]=0x38u; // group 0 stage 2 output 0 receives +1
    w3[0]=0x38u; // group 0 stage 3 output 0 receives +1
    auto out=reference(x,w1,w2,w3);
    assert(out.size()==512u);
    assert(out[0]==quant(cubic(1.f)));
    assert(out[0]==0x3au); // cubic-SiLU-like(1) -> nearest E4M3 1.25
    for(unsigned i=1;i<512;i++)assert(out[i]==0u);
    x[0]=0u;
    out=reference(x,w1,w2,w3);
    for(auto v:out)assert(v==0u);
    assert(quant(448.f)==0x7eu);
    assert(quant(-2.f)==0xc0u);
}
```

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <initializer_list>
#include "rdna2_nr_float_quantize_policy.h"
using namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;
int main(){
    for(const std::uint32_t count:{4u,64u*4u,2560u*512u,
                                   2560u*1024u,2560u*4096u}){
        const FloatQuantize p{count,0u,0u,0u};
        const FloatQuantizeStorage s{std::uint64_t(count)*4u,count};

    assert(!CanFloatQuantize({0u,0u,0u,0u},max));
    assert(!CanFloatQuantize({3u,0u,0u,0u},max));

    assert(!CanFloatQuantize({4u,UINT32_MAX,0u,0u},max));

}
```

`extras/graphics/test_rdna2_nr_fswin_bindings.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <initializer_list>
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/nr_rdna2_fswin_bindings.h"
using namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;
static FSwinGraph MakePlan(std::uint32_t C){
    FSwinGraph plan{};
    const auto heads=C/32u;
    for(std::uint32_t i=0;i<4u;++i){
        if(i==1u&&C==32u)continue;
        plan.dense[i]={0,0,0,0,0,1,C,i};
        const auto in=64u*(i==1u||(i==2u&&C==32u)?4u*C:C);
        const auto wt=i==0u?4u*C*C:i==1u?C*128u:
                      (i==2u&&C==32u)?4u*C*C:C*C;
        const auto out=64u*(i==0u?4u*C:C);
        plan.dense_storage[i]={in,wt,64u*C,4u*C,out};
    }
    const auto total=64u*C;
    plan.qkv={0,0,0,0,0,0,1,C,heads};
    plan.qkv_storage={total,3u*C*C,4u*heads,total,total,total};
    plan.attention={0,0,0,0,0,1,heads};
    plan.attention_storage={total,total,total,total,heads*4096u*4u};
    return plan;
}
int main(){
    for(std::uint32_t C:{32u,64u,128u,256u}){
        FSwinLayerWeightRanges weights{};
        weights.channels=C;weights.heads=C/32u;
        const std::array<NeuralWeightRange*,9> ranges{
            &weights.expand,&weights.middle,&weights.contract,
            &weights.qkv,&weights.projection,&weights.residual_scale,
            &weights.attention_residual_scale,&weights.attention_bias,
            &weights.qk_scales};
        const std::array<std::uint64_t,9> lengths{
            4ull*C*C,C==32u?0ull:std::uint64_t(C)*128u,
            C==32u?4ull*C*C:std::uint64_t(C)*C,
            3ull*C*C,std::uint64_t(C)*C,4ull*C,4ull*C,
            std::uint64_t(weights.heads)*4096u*4u,
            4ull*weights.heads};
        std::uint64_t arena_bytes=0u;
        for(std::size_t i=0;i<ranges.size();++i){
            if(lengths[i]==0u)continue;
            ranges[i]->offset_bytes=std::uint32_t(arena_bytes);
            ranges[i]->length_bytes=std::uint32_t(lengths[i]);
            arena_bytes=(arena_bytes+lengths[i]+255u)&~255ull;
        }
        auto plan=MakePlan(C);
        assert(BindFSwinGraphWeights(weights,arena_bytes,plan));
        assert(CanFSwinGraph(plan));
        assert(plan.dense[0].w_base_bytes==weights.expand.offset_bytes);
        assert(plan.dense[2].w_base_bytes==weights.contract.offset_bytes);
        assert(plan.dense[3].w_base_bytes==weights.projection.offset_bytes);
        assert(plan.qkv.w_base_bytes==weights.qkv.offset_bytes);
        assert(plan.qkv.scale_base_floats==weights.qk_scales.offset_bytes/4u);
        assert(plan.attention.bias_base_floats==
               weights.attention_bias.offset_bytes/4u);
        assert(plan.dense[2].scale_base_floats==
               weights.residual_scale.offset_bytes/4u);
        assert(plan.dense[3].scale_base_floats==
               weights.attention_residual_scale.offset_bytes/4u);
        const auto saved=plan.qkv.w_base_bytes;
        auto bad=weights;bad.qkv.length_bytes--;
        assert(!BindFSwinGraphWeights(bad,arena_bytes,plan));
        assert(plan.qkv.w_base_bytes==saved);
        bad=weights;bad.qkv.offset_bytes=bad.expand.offset_bytes;
        assert(!BindFSwinGraphWeights(bad,arena_bytes,plan));
        bad=weights;bad.attention_bias.offset_bytes++;
        assert(!BindFSwinGraphWeights(bad,arena_bytes,plan));
        bad=weights;
        assert(!BindFSwinGraphWeights(bad,arena_bytes-1u,plan));
        bad=weights;bad.heads++;
        assert(!BindFSwinGraphWeights(bad,arena_bytes,plan));
        if(C==32u){
            bad=weights;bad.middle.length_bytes=128u;
            assert(!BindFSwinGraphWeights(bad,arena_bytes,plan));
        }
    }
}
```

`extras/graphics/test_rdna2_nr_fswin_chain_layout_policy.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>
#include "rdna2_nr_fswin_chain_layout_policy.h"
using namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;

int main(){
    const std::array<FSwinWindowLayout,3> legacy{};
    assert(CanFSwinChainWindowLayouts(legacy,16u));
    assert(!FSwinNeedsWindowRepack(legacy[0],legacy[1]));
    assert(!CanFSwinChainWindowLayouts(legacy,0u));
    assert(CanFSwinChainWindowLayouts(legacy,257u));
    assert(!CanFSwinChainWindowLayouts(legacy,65536u));
    const std::array<FSwinWindowLayout,4> alternating{{
        {4,4,0,0},{4,4,1,1},{4,4,0,0},{4,4,-1,1},
    }};
    assert(CanFSwinChainWindowLayouts(alternating,16u));
    assert(FSwinNeedsWindowRepack(alternating[0],alternating[1]));
    assert(FSwinNeedsWindowRepack(alternating[1],alternating[2]));
    assert(!FSwinNeedsWindowRepack(alternating[0],alternating[2]));
    assert(CanFSwinChainWindowLayouts(
        std::array<FSwinWindowLayout,1>{{{1,1,1,0}}},1u));
    assert(CanFSwinChainWindowLayouts(
        std::array<FSwinWindowLayout,1>{{{16,16,-1,1}}},256u));
    auto bad=alternating;
    bad[2].windows_y=5u;
    assert(!CanFSwinChainWindowLayouts(bad,16u));
    bad=alternating;bad[0].windows_x=0u;
    assert(!CanFSwinChainWindowLayouts(bad,16u));
    bad=alternating;bad[0].windows_x=0u;bad[0].windows_y=0u;
    assert(!CanFSwinChainWindowLayouts(bad,16u));
    bad=alternating;bad[1].shift_x=2;
    assert(!CanFSwinChainWindowLayouts(bad,16u));
    bad=alternating;bad[1].shift_y=-2;
    assert(!CanFSwinChainWindowLayouts(bad,16u));
    const std::array<FSwinWindowLayout,2> mixed{{
        {0,0,0,0},{4,4,0,0},
    }};
    assert(!CanFSwinChainWindowLayouts(mixed,16u));
    const std::array<FSwinWindowLayout,2> no_grid_shift{{
        {0,0,0,0},{0,0,1,0},
    }};
    assert(!CanFSwinChainWindowLayouts(no_grid_shift,16u));
    const std::vector<FSwinWindowLayout> too_many(161);
    assert(!CanFSwinChainWindowLayouts(too_many,1u));
}
```

`extras/graphics/test_rdna2_nr_fswin_dense_policy.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>
#include <initializer_list>
#include "rdna2_nr_fswin_dense_policy.h"
using namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;
int main(){
    for(std::uint32_t C:{32u,64u,128u,256u})
        for(std::uint32_t stage=0;stage<4;stage++){
            const FSwinDense p{0,0,0,0,0,1,C,stage};
            const auto in=64u*(stage==1u||(stage==2u&&C==32u)?4u*C:C);
            const auto wt=stage==0u?4u*C*C:
                stage==1u?C*128u:
                stage==2u&&C==32u?4u*C*C:C*C;
            const auto out=64u*(stage==0u?4u*C:C);
            const FSwinDenseStorage s{in,wt,C*64u,C*4u,out};
            if(C==32u&&stage==1u){
                assert(!CanFSwinDense(p,s));
                continue;
            }
            assert(CanFSwinDense(p,s));
            assert(FSwinDenseGridX(p)==(stage==0u?(C+63u)/64u:1u));
            assert(!CanFSwinDense(p,{in-1u,wt,C*64u,C*4u,out}));
            assert(!CanFSwinDense(p,{in,wt-1u,C*64u,C*4u,out}));
            assert(!CanFSwinDense(p,{in,wt,C*64u,C*4u,out-1u}));
            if(stage>=2u){
                assert(!CanFSwinDense(p,{in,wt,C*64u-1u,C*4u,out}));
                assert(!CanFSwinDense(p,{in,wt,C*64u,C*4u-1u,out}));
            }
        }
    FSwinDense p{0,0,0,0,0,65536,32,0};
    const FSwinDenseStorage ample{UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX};
    assert(!CanFSwinDense(p,ample));
    // 960x540 C32 -> 120x68=8160 windows is within storage budget.
    p={0,0,0,0,0,8160,32,0};
    assert(CanFSwinDense(p,ample));
    p.windows=1;p.channels=16;assert(!CanFSwinDense(p,ample));
    p.channels=32;p.stage=4;assert(!CanFSwinDense(p,ample));
    p.stage=0;p.x_base_bytes=1;assert(!CanFSwinDense(p,ample));
    p.x_base_bytes=0;p.w_base_bytes=UINT32_MAX-3u;
    assert(!CanFSwinDense(p,ample));
}
```

`extras/graphics/test_rdna2_nr_fswin_downsample_policy.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <initializer_list>
#include <limits>
#include "rdna2_nr_fswin_downsample_policy.h"
using namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;
int main(){
    for(std::uint32_t C:{32u,64u,128u,256u})
        for(std::uint32_t W:{8u,32u,540u})
            for(std::uint32_t H:{8u,17u,960u}){
                FSwinDownsample p{
                    W,H,(W+7u)/8u,(H+7u)/8u,C,0,-1,0,0,0};
                const auto input=std::uint64_t(p.windows_x)*
                    p.windows_y*64u*C;
                const auto weights=std::uint64_t(2u)*C*C;
                const auto output=(std::uint64_t(W)/2u)*
                    (std::uint64_t(H)/2u)*2u*C;
                const FSwinDownsampleStorage s{input,weights,output};
                assert(CanFSwinDownsample(p,s));
                assert(FSwinDownsampleGridX(p)==C/8u);
                assert(!CanFSwinDownsample(
                    p,{input-1u,weights,output}));
                assert(!CanFSwinDownsample(
                    p,{input,weights-1u,output}));
                assert(!CanFSwinDownsample(
                    p,{input,weights,output-1u}));
                p.shift_y=-2;
                assert(!CanFSwinDownsample(p,s));
                p.shift_y=-1;
                p.windows_x++;
                assert(!CanFSwinDownsample(p,s));
            }
    const FSwinDownsampleStorage unlimited{
        UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX};
    FSwinDownsample bad{1920,1080,240,135,256,0,-1,0,0,0};
    assert(!CanFSwinDownsample(bad,unlimited));
    bad={8,8,1,1,32,0,0,1,0,0};
    assert(!CanFSwinDownsample(bad,unlimited));
    bad={8,8,1,1,32,0,0,UINT32_MAX-3u,0,0};
    assert(!CanFSwinDownsample(bad,unlimited));
}
```

`extras/graphics/test_rdna2_nr_fswin_graph_policy.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Host-only proof that six FSwin pass contracts compose for all C.
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <initializer_list>
#include "rdna2_nr_fswin_graph_policy.h"
using namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;
int main(){
    for(std::uint32_t C:{32u,64u,128u,256u}){
        FSwinGraph p{};
        const auto heads=C/32u;
        for(std::uint32_t i=0;i<4u;++i){
            const auto in=64u*(i==1u||(i==2u&&C==32u)?4u*C:C);
            const auto w=i==0u?4u*C*C:
                i==1u?C*128u:i==2u&&C==32u?4u*C*C:C*C;
            const auto out=64u*(i==0u?4u*C:C);
            p.dense[i]=(i==1u&&C==32u)?
                FSwinDense{}:FSwinDense{0,0,0,0,0,1,C,i};
            p.dense_storage[i]={in,w,64u*C,4u*C,out};
        }
        const auto tensor=64u*C;
        p.qkv={0,0,0,0,0,0,1,C,heads};
        p.qkv_storage={tensor,3u*C*C,heads*4u,tensor,tensor,tensor};
        p.attention={0,0,0,0,0,1,heads};
        p.attention_storage={tensor,tensor,tensor,tensor,
                             heads*64u*64u*4u};
        assert(CanFSwinGraph(p));
        p.dense[3].stage=2;assert(!CanFSwinGraph(p));
        p.dense[3].stage=3;
        p.qkv.channels=512;assert(!CanFSwinGraph(p));
        p.qkv.channels=C;
        p.attention.heads++;assert(!CanFSwinGraph(p));
        p.attention.heads=heads;
        if(C==32u){
            p.dense[1].windows=1u;assert(!CanFSwinGraph(p));
            p.dense[1].windows=0u;
        }else{
            p.dense_storage[1].weight_bytes--;
            assert(!CanFSwinGraph(p));
            p.dense_storage[1].weight_bytes++;
        }
        assert(CanFSwinGraph(p));
    }
}
```

`extras/graphics/test_rdna2_nr_fswin_level_link_policy.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <initializer_list>
#include "rdna2_nr_fswin_level_link_policy.h"
using namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;
int main(){
    for(std::uint32_t C:{32u,64u,128u}){
        const std::uint32_t w=C==32u?540u:C==64u?270u:135u;
        const std::uint32_t h=C==32u?960u:C==64u?480u:240u;
        const FSwinLevelLink p{
            w,h,C,2u*C,{(w+7u)/8u,(h+7u)/8u,0,-1},
            {(w/2u+7u)/8u,(h/2u+7u)/8u,0,0}};
        const auto bytes=std::uint64_t(w/2u)*(h/2u)*2u*C;
        const auto target=std::uint64_t(p.destination_grid.windows_x)*
            p.destination_grid.windows_y*64u*2u*C;
        assert(CanFSwinLevelLink(p,bytes,target));
        assert(!CanFSwinLevelLink(p,bytes-1u,target));
        assert(!CanFSwinLevelLink(p,bytes,target-1u));
        auto bad=p;bad.destination_channels=C;
        assert(!CanFSwinLevelLink(bad,bytes,target));
        bad=p;bad.destination_grid.shift_x=-1;
        assert(!CanFSwinLevelLink(bad,bytes,target));
        bad=p;bad.destination_grid.windows_y++;
        assert(!CanFSwinLevelLink(bad,bytes,target));
        bad=p;bad.source_grid.windows_x++;
        assert(!CanFSwinLevelLink(bad,bytes,target));
        bad=p;bad.source_grid.shift_y=2;
        assert(!CanFSwinLevelLink(bad,bytes,target));
    }
    // W=135 is odd: exact native 135x240 -> 67x120.
    {
        const FSwinLevelLink p{
            135u,240u,128u,256u,
            {17u,30u,0,-1},{9u,15u,0,0}};
        const std::uint64_t exact=67ull*120u*256u;
        const std::uint64_t padded=9ull*15u*64u*256u;
        assert(CanFSwinLevelLink(p,exact,padded));
        assert(!CanFSwinLevelLink(p,exact-1u,padded));
    }
    // 256->512 is a Split-Swin transition, NOT a same-family FSwin link.
    const FSwinLevelLink split{120u,67u,256u,512u,
                              {15u,9u,0,-1},{8u,5u,0,0}};
    assert(!CanFSwinLevelLink(split,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX));
    const FSwinLevelLink huge{16384u,16384u,32u,64u,
                             {2048u,2048u,0,0},{1024u,1024u,0,0}};
    assert(!CanFSwinLevelLink(huge,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX));
}
```

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <initializer_list>
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/nr_rdna2_fswin_output_view_policy.h"
using namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;
int main(){
    for(std::uint32_t C:{32u,64u,128u,256u})
        for(std::uint32_t WX:{1u,2u,8u,68u}){
            const auto WY=WX==68u?120u:3u;
            const FSwinWindowLayout l{WX,WY,0,-1};
            const auto bytes=std::uint64_t(WX)*WY*64u*C;
            const auto dest=std::uint64_t(WX*8u-4u)*WY*8u*C;
            FSwinOutputViewPlan p{};

            assert(p.repack.dst_shift_y==0&&p.raster.direction==1u);

            assert(p.raster_storage.output_bytes==dest);

            assert(FSwinRasterLayoutGridX(p.raster)==C/4u);
```
