`extras/graphics/test_rdna2_nr_session_preflight.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// CPU-only, real source-level R09 session gate. The 2-byte payloads in
// synthetic NRMODEL1 files are NOT learned weights and MUST NEVER be
// consumed by a GPU inference test; this checks the index, manifest,
// complete 152/76 model plan, routes and exact geometry without Vulkan.
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/nr_rdna2_session_preflight.h"
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdint>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>
using namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;
static void Put32(std::vector<std::uint8_t>& bytes,std::uint32_t v){
    for(std::uint32_t i=0;i<4u;++i)
        bytes.push_back(std::uint8_t(v>>(i*8u)));
}
static void Put64(std::vector<std::uint8_t>& bytes,std::uint64_t v){
    for(std::uint32_t i=0;i<8u;++i)
        bytes.push_back(std::uint8_t(v>>(i*8u)));
}
template<std::size_t N>
static void MakeIndexOnlyPack(const std::filesystem::path& path,
    const std::array<std::string_view,N>& manifest,
    std::string_view optional={},bool omit_last=false,
    bool bad_input_lift=false,bool bad_output_project=false,
    bool valid_learned_upsamples=false,bool bad_learned_gain=false){
    const std::size_t n=N-(omit_last?1u:0u)+(!optional.empty()?1u:0u);
    std::vector<std::string_view> names(manifest.begin(),
                                        manifest.begin()+N-(omit_last?1u:0u));
    if(!optional.empty())names.emplace_back(optional);
    std::uint64_t cursor=16u;
    for(auto name:names)cursor+=4u+name.size()+16u;
    cursor=(cursor+255u)&~std::uint64_t(255u);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> index{
        'N','R','M','O','D','E','L','1'};
    Put32(index,static_cast<std::uint32_t>(n));
    Put32(index,0u);
    for(const auto name:names){
        Put32(index,static_cast<std::uint32_t>(name.size()));
        for(const auto c:name)
            index.push_back(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(c));
        const bool pre=name==
            "unpacked-preblock/block0.layer0.layer.input_lift.bin";
        const bool post=name==
            "unpacked-postblock/block70.layer0.layer.out_project.bin"||
            name=="unpacked-postblock/block30.layer0.layer.out_project.bin";
        std::uint64_t bytes=(pre||post)?1024u:2u;
        // These are only zero-filled, shape-correct FAKE regions. They
        // test descriptor admission and must never be used for inference.
        if(valid_learned_upsamples){
            const std::array<std::uint32_t,4u> up_blocks=
                N==599u?std::array<std::uint32_t,4u>{66u,62u,56u,48u}:
                        std::array<std::uint32_t,4u>{28u,26u,24u,22u};
            for(std::size_t i=0u;i<4u;++i){
                const auto channels=32u<<i;
                const std::string prefix="unpacked/block"+
                    std::to_string(up_blocks[i])+".layer0.layer";
                if(name==prefix+".resample.bin")
                    bytes=std::uint64_t(channels)*2u*channels;
                if(name==prefix+".upsample_gain.bin")
                    bytes=2u*(channels==32u?channels:channels-16u)-
                        (bad_learned_gain&&i==2u?2u:0u);
                if(channels>=64u&&name==prefix+".residual_scale.bin")
                    bytes=2u*(channels+16u);
            }
        }
        const std::uint64_t declared=
            (pre&&bad_input_lift)||(post&&bad_output_project)?
            1022u:bytes;
        Put64(index,cursor);
        Put64(index,declared);
        cursor+=(declared+255u)&~std::uint64_t(255u);
    }
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> full(static_cast<std::size_t>(cursor));
    assert(index.size()<=full.size());
    std::copy(index.begin(),index.end(),full.begin());
    std::ofstream stream(path,std::ios::binary|std::ios::trunc);
    assert(stream);
    stream.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(full.data()),
                 static_cast<std::streamsize>(full.size()));
    assert(stream.good());
    stream.close();
}
static std::string Read(const char* path){
    std::ifstream in(path,std::ios::binary);
    assert(in);
    return {std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(in),
            std::istreambuf_iterator<char>()};
}
template<std::size_t N>
static void Check(const std::array<std::string_view,N>& names,
    std::string_view extension,const std::string& good,
    const std::string& bad,const std::filesystem::path& file){
    R09SessionCPUPlan out{};
    MakeIndexOnlyPack(file,names);
    assert(PreflightR09Session(file.string(),good,1920u,1080u,
                               1920u,1080u,out));
    assert(out.model.IsOpen());
    assert(out.raster_width==1080u&&out.raster_height==1920u);
    assert(out.graph.count==4u);
    assert(out.routes.run_count==2u);
    assert(out.vit_route.count==8u);
    // An index-only synthetic model may exercise route parsing, but it
    // must NEVER pass the stricter GPU-admission gain preflight.
    assert(!ValidateR09LearnedUpsampleInputs(out));
    assert(out.down_segments[0]!=out.up_segments[0]);
    // A shape-complete fake pack exercises all four real loader contracts
    // without pretending any of its zero-filled values are learned weights.
    MakeIndexOnlyPack(file,names,{},false,false,false,true);
    assert(PreflightR09Session(file.string(),good,1920u,1080u,
                               1920u,1080u,out));
    assert(ValidateR09LearnedUpsampleInputs(out));
    MakeIndexOnlyPack(file,names,{},false,false,false,true,true);
    assert(PreflightR09Session(file.string(),good,1920u,1080u,
                               1920u,1080u,out));
    assert(!ValidateR09LearnedUpsampleInputs(out));
    // Correctly named manifest alone must not allocate GPU memory when
    // either learned FP16 image-boundary matrix has a bad byte length.
    MakeIndexOnlyPack(file,names,{},false,true,false);
    assert(!PreflightR09Session(file.string(),good,1920u,1080u,
                                1920u,1080u,out));
    assert(!out.model.IsOpen());
    MakeIndexOnlyPack(file,names,{},false,false,true);
    assert(!PreflightR09Session(file.string(),good,1920u,1080u,
                                1920u,1080u,out));
    assert(!out.model.IsOpen());
    MakeIndexOnlyPack(file,names);
    assert(!PreflightR09Session(file.string(),bad,1920u,1080u,
                                1920u,1080u,out));
    assert(!out.model.IsOpen());
    assert(!PreflightR09Session(file.string(),good,1280u,720u,
                                1920u,1080u,out));
    assert(!out.model.IsOpen());
    assert(!PreflightR09Session(file.string(),good,1920u,1080u,
                                1280u,720u,out));
    assert(!out.model.IsOpen());
    MakeIndexOnlyPack(file,names,{},true);
    assert(!PreflightR09Session(file.string(),good,1920u,1080u,
                                1920u,1080u,out));
    assert(!out.model.IsOpen());
    MakeIndexOnlyPack(file,names,extension);
    assert(PreflightR09Session(file.string(),good,1920u,1080u,
                               1920u,1080u,out));
    assert(out.model.Find(extension)!=nullptr);
    assert(!PreflightR09Session(file.string(),good.substr(0,110u),
                                1920u,1080u,1920u,1080u,out));
    std::filesystem::remove(file);
}
int main(int argc,char** argv){
    assert(argc==3);
    const auto original=Read(argv[1]);
    const auto compact=Read(argv[2]);
    const auto base=std::filesystem::temp_directory_path()/
        ("eden-r09-cpu-preflight-"+
         std::to_string(std::chrono::steady_clock::now()
                        .time_since_epoch().count())+".nrmodel");
    Check(R09OriginalManifest,R09OriginalTemporalScale,
          original,compact,base);
    Check(R09CompactManifest,R09CompactTemporalScale,
          compact,original,base);
}
```

`extras/graphics/test_rdna2_nr_split_block_policy.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
#include "rdna2_nr_split_block_policy.h"
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
using namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;
int main(){
    constexpr auto windows=40u;
    constexpr std::uint64_t fp8=40ull*64u*512u;
    constexpr SplitBlockCapacity caps{
        fp8,fp8,fp8,fp8,fp8,fp8,fp8,fp8,fp8,fp8*4u};
    const SplitBlockPlan p{windows,false};
    assert(CanSplitBlock(p,caps));
    // A ProjPool output cannot be omitted by treating it as a plain Proj.
    // Native 1080p ProjPool: width 60, height 33, windows 8x5.
    // The half-res side output is 32x20 (640 tokens), plus 1280 zero
    // tail tokens for the native default 1920-token FinalHead.
    auto pooled_caps=caps;
    pooled_caps.pooled=1920u*512u;
    const SplitBlockPlan pooled{windows,true,60u,33u,8u,5u,1920u};
    assert(CanSplitBlock(pooled,pooled_caps));
    // The last NRMODEL1 layer (FinalHead, 512->1024) can be linked,
    // provided distinct FP32 scratch and output buffers are allocated.
    pooled_caps.final_fp32=1920ull*1024u*4u;
    pooled_caps.final_fp8=1920ull*1024u;
    const SplitBlockPlan with_final{
        windows,true,60u,33u,8u,5u,1920u,1920u};
    assert(CanSplitBlock(with_final,pooled_caps));
    auto insufficient_final=pooled_caps;
    insufficient_final.final_fp8--;
    assert(!CanSplitBlock(with_final,insufficient_final));
    insufficient_final=pooled_caps;
    insufficient_final.final_fp32--;
    assert(!CanSplitBlock(with_final,insufficient_final));
    assert(!CanSplitBlock({
        windows,false,0u,0u,0u,0u,0u,1920u},pooled_caps));
    assert(!CanSplitBlock({
        windows,true,60u,33u,8u,5u,1920u,2560u},pooled_caps));
    pooled_caps.pooled=1920u*512u-1u;
    assert(!CanSplitBlock(pooled,pooled_caps));
    pooled_caps.pooled=1920u*512u;
    assert(!CanSplitBlock({windows,true,60u,33u,7u,5u,1920u},pooled_caps));
    assert(!CanSplitBlock({windows,true,60u,33u,8u,5u,639u},pooled_caps));
    assert(!CanSplitBlock({windows,true,60u,33u,8u,5u,0u},
                          {fp8,fp8,fp8,fp8,fp8,fp8,fp8,fp8,fp8,
                           fp8*4u,639u*512u}));

    // Attention shift -1/-1 lives on its own input and output tensors.
    // Without both GPU repacks the QKV/Proj descriptors would be wrong.
    auto shift_caps=caps;
    shift_caps.shifted_input=fp8;
    shift_caps.unshifted_context=fp8;
    SplitBlockPlan shifted{windows,false};
    shifted.window_grid_x=8u;shifted.window_grid_y=5u;
    shifted.attention_shift_x=-1;
    shifted.attention_shift_y=-1;
    assert(CanSplitBlock(shifted,shift_caps));
    auto missing=shift_caps;missing.shifted_input=fp8-1u;
    assert(!CanSplitBlock(shifted,missing));
    missing=shift_caps;missing.unshifted_context=fp8-1u;
    assert(!CanSplitBlock(shifted,missing));
    shifted.attention_shift_x=2;
    assert(!CanSplitBlock(shifted,shift_caps));
    shifted.attention_shift_x=1;
    assert(CanSplitBlock(shifted,shift_caps));
    shifted.window_grid_y=4u;
    assert(!CanSplitBlock(shifted,shift_caps));
    assert(!CanSplitBlock({windows,true},caps));
    assert(!CanSplitBlock({0u,false},caps));
    assert(!CanSplitBlock({1024u,false},caps));
    assert(CanSplitBlock({1u,false},{
        32768u,32768u,32768u,32768u,32768u,32768u,
        32768u,32768u,32768u,32768u*4u}));
    auto broken=caps;broken.input=fp8-1u;
    assert(!CanSplitBlock(p,broken));
    broken=caps;broken.ffwd=fp8-1u;
    assert(!CanSplitBlock(p,broken));
    broken=caps;broken.ffwd_projected=fp8-1u;
    assert(!CanSplitBlock(p,broken));
    broken=caps;broken.context_heads=fp8-1u;
    assert(!CanSplitBlock(p,broken));
    broken=caps;broken.context_tokens=fp8-1u;
    assert(!CanSplitBlock(p,broken));
    broken=caps;broken.projected=fp8-1u;
    assert(!CanSplitBlock(p,broken));
    broken=caps;broken.query=fp8-1u;
    assert(!CanSplitBlock(p,broken));
    broken=caps;broken.key=fp8-1u;
    assert(!CanSplitBlock(p,broken));
    broken=caps;broken.value=fp8-1u;
    assert(!CanSplitBlock(p,broken));
    broken=caps;broken.fp32_scratch=fp8*4u-1u;
    assert(!CanSplitBlock(p,broken));
}
```

`extras/graphics/test_rdna2_nr_split_context_repack_policy.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
#include "rdna2_nr_split_context_repack_policy.h"
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>
using namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;
int main(){
    constexpr SplitContextRepack p{40u,16u,0u,0u};
    constexpr std::uint64_t total=40ull*64u*512u;
    assert(CanSplitContextRepack(p,{total,total}));
    assert(SplitContextRepackGridX(p)==1280u);
    assert(!CanSplitContextRepack(p,{total-4u,total}));
    assert(!CanSplitContextRepack(p,{total,total-4u}));
    assert(!CanSplitContextRepack({40u,8u,0u,0u},{
        UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX}));
    assert(!CanSplitContextRepack({0u,16u,0u,0u},{
        UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX}));
    assert(!CanSplitContextRepack({1025u,16u,0u,0u},{
        UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX}));
    assert(!CanSplitContextRepack({40u,16u,1u,0u},{
        UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX}));
    assert(!CanSplitContextRepack({40u,16u,0u,1u},{
        UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX}));
    constexpr std::uint32_t windows=2u,heads=16u;
    std::vector<std::uint32_t> src(windows*64u*heads*8u);
    std::vector<std::uint32_t> dst(src.size(),0u);
    // Each 32-bit word is one 4-channel group (E4M3FN).
    for(std::uint32_t w=0;w<windows;++w)
      for(std::uint32_t h=0;h<heads;++h)
        for(std::uint32_t t=0;t<64u;++t)
          for(std::uint32_t lane=0;lane<8u;++lane){
            const auto pos=((w*heads+h)*64u+t)*8u+lane;
            src[pos]=1u+(w<<20u)+(t<<12u)+(h<<4u)+lane;
          }
    for(std::uint32_t w=0;w<windows;++w)
      for(std::uint32_t t=0;t<64u;++t)
        for(std::uint32_t h=0;h<heads;++h)
          for(std::uint32_t lane=0;lane<8u;++lane){
            const auto from=((w*heads+h)*64u+t)*8u+lane;
            const auto to=((w*64u+t)*heads+h)*8u+lane;
            dst[to]=src[from];
          }
    for(std::uint32_t w=0;w<windows;++w)
      for(std::uint32_t t=0;t<64u;++t)
        for(std::uint32_t h=0;h<heads;++h)
          for(std::uint32_t lane=0;lane<8u;++lane){
            const auto to=((w*64u+t)*heads+h)*8u+lane;
            assert(dst[to]==1u+(w<<20u)+(t<<12u)+(h<<4u)+lane);
          }
    assert(CanSplitContextRepack({windows,heads,0u,0u},{
        std::uint64_t(src.size())*4u,std::uint64_t(dst.size())*4u}));
}
```

`extras/graphics/test_rdna2_nr_split_decoder_skip_repack_policy.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Exhaustive independent CPU mapping for native 512-channel 8x8-window
// -> 4x4-tile/16x16-channel-packed decoder skip, including partial borders.
#include "rdna2_nr_split_decoder_skip_repack_policy.h"
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <initializer_list>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>
using namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;
static void Check(std::uint32_t W,std::uint32_t H){
    const std::uint32_t wx=(W+7u)/8u,wy=(H+7u)/8u;
    const SplitDecoderSkipRepack p{W,H,wx,wy,512u};
    const auto input_bytes=SplitSkipInputTokens(p)*512u;
    const auto output_bytes=SplitSkipOutputTokens(p)*512u;
    assert(CanSplitDecoderSkipRepack(p,{input_bytes,output_bytes}));
    std::vector<std::uint32_t> source(input_bytes/4u);
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<source.size();++i)
        source[i]=std::uint32_t(31337u*i+101u);
    std::vector<std::uint32_t> destination(output_bytes/4u,0xdeadc0deu);
    std::vector<bool> seen(SplitSkipInputTokens(p),false);
    std::uint32_t live=0u,zeroed=0u;
    const auto cols=(W+3u)/4u;
    for(std::uint32_t t=0u;t<SplitSkipOutputTokens(p);++t){
        const auto tile=t/16u,slot=t%16u;
        const auto x=(tile%cols)*4u+slot%4u;
        const auto y=(tile/cols)*4u+slot/4u;
        const bool valid=x<W&&y<H;
        std::uint32_t source_token=0u;
        if(valid){
            const auto window=(y/8u)*wx+x/8u;
            const auto quadrant=((y%8u)/4u)*2u+(x%8u)/4u;
            source_token=window*64u+quadrant*16u+
                         (y%4u)*4u+x%4u;
            assert(source_token<seen.size());
            assert(!seen[source_token]);
            seen[source_token]=true;
            ++live;
        }else ++zeroed;
        for(std::uint32_t cw=0u;cw<128u;++cw){
            const auto dst=((t/16u)*32u+cw/4u)*64u+
                           (t%16u)*4u+cw%4u;
            assert(dst<destination.size());
            destination[dst]=valid?source[source_token*128u+cw]:0u;
        }
    }
    assert(live==W*H);
    assert(zeroed==SplitSkipOutputTokens(p)-live);
    for(std::uint32_t t=0u;t<SplitSkipOutputTokens(p);++t){
        const auto tile=t/16u,slot=t%16u;
        const auto x=(tile%cols)*4u+slot%4u;
        const auto y=(tile/cols)*4u+slot/4u;
        const auto dst=((t/16u)*32u)*64u+(t%16u)*4u;
        if(x>=W||y>=H)assert(destination[dst]==0u);
        else assert(destination[dst]!=0xdeadc0deu);
    }
    assert(!CanSplitDecoderSkipRepack(p,{
        input_bytes-1u,output_bytes}));
    assert(!CanSplitDecoderSkipRepack(p,{
        input_bytes,output_bytes-1u}));
}
int main(){
    for(const auto dims:{
        std::pair{33u,60u},std::pair{8u,8u},
        std::pair{7u,13u},std::pair{31u,17u},
        std::pair{4u,4u},std::pair{1u,1u}})
        Check(dims.first,dims.second);
    constexpr SplitDecoderSkipRepack native{33u,60u,5u,8u,512u};
    static_assert(SplitSkipInputTokens(native)==2560u);
    static_assert(SplitSkipOutputTokens(native)==2160u);
    static_assert(CanSplitDecoderSkipRepack(native,{
        2560ull*512u,2160ull*512u}));
    assert(!CanSplitDecoderSkipRepack(
        {33u,60u,8u,5u,512u},{
            2560ull*512u,2160ull*512u}));
    assert(!CanSplitDecoderSkipRepack(
        {33u,60u,5u,8u,256u},{
            2560ull*512u,2160ull*512u}));
    assert(!CanSplitDecoderSkipRepack(
        {0u,60u,0u,8u,512u},{UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX}));
    assert(!CanSplitDecoderSkipRepack(
        {4096u,4096u,512u,512u,512u},
        {UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX}));
    // Native border examples: x=32,y=59 is in window #39, slot 12,
    // but the decoder reads it as tile #134, slot 12.
    const std::uint32_t src=(7u*5u+4u)*64u+12u;
    const std::uint32_t dst=(14u*9u+8u)*16u+12u;
    assert(src==2508u&&dst==2156u);
}
```

`extras/graphics/test_rdna2_nr_split_ffwd_weights.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Bijective reference: canonical [512,512] -> original FFWD3 bit maps.
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/nr_rdna2_split_ffwd_weight_loader.h"
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>
using namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;
static std::vector<std::uint8_t> CanonicalFromFragment(
    const std::vector<std::uint8_t>& raw) {
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> matrix(kSplitFFMatrix);
    for(std::size_t kg=0u;kg<16u;++kg)
      for(std::size_t ng=0u;ng<32u;++ng)
        for(std::size_t half=0u;half<2u;++half)
          for(std::size_t lane=0u;lane<32u;++lane)
            for(std::size_t byte=0u;byte<8u;++byte){
                const auto n=ng*16u+half*8u+lane/4u;
                const auto k=kg*32u+8u*(byte/2u)+
                             2u*(lane%4u)+(byte%2u);
                const auto src=(kg*32u+ng)*512u+
                                lane*16u+half*8u+byte;
                matrix[n*512u+k]=raw[src];
            }
    return matrix;
}
int main() {
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> original_a(kSplitFFMatrix);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> original_b(kSplitFFMatrix);
    // All values are finite E4M3FN, distinct enough to expose permutations.
    for(std::size_t i=0u;i<kSplitFFMatrix;++i){
        original_a[i]=static_cast<std::uint8_t>(1u+(i*37u)%120u);
        original_b[i]=static_cast<std::uint8_t>(1u+(i*47u)%120u);
    }
    auto can_a=CanonicalFromFragment(original_a);
    auto can_b=CanonicalFromFragment(original_b);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> roundtrip;
    assert(SplitFFCanonicalToFragment(can_a,roundtrip));
    assert(roundtrip==original_a);
    assert(SplitFFCanonicalToFragment(can_b,roundtrip));
    assert(roundtrip==original_b);
    // The authentic DLL pack stores the source in fragment order.
    // Check the new inverse used by raw-inventory fallback byte for byte.
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> direct;
    assert(SplitFFFragmentToCanonical(original_a,direct));
    assert(direct==can_a);
    assert(SplitFFFragmentToCanonical(original_b,direct));
    assert(direct==can_b);
    assert(!SplitFFFragmentToCanonical(
        std::span<const std::uint8_t>{original_a.data(),
                                       original_a.size()-1u},direct));
    assert(direct.empty());
    assert(!SplitFFCanonicalToFragment(
        std::span<const std::uint8_t>{can_a.data(),can_a.size()-1u},
        roundtrip));
    assert(roundtrip.empty());

    SplitFFWDWeights decoded;
    assert(DecodeSplitFFWDWeights(can_a,can_b,decoded));
    assert(decoded.w1.size()==262144u);
    assert(decoded.w2.size()==131072u);
    assert(decoded.w3.size()==131072u);
    for(std::uint32_t g=0u;g<8u;++g) {
        for(std::uint32_t r=0u;r<64u;++r)
            for(std::uint32_t k=0u;k<512u;++k)
                assert(decoded.w1[(g*64u+r)*512u+k]==
                       original_a[SplitFFSourceA(g,r,k)]);
        for(std::uint32_t j=0u;j<256u;++j)
            for(std::uint32_t r=0u;r<64u;++r)
                assert(decoded.w2[(g*256u+j)*64u+r]==
                       original_b[SplitFFSourceQ0(g,j,r)]);
        for(std::uint32_t n=0u;n<64u;++n)
            for(std::uint32_t j=0u;j<256u;++j)
                assert(decoded.w3[(g*64u+n)*256u+j]==
                       original_b[SplitFFSourceQ2(g,n,j)]);
    }
    // Fail atomically on size mismatch or nonfinite FP8 values.
    assert(!DecodeSplitFFWDWeights(
        std::span<const std::uint8_t>{can_a.data(),can_a.size()-1u},
        can_b,decoded));
    assert(decoded.w1.empty()&&decoded.w2.empty()&&decoded.w3.empty());
    can_a[100u]=0x7fu;
    assert(!DecodeSplitFFWDWeights(can_a,can_b,decoded));
    assert(decoded.w1.empty()&&decoded.w2.empty()&&decoded.w3.empty());
    can_a[100u]=0x38u;
    can_b[101u]=0xffu;
    assert(!DecodeSplitFFWDWeights(can_a,can_b,decoded));
    assert(decoded.w1.empty()&&decoded.w2.empty()&&decoded.w3.empty());
}
```

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/nr_rdna2_split_final_head_weight_loader.h"

         padded.output_bytes-4u,padded.free_transient_bytes},
```

`extras/graphics/test_rdna2_nr_split_native_routes_policy.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Original=16 and Compact=4 native Split blocks, 2 runs each.
// Build with actual 152/76-row MIT shape fixtures; no trained weights.
#include "rdna2_nr_split_native_routes_policy.h"
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
using namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;
void Check(const char* path,bool original){
    std::ifstream stream(path,std::ios::binary);
    assert(stream);
    const std::string data{std::istreambuf_iterator<char>{stream},
                           std::istreambuf_iterator<char>{}};
    std::vector<NativePlanStep> source;
    assert(ParseNativePlan(data,source)==NativePlanError::Ok);
    NativeSplitRoutes routes;
    assert(BuildNativeSplitRoutes(source,routes)==SplitNativeRoutesError::Ok);
    assert(routes.count==(original?16u:4u));
    assert(routes.run_count==2u);
    assert(routes.runs[0].count==(original?8u:2u));
    assert(routes.runs[1].count==(original?8u:2u));
    assert(routes.blocks[0].block==(original?23u:9u));
    assert(routes.blocks[routes.runs[1].start].block==
           (original?40u:20u));
    assert(routes.blocks[routes.count-1u].block==(original?47u:21u));
    assert(routes.blocks[0].input_view);
    assert(routes.blocks[routes.count-1u].output_view);
    std::uint32_t shifted=0u,pooled=0u;
    for(std::uint32_t i=0u;i<routes.count;++i){
        const auto& b=routes.blocks[i];
        const auto& p=b.plan;
        assert(p.windows==40u);
        assert(p.window_grid_x==5u&&p.window_grid_y==8u);
        assert(b.native_compute_tokens==2160u);
        assert(b.raster_width==33u&&b.raster_height==60u);
        assert(b.layer_count==(p.has_pooled_projection?5u:4u));
        const bool has_shift=p.attention_shift_x||p.attention_shift_y;
        shifted+=has_shift;
        pooled+=p.has_pooled_projection;
        // Every extracted real block shape has a directly preflightable
        // GPU capacity plan, including native signed QKV shifts.
        const std::uint64_t extent=40ull*64u*512u;
        SplitBlockCapacity caps{
            extent,extent,extent,extent,extent,extent,
            extent,extent,extent,extent*4u};
        if(has_shift){
            caps.shifted_input=extent;
            caps.unshifted_context=extent;
        }
        if(p.has_pooled_projection){
            caps.pooled=2160ull*512u;
            caps.final_fp32=2160ull*1024u*4u;
            caps.final_fp8=2160ull*1024u;
            assert(p.pool_width==33u&&p.pool_height==60u);
            assert(p.pool_windows_x==5u&&p.pool_windows_y==8u);
            assert(p.pool_output_tokens==2160u);
            assert(p.final_head_tokens==2160u);
        }
        assert(CanSplitBlock(p,caps));
    }
    assert(shifted>0u&&pooled==1u);
    const auto& pool=routes.blocks[routes.runs[0].count-1u];
    assert(pool.block==(original?30u:10u));
    assert(pool.plan.has_pooled_projection);
    assert(!routes.blocks[routes.count-1u].plan.has_pooled_projection);

    auto broken=source;
    for(auto& x:broken)if(x.type=="CCSplitSwin16HQKVAttn"){
        x.shift_x=100;break;
    }
    assert(BuildNativeSplitRoutes(broken,routes)==
           SplitNativeRoutesError::InvalidShift);
    assert(routes.count==0u);
    broken=source;
    for(auto& x:broken)if(x.type=="CCSplitSwin16HQKVAttn"){
        x.grid_x=6u;break;
    }
    assert(BuildNativeSplitRoutes(broken,routes)==
           SplitNativeRoutesError::InvalidShape);
    assert(routes.count==0u);
    broken=source;
    for(auto& x:broken)if(x.type=="CCSplitSwin16HFfwdProj"){
        x.input0=0;break;
    }
    assert(BuildNativeSplitRoutes(broken,routes)!=
           SplitNativeRoutesError::Ok);
    assert(routes.count==0u);
    broken=source;
    for(auto& x:broken)if(x.type=="CCSplitSwin16HFinalHead"){
        x.type="CCSplitSwin16HProj";break;
    }
    assert(BuildNativeSplitRoutes(broken,routes)!=
           SplitNativeRoutesError::Ok);
    assert(routes.count==0u);
}
int main(int argc,char** argv){
    assert(argc==3);
    Check(argv[1],true);
    Check(argv[2],false);
}
```

`extras/graphics/test_rdna2_nr_split_projection_pool_policy.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Reference for 4x4 tiles per 8x8 window, half-resolution tiled output.
// Does not assume a native capture or certify any Vulkan execution.
#include "rdna2_nr_split_projection_pool_policy.h"
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>
using namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;
static std::uint32_t SourceToken(
    std::uint32_t x,std::uint32_t y,std::uint32_t windows_x){
    const std::uint32_t wx=x/8u,wy=y/8u;
    const std::uint32_t quadrant=2u*((y%8u)/4u)+(x%8u)/4u;
    const std::uint32_t slot=4u*(y%4u)+x%4u;
    return ((wy*windows_x+wx)*64u+quadrant*16u+slot);
}
static std::uint32_t DestinationToken(
    std::uint32_t x,std::uint32_t y,std::uint32_t padded_width){
    return ((y/4u)*(padded_width/4u)+x/4u)*16u+
           4u*(y%4u)+(x%4u);
}
int main(){
    constexpr SplitProjectionPool p{60u,33u,8u,5u,0u,0u,0u,0u,1920u};
    constexpr auto input=40ull*64u*512u;
    assert(SplitPoolWidth(p)==32u&&SplitPoolHeight(p)==20u);
    assert(SplitPoolLiveTokens(p)==640u);
    assert(SplitPoolOutputTokens(p)==1920u);
    assert(CanSplitProjectionPool(p,{input*4u,input,1024u,1920ull*512u}));
    assert(!CanSplitProjectionPool(p,{input*4u-1u,input,1024u,1920ull*512u}));
    assert(!CanSplitProjectionPool(p,{input*4u,input-1u,1024u,1920ull*512u}));
    assert(!CanSplitProjectionPool(p,{input*4u,input,1023u,1920ull*512u}));
    assert(!CanSplitProjectionPool(p,{input*4u,input,1024u,1920ull*512u-1u}));
    auto bad=p;bad.output_tokens=639u;
    assert(!CanSplitProjectionPool(bad,{UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX}));
    bad=p;bad.windows_x=7u;
    assert(!CanSplitProjectionPool(bad,{UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX}));
    bad=p;bad.width=65u;
    assert(!CanSplitProjectionPool(bad,{UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX}));
    bad=p;bad.pool_base_bytes=1u;
    assert(!CanSplitProjectionPool(bad,{UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX}));
    bad=p;bad.gain_base_halfwords=UINT32_MAX;
    assert(!CanSplitProjectionPool(bad,{UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX}));
    // Every padded source pixel has one distinct window/quadrant/slot.
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> hits(40u*64u,0u);
    for(std::uint32_t y=0u;y<40u;++y)
      for(std::uint32_t x=0u;x<64u;++x)
        ++hits[SourceToken(x,y,8u)];
    for(auto v:hits)assert(v==1u);
    // One unique destination per valid / padded half-res pixel.
    hits.assign(32u*20u,0u);
    for(std::uint32_t y=0u;y<20u;++y)
      for(std::uint32_t x=0u;x<32u;++x)
        ++hits[DestinationToken(x,y,32u)];
    for(auto v:hits)assert(v==1u);
    // 2x2 pooling with 4x4 tile source order, before quantizing.
    std::vector<float> values(40u*64u,0.f),pooled(32u*20u,0.f);
    for(std::uint32_t y=0u;y<33u;++y)
      for(std::uint32_t x=0u;x<60u;++x)
        values[SourceToken(x,y,8u)]=float(y*60u+x);
    for(std::uint32_t y=0u;y<17u;++y)
      for(std::uint32_t x=0u;x<30u;++x){
        float s=0.f;
        for(std::uint32_t dy=0u;dy<2u;++dy)
          for(std::uint32_t dx=0u;dx<2u;++dx){
            const auto sx=2u*x+dx,sy=2u*y+dy;
            if(sx<60u&&sy<33u)
                s+=values[SourceToken(sx,sy,8u)];
          }
        pooled[DestinationToken(x,y,32u)]=s*0.25f;
      }
    assert(pooled[DestinationToken(0u,0u,32u)]==30.5f);
    assert(pooled[DestinationToken(29u,16u,32u)]==
           (1978.f+1979.f)*0.25f);
    assert(pooled[DestinationToken(30u,0u,32u)]==0.f);
    assert(pooled[DestinationToken(0u,17u,32u)]==0.f);
}
```

`extras/graphics/test_rdna2_nr_split_residual_weights.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/nr_rdna2_split_residual_weight_loader.h"
#include "rdna2_nr_vit_epilogue_policy.h"
#include "rdna2_nr_projection_policy.h"
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>
using namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;
int main(){
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> matrix(512u*512u,0x38u);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> gain(1024u);
    // Exact FP16 representation of +1.0 for all 512 skip channels.
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<512u;++i){
        gain[2u*i]=0u;
        gain[2u*i+1u]=0x3cu;
    }
    matrix[0]=0x00u; // existing model requantization +0 -> -0
    SplitResidualWeights staged;
    assert(DecodeSplitResidualWeights(matrix,gain,staged));
    assert(staged.matrix.size()==512u*512u);
    assert(staged.gain_f16.size()==1024u);
    assert(staged.matrix[0]==0x80u);
    assert(staged.matrix[1]==0x38u);
    assert(staged.gain_f16[1]==0x3cu);
    const Projection proj{2160u,512u,512u,512u,512u,0u,0u};
    const Storage caps{2160ull*512u,512u*512u,
                       2160ull*512u*4u,2160ull*512u*4u};
    assert(CanDispatch(proj,caps));
    const VitResidual residual{2160u,512u,0u,0u,0u,0u};
    const VitEpilogueStorage rcaps{
        caps.output_bytes,2160ull*512u,1024u,2160ull*512u};
    assert(CanVitResidual(residual,rcaps));
    assert(!CanVitResidual(residual,{caps.output_bytes,
        2160ull*512u,1023u,2160ull*512u}));
    assert(!DecodeSplitResidualWeights(
        std::span<const std::uint8_t>{matrix.data(),matrix.size()-1u},
        gain,staged));
    assert(staged.matrix.empty()&&staged.gain_f16.empty());
    assert(!DecodeSplitResidualWeights(matrix,
        std::span<const std::uint8_t>{gain.data(),gain.size()-1u},
        staged));
    assert(staged.matrix.empty()&&staged.gain_f16.empty());
    matrix[100u]=0x7fu;
    assert(!DecodeSplitResidualWeights(matrix,gain,staged));
    assert(staged.matrix.empty()&&staged.gain_f16.empty());
    matrix[100u]=0x38u;
    // NaN FP16 (0x7e00) must be rejected by the gain decoder.
    gain[0]=0u;gain[1]=0x7eu;
    assert(!DecodeSplitResidualWeights(matrix,gain,staged));
    assert(staged.matrix.empty()&&staged.gain_f16.empty());
}
```

`extras/graphics/test_rdna2_nr_split_window_link.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Host verification of a true RDNA2 Split-Swin QKV -> attention handoff.
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/nr_rdna2_split_window_link_policy.h"
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
using namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;

int main() {
    constexpr std::uint32_t windows=64u, heads=8u;
    constexpr std::uint64_t activation=std::uint64_t(windows)*64u*512u;
    constexpr std::uint64_t weights=std::uint64_t(heads)*96u*512u;
    constexpr std::uint64_t tensor=std::uint64_t(windows)*heads*64u*32u;
    constexpr std::uint64_t bias=std::uint64_t(heads)*64u*64u*4u;
    const SplitWindowLink shape{
        {0u,0u,0u,0u,0u,0u,windows,heads},
        {0u,0u,0u,0u,0u,windows,heads}};
    const SplitWindowLinkStorage capacity{
        {activation,weights,heads*4u,tensor,tensor,tensor},
        {tensor,tensor,tensor,tensor,bias}};
    assert(CanSplitWindowLink(shape,capacity));

    // Tests all three producer/consumer offsets independently.
    auto bad=shape;
    bad.attention.q_base_bytes=4u;
    assert(!CanSplitWindowLink(bad,capacity));
    bad=shape;bad.attention.k_base_bytes=4u;
    assert(!CanSplitWindowLink(bad,capacity));
    bad=shape;bad.attention.v_base_bytes=4u;
    assert(!CanSplitWindowLink(bad,capacity));
    bad=shape;bad.attention.windows=windows/2u;
    assert(!CanSplitWindowLink(bad,capacity));
    bad=shape;bad.attention.heads=heads/2u;
    assert(!CanSplitWindowLink(bad,capacity));

    auto smaller=capacity;
    smaller.qkv.q_bytes=tensor-4u;
    assert(!CanSplitWindowLink(shape,smaller));
    smaller=capacity;smaller.attention.context_bytes=0u;
    assert(!CanSplitWindowLink(shape,smaller));
    smaller=capacity;smaller.attention.bias_bytes=bias-1u;
    assert(!CanSplitWindowLink(shape,smaller));
    smaller=capacity;smaller.attention.v_bytes=tensor+4u;
    assert(!CanSplitWindowLink(shape,smaller));

    // Matching nonzero, byte-aligned offsets are allowed when both stages
    // target the same live descriptor ranges.
    auto shifted=shape;
    shifted.qkv.q_base_bytes=shifted.attention.q_base_bytes=4u;
    shifted.qkv.k_base_bytes=shifted.attention.k_base_bytes=4u;
    shifted.qkv.v_base_bytes=shifted.attention.v_base_bytes=4u;
    auto padded=capacity;
    padded.qkv.q_bytes=padded.attention.q_bytes=tensor+4u;
    padded.qkv.k_bytes=padded.attention.k_bytes=tensor+4u;
    padded.qkv.v_bytes=padded.attention.v_bytes=tensor+4u;
    assert(CanSplitWindowLink(shifted,padded));
    shifted.attention.v_base_bytes=0u;
    assert(!CanSplitWindowLink(shifted,padded));
}
```

`extras/graphics/test_rdna2_nr_split_window_weight_loader.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Verified CCSplitSwin16HQKVAttn layout: 1536x512 QKV, 16 heads,
// 16*64*64 FP16 attention bias, and 16 FP32 temperatures.
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/nr_rdna2_split_window_weight_loader.h"
#include <array>
#include <bit>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>
using namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;
int main(){
    constexpr std::size_t C=512u;
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> qkv(3u*C*C,0x38u);
    qkv[0]=0x00u; // +0 must re-quantize to -0
    qkv[512u*C]=0x40u; // K head 0, channel 0
    qkv[1024u*C]=0x48u; // V head 0, channel 0
    qkv[32u*C]=0x50u; // Q head 1, channel 0
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> ordered;
    assert(ReorderSplitWindowQkv(qkv,ordered));
    assert(ordered.size()==qkv.size());
    assert(ordered[0]==0x80u);
    assert(ordered[32u*C]==0x40u);
    assert(ordered[64u*C]==0x48u);
    assert(ordered[96u*C]==0x50u);
    assert(!ReorderSplitWindowQkv(
        std::span<const std::uint8_t>{qkv.data(),qkv.size()-1u},ordered));
    assert(ordered.empty());
    qkv[128u*C]=0x7fu;
    assert(!ReorderSplitWindowQkv(qkv,ordered));
    assert(ordered.empty());
    std::array<std::uint8_t,64> raw{};
    for(std::size_t head=0u;head<16u;++head){
        auto bits=std::bit_cast<std::uint32_t>(1.0f+head/16.f);
        for(unsigned j=0;j<4u;++j)
            raw[4u*head+j]=std::uint8_t(bits>>(8u*j));
    }
    std::array<float,16> temperatures{};
    assert(DecodeSplitWindowTemperatures(raw,temperatures));
    assert(temperatures[0]==1.f);
    assert(temperatures[15]==1.f+15.f/16.f);
    assert(!DecodeSplitWindowTemperatures(
        std::span<const std::uint8_t>{raw.data(),63u},temperatures));
    for(float x:temperatures)assert(x==0.f);
    // Reject invalid head temperature, regardless of the other 15 heads.
    raw[0]=0u;raw[1]=0u;raw[2]=0xc0u;raw[3]=0x7fu; // 0x7fc00000 NaN
    assert(!DecodeSplitWindowTemperatures(raw,temperatures));
    std::vector<float> deswizzled;
    std::vector<float> per_head_bias(16u*4096u);
    for(unsigned h=0u;h<16u;++h)
        for(unsigned i=0u;i<4096u;++i)
            per_head_bias[h*4096u+i]=float(h);
    assert(NeuralDeswizzleBias64(per_head_bias,16u,deswizzled));
    assert(deswizzled.size()==per_head_bias.size());
    for(unsigned h=0u;h<16u;++h)
        for(unsigned i=0u;i<4096u;++i)
            assert(deswizzled[h*4096u+i]==float(h));
}
```

`extras/graphics/test_rdna2_nr_temporal_compose_policy.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
#include "rdna2_nr_temporal_compose_policy.h"
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/nr_rdna2_temporal_blend_weight_loader.h"
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <chrono>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
using namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;
static void Write32(std::vector<std::uint8_t>& v,std::size_t at,
                    std::uint32_t x){
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<4u;++i)v[at+i]=
        static_cast<std::uint8_t>(x>>(8u*i));
}
static void Write64(std::vector<std::uint8_t>& v,std::size_t at,
                    std::uint64_t x){
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<8u;++i)v[at+i]=
        static_cast<std::uint8_t>(x>>(8u*i));
}
static void FakePack(const std::filesystem::path& file,
                     std::uint16_t coefficient,
                     std::size_t payload_size=2u){
    const std::string name=
        "unpacked-postblock/block70.layer0.layer.blend_scale.bin";
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> bytes(256u+payload_size);
    const std::string magic="NRMODEL1";
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<8u;++i)bytes[i]=
        static_cast<std::uint8_t>(magic[i]);
    Write32(bytes,8u,1u);
    Write32(bytes,12u,0u);
    Write32(bytes,16u,static_cast<std::uint32_t>(name.size()));
    std::size_t at=20u;
    for(char c:name)bytes[at++]=static_cast<std::uint8_t>(c);
    Write64(bytes,at,256u);
    Write64(bytes,at+8u,payload_size);
    bytes[256u]=static_cast<std::uint8_t>(coefficient);
    bytes[257u]=static_cast<std::uint8_t>(coefficient>>8u);
    std::ofstream output(file,std::ios::binary);
    output.write(
        reinterpret_cast<const char*>(bytes.data()),
        static_cast<std::streamsize>(bytes.size()));
    assert(output.good());
    output.close();
}
int main(){
    constexpr NRTemporalComposeShape shape{80u,60u,0.65f,0.75f,1u,0u,0u,0u};
    constexpr std::uint64_t n=80ull*60ull;
    const std::array<std::uint64_t,6> capacities{
        n*16u,n*32u,n*16u,n*16u,n*16u,n*16u};
    assert(CanNRTemporalCompose(shape,capacities));
    auto invalid=shape;
    invalid.intensity=1.1f;
    assert(!CanNRTemporalCompose(invalid,capacities));
    invalid=shape;invalid.blend_scale=-1.0f;
    assert(!CanNRTemporalCompose(invalid,capacities));
    invalid=shape;invalid.history_valid=2u;
    assert(!CanNRTemporalCompose(invalid,capacities));
    invalid=shape;invalid.reserved2=1u;
    assert(!CanNRTemporalCompose(invalid,capacities));
    invalid=shape;invalid.width=0u;
    assert(!CanNRTemporalCompose(invalid,capacities));
    auto short_head=capacities;--short_head[1];
    assert(!CanNRTemporalCompose(shape,short_head));
    auto invalid_float=shape;
    invalid_float.intensity=std::nanf("");
    assert(!CanNRTemporalCompose(invalid_float,capacities));
    NRTemporalComposeShape cold=shape;
    cold.history_valid=0u;
    assert(CanNRTemporalCompose(cold,capacities));

    const auto file=std::filesystem::temp_directory_path()/
        ("eden-r09-blend-"+
         std::to_string(std::chrono::steady_clock::now()
            .time_since_epoch().count())+".nrmodel");
    auto checked=[&](std::uint16_t scalar,std::size_t size,
                     bool should_pass){
        FakePack(file,scalar,size);
        NeuralModelFile pack;
        assert(pack.Open(file.string()));
        float blend=99.0f;
        const bool ok=PrepareNRTemporalBlendScale(pack,70u,blend);
        assert(ok==should_pass);
        if(should_pass)assert(blend==0.75f);
        else assert(blend==0.0f);
        std::filesystem::remove(file);
    };
    checked(0x3a00u,2u,true); // exactly 0.75 FP16
    checked(0x4000u,2u,false); // greater than one
    checked(0x7e00u,2u,false); // NaN
    checked(0x3a00u,4u,false); // not precisely one FP16 scalar
    float missing=1.0f;
    assert(!PrepareNRTemporalBlendScale(NeuralModelFile{},70u,missing));
    assert(missing==0.0f);
}
```

`extras/graphics/test_rdna2_nr_tile_layout.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// RDNA2 import/export of MIT 16x16 E4M3FN tiled model matrices.
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <span>
#include <vector>
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/nr_rdna2_tile_layout.h"
using namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;

static void check_shape(std::uint32_t rows,std::uint32_t columns){
    const std::size_t size=std::size_t(rows)*columns;
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> linear(size),tiled(size),restored(size);
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<size;++i)
        linear[i]=std::uint8_t(((i*53u)+(i>>8u)*79u+(i>>3u))&0xffu);
    assert(RowMajorToNeuralTiles(linear,tiled,rows,columns)==NeuralTileResult::Ok);
    assert(NeuralTilesToRowMajor(tiled,restored,rows,columns)==NeuralTileResult::Ok);
    assert(restored==linear);
    // Every destination element must originate from its exact row,col.
    for(std::uint32_t r=0;r<rows;r+=16u)
        for(std::uint32_t c=0;c<columns;c+=16u){
            const auto ix=Tile16Index(r,c,columns);
            assert(ix< size);
            assert(tiled[ix]==linear[RowMajorIndex(r,c,columns)]);
            const auto ix2=Tile16Index(r+15u,c+15u,columns);
            assert(tiled[ix2]==linear[RowMajorIndex(r+15u,c+15u,columns)]);
        }
}
int main(){
    static_assert(ValidNeuralTileShape(16,16));
    static_assert(Tile16Index(0,0,16)==0);
    static_assert(Tile16Index(15,15,16)==255);
    static_assert(Tile16Index(0,16,32)==256);
    static_assert(Tile16Index(16,0,32)==512);
    static_assert(!ValidNeuralTileShape(15,16));
    static_assert(!ValidNeuralTileShape(16,15));
    static_assert(!ValidNeuralTileShape(0,16));
    static_assert(!ValidNeuralTileShape(65536u,65536u));

    check_shape(16,16);
    check_shape(16,32);
    check_shape(32,16);
    check_shape(32,32);
    // QKV: [16 heads*96 output features,512 inputs].
    check_shape(1536,512);
    // FFWD3 W1/W2/W3: eight groups laid out contiguously.
    check_shape(512,512);
    check_shape(2048,64);
    check_shape(512,256);
    // ViT/global attention uses tiles of 16 token by 16 channels.
    check_shape(64,1024);

    std::vector<std::uint8_t> a(256),b(256);
    assert(NeuralTilesToRowMajor(a,b,0,16)==NeuralTileResult::InvalidShape);
    assert(NeuralTilesToRowMajor(a,b,16,12)==NeuralTileResult::InvalidShape);
    assert(NeuralTilesToRowMajor(
        std::span<const std::uint8_t>(a.data(),255),b,16,16)==
        NeuralTileResult::InsufficientInput);
    assert(NeuralTilesToRowMajor(
        a,std::span<std::uint8_t>(b.data(),255),16,16)==
        NeuralTileResult::InsufficientOutput);
    assert(NeuralTilesToRowMajor(a,a,16,16)==NeuralTileResult::Aliasing);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> overlap(260u);
    assert(NeuralTilesToRowMajor(
        std::span<const std::uint8_t>(overlap.data(),256),
        std::span<std::uint8_t>(overlap.data()+4u,256),16,16)==
        NeuralTileResult::Aliasing);
    // Destination must not be touched when inputs fail validation.
    b.assign(256,0x5au);
    assert(NeuralTilesToRowMajor(
        std::span<const std::uint8_t>(a.data(),255),b,16,16)==
        NeuralTileResult::InsufficientInput);
    for(auto x:b)assert(x==0x5au);
}
```

`extras/graphics/test_rdna2_nr_token_repack_policy.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// CPU reference for the public MIT network token-tile permutation.
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include "rdna2_nr_token_repack_policy.h"
using namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;

static uint32_t offset(uint32_t token,uint32_t channel,uint32_t c) {
    return ((token/16u)*(c/16u)+channel/16u)*256u+(token%16u)*16u;
}
static void repack(std::vector<uint8_t>& mem,TokenRepack p) {
    assert(CanRepack(p,mem.size()));
    const uint32_t runs=p.channels/16u;
    for(uint32_t i=0;i<p.width*p.height*runs;++i){
        uint32_t raster=i/runs,channel=(i%runs)*16u;
        uint32_t x=raster%p.width,y=raster/p.width;
        uint32_t tile=((y/4u)*(p.width/4u)+x/4u)*16u+(y%4u)*4u+x%4u;
        auto from=p.inverse ? raster:tile, to=p.inverse ? tile:raster;
        const auto src=p.src_base_bytes+offset(from,channel,p.channels);
        const auto dst=p.dst_base_bytes+offset(to,channel,p.channels);
        std::copy_n(mem.begin()+src,16,mem.begin()+dst);
    }
}
int main(){
    TokenRepack p{0,2048,8,8,32,0};
    std::vector<uint8_t> data(6144,0);
    for(uint32_t i=0;i<2048;++i)data[i]=uint8_t((i*29u+11u)&255u);
    const auto initial=data;
    assert(CanRepack(p,data.size()));
    repack(data,p);
    TokenRepack back{2048,4096,8,8,32,1};
    assert(CanRepack(back,data.size()));
    repack(data,back);
    assert(std::equal(data.begin(),data.begin()+2048,data.begin()+4096));
    assert(!CanRepack({0,0,8,8,32,0},data.size()));
    assert(!CanRepack({0,1024,8,8,32,0},data.size()));
    assert(!CanRepack({0,2048,7,8,32,0},data.size()));
    assert(!CanRepack({0,2048,8,8,31,0},data.size()));
    assert(!CanRepack({0,2048,8,8,32,2},data.size()));
    assert(!CanRepack({1,2048,8,8,32,0},data.size()));
    assert(!CanRepack({0,2048,8,8,32,0},2048));
    assert(!CanRepack({0,UINT32_MAX-15u,8,8,32,0},UINT64_MAX));
    return 0;
}
```

`extras/graphics/test_rdna2_nr_unet_bottleneck_link_policy.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
#include "rdna2_nr_unet_bottleneck_link_policy.h"
#include <cassert>
#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
using namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;
static void Check(const char* path){
    std::ifstream f(path,std::ios::binary);assert(f);
    const std::string text{std::istreambuf_iterator<char>{f},
                           std::istreambuf_iterator<char>{}};
    std::vector<NativePlanStep> rows;
    assert(ParseNativePlan(text,rows)==NativePlanError::Ok);
    NativeUNetSkipMap graph{};
    NativeSplitRoutes split{};
    NativeVitRoute vit{};
    assert(BuildNativeUNetSkipMap(rows,graph)==NativeUNetSkipError::Ok);
    assert(BuildNativeSplitRoutes(rows,split)==SplitNativeRoutesError::Ok);
    assert(BuildNativeVitRoute(rows,vit)==NativeVitRouteError::Ok);
    const auto& first=split.blocks[split.runs[0].start];
    const auto required=std::uint64_t(first.raster_width)*
                        first.raster_height*512u;
    assert(CanNativeUNetBottleneckLink(
        graph,split,vit,required,required,required));
    assert(!CanNativeUNetBottleneckLink(
        graph,split,vit,required-1u,required,required));
    assert(!CanNativeUNetBottleneckLink(
        graph,split,vit,required,required-1u,required));
    assert(!CanNativeUNetBottleneckLink(
        graph,split,vit,required,required,required-1u));
    auto g=graph;g.count=3u;
    assert(!CanNativeUNetBottleneckLink(g,split,vit,required,required,required));
    g=graph;for(auto& edge:g.edges)if(edge.channels==256u)++edge.down_block;
    assert(!CanNativeUNetBottleneckLink(g,split,vit,required,required,required));
    g=graph;for(auto& edge:g.edges)if(edge.channels==256u)++edge.up_input_block;
    assert(!CanNativeUNetBottleneckLink(g,split,vit,required,required,required));
    auto s=split;
    s.blocks[s.runs[0].start].raster_width++;
    assert(!CanNativeUNetBottleneckLink(graph,s,vit,required,required,required));
    s=split;s.blocks[s.runs[1].start+s.runs[1].count-1u].output_view=false;
    assert(!CanNativeUNetBottleneckLink(graph,s,vit,required,required,required));
    auto bad_vit=vit;bad_vit.raster_height++;
    assert(!CanNativeUNetBottleneckLink(graph,split,bad_vit,
                                        required,required,required));
}
int main(int argc,char** argv){
    assert(argc==3);
    Check(argv[1]);
    Check(argv[2]);
}
```

`extras/graphics/test_rdna2_nr_unet_down_sequence_policy.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Original and Compact native plans; one depth cannot be silently omitted.
#include "rdna2_nr_unet_down_sequence_policy.h"
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
using namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;
static void Test(const char* path){
    std::ifstream f(path,std::ios::binary);assert(f);
    const std::string content{std::istreambuf_iterator<char>{f},
                              std::istreambuf_iterator<char>{}};
    std::vector<NativePlanStep> steps;
    assert(ParseNativePlan(content,steps)==NativePlanError::Ok);
    NativeUNetSkipMap map{};
    assert(BuildNativeUNetSkipMap(steps,map)==NativeUNetSkipError::Ok);
    std::array<FSwinWindowLayout,4> in{},out{};
    std::array<std::uint64_t,4> down{};
    std::uint64_t first=0u;
    for(const auto& e:map.edges){
        const auto i=e.channels==32u?0u:e.channels==64u?1u:
                     e.channels==128u?2u:3u;
        in[i]={e.skip_windows_x,e.skip_windows_y,0,0};
        out[i]={e.skip_windows_x,e.skip_windows_y,0,-1};
        const auto w=e.skip_height,h=e.skip_width;
        down[i]=std::uint64_t(w/2u)*(h/2u)*(e.channels*2u);
        if(i==0u)first=std::uint64_t(w)*h*32u;
    }
    assert(CanNativeUNetDownSequence(map,in,out,first,down));
    assert(!CanNativeUNetDownSequence(map,in,out,first-1u,down));
    for(std::size_t i=0u;i<4u;++i){
        auto bad=down;bad[i]--;
        assert(!CanNativeUNetDownSequence(map,in,out,first,bad));
        auto bad_input=in;bad_input[i].windows_x++;
        assert(!CanNativeUNetDownSequence(map,bad_input,out,first,down));
        bad_input=in;bad_input[i].shift_y=-1;
        assert(!CanNativeUNetDownSequence(map,bad_input,out,first,down));
        auto bad_output=out;bad_output[i].shift_x=2;
        assert(!CanNativeUNetDownSequence(map,in,bad_output,first,down));
    }
    auto bad_map=map;bad_map.count=3u;
    assert(!CanNativeUNetDownSequence(bad_map,in,out,first,down));
    bad_map=map;bad_map.edges[0].channels=512u;
    assert(!CanNativeUNetDownSequence(bad_map,in,out,first,down));
    bad_map=map;bad_map.edges[1].down_block=bad_map.edges[2].down_block;
    assert(!CanNativeUNetDownSequence(bad_map,in,out,first,down));
}
int main(int argc,char** argv){
    assert(argc==3);
    Test(argv[1]);Test(argv[2]);
```

`extras/graphics/test_rdna2_nr_unet_skip_map.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Verify U-Net skip relationships against BOTH recovered native plans.
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/nr_rdna2_unet_skip_map.h"
using namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;
static void Check(const char* path,bool original){
    std::ifstream f(path,std::ios::binary);
    assert(f);
    const std::string text{std::istreambuf_iterator<char>{f},
                           std::istreambuf_iterator<char>{}};
    std::vector<NativePlanStep> steps;
    assert(ParseNativePlan(text,steps)==NativePlanError::Ok);
    NativeUNetSkipMap map{};
    assert(BuildNativeUNetSkipMap(steps,map)==NativeUNetSkipError::Ok);
    assert(map.count==4u);
    constexpr std::array<std::uint32_t,4> original_down{22,14,8,4};
    constexpr std::array<std::uint32_t,4> original_up{48,56,62,66};
    constexpr std::array<std::uint32_t,4> small_down{8,6,4,2};
    constexpr std::array<std::uint32_t,4> small_up{22,24,26,28};
    const auto& downs=original?original_down:small_down;
    const auto& ups=original?original_up:small_up;
    for(std::size_t i=0u;i<map.count;++i){
        const auto& edge=map.edges[i];
        assert(edge.down_block==downs[i]);
        assert(edge.up_block==ups[i]);
        assert(edge.channels==(i==0u?256u:i==1u?128u:i==2u?64u:32u));
        assert(edge.up_input_block+1u==edge.up_block);
    }
    // Never accept a dangling or mismatched skip producer.
    auto malformed=steps;
    for(auto& s:malformed)
        if(s.block==ups[0]){
            s.input1=999;
            break;
        }
    assert(BuildNativeUNetSkipMap(malformed,map)==
           NativeUNetSkipError::MissingProducer);
    assert(map.count==0u);
    // A skip's width is an architectural constraint, not a guess.
    malformed=steps;
    for(auto& s:malformed)
        if(s.block==ups[1]){
            ++s.input_channels;
            break;
        }
    assert(BuildNativeUNetSkipMap(malformed,map)==
           NativeUNetSkipError::BadShape);
    assert(map.count==0u);
    malformed=steps;
    for(auto& s:malformed)
        if(s.block==downs[0]){
            ++s.output_channels;
            break;
        }
    assert(BuildNativeUNetSkipMap(malformed,map)==
           NativeUNetSkipError::BadShape);
    assert(map.count==0u);
    malformed=steps;
    malformed.erase(
        std::remove_if(malformed.begin(),malformed.end(),
            [first=ups[0]](const auto& s){return s.block==first;}),
        malformed.end());
    assert(BuildNativeUNetSkipMap(malformed,map)==
           NativeUNetSkipError::Incomplete);
}
int main(int argc,char**argv){
    assert(argc==3);
    Check(argv[1],true);
    Check(argv[2],false);
}
```

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
#include "rdna2_nr_unet_up_sequence_policy.h"
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
using namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;
static void Test(const char* name){
    std::ifstream f(name,std::ios::binary);assert(f);
    const std::string source{std::istreambuf_iterator<char>{f},
                             std::istreambuf_iterator<char>{}};
    std::vector<NativePlanStep> rows;
    assert(ParseNativePlan(source,rows)==NativePlanError::Ok);
    NativeUNetSkipMap graph{};
    assert(BuildNativeUNetSkipMap(rows,graph)==NativeUNetSkipError::Ok);
    std::array<FSwinWindowLayout,4> in{},out{};
    std::array<std::uint64_t,4> buffers{};
    std::uint64_t low=0u;
    for(const auto& e:graph.edges){
        const std::size_t i=e.channels==256u?0u:
                            e.channels==128u?1u:
                            e.channels==64u?2u:3u;
        in[i]={e.skip_windows_x,e.skip_windows_y,0,0};
        out[i]={e.skip_windows_x,e.skip_windows_y,-1,0};
        buffers[i]=std::uint64_t(e.skip_height)*e.skip_width*e.channels;
        if(i==0u)
            low=std::uint64_t(e.skip_height/2u)*
                (e.skip_width/2u)*512u;
    }
    assert(CanNativeUNetUpSequence(graph,in,out,low,buffers));
    assert(!CanNativeUNetUpSequence(graph,in,out,low-1u,buffers));
    for(std::size_t i=0u;i<4u;++i){
        auto smaller=buffers;smaller[i]--;
        assert(!CanNativeUNetUpSequence(graph,in,out,low,smaller));
        auto wrong_in=in;wrong_in[i].windows_y++;
        assert(!CanNativeUNetUpSequence(graph,wrong_in,out,low,buffers));
        wrong_in=in;wrong_in[i].shift_x=-2;
        assert(!CanNativeUNetUpSequence(graph,wrong_in,out,low,buffers));
        auto wrong_out=out;wrong_out[i].shift_y=2;
        assert(!CanNativeUNetUpSequence(graph,in,wrong_out,low,buffers));
    }
    auto bad=graph;bad.count=3u;
    assert(!CanNativeUNetUpSequence(bad,in,out,low,buffers));
    bad=graph;bad.edges[0].channels=512u;
    assert(!CanNativeUNetUpSequence(bad,in,out,low,buffers));
    bad=graph;bad.edges[1].up_input_block=bad.edges[1].up_block;
    assert(!CanNativeUNetUpSequence(bad,in,out,low,buffers));
}
int main(int argc,char** argv){
    assert(argc==3);
    Test(argv[1]);Test(argv[2]);
}
```

`extras/graphics/test_rdna2_nr_unet_upsample_edges.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Original and Compact exact native graph: test the four upsample edges,
// transposed raster axes, low FP8 storage and shifted first FSwin windows.
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include "rdna2_nr_fswin_upsample_policy.h"
#include "rdna2_nr_fswin_window_repack_policy.h"
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/nr_rdna2_unet_skip_map.h"
using namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;
static void Test(std::string path,bool original){
    std::ifstream f(path,std::ios::binary);
    assert(f);
    const std::string input{
        std::istreambuf_iterator<char>{f},
        std::istreambuf_iterator<char>{}};
    std::vector<NativePlanStep> rows;
    assert(ParseNativePlan(input,rows)==NativePlanError::Ok);
    NativeUNetSkipMap map{};
    assert(BuildNativeUNetSkipMap(rows,map)==NativeUNetSkipError::Ok);
    assert(map.count==4u);
    const std::array<std::uint32_t,4> original_up{48,56,62,66};
    const std::array<std::uint32_t,4> compact_up{22,24,26,28};
    const auto& expected=original?original_up:compact_up;
    const auto segments=ExtractNativeFSwinSegments(rows);
    // Every upsample must supply its OWN FSwin body, not only the
    // prologue. Old extraction silently lost four learned layers.
    assert(segments.size()==8u);
    std::size_t shifted_count=0u;
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<4u;++i){
        const auto& edge=map.edges[i];
        assert(edge.up_block==expected[i]);
        const std::uint64_t high_w=edge.skip_height;
        const std::uint64_t high_h=edge.skip_width;
        const auto it=std::find_if(rows.begin(),rows.end(),
            [id=edge.up_block](const NativePlanStep& row){
                return row.block==id&&row.layer==0u;});
        assert(it!=rows.end()&&it->inputs==2u);
        assert(NativeUpsampleFSwin(*it));
        const auto seg=std::find_if(segments.begin(),segments.end(),
            [block=edge.up_block](const NativeFSwinSegment& candidate) {
                return !candidate.layers.empty() &&
                    candidate.layers.front().block==block;
            });
        assert(seg!=segments.end());
        assert(seg->layers.front().view==NativeFSwinView::Upsample);
        assert(seg->layers.front().layer==0u);
        assert(seg->layers.front().weight_prefix==
            "unpacked/block"+std::to_string(edge.up_block)+".layer0.layer");
        if(seg->layers.size()>1u)
            assert(seg->layers[1].block==edge.up_block+1u);
        assert(it->input0==static_cast<std::int32_t>(edge.up_input_block));
        assert(it->input1==static_cast<std::int32_t>(edge.down_block));
        assert(it->width==high_h/2u&&it->height==high_w/2u);
        assert(edge.skip_windows_x==(high_w+7u)/8u);
        assert(edge.skip_windows_y==(high_h+7u)/8u);
        assert(it->grid_x==edge.skip_windows_x&&
               it->grid_y==edge.skip_windows_y);
        const auto low=(high_w/2u)*(high_h/2u)*2u*edge.channels;
        const auto high=high_w*high_h*edge.channels;
        const auto weights=2ull*edge.channels*edge.channels;
        assert(low>0u&&high>0u);
        const FSwinUpsample stage{
            static_cast<std::uint32_t>(high_w),
            static_cast<std::uint32_t>(high_h),
            edge.skip_windows_x,edge.skip_windows_y,
            edge.channels,0u,0u,0u,0u,0u};
        assert(CanFSwinUpsample(stage,
            {low,high,weights,4u*edge.channels,high}));
        assert(!CanFSwinUpsample(stage,
            {low-1u,high,weights,4u*edge.channels,high}));
        const auto next=std::find_if(rows.begin(),rows.end(),
            [id=edge.up_block](const NativePlanStep& row){
                return row.block==id+1u&&row.layer==0u;});
        assert(next!=rows.end()&&next->input0==
               static_cast<std::int32_t>(edge.up_block));
        assert(next->grid_x==edge.skip_windows_x&&
               next->grid_y==edge.skip_windows_y);
        const FSwinWindowRepack shifted{
            .windows_x=next->grid_x,.windows_y=next->grid_y,
            .channels=next->channels,
            .src_shift_x=0,.src_shift_y=0,
            .dst_shift_x=next->shift_x,
            .dst_shift_y=next->shift_y};
        const auto padded=std::uint64_t(next->grid_x)*
            next->grid_y*64u*next->channels;
        assert(CanFSwinWindowRepack(shifted,{padded,padded}));
        if(next->shift_x||next->shift_y)++shifted_count;
        assert(next->channels==edge.channels);
        auto bad=*it;
        bad.input_channels=edge.channels;
        assert(!NativeUpsampleFSwin(bad));
        bad=*it;
        bad.input1=-1;
        assert(!NativeUpsampleFSwin(bad));
    }
    assert(shifted_count>0u); // both models need the new shifted GPU ingress
}
int main(int argc,char**argv){
    assert(argc==3);
    Test(argv[1],true);
    Test(argv[2],false);
}
```

`extras/graphics/test_rdna2_nr_upsample_gain_reconstruction.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// R09: independently recovered FP16 C64/128/256 split into real model slices.
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/nr_rdna2_weight_decode.h"
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>
#include <vector>
using namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;

static void CheckWide(std::uint32_t c) {
    std::vector<float> residual(c+16u),short_gain(c-16u),merged{999.0f};
    for(std::uint32_t i=0;i<c;++i)residual[i]=float(i)/8.0f;
    for(std::uint32_t i=0;i<16u;++i)residual[c+i]=500.0f+float(i);
    for(std::uint32_t i=0;i<c-16u;++i)short_gain[i]=516.0f+float(i);
    assert(NeuralRecoverUpsampleGains(short_gain,residual,c,merged));
    assert(merged.size()==c);
    for(std::uint32_t i=0;i<c;++i)
        assert(merged[i]==500.0f+float(i));
    std::vector<float> recovered_residual;
    assert(NeuralWideUpsampleResidual(residual,c,recovered_residual));
    assert(recovered_residual.size()==c);
    for(std::uint32_t i=0;i<c;++i)
        assert(recovered_residual[i]==float(i)/8.0f);
    // Accept full source data; it must not be prepended twice.
    assert(NeuralRecoverUpsampleGains(merged,residual,c,recovered_residual));
    assert(recovered_residual==merged);
    auto broken=short_gain;
    broken.pop_back();
    assert(!NeuralRecoverUpsampleGains(broken,residual,c,merged));
    assert(merged.empty());
    auto extra=residual;
    extra.pop_back();
    assert(!NeuralRecoverUpsampleGains(short_gain,extra,c,merged));
    assert(merged.empty());
    assert(!NeuralWideUpsampleResidual(extra,c,recovered_residual));
    assert(recovered_residual.empty());
    extra=residual;
    extra[c]=std::numeric_limits<float>::quiet_NaN();
    assert(!NeuralRecoverUpsampleGains(short_gain,extra,c,merged));
    assert(merged.empty());
    extra=residual;
    extra[0]=std::numeric_limits<float>::infinity();
    assert(!NeuralWideUpsampleResidual(extra,c,recovered_residual));
    assert(recovered_residual.empty());
    broken=short_gain;
    broken[0]=std::numeric_limits<float>::infinity();
    assert(!NeuralRecoverUpsampleGains(broken,residual,c,merged));
    assert(merged.empty());
}
int main(){
    std::vector<float> gain32(32),output;
    for(std::uint32_t i=0;i<32u;++i)gain32[i]=float(i);
    assert(NeuralRecoverUpsampleGains(gain32,{},32u,output));
    assert(output==gain32);
    assert(!NeuralRecoverUpsampleGains(gain32,{},64u,output));
    assert(output.empty());
    assert(!NeuralRecoverUpsampleGains(gain32,{},48u,output));
    assert(output.empty());
    CheckWide(64u);
    CheckWide(128u);
    CheckWide(256u);
}
```

`extras/graphics/test_rdna2_nr_upsample_view_policy.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// CPU reference for public MIT model's padded view / channel spill mapping.
#include <cassert>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>
#include "rdna2_nr_upsample_view_policy.h"
using namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;
static uint32_t at(uint32_t t,uint32_t c,uint32_t C){
    return ((t/16u)*(C/16u)+c/16u)*256u+(t%16u)*16u;
}
static void convert(std::vector<uint8_t>& mem,const UpsampleView& p){
    assert(CanUpsampleView(p,mem.size()));
    auto runs=p.channels/16u;
    for(uint32_t i=0;i<p.tokens*runs;++i){
        uint32_t t=i/runs,c=(i%runs)*16u;
        uint32_t tw=p.resized_width/4u;
        uint32_t x=(t/16u%tw)*4u+t%4u;
        uint32_t y=(t/16u/tw)*4u+(t%16u)/4u;
        uint32_t pos=(c/16u)*p.resized_width*p.resized_height+
            y*p.resized_width+x;
        uint32_t sc=(pos/(p.width*p.height))*16u;
        uint32_t pixel=pos%(p.width*p.height);
        uint32_t sx=pixel%p.width,sy=pixel/p.width;
        uint32_t st=((sy/4u)*(p.width/4u)+sx/4u)*16u+(sy%4u)*4u+sx%4u;
        auto dst=p.dst_base_bytes+at(t,c,p.channels);
        if(y<p.resized_height && sc<p.channels)
            std::copy_n(mem.begin()+p.src_base_bytes+at(st,sc,p.channels),
                        16,mem.begin()+dst);
        else std::fill_n(mem.begin()+dst,16,0u);
    }
}
int main(){
    // No padding: exact bitwise copy at every token/channel.
    UpsampleView p{0,2048,64,32,8,8,8,8};
    std::vector<uint8_t> mem(15000,0);
    for(uint32_t i=0;i<2048;++i)mem[i]=uint8_t((i*73u+31u)&255u);
    assert(CanUpsampleView(p,mem.size()));
    convert(mem,p);
    assert(std::equal(mem.begin(),mem.begin()+2048,mem.begin()+2048));
    // Padded grid: view crosses channel-plane boundaries; out of
    // range of all source channels produces zero.
    p={0,4096,144,32,8,8,12,12};
    assert(CanUpsampleView(p,mem.size()));
    convert(mem,p);
    assert(std::equal(mem.begin(),mem.begin()+16,mem.begin()+4096));
    auto invalid=p;
    invalid.width=7;assert(!CanUpsampleView(invalid,mem.size()));
    invalid=p;invalid.tokens=143;assert(!CanUpsampleView(invalid,mem.size()));
    invalid=p;invalid.dst_base_bytes=16;assert(!CanUpsampleView(invalid,mem.size()));
    invalid=p;invalid.channels=31;assert(!CanUpsampleView(invalid,mem.size()));
    invalid=p;invalid.resized_width=4;assert(!CanUpsampleView(invalid,mem.size()));
    invalid=p;invalid.src_base_bytes=1;assert(!CanUpsampleView(invalid,mem.size()));
    invalid=p;invalid.dst_base_bytes=UINT32_MAX-15u;
    assert(!CanUpsampleView(invalid,UINT64_MAX));
    return 0;
}
```

`extras/graphics/test_rdna2_nr_vit_attention_policy.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Scalar numerical oracle for ViT probability-before-normalization contract.
#include <cassert>
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>
#include "rdna2_nr_vit_attention_policy.h"
using namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;
static float decode(unsigned r){
    unsigned e=(r>>3u)&15u,m=r&7u;
    float sign=(r&128u)?-1.f:1.f;
    if(e==15u&&m==7u)return std::numeric_limits<float>::quiet_NaN();
    if(e==0u)return sign*float(m)*std::exp2(-9.f);
    return sign*float(8u+m)*std::exp2(float(int(e)-10));
}
static unsigned quant(float v){
    unsigned sign=std::signbit(v)?128u:0u;
    if(std::isnan(v))return sign|127u;
    float a=std::fmin(std::fabs(v),448.f);
    if(a<0.015625f) {
        auto m=static_cast<unsigned>(std::nearbyint(a*512.f));
        return sign|(m>=8u?8u:m);
    }
    int e=static_cast<int>(std::floor(std::log2(a)));
    auto m=static_cast<unsigned>(std::nearbyint((a/std::exp2(float(e))-1.f)*8.f));
    if(m==8u){++e;m=0u;}
    auto eb=static_cast<unsigned>(e+7);
    if(eb>15u||(eb==15u&&m>6u))return sign|126u;
    return sign|(eb<<3u)|m;
}
// Includes half mantissa transform; coefficients exactly representable in f16.
// This CPU test does not certify bitwise equivalence of GPU half FMA.
static float vit_exp(float x) {
    const float y=std::clamp(std::fma(x,0.08953857421875f,1.708984375f),
                            1.439453125f,1.9775390625f);
    const auto mant=static_cast<unsigned>(std::nearbyint((y-1.f)*1024.f));
    const unsigned half=(mant&1023u)<<4u;
    const unsigned e=(half>>10u)&31u, m=half&1023u;
    if(e==0u)return float(m)*std::exp2(-24.f);
    return (1.f+float(m)/1024.f)*std::exp2(float(int(e)-15));
}
static std::array<unsigned,32> context(
    const std::array<std::array<uint8_t,32>,3>& q,
    const std::array<std::array<uint8_t,32>,3>& k,
    const std::array<std::array<uint8_t,32>,3>& v,
    unsigned query,unsigned tokens) {
    std::array<float,32> ctx{};
    float den=0.f;
    for(unsigned key=0;key<tokens;key++){
        float score=0.f;
        for(unsigned c=0;c<32;c++)
            score=std::fma(decode(q[query][c]),decode(k[key][c]),score);
        float p=vit_exp(score);
        den+=p;
        float pq=decode(quant(p));
        for(unsigned c=0;c<32;c++)
            ctx[c]=std::fma(pq,decode(v[key][c]),ctx[c]);
    }
    std::array<unsigned,32> out{};
    for(unsigned c=0;c<32;c++)
        out[c]=quant(ctx[c]/std::max(den,6.198883056640625e-05f));
    return out;
}
int main(){
    VitAttention p{0,0,0,0,1};
    VitAttentionStorage s{1024,1024,1024,1024};
    assert(CanVitAttention(p,s));
    assert(!CanVitAttention(p,{1023,1024,1024,1024}));
    assert(!CanVitAttention(p,{1024,1023,1024,1024}));
    assert(!CanVitAttention(p,{1024,1024,1023,1024}));
    assert(!CanVitAttention(p,{1024,1024,1024,1023}));
    p.tokens=0;assert(!CanVitAttention(p,s));
    p.tokens=4097;assert(!CanVitAttention(p,{UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX}));
    p={1,0,0,0,1};assert(!CanVitAttention(p,{UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX}));
    p={0,0,0,UINT32_MAX-3u,1};
    assert(!CanVitAttention(p,{UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX}));
    p={0,0,0,0,2048};
    assert(CanVitAttention(p,{2097152,2097152,2097152,2097152}));
    // Native Original and Compact 1080p plans produce 2560 ViT tokens.
    p.tokens=2560;
    assert(CanVitAttention(p,{2621440,2621440,2621440,2621440}));
    assert(!CanVitAttention(p,{2621439,2621440,2621440,2621440}));
    p.tokens=4096;
    assert(CanVitAttention(p,{4194304,4194304,4194304,4194304}));
    p.tokens=4097;
    assert(!CanVitAttention(p,{UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX}));

    std::array<std::array<uint8_t,32>,3> q{},k{},v{};
    // For two equal logits, the value 0.5 survives E4M3FN quantization.
    v[0].fill(0x38u);
    v[1].fill(0x00u);
    auto o=context(q,k,v,0u,2u);
    for(auto z:o)assert(std::fabs(decode(z)-0.5f)<0.125f);
    // With all zero values, all 32 outputs must be exactly zero.
    v[0].fill(0u);
    o=context(q,k,v,0u,2u);
    for(auto z:o)assert(z==0u);
    // A nonzero Q·K shifts the weighted result toward the matching value.
    q[0][0]=0x40u; // +2
    k[0][0]=0x48u; // +4
    v[0].fill(0x38u);
    o=context(q,k,v,0u,2u);
    for(auto z:o)assert(decode(z)>0.5f);
    // Denominator includes unquantized exp; numerator uses FP8 exp.
    assert(vit_exp(0.f)>0.f);
    assert(std::fabs(decode(quant(vit_exp(0.f)))-vit_exp(0.f))>0.f);
    assert(quant(448.f)==0x7eu);
}
```

`extras/graphics/test_rdna2_nr_vit_boundary_repack_policy.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
#include "rdna2_nr_vit_boundary_repack_policy.h"
#include <cassert>
using namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;
int main() {
    constexpr VitBoundaryRepack to_vit{33,60,1024,2560,0,0,0};
    constexpr VitBoundaryRepack to_tiles{33,60,1024,2560,1,0,0};
    static_assert(sizeof(VitBoundaryRepack)==7u*sizeof(std::uint32_t));
    static_assert(VitTiledTokenCount(to_vit)==2160);
    // The 33-column raster uses 9 four-wide tiles per row. An
    // accidental 60x33 swap still occupies 2160 tokens but points
    // row 4 at tile #15 instead of tile #9.
    constexpr auto tile_index=[](std::uint32_t width,
                                 std::uint32_t x,std::uint32_t y){
        return ((y/4u)*((width+3u)/4u)+x/4u)*16u+
               (y%4u)*4u+x%4u;
    };
    static_assert(tile_index(to_vit.width,0u,4u)==144u);
    static_assert(tile_index(60u,0u,4u)==240u);
    static_assert(tile_index(to_vit.width,32u,59u)==2156u);
    static_assert(tile_index(to_vit.width,32u,59u)!=
                  tile_index(60u,32u,59u));
    static_assert(VitBoundaryGrid(to_vit)==2560);
    static_assert(VitBoundaryGrid(to_tiles)==2160);
    static_assert(CanVitBoundaryRepack(to_vit,{2160ull*1024,2560ull*1024}));
    static_assert(CanVitBoundaryRepack(to_tiles,{2560ull*1024,2160ull*1024}));
    static_assert(!CanVitBoundaryRepack(to_vit,{2160ull*1024-1,2560ull*1024}));
    static_assert(!CanVitBoundaryRepack(to_tiles,{2560ull*1024,2160ull*1024-1}));
    static_assert(!CanVitBoundaryRepack({0,60,1024,2560,0,0,0},{1ull<<24,1ull<<24}));
    static_assert(!CanVitBoundaryRepack({33,60,256,2560,0,0,0},{1ull<<24,1ull<<24}));
    static_assert(!CanVitBoundaryRepack({33,60,1024,2560,2,0,0},{1ull<<24,1ull<<24}));
    static_assert(!CanVitBoundaryRepack({33,60,1024,2560,0,1,0},{1ull<<24,1ull<<24}));
    static_assert(!CanVitBoundaryRepack({33,60,1024,1900,0,0,0},{1ull<<24,1ull<<24}));
    static_assert(!CanVitBoundaryRepack({4096,4096,1024,4096,0,0,0},{1ull<<32,1ull<<32}));
}
```

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
#include "rdna2_nr_vit_epilogue_policy.h"
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
using namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;
int main(){
    constexpr auto n=2560u;
    constexpr VitActivation expand{n,4096u,0u,0u};
    constexpr std::uint64_t e=std::uint64_t(n)*4096u;
    assert(CanVitActivation(expand,{e*4u,0u,0u,e}));
    assert(!CanVitActivation(expand,{e*4u-1u,0u,0u,e}));
    assert(!CanVitActivation(expand,{e*4u,0u,0u,e-1u}));
    assert(VitEpilogueGroups(n,4096u)==(e+511u)/512u);
    constexpr VitResidual vit{n,1024u,0u,0u,0u,0u};
    constexpr std::uint64_t v=std::uint64_t(n)*1024u;
    assert(CanVitResidual(vit,{v*4u,v,2048u,v}));
    assert(!CanVitResidual(vit,{v*4u,v-1u,2048u,v}));
    assert(!CanVitResidual(vit,{v*4u,v,2047u,v}));
    assert(!CanVitResidual(vit,{v*4u,v,2048u,v-1u}));
    // Split-Swin 512-channel projection uses the same residual primitive.
    constexpr VitResidual split{2160u,512u,0u,0u,0u,0u};
    constexpr std::uint64_t s=2160ull*512u;
    assert(CanVitResidual(split,{s*4u,s,1024u,s}));

                           {UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX}));
    assert(!CanVitResidual({0u,512u,0u,0u,0u,0u},
                           {UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX}));
    assert(!CanVitResidual({4097u,512u,0u,0u,0u,0u},
                           {UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX}));
    assert(!CanVitResidual({2160u,512u,0u,1u,0u,0u},
                           {UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX}));
    assert(!CanVitResidual({2160u,512u,0u,0u,2u,0u},
                           {UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX}));
    auto offset=split;offset.input_offset_floats=4u;
    assert(CanVitResidual(offset,{(s+4u)*4u,s,1024u,s}));
    offset=split;offset.gain_offset_halfwords=2u;
    assert(CanVitResidual(offset,{s*4u,s,1028u,s}));
    assert(!CanVitResidual(offset,{s*4u,s,1024u,s}));
    offset=split;offset.gain_offset_halfwords=UINT32_MAX;
    assert(!CanVitResidual(offset,{
        UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX}));

        UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX}));
```
