`extras/graphics/test_rdna2_nr_vit_ffn_weight_loader.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Entire local NRMODEL1 FFN/Proj model: no trained weights distributed.
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/nr_rdna2_vit_projection_layer_weight_loader.h"
#include <cassert>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
using namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;
namespace {
void Put32(std::vector<std::uint8_t>& out,std::uint32_t n){
    for(unsigned j=0;j<4u;++j)out.push_back(std::uint8_t(n>>(j*8u)));
}
void Put64(std::vector<std::uint8_t>& out,std::uint64_t n){
    for(unsigned j=0;j<8u;++j)out.push_back(std::uint8_t(n>>(j*8u)));
}
void Write64(std::vector<std::uint8_t>& out,std::size_t at,
             std::uint64_t n){
    for(unsigned j=0;j<8u;++j)out[at+j]=std::uint8_t(n>>(j*8u));
}
struct Entry{
    std::string name;
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> bytes;
};
std::vector<std::uint8_t> Pack(const std::vector<Entry>& entries){
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> out{'N','R','M','O','D','E','L','1'};
    Put32(out,static_cast<std::uint32_t>(entries.size()));
    Put32(out,0u);
    std::vector<std::size_t> positions;
    for(const auto& e:entries){
        Put32(out,static_cast<std::uint32_t>(e.name.size()));
        out.insert(out.end(),e.name.begin(),e.name.end());
        positions.push_back(out.size());
        Put64(out,0u);Put64(out,e.bytes.size());
    }
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<entries.size();++i){
        out.resize((out.size()+255u)&~std::size_t(255u),0u);
        Write64(out,positions[i],out.size());
        out.insert(out.end(),entries[i].bytes.begin(),entries[i].bytes.end());
    }
    return out;
}
void Save(const std::filesystem::path& path,
          const std::vector<Entry>& entries){
    const auto bytes=Pack(entries);
    std::ofstream file(path,std::ios::binary|std::ios::trunc);
    assert(file.good());
    file.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(bytes.data()),
               static_cast<std::streamsize>(bytes.size()));
    assert(file.good());
}
std::vector<Entry> Fixture(){
    const std::string base="unpacked-vit/block31.layer";
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> expand(4096u*1024u,0x38u);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> contract(1024u*4096u,0x40u);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> projection(1024u*1024u,0x48u);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> gain(2048u,0u);
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<1024u;++i)gain[2u*i+1u]=0x3cu;
    expand[0]=0u;
    return {
        {base+"0.layer.weight.bin",std::move(expand)},
        {base+"1.layer.weight.bin",std::move(contract)},
        {base+"1.layer.skip_weight.bin",gain},
        {base+"4.layer.weight.bin",std::move(projection)},
        {base+"4.layer.skip_weight.bin",gain}};
}
}
int main(){
    auto fixture=Fixture();
    const auto file=std::filesystem::temp_directory_path()/
        ("encore-vitffn-"+std::to_string(
            std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch().count())+
         ".nrmodel1");
    Save(file,fixture);
    NeuralModelFile model;
    assert(model.Open(file.string()));
    VitFfnBlockWeights whole;
    assert(PrepareVitFfnBlockWeights(model,31u,whole));
    assert(whole.expansion.size()==4096u*1024u);
    assert(whole.contraction.size()==1024u*4096u);
    assert(whole.projection.size()==1024u*1024u);
    assert(whole.contract_gain_f16.size()==2048u);
    assert(whole.projection_gain_f16.size()==2048u);
    assert(whole.expansion[0]==0x80u);
    assert(whole.expansion[1]==0x38u);
    assert(whole.contraction[0]==0x40u);
    assert(whole.projection[0]==0x48u);
    assert(whole.contract_gain_f16[1]==0x3cu);
    VitProjectionLayerWeights layer;
    assert(PrepareVitProjectionLayerWeights(
        model,31u,VitProjectionKind::Expand,layer));
    assert(layer.matrix.size()==4096u*1024u);
    assert(layer.gain_f16.empty());
    assert(PrepareVitProjectionLayerWeights(
        model,31u,VitProjectionKind::Contract,layer));
    assert(layer.matrix.size()==1024u*4096u);
    assert(layer.gain_f16.size()==2048u);
    assert(PrepareVitProjectionLayerWeights(
        model,31u,VitProjectionKind::ResidualProjection,layer));
    assert(layer.matrix.size()==1024u*1024u);
    assert(layer.gain_f16.size()==2048u);
    assert(!PrepareVitProjectionLayerWeights(
        model,512u,VitProjectionKind::Expand,layer));
    assert(layer.matrix.empty()&&layer.gain_f16.empty());
    // Invalid E4M3 source is fatal: never discard a layer silently.
    fixture[0].bytes[200u]=0x7fu;
    Save(file,fixture);assert(model.Open(file.string()));
    assert(!PrepareVitFfnBlockWeights(model,31u,whole));
    assert(whole.expansion.empty()&&whole.contraction.empty());
    fixture[0].bytes[200u]=0x38u;
    fixture[3].bytes.resize(1024u*1024u-1u);
    Save(file,fixture);assert(model.Open(file.string()));
    assert(!PrepareVitFfnBlockWeights(model,31u,whole));
    assert(whole.expansion.empty()&&whole.contraction.empty());
    fixture[3].bytes.resize(1024u*1024u,0x48u);
    fixture[2].bytes[0]=0u;fixture[2].bytes[1]=0x7eu;
    Save(file,fixture);assert(model.Open(file.string()));
    assert(!PrepareVitFfnBlockWeights(model,31u,whole));
    assert(whole.expansion.empty()&&whole.contraction.empty());
    std::filesystem::remove(file);
}
```

`extras/graphics/test_rdna2_nr_vit_native_route_policy.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
#include "rdna2_nr_vit_native_route_policy.h"
#include "rdna2_nr_split_native_routes_policy.h"
#include "rdna2_nr_vit_boundary_repack_policy.h"
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
using namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;
void Check(const char* file,bool original){
    std::ifstream stream(file,std::ios::binary);
    assert(stream);
    const std::string text{std::istreambuf_iterator<char>{stream},
                           std::istreambuf_iterator<char>{}};
    std::vector<NativePlanStep> rows;
    assert(ParseNativePlan(text,rows)==NativePlanError::Ok);
    NativeVitRoute route{};
    assert(BuildNativeVitRoute(rows,route)==NativeVitRouteError::Ok);
    assert(route.count==8u&&route.tokens==2560u);
    // Both 1080p model tables spell W=60,H=33, but FinalHead writes
    // 33 raster columns x 60 rows (upstream p.W=s.H, p.rows=s.W).
    assert(route.raster_width==33u&&route.raster_height==60u);
    const VitBoundaryRepack into_vit{
        route.raster_width,route.raster_height,1024u,
        route.tokens,0u,0u,0u};
    const VitBoundaryRepack into_decoder{
        route.raster_width,route.raster_height,1024u,
        route.tokens,1u,0u,0u};
    assert(VitTiledTokenCount(into_vit)==2160u);
    assert(CanVitBoundaryRepack(into_vit,{
        2160ull*1024u,2560ull*1024u}));
    assert(CanVitBoundaryRepack(into_decoder,{
        2560ull*1024u,2160ull*1024u}));
    NativeSplitRoutes split{};
    assert(BuildNativeSplitRoutes(rows,split)==SplitNativeRoutesError::Ok);
    const auto& terminal=split.blocks[split.runs[0].start+
                                  split.runs[0].count-1u];
    assert(terminal.block==route.input_split_block);
    assert(terminal.plan.has_pooled_projection);
    assert(terminal.plan.pool_width==route.raster_width);
    assert(terminal.plan.pool_height==route.raster_height);
    assert(terminal.raster_width==route.raster_width);
    assert(terminal.raster_height==route.raster_height);
    assert(route.input_split_block==(original?30u:10u));
    assert(route.decoder_block==(original?39u:19u));
    assert(route.blocks[0].block==(original?31u:11u));
    assert(route.blocks[7].block==(original?38u:18u));
    for(std::uint32_t i=0u;i<8u;++i){
        const auto& b=route.blocks[i];
        assert(b.block==route.blocks[0].block+i);
        assert(b.tokens==route.tokens);
        assert(b.input_block==(i==0u?route.input_split_block:
                               route.blocks[i-1u].block));
        for(std::uint32_t j=0u;j<5u;++j)
            assert(rows[b.first_row+j].layer==j);
    }
    auto broken=rows;
    for(auto& r:broken)if(r.type=="CCVit1DFfnContract"){
        r.output_channels=2048u;break;
    }
    assert(BuildNativeVitRoute(broken,route)!=NativeVitRouteError::Ok);
    assert(route.count==0u);
    broken=rows;
    for(auto& r:broken)if(r.type=="CCVit1DQKV"){
        r.input0=0;break;
    }
    assert(BuildNativeVitRoute(broken,route)!=NativeVitRouteError::Ok);
    assert(route.count==0u);
    broken=rows;
    for(auto& r:broken)if(r.type=="CCDecInputUpsample"){
        r.input1=0;break;
    }
    assert(BuildNativeVitRoute(broken,route)!=NativeVitRouteError::Ok);
    assert(route.count==0u);
    broken=rows;
    for(auto& r:broken)if(r.type=="CCVit1DProjection"){
        r.tokens--;break;
    }
    assert(BuildNativeVitRoute(broken,route)!=NativeVitRouteError::Ok);
    assert(route.count==0u);
}
int main(int argc,char** argv){
    assert(argc==3);
    Check(argv[1],true);
    Check(argv[2],false);
}
```

`extras/graphics/test_rdna2_nr_vit_projection_stage_policy.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
#include "rdna2_nr_vit_projection_stage_policy.h"
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
using namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;
static void Check(
    VitProjectionKind kind,std::uint32_t N,std::uint32_t K,
    std::uint32_t tokens) {
    const VitProjectionStageCapacity c{
        std::uint64_t(tokens)*K,std::uint64_t(N)*K,
        std::uint64_t(1024u)*N*4u,
        kind==VitProjectionKind::Expand?0u:
            std::uint64_t(tokens)*N,
        kind==VitProjectionKind::Expand?0u:
            std::uint64_t(N)*2u,
        std::uint64_t(tokens)*N};
    VitProjectionStageBatches p{};
    assert(BuildVitProjectionStage(kind,tokens,c,p));
    assert(ValidateVitProjectionStage(p));
    assert(p.count==(tokens+1023u)/1024u);
    std::uint32_t done=0u;
    for(std::uint32_t i=0u;i<p.count;++i){
        const auto& step=p.slices[i];
        assert(step.gemm.tokens<=1024u);
        assert(step.gemm.a_base_bytes==done*K);
        assert(step.gemm.channels==N&&step.gemm.inner==K);
        if(kind==VitProjectionKind::Expand){
            assert(step.activation.output_offset_bytes==done*N);
            assert(step.activation.channels==N);
        }else {
            assert(step.residual.output_offset_bytes==done*N);
            assert(step.residual.residual_offset_bytes==done*N);
            assert(step.residual.channels==N);
        }
        done+=step.gemm.tokens;
    }
    assert(done==tokens);
    auto invalid=p;
    invalid.slices[p.count-1u].gemm.a_base_bytes=0u;
    if(p.count>1u)assert(!ValidateVitProjectionStage(invalid));
    invalid=p;
    invalid.slices[p.count-1u].gemm.tokens++;
    assert(!ValidateVitProjectionStage(invalid));
    auto broken=c;
    broken.scratch_bytes=0u;
    assert(!BuildVitProjectionStage(kind,tokens,broken,invalid));
    assert(invalid.count==0u);
    broken=c;
    broken.weights_bytes--;
    assert(!BuildVitProjectionStage(kind,tokens,broken,invalid));
    broken=c;
    broken.output_bytes--;
    assert(!BuildVitProjectionStage(kind,tokens,broken,invalid));
    if(kind!=VitProjectionKind::Expand){
        broken=c;
        broken.residual_bytes--;
        assert(!BuildVitProjectionStage(kind,tokens,broken,invalid));
        broken=c;
        broken.gain_bytes--;
        assert(!BuildVitProjectionStage(kind,tokens,broken,invalid));
    }
    broken=c;
    broken.input_bytes--;
    assert(!BuildVitProjectionStage(kind,tokens,broken,invalid));
}
int main() {
    Check(VitProjectionKind::Expand,4096u,1024u,2560u);
    Check(VitProjectionKind::Contract,1024u,4096u,2560u);
    Check(VitProjectionKind::ResidualProjection,1024u,1024u,2560u);
    Check(VitProjectionKind::Expand,4096u,1024u,4096u);
    Check(VitProjectionKind::Contract,1024u,4096u,4096u);
    Check(VitProjectionKind::ResidualProjection,1024u,1024u,4096u);
    VitProjectionStageBatches p{};
    constexpr VitProjectionStageCapacity tiny{
        4096ull*1024u,4096ull*1024u,
        255ull*4096u*4u,0u,0u,4096ull*4096u};
    assert(!BuildVitProjectionStage(VitProjectionKind::Expand,4096u,tiny,p));
    assert(p.count==0u);
    assert(!BuildVitProjectionStage(VitProjectionKind::Expand,0u,tiny,p));
    assert(!BuildVitProjectionStage(VitProjectionKind::Expand,4097u,tiny,p));
}
```

`extras/graphics/test_rdna2_nr_vit_qkv_batches_policy.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
#include "rdna2_nr_vit_qkv_batches_policy.h"
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
using namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;
int main(){
    constexpr std::uint64_t T=4096u,N=3072u,K=1024u;
    const VitQkvBuffersCapacity caps{
        T*K,N*K,2048u*N*4u,128u,T*K,T*K,T*K,T*K};
    VitQkvBatches plan{};
    assert(BuildVitQkvBatches(4096u,caps,plan));
    assert(ValidVitQkvBatches(plan));
    assert(plan.count==2u&&plan.total_tokens==4096u);
    assert(plan.slices[0].gemm.tokens==2048u);
    assert(plan.slices[1].gemm.tokens==2048u);
    assert(plan.slices[1].gemm.a_base_bytes==2048u*K);
    assert(plan.slices[1].normalize.q_base_bytes==2048u*K);
    assert(plan.slices[1].normalize.k_base_bytes==2048u*K);
    assert(plan.slices[1].normalize.v_base_bytes==2048u*K);
    auto bad=plan;bad.slices[1].normalize.k_base_bytes=0u;
    assert(!ValidVitQkvBatches(bad));
    bad=plan;bad.slices[0].gemm.a_base_bytes+=4u;
    assert(!ValidVitQkvBatches(bad));
    // The 2560-token 1080p native plan remains one dispatch pair if
    // its whole FP32 result fits into the available transient.
    auto full=caps;full.fp32=2560u*N*4u;
    assert(BuildVitQkvBatches(2560u,full,plan));
    assert(plan.count==1u&&plan.slices[0].gemm.tokens==2560u);
    assert(ValidVitQkvBatches(plan));
    // A 1024-token transient now supports 4,096 tokens via 4 ordered slices.
    full.fp32=1024u*N*4u;
    assert(BuildVitQkvBatches(4096u,full,plan));
    assert(plan.count==4u&&ValidVitQkvBatches(plan));
    // Bound is 16 slices: reject micro-batches that would silently
    // require more dispatches than retained in the plan.
    full.fp32=255u*N*4u;
    assert(!BuildVitQkvBatches(4096u,full,plan));
    assert(plan.count==0u);
    full=caps;full.fp32=0u;
    assert(!BuildVitQkvBatches(4096u,full,plan));
    full=caps;full.query=T*K-1u;
    assert(!BuildVitQkvBatches(4096u,full,plan));
    full=caps;full.weights=N*K-1u;
    assert(!BuildVitQkvBatches(4096u,full,plan));
    full=caps;full.temperatures=127u;
    assert(!BuildVitQkvBatches(4096u,full,plan));
    assert(!BuildVitQkvBatches(4097u,caps,plan));
    assert(!BuildVitQkvBatches(0u,caps,plan));
}
```

`extras/graphics/test_rdna2_nr_vit_qkv_norm_policy.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Host safety and numerical reference for RDNA2 32-head ViT QKV bridge.
#include "rdna2_nr_vit_qkv_norm_policy.h"
#include "rdna2_nr_projection_policy.h"
#include "rdna2_nr_vit_attention_policy.h"
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>
using namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;
static float normalize(float x,float norm2,float temperature){
    return x*std::sqrt(32.0f)*temperature/
        std::sqrt(std::max(norm2,1e-30f));
}
int main(){
    constexpr std::uint32_t n=2560;
    const VitQkvNorm norm{n,0u,0u,0u,0u,0u};
    const VitQkvNormStorage size{
        std::uint64_t(n)*3072u*4u,128u,
        std::uint64_t(n)*1024u,std::uint64_t(n)*1024u,
        std::uint64_t(n)*1024u};
    assert(CanVitQkvNorm(norm,size));
    // Same exact buffers validate both sides of ViT QKV -> attention.
    const Projection gemm{n,3072u,1024u,1024u,1024u,0u,0u};
    const Storage storage{
        std::uint64_t(n)*1024u,3072ull*1024u,
        size.input_bytes,size.input_bytes};
    assert(CanDispatch(gemm,storage));
    const VitAttention attn{0u,0u,0u,0u,n};
    assert(CanVitAttention(attn,
        {size.q_bytes,size.k_bytes,size.v_bytes,size.q_bytes}));
    // Reject all incomplete tensor capacities (fail-closed).
    assert(!CanVitQkvNorm(norm,{size.input_bytes-4u,size.scale_bytes,
                                size.q_bytes,size.k_bytes,size.v_bytes}));
    assert(!CanVitQkvNorm(norm,{size.input_bytes,size.scale_bytes-4u,
                                size.q_bytes,size.k_bytes,size.v_bytes}));
    assert(!CanVitQkvNorm(norm,{size.input_bytes,size.scale_bytes,
                                size.q_bytes-1u,size.k_bytes,size.v_bytes}));
    assert(!CanVitQkvNorm(norm,{size.input_bytes,size.scale_bytes,
                                size.q_bytes,size.k_bytes-1u,size.v_bytes}));
    assert(!CanVitQkvNorm(norm,{size.input_bytes,size.scale_bytes,
                                size.q_bytes,size.k_bytes,size.v_bytes-1u}));
    auto bad=norm;
    bad.tokens=0u;assert(!CanVitQkvNorm(bad,size));
    bad.tokens=4097u;assert(!CanVitQkvNorm(bad,{
        UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX}));
    bad=norm;bad.q_base_bytes=1u;
    assert(!CanVitQkvNorm(bad,{UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,
                              UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX}));
    bad=norm;bad.src_base_floats=UINT32_MAX-3u;
    assert(!CanVitQkvNorm(bad,{UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,
                              UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX}));
    bad=norm;bad.scale_base_floats=UINT32_MAX-3u;
    assert(!CanVitQkvNorm(bad,{UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,
                              UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX}));
    bad=norm;bad.q_base_bytes=4u;
    auto padded=size;padded.q_bytes+=4u;
    assert(CanVitQkvNorm(bad,padded));
    bad=norm;bad.tokens=4096u;
    const VitQkvNormStorage max{
        4096ull*3072u*4u,128u,4096ull*1024u,
        4096ull*1024u,4096ull*1024u};
    assert(CanVitQkvNorm(bad,max));
    bad.tokens=4097u;assert(!CanVitQkvNorm(bad,max));
    // Numerical oracle: head-0 one-hot Q and K are cosine normalized;
    // V passes unchanged (the neural attention shader reads FP8 Q/K/V).
    std::array<float,32> q{},k{},v{};
    q[0]=3.0f; k[0]=4.0f; v[0]=2.0f;
    float qn=0.f,kn=0.f;
    for(unsigned c=0;c<32u;++c){
        qn=std::fma(q[c],q[c],qn);
        kn=std::fma(k[c],k[c],kn);
    }
    assert(std::fabs(normalize(q[0],qn,1.f)-std::sqrt(32.0f))<1e-5f);
    assert(std::fabs(k[0]/std::sqrt(kn)-1.f)<1e-5f);
    assert(v[0]==2.f);
    q.fill(0.f);k.fill(0.f);
    assert(normalize(q[0],0.f,2.f)==0.f);
}
```

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Synthetic NRMODEL1 ViT QKV importer; no proprietary weights bundled.
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/nr_rdna2_vit_qkv_weight_loader.h"
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/nr_rdna2_split_ffwd_weight_loader.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <bit>
#include <cassert>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdint>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>
using namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;
namespace {
void Push32(std::vector<std::uint8_t>& b,std::uint32_t value){
    for(unsigned j=0;j<4u;++j)b.push_back(std::uint8_t(value>>(8u*j)));
}
void Push64(std::vector<std::uint8_t>& b,std::uint64_t value){
    for(unsigned j=0;j<8u;++j)b.push_back(std::uint8_t(value>>(8u*j)));
}
void Write64(std::vector<std::uint8_t>& b,std::size_t position,std::uint64_t v){
    for(unsigned j=0;j<8u;++j)b[position+j]=std::uint8_t(v>>(8u*j));
}
struct Entry{
    std::string name;
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> content;
};
std::vector<std::uint8_t> Pack(const std::vector<Entry>& entries){
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> b{'N','R','M','O','D','E','L','1'};
    Push32(b,static_cast<std::uint32_t>(entries.size()));
    Push32(b,0u);
    std::vector<std::size_t> offset_positions;
    for(const auto& entry:entries){
        Push32(b,static_cast<std::uint32_t>(entry.name.size()));
        b.insert(b.end(),entry.name.begin(),entry.name.end());
        offset_positions.push_back(b.size());
        Push64(b,0u);
        Push64(b,entry.content.size());
    }
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<entries.size();++i){
        b.resize((b.size()+255u)&~std::size_t(255u),0u);
        Write64(b,offset_positions[i],b.size());
        b.insert(b.end(),entries[i].content.begin(),entries[i].content.end());
    }
    return b;
}
std::vector<Entry> Fixture(){
    constexpr auto prefix="unpacked/block31.layer2.layer";
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> header(128u);
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<32u;++i){
        const auto word=std::bit_cast<std::uint32_t>(1.0f+float(i)/64.f);
        for(unsigned j=0u;j<4u;++j)
            header[4u*i+j]=std::uint8_t(word>>(8u*j));
    }
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> q(1024u*1024u,0x38u);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> k(1024u*1024u,0x40u);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> v(1024u*1024u,0x48u);
    q[0]=0u; // exactly the upstream +0 -> -0 requantization
    return {
        {std::string(prefix)+".header.bin",std::move(header)},
        {std::string(prefix)+".q.bin",std::move(q)},
        {std::string(prefix)+".k.bin",std::move(k)},
        {std::string(prefix)+".v.bin",std::move(v)}};
}
void WriteFile(const std::filesystem::path& name,
               std::span<const std::uint8_t> bytes){
    std::ofstream file(name,std::ios::binary|std::ios::trunc);
    assert(file.good());
    file.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(bytes.data()),
               static_cast<std::streamsize>(bytes.size()));
    assert(file.good());
}
}
int main(){
    std::array<float,32> values{};
    auto fixture=Fixture();
    assert(DecodeViTQkvTemperatures(fixture[0].content,values));
    assert(values[0]==1.f);
    assert(values[31]==1.f+31.f/64.f);
    assert(!DecodeViTQkvTemperatures(
        std::span<const std::uint8_t>{
            fixture[0].content.data(),127u},values));
    for(float v:values)assert(v==0.f);
    const auto name=std::filesystem::temp_directory_path()/
        ("encore-vitqkv-host-"+std::to_string(
            std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch().count())+
            ".nrmodel1");
    const auto write=[&](const std::vector<Entry>& entries){
        const auto data=Pack(entries);
        WriteFile(name,data);
    };
    NeuralModelFile model;
    ViTQkvModelPayload output;
    write(fixture);
    assert(model.Open(name.string()));
    assert(PrepareViTQkvModelWeights(
        model,"unpacked/block31.layer2.layer",output));
    assert(output.row_major_qkv.size()==3u*1024u*1024u);
    assert(output.row_major_qkv[0]==0x80u);
    assert(output.row_major_qkv[1]==0x38u);
    assert(output.row_major_qkv[1024u*1024u]==0x40u);
    assert(output.row_major_qkv[2u*1024u*1024u]==0x48u);
    assert(output.temperatures[31]==1.f+31.f/64.f);
    assert(!PrepareViTQkvModelWeights(model,"../unsafe",output));
    assert(output.row_major_qkv.empty());
    // The model index may be valid while a learned temperature is NaN.
    auto broken=fixture;
    const std::uint32_t nan=0x7fc00000u;
    for(unsigned j=0u;j<4u;++j)
        broken[0].content[j]=std::uint8_t(nan>>(8u*j));
    write(broken);
    assert(model.Open(name.string()));
    assert(!PrepareViTQkvModelWeights(
        model,"unpacked/block31.layer2.layer",output));
    assert(output.row_major_qkv.empty());
    // Every learned E4M3 byte must be finite.
    broken=fixture;
    broken[1].content[100u]=0x7fu;
    write(broken);
    assert(model.Open(name.string()));
    assert(!PrepareViTQkvModelWeights(
        model,"unpacked/block31.layer2.layer",output));
    assert(output.row_major_qkv.empty());
    // A truncated/missing K tensor is never accepted.
    broken=fixture;
    broken[2].content.resize(1024u*1024u-1u);
    write(broken);

        model,"unpacked/block31.layer2.layer",output));

    // as raw inventory records. Exercise BOTH native fallbacks with a
    // synthetic, non-proprietary 2-record NRMODEL1 pack.

    std::vector<std::uint8_t> raw_qkv(128u+3u*1024u*1024u);
    std::copy(raw_head.begin(),raw_head.end(),raw_qkv.begin());
    for(std::uint32_t tile=0;tile<1024u;++tile)
        for(std::uint32_t part=0;part<3u;++part){
            const std::uint8_t value=part==0u?0x38u:
                                     part==1u?0x40u:0x48u;
            std::fill_n(raw_qkv.begin()+128u+
                (3u*tile+part)*1024u,1024u,value);
        }
    // Probe a non-uniform K/row placement in the original interleaving.
    constexpr std::uint32_t row=5u,k=37u,which=1u;
    const std::uint32_t b=(k&1u)|(((k>>1u)&1u)<<4u)|
        (((k>>2u)&1u)<<5u)|(((k>>3u)&1u)<<1u)|
        (((k>>4u)&1u)<<2u)|((row&1u)<<6u)|
        (((row>>1u)&1u)<<7u)|(((row>>2u)&1u)<<8u)|
        (((row>>3u)&1u)<<3u)|(((row>>4u)&1u)<<9u);
    const std::uint32_t tile=(row>>5u)|((k>>5u)<<5u);
    raw_qkv[128u+(3u*tile+which)*1024u+b]=0x18u;
    std::vector<Entry> inventory{
        {"inventory/weights/block23.layer0.layer.bin",
            std::vector<std::uint8_t>(524288u,0x80u)},
        {"inventory/weights/block31.layer2.layer.bin",
            std::move(raw_qkv)}};
    write(inventory);
    assert(model.Open(name.string()));
    SplitFFWDWeights split{};
    assert(PrepareSplitFFWDWeights(
        model,"unpacked-splitswin/block23.layer0.layer",split));
    assert(split.w1.size()==262144u&&split.w2.size()==131072u&&
           split.w3.size()==131072u);
    assert(split.w1[0u]==0x80u&&split.w2[0u]==0x80u);
    assert(PrepareViTQkvModelWeights(
        model,"unpacked-vit/block31.layer2.layer",output));
    assert(output.row_major_qkv.size()==3u*1024u*1024u);
    assert(output.row_major_qkv[0u]==0x38u);
    assert(output.row_major_qkv[1024u*1024u]==0x40u);
    assert(output.row_major_qkv[2u*1024u*1024u]==0x48u);
    assert(output.row_major_qkv[

    assert(output.temperatures[31u]==1.f+31.f/64.f);
    // Partially unpacked, truncated, or unsafe inventory is rejected.
    auto damaged=inventory;
    damaged[0u].content.pop_back();

    assert(model.Open(name.string()));
    assert(!PrepareSplitFFWDWeights(
        model,"unpacked-splitswin/block23.layer0.layer",split));

    damaged[1u].content.pop_back();

    assert(!PrepareViTQkvModelWeights(
        model,"unpacked-vit/block31.layer2.layer",output));
```

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Numerical unit tests for learned-model half scalars and Swin bias layout.
#include <algorithm>
#include <cassert>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>
#include <vector>
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/nr_rdna2_weight_decode.h"
using namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;
int main(){
    assert(NeuralHalfToFloat(0x3c00u)==1.0f);
    assert(NeuralHalfToFloat(0xbc00u)==-1.0f);
    assert(NeuralHalfToFloat(0x4000u)==2.0f);
    assert(NeuralHalfToFloat(0x0001u)==std::ldexp(1.0f,-24));
    assert(NeuralHalfToFloat(0x0400u)==std::ldexp(1.0f,-14));
    assert(NeuralHalfToFloat(0x7bffu)==65504.0f);
    assert(std::isinf(NeuralHalfToFloat(0x7c00u)));
    assert(std::isnan(NeuralHalfToFloat(0x7e00u)));
    std::vector<float> decoded;
    const std::vector<std::uint8_t> halfs{0x00,0x3c,0x00,0xc0};
    assert(NeuralDecodeF16(halfs,decoded));
    assert(decoded.size()==2u&&decoded[0]==1.0f&&decoded[1]==-2.0f);
    assert(!NeuralDecodeF16(std::vector<std::uint8_t>{0x00},decoded));
    assert(decoded.empty());
    assert(!NeuralDecodeF16(std::vector<std::uint8_t>{0x00,0x7c},decoded));
    assert(decoded.empty());

    std::vector<float> packed(8192u);
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<packed.size();++i)packed[i]=float(i);
    std::vector<float> bias;
    assert(NeuralDeswizzleBias64(packed,2u,bias));
    assert(bias.size()==8192u);
    for(std::uint32_t h=0;h<2u;++h)
        for(std::uint32_t i=0;i<64u;++i)
            for(std::uint32_t j=0;j<64u;++j){
                const auto lane=4u*((i%16u)%8u)+((j%16u)%8u)/2u;
                const auto sl=(j%2u)|(((i%16u)/8u)<<1u)|
                    (((j%16u)/8u)<<2u);
                const auto src=(4u*(i/16u)+(j/16u))*256u+lane*8u+sl;
                assert(bias[h*4096u+i*64u+j]==packed[h*4096u+src]);
            }
    std::sort(bias.begin(),bias.begin()+4096u);
    for(unsigned i=0;i<4096u;++i)assert(bias[i]==float(i));
    assert(!NeuralDeswizzleBias64(packed,3u,bias));
    assert(bias.empty());

    std::vector<float> residual(48u,0.f);
    for(unsigned i=0;i<32u;++i)residual[8u+i]=float(i+1u);
    std::vector<float> out;
    assert(NeuralResidualScale(residual,32u,false,out));
    assert(out.size()==32u&&out[0]==1.f&&out[31]==32.f);
    residual.assign(80u,3.f);
    for(unsigned i=0;i<80u;++i)residual[i]=float(i+1u);
    assert(NeuralResidualScale(residual,64u,false,out));
    assert(out.front()==1.f&&out.back()==64.f);
    assert(NeuralResidualScale(residual,64u,true,out));
    assert(out.front()==17.f&&out.back()==80.f);
    assert(!NeuralResidualScale(residual,256u,false,out));
    assert(out.empty());
}
```

`extras/graphics/test_rdna2_nr_window_attention_policy.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Unfused RDNA2 64x32 attention: validated shape, packed FP8, stable softmax.
#include <cassert>
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>
#include "rdna2_nr_window_attention_policy.h"
using namespace Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;

static float dequant(uint32_t raw){
    const auto e=(raw>>3)&15u, m=raw&7u;
    const float sign=(raw&128u)?-1.f:1.f;
    if(e==15u && m==7u)return std::numeric_limits<float>::quiet_NaN();
    if(e==0)return sign*float(m)*std::exp2(-9.f);
    return sign*float(8u+m)*std::exp2(float(int(e)-10));
}
static uint32_t quant(float v){
    const uint32_t s=std::signbit(v)?128u:0u;
    if(std::isnan(v))return s|127u;
    float a=std::fmin(std::fabs(v),448.f);
    if(a<0.015625f) {
        auto m=static_cast<uint32_t>(std::nearbyint(a*512.f));
        return s|(m>=8u?8u:m);
    }
    int e=static_cast<int>(std::floor(std::log2(a)));
    auto m=static_cast<uint32_t>(std::nearbyint((a/std::exp2(float(e))-1.f)*8.f));
    if(m==8u){++e;m=0u;}
    auto eb=static_cast<uint32_t>(e+7);
    if(eb>15u || (eb==15u && m>6u))return s|126u;
    return s|(eb<<3u)|m;
}
static std::array<uint8_t,32> attention(
    const std::array<uint8_t,32>& q,
    const std::array<std::array<uint8_t,32>,64>& k,
    const std::array<std::array<uint8_t,32>,64>& v,
    const std::array<float,64>& bias) {
    std::array<float,64> logits{}, weights{};
    float peak=-std::numeric_limits<float>::max();
    for(unsigned j=0;j<64;j++){
        float score=0.f;
        for(unsigned c=0;c<32;c++)
            score=std::fma(dequant(q[c]),dequant(k[j][c]),score);
        logits[j]=score+bias[j];
        peak=std::max(peak,logits[j]);
    }
    float denominator=0.f;
    for(unsigned j=0;j<64;j++){
        weights[j]=std::exp(logits[j]-peak);
        denominator+=weights[j];
    }
    denominator=std::max(denominator,6.103515625e-05f);
    std::array<float,32> context{};
    for(unsigned j=0;j<64;j++){
        float weight=dequant(quant(weights[j]/denominator));
        for(unsigned c=0;c<32;c++)
            context[c]=std::fma(weight,dequant(v[j][c]),context[c]);
    }
    std::array<uint8_t,32> out{};
    for(unsigned c=0;c<32;c++)out[c]=static_cast<uint8_t>(quant(context[c]));
    return out;
}
int main(){
    // Exact contract: one 64x32 E4M3FN tensor, one head, one window.
    WindowAttention p{0,0,0,0,0,1,1};
    AttentionStorage s{2048,2048,2048,2048,16384};
    assert(CanWindowAttention(p,s));
    assert(!CanWindowAttention(p,{2047,2048,2048,2048,16384}));
    assert(!CanWindowAttention(p,{2048,2047,2048,2048,16384}));
    assert(!CanWindowAttention(p,{2048,2048,2047,2048,16384}));
    assert(!CanWindowAttention(p,{2048,2048,2048,2047,16384}));
    assert(!CanWindowAttention(p,{2048,2048,2048,2048,16383}));
    p.heads=3;assert(!CanWindowAttention(p,{UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX}));
    p={0,0,0,0,0,1,1};
    p.windows=65536;assert(!CanWindowAttention(p,{UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX}));
    p={0,0,0,0,0,1,1};
    p.q_base_bytes=1;assert(!CanWindowAttention(p,{UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX}));
    p={0,0,0,0,0,1,1};
    p.bias_base_floats=UINT32_MAX;
    assert(!CanWindowAttention(p,{UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX}));
    p={0,0,0,0,0,1,1};
    p.out_base_bytes=UINT32_MAX-3u;
    assert(!CanWindowAttention(p,{UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX}));

    assert(quant(0.f)==0x00u);
    assert(quant(1.f)==0x38u);
    assert(quant(-2.f)==0xc0u);
    assert(quant(448.f)==0x7eu);
    assert(quant(0.015625f)==0x08u);
    assert(quant(1.f/64.f)==0x08u);
    assert(quant(1000.f)==0x7eu);
    assert(dequant(0x38u)==1.f);
    assert(dequant(0x08u)==1.f/64.f);

    std::array<uint8_t,32> q{};
    std::array<std::array<uint8_t,32>,64> k{},v{};
    std::array<float,64> bias{};
    // Zero Q/K and zero bias: exact 1/64 weight in E4M3FN.
    for(auto& token:v)token.fill(0x38u); // value +1 for all keys
    auto out=attention(q,k,v,bias);
    for(auto x:out)assert(x==0x38u); // context 64*(1/64)*1
    // Large relative bias: stable exponential and one-hot context.
    for(auto& token:v)token.fill(0x00u);
    v[7].fill(0x40u); // +2 at key 7
    bias[7]=100.f;
    out=attention(q,k,v,bias);
    for(auto x:out)assert(x==0x40u); // softmax key 7 rounds to 1
    bias[7]=-100.f;
    out=attention(q,k,v,bias);
    for(auto x:out)assert(x==0x00u);
    // Q/K score can determine selection even without a bias.
    bias.fill(0.f);
    q[0]=0x38u;
    k[7][0]=0x50u; // 8.0, stronger key 7 logit
    out=attention(q,k,v,bias);
    for(auto x:out)assert(dequant(x)>0.0f && dequant(x)<=2.0f);
}
```

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#include "sgsr_sharpness_policy.h"
#include <cassert>
#include <cmath>
int main() {
    using Eden::Graphics::SgsrEdgeIntensityFromInternal;
    assert(SgsrEdgeIntensityFromInternal(200)==0.0f);
    assert(SgsrEdgeIntensityFromInternal(100)==1.0f);
    assert(SgsrEdgeIntensityFromInternal(0)==2.0f);
    assert(SgsrEdgeIntensityFromInternal(-100)==2.0f);
    assert(SgsrEdgeIntensityFromInternal(1000)==0.0f);

    for (int percent=0;percent<=100;++percent) {
        const float strength=SgsrEdgeIntensityFromInternal(200-percent*2);
        assert(strength>=0 && strength<=2);
        assert(strength>=previous);
        assert(std::abs(strength-static_cast<float>(percent)/50.0f)<0.0001f);
        previous=strength;
    }
    return 0;
```

```inc
    for (;;) {}
}
static void churn_worker(u64 index) {
    for (u64 iteration = 1;; ++iteration) {
        Registers child = create_thread(0, (u64)churn_child, index,
            (u64)(child_stacks[index] + sizeof(child_stacks[index])), 44, index);
        check(child.rc); check(ONE(start_thread, child.first).rc);

        __atomic_store_n(&churn_progress[index], iteration, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    }
}

    stage = 90;
    for (u32 i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {

        close(worker.first);
```

```inc
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#ifdef EDEN_GUEST_FP
static void fp_result(u64 actual, u64 expected) {
    print_value("EDEN_GUEST_FP_RESULT=", actual);
    require(actual == expected);
}

// Explicit instructions prevent constant folding from replacing the tested work.
#define FP32(instruction, a, b, c, expected) do { \
    const u32 input[] = {a, b, c}; u32 output; \
    __asm__ volatile("ldr s0, [%1]; ldr s1, [%1, #4]; ldr s2, [%1, #8]; " \
        instruction "; fmov %w0, s3" : "=r"(output) : "r"(input) \
        : "v0", "v1", "v2", "v3", "memory"); \
    fp_result(output, expected); \
} while (0)
#define FP64(instruction, a, b, c, expected) do { \
    const u64 input[] = {a, b, c}; u64 output; \
    __asm__ volatile("ldr d0, [%1]; ldr d1, [%1, #8]; ldr d2, [%1, #16]; " \
        instruction "; fmov %0, d3" : "=r"(output) : "r"(input) \
        : "v0", "v1", "v2", "v3", "memory"); \
    fp_result(output, expected); \
} while (0)

static void check_fp(void) {
    stage = 70;

        : "=r"(saved_fpcr), "=r"(saved_fpsr) : : "memory");
    FP32("fadd s3, s0, s1", 0x3fc00000, 0x40100000, 0, 0x40700000); // 1.5 + 2.25
    FP32("fmul s3, s0, s1", 0xc0400000, 0x3f000000, 0, 0xbfc00000); // -3 * .5
    FP32("fdiv s3, s0, s1", 0x40e00000, 0x40000000, 0, 0x40600000); // 7 / 2
    FP32("fsqrt s3, s0", 0x40800000, 0, 0, 0x40000000);

    FP32("fneg s3, s0", 0, 0, 0, 0x80000000); // negative zero
    FP32("fadd s3, s0, s1", 1, 1, 0, 2); // gradual underflow, FZ disabled
    FP32("fmadd s3, s0, s1, s2", 0x3f800001, 0x3f7ffffe, 0xbf800000, 0xa8800000); // -2^-46, single rounding
    FP32("fdiv s3, s0, s1", 0x3f800000, 0, 0, 0x7f800000); // positive infinity

        "fadd s4, s4, s3; fmul s4, s4, s2; str q4, [%0]; "
```

```inc
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#ifdef EDEN_GUEST_LIFECYCLE
static unsigned char state_stacks[2][4096] __attribute__((aligned(16)));
static u64 state_ready[2], state_errors[2];
static void state_worker(u64 index) {
    const u64 control = (index + 1) << 22;
    const u64 values[] = {0x1122334455667788ULL + index, 0x8877665544332211ULL + index,
                         0x123456789abcdef0ULL + index, 0xfedcba9876543210ULL + index};
    for (u64 round = 1; round <= 100; ++round) {
        __asm__ volatile("msr fpcr, %0; ldp q8, q31, [%1]" : : "r"(control), "r"(values)
            : "v8", "v31", "memory");
        __atomic_store_n(&state_ready[index], round, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
        while (__atomic_load_n(&state_ready[1-index], __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) < round)
            ONE(sleep_thread, 100000);
        u64 observed[6] = {0};
        __asm__ volatile("stp q8, q31, [%0]; mrs x9, fpcr; str x9, [%0, #32]; "
            "fmov s0, #2.5; frinti s0, s0; str s0, [%0, #40]"
            : : "r"(observed) : "x9", "v0", "memory");
        for (u32 lane = 0; lane < 4; ++lane)
            if (observed[lane] != values[lane]) state_errors[index] |= 1;
        if (observed[4] != control) state_errors[index] |= 2;
        if (observed[5] != (index ? 0x40000000 : 0x40400000)) state_errors[index] |= 4;
    }
    ONE(exit_thread, 0);
    for (;;) {}
}
static void check_state(void) {
    stage = 80;
    u32 handles[2];
    for (u32 i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
        Registers thread = create_thread(0, (u64)state_worker, i,
            (u64)(state_stacks[i] + sizeof(state_stacks[i])), 44, 0);
        check(thread.rc); handles[i] = thread.first;
        check(ONE(start_thread, handles[i]).rc);
    }
    for (u32 i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
        check(wait(handles[i], 3000000000ULL).rc); close(handles[i]);
        print_value("EDEN_GUEST_STATE_ERRORS=", state_errors[i]);
        require(state_errors[i] == 0 && state_ready[i] == 100);
    }
    PRINT("EDEN_GUEST_STATE_PASS");
}

SVC(map_memory, 0x4) SVC(unmap_memory, 0x5)
typedef struct { u64 address, size; u32 state, attribute, permission, ipc_refs, device_refs, pad; } MemoryInfo;
static MemoryInfo memory_info(u64 address) {
    MemoryInfo memory;
    check(query_memory((u64)&memory, 0, address, 0, 0, 0).rc);
    require(memory.size && memory.address <= address && memory.address + memory.size > address);
    return memory;
}
static void memory_error(u64 result, u64 expected) {
    print_value("EDEN_GUEST_MEMORY_ERROR=", result);
    require(result == expected);
}
static void check_memory(void) {
    stage = 81;
    const u64 unit = 2 * 1024 * 1024;
    Registers allocation = set_heap_size(0, unit, 0, 0, 0, 0); check(allocation.rc);
    const u64 base = allocation.first;
    volatile unsigned char* bytes = (volatile unsigned char*)base;
    for (u64 i = 0; i < unit; i += 4096) bytes[i] = (unsigned char)(i / 4096 + 7);
    Registers grown = set_heap_size(0, 2 * unit, 0, 0, 0, 0); check(grown.rc);
    require(grown.first == base && memory_info(base + 2 * unit - 1).permission == 3);
    for (u64 i = 0; i < unit; i += 4096) require(bytes[i] == (unsigned char)(i / 4096 + 7));
    bytes[unit] = 0xab;
    check(set_heap_size(0, unit, 0, 0, 0, 0).rc);
    require(memory_info(base + unit).state == 0);
    check(set_heap_size(0, 2 * unit, 0, 0, 0, 0).rc);
    require(bytes[unit] == 0);
    memory_error(set_heap_size(0, unit + 1, 0, 0, 0, 0).rc, 0xca01); // InvalidSize
    require(memory_info(base + 2 * unit - 1).permission == 3);
    stage = 82;
    u64 destination = info(14), end = destination + info(15); // Stack region
    for (u32 i = 0; i < 64 && destination < end; ++i) {
        MemoryInfo memory = memory_info(destination);
        if (memory.state == 0 && memory.address + memory.size - destination >= 4096) break;
        destination = memory.address + memory.size;
    }
    require(destination < end && memory_info(destination).state == 0);
    memory_error(map_memory(destination + 1, base, 4096, 0, 0, 0).rc, 0xcc01); // InvalidAddress
    memory_error(map_memory(destination, base, 0, 0, 0, 0).rc, 0xca01);
    for (u32 round = 0; round < 32; ++round) {
        check(map_memory(destination, base, 4096, 0, 0, 0).rc);
        require(memory_info(base).permission == 0 && memory_info(destination).permission == 3);
        volatile unsigned char* mapped = (volatile unsigned char*)destination;
        require(mapped[0] == (round ? round - 1 : 7));
        mapped[0] = (unsigned char)round;
        check(unmap_memory(destination, base, 4096, 0, 0, 0).rc);
        require(memory_info(destination).state == 0 && memory_info(base).permission == 3);
        require(bytes[0] == round);
    }
    memory_error(unmap_memory(destination, base, 4096, 0, 0, 0).rc, 0xd401); // InvalidCurrentMemory
    for (u64 i = 4096; i < unit; i += 4096) require(bytes[i] == (unsigned char)(i / 4096 + 7));
    check(set_heap_size(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0).rc);
    require(memory_info(base).state == 0);
    PRINT("EDEN_GUEST_MEMORY_PASS");
    stage = 83;
    require(EDEN_GUEST_LIFECYCLE == 1);
}
#endif
```

```inc
        for (u32 frame = 0; frame < 240; ++frame) voice_pcm[frame] = index == 0 ? (frame % 48 < 24 ? 1024 : -1024) : (frame % 24 < 12 ? 512 : -512);
        u64* pool = (u64*)(input + 0x50 + index * 0x20);
        pool[0] = (u64)voice_pcm; pool[1] = 0x1000; pool[2] = 4; // RequestAttach
        unsigned char* resource = input + 0x150 + index * 0x70;
        ((u32*)resource)[0] = index;
        ((u32*)resource)[1] = index == 0 ? 0x3f000000 : 0x3e800000; // Left gains 0.5, 0.25
        ((u32*)resource)[2] = index == 0 ? 0x3e800000 : 0x3f000000; // Right gains 0.25, 0.5
        resource[0x64] = 1;
        unsigned char* voice = input + 0x230 + index * 0x170;
        ((u32*)voice)[0] = index;
        ((u32*)voice)[0x140 / 4] = index;
        voice[8] = 1; voice[9] = 1; voice[10] = 0; voice[11] = 2; // New, active, started, PCM16
        ((u32*)voice)[3] = 24000; ((u32*)voice)[6] = 1;
        ((u32*)voice)[7] = 0x3f800000; ((u32*)voice)[8] = 0x3f800000;
        ((u32*)voice)[0x3c / 4] = 1;
        ((u32*)voice)[0x5c / 4] = 0xffffffff;
        *(u64*)(voice + 0x60) = (u64)voice_pcm;
        *(u64*)(voice + 0x68) = 240 * sizeof(short);
        *(u32*)(voice + 0x74) = 240; voice[0x78] = 1;
        for (u32 slot = 1; slot < 4; ++slot) voice[0x60 + slot * 0x38 + 0x1a] = 1;
        voice[0x15c] = 0; // Enable 24-to-48 kHz sample-rate conversion.
        voice[0x15e] = 1; // High quality: eight-tap resampling.
    }
    u32* mix = (u32*)(input + 0x40 + 0x10 + 0x100 + 0xe0 + 0x2e0);
    mix[0] = 0x3f800000; mix[1] = 48000; mix[2] = 2; mix[3] = 1;
    mix[0x924 / 4] = 0x7fffffff; mix[0x928 / 4] = 0xffffffff;
    unsigned char* sink = (unsigned char*)mix + 0x930;
    sink[0] = 1; sink[1] = 1;
    const char device[] = "MainAudioOut";
    for (u32 i = 0; i < sizeof(device); ++i) sink[0x20 + i] = device[i];
    *(u32*)(sink + 0x120) = 2; sink[0x124] = 0; sink[0x125] = 1;
    ipc(renderer, 5, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);
    require(*(u32*)ipc(renderer, 3, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0) == 0);
    u64 previous_frames = 0;
    u64 previous_samples[2] = {0, 0};
    for (u32 update = 0; update < 3; ++update) {
        ipc_full(renderer, 4, 0, 2, input, 0xf90, 0, 0, 0,
                 0, output, 0x1d0, 0, performance, 0x10);
        const u32* response = (const u32*)output;
        require(response[15] == 0x1d0 && response[1] == 0xb0 && response[2] == 0x80);
        require(response[3] == 0x20 && response[7] == 0x20 && response[8] == 0x10);
        require(*(u32*)(output + 0x40 + 0x80 + 0x20 + 0x20 + 0x10 + 0xa0) == 0);
        require(response[10] == 0x10);
        for (u32 index = 0; index < 2; ++index) {
            unsigned char* voice = input + 0x230 + index * 0x170;
            u64* pool = (u64*)(input + 0x50 + index * 0x20);
            if (update == 0) require(*(u32*)(output + 0x40 + index * 0x10) == 5); // Attached
            voice[8] = 0; voice[0x7a] = 1; pool[2] = 5;
            const u64 samples = *(u64*)(output + 0xc0 + index * 0x10);
            require(update == 0 || samples > previous_samples[index]);
            previous_samples[index] = samples;
            print_value(index == 0 ? "EDEN_GUEST_RENDERER_VOICE_SAMPLES=" : "EDEN_GUEST_RENDERER_SECOND_SAMPLES=", samples);
        }
        const u64 frames = *(u64*)(output + 0x1c0);
        require(update == 0 || frames > previous_frames);
        previous_frames = frames;
        print_value("EDEN_GUEST_RENDERER_FRAMES=", frames);
        check(wait(event, 1000000000).rc);
        ONE(sleep_thread, 30000000);
        PRINT("EDEN_GUEST_RENDERER_UPDATE_PASS");
    }
    ipc(renderer, 6, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);
    require(*(u32*)ipc(renderer, 3, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0) == 1);
    close(event); close(renderer); close(manager); close(memory.first);
    PRINT("EDEN_GUEST_RENDERER_HIGH_SRC_PASS");
    PRINT("EDEN_GUEST_RENDERER_SRC_PASS");
    PRINT("EDEN_GUEST_RENDERER_MIX_PASS");
    PRINT("EDEN_GUEST_RENDERER_VOICE_PASS");
    PRINT("EDEN_GUEST_RENDERER_PASS");
}
```

`fixtures/core-services.c`:

```c
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Freestanding guest checks against Eden's public SVC and CMIF service ABI.
typedef unsigned int u32;
typedef unsigned long long u64;
typedef struct { u64 rc, first, second; } Registers;
#define SVC(name, number) \
static inline Registers name(u64 a, u64 b, u64 c, u64 d, u64 e, u64 f) { \
    register u64 x0 __asm__("x0") = a, x1 __asm__("x1") = b, x2 __asm__("x2") = c; \
    register u64 x3 __asm__("x3") = d, x4 __asm__("x4") = e, x5 __asm__("x5") = f; \
    __asm__ volatile("svc " #number : "+r"(x0), "+r"(x1), "+r"(x2), "+r"(x3), "+r"(x4), "+r"(x5) \
                     : : "x6", "x7", "memory", "cc"); \
    return (Registers){x0, x1, x2}; \
}
SVC(exit_process, 0x7) SVC(create_thread, 0x8) SVC(start_thread, 0x9)
SVC(exit_thread, 0xa) SVC(sleep_thread, 0xb) SVC(signal_event, 0x11)
SVC(close_handle, 0x16) SVC(reset_signal, 0x17) SVC(wait_sync, 0x18)
SVC(get_tick, 0x1e) SVC(connect_port, 0x1f) SVC(send_sync, 0x21)
SVC(debug_string, 0x27) SVC(create_event, 0x45)
SVC(query_memory, 0x6) SVC(map_shared, 0x13) SVC(unmap_shared, 0x14) SVC(get_info, 0x29)
SVC(set_heap_size, 0x1) SVC(create_transfer, 0x15)
#define ONE(name, x) name((u64)(x), 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
#define PRINT(s) debug_string((u64)(s), sizeof(s) - 1, 0, 0, 0, 0)
static volatile u64 shared_value;
static unsigned char thread_stack[4096] __attribute__((aligned(16)));
static char file_path[0x301];
static unsigned char written[512], read_back[512];
static short tone[12000 * 2];
static char audio_name[0x100], audio_name_out[0x100];
static u32 stage;
static void print_value(const char* label, u64 value);

__attribute__((noreturn)) static void fail(u64 result) {
    PRINT("EDEN_CORE_FIXTURE_FAIL");
    print_value("EDEN_GUEST_FAIL_STAGE=", stage);
    print_value("EDEN_GUEST_FAIL_RESULT=", result);
    ONE(exit_process, 0);
    for (;;) {}
}
static void check(u64 result) { if (result) fail(result); }
static void require(int ok) { if (!ok) fail(0xffffffff); }
static void close(u32 handle) { check(ONE(close_handle, handle).rc); }
static Registers wait(u32 handle, u64 timeout) {
    return wait_sync(0, (u64)&handle, 1, timeout, 0, 0);
}
static void thread_entry(u64 event) {
    shared_value = 0x12345678;
    check(ONE(signal_event, event).rc);
    ONE(exit_thread, 0);
    for (;;) {}
}

// Bounded input/output descriptors and one returned handle cover these services.
// kind: 0 = none, 1 = input pointer, 2 = input map alias, 3 = output map alias.
static u64* ipc_full(u32 handle, u32 command, int pid, int kind, void* buffer, u32 size,
                   const u64* args, u32 words, u32* out_handle,
                   u32 copy_handle, void* receive, u32 receive_size,
                   u32 second_handle, void* performance, u32 performance_size) {
    require(!second_handle || copy_handle);
    require(!performance || (receive && kind == 2));
    u32* tls;
    __asm__ volatile("mrs %0, tpidrro_el0" : "=r"(tls));
    for (u32 i = 0; i < 64; ++i) tls[i] = 0;
    tls[0] = 4 | (kind == 1 ? 1u << 16 : kind == 2 ? 1u << 20 : kind == 3 ? 1u << 24 : 0);
    if (receive) tls[0] |= 1u << 24;
    if (performance) tls[0] += 1u << 24;
    tls[1] = (8 + words * 2) | (pid || copy_handle ? 1u << 31 : 0);
    u32 i = 2;
    if (pid || copy_handle) {
        tls[i++] = (pid ? 1 : 0) | (copy_handle ? (second_handle ? 4 : 2) : 0);
        if (pid) i += 2;
        if (copy_handle) tls[i++] = copy_handle;
        if (second_handle) tls[i++] = second_handle;
    }
    const u64 address = (u64)buffer;
    if (kind == 1) {
        tls[i++] = size << 16 | ((address >> 32) & 15) << 12 | ((address >> 36) & 7) << 6;
        tls[i++] = (u32)address;
    } else if (kind) {
        tls[i++] = size; tls[i++] = (u32)address;
        tls[i++] = 1 | ((address >> 32) & 15) << 28 | ((address >> 36) & 7) << 2;
    }
    if (receive) {
        const u64 output_address = (u64)receive;
        tls[i++] = receive_size; tls[i++] = (u32)output_address;
        tls[i++] = 1 | ((output_address >> 32) & 15) << 28 | ((output_address >> 36) & 7) << 2;
    }
    if (performance) {
        const u64 output_address = (u64)performance;
        tls[i++] = performance_size; tls[i++] = (u32)output_address;
        tls[i++] = 1 | ((output_address >> 32) & 15) << 28 | ((output_address >> 36) & 7) << 2;
    }
    i = (i + 3) & ~3u;
    require(i + 4 + words * 2 <= 64);
    tls[i] = 0x49434653; tls[i + 2] = command;
    for (u32 j = 0; j < words; ++j) ((u64*)&tls[i + 4])[j] = args[j];
    check(ONE(send_sync, handle).rc);
    i = 2;
    if (tls[1] >> 31) {
        const u32 header = tls[i++];
        require((header == 0x20 || header == 2) && out_handle); // one moved session or copied handle
        *out_handle = tls[i++];
    } else require(!out_handle);
    i = (i + 3) & ~3u;
    require(tls[i] == 0x4f434653);
    check(tls[i + 2]);
    return (u64*)&tls[i + 4];
}
static u64* ipc_ex(u32 handle, u32 command, int pid, int kind, void* buffer, u32 size,
                   const u64* args, u32 words, u32* out_handle,
                   u32 copy_handle, void* receive, u32 receive_size) {
    return ipc_full(handle, command, pid, kind, buffer, size, args, words, out_handle,
                    copy_handle, receive, receive_size, 0, 0, 0);
}
static u64* ipc(u32 handle, u32 command, int pid, int kind, void* buffer, u32 size,
                const u64* args, u32 words, u32* out_handle) {
    return ipc_ex(handle, command, pid, kind, buffer, size, args, words, out_handle, 0, 0, 0);
}
static u32 service(u32 sm, const char* name) {
    u64 name_word = 0;
    for (u32 i = 0; i < 8 && name[i]; ++i) name_word |= (u64)(unsigned char)name[i] << (i * 8);
    u32 handle;
    ipc(sm, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, &name_word, 1, &handle);
    return handle;
}
static u64 info(u32 type) {
    Registers r = get_info(0, type, 0xffff8001, 0, 0, 0); check(r.rc); return r.first;
}
static u64 shared_address(void) {
    const u64 start = info(12), end = start + info(13);
    const u64 alias = info(2), alias_end = alias + info(3), heap = info(4), heap_end = heap + info(5);
    u64 address = start;
    for (u32 region = 0; region < 64 && address < end; ++region) {
        struct { u64 address, size; u32 state, attribute, permission, ipc_refs, device_refs, pad; } memory;
        check(query_memory((u64)&memory, 0, address, 0, 0, 0).rc);
        require(memory.size && memory.address + memory.size > address);
        if (address >= alias && address < alias_end) { address = alias_end; continue; }
        if (address >= heap && address < heap_end) { address = heap_end; continue; }
        u64 limit = memory.address + memory.size;
        if (address < alias && alias < limit) limit = alias;
        if (address < heap && heap < limit) limit = heap;
        if (memory.state == 0 && limit - address >= 0x40000 && end - address >= 0x40000) return address;
        address = memory.address + memory.size;
    }
    fail(0xfffffffe);
}
static void print_value(const char* label, u64 value) {
    char text[80]; u32 length = 0;
    while (label[length] && length < 63) { text[length] = label[length]; ++length; }
    const char hex[] = "0123456789abcdef";
    for (u32 i = 0; i < 16; ++i) text[length + i] = hex[(value >> (60 - 4 * i)) & 15];
    debug_string((u64)text, length + 16, 0, 0, 0, 0);
}
typedef struct { u64 sample, buttons; int lx, ly, rx, ry; u32 attributes, pad; } PadSample;
static int read_pad(u64 mapping, PadSample* sample) {
    volatile u64* ring = (volatile u64*)(mapping + 0x9a00 + 0x28);
    const u64 tail = ring[2];
    if (!ring[3] || tail >= 17) return 0;
    volatile u64* entry = ring + 4 + tail * 6;
    const u64 before = entry[0];
    *sample = *(volatile PadSample*)(entry + 1);
    return entry[0] == before && ring[2] == tail && before == sample->sample * 2 &&
           sample->sample && (sample->attributes & 1);
}
static void check_hid(u32 sm) {
    stage = 5;
    u32 hid = service(sm, "hid"), applet, memory;
    const u64 zero[] = {0}, style[] = {1, 0};
    ipc(hid, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, zero, 1, &applet);
    ipc(applet, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, &memory);
    const u64 address = shared_address();
    check(map_shared(memory, address, 0x40000, 1, 0, 0).rc);
    const u32 player = 0;
    ipc(hid, 100, 1, 0, 0, 0, style, 2, 0);
    ipc(hid, 102, 1, 1, (void*)&player, sizeof(player), zero, 1, 0);
    ipc(hid, 103, 1, 0, 0, 0, zero, 1, 0);
    PRINT("EDEN_GUEST_HID_READY");
    const u64 deadline = ONE(get_tick, 0).rc + 19200000ULL * 15;
    u32 phase = 0; PadSample pressed = {0};
    while (ONE(get_tick, 0).rc < deadline && phase < 3) {
        PadSample sample;
        if (read_pad(address, &sample)) {
            if (phase == 0 && !(sample.buttons & 1)) phase = 1;
            else if (phase == 1 && (sample.buttons & 1)) { pressed = sample; phase = 2; }
            else if (phase == 2 && (sample.buttons & 1)) pressed = sample;
            else if (phase == 2 && !(sample.buttons & 1)) phase = 3;
        }
        ONE(sleep_thread, 1000000);
    }
    if (phase != 3) {
        print_value("EDEN_HID_PHASE=", phase);
        print_value("EDEN_HID_STYLE=", *(volatile u32*)(address + 0x9a00));
        volatile u64* ring = (volatile u64*)(address + 0x9a00 + 0x28);
        print_value("EDEN_HID_TAIL=", ring[2]); print_value("EDEN_HID_COUNT=", ring[3]);
        PadSample last = {0};
        print_value("EDEN_HID_VALID=", read_pad(address, &last));
        print_value("EDEN_HID_ATTRIBUTES=", last.attributes);
        print_value("EDEN_HID_SAMPLE=", last.sample);
        print_value("EDEN_HID_BUTTONS=", last.buttons);
        fail(0xffffffff);
    }
    print_value("EDEN_GUEST_HID_BUTTONS=", pressed.buttons);
    print_value("EDEN_GUEST_HID_LX=", (u32)pressed.lx);
    print_value("EDEN_GUEST_HID_RY=", (u32)pressed.ry);
    check(unmap_shared(memory, address, 0x40000, 0, 0, 0).rc);
    close(memory); close(applet); close(hid);
    PRINT("EDEN_GUEST_HID_PASS");
}
static void check_audio(u32 sm) {
    stage = 6;
    const u32 manager = service(sm, "audout:u");
    u32 audio, event;
    const u64 config[] = {48000ULL | (2ULL << 32), 0};
    const u32* format = (u32*)ipc_ex(manager, 1, 1, 2, audio_name, sizeof(audio_name), config, 2,
                                    &audio, 0xffff8001, audio_name_out, sizeof(audio_name_out));
    require(format[0] == 48000 && format[1] == 2 && format[2] == 2 && format[3] == 1);
    ipc(audio, 4, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, &event);
    for (u32 frame = 0; frame < 12000; ++frame) {
        const short value = frame == 11999 ? 0 : frame % 96 < 48 ? 1024 : -1024;
        tone[frame * 2] = value; tone[frame * 2 + 1] = value;
    }
    const u64 buffer[] = {0, (u64)tone, sizeof(tone), sizeof(tone), 0};
    const u64 tag[] = {0xede10001};
    ipc(audio, 3, 0, 2, (void*)buffer, sizeof(buffer), tag, 1, 0);
    ipc(audio, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);
    require(*(u32*)ipc(audio, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0) == 0);
    const u64 deadline = ONE(get_tick, 0).rc + 19200000ULL * 2;
    u64 released = 0;
    while (ONE(get_tick, 0).rc < deadline && !released) {
        Registers ready = wait(event, 100000000);
        require(ready.rc == 0 || ready.rc == 0xea01);
        if (!ready.rc) check(ONE(reset_signal, event).rc);
        const u32 count = *(u32*)ipc(audio, 5, 0, 3, &released, sizeof(released), 0, 0, 0);
        require(count <= 1 && (count == 0 || released == tag[0]));
    }
    require(released == tag[0]);
    // Eden's sample counter includes 25 ms reporting leeway. Allow the tail to drain.
    ONE(sleep_thread, 50000000);
    require(*ipc(audio, 10, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0) >= 12000);
    ipc(audio, 2, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);
    require(*(u32*)ipc(audio, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0) == 1);
    close(event); close(audio); close(manager);
    PRINT("EDEN_GUEST_AUDIO_PASS");
}

#include "core-renderer.inc"
#include "core-save.inc"
#include "core-threads.inc"
#include "core-fp.inc"
#include "core-lifecycle.inc"
#include "core-churn.inc"

void guest_main(void) {
#ifdef EDEN_GUEST_CHURN
    check_churn();
#endif
#ifdef EDEN_GUEST_LIFECYCLE
    check_state();
    check_memory();
#endif
#ifdef EDEN_GUEST_FP
    check_fp();
#endif
#ifdef EDEN_GUEST_THREADS_EXPECTED
    check_threads();
#endif
#ifdef EDEN_GUEST_CPU_EXPECTED
    extern u64 cpu_pressure(u64 seed);
    stage = 60;
    u64 result = 1;
    for (u32 pass = 0; pass < 2; ++pass) {
        result = cpu_pressure(result);
        print_value("EDEN_GUEST_CPU_RESULT=", result);
    }
    require(result == EDEN_GUEST_CPU_EXPECTED);
    PRINT("EDEN_GUEST_CPU_PASS");
#endif
    stage = 1;
    shared_value = 40; shared_value += 2; require(shared_value == 42);
    const u64 before = ONE(get_tick, 0).rc;
    ONE(sleep_thread, 2000000);
    require(ONE(get_tick, 0).rc > before);
    PRINT("EDEN_GUEST_TIMER_PASS");
    stage = 2;
    Registers event = ONE(create_event, 0); check(event.rc);
    const u32 write_event = event.first, read_event = event.second;
    require(wait(read_event, 0).rc == 0xea01);
    Registers thread = create_thread(0, (u64)thread_entry, write_event,
                                     (u64)(thread_stack + sizeof(thread_stack)), 44, -2);
    check(thread.rc); check(ONE(start_thread, thread.first).rc);
    Registers signaled = wait(read_event, 1000000000); check(signaled.rc); require(signaled.first == 0);
    require(shared_value == 0x12345678);
    check(ONE(reset_signal, read_event).rc);
    require(wait(read_event, 1000000).rc == 0xea01);
    check(wait(thread.first, 1000000000).rc);
    close(thread.first); close(read_event); close(write_event);
    PRINT("EDEN_GUEST_SYNC_PASS");
    stage = 3;
    Registers connection = connect_port(0, (u64)"sm:", 0, 0, 0, 0); check(connection.rc);
    u32 sm = connection.first, fs, sd, file;
    const u64 zero[] = {0};
    ipc(sm, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, zero, 1, 0);
    const char name[8] __attribute__((aligned(8))) = "fsp-srv";
    ipc(sm, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, (const u64*)name, 1, &fs);
    ipc(fs, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, zero, 1, 0);
    ipc(fs, 18, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, &sd);
    PRINT("EDEN_GUEST_SERVICE_PASS");
    stage = 4;
    const char path[] = "/eden-offline-fixture.bin";
    for (u32 i = 0; i < sizeof(path); ++i) file_path[i] = path[i];
    const u64 create_args[] = {0, sizeof(written)};
    ipc(sd, 0, 0, 1, file_path, sizeof(file_path), create_args, 2, 0);
    const u64 mode[] = {3}; // read and write
    ipc(sd, 8, 0, 1, file_path, sizeof(file_path), mode, 1, &file);
    for (u32 i = 0; i < sizeof(written); ++i) written[i] = (unsigned char)(i * 37 + 11);
    const u64 write_args[] = {1, 0, sizeof(written)}; // flush, offset, length
    ipc(file, 1, 0, 2, written, sizeof(written), write_args, 3, 0);
    ipc(file, 2, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);
    require(*ipc(file, 4, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0) == sizeof(written));
    const u64 read_args[] = {0, 0, sizeof(read_back)};
    require(*ipc(file, 0, 0, 3, read_back, sizeof(read_back), read_args, 3, 0) == sizeof(read_back));
    for (u32 i = 0; i < sizeof(written); ++i) require(read_back[i] == written[i]);
    close(file);
    ipc(sd, 1, 0, 1, file_path, sizeof(file_path), 0, 0, 0);
    close(sd);
#ifdef EDEN_GUEST_SAVE_PHASE
    check_save(fs);
#endif
    close(fs);
    PRINT("EDEN_GUEST_STORAGE_PASS");
#ifdef EDEN_GUEST_DEVICES
    check_audio(sm);
    check_renderer(sm);
    check_hid(sm);
#endif
    close(sm);
    PRINT("EDEN_CORE_FIXTURE_PASS");
}
```

`fixtures/core-threads.inc`:

```inc
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#ifdef EDEN_GUEST_THREADS_EXPECTED
SVC(current_core, 0x10)
static unsigned char worker_stacks[4][4096] __attribute__((aligned(16)));
static u64 counter, ready, go, done[4], sums[4], cores[4];

static void atomic_worker(u64 index) {
    cores[index] = ONE(current_core, 0).rc;
    __atomic_fetch_add(&ready, 1, __ATOMIC_ACQ_REL);
    while (!__atomic_load_n(&go, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE)) ONE(sleep_thread, 100000);
    u64 sum = 0;
    for (u32 i = 0; i < 10000; ++i)
        sum += __atomic_fetch_add(&counter, 1, __ATOMIC_ACQ_REL);
    sums[index] = sum;
    cores[index] |= ONE(current_core, 0).rc << 32;
    __atomic_store_n(&done[index], 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    ONE(exit_thread, 0);
    for (;;) {}
}

static void check_threads(void) {
    stage = 61;
    u32 handles[4];
    for (u32 i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
        Registers thread = create_thread(0, (u64)atomic_worker, i,
            (u64)(worker_stacks[i] + sizeof(worker_stacks[i])), 44, i);
        check(thread.rc);
        handles[i] = thread.first;
        check(ONE(start_thread, handles[i]).rc);
    }
    const u64 deadline = ONE(get_tick, 0).rc + 19200000ULL * 3;
    while (__atomic_load_n(&ready, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) != 4) {
        require(ONE(get_tick, 0).rc < deadline);
        ONE(sleep_thread, 100000);
    }
    __atomic_store_n(&go, 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    stage = 62;
    u64 sum = 0;
    for (u32 i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
        while (!__atomic_load_n(&done[i], __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE)) {
            require(ONE(get_tick, 0).rc < deadline);
            ONE(sleep_thread, 100000);
        }
        // Read each worker's ordinary writes after acquire, before joining.
        sum += sums[i];
        require(cores[i] == ((u64)i << 32 | i));
        print_value("EDEN_GUEST_THREAD_CORES=", cores[i]);
        check(wait(handles[i], 1000000000).rc);
        close(handles[i]);
    }
    stage = 63;
    const u64 total = __atomic_load_n(&counter, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    print_value("EDEN_GUEST_THREAD_COUNT=", total);
    print_value("EDEN_GUEST_THREAD_SUM=", sum);
    require(total == EDEN_GUEST_THREADS_EXPECTED);
    require(sum == 40000ULL * 39999 / 2);
    PRINT("EDEN_GUEST_THREADS_PASS");
}
#endif
```

```txt
    # Only main.cpp needs to recompile when the SHA changes. The stable
    # video_core and other native app objects keep their incremental caches.
    if(NOT DEFINED EDEN_ENCORE_SOURCE_COMMIT)
        set(EDEN_ENCORE_SOURCE_COMMIT "unknown")
    endif()
    if(NOT EDEN_ENCORE_SOURCE_COMMIT STREQUAL "unknown")
        string(LENGTH "${EDEN_ENCORE_SOURCE_COMMIT}" encore_commit_len)
        if(NOT encore_commit_len EQUAL 40 OR
           NOT EDEN_ENCORE_SOURCE_COMMIT MATCHES "^[0-9a-f]+$")
            message(FATAL_ERROR "EDEN_ENCORE_SOURCE_COMMIT must be a 40-char lowercase Git SHA")
        endif()
    endif()
    set_property(SOURCE "${EDEN_PORT_DIR}/main.cpp" APPEND PROPERTY
        COMPILE_DEFINITIONS "EDEN_NATIVE_SOURCE_COMMIT=\"${EDEN_ENCORE_SOURCE_COMMIT}\"")
    # Native-title libc rejects socket fcntl and its resolver may depend on an
    # unloaded WebKit module. ps5_net_compat.c supplies sceNetResolver DNS and
    # translates only refused socket flags to native SO_NBIO.
    target_link_options(eden-headless PRIVATE -Wl,--wrap=fcntl
        -Wl,--wrap=connect -Wl,--wrap=send -Wl,--wrap=sendto
        -Wl,--wrap=recv -Wl,--wrap=recvfrom)
    set_property(TARGET eden-headless APPEND PROPERTY LINK_DEPENDS
        "${PORT_ROOT}/tools/link-headless-native.sh" "${PORT_ROOT}/tools/unwind.ld"
        "${PORT_ROOT}/tools/app-symbols.map")
    if(EDEN_PS5_VULKAN AND EDEN_VULKAN_DRIVER STREQUAL "RADV")
        set_property(TARGET eden-headless APPEND PROPERTY LINK_DEPENDS
            "${PORT_ROOT}/tools/radv-link-eden.sh"
            "${PORT_ROOT}/../mihawk-vulkan-review/tools/radv-link.sh")
    endif()
    target_compile_definitions(common PRIVATE PS5_NATIVE=1 YUZU_BUNDLED_OPENSSL=1)
else()
    add_executable(eden-headless "${EDEN_PORT_DIR}/main.cpp" "${PORT_ROOT}/src/aligned_alloc.c")
    target_link_options(eden-headless PRIVATE -Wl,--wrap=aligned_alloc)
    add_executable(eden-romfs-check "${EDEN_PORT_DIR}/romfs_check.cpp")
    target_include_directories(eden-romfs-check PRIVATE "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/src")
    target_link_libraries(eden-romfs-check PRIVATE core)
    target_compile_options(eden-romfs-check PRIVATE -fno-rtti)
    add_executable(eden-scalar-check "${EDEN_PORT_DIR}/scalar_check.cpp")
    target_include_directories(eden-scalar-check PRIVATE "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/src")
    target_link_libraries(eden-scalar-check PRIVATE dynarmic)
    add_executable(eden-memory-check "${EDEN_PORT_DIR}/memory_check.cpp")
    target_include_directories(eden-memory-check PRIVATE "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/src")
    target_link_libraries(eden-memory-check PRIVATE dynarmic common)
    target_compile_definitions(eden-memory-check PRIVATE EDEN_SHARED_JIT_AVAILABLE=0)
    target_compile_options(eden-scalar-check PRIVATE -fno-rtti)
    add_executable(eden-ryujinx-check "${EDEN_PORT_DIR}/ryujinx_check.cpp")
    # Run on the host: whole shader cache entries survive a damaged tail.
    add_executable(eden-shader-cache-check "${EDEN_PORT_DIR}/shader_cache_check.cpp")
    target_include_directories(eden-shader-cache-check PRIVATE "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/src")
    target_link_libraries(eden-shader-cache-check PRIVATE video_core)
    target_compile_options(eden-shader-cache-check PRIVATE -fno-rtti)
    add_executable(eden-mods-check "${EDEN_PORT_DIR}/mods_check.cpp")
    target_include_directories(eden-mods-check PRIVATE "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/src")
    target_link_libraries(eden-mods-check PRIVATE core)
    target_compile_options(eden-mods-check PRIVATE -fno-rtti)
    # The settings store's check is written with assert(): they stay in a release build.
    add_executable(eden-settings-check "${EDEN_PORT_DIR}/preferences_check.cpp")
    target_link_libraries(eden-settings-check PRIVATE core)
    target_compile_options(eden-settings-check PRIVATE -UNDEBUG)
    add_executable(eden-devices-check "${EDEN_PORT_DIR}/devices_check.cpp")
    target_link_libraries(eden-devices-check PRIVATE core eden-pad eden-device-mock)
    target_compile_options(eden-devices-check PRIVATE -fno-rtti)
endif()
target_include_directories(eden-headless PRIVATE "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/src")

    message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing or invalid compiled native PS5 contentVersion")

# N76 -- NS2 guest CNTPCT calibration through Encore's shared CPU/JIT.
# Upstream-compatible guest tick semantics selected by the reviewed NPDM; NS1 unchanged.
# N76 now follows the reviewed dual-NPDM loader automatically on PS5.
# A single PS5 release can select the real NS2 31.25 MHz timer per program
# while preserving 19.2 MHz for every first-generation title. The shared
# optimized G11 JIT and common clock are already maintained and host-tested.
# This is NOT the six-core scheduler or experimental A64 decoder.
set(EDEN_SHARED_NS2_GUEST_COUNTER OFF)
if(PS5_NATIVE AND EDEN_REVIEWED_DUAL_NPDM)
    set(EDEN_SHARED_NS2_GUEST_COUNTER ON)
endif()
if(EDEN_SHARED_NS2_GUEST_COUNTER)
    if(NOT PS5_NATIVE OR NOT EDEN_REVIEWED_DUAL_NPDM)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "N76 requires native PS5 with the reviewed dual-NPDM loader")
    endif()
    set(EDEN_N76_CLOCK_ROOT
        "${PORT_ROOT}/vendor/encore-active/eden-core")
    set(EDEN_N76_GUEST_COUNTER_HEADER
        "${EDEN_N76_CLOCK_ROOT}/include/encore/guest_counter_policy.h")
    set(EDEN_N76_NATIVE_CPU_SOURCE
        "${EDEN_N76_CLOCK_ROOT}/src/common/cpu_features.cpp")
    # G11 has already replaced the upstream A64 translation unit.
    # Keep its fully optimized native owner and graft the opt-in counter
    # contract into it; never silently replace it with a legacy source.
    set(EDEN_N76_G11_PROFILE normal)
    set(EDEN_N76_NATIVE_JIT_SOURCE
        "${EDEN_N76_CLOCK_ROOT}/src/core/arm/dynarmic/g11/arm_dynarmic_64_native_${EDEN_N76_G11_PROFILE}.cpp")
    foreach(n76_file IN ITEMS
        "${EDEN_N76_GUEST_COUNTER_HEADER}"
        "${EDEN_N76_CLOCK_ROOT}/include/common/cpu_features.h"
        "${EDEN_N76_NATIVE_CPU_SOURCE}"
        "${EDEN_N76_NATIVE_JIT_SOURCE}")
        if(NOT EXISTS "${n76_file}")
            message(FATAL_ERROR "N76 missing maintained vendor clock owner: ${n76_file}")
        endif()
    endforeach()
    get_target_property(n76_common_sources common SOURCES)
    list(FIND n76_common_sources
        "${EDEN_N76_NATIVE_CPU_SOURCE}" n76_clock_owner_idx)
    if(n76_clock_owner_idx EQUAL -1)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "N76 real native common clock owner is not compiled")
    endif()
    get_target_property(n76_core_sources core SOURCES)
    list(FIND n76_core_sources "${EDEN_N76_NATIVE_JIT_SOURCE}"
         n76_selected_g11_owner_idx)
    if(n76_selected_g11_owner_idx EQUAL -1)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "N76 requires the existing, optimized G11 native A64 owner")
    endif()
    list(FIND n76_core_sources "arm/dynarmic/arm_dynarmic_64.cpp"
         n76_legacy_owner_idx)
    if(NOT n76_legacy_owner_idx EQUAL -1)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "N76 must not compile the unqualified legacy A64 owner")
    endif()
    # Switch 1 selects 19.2 MHz at its original ExeFS handoff, while NS2
    # selects 31.25 MHz only AFTER the full patched-NSO bounds preflight.
    # This keeps malformed NS2 titles from changing the next title's clock;
    # G11 retains the optimized native owner.
    # The dedicated host selector guard verifies the opt-in G11 source bytes.
    # The GPU report-timestamp owner must see the SAME metadata-selected
    # guest generation as the A64/JIT and loader. No global NS2 GPU mode
    # and no compile-time change to NS1's GPU-tick clock domain.
    foreach(n76_target IN ITEMS core common eden-headless video_core)
        target_compile_definitions(${n76_target} PRIVATE EDEN_NS2_GUEST_COUNTER=1)
        target_include_directories(${n76_target} BEFORE PRIVATE
            "${EDEN_N76_CLOCK_ROOT}/include")
    endforeach()
endif()

option(EDEN_HOST_ASAN "Instrument host emulator code for memory diagnostics" OFF)
if(EDEN_HOST_ASAN)
    if(PS5_NATIVE)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "EDEN_HOST_ASAN is a Linux host diagnostic only")
    endif()
    # Generated guest instructions and custom fiber stacks are not covered.
    foreach(asan_target common core audio_core video_core hid_core eden-pad eden-device-mock eden-headless)
        target_compile_options(${asan_target} PRIVATE -fsanitize=address -g1 -fno-omit-frame-pointer
            -fno-sanitize-address-use-after-scope -fsanitize-address-use-after-return=never)
    endforeach()
    target_link_options(eden-headless PRIVATE -fsanitize=address)
endif()
target_compile_options(eden-headless PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Wno-unused-parameter -fwrapv $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-fno-rtti>)
if(PS5_NATIVE)
    target_compile_options(eden-headless PRIVATE -femulated-tls)
    # One maintained native controller/audio frontend source graph.
    target_compile_definitions(eden-headless PRIVATE EDEN_DEVICE_FRONTEND=0)
endif()

# Consume the frozen, relocatable 4.6 SDK as one complete profile.
option(EDEN_PS5_OPENGL "Use the PS5 EGL/OpenGL frontend" OFF)
if(EDEN_PS5_OPENGL)
    if(NOT PS5_NATIVE OR NOT ENABLE_OPENGL)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "PS5 graphics requires the native OpenGL build")
    endif()
    # Audited PS5 OpenGL source snapshot. It includes SDK 1.0.1 plus the reviewed post-release
    # constant-buffer/alignment and scanout-flush fixes; tools/build-opengl-sdk.sh verifies its
    # source commit and installed manifest before CMake sees it.
    set(gl46 "${PORT_ROOT}/.local/ps5-opengl-sdk-ad2807d")
    set(gl46_commit "ad2807d41cef2681882a9ee0d20808779f74b7cd")
    if(NOT EXISTS "${gl46}/lib/libps5_opengl_core33.a" OR NOT EXISTS "${gl46}/manifest.sha256" OR
       NOT EXISTS "${gl46}/ENCORE_SOURCE_COMMIT")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing audited PS5 OpenGL SDK in ${gl46}; run make prepare")
    endif()
    file(READ "${gl46}/ENCORE_SOURCE_COMMIT" gl46_built_commit)
    string(STRIP "${gl46_built_commit}" gl46_built_commit)
    if(NOT gl46_built_commit STREQUAL gl46_commit)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Frozen OpenGL source commit changed: ${gl46_built_commit}")
    endif()
    file(SHA256 "${gl46}/manifest.sha256" gl46_manifest_hash)
    set(PS5OpenGL_DIR "${gl46}/lib/cmake/PS5OpenGL" CACHE PATH "Frozen Eden graphics SDK" FORCE)
    find_package(PS5OpenGL CONFIG REQUIRED PATHS "${gl46}/lib/cmake/PS5OpenGL" NO_DEFAULT_PATH NO_CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH)
    target_sources(eden-headless PRIVATE "${EDEN_PORT_DIR}/graphics.cpp")
    # The loading screen's shader as a string for the OpenGL window; the Vulkan HUD pass includes
    # the same two files (vulkan_hud.frag).
    file(READ "${EDEN_PORT_DIR}/loading_wordmark.glsl" loading_wordmark)
    file(READ "${EDEN_PORT_DIR}/loading_scene.glsl" loading_scene)
    set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
        "${EDEN_PORT_DIR}/loading_wordmark.glsl" "${EDEN_PORT_DIR}/loading_scene.glsl")
    write_derived("${PORT_BUILD_DIR}/include/loading_scene_glsl.h"
        "// Generated from loading_wordmark.glsl and loading_scene.glsl.\n#pragma once\ninline constexpr const char* kLoadingSceneGlsl = R\"glsl(\n${loading_wordmark}${loading_scene})glsl\";\n")
    target_compile_definitions(eden-headless PRIVATE EDEN_PS5_OPENGL=1)
    target_link_libraries(eden-headless PRIVATE PS5OpenGL::OpenGL glad)
endif()
    # Launcher UI: its own small OpenGL renderer, mixer and screens (headless/prosperoeden/pe),
    # all gone before a game starts.
    if(PS5_NATIVE)
        set(launcher_dir "${EDEN_PORT_DIR}/prosperoeden")
        # Pinned BSD-licensed libwebp: background one-time encoding and decode.
        # inject.cmake registers the pinned WebP target before the deferred
        # add_eden_headless callback. No subdirectories may be created here.
        if(NOT TARGET webp OR NOT EXISTS "${EDEN_WEBP_ROOT}/CMakeLists.txt")
            message(FATAL_ERROR "Pinned libwebp target was not registered in project(yuzu)")
        endif()
        # The PS5 SDK is x86-64 (Zen 2), where SSE2 is baseline ABI.
        # Our default conservative -mno-sse2 flag breaks libwebp C scalar
        # routines returning doubles: clang reports "SSE2 register return
        # with SSE2 disabled". Restore only SSE2 for the pinned WebP object
        # libraries; keep globally disabled SIMD extensions and the
        # WEBP_ENABLE_SIMD=OFF policy unchanged. These CMake targets own
        # every WebP object linked into eden-headless (including SharpYUV).
        foreach(eden_webp_c_target IN ITEMS
                sharpyuv webpdecode webpdspdecode webputilsdecode
                webpencode webpdsp webputils webp webpdecoder)
            if(NOT TARGET ${eden_webp_c_target})
                message(FATAL_ERROR
                    "Missing pinned WebP ABI target: ${eden_webp_c_target}")
            endif()
            target_compile_options(${eden_webp_c_target} PRIVATE
                $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C>:-msse2>)
        endforeach()
        target_link_libraries(eden-headless PRIVATE webp)
        target_include_directories(eden-headless PRIVATE "${EDEN_WEBP_ROOT}/src")
        target_sources(eden-headless PRIVATE
            "${launcher_dir}/runtime_shims.cpp"
            "${launcher_dir}/radio_input.c")
        target_include_directories(eden-headless PRIVATE "${launcher_dir}" "${PORT_ROOT}/third_party")
        # native_app_update.cpp consumes the pinned CA bundle generated by
        # tools/build-headless-native.sh at the configured OpenSSL include root.
        target_include_directories(eden-headless PRIVATE "${OPENSSL_INCLUDE_DIR}")
        if(EDEN_PS5_OPENGL)
            set(launcher_sources
                "${launcher_dir}/frontend.cpp"
                "${launcher_dir}/eden_services.cpp"
                "${launcher_dir}/native_app_update.cpp"
                "${EDEN_PORT_DIR}/update_check/self_update_sha256.c"
                "${launcher_dir}/pe/audio/mixer.cpp"
                "${launcher_dir}/pe/audio/sounds.cpp"
                "${launcher_dir}/pe/audio/wav.cpp"
                "${launcher_dir}/pe/core/strings.cpp"
                "${launcher_dir}/pe/gfx/bidi.cpp"
                "${launcher_dir}/pe/gfx/draw_list.cpp"
                "${launcher_dir}/pe/gfx/font.cpp"
                "${launcher_dir}/pe/gfx/gl_batch.cpp"
                "${launcher_dir}/pe/gfx/gl_program.cpp"
                "${launcher_dir}/pe/gfx/harfbuzz.cpp"
                "${launcher_dir}/pe/gfx/image.cpp"
                "${launcher_dir}/pe/gfx/system_fonts.cpp"
                "${launcher_dir}/pe/platform/audio_out.cpp"
                "${launcher_dir}/pe/platform/display_egl.cpp"
                "${launcher_dir}/pe/ui/browse.cpp"
                "${launcher_dir}/pe/ui/home.cpp"
                "${launcher_dir}/room_directory.cpp"
                "${launcher_dir}/pe/ui/multiplayer.cpp"
                "${launcher_dir}/pe/ui/launcher.cpp"
                "${launcher_dir}/pe/ui/library.cpp"
                "${launcher_dir}/pe/ui/mapping.cpp"
                "${launcher_dir}/pe/ui/settings.cpp"
                "${launcher_dir}/pe/ui/switch_theme.cpp"
                "${launcher_dir}/pe/ui/textures.cpp"
                "${launcher_dir}/pe/ui/widgets.cpp")
            target_sources(eden-headless PRIVATE ${launcher_sources})
            # The launcher calls OpenGL by name (the SDK's headers), not through glad.
            set(launcher_definitions "GL_GLEXT_PROTOTYPES=1")
            if(EXISTS "${EDEN_PORT_DIR}/ryujinx_saves.h")
                list(APPEND launcher_definitions "EDEN_SAVE_IMPORT=1")
            endif()
            set_source_files_properties(${launcher_sources}
                PROPERTIES COMPILE_DEFINITIONS "${launcher_definitions}")
            # Text in the scripts the baked font lacks: the console's own fonts, shaped by HarfBuzz
            # (a pinned source release, tools/deps.json) and drawn through stb_truetype.
            set(harfbuzz_dir "${PORT_ROOT}/.deps/harfbuzz-12.3.2/src")
            if(NOT EXISTS "${harfbuzz_dir}/harfbuzz.cc")
                message(FATAL_ERROR "HarfBuzz is missing (${harfbuzz_dir}): run make deps")
            endif()
            set_source_files_properties(
                "${launcher_dir}/pe/gfx/system_fonts.cpp" "${launcher_dir}/pe/gfx/harfbuzz.cpp"
                PROPERTIES INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${harfbuzz_dir};${PORT_ROOT}/tools/launcher/stb")
            # HarfBuzz is not ours to tidy: its warnings are off.
            set_source_files_properties("${launcher_dir}/pe/gfx/harfbuzz.cpp" PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-w")
        else()
            target_sources(eden-headless PRIVATE "${launcher_dir}/frontend_stub.cpp")
        endif()
        target_link_libraries(eden-headless PRIVATE eden-metadata)
    endif()

if(EDEN_PS5_VULKAN)
    # Both backends import the same system module; use the superset facade.
    get_target_property(gl_imports PS5OpenGL::OpenGL INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES)

        target_compile_definitions(eden-headless PRIVATE EDEN_PS5_RADV=1)
    endif()
```
