```txt
endif()


# Capture reproducible GPU compatibility evidence without changing any
# Maxwell/Fermi instructions or swallowing unsupported feature failures.
include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/gpu_native_observability.cmake")
# Disabled native GPU coherency bridge, explicit developer compilation only.
include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/guest_write_deferred_bridge.cmake")

# Experimental ExeFS bridge must be selected AFTER all Encore-owned source
# substitutions (NCZ/XCZ and the PS5 16-KiB aligned NSO loader).
# The same maintained loader owns ordinary NS1 ExeFS and NS2 extracted
# programs in the ONE PS5 shipping binary. Preserve the audited PS5 NSO
# implementation and baseline kernel dispatcher in release; research-only
# NSO/SVC source replacements are not silently shipped.
set(EDEN_SHARED_NS2_EXEFS OFF)
if(PS5_NATIVE AND EDEN_REVIEWED_DUAL_NPDM)
    set(EDEN_SHARED_NS2_EXEFS ON)
endif()
if(EDEN_SHARED_NS2_EXEFS)
    if(NOT EDEN_REVIEWED_DUAL_NPDM)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "NS2 ExeFS requires the reviewed dual-generation NPDM reader")
    endif()
    set(eden_ns2_loader_origin
        "${PORT_ROOT}/vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/core/loader/loader.cpp")
    if(PS5_NATIVE)
        set(eden_ns2_romdir_origin
            "${PORT_ROOT}/vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/core/loader/deconstructed_rom_directory.cpp")
    else()
        set(eden_ns2_romdir_origin "loader/deconstructed_rom_directory.cpp")
    endif()
    get_target_property(eden_ns2_exefs_sources core SOURCES)
    foreach(eden_ns2_pair IN ITEMS
            "loader.cpp|${eden_ns2_loader_origin}"
            "deconstructed_rom_directory.cpp|${eden_ns2_romdir_origin}")
        string(REPLACE "|" ";" eden_ns2_parts "${eden_ns2_pair}")
        list(GET eden_ns2_parts 0 eden_ns2_basename)
        list(GET eden_ns2_parts 1 eden_ns2_original)
        list(FIND eden_ns2_exefs_sources "${eden_ns2_original}" eden_ns2_original_idx)
        if(eden_ns2_original_idx EQUAL -1)
            message(FATAL_ERROR "NS2 ExeFS owner changed: ${eden_ns2_original}")
        endif()
        set(eden_ns2_replacement
            "${EDEN_NS2_METADATA_OVERLAY}/core/loader/${eden_ns2_basename}")
        if(NOT EXISTS "${eden_ns2_replacement}")
            message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing NS2 ExeFS source: ${eden_ns2_replacement}")
        endif()
        list(REMOVE_ITEM eden_ns2_exefs_sources "${eden_ns2_original}")
        list(APPEND eden_ns2_exefs_sources "${eden_ns2_replacement}")
    endforeach()
    if(NOT EXISTS "${EDEN_NS2_CORE_HELPERS}/core/loader/deconstructed_rom_directory.h")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing NS2 ExeFS maintained loader header")
    endif()
    # Select a complete maintained native PS5 NSO source, preserving sparse
    # BSS and ZBIC support. Do not accidentally fall back to pinned NSO.
    set_property(TARGET core PROPERTY SOURCES "${eden_ns2_exefs_sources}")
    if(EDEN_SHARED_NS2_EXEFS)
        message(STATUS "Encore unified PS5 ExeFS: NS1/NS2 loader + reviewed NPDM; retain native optimized NSO/SVC")
    endif()

endif()

# The Switch 2 GPU-access memory SVC is a validated kernel admission,
# not a simulated GPU mapping or a successful native submission. A separate
# exact NS2 process PID and memory-profile guard preserves NS1's SVC table.
set(EDEN_SHARED_NS2_GPU_ACCESS_SVC OFF)
if(PS5_NATIVE AND EDEN_REVIEWED_DUAL_NPDM)
    set(EDEN_SHARED_NS2_GPU_ACCESS_SVC ON)
endif()
if(EDEN_SHARED_NS2_GPU_ACCESS_SVC)
    set(EDEN_NS2_GPU_ACCESS_ROOT "${PORT_ROOT}/vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/gpu_access_svc")
    set(EDEN_NS2_GPU_ACCESS_SOURCE "${EDEN_NS2_GPU_ACCESS_ROOT}/core/hle/kernel/svc.cpp")
    if(NOT EXISTS "${EDEN_NS2_GPU_ACCESS_SOURCE}" OR
       NOT EXISTS "${EDEN_NS2_GPU_ACCESS_ROOT}/core/hle/kernel/svc_types.h" OR
       NOT EXISTS "${EDEN_NS2_GPU_ACCESS_ROOT}/core/hle/kernel/k_memory_block.h" OR
       NOT EXISTS "${EDEN_NS2_GPU_ACCESS_ROOT}/core/hle/kernel/ns2_gpu_memory_attribute.h" OR
       NOT EXISTS "${EDEN_NS2_CORE_HELPERS}/core/loader/ns2_svc_trace.h")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing validated NS2 GPU-access SVC owner")
    endif()
    get_target_property(eden_ns2_gpu_access_sources core SOURCES)
    list(FIND eden_ns2_gpu_access_sources "hle/kernel/svc.cpp" eden_ns2_gpu_access_index)
    if(eden_ns2_gpu_access_index EQUAL -1)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "NS1 kernel SVC ownership changed: review NS2 GPU-access selector")
    endif()
    list(REMOVE_ITEM eden_ns2_gpu_access_sources "hle/kernel/svc.cpp")
    list(APPEND eden_ns2_gpu_access_sources "${EDEN_NS2_GPU_ACCESS_SOURCE}")
    set_property(TARGET core PROPERTY SOURCES "${eden_ns2_gpu_access_sources}")
    # All consumers of the kernel's u8 memory attributes must agree on the
    # same 0x20 enum value; otherwise QueryMemory may hide the stored bit.
    # The two maintained headers keep the complete pinned NS1 structures.
    target_include_directories(core BEFORE PUBLIC "${EDEN_NS2_GPU_ACCESS_ROOT}")
    target_include_directories(video_core BEFORE PRIVATE "${EDEN_NS2_GPU_ACCESS_ROOT}")
endif()

# P1.3: Switch 2 uses SVC arbitration type 3 (WaitIfEqual64), including
# the high 32 bits. Select one reviewed kernel owner for both guests when
# native dual-NPDM release is configured. Types 0/1/2 retain the original
# 32-bit compare and alignment semantics; no alternate kernel/worker exists.
set(EDEN_SHARED_NS2_WAIT64 OFF)
if(EDEN_SHARED_NS2_GPU_ACCESS_SVC)
    set(EDEN_SHARED_NS2_WAIT64 ON)
    set(EDEN_NS2_WAIT64_ROOT
        "${PORT_ROOT}/vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/kernel_wait64")
    foreach(eden_ns2_wait_header IN ITEMS
            "core/hle/kernel/k_address_arbiter.h"
            "core/hle/kernel/k_process.h"
            "core/hle/kernel/svc.h")
        if(NOT EXISTS "${EDEN_NS2_WAIT64_ROOT}/${eden_ns2_wait_header}")
            message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing common NS2 64-bit arbiter header: ${eden_ns2_wait_header}")
        endif()
    endforeach()
    get_target_property(eden_wait64_sources core SOURCES)
    foreach(eden_wait64_owner IN ITEMS
            "hle/kernel/k_address_arbiter.cpp"
            "hle/kernel/svc/svc_address_arbiter.cpp")
        # The PS5 guest-threading CMake module has already promoted its
        # reviewed 32-bit HLE source. Replace THAT exact source with the
        # combined Wait64 + validity/overflow owner, never add two owners.
        set(eden_wait64_selected_source "${eden_wait64_owner}")
        list(FIND eden_wait64_sources "${eden_wait64_selected_source}" eden_wait64_index)
        if(eden_wait64_index LESS 0 AND PS5_NATIVE)
            # The maintained threading module has already replaced pinned HLE
            # sources with absolute paths. PORT_ROOT may still contain /headless/..
            # while CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR in the module is canonical: compare
            # existing source files by real path, never by their spelling.
            get_filename_component(eden_wait64_reviewed_real
                "${PORT_ROOT}/vendor/encore-active/eden-threading/src/core/${eden_wait64_owner}"
                REALPATH)
            foreach(eden_wait64_candidate IN LISTS eden_wait64_sources)
                if(IS_ABSOLUTE "${eden_wait64_candidate}" AND
                   EXISTS "${eden_wait64_candidate}")
                    get_filename_component(eden_wait64_candidate_real
                        "${eden_wait64_candidate}" REALPATH)
                    if(eden_wait64_candidate_real STREQUAL eden_wait64_reviewed_real)
                        set(eden_wait64_selected_source "${eden_wait64_candidate}")
                        list(FIND eden_wait64_sources
                            "${eden_wait64_selected_source}" eden_wait64_index)
                        break()
                    endif()
                endif()
            endforeach()
        endif()
        if(eden_wait64_index LESS 0)
            message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing unified address arbiter owner: ${eden_wait64_owner}")
        endif()
        set(eden_wait64_replacement
            "${EDEN_NS2_WAIT64_ROOT}/core/${eden_wait64_owner}")
        if(NOT EXISTS "${eden_wait64_replacement}")
            message(FATAL_ERROR "Reviewed address arbiter source missing: ${eden_wait64_replacement}")
        endif()
        list(REMOVE_ITEM eden_wait64_sources "${eden_wait64_selected_source}")
        list(APPEND eden_wait64_sources "${eden_wait64_replacement}")
    endforeach()
    set_property(TARGET core PROPERTY SOURCES "${eden_wait64_sources}")
    # Keep class layouts and inline method signatures identical in every
    # consumer; the GPU service may include KProcess through its core ABI.
    target_include_directories(core BEFORE PUBLIC "${EDEN_NS2_WAIT64_ROOT}")
    target_include_directories(video_core BEFORE PRIVATE "${EDEN_NS2_WAIT64_ROOT}")
    message(STATUS "Encore common kernel arbitration: 32-bit legacy + native WaitIfEqual64")
endif()

# Unified NS2 six-core kernel owner; each process retains its physical
# affinity and NS1 tick cadence. No DEV or roadmap profile selection.
if(PS5_NATIVE AND EDEN_REVIEWED_DUAL_NPDM)
    set(EDEN_NS2_CPU6_ROOT "${PORT_ROOT}/vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/cpu6")
    foreach(eden_ns2_cpu6_header IN ITEMS
            "core/hardware_properties.h"
            "dynarmic/interface/exclusive_monitor.h")
        if(NOT EXISTS "${EDEN_NS2_CPU6_ROOT}/${eden_ns2_cpu6_header}")
            message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing experimental NS2 6-core header ${eden_ns2_cpu6_header}")
        endif()
    endforeach()
    target_include_directories(core BEFORE PUBLIC "${EDEN_NS2_CPU6_ROOT}")
    target_include_directories(dynarmic BEFORE PUBLIC "${EDEN_NS2_CPU6_ROOT}")
    target_include_directories(eden-headless BEFORE PRIVATE "${EDEN_NS2_CPU6_ROOT}")
    # The original 4-core scheduler table defaults the two added preemption
    # priorities to zero; the original Dynarmic AddTicks divides even NS1
    # cycles by six. Both defects must be fixed before CPU6 can be exercised.
    # Derive three narrow sources from the pinned baseline without forking
    # unrelated scheduler, kernel or JIT code into the native release.
    # N76 must already have selected the current optimized G11 normal/dev
    # JIT. NEVER replace that TU with the legacy Eden arm_dynarmic_64.cpp.
    if(NOT EDEN_SHARED_NS2_GUEST_COUNTER OR
       NOT DEFINED EDEN_N76_NATIVE_JIT_SOURCE OR
       NOT EXISTS "${EDEN_N76_NATIVE_JIT_SOURCE}")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "CPU6 needs the existing N76/G11 native A64 owner")
    endif()
    set(EDEN_CPU6_SOURCE_ROOT "${PORT_ROOT}/vendor/sources/eden/src")
    set(EDEN_CPU6_A64_SOURCE "${EDEN_N76_NATIVE_JIT_SOURCE}")
    set(EDEN_CPU6_OUTPUT_ROOT "${PORT_BUILD_DIR}/ns2-cpu6")
    include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/ns2_cpu6_source_bridge.cmake")
    get_target_property(eden_cpu6_core_sources core SOURCES)
    foreach(eden_cpu6_file IN ITEMS
            "hle/kernel/global_scheduler_context.cpp"
            "arm/dynarmic/arm_dynarmic_32.cpp")
        # G11 has already replaced the original A32 translation unit.
        # Consume that exact selected native profile, not the removed relative
        # upstream file. The CPU6 A32 static owner is based on this G11 profile
        # and changes only the per-process six-core tick denominator.
        set(eden_cpu6_selected_source "${eden_cpu6_file}")
        if(eden_cpu6_file STREQUAL "arm/dynarmic/arm_dynarmic_32.cpp")
            set(eden_cpu6_selected_source
                "${EDEN_G11_ROOT}/arm_dynarmic_32_${EDEN_G11_PLATFORM}_${EDEN_G11_PROFILE}.cpp")
            if(NOT PS5_NATIVE OR NOT EXISTS "${eden_cpu6_selected_source}")
                message(FATAL_ERROR "CPU6 requires maintained native G11 A32 source")
            endif()
        endif()
        list(FIND eden_cpu6_core_sources "${eden_cpu6_selected_source}" eden_cpu6_owner_idx)
        if(eden_cpu6_owner_idx EQUAL -1)
            message(FATAL_ERROR "Selected CPU6 scheduler/tick owner changed: ${eden_cpu6_selected_source}")
        endif()
        list(REMOVE_ITEM eden_cpu6_core_sources "${eden_cpu6_selected_source}")
        list(APPEND eden_cpu6_core_sources
            "${EDEN_CPU6_OUTPUT_ROOT}/core/${eden_cpu6_file}")
    endforeach()
    list(FIND eden_cpu6_core_sources
         "${EDEN_N76_NATIVE_JIT_SOURCE}" eden_cpu6_g11_owner_idx)
    if(eden_cpu6_g11_owner_idx EQUAL -1)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "CPU6 must retain selected N76/G11 JIT source")
    endif()
    list(REMOVE_ITEM eden_cpu6_core_sources "${EDEN_N76_NATIVE_JIT_SOURCE}")
    list(APPEND eden_cpu6_core_sources
        "${EDEN_CPU6_OUTPUT_ROOT}/core/arm/dynarmic/arm_dynarmic_64.cpp")
    set_property(TARGET core PROPERTY SOURCES "${eden_cpu6_core_sources}")
endif()

    # P2.7: native semaphore parking must use exactly one scheduler implementation

    set(EDEN_NS2_GPFIFO_ROOT
        "${PORT_ROOT}/vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/gpu_dispatch")

        "${EDEN_NS2_GPFIFO_ROOT}/video_core/control/scheduler.cpp")
    foreach(EDEN_NS2_GPFIFO_OWNER IN ITEMS
        "${EDEN_NS2_GPFIFO_ROOT}/video_core/dma_pusher.h"
        "${EDEN_NS2_GPFIFO_ROOT}/video_core/control/scheduler.h"
        "${EDEN_NS2_GPFIFO_SCHEDULER}")
        if(NOT EXISTS "${EDEN_NS2_GPFIFO_OWNER}")
            message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing maintained native GPFIFO suspend/resume owner")
        endif()
    endforeach()
    get_target_property(eden_ns2_sched_sources video_core SOURCES)
    list(FIND eden_ns2_sched_sources "control/scheduler.cpp" eden_ns2_sched_idx)
    if(eden_ns2_sched_idx EQUAL -1)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Pinned GPFIFO scheduler owner moved; requalify")
    endif()
    list(REMOVE_ITEM eden_ns2_sched_sources "control/scheduler.cpp")
    list(APPEND eden_ns2_sched_sources "${EDEN_NS2_GPFIFO_SCHEDULER}")
    set_property(TARGET video_core PROPERTY SOURCES "${eden_ns2_sched_sources}")
    # PS5_NATIVE is not a transitive preprocessor definition. Ensure the
    # selected DMA TU actually compiles its native resume/GPFIFO cursor
    # code, including the non-Vulkan PS5 path; do not define it for core.
    set_property(SOURCE "${EDEN_MAINTAINED_GPU_DMA}"
        TARGET_DIRECTORY video_core APPEND PROPERTY COMPILE_DEFINITIONS "PS5_NATIVE=1")
    # Research-only header and .cpp must be the SAME Puller class to keep
    # DmaPusher ABI consistent in every video_core translation unit.
    set(EDEN_NS2_GPU_DISPATCH_ROOT
        "${PORT_ROOT}/vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/gpu_dispatch")
    if(NOT EXISTS "${EDEN_NS2_GPU_DISPATCH_ROOT}/video_core/engines/puller.h" OR
       NOT EXISTS "${EDEN_NS2_GPU_DISPATCH_ROOT}/video_core/native_ampere_macro_state.h" OR
       NOT EXISTS "${EDEN_NS2_GPU_DISPATCH_ROOT}/video_core/macro_turing.h")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing isolated Ampere MME/puller dispatch headers")
    endif()
    target_include_directories(video_core BEFORE PRIVATE
        "${EDEN_NS2_GPU_DISPATCH_ROOT}"
        "${EDEN_NS2_NVDRV_GPU_ROOT}" "${EDEN_NS2_NVDRV_ROOT}")
    # Core stores ChannelState payloads containing DmaPusher by value.
    # Do not permit a split Puller/DmaPusher ABI between core and video_core.
    target_include_directories(core BEFORE PRIVATE
        "${EDEN_NS2_GPU_DISPATCH_ROOT}")
    # Native admission follows the actual channel/process registration.
    # Unregistered NS1 Maxwell commands retain the original DMA path.
endif()

# P0.2: Compile the same native Ampere-to-Maxwell frontend in the ONE
# qualified native release source graph. Shader execution is still routed
# exclusively by the separate GPU session/renderer owner: compiling these
# units does not make a Switch 1 shader enter the Ampere translator.
# Guest process and channel identity selects Maxwell or Ampere at runtime.
set(EDEN_SHARED_NS2_AMPERE_CORE OFF)
if(PS5_NATIVE AND
   EDEN_REVIEWED_DUAL_NPDM AND EDEN_PS5_VULKAN)
    set(EDEN_SHARED_NS2_AMPERE_CORE ON)
endif()
if(EDEN_SHARED_NS2_AMPERE_CORE)
    if(NOT EDEN_REVIEWED_DUAL_NPDM)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "NS2 Ampere ISA requires reviewed native NPDM")
    endif()
    # The alternative 32-slot resource header changes BufferCache signatures,
    # NUM_STORAGE_BUFFERS (16 -> 32), and is NOT ABI-safe as a header-only
    # native override. Do not include it in the shared 16-slot NS1 BufferCache ABI.
    set(EDEN_NS2_SHADER_RESOURCE_ROOT
        "${PORT_ROOT}/vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/shader_resource/include")
    if(NOT EXISTS "${EDEN_NS2_SHADER_RESOURCE_ROOT}/shader_recompiler/frontend/ir/attribute.h" OR
       NOT EXISTS "${EDEN_NS2_SHADER_RESOURCE_ROOT}/video_core/buffer_cache/buffer_cache_base.h")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing native NS2 shader/texture resource headers")
    endif()
    # The generic31 Y/Z/W classifier is a pure, shared IR fix. Copy
    # only this reviewed header into the common build include tree;
    # do not silently replace the BufferCache layout or methods.
    file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${PORT_BUILD_DIR}/include/shader_recompiler/frontend/ir")
    configure_file(
        "${EDEN_NS2_SHADER_RESOURCE_ROOT}/shader_recompiler/frontend/ir/attribute.h"
        "${PORT_BUILD_DIR}/include/shader_recompiler/frontend/ir/attribute.h" COPYONLY)
    target_include_directories(shader_recompiler BEFORE PRIVATE "${PORT_BUILD_DIR}/include")
    target_include_directories(video_core BEFORE PRIVATE "${PORT_BUILD_DIR}/include")
    target_include_directories(core BEFORE PRIVATE "${PORT_BUILD_DIR}/include")
    set(EDEN_NS2_AMPERE_ROOT "${PORT_ROOT}/vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/ampere")
    set(EDEN_NS2_AMPERE_PROBE
        "${EDEN_NS2_AMPERE_ROOT}/shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/probe.cpp")
    foreach(eden_ampere_header IN ITEMS ampere_isa_table.h classify.h instruction.h probe.h
            lower_to_maxwell.h lower_bridge.h register_pressure.h maxwell_image.h
            native_stage_buffer.h
            program_address_map.h capture.h program_capture.h translation_cache.h
            maxwell_environment.h ir_bridge.h)
        if(NOT EXISTS
           "${EDEN_NS2_AMPERE_ROOT}/shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/${eden_ampere_header}")
            message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing NS2 Ampere ISA header: ${eden_ampere_header}")
        endif()
    endforeach()
    if(NOT EXISTS "${EDEN_NS2_AMPERE_PROBE}")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing NS2 Ampere shader instruction decoder")
    endif()
    set(EDEN_NS2_AMPERE_LOWER_BRIDGE
        "${EDEN_NS2_AMPERE_ROOT}/shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/lower_bridge.cpp")
    if(NOT EXISTS "${EDEN_NS2_AMPERE_LOWER_BRIDGE}")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing NS2 bounded native-to-Maxwell translation bridge")
    endif()
    set(EDEN_NS2_MAXWELL_IMAGE_BRIDGE
        "${EDEN_NS2_AMPERE_ROOT}/shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/maxwell_image.cpp")
    if(NOT EXISTS "${EDEN_NS2_MAXWELL_IMAGE_BRIDGE}")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing NS2 native-to-Maxwell shader-environment image adapter")
    endif()
    set(EDEN_NS2_NATIVE_SHADER_CAPTURE
        "${EDEN_NS2_AMPERE_ROOT}/shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/capture.cpp")
    set(EDEN_NS2_NATIVE_GMMU_CAPTURE
        "${EDEN_NS2_AMPERE_ROOT}/video_core/native_shader_capture.cpp")
    if(NOT EXISTS "${EDEN_NS2_NATIVE_SHADER_CAPTURE}" OR
       NOT EXISTS "${EDEN_NS2_NATIVE_GMMU_CAPTURE}" OR
       NOT EXISTS "${EDEN_NS2_AMPERE_ROOT}/video_core/native_shader_capture.h")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing NS2 real GMMU-backed native shader capture owner")
    endif()
    set(EDEN_NS2_NATIVE_TRANSLATION_CACHE
        "${EDEN_NS2_AMPERE_ROOT}/shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/translation_cache.cpp")
    if(NOT EXISTS "${EDEN_NS2_NATIVE_TRANSLATION_CACHE}")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing bounded, process-owned NS2 translation cache")
    endif()
    set(EDEN_NS2_MAXWELL_ENVIRONMENT_ADAPTER
        "${EDEN_NS2_AMPERE_ROOT}/shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/maxwell_environment.cpp")
    if(NOT EXISTS "${EDEN_NS2_MAXWELL_ENVIRONMENT_ADAPTER}")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing NS2 Shader::Environment Maxwell frontend adapter")
    endif()
    set(EDEN_NS2_MAXWELL_IR_BRIDGE
        "${EDEN_NS2_AMPERE_ROOT}/shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/ir_bridge.cpp")
    if(NOT EXISTS "${EDEN_NS2_MAXWELL_IR_BRIDGE}")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing native Ampere Maxwell CFG/IR handoff")
    endif()
    target_sources(shader_recompiler PRIVATE
        "${EDEN_NS2_MAXWELL_IR_BRIDGE}"
        "${EDEN_NS2_AMPERE_PROBE}"
        "${EDEN_NS2_AMPERE_LOWER_BRIDGE}"
        "${EDEN_NS2_MAXWELL_IMAGE_BRIDGE}"
        "${EDEN_NS2_NATIVE_SHADER_CAPTURE}"
        "${EDEN_NS2_NATIVE_TRANSLATION_CACHE}"
        "${EDEN_NS2_MAXWELL_ENVIRONMENT_ADAPTER}")
    target_include_directories(shader_recompiler BEFORE PRIVATE "${EDEN_NS2_AMPERE_ROOT}")
    target_sources(video_core PRIVATE "${EDEN_NS2_NATIVE_GMMU_CAPTURE}")
    target_include_directories(video_core BEFORE PRIVATE "${EDEN_NS2_AMPERE_ROOT}")

# N3m: compile a renderer-callable, explicitly scoped NS2 VertexB IR -> SPIR-V
# adapter. The active PS5 Vulkan pipeline owner is NOT replaced or modified:
# only a session-verified NS2 caller may invoke this isolated API.
# P0.2: the native SPIR-V compiler and QMD3 bounds emitter are complete
# maintained C++ source owners. Compile them in the PS5 release library,
# while keeping the actual Vulkan dispatch, GPU session and 4K NVDRV
# through the same GPU-owner/process chain. The SPIR-V
# overrides use a thread-local Ampere scope: Maxwell takes its original
# indirect-bank switch, byte-for-byte (see the host source parity test).
set(EDEN_SHARED_NS2_SPIRV_COMPILER OFF)
if(EDEN_SHARED_NS2_AMPERE_CORE)
    set(EDEN_SHARED_NS2_SPIRV_COMPILER ON)
endif()
if(EDEN_SHARED_NS2_SPIRV_COMPILER)
    set(EDEN_NS2_VULKAN_SHADER_BRIDGE
        "${PORT_ROOT}/vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/ampere/shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/renderer_spirv_bridge.cpp")
    if(NOT EXISTS "${EDEN_NS2_VULKAN_SHADER_BRIDGE}")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing NS2 renderer-side SPIR-V compiler")
    endif()
    set(EDEN_NS2_NATIVE_GPU_SPIRV_CAPTURE
        "${PORT_ROOT}/vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/ampere/video_core/ns2_shader_spirv_compile.cpp")
    if(NOT EXISTS "${EDEN_NS2_NATIVE_GPU_SPIRV_CAPTURE}" OR
       NOT EXISTS "${PORT_ROOT}/vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/ampere/video_core/ns2_shader_spirv_compile.h")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing verified NS2 GMMU-to-SPIR-V pipeline entrypoint")
    endif()
    # P2.3: SPIR-V indirect CBUF dispatch uses exactly the reflected native
    # QMD3 banks, never the generic 14-bank Maxwell switch. Select the
    # complete tracked source with the shared native Ampere compiler.
    set(EDEN_NS2_QMD_CBUF_SPIRV
        "${EDEN_NS2_AMPERE_ROOT}/shader_recompiler/backend/spirv/spirv_emit_context.cpp")
    set(EDEN_NS2_QMD_CBUF_DIRECT_SPIRV
        "${EDEN_NS2_AMPERE_ROOT}/shader_recompiler/backend/spirv/emit_spirv_context_get_set.cpp")
    # Real SPIR-V descriptor arrays must have the same variable type that
    # the shared image emitter indexes, including storage texel buffers.
    set(EDEN_NS2_SPIRV_IMAGE_ARRAY
        "${EDEN_NS2_AMPERE_ROOT}/shader_recompiler/backend/spirv/emit_spirv_image.cpp")
    if(NOT EXISTS "${EDEN_NS2_SPIRV_IMAGE_ARRAY}" OR
       NOT EXISTS "${EDEN_NS2_QMD_CBUF_SPIRV}" OR
       NOT EXISTS "${EDEN_NS2_QMD_CBUF_DIRECT_SPIRV}" OR
       NOT EXISTS "${EDEN_NS2_AMPERE_ROOT}/shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/native_indirect_cbuf.h" OR
       NOT EXISTS "${EDEN_NS2_AMPERE_ROOT}/shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/native_global_atomic_binding.h")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing reviewed native QMD3 indirect CBUF compiler")
    endif()
    get_target_property(eden_ns2_shader_sources shader_recompiler SOURCES)
    list(FIND eden_ns2_shader_sources
        "backend/spirv/spirv_emit_context.cpp" eden_ns2_spirv_source_idx)
    if(eden_ns2_spirv_source_idx LESS 0)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Pinned SPIR-V emitter owner changed: audit QMD3 CBUF selection")
    endif()
    list(REMOVE_ITEM eden_ns2_shader_sources "backend/spirv/spirv_emit_context.cpp")
    list(APPEND eden_ns2_shader_sources "${EDEN_NS2_QMD_CBUF_SPIRV}")
    # Native direct-bank LDC also requires a pre-access bounds check. Replace
    # this FULL companion translation unit for both authenticated guest modes.
    list(FIND eden_ns2_shader_sources
        "backend/spirv/emit_spirv_context_get_set.cpp" eden_ns2_cbuf_direct_source_idx)
    if(eden_ns2_cbuf_direct_source_idx LESS 0)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Pinned direct CBUF emitter owner changed: audit QMD3 selection")
    endif()
    list(REMOVE_ITEM eden_ns2_shader_sources "backend/spirv/emit_spirv_context_get_set.cpp")
    list(APPEND eden_ns2_shader_sources "${EDEN_NS2_QMD_CBUF_DIRECT_SPIRV}")
    # Exactly one shared SPIR-V image emitter; remove the pinned owner
    # rather than adding a second translation unit or per-title shader.
    list(FIND eden_ns2_shader_sources
        "backend/spirv/emit_spirv_image.cpp" eden_ns2_image_source_idx)
    if(eden_ns2_image_source_idx LESS 0)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Pinned SPIR-V image emitter owner changed")
    endif()
    list(REMOVE_ITEM eden_ns2_shader_sources "backend/spirv/emit_spirv_image.cpp")
    list(APPEND eden_ns2_shader_sources "${EDEN_NS2_SPIRV_IMAGE_ARRAY}")
    set_property(TARGET shader_recompiler PROPERTY SOURCES "${eden_ns2_shader_sources}")
    target_sources(video_core PRIVATE "${EDEN_NS2_VULKAN_SHADER_BRIDGE}")
    target_sources(video_core PRIVATE "${EDEN_NS2_NATIVE_GPU_SPIRV_CAPTURE}")
    target_include_directories(video_core BEFORE PRIVATE "${PORT_ROOT}/vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/hle")
    # The single native PS5 runtime exposes the same Vulkan rasterizer
    # virtual methods. The real channel owner selects native QMD3 dispatch,
    # while legacy NS1 commands keep the maintained Maxwell dispatch.
    # Native Vulkan's RasterizerVulkan::DispatchNativeCompute overrides a
    # RasterizerInterface virtual method. The pinned build-source archive
    # otherwise provides the pre-NS2 interface, causing an 'override' error
    # when unrelated Vulkan consumers compile. Select the REVIEWED vendor
    # interface for every native PS5 compilation target.
    set(EDEN_NS2_RASTERIZER_INTERFACE
        "${PORT_ROOT}/vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/vulkan_abi/video_core/rasterizer_interface.h")
    if(NOT EXISTS "${EDEN_NS2_RASTERIZER_INTERFACE}")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing reviewed native QMD3 RasterizerInterface ABI")
    endif()
    file(STRINGS "${EDEN_NS2_RASTERIZER_INTERFACE}" eden_ns2_rasterizer_interface_text
        REGEX "virtual bool DispatchNativeCompute" LIMIT_COUNT 1)
    if(NOT eden_ns2_rasterizer_interface_text MATCHES
           "virtual bool DispatchNativeCompute\\(const Tegra::NativeComputeLaunch&\\)")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Reviewed native QMD3 RasterizerInterface ABI changed")
    endif()
    file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${PORT_BUILD_DIR}/include/video_core")
    configure_file("${EDEN_NS2_RASTERIZER_INTERFACE}"
        "${PORT_BUILD_DIR}/include/video_core/rasterizer_interface.h" COPYONLY)
    # The virtual table is shared by core, video_core and their consumers.
    # Do not give video_core a private, incompatible interpretation.
    # Native compute belongs to the PS5 RasterizerInterface for both guests.
    # Channel/process ownership determines whether QMD3 can execute.
endif()

# N50: shared native PS5 device-memory contiguous page-run safety.

if(PS5_NATIVE)
    if(NOT EXISTS "${PORT_ROOT}/vendor/encore-active/eden-core/overrides/core/device_memory_manager.inc")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "N50 maintained PS5 device-memory source missing")

    if(NOT EXISTS "${PORT_ROOT}/vendor/encore-active/ns2-helpers/include/core/ns2_egl_continuity_guard.h")

    endif()
    target_include_directories(core BEFORE PRIVATE
        "${PORT_ROOT}/vendor/encore-active/ns2-helpers/include")
    target_include_directories(video_core BEFORE PRIVATE
        "${PORT_ROOT}/vendor/encore-active/ns2-helpers/include")

# P2.4 Native Task/Mesh shaders: maintained compiler units and ABI headers.
# Shared shader ABI for NS1/NS2: no alternate emulator mode and no runtime
# patch generation. Existing Maxwell paths retain their legacy behavior.
if(EDEN_SHARED_NS2_SPIRV_COMPILER)
    set(EDEN_NATIVE_TASK_MESH_ROOT
        "${PORT_ROOT}/vendor/encore-active/eden-shader/src")
    set(EDEN_NATIVE_TASK_MESH_VULKAN_HEADERS
        "${PORT_ROOT}/vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/include")
    foreach(eden_mesh_header IN ITEMS

        shader_recompiler/frontend/ir/opcodes.inc
        shader_recompiler/frontend/ir/program.h
        shader_recompiler/frontend/maxwell/maxwell.inc
        shader_recompiler/frontend/maxwell/opcodes.h
        shader_recompiler/runtime_info.h

        shader_recompiler/stage.h
        )
        if(NOT EXISTS "${EDEN_NATIVE_TASK_MESH_ROOT}/${eden_mesh_header}")
            message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing maintained Task/Mesh shader header: ${eden_mesh_header}")
        endif()
    endforeach()
    if(NOT EXISTS "${EDEN_NATIVE_TASK_MESH_VULKAN_HEADERS}/video_core/vulkan_common/vulkan_device.h")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing native Task/Mesh Vulkan feature ABI header")
    endif()
    set(eden_mesh_source_paths
        backend/spirv/emit_spirv.cpp
        backend/spirv/emit_spirv_special.cpp
        frontend/ir/ir_emitter.cpp
        frontend/ir/microinstruction.cpp
        frontend/ir/opcodes.cpp
        # ISBE_nx2 adds a reviewed pseudo-opcode. The enum, decoder and
        # name table MUST be built against the same maintained maxwell.inc.
        frontend/maxwell/decode.cpp
        frontend/maxwell/opcodes.cpp
        frontend/maxwell/structured_control_flow.cpp
        frontend/maxwell/translate/impl/internal_stage_buffer_entry_read.cpp
        frontend/maxwell/translate_program.cpp
        ir_opt/collect_shader_info_pass.cpp
    )
    if(ENABLE_OPENGL)
        list(APPEND eden_mesh_source_paths
            backend/glasm/emit_glasm.cpp
            backend/glasm/emit_glasm_not_implemented.cpp
            backend/glasm/glasm_emit_context.cpp
            backend/glsl/emit_glsl_not_implemented.cpp
            backend/glsl/glsl_emit_context.cpp
        )
    endif()
    get_target_property(eden_mesh_shader_target_sources shader_recompiler SOURCES)
    foreach(eden_mesh_relative IN LISTS eden_mesh_source_paths)
        list(FIND eden_mesh_shader_target_sources "${eden_mesh_relative}" eden_mesh_source_idx)
        if(eden_mesh_source_idx LESS 0)
            message(FATAL_ERROR "Pinned Task/Mesh shader owner changed: ${eden_mesh_relative}")
        endif()
        list(REMOVE_ITEM eden_mesh_shader_target_sources "${eden_mesh_relative}")
        list(APPEND eden_mesh_shader_target_sources
            "${EDEN_NATIVE_TASK_MESH_ROOT}/shader_recompiler/${eden_mesh_relative}")
    endforeach()
    list(APPEND eden_mesh_shader_target_sources
        "${EDEN_NATIVE_TASK_MESH_ROOT}/shader_recompiler/backend/spirv/emit_spirv_mesh.cpp")
    set_property(TARGET shader_recompiler PROPERTY SOURCES "${eden_mesh_shader_target_sources}")
    target_include_directories(shader_recompiler BEFORE PRIVATE "${EDEN_NATIVE_TASK_MESH_ROOT}")
    # P5: native Task/Mesh also contributes the original maintained Vulkan
    # include directory. Place the CMake-selected ABI header overlay FIRST:
    # renderer_vulkan_r08, vk_blit_screen_r08 and window_adapt_pass_r08 must
    # be seen by their matching C++ implementations. Otherwise the older
    # vendor headers shadow the selected release headers and compilation
    # breaks on missing HUD/framegen members.
    target_include_directories(video_core BEFORE PRIVATE
        "${PORT_BUILD_DIR}/include"
        "${EDEN_NATIVE_TASK_MESH_ROOT}" "${EDEN_NATIVE_TASK_MESH_VULKAN_HEADERS}")
    target_include_directories(core BEFORE PRIVATE "${EDEN_NATIVE_TASK_MESH_ROOT}")
endif()

# P5 link parity: native shader atomic CAS owners
# The cached original source builds successfully but does not define all
# CAS symbols referenced by the pinned Task/Mesh opcode/dispatch headers.
# Select the COMPLETE audited implementations from the same pinned Eden
# source snapshot, including real SPIR-V OpAtomicCompareExchange, GLSL,
# GLASM fail-closed semantics, and the Maxwell ATOM.CAS translator.
# This is an NS1/NS2 shared compiler fix; no generated stubs or fake symbols.
if(PS5_NATIVE)
    set(EDEN_PINNED_SHADER_CAS_ROOT
        "${PORT_ROOT}/vendor/sources/eden/src/shader_recompiler")
    set(eden_native_cas_paths
        backend/spirv/emit_spirv_atomic.cpp
        frontend/maxwell/translate/impl/atomic_operations_global_memory.cpp)
    if(ENABLE_OPENGL)
        list(APPEND eden_native_cas_paths
            backend/glasm/emit_glasm_memory.cpp
            backend/glsl/emit_glsl_atomic.cpp)
    endif()
    get_target_property(eden_native_cas_sources shader_recompiler SOURCES)
    foreach(eden_cas_path IN LISTS eden_native_cas_paths)
        set(eden_cas_impl "${EDEN_PINNED_SHADER_CAS_ROOT}/${eden_cas_path}")
        if(NOT EXISTS "${eden_cas_impl}")
            message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing pinned shader CAS owner: ${eden_cas_path}")
        endif()
        list(FIND eden_native_cas_sources "${eden_cas_path}" eden_cas_original)
        if(eden_cas_original LESS 0)
            message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing native shader CAS source: ${eden_cas_path}")
        endif()
        list(REMOVE_ITEM eden_native_cas_sources "${eden_cas_path}")
        list(APPEND eden_native_cas_sources "${eden_cas_impl}")
    endforeach()
    set_property(TARGET shader_recompiler PROPERTY SOURCES
        "${eden_native_cas_sources}")
endif()
```

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// The storage root for game/user-supplied files. Internal storage is /data/prosperoeden by
// default; an external selection changes only this root, never the required subfolder layout.
// Resolved once per process; a new root applies after Encore is reopened.
#pragma once
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <filesystem>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <system_error>
#include <vector>
#if defined(__PROSPERO__)
#include "native_directory.h"
#endif

#include "settings_store.h"
#include "storage_paths.h"

namespace Eden {
// One storage root, one schema. Internal storage defaults to /data/prosperoeden; an optional
// external root is saved as a single path and must contain the same keys/, firmware/, roms/,
// updates/, mods/, save-import/, save-export/ and ryujinx/ layout. Without filesystem access the
// app can only see its packaged/sandbox assets/ fallback.
inline std::string ResolveAssetsDir() {
    if (!FilesystemAccess()) return AppFile("assets");
    if (std::string saved = LoadSavedAssetsDir(); !saved.empty())
        return saved;
    return kDefaultAssetsDir;
}

inline const std::string& AssetsDir() {
    static const std::string directory = ResolveAssetsDir();
    return directory;
}
// Firmware and keys are independently discovered for each console family.
// All paths remain inside the selected storage root; never cross into a symlink.
enum class SwitchFamily { Switch1, Switch2 };

inline bool StorageRegular(const std::filesystem::path& path) {
    std::error_code ec;
    const auto status = std::filesystem::symlink_status(path, ec);
    return !ec && std::filesystem::is_regular_file(status) &&
           !std::filesystem::is_symlink(status);
}
inline bool StorageDirectory(const std::filesystem::path& path) {
    std::error_code ec;
    const auto status = std::filesystem::symlink_status(path, ec);
    return !ec && std::filesystem::is_directory(status) &&
           !std::filesystem::is_symlink(status);
}
// Console family and storage format are orthogonal. Never assume NS2==dump
// or NS1==NCA: either generation may use encrypted NCAs, extracted code or ZIP.
enum class FirmwareFormat { None, Nca, Extracted, Zip };
inline bool StorageTitleId(std::string_view name) {
    if (name.size() != 16) return false;
    for (char ch : name)
        if (!((ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') || (ch >= 'a' && ch <= 'f') ||
              (ch >= 'A' && ch <= 'F'))) return false;
    return true;
}
inline FirmwareFormat DetectFirmwareFormat(const std::filesystem::path& folder) {
    namespace fs = std::filesystem;
    if (!StorageDirectory(folder)) return FirmwareFormat::None;
    if (StorageRegular(folder / "firmware-dump-named.json") &&
        StorageRegular(folder / "ncm-system-programs.bin"))
        return FirmwareFormat::Extracted;
    if (StorageRegular(folder / "main.npdm") ||
        StorageRegular(folder / "exefs/main.npdm"))
        return FirmwareFormat::Extracted;
    std::error_code ec;
#if defined(__PROSPERO__)
    const auto entries = ReadNativeDirectory(folder, ec);
#else
    std::vector<fs::directory_entry> entries;
    for (fs::directory_iterator it{folder, fs::directory_options::skip_permission_denied, ec}, end;
         !ec && it != end && entries.size() < 2048; it.increment(ec))
        entries.push_back(*it);
#endif
    if (ec) return FirmwareFormat::None;
    bool archive = false, extracted = false;
    for (const auto& entry : entries) {
        const fs::path path = entry.path();
        if (StorageRegular(path)) {
            if (path.extension() == ".nca") return FirmwareFormat::Nca;
            if (path.extension() == ".zip") archive = true;
        } else if (StorageDirectory(path) && StorageTitleId(path.filename().string())) {
            if (StorageRegular(path / "main.npdm")) extracted = true;
        }
    }
    if (extracted) return FirmwareFormat::Extracted;
    return archive ? FirmwareFormat::Zip : FirmwareFormat::None;
}
inline bool HasFirmwareNca(const std::filesystem::path& folder) {
    return DetectFirmwareFormat(folder) == FirmwareFormat::Nca;
}
inline bool HasExtractedSystemCode(const std::filesystem::path& folder) {
    return DetectFirmwareFormat(folder) == FirmwareFormat::Extracted;
}
inline bool FirmwareHasNs2Identity(const std::filesystem::path& dir) {
    if (StorageRegular(dir / ".ns2jb-firmware-dump.json")) return true;
    // A 040... system-program folder is NS2 evidence; no NCA-only guessing.
    std::error_code ec;
#if defined(__PROSPERO__)
    const auto entries = ReadNativeDirectory(dir, ec);
#else
    std::vector<std::filesystem::directory_entry> entries;
    for (std::filesystem::directory_iterator it{dir,
         std::filesystem::directory_options::skip_permission_denied, ec}, end;
         !ec && it != end && entries.size() < 512; it.increment(ec))
        entries.push_back(*it);
#endif
    if (ec) return false;
    for (const auto& entry : entries) {
        const auto p = entry.path();
        const std::string name = p.filename().string();
        if (StorageDirectory(p) && StorageTitleId(name) &&
            name.substr(0, 3) == "040" && StorageRegular(p / "main.npdm"))
            return true;
    }
    return false;
}
inline bool FirmwareHasNs1Identity(const std::filesystem::path& dir) {
    // A 010... extracted system title is NS1 evidence; .nca alone is not.
    std::error_code ec;
#if defined(__PROSPERO__)
    const auto entries = ReadNativeDirectory(dir, ec);
#else
    std::vector<std::filesystem::directory_entry> entries;
    for (std::filesystem::directory_iterator it{dir,
         std::filesystem::directory_options::skip_permission_denied, ec}, end;
         !ec && it != end && entries.size() < 512; it.increment(ec))
        entries.push_back(*it);
#endif
    if (ec) return false;
    for (const auto& entry : entries) {
        const auto p = entry.path();
        const std::string name = p.filename().string();
        if (StorageDirectory(p) && StorageTitleId(name) &&
            name.substr(0, 3) == "010" && StorageRegular(p / "main.npdm"))
            return true;
    }
    return false;
}
// Explicit family folder wins, but only when it contains a recognizable
// firmware format; a flat NCA remains assigned to NS1 for backward compatibility.
// Flat extracted data requires identifying contents, not a guessed generation.
inline std::string ResolveFirmwarePath(SwitchFamily family) {
    namespace fs = std::filesystem;
    const fs::path root{AssetsDir()};
    const auto valid = [&](const fs::path& p) {
        if (!StorageDirectory(root)) return false;
        fs::path walk = root;
        for (const auto& part : p.lexically_relative(root)) {
            walk /= part;
            if (!StorageDirectory(walk)) return false;
        }
        return DetectFirmwareFormat(p) != FirmwareFormat::None;
    };
    constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 9> ns1{
        "firmware/ns1", "firmware/switch1", "ns1/firmware",
        "switch1/firmware", "ns1", "switch1",
        "firmware/ns1-extracted", "firmware/switch1-extracted", "firmware"};
    constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 10> ns2{
        "firmware/ns2", "firmware/switch2", "firmware/ns2-extracted",
        "ns2/firmware", "switch2/firmware", "ns2", "switch2",
        "firmware/switch2-extracted", "firmware", "firmware/firmware"};
    const auto check_explicit = [&](std::string_view name) -> std::string {
        const fs::path p = root / name;
        if (!StorageDirectory(p)) return {};
        const auto inspect_leaf = [&](const fs::path& leaf) -> std::string {
            if (!valid(leaf)) return {};
            if (DetectFirmwareFormat(leaf) == FirmwareFormat::Zip) return {};
            return leaf.string();
        };
        // Prefer already imported firmware over a ZIP left in the same directory.
        if (auto found = inspect_leaf(p); !found.empty()) return found;
        for (std::string_view wrapper : {"firmware", "ns1-extracted", "ns2-extracted"}) {
            if (auto found = inspect_leaf(p / wrapper); !found.empty()) return found;
        }
        // Every ZIP is staged into an isolated imported-* child. Inspect all
        // direct children, but retain ONLY the lexically first valid import:
        // taking the first 128 directory entries before sorting is not
        // deterministic when a family contains more than 128 entries.
        // Never follow links or infer a firmware version from a directory name.
        std::string best_name, best_import;
        const auto consider = [&](const fs::directory_entry& child) {
            const fs::path sub = child.path();
            const std::string name = sub.filename().string();
            if (name.rfind("encore-imported-", 0) != 0 ||
                !StorageDirectory(sub)) return;
            if (!best_import.empty() && name >= best_name) return;
            std::string found = inspect_leaf(sub);
            if (found.empty()) {
                for (const auto& wrapper : {"firmware", "ns2-extracted", "ns1-extracted"}) {
                    found = inspect_leaf(sub / wrapper);
                    if (!found.empty()) break;
                }
            }
            if (!found.empty()) {
                best_name = name;
                best_import = std::move(found);
            }
        };
        std::error_code ec;
#if defined(__PROSPERO__)
        const auto children = ReadNativeDirectory(p, ec);
        if (!ec) for (const auto& child : children) consider(child);
#else
        for (fs::directory_iterator it{p, fs::directory_options::skip_permission_denied, ec}, end;
             !ec && it != end; it.increment(ec))
            consider(*it);
#endif
        if (!ec && !best_import.empty()) return best_import;
        return valid(p) && DetectFirmwareFormat(p) == FirmwareFormat::Zip
            ? p.string() : std::string{};
    };
    if (family == SwitchFamily::Switch1) {
        for (auto name : ns1) {
            if (name == "firmware") continue;
            if (auto p = check_explicit(name); !p.empty()) return p;
        }
    } else {
        for (auto name : ns2) {
            if (name == "firmware" || name == "firmware/firmware") continue;
            if (auto p = check_explicit(name); !p.empty()) return p;
        }
    }
    const fs::path flat = root / "firmware";
    if (valid(flat)) {
        const auto kind = DetectFirmwareFormat(flat);
        if (family == SwitchFamily::Switch2 &&
            kind == FirmwareFormat::Extracted && FirmwareHasNs2Identity(flat))
            return flat.string();
        if (family == SwitchFamily::Switch1 &&
            (kind == FirmwareFormat::Nca ||
             (kind == FirmwareFormat::Extracted && FirmwareHasNs1Identity(flat))))
            return flat.string();
        // Do not claim an unlabelled ZIP or NCA belongs to Switch 2.
    }
    if (family == SwitchFamily::Switch2 && valid(flat / "firmware") &&
        FirmwareHasNs2Identity(flat / "firmware")) return (flat / "firmware").string();
    // Nonexistent default is intentional, and never passed off as detected.
    return (root / "firmware" /
            (family == SwitchFamily::Switch1 ? "ns1" : "ns2")).string();
}
inline std::string ResolveKeysPath(SwitchFamily family) {
    namespace fs = std::filesystem;
    const fs::path root{AssetsDir()};
    const char* explicit1[] = {"keys/ns1", "keys/switch1",
                               "ns1/keys", "switch1/keys", "keys"};
    const char* explicit2[] = {"keys/ns2", "keys/switch2",
                               "ns2/keys", "switch2/keys", "keys"};
    const char* const* locations = family == SwitchFamily::Switch1 ? explicit1 : explicit2;
    const std::size_t n = family == SwitchFamily::Switch1
        ? std::size(explicit1) : std::size(explicit2);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        const fs::path candidate = root / locations[i];
        if (!StorageDirectory(root)) break;
        const fs::path relative = candidate.lexically_relative(root);
        fs::path segment = root;
        bool safe = true;
        for (const auto& part : relative) {
            segment /= part;
            if (!StorageDirectory(segment)) { safe = false; break; }
        }
        if (safe && StorageRegular(candidate / "prod.keys"))
            return candidate.string();
    }
    return (root / "keys").string();
}
// Compatibility: all existing NS1 consumers, including the native BIS
// system-NCA loader and KeyManager path, use the detected NS1 root.
// The NS2 metadata/service inventory is separate and never masquerades as
// an NS1 NCA firmware or an AES prod.keys file.
inline std::string AssetsPath(std::string_view child) {
    if (child == "firmware") return ResolveFirmwarePath(SwitchFamily::Switch1);
    if (child == "keys") return ResolveKeysPath(SwitchFamily::Switch1);
    return AssetsDir() + "/" + std::string(child);
}
inline std::string Ns2FirmwarePath() { return ResolveFirmwarePath(SwitchFamily::Switch2); }
inline std::string Ns2KeysPath() { return ResolveKeysPath(SwitchFamily::Switch2); }
} // namespace Eden
```

`headless/audio.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#include "devices.h"
#include "crash_report.h"
#include "preferences.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <stdexcept>
#include "audio_core/sink/null_sink.h"
#include "common/logging.h"
#include "native_audio.hpp"
#include "audio_out_init.h"

namespace Eden {
using namespace AudioCore::Sink;
using namespace ps5::native_audio;

AudioStream::AudioStream(Core::System& system, u32 channels, const std::string& name_, StreamType type)
    : SinkStream{system, type} {
    if (type == StreamType::In || (channels != 1 && channels != 2 && channels != 6))
        throw std::invalid_argument("Unsupported AudioOut stream format");
    name = name_;
    system_channels = channels;
    device_channels = 2;
    SetRingSize(4);
    if (!AudioOutReady()) throw std::runtime_error("sceAudioOutInit failed");
    handle = sceAudioOutOpen(0xff, 0, 0, kAudioOutGrain, kAudioOutRate, kAudioOutStereoS16);
    if (handle < 0) throw std::runtime_error("sceAudioOutOpen failed");
    std::array<int, 8> volumes;
    volumes.fill(AudioVolume(LoadPreferences()));
    if (sceAudioOutSetVolume(handle, 3, volumes.data()) < 0) {
        sceAudioOutClose(handle);
        handle = -1;
        throw std::runtime_error("sceAudioOutSetVolume failed");
    }
    try {
        worker = std::jthread([this](std::stop_token stop) {
            std::array<s16, kAudioOutGrain * 2> block{};
            Crash::audio_completed_blocks.store(0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
            Crash::audio_last_output_result.store(0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
            Crash::audio_worker_thread.store(
                (std::uintptr_t)pthread_self(), std::memory_order_release);
            std::unique_lock lock(mutex);
            while (!stop.stop_requested()) {
                Crash::audio_worker_phase.store(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
                if (!wake.wait(lock, stop, [this] { return !IsPaused(); })) break;
                Crash::audio_worker_phase.store(2, std::memory_order_relaxed);
                ProcessAudioOutAndRender(block, kAudioOutGrain);
                // AudioOut paces complete 256-frame, 48 kHz stereo blocks.
                in_flight = true;
                Crash::audio_worker_phase.store(3, std::memory_order_relaxed);
                lock.unlock();
                const int result = sceAudioOutOutput(handle, block.data());
                // Diagnostic-only PCM scan needs no access to stream state.
                // Keep the producer-facing stream mutex free while inspecting
                // the worker-owned output block. On failed output the block
                // was never accepted and must not contribute to counters.
                u64 nonzero_in_block = 0;
                if (result >= 0) {
                    for (std::size_t frame = 0; frame < kAudioOutGrain; ++frame)
                        nonzero_in_block += block[frame * 2] != 0 ||
                                            block[frame * 2 + 1] != 0;
                }
                lock.lock();
                in_flight = false;
                Crash::audio_worker_phase.store(4, std::memory_order_relaxed);
                Crash::audio_last_output_result.store(result, std::memory_order_relaxed);
                wake.notify_all();
                if (result < 0) {
                    failed = true;
                    SignalPause();
                    LOG_ERROR(Audio_Sink, "PS5 AudioOut output failed");
                    break;
                }
                output_frames += kAudioOutGrain;
                nonzero_frames += nonzero_in_block;
                Crash::audio_completed_blocks.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
            }
            Crash::audio_worker_phase.store(5, std::memory_order_relaxed);
            Crash::audio_worker_thread.store(0, std::memory_order_release);
        });
    } catch (...) {
        sceAudioOutClose(handle);
        handle = -1;
        throw;
    }
}
AudioStream::~AudioStream() { Finalize(); }
void AudioStream::Start(bool) {
    std::scoped_lock lock(mutex);
    if (handle >= 0 && !failed) { paused = false; wake.notify_one(); }
}
void AudioStream::Stop() {
    SignalPause();
    std::unique_lock lock(mutex);
    wake.wait(lock, [this] { return !in_flight; });
}
void AudioStream::Finalize() {
    worker.request_stop();
    wake.notify_all();
    if (worker.joinable()) worker.join();
    std::scoped_lock lock(mutex);
    SignalPause();
    if (handle >= 0) {
        const int drain = sceAudioOutOutput(handle, nullptr);
        const int close = sceAudioOutClose(handle);
        LOG_INFO(Audio_Sink, "EDEN_AUDIO_PORT_CLOSED frames={} nonzero={} failed={} drain={} close={}",
                 output_frames, nonzero_frames, failed.load(), drain, close);
        handle = -1;
    }
}
void AudioStream::AppendBuffer(SinkBuffer& buffer, std::span<s16> samples) {
    std::scoped_lock lock(mutex); // Publish PCM and its descriptor before the consumer runs.
    if (buffer.frames == 0 || buffer.frames > 0x8000 || buffer.frames_played != 0 ||
        samples.size() != buffer.frames * system_channels)
        throw std::invalid_argument("Invalid PCM buffer dimensions");
    if (failed || handle < 0) throw std::runtime_error("AudioOut stream is unavailable");
    SinkStream::AppendBuffer(buffer, samples);
}
SinkStream* AudioSink::AcquireSinkStream(Core::System& system, u32 channels,
                                        const std::string& name, StreamType type) {
    system_channels = channels;
    // Microphone capture is outside this output adapter.
    SinkStreamPtr stream = type == StreamType::In ?
        SinkStreamPtr{std::make_unique<NullSinkStreamImpl>(system, type)} :
        SinkStreamPtr{std::make_unique<AudioStream>(system, channels, name, type)};
    stream->SetDeviceVolume(device_volume);
    stream->SetSystemVolume(system_volume);
    auto* result = stream.get();
    streams.push_back(std::move(stream));
    return result;
}
void AudioSink::CloseStream(SinkStream* stream) {
    std::erase_if(streams, [stream](const auto& item) { return item.get() == stream; });
}
void AudioSink::SetDeviceVolume(f32 value) {
    device_volume = std::clamp(value, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    for (auto& stream : streams) stream->SetDeviceVolume(device_volume);
}
void AudioSink::SetSystemVolume(f32 value) {
    system_volume = std::clamp(value, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    for (auto& stream : streams) stream->SetSystemVolume(system_volume);
}
}
```

`headless/audio_out_init.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#pragma once
#include <mutex>

extern "C" int sceAudioOutInit(void);

namespace Eden {
// AudioOut is initialised once per process: the launcher's sounds and each game's audio both need
// it, and a second sceAudioOutInit reports "already initialised" as an error.
inline bool AudioOutReady() {
    static std::once_flag once;
    static int result = -1;
    std::call_once(once, [] { result = sceAudioOutInit(); });
    return result >= 0 || result == static_cast<int>(0x8026000e);
}
} // namespace Eden
```

```patch
     BuildErrnoResponse(ctx, ListenImpl(fd, backlog));

+// IPC cmd 19 must always reply with the BSD (ret, errno) tuple. Leaving it
+// unregistered causes a fatal user-process panic when FC27 queries its sockets.
+// FIONBIO is handled through the same socket state as Fcntl(SETFL); unknown
+// requests fail explicitly rather than reporting a fictitious success.
+void BSD_USA::Ioctl(HLERequestContext& ctx) {
+    IPC::RequestParser rp{ctx};
+    const s32 fd = rp.Pop<s32>();
+    const u32 request = rp.Pop<u32>();
+    if (!IsFileDescriptorValid(fd)) {
+        BuildErrnoResponse(ctx, Errno::BADF);
+        return;
+    }
+    if (!file_descriptors[fd]->socket) {
+        BuildErrnoResponse(ctx, Errno::BADF);
+        return;
+    }
+    constexpr u32 kFionbio = 0x8004667e;
+    if (request == kFionbio) {
+        const auto data = ctx.ReadBuffer();
+        if (data.size() < sizeof(u32)) {
+            BuildErrnoResponse(ctx, Errno::INVAL);
+            return;
+        }
+        const u32 nonblocking = GetValue<u32>(data);
+        const Errno result = Translate(file_descriptors[fd]->socket->SetNonBlock(nonblocking != 0));
+        if (result == Errno::SUCCESS) {
+            constexpr s32 nonblock_flag = Network::FLAG_O_NONBLOCK;
+            if (nonblocking) file_descriptors[fd]->flags |= nonblock_flag;
+            else file_descriptors[fd]->flags &= ~nonblock_flag;
+        }
+        BuildErrnoResponse(ctx, result);
+        return;
+    }
+    LOG_DEBUG(Service, "Unsupported BSD Ioctl fd={} request={:#x}", fd, request);
+    BuildErrnoResponse(ctx, Errno::INVAL);
+}
+
```

```patch
+Result FSP_SRV::OpenDataFileSystemByCurrentProcess(OutInterface<IFileSystem> out_interface) {
+    LOG_DEBUG(Service_FS, "called");
+
+    if (!romfs) {
+        auto current_romfs = romfs_controller->OpenRomFSCurrentProcess();
+        if (!current_romfs) {
+            LOG_CRITICAL(Service_FS, "No file system interface available!");
+            R_RETURN(ResultUnknown);
+        }
+
+        romfs = current_romfs;
+    }
+
+    auto extracted_romfs = FileSys::ExtractRomFS(romfs);
+    if (!extracted_romfs) {
+        LOG_CRITICAL(Service_FS, "Failed to extract RomFS for the current process!");
+        R_RETURN(ResultUnknown);
+    }
+
+    *out_interface = std::make_shared<IFileSystem>(
+        system, extracted_romfs, SizeGetter::FromStorageId(fsc, FileSys::StorageId::NandUser));
+
+    R_SUCCEED();
+}

+
+IAsyncResult::IAsyncResult(Core::System& system_, Service::Event* event_)
+    : ServiceFramework{system_, "nn::ns::detail::IAsyncResult"}, event{event_} {
+    // clang-format off
+    static const FunctionInfo functions[] = {
+        {0, nullptr, "Get"},
+        {1, D<&IAsyncResult::Cancel>, "Cancel"},
+        {2, nullptr, "GetErrorContext"}, // 4.0.0+
+    };
+    // clang-format on
+
+    RegisterHandlers(functions);
+}
+
+IAsyncResult::~IAsyncResult() = default;
+
+Result IAsyncResult::Cancel() {
+    LOG_DEBUG(Service_NS, "called");
+    if (event != nullptr) {
+        event->Signal(system.Kernel());
+    }
+
+    R_SUCCEED();
+}
```

```patch
         using namespace Common::Literals;
+#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
+        // Console storage is slow and a global Debug filter can otherwise burn through
+        // hundreds of MiB before the event we need to diagnose. Keep the first 8 MiB
+        // plus a rolling 8 MiB recent tail; never stop logging merely because the cap
+        // was reached, or a late soft-freeze would disappear from the evidence.
+        constexpr auto write_limit = 8_MiB;
+        if (bytes_written > write_limit) {

+        }
+        // Thousands of guest/device unmapped-memory errors can arrive
+        // during a broken scene. Flush-on-EVERY-error serialized tens of
+        // thousands of writes onto the PS5 storage, compounding stalls.
+        // Keep ALL lines and immediate first-error/critical durability,
+        // but amortize later Error-level syncs to every 64th event.
+        if (entry.log_level >= Level::Error) {

+#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
+    void RotatePs5() noexcept {
+        if (!file || !file->IsOpen()) {
+            enabled = false;
+            return;
+        }
+        // IOFile's Flush/Open/SetSize emit LOG_ERROR on failure. Re-entrant
+        // logging during rotation must be ignored instead of recursing into
+        // RotatePs5 and risking a stack overflow on full/failed storage.
+        enabled = false;
+        file->Flush();
+        if (!rotated) {
+            file->Close();
+            void(FS::RemoveFile(first_filename));
+            if (!FS::RenameFile(filename, first_filename)) {
+                file->Open(filename, FS::FileAccessMode::Append, FS::FileType::TextFile);
+                enabled = file->IsOpen();
+                return;
+            }
+            file->Open(filename, FS::FileAccessMode::Write, FS::FileType::TextFile);
+            rotated = true;
+        } else {
+            // Keep the first segment untouched and recycle only the current file,
+            // which makes eden_log.txt always contain the newest diagnostics.
+            if (!file->SetSize(0) || !file->Seek(0, FS::SeekOrigin::SetOrigin)) {
+                enabled = false;
+                return;
+            }
+        }
+        bytes_written = 0;
+        static constexpr std::string_view marker{
+            "[Eden Encore] log tail rotated; storage remains bounded\n"};
+        bytes_written += file->WriteSpan(std::span<const char>{marker.data(), marker.size()});
+        enabled = file->IsOpen();
+    }
+
+    std::filesystem::path filename;
+    std::filesystem::path first_filename;
+    bool rotated = false;
```

```patch
     [[nodiscard]] inline const u8* GetSpan(const VAddr addr, const std::size_t size) const noexcept {
+#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
+        if (!size || !AddressSpaceContains(*current_page_table, addr, size)) return nullptr;
+        const auto first = addr >> YUZU_PAGEBITS;
+        const auto last = (addr + size - 1) >> YUZU_PAGEBITS;
+        if (last != first) {
+            const auto [delta, type, block] = current_page_table->entries[first].PointerTypeBlock();
+            if (type != Common::PageType::Memory) return nullptr;
+            for (std::size_t page = first + 1; page <= last; ++page) {
+                const auto [p, t, b] = current_page_table->entries[page].PointerTypeBlock();
+                if (p != delta || t != type || b != block) return nullptr;
+            }
+        }
+        return GetPointerSilent(addr);
+#else
         return (current_page_table->entries[addr >> YUZU_PAGEBITS].Block() == current_page_table->entries[(addr + size) >> YUZU_PAGEBITS].Block()) ? GetPointerSilent(addr) : nullptr;
+#endif
     }
     [[nodiscard]] inline u8* GetSpan(const VAddr addr, const std::size_t size) noexcept {
+#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
+        return const_cast<u8*>(static_cast<const Impl&>(*this).GetSpan(addr, size));
+#else
         return (current_page_table->entries[addr >> YUZU_PAGEBITS].Block() == current_page_table->entries[(addr + size) >> YUZU_PAGEBITS].Block()) ? GetPointerSilent(addr) : nullptr;
+#endif
     }
```

```patch
-    return gpu_memory.GpuToCpuAddress(address, guest_size_bytes).has_value();
-}
+bool IsValidEntry(const Tegra::MemoryManager& gpu_memory, const TICEntry& config) {
+#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
+    // TextureFormat's first defined value is 1. An invalid 0 descriptor
+    // cannot be reinterpreted as RGBA8: doing so allocates a bogus view and
+    // can sample unrelated GPU pages. Preserve all legitimate formats.
+    if (config.format == static_cast<Tegra::Texture::TextureFormat>(0)) {
+        return false;
+    }
+#endif
+    const GPUVAddr address = config.Address();
+    if (address == 0) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    if (address >= (1ULL << 40)) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    if (gpu_memory.GpuToCpuAddress(address).has_value()) {
+        return true;
+    }
+#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
+    // The range overload means ANY page in a range is mapped, not ALL pages.
+    // A normal (non-sparse) texture with an absent first page cannot be
+    // sampled safely just because a later, unrelated page happens to exist.
+    // Preserve upstream's partial-mapping handling for genuine sparse TICs.
+    if (config.is_sparse == 0) {
+        return false;
+    }
+#endif
+    const ImageInfo info{config};
+    const size_t guest_size_bytes = CalculateGuestSizeInBytes(info);
+    return gpu_memory.GpuToCpuAddress(address, guest_size_bytes).has_value();
+}
 
 boost::container::small_vector<BufferImageCopy, 16> UnswizzleImage(Tegra::MemoryManager& gpu_memory,
                                                                    GPUVAddr gpu_addr,
```

```patch
     template <typename Func>
     static void ForEachCPUPage(DAddr addr, size_t size, Func&& func) {
+#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
+        // invoke_result is the trait struct, not the callback return type.
+        // Respect early-stop bool callbacks after the first matching image.
+        static constexpr bool RETURNS_BOOL = std::is_same_v<std::invoke_result_t<Func, u64>, bool>;
+#else
         static constexpr bool RETURNS_BOOL = std::is_same_v<std::invoke_result<Func, u64>, bool>;
+#endif
+#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
+        // A zero byte region has no pages. An overflowing exclusive end
+        // cannot refer to a valid guest mapping: do not wrap into a huge
+        // page scan (notably addr=0, size=0).
+        if (size == 0 || size - 1 > (std::numeric_limits<u64>::max)() - addr) {
+            return;
+        }
+#endif
         const u64 page_end = (addr + size - 1) >> YUZU_PAGEBITS;
         for (u64 page = addr >> YUZU_PAGEBITS; page <= page_end; ++page) {
             if constexpr (RETURNS_BOOL) {
                 if (func(page)) {
                     break;
                 }
             } else {
                 func(page);
             }
         }
     }
```

```patch
+ImageViewId TextureCache<P>::CreateImageView(const TICEntry& config) {
+    const ImageInfo info(config);
+    if (info.type == ImageType::Buffer) {
+        const ImageViewInfo view_info(config, 0);
+        return slot_image_views.insert(runtime, info, view_info, config.Address());
+    }
+#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
+    // TIC base-layer offsets are byte addresses, not 32-bit arithmetic.
+    // Reject invalid addresses before a wrapped image mapping is created.
+    const u64 layer_offset = static_cast<u64>(config.BaseLayer()) * info.layer_stride;
+    if (layer_offset > config.Address()) {
+        return NULL_IMAGE_VIEW_ID;
+    }
+#else
+    const u32 layer_offset = config.BaseLayer() * info.layer_stride;
+#endif
+    const GPUVAddr image_gpu_addr = config.Address() - layer_offset;
+    const ImageId image_id = FindOrInsertImage(info, image_gpu_addr);
+    if (!image_id) {
+        return NULL_IMAGE_VIEW_ID;
+    }
+    ImageBase& image = slot_images[image_id];
+#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
+    // A remapped or incomplete texture may not contain the requested layer.
+    // Defer this view instead of dereferencing an empty optional on the GPU
+    // worker; the existing NULL-view retry path can rebuild it later.
+    const auto base = image.TryFindBase(config.Address());
+    if (!base) {
+        return NULL_IMAGE_VIEW_ID;
+    }
+    ASSERT(base->level == 0);
+    const ImageViewInfo view_info(config, base->layer);
+#else
+    const SubresourceBase base = image.TryFindBase(config.Address()).value();
+    ASSERT(base.level == 0);
+    const ImageViewInfo view_info(config, base.layer);
+#endif

+    image_view.flags |= ImageViewFlagBits::Strong;
+    image.flags |= ImageFlagBits::Strong;
```

`headless/boot_trace.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Early startup trace for hardware failures before the normal crash/log stack is ready.
#pragma once

#include <cerrno>
#include <csignal>
#include <cstdarg>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <ctime>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <string>
#include <unistd.h>

extern "C" int sceKernelDebugOutText(int, const char*);
extern "C" int sysctlbyname(const char*, void*, size_t*, const void*, size_t);

namespace Eden::BootTrace {
namespace detail {
inline std::string& Memory() {
    static std::string text;
    return text;
}
inline int& File() {
    static int fd = -1;
    return fd;
}
inline bool& QuietMode() {
    static bool muted = false;
    return muted;
}
inline timespec& Start() {
    static timespec value = [] {
        timespec now{};
        clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &now);
        return now;
    }();
    return value;
}
inline long Milliseconds() {
    timespec now{};
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &now);
    const timespec& begin = Start();
    return (now.tv_sec - begin.tv_sec) * 1000L + (now.tv_nsec - begin.tv_nsec) / 1000000L;
}
inline void WriteAll(int out, const char* data, size_t size) {
    while (out >= 0 && size) {
        const ssize_t wrote = write(out, data, size);
        if (wrote < 0 && errno == EINTR) continue;
        if (wrote <= 0) break;
        data += wrote;
        size -= static_cast<size_t>(wrote);
    }
}
inline void Emit(const char* line) {
    (void)sceKernelDebugOutText(0, line);
}
inline void OnFatal(int signal, siginfo_t* info, void*) {
    char line[192];
    const int length = std::snprintf(
        line, sizeof(line),
        "[Prospero.Eden Encore diag] +%ldms FATAL signal=%d address=%p before normal crash handler\n",
        Milliseconds(), signal, info ? info->si_addr : nullptr);
    Emit(line);
    if (length > 0 && File() >= 0) {
        const size_t n = static_cast<size_t>(length) < sizeof(line) ?
            static_cast<size_t>(length) : sizeof(line) - 1;
        WriteAll(File(), line, n);
        (void)fsync(File());
    }
    std::signal(signal, SIG_DFL);
    (void)raise(signal);
}
} // namespace detail

inline void Line(const char* format, ...) {
    if (detail::QuietMode()) return;
    char body[700];
    va_list args;
    va_start(args, format);
    std::vsnprintf(body, sizeof(body), format, args);
    va_end(args);

    char line[820];
    const int length = std::snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "[Prospero.Eden Encore diag] +%ldms %s\n",
                                     detail::Milliseconds(), body);
    if (length <= 0) return;
    const size_t size = static_cast<size_t>(length) < sizeof(line) ?
        static_cast<size_t>(length) : sizeof(line) - 1;
    detail::Emit(line);
    detail::Memory().append(line, size);
    if (detail::File() >= 0) {
        detail::WriteAll(detail::File(), line, size);
        (void)fsync(detail::File());
    }
}

inline void Begin(const char* version, const char* build) {
    (void)detail::Start();

    struct sigaction action{};
    action.sa_sigaction = detail::OnFatal;
    action.sa_flags = SA_SIGINFO;
    for (int signal : {SIGSEGV, SIGBUS, SIGILL, SIGFPE, SIGABRT})
        (void)sigaction(signal, &action, nullptr);

    (void)std::rename("/download0/boot-trace.txt", "/download0/boot-trace.prev.txt");
    detail::File() = open("/download0/boot-trace.txt", O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_TRUNC, 0666);

    unsigned int sdk = 0;
    size_t size = sizeof(sdk);
    const bool known = sysctlbyname("kern.sdk_version", &sdk, &size, nullptr, 0) == 0;
    Line("start version=%s build=%s firmware=%s0x%08x pid=%d uid=%d/%d gid=%d/%d trace_fd=%d",
         version, build, known ? "" : "unknown ", sdk, static_cast<int>(getpid()),
         static_cast<int>(getuid()), static_cast<int>(geteuid()),
         static_cast<int>(getgid()), static_cast<int>(getegid()), detail::File());
}

// The startup bootstrap can write a trace before preferences are readable.
// Once crash handling is installed, quiet sessions do not retain those files.
// Fatal events still use the independent Crash::WriteReport path.
inline void Quiet(const std::string& logs_dir) {
    detail::QuietMode() = true;
    if (detail::File() >= 0) {
        close(detail::File());
        detail::File() = -1;
    }
    detail::Memory().clear();
    (void)std::remove("/download0/boot-trace.txt");
    (void)std::remove("/download0/boot-trace.prev.txt");
    for (const char* name : {"/boot-trace.txt", "/boot-trace.prev.txt",
                              "/boot-trace.sandbox-prev.txt"})
        (void)std::remove((logs_dir + name).c_str());
}

inline void Ready(const std::string& logs_dir, bool full_filesystem) {
    if (!full_filesystem) {
        Line("filesystem unavailable; trace remains in /download0");
        return;
    }

    const std::string path = logs_dir + "/boot-trace.txt";
    (void)std::rename(path.c_str(), (logs_dir + "/boot-trace.prev.txt").c_str());

    // Preserve the previous sandbox-only crash trace after access becomes available.
    if (int previous = open("/mnt/sandbox/PPSA99008_000/download0/boot-trace.prev.txt", O_RDONLY);
        previous >= 0) {
        const std::string copy_path = logs_dir + "/boot-trace.sandbox-prev.txt";
        const int copy = open(copy_path.c_str(), O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_TRUNC, 0666);
        char buffer[4096];
        for (ssize_t got; (got = read(previous, buffer, sizeof(buffer))) > 0;)
            detail::WriteAll(copy, buffer, static_cast<size_t>(got));
        if (copy >= 0) close(copy);
        close(previous);
    }

    const int out = open(path.c_str(), O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_TRUNC, 0666);
    if (out < 0) {
        Line("cannot open %s: %s", path.c_str(), std::strerror(errno));
        return;
    }
    detail::WriteAll(out, detail::Memory().data(), detail::Memory().size());
    if (detail::File() >= 0) close(detail::File());
    detail::File() = out;
    (void)fsync(out);
    Line("trace moved to %s", path.c_str());
}
} // namespace Eden::BootTrace
```

`headless/buffer_pages.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#pragma once
// Monotonic witness: a buffer has ever occupied a guest-physical page.
// Every representable registration is published; a large but valid buffer
// must not permanently turn off the never-owned fast path for the whole game.
#include <array>
#include <atomic>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
namespace Eden::BufferPages {
inline constexpr unsigned kPageBits=12;
inline constexpr std::uint64_t kSpace=std::uint64_t{1}<<34;
inline constexpr std::size_t kWords=static_cast<std::size_t>(kSpace>>kPageBits)/64;
inline std::array<std::atomic<std::uint64_t>,kWords> registered{};
inline std::atomic<bool> coverage_unknown{false};
constexpr std::uint64_t Bits(unsigned first,unsigned last) noexcept {
  return (~std::uint64_t{0}>>(63-last)) & (~std::uint64_t{0}<<first);
}
inline void Mark(std::uint64_t address,std::uint64_t size) noexcept {
  if(!size)return;
  // The bitmap already covers the entire 16 GiB guest-physical domain.
  // Old code treated any >128 MiB allocation as unknown forever, forcing
  // later unrelated CPU writes through both cache-lock fallbacks. A large
  // valid buffer costs a bounded bitmap walk but keeps untouched pages fast.
  if(address>=kSpace || size>kSpace-address){
    coverage_unknown.store(true,std::memory_order_release);
    return;
  }
  // A one-page registration is common for guest uniform/state buffers.
  // Avoid the generic word-range loop and two endpoint masks.
  constexpr std::uint64_t page_mask=(std::uint64_t{1}<<kPageBits)-1;
  if(size <= (std::uint64_t{1}<<kPageBits)-(address&page_mask)){
    const auto page=address>>kPageBits;
    const auto bit=std::uint64_t{1}<<(page%64);
    const auto word=page/64;
    if(!(registered[word].load(std::memory_order_acquire)&bit))
      registered[word].fetch_or(bit,std::memory_order_release);
    return;
  }
  const auto first=address>>kPageBits,last=(address+size-1)>>kPageBits;
  const auto first_word=first/64,last_word=last/64;
  // Small buffers often cross a 4 KiB page but remain inside one 256 KiB
  // bitmap word. Publish their complete mask with one atomic probe/RMW.
  if(first_word==last_word){
    const auto mask=Bits(first%64,last%64);
    if((registered[first_word].load(std::memory_order_acquire)&mask)!=mask)
      registered[first_word].fetch_or(mask,std::memory_order_release);
    return;
  }
  for(auto word=first_word;word<=last_word;++word){
    const auto mask=Bits(word==first_word?first%64:0,
                         word==last_word?last%64:63);
    // Most image/buffer reuses touch pages that were already published.
    // A read-only witness avoids another contended atomic RMW in that case.
    // A partial/previously unseen word still uses fetch_or so concurrent
    // registrations of disjoint pages cannot lose either registration.
    if ((registered[word].load(std::memory_order_acquire) & mask) != mask)
      registered[word].fetch_or(mask,std::memory_order_release);
  }
}
inline bool NeverRegistered(std::uint64_t address,std::uint64_t size) noexcept {
  // Read global unknown coverage only on a path that would actually
  // elide the cache lock. Owned/invalid ranges already fail closed.
  // Its final acquire load still pairs with Mark's release publication.
  if(!size || size>256*1024 || address>=kSpace || size>kSpace-address)return false;
  // A CPU write contained in one 4 KiB page needs only one bit test,
  // then the final unknown-coverage guard. Cross-page queries retain the
  // existing bounded two-word scan and acquire/release correctness.
  constexpr std::uint64_t page_mask=(std::uint64_t{1}<<kPageBits)-1;
  if(size <= (std::uint64_t{1}<<kPageBits)-(address&page_mask)){
    const auto page=address>>kPageBits;
    if(registered[page/64].load(std::memory_order_acquire)&
       (std::uint64_t{1}<<(page%64)))return false;
    return !coverage_unknown.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
  }
  const auto first=address>>kPageBits,last=(address+size-1)>>kPageBits;
  // Up to 256 KiB touches at most 65 4 KiB pages and two bitmap
  // words, including unaligned ends: the same two atomic loads as before.
  const auto first_word=first/64,last_word=last/64;
  const auto first_mask=Bits(first%64,first_word==last_word?last%64:63);
  if(registered[first_word].load(std::memory_order_acquire)&first_mask)return false;
  if(first_word!=last_word &&
     (registered[last_word].load(std::memory_order_acquire)&Bits(0,last%64)))return false;
  return !coverage_unknown.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
}
} // namespace Eden::BufferPages

```

`headless/buffer_write_ahead.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#pragma once
// Conservative write-ahead for already registered guest buffer pages.
// Caller MUST hold the buffer-cache mutex. Never marks texture/shader pages.
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>
#include <utility>

namespace Eden::BufferWriteAhead {
inline constexpr std::uint64_t PageBytes = 4096;
inline constexpr unsigned MaxPages = 64;

template <class CoversBuffer, class MarkCpuModified>
unsigned MarkFollowingPages(std::uint64_t address, std::uint64_t size, unsigned requested,
                            CoversBuffer&& covers_buffer, MarkCpuModified&& mark_cpu_modified) {
    if (!size || !requested || size - 1 > UINT64_MAX - address) return 0;
    const std::uint64_t last = address + size - 1;
    // No page after the write fits the address space.
    if (last >= UINT64_MAX - PageBytes) return 0;
    std::uint64_t next = (last & ~(PageBytes - 1)) + PageBytes;
    unsigned marked = 0;
    for (const unsigned limit = std::min(requested, MaxPages); marked < limit; ) {
        // Do not declare an unregistered page CPU-dirty: this cannot invent ownership.
        if (!covers_buffer(next, PageBytes) || mark_cpu_modified(next, PageBytes)) break;
        ++marked;
        if (next > UINT64_MAX - PageBytes) break;
        next += PageBytes;
    }
    return marked;
}
} // namespace Eden::BufferWriteAhead
```
