```h
inline constexpr int ClampTier(int tier) { return tier < 0 ? 0 : tier >= kAuthoredProfileCount ? kAuthoredProfileCount - 1 : tier; }
inline constexpr const VideoProfile& GeneralProfile(int tier) { return kGeneralProfiles[static_cast<std::size_t>(ClampTier(tier))]; }
inline constexpr const VideoProfile& ProfileForTitle(std::uint64_t title_id, int tier) {
    for (const auto& entry : kTitleProfiles) if (entry.title_id == title_id) return entry.profiles[static_cast<std::size_t>(ClampTier(tier))];
    return GeneralProfile(tier);
}
inline constexpr bool HasSpecificProfile(std::uint64_t title_id) {
    for (const auto& entry : kTitleProfiles) if (entry.title_id == title_id) return true;
    return false;
}
} // namespace Eden::EncoreOverrides

```

`headless/encore_overrides_runtime.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Optional runtime layer over the generated encore-overrides snapshot.
#pragma once

#include "encore_overrides_generated.h"
#include "storage_paths.h"

#include <array>
#include <cctype>
#include <cstdint>
#include <fstream>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

#include <nlohmann/json.hpp>

namespace Eden::EncoreOverridesRuntime {

using VideoProfile = EncoreOverrides::VideoProfile;

struct TitleProfiles {
    std::uint64_t title_id = 0;
    std::array<VideoProfile, EncoreOverrides::kAuthoredProfileCount> profiles{};
};

struct State {
    bool valid = false;
    int database_revision = 0;
    std::array<VideoProfile, EncoreOverrides::kAuthoredProfileCount> general{};
    std::vector<TitleProfiles> titles;
};

inline std::string ManifestPath() {
    return ConfigFile("encore-overrides-runtime.json");
}

inline std::optional<std::uint64_t> ParseTitleId(std::string_view value) {
    if (value.size() != 16) return std::nullopt;
    std::uint64_t result = 0;
    for (unsigned char c : value) {
        unsigned digit = 0;
        if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') digit = c - '0';
        else if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'F') digit = c - 'A' + 10;
        else if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'f') digit = c - 'a' + 10;
        else return std::nullopt;
        result = (result << 4) | digit;
    }
    return result == 0 ? std::nullopt : std::optional<std::uint64_t>{result};
}

inline std::optional<VideoProfile> ParseProfile(const nlohmann::json& settings) {
    if (!settings.is_object()) return std::nullopt;
    const auto string_value = [&](const char* key) -> std::optional<std::string> {
        const auto it = settings.find(key);
        return it != settings.end() && it->is_string() ?
            std::optional<std::string>{it->get<std::string>()} : std::nullopt;
    };
    const auto int_value = [&](const char* key) -> std::optional<int> {
        const auto it = settings.find(key);
        return it != settings.end() && it->is_number_integer() ?
            std::optional<int>{it->get<int>()} : std::nullopt;
    };
    const auto renderer = string_value("renderer");
    const auto output = string_value("tv_output");
    const auto filter = string_value("upscaling_filter");
    const auto aa = string_value("anti_aliasing");
    const auto mode = string_value("console_mode");
    const auto fsr = int_value("fsr_sharpness");
    const auto refresh = int_value("refresh_rate_hz");
    const auto resolution_it = settings.find("game_resolution");
    if (!renderer || !output || !filter || !aa || !mode || !fsr || !refresh ||
        resolution_it == settings.end() || !resolution_it->is_number())
        return std::nullopt;

    VideoProfile p{};
    if (*renderer == "opengl") p.renderer = 0;
    else if (*renderer == "vulkan") p.renderer = 1;
    else return std::nullopt;

    if (*output == "1080p") p.output = 0;
    else if (*output == "1440p") p.output = 1;
    else if (*output == "2160p") p.output = 2;
    else return std::nullopt;

    const double resolution = resolution_it->get<double>();
    static constexpr std::array<double, 9> scales{0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0, 1.25, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0};
    p.resolution = -1;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < scales.size(); ++i)
        if (resolution > scales[i] - 0.001 && resolution < scales[i] + 0.001) {
            p.resolution = static_cast<int>(i);
            break;
        }
    if (p.resolution < 0) return std::nullopt;

    if (*filter == "bilinear") p.filter = 0;
    else if (*filter == "fsr") p.filter = 1;
    else if (*filter == "bicubic") p.filter = 2;
    else if (*filter == "nearest") p.filter = 3;
    else if (*filter == "lanczos") p.filter = 4;
    else if (*filter == "sgsr") p.filter = 5;
    else if (*filter == "sgsr_edge") p.filter = 6;
    else if (*filter == "anime4k_3d") p.filter = 7;
    else if (*filter == "anime4k_soft") p.filter = 8;
    else if (*filter == "anime4k_denoise") p.filter = 9;
    else return std::nullopt;

    if (*fsr < 0 || *fsr > 100) return std::nullopt;
    p.fsr_sharpness = *fsr;
    if (*aa == "none") p.anti_aliasing = 0;
    else if (*aa == "fxaa") p.anti_aliasing = 1;
    else if (*aa == "smaa") p.anti_aliasing = 2;
    else if (*aa == "fxaa_quality") p.anti_aliasing = 3;
    else if (*aa == "msaa_2x") p.anti_aliasing = 4;
    else if (*aa == "msaa_4x") p.anti_aliasing = 5;
    else if (*aa == "msaa_8x") p.anti_aliasing = 6;
    else if (*aa == "msaa_16x") p.anti_aliasing = 7;
    else return std::nullopt;
    // A remote profile cannot claim SGSR/FXAA+ on OpenGL: that backend
    // would silently execute Bilinear/standard FXAA instead.
    if (p.renderer == 0 &&
        ((p.filter >= 5 && p.filter <= 9) ||
         p.anti_aliasing >= 3))
        return std::nullopt;
    if (*refresh == 60) p.refresh = 0;
    else if (*refresh == 120) p.refresh = 1;
    else return std::nullopt;
    if (*mode == "docked") p.docked = true;
    else if (*mode == "handheld") p.docked = false;
    else return std::nullopt;
    return p;
}

inline bool ParseManifest(const nlohmann::json& root, State* out) {
    if (out == nullptr || !root.is_object() || root.value("schema_version", 0) != 1)
        return false;
    const int revision = root.value("database_revision", -1);
    // Never let an older remote database override the snapshot shipped with this binary.
    if (revision < EncoreOverrides::kDatabaseRevision) return false;
    const auto general_it = root.find("general_profiles");
    const auto titles_it = root.find("specific_titles");
    if (general_it == root.end() || !general_it->is_object() || titles_it == root.end() ||
        !titles_it->is_array() || titles_it->size() > 512)
        return false;

    State parsed;
    parsed.database_revision = revision;
    static constexpr const char* names[] = {"minimum", "recommended", "high", "ultra"};
    for (int tier = 0; tier < EncoreOverrides::kAuthoredProfileCount; ++tier) {
        const auto profile_it = general_it->find(names[tier]);
        if (profile_it == general_it->end() || !profile_it->is_object()) return false;
        const auto settings_it = profile_it->find("settings");
        if (settings_it == profile_it->end()) return false;
        const auto profile = ParseProfile(*settings_it);
        if (!profile) return false;
        parsed.general[static_cast<std::size_t>(tier)] = *profile;
    }
    for (const auto& item : *titles_it) {
        if (!item.is_object()) return false;
        const auto id_it = item.find("title_id");
        const auto profiles_it = item.find("profiles");
        if (id_it == item.end() || !id_it->is_string() || profiles_it == item.end() ||
            !profiles_it->is_object())
            return false;
        const auto title_id = ParseTitleId(id_it->get<std::string>());
        if (!title_id) return false;
        TitleProfiles entry;
        entry.title_id = *title_id;
        for (int tier = 0; tier < EncoreOverrides::kAuthoredProfileCount; ++tier) {
            const auto it = profiles_it->find(names[tier]);
            if (it == profiles_it->end()) return false;
            const auto profile = ParseProfile(*it);
            if (!profile) return false;
            entry.profiles[static_cast<std::size_t>(tier)] = *profile;
        }
        parsed.titles.push_back(entry);
    }
    parsed.valid = true;
    *out = std::move(parsed);
    return true;
}

inline bool ParseManifestText(std::string_view body, State* out) {
    if (body.empty() || body.size() > (128u << 10)) return false;
    try {
        return ParseManifest(nlohmann::json::parse(body.begin(), body.end()), out);
    } catch (...) {
        return false;
    }
}

inline State LoadCachedState() {
    std::ifstream file(ManifestPath(), std::ios::binary);
    if (!file) return {};
    std::string body((std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(file)), std::istreambuf_iterator<char>());
    State state;
    return ParseManifestText(body, &state) ? state : State{};
}

inline const State& CachedState() {
    static const State state = LoadCachedState();
    return state;
}

inline VideoProfile ProfileForTitle(std::uint64_t title_id, int tier) {
    tier = EncoreOverrides::ClampTier(tier);
    const State& state = CachedState();
    if (state.valid) {
        for (const auto& entry : state.titles)
            if (entry.title_id == title_id)
                return entry.profiles[static_cast<std::size_t>(tier)];
        return state.general[static_cast<std::size_t>(tier)];
    }
    return EncoreOverrides::ProfileForTitle(title_id, tier);
}

inline bool HasRemoteProfile(std::uint64_t title_id) {
    const State& state = CachedState();
    if (!state.valid) return false;
    for (const auto& entry : state.titles)
        if (entry.title_id == title_id) return true;
    return false;
}

} // namespace Eden::EncoreOverridesRuntime
```

`headless/encore_performance_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#pragma once

#include "settings_store.h"

#include <algorithm>

namespace Eden::EncorePerformance {

// The seven performance controls exposed by current ProsperoEden master. Encore keeps them behind
// its user-facing Minimum / Recommended / High / Ultra profiles so a normal player does not have
// to understand emulator internals.
struct Policy {
    bool compile_ahead;
    bool async_shaders;
    bool fast_gpu;
    bool unsafe_cpu;
    bool unsafe_dma;
    bool reactive_flushing;
    bool skip_invalidation;
};

// Generic PS5 policy. It must work for titles that have no database entry; title-specific data may
// refine video settings but is never required for these controls.
//
// Compile-ahead is deliberately false in shipping Encore today. The shipping build uses ordinary
// per-core Dynarmic and does not compile the experimental shared-JIT path that the saved-block
// precompiler needs. Re-enabling it requires a generic pressure-aware implementation, not a
// hand-maintained game whitelist.
//
// The three unsafe/correctness switches stay conservative in all normal tiers. Minimum gains speed
// through lower render cost + asynchronous shaders + low GPU accuracy, rather than silently risking
// CPU/DMA correctness or stale GPU memory. All Vulkan tiers now enable asynchronous shader
// compilation: a first-use effect may appear a moment late instead of blocking a frame, even
// in High/Ultra. The image-quality tier still controls resolution, AA and accuracy; shader
// compilation completion (not shader omission) remains the target.
inline constexpr Policy kPolicies[EncoreOverrides::kAuthoredProfileCount] = {
    // compile  async  fastGPU unsafeCPU unsafeDMA reactive skipInv
    {false,    true,  true,   false,    false,    true,    false}, // Minimum
    {false,    true,  false,  false,    false,    true,    false}, // Recommended
    {false,    true,  false,  false,    false,    true,    false}, // High
    {false,    true,  false,  false,    false,    true,    false}, // Ultra
};

inline constexpr Policy ForTier(int tier) {
    return kPolicies[static_cast<std::size_t>(
        std::clamp(tier, 0, EncoreOverrides::kAuthoredProfileCount - 1))];
}

} // namespace Eden::EncorePerformance
```

`headless/error_applet.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// A game's error dialog without a UI. Eden's built-in one writes the error to the log and never
// answers, so a game that shows an error waits on it for good (seen on the console: a game that
// could not go online stopped at its "Saving..." screen). This one writes the error to the log
// and answers at once, as if the player had closed the dialog, and the game carries on.
#pragma once
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdio>
#include <string>
#include "core/frontend/applets/error.h"
#include "diagnostics.h"

namespace Eden {
class LoggedErrorApplet final : public Core::Frontend::ErrorApplet {
public:
    void Close() const override {}

    void ShowError(Result error, FinishedCallback finished) const override {
        Note(error, {});
        finished();
    }

    void ShowErrorWithTimestamp(Result error, std::chrono::seconds, FinishedCallback finished) const override {
        Note(error, {});
        finished();
    }

    void ShowCustomErrorText(Result error, std::string main_text, std::string detail_text,
                             FinishedCallback finished) const override {
        Note(error, main_text.empty() ? detail_text : main_text);
        finished();
    }

private:
    // The code as the console shows it: 2 and the module, then the description.
    static void Note(Result error, const std::string& text) {
        char line[256];
        std::snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "The game showed error 2%03u-%04u%s%.160s; it was closed for the player",
                      static_cast<unsigned>(error.GetModule()), static_cast<unsigned>(error.GetDescription()),
                      text.empty() ? "" : ": ", text.c_str());
        Report("game error", line);
    }
};
}
```

`headless/extracted_npdm_identity.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Read-only, bounded NPDM identity fallback for extracted NS1/NS2 programs.
// This does NOT validate permissions or make a program bootable.
#pragma once
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <string>

namespace Eden::ExtractedNpdm {
inline std::uint32_t Read32(const unsigned char* p) noexcept {
    return std::uint32_t(p[0]) | (std::uint32_t(p[1]) << 8) |
           (std::uint32_t(p[2]) << 16) | (std::uint32_t(p[3]) << 24);
}
inline std::uint64_t Read64(const unsigned char* p) noexcept {
    return std::uint64_t(Read32(p)) | (std::uint64_t(Read32(p + 4)) << 32);
}
// Read-only diagnostic of ACID/FS access-control layout, intended only for
// reporting failed loads. Never grants/relaxes filesystem permissions.
struct AccessProbe {
    bool header_ok = false;
    bool acid_found = false;
    bool extended = false;
    bool fac_valid = false;
    std::uint32_t acid_size = 0;
    std::uint32_t fac_offset = 0;
    std::uint32_t fac_size = 0;
};
inline AccessProbe ProbeAccess(const std::filesystem::path& npdm) {
    AccessProbe result{};
    std::error_code ec;
    const auto status = std::filesystem::symlink_status(npdm, ec);
    if (ec || !std::filesystem::is_regular_file(status) ||
        std::filesystem::is_symlink(status)) return result;
    const auto size = std::filesystem::file_size(npdm, ec);
    if (ec || size < 0x80 || size > (1u << 20)) return result;
    std::ifstream input(npdm, std::ios::binary);
    std::array<unsigned char, 0x80> header{};
    if (!input.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(header.data()), header.size()) ||
        std::string(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(header.data()), 4) != "META")
        return result;
    result.header_ok = true;
    const auto offset = Read32(header.data() + 0x78);
    const auto length = Read32(header.data() + 0x7c);
    result.acid_size = length;
    if (offset < 0x80 || offset > size || length > size - offset) return result;
    // ACID signed-body headers start after the NS1 (0x200) or NS2
    // (0x300) signature/key prefix. Check both; do not infer from a title ID.
    for (const unsigned prefix : {0x200u, 0x300u}) {
        if (prefix > length || 0x40u > length - prefix) continue;
        std::array<unsigned char, 0x40> acid{};
        input.clear();
        input.seekg(static_cast<std::streamoff>(offset + prefix));
        if (!input.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(acid.data()), acid.size()) ||
            std::string(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(acid.data()), 4) != "ACID")
            continue;
        result.acid_found = true;
        result.extended = (prefix == 0x300);
        result.fac_offset = Read32(acid.data() + 0x20);
        result.fac_size = Read32(acid.data() + 0x24);
        result.fac_valid = result.fac_size >= 0x2c &&
                           result.fac_offset <= length &&
                           result.fac_size <= length - result.fac_offset;
        return result;
    }
    return result;
}

inline std::uint64_t TitleId(const std::filesystem::path& npdm) {
    std::error_code error;
    const auto status = std::filesystem::symlink_status(npdm, error);
    if (error || !std::filesystem::is_regular_file(status) ||
        std::filesystem::is_symlink(status)) return 0;
    const auto size = std::filesystem::file_size(npdm, error);
    if (error || size < 0x98 || size > (1u << 20)) return 0;
    std::ifstream input(npdm, std::ios::binary);
    std::array<unsigned char, 0x80> header{};
    if (!input.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(header.data()), header.size()) ||
        std::string(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(header.data()), 4) != "META") return 0;
    const auto offset = Read32(header.data() + 0x70);
    const auto length = Read32(header.data() + 0x74);
    if (offset < 0x80 || length < 0x18 || offset > size || length > size - offset)
        return 0;
    std::array<unsigned char, 0x18> aci{};
    input.seekg(offset, std::ios::beg);
    if (!input.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(aci.data()), aci.size()) ||
        std::string(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(aci.data()), 4) != "ACI0") return 0;
    return Read64(aci.data() + 0x10);
}
} // namespace Eden::ExtractedNpdm
```

`headless/fastmem_handler.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Dynarmic x64 fastmem fault handler for the PS5 port and its Linux host checks, after
// dynarmic's exception_handler_posix.cpp (0BSD). A fault at a fastmem access in JIT code
// becomes a call to that access's fallback, which returns after the faulting instruction;
// dynarmic then recompiles the access onto the page-table path. Guest code runs on
// fiber stacks with ample room, so no alternate signal stack is used.
#include <signal.h>
#include <array>
#include <atomic>
#include <bit>
#include <csignal>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <functional>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>

#include "dynarmic/backend/exception_handler.h"
#include "dynarmic/backend/x64/block_of_code.h"
#include "../src/fastmem.h"

namespace Dynarmic::Backend {
namespace {
struct CodeRange {
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> begin{0}, end{0};
    std::atomic<const std::function<FakeCall(u64)>*> callback{nullptr};
};
// One entry per JIT code cache with fastmem (a few per emulated core). Lock-free so the
// handler never waits on a thread that registers or retires a JIT.
std::array<CodeRange, 64> ranges;
// Only the highest ever published slot bounds the signal-time scan.
// Do not shrink on retirement: concurrent handlers may still see the old
// bound, while reuse of a low slot requires no changes to that bound.
std::atomic<std::size_t> published_range_prefix{0};
std::atomic<std::uint64_t> fault_count{0};
struct sigaction previous_segv{}, previous_bus{};
std::once_flag install_once;
bool installed = false;

// The all-ones begin value is reserved while a slot is being published.
// Registration happens outside the signal handler; reject invalid or
// wrapping JIT ranges before exposing them to asynchronous fault handling.
constexpr bool ValidCodeRange(std::uint64_t begin, std::uint64_t size) noexcept {
    return begin != 0 && begin != ~std::uint64_t{0} &&
           size != 0 && size <= ~std::uint64_t{0} - begin;
}

void Forward(int signal, siginfo_t* info, void* context) {
    const struct sigaction& previous = signal == SIGSEGV ? previous_segv : previous_bus;
    if (previous.sa_flags & SA_SIGINFO) {
        previous.sa_sigaction(signal, info, context);
    } else if (previous.sa_handler == SIG_DFL) {
        std::signal(signal, SIG_DFL); // The faulting instruction repeats and terminates.
    } else if (previous.sa_handler != SIG_IGN) {
        previous.sa_handler(signal);
    }
}

void Handle(int signal, siginfo_t* info, void* context) {
    const std::uint64_t pc = Eden::Fastmem::ContextRip(context);
    const std::size_t prefix = published_range_prefix.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < prefix; ++i) {
        auto& range = ranges[i];
        const auto begin = range.begin.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        if (!begin || pc < begin || pc >= range.end.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) continue;
        const auto* callback = range.callback.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        if (!callback) break;
        fault_count.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        const FakeCall call = (*callback)(pc);
        auto& sp = Eden::Fastmem::ContextRsp(context);
        sp -= sizeof(std::uint64_t);
        *reinterpret_cast<std::uint64_t*>(sp) = call.ret_rip;
        Eden::Fastmem::ContextRip(context) = call.call_rip;
        return;
    }
    Forward(signal, info, context);
}

bool Install() {
    std::call_once(install_once, [] {
        struct sigaction action{};
        action.sa_sigaction = Handle;
        action.sa_flags = SA_SIGINFO | SA_RESTART;
        sigemptyset(&action.sa_mask);
        // Both signals must be ours, or neither may be ours. The original
        // short-circuit installation left SIGSEGV intercepted if SIGBUS failed.
        if (sigaction(SIGSEGV, &action, &previous_segv) == 0) {
            if (sigaction(SIGBUS, &action, &previous_bus) == 0) {
                installed = true;
            } else if (sigaction(SIGSEGV, &previous_segv, nullptr) != 0) {
                // Do not continue with a partially installed trap handler.
                std::abort();
            }
        }
        std::printf("EDEN_FASTMEM_HANDLER installed=%d\n", installed ? 1 : 0);
    });
    return installed;
}
} // namespace

struct ExceptionHandler::Impl final {
    std::uint64_t begin{}, size{};
    std::function<FakeCall(u64)> callback;
    CodeRange* range{};
    ~Impl() {
        if (!range) return;
        range->callback.store(nullptr, std::memory_order_release);
        range->begin.store(0, std::memory_order_release);
    }
};

ExceptionHandler::ExceptionHandler() = default;
ExceptionHandler::~ExceptionHandler() = default;

void ExceptionHandler::Register(X64::BlockOfCode& code) {
    impl = std::make_unique<Impl>();
    impl->begin = std::bit_cast<u64>(code.getCode());
    impl->size = code.GetTotalCodeSize();
}

bool ExceptionHandler::SupportsFastmem() const noexcept {
    return impl && impl->range;
}

void ExceptionHandler::SetFastmemCallback(std::function<FakeCall(u64)> cb) {
    if (!impl || impl->range || !ValidCodeRange(impl->begin, impl->size) || !Install()) return;
    impl->callback = std::move(cb);
    for (auto& range : ranges) {
        std::uint64_t expected = 0;
        // Claim a free entry; publish the callback before the range becomes visible.
        if (!range.callback.load(std::memory_order_acquire) &&
            range.begin.compare_exchange_strong(expected, ~std::uint64_t{0}, std::memory_order_acq_rel)) {
            range.end.store(impl->begin + impl->size, std::memory_order_relaxed);
            range.callback.store(&impl->callback, std::memory_order_release);
            range.begin.store(impl->begin, std::memory_order_release);
            // Publish after callback/end/begin, before registration returns.
            // Registration is cold; Handle must never scan 64 empty slots.
            const std::size_t required_prefix =
                static_cast<std::size_t>(&range - ranges.data()) + 1;
            std::size_t previous_prefix =
                published_range_prefix.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
            while (previous_prefix < required_prefix &&
                   !published_range_prefix.compare_exchange_weak(
                       previous_prefix, required_prefix,
                       std::memory_order_release, std::memory_order_relaxed)) {}
            impl->range = &range;
            return;
        }
    }
    std::printf("EDEN_FASTMEM_HANDLER ranges=full\n");
}

} // namespace Dynarmic::Backend

namespace Eden::Fastmem {
std::uint64_t Faults() noexcept {
    return Dynarmic::Backend::fault_count.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
}
} // namespace Eden::Fastmem
```

`headless/filesystem_probe.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#pragma once

#include <cerrno>
#include <cstddef>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <string>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <unistd.h>

namespace Eden {

// Prove the capability Encore actually needs instead of inferring it from uid/gid values.
// The probe also creates the persistent root on a clean install. It never follows a root symlink.
inline bool ProbeWritableRoot(const std::string& root) noexcept {
    struct stat info {};
    if (lstat(root.c_str(), &info) != 0) {
        if (errno != ENOENT)
            return false;
        if (mkdir(root.c_str(), 0777) != 0 && errno != EEXIST)
            return false;
        if (lstat(root.c_str(), &info) != 0)
            return false;
    }
    if (!S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) || S_ISLNK(info.st_mode))
        return false;

    const std::string probe = root + "/.encore-access-probe-" + std::to_string(static_cast<long long>(getpid()));
    const int fd = open(probe.c_str(), O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_EXCL, 0600);
    if (fd < 0)
        return false;

    static constexpr char token[] = "ENCORE_FS_OK\n";
    std::size_t done = 0;
    while (done < sizeof(token) - 1) {
        const ssize_t wrote = write(fd, token + done, sizeof(token) - 1 - done);
        if (wrote < 0 && errno == EINTR)
            continue;
        if (wrote <= 0)
            break;
        done += static_cast<std::size_t>(wrote);
    }
    const bool wrote_all = done == sizeof(token) - 1;
    const bool synced = !wrote_all || fsync(fd) == 0;
    const bool closed = close(fd) == 0;
    const bool removed = unlink(probe.c_str()) == 0;
    return wrote_all && synced && closed && removed;
}

} // namespace Eden

```

`headless/firmware_zip_import.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Automatic, bounded ZIP import of user-supplied firmware. Never downloads,
// decrypts, executes or overwrites system modules; import is data staging only.
#pragma once
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>
#include <zlib.h>

namespace Eden::FirmwareZip {
namespace fs = std::filesystem;
inline std::uint16_t U16(const unsigned char* p) {
    return std::uint16_t(p[0]) | std::uint16_t(p[1]) << 8;
}
inline std::uint32_t U32(const unsigned char* p) {
    return std::uint32_t(U16(p)) | std::uint32_t(U16(p + 2)) << 16;
}
inline bool Read(std::ifstream& stream, std::uint64_t at, void* ptr, std::size_t n) {
    stream.clear();
    stream.seekg(static_cast<std::streamoff>(at));
    return static_cast<bool>(stream.read(static_cast<char*>(ptr), n));
}
inline bool SafeName(std::string_view name) {
    if (name.empty() || name.size() > 240 || name[0] == '/' ||
        name.find('\\') != name.npos || name.find('\0') != name.npos ||
        name.find(':') != name.npos) return false;
    if (name.back() == '/') name.remove_suffix(1);
    if (name.empty()) return false;
    const fs::path path{name};
    for (const auto& part : path)
        if (part == "." || part == ".." || part.empty()) return false;
    return !path.is_absolute();
}
struct Entry {
    std::string name;
    std::uint16_t method = 0;
    std::uint32_t compressed = 0;
    std::uint32_t expanded = 0;
    std::uint32_t crc = 0;
    std::uint32_t local_offset = 0;
};
// Central-directory validated ZIP32 only; reject multivolume, encryption,
// symlinks, Zip64 and oversized files instead of silently truncating data.
inline bool Index(std::ifstream& stream, std::vector<Entry>* out) {
    constexpr std::uint64_t max_zip = 1024ULL * 1024 * 1024;
    constexpr std::uint64_t max_expanded = 3ULL * 1024 * 1024 * 1024;
    if (!out) return false;
    stream.seekg(0, std::ios::end);
    const auto end = stream.tellg();
    if (end < 22 || static_cast<std::uint64_t>(end) > max_zip) return false;
    const std::uint64_t size = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(end);
    const std::uint64_t start = size > 65557 ? size - 65557 : 0;
    std::vector<unsigned char> tail(size - start);
    if (!Read(stream, start, tail.data(), tail.size())) return false;
    std::size_t pos = tail.size() - 22;
    // The optional ZIP comment may itself contain the EOCD signature.
    // A signature inside that comment is not the actual end record unless
    // its declared comment length ends at the physical end of the archive.
    // Keep searching backwards instead of rejecting a valid firmware ZIP.
    while (!(tail[pos] == 0x50 && tail[pos+1] == 0x4b &&
             tail[pos+2] == 0x05 && tail[pos+3] == 0x06 &&
             pos + 22u + U16(tail.data() + pos + 20) == tail.size())) {
        if (pos == 0) return false;
        --pos;
    }
    const auto* e = tail.data() + pos;
    if (U16(e+4) || U16(e+6) || U16(e+8) != U16(e+10) ||
        U16(e+10) == 0 || U16(e+10) > 8192 ||
        U32(e+12) == 0xffffffffu || U32(e+16) == 0xffffffffu ||
        pos + 22u + U16(e+20) != tail.size()) return false;
    const std::uint64_t cd = U32(e+16), cd_end = cd + U32(e+12);
    if (cd_end > start + pos) return false;
    std::uint64_t cursor = cd, total = 0;
    for (unsigned index = 0; index < U16(e+10); ++index) {
        std::array<unsigned char,46> header{};
        if (cursor > cd_end || cd_end - cursor < header.size() ||
            !Read(stream, cursor, header.data(), header.size()) ||
            U32(header.data()) != 0x02014b50u) return false;
        const auto* h = header.data();
        const std::uint16_t name_size=U16(h+28), extra=U16(h+30), comment=U16(h+32);
        const std::uint16_t flags=U16(h+8), method=U16(h+10);
        const std::uint32_t compressed=U32(h+20), expanded=U32(h+24);
        const std::uint64_t next=cursor+46ull+name_size+extra+comment;
        const unsigned mode=(U32(h+38)>>16)&0170000;
        if (next > cd_end || !name_size || name_size > 240 ||
            flags & 1u || (method != 0 && method != 8) ||
            mode == 0120000 || U16(h+34) != 0 ||
            compressed == 0xffffffffu || expanded == 0xffffffffu ||
            U32(h+42) == 0xffffffffu ||
            expanded > max_expanded - total) return false;
        std::string name(name_size, '\0');
        if (!Read(stream, cursor+46, name.data(), name.size()) ||
            !SafeName(name)) return false;
        // Validate the local header and its exact filename before accepting
        // an entry. ZIP metadata is duplicated; trusting only the central
        // directory allows a forged local name or an extent that overlaps
        // the central directory to be extracted as firmware payload.
        const std::uint64_t local_offset = U32(h+42);
        std::array<unsigned char,30> local{};
        if (local_offset > cd || cd - local_offset < local.size() ||
            !Read(stream, local_offset, local.data(), local.size()) ||
            U32(local.data()) != 0x04034b50u ||
            U16(local.data()+6) != flags ||
            U16(local.data()+8) != method ||
            U16(local.data()+26) != name_size) return false;
        const std::uint64_t data_start = local_offset + 30ull +
            name_size + U16(local.data()+28);
        if (data_start > cd || compressed > cd - data_start ||
            (method == 0 && compressed != expanded)) return false;
        std::string local_name(name_size, '\0');
        if (!Read(stream, local_offset + 30ull,
                  local_name.data(), local_name.size()) ||
            local_name != name) return false;
        // With bit 3 clear the local sizes and CRC must match the central
        // record. Bit 3 permits a trailing data descriptor instead.
        if (!(flags & 0x0008u) &&
            (U32(local.data()+14) != U32(h+16) ||
             U32(local.data()+18) != compressed ||
             U32(local.data()+22) != expanded)) return false;
        total += expanded;
        if (name.back() != '/' && name.rfind("__MACOSX/",0) != 0 &&
            name.find("/._") == std::string::npos && name != ".DS_Store" &&
            !name.ends_with("/.DS_Store")) {
            out->push_back({std::move(name), method, compressed, expanded,
                            U32(h+16), U32(h+42)});
        }
        cursor=next;
    }
    return cursor == cd_end && !out->empty();
}
inline bool ExtractEntry(std::ifstream& zip, const Entry& file, const fs::path& output) {
    std::array<unsigned char,30> local{};
    if (!Read(zip,file.local_offset,local.data(),local.size()) ||
        U32(local.data())!=0x04034b50u || U16(local.data()+8)!=file.method ||
        (U16(local.data()+6)&1u)) return false;
    const std::uint64_t content=file.local_offset + 30ull +
        U16(local.data()+26)+U16(local.data()+28);
    // An index validated against one file must not be used against a
    // different local member if the archive changed before extraction.
    if (U16(local.data()+26) != file.name.size()) return false;
    std::string local_name(file.name.size(), '\0');
    if (!Read(zip, file.local_offset + 30ull,
              local_name.data(), local_name.size()) ||
        local_name != file.name) return false;
    std::error_code ec;
    fs::create_directories(output.parent_path(),ec);
    if (ec || fs::exists(output,ec)) return false;
    std::ofstream output_file(output,std::ios::binary);
    if (!output_file) return false;
    std::array<unsigned char,65536> in{}, out{};
    std::uint64_t remaining=file.compressed, position=content, written=0;
    auto crc=crc32(0,Z_NULL,0);
    z_stream inflater{};
    const bool deflate=file.method==8;
    if (deflate && inflateInit2(&inflater,-MAX_WBITS)!=Z_OK) return false;
    bool ok=true, complete=!deflate;
    while (ok && remaining) {
        const auto count=static_cast<std::size_t>(std::min<std::uint64_t>(remaining,in.size()));
        if (!Read(zip,position,in.data(),count)) { ok=false; break; }
        remaining-=count; position+=count;
        if (!deflate) {
            if (written+count > file.expanded) {ok=false;break;}
            output_file.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(in.data()),count);
            crc=crc32(crc,in.data(),static_cast<uInt>(count));written+=count;
            ok=static_cast<bool>(output_file);
        } else {
            inflater.next_in=in.data(); inflater.avail_in=static_cast<uInt>(count);
            do {
                inflater.next_out=out.data(); inflater.avail_out=static_cast<uInt>(out.size());
                const int rc=inflate(&inflater,Z_NO_FLUSH);
                const auto produced=out.size()-inflater.avail_out;
                if ((rc!=Z_OK && rc!=Z_STREAM_END) || written+produced>file.expanded) {
                    ok=false;break;
                }
                output_file.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(out.data()),produced);
                crc=crc32(crc,out.data(),static_cast<uInt>(produced));
                written+=produced;
                if (!output_file) {ok=false;break;}
                if (rc==Z_STREAM_END) {complete=true;break;}
            // A compressed block may consume all input while filling the
            // 64 KiB output buffer exactly. zlib can still hold pending
            // bytes (including the final stream marker); drain once more
            // with no input instead of silently truncating the file.
            } while (!complete && (inflater.avail_in || inflater.avail_out == 0));
            if (complete && (remaining || inflater.avail_in)) ok=false;
        }
    }
    if (deflate) inflateEnd(&inflater);
    output_file.close();
    const bool passed = ok && complete && written==file.expanded && crc==file.crc &&
                        file.compressed >= (deflate ? 0u : file.expanded);
    if (!passed) std::fprintf(stderr,
        "EDEN_FIRMWARE_ZIP_DECODE_FAIL file=%s ok=%d complete=%d written=%llu expected=%u crc=%08lx expected_crc=%08x remaining=%llu\\n",
        file.name.c_str(), int(ok), int(complete), static_cast<unsigned long long>(written),
        file.expanded, static_cast<unsigned long>(crc), file.crc,
        static_cast<unsigned long long>(remaining));
    return passed;
}
inline bool Import(const fs::path& archive, const fs::path& target, std::string* reason=nullptr) {
    auto fail=[&](const char* why) {if (reason) *reason=why;return false;};
    std::error_code ec;
    const auto status=fs::symlink_status(archive,ec);
    if (ec || !fs::is_regular_file(status) || fs::is_symlink(status))
        return fail("archive is missing or is a symlink");
    const auto target_status=fs::symlink_status(target,ec);
    if (!ec && target_status.type()!=fs::file_type::not_found)
        return fail("import already exists; preserving user files");
    ec.clear();
    std::ifstream zip(archive,std::ios::binary);
    if (!zip) return fail("archive cannot be opened");
    std::vector<Entry> files;
    if (!Index(zip,&files)) return fail("ZIP index or entry policy rejected");
    const bool firmware_content=std::any_of(files.begin(),files.end(),[](const Entry& item) {
        return item.name.ends_with(".nca") || item.name.ends_with("/main.npdm") ||
               item.name.ends_with("firmware-dump-named.json");
    });
    if (!firmware_content) return fail("ZIP does not contain recognizable firmware content");
    const fs::path stage=target.string()+".incomplete";
    const auto stage_status=fs::symlink_status(stage,ec);
    if (!ec && stage_status.type()!=fs::file_type::not_found)
        return fail("stale partial import; will not overwrite");
    ec.clear();
    if (!fs::create_directories(stage,ec) || ec) return fail("cannot prepare staging directory");
    bool ok=true;
    for (const auto& file : files) {
        const fs::path relative=file.name;
        const fs::path dest=stage/relative;
        if (!ExtractEntry(zip,file,dest)) {
            std::fprintf(stderr, "EDEN_FIRMWARE_ZIP_ENTRY_FAILED file=%s method=%u expanded=%u\\n",
                         file.name.c_str(), unsigned(file.method), file.expanded);
            ok=false;break;
        }
    }
    if (ok && !fs::exists(target,ec)) {
        fs::rename(stage,target,ec);
        if (ec) std::fprintf(stderr, "EDEN_FIRMWARE_ZIP_RENAME_FAILED code=%d\\n", ec.value());
        ok=!ec;
    } else ok=false;
    if (!ok) {
        std::error_code cleanup;
        fs::remove_all(stage,cleanup);
        return fail("archive extraction or commit failed; original ZIP unchanged");
    }
    if (reason) *reason="firmware ZIP imported without modifying original";
    return true;
}
} // namespace Eden::FirmwareZip
```

`headless/frame_metrics.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#pragma once
// R01: session-scoped, opt-in CPU-observed Vulkan frame accounting.
//
// These counters are NOT proof of physical scan-out, input-to-photon latency,
// game simulation speed, guest HIPC progress, or GPU timestamps. The guest
// VI clock is a requested cadence, not measured game FPS.
//
// Enabled only by existing detailed_logging, which itself disables normal
// low-overhead performance runs. No heap, time, syscalls or output in hot
// paths when disabled. Reset only after previous title renderer joins.
#include <atomic>
#include <cstdint>

namespace Eden::FrameMetrics {
inline std::atomic<bool> enabled{false};
inline std::atomic<std::uint64_t> source_composites{0};
inline std::atomic<std::uint64_t> real_frames_queued{0};
inline std::atomic<std::uint64_t> generated_frames_queued{0};
inline std::atomic<std::uint64_t> skipped_source_frames{0};
inline std::atomic<std::uint64_t> loading_frames_queued{0};
inline std::atomic<std::uint64_t> present_calls_returned{0};
inline std::atomic<std::uint64_t> last_report_ns{0};

struct Window {
    std::uint64_t interval_ns{};
    std::uint64_t source_composites{};
    std::uint64_t real_frames_queued{};
    std::uint64_t generated_frames_queued{};
    std::uint64_t skipped_source_frames{};
    std::uint64_t loading_frames_queued{};
    std::uint64_t present_calls_returned{};
    bool valid{};
};

// Main thread: call once per title only after the prior renderer has stopped.
// Never call while another title is drawing; no frame should be mixed across
// sessions. The detailed profile may be toggled between title sessions.
inline void ResetForTitle(bool opt_in, std::uint64_t mono_ns) noexcept {
    enabled.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
    source_composites.store(0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    real_frames_queued.store(0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    generated_frames_queued.store(0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    skipped_source_frames.store(0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    loading_frames_queued.store(0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    present_calls_returned.store(0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    last_report_ns.store(mono_ns, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    enabled.store(opt_in, std::memory_order_release);
}

inline bool Enabled() noexcept {
    return enabled.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
}
inline void OnSourceComposite() noexcept {
    if (Enabled()) source_composites.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
}
inline void OnRealQueued() noexcept {
    if (Enabled()) real_frames_queued.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
}
inline void OnGeneratedQueued() noexcept {
    if (Enabled()) generated_frames_queued.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
}
inline void OnSourceSkipped() noexcept {
    if (Enabled()) skipped_source_frames.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
}
inline void OnLoadingQueued() noexcept {
    if (Enabled()) loading_frames_queued.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
}
inline void OnSwapchainPresentReturned() noexcept {
    if (Enabled()) present_calls_returned.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
}

// Called on the existing five-second GPU report path only, never per frame.
// The separate presenter may still be consuming its queue: values are
// approximate per-window CPU-observed rates, not frame-perfect matched pairs.
inline Window Sample(std::uint64_t mono_ns) noexcept {
    if (!Enabled()) return {};
    const auto before = last_report_ns.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
    if (!before || mono_ns <= before) return {};
    last_report_ns.store(mono_ns, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    Window out{};
    out.valid = true;
    out.interval_ns = mono_ns - before;
    out.source_composites = source_composites.exchange(0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    out.real_frames_queued = real_frames_queued.exchange(0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    out.generated_frames_queued = generated_frames_queued.exchange(0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    out.skipped_source_frames = skipped_source_frames.exchange(0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    out.loading_frames_queued = loading_frames_queued.exchange(0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    out.present_calls_returned = present_calls_returned.exchange(0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    return out;
}
inline double Rate(std::uint64_t frames, std::uint64_t interval_ns) noexcept {
    return interval_ns ? static_cast<double>(frames) * 1'000'000'000.0 /
                             static_cast<double>(interval_ns) : 0.0;
}
} // namespace Eden::FrameMetrics
```

`headless/fsr3_optical_session.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#include "mihawk_volk.h"
#include "fsr3_optical_session.h"
#include "ps5_framegen.h"
#include "mihawk_vulkan_history_barriers.h"
#include "diagnostics.h"
#include <array>
#include <memory>
#include <string>

namespace Eden::FeatureLab {
namespace {
VkImageSubresourceLayers ColorLayers() noexcept {
    VkImageSubresourceLayers x{};
    x.aspectMask = VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT;
    x.layerCount = 1;
    return x;
}
VkImageMemoryBarrier Transition(VkImage image, VkImageLayout from,
                                 VkImageLayout to, VkAccessFlags src,
                                 VkAccessFlags dst) noexcept {
    return MakeImageBarrier(image, src, dst, from, to);
}
}

// Keep the default constructor next to the complete interpolator type.
// An inline defaulted constructor instantiates unique_ptr's cleanup path
// while ps5::framegen::interpolator is still forward-declared in the header.
Fsr3OpticalSession::Fsr3OpticalSession() = default;
Fsr3OpticalSession::~Fsr3OpticalSession() { Destroy(); }

bool Fsr3OpticalSession::Ready() const noexcept {
    return engine_ && engine_->ready();
}

void Fsr3OpticalSession::Destroy() noexcept {
    // Renderer must have drained the command worker before destruction.
    if (engine_ && device_ && vkDeviceWaitIdle)
        (void)vkDeviceWaitIdle(device_);
    engine_.reset();
    device_ = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    width_ = height_ = 0;
    format_ = VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED;
}

bool Fsr3OpticalSession::Create(PFN_vkGetInstanceProcAddr proc, VkInstance instance,
                                VkPhysicalDevice physical, VkDevice device,
                                std::uint32_t width, std::uint32_t height,
                                VkFormat format) {
    Destroy();
    if (!proc || !instance || !physical || !device ||
        width < 128 || height < 128 || width > 3840 || height > 2160 ||
        (format != VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM &&
         format != VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM))
        return false;
    volkInitializeCustom(proc);
    volkLoadInstance(instance);
    volkLoadDevice(device);
    if (!vkGetPhysicalDeviceFeatures || !vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties2 ||
        !vkGetPhysicalDeviceFormatProperties || !vkCreateComputePipelines ||
        !vkCmdDispatch || !vkCmdPipelineBarrier || !vkCmdCopyImage ||
        !vkCmdBlitImage || !vkDeviceWaitIdle)
        return false;
    VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures features{};
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceFeatures(physical, &features);
    VkPhysicalDeviceSubgroupProperties subgroup{};
    subgroup.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_SUBGROUP_PROPERTIES;
    VkPhysicalDeviceProperties2 properties{};
    properties.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_PROPERTIES_2;
    properties.pNext = &subgroup;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties2(physical, &properties);
    if (!features.shaderStorageImageExtendedFormats ||
        !(subgroup.supportedStages & VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT) ||
        !(subgroup.supportedOperations & VK_SUBGROUP_FEATURE_QUAD_BIT)) {
        Eden::Report("framegen",
            "FSR3 optical flow requires extended storage images and subgroup quad");
        return false;
    }
    VkFormatProperties output_props{}, present_props{};
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceFormatProperties(
        physical, VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM, &output_props);
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceFormatProperties(physical, format, &present_props);
    if (!(output_props.optimalTilingFeatures & VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_BLIT_SRC_BIT) ||
        !(present_props.optimalTilingFeatures & VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_BLIT_DST_BIT))
        return false;

    auto candidate = std::make_unique<ps5::framegen::interpolator>();
    std::string error;
    if (!candidate->create(physical, device, width, height, error, format)) {
        Eden::Report("framegen", ("FSR3 optical flow: " + error).c_str());
        return false;
    }
    candidate->set_generated(1); // conservative single midpoint
    device_ = device;
    width_ = width;
    height_ = height;
    format_ = format;
    engine_ = std::move(candidate);
    Eden::Report("framegen", "FSR3 optical-flow Vulkan session initialized");
    return true;
}

bool Fsr3OpticalSession::Record(VkCommandBuffer cmd, VkImage real,
                                VkImage synthetic, bool generate) noexcept {
    if (!Ready() || !cmd || !real ||
        (generate && (!synthetic || synthetic == real)))
        return false;
    engine_->prepare(cmd);
    const VkImage owned = engine_->frame_image();
    if (!owned || owned == real || owned == synthetic)
        return false;
    const std::array before{
        Transition(real, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL,
                   VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL,
                   VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT,
                   VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT),
        Transition(owned, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL,
                   VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL,
                   VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT | VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT,
                   VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT)
    };
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cmd,
        VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT |
            VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COMPUTE_SHADER_BIT |
            VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT,
        VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, 0, 0, nullptr, 0, nullptr,
        static_cast<std::uint32_t>(before.size()), before.data());

    VkImageCopy copy{};
    copy.srcSubresource = copy.dstSubresource = ColorLayers();
    copy.extent = {width_, height_, 1};
    vkCmdCopyImage(cmd, real, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL,
                   owned, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, 1, &copy);
    const std::array after{
        Transition(real, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL,
                   VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT,
                   VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT |
                       VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT |
                       VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT),
        Transition(owned, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL,
                   VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT,
                   VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT)
    };
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cmd, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT,
        VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT |
            VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COMPUTE_SHADER_BIT |
            VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT,
        0, 0, nullptr, 0, nullptr,
        static_cast<std::uint32_t>(after.size()), after.data());

    const bool made = engine_->record(cmd, !generate);
    if (generate && made) {
        const auto prepare = Transition(
            synthetic, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL,
            VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL,
            VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT, VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT);
        vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cmd, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT,
                             VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT,
                             0, 0, nullptr, 0, nullptr, 1, &prepare);
        VkImageBlit blit{};
        blit.srcSubresource = blit.dstSubresource = ColorLayers();
        blit.srcOffsets[1] = {
            static_cast<std::int32_t>(width_),
            static_cast<std::int32_t>(height_), 1};
        blit.dstOffsets[1] = blit.srcOffsets[1];
        vkCmdBlitImage(cmd, engine_->output_image(), VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL,
                       synthetic, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL,
                       1, &blit, VK_FILTER_NEAREST);
        const auto ready = Transition(
            synthetic, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL,
            VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT,
            VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT |
                VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT |
                VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT);
        vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cmd, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT,
            VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT |
                VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT,
            0, 0, nullptr, 0, nullptr, 1, &ready);
    }
    engine_->advance();
    return !generate || made;
}
} // namespace Eden::FeatureLab
```

`headless/fxaa_quality.frag`:

```frag
// SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright 2021 yuzu Emulator Project
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later

// Source code is adapted from
// https://www.geeks3d.com/20110405/fxaa-fast-approximate-anti-aliasing-demo-glsl-opengl-test-radeon-geforce/3/

#version 460
// Encore FXAA High: longer edge span and less reduction than stock FXAA.
// A separate SPIR-V module, not a second copy of the stock pass.

#ifdef VULKAN

#define BINDING_COLOR_TEXTURE 1

#else // ^^^ Vulkan ^^^ // vvv OpenGL vvv

#define BINDING_COLOR_TEXTURE 0

#endif

layout (location = 0) in vec4 posPos;

layout (location = 0) out vec4 frag_color;

layout (binding = BINDING_COLOR_TEXTURE) uniform sampler2D input_texture;

const float FXAA_SPAN_MAX = 12.0;
const float FXAA_REDUCE_MUL = 1.0 / 16.0;
const float FXAA_REDUCE_MIN = 1.0 / 256.0;

#define FxaaTexLod0(t, p) textureLod(t, p, 0.0)
#define FxaaTexOff(t, p, o) textureLodOffset(t, p, 0.0, o)

vec3 FxaaPixelShader(vec4 posPos, sampler2D tex) {

    vec3 rgbNW = FxaaTexLod0(tex, posPos.zw).xyz;
    vec3 rgbNE = FxaaTexOff(tex, posPos.zw, ivec2(1,0)).xyz;
    vec3 rgbSW = FxaaTexOff(tex, posPos.zw, ivec2(0,1)).xyz;
    vec3 rgbSE = FxaaTexOff(tex, posPos.zw, ivec2(1,1)).xyz;
    vec3 rgbM  = FxaaTexLod0(tex, posPos.xy).xyz;
/*---------------------------------------------------------*/
    vec3 luma = vec3(0.299, 0.587, 0.114);
    float lumaNW = dot(rgbNW, luma);
    float lumaNE = dot(rgbNE, luma);
    float lumaSW = dot(rgbSW, luma);
    float lumaSE = dot(rgbSE, luma);
    float lumaM  = dot(rgbM,  luma);
/*---------------------------------------------------------*/
    float lumaMin = min(lumaM, min(min(lumaNW, lumaNE), min(lumaSW, lumaSE)));
    float lumaMax = max(lumaM, max(max(lumaNW, lumaNE), max(lumaSW, lumaSE)));
/*---------------------------------------------------------*/
    vec2 dir;
    dir.x = -((lumaNW + lumaNE) - (lumaSW + lumaSE));
    dir.y =  ((lumaNW + lumaSW) - (lumaNE + lumaSE));
/*---------------------------------------------------------*/
    float dirReduce = max(
        (lumaNW + lumaNE + lumaSW + lumaSE) * (0.25 * FXAA_REDUCE_MUL),
        FXAA_REDUCE_MIN);
    float rcpDirMin = 1.0/(min(abs(dir.x), abs(dir.y)) + dirReduce);
    dir = min(vec2( FXAA_SPAN_MAX,  FXAA_SPAN_MAX),
          max(vec2(-FXAA_SPAN_MAX, -FXAA_SPAN_MAX),
          dir * rcpDirMin)) / textureSize(tex, 0);
/*--------------------------------------------------------*/
    vec3 rgbA = (1.0 / 2.0) * (
        FxaaTexLod0(tex, posPos.xy + dir * (1.0 / 3.0 - 0.5)).xyz +
        FxaaTexLod0(tex, posPos.xy + dir * (2.0 / 3.0 - 0.5)).xyz);
    vec3 rgbB = rgbA * (1.0 / 2.0) + (1.0 / 4.0) * (
        FxaaTexLod0(tex, posPos.xy + dir * (0.0 / 3.0 - 0.5)).xyz +
        FxaaTexLod0(tex, posPos.xy + dir * (3.0 / 3.0 - 0.5)).xyz);
    float lumaB = dot(rgbB, luma);
    if((lumaB < lumaMin) || (lumaB > lumaMax)) return rgbA;
    return rgbB;
}

void main() {
  frag_color = vec4(FxaaPixelShader(posPos, input_texture), texture(input_texture, posPos.xy).a);
}
```
