```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#include "mihawk_native_session.h"
#include "mihawk_volk.h"
#include "diagnostics.h"
#include <array>
#include <cstdio>
#include <vector>

namespace Eden::FeatureLab {
namespace {
// Pinned MihawkGen v1 network: an unexpected size must never be loaded
// accidentally as an arbitrary memory blob.
constexpr std::size_t kModelBytes = 1'757'240;
}
MihawkNativeSession::~MihawkNativeSession() { Destroy(); }

bool MihawkNativeSession::Create(const MihawkSessionCreate& setup) noexcept {
    Destroy();
    if (!setup.instance_proc || !setup.instance || !setup.physical || !setup.device ||
        setup.width == 0 || setup.height == 0 || setup.model_path.empty())
        return false;

    // Initialise the SAME Vulkan device as RendererVulkan. volk is
    // namespaced so Encore's RADV vkGetInstanceProcAddr stays a real function.
    volkInitializeCustom(setup.instance_proc);
    volkLoadInstance(setup.instance);
    volkLoadDevice(setup.device);
    if (!vkCreateImage || !vkCmdPipelineBarrier || !vkCmdDispatch ||
        !vkCreateComputePipelines || !vkQueueSubmit || !vkDeviceWaitIdle) {
        Eden::Report("framegen", "native Vulkan dispatch missing for MihawkGen");
        return false;
    }

    FILE* f = std::fopen(setup.model_path.c_str(), "rb");
    if (!f) {
        Eden::Report("framegen", "MihawkGen model is absent from the application");
        return false;
    }
    if (std::fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END) != 0) { std::fclose(f); return false; }
    const long length = std::ftell(f);
    if (length != static_cast<long>(kModelBytes) || std::fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET) != 0) {
        std::fclose(f);
        Eden::Report("framegen", "MihawkGen model has an unexpected size");
        return false;
    }
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> bytes;
    try {
        bytes.resize(kModelBytes);
    } catch (...) {
        std::fclose(f);
        Eden::Report("framegen", "MihawkGen model allocation failed");
        return false;
    }
    const bool read_ok = std::fread(bytes.data(), 1, bytes.size(), f) == bytes.size();
    const bool close_ok = std::fclose(f) == 0;
    if (!read_ok || !close_ok) return false;

    fg_create_info init{};
    init.device = setup.device;
    init.physical_device = setup.physical;
    init.width = setup.width;
    init.height = setup.height;
    init.slots = 1;  // serial GPU fence gate also protects descriptor reuse
    init.output_format = VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
    std::array<char, 256> error{};
    if (fg_context_create(&init, &context_, error.data(), error.size()) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        context_ = nullptr;
        Eden::Report("framegen", error.data());
        return false;
    }
    if (fg_context_load_network(context_, bytes.data(), bytes.size(),
                                error.data(), error.size()) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        Eden::Report("framegen", error.data());
        Destroy();
        return false;
    }
    model_loaded_ = true;
    const auto alloc = owned_.Create(setup.device, setup.physical, setup.width, setup.height,
                                     setup.compositor_format);
    if (alloc != MihawkAllocateError::None) {
        Eden::Report("framegen", "MihawkGen private history allocation failed");
        Destroy();
        return false;
    }
    Eden::Report("framegen", "MihawkGen private Vulkan history and neural context initialized");
    return true;
}

void MihawkNativeSession::Destroy() noexcept {
    // Never release neural pipelines or descriptor sets while GPU reads are
    // still running. The renderer owns VkDevice and destroys us first.
    if (context_) {
        // The owning renderer already waits idle at shutdown; if invoked
        // earlier, the private resource destructor supplies device wait.
        owned_.Destroy();
        fg_context_destroy(context_);
        context_ = nullptr;
    } else {
        owned_.Destroy();
    }
    model_loaded_ = false;
    output_was_blitted_ = false;
    // Destroy waited for private resources to finish. All GPU serials
    // associated with this allocation generation are now retired.
    encoder_.ResetAfterDeviceIdle();
}
} // namespace Eden::FeatureLab

```

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#include "mihawk_vulkan_encoder.h"

namespace Eden::FeatureLab {
MihawkEncoderResult MihawkVulkanEncoder::Record(const MihawkEncoderInput& input) noexcept {
    MihawkEncoderResult result{};
    if (timeline_.Pending()) {
        result.plan.status = MihawkPlanStatus::SubmissionPending;
        return result;
    }
    AdoptResources(input.images);
    result.plan = timeline_.Prepare(input.request);
    if (!result.plan.CanCapture())
        return result;

    const std::uint8_t next = result.plan.capture_slot;
    const std::uint8_t prev = result.plan.previous_slot;
    const MihawkSourceRecord copy{
        .cmd = input.commands,
        .source_real = input.real_composited_image,
        .history_owned = images_.history[next],
        .history_initialized = history_initialized_[next],
        .width = input.request.source.width,
        .height = input.request.source.height
    };
    result.recording = ValidateOwnedSnapshot(copy);
    if (result.recording != MihawkRecordResult::Recorded) {
        Abort();
        return result;
    }

    MihawkGenerateRecord generate{};
    if (result.plan.CanGenerate()) {
        generate = {
            .context = input.neural_context,
            .cmd = input.commands,
            .previous_owned = images_.history[prev],
            .current_owned = images_.history[next],
            .previous_view = images_.history_view[prev],
            .current_view = images_.history_view[next],
            .private_rgba_output = images_.rgba_output,
            .private_rgba_view = images_.rgba_view,
            .synthetic_present = input.synthetic_present_image,
            .width = input.request.source.width,
            .height = input.request.source.height,
            .descriptor_slot = 0,
            .context_slot_count = input.descriptor_slots,
            .output_was_blitted = output_blitted_,
            .capabilities = input.request.surface
        };
        // Check the *whole* stage before recording the first image barrier:
        // this avoids partially scheduled history copies on a failed generator.
        result.recording = ValidateNativeMihawkPair(generate);
        if (result.recording != MihawkRecordResult::Recorded) {
            Abort();
            return result;
        }
    }

    result.recording = RecordOwnedSnapshot(copy);
    if (result.recording != MihawkRecordResult::Recorded) {
        Abort();
        return result;
    }
    if (result.plan.CanGenerate()) {
        result.recording = RecordNativeMihawkPair(generate);
        if (result.recording != MihawkRecordResult::Recorded) {
            // A failure after recording commands must cause the entire command
            // buffer to be discarded. Caller sees IsRecorded()==false.
            Abort();
            return result;
        }
    }
    return result;
}

bool MihawkVulkanEncoder::Commit(const MihawkEncoderResult& result,
                                 std::uint64_t actual_gpu_serial) noexcept {
    if (!result.IsRecorded() ||
        !timeline_.Commit(result.plan, actual_gpu_serial)) return false;
    history_initialized_[result.plan.capture_slot] = true;
    if (result.WillPresentSynthetic()) output_blitted_ = true;
    return true;
}
} // namespace Eden::FeatureLab
```

`headless/mihawk_vulkan_encoder.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#pragma once
// Composition of real-frame gating, GPU timeline ownership, source snapshots,
// neural dispatch and conversion. THIS IS NOT YET CALLED BY THE PS5 RENDERER.
// Opt-in qualifier cannot be enabled without real fences and HUD verification.
#include "mihawk_vulkan_stage.h"
#include "mihawk_submission_timeline.h"
#include "mihawk_vulkan_resources.h"

namespace Eden::FeatureLab {
struct MihawkEncoderImages {
    VkImage history[2]{VK_NULL_HANDLE, VK_NULL_HANDLE};
    VkImageView history_view[2]{VK_NULL_HANDLE, VK_NULL_HANDLE};
    VkImage rgba_output = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkImageView rgba_view = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    std::uint64_t resource_generation = 0;
    static MihawkEncoderImages FromOwned(const MihawkVulkanResources& owned) noexcept {
        if (!owned.IsReady()) return {};
        return {
            {owned.History(0).image, owned.History(1).image},
            {owned.History(0).view, owned.History(1).view},
            owned.RgbaOutput().image, owned.RgbaOutput().view,
            owned.Generation()
        };
    }
};
struct MihawkEncoderInput {
    MihawkSubmitRequest request{};
    VkCommandBuffer commands = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkImage real_composited_image = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkImage synthetic_present_image = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    fg_context* neural_context = nullptr;
    std::uint32_t descriptor_slots = 0;
    MihawkEncoderImages images{};
};
struct MihawkEncoderResult {
    MihawkSubmissionPlan plan{};
    MihawkRecordResult recording = MihawkRecordResult::NotReady;
    constexpr bool IsRecorded() const noexcept {
        return plan.CanCapture() && recording == MihawkRecordResult::Recorded;
    }
    constexpr bool WillPresentSynthetic() const noexcept {
        return IsRecorded() && plan.CanGenerate();
    }
};

class MihawkVulkanEncoder {
public:
    MihawkEncoderResult Record(const MihawkEncoderInput& input) noexcept;
    // Must receive the actual GPU completion tick from Scheduler::Flush.
    bool Commit(const MihawkEncoderResult& result,
                std::uint64_t actual_gpu_serial) noexcept;
    // Aborting means the renderer DROPS its command buffer: no partial
    // snapshots/generation may be submitted after calling Abort.
    void Abort() noexcept { timeline_.Abort(); ResetLocalHistory(); }
    void InvalidateHistory() noexcept {
        timeline_.InvalidateHistory();
        ResetLocalHistory();
    }
    constexpr const MihawkSubmissionTimeline& Timeline() const noexcept { return timeline_; }
    // Must only be called after VkDeviceWaitIdle, destruction/reallocation of
    // the owned resources and a game/renderer reset. Not a frame fallback.
    void ResetAfterDeviceIdle() noexcept {
        timeline_.ResetAfterDeviceIdle();
        ResetLocalHistory();
        images_ = {};
    }
private:
    void AdoptResources(const MihawkEncoderImages& incoming) noexcept {
        if (images_.resource_generation != incoming.resource_generation ||
            images_.history[0] != incoming.history[0] ||
            images_.history[1] != incoming.history[1] ||
            images_.history_view[0] != incoming.history_view[0] ||
            images_.history_view[1] != incoming.history_view[1] ||
            images_.rgba_output != incoming.rgba_output ||
            images_.rgba_view != incoming.rgba_view) {
            InvalidateHistory(); // GPU serial reservations are NOT erased
            images_ = incoming;
        }
    }
    void ResetLocalHistory() noexcept {
        // Do not forget the in-flight GPU serials: Timeline retains them.
        history_initialized_[0] = history_initialized_[1] = false;
        output_blitted_ = false;
    }
    MihawkSubmissionTimeline timeline_{};
    MihawkEncoderImages images_{};
    bool history_initialized_[2]{};
    bool output_blitted_ = false;
};
} // namespace Eden::FeatureLab

```

`headless/mihawk_vulkan_resources.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#include "mihawk_vulkan_resources.h"

#include <limits>

namespace Eden::FeatureLab {
namespace {
bool Supports(VkPhysicalDevice physical, VkFormat format,
              VkFormatFeatureFlags required) noexcept {
    VkFormatProperties properties{};
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceFormatProperties(physical, format, &properties);
    return (properties.optimalTilingFeatures & required) == required;
}

int DeviceLocalIndex(const VkPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties& props,
                     std::uint32_t bits) noexcept {
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < props.memoryTypeCount; ++i) {
        if ((bits & (1U << i)) &&
            (props.memoryTypes[i].propertyFlags & VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_DEVICE_LOCAL_BIT))
            return static_cast<int>(i);
    }
    return -1;
}
} // namespace

MihawkVulkanResources::~MihawkVulkanResources() {
    Destroy();
}

void MihawkVulkanResources::ReleaseImages() noexcept {
    if (!device_) return;
    for (auto& image : images_) {
        if (image.view) vkDestroyImageView(device_, image.view, nullptr);
        if (image.image) vkDestroyImage(device_, image.image, nullptr);
        if (image.memory) vkFreeMemory(device_, image.memory, nullptr);
        image = {};
    }
    ready_ = false;
    initialized_ = {};
    total_bytes_ = 0;
}

void MihawkVulkanResources::Destroy() noexcept {
    if (device_) {
        // Safe when this object's containing renderer owns device_. The app
        // must destroy this *before* destroying VkDevice.
        (void)vkDeviceWaitIdle(device_);
        ReleaseImages();
    }
    device_ = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    source_format_ = VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED;
    width_ = height_ = 0;
}

bool MihawkVulkanResources::CreateImage(
    std::uint32_t slot, VkFormat format, VkImageUsageFlags usage,
    VkDeviceSize budget, const VkPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties& types,
    MihawkAllocateError& error) noexcept {
    auto& out = images_[slot];
    VkImageCreateInfo image{};
    image.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_CREATE_INFO;
    image.imageType = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D;
    image.format = format;
    image.extent = {width_, height_, 1};
    image.mipLevels = 1;
    image.arrayLayers = 1;
    image.samples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;
    image.tiling = VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL;
    image.usage = usage;
    image.sharingMode = VK_SHARING_MODE_EXCLUSIVE;
    image.initialLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;

    VkImage created_image = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    if (vkCreateImage(device_, &image, nullptr, &created_image) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        error = MihawkAllocateError::ImageCreationFailed;
        return false;
    }
    out.image = created_image;
    VkMemoryRequirements requirements{};
    vkGetImageMemoryRequirements(device_, out.image, &requirements);
    if (requirements.size == 0 || requirements.size > budget - total_bytes_) {
        error = MihawkAllocateError::ExcessiveMemory;
        return false;
    }
    const int index = DeviceLocalIndex(types, requirements.memoryTypeBits);
    if (index < 0) {
        error = MihawkAllocateError::NoDeviceLocalMemory;
        return false;
    }
    VkMemoryAllocateInfo allocate{};
    allocate.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO;
    allocate.allocationSize = requirements.size;
    allocate.memoryTypeIndex = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(index);
    VkDeviceMemory allocated_memory = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    if (vkAllocateMemory(device_, &allocate, nullptr, &allocated_memory) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        error = MihawkAllocateError::AllocationFailed;
        return false;
    }
    out.memory = allocated_memory;
    out.allocation_size = requirements.size;
    total_bytes_ += requirements.size;
    if (vkBindImageMemory(device_, out.image, out.memory, 0) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        error = MihawkAllocateError::BindFailed;
        return false;
    }

    VkImageViewCreateInfo view{};
    view.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_VIEW_CREATE_INFO;
    view.image = out.image;
    view.viewType = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D;
    view.format = format;
    view.components = {VK_COMPONENT_SWIZZLE_IDENTITY, VK_COMPONENT_SWIZZLE_IDENTITY,
                       VK_COMPONENT_SWIZZLE_IDENTITY, VK_COMPONENT_SWIZZLE_IDENTITY};
    view.subresourceRange.aspectMask = VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT;
    view.subresourceRange.levelCount = 1;
    view.subresourceRange.layerCount = 1;
    VkImageView created_view = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    if (vkCreateImageView(device_, &view, nullptr, &created_view) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        error = MihawkAllocateError::ViewCreationFailed;
        return false;
    }
    out.view = created_view;
    return true;
}

MihawkAllocateError MihawkVulkanResources::Create(
    VkDevice device, VkPhysicalDevice physical, std::uint32_t width,
    std::uint32_t height, VkFormat compositor_format,
    VkDeviceSize max_allocation_bytes) {
    if (device_ || ready_) return MihawkAllocateError::AlreadyAllocated;
    // The first native implementation does not authorize 8K interpolation.
    // 4K+ or unsupported extents fail before allocating anything.
    if (!device || !physical || !width || !height ||
        width > 3840 || height > 2160 ||
        max_allocation_bytes < 1ull * 1024 * 1024 ||
        max_allocation_bytes > 512ull * 1024 * 1024)
        return MihawkAllocateError::InvalidArguments;
    if (compositor_format != VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM &&
        compositor_format != VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM)
        return MihawkAllocateError::UnsupportedFormat;
    const VkFormatFeatureFlags history_features =
        VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_SAMPLED_IMAGE_BIT | VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT |
        VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT;
    const VkFormatFeatureFlags rgba_features =
        VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_STORAGE_IMAGE_BIT | VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_BLIT_SRC_BIT;
    if (!Supports(physical, compositor_format, history_features) ||
        !Supports(physical, compositor_format, VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_BLIT_DST_BIT) ||
        !Supports(physical, VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM, rgba_features))
        return MihawkAllocateError::UnsupportedFormat;

    VkPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties types{};
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties(physical, &types);
    device_ = device;
    width_ = width;
    height_ = height;
    source_format_ = compositor_format;

    MihawkAllocateError error = MihawkAllocateError::None;
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
        const VkFormat fmt = i == 2 ? VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM : compositor_format;
        const VkImageUsageFlags usage =
            i == 2 ? (VK_IMAGE_USAGE_STORAGE_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT)
                   : (VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT);
        if (!CreateImage(i, fmt, usage, max_allocation_bytes, types, error)) {
            // No GPU commands have been submitted: these allocations can be
            // destroyed immediately. Do not keep partial/stale resources.
            ReleaseImages();
            device_ = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
            source_format_ = VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED;
            width_ = height_ = 0;
            return error;
        }
    }
    ++generation_;
    ready_ = true;
    return MihawkAllocateError::None;
}
} // namespace Eden::FeatureLab
```

`headless/mihawk_vulkan_resources.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#pragma once
// R08 private history and output resources. Linked in Encore's native Vulkan
// renderer; synthetic presentation requires independent runtime qualification.
#include <vulkan/vulkan.h>
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>

namespace Eden::FeatureLab {

enum class MihawkAllocateError : std::uint8_t {
    None, AlreadyAllocated, InvalidArguments, UnsupportedFormat,
    ExcessiveMemory, NoDeviceLocalMemory, ImageCreationFailed,
    AllocationFailed, BindFailed, ViewCreationFailed
};

struct MihawkOwnedImage {
    VkImage image = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkImageView view = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkDeviceMemory memory = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkDeviceSize allocation_size = 0;
};

// Resource lifetime must be shorter than VkDevice lifetime. Destruction
// synchronizes (vkDeviceWaitIdle) before releasing GPU memory; never call
// Destroy from the 60 Hz render loop.
class MihawkVulkanResources {
public:
    MihawkVulkanResources() = default;
    ~MihawkVulkanResources();
    MihawkVulkanResources(const MihawkVulkanResources&) = delete;
    MihawkVulkanResources& operator=(const MihawkVulkanResources&) = delete;
    MihawkVulkanResources(MihawkVulkanResources&&) = delete;
    MihawkVulkanResources& operator=(MihawkVulkanResources&&) = delete;

    MihawkAllocateError Create(VkDevice device, VkPhysicalDevice physical,
                               std::uint32_t width, std::uint32_t height,
                               VkFormat compositor_format,
                               VkDeviceSize max_allocation_bytes = 128ull * 1024 * 1024);
    void Destroy() noexcept;
    void ResetHistory() noexcept { initialized_ = {}; }

    bool IsReady() const noexcept { return ready_; }
    const MihawkOwnedImage& History(std::uint32_t slot) const noexcept {
        return images_[slot % 2];
    }
    const MihawkOwnedImage& RgbaOutput() const noexcept { return images_[2]; }
    bool Initialized(std::uint32_t slot) const noexcept { return initialized_[slot % 2]; }
    void MarkInitialized(std::uint32_t slot) noexcept { initialized_[slot % 2] = true; }
    VkFormat SourceFormat() const noexcept { return source_format_; }
    VkDeviceSize AllocatedBytes() const noexcept { return total_bytes_; }
    std::uint32_t Width() const noexcept { return width_; }
    std::uint32_t Height() const noexcept { return height_; }
    // Incremented for every successfully recreated allocation group. This
    // distinguishes handles recycled by VkDevice/VkAllocator after reset.
    std::uint64_t Generation() const noexcept { return generation_; }

private:
    bool CreateImage(std::uint32_t slot, VkFormat format, VkImageUsageFlags usage,
                     VkDeviceSize budget, const VkPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties& types,
                     MihawkAllocateError& error) noexcept;
    void ReleaseImages() noexcept;
    std::array<MihawkOwnedImage, 3> images_{};
    std::array<bool, 2> initialized_{};
    VkDevice device_ = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkFormat source_format_ = VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED;
    std::uint32_t width_ = 0, height_ = 0;
    VkDeviceSize total_bytes_ = 0;
    std::uint64_t generation_ = 0;
    bool ready_ = false;
};

} // namespace Eden::FeatureLab
```

`headless/mihawk_vulkan_stage.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#include "mihawk_vulkan_stage.h"

#include <array>
#include <cmath>

namespace Eden::FeatureLab {
namespace {
constexpr VkImageSubresourceLayers ColorLayers() noexcept {
    VkImageSubresourceLayers layer{};
    layer.aspectMask = VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT;
    layer.layerCount = 1;
    return layer;
}
constexpr VkImageCopy FullImageCopy(std::uint32_t width, std::uint32_t height) noexcept {
    VkImageCopy copy{};
    copy.srcSubresource = ColorLayers();
    copy.dstSubresource = ColorLayers();
    copy.extent = {width, height, 1};
    return copy;
}
constexpr VkImageBlit FullImageBlit(std::uint32_t width, std::uint32_t height) noexcept {
    VkImageBlit blit{};
    blit.srcSubresource = ColorLayers();
    blit.dstSubresource = ColorLayers();
    blit.srcOffsets[1] = {static_cast<std::int32_t>(width), static_cast<std::int32_t>(height), 1};
    blit.dstOffsets[1] = blit.srcOffsets[1];
    return blit;
}
bool Distinct3(VkImage a, VkImage b, VkImage c) noexcept {
    return a != b && a != c && b != c;
}
} // namespace

MihawkRecordResult ValidateOwnedSnapshotInput(const MihawkSourceRecord& r) noexcept {
    if (!r.source_real || !r.history_owned ||
        r.width == 0 || r.height == 0 || r.width > 7680 || r.height > 4320)
        return MihawkRecordResult::InvalidHandles;
    if (r.source_real == r.history_owned)
        return MihawkRecordResult::DuplicateImages;
    return MihawkRecordResult::Recorded;
}

MihawkRecordResult ValidateOwnedSnapshot(const MihawkSourceRecord& r) noexcept {
    if (!r.cmd) return MihawkRecordResult::InvalidHandles;
    return ValidateOwnedSnapshotInput(r);
}

MihawkRecordResult RecordOwnedSnapshot(const MihawkSourceRecord& r) noexcept {
    const auto validated = ValidateOwnedSnapshot(r);
    if (validated != MihawkRecordResult::Recorded) return validated;
    const auto before = BeforeHistoryCopy(r.source_real, r.history_owned, r.history_initialized);
    const std::array barriers{before.source, before.history};
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier(r.cmd, before.src_stage, before.dst_stage, 0, 0, nullptr,
                         0, nullptr, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(barriers.size()), barriers.data());
    const auto copy = FullImageCopy(r.width, r.height);
    vkCmdCopyImage(r.cmd, r.source_real, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL,
                   r.history_owned, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, 1, &copy);
    const auto after = AfterHistoryCopy(r.source_real, r.history_owned);
    const std::array after_barriers{after.source, after.history};
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier(r.cmd, after.src_stage, after.dst_stage, 0, 0, nullptr,
                         0, nullptr, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(after_barriers.size()),
                         after_barriers.data());
    return MihawkRecordResult::Recorded;
}

MihawkRecordResult ValidateNativeMihawkPairInput(const MihawkGenerateRecord& r) noexcept {
    if (CheckNativeMihawkSurface(r.capabilities) != NativeMihawkReject::None)
        return MihawkRecordResult::Unsupported;
    if (!r.context || !fg_method_available(r.context, FG_METHOD_NEURAL))
        return MihawkRecordResult::NotReady;
    if (r.descriptor_slot >= r.context_slot_count || r.context_slot_count == 0 ||
        r.context_slot_count > 8)
        return MihawkRecordResult::InvalidSlot;
    if (!r.previous_owned || !r.current_owned || !r.previous_view ||
        !r.current_view || !r.private_rgba_output || !r.private_rgba_view ||
        !r.synthetic_present || r.width != r.capabilities.width ||
        r.height != r.capabilities.height)
        return MihawkRecordResult::InvalidHandles;
    if (!Distinct3(r.previous_owned, r.current_owned, r.private_rgba_output) ||
        r.synthetic_present == r.private_rgba_output ||
        r.synthetic_present == r.previous_owned ||
        r.synthetic_present == r.current_owned)
        return MihawkRecordResult::DuplicateImages;
    return MihawkRecordResult::Recorded;
}

MihawkRecordResult ValidateNativeMihawkPair(const MihawkGenerateRecord& r) noexcept {
    if (!r.cmd) return MihawkRecordResult::InvalidHandles;
    return ValidateNativeMihawkPairInput(r);
}

MihawkRecordResult RecordNativeMihawkPair(const MihawkGenerateRecord& r) noexcept {
    const auto validated = ValidateNativeMihawkPair(r);
    if (validated != MihawkRecordResult::Recorded) return validated;
    const VkImageMemoryBarrier output_prepare =
        BeforeNeuralOutput(r.private_rgba_output, r.output_was_blitted);
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier(r.cmd,
                         r.output_was_blitted ? VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT
                                              : VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TOP_OF_PIPE_BIT,
                         VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COMPUTE_SHADER_BIT, 0,
                         0, nullptr, 0, nullptr, 1, &output_prepare);

    fg_frame_pair pair{};
    pair.prev_color = r.previous_view;
    pair.next_color = r.current_view;
    pair.t = 0.5f; // x2 only, protected by present cadence gate
    fg_record_generate(r.context, r.cmd, r.descriptor_slot, FG_METHOD_NEURAL,
                       &pair, r.private_rgba_view);

    const auto pre_blit = BeforeGeneratedBlit(r.private_rgba_output, r.synthetic_present);
    const std::array barriers{pre_blit.source, pre_blit.history};
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier(r.cmd, pre_blit.src_stage, pre_blit.dst_stage, 0,
                         0, nullptr, 0, nullptr,
                         static_cast<std::uint32_t>(barriers.size()), barriers.data());

    const auto blit = FullImageBlit(r.width, r.height);
    // VkImageBlit converts RGBA8 storage to the presentation image's BGRA8
    // format when supported. The format/properties must be checked by caller.
    vkCmdBlitImage(r.cmd, r.private_rgba_output, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL,
                   r.synthetic_present, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL,
                   1, &blit, VK_FILTER_NEAREST);

    const VkImageMemoryBarrier synthetic_ready = AfterGeneratedBlit(r.synthetic_present);
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier(r.cmd, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT,
                         VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT |
                             VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT, 0,
                         0, nullptr, 0, nullptr, 1, &synthetic_ready);
    return MihawkRecordResult::Recorded;
}
} // namespace Eden::FeatureLab
```

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#pragma once
// MihawkGen R08: command recording into CALLER-OWNED GPU resources.
// This module does not allocate, publish, recycle or present frames.
// Lifetime: the caller guarantees fenced dedicated history images, a distinct
// output RGBA8 image, and a safe PresentManager slot.
#include "mihawk_native_surface_contract.h"
#include "mihawk_vulkan_history_barriers.h"
#include "framegen.h"

namespace Eden::FeatureLab {

enum class MihawkRecordResult : std::uint8_t {
    Recorded, Unsupported, NotReady, InvalidHandles, DuplicateImages, InvalidSlot
};
struct MihawkSourceRecord {
    VkCommandBuffer cmd = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkImage source_real = VK_NULL_HANDLE; // last compositor pass finished in GENERAL
    VkImage history_owned = VK_NULL_HANDLE; // separate stable sampled image
    bool history_initialized = false; // true iff this history survived the prior pass
    std::uint32_t width = 0, height = 0;
};

// Prepares copy with explicit GENERAL -> TRANSFER_SRC -> GENERAL on the
// actual composed frame. Only the private image is kept for interpolation.
// Preflight before VkCommandBuffer is allocated. Command recording later
// checks the actual command handle; never fabricate a VkCommandBuffer.
MihawkRecordResult ValidateOwnedSnapshotInput(const MihawkSourceRecord& record) noexcept;
MihawkRecordResult ValidateOwnedSnapshot(const MihawkSourceRecord& record) noexcept;
MihawkRecordResult RecordOwnedSnapshot(const MihawkSourceRecord& record) noexcept;

struct MihawkGenerateRecord {
    fg_context* context = nullptr;
    VkCommandBuffer cmd = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkImage previous_owned = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkImage current_owned = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkImageView previous_view = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkImageView current_view = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkImage private_rgba_output = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkImageView private_rgba_view = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkImage synthetic_present = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    std::uint32_t width = 0, height = 0;
    std::uint32_t descriptor_slot = 0;
    std::uint32_t context_slot_count = 0;
    bool output_was_blitted = false;
    // Caller must verify all these from the active renderer, not hardcode true.
    MihawkSurfaceCapabilities capabilities{};
};

// Records one neural interpolation with format-aware transfer to a distinct
// presentation frame. Does not submit, flush, present or increment guest FPS.
// Preflight does not require a command handle; the actual recording path
// separately verifies VkCommandBuffer before emitting its first command.
MihawkRecordResult ValidateNativeMihawkPairInput(const MihawkGenerateRecord& record) noexcept;
MihawkRecordResult ValidateNativeMihawkPair(const MihawkGenerateRecord& record) noexcept;
MihawkRecordResult RecordNativeMihawkPair(const MihawkGenerateRecord& record) noexcept;
```

```cpp
std::array<std::int16_t, 960> HighRendererReference() {
    using namespace AudioCore::Renderer;
    std::array<s32, 480> left{}, right{};
    for (unsigned voice = 0; voice < 2; ++voice) {
        std::array<s16, 256> input{};
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < input.size(); ++i)
            input[i] = voice == 0 ? (i % 48 < 24 ? 1024 : -1024) : (i % 24 < 12 ? 512 : -512);
        std::array<s32, 480> output{};
        Common::FixedPoint<49, 15> fraction{0};
        Resample(output, input, Common::FixedPoint<49, 15>{0.5}, fraction, 480, AudioCore::SrcQuality::High);
        ApplyMixRamp<15>(left, output, voice == 0 ? 0.5f : 0.25f, 0, 480);
        ApplyMixRamp<15>(right, output, voice == 0 ? 0.25f : 0.5f, 0, 480);
    }
    std::array<std::int16_t, 960> result{};
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 480; ++i) { result[2*i] = left[i]; result[2*i+1] = right[i]; }
    return result;
}
bool RendererPcmMatches(std::span<const std::int16_t> pcm, bool high) {
    if (pcm.size() % 2) return false;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < pcm.size(); i += 2) {
        if (std::abs(pcm[i]) > (high ? 1024 : 640) || std::abs(pcm[i + 1]) > (high ? 1024 : 512)) return false;
    }
    std::array<std::int16_t, 960> expected{};
    for (unsigned frame = 0; frame < 480; ++frame) {
        const auto sign = frame % 96 < 48 ? 1 : -1;
        const auto second = frame % 48 < 24 ? 1 : -1;
        expected[frame * 2] = sign * 512 + second * 128;
        expected[frame * 2 + 1] = sign * 256 + second * 256;
    }
    if (high) expected = HighRendererReference();
    const auto found = std::search(pcm.begin(), pcm.end(), expected.begin(), expected.end());
    return found != pcm.end() && (found - pcm.begin()) % 2 == 0;
}
void BeginGuestCycle() {
    std::scoped_lock lock(state.mutex);
    state.audio.clear();
    state.audio_opens = state.audio_closes = state.audio_drains = 0;
    state.guest_input = true;
    state.guest_start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
}
void CheckGuestCycle() {
    std::scoped_lock lock(state.mutex);
    state.guest_input = false;
    if (!state.audio_opens || state.audio_opens != state.audio_closes || state.audio_drains != state.audio_closes)
        throw std::runtime_error("Guest audio ports were not balanced");
    unsigned matches = 0;
    unsigned renderer_matches = 0;
    for (const auto& [handle, blocks] : state.audio) {
        std::vector<std::int16_t> pcm;
        for (const auto& block : blocks) pcm.insert(pcm.end(), block.begin(), block.end());
        auto start = std::find_if(pcm.begin(), pcm.end(), [](auto value) { return value != 0; });
        if (start == pcm.end()) continue;
        if (*start != 1024) {
            if (!RendererPcmMatches(pcm, true)) throw std::runtime_error("Renderer PCM waveform or channel gains differ");
            ++renderer_matches;
            continue;
        }
        if (pcm.end() - start < 24000) throw std::runtime_error("Guest PCM tail missing");
        for (unsigned frame = 0; frame < 12000; ++frame) {
            const auto value = frame == 11999 ? 0 : frame % 96 < 48 ? 1024 : -1024;
            if (start[frame * 2] != value || start[frame * 2 + 1] != value)
                throw std::runtime_error("Guest PCM samples differ from AudioOut output");
        }
        if (!std::all_of(start + 24000, pcm.end(), [](auto value) { return value == 0; }))
            throw std::runtime_error("Unexpected PCM after guest tone");
        ++matches;
    }
    if (matches != 1) throw std::runtime_error("Expected one guest PCM output stream");
    if (renderer_matches != 1) throw std::runtime_error("Expected one rendered PCM voice stream");
    state.audio.clear();
}
}

int scePadRead(int, ps5::pad::Data* data, int capacity) {
    std::scoped_lock lock(state.mutex);
    if (state.read_result) return state.read_result;
    if (state.guest_input && capacity > 0) {
        auto sample = ps5::pad::neutral_data(); sample.connected = 1;
        const auto phase = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(
            std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - state.guest_start).count() % 1500;
        if (phase >= 500 && phase < 1000) {
            sample.buttons = ps5::pad::kButtonCircle;
            sample.triggers.l2 = 255;
            sample.left_stick.x = 255;
            sample.right_stick.y = 0;
        }
        data[0] = sample;
        return 1;
    }
    const auto count = std::min<std::size_t>(capacity, state.pad_samples.size());
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
        data[i] = state.pad_samples.front();
        state.pad_samples.pop_front();
    }
    return static_cast<int>(count);
}

    if (state.fail_audio_open || user != 0xff || type != 0 || index != 0 ||
        grain != 256 || rate != 48000 || format != 1) return -1;
    const auto handle = 100 + ++state.audio_opens;
    state.audio[handle];
    return handle;
}
int sceAudioOutSetVolume(int, int flags, const int* volume) {
    return state.fail_volume || flags != 3 || volume[0] != 0x8000 || volume[1] != 0x8000 ? -1 : 0;
}
int sceAudioOutOutput(int handle, const void* samples) {
    {
        std::scoped_lock lock(state.mutex);
        if (!samples) { ++state.audio_drains; return 0; }
        if (state.fail_output) return -1;
        // Bound capture memory during whole-core offline runs.
        auto& blocks = state.audio[handle];
        if (blocks.size() < 256) {
            auto& block = blocks.emplace_back();
            std::copy_n(static_cast<const std::int16_t*>(samples), block.size(), block.begin());
        }
        state.wake.notify_all();
    }
    std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::microseconds(5333));
    return 0;
}
int sceAudioOutClose(int) { std::scoped_lock lock(state.mutex); ++state.audio_closes; return 0; }
```

`headless/mods.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Mods: what the player put in the game files folder's mods/ (next to roms/), in the layout Eden's
// patch manager reads and mod archives come in:
//
//   mods/<title ID, 16 hex digits>/<mod name>/exefs/    code patches (*.pchtxt, *.ips) or whole
//                                                       replacement files (main, subsdk0, ...)
//                                           /romfs/     game files that replace the game's own
//                                           /romfs_ext/ (also romfslite/)
//                                           /cheats/    <build ID>.txt
//   mods/<title ID>/cheat_<anything>.txt                 cheats without a folder
//
// Eden applies every mod of the running game, in the order of their names, except those the
// launcher switched off (settings_store.h keeps their names per game; main.cpp hands them to
// Eden). This header only looks: the launcher lists a game's mods with it and main.cpp names
// them in the log. The title's folder is found whatever the case of its letters (the derived
// bis_factory.cpp does the same for Eden), and is never created behind the player's back.
#pragma once
#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>
#include <cinttypes>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <filesystem>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <system_error>
#include <vector>

#if defined(__PROSPERO__)
#include "native_directory.h"
#endif

namespace Eden::Mods {
namespace fs = std::filesystem;

enum : unsigned {
    kCode = 1,    // exefs: patches or replacement code
    kFiles = 2,   // romfs: replacement game files
    kCheats = 4,  // cheats
};

struct Mod {
    std::string name;  // the folder's (or cheat file's) name: what Eden's disabled list holds
    unsigned kinds = 0;
};

inline std::string Lower(std::string_view text) {
    std::string result(text);
    for (char& c : result) c = static_cast<char>(std::tolower(static_cast<unsigned char>(c)));
    return result;
}

inline std::string TitleName(uint64_t title_id) {
    char name[17];
    std::snprintf(name, sizeof(name), "%016" PRIX64, title_id);
    return name;
}

inline std::vector<fs::directory_entry> ListFolder(const fs::path& folder) {
    std::error_code error;
    if (!fs::is_directory(folder, error) || error) return {};
#if defined(__PROSPERO__)
    // The console's directory iterator needs this reader (native_directory.h).
    auto entries = Eden::ReadNativeDirectory(folder, error);
    if (error) entries.clear();
    return entries;
#else
    std::vector<fs::directory_entry> entries;
    for (fs::directory_iterator it{folder, error}, end; !error && it != end; it.increment(error))
        entries.push_back(*it);
    return entries;
#endif
}

inline bool IsFolder(const fs::directory_entry& entry) {
    std::error_code error;
    return entry.is_directory(error) && !error;
}

// The game's folder in mods/ (root), or empty when it has none.
inline std::string TitleFolder(const std::string& root, uint64_t title_id) {
    if (title_id == 0) return {};
    const std::string wanted = Lower(TitleName(title_id));
    for (const auto& entry : ListFolder(root))
        if (IsFolder(entry) && Lower(entry.path().filename().string()) == wanted) return entry.path().string();
    return {};
}

// The path the launcher tells the player to use for a game's mods.
inline std::string TitleFolderToCreate(const std::string& root, uint64_t title_id) {
    return root + "/" + TitleName(title_id);
}

// What a mod's folder holds, as Eden will use it.
inline unsigned Kinds(const fs::path& mod) {
    static constexpr std::string_view kCodeFiles[] = {"main", "main.npdm", "rtld", "sdk", "subsdk0", "subsdk1",
        "subsdk2", "subsdk3", "subsdk4", "subsdk5", "subsdk6", "subsdk7", "subsdk8", "subsdk9"};
    unsigned kinds = 0;
    for (const auto& part : ListFolder(mod)) {
        if (!IsFolder(part)) continue;
        const std::string name = Lower(part.path().filename().string());
        const auto inside = ListFolder(part.path());
        if (inside.empty()) continue;
        if (name == "romfs" || name == "romfslite" || name == "romfs_ext") kinds |= kFiles;
        if (name == "cheats") kinds |= kCheats;
        if (name != "exefs") continue;
        for (const auto& file : inside) {
            const std::string file_name = file.path().filename().string();
            const std::string extension = file.path().extension().string();
            if (extension == ".ips" || extension == ".pchtxt" ||
                std::find(std::begin(kCodeFiles), std::end(kCodeFiles), file_name) != std::end(kCodeFiles))
                kinds |= kCode;
        }
    }
    return kinds;
}

// The game's mods, in the order Eden applies them.
inline std::vector<Mod> List(const std::string& root, uint64_t title_id) {
    std::vector<Mod> mods;
    const std::string folder = TitleFolder(root, title_id);
    if (folder.empty()) return mods;
    for (const auto& entry : ListFolder(folder)) {
        const std::string name = entry.path().filename().string();
        if (IsFolder(entry)) {
            if (const unsigned kinds = Kinds(entry.path())) mods.push_back({name, kinds});
        } else if (name.starts_with("cheat_")) {
            mods.push_back({name, kCheats});
        }
    }
    std::sort(mods.begin(), mods.end(), [](const Mod& a, const Mod& b) { return a.name < b.name; });
    return mods;
}

// One line for the log and the crash report: the mods in use, by name.
inline std::string Summary(const std::vector<Mod>& mods, const std::vector<std::string>& disabled) {
    std::string used;
    unsigned off = 0;
    for (const Mod& mod : mods) {
        if (std::find(disabled.begin(), disabled.end(), mod.name) != disabled.end()) {
            ++off;
            continue;
        }
        used += (used.empty() ? "" : ", ") + mod.name;
    }
    if (used.empty()) used = "none";
    if (off != 0) used += " (" + std::to_string(off) + " switched off)";
    return used;
}
} // namespace Eden::Mods
```

`headless/mods_check.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Host check for mods: Eden's patch code as this build derives it (.ips and .pchtxt patches, which
// the pinned source could not apply: headless/CMakeLists.txt), what the launcher lists from a
// game's mods folder (mods.h), and the names it switches off (settings_store.h).
#include "mods.h"
#include "settings_store.h"

#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <fstream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "core/file_sys/ips_layer.h"
#include "core/file_sys/vfs/vfs_vector.h"

namespace {
namespace fs = std::filesystem;

void require(bool condition, const char* what) {
    if (!condition) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "Mods FAIL: %s\n", what);
        std::exit(1);
    }
}

void write_text(const fs::path& path, const std::string& text) {
    fs::create_directories(path.parent_path());
    std::ofstream(path, std::ios::binary) << text;
}

FileSys::VirtualFile file(std::vector<u8> bytes, const char* name) {
    return std::make_shared<FileSys::VectorVfsFile>(std::move(bytes), name);
}

// A stand-in for a game's code: 0x800 bytes that count up.
std::vector<u8> code() {
    std::vector<u8> bytes(0x800);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < bytes.size(); ++i) bytes[i] = static_cast<u8>(i * 7 + 3);
    return bytes;
}

void append(std::vector<u8>& out, std::initializer_list<int> bytes) {
    for (const int byte : bytes) out.push_back(static_cast<u8>(byte));
}

void check_ips() {
    const std::vector<u8> original = code();
    // IPS: a record of three bytes at 0x10, then a run of eight 0xAA at 0x100.
    std::vector<u8> ips{'P', 'A', 'T', 'C', 'H'};
    append(ips, {0x00, 0x00, 0x10, 0x00, 0x03, 0x11, 0x22, 0x33});
    append(ips, {0x00, 0x01, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x08, 0xAA});
    append(ips, {'E', 'O', 'F'});
    auto patched = FileSys::PatchIPS(file(original, "main"), file(ips, "patch.ips"));
    require(patched != nullptr, "an IPS patch applies");
    auto bytes = patched->ReadAllBytes();
    require(bytes.size() == original.size() && bytes[0x10] == 0x11 && bytes[0x11] == 0x22 && bytes[0x12] == 0x33,
            "IPS record bytes");
    for (std::size_t i = 0x100; i < 0x108; ++i) require(bytes[i] == 0xAA, "IPS run bytes");
    require(bytes[0x0F] == original[0x0F] && bytes[0x13] == original[0x13] && bytes[0x108] == original[0x108],
            "IPS leaves the rest alone");
    // IPS32: offsets of four bytes, end marker "EEOF".
    std::vector<u8> ips32{'I', 'P', 'S', '3', '2'};
    append(ips32, {0x00, 0x00, 0x07, 0x00, 0x00, 0x02, 0xC0, 0xDE});
    append(ips32, {'E', 'E', 'O', 'F'});
    patched = FileSys::PatchIPS(file(original, "main"), file(ips32, "patch.ips"));
    require(patched != nullptr, "an IPS32 patch applies");
    bytes = patched->ReadAllBytes();
    require(bytes[0x700] == 0xC0 && bytes[0x701] == 0xDE && bytes[0x702] == original[0x702], "IPS32 record bytes");
    // Not a patch, a patch without its end, and a patch past the end of the code: nothing applies.
    require(FileSys::PatchIPS(file(original, "main"), file(original, "not.ips")) == nullptr, "a file that is no patch");
    std::vector<u8> cut(ips.begin(), ips.end() - 3);
    require(FileSys::PatchIPS(file(original, "main"), file(cut, "cut.ips")) == nullptr, "a patch without its end");
    std::vector<u8> beyond{'P', 'A', 'T', 'C', 'H'};
    append(beyond, {0x00, 0x09, 0x00, 0x00, 0x01, 0x55, 'E', 'O', 'F'});
    require(FileSys::PatchIPS(file(original, "main"), file(beyond, "beyond.ips")) == nullptr,
            "a patch past the end of the code");
}

void check_pchtxt() {
    // Offsets count from the start of the NSO with the shift a patch file may name; a patch's
    // values are the bytes as written, a quoted value is text.
    std::string text =
        "@nsobid-0123456789ABCDEF0123456789abcdef01234567\n"
        "# 60 FPS\n"
        "@flag offset_shift 0x100\n"
        "@enabled\n"
        "00000010 DEADBEEF\n"
        "00000020 \"Hi\\n!\"\n"
        "00000040 01 // one byte\n"
        "@disabled\n"
        "00000030 FFFFFFFF\n"
        "@enabled\n"
        // What patch files carry besides records: their authors' names and links. None of it is a
        // record or a flag (read as such, it wrote over the start of the code and the build ID).
        "@somebody\r\n"
        "@nobody-here\r\n"
        "@blender\r\n"
        "https://example.invalid/somebody\r\n"
        "Special thanks to the team!\r\n"
        "Contributors (thank you)\r\n"
        "Somebody#1234, Another One#5678\r\n";
    // A value longer than the pinned code's 248-byte record.
    std::string wide = "00000200 ";
    for (int i = 0; i < 300; ++i) wide += "5A";
    text += wide + "\n@stop\n00000050 EE\n";
    const FileSys::IPSwitchCompiler compiler{
        file(std::vector<u8>(text.begin(), text.end()), "60fps.pchtxt")};
    const auto id = compiler.GetBuildID();
    static constexpr u8 kId[] = {0x01, 0x23, 0x45, 0x67, 0x89, 0xAB, 0xCD, 0xEF, 0x01, 0x23, 0x45, 0x67,
                                 0x89, 0xAB, 0xCD, 0xEF, 0x01, 0x23, 0x45, 0x67};
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < id.size(); ++i) require(id[i] == (i < sizeof(kId) ? kId[i] : 0), "the build ID");
    const std::vector<u8> original = code();
    const auto patched = compiler.Apply(file(original, "main"));
    require(patched != nullptr, "a .pchtxt patch applies");
    const auto bytes = patched->ReadAllBytes();
    require(bytes.size() == original.size(), "the code keeps its size");
    require(bytes[0x110] == 0xDE && bytes[0x111] == 0xAD && bytes[0x112] == 0xBE && bytes[0x113] == 0xEF,
            "hex values, in the order written");
    require(bytes[0x120] == 'H' && bytes[0x121] == 'i' && bytes[0x122] == '\n' && bytes[0x123] == '!' &&
            bytes[0x124] == original[0x124], "text values");
    require(bytes[0x140] == 0x01 && bytes[0x141] == original[0x141], "a value before a comment");
    require(bytes[0x130] == original[0x130], "a disabled patch is skipped");
    for (std::size_t i = 0x100; i < 0x110; ++i) require(bytes[i] == original[i], "credits are not records");
    for (std::size_t i = 0x300; i < 0x300 + 300; ++i) require(bytes[i] == 0x5A, "a long value");
    require(bytes[0x300 + 300] == original[0x300 + 300], "a long value ends where it should");
    require(bytes[0x150] == original[0x150], "nothing after @stop");
}

void check_listing(const fs::path& base) {
    using namespace Eden::Mods;
    const std::uint64_t game = 0x0100ABCD00001000ULL, other = 0x0100FFFF00002000ULL;
    const std::string root = (base / "mods").string();
    require(List(root, game).empty() && TitleFolder(root, game).empty(), "no mods folder");
    require(TitleFolderToCreate(root, game) == root + "/0100ABCD00001000", "the folder to make");
    // The title's folder in lower case, as a file manager may have it.
    const fs::path title = base / "mods" / "0100abcd00001000";
    write_text(title / "60 FPS" / "exefs" / "0123456789ABCDEF.pchtxt", "@enabled\n");
    write_text(title / "Texture pack" / "romfs" / "model" / "hero.bin", "x");
    write_text(title / "Everything" / "ExeFS" / "main", "x");
    write_text(title / "Everything" / "romfs_ext" / "a.stub", "");
    write_text(title / "Everything" / "cheats" / "0123456789ABCDEF.txt", "[cheat]\n");
    write_text(title / "cheat_infinite.txt", "[cheat]\n");
    write_text(title / "notes.txt", "not a mod");
    fs::create_directories(title / "Empty" / "exefs");
    write_text(title / "Readme only" / "readme.txt", "nothing Eden uses");
    write_text(title / "Wrong exefs" / "exefs" / "notes.txt", "nothing Eden uses");
    require(TitleFolder(root, game) == title.string(), "the title's folder in either case");
    const auto mods = List(root, game);
    require(mods.size() == 4, "four mods");
    require(mods[0].name == "60 FPS" && mods[0].kinds == kCode, "a patch");
    require(mods[1].name == "Everything" && mods[1].kinds == (kCode | kFiles | kCheats), "all three kinds");
    require(mods[2].name == "Texture pack" && mods[2].kinds == kFiles, "replacement files");
    require(mods[3].name == "cheat_infinite.txt" && mods[3].kinds == kCheats, "a loose cheat file");
    require(List(root, other).empty() && List(root, 0).empty(), "another game has none");
    require(Summary(mods, {}) == "60 FPS, Everything, Texture pack, cheat_infinite.txt", "all in use");
    require(Summary(mods, {"Everything", "Gone"}) == "60 FPS, Texture pack, cheat_infinite.txt (1 switched off)",
            "one switched off");
    require(Summary({}, {}) == "none", "no mods");
}

void check_settings(const fs::path& base) {
    const std::string settings = (base / "prosperoeden.json").string();
    const std::uint64_t game = 0x0100ABCD00001000ULL, other = 0x0100FFFF00002000ULL;
    require(Eden::LoadDisabledMods(game, settings).empty(), "nothing switched off at first");
    require(Eden::SaveGameSettings(game, {1, 4, 1}, settings), "game settings");
    require(Eden::SaveModEnabled(game, "60 FPS", false, settings) &&
            Eden::SaveModEnabled(game, "Texture pack", false, settings) &&
            Eden::SaveModEnabled(game, "60 FPS", false, settings), "switching off");
    auto off = Eden::LoadDisabledMods(game, settings);
    require(off == std::vector<std::string>({"Texture pack", "60 FPS"}), "the names switched off, once each");
    require(Eden::LoadDisabledMods(other, settings).empty(), "per game");
    require(Eden::SaveModEnabled(game, "Texture pack", true, settings), "switching on");
    off = Eden::LoadDisabledMods(game, settings);
    require(off == std::vector<std::string>({"60 FPS"}), "one left");
    const auto kept = Eden::LoadGameSettings(game, settings);
    require(kept.renderer == 1 && kept.resolution == 4 && kept.upscaling_filter == 1, "the other settings stay");
    require(Eden::SaveModEnabled(game, "60 FPS", true, settings) && Eden::LoadDisabledMods(game, settings).empty(),
            "all on again");
    require(!Eden::SaveModEnabled(0, "x", false, settings) && !Eden::SaveModEnabled(game, "", false, settings),
            "nothing to save");
    // The Library's Mods switch: on unless turned off, per game, and the mods' own switches and
    // the game's other settings stay as they are behind it.
    require(Eden::LoadModsEnabled(game, settings) && Eden::LoadModsEnabled(other, settings) &&
            Eden::LoadModsEnabled(0, settings), "the switch is on at first");
    require(Eden::SaveModEnabled(game, "60 FPS", false, settings) && Eden::SaveModsEnabled(game, false, settings),
            "the switch turned off");
    require(!Eden::LoadModsEnabled(game, settings) && Eden::LoadModsEnabled(other, settings), "off for that game only");
    require(Eden::LoadDisabledMods(game, settings) == std::vector<std::string>({"60 FPS"}), "a mod's own switch stays");
    require(Eden::LoadGameSettings(game, settings).resolution == 4, "the other settings stay with the switch off");
    require(Eden::SaveModsEnabled(game, true, settings) && Eden::LoadModsEnabled(game, settings), "the switch back on");
    std::ifstream written(settings);
    const std::string text{std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(written), {}};
    require(text.find("\"mods\"") == std::string::npos && text.find("\"mods_off\"") != std::string::npos,
            "on is not written; the mod switched off still is");
    require(!Eden::SaveModsEnabled(0, false, settings), "no game, nothing to save");
}
} // namespace

int main() {
    char pattern[] = "/tmp/mods-check-XXXXXX";
    require(mkdtemp(pattern) != nullptr, "temporary folder");
    const fs::path base = pattern;
    check_ips();
    check_pchtxt();
    check_listing(base);
    check_settings(base);
    fs::remove_all(base);
    std::puts("Mods: IPS and IPS32 patches, .pchtxt hex, text and long values, the folder listing, "
              "switching off per game, the game's Mods switch PASS");
}
```

`headless/native_directory.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#pragma once
#include <cerrno>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <dirent.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <filesystem>
#include <system_error>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <vector>

extern "C" int sceKernelGetdents(int, char*, int);

namespace Eden {
inline std::vector<std::filesystem::directory_entry> ReadNativeDirectory(
        const std::filesystem::path& path, std::error_code& error) {
    std::vector<std::filesystem::directory_entry> entries;
    const int fd = open(path.c_str(), O_RDONLY | O_DIRECTORY);
    if (fd < 0) {
        error = {errno, std::generic_category()};
        std::fprintf(stderr, "EDEN_DIRECTORY open error=%d path=%s\n", error.value(), path.c_str());
        return entries;
    }
    struct Close { int fd; ~Close() { close(fd); } } close_fd{fd};
    // Mounted PS5 filesystems can require directory reads larger than 8 KiB.
    // FS service threads have small stacks; keep the kernel read buffer on heap.
    std::vector<char> buffer(65536);
    error.clear();
    for (;;) {
        const int count = sceKernelGetdents(fd, buffer.data(), buffer.size());
        if (count == 0) return entries;
        if (count < 0 || count > static_cast<int>(buffer.size())) {
            std::fprintf(stderr, "EDEN_DIRECTORY getdents result=%d errno=%d path=%s\n", count, errno, path.c_str());
            error = std::make_error_code(std::errc::io_error);
            return {};
        }
        std::size_t offset = 0;
        while (offset < static_cast<std::size_t>(count)) {
            constexpr auto name_offset = offsetof(dirent, d_name);
            const auto available = static_cast<std::size_t>(count) - offset;
            if (available <= name_offset) {
                error = std::make_error_code(std::errc::io_error); return {};
            }
            uint16_t length;
            std::memcpy(&length, buffer.data() + offset + offsetof(dirent, d_reclen), sizeof(length));
            if (length <= name_offset || length > available) {
                std::fprintf(stderr, "EDEN_DIRECTORY record length=%u available=%zu name_offset=%zu path=%s\n", length, available, name_offset, path.c_str());
                error = std::make_error_code(std::errc::io_error); return {};
            }
            uint8_t type = DT_UNKNOWN;
            std::memcpy(&type, buffer.data() + offset + offsetof(dirent, d_type), sizeof(type));
            const char* name = buffer.data() + offset + name_offset;
            const char* end = static_cast<const char*>(std::memchr(name, 0, length - name_offset));
            if (!end || end == name || std::memchr(name, '/', end - name)) {
                error = std::make_error_code(std::errc::io_error); return {};
            }
            const std::string_view filename{name, static_cast<std::size_t>(end - name)};
            if (filename != "." && filename != "..") {
                if (type == DT_LNK) {
                    offset += length;
                    continue;
                }
                const auto full = path / filename;
                struct stat native {};
                if (lstat(full.c_str(), &native) == 0) {
                    if (S_ISLNK(native.st_mode)) {
                        offset += length;
                        continue;
                    }
                } else if (errno != EPERM && errno != EACCES) {
                    error = {errno, std::generic_category()};
                    return {};
                }

                entries.emplace_back(full, error);
                // Some PS5 app mounts deny lstat; in that specific case the directory entry may
                // still be readable through followed status.
                if (error == std::errc::operation_not_permitted) {
                    const auto status = entries.back().status(error);
                    if (!error && !std::filesystem::exists(status))
                        error = std::make_error_code(std::errc::no_such_file_or_directory);
                }
                if (error) {
                    std::fprintf(stderr, "EDEN_DIRECTORY entry error=%d path=%s name=%s\n", error.value(), path.c_str(), name);
                    return {};
                }
            }
            offset += length;
        }
    }
}
}
```
