`headless/ncz.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright 2026 Oliv3rmoon
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Eden's side of NCZ files (ncz_vfs.h): headless/ncz.h's reader as a VfsFile, its sections
// encrypted again with Eden's AES, and the folder solid NCZs are unpacked to.
#include "ncz_vfs.h"

#include <atomic>
#include <cstdio>
#include <list>
#include <map>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
#include <set>
#include <string>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

#include <fmt/format.h>

#include "common/logging.h"
#include "core/crypto/aes_util.h"
#include "core/crypto/key_manager.h"
#include "core/file_sys/vfs/vfs.h"
#include "ncz.h"

namespace Eden::Ncz {
namespace {
std::atomic<bool> unpack_allowed{false};

// The unpack folder and what is in use there. Only short work is done under `lock`; `unpacking`
// is held while one file is unpacked, since two at once would only compete for the storage.
struct UnpackFolder {
    std::mutex lock, unpacking;
    std::string folder;
    std::function<void(const std::function<bool(const std::string&)>&)> clear;
    std::multiset<std::string> in_use;  // unpacked files being read
    std::set<std::string> this_game;    // unpacked files read since the game started
};
UnpackFolder& Folder() {
    static UnpackFolder folder;
    return folder;
}

bool EndsWith(const std::string& name, const char* suffix) {
    const std::size_t length = std::char_traits<char>::length(suffix);
    return name.size() >= length && name.compare(name.size() - length, length, suffix) == 0;
}

std::string SizeLabel(u64 bytes) {
    return bytes >= (1ull << 30) ? fmt::format("{:.1f} GiB", static_cast<double>(bytes) / (1ull << 30))
                                 : fmt::format("{} MiB", (bytes + (1ull << 20) - 1) >> 20);
}

// A solid NCZ's files in the folder: <its name>-<its NCA size>.unpacked and .pieces. Its name is
// the NCA's ID, so the same content has the same files wherever it comes from.
std::string FileOf(const std::string& ncz_name, u64 nca_size, const char* kind) {
    return fmt::format("{}-{:x}.{}", ncz_name, nca_size, kind);
}

// The pieces found in each solid NCZ outside a game, for every reader of it: one object per NCZ
// for as long as any reader holds it (two on one pieces file would write over each other), and
// the most recently used 16 kept when none does. Those in its file stay there for later starts.
std::shared_ptr<SolidPieces> PiecesOf(const std::string& name) {
    static std::mutex lock;
    static std::map<std::string, std::weak_ptr<SolidPieces>> live;
    static std::list<std::shared_ptr<SolidPieces>> recent;
    std::string folder;
    {
        auto& unpack = Folder();
        std::scoped_lock guard{unpack.lock};
        folder = unpack.folder;
    }
    std::scoped_lock guard{lock};
    std::shared_ptr<SolidPieces> pieces = live[name].lock();
    if (pieces) {
        recent.remove(pieces);
    } else {
        pieces = std::make_shared<SolidPieces>(folder.empty() ? std::string{} : folder + "/" + name);
        live[name] = pieces;
    }
    recent.push_back(pieces);
    if (recent.size() > 16) recent.pop_front();
    for (auto it = live.begin(); it != live.end();) it = it->second.expired() ? live.erase(it) : std::next(it);
    return pieces;
}

// An unpacked file in use for as long as its reader lives.
class HeldPlaintext final : public Plaintext {
public:
    HeldPlaintext(std::unique_ptr<Plaintext> inner_, std::string name_)
        : inner(std::move(inner_)), name(std::move(name_)) {
        auto& folder = Folder();
        std::scoped_lock lock{folder.lock};
        folder.in_use.insert(name);
        if (unpack_allowed.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) folder.this_game.insert(name);
    }
    ~HeldPlaintext() override {
        auto& folder = Folder();
        std::scoped_lock lock{folder.lock};
        if (const auto it = folder.in_use.find(name); it != folder.in_use.end()) folder.in_use.erase(it);
    }
    bool Read(u8* data, std::size_t size, u64 offset) override { return inner->Read(data, size, offset); }

private:
    std::unique_ptr<Plaintext> inner;
    std::string name;
};

// The copy of a solid NCZ unpacked before, at any time (also outside a game).
std::unique_ptr<Plaintext> Unpacked(const std::string& ncz_name, u64 nca_size) {
    std::string folder;
    {
        auto& unpack = Folder();
        std::scoped_lock lock{unpack.lock};
        folder = unpack.folder;
    }
    if (folder.empty()) return nullptr;
    const std::string name = FileOf(ncz_name, nca_size, "unpacked");
    auto plaintext = OpenUnpacked(folder + "/" + name, nca_size - kHeaderSize);
    if (!plaintext) return nullptr;
    LOG_INFO(Loader, "{}: reading the copy unpacked before ({})", ncz_name, name);
    return std::make_unique<HeldPlaintext>(std::move(plaintext), name);
}

// Unpacks a solid NCZ, while its game runs: what was unpacked for another game is removed first.
std::unique_ptr<Plaintext> Unpack(const std::string& ncz_name, const Layout& layout, const ReadFn& read) {
    auto& unpack = Folder();
    std::scoped_lock unpacking{unpack.unpacking};
    std::string folder;
    {
        std::scoped_lock lock{unpack.lock};
        folder = unpack.folder;
    }
    const std::string size = SizeLabel(layout.StreamSize());
    if (folder.empty()) {
        LOG_ERROR(Loader, "{} is a solid NCZ of {} and there is no folder to unpack it to", ncz_name, size);
        return nullptr;
    }
    const std::string name = FileOf(ncz_name, layout.nca_size, "unpacked");
    const std::string path = folder + "/" + name;
    if (auto plaintext = OpenUnpacked(path, layout.StreamSize()))  // another reader made it meanwhile
        return std::make_unique<HeldPlaintext>(std::move(plaintext), name);
    // Only the game being played keeps its unpacked copies: the console's storage is not for all.
    // The pieces files are small and are kept. Under the lock: a copy opened meanwhile is in use.
    {
        std::scoped_lock lock{unpack.lock};
        if (unpack.clear)
            unpack.clear([&](const std::string& file) {
                return EndsWith(file, ".pieces") || file == name || unpack.in_use.contains(file) ||
                       unpack.this_game.contains(file);
            });
    }
    LOG_INFO(Loader, "{} is solid-compressed: unpacking its {} to {} once, for this and later starts", ncz_name,
             size, path);
    std::fprintf(stderr, "[ProsperoEden] NSZ: unpacking %s (%s, solid) to %s\n", ncz_name.c_str(), size.c_str(),
                 path.c_str());
    std::string error;
    auto plaintext = UnpackToFile(
        layout, read, path, &error,
        [&ncz_name](u64 done, u64 total) {
            std::fprintf(stderr, "[ProsperoEden] NSZ: %s %.0f%%\n", ncz_name.c_str(),
                         100.0 * static_cast<double>(done) / static_cast<double>(total));
        },
        [] { return !unpack_allowed.load(std::memory_order_relaxed); });
    if (!plaintext) {
        LOG_ERROR(Loader, "Cannot unpack {}: {}. It needs {} free. It is read without unpacking instead, which is "
                  "slow; nsz -D, then nsz -C -B (block compression) on a computer, lets it be played without "
                  "unpacking", ncz_name, error, size);
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[ProsperoEden] NSZ: cannot unpack %s: %s\n", ncz_name.c_str(), error.c_str());
        return nullptr;
    }
    return std::make_unique<HeldPlaintext>(std::move(plaintext), name);
}

class NczFile final : public FileSys::VfsFile {
public:
    NczFile(FileSys::VirtualFile base_, Layout layout, std::string name_)
        : base(std::move(base_)), name(std::move(name_)) {
        const std::string ncz_name = base->GetName();
        const FileSys::VirtualFile source = base;
        ReadFn read = [source](u8* data, std::size_t size, u64 offset) { return source->Read(data, size, offset); };
        SolidOptions solid;
        if (!layout.block) {
            solid.unpacked = [ncz_name, nca_size = layout.nca_size] { return Unpacked(ncz_name, nca_size); };
            solid.unpack = [ncz_name](const Layout& l, const ReadFn& r) { return Unpack(ncz_name, l, r); };
            solid.may_unpack = [] { return unpack_allowed.load(std::memory_order_relaxed); };
            solid.pieces = PiecesOf(FileOf(ncz_name, layout.nca_size, "pieces"));
        }
        reader = std::make_unique<Reader>(
            std::move(layout), read,
            [this](std::size_t index, u64 offset, u8* data, std::size_t size) { Encrypt(index, offset, data, size); },
            std::move(solid));
    }

    std::string GetName() const override { return name; }
    std::size_t GetSize() const override { return static_cast<std::size_t>(reader->Size()); }
    bool Resize(std::size_t) override { return false; }
    FileSys::VirtualDir GetContainingDirectory() const override { return base->GetContainingDirectory(); }
    bool IsWritable() const override { return false; }
    bool IsReadable() const override { return true; }
    std::size_t Read(u8* data, std::size_t length, std::size_t offset) const override {
        std::scoped_lock guard{lock};
        return reader->Read(data, length, offset);
    }
    std::size_t Write(const u8*, std::size_t, std::size_t) override { return 0; }
    bool Rename(std::string_view) override { return false; }

private:
    // Called from Read, with the lock held. A BKTR's sections (thousands, split by their counters)
    // share one key: one cipher per key.
    void Encrypt(std::size_t index, u64 offset, u8* data, std::size_t size) const {
        const Section& section = reader->GetLayout().sections[index];
        auto& cipher = ciphers[section.key];
        if (!cipher) {
            Core::Crypto::Key128 key;
            std::copy(section.key.begin(), section.key.end(), key.begin());
            cipher = std::make_unique<Core::Crypto::AESCipher<Core::Crypto::Key128>>(key, Core::Crypto::Mode::CTR);
        }
        cipher->SetIV(CounterFor(section, offset));
        cipher->Transcode(data, size, data, Core::Crypto::Op::Encrypt);
    }

    FileSys::VirtualFile base;
    std::string name;
    mutable std::mutex lock;
    mutable std::unique_ptr<Reader> reader;
    mutable std::map<std::array<u8, 16>, std::unique_ptr<Core::Crypto::AESCipher<Core::Crypto::Key128>>> ciphers;
};
} // namespace

FileSys::VirtualFile Open(FileSys::VirtualFile file) {
    if (!file) return nullptr;
    // The archive supplies this name and it becomes the filename of a
    // regenerable cache entry. Reject separators and excessive lengths
    // before the name can be used in any filesystem operation.
    const std::string original_name = file->GetName();
    if (original_name.empty() || original_name.size() > 96 ||
        original_name.find_first_of("/\\") != std::string::npos ||
        original_name.find('\0') != std::string::npos) {
        LOG_ERROR(Loader, "Unsafe NCZ archive entry name");
        return nullptr;
    }
    const ReadFn read = [&file](u8* data, std::size_t size, u64 offset) { return file->Read(data, size, offset); };
    std::string error;
    auto layout = ParseLayout(read, file->GetSize(), &error);
    if (!layout) {
        LOG_ERROR(Loader, "Cannot read {} as an NCZ: {}", file->GetName(), error);
        return nullptr;
    }
    std::string name = file->GetName();
    if (name.size() > 4 && name.ends_with(".ncz")) name.replace(name.size() - 4, 4, ".nca");
    LOG_DEBUG(Loader, "{}: {} NCZ of {} bytes ({} sections)", file->GetName(), layout->block ? "block" : "solid",
              layout->nca_size, layout->sections.size());
    return std::make_shared<NczFile>(std::move(file), std::move(*layout), std::move(name));
}

void SetUnpackAllowed(bool allowed) {
    if (allowed && !unpack_allowed.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
        auto& folder = Folder();
        std::scoped_lock lock{folder.lock};
        folder.this_game.clear();  // a new game starts
    }
    unpack_allowed.store(allowed, std::memory_order_relaxed);
}

void SetUnpackFolder(std::string folder,
                     std::function<void(const std::function<bool(const std::string&)>& keep)> clear) {
    // What an unpack cut short (the app closed, the power went) left behind goes now.
    if (clear) clear([](const std::string& file) { return !EndsWith(file, ".part"); });
    auto& unpack = Folder();
    std::scoped_lock lock{unpack.lock};
    unpack.folder = std::move(folder);
    unpack.clear = std::move(clear);
}
} // namespace Eden::Ncz

```

`headless/ncz.h`:

```h
// SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright 2026 Oliv3rmoon
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// NCZ: an NCA as nsz (https://github.com/nicoboss/nsz) compresses it, the form NSZ and XCZ files
// hold their programs and data in. This reads one back as the NCA it was made from, byte for byte,
// without writing the NCA anywhere: Eden then reads it as it reads any NCA (ncz.cpp).
//
// The layout, as nsz writes it and its own decompressor reads it:
//   0x0000  the NCA's first 0x4000 bytes (its header), as they are
//   0x4000  "NCZSECTN", a u64 count, then that many sections of 0x40 bytes: u64 offset, u64 size,
//           u64 crypto type, u64 padding, 16-byte key, 16-byte counter. They cover the NCA from
//           the first one's offset to its end, one after the other.
//   then    either "NCZBLOCK" (u8 version, u8 type, u8 unused, u8 block size exponent, u32 block
//           count, u64 decompressed size, a u32 compressed size per block) and the blocks, or
//           (solid) one zstd stream.
// What is compressed is the NCA from 0x4000 to its end, decrypted. A section of crypto type 3
// (CTR) or 4 (BKTR) is encrypted again with AES-128-CTR, its key, and a counter of the section
// counter's first 8 bytes then the NCA offset / 16 (big endian). A block is stored as it is when
// compressing it made it no smaller; the last one holds what remains.
//
// Block NCZs (nsz -B, the default for XCZ) are read where they are asked. A solid one (the default
// for NSZ) can only be decompressed from its start. While its game runs, it is unpacked once to a
// file (SolidOptions::unpack), which later starts use as well. Outside a game, a read decompresses
// it up to the read and keeps a few MiB around it, for every reader of that NCZ and (in a file
// beside the unpacked ones) for later starts: opening an update reads its patch tables at the end
// of its data, opening a game its logo after its data, and a library scan opens them every time.
#pragma once
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <functional>
#include <list>
#include <map>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include <fcntl.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <zstd.h>

namespace Eden::Ncz {
using u8 = std::uint8_t;
using u32 = std::uint32_t;
using u64 = std::uint64_t;

inline constexpr u64 kHeaderSize = 0x4000;
inline constexpr std::size_t kSectionEntrySize = 0x40;
inline constexpr std::size_t kMaxSections = 1u << 16;  // BKTR sections are split by their counters
inline constexpr unsigned kLowestBlockExponent = 14;    // nsz's own limits
inline constexpr unsigned kHighestBlockExponent = 32;
inline constexpr unsigned kLargestBlockExponent = 26;   // what this reads: 64 MiB blocks at most
// A solid NCZ no larger than this is never unpacked: one window holds it whole.
inline constexpr u64 kSmallSolid = 16ull << 20;

struct Section {
    u64 offset = 0, size = 0, crypto_type = 0;
    std::array<u8, 16> key{}, counter{};
    bool Encrypted() const { return crypto_type == 3 || crypto_type == 4; }
    u64 End() const { return offset + size; }
};

struct Layout {
    std::vector<Section> sections;
    u64 nca_size = 0;     // the NCA it reads as
    u64 data_offset = 0;  // where the blocks or the stream begin in the NCZ
    bool block = false;
    unsigned block_exponent = 0;
    std::vector<u64> block_offsets;  // in the NCZ
    std::vector<u32> block_sizes;    // compressed
    u64 BlockSize() const { return u64{1} << block_exponent; }
    u64 StreamSize() const { return nca_size - kHeaderSize; }
};

// Reads `size` bytes at `offset` of the NCZ; returns how many it read.
using ReadFn = std::function<std::size_t(u8* data, std::size_t size, u64 offset)>;

namespace Detail {
inline u64 Le64(const u8* p) {
    u64 value = 0;
    for (int i = 7; i >= 0; --i) value = (value << 8) | p[i];
    return value;
}
inline u32 Le32(const u8* p) {
    return u32{p[0]} | u32{p[1]} << 8 | u32{p[2]} << 16 | u32{p[3]} << 24;
}
inline bool ReadExact(const ReadFn& read, u8* data, std::size_t size, u64 offset) {
    std::size_t done = 0;
    while (done < size) {
        const std::size_t got = read(data + done, size - done, offset + done);
        if (got == 0) return false;
        done += got;
    }
    return true;
}
} // namespace Detail

// Whether the file starts like an NCZ: an NCA header, then "NCZSECTN".
inline bool LooksLikeNcz(const ReadFn& read, u64 file_size) {
    u8 magic[8];
    return file_size >= kHeaderSize + 16 && Detail::ReadExact(read, magic, 8, kHeaderSize) &&
           std::memcmp(magic, "NCZSECTN", 8) == 0;
}

// The NCZ's layout, or nothing (and why) when it is not one this can read.
inline std::optional<Layout> ParseLayout(const ReadFn& read, u64 file_size, std::string* error) {
    const auto fail = [error](const char* why) -> std::optional<Layout> {
        if (error) *error = why;
        return std::nullopt;
    };
    if (file_size < kHeaderSize + 16) return fail("too small for an NCZ");
    u8 head[16];
    if (!Detail::ReadExact(read, head, sizeof(head), kHeaderSize)) return fail("cannot read its section header");
    if (std::memcmp(head, "NCZSECTN", 8) != 0) return fail("no NCZSECTN after the NCA header");
    const u64 count = Detail::Le64(head + 8);
    if (count == 0 || count > kMaxSections) return fail("section count out of range");
    u64 at = kHeaderSize + 16;
    if (count * kSectionEntrySize > file_size - at) return fail("section table runs past the file");
    std::vector<u8> table(count * kSectionEntrySize);
    if (!Detail::ReadExact(read, table.data(), table.size(), at)) return fail("cannot read its section table");
    at += table.size();

    Layout layout;
    layout.sections.resize(count);
    for (u64 i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
        const u8* entry = table.data() + i * kSectionEntrySize;
        Section& section = layout.sections[i];
        section.offset = Detail::Le64(entry);
        section.size = Detail::Le64(entry + 8);
        section.crypto_type = Detail::Le64(entry + 16);
        std::memcpy(section.key.data(), entry + 32, 16);
        std::memcpy(section.counter.data(), entry + 48, 16);
        if (section.size > ~u64{0} - section.offset) return fail("a section ends past 2^64");
        // nsz writes them one after the other, and its decompressor relies on it.
        if (i > 0 && section.offset != layout.sections[i - 1].End()) return fail("sections are not contiguous");
    }
    layout.nca_size = std::max(kHeaderSize, layout.sections.back().End());
    if (layout.nca_size == kHeaderSize) return fail("no data after the NCA header");
    layout.data_offset = at;

    u8 block_head[24];
    layout.block = file_size - at >= sizeof(block_head) &&
                   Detail::ReadExact(read, block_head, sizeof(block_head), at) &&
                   std::memcmp(block_head, "NCZBLOCK", 8) == 0;
    if (!layout.block) return layout;

    layout.block_exponent = block_head[11];
    if (layout.block_exponent < kLowestBlockExponent || layout.block_exponent > kHighestBlockExponent)
        return fail("block size exponent out of range (14 to 32)");
    if (layout.block_exponent > kLargestBlockExponent)
        return fail("blocks larger than 64 MiB are not supported; nsz -D, then nsz -C -B (1 MiB blocks), makes "
                    "one that is");
    const u64 blocks = Detail::Le32(block_head + 12);
    const u64 decompressed = Detail::Le64(block_head + 16);
    if (decompressed != layout.StreamSize()) return fail("block data size does not match its sections");
    const u64 block_size = layout.BlockSize();
    if (blocks != (decompressed + block_size - 1) / block_size) return fail("block count does not match its size");
    at += sizeof(block_head);
    if (blocks * 4 > file_size - at) return fail("block size list runs past the file");
    std::vector<u8> sizes(blocks * 4);
    if (!Detail::ReadExact(read, sizes.data(), sizes.size(), at)) return fail("cannot read its block sizes");
    at += sizes.size();
    layout.data_offset = at;
    layout.block_offsets.resize(blocks);
    layout.block_sizes.resize(blocks);
    for (u64 i = 0; i < blocks; ++i) {
        const u32 size = Detail::Le32(sizes.data() + i * 4);
        if (size == 0) return fail("a block has no data");
        if (size > file_size - at) return fail("blocks run past the file");
        layout.block_offsets[i] = at;
        layout.block_sizes[i] = size;
        at += size;
    }
    return layout;
}

// The decompressed (and decrypted) NCA from 0x4000, read by offset in it.
class Plaintext {
public:
    virtual ~Plaintext() = default;
    // Fills [offset, offset + size); false when it cannot.
    virtual bool Read(u8* data, std::size_t size, u64 offset) = 0;
};

struct DCtxFree {
    void operator()(ZSTD_DCtx* context) const { ZSTD_freeDCtx(context); }
};
using DCtxPtr = std::unique_ptr<ZSTD_DCtx, DCtxFree>;

// Block NCZ: each block on its own, the last few kept.
class BlockPlaintext final : public Plaintext {
public:
    BlockPlaintext(const Layout& layout_, ReadFn read_)
        : layout(layout_), read(std::move(read_)), context(ZSTD_createDCtx()),
          kept(std::clamp<std::size_t>(static_cast<std::size_t>((8ull << 20) / layout.BlockSize()), 1, 4)) {}

    bool Read(u8* data, std::size_t size, u64 offset) override {
        const u64 block_size = layout.BlockSize();
        while (size > 0) {
            const u64 index = offset / block_size;
            const std::vector<u8>* block = Block(index);
            if (!block) return false;
            const u64 within = offset - index * block_size;
            if (within >= block->size()) return false;
            const std::size_t part = static_cast<std::size_t>(std::min<u64>(size, block->size() - within));
            std::memcpy(data, block->data() + within, part);
            data += part;
            offset += part;
            size -= part;
        }
        return true;
    }

private:
    struct Cached {
        u64 index;
        std::vector<u8> data;
    };

    const std::vector<u8>* Block(u64 index) {
        if (index >= layout.block_sizes.size() || !context) return nullptr;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < cache.size(); ++i)
            if (cache[i].index == index) {
                std::rotate(cache.begin(), cache.begin() + i, cache.begin() + i + 1);
                return &cache.front().data;
            }
        const u64 block_size = layout.BlockSize();
        const u64 expected = std::min(block_size, layout.StreamSize() - index * block_size);
        const u32 stored = layout.block_sizes[index];
        std::vector<u8> out(static_cast<std::size_t>(expected));
        if (stored < expected) {
            compressed.resize(stored);
            if (!Detail::ReadExact(read, compressed.data(), stored, layout.block_offsets[index])) return nullptr;
            const std::size_t made = ZSTD_decompressDCtx(context.get(), out.data(), out.size(),
                                                         compressed.data(), compressed.size());
            if (ZSTD_isError(made) || made != out.size()) return nullptr;
        } else if (!Detail::ReadExact(read, out.data(), out.size(), layout.block_offsets[index])) {
            return nullptr;
        }
        if (cache.size() == kept) cache.pop_back();
        cache.insert(cache.begin(), Cached{index, std::move(out)});
        return &cache.front().data;
    }

    const Layout& layout;
    ReadFn read;
    DCtxPtr context;
    std::size_t kept;
    std::vector<Cached> cache;
    std::vector<u8> compressed;
};

// A solid NCZ's zstd stream, decompressed from its start onwards, a piece at a time.
class SolidStream {
public:
    SolidStream(const Layout& layout_, const ReadFn& read_)
        : layout(layout_), read(read_), context(ZSTD_createDCtx()), in(ZSTD_DStreamInSize()),
          out(ZSTD_DStreamOutSize()), source(layout.data_offset) {}

    u64 Produced() const { return produced; }

    // Calls `sink` with what follows, in order, until `until` bytes have been produced in all.
    bool Next(u64 until, const std::function<bool(const u8* data, std::size_t size)>& sink) {
        if (!context) return false;
        until = std::min(until, layout.StreamSize());
        while (produced < until) {
            if (input.pos == input.size) {
                const std::size_t got = read(in.data(), in.size(), source);
                if (got == 0) return false;  // the stream ends before the NCA does
                source += got;
                input = {in.data(), got, 0};
            }
            ZSTD_outBuffer output{out.data(), out.size(), 0};
            if (ZSTD_isError(ZSTD_decompressStream(context.get(), &output, &input))) return false;
            if (output.pos == 0) continue;
            // A stream longer than the NCA: what is past its end is not the NCA's.
            const std::size_t part = static_cast<std::size_t>(std::min<u64>(output.pos, layout.StreamSize() - produced));
            if (part == 0) return false;
            // The piece may run past `until`: the caller keeps what it is given.
            if (!sink(out.data(), part)) return false;
            produced += part;
        }
        return true;
    }

private:
    const Layout& layout;
    const ReadFn& read;
    DCtxPtr context;
    std::vector<u8> in, out;
    u64 source, produced = 0;
    ZSTD_inBuffer input{nullptr, 0, 0};
};

// A solid NCZ from its start to its end, a piece at a time.
inline bool DecompressSolid(const Layout& layout, const ReadFn& read,
                            const std::function<bool(const u8* data, std::size_t size)>& sink) {
    SolidStream stream(layout, read);
    return stream.Next(layout.StreamSize(), sink) && stream.Produced() == layout.StreamSize();
}

// The whole plaintext of a solid NCZ, unpacked (UnpackFn: UnpackToFile, through the frontend).
using UnpackFn = std::function<std::unique_ptr<Plaintext>(const Layout&, const ReadFn&)>;

namespace Detail {
inline void PutLe64(u8* p, u64 value) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) p[i] = static_cast<u8>(value >> (8 * i));
}
inline u64 Fnv64(const u8* data, std::size_t size, u64 hash = 1469598103934665603ull) {
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) hash = (hash ^ data[i]) * 1099511628211ull;
    return hash;
}
// Writes what is buffered and makes it durable.
// All regenerable NCZ caches may live on writable console storage. Never
// follow a symlink into another app's data, and open new files exclusively.
inline std::FILE* OpenCacheFile(const std::string& path, int flags, const char* mode) {
    const int fd = ::open(path.c_str(), flags | O_NOFOLLOW, 0600);
    if (fd < 0) return nullptr;
    std::FILE* result = ::fdopen(fd, mode);
    if (!result) ::close(fd);
    return result;
}
inline bool Sync(std::FILE* file) {
    return std::fflush(file) == 0 && fsync(fileno(file)) == 0;
}
inline void SyncFolder(const std::string& path) {
    const auto slash = path.find_last_of('/');
    const int folder = open(slash == std::string::npos ? "." : path.substr(0, slash).c_str(), O_RDONLY);
    if (folder >= 0) {
        (void)fsync(folder);
        close(folder);
    }
}
} // namespace Detail

// An unpacked file ends with this and the plaintext's size: what was cut short (or lost in a power
// cut before it was written out) does not have it.
inline constexpr char kUnpackedMark[8] = {'E', 'D', 'E', 'N', 'N', 'C', 'Z', '1'};

// The plaintext of a solid NCZ unpacked to a file (UnpackToFile).
class FilePlaintext final : public Plaintext {
public:
    FilePlaintext(std::FILE* file_, u64 size_) : file(file_), size(size_) {}
    ~FilePlaintext() override { std::fclose(file); }
    bool Read(u8* data, std::size_t length, u64 offset) override {
        if (offset > size || length > size - offset) return false;
        if (fseeko(file, static_cast<off_t>(offset), SEEK_SET) != 0) return false;
        return std::fread(data, 1, length, file) == length;
    }

private:
    std::FILE* file;
    u64 size;
};

// An unpacked file made before, when it is there whole: of the plaintext's size and marked so.
inline std::unique_ptr<Plaintext> OpenUnpacked(const std::string& path, u64 size) {
    std::FILE* file = Detail::OpenCacheFile(path, O_RDONLY, "rb");
    if (!file) return nullptr;
    u8 mark[16];
    const bool whole = fseeko(file, 0, SEEK_END) == 0 && static_cast<u64>(ftello(file)) == size + sizeof(mark) &&
                       fseeko(file, static_cast<off_t>(size), SEEK_SET) == 0 &&
                       std::fread(mark, 1, sizeof(mark), file) == sizeof(mark) &&
                       std::memcmp(mark, kUnpackedMark, 8) == 0 && Detail::Le64(mark + 8) == size;
    if (!whole) {
        std::fclose(file);
        return nullptr;
    }
    return std::make_unique<FilePlaintext>(file, size);
}

// Unpacks a solid NCZ's plaintext to `path`: written as `path`.part, made durable and marked, and
// given its name only once it is whole. `progress` hears how much is done; `stop` ends it early.
inline std::unique_ptr<Plaintext> UnpackToFile(const Layout& layout, const ReadFn& read,
                                               const std::string& path, std::string* error,
                                               const std::function<void(u64 done, u64 total)>& progress = {},
                                               const std::function<bool()>& stop = {}) {
    const std::string part = path + ".part";
    std::FILE* out = Detail::OpenCacheFile(part, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_EXCL, "wb");
    if (!out) {
        if (error) *error = "cannot create " + part;
        return nullptr;
    }
    u64 written = 0, reported = 0;
    bool write_failed = false, stopped = false;
    bool done = DecompressSolid(layout, read, [&](const u8* piece, std::size_t size) {
        if (stop && stop()) {
            stopped = true;
            return false;
        }
        if (std::fwrite(piece, 1, size, out) != size) {
            write_failed = true;
            return false;
        }
        written += size;
        if (progress && written - reported >= (256ull << 20)) {
            reported = written;
            progress(written, layout.StreamSize());
        }
        return true;
    });
    if (done) {
        u8 mark[16];
        std::memcpy(mark, kUnpackedMark, 8);
        Detail::PutLe64(mark + 8, layout.StreamSize());
        write_failed = std::fwrite(mark, 1, sizeof(mark), out) != sizeof(mark) || !Detail::Sync(out);
        done = !write_failed;
    }
    const bool closed = std::fclose(out) == 0;
    if (!done || !closed || written != layout.StreamSize() || std::rename(part.c_str(), path.c_str()) != 0) {
        std::remove(part.c_str());
        if (error)
            *error = stopped               ? "stopped: the game was left"
                     : write_failed || done ? "cannot write " + part + " (is the console's storage full?)"
                                            : "its zstd stream is damaged or cut short";
        return nullptr;
    }
    Detail::SyncFolder(path);
    if (progress) progress(written, layout.StreamSize());
    return OpenUnpacked(path, layout.StreamSize());
}

// Pieces of a solid NCZ's plaintext a read found by decompressing up to it (SolidPlaintext), for
// every reader of that NCZ: those far into it in a file of their own when one is given, which
// later starts read again; the rest in memory (the most recently used, up to kMemoryLimit). One
// object per file: two writing one file would write over each other's pieces (ncz.cpp).
class SolidPieces {
public:
    static constexpr u64 kMemoryLimit = 32ull << 20;  // in memory
    static constexpr u64 kFileLimit = 16ull << 20;    // in its file: past it, new ones stay in memory
    static constexpr std::size_t kRecordHead = 32;    // "NCZPIECE", offset, size, FNV-1a of the data

    explicit SolidPieces(std::string path_ = {}) : path(std::move(path_)) { Load(); }
    ~SolidPieces() {
        if (file) std::fclose(file);
    }
    SolidPieces(const SolidPieces&) = delete;
    SolidPieces& operator=(const SolidPieces&) = delete;

    bool Find(u8* data, std::size_t size, u64 offset) {
        std::scoped_lock lock{guard};
        for (auto it = pieces.begin(); it != pieces.end(); ++it) {
            if (offset < it->offset || offset + size > it->offset + it->size) continue;
            if (!it->in_file) {
                std::memcpy(data, it->data.data() + (offset - it->offset), size);
                pieces.splice(pieces.end(), pieces, it);  // the most recently used last
                return true;
            }
            if (!it->checked && !Check(*it)) {
                pieces.erase(it);  // damaged on the storage: found again by decompressing
                return false;
            }
            return fseeko(file, static_cast<off_t>(it->at + (offset - it->offset)), SEEK_SET) == 0 &&
                   std::fread(data, 1, size, file) == size;
        }
        return false;
    }

    // `keep`: also in the file (a piece that is slow to find again), else in memory only.
    void Add(u64 offset, std::vector<u8> piece, bool keep = true) {
        std::scoped_lock lock{guard};
        if (keep && file && writable && end + kRecordHead + piece.size() <= kFileLimit) {
            u8 head[kRecordHead];
            std::memcpy(head, "NCZPIECE", 8);
            Detail::PutLe64(head + 8, offset);
            Detail::PutLe64(head + 16, piece.size());
            Detail::PutLe64(head + 24, Hash(offset, piece));
            if (fseeko(file, static_cast<off_t>(end), SEEK_SET) == 0 &&
                std::fwrite(head, 1, sizeof(head), file) == sizeof(head) &&
                std::fwrite(piece.data(), 1, piece.size(), file) == piece.size() && Detail::Sync(file)) {
                pieces.push_back({offset, piece.size(), end + kRecordHead, true, true, 0, {}});
                end += kRecordHead + piece.size();
                return;
            }
            // A file that cannot take more: what it holds stays, the rest is kept in memory.
            writable = false;
        }
        for (auto it = pieces.begin(); it != pieces.end();)
            it = !it->in_file && it->offset == offset ? (in_memory -= it->size, pieces.erase(it)) : std::next(it);
        in_memory += piece.size();
        pieces.push_back({offset, piece.size(), 0, false, true, 0, std::move(piece)});
        while (in_memory > kMemoryLimit) {
            auto oldest = std::find_if(pieces.begin(), pieces.end(), [](const Piece& p) { return !p.in_file; });
            if (oldest == std::prev(pieces.end())) break;  // never the one just added
            in_memory -= oldest->size;
            pieces.erase(oldest);
        }
    }

    // Held while one reader decompresses: another that wants the same then finds it here.
    std::mutex& Pass() { return pass; }

private:
    struct Piece {
        u64 offset, size, at;
        bool in_file, checked;
        u64 hash;
        std::vector<u8> data;
    };

    // A piece's checksum: FNV-1a of where it is and its data.
    static u64 Hash(u64 offset, const std::vector<u8>& data) {
        u8 where[16];
        Detail::PutLe64(where, offset);
        Detail::PutLe64(where + 8, data.size());
        return Detail::Fnv64(data.data(), data.size(), Detail::Fnv64(where, sizeof(where)));
    }

    // Whether a piece in the file still has the data it was written with (read once, on first use).
    bool Check(Piece& piece) {
        std::vector<u8> data(static_cast<std::size_t>(piece.size));
        piece.checked = fseeko(file, static_cast<off_t>(piece.at), SEEK_SET) == 0 &&
                        std::fread(data.data(), 1, data.size(), file) == data.size() &&
                        Hash(piece.offset, data) == piece.hash;
        return piece.checked;
    }

    // Reads where the file's pieces are (their data is checked when first used); one cut short
    // ends it there, and the next piece is written over it.
    void Load() {
        if (path.empty()) return;
        file = Detail::OpenCacheFile(path, O_RDWR, "r+b");
        if (!file) {
            file = Detail::OpenCacheFile(path, O_RDWR | O_CREAT | O_EXCL, "w+b");
            return;
        }
        if (fseeko(file, 0, SEEK_END) != 0) return;
        const u64 length = static_cast<u64>(ftello(file));
        u8 head[kRecordHead];
        while (end + kRecordHead <= length && fseeko(file, static_cast<off_t>(end), SEEK_SET) == 0 &&
               std::fread(head, 1, sizeof(head), file) == sizeof(head) && std::memcmp(head, "NCZPIECE", 8) == 0) {
            const u64 size = Detail::Le64(head + 16);
            if (size == 0 || size > kFileLimit || size > length - end - kRecordHead) break;
            pieces.push_back({Detail::Le64(head + 8), size, end + kRecordHead, true, false, Detail::Le64(head + 24), {}});
            end += kRecordHead + size;
        }
    }

    std::string path;
    std::FILE* file = nullptr;
    u64 end = 0, in_memory = 0;
    bool writable = true;
    std::list<Piece> pieces;
    std::mutex guard, pass;
};

struct SolidOptions {
    std::function<std::unique_ptr<Plaintext>()> unpacked;  // the copy unpacked before, if there is one
    UnpackFn unpack;                                        // unpacks it now
    std::function<bool()> may_unpack;                       // whether it may be unpacked now; empty: yes
    std::shared_ptr<SolidPieces> pieces;                    // empty: its own, in memory
};

class SolidPlaintext final : public Plaintext {
public:
    // What one decompression keeps: from a MiB before the read to 4 MiB after it (an update's two
    // patch tables lie together at the end of its data).
    static constexpr u64 kWindowBefore = 1ull << 20, kWindowAfter = 4ull << 20;
    static constexpr u64 kLargestPiece = kSmallSolid;

    SolidPlaintext(const Layout& layout_, ReadFn read_, SolidOptions options_)
        : layout(layout_), read(std::move(read_)), options(std::move(options_)) {
        if (!options.pieces) options.pieces = std::make_shared<SolidPieces>();
    }

    bool Read(u8* data, std::size_t size, u64 offset) override {
        if (whole) return whole->Read(data, size, offset);
        if (!looked) {
            looked = true;
            if (options.unpacked) whole = options.unpacked();
            if (whole) return whole->Read(data, size, offset);
        }
        if (options.pieces->Find(data, size, offset)) return true;
        if (!unpack_failed && options.unpack && layout.StreamSize() > kSmallSolid &&
            (!options.may_unpack || options.may_unpack())) {
            whole = options.unpack(layout, read);
            if (whole) return whole->Read(data, size, offset);
            unpack_failed = true;  // read as outside a game from now on
        }
        return ReadThroughStream(data, size, offset);
    }

private:
    // Decompresses from the start to past the read, keeping the window around it.
    bool ReadThroughStream(u8* data, std::size_t size, u64 offset) {
        std::scoped_lock pass{options.pieces->Pass()};
        if (options.pieces->Find(data, size, offset)) return true;
        const u64 from = offset > kWindowBefore ? offset - kWindowBefore : 0;
        const u64 to = std::min(layout.StreamSize(),
                                std::max({offset + size, offset + kWindowAfter, std::min(kSmallSolid, layout.StreamSize())}));
        if (offset + size > to) return false;
        std::vector<u8> window;
        window.reserve(static_cast<std::size_t>(to - from));
        u64 at = 0;
        SolidStream stream(layout, read);
        const bool done = stream.Next(to, [&](const u8* piece, std::size_t part) {
            const u64 piece_end = at + part;
            if (piece_end > from && at < to) {
                const u64 keep_from = std::max(at, from), keep_to = std::min(piece_end, to);
                window.insert(window.end(), piece + (keep_from - at), piece + (keep_to - at));
            }
            at = piece_end;
            return true;
        });
        if (!done || window.size() != to - from) return false;
        std::memcpy(data, window.data() + (offset - from), size);
        // A larger read (of much of the NCZ at once) is not kept: the pieces are for small reads.
        // Only those far into it go to the file: the start decompresses again in moments.
        if (window.size() <= kLargestPiece) options.pieces->Add(from, std::move(window), from >= kSmallSolid);
        return true;
    }

    const Layout& layout;
    ReadFn read;
    SolidOptions options;
    std::unique_ptr<Plaintext> whole;
    bool looked = false, unpack_failed = false;
};

// Encrypts `size` bytes in place for `section`, as AES-128-CTR; `offset` is the NCA offset of
// data[0] and a multiple of 16.
using EncryptFn = std::function<void(std::size_t section, u64 offset, u8* data, std::size_t size)>;

// The counter block for an NCA offset in a section (nsz's AESCTR): its counter's first 8 bytes,
// then offset / 16, big endian.
inline std::array<u8, 16> CounterFor(const Section& section, u64 offset) {
    std::array<u8, 16> iv{};
    std::memcpy(iv.data(), section.counter.data(), 8);
    u64 block = offset >> 4;
    for (int i = 15; i >= 8; --i) {
        iv[i] = static_cast<u8>(block);
        block >>= 8;
    }
    return iv;
}

// The NCA an NCZ was made from. Not thread safe: its owner serialises reads.
class Reader {
public:
    Reader(const Reader&) = delete;
    Reader& operator=(const Reader&) = delete;
    Reader(Layout layout_, ReadFn read_, EncryptFn encrypt_, SolidOptions solid = {})
        : layout(std::move(layout_)), read(std::move(read_)), encrypt(std::move(encrypt_)) {
        if (layout.block)
            plaintext = std::make_unique<BlockPlaintext>(layout, read);
        else
            plaintext = std::make_unique<SolidPlaintext>(layout, read, std::move(solid));
    }

    const Layout& GetLayout() const { return layout; }
    u64 Size() const { return layout.nca_size; }

    std::size_t Read(u8* data, std::size_t size, u64 offset) {
        if (offset >= layout.nca_size) return 0;
        size = static_cast<std::size_t>(std::min<u64>(size, layout.nca_size - offset));
        std::size_t done = 0;
        if (offset < kHeaderSize) {
            const std::size_t part = static_cast<std::size_t>(std::min<u64>(size, kHeaderSize - offset));
            if (!Detail::ReadExact(read, data, part, offset)) return 0;
            done = part;
        }
        if (done == size) return done;
        const u64 from = offset + done;
        if (!plaintext->Read(data + done, size - done, from - kHeaderSize)) return done;
        Encrypt(data + done, size - done, from);
        return size;
    }

private:
    // Encrypts the plaintext of [offset, offset + size) where its sections are encrypted.
    void Encrypt(u8* data, std::size_t size, u64 offset) {
        const u64 end = offset + size;
        auto section = std::upper_bound(layout.sections.begin(), layout.sections.end(), offset,
                                        [](u64 at, const Section& s) { return at < s.End(); });
        for (; section != layout.sections.end() && section->offset < end; ++section) {
            if (!section->Encrypted()) continue;
            u64 from = std::max(offset, section->offset);
            const u64 to = std::min(end, section->End());
            const std::size_t index = static_cast<std::size_t>(section - layout.sections.begin());
            if (const u64 within = from & 15; within != 0 && from < to) {
                std::array<u8, 16> block{};
                const std::size_t part = static_cast<std::size_t>(std::min<u64>(16 - within, to - from));
                std::memcpy(block.data() + within, data + (from - offset), part);
                encrypt(index, from - within, block.data(), block.size());
                std::memcpy(data + (from - offset), block.data() + within, part);
                from += part;
            }
            if (from < to) encrypt(index, from, data + (from - offset), static_cast<std::size_t>(to - from));
        }
    }

    Layout layout;
    ReadFn read;
    EncryptFn encrypt;
    std::unique_ptr<Plaintext> plaintext;
};
} // namespace Eden::Ncz

```

`headless/ncz_check.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright 2026 Oliv3rmoon
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Host check of headless/ncz.h (tools/check-ncz.py): NCAs made up here, packed as nsz packs them
// (block and solid), must read back byte for byte, wherever and however much is read.
#include "ncz.h"

#include <cassert>
#include <cctype>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <random>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include <openssl/evp.h>
#include <zstd.h>

using namespace Eden::Ncz;

namespace {
int failures = 0;
void Expect(bool ok, const std::string& what) {
    if (!ok) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: %s\n", what.c_str());
        ++failures;
    }
}

std::mt19937_64 rng(20261020);

std::vector<u8> Random(std::size_t size) {
    std::vector<u8> out(size);
    for (auto& b : out) b = static_cast<u8>(rng());
    return out;
}

// AES-128 of one block (ECB): the reference keystream is built from it by hand, not by CTR mode.
std::array<u8, 16> AesBlock(const std::array<u8, 16>& key, const std::array<u8, 16>& in) {
    EVP_CIPHER_CTX* context = EVP_CIPHER_CTX_new();
    std::array<u8, 16> out{};
    int length = 0;
    assert(EVP_EncryptInit_ex(context, EVP_aes_128_ecb(), nullptr, key.data(), nullptr) == 1);
    EVP_CIPHER_CTX_set_padding(context, 0);
    assert(EVP_EncryptUpdate(context, out.data(), &length, in.data(), 16) == 1 && length == 16);
    EVP_CIPHER_CTX_free(context);
    return out;
}

struct Spec {
    u64 offset, size, type;
};

struct Made {
    std::vector<u8> nca;        // what must be read back
    std::vector<u8> plaintext;  // the NCA from 0x4000, decrypted
    std::vector<Section> sections;
};

// An NCA of these sections: a random header, data partly random and partly runs of one byte (so
// some blocks compress and some do not), sections of type 3 and 4 encrypted as an NCA's are.
Made MakeNca(const std::vector<Spec>& specs) {
    Made made;
    const u64 end = specs.back().offset + specs.back().size;
    made.nca = Random(static_cast<std::size_t>(kHeaderSize));
    made.plaintext.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(end - kHeaderSize));
    for (std::size_t at = 0; at < made.plaintext.size();) {
        const std::size_t run = std::min<std::size_t>(made.plaintext.size() - at, 1 + rng() % 60000);
        const bool random = rng() % 2;
        const u8 fill = static_cast<u8>(rng());
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < run; ++i) made.plaintext[at + i] = random ? static_cast<u8>(rng()) : fill;
        at += run;
    }
    for (const Spec& spec : specs) {
        Section section;
        section.offset = spec.offset;
        section.size = spec.size;
        section.crypto_type = spec.type;
        const auto key = Random(16), counter = Random(16);
        std::copy(key.begin(), key.end(), section.key.begin());
        std::copy(counter.begin(), counter.end(), section.counter.begin());
        made.sections.push_back(section);
    }
    made.nca.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(end));
    for (u64 x = kHeaderSize; x < end; ++x) {
        u8 byte = made.plaintext[x - kHeaderSize];
        for (const Section& s : made.sections) {
            if (x < s.offset || x >= s.End() || !s.Encrypted()) continue;
            std::array<u8, 16> block{};
            std::copy(s.counter.begin(), s.counter.begin() + 8, block.begin());
            const u64 index = x / 16;
            for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) block[15 - i] = static_cast<u8>(index >> (8 * i));
            static std::array<u8, 16> last_in{}, last_out{};
            static const Section* last_section = nullptr;
            if (last_section != &s || last_in != block) {
                last_out = AesBlock(s.key, block);
                last_in = block;
                last_section = &s;
            }
            byte ^= last_out[x % 16];
        }
        made.nca[x] = byte;
    }
    return made;
}

void Put64(std::vector<u8>& out, u64 value) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) out.push_back(static_cast<u8>(value >> (8 * i)));
}
void Put32(std::vector<u8>& out, u32 value) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) out.push_back(static_cast<u8>(value >> (8 * i)));
}

std::vector<u8> SectionTable(const Made& made) {
    std::vector<u8> out(made.nca.begin(), made.nca.begin() + kHeaderSize);
    out.insert(out.end(), {'N', 'C', 'Z', 'S', 'E', 'C', 'T', 'N'});
    Put64(out, made.sections.size());
    for (const Section& s : made.sections) {
        Put64(out, s.offset);
        Put64(out, s.size);
        Put64(out, s.crypto_type);
        Put64(out, 0);
        out.insert(out.end(), s.key.begin(), s.key.end());
        out.insert(out.end(), s.counter.begin(), s.counter.end());
    }
    return out;
}

// As nsz -B: a block that does not compress smaller is stored as it is.
std::vector<u8> BlockNcz(const Made& made, unsigned exponent, unsigned* raw_blocks = nullptr) {
    std::vector<u8> out = SectionTable(made);
    const u64 block = u64{1} << exponent, total = made.plaintext.size();
    const u32 blocks = static_cast<u32>((total + block - 1) / block);
    out.insert(out.end(), {'N', 'C', 'Z', 'B', 'L', 'O', 'C', 'K', 2, 1, 0, static_cast<u8>(exponent)});
    Put32(out, blocks);
    Put64(out, total);
    std::vector<std::vector<u8>> data;
    for (u32 i = 0; i < blocks; ++i) {
        const u8* from = made.plaintext.data() + i * block;
        const std::size_t size = static_cast<std::size_t>(std::min(block, total - i * block));
        std::vector<u8> packed(ZSTD_compressBound(size));
        const std::size_t made_size = ZSTD_compress(packed.data(), packed.size(), from, size, 3);
        assert(!ZSTD_isError(made_size));
        if (made_size < size) {
            packed.resize(made_size);
        } else {
            packed.assign(from, from + size);
            if (raw_blocks) ++*raw_blocks;
        }
        Put32(out, static_cast<u32>(packed.size()));
        data.push_back(std::move(packed));
    }
    for (const auto& d : data) out.insert(out.end(), d.begin(), d.end());
    return out;
}

// As nsz -S: a zstd stream (written in pieces, as a streaming compressor does). `frames` > 1 cuts
// it into that many frames one after the other, and `trailing` bytes follow it.
std::vector<u8> SolidNcz(const Made& made, int frames = 1, std::size_t trailing = 0) {
    std::vector<u8> out = SectionTable(made);
    ZSTD_CCtx* context = ZSTD_createCCtx();
    std::vector<u8> buffer(ZSTD_CStreamOutSize());
    const std::size_t total = made.plaintext.size();
    for (int frame = 0; frame < frames; ++frame) {
        const std::size_t from = total * frame / frames, to = total * (frame + 1) / frames;
        ZSTD_inBuffer input{made.plaintext.data() + from, to - from, 0};
        for (;;) {
            ZSTD_outBuffer output{buffer.data(), buffer.size(), 0};
            const std::size_t left = ZSTD_compressStream2(context, &output, &input, ZSTD_e_end);
            assert(!ZSTD_isError(left));
            out.insert(out.end(), buffer.data(), buffer.data() + output.pos);
            if (left == 0) break;
        }
    }
    ZSTD_freeCCtx(context);
    const auto extra = Random(trailing);
    out.insert(out.end(), extra.begin(), extra.end());
    return out;
}

// NCZ_CHECK_EXPORT=<folder>: each case's NCZ and the NCA it must read as, for checking them
// against nsz's own decompressor.
void Export(const std::string& name, const std::vector<u8>& ncz, const std::vector<u8>& nca) {
    const char* folder = std::getenv("NCZ_CHECK_EXPORT");
    if (!folder) return;
    std::string file;
    for (const char c : name) file += std::isalnum(static_cast<unsigned char>(c)) ? c : '-';
    for (const auto& [suffix, data] : {std::pair{".ncz", &ncz}, std::pair{".nca", &nca}}) {
        std::FILE* out = std::fopen((std::string(folder) + "/" + file + suffix).c_str(), "wb");
        assert(out && std::fwrite(data->data(), 1, data->size(), out) == data->size());
        std::fclose(out);
    }
}

ReadFn Over(const std::vector<u8>& file) {
    return [&file](u8* data, std::size_t size, u64 offset) -> std::size_t {
        if (offset >= file.size()) return 0;
        const std::size_t part = static_cast<std::size_t>(std::min<u64>(size, file.size() - offset));
        // Never more than 100 KiB at once: callers must not assume one read is enough.
        const std::size_t given = std::min<std::size_t>(part, 100000);
        std::memcpy(data, file.data() + offset, given);
        return given;
    };
}

// What Eden's AESCipher does in ncz.cpp: AES-128-CTR from CounterFor.
EncryptFn Ctr(const Layout& layout) {
    return [&layout](std::size_t index, u64 offset, u8* data, std::size_t size) {
        assert(offset % 16 == 0);
        const Section& section = layout.sections[index];
        const auto iv = CounterFor(section, offset);
        EVP_CIPHER_CTX* context = EVP_CIPHER_CTX_new();
        int length = 0;
        assert(EVP_EncryptInit_ex(context, EVP_aes_128_ctr(), nullptr, section.key.data(), iv.data()) == 1);
        assert(EVP_EncryptUpdate(context, data, &length, data, static_cast<int>(size)) == 1);
        assert(static_cast<std::size_t>(length) == size);
        EVP_CIPHER_CTX_free(context);
    };
}

// Reads `reader` whole in pieces, then at random places and lengths, against `expected`.
void ReadsBack(Reader& reader, const std::vector<u8>& expected, const std::string& name, int random_reads = 1500) {
    Expect(reader.Size() == expected.size(), name + ": size");
    std::vector<u8> all(expected.size());
    for (std::size_t at = 0; at < all.size();) {
        const std::size_t want = std::min<std::size_t>(all.size() - at, 1 + rng() % 200000);
        const std::size_t got = reader.Read(all.data() + at, want, at);
        Expect(got == want, name + ": sequential read short at " + std::to_string(at));
        if (got != want) return;
        at += got;
    }
    Expect(all == expected, name + ": sequential bytes");
    for (int i = 0; i < random_reads; ++i) {
        u64 offset = rng() % expected.size();
        if (i % 7 == 0) offset = kHeaderSize - 1 - rng() % 40;  // across the header's end
        const std::size_t want = 1 + static_cast<std::size_t>(rng() % 70000);
        std::vector<u8> piece(want);
        const std::size_t got = reader.Read(piece.data(), want, offset);
        const std::size_t should = static_cast<std::size_t>(std::min<u64>(want, expected.size() - offset));
        Expect(got == should, name + ": random read size at " + std::to_string(offset));
        Expect(std::equal(piece.begin(), piece.begin() + should, expected.begin() + offset),
               name + ": random read bytes at " + std::to_string(offset));
        if (failures > 20) return;
    }
    u8 byte = 0;
    Expect(reader.Read(&byte, 1, expected.size()) == 0, name + ": nothing past the end");
}

void Block(const std::vector<Spec>& specs, unsigned exponent, const std::string& name) {
    const Made made = MakeNca(specs);
    unsigned raw = 0;
    const std::vector<u8> file = BlockNcz(made, exponent, &raw);
    Export(name, file, made.nca);
    std::string error;
    auto layout = ParseLayout(Over(file), file.size(), &error);
    Expect(layout.has_value(), name + ": parses (" + error + ")");
    if (!layout) return;
    Expect(layout->block && layout->block_exponent == exponent, name + ": is a block NCZ");
    Reader reader(*layout, Over(file), {});
    Reader encrypted(*layout, Over(file), Ctr(reader.GetLayout()));
    ReadsBack(encrypted, made.nca, name);
    std::printf("  %s: %zu bytes, %zu blocks (%u stored as they are), %zu sections\n", name.c_str(),
                made.nca.size(), layout->block_sizes.size(), raw, layout->sections.size());
}

std::string CheckPath(const std::string& name) { return std::string(std::getenv("NCZ_CHECK_DIR")) + "/" + name; }

bool Exists(const std::string& path) {
    std::FILE* file = std::fopen(path.c_str(), "rb");
    if (file) std::fclose(file);
    return file != nullptr;
}

// A solid NCZ in a game: read whole and at random places; one larger than kSmallSolid is unpacked
// once, and the unpacked copy is found again by the next reader.
void Solid(const std::vector<Spec>& specs, const std::string& name, bool expect_unpack, int frames = 1,
           std::size_t trailing = 0) {
    const Made made = MakeNca(specs);
    const std::vector<u8> file = SolidNcz(made, frames, trailing);
    Export(name, file, made.nca);
    std::string error;
    auto layout = ParseLayout(Over(file), file.size(), &error);
    Expect(layout.has_value() && !layout->block, name + ": parses as solid (" + error + ")");
    if (!layout) return;
    const std::string path = CheckPath(name + ".unpacked");
    int unpacks = 0;
    std::vector<std::pair<u64, u64>> progress;
    const auto options = [&] {
        return SolidOptions{[&] { return OpenUnpacked(path, layout->StreamSize()); },
                            [&](const Layout& l, const ReadFn& read) {
                                ++unpacks;
                                return UnpackToFile(l, read, path, &error, [&](u64 done, u64 total) {
                                    progress.emplace_back(done, total);
                                });
                            },
                            {}, {}};
    };
    {
        Reader encrypted(*layout, Over(file), Ctr(*layout), options());
        ReadsBack(encrypted, made.nca, name, 400);
        Expect(unpacks == (expect_unpack ? 1 : 0), name + ": unpacked " + std::to_string(unpacks) + " times");
    }
    if (expect_unpack) {
        Expect(!progress.empty() && progress.back().first == progress.back().second, name + ": progress reaches the end");
        Expect(!Exists(path + ".part"), name + ": no .part is left");
        Reader again(*layout, Over(file), Ctr(*layout), options());
        std::vector<u8> piece(4096);
        const u64 deep = made.nca.size() - 5000;
        Expect(again.Read(piece.data(), piece.size(), deep) == 4096 &&
                   std::equal(piece.begin(), piece.end(), made.nca.begin() + deep),
               name + ": the next reader reads the unpacked copy");
        Expect(unpacks == 1, name + ": the unpacked copy is not made again");
        Expect(OpenUnpacked(path, layout->StreamSize() + 1) == nullptr, name + ": a copy of another size is not used");
        std::remove(path.c_str());
    }
    std::printf("  %s: %zu bytes solid (%d frame(s), %zu trailing bytes), unpacked %d time(s)\n", name.c_str(),
                made.nca.size(), frames, trailing, unpacks);
}

// A solid NCZ outside a game (a library scan opening an update, or a game at its start): reads are
// found by decompressing up to them, the window around them serves the next ones, for every reader
// of the NCZ and, through the pieces file, for the next start of the app; nothing is unpacked. Once
// a game runs, a read unpacks it, and outside a game again the unpacked copy is read.
void OutsideAGame() {
    const Made made = MakeNca({{kHeaderSize, 30u << 20, 3}, {kHeaderSize + (30u << 20), 12u << 20, 4}});
    const std::vector<u8> file = SolidNcz(made);
    std::string error;
    auto layout = ParseLayout(Over(file), file.size(), &error);
    assert(layout && !layout->block);
    u64 read_bytes = 0;
    const ReadFn counted = [&](u8* data, std::size_t size, u64 offset) {
        const std::size_t got = Over(file)(data, size, offset);
        read_bytes += got;
        return got;
    };
    bool in_game = false;
    int unpacks = 0;
    const std::string unpacked = CheckPath("outside.unpacked"), pieces_file = CheckPath("outside.pieces");
    auto pieces = std::make_shared<SolidPieces>(pieces_file);
    const auto options = [&](std::shared_ptr<SolidPieces> shared) {
        return SolidOptions{[&] { return OpenUnpacked(unpacked, layout->StreamSize()); },
                            [&](const Layout& l, const ReadFn& read) {
                                ++unpacks;
                                return UnpackToFile(l, read, unpacked, &error);
                            },
                            [&] { return in_game; }, std::move(shared)};
    };
    const auto check = [&](Reader& reader, u64 offset, std::size_t size, const std::string& what) {
        std::vector<u8> piece(size);
        const bool ok = reader.Read(piece.data(), size, offset) == size &&
                        std::equal(piece.begin(), piece.end(), made.nca.begin() + offset);
        Expect(ok, what);
    };
    // The "patch tables": 64 KiB near the end of the second section, then 16 KiB after them.
    const u64 tables = made.nca.size() - (3u << 20);
    {
        Reader scan(*layout, counted, Ctr(*layout), options(pieces));
        check(scan, 0, static_cast<std::size_t>(kHeaderSize + 4096), "outside a game: the header and the start");
        check(scan, tables, 65536, "outside a game: a read near the end");
        const u64 after_first = read_bytes;
        Expect(after_first >= file.size() * 9 / 10, "outside a game: the read near the end decompressed up to it");
        check(scan, tables + 70000, 16384, "outside a game: the next read in the window");
        Expect(read_bytes == after_first, "outside a game: the window serves the next read");
    }
    {
        const u64 before = read_bytes;
        Reader again(*layout, counted, Ctr(*layout), options(pieces));
        check(again, tables + 1000, 4096, "outside a game: another reader of the NCZ");
        Expect(read_bytes == before, "outside a game: another reader uses the window too");
    }
    pieces.reset();
    {
        // The next start of the app: the pieces file holds what was found.
        const u64 before = read_bytes;
        Reader next_start(*layout, counted, Ctr(*layout), options(std::make_shared<SolidPieces>(pieces_file)));
        check(next_start, tables + 2000, 4096, "next start: a read near the end");
        Expect(read_bytes - before < 0x4000 + 8192, "next start: found in the pieces file, not decompressed again");
        // The start is not kept in the file: it decompresses again, and no further than 16 MiB.
        const u64 before_start = read_bytes;
        check(next_start, kHeaderSize + 100, 4096, "next start: a read at the start");
        Expect(read_bytes - before_start < file.size() / 2, "next start: the start decompresses no further than it needs");
        check(next_start, kHeaderSize + (20u << 20), 4096, "next start: a read outside the windows");
        Expect(unpacks == 0, "outside a game: nothing is unpacked");
    }
    {
        // A pieces file damaged on the storage: what it holds is found again by decompressing.
        std::FILE* damaged = std::fopen(pieces_file.c_str(), "r+b");
        assert(damaged);
        fseeko(damaged, 100, SEEK_SET);
        const int byte = std::fgetc(damaged);
        fseeko(damaged, 100, SEEK_SET);
        std::fputc(byte ^ 0x40, damaged);
        std::fclose(damaged);
        Reader after_damage(*layout, counted, Ctr(*layout), options(std::make_shared<SolidPieces>(pieces_file)));
        check(after_damage, kHeaderSize + 50, 4096, "a damaged pieces file: still read right");
        check(after_damage, tables + 3000, 4096, "a damaged pieces file: other pieces still read right");
    }
    {
        // A piece whose place in the NCZ is damaged (its record's offset): not read at the wrong place.
        std::remove(pieces_file.c_str());
        {
            Reader fresh(*layout, counted, Ctr(*layout), options(std::make_shared<SolidPieces>(pieces_file)));
            check(fresh, tables, 4096, "a fresh pieces file");
        }
        std::FILE* damaged = std::fopen(pieces_file.c_str(), "r+b");
        assert(damaged);
        u8 head[16];
        assert(std::fread(head, 1, 16, damaged) == 16 && std::memcmp(head, "NCZPIECE", 8) == 0);
        u64 offset = 0;
        for (int i = 7; i >= 0; --i) offset = (offset << 8) | head[8 + i];
        const u64 moved = offset - (256u << 10);
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) head[8 + i] = static_cast<u8>(moved >> (8 * i));
        fseeko(damaged, 0, SEEK_SET);
        std::fwrite(head, 1, 16, damaged);
        std::fclose(damaged);
        Reader moved_piece(*layout, counted, Ctr(*layout), options(std::make_shared<SolidPieces>(pieces_file)));
        check(moved_piece, kHeaderSize + moved + 1000, 4096, "a piece with a damaged offset: read right");
    }
    {
        Reader game(*layout, counted, Ctr(*layout), options(std::make_shared<SolidPieces>(pieces_file)));
        in_game = true;
        check(game, kHeaderSize + (25u << 20), 4096, "in a game: a read");
        Expect(unpacks == 1, "in a game: it is unpacked once");
        check(game, kHeaderSize + (2u << 20), 100000, "in a game: then read from the unpacked copy");
    }
    {
        in_game = false;
        const u64 before = read_bytes;
        Reader after(*layout, counted, Ctr(*layout), options(std::make_shared<SolidPieces>(pieces_file)));
        check(after, kHeaderSize + (15u << 20), 4096, "outside a game again: a read anywhere");
        Expect(read_bytes - before < 0x4000 + 8192, "outside a game again: from the unpacked copy");
        Expect(unpacks == 1, "outside a game again: not unpacked again");
    }
    {
        // An unpack stopped (the game was left) leaves nothing, and says why.
        std::remove(unpacked.c_str());
        const std::string stopped = CheckPath("stopped.unpacked");
        int pieces_seen = 0;
        auto none = UnpackToFile(*layout, Over(file), stopped, &error, {}, [&] { return ++pieces_seen > 20; });
        Expect(!none && !Exists(stopped) && !Exists(stopped + ".part"), "a stopped unpack leaves no file");
        Expect(error.find("stopped") != std::string::npos, "a stopped unpack says so: " + error);
    }
    {
        // A copy without its mark (cut short by a power cut) is not used.
        std::FILE* out = std::fopen(unpacked.c_str(), "wb");
        std::vector<u8> zeros(static_cast<std::size_t>(layout->StreamSize()) + 16);
        std::fwrite(zeros.data(), 1, zeros.size(), out);
        std::fclose(out);
        Expect(OpenUnpacked(unpacked, layout->StreamSize()) == nullptr, "a copy without its mark is not used");
        std::remove(unpacked.c_str());
    }
    std::remove(pieces_file.c_str());
    std::puts("  outside a game: found without unpacking, shared and kept for the next start; unpacked once in a "
              "game and read from then on");
}

void Damaged() {
    const Made made = MakeNca({{kHeaderSize, 300000, 3}, {kHeaderSize + 300000, 200000, 1}});
    const std::vector<u8> good = BlockNcz(made, 14);
    std::string error;
    const auto rejects = [&](std::vector<u8> file, const std::string& what) {
        Expect(!ParseLayout(Over(file), file.size(), &error).has_value(), "rejects " + what);
        Expect(!error.empty(), what + " says why");
    };
    {
        auto file = good;
        file[kHeaderSize] = 'X';
        rejects(file, "a file without NCZSECTN");
    }
    {
        auto file = good;
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) file[kHeaderSize + 8 + i] = 0;
        rejects(file, "no sections");
    }
    {
        auto file = good;
        file[kHeaderSize + 16 + kSectionEntrySize] ^= 0x10;  // the second section's offset
        rejects(file, "sections with a gap");
    }
    {
        auto file = good;
        const std::size_t block_head = kHeaderSize + 16 + 2 * kSectionEntrySize;
        file[block_head + 11] = 13;
        rejects(file, "a block size under 2^14");
        file[block_head + 11] = 27;
        rejects(file, "a block size over 64 MiB");
        file = good;
        file[block_head + 12] ^= 1;
        rejects(file, "a wrong block count");
        file = good;
        file[block_head + 16] ^= 1;
        rejects(file, "a wrong decompressed size");
    }
    rejects(std::vector<u8>(good.begin(), good.begin() + kHeaderSize + 40), "a cut-short section table");
    rejects(std::vector<u8>(good.begin(), good.end() - 1), "blocks cut short");
    rejects(std::vector<u8>(100, 0), "a tiny file");
    {
        // A block whose zstd data is damaged: the header still reads, the data does not.
        auto file = good;
        auto layout = ParseLayout(Over(file), file.size(), &error);
        assert(layout);
        std::size_t compressed = 0;
        while (layout->block_sizes[compressed] >= layout->BlockSize()) ++compressed;
        for (u32 i = 0; i < layout->block_sizes[compressed]; ++i) file[layout->block_offsets[compressed] + i] ^= 0x5a;
        Reader reader(*layout, Over(file), Ctr(*layout));
        std::vector<u8> piece(100);
        Expect(reader.Read(piece.data(), 100, 0) == 100, "a damaged block leaves the header readable");
        const u64 inside = kHeaderSize + compressed * layout->BlockSize();
        Expect(reader.Read(piece.data(), 100, inside) == 0, "a damaged block reads as nothing");
    }
    {
        // A solid stream cut short: the start reads, past the cut nothing does (neither by unpacking
        // nor by decompressing), and no file stays.
        const Made big = MakeNca({{kHeaderSize, 40u << 20, 3}});
        auto file = SolidNcz(big);
        file.resize(file.size() / 2);
        auto layout = ParseLayout(Over(file), file.size(), &error);
        assert(layout && !layout->block);
        const std::string path = CheckPath("cut.unpacked");
        Reader reader(*layout, Over(file), Ctr(*layout),
                      SolidOptions{{}, [&](const Layout& l, const ReadFn& read) { return UnpackToFile(l, read, path, &error); },
                                   [] { return false; }, {}});
        std::vector<u8> piece(100);
        Expect(reader.Read(piece.data(), 100, kHeaderSize + 1000) == 100, "a cut-short stream reads at its start");
        Reader in_game(*layout, Over(file), Ctr(*layout),
                       SolidOptions{{}, [&](const Layout& l, const ReadFn& read) { return UnpackToFile(l, read, path, &error); },
                                    {}, {}});
        Expect(in_game.Read(piece.data(), 100, big.nca.size() - 200) == 0, "a cut-short stream reads nothing past the cut");
        Expect(error.find("damaged") != std::string::npos, "a cut-short stream says so: " + error);
        Expect(!Exists(path) && !Exists(path + ".part"), "a cut-short stream leaves no file");
    }
    {
        // An unpack that cannot write (the storage is full): it is tried once and says why, and the
        // NCZ is then read without unpacking, right.
        const Made big = MakeNca({{kHeaderSize, 40u << 20, 3}});
        const auto file = SolidNcz(big);
        auto layout = ParseLayout(Over(file), file.size(), &error);
        int tries = 0;
        Reader reader(*layout, Over(file), Ctr(*layout), SolidOptions{{}, [&](const Layout& l, const ReadFn& read) {
                                                               ++tries;
                                                               return UnpackToFile(l, read, "/nonexistent-ncz-folder/x", &error);
                                                           }, {}, {}});
        std::vector<u8> piece(100);
        for (const u64 at : {u64{big.nca.size() - 200}, kHeaderSize + 10, u64{big.nca.size() / 2}})
            Expect(reader.Read(piece.data(), 100, at) == 100 && std::equal(piece.begin(), piece.end(), big.nca.begin() + at),
                   "an unwritable unpack: read without it at " + std::to_string(at));
        Expect(tries == 1, "an unwritable unpack is tried once");
        Expect(error.find("cannot create") != std::string::npos, "an unwritable unpack says so: " + error);
    }
}
// Cache files may be on writable console storage even when the runtime has
// elevated filesystem access. Existing symlinks must never be dereferenced
// for unpacked copies, compressed-pieces files or partial unpack writes.
void RejectSymlinkCache() {
    const std::string protected_file = CheckPath("protected-file");
    {
        std::FILE* out = std::fopen(protected_file.c_str(), "wb");
        assert(out && std::fwrite("PROTECTED", 1, 9, out) == 9);
        std::fclose(out);
    }
    const std::string unpacked = CheckPath("evil.unpacked");
    const std::string part = unpacked + ".part";
    const std::string pieces = CheckPath("evil.pieces");
    for (const auto& path : {unpacked, part, pieces}) {
        std::remove(path.c_str());
        Expect(::symlink(protected_file.c_str(), path.c_str()) == 0,
               "create hostile NCZ cache symlink");
    }
    Expect(Detail::OpenCacheFile(unpacked, O_RDONLY, "rb") == nullptr,
           "unpacked copy must not follow a symlink");
    Expect(Detail::OpenCacheFile(pieces, O_RDWR, "r+b") == nullptr,
           "pieces file must not follow a symlink");
    {
        SolidPieces ignored(pieces);
        (void)ignored;
    }
    Layout fake;
    fake.nca_size = kHeaderSize + 512;
    std::string error;
    const auto no_data = [](u8*, std::size_t, u64) -> std::size_t { return 0; };
    Expect(UnpackToFile(fake, no_data, unpacked, &error) == nullptr,
           "unpack must not follow or overwrite existing .part");
    Expect(error.find("cannot create") != std::string::npos,
           "unsafe cache path rejected before decompression");
    {
        std::FILE* in = std::fopen(protected_file.c_str(), "rb");
        char data[10]{};
        Expect(in && std::fread(data, 1, 9, in) == 9 &&
                   std::memcmp(data, "PROTECTED", 9) == 0,
               "hostile symlinks never damage another file");
        if (in) std::fclose(in);
    }
    for (const auto& path : {unpacked, part, pieces}) std::remove(path.c_str());
    std::remove(protected_file.c_str());
}

} // namespace

int main() {
    // The counter nsz's AESCTR uses: the section counter's first 8 bytes, then offset / 16.
    Section section;
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; ++i) section.counter[i] = static_cast<u8>(0xa0 + i);
    const auto iv = CounterFor(section, 0x123456789abcdef0ull);
    const std::array<u8, 16> expected_iv{0xa0, 0xa1, 0xa2, 0xa3, 0xa4, 0xa5, 0xa6, 0xa7,
                                         0x01, 0x23, 0x45, 0x67, 0x89, 0xab, 0xcd, 0xef};
    Expect(iv == expected_iv, "counter block");

    std::puts("Block NCZs:");
    Block({{kHeaderSize, 1u << 20, 3}}, 14, "one CTR section, whole blocks");
    Block({{kHeaderSize, 300001, 3}, {kHeaderSize + 300001, 123457, 1}, {kHeaderSize + 423458, 777777, 4}}, 14,
          "CTR, plain and BKTR sections, a short last block");
    Block({{0xC00, 0x4000 - 0xC00 + 500000, 3}, {0x4000 + 500000, 65536, 3}}, 16,
          "a first section that starts inside the header");
    Block({{0x4200, 400000, 3}}, 15, "data before the first section");
    Block({{kHeaderSize, 5000, 3}}, 20, "one block smaller than its block size");
    std::vector<Spec> many;
    for (u64 at = kHeaderSize, i = 0; i < 300; ++i) {
        const u64 size = 1 + rng() % 9000;
        many.push_back({at, size, i % 3 == 1 ? 1u : 3u});
        at += size;
    }
    Block(many, 14, "300 sections (a split BKTR)");

    std::puts("Solid NCZs:");
    Solid({{kHeaderSize, 3u << 20, 3}}, "solid-small", false);
    Solid({{kHeaderSize, 6u << 20, 3}, {kHeaderSize + (6u << 20), 6u << 20, 1}}, "solid-in-one-window", false, 3, 1000);
    Solid({{kHeaderSize, 20u << 20, 3}, {kHeaderSize + (20u << 20), 20u << 20, 4}}, "solid-unpacked", true);
    Solid({{kHeaderSize, 12u << 20, 3}, {kHeaderSize + (12u << 20), 12u << 20, 4}}, "solid-frames-unpacked", true, 4, 777);

    OutsideAGame();

    std::puts("Damaged files:");
    Damaged();

    std::puts("Cache symlink safety:");
    RejectSymlinkCache();

    if (failures) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "%d failure(s)\n", failures);
        return 1;
    }
    std::puts("NCZ: PASS");
    return 0;
}
```

`headless/ncz_vfs.h`:

```h
// SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright 2026 Oliv3rmoon
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// NSZ and XCZ: an NSP or XCI whose larger NCAs nsz compressed into NCZ files. Eden finds a .ncz
// where it looks for a .nca (FileSys::NSP, FileSys::XCI; headless/CMakeLists.txt) and reads the
// NCA it was made from through Open (ncz.cpp, on headless/ncz.h).
#pragma once
#include <functional>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "core/file_sys/vfs/vfs_types.h"

namespace Eden::Ncz {
// The NCA an NCZ file holds, named as it was (<id>.nca); nullptr when `file` is null or is not an
// NCZ this can read (the log says why).
FileSys::VirtualFile Open(FileSys::VirtualFile file);

// Whether a solid NCZ may be unpacked now: while a game runs (the frontend says when, and that a
// new game starts). An unpack under way stops when it may not. Outside a game, a read
// decompresses it up to the read and keeps a few MiB around it, in a .pieces file beside the
// unpacked ones for later starts.
void SetUnpackAllowed(bool allowed);

// Where solid NCZs are unpacked to, and what removes files there: it is given which names to
// keep. The NCZ side asks it to remove an unpack cut short (*.part) at once, and the other games'
// unpacked copies before it unpacks one. The frontend sets it; until it does, a solid NCZ is never
// unpacked.
void SetUnpackFolder(std::string folder,
                     std::function<void(const std::function<bool(const std::string&)>& keep)> clear);
} // namespace Eden::Ncz
```
