`headless/network_audit.c`:

```c
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Detailed-logging-only, bounded, buffered audit of network *API* events.
// This does not intercept, reroute, override or configure any system DNS.
#include "network_audit.h"
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>

enum { MAX_PATH=768, MAX_LOG=4*1024*1024, BUFFER_SIZE=32768 };
static pthread_mutex_t audit_mutex = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static atomic_int audit_enabled = ATOMIC_VAR_INIT(0);
static char audit_path[MAX_PATH], audit_old[MAX_PATH + 12];
static char audit_buffer[BUFFER_SIZE];
static FILE* audit_file;
static unsigned long long audit_bytes;
static unsigned audit_line_count;
// Repeated guest DNS refusals must not serialize thousands of identical writes
// through this diagnostic logger. The network policy executes independently,
// before this call; only the *audit* of duplicate denied requests is folded.
// Exact events and all accepted native/guest packets retain their usual logs.
static atomic_uint_fast64_t denied_epoch_hash = ATOMIC_VAR_INIT(0);
static atomic_ullong denied_suppressed = ATOMIC_VAR_INIT(0);

// Only on the optional audit writer. Existing Unix epoch stays for backwards
// compatibility; UTC is human-readable and mono_ns correlates with native
// CPU/GPU clocks. Never read either clock when Detailed Logging is OFF.
static void audit_timestamp(char utc[32], long long* epoch, long long* mono_ns) {
    struct timespec real = {0, 0};
    struct timespec mono = {0, 0};
    if (clock_gettime(CLOCK_REALTIME, &real) != 0)
        real.tv_sec = time(NULL);
    const int monotonic_ok = clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &mono) == 0;
    *epoch = (long long)real.tv_sec;
    *mono_ns = monotonic_ok ?
        (long long)mono.tv_sec * 1000000000LL + (long long)mono.tv_nsec : -1LL;
    struct tm converted = {0};
    if (gmtime_r(&real.tv_sec, &converted)) {
        (void)snprintf(utc, 32, "%04d-%02d-%02dT%02d:%02d:%02d.%03ldZ",
            converted.tm_year + 1900, converted.tm_mon + 1, converted.tm_mday,
            converted.tm_hour, converted.tm_min, converted.tm_sec,
            real.tv_nsec / 1000000L);
    } else {
        (void)snprintf(utc, 32, "unknown");
    }
}


static void flush_denied_summary_locked(void) {
    const unsigned long long skipped = atomic_exchange_explicit(
        &denied_suppressed, 0, memory_order_relaxed);
    if (!audit_file || !skipped) return;
    char utc[32];
    long long epoch = 0, mono_ns = -1;
    audit_timestamp(utc, &epoch, &mono_ns);
    // A summary records the time it was flushed, NOT a fabricated original
    // timestamp for each suppressed denial. Keep the same schema as events.
    const int count = fprintf(audit_file,
        "epoch=%lld utc=%s mono_ns=%lld scope=guest event=dns-denied-summary target=aggregated bytes=0 status=0 count=%llu\n",
        epoch, utc, mono_ns, skipped);
    if (count > 0) audit_bytes += (unsigned)count;
}

static uint32_t audit_host_hash(const char* host, int status) {
    uint32_t h = UINT32_C(2166136261) ^ (uint32_t)status;
    for (const unsigned char* p=(const unsigned char*)host; *p; ++p)
        h = (h ^ *p) * UINT32_C(16777619);
    return h;
}

static void close_locked(void) {
    if (audit_file) {
        flush_denied_summary_locked();
        (void)fflush(audit_file);
        (void)fclose(audit_file);
        audit_file = NULL;
    }
    audit_bytes=0;
    audit_line_count=0;
}
static void open_locked(void) {
    if (!audit_path[0] || audit_file) return;
    // Before opening a new file, roll over stale logs from past sessions.
    FILE* existing=fopen(audit_path,"rb");
    long old_size=0;
    if (existing) {
        if (!fseek(existing,0,SEEK_END)) old_size=ftell(existing);
        fclose(existing);
    }
    if (old_size < 0) old_size=0;
    if (old_size >= MAX_LOG) {
        (void)remove(audit_old);
        (void)rename(audit_path,audit_old);
        old_size=0;
    }
    audit_file=fopen(audit_path,"ab");
    if (audit_file) {
        (void)setvbuf(audit_file,audit_buffer,_IOFBF,sizeof(audit_buffer));
        audit_bytes=(unsigned long long)old_size;
    }
}
int eden_network_audit_init(const char* path, int detailed) {
    if (!path) return -1;
    const size_t n=strlen(path);
    if (!n || n+6 >= sizeof(audit_path)) return -1;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&audit_mutex);
    if (audit_path[0]) { pthread_mutex_unlock(&audit_mutex); return -1; }
    memcpy(audit_path,path,n+1);
    snprintf(audit_old,sizeof(audit_old),"%s.prev",path);
    // No normal log file when Detailed Logging is OFF. Keep separate crash-*.
    if (!detailed) { (void)remove(audit_path); (void)remove(audit_old); }
    atomic_store_explicit(&audit_enabled,detailed!=0,memory_order_release);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&audit_mutex);
    return 0;
}
int eden_network_audit_active(void) {
    return atomic_load_explicit(&audit_enabled,memory_order_relaxed);
}
void eden_network_audit_enable(int detailed) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&audit_mutex);
    if (!detailed) atomic_store_explicit(&audit_enabled,0,memory_order_release);
    if (!detailed) close_locked();
    if (detailed && audit_path[0])
        atomic_store_explicit(&audit_enabled,1,memory_order_release);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&audit_mutex);
}
static void safe_token(const char* s, char* out, size_t n) {
    size_t i=0;
    if (!s) s="-";
    for (;*s && i+1<n;++s) {
        const unsigned char c=(unsigned char)*s;
        out[i++]=(c>=33 && c<=126 && c!='"' && c!='\\') ? (char)c : '_';
    }
    out[i]=0;
}
void eden_network_audit_event(const char* scope, const char* event,
                              const char* target, unsigned long long bytes,
                              int status) {
    if (!atomic_load_explicit(&audit_enabled,memory_order_acquire)) return;
    if (scope && event && target && strcmp(scope,"guest")==0 &&
        strcmp(event,"dns-denied")==0) {
        const uint64_t key = ((uint64_t)(uint32_t)time(NULL) << 32) |
                             audit_host_hash(target,status);
        // Lock-free common path: at most one verbatim identical denial per
        // second per dominant domain. Hash collisions affect only diagnostic
        // compression, never actual DNS answers or domain-policy matches.
        if (atomic_exchange_explicit(&denied_epoch_hash, key,
                                     memory_order_relaxed) == key) {
            atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&denied_suppressed, 1,
                                      memory_order_relaxed);
            return;
        }
    }
    pthread_mutex_lock(&audit_mutex);
    if (!atomic_load_explicit(&audit_enabled,memory_order_relaxed)) {
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&audit_mutex);
        return;
    }
    open_locked();
    if (audit_file) {
        flush_denied_summary_locked();
        char sc[24],kind[28],dst[256];
        safe_token(scope,sc,sizeof(sc));
        safe_token(event,kind,sizeof(kind));
        safe_token(target,dst,sizeof(dst));
        char utc[32];
        long long epoch = 0, mono_ns = -1;
        audit_timestamp(utc, &epoch, &mono_ns);
        const int count=fprintf(audit_file,
            "epoch=%lld utc=%s mono_ns=%lld scope=%s event=%s target=%s bytes=%llu status=%d\n",
            epoch,utc,mono_ns,sc,kind,dst,bytes,status);
        if (count > 0) audit_bytes+=(unsigned)count;
        if (++audit_line_count >= 64) {
            // Buffer output: periodic fflush for forensic usefulness; no
            // fsync-per-packet and no quiet-mode cost.
            (void)fflush(audit_file);
            audit_line_count=0;
        }
        if (audit_bytes >= MAX_LOG) {
            close_locked();
            (void)remove(audit_old);
            (void)rename(audit_path,audit_old);
        }
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&audit_mutex);
}
```

`headless/network_audit_sockets.c`:

```c
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// PS5 process-local POSIX BSD socket observation only. Never changes DNS,
// SceNet configuration, arguments, return values or observed errno.
#include "network_audit.h"
#include <arpa/inet.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <netinet/in.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <sys/socket.h>
#include <sys/types.h>

extern int __real_connect(int, const struct sockaddr*, socklen_t);
extern ssize_t __real_send(int, const void*, size_t, int);
extern ssize_t __real_sendto(int, const void*, size_t, int,
                            const struct sockaddr*, socklen_t);
extern ssize_t __real_recv(int, void*, size_t, int);
extern ssize_t __real_recvfrom(int, void*, size_t, int,
                              struct sockaddr*, socklen_t*);

static void socket_target(int fd, const struct sockaddr* addr, socklen_t length,
                          char* output, size_t cap) {
    const struct sockaddr* peer=addr;
    struct sockaddr_storage storage;
    socklen_t plen=sizeof(storage);
    if (!peer && getpeername(fd,(struct sockaddr*)&storage,&plen)==0) {
        peer=(const struct sockaddr*)&storage;
        length=plen;
    }
    if (peer && peer->sa_family==AF_INET && length>=sizeof(struct sockaddr_in)) {
        const struct sockaddr_in* in=(const struct sockaddr_in*)peer;
        char ip[INET_ADDRSTRLEN];
        if (inet_ntop(AF_INET,&in->sin_addr,ip,sizeof(ip))) {
            (void)snprintf(output,cap,"%s:%u",ip,(unsigned)ntohs(in->sin_port));
            return;
        }
    }
    (void)snprintf(output,cap,"fd:%d",fd);
}
int __wrap_connect(int fd, const struct sockaddr* addr, socklen_t length) {
    const int ret=__real_connect(fd,addr,length);
    const int saved=errno;
    if (eden_network_audit_active() && (ret==0 || saved==EINPROGRESS)) {
        char target[80]; socket_target(fd,addr,length,target,sizeof(target));
        eden_network_audit_event("native","connect",target,0,ret==0?0:EINPROGRESS);
    }
    errno=saved;
    return ret;
}
ssize_t __wrap_send(int fd, const void* buffer, size_t length, int flags) {
    const ssize_t ret=__real_send(fd,buffer,length,flags);
    const int saved=errno;
    if (ret>0 && eden_network_audit_active()) {
        char target[80]; socket_target(fd,NULL,0,target,sizeof(target));
        eden_network_audit_event("native","tx",target,(unsigned long long)ret,0);
    }
    errno=saved;
    return ret;
}
ssize_t __wrap_sendto(int fd, const void* buffer, size_t length, int flags,
                      const struct sockaddr* addr, socklen_t addr_len) {
    const ssize_t ret=__real_sendto(fd,buffer,length,flags,addr,addr_len);
    const int saved=errno;
    if (ret>0 && eden_network_audit_active()) {
        char target[80]; socket_target(fd,addr,addr_len,target,sizeof(target));
        eden_network_audit_event("native","tx",target,(unsigned long long)ret,0);
    }
    errno=saved;
    return ret;
}
ssize_t __wrap_recv(int fd, void* buffer, size_t length, int flags) {
    const ssize_t ret=__real_recv(fd,buffer,length,flags);
    const int saved=errno;
    if (ret>0 && eden_network_audit_active()) {
        char target[80]; socket_target(fd,NULL,0,target,sizeof(target));
        eden_network_audit_event("native","rx",target,(unsigned long long)ret,0);
    }
    errno=saved;
    return ret;
}
ssize_t __wrap_recvfrom(int fd, void* buffer, size_t length, int flags,
                        struct sockaddr* addr, socklen_t* addr_len) {
    const ssize_t ret=__real_recvfrom(fd,buffer,length,flags,addr,addr_len);
    const int saved=errno;
    if (ret>0 && eden_network_audit_active()) {
        char target[80];
        socket_target(fd,addr,addr && addr_len ? *addr_len : 0,target,sizeof(target));
        eden_network_audit_event("native","rx",target,(unsigned long long)ret,0);
    }
    errno=saved;
    return ret;
}
```

`headless/network_domain_rules.c`:

```c
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Small C11 immutable runtime policy: no heap allocation, DNS, sockets or
// logging on the per-lookup path. Caller loads once before network startup.
#include "network_domain_rules.h"
#include <ctype.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

enum { MAX_RULES = 512, MAX_NAME = 255 };
static char rules[MAX_RULES][MAX_NAME + 1];
static unsigned rule_count;
static atomic_int ready = ATOMIC_VAR_INIT(0);

static int is_valid_name(const char* name, int wildcard) {
    size_t label = 0;
    for (const unsigned char* p = (const unsigned char*)name; *p; ++p) {
        const unsigned char c = *p;
        if (c == '.') {
            if (!label) return 0;
            label = 0;
        } else if ((c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') || (c >= '0' && c <= '9') ||
                   c == '-' || (wildcard && c == '*')) {
            ++label;
        } else {
            return 0;
        }
    }
    return label != 0;
}

static int canonical_name(const char* raw, char* output, int wildcard) {
    if (!raw) return 0;
    size_t n = 0;
    while (*raw && n <= MAX_NAME) {
        const unsigned char c = (unsigned char)*raw++;
        // Accept escaped dots in supplied host rules (gw\\.hac...) as '.'.
        if (wildcard && c == '\\' && *raw == '.') {
            ++raw;
            output[n++] = '.';
        } else if (c < 128) {
            output[n++] = (char)tolower(c);
        } else {
            return 0;
        }
    }
    if (n > MAX_NAME || *raw) return 0;
    if (n && output[n-1] == '.') --n; // absolute DNS name with final dot
    output[n] = '\0';
    return n && is_valid_name(output, wildcard);
}

// Anchored glob: '*' is zero or more characters INSIDE a single DNS label.
// Iterate hostname suffixes separately to grant implicit subdomain matching.
static int glob_label_safe(const char* host, const char* pattern) {
    const char* star = NULL;
    const char* retry = NULL;
    while (*host) {
        if (*pattern == '*') {
            star = pattern++;
            retry = host;
        } else if (*pattern == *host) {
            ++pattern;
            ++host;
        } else if (star && *retry && *retry != '.') {
            pattern = star + 1;
            host = ++retry;
        } else {
            return 0;
        }
    }
    while (*pattern == '*') ++pattern;
    return *pattern == '\0';
}

int eden_network_filter_load(const char* path) {
    // Never silently replace an in-use immutable table.
    if (atomic_load_explicit(&ready, memory_order_acquire)) return -1;
    if (!path) return -1;
    FILE* f = fopen(path, "rb");
    if (!f) return -1;
    unsigned count = 0;
    char line[512];
    int valid = 1;
    while (fgets(line, sizeof(line), f)) {
        if (!strchr(line, '\n') && !feof(f)) { valid = 0; break; }
        char* p = line;
        while (*p == ' ' || *p == '\t') ++p;
        if (!*p || *p == '#' || *p == '\r' || *p == '\n') continue;
        char* end = p;
        while (*end && *end != '#' && *end != '\n' && *end != '\r' &&
               *end != ' ' && *end != '\t') ++end;
        *end = '\0';
        if (count >= MAX_RULES || !canonical_name(p, rules[count], 1)) {
            valid = 0;
            break;
        }
        ++count;
    }
    if (ferror(f)) valid = 0;
    fclose(f);
    if (!valid || !count) { rule_count = 0; return -1; }
    rule_count = count;
    atomic_store_explicit(&ready, 1, memory_order_release);
    return 0;
}

unsigned eden_network_filter_count(void) {
    return atomic_load_explicit(&ready, memory_order_acquire) ? rule_count : 0;
}

int eden_network_host_blocked(const char* host) {
    // Even failure to read the packaged list must never bypass the policy.
    if (!atomic_load_explicit(&ready, memory_order_acquire)) return 1;
    char canonical[MAX_NAME + 1];
    if (!canonical_name(host, canonical, 0)) return 1;
    for (const char* suffix = canonical; ; ) {
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < rule_count; ++i)
            if (glob_label_safe(suffix, rules[i])) return 1;
        const char* dot = strchr(suffix, '.');
        if (!dot) break;
        suffix = dot + 1;
    }
    return 0;
}
```

`headless/neural_runtime_state.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Single running game's independently selected neural video mode.
// Frontend sets it during game launch; Vulkan present layer reads it.
// A4K has a separate existing shader path and is not activated here.
#pragma once
#include "neural_video_policy.h"
#include <atomic>
#include <algorithm>
namespace Eden::NeuralRuntime {
struct Selection {
    int mode{};
    int strength{};
};
inline std::atomic<int> current_mode{NeuralVideo::kOff};
inline std::atomic<int> current_strength{65};
inline void Configure(int requested_mode,int requested_strength) noexcept {
    const int strength=std::clamp(requested_strength,0,100);
    current_strength.store(strength,std::memory_order_relaxed);
    current_mode.store(NeuralVideo::IsDlss(requested_mode)?
        requested_mode:NeuralVideo::kOff,std::memory_order_release);
}
[[nodiscard]] inline Selection Current() noexcept {
    return {current_mode.load(std::memory_order_acquire),
            current_strength.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)};
}
} // namespace Eden::NeuralRuntime
```

`headless/neural_video_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// One selectable Neural Rendering mode per game: three A4K + two DLSS-NR.
// Upscaling and frame generation remain separate, exclusive controls.
#pragma once
namespace Eden::NeuralVideo {
inline constexpr bool kRuntimeValidated=false; // DLSS-NR PS5 image execution, not menu selection.
inline constexpr int kOff=0;
inline constexpr int kA4kDetail=1;
inline constexpr int kA4kSoft=2;
inline constexpr int kA4kDenoise=3;
inline constexpr int kDlssOriginal=4;
inline constexpr int kDlssCompact=5;
inline constexpr int kRdna2=kDlssOriginal; // legacy call-site alias
inline constexpr int kModeCount=6;
enum class Reason {
    Available,Disabled,EngineIncomplete,RequiresVulkan,
    NeedsExclusiveUpscaler,MsaaUnverified,FrameGenerationUnverified
};
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool IsA4k(int mode) noexcept {
    return mode>=kA4kDetail&&mode<=kA4kDenoise;
}
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool IsDlss(int mode) noexcept {
    return mode==kDlssOriginal||mode==kDlssCompact;
}
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool IsA4kFilter(int value) noexcept {
    return value>=7&&value<=9; // legacy internal Vulkan presenter IDs
}
[[nodiscard]] constexpr int InternalA4kFilter(int mode) noexcept {
    return IsA4k(mode)?mode+6:-1; // NR A4K 1/2/3 -> internal shader 7/8/9
}
[[nodiscard]] constexpr int ModeFromLegacyA4kFilter(int filter) noexcept {
    return IsA4kFilter(filter)?filter-6:kOff;
}
[[nodiscard]] constexpr int DlssModelIndex(int mode) noexcept {
    return mode==kDlssOriginal?0:mode==kDlssCompact?1:-1;
}
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool HasStrength(int mode) noexcept {
    return IsDlss(mode);
}
[[nodiscard]] constexpr Reason Check(
    int mode,int renderer,int upscaling,int aa,int framegen,
    bool runtime_validated=kRuntimeValidated) noexcept {
    if(mode==kOff)return Reason::Disabled;
    if(!IsA4k(mode)&&!IsDlss(mode))return Reason::EngineIncomplete;
    if(renderer!=1)return Reason::RequiresVulkan;
    // Conservative until specific image composition is proven.
    if(upscaling!=0)return Reason::NeedsExclusiveUpscaler;
    if(aa<0||aa>3)return Reason::MsaaUnverified;
    if(framegen!=0)return Reason::FrameGenerationUnverified;
    if(IsDlss(mode)&&!runtime_validated)return Reason::EngineIncomplete;
    return Reason::Available;
}
[[nodiscard]] constexpr Reason CheckSelectable(
    int mode,int renderer,int filter,int aa,int fg) noexcept {
    return Check(mode,renderer,filter,aa,fg,true);
}
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool CanSelect(
    int mode,int renderer,int filter,int aa,int fg) noexcept {
    return CheckSelectable(mode,renderer,filter,aa,fg)==Reason::Available;
}
// Only an explicitly selected DLSS-NR model suppresses screen-space AA.
// Return the effective per-session value, without editing saved preferences.
[[nodiscard]] constexpr int EffectiveAntiAliasing(
    int requested,int renderer,int neural_mode,bool neural_selectable) noexcept {
    if(neural_selectable&&IsDlss(neural_mode))return 0;
    return renderer!=1&&requested>=4?0:requested;
}
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool CanEnable(
    int renderer,int filter,int aa,int fg,
    bool validated=kRuntimeValidated) noexcept {
    return Check(kDlssOriginal,renderer,filter,aa,fg,validated)==Reason::Available;
}
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool RuntimeParametersEnabled(
    int mode,bool validated=kRuntimeValidated) noexcept {
    return IsA4k(mode)||(IsDlss(mode)&&validated);
}
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool FramegenMethodSelectable(
    int method,int renderer,int mode,bool has_lossless) noexcept {
    return method>=0&&method<=3&&
        (method==0||(renderer==1&&mode==kOff&&(method!=3||has_lossless)));
}
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool UpscaleSelectable(
    int filter,int renderer,int mode) noexcept {
    if(filter<0||filter>6||(filter>=5&&renderer!=1))return false;
    return mode==kOff||filter==0;
}
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool AntiAliasingSelectable(
    int aa,int renderer,int mode) noexcept {
    return aa>=0&&aa<=7&&(aa<=3||renderer==1)&&
           (mode==kOff||aa<=3);
}
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool PresetsMayBeStored(int model,int strength) noexcept {
    return model>=0&&model<=1&&strength>=0&&strength<=100;
}
} // namespace Eden::NeuralVideo
```

`headless/nr_dll_launch_preflight.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#pragma once
// One user-supplied DLL, one private cache. All CPU work is performed at
// game launch, never during the guest frame's Vulkan presentation.
#include "neural_video_policy.h"
#include "nr_dll_user_file.h"
#include "nr_dll_model_import.h"
#include "nr_dll_tensor_digests.h"
#include "glyph_sha256.h"
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/nr_rdna2_model_file.h"
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/nr_rdna2_model_manifest.h"
#include <array>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdint>
#include <fstream>
#include <span>
#include <string_view>
#include <filesystem>
#include <string>
#include <system_error>

namespace Eden::Graphics {
struct R09LaunchModelResult {
    bool ready{};
    bool imported{};
    const char* reason{};
};
// A private cached pack can be tampered with after an authentic DLL import.
// Read the COMPLETE learned tensor bytes and prove they match the public
// Original/Compact SHA-256 references before the renderer allocates Vulkan.
[[nodiscard]] inline bool R09UsableCachedPack(
    const std::filesystem::path& path,
    Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2::R09ModelVariant variant) {
    namespace NR=Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;
    NR::NeuralModelFile model;
    if(!model.Open(path.string())||
       !NR::ValidateR09ModelManifest(model.Entries(),variant))
        return false;
    const auto* input=model.Find(
        "unpacked-preblock/block0.layer0.layer.input_lift.bin");
    const auto* output=model.Find(variant==NR::R09ModelVariant::Original?
        "unpacked-postblock/block70.layer0.layer.out_project.bin":
        "unpacked-postblock/block30.layer0.layer.out_project.bin");
    if(!input||!output||input->size!=1024u||output->size!=1024u)
        return false;
    const std::span<const std::string_view> names =
        variant==NR::R09ModelVariant::Original?
        std::span<const std::string_view>(NR::R09OriginalManifest):
        std::span<const std::string_view>(NR::R09CompactManifest);
    const std::span<const std::string_view> digests =
        variant==NR::R09ModelVariant::Original?
        std::span<const std::string_view>(NR::R09OriginalTensorDigests):
        std::span<const std::string_view>(NR::R09CompactTensorDigests);
    if(names.size()!=digests.size())return false;
    std::ifstream file(path,std::ios::binary|std::ios::ate);
    if(!file)return false;
    const auto end=file.tellg();
    if(end<0)return false;
    const auto size=static_cast<std::uint64_t>(end);
    std::array<char,65536> chunk{};
    for(std::size_t i=0u;i<names.size();++i){
        const auto* entry=model.Find(names[i]);
        if(!entry||entry->size==0u||entry->offset>size||
           entry->size>size-entry->offset)return false;
        file.clear();
        file.seekg(static_cast<std::streamoff>(entry->offset));
        if(!file)return false;
        std::uint64_t left=entry->size;
        Eden::GlyphIntegrity::Sha256 digest;
        while(left){
            const auto count=static_cast<std::size_t>(
                std::min(left,std::uint64_t(chunk.size())));
            file.read(chunk.data(),static_cast<std::streamsize>(count));
            if(!file||file.gcount()!=static_cast<std::streamsize>(count))
                return false;
            digest.Update(chunk.data(),count);
            left-=count;
        }
        if(digest.FinishHex()!=digests[i])return false;
    }
    return true;
}
[[nodiscard]] inline R09LaunchModelResult PrepareR09UserModel(
    int mode,const std::filesystem::path& user,
    const std::filesystem::path& config) {
    namespace fs=std::filesystem;
    namespace NR=Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;
    if(!Eden::NeuralVideo::IsDlss(mode))
        return {true,false,nullptr};
    const auto original=mode==Eden::NeuralVideo::kDlssOriginal;
    const auto variant=original?NR::R09ModelVariant::Original:
                                NR::R09ModelVariant::Compact;
    const auto dir=config/"neural";
    const auto cache=dir/(original?"original.nrmodel":"compact.nrmodel");
    const auto legacy=dir/(original?"dlssnr.bin":"dlssnr-small.bin");
    // A cached pack is an implementation detail, not a second user input.
    // If the user's DLL was removed after a successful import, disable
    // neural rendering for this launch even when the cache remains valid.
    // Check this BEFORE considering either current or legacy cache paths.
    if(!DlssNrUserFileLooksValid(user,config))
        return {false,false,"DLSS-NR: nvngx_dlssnr.dll missing or invalid. Place your own file in /data/prosperoeden/user/dlssnr/nvngx_dlssnr.dll."};
    // Compact has no importer for this one-DLL contract yet. An old
    // authenticated Compact cache alone does not prove that the currently
    // installed user DLL contains the Compact resource.
    if(!original)
        return {false,false,"DLSS-NR Compact: compatible Compact weights are unavailable in the installed DLL; Original remains selectable."};
    // Never accept an unverified file only because a matching filename
    // exists; cache missing/invalid must remain fail-closed.
    if(R09UsableCachedPack(cache,variant)||
       R09UsableCachedPack(legacy,variant))
        return {true,false,nullptr};
    const std::array<fs::path,4> candidates{
        user/kDlssNrRelative,
        config/"neural/nvngx_dlssnr.dll",
        config/"nvngx_dlssnr.dll",
        user/"nvngx_dlssnr.dll"};
    for(const auto& dll:candidates) {
        std::error_code ec;
        const auto status=fs::symlink_status(dll,ec);
        if(ec||fs::is_symlink(status)||!fs::is_regular_file(status))
            continue;
        const auto imported=Eden::NRDllImport::ImportOriginal(
            dll,cache,NR::R09OriginalManifest);
        if(!imported.imported)
            return {false,false,
                "DLSS-NR Original: user DLL is present but its neural weight resource failed integrity/import checks."};
        if(!R09UsableCachedPack(cache,variant))
            return {false,false,
                "DLSS-NR Original: imported cache failed the exact native model manifest."};
        return {true,true,nullptr};
    }
    return {false,false,
        "DLSS-NR: no safe regular user DLL could be opened for import."};
}
} // namespace Eden::Graphics
```

`headless/nr_dll_model_import.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Import user-owned nvngx_dlssnr.dll weights as a private NRMODEL1 pack.
// The Windows PE is parsed as DATA. Its code is never loaded or executed.
// The proprietary DLL and learned weights are NOT distributed by Eden Encore.
#pragma once
#include "glyph_sha256.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <functional>
#include <span>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

namespace Eden::NRDllImport {
namespace detail {
struct BadModel final : std::runtime_error {
    using std::runtime_error::runtime_error;
};
struct Bytes {
    const std::uint8_t* ptr{};
    std::size_t size{};
    [[nodiscard]] Bytes Sub(std::size_t off,std::size_t len) const {
        if(off>size||len>size-off)throw BadModel("DLL/resource bounds violated");
        return {ptr+off,len};
    }
    [[nodiscard]] std::uint8_t U8(std::size_t p) const {
        return Sub(p,1).ptr[0];
    }
    [[nodiscard]] std::uint16_t U16(std::size_t p) const {
        auto a=Sub(p,2).ptr;
        return std::uint16_t(a[0])|(std::uint16_t(a[1])<<8);
    }
    [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t U32(std::size_t p) const {
        return std::uint32_t(U16(p))|(std::uint32_t(U16(p+2))<<16);
    }
    [[nodiscard]] std::uint64_t U64(std::size_t p) const {
        return std::uint64_t(U32(p))|(std::uint64_t(U32(p+4))<<32);
    }
    [[nodiscard]] std::string Text(std::size_t p,std::size_t n) const {
        auto s=Sub(p,n);
        return {reinterpret_cast<const char*>(s.ptr),s.size};
    }
};
[[nodiscard]] inline bool Starts(std::string_view s,std::string_view prefix) {
    return s.starts_with(prefix);
}
[[nodiscard]] inline bool Ends(std::string_view s,std::string_view suffix) {
    return s.ends_with(suffix);
}
// Read only the named RCDATA/WEIGHTS_HT resource. No guessed image offsets.
[[nodiscard]] inline Bytes FindOriginalResource(Bytes file) {
    if(file.size<1024u||file.size>(512u<<20)||file.Text(0,2)!="MZ")
        throw BadModel("not a bounded PE DLL");
    const auto pe=static_cast<std::size_t>(file.U32(0x3c));
    if(file.Text(pe,4)!=std::string_view{"PE\0\0",4}||
       file.U16(pe+4)!=0x8664u)
        throw BadModel("not an AMD64 Windows PE");
    const auto sections=file.U16(pe+6),optional=file.U16(pe+20);
    const auto op=pe+24;
    if(!sections||sections>64u||optional<144u||file.U16(op)!=0x20bu)
        throw BadModel("invalid PE32+ structure");
    (void)file.Sub(op,optional);
    const auto resource_rva=file.U32(op+128);
    const auto resource_length=file.U32(op+132);
    const auto table=op+optional;
    (void)file.Sub(table,std::size_t(sections)*40u);
    const auto translate=[&](std::uint32_t rva,std::uint32_t count){
        for(std::size_t i=0;i<sections;++i){
            const auto o=table+40u*i;
            const auto base=file.U32(o+12),size=file.U32(o+16);
            const auto offset=file.U32(o+20);
            if(rva>=base&&std::uint64_t(rva)-base+count<=size){
                const auto p=std::uint64_t(offset)+rva-base;
                if(p<=file.size&&count<=file.size-p)
                    return static_cast<std::size_t>(p);
            }
        }
        throw BadModel("resource RVA not backed by file bytes");
    };
    if(!resource_rva||!resource_length||resource_length>(256u<<20))
        throw BadModel("missing/oversized PE resource tree");
    const Bytes tree=file.Sub(translate(resource_rva,resource_length),
                              resource_length);
    std::array<std::string,4> labels{};
    Bytes found{};
    std::size_t matches=0;
    std::array<std::uint32_t,4> active{};
    const auto read_name=[&](std::uint32_t value){
        if(!(value&0x80000000u))return std::to_string(value);
        const auto at=static_cast<std::size_t>(value&0x7fffffffu);
        const auto length=tree.U16(at);
        if(length>256u)throw BadModel("resource name too long");
        (void)tree.Sub(at+2u,std::size_t(length)*2u);
        std::string result;
        for(std::size_t i=0;i<length;++i){
            const auto c=tree.U16(at+2u+i*2u);
            if(c<32u||c>126u)throw BadModel("unsupported resource name");
            result.push_back(static_cast<char>(c));
        }
        return result;
    };
    std::function<void(std::size_t,unsigned)> walk;
    walk=[&](std::size_t at,unsigned depth){
        if(depth>3u)throw BadModel("resource recursion limit exceeded");
        for(unsigned i=0;i<depth;++i)
            if(active[i]==at)throw BadModel("cyclic PE resource tree");
        active[depth]=static_cast<std::uint32_t>(at);
        const auto count=std::size_t(tree.U16(at+12u))+tree.U16(at+14u);
        if(count>1024u)throw BadModel("too many PE resources");
        (void)tree.Sub(at+16u,count*8u);
        for(std::size_t i=0;i<count;++i){
            const auto p=at+16u+8u*i;
            const auto name=read_name(tree.U32(p));
            const auto child=tree.U32(p+4u);
            labels[depth]=name;
            if(depth==0u&&name!="10")continue;
            if(depth==1u&&name!="WEIGHTS_HT")continue;
            if(child&0x80000000u){
                if(depth==3u)throw BadModel("resource tree too deep");
                walk(child&0x7fffffffu,depth+1u);
            }else if(depth==2u&&labels[0]=="10"&&
                     labels[1]=="WEIGHTS_HT"){
                const auto data=std::size_t(child);
                const auto rva=tree.U32(data),size=tree.U32(data+4u);
                if(!size||size>(256u<<20))
                    throw BadModel("bad neural payload size");
                found=file.Sub(translate(rva,size),size);
                ++matches;
            }
        }
    };
    walk(0u,0u);
    if(matches!=1u)
        throw BadModel("exactly one WEIGHTS_HT resource required");
    // Trust the model payload, not a fixed SHA of the entire DLL: Windows
    // DLLs may differ while carrying the same exact learned-weight resource.
    constexpr auto expected=
        "836f445d06ecd2e59bb9f17b84b91c143396fd76ccda1c9dc7fe81d5edd548f4";
    GlyphIntegrity::Sha256 hash;
    hash.Update(found.ptr,found.size);
    if(hash.FinishHex()!=expected)
        throw BadModel("WEIGHTS_HT SHA-256 differs from canonical Original");
    return found;
}
using Records=std::unordered_map<std::string,Bytes>;
[[nodiscard]] inline Records ReadRecords(Bytes resource){
    if(resource.size<8u||resource.U64(0)!=resource.size)
        throw BadModel("WEIGHTS_HT envelope size mismatch");
    Records records;
    std::size_t at=8u;
    while(at<resource.size){
        const auto n=resource.U64(at);at+=8u;
        if(!n||n>4096u)throw BadModel("bad weight name size");
        auto name=resource.Text(at,static_cast<std::size_t>(n));at+=n;
        if(!Starts(name,"block")||name.size()>120u)
            throw BadModel("unexpected weight name");
        for(char c:name)
            if(!((c>='0'&&c<='9')||c=='.'||c=='_'||
                 (c>='a'&&c<='z')))
                throw BadModel("invalid weight record name");
        const auto outer=resource.U64(at);at+=8u;
        if(outer<36u||outer>resource.size-at)
            throw BadModel("bad weight record byte count");
        auto body=resource.Sub(at,static_cast<std::size_t>(outer));
        const auto inner=body.U64(0),payload=body.U64(8);
        const auto device=body.U32(16);
        if(inner!=outer||!payload||payload>outer-36u||device>1u)
            throw BadModel("bad weight envelope");
        const auto meta=static_cast<std::size_t>(20u+payload);
        const auto dims=body.U64(meta+8u);
        if(dims>32u||meta+16u+4u*dims!=outer)
            throw BadModel("invalid weight dimension metadata");
        auto span=body.Sub(20u,static_cast<std::size_t>(payload));
        if(!records.emplace(std::move(name),span).second)
            throw BadModel("duplicate weight record");
        at+=static_cast<std::size_t>(outer);
        if(records.size()>512u)throw BadModel("too many weight records");
    }
    if(at!=resource.size||records.size()!=153u)
        throw BadModel("incomplete canonical Original resource");
    return records;
}
enum class Kind {Raw, Swin, Split, PostFP16, VitQKV};
struct Region {
    std::string name;
    std::size_t off{},size{};
    std::uint32_t n{},k{},inner{};
    Kind kind{Kind::Raw};
};
using Layout=std::vector<Region>;
inline void Add(Layout& out,std::string_view name,std::size_t size,
                std::uint32_t n=0u,std::uint32_t k=0u,
                std::uint32_t inner=0u,Kind kind=Kind::Raw){
    const auto start=out.empty()?0u:out.back().off+out.back().size;
    out.push_back({std::string(name),start,size,n,k,inner,kind});
}
[[nodiscard]] inline Layout SwinLayout(std::uint32_t c,
                                     std::uint32_t in,std::uint32_t out){
    const std::uint32_t heads=c/32u,h=4u*c;
    Layout a;
    if(heads==1u){
        Add(a,"mlp_expand",c*h,h,c,h/16u,Kind::Swin);
        Add(a,"mlp_contract",c*h,c,h,c/16u,Kind::Swin);
    }else{
        Add(a,"mlp_expand",c*h,h,c,h/heads/16u,Kind::Swin);
        Add(a,"mlp_mid",c*h/heads,c,h/heads,c/heads/16u,Kind::Swin);
        Add(a,"mlp_contract",c*c,c,c,c/16u,Kind::Swin);
    }
    const auto resample=in!=out?in*out:0u;
    const bool up=resample&&out<in;
    if(up)Add(a,"resample",resample,out,in,out/16u,Kind::Swin);
    Add(a,"residual_scale",2u*c+32u);
    if(up)Add(a,"upsample_gain",c==32u?2u*c:2u*c-32u);
    Add(a,"qkv",3u*c*c,3u*c,c,3u*c/16u,Kind::Swin);
    Add(a,"attn_pos_bias",heads*8192u);
    Add(a,"scalars_b",std::max(16u,4u*heads));
    Add(a,"attn_out_proj",c*c,c,c,c/16u,Kind::Swin);
    if(resample&&!up){
        Add(a,"attn_residual_scale",2u*c);
        Add(a,"resample",resample,out,in,out/16u,Kind::Swin);
        if(c==32u)Add(a,"tail",16u);
    }else Add(a,"attn_residual_scale",2u*c+16u);
    return a;
}
[[nodiscard]] inline Layout FixedLayout(bool post){
    Layout a;
    Add(a,"mlp_expand",4096u,128u,32u,8u,Kind::Swin);
    Add(a,"mlp_contract",4096u,32u,128u,2u,Kind::Swin);
    if(!post){
        Add(a,"pad",16u);
        Add(a,"input_lift",1024u);
        Add(a,"residual_scale",80u);
        Add(a,"qkv",3072u,96u,32u,6u,Kind::Swin);
        Add(a,"attn_pos_bias",8192u);
        Add(a,"scalars_b",16u);
        Add(a,"attn_out_proj",1024u,32u,32u,2u,Kind::Swin);
        Add(a,"attn_residual_scale",80u);
    }else{
        Add(a,"pad",16u);
        Add(a,"residual_scale",64u);
        Add(a,"main_gain",64u);
        Add(a,"skip_gain",64u);
        Add(a,"qkv",3072u,96u,32u,6u,Kind::Swin);
        Add(a,"attn_pos_bias",8192u);
        Add(a,"scalars_b",16u);
        Add(a,"attn_out_proj",1024u,32u,32u,2u,Kind::Swin);
        Add(a,"attn_residual_scale",80u);
        Add(a,"out_project",1024u,16u,32u,0u,Kind::PostFP16);
    }
    return a;
}
[[nodiscard]] inline Layout SplitLayout(std::size_t raw){
    Layout a;
    if(raw==524288u){
        Add(a,"ffwd_a",262144u,512u,512u,0u,Kind::Split);
        Add(a,"ffwd_b",262144u,512u,512u,0u,Kind::Split);
    }else if(raw==263168u){
        Add(a,"weight",262144u,512u,512u,0u,Kind::Split);
        Add(a,"skip_weight",1024u);
    }else if(raw==917568u){
        Add(a,"qkv",786432u,1536u,512u,0u,Kind::Split);
        Add(a,"attn_pos_bias",131072u);
        Add(a,"tail",64u);
    }else if(raw==524304u){
        Add(a,"weight",524288u,1024u,512u,0u,Kind::Split);
        Add(a,"tail",16u);
    }else if(raw==525312u){
        Add(a,"weight",524288u,512u,1024u,0u,Kind::Split);
        Add(a,"skip_weight",1024u);
    }
    return a;
}
[[nodiscard]] inline Layout VitLayout(std::size_t raw){
    Layout a;
    if(raw==3145856u){
        Add(a,"header",128u);
        Add(a,"q",1048576u,1024u,1024u,0u,Kind::VitQKV);
        Add(a,"k",1048576u,1024u,1024u,1u,Kind::VitQKV);
        Add(a,"v",1048576u,1024u,1024u,2u,Kind::VitQKV);
    }else if(raw==4194320u){
        Add(a,"weight",4194304u,4096u,1024u,0u,Kind::Split);
        Add(a,"tail",16u);
    }else if(raw==4196352u){
        Add(a,"weight",4194304u,1024u,4096u,0u,Kind::Split);
        Add(a,"skip_weight",2048u);
    }else if(raw==1050624u){
        Add(a,"weight",1048576u,1024u,1024u,0u,Kind::Split);
        Add(a,"skip_weight",2048u);
    }
    return a;
}
[[nodiscard]] inline Layout ForFamily(std::string_view family,std::size_t raw){
    if(family=="unpacked-preblock")return FixedLayout(false);
    if(family=="unpacked-postblock")return FixedLayout(true);
    if(family=="unpacked-splitswin")return SplitLayout(raw);
    if(family=="unpacked-vit")return VitLayout(raw);
    if(family!="unpacked")throw BadModel("unknown neural tensor family");
    Layout found;
    for(std::uint32_t c:{32u,64u,128u,256u})
        for(std::uint32_t direction=0u;direction<3u;++direction){
            const auto in=direction==2u?2u*c:c;
            const auto out=direction==1u?2u*c:c;
            auto layout=SwinLayout(c,in,out);
            if(layout.back().off+layout.back().size==raw){
                if(!found.empty())
                    throw BadModel("ambiguous Swin input/output shape");
                found=std::move(layout);
            }
        }
    if(found.empty())throw BadModel("unrecognized Swin record geometry");
    return found;
}
[[nodiscard]] inline std::vector<std::uint8_t> DeswizzleSwin(
    Bytes raw,const Region& r){
    if(r.kind!=Kind::Swin||!r.n||!r.k||!r.inner||
       r.n%16u||r.k%32u)throw BadModel("invalid Swin tile geometry");
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> dst(std::size_t(r.n)*r.k);
    const auto slices=r.k/32u;
    for(std::uint32_t t=0;t<r.n/16u;++t)
        for(std::uint32_t g=0;g<slices;++g){
            const auto base=r.off+std::size_t(t%r.inner)*512u+
                std::size_t(g)*512u*r.inner+
                std::size_t(t/r.inner)*512u*r.inner*slices;
            for(std::uint32_t half=0;half<2u;++half)
                for(std::uint32_t n=0;n<8u;++n)
                    for(std::uint32_t k=0;k<32u;++k){
                        const auto lane=4u*n+(k%8u)/2u;
                        const auto src=base+lane*16u+half*8u+
                            2u*(k/8u)+(k%2u);
                        dst[(std::size_t(t)*16u+half*8u+n)*r.k+g*32u+k]=
                            raw.U8(src);
                    }
        }
    return dst;
}
[[nodiscard]] inline std::vector<std::uint8_t> DeswizzleSplit(
    Bytes raw,const Region& r){
    if(r.kind!=Kind::Split||!r.n||!r.k||
       r.n%16u||r.k%32u)throw BadModel("invalid Split/ViT tile geometry");
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> dst(std::size_t(r.n)*r.k);
    const auto groups=r.n/16u;
    for(std::uint32_t gk=0;gk<r.k/32u;++gk)
        for(std::uint32_t gn=0;gn<groups;++gn){
            const auto base=r.off+(std::size_t(gk)*groups+gn)*512u;
            for(std::uint32_t half=0;half<2u;++half)
                for(std::uint32_t lane=0;lane<32u;++lane)
                    for(std::uint32_t b=0;b<8u;++b){
                        const auto n=gn*16u+half*8u+lane/4u;
                        const auto k=gk*32u+8u*(b>>1u)+
                            2u*(lane%4u)+(b&1u);
                        dst[std::size_t(n)*r.k+k]=
                            raw.U8(base+lane*16u+half*8u+b);
                    }
        }
    return dst;
}
[[nodiscard]] inline std::vector<std::uint8_t> DeswizzleVitQKV(
    Bytes raw,const Region& r){
    if(r.kind!=Kind::VitQKV||r.size!=1048576u||r.inner>2u)
        throw BadModel("invalid ViT QKV shape");
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> dst(r.size);
    for(std::uint32_t row=0;row<1024u;++row)
        for(std::uint32_t k=0;k<1024u;++k){
            const auto b=(k&1u)|((k>>1u&1u)<<4u)|((k>>2u&1u)<<5u)|
                ((k>>3u&1u)<<1u)|((k>>4u&1u)<<2u)|
                ((row&1u)<<6u)|((row>>1u&1u)<<7u)|
                ((row>>2u&1u)<<8u)|((row>>3u&1u)<<3u)|
                ((row>>4u&1u)<<9u);
            const auto tile=(row>>5u)|((k>>5u)<<5u);
            dst[std::size_t(row)*1024u+k]=
                raw.U8(128u+(3u*tile+r.inner)*1024u+b);
        }
    return dst;
}
[[nodiscard]] inline std::vector<std::uint8_t> DeswizzlePostFP16(
    Bytes raw,const Region& r){
    if(r.kind!=Kind::PostFP16||r.size!=1024u)
        throw BadModel("invalid postblock FP16 projection");
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> dst(r.size);
    for(std::uint32_t n=0;n<16u;++n)
        for(std::uint32_t k=0;k<32u;++k){
            const auto i=(k/16u)*256u+32u*(n%8u)+
                8u*((k%8u)/2u)+4u*(n/8u)+k%2u+2u*((k%16u)/8u);
            const auto source=r.off+2u*i;
            const auto target=2u*(n*32u+k);
            dst[target]=raw.U8(source);
            dst[target+1u]=raw.U8(source+1u);
        }
    return dst;
}
[[nodiscard]] inline std::vector<std::uint8_t> Tensor(
    std::string_view path,const Records& records){
    const auto slash=path.find('/');
    if(slash==std::string_view::npos||!Ends(path,".bin"))
        throw BadModel("invalid canonical model path");
    const auto family=path.substr(0,slash);
    const auto stem=path.substr(slash+1u,path.size()-slash-5u);
    std::string base;
    if(family=="inventory"){
        if(!Starts(stem,"weights/"))throw BadModel("invalid inventory path");
        base=std::string(stem.substr(8u));
    }else{
        const auto pos=stem.find(".layer");
        if(pos==std::string_view::npos)throw BadModel("invalid weight name");
        const auto second=stem.find(".layer",pos+6u);
        if(second==std::string_view::npos)throw BadModel("invalid model layer");
        base=std::string(stem.substr(0,second+6u));
    }
    const auto it=records.find(base);
    if(it==records.end())
        throw BadModel("missing source weight record: "+base);
    const Bytes raw=it->second;
    if(family=="inventory")return {raw.ptr,raw.ptr+raw.size};
    const auto layout=ForFamily(family,raw.size);
    if(layout.empty()||layout.back().off+layout.back().size!=raw.size)
        throw BadModel("unrecognized neural layer record size: "+base);
    const auto suffix=stem.substr(base.size()+1u);
    const auto selected=std::find_if(layout.begin(),layout.end(),
        [&](const Region& r){return suffix==r.name;});
    if(selected==layout.end())
        throw BadModel("unrecognized canonical tensor: "+std::string(path));
    const auto& r=*selected;
    (void)raw.Sub(r.off,r.size);
    switch(r.kind){
    case Kind::Raw:return {raw.ptr+r.off,raw.ptr+r.off+r.size};
    case Kind::Swin:return DeswizzleSwin(raw,r);
    case Kind::Split:return DeswizzleSplit(raw,r);
    case Kind::VitQKV:return DeswizzleVitQKV(raw,r);
    case Kind::PostFP16:return DeswizzlePostFP16(raw,r);
    }
    throw BadModel("unsupported tensor kind");
}
inline void WriteLE32(std::vector<std::uint8_t>& bytes,std::uint32_t n){
    for(unsigned j=0;j<4;++j)bytes.push_back(std::uint8_t(n>>(8u*j)));
}
inline void WriteLE64(std::vector<std::uint8_t>& bytes,std::uint64_t n){
    for(unsigned j=0;j<8;++j)bytes.push_back(std::uint8_t(n>>(8u*j)));
}
[[nodiscard]] inline bool WritePack(
    const std::filesystem::path& target,
    const std::span<const std::string_view> manifest,
    const Records& records){
    if(manifest.empty()||manifest.size()>4096u)return false;
    std::size_t index_length=16u;
    for(auto name:manifest){
        if(name.empty()||name.size()>4096u)return false;
        index_length+=4u+name.size()+16u;
    }
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> index;
    index.reserve(index_length);
    for(char c:std::string_view{"NRMODEL1"})
        index.push_back(std::uint8_t(c));
    WriteLE32(index,static_cast<std::uint32_t>(manifest.size()));
    WriteLE32(index,0u);
    std::error_code error;
    std::filesystem::create_directories(target.parent_path(),error);
    if(error)return false;
    const auto temp=target.string()+".importing";
    struct Cleanup {
        std::string path;
        ~Cleanup(){std::error_code ec;std::filesystem::remove(path,ec);}
    } cleanup{temp};
    std::fstream out(temp,std::ios::binary|std::ios::out|std::ios::trunc);
    if(!out)return false;
    out.seekp(static_cast<std::streamoff>(index_length),std::ios::beg);
    if(!out)return false;
    std::uint64_t position=(index_length+255u)&~std::uint64_t{255u};
    for(auto name:manifest){
        const auto tensor=Tensor(name,records);
        if(tensor.empty()||tensor.size()>(256u<<20))return false;
        WriteLE32(index,static_cast<std::uint32_t>(name.size()));
        for(char c:name)index.push_back(std::uint8_t(c));
        WriteLE64(index,position);
        WriteLE64(index,tensor.size());
        out.seekp(static_cast<std::streamoff>(position),std::ios::beg);
        if(!out)return false;
        out.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(tensor.data()),
                  static_cast<std::streamsize>(tensor.size()));
        if(!out)return false;
        position=(position+tensor.size()+255u)&~std::uint64_t{255u};
    }
    if(index.size()!=index_length)return false;
    out.seekp(0,std::ios::beg);
    out.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(index.data()),
              static_cast<std::streamsize>(index.size()));
    out.flush();
    if(!out)return false;
    out.close();
    if(!out)return false;
    std::ifstream verify(temp,std::ios::binary|std::ios::ate);
    if(!verify)return false;
    const auto final_size=verify.tellg();
    if(final_size<=static_cast<std::streamoff>(index_length))return false;
    verify.seekg(0);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> saved(index_length);
    verify.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(saved.data()),
                static_cast<std::streamsize>(saved.size()));
    if(!verify||saved!=index)return false;
    verify.close();
    std::filesystem::rename(temp,target,error);
    return !error;
}
} // namespace detail

struct Result {
    bool imported{};
    std::string reason{};
};
// A single user-supplied DLL can supply the Original network. Its resource
// is authenticated by SHA-256; unsupported/missing Compact never receives
// substituted Original tensor data or an invented success status.
[[nodiscard]] inline Result ImportOriginal(
    const std::filesystem::path& user_dll,
    const std::filesystem::path& model_cache,
    std::span<const std::string_view> public_manifest){
    try{
        std::ifstream stream(user_dll,std::ios::binary|std::ios::ate);
        if(!stream)return {false,"user DLL is not installed"};
        const auto n=stream.tellg();
        if(n<1024||n>static_cast<std::streamoff>(512u<<20))
            return {false,"invalid DLL file size"};
        std::vector<std::uint8_t> dll(static_cast<std::size_t>(n));
        stream.seekg(0);
        stream.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(dll.data()),n);
        if(!stream||stream.gcount()!=n)
            return {false,"unable to read complete user DLL"};
        const detail::Bytes file{dll.data(),dll.size()};
        const auto resource=detail::FindOriginalResource(file);
        const auto records=detail::ReadRecords(resource);
        if(!detail::WritePack(model_cache,public_manifest,records))
            return {false,"unable to publish verified private model cache"};
        return {true,"authenticated Original model imported from user DLL"};
    }catch(const std::exception& e){return {false,e.what()};}
}
} // namespace Eden::NRDllImport
```

`headless/nr_dll_user_file.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#pragma once
// Nonblocking launcher/launch-time discovery, like lossless_user_file.h.
// This only verifies the presence of a plausible user-owned PE DLL.
// The native Original importer verifies WEIGHTS_HT SHA-256 and tensor layout.
#include <array>
#include <cstdio>
#include <filesystem>
#include <system_error>

namespace Eden::Graphics {
inline constexpr const char* kDlssNrRelative = "dlssnr/nvngx_dlssnr.dll";
inline constexpr const char* kDlssNrConsolePath =
    "/data/prosperoeden/user/dlssnr/nvngx_dlssnr.dll";

inline bool DlssNrUserFileLooksValid(
    const std::filesystem::path& user_dir,
    const std::filesystem::path& config_dir) {
    // Match the Vulkan presenter's accepted import paths. Keep the documented
    // user/dlssnr/ path first; other locations are migration fallbacks only.
    const std::array<std::filesystem::path, 4> candidates{
        user_dir / kDlssNrRelative,
        config_dir / "neural/nvngx_dlssnr.dll",
        config_dir / "nvngx_dlssnr.dll",
        user_dir / "nvngx_dlssnr.dll",
    };
    for (const auto& path : candidates) {
        std::error_code ec;
        const auto status = std::filesystem::symlink_status(path, ec);
        if (ec || std::filesystem::is_symlink(status) ||
            !std::filesystem::is_regular_file(status)) continue;
        const auto size = std::filesystem::file_size(path, ec);
        if (ec || size < 1024u || size > (512ull << 20)) continue;
        std::FILE* file = std::fopen(path.string().c_str(), "rb");
        if (!file) continue;
        unsigned char magic[2]{};
        const bool read = std::fread(magic, 1, sizeof(magic), file) ==
                          sizeof(magic);
        (void)std::fclose(file);
        if (read && magic[0] == 'M' && magic[1] == 'Z') return true;
    }
    return false;
}
} // namespace Eden::Graphics
```

```cpp
// SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright 2018 yuzu Emulator Project

namespace Service::AOC {

static bool CheckAOCTitleIDMatchesBase(u64 title_id, u64 base) {
    return FileSys::GetBaseTitleID(title_id) == base;
}

static u64 GetCallerBaseTitleID(Core::System& system, const ClientProcessId& process_id) {
    return FileSys::GetBaseTitleID(system.ResolveCallerProgramId(*process_id));
}

// P5-only common AoC supplement: only the loaded NUP title contributes.
// NCA/extracted AOC retains its original precedence and identification.
static std::vector<u64> VisibleAddOnTitleIds(
    const std::vector<u64>& installed, u64 caller_base) {
    std::vector<u64> result;
    for (const auto id : installed) {
        if (CheckAOCTitleIDMatchesBase(id, caller_base))
            result.push_back(id);
    }
    const auto nup = Eden::NupV1::Native::SoleActiveAddOns();
    if (nup && nup->OwnerBaseId() == caller_base) {
        const auto base = nup->BaseId(caller_base);
        if (base) {
            // The NUP package parser bounds title indices to 11 bits.
            for (const auto index : nup->ListIds(caller_base, 0, 2048))
                result.push_back(*base + index);
        }
    }
    std::sort(result.begin(), result.end());
    result.erase(std::unique(result.begin(), result.end()), result.end());
    return result;
}

static std::vector<u64> AccumulateAOCTitleIDs(Core::System& system) {
    std::vector<u64> add_on_content;
    const auto& rcu = system.GetContentProvider();
    const auto list =
        rcu.ListEntriesFilter(FileSys::TitleType::AOC, FileSys::ContentRecordType::Data);
    std::transform(list.begin(), list.end(), std::back_inserter(add_on_content),
                   [](const FileSys::ContentProviderEntry& rce) { return rce.title_id; });
    add_on_content.erase(
        std::remove_if(
            add_on_content.begin(), add_on_content.end(),
            [&rcu](u64 tid) {
                // A registered content ID can become unavailable before
                // aoc:u is constructed. Never dereference a missing NCA.
                const auto entry = rcu.GetEntry(tid, FileSys::ContentRecordType::Data);
                return !entry || entry->GetStatus() != Loader::ResultStatus::Success;
            }),
        add_on_content.end());
    // Also advertise safely extracted AOC content by its explicit Nintendo
    // AOC Title ID. The folder scanner rejects ambiguous IDs and only
    // discovers content in the selected game's registered storage roots.
    const auto extracted = FileSys::ExtractedAoc::InstalledIds();
    add_on_content.insert(add_on_content.end(), extracted.begin(), extracted.end());
    std::sort(add_on_content.begin(), add_on_content.end());
    add_on_content.erase(std::unique(add_on_content.begin(), add_on_content.end()),
                         add_on_content.end());
    return add_on_content;
}

IAddOnContentManager::IAddOnContentManager(Core::System& system_)
    : ServiceFramework{system_, "aoc:u"}, add_on_content{AccumulateAOCTitleIDs(system)},
      service_context{system_, "aoc:u"} {

        {8, D<&IAddOnContentManager::GetAddOnContentListChangedEvent>, "GetAddOnContentListChangedEvent"},

Result IAddOnContentManager::CountAddOnContent(Out<u32> out_count, ClientProcessId process_id) {
    LOG_DEBUG(Service_AOC, "called. process_id={}", process_id.pid);

    const auto current = GetCallerBaseTitleID(system, process_id);

    const auto& disabled = Settings::values.disabled_addons[current];
    if (std::find(disabled.begin(), disabled.end(), "DLC") != disabled.end()) {
        *out_count = 0;
        R_SUCCEED();
    }

    *out_count = static_cast<u32>(
        VisibleAddOnTitleIds(add_on_content, current).size());

    R_SUCCEED();
}

Result IAddOnContentManager::ListAddOnContent(Out<u32> out_count,
                                              OutBuffer<BufferAttr_HipcMapAlias> out_addons,
                                              u32 offset, u32 count, ClientProcessId process_id) {
    LOG_DEBUG(Service_AOC, "called with offset={}, count={}, process_id={}", offset, count,
              process_id.pid);

    const auto current = GetCallerBaseTitleID(system, process_id);

    std::vector<u32> out;
    const auto& disabled = Settings::values.disabled_addons[current];
    if (std::find(disabled.begin(), disabled.end(), "DLC") == disabled.end()) {
        const auto ids = VisibleAddOnTitleIds(add_on_content, current);
        const auto nup = Eden::NupV1::Native::SoleActiveAddOns();
        const auto nacp_base = nup ? nup->BaseId(current) : std::nullopt;
        for (u64 content_id : ids) {
            // Only NUP-selected titles use a custom NACP AoC base.
            // Keep the common GetAOCID contract for NCA/extracted titles.
            if (nacp_base && content_id >= *nacp_base &&
                content_id - *nacp_base <= FileSys::AOC_TITLE_ID_MASK)
                out.push_back(static_cast<u32>(content_id - *nacp_base));
            else
                out.push_back(static_cast<u32>(FileSys::GetAOCID(content_id)));
        }
        std::sort(out.begin(), out.end());
        out.erase(std::unique(out.begin(), out.end()), out.end());
    }

    R_UNLESS(out.size() >= offset, AM::ResultApplicationRecordNotFound);

    // IPC supplies the actual destination span, not a promise that the
    // caller's requested count fits it. Never write past a short HIPC
    // map-alias buffer, even when the NUP addon index is otherwise valid.
    const std::size_t capacity = out_addons.size() / sizeof(u32);
    *out_count = static_cast<u32>(std::min({
        out.size() - offset, static_cast<std::size_t>(count), capacity}));
    if (*out_count) {
        std::memcpy(out_addons.data(), out.data() + offset,
                    static_cast<std::size_t>(*out_count) * sizeof(u32));
    }

    R_SUCCEED();
}

Result IAddOnContentManager::GetAddOnContentBaseId(Out<u64> out_title_id,
                                                   ClientProcessId process_id) {
    LOG_DEBUG(Service_AOC, "called. process_id={}", process_id.pid);

    const auto title_id = system.ResolveCallerProgramId(*process_id);
    if (const auto nup = Eden::NupV1::Native::SoleActiveAddOns()) {
        if (const auto base = nup->BaseId(title_id)) {
            *out_title_id = *base;
            R_SUCCEED();
        }
    }
    const FileSys::PatchManager pm{title_id, system.GetFileSystemController(),
                                   system.GetContentProvider()};

    const auto res = pm.GetControlMetadata();
    if (res.first == nullptr) {
        *out_title_id = FileSys::GetAOCBaseTitleID(title_id);
        R_SUCCEED();
    }

    *out_title_id = res.first->GetDLCBaseTitleId();

    R_SUCCEED();
}

Result IAddOnContentManager::PrepareAddOnContent(s32 addon_index, ClientProcessId process_id) {
    const auto program_id = system.ResolveCallerProgramId(*process_id);
    const auto current = FileSys::GetBaseTitleID(program_id);
    const auto& disabled = Settings::values.disabled_addons[current];
    // This is an AoC ID, not an array index or an arbitrary title ID.
    // An absent/disabled DLC must not return success to the guest.
    R_UNLESS(addon_index >= 0 &&
             static_cast<u32>(addon_index) <= FileSys::AOC_TITLE_ID_MASK &&
             std::find(disabled.begin(), disabled.end(), "DLC") == disabled.end(),
             AM::ResultApplicationRecordNotFound);
    if (const auto nup = Eden::NupV1::Native::SoleActiveAddOns();
        nup && nup->BaseId(program_id)) {
        // The actual data storage is mounted by the shared FSP RomFSFactory.
        R_UNLESS(nup->OpenRomFS(program_id, static_cast<u32>(addon_index)),
                 AM::ResultApplicationRecordNotFound);
        R_SUCCEED();
    }
    // Ordinary NCA and extracted AoC must use the caller's NACP base,
    // not a guessed high prefix. Only an actually enumerated, usable
    // installation may be acknowledged.
    const FileSys::PatchManager pm{program_id, system.GetFileSystemController(),
                                   system.GetContentProvider()};
    const auto control = pm.GetControlMetadata();
    const u64 aoc_base = control.first ? control.first->GetDLCBaseTitleId()
                                       : FileSys::GetAOCBaseTitleID(program_id);
    R_UNLESS(aoc_base != 0 &&
             aoc_base <= std::numeric_limits<u64>::max() -
                             static_cast<u32>(addon_index),
             AM::ResultApplicationRecordNotFound);
    const u64 requested_id = aoc_base + static_cast<u32>(addon_index);
    R_UNLESS(std::find(add_on_content.begin(), add_on_content.end(), requested_id) !=
                 add_on_content.end(), AM::ResultApplicationRecordNotFound);
    R_SUCCEED();
}
```

`headless/nup_v1_loader_route.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Prepared P5-only loader-factory bridge. The CMake switch is OFF by default.
// All ordinary NS1/NS2 formats continue through the original vendor factory.
#include "nup_v1_native_loader.h"
#include "nup_v1_native_vfs.h"

#include <memory>
#include <string>
#include <utility>

#include "core/file_sys/common_funcs.h"
#include "core/loader/loader.h"

namespace Loader {

// The original pinned loader.cpp is compiled with the source-local
// GetLoader=EdenOriginalGetLoader token alias. No vendor C++ is rewritten,
// and all non-NUP requests continue to use the exact existing implementation.
std::unique_ptr<AppLoader> EdenOriginalGetLoader(
    Core::System& system, FileSys::VirtualFile file,
    u64 program_id, std::size_t program_index);

std::unique_ptr<AppLoader> GetLoader(
    Core::System& system, FileSys::VirtualFile file,
    u64 program_id, std::size_t program_index) {
    if (!file) return nullptr;
    if (!Eden::NupV1::Native::HasNupV1Header(file))
        return EdenOriginalGetLoader(system, std::move(file),
                                     program_id, program_index);
    // A NUP bundles one effective application. Never select a guessed NCA
    // program index, and never fall back to interpreting failed NUP as NSP.
    if (program_index != 0) return nullptr;
    std::string error;
    auto loader = Eden::NupV1::Native::NupAppLoader::Open(
        std::move(file), &error);
    if (!loader) return nullptr;
    u64 actual_program_id{};
    if (loader->ReadProgramId(actual_program_id) != ResultStatus::Success ||
        (program_id != 0 &&
         FileSys::GetBaseTitleID(program_id) !=
             FileSys::GetBaseTitleID(actual_program_id))) {
        return nullptr;
    }
    return loader;
}

} // namespace Loader

```

`headless/nup_v1_native_aoc.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#include "nup_v1_native_aoc.h"
#include <iterator>
#include <mutex>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <utility>
#include "core/file_sys/common_funcs.h"

namespace Eden::NupV1::Native {
namespace {
struct ActiveRegistry {
    std::mutex mutex;
    std::unordered_map<const Loader::AppLoader*,
                       std::shared_ptr<const AddOnIndex>> entries;
};
ActiveRegistry& Registry() {
    static ActiveRegistry registry;
    return registry;
}
} // namespace

void PublishActiveAddOns(const Loader::AppLoader* loader,
                         std::shared_ptr<const AddOnIndex> index) {
    if (!loader || !index) return;
    auto& registry = Registry();
    std::lock_guard guard(registry.mutex);
    registry.entries.insert_or_assign(loader, std::move(index));
}

void ForgetActiveAddOns(const Loader::AppLoader* loader) {
    auto& registry = Registry();
    std::lock_guard guard(registry.mutex);
    registry.entries.erase(loader);
}

std::shared_ptr<const AddOnIndex> ActiveAddOnsForLoader(
    const Loader::AppLoader* loader) {
    if (!loader) return {};
    auto& registry = Registry();
    std::lock_guard guard(registry.mutex);
    const auto found = registry.entries.find(loader);
    return found == registry.entries.end() ? nullptr : found->second;
}

std::shared_ptr<const AddOnIndex> SoleActiveAddOns() {
    auto& registry = Registry();
    std::lock_guard guard(registry.mutex);
    return registry.entries.size() == 1 ?
           registry.entries.begin()->second : nullptr;
}

AddOnIndex::AddOnIndex(std::shared_ptr<Mount> mount,
                       std::uint64_t caller_program_id,
                       std::optional<std::uint64_t> nacp_aoc_base_id) {
    if (!mount || !caller_program_id) return;
    owner_base_id_ = FileSys::GetBaseTitleID(caller_program_id);
    // Never grant a caller an add-on family from a base/update of another
    // application. Add-on-only packages require the explicit caller scope.
    for (const auto& pkg : mount->Packages()) {
        if (pkg.kind != 2 &&
            FileSys::GetBaseTitleID(pkg.title_id) != owner_base_id_) {
            owner_base_id_ = 0;
            return;
        }
    }
    if (nacp_aoc_base_id &&
        (*nacp_aoc_base_id & FileSys::AOC_TITLE_ID_MASK))
        return;
    aoc_base_id_ = nacp_aoc_base_id.value_or(
        owner_base_id_ + FileSys::AOC_TITLE_ID_OFFSET);
    content_ = std::make_unique<ContentSet>(
        std::move(mount), caller_program_id, nacp_aoc_base_id);
    for (const auto& addon : content_->AddOns()) {
        if (addon.title_id < *aoc_base_id_ ||
            addon.title_id - *aoc_base_id_ > FileSys::AOC_TITLE_ID_MASK)
            continue;
        indexes_.emplace(
            static_cast<std::uint32_t>(addon.title_id - *aoc_base_id_),
            addon.package_index);
    }
}

bool AddOnIndex::MatchesCaller(std::uint64_t caller_program_id) const {
    return content_ && caller_program_id &&
           FileSys::GetBaseTitleID(caller_program_id) == owner_base_id_;
}

std::optional<std::uint64_t> AddOnIndex::BaseId(
    std::uint64_t caller_program_id) const {
    return MatchesCaller(caller_program_id) ? aoc_base_id_ : std::nullopt;
}

std::size_t AddOnIndex::Count(std::uint64_t caller_program_id) const {
    return MatchesCaller(caller_program_id) ? indexes_.size() : 0;
}

std::vector<std::uint32_t> AddOnIndex::ListIds(
    std::uint64_t caller_program_id, std::size_t offset,
    std::size_t limit) const {
    std::vector<std::uint32_t> result;
    if (!MatchesCaller(caller_program_id) || offset >= indexes_.size() ||
        limit == 0) return result;
    auto it = indexes_.begin();
    std::advance(it, static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(offset));
    for (; it != indexes_.end() && result.size() < limit; ++it)
        result.push_back(it->first);
    return result;
}

FileSys::VirtualFile AddOnIndex::OpenRomFS(
    std::uint64_t caller_program_id, std::uint32_t aoc_index) const {
    if (!MatchesCaller(caller_program_id)) return {};
    const auto it = indexes_.find(aoc_index);
    return it == indexes_.end() ? FileSys::VirtualFile{} :
           content_->CreateAddOnRomFS(it->second);
}

} // namespace Eden::NupV1::Native
```

`headless/nup_v1_native_content.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#include "nup_v1_native_content.h"

#include <limits>
#include <map>
#include <optional>
#include <utility>

#include "core/file_sys/common_funcs.h"
#include "core/file_sys/romfs.h"
#include "core/file_sys/vfs/vfs.h"

namespace Eden::NupV1::Native {

ContentSet::ContentSet(std::shared_ptr<Mount> mount,
                       std::optional<std::uint64_t> caller_program_id,
                       std::optional<std::uint64_t> nacp_aoc_base_id)
    : mount_(std::move(mount)) {
    if (!mount_) return;
    const auto& packages = mount_->Packages();

    // Mirror the existing aoc:u service's GetBaseTitleID contract. This
    // prevents packages belonging to unrelated games from appearing as DLC.
    std::optional<std::uint64_t> active_base;
    for (const auto& package : packages) {
        if (package.kind == 0) {
            active_base = FileSys::GetBaseTitleID(package.title_id);
            break;
        }
    }
    if (!active_base) {
        const Package* newest = nullptr;
        for (const auto& package : packages) {
            if (package.kind == 1 && (!newest || package.version > newest->version))
                newest = &package;
        }
        if (newest) active_base = FileSys::GetBaseTitleID(newest->title_id);
    }

    if (caller_program_id) {
        const auto requested = FileSys::GetBaseTitleID(*caller_program_id);
        if (active_base && *active_base != requested) return;
        active_base = requested;
    }
    // Add-on-only archives carry no owning executable title: callers must
    // supply the program identity instead of seeing cross-title content.
    if (!active_base) return;
    // A non-default NACP-declared AoC family is only meaningful when bound to
    // a known caller. Do not grant blanket visibility from an unscoped mount.
    if (nacp_aoc_base_id && !caller_program_id) return;
    // The AoC base must identify the start of an 0x800-title range.
    // Reject a malformed NACP base instead of registering a shifted range
    // or falling back to unrelated conventional DLC.
    if (nacp_aoc_base_id && (*nacp_aoc_base_id & FileSys::AOC_TITLE_ID_MASK))
        return;
    if (*active_base > std::numeric_limits<std::uint64_t>::max() - FileSys::AOC_TITLE_ID_OFFSET)
        return;
    const auto aoc_base = nacp_aoc_base_id.value_or(
        *active_base + FileSys::AOC_TITLE_ID_OFFSET);

    // Select DLC from the declared AoC base, never by blindly treating every
    // title with a similar high prefix as belonging to the application.
    // Custom bases are inputs from trusted NACP metadata, not per-game hacks.
    // Two revisions of one DLC use the highest NCM version.
    std::map<std::uint64_t, std::size_t> selected;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < packages.size(); ++i) {
        const auto& package = packages[i];
        if (package.kind != 2) continue;
        if (package.title_id < aoc_base ||
            package.title_id - aoc_base > FileSys::AOC_TITLE_ID_MASK)
            continue;
        const auto it = selected.find(package.title_id);
        if (it == selected.end() ||
            package.version > packages[it->second].version) {
            selected.insert_or_assign(package.title_id, i);
        }
    }

    for (const auto& [title_id, index] : selected) {
        const auto directory = mount_->PackageView(index, ContentView::RomFS);
        if (!directory) continue;
        addons_.push_back(AddOnDirectory{
            index, title_id, packages[index].version, directory});
    }
}

FileSys::VirtualDir ContentSet::ExeFS() const {
    return mount_ ? mount_->Effective(ContentView::ExeFS) : FileSys::VirtualDir{};
}

FileSys::VirtualFile ContentSet::CreateRomFS() const {
    if (!mount_) return {};
    auto directory = mount_->Effective(ContentView::RomFS);
    return directory ? FileSys::CreateRomFS(std::move(directory), nullptr)
                     : FileSys::VirtualFile{};
}

FileSys::VirtualFile ContentSet::CreateAddOnRomFS(std::size_t package_index) const {
    for (const auto& addon : addons_) {
        if (addon.package_index == package_index && addon.romfs) {
            return FileSys::CreateRomFS(addon.romfs, nullptr);
        }
    }
    return {};
}

bool ContentSet::HasExecutableMain() const {
    const auto exefs = ExeFS();
    return exefs && exefs->GetFile("main") && exefs->GetFile("main.npdm");
}

} // namespace Eden::NupV1::Native
```

`headless/nup_v1_native_content.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Native NUP content bridge: no FileType/launcher/AoC registration.
#pragma once

#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <memory>
#include <optional>
#include <vector>

#include "nup_v1_native_vfs.h"

namespace Eden::NupV1::Native {

struct AddOnDirectory {
    std::size_t package_index{};
    std::uint64_t title_id{};
    std::uint32_t version{};
    FileSys::VirtualDir romfs;
};

// Assemble the *same* effective ExeFS/RomFS views for NS1 and NS2.
// This is an inert content provider, NOT a game loader. Integration must
// supply metadata validation, title identity, PatchManager/AoC and the
// app loader's ReadRomFS result before NUP can be called playable.
class ContentSet final {
public:
    // Caller title is mandatory when examining an add-on-only archive.
    // Never enumerate add-ons of unknown ownership globally.
    // A trusted NACP may declare a non-default AddOnContentBaseId (including
    // NS2 upgrade packs). A custom base requires an explicit caller and must
    // never be inferred by guessing an offset from the package title ID.
    explicit ContentSet(std::shared_ptr<Mount> mount,
                        std::optional<std::uint64_t> caller_program_id = std::nullopt,
                        std::optional<std::uint64_t> nacp_aoc_base_id = std::nullopt);
    FileSys::VirtualDir ExeFS() const;
    // Read-only RomFS binary via the existing engine's CreateRomFS builder;
    // nullptr when no effective RomFS directory exists.
    FileSys::VirtualFile CreateRomFS() const;
    // The extracted-directory loader requires BOTH main and main.npdm.
    bool HasExecutableMain() const;
    // Directory handles only. Registration into the shared AoC provider
    // is deliberately deferred; no addon is folded into effective RomFS.
    const std::vector<AddOnDirectory>& AddOns() const { return addons_; }
    // Explicit addon-only RomFS binary for a future AoC provider.
    // Base/update packages are rejected, never merged into CreateRomFS().
    FileSys::VirtualFile CreateAddOnRomFS(std::size_t package_index) const;

private:
    std::shared_ptr<Mount> mount_;
    std::vector<AddOnDirectory> addons_;
};

} // namespace Eden::NupV1::Native
```
