`headless/nup_v1_native_loader.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#include "nup_v1_native_loader.h"
#include "nup_v1_native_aoc.h"

#include <array>
#include <cstddef>
#include <optional>
#include <span>
#include <utility>
#include <zlib.h>

#include "core/file_sys/control_metadata.h"
#include "core/file_sys/common_funcs.h"
#include "core/file_sys/program_metadata.h"
#include "core/file_sys/vfs/vfs.h"
#include "core/file_sys/vfs/vfs_vector.h"
#include "core/loader/deconstructed_rom_directory.h"

namespace Eden::NupV1::Native {
namespace {

// Vendor NACP may contain raw-deflate language records. Its constructor
// assumes their input length is safe and then copies inflated data to
// LanguageEntry slots. Validate bounds and the complete frame BEFORE calling
// that constructor, including through the extracted ExeFS loader.
bool SafeNacpLanguageData(std::span<const u8> bytes) {
    if (bytes.size() != sizeof(FileSys::RawNACP)) return false;
    constexpr auto type_offset = offsetof(FileSys::RawNACP, titles_data_format);
    static_assert(type_offset < sizeof(FileSys::RawNACP));
    const auto format = bytes[type_offset];
    if (format == static_cast<u8>(FileSys::TitleDataFormat::Uncompressed))
        return true;
    if (format != static_cast<u8>(FileSys::TitleDataFormat::Compressed))
        return false;

    constexpr std::size_t MaxCompressedBytes = 0x2ffe;
    constexpr std::size_t RecordBytes = sizeof(FileSys::LanguageEntry);
    static_assert(RecordBytes == 0x300);
    static_assert(sizeof(FileSys::LanguageEntryData) == 0x3000);
    const std::size_t compressed_size =
        std::size_t(bytes[0]) | (std::size_t(bytes[1]) << 8);
    if (!compressed_size || compressed_size > MaxCompressedBytes) return false;
    std::array<u8, RecordBytes * 32> expanded{};
    z_stream stream{};
    stream.next_in = const_cast<Bytef*>(bytes.data() + 2);
    stream.avail_in = static_cast<uInt>(compressed_size);
    stream.next_out = expanded.data();
    stream.avail_out = static_cast<uInt>(expanded.size());
    if (inflateInit2(&stream, -MAX_WBITS) != Z_OK) return false;
    const auto status = inflate(&stream, Z_FINISH);
    inflateEnd(&stream);
    return status == Z_STREAM_END &&
           stream.total_in == compressed_size &&
           stream.total_out > 0 &&
           stream.total_out % RecordBytes == 0 &&
           stream.total_out <= expanded.size();
}
} // namespace

NupAppLoader::NupAppLoader(FileSys::VirtualFile source)
    : Loader::AppLoader(std::move(source)) {}
NupAppLoader::~NupAppLoader() {
    ForgetActiveAddOns(this);
}

std::unique_ptr<NupAppLoader> NupAppLoader::Open(FileSys::VirtualFile source,
                                                 std::string* error) {
    if (error) error->clear();
    if (!source) {
        if (error) *error = "NUP source is null";
        return {};
    }

    auto loader = std::unique_ptr<NupAppLoader>(new NupAppLoader(std::move(source)));
    loader->mount_ = Mount::Open(loader->file, error);
    if (!loader->mount_) return {};
    loader->content_ = std::make_unique<ContentSet>(loader->mount_);
    if (!loader->content_->HasExecutableMain()) {
        if (error) *error = "NUP effective ExeFS lacks main or main.npdm";
        return {};
    }

    // The real extracted loader reads main.npdm *in its constructor*.
    // Reject an invalid title and oversized untrusted NPDM BEFORE reaching
    // that constructor (or its metadata, title and icon handling).
    u64 validated_program_id{};
    if (loader->ValidateProgramIdentity(validated_program_id) !=
        Loader::ResultStatus::Success) {
        if (error) *error = "NUP invalid NPDM program identity";
        return {};
    }

    std::optional<std::uint64_t> aoc_base;
    constexpr auto aoc_offset = offsetof(FileSys::RawNACP, dlc_base_title_id);
    static_assert(sizeof(FileSys::RawNACP) == 0x4000);
    static_assert(aoc_offset == 0x3070, "vendor RawNACP AoC base field ABI drift");
    static_assert(aoc_offset + sizeof(std::uint64_t) <= sizeof(FileSys::RawNACP));

    const std::vector<std::uint8_t>* nacp_data = nullptr;
    if (const auto* metadata = loader->mount_->ApplicationMetadata();
        metadata && metadata->control_nacp.size() == sizeof(FileSys::RawNACP)) {
        nacp_data = &metadata->control_nacp; // TLV wins over extracted tree
    }
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> extracted_nacp;
    // Validate the ExeFS NACP even when a TLV overrides it. The *vendor*
    // extracted-loader constructor also reads that file automatically.
    const auto exefs = loader->content_->ExeFS();
    const auto control = exefs ? exefs->GetFile("control.nacp") : nullptr;
    if (control) {
        if (control->GetSize() != sizeof(FileSys::RawNACP)) {
            if (error) *error = "NUP control.nacp has invalid size";
            return {};
        }
        extracted_nacp.resize(sizeof(FileSys::RawNACP));
        if (control->Read(extracted_nacp.data(), extracted_nacp.size(), 0) !=
            extracted_nacp.size()) {
            if (error) *error = "NUP control.nacp integrity failure";
            return {};
        }
        if (!SafeNacpLanguageData(extracted_nacp)) {
            if (error) *error = "NUP unsafe control.nacp language metadata";
            return {};
        }
        if (!nacp_data) nacp_data = &extracted_nacp;
    }
    if (nacp_data && !SafeNacpLanguageData(*nacp_data)) {
        if (error) *error = "NUP unsafe control.nacp language metadata";
        return {};
    }
    if (nacp_data) {
        std::uint64_t raw_id{};
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < sizeof(std::uint64_t); ++i)
            raw_id |= std::uint64_t((*nacp_data)[aoc_offset + i]) << (8 * i);
        if (raw_id != 0) aoc_base = raw_id;
    }
    // Recreate the selection only after the actual NPDM establishes the
    // caller's application identity; an untrusted NACP does not bypass it.
    loader->nacp_aoc_base_id_ = aoc_base;
    loader->content_ = std::make_unique<ContentSet>(
        loader->mount_, validated_program_id, aoc_base);

    // The extracted loader eagerly reads the selected icon into memory in
    // its constructor. Refuse oversized image candidates before invoking it;
    // TLV icons are already limited by the package metadata parser.
    constexpr std::size_t MaxExtractedIconBytes = 4U * 1024U * 1024U;
    if (const auto exefs = loader->content_->ExeFS()) {
        for (const auto& candidate : exefs->GetFiles()) {
            if (!candidate) continue;
            const auto name = candidate->GetName();
            const bool named_icon = name.starts_with("icon_") && name.ends_with(".dat");
            const bool image_file = name.ends_with(".jpg") ||
                                    name.ends_with(".jpeg") ||
                                    name.ends_with(".png") ||
                                    name.ends_with(".bmp");
            if ((named_icon || image_file) &&
                candidate->GetSize() > MaxExtractedIconBytes) {
                if (error) *error = "NUP ExeFS icon too large";
                return {};
            }
        }
    }

    // No double patching of the NUP effective ExeFS directory: explicitly
    // disable the deconstructed loader's own update-overlay flag.
    // The main-file constructor initializes title/icon/control metadata,
    // unlike the directory-only overload in the pinned extracted loader.
    // Our NativeFile retains its containing ExeFS directory across reads.
    const auto main_file = loader->content_->ExeFS()->GetFile("main");
    loader->extracted_loader_ =
        std::make_unique<Loader::AppLoader_DeconstructedRomDirectory>(
            main_file, false);
    // Merely inspecting NUP metadata for the game catalogue must NOT expose
    // add-ons to a running game's services. Publish only after Load succeeds.
    return loader;
}

Loader::ResultStatus NupAppLoader::ValidateProgramIdentity(u64& program_id) const {
    if (!content_ || !mount_) return Loader::ResultStatus::ErrorNoExeFS;
    const auto exefs = content_->ExeFS();
    if (!exefs) return Loader::ResultStatus::ErrorNoExeFS;
    const auto npdm = exefs->GetFile("main.npdm");
    if (!npdm) return Loader::ResultStatus::ErrorMissingNPDM;
    // The real ProgramMetadata reader allocates arrays based on NPDM fields.
    // This is an app description, not a full game image: cap its total size
    // before any vendor parser or extracted-loader constructor touches it.
    constexpr std::size_t MaxNPDMBytes = 4U * 1024U * 1024U;
    if (npdm->GetSize() == 0 || npdm->GetSize() > MaxNPDMBytes)
        return Loader::ResultStatus::ErrorBadNPDMHeader;

    FileSys::ProgramMetadata metadata;
    const auto status = metadata.Load(npdm);
    if (status != Loader::ResultStatus::Success) return status;

    // Both the NUP record and the actual executable's NPDM must identify
    // the same base program. Without this check an otherwise valid archive
    // can misassociate a dumped executable with another application's ID.
    const auto& packages = mount_->Packages();
    const Package* declared = nullptr;
    for (const auto& package : packages) {
        if (package.kind == 0) {
            declared = &package;
            break;
        }
        if (package.kind == 1 && (!declared || package.version > declared->version))
            declared = &package;
    }
    if (!declared) return Loader::ResultStatus::ErrorNoExeFS;
    program_id = metadata.GetTitleID();
    // A base package identifies the exact program, including its program
    // index. A standalone update carries the update title ID, so only its
    // common base-program family can be compared with the loaded NPDM.
    if ((declared->kind == 0 && program_id != declared->title_id) ||
        (declared->kind == 1 &&
         FileSys::GetBaseTitleID(program_id) !=
             FileSys::GetBaseTitleID(declared->title_id))) {
        return Loader::ResultStatus::ErrorBadNPDMHeader;
    }
    return Loader::ResultStatus::Success;
}

NupAppLoader::LoadResult NupAppLoader::Load(Kernel::KProcess& process,
                                             Core::System& system) {
    if (!extracted_loader_)
        return {Loader::ResultStatus::ErrorNoExeFS, {}};
    u64 program_id{};
    const auto status = ValidateProgramIdentity(program_id);
    if (status != Loader::ResultStatus::Success) return {status, {}};
    auto result = extracted_loader_->Load(process, system);
    if (result.first == Loader::ResultStatus::Success) {
        PublishActiveAddOns(this, std::make_shared<AddOnIndex>(
            mount_, program_id, nacp_aoc_base_id_));
    }
    return result;
}

Loader::ResultStatus NupAppLoader::ReadRomFS(FileSys::VirtualFile& out_file) {
    out_file.reset();
    if (!content_) return Loader::ResultStatus::ErrorNoRomFS;
    u64 program_id{};
    const auto status = ValidateProgramIdentity(program_id);
    if (status != Loader::ResultStatus::Success) return status;
    std::scoped_lock guard(romfs_mutex_);
    if (!effective_romfs_) effective_romfs_ = content_->CreateRomFS();
    if (!effective_romfs_) return Loader::ResultStatus::ErrorNoRomFS;
    out_file = effective_romfs_;
    return Loader::ResultStatus::Success;
}

Loader::ResultStatus NupAppLoader::ReadIcon(std::vector<u8>& out_buffer) {
    u64 program_id{};
    const auto status = ValidateProgramIdentity(program_id);
    if (status != Loader::ResultStatus::Success) return status;
    if (const auto* metadata = mount_->ApplicationMetadata();
        metadata && !metadata->default_icon.empty()) {
        out_buffer = metadata->default_icon;
        return Loader::ResultStatus::Success;
    }
    return extracted_loader_ ? extracted_loader_->ReadIcon(out_buffer)
                             : Loader::ResultStatus::ErrorNoIcon;
}

Loader::ResultStatus NupAppLoader::ReadControlData(FileSys::NACP& out_control) {
    // Use the real vendor NACP constructor, not a parallel, incomplete NACP
    // decoder. This path is inert until the NUP AppLoader is registered.
    u64 program_id{};
    const auto status = ValidateProgramIdentity(program_id);
    if (status != Loader::ResultStatus::Success) return status;
    std::vector<u8> bytes;
    if (const auto* metadata = mount_->ApplicationMetadata();
        metadata && metadata->control_nacp.size() == sizeof(FileSys::RawNACP)) {
        bytes = metadata->control_nacp;
    } else {
        const auto exefs = content_->ExeFS();
        const auto nacp = exefs ? exefs->GetFile("control.nacp") : nullptr;
        if (!nacp) return Loader::ResultStatus::ErrorNoControl;
        if (nacp->GetSize() != sizeof(FileSys::RawNACP))
            return Loader::ResultStatus::ErrorNoControl;
        bytes.resize(sizeof(FileSys::RawNACP));
        if (nacp->Read(bytes.data(), bytes.size(), 0) != bytes.size())
            return Loader::ResultStatus::ErrorIntegrityVerificationFailed;
    }
    if (!SafeNacpLanguageData(bytes))
        return Loader::ResultStatus::ErrorNoControl;
    // The native NACP constructor fills compressed or plain language tables
    // as well as raw fields. Do not assign only RawNACP and leave it partial.
    out_control = FileSys::NACP(
        std::make_shared<FileSys::VectorVfsFile>(std::move(bytes)));
    return Loader::ResultStatus::Success;
}

Loader::ResultStatus NupAppLoader::ReadProgramId(u64& out_program_id) {
    u64 validated{};
    const auto status = ValidateProgramIdentity(validated);
    if (status == Loader::ResultStatus::Success) out_program_id = validated;
    return status;
}

Loader::ResultStatus NupAppLoader::ReadTitle(std::string& out_title) {
    u64 program_id{};
    const auto status = ValidateProgramIdentity(program_id);
    if (status != Loader::ResultStatus::Success) return status;
    if (const auto* metadata = mount_->ApplicationMetadata();
        metadata && !metadata->title.empty()) {
        out_title = metadata->title;
        return Loader::ResultStatus::Success;
    }
    return extracted_loader_ ? extracted_loader_->ReadTitle(out_title)
                             : Loader::ResultStatus::ErrorNoControl;
}

Loader::ResultStatus NupAppLoader::ReadLocalizedTitle(
    std::string& out_title, std::string_view language) {
    u64 program_id{};
    const auto status = ValidateProgramIdentity(program_id);
    if (status != Loader::ResultStatus::Success) return status;
    if (const auto* metadata = mount_->ApplicationMetadata()) {
        const auto translated = metadata->TitleFor(language);
        if (!translated.empty()) {
            out_title = std::string(translated);
            return Loader::ResultStatus::Success;
        }
    }
    return ReadTitle(out_title);
}

Loader::ResultStatus NupAppLoader::ReadLocalizedIcon(
    std::vector<u8>& out_icon, std::string_view language) {
    u64 program_id{};
    const auto status = ValidateProgramIdentity(program_id);
    if (status != Loader::ResultStatus::Success) return status;
    if (const auto* metadata = mount_->ApplicationMetadata()) {
        if (const auto* cover = metadata->IconFor(language);
            cover && !cover->empty()) {
            out_icon = *cover;
            return Loader::ResultStatus::Success;
        }
    }
    return ReadIcon(out_icon);
}

Loader::ResultStatus NupAppLoader::ReadNSOModules(Modules& out_modules) {
    u64 program_id{};
    const auto status = ValidateProgramIdentity(program_id);
    if (status != Loader::ResultStatus::Success) return status;
    return extracted_loader_ ? extracted_loader_->ReadNSOModules(out_modules)
                             : Loader::ResultStatus::ErrorNotInitialized;
}

const std::vector<AddOnDirectory>& NupAppLoader::SelectedAddOns() const {
    return content_->AddOns();
}

std::unique_ptr<AddOnIndex> NupAppLoader::MakeAddOnIndex() const {
    // Do not expose a cached DLC snapshot if underlying VFS bytes were
    // modified after opening. Resolve the NPDM identity again first.
    u64 program_id{};
    if (ValidateProgramIdentity(program_id) !=
        Loader::ResultStatus::Success)
        return {};
    return std::make_unique<AddOnIndex>(
        mount_, program_id, nacp_aoc_base_id_);
}

} // namespace Eden::NupV1::Native
```

```h
// Reuse the existing deconstructed ExeFS/NSO loader, while providing the
// effective NUP RomFS explicitly. No title-ID special cases or new CPU/GPU path.
class NupAppLoader final : public Loader::AppLoader {
public:
    // A valid NUP containing main and main.npdm is required; no boot is
    // initiated. The loader stays a local explicit-only adapter until vetted.
    static std::unique_ptr<NupAppLoader> Open(FileSys::VirtualFile source,
                                               std::string* error = nullptr);
    ~NupAppLoader() override;

    Loader::FileType GetFileType() const override { return Loader::FileType::Unknown; }

    Loader::ResultStatus ReadRomFS(FileSys::VirtualFile& out_file) override;
    Loader::ResultStatus ReadIcon(std::vector<u8>& out_buffer) override;

    Loader::ResultStatus ReadProgramId(u64& out_program_id) override;
    Loader::ResultStatus ReadTitle(std::string& out_title) override;
    // Explicit locale APIs for the launcher. Core AppLoader keeps using the
    // existing default title/icon contract without a per-game special case.
    Loader::ResultStatus ReadLocalizedTitle(
        std::string& out_title, std::string_view language);
    Loader::ResultStatus ReadLocalizedIcon(
        std::vector<u8>& out_icon, std::string_view language);
    Loader::ResultStatus ReadNSOModules(Modules& out_modules) override;
    // NUP has already applied its highest-version directory overlay.
    bool IsRomFSUpdatable() const override { return false; }

    // Does NOT register titles with aoc:u or make DLC visible to the guest.

    // A future aoc:u service can request this verified per-caller snapshot.
    std::unique_ptr<AddOnIndex> MakeAddOnIndex() const;
```

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#include "nup_v1_native_vfs.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>
#include <mutex>
#include <optional>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <utility>

#include "core/file_sys/vfs/vfs.h"

namespace Eden::NupV1::Native {

bool HasNupV1Header(const FileSys::VirtualFile& source) {
    if (!source || !source->IsReadable() || source->GetSize() < 0x80)
        return false;
    std::array<u8, 0x80> header{};
    if (source->Read(header.data(), header.size(), 0) != header.size())
        return false;
    const auto le16 = [&](std::size_t off) -> std::uint64_t {
        return std::uint64_t(header[off]) | (std::uint64_t(header[off + 1]) << 8);
    };
    const auto le64 = [&](std::size_t off) -> std::uint64_t {
        std::uint64_t value{};
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
            value |= std::uint64_t(header[off + i]) << (8 * i);
        return value;
    };
    const auto toc_size = le64(0x10);
    const auto blob_offset = le64(0x38);
    const auto actual_size = std::uint64_t(source->GetSize());
    return header[0] == 'N' && header[1] == 'U' &&
           header[2] == 'P' && header[3] == 1 &&
           le16(4) == 0x80 && le16(6) == 1 &&
           le64(8) == 0x80 && toc_size > 0 &&
           toc_size <= 64ULL * 1024 * 1024 &&
           toc_size <= actual_size - 0x80 &&
           blob_offset >= 0x80 + toc_size &&
           blob_offset <= actual_size &&
           blob_offset % 16 == 0 &&
           le64(0x40) == actual_size;
}

namespace {
class NativeSource final : public Eden::NupV1::Source {
public:
    explicit NativeSource(FileSys::VirtualFile file)
        : file_(std::move(file)), size_(file_ ? file_->GetSize() : 0) {}

    std::uint64_t Size() const override { return size_; }

    bool ReadAt(std::uint64_t offset, std::span<std::uint8_t> dst) const override {
        std::scoped_lock guard(mutex_);
        if (!file_ || !file_->IsReadable() || file_->GetSize() != size_ ||
            offset > size_ || dst.size() > size_ - offset ||
            offset > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) {
            return false;
        }
        return dst.empty() || file_->Read(dst.data(), dst.size(),
                                          static_cast<std::size_t>(offset)) == dst.size();
    }

    // Even a read-only VfsFile can change externally. Do not reuse SHA-256
    // results across reads of an unpinned backing source.
    bool AllowsVerifiedMemberCache() const override { return false; }

private:
    FileSys::VirtualFile file_;
    std::uint64_t size_{};
    mutable std::mutex mutex_;
};
} // namespace

namespace Detail {
struct State {
    explicit State(FileSys::VirtualFile file) : source(std::move(file)) {}
    NativeSource source;
    std::unique_ptr<Eden::NupV1::Archive> archive; // destructed before source
};
} // namespace Detail

namespace {
class NativeFile final : public FileSys::VfsFile {
public:
    NativeFile(std::shared_ptr<Detail::State> state, std::size_t index,
               std::string name, FileSys::VirtualDir parent)
        : state_(std::move(state)), index_(index), name_(std::move(name)),
          parent_(std::move(parent)) {}

    std::string GetName() const override { return name_; }
    std::size_t GetSize() const override {
        return static_cast<std::size_t>(state_->archive->MemberSize(index_));
    }
    bool Resize(std::size_t) override { return false; }
    FileSys::VirtualDir GetContainingDirectory() const override { return parent_; }
    bool IsWritable() const override { return false; }
    bool IsReadable() const override { return true; }

    std::size_t Read(u8* dst, std::size_t len, std::size_t offset) const override {
        const auto size = GetSize();
        if (!dst || offset >= size || len == 0) return 0;
        const auto count = (std::min)(len, size - offset);
        // ReadMember can write a partial range before finding an integrity
        // or decoding error. Clear that range so callers can never observe
        // unverified data even when they mishandle a short VFS read.
        if (!state_->archive->ReadMember(index_, offset,
                                         std::span<std::uint8_t>(dst, count))) {
            std::fill_n(dst, count, u8{});
            return 0;
        }
        return count;
    }
    std::size_t Write(const u8*, std::size_t, std::size_t) override { return 0; }
    bool Rename(std::string_view) override { return false; }

private:
    std::shared_ptr<Detail::State> state_;
    std::size_t index_{};
    std::string name_;
    FileSys::VirtualDir parent_;
};

class NativeDirectory final : public FileSys::ReadOnlyVfsDirectory,
                              public std::enable_shared_from_this<NativeDirectory> {
public:
    NativeDirectory(std::shared_ptr<Detail::State> state,
                    std::optional<std::size_t> package, ContentView view,
                    std::string path, std::string name,
                    FileSys::VirtualDir parent = {})
        : state_(std::move(state)), package_(package), view_(view),
          path_(std::move(path)), name_(std::move(name)), parent_(std::move(parent)) {}

    std::vector<FileSys::VirtualFile> GetFiles() const override {
        std::vector<FileSys::VirtualFile> result;
        const auto& entries = Entries();
        if (!entries) return result;
        const auto self = std::const_pointer_cast<NativeDirectory>(shared_from_this());
        for (const auto& entry : *entries) {
            if (entry.directory || !entry.file_index) continue;
            const auto size = state_->archive->MemberSize(*entry.file_index);
            if (size > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) continue;
            result.emplace_back(std::make_shared<NativeFile>(
                state_, *entry.file_index, entry.name, self));
        }
        return result;
    }

    std::vector<FileSys::VirtualDir> GetSubdirectories() const override {
        std::vector<FileSys::VirtualDir> result;
        const auto& entries = Entries();
        if (!entries) return result;
        const auto self = std::const_pointer_cast<NativeDirectory>(shared_from_this());
        for (const auto& entry : *entries) {
            if (!entry.directory) continue;
            const auto next = path_.empty() ? entry.name : path_ + "/" + entry.name;
            result.emplace_back(std::make_shared<NativeDirectory>(
                state_, package_, view_, next, entry.name, self));
        }
        return result;
    }

    std::string GetName() const override { return name_; }
    FileSys::VirtualDir GetParentDirectory() const override { return parent_; }

private:
    const std::optional<std::vector<DirEntry>>& Entries() const {
        // The mounted NUP TOC and effective overlay are immutable. Cache only
        // directory metadata; NativeFile::Read still verifies the live source.
        // Both VFS GetFiles/GetSubdirectories may be called by different
        // services, so initialize exactly once and never copy the entry vector.
        std::call_once(entries_once_, [this] {
            entries_ = package_
                ? state_->archive->ListPackageDirectory(*package_, view_, path_)
                : state_->archive->ListEffectiveDirectory(view_, path_);
        });
        return entries_;
    }

    mutable std::once_flag entries_once_;
    mutable std::optional<std::vector<DirEntry>> entries_;
    std::shared_ptr<Detail::State> state_;
    std::optional<std::size_t> package_;
    ContentView view_;
    std::string path_;
    std::string name_;
    FileSys::VirtualDir parent_;
};
} // namespace

Mount::Mount(std::shared_ptr<Detail::State> state) : state_(std::move(state)) {}
Mount::~Mount() = default;

std::shared_ptr<Mount> Mount::Open(FileSys::VirtualFile file, std::string* error) {
    if (!file || !file->IsReadable()) {
        if (error) *error = "NUP input VFS file is not readable";
        return {};
    }
    auto state = std::make_shared<Detail::State>(std::move(file));
    state->archive = Eden::NupV1::Archive::Mount(state->source, error);
    if (!state->archive) return {};
    return std::shared_ptr<Mount>(new Mount(std::move(state)));
}

const std::vector<Eden::NupV1::Package>& Mount::Packages() const {
    return state_->archive->Packages();
}

const Eden::NupV1::PackageMetadata* Mount::ApplicationMetadata() const {
    return state_->archive->ApplicationMetadata();
}

FileSys::VirtualDir Mount::Effective(ContentView view) const {
    if (!state_->archive->ListEffectiveDirectory(view)) return {};
    return std::make_shared<NativeDirectory>(
        state_, std::nullopt, view, "", view == ContentView::ExeFS ? "exefs" : "romfs");
}

FileSys::VirtualDir Mount::PackageView(std::size_t package_index, ContentView view) const {
    if (!state_->archive->ListPackageDirectory(package_index, view)) return {};
    return std::make_shared<NativeDirectory>(
        state_, package_index, view, "", view == ContentView::ExeFS ? "exefs" : "romfs");
}
} // namespace Eden::NupV1::Native
```

```cpp
// SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright 2026 Eden Emulator Project
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later

// SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright 2018 yuzu Emulator Project
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later

#include <algorithm>
#include <memory>
#include "common/settings.h"
#include "nup_v1_native_aoc.h"
#include "common/assert.h"
#include "common/common_types.h"
#include "common/logging.h"
#include "core/file_sys/common_funcs.h"
#include "core/file_sys/content_archive.h"
#include "core/file_sys/nca_metadata.h"

#include "extracted_aoc.h"
#include "core/hle/kernel/k_process.h"
#include "core/hle/service/filesystem/filesystem.h"
#include "core/loader/loader.h"

namespace FileSys {

RomFSFactory::RomFSFactory(Loader::AppLoader& app_loader, ContentProvider& provider,
                           Service::FileSystem::FileSystemController& controller)
    : content_provider{provider}, filesystem_controller{controller} {
    // Load the RomFS from the app
    if (app_loader.ReadRomFS(file) != Loader::ResultStatus::Success) {
        LOG_WARNING(Service_FS, "Unable to read base RomFS");
    }

    updatable = app_loader.IsRomFSUpdatable();
}

RomFSFactory::~RomFSFactory() = default;

void RomFSFactory::SetPackedUpdate(VirtualFile update_raw_file) {
    packed_update_raw = std::move(update_raw_file);
}

VirtualFile RomFSFactory::OpenCurrentProcess(u64 current_process_title_id) const {
    if (!updatable) {
        return file;
    }

    const auto type = ContentRecordType::Program;
    const auto nca = content_provider.GetEntry(current_process_title_id, type);
    const PatchManager patch_manager{current_process_title_id, filesystem_controller,
                                     content_provider};
    return patch_manager.PatchRomFS(nca.get(), file, ContentRecordType::Program, packed_update_raw);
}

VirtualFile RomFSFactory::OpenPatchedRomFS(u64 title_id, ContentRecordType type) const {
    auto nca = content_provider.GetEntry(title_id, type);

    if (nca == nullptr) {
        return nullptr;
    }

    const PatchManager patch_manager{title_id, filesystem_controller, content_provider};

    return patch_manager.PatchRomFS(nca.get(), nca->GetRomFS(), type);
}

VirtualFile RomFSFactory::OpenPatchedRomFSWithProgramIndex(u64 title_id, u8 program_index,
                                                           ContentRecordType type) const {
    const auto res_title_id = GetBaseTitleIDWithProgramIndex(title_id, program_index);

    return OpenPatchedRomFS(res_title_id, type);
}

VirtualFile RomFSFactory::Open(u64 title_id, StorageId storage, ContentRecordType type) const {
    const auto nup = Eden::NupV1::Native::SoleActiveAddOns();
    const bool nup_data = nup && type == ContentRecordType::Data;
    const auto active_base = nup_data ? nup->BaseId(nup->OwnerBaseId())
                                      : std::nullopt;
    const bool nup_addon_id = active_base && title_id >= *active_base &&
        title_id - *active_base <= FileSys::AOC_TITLE_ID_MASK;
    const auto try_nup = [&]() -> VirtualFile {
        if (!nup_addon_id) return {};
        const auto current = nup->OwnerBaseId();
        const auto& disabled = Settings::values.disabled_addons[current];
        if (std::find(disabled.begin(), disabled.end(), "DLC") != disabled.end())
            return {};
        return nup->OpenRomFS(current, static_cast<u32>(title_id - *active_base));
    };
    const u64 aoc_suffix = title_id & 0x1fffU;
    const bool extracted_aoc_id = type == ContentRecordType::Data &&
                                  aoc_suffix >= 0x1000U && aoc_suffix <= 0x17ffU;
    // Host storage has no NCA provider in GetEntry: avoid its
    // UNIMPLEMENTED path for explicitly installed extracted AOC content.
    if (storage == StorageId::Host && (extracted_aoc_id || nup_addon_id)) {
        if (const auto extracted = extracted_aoc_id ?
                ExtractedAoc::OpenRomFS(title_id) : VirtualFile{})
            return extracted;
        return try_nup();
    }
    const std::shared_ptr<NCA> res = GetEntry(title_id, storage, type);
    if (res == nullptr) {
        // Existing extracted RomFS and authentic NCA retain precedence;
        // NUP is only another explicit, title-scoped read-only DLC provider.
        const bool allowed_storage = storage == StorageId::None ||
            storage == StorageId::NandUser || storage == StorageId::SdCard;
        if (allowed_storage && extracted_aoc_id) {
            if (const auto extracted = ExtractedAoc::OpenRomFS(title_id))
                return extracted;
        }
        return allowed_storage ? try_nup() : VirtualFile{};
    }

    return res->GetRomFS();
}

std::shared_ptr<NCA> RomFSFactory::GetEntry(u64 title_id, StorageId storage,
                                            ContentRecordType type) const {
    switch (storage) {
    case StorageId::None:
        return content_provider.GetEntry(title_id, type);
    case StorageId::NandSystem:
        return filesystem_controller.GetSystemNANDContents()->GetEntry(title_id, type);
    case StorageId::NandUser:
        return filesystem_controller.GetUserNANDContents()->GetEntry(title_id, type);
    case StorageId::SdCard:
        return filesystem_controller.GetSDMCContents()->GetEntry(title_id, type);
    case StorageId::Host:
    case StorageId::GameCard:
    default:
        UNIMPLEMENTED_MSG("Unimplemented storage_id={:02X}", static_cast<u8>(storage));
        return nullptr;
    }
}

} // namespace FileSys
```

```cmake
# NUP is part of the unified, production NS1/NS2 content loader.
# Use the single existing vendor loader, VFS and AoC owners for all builds.
# This is ordinary source selection, not a release-policy or roadmap gate.
get_target_property(eden_nup_core_sources core SOURCES)
set(eden_nup_loader_owners)
foreach(eden_nup_owner IN LISTS eden_nup_core_sources)
    if(eden_nup_owner MATCHES "(^|/)loader/loader\\.cpp$")
        list(APPEND eden_nup_loader_owners "${eden_nup_owner}")
    endif()
endforeach()
list(LENGTH eden_nup_loader_owners eden_nup_owner_count)
if(NOT eden_nup_owner_count EQUAL 1)
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "NUP route requires exactly one pinned loader.cpp owner; re-audit source selection")
endif()
list(GET eden_nup_loader_owners 0 eden_nup_original_loader)
# Compile-only token alias changes the original entrypoint's *symbol*
# to EdenOriginalGetLoader while preserving its unmodified implementation.
# The wrapper in nup_v1_loader_route.cpp is the only public GetLoader.
set_property(SOURCE "${eden_nup_original_loader}" TARGET_DIRECTORY core
    APPEND PROPERTY COMPILE_DEFINITIONS GetLoader=EdenOriginalGetLoader)
target_sources(core PRIVATE
    "${EDEN_PORT_DIR}/nup_v1_vfs.cpp"
    "${EDEN_PORT_DIR}/nup_v1_native_vfs.cpp"
    "${EDEN_PORT_DIR}/nup_v1_native_content.cpp"

    "${EDEN_PORT_DIR}/nup_v1_native_loader.cpp"
    "${EDEN_PORT_DIR}/nup_v1_loader_route.cpp")
# Share maintained AoC enumeration and RomFS lookup with NUP. Preserve
# their NCA/extracted logic, adding a caller-scoped NUP source owner.
get_target_property(eden_nup_runtime_sources core SOURCES)
foreach(eden_nup_pair IN ITEMS
        "file_sys/romfs_factory.cpp|nup_v1_romfs_factory.cpp"
        "hle/service/aoc/addon_content_manager.cpp|nup_v1_aoc_service.cpp")
    string(REPLACE "|" ";" eden_nup_parts "${eden_nup_pair}")
    list(GET eden_nup_parts 0 eden_nup_previous_suffix)
    list(GET eden_nup_parts 1 eden_nup_new_name)
    set(eden_nup_matches)
    foreach(eden_nup_source IN LISTS eden_nup_runtime_sources)
        if(eden_nup_source MATCHES "(^|/)${eden_nup_previous_suffix}$")
            list(APPEND eden_nup_matches "${eden_nup_source}")
        endif()
    endforeach()
    list(LENGTH eden_nup_matches eden_nup_match_count)
    if(NOT eden_nup_match_count EQUAL 1)
        message(FATAL_ERROR
            "NUP requires exactly one existing AoC/ROMFS source owner: ${eden_nup_previous_suffix}")
    endif()
    list(GET eden_nup_matches 0 eden_nup_old_source)
    list(REMOVE_ITEM eden_nup_runtime_sources "${eden_nup_old_source}")
    list(APPEND eden_nup_runtime_sources
        "${EDEN_PORT_DIR}/${eden_nup_new_name}")
endforeach()
set_property(TARGET core PROPERTY SOURCES "${eden_nup_runtime_sources}")
set(eden_nup_extracted_aoc_headers
    "${PORT_ROOT}/vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/core/file_sys")
if(NOT EXISTS "${eden_nup_extracted_aoc_headers}/extracted_aoc.h")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "NUP AoC requires maintained existing extracted-aoc interface")
endif()
target_include_directories(core PRIVATE
    "${EDEN_PORT_DIR}" "${eden_nup_extracted_aoc_headers}")
# The single unified build always compiles NUP metadata/game selection.
# This is an internal source-definition shared by the headless frontend and
# metadata unit, never a selectable DEV/release/roadmap build variant.
target_compile_definitions(eden-headless PRIVATE EDEN_NUP_V1_RUNTIME=1)
target_compile_definitions(eden-metadata PRIVATE EDEN_NUP_V1_RUNTIME=1)
if(NOT TARGET libzstd_static OR NOT TARGET ZLIB::ZLIB)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "NUP requires existing pinned zstd and zlib targets")
endif()
target_link_libraries(core PRIVATE libzstd_static ZLIB::ZLIB)
```
