```cpp
void Launcher::draw_switch_game(Canvas& c,float opened) {
    auto& d=c.list;
    d.push_opacity(opened);
    const Game* game=library_.selected>=0&&library_.selected<static_cast<int>(games_.size())?
        &games_[static_cast<std::size_t>(library_.selected)]:nullptr;
    advanced_panel(c,tr("Game settings"),game?game->name:std::string{});
    const std::uint64_t id=game?game->title_id:0;
    const bool authored=prefs_.performance_profile>=0&&
        prefs_.performance_profile<kAuthoredVideoProfiles;
    const auto base=VideoPresetForTitle(id,authored?prefs_.performance_profile:1);
    const auto out=[](int v)->const char*{return v==2?"2160p":v==1?"1440p":"1080p";};
    const int baseRenderer=authored?base.renderer:prefs_.renderer;
    const int baseOutput=authored?base.output:prefs_.output;
    const int baseRes=authored?base.resolution:prefs_.resolution;
    const int baseFilter=authored?base.filter:prefs_.filter;
    const int baseFsr=authored?base.fsr_sharpness:prefs_.fsr_sharpness;
    const int baseAa=authored?base.anti_aliasing:prefs_.anti_aliasing;
    const int baseAniso=authored ? Eden::EncoreTextureProfiles::ForTitle(
        id,prefs_.performance_profile) : prefs_.texture_anisotropy;
    const int baseHz=authored?base.refresh:prefs_.refresh;
    static constexpr const char* names[]={
        TR("Console mode"),TR("Renderer"),TR("Video preset"),TR("TV output"),
        TR("Resolution"),TR("Upscaling"),TR("Sharpness"),
        TR("Anti-aliasing"),TR("Texture filtering"),TR("Frame Generation"),
        TR("Neural Rendering"),TR("Intensité DLSS-NR"),
        TR("Refresh rate"),TR("Button mapping"),TR("Mods"),TR("Save data")};
    const auto fallback=[](int local,const std::string& def,
                           const std::string& selected)->std::string{
        return local<0?switch_default(def):selected;
    };
    const auto g=game_settings_;
    const std::array<std::string,16> values={
        game_docked_?tr("Docked"):tr("Handheld"),
        fallback(g.renderer,baseRenderer?"Vulkan":"OpenGL",g.renderer?"Vulkan":"OpenGL"),
        fallback(g.performance_profile,
            switch_value(services_.performance_profile_labels(),prefs_.performance_profile),
            switch_value(services_.performance_profile_labels(),g.performance_profile)),
        fallback(g.output,out(baseOutput),out(g.output)),
        fallback(g.resolution,switch_value(services_.resolution_labels(),baseRes),
            switch_value(services_.resolution_labels(),g.resolution)),
        fallback(g.filter,switch_value(services_.filter_labels(),baseFilter),
            switch_value(services_.filter_labels(),g.filter)),
        fallback(g.fsr_sharpness,std::to_string(baseFsr)+"%",
            std::to_string(g.fsr_sharpness)+"%"),
        fallback(g.anti_aliasing,switch_value(services_.anti_aliasing_labels(),baseAa),
            switch_value(services_.anti_aliasing_labels(),g.anti_aliasing)),
        fallback(g.texture_anisotropy,TextureAnisotropyName(baseAniso),
            TextureAnisotropyName(g.texture_anisotropy)),
        fallback(g.frame_generation,
            prefs_.frame_generation == 0 ? tr("Off") :
                prefs_.frame_generation == 1 ? "MihawkGen" :
                prefs_.frame_generation == 2 ? "FSR 3" : "LSFG",
            g.frame_generation == 0 ? tr("Off") :
                g.frame_generation == 1 ? "MihawkGen" :
                g.frame_generation == 2 ? "FSR 3" : "LSFG"),
        fallback(g.neural_mode,NeuralModeName(prefs_.neural_mode),
                 NeuralModeName(g.neural_mode)),
        fallback(g.neural_strength,std::to_string(prefs_.neural_strength)+"%",
                 std::to_string(g.neural_strength)+"%"),
        fallback(g.refresh,hertz(baseHz),hertz(g.refresh)),
        g.own_mapping?
            switch_profile_name(g.controller_layout>=0?g.controller_layout:prefs_.controller_layout,
                                g.mapping):
        g.controller_layout>=0?
            switch_profile_name(g.controller_layout,Eden::BaseMappingForLayout(g.controller_layout)):
            fill(tr("Global ({0})"),{switch_profile_name(prefs_.controller_layout,prefs_.mapping)}),
        mods_.empty()?tr("No mods"):
            game&&!game->mods_enabled?tr("Off"):
            fill(tr("{0} of {1} on"),{
                std::to_string(std::count_if(mods_.begin(),mods_.end(),
                    [](const Mod& m){return m.enabled;})),
                std::to_string(mods_.size())}),
        import_source_==SaveSource::ryujinx?tr("Ryujinx save found"):
            import_source_==SaveSource::folder?tr("Save folder found"):tr("Nothing to import")
    };
    d.push_clip(kAdvancedClip);
    for(int i=game_rows_.first_row();i<=game_rows_.last_row();++i) {
        if(i<0||i>=16)continue;
        const float y=318+float(i)*96-game_rows_.scroll();
        advanced_row(c,y,i==option_,tr(names[i]),values[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)],
                     game_rows_.row_alpha(i,92));
    }
    d.pop_clip();
    if (confirmation_==Confirmation::none && message_.empty() &&
        option_>=5 && option_<=11) {
        const int filter=EffectiveGameUpscalingFilter(game_settings_,prefs_,id);
        const int aa=game_settings_.anti_aliasing>=0?
            game_settings_.anti_aliasing:baseAa;
        const int renderer=EffectiveGameRenderer(game_settings_,prefs_,id);
        const char* guide=nullptr;
        bool inactive=false;
        if (option_==5) {
            inactive=!UpscalingFilterSelectable(filter,renderer);
            guide=inactive?UpscalingUnsupportedGuide():UpscalingGuide(filter);
        } else if (option_==6) {
            inactive=!UpscalingSupportsSharpness(filter) ||
                !UpscalingFilterSelectable(filter,renderer);
            guide=SharpnessGuide(filter,!inactive);
        } else if (option_==7) {
            inactive=aa==3 && renderer!=1;
            guide=inactive?FxaaUnsupportedGuide():AntiAliasingGuide(aa);
        } else if (option_==8) {
            guide=TextureGuide();
        } else if (option_==9) {
            inactive=!FrameGenerationSelectable(renderer) ||
                (g.neural_mode<0?prefs_.neural_mode:g.neural_mode)!=Eden::NeuralVideo::kOff;
            guide=inactive?FramegenUnsupportedGuide():
                tr(TR("Frame generation can smooth the display without speeding up the game. Lossless Scaling needs your own DLL."));
        } else if (option_==10) {
            guide=NeuralModeGuide(g.neural_mode<0?prefs_.neural_mode:g.neural_mode);
        } else if (option_==11) {
            const int mode=g.neural_mode<0?prefs_.neural_mode:g.neural_mode;
            inactive=!Eden::NeuralVideo::IsDlss(mode);
            guide=NeuralStrengthGuide(mode);
        }
        if (guide)
            switch_video_help(c,tr(names[option_]),guide,inactive,730.0f);
    }
    if(confirmation_==Confirmation::none)
        advanced_status(c,message_,message_warning_,option_==15?TR("Import"):
                        option_==14?TR("Open"):TR("Change"));
    d.pop_opacity();
}
void Launcher::draw_switch_mods(Canvas& c,float opened) {
    auto& d=c.list;
    d.push_opacity(opened);
    const Game* game=library_.selected>=0&&library_.selected<static_cast<int>(games_.size())?
        &games_[static_cast<std::size_t>(library_.selected)]:nullptr;
    advanced_panel(c,tr("Mods"),game?game->name:std::string{});
    if(mods_.empty())
        text_block(c,fill(tr("No mods for this game yet. Copy each mod's folder to {0}, next to roms/."),
                    {game?services_.mods_folder(game->title_id):std::string{}}),
                   546,baseline(332,72,23),23,40,kInk,828,5);
    else {
        const bool active=!game||game->mods_enabled;
        d.push_clip(kAdvancedClip);
        for(int i=mod_rows_.first_row();i<=mod_rows_.last_row();++i) {
            if(i<0||i>=static_cast<int>(mods_.size()))continue;
            const auto& m=mods_[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)];
            advanced_row(c,318+float(i)*96-mod_rows_.scroll(),
                i==mod_rows_.selected,m.name+" · "+m.kind,
                active&&m.enabled?tr("On"):tr("Off"),mod_rows_.row_alpha(i,92));
        }
        d.pop_clip();
    }
    if(confirmation_==Confirmation::none)
        advanced_status(c,message_,message_warning_,mods_.empty()?
                        TR("Create the folder"):TR("Turn on or off"));
    d.pop_opacity();
}
void Launcher::draw_switch_mapping(Canvas& c,float opened) {
    auto& d=c.list;
    d.push_opacity(opened);
    const Game* game=mapping_for_game_&&library_.selected>=0&&
        library_.selected<static_cast<int>(games_.size())?
        &games_[static_cast<std::size_t>(library_.selected)]:nullptr;
    const ButtonMapping buttons=mapping_for_game_?
        Eden::ResolveSessionButtonMapping(prefs_.controller_layout,prefs_.mapping,
            game_settings_.controller_layout,game_settings_.own_mapping,
            game_settings_.mapping).buttons:prefs_.mapping;
    const int layout=mapping_for_game_&&game_settings_.controller_layout>=0?
        game_settings_.controller_layout:prefs_.controller_layout;
    const std::string profile=switch_profile_name(layout,buttons);
    advanced_panel(c,tr("Button mapping"),game?game->name+" · "+profile:
                   fill(tr("Global controller profile: {0}"),{profile}));
    static constexpr const char* names[]={"A","B","X","Y","L","R","ZL","ZR","+","-",
        TR("Left stick press"),TR("Right stick press")};
    d.push_clip(kAdvancedClip);
    for(int i=mapping_rows_.first_row();i<=mapping_rows_.last_row();++i) {
        if(i<0||i>=kGameButtons)continue;
        const float y=318+float(i)*96-mapping_rows_.scroll();
        const int mapped=buttons[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)];
        const float opacity=mapping_rows_.row_alpha(i,92);
        advanced_row(c,y,i==mapping_rows_.selected,tr(names[i]),
                     switch_pad_label(mapped),opacity);
        // Match the original functional editor: the real physical pad glyph
        // stays visible next to the text, even for triggers and touchpad.
        d.push_opacity(opacity);
        const Pad icon=switch_physical_pad(mapped);
        if(mapped>=4) {
            // The shared physical-pad renderer uses light symbols for shoulder
            // and system keys. A dark neutral keycap is required on the
            // Switch theme's white paper; otherwise L/R are invisible.
            const float width=pad_width(icon,30.0f);
            d.rounded_rect({1030.0f,y+25.0f,std::max(44.0f,width+12.0f),42.0f},
                           9.0f,kInk);
        }
        draw_pad(c,icon,1035.0f,y+46.0f,30.0f);
        d.pop_opacity();
    }
    d.pop_clip();
    if(confirmation_==Confirmation::none)
        advanced_status(c,message_,message_warning_,TR("Change"));
    d.pop_opacity();
}

void Launcher::draw_switch_confirmation(Canvas& c) {
    if(confirmation_==Confirmation::none) return;
    auto& list=c.list;
    list.rounded_rect({0,0,1920,1080},0,kInk.with_alpha(0.52f));
    const Rect panel{512.0f,355.0f,896.0f,345.0f};
    list.shadow({panel.x-9,panel.y-8,panel.w+18,panel.h+20},
                9,32,kBlack.with_alpha(0.18f));
    list.rounded_rect(panel,5,kWhite);
    const char* title=tr("Confirm");
    if (confirmation_==Confirmation::app_update)
        title=tr("Application updates");
    if(confirmation_==Confirmation::exit_app)
        title=tr("Exit Eden Encore");
    else if(confirmation_==Confirmation::console_mode)
        title=tr("Console mode");
    else if(confirmation_==Confirmation::mapping_reset)
        title=tr("Controls");
    else if(confirmation_==Confirmation::shader_caches)
        title=tr("Diagnostics");
    text_shrink(c,title,563.0f,baseline(382.0f,67.0f,32.0f),
                32.0f,kInk,780.0f);
    list.rounded_rect({563,464,780,2},0,kGrey);
    text_shrink(c,message_,563.0f,baseline(492.0f,75.0f,26.0f),
                26.0f,kInk,780.0f);
    list.rounded_rect({563,607,780,1},0,kGrey);
    list.ring(1038,651,15,2,kSubtle);
    text(c,"B",1038,657,18,kInk,Align::center);
    text_shrink(c,tr("Cancel"),1065,658,21,kInk,112);
    list.ring(1230,651,15,2,kSubtle);
    text(c,"A",1230,657,18,kInk,Align::center);
    text_shrink(c,tr("Confirm"),1258,658,21,kInk,115);
}

void Launcher::draw_switch_dialog(Canvas& c, Modal modal, float opened) {
    auto& list=c.list;
    list.push_opacity(opened);
    const Rect panel{430.0f,113.0f,1060.0f,854.0f};
    list.rounded_rect(panel,3.0f,kWhite);
    list.bordered_rect(panel,3.0f,kWhite,1.5f,kGrey);
    const char *heading=tr("System Settings");
    switch(modal) {
    case Modal::video:heading=tr("Video");break;
    case Modal::audio:heading=tr("Audio");break;
    case Modal::controls:heading=tr("Controls");break;
    case Modal::accessibility:heading=tr("Accessibility");break;
    case Modal::appearance:heading=tr("Appearance");break;
    case Modal::application:heading=tr("Application updates");break;
    case Modal::diagnostics:heading=tr("Diagnostics");break;
    default:break;
    }
    text_shrink(c,heading,493.0f,baseline(150.0f,72.0f,36.0f),
                36.0f,kInk,910.0f);
    list.rounded_rect({493,245,932,2},0,kGrey);
    const int total=dialog_rows(modal);
    const int first=(modal==Modal::video || modal==Modal::appearance)?std::clamp(option_-2,0,std::max(0,total-5)):0;
    const int last=std::min(total,first+(modal==Modal::video?4:5));
    for(int i=first;i<last;++i) {
        const float y=278.0f+float(i-first)*112.0f;
        const Rect row{495.0f,y,930.0f,101.0f};
        if(i==option_) {
            list.rounded_rect(row,3.0f,gfx::Color::rgb(0xdff8fb));
            list.bordered_rect(row,3.0f,kPaper.with_alpha(0.0f),3.0f,kFocus);
        } else list.rounded_rect({row.x,row.y+100,row.w,1},0,kGrey);
        const char *label="";
        std::string value;
        switch(modal) {
        case Modal::appearance: {
            const char* labels[] = {
                TR("Theme"), TR("Official logo"), TR("Accent"), TR("Background"),
                TR("Local image"), TR("Color 1 preset"), TR("Color 1 red"),
                TR("Color 1 green"), TR("Color 1 blue"), TR("Color 2 preset"),
                TR("Color 2 red"), TR("Color 2 green"), TR("Color 2 blue"),
                TR("Focus glow"), TR("Glow intensity"), TR("Image darkness"),
                TR("Background motion"), TR("Image scaling"), TR("Game background"),
                TR("Reset appearance")};
            const char* theme_names[] = {
                "Encore Neon", "Switch", "Encore Non-Neon", "Encore Dark", "Encore Light"};
            const char* logos[] = {"Automatic", "Neon", "Non-Neon", "White", "Dark"};
            const char* backgrounds[] = {
                "Theme default", "Encore artwork", "Solid color", "Gradient",
                "Local image", "Daily Switch"};
            const char* accents[] = {"Original", "Ocean", "Emerald", "Amber", "Rose"};
            const int theme = prefs_.ui_theme ? 1 :
                (prefs_.color_palette == 0 ? 0 : std::clamp(prefs_.color_palette+1, 2, 4));
            label = tr(labels[i]);
            switch(i) {
            case 0: value = theme_names[theme]; break;
            case 1: value = logos[std::clamp(prefs_.logo_choice,0,4)]; break;
            case 2: value = accents[std::clamp(prefs_.accent_color,0,4)]; break;
            case 3: value = backgrounds[std::clamp(prefs_.background_style,0,5)]; break;
            case 4: value = prefs_.wallpaper_file.empty()?tr("None"):prefs_.wallpaper_file; break;
            case 5: value = std::to_string(prefs_.background_color); break;
            case 6: case 7: case 8:
                value = std::to_string((prefs_.background_color >> (16 - 8*(i-6))) & 255u);
                break;
            case 9: value = std::to_string(prefs_.background_color2); break;
            case 10: case 11: case 12:
                value = std::to_string((prefs_.background_color2 >> (16 - 8*(i-10))) & 255u);
                break;
            case 13: value = prefs_.glow_enabled?tr("On"):tr("Off"); break;
            case 14: value = std::to_string(prefs_.glow_strength)+"%"; break;
            case 15: value = std::to_string(prefs_.background_overlay)+"%"; break;
            case 16: value = prefs_.background_animate?tr("On"):tr("Off"); break;
            case 17: value = prefs_.background_fit?tr("Contain"):tr("Fill"); break;
            case 18: value = prefs_.show_game_background?tr("On"):tr("Off"); break;
            default: value = tr("Restore Neon"); break;
            }
            break;
        }
        case Modal::application:
            label = i==0 ? tr("Check now") : tr("Check on launcher start");
            value = i==0 ? tr("Search GitHub Releases") :
                             (prefs_.check_updates_on_start ? tr("On") : tr("Off"));
            break;
        case Modal::accessibility:
            label=i==0?tr("Larger text"):i==1?tr("High contrast"):tr("Reduce motion");
            value=(i==0?prefs_.large_text:i==1?prefs_.high_contrast:prefs_.reduce_motion)?tr("On"):tr("Off");
            break;
        case Modal::audio:
            label=i==0?tr("Game volume"):i==1?tr("Mute"):tr("Menu sounds");
            value=i==0?std::to_string(prefs_.volume)+"%":
                  i==1?(prefs_.mute?tr("On"):tr("Off")):std::to_string(prefs_.menu_volume)+"%";
            break;
        case Modal::video: {
            static constexpr const char* labels[]={
                TR("Renderer"),TR("Video preset"),TR("TV output"),TR("Game resolution"),
                TR("Upscaling"),TR("Sharpness"),TR("Anti-aliasing"),
                TR("Texture filtering"),TR("Frame Generation"),
                TR("Neural Rendering"),TR("Intensité DLSS-NR"),
                TR("Refresh rate"),TR("FPS overlay")};
            label=tr(labels[i]);
            switch(i) {
            case 0:value=prefs_.renderer?tr("Vulkan (recommended)"):"OpenGL";break;
            case 1:value=switch_value(services_.performance_profile_labels(),prefs_.performance_profile);break;
            case 2:value=prefs_.output==2?"2160p":prefs_.output==1?"1440p":"1080p";break;
            case 3:value=switch_value(services_.resolution_labels(),prefs_.resolution);break;
            case 4:value=switch_value(services_.filter_labels(),prefs_.filter);break;
            case 5:value=std::to_string(prefs_.fsr_sharpness)+"%";break;
            case 6:value=switch_value(services_.anti_aliasing_labels(),prefs_.anti_aliasing);break;
            case 7:value=TextureAnisotropyName(prefs_.texture_anisotropy);break;
            case 8:value=prefs_.frame_generation==0?tr("Off"):
                          prefs_.frame_generation==1?"MihawkGen":
                          prefs_.frame_generation==2?"FSR 3":"LSFG";break;
            case 9:value=NeuralModeName(prefs_.neural_mode);break;
            case 10:value=std::to_string(prefs_.neural_strength)+"%";break;
            case 11:value=prefs_.refresh?"120 Hz":"60 Hz";break;
            default:value=prefs_.hud?tr("On"):tr("Off");break;
            }
            break;
        }
        case Modal::controls:
            label=i==0?tr("Button profile"):i==1?tr("Button mapping"):
                  i==2?tr("Vibration"):i==3?tr("Vibration strength"):tr("Stick deadzone");
            value=i==0?(prefs_.controller_layout?"Switch":"PlayStation"):
                i==1?tr("Customize"):i==2?(prefs_.vibration?tr("On"):tr("Off")):
                i==3?std::to_string(prefs_.vibration_strength)+"%":
                     std::to_string(prefs_.stick_deadzone)+"%";
            break;
        case Modal::diagnostics:
            label=i==0?tr("Detailed logging"):tr("Clear cache");
            value=i==0?(prefs_.detailed_logging?tr("On"):tr("Off")):tr("Clear");
            break;
        default:
            label=tr("Select");
            break;
        }
        text_shrink(c,label,row.x+22,baseline(y,101,26),26,kInk,590);
        text_shrink(c,value,row.x+row.w-25,baseline(y,101,24),24,
                    i==option_?kInk:kSubtle,294,Align::right);
    }
    if (modal==Modal::video && message_.empty() &&
        option_>=4 && option_<=10) {
        const char* guides=nullptr;
        bool inactive=false;
        if (option_==4) {
            inactive=!UpscalingFilterSelectable(prefs_.filter,prefs_.renderer);
            guides=inactive?UpscalingUnsupportedGuide():UpscalingGuide(prefs_.filter);
        } else if (option_==5) {
            inactive=!UpscalingSupportsSharpness(prefs_.filter) ||
                !UpscalingFilterSelectable(prefs_.filter,prefs_.renderer);
            guides=SharpnessGuide(prefs_.filter,!inactive);
        } else if (option_==6) {
            inactive=prefs_.anti_aliasing>=3 && prefs_.renderer!=1;
            guides=inactive?FxaaUnsupportedGuide():
                AntiAliasingGuide(prefs_.anti_aliasing);
        } else if (option_==7) {
            guides=TextureGuide();
        } else if (option_==8) {
            inactive=!FrameGenerationSelectable(prefs_.renderer) ||
                prefs_.neural_mode!=Eden::NeuralVideo::kOff;
            guides=inactive?FramegenUnsupportedGuide():
                tr(TR("Frame generation can smooth the display without speeding up the game. Lossless Scaling needs your own DLL."));
        } else if (option_==9) {
            guides=NeuralModeGuide(prefs_.neural_mode);
        } else if (option_==10) {
            inactive=!Eden::NeuralVideo::IsDlss(prefs_.neural_mode);
            guides=NeuralStrengthGuide(prefs_.neural_mode);
        }
        static constexpr const char* labels[] = {
            TR("Upscaling"),TR("Sharpness"),TR("Anti-aliasing"),
            TR("Texture filtering"),TR("Frame Generation"),
            TR("Neural Rendering"),TR("Intensité DLSS-NR")
        };
        if (guides)
            switch_video_help(c,tr(labels[option_-4]),guides,inactive,744.0f);
    }
    list.rounded_rect({493,888,932,2},0,kGrey);
    text_shrink(c,tr("Change"),1252.0f,baseline(901,51,19),
                19,kInk,180,Align::right);
    text_shrink(c,tr("Back"),1397.0f,baseline(901,51,19),
                19,kInk,100,Align::right);
    list.pop_opacity();
}

void Launcher::press_switch_settings(Key key) {
    if(key==Key::down||key==Key::up||key==Key::left||key==Key::right||
       key==Key::l1||key==Key::r1) {
        // System Settings in the reference stops at the first/last category.
        // Do not change the wrapping behavior of Encore's shared ListView.
        const bool original_wrap=settings_.wrap;
        settings_.wrap=false;
        const bool moved=settings_.move(key==Key::down||key==Key::right||
                                        key==Key::r1?1:-1);
        settings_.wrap=original_wrap;
        if(moved) {
            section_.snap(1.0f);cue(Cue::focus);
            // Category Diagnostics performs its expensive scan off-thread.
            if(settings_.selected==5) start_diagnostics();
        }
        return;
    }
    // Preserve all native settings dialogs, language and storage behavior.
    press_settings(key);
}
```

```hpp
#pragma once

namespace pe::ui {
// R10 texture sampling, not upscaling or AI-generated texture replacement.
// The numeric choices are 2x/4x/8x/16x anisotropic sampler levels.
inline constexpr const char* kTextureAnisotropyLabels[] = {
    TR("Automatic"), TR("Game default"), "2x", "4x", "8x", "16x"};
inline const char* TextureAnisotropyName(int choice) {
    return pe::tr(kTextureAnisotropyLabels[std::clamp(choice, 0, 5)]);
}
```

`headless/prosperoeden/pe/ui/textures.cpp`:

```cpp
// ProsperoEden - The launcher's textures: its own art and lazily loaded covers.
// Copyright (C) 2026 BlackBearReloaded
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later

#include "pe/ui/textures.hpp"

#include "pe/ui/dualsense_mask_asset.hpp"
#include "pe/core/log.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <future>
#include <string_view>
#include <utility>

namespace pe::ui
{

namespace
{

constexpr std::size_t kMaxCovers = 160;
constexpr std::size_t kMaxTextureReclaimsPerFrame = 2;
// Nlib replaces images by atomic rename. Multiple invalidations can leave
// stale decode requests in the FIFO. Never drain an unbounded number of
// invalid keys in one held-D-pad UI frame; finish the backlog next frame.
constexpr std::size_t kMaxCoverQueueLookupsPerFrame = 24;
// Profile avatars are UI-critical and often arrive after NiakPS5's broker
// creates its staged image. Give their small decode priority over a library
// full of 16:9 screenshots. The decoder still runs off the GL/UI thread.
bool IsProfileAvatarImage(std::string_view path)
{
    return path.find("/system_data/priv/cache/profile/") != std::string_view::npos ||
           path.find("/NiakPS5/assets/niak-profile.") != std::string_view::npos;
}

} // namespace

Textures::~Textures()
{
    release();
}

std::uint32_t Textures::create(const gfx::Image &image)
{
    return image.empty() ? 0 : batch_.create_texture(image.width, image.height, image.rgba.data());
}

void Textures::clear_case_pages()
{
    for (const auto texture : case_pages_)
        batch_.delete_texture(texture);
    case_pages_.clear();
}

std::uint32_t Textures::render_case_page(const gfx::DrawList& drawing,
                                          const gfx::Font* font,
                                          std::uint32_t font_texture,
                                          int width, int height,
                                          std::uint32_t existing)
{
    // A single title owns at most two live pages (front/back). Refreshing
    // existing ink must never allocate a third page or change its GL ID.
    if (width <= 0 || width > 1024 || height <= 0 || height > 1536 ||
        drawing.instances().empty())
        return 0;
    const bool refresh = existing != 0;
    if (refresh) {
        if (std::find(case_pages_.begin(), case_pages_.end(), existing) ==
            case_pages_.end()) return 0;
    } else if (case_pages_.size() >= 2) {
        return 0;
    }
    const std::uint32_t ink = refresh ? existing :
        batch_.create_texture(width, height, nullptr);
    if (!ink) return 0;
    GLint old_fbo = 0;
    GLint old_viewport[4]{};
    GLfloat old_clear[4]{};
    const GLboolean old_scissor = glIsEnabled(GL_SCISSOR_TEST);
    glGetIntegerv(GL_FRAMEBUFFER_BINDING, &old_fbo);
    glGetIntegerv(GL_VIEWPORT, old_viewport);
    glGetFloatv(GL_COLOR_CLEAR_VALUE, old_clear);
    GLuint framebuffer = 0;
    glGenFramebuffers(1, &framebuffer);
    if (!framebuffer) {
        if (!refresh) batch_.delete_texture(ink);
        return 0;
    }
    glBindFramebuffer(GL_FRAMEBUFFER, framebuffer);
    glFramebufferTexture2D(GL_FRAMEBUFFER, GL_COLOR_ATTACHMENT0,
                           GL_TEXTURE_2D, ink, 0);
    const bool complete = glCheckFramebufferStatus(GL_FRAMEBUFFER) ==
                          GL_FRAMEBUFFER_COMPLETE;
    if (complete) {
        // Render only the paper ink. The original launcher still owns the
        // shared 3D transparent shell, rounded plastic and red physical spine.
        glDisable(GL_SCISSOR_TEST);
        glViewport(0, 0, width, height);
        // Printed jacket paper is ONE fully opaque sheet, even at the
        // outermost top/bottom texels and under missing async media.
        // Clearing to transparent allowed the shell/background to show
        // through GL's interpolated edges during the 3D rotation.
        glClearColor(17.0f / 255.0f, 34.0f / 255.0f,
                     53.0f / 255.0f, 1.0f);
        glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
        if (font && font_texture)
            batch_.sync_font_texture(font_texture, *font);
        batch_.draw(drawing, gfx::Viewport{}, width, height);
    }
    glBindFramebuffer(GL_FRAMEBUFFER, static_cast<GLuint>(old_fbo));
    glViewport(old_viewport[0], old_viewport[1],
               old_viewport[2], old_viewport[3]);
    glClearColor(old_clear[0], old_clear[1], old_clear[2], old_clear[3]);
    if (old_scissor) glEnable(GL_SCISSOR_TEST);
    else glDisable(GL_SCISSOR_TEST);
    glDeleteFramebuffers(1, &framebuffer);
    if (!complete) {
        if (!refresh) batch_.delete_texture(ink);
        return 0;
    }
    if (!refresh) case_pages_.push_back(ink);
    return ink;
}

bool Textures::load_art(const std::string &directory)
{
    const auto load = [&](const char *name, std::uint32_t *texture)
    {
        gfx::Image image;
        const std::string legacy = directory + "/" + name;
        const std::string preferred = legacy.ends_with(".tga")
            ? legacy.substr(0, legacy.size() - 4) + ".webp" : legacy;
        // The PS5 package ships WebP, while host previews and older
        // installations may still ship the original uncompressed TGA.
        if (!services_.load_image(preferred, &image) &&
            !services_.load_image(legacy, &image))
        {
            sys::log("art %s could not be read", name);
            return false;
        }
        *texture = create(image);
        return *texture != 0;
    };
    // The package generates this from assets/encore-background.jpg. It is launcher-only and is
    // released before a game starts, so it does not consume gameplay VRAM.
    (void)load("art/backdrop.tga", &backdrop_);
    const bool brand = load("art/brand.tga", &brand_);
    (void)load("art/brand-noneon.tga", &logos_[0]);
    (void)load("art/brand-white.tga", &logos_[1]);
    (void)load("art/brand-dark.tga", &logos_[2]);
    // Exact fixed components are optional assets; the painter retains a
    // clean metadata-only fallback when they are absent.
    (void)load("art/switch-logo.tga", &switch_logo_);
    (void)load("art/switch-rear-footer.tga", &switch_rear_footer_);
    (void)load("art/ns2-head.tga", &switch2_header_);
    // Licensed DualSense artwork is a compact 144x100 mask embedded in the
    // launcher. Decode it ONCE before any frame; no SVG parser, PNG I/O or
    // texture upload inside navigation/gameplay. Fall back to the old local
    // controller TGA if an asset revision is ever malformed.
    gfx::Image pad_image;
    pad_image.width = art::kDualSenseWidth;
    pad_image.height = art::kDualSenseHeight;
    constexpr std::size_t kPixels =
        static_cast<std::size_t>(art::kDualSenseWidth) * art::kDualSenseHeight;
    pad_image.rgba.resize(kPixels * 4u);
    std::size_t pixel = 0;
    bool valid = true;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < art::kDualSenseRunsCount; i += 2) {
        const std::size_t length = art::kDualSenseAlphaRuns[i];
        const auto level = art::kDualSenseAlphaRuns[i + 1];
        if (length == 0 || level > 3 || length > kPixels - pixel) {
            valid = false;
            break;
        }
        for (std::size_t n = 0; n < length; ++n, ++pixel) {
            auto* color = pad_image.rgba.data() + pixel * 4u;
            color[0] = color[1] = color[2] = 255;
            // The supplied outline uses predominantly alpha level 1
            // (85/255). On Eden's near-black TV panels this looks BLACK,
            // even when the RGB tint is white. Preserve transparent pixels
            // but render nonzero outline samples as opaque white.
            color[3] = level == 0 ? 0 : (level == 1 ? 240 : 255);
        }
    }
    if (valid && pixel == kPixels)
        controller_ = create(pad_image);
    if (!controller_)
        (void)load("art/controller.tga", &controller_);
    return brand;
}

void Textures::release()
{
    clear_case_pages();
    // The worker only reads/decompresses CPU-side bytes. Its lifetime must
    // end before the Services reference backing it can be destroyed.
    if (decode_.valid()) {
        decode_.wait();
        try { (void)decode_.get(); } catch (...) {}
    }
    for (std::uint32_t *texture : {&backdrop_, &backdrop_blur_, &brand_, &controller_,
                                   &switch_logo_, &switch_rear_footer_, &switch2_header_})
    {
        batch_.delete_texture(*texture);
        *texture = 0;
    }
    for (auto &texture : logos_) {
        batch_.delete_texture(texture);
        texture = 0;
    }
    for (auto &[key, entry] : covers_)
        batch_.delete_texture(entry.texture);
    covers_.clear();
    // A context is still current during release; drain the bounded-per-frame
    // invalidation backlog before destroying it to prevent orphaned GL IDs.
    for (const std::uint32_t texture : pending_deletes_)
        batch_.delete_texture(texture);
    pending_deletes_.clear();
    queue_.clear();
}

Cover Textures::cover(const std::string &path, float size)
{
    if (path.empty())
        return {0, 0.0f, true, 1.0f};
    // A 1920px Nlib screenshot used as a 300px library tile must not
    // upload the full 8 MiB RGBA image on the GL/UI thread. Quantize
    // requested physical pixels into stable power-of-two buckets, retaining
    // the unscaled source for the 1920px Home Hero.
    const float pixels = std::clamp(size * output_scale_, 1.0f, 2048.0f);
    int target_pixels = 64;
    while (target_pixels < pixels && target_pixels < 2048)
        target_pixels *= 2;
    const std::string key = path + '#' + std::to_string(target_pixels);
    auto it = covers_.find(key);
    if (it == covers_.end())
    {
        Entry entry;
        entry.path = path;
        entry.target_pixels = target_pixels;
        entry.generation = ++next_generation_;
        it = covers_.emplace(key, std::move(entry)).first;
        if (IsProfileAvatarImage(path)) queue_.push_front(key);
        else queue_.push_back(key);
    }
    it->second.used = frame_;
    // Calculate age only for visible/queried covers, not every cached entry.
    float age = it->second.loaded
        ? static_cast<float>(uptime_seconds_ - it->second.loaded_at_seconds)
        : 0.0f;
    // Nlib downloads arrive by atomic rename. Poll a missing *visible* cover
    // once after 450 ms (instead of freezing its placeholder for three seconds),
    // then back off to 1.5 / 3 s if it is truly absent. No per-frame stat().
    const float retry_after = it->second.failed_loads <= 1 ? 0.45f :
                              it->second.failed_loads == 2 ? 1.5f : 3.0f;
    if (it->second.loaded && it->second.texture == 0 &&
        age >= retry_after) {
        it->second.loaded = false;
        it->second.loaded_at_seconds = uptime_seconds_;
        age = 0.0f;
        if (IsProfileAvatarImage(path)) queue_.push_front(key);
        else queue_.push_back(key);
    }
    // Preserve a previously confirmed missing state while its next decode
    // is queued. Otherwise a failed official scan briefly hides its composed
    // sleeve on every retry, before the eventual successful upload.
    const bool missing = it->second.texture == 0 &&
                         (it->second.loaded || it->second.failed_loads != 0);
    return {it->second.texture, age, missing,
            it->second.aspect};
}

void Textures::invalidate(const std::string &path)
{
    if (path.empty()) return;
    // The Nlib atomic rename invalidates every size bucket of this path.
    // Also purge its pending decode requests now: otherwise repeated media
    // refreshes can leave hundreds of dead FIFO entries, and the bounded
    // 24-lookups/frame decoder delays newly visible covers behind them.
    // The '#' boundary prevents removing a different path with the same prefix.
    const auto is_queued_variant = [&](const std::string& key) {
        return key.size() > path.size() &&
               key.compare(0, path.size(), path) == 0 &&
               key[path.size()] == '#';
    };
    queue_.erase(std::remove_if(queue_.begin(), queue_.end(),
                                is_queued_variant), queue_.end());
    for (auto it = covers_.begin(); it != covers_.end(); )
    {
        if (it->second.path == path) {
            if (it->second.texture != 0)
                pending_deletes_.push_back(it->second.texture);
            it = covers_.erase(it);
        } else {
            ++it;
        }
    }
}

void Textures::pump(float dt, int budget)
{
    ++frame_;
    uptime_seconds_ += static_cast<double>(dt);
    // Nlib can replace a banner, icon and three screenshots at once.
    // Invalidation itself performs zero GL calls; retire at most two of
    // their old textures here, spreading driver cleanup across frames.
    std::size_t deleted_this_frame = 0;
    while (deleted_this_frame < kMaxTextureReclaimsPerFrame &&
           !pending_deletes_.empty()) {
        batch_.delete_texture(pending_deletes_.front());
        pending_deletes_.pop_front();
        ++deleted_this_frame;
    }
    // Cache-wide age updates removed: elapsed time is computed lazily.

    // Decoding a 1920x1080 Nlib JPEG/TGA and generating downsized copies on
    // the UI thread caused visible menu repeat/scroll stalls (>100 ms).
    // Only the GL texture upload stays on the owner thread. Handle *at most
    // one* completed upload this frame and prefetch the next image afterwards.
    if (decode_.valid() &&
        decode_.wait_for(std::chrono::seconds(0)) == std::future_status::ready)
    {
        try {
            DecodedCover result = decode_.get();
            const auto it = covers_.find(result.key);
            if (it != covers_.end() &&
                it->second.generation == result.generation) {
                Entry &entry = it->second;
                entry.loaded = true;
                entry.loaded_at_seconds = uptime_seconds_;
                const bool profile_avatar = IsProfileAvatarImage(entry.path);
                const bool retail_case =
                    entry.path.find("/box-front-") != std::string::npos ||
                    entry.path.find("/box-back-") != std::string::npos ||
                    entry.path.find("/box-spine-") != std::string::npos;
                if (!result.ok || result.image.empty()) {
                    entry.failed_loads = std::min(entry.failed_loads + 1u, 4u);
                    if (retail_case)
                        sys::log("EDEN_CASE_TEXTURE status=decode-failed path=%s attempt=%u",
                                 entry.path.c_str(), entry.failed_loads);
                    if (profile_avatar)
                        sys::log("EDEN_PROFILE_AVATAR_TEXTURE status=decode_failed attempt=%u",
                                 entry.failed_loads);
                } else {
                    entry.failed_loads = 0;
                    entry.aspect = static_cast<float>(result.image.width) /
                                   static_cast<float>(result.image.height);
                    entry.texture = create(result.image);
                    if (entry.texture == 0)
                        entry.failed_loads = std::min(entry.failed_loads + 1u, 4u);
                    if (retail_case)
                        sys::log("EDEN_CASE_TEXTURE status=%s path=%s width=%d height=%d texture=%u",
                                 entry.texture ? "ready" : "upload-failed",
                                 entry.path.c_str(), result.image.width,
                                 result.image.height, entry.texture);
                    if (profile_avatar)
                        sys::log("EDEN_PROFILE_AVATAR_TEXTURE status=%s width=%d height=%d",
                                 entry.texture ? "ready" : "upload_failed",
                                 result.image.width, result.image.height);
                }
            }
        } catch (const std::exception& error) {
            sys::log("cover decode failed: %s", error.what());
        } catch (...) {
            sys::log("cover decode failed: unknown error");
        }
        // A consumed future is invalid. The next queued image can start now.
    }

    if (budget > 0 && !decode_.valid()) {
        std::size_t inspected = 0;
        while (!queue_.empty() && inspected < kMaxCoverQueueLookupsPerFrame) {
            ++inspected;
            std::string key = std::move(queue_.front());
            queue_.pop_front();
            const auto it = covers_.find(key);
            if (it == covers_.end() || it->second.loaded) continue;
            const std::string path = it->second.path;
            const int target_pixels = it->second.target_pixels;
            const auto generation = it->second.generation;
            try {
                decode_ = std::async(std::launch::async,
                    [this, key = std::move(key), path, target_pixels, generation]() mutable {
                        DecodedCover decoded;
                        decoded.key = std::move(key);
                        decoded.generation = generation;
                        try {
                            decoded.ok = services_.load_image(path, &decoded.image);
                            if (decoded.ok) {
                                // Keep the largest dimension near the actual
                                // rendering footprint. This scaling is CPU-side
                                // on the decode worker, never in the UI frame.
                                // The 3/2 threshold avoids uploading a 960px
                                // image for a 512px tile while respecting the
                                // original Hero resolution at 2048px.
                                while (decoded.image.width > 1 &&
                                       decoded.image.height > 1 &&
                                       std::max(decoded.image.width, decoded.image.height) >
                                           target_pixels * 3 / 2)
                                    decoded.image = gfx::halve(decoded.image);
                            }
                        } catch (...) {
                            decoded.image = {};
                            decoded.ok = false; // normal retry/backoff on bad media
                        }
                        return decoded;
                    });
            } catch (const std::exception& error) {
                sys::log("cover queue failed: %s", error.what());
                it->second.loaded = true;
                it->second.loaded_at_seconds = uptime_seconds_;
                it->second.failed_loads = std::min(it->second.failed_loads + 1u, 4u);
            }
            break;
        }
    }

    if (covers_.size() > kMaxCovers)
    {
        // Avoid building and sorting a temporary vector every UI frame.
        // Evict at most two stale, completed covers per update: a bounded
        // number of GL deletes and no heap allocation in this hot path.
        for (std::size_t reclaimed = 0;
             deleted_this_frame + reclaimed < kMaxTextureReclaimsPerFrame &&
             covers_.size() > kMaxCovers * 3 / 4; ++reclaimed)
        {
            auto oldest = covers_.end();
            for (auto it = covers_.begin(); it != covers_.end(); ++it)
            {
                // Never evict in-flight decodes or the last two frames'
                // visible covers, even under a large collection pressure.
                if (!it->second.loaded || it->second.used + 2 >= frame_)
                    continue;
                if (oldest == covers_.end() ||
                    it->second.used < oldest->second.used)
                    oldest = it;
            }
            if (oldest == covers_.end())
                break;
            batch_.delete_texture(oldest->second.texture);
            covers_.erase(oldest);
        }
    }
}

} // namespace pe::ui
```

`headless/prosperoeden/pe/ui/textures.hpp`:

```hpp
// ProsperoEden - The launcher's textures: its own art and lazily loaded covers.
// Copyright (C) 2026 BlackBearReloaded
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later

#pragma once

#include "pe/gfx/gl_batch.hpp"
#include "pe/ui/services.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <deque>
#include <future>
#include <string>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>

namespace pe::ui
{

// A cover as far as it is known.
struct Cover
{
    std::uint32_t texture = 0; // 0 while it is queued, and when there is none
    float age = 0.0f;          // seconds since it loaded, for the fade-in
    bool missing = false;      // the game has no cover, or its file cannot be read
    float aspect = 1.0f;       // loaded source width / height, used for CSS-like cover cropping
};

// Owns every GL texture of the launcher. Decoding and geometric scaling are
// off-thread; the UI thread uploads at most one ready texture per frame.
// Distinct display-size buckets avoid uploading 1080p artwork for small tiles.
// The least recently drawn texture variants are discarded.
class Textures
{
  public:
    Textures(gfx::GlBatch &batch, Services &services) : batch_(batch), services_(services) {}
    Textures(const Textures &) = delete;
    Textures &operator=(const Textures &) = delete;
    ~Textures();

    // Launcher background, brand and controller art. The background is generated from Encore art.
    bool load_art(const std::string &directory);
    // Deletes every texture; the GL context must still be current.
    void release();

    std::uint32_t backdrop() const
    {
        return backdrop_;
    }
    std::uint32_t backdrop_blur() const
    {
        return backdrop_blur_;
    }
    std::uint32_t brand() const
    {
        return brand_;
    }
    // 0 original Neon; 1 Non-Neon; 2 White; 3 Dark. Absent asset -> Neon.
    std::uint32_t logo(int selection) const {
        if (selection < 1 || selection > 3) return brand_;
        const auto texture = logos_[static_cast<std::size_t>(selection - 1)];
        return texture ? texture : brand_;
    }

    // A controller in white on transparent (0 when the picture is missing).
    std::uint32_t controller() const
    {
        return controller_;
    }
    // Immutable printed inserts for metadata-composed Switch jackets.
    // Loaded with launcher art, never fetched in a frame.
    std::uint32_t switch_logo() const { return switch_logo_; }
    std::uint32_t switch_rear_footer() const { return switch_rear_footer_; }
    std::uint32_t switch2_header() const { return switch2_header_; }

    // The cover drawn `size` virtual pixels wide. Queues it on first use.
    Cover cover(const std::string &path, float size);
    // Schedules at most one background image decode and uploads at most one
    // completed texture per frame. Never does file I/O or JPEG/TGA decode
    // on the input/navigation/render thread.
    void pump(float dt, int budget = 2);
    // Called only when Nlib atomically replaces an image with the same path.
    void invalidate(const std::string &path);
    // Compose one offline artwork sleeve with the REAL C++/OpenGL UI painter.
    // At most one page per face. A provisional page can be refreshed IN PLACE
    // after its cached input images finish decoding, without a third GPU page.
    // existing must be a live case page owned by this Textures instance (or 0
    // to allocate); 0 on failure leaves an existing page usable and unchanged.
    std::uint32_t render_case_page(const gfx::DrawList& drawing,
                                   const gfx::Font* font,
                                   std::uint32_t font_texture,
                                   int width, int height,
                                   std::uint32_t existing = 0);
    void clear_case_pages();
    // Output pixels per virtual pixel: picks how much detail a cover needs.
    void set_output_scale(float scale)
    {
        output_scale_ = scale;
    }

  private:
    struct Entry
    {
        std::uint32_t texture = 0;
        // Per-cover timestamp; no per-frame cache-wide age mutation.
        double loaded_at_seconds = 0.0;
        bool loaded = false; // false: queued or decoding
        std::uint64_t generation = 0;
        unsigned failed_loads = 0; // bounded retry backoff when async Nlib media arrive
        std::uint64_t used = 0;
        std::string path;
        int target_pixels = 64; // desired max image dimension, quantized to power of two
        float aspect = 1.0f;
    };

    struct DecodedCover {
        std::string key;
        std::uint64_t generation = 0;
        gfx::Image image;
        bool ok = false;
    };
    std::future<DecodedCover> decode_;
    std::uint32_t create(const gfx::Image &image);

    gfx::GlBatch &batch_;
    Services &services_;
    // At most two short-lived GPU pages for the current launch transition.
    std::vector<std::uint32_t> case_pages_;
    std::uint32_t backdrop_ = 0;
    std::uint32_t backdrop_blur_ = 0;
    std::uint32_t brand_ = 0;
    std::array<std::uint32_t, 3> logos_{};
    std::uint32_t controller_ = 0;
    std::uint32_t switch_logo_ = 0;
    std::uint32_t switch_rear_footer_ = 0;
    std::uint32_t switch2_header_ = 0;
    std::unordered_map<std::string, Entry> covers_;
    std::deque<std::string> queue_; // O(1) pop_front during frame updates
    std::deque<std::uint32_t> pending_deletes_; // invalidated GPU IDs, amortized in pump()
    std::uint64_t frame_ = 0;
    double uptime_seconds_ = 0.0; // double precision survives long launcher sessions
    std::uint64_t next_generation_ = 0;
    float output_scale_ = 1.0f;
};

} // namespace pe::ui
```

```hpp
                                 kCaseBackHold + kCaseSettleSeconds;


// Color tokens share the existing draw path. Theme changes never affect game shaders.
// Like Nuvio, the palette is separate from the selected home-screen layout.
inline void apply_palette(int palette, int accent)
{
    const std::array<Color*, 27> slots = {
        &kBase, &kScrim, &kGlass, &kPanel, &kPanelEdge, &kPanelEdgeSoft, &kRow,
        &kRowEdge, &kRowFocus, &kFocusCore, &kFocusBlue, &kLime, &kLimeDeep,
        &kLimePale, &kSun, &kBlue, &kAccentTeal, &kText, &kTitle, &kValue,
        &kBody, &kCopy, &kMeta, &kLabel, &kMuted, &kFaint, &kWarning};
    static const auto neon = [&] {
        std::array<Color, 27> result{};
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < result.size(); ++i) result[i] = *slots[i];
        return result;
    }();
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < slots.size(); ++i) *slots[i] = neon[i];
    kRule = Color::rgb(0x3f3b51);

        kRow = Color::rgb(0x20262d); kRowEdge = Color::rgb(0x48515c);
        kRowFocus = Color::rgb(0x23374c); kRule = Color::rgb(0x343d48);
        kLime = Color::rgb(0x7196bc); kLimeDeep = Color::rgb(0x3b5873);
        kLimePale = Color::rgb(0xa9cee9); kFocusCore = Color::rgb(0x8ab8ec);
        kFocusBlue = Color::rgb(0x749fc6); kSun = Color::rgb(0x8997aa);
        kAccentTeal = Color::rgb(0xb7d2e6);
    }
    if (palette == 2) { // monochrome Dark
        kBase = Color::rgb(0x0b0c0f); kGlass = Color::rgb(0x141519);
        kPanel = Color::rgb(0x16171b); kRow = Color::rgb(0x1f2025);
        kRowFocus = Color::rgb(0x34363c); kPanelEdge = Color::rgb(0x74777e);
        kLime = Color::rgb(0x9297a1); kLimePale = Color::rgb(0xf2f4f6);

        kFocusCore = Color::rgb(0xffffff); kFocusBlue = Color::rgb(0x9297a1);
        kBlue = Color::rgb(0x8e97a5);
    } else if (palette == 3) { // Neutral Light
        kBase = Color::rgb(0xf1f3f5); kScrim = Color::rgb(0x1a2938);
        kGlass = Color::rgb(0xf8fafc); kPanel = Color::rgb(0xffffff);
        kPanelEdge = Color::rgb(0x8b98a7); kPanelEdgeSoft = Color::rgb(0xc2cbd4);
        kRow = Color::rgb(0xe6eaf0); kRowEdge = Color::rgb(0xa7b4c3);
        kRowFocus = Color::rgb(0xc9e0f3);
        kLime = Color::rgb(0x286898); kLimeDeep = Color::rgb(0x194e7a);
        kLimePale = Color::rgb(0x15527e); kFocusCore = Color::rgb(0x135eaa);
        kFocusBlue = Color::rgb(0x216ba6); kSun = Color::rgb(0x427e9a);
        kBlue = Color::rgb(0x246b9a); kAccentTeal = Color::rgb(0x206b95);

        kFaint = Color::rgb(0x667789); kWarning = Color::rgb(0xa52a2a);

// How the launcher is shown: Settings > Accessibility.
struct Look
{
    bool large_text = false;    // small text is drawn larger
    bool high_contrast = false; // solid panels, brighter text, an outlined highlight
    bool reduce_motion = false; // nothing drifts, slides or zooms: screens fade
    int palette = 0; // Neon, Non-Neon, Dark, Light
    int background = 0; // Auto, Artwork, Solid, Gradient, Image, Daily
    bool glow = true;
    float glow_strength = 1.0f;
    std::uint32_t background_color = 0x121824u, background_color2 = 0x263d59u;
    int background_overlay = 20;
    bool background_animate = true;
    int background_fit = 0;
    std::string wallpaper_path;
};
inline Look &look()
{
    static Look value;
    return value;
}
// 1 normally, 0 with reduced motion: every slide, zoom and drift is multiplied by it.
inline float motion()
{
    return look().reduce_motion ? 0.0f : 1.0f;
}
// The size text of `size` is drawn at. "Larger text" raises everything under 30 to between 26
// and 30 (26 is the least the console accessibility guidelines ask of text on a 1080p TV).
inline float text_size(float size)
{
    return look().large_text && size < 30.0f ? std::clamp(size * 1.3f, 26.0f, 30.0f) : size;
}

// The baseline that centres text of `size` in a line box of height `line` starting at `top`.
inline float baseline(float top, float line, float size)
{
    return top + line * 0.5f + size * 0.35f;
}

inline bool inside(const Rect &r, float x, float y)
{
    return x >= r.x && y >= r.y && x < r.x + r.w && y < r.y + r.h;
}

} // namespace pe::ui
```

```hpp
inline void DrawVideoGuide(Canvas& c, std::string_view label,
                           std::string_view explanation,
                           bool inactive = false, bool light_theme = false) {
    constexpr Rect panel{592.0f, 724.0f, 736.0f, 112.0f};
    const Color background = light_theme
        ? Color::rgb(inactive ? 0xfff4e6 : 0xeaf5ff, 0.99f)
        : Color::rgb(inactive ? 0x332617 : 0x101e30, 0.99f);
    const Color ink = light_theme ? Color::rgb(0x172c40) : Color::rgb(0xf2f7ff);
    const Color accent = light_theme
        ? Color::rgb(inactive ? 0x925100 : 0x087a80)
        : Color::rgb(inactive ? 0xffc26e : 0x8cf5d4);
    c.list.rounded_rect(panel, 14.0f, background);
    c.list.rounded_rect({panel.x, panel.y + 8.0f, 5.0f, panel.h - 16.0f},
                        2.5f, accent);
    text_shrink(c, label, panel.x + 18.0f, panel.y + 25.0f,
                17.0f, accent, panel.w - 36.0f);
    // Real measured word wrapping: up to 3 lines, not a single squeezed
    // sentence or an ellipsis that hides the actual instructions.
    text_block(c, explanation, panel.x + 18.0f, panel.y + 51.0f,
               18.0f, 22.0f, ink, panel.w - 38.0f, 3, 0.86f);
}
```

`headless/prosperoeden/pe/ui/video_presets.hpp`:

```hpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#pragma once

#include "encore_overrides_generated.h"
#include "encore_overrides_runtime.h"
#include "encore_texture_profiles.h"
#include "pe/ui/services.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>

namespace pe::ui {

using VideoPresetValues = Eden::EncoreOverrides::VideoProfile;

inline constexpr int kAuthoredVideoProfiles = Eden::EncoreOverrides::kAuthoredProfileCount;
inline constexpr int kCustomVideoProfile = Eden::EncoreOverrides::kCustomProfile;

inline VideoPresetValues VideoPresetForTitle(std::uint64_t title_id, int preset) {
    return Eden::EncoreOverridesRuntime::ProfileForTitle(title_id, preset);
}

// QUALITY ORDER — theoretical spatial reconstruction (BEST -> LOWEST)
// and post-AA (BEST -> LOWEST). No static chart can guarantee superiority
// across games/frames; see docs/ENCORE_GRAPHICS_QUALITY_RANKING.md.
// This is ONLY the interface/cycling order: persisted enum IDs do not change.
inline constexpr std::array<int, 7> kUpscalingQualityOrder{
    6, 5, 1, 4, 2, 0, 3}; // Spatial scaling only; the three A4K engines live in Neural Rendering.
// Navigation order only: no visual superiority is established before console A/B.
inline constexpr std::array<int, 4> kAntiAliasingQualityOrder{
    2, 3, 1, 0}; // SMAA Ultra, FXAA+, FXAA, None

template <std::size_t N, typename Allowed>
inline int CycleQualityRanked(int current, int step,
                             const std::array<int, N>& order,
                             bool allow_inherit, Allowed allowed) {
    constexpr int kCountMax = 16;
    static_assert(N > 0 && N <= kCountMax);
    const int count = static_cast<int>(N) + (allow_inherit ? 1 : 0);
    int position = allow_inherit ? 0 : -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < static_cast<int>(N); ++i)
        if (order[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)] == current)
            position = i + (allow_inherit ? 1 : 0);
    if (!allow_inherit && position < 0) position = 0;
    const int direction = step < 0 ? -1 : 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
        position = (position + direction + count) % count;
        const int candidate = allow_inherit && position == 0
            ? -1 : order[static_cast<std::size_t>(position - (allow_inherit ? 1 : 0))];
        if (candidate == -1 || allowed(candidate)) return candidate;
    }
    return current;
}

inline constexpr bool UpscalingRequiresVulkan(int filter) {
    return filter >= 5 && filter <= 9; // SGSR and A4K CNN profiles; Vulkan only
}
inline constexpr bool UpscalingSupportsSharpness(int filter) {
    return filter == 1 || filter == 5 || filter == 6;
}
inline constexpr bool UpscalingFilterSelectable(int filter,int renderer) {
    return !UpscalingRequiresVulkan(filter) || renderer == 1;
}

// Frame synthesis is implemented exclusively on the native Vulkan path.
inline bool FrameGenerationSelectable(int renderer) {
    return renderer == 1;
}

inline int EffectiveGameRenderer(const GameSettings& game,
                                 const Preferences& global,
                                 std::uint64_t title_id) {
    if (game.renderer >= 0) return game.renderer;
    if (game.performance_profile >= 0 &&
        game.performance_profile < kAuthoredVideoProfiles)
        return VideoPresetForTitle(title_id, game.performance_profile).renderer;
    if (global.performance_profile >= 0 &&
        global.performance_profile < kAuthoredVideoProfiles)
        return VideoPresetForTitle(title_id, global.performance_profile).renderer;
    return global.renderer;
}

inline int EffectiveGameUpscalingFilter(const GameSettings& game,
                                        const Preferences& global,
                                        std::uint64_t title_id) {
    if (game.filter >= 0) return game.filter;
    if (game.performance_profile >= 0 &&
        game.performance_profile < kAuthoredVideoProfiles)
        return VideoPresetForTitle(title_id, game.performance_profile).filter;
    if (global.performance_profile >= 0 &&
        global.performance_profile < kAuthoredVideoProfiles)
        return VideoPresetForTitle(title_id, global.performance_profile).filter;
    return global.filter;
}

inline int ClampVideoPreset(int preset) {
    return std::clamp(preset, 0, kAuthoredVideoProfiles - 1);
}

inline int CycleVideoPreset(int current, int step) {
    // Custom is derived from manual edits, never an authored preset to apply. From Custom, moving
    // right starts at Minimum; moving left starts at Ultra.
    if (current == kCustomVideoProfile)
        return step >= 0 ? 0 : kAuthoredVideoProfiles - 1;
    current = std::clamp(current, 0, kAuthoredVideoProfiles - 1);
    return (current + step + kAuthoredVideoProfiles) % kAuthoredVideoProfiles;
}

inline bool MatchesPreset(const Preferences& preferences, const VideoPresetValues& value,
                          int tier) {
    return preferences.renderer == value.renderer && preferences.output == value.output &&
           preferences.resolution == value.resolution && preferences.filter == value.filter &&
           preferences.fsr_sharpness == value.fsr_sharpness &&
           preferences.anti_aliasing == value.anti_aliasing &&
           preferences.texture_anisotropy ==
               Eden::EncoreTextureProfiles::ForTitle(0, tier) &&
           preferences.refresh == value.refresh;
}

inline int DetectVideoProfile(const Preferences& preferences) {
    for (int preset = 0; preset < kAuthoredVideoProfiles; ++preset)
        if (MatchesPreset(preferences, VideoPresetForTitle(0, preset), preset))
            return preset;
    return kCustomVideoProfile;
}

inline void RefreshVideoProfile(Preferences& preferences) {
    preferences.performance_profile = DetectVideoProfile(preferences);
}

inline int DetectVideoProfile(const GameSettings& settings, const Preferences& global,
                              std::uint64_t title_id = 0) {
    const auto effective = [](int local, int fallback) { return local >= 0 ? local : fallback; };
    for (int preset = 0; preset < kAuthoredVideoProfiles; ++preset) {
        const auto value = VideoPresetForTitle(title_id, preset);
        if (effective(settings.renderer, global.renderer) == value.renderer &&
            effective(settings.output, global.output) == value.output &&
            effective(settings.resolution, global.resolution) == value.resolution &&
            effective(settings.filter, global.filter) == value.filter &&
            effective(settings.fsr_sharpness, global.fsr_sharpness) == value.fsr_sharpness &&
            effective(settings.anti_aliasing, global.anti_aliasing) == value.anti_aliasing &&
            (settings.texture_anisotropy >= 0
                ? settings.texture_anisotropy
                : global.performance_profile == kCustomVideoProfile
                    ? global.texture_anisotropy
                    : Eden::EncoreTextureProfiles::ForTitle(title_id, preset))
                    == Eden::EncoreTextureProfiles::ForTitle(title_id, preset) &&
            effective(settings.refresh, global.refresh) == value.refresh &&
            (settings.console_mode < 0 || (settings.console_mode == 1) == value.docked))
            return preset;
    }
    return kCustomVideoProfile;
}

inline void RefreshVideoProfile(GameSettings& settings, const Preferences& global,
                                std::uint64_t title_id = 0) {
    settings.performance_profile = DetectVideoProfile(settings, global, title_id);
}

inline void ApplyVideoPreset(Preferences& preferences, int preset) {
    const auto value = VideoPresetForTitle(0, ClampVideoPreset(preset));
    preferences.performance_profile = ClampVideoPreset(preset);
    preferences.renderer = value.renderer;
    preferences.output = value.output;
    preferences.resolution = value.resolution;
    preferences.filter = value.filter;
    preferences.fsr_sharpness = value.fsr_sharpness;
    preferences.anti_aliasing = value.anti_aliasing;
    preferences.texture_anisotropy = Eden::EncoreTextureProfiles::ForTitle(0, preset);
    preferences.refresh = value.refresh;
}

inline void ApplyVideoPreset(GameSettings& settings, int preset, std::uint64_t title_id = 0) {
    preset = ClampVideoPreset(preset);
    const auto value = VideoPresetForTitle(title_id, preset);
    settings.performance_profile = preset;
    settings.console_mode = value.docked ? 1 : 0;
    settings.renderer = value.renderer;
    settings.output = value.output;
    settings.resolution = value.resolution;
    settings.filter = value.filter;
    settings.fsr_sharpness = value.fsr_sharpness;
    settings.anti_aliasing = value.anti_aliasing;
    settings.texture_anisotropy =
        Eden::EncoreTextureProfiles::ForTitle(title_id, preset);
    settings.refresh = value.refresh;
}

} // namespace pe::ui
```
