`headless/vulkan_pool_capacity.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#pragma once
#include <atomic>
#include <cstdint>

namespace Eden::VulkanMemory {
// Process-global GPU capacity estimate, reset when a new VkDevice is built.
// Startup's first platform free-direct-memory query may transiently fail and
// report zero. Latch the first later nonzero observation, not permanent zero.
// Sampling is performed by the EXISTING throttled graphics_memory_free
// callback; this helper issues no new kernel probes and allocates nothing.
class PoolCapacityLatch {
public:
    void Reset(std::uint64_t initial_confirmed_free) noexcept {
        capacity_.store(initial_confirmed_free, std::memory_order_release);
    }
    std::uint64_t Observe(std::uint64_t confirmed_free_now) noexcept {
        std::uint64_t capacity = capacity_.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        if (capacity != 0 || confirmed_free_now == 0)
            return capacity;
        std::uint64_t absent = 0;
        if (capacity_.compare_exchange_strong(absent, confirmed_free_now,
                                               std::memory_order_acq_rel,
                                               std::memory_order_acquire))
            return confirmed_free_now;
        return absent;
    }
    std::uint64_t Value() const noexcept {
        return capacity_.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    }
private:
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> capacity_{0};
};
} // namespace Eden::VulkanMemory

```

`headless/vulkan_present_layer_r24.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright 2026 Eden Emulator Project
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later

// R24 maintained native AA layer. Based on the pinned Encore Vulkan fork
// SHA256 f1b2ea6d7bc607c35a7fc7ccfbb5ff6d12ecc6dfec2adf3268a730cead382a87;
// vendor remains unchanged.
// SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright 2024 yuzu Emulator Project
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <exception>
#include <memory>
#include <string>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <variant>
#include "aa_source_extent.h"
#include "nr_display_capture_policy.h"
#include "neural_runtime_state.h"
#include "r09_native_plans.h"
#include "storage_paths.h"
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/nr_rdna2_frame_session.h"
#include "common/logging.h"
#include "fxaa_quality_select.h"
#include "video_core/present.h"
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/present/anti_alias_pass.h"
/* X11 defines */
#undef Success
#undef BadValue
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_rasterizer.h"

#include "common/settings.h"
#include "video_core/framebuffer_config.h"
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/present/fsr.h"
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/present/sgsr.h"
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/present/fxaa.h"
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/present/layer.h"
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/present/present_push_constants.h"
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/present/smaa.h"
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/present/util.h"
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_blit_screen.h"
#include "video_core/textures/decoders.h"

namespace Vulkan {

namespace {

u32 GetBytesPerPixel(const Tegra::FramebufferConfig& framebuffer) {
    using namespace VideoCore::Surface;
    return BytesPerBlock(PixelFormatFromGPUPixelFormat(framebuffer.pixel_format));
}

std::size_t GetSizeInBytes(const Tegra::FramebufferConfig& framebuffer) {
    return static_cast<std::size_t>(framebuffer.stride) *
           static_cast<std::size_t>(framebuffer.height) * GetBytesPerPixel(framebuffer);
}

VkFormat GetFormat(const Tegra::FramebufferConfig& framebuffer) {
    switch (framebuffer.pixel_format) {
    case Service::android::PixelFormat::Rgba8888:
    case Service::android::PixelFormat::Rgbx8888:
        return VK_FORMAT_A8B8G8R8_UNORM_PACK32;
    case Service::android::PixelFormat::Rgb565:
        return VK_FORMAT_R5G6B5_UNORM_PACK16;
    case Service::android::PixelFormat::Bgra8888:
        return VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM;
    default:
        UNIMPLEMENTED_MSG("Unknown framebuffer pixel format: {}",
                          static_cast<u32>(framebuffer.pixel_format));
        return VK_FORMAT_A8B8G8R8_UNORM_PACK32;
    }
}

} // Anonymous namespace

Layer::Layer(const Device& device, MemoryAllocator& memory_allocator_, Scheduler& scheduler_, Tegra::MaxwellDeviceMemoryManager& device_memory_, size_t image_count_, VkExtent2D output_size, VkDescriptorSetLayout layout, const PresentFilters& filters_)
    : memory_allocator(memory_allocator_)
    , scheduler(scheduler_)
    , device_memory(device_memory_)
    , filters(filters_)
    , image_count(image_count_)
{
    CreateDescriptorPool(device);
    CreateDescriptorSets(device, layout);
    if (filters.get_scaling_filter() == Settings::ScalingFilter::Fsr) {
        sr_filter.emplace<FSR>(device, memory_allocator, image_count, output_size);
    } else if (filters.get_scaling_filter() == Settings::ScalingFilter::Sgsr) {
        sr_filter.emplace<SGSR>(device, memory_allocator, image_count, output_size, false);
    } else if (filters.get_scaling_filter() == Settings::ScalingFilter::SgsrEdge) {
        sr_filter.emplace<SGSR>(device, memory_allocator, image_count, output_size, true);
    } else if (filters.get_scaling_filter() == Settings::ScalingFilter::Anime4K3D) {
        // Real MIT Anime4K v4 3D CNN four-pass native compute backend.
        // No fake FSR3 timeline/history nor per-game shader hash.
        sr_filter.emplace<Anime4K3D>(device, memory_allocator, scheduler, image_count,
                                     output_size, Anime4K3D::Profile::Details);
    } else if (filters.get_scaling_filter() == Settings::ScalingFilter::Anime4KSoft) {
        sr_filter.emplace<Anime4K3D>(device, memory_allocator, scheduler, image_count,
                                     output_size, Anime4K3D::Profile::Soft);
    } else if (filters.get_scaling_filter() == Settings::ScalingFilter::Anime4KDenoise) {
        sr_filter.emplace<Anime4K3D>(device, memory_allocator, scheduler, image_count,
                                     output_size, Anime4K3D::Profile::Denoise);
    }
}

Layer::~Layer() {
    ReleaseRawImages();
}

void Layer::ConfigureDraw(const Device& device, PresentPushConstants* out_push_constants,
                          VkDescriptorSet* out_descriptor_set, RasterizerVulkan& rasterizer,
                          VkSampler sampler, size_t image_index,
                          const Tegra::FramebufferConfig& framebuffer,
                          const Layout::FramebufferLayout& layout) {
    const auto texture_info = rasterizer.AccelerateDisplay(
        framebuffer, framebuffer.address + framebuffer.offset, framebuffer.stride);
    const u32 texture_width = texture_info ? texture_info->width : framebuffer.width;
    const u32 texture_height = texture_info ? texture_info->height : framebuffer.height;
    const u32 scaled_width = texture_info ? texture_info->scaled_width : texture_width;
    const u32 scaled_height = texture_info ? texture_info->scaled_height : texture_height;
    const bool use_accelerated = texture_info.has_value();

    RefreshResources(device, framebuffer);
    // AA must render at the dimensions of the actual sampled source.
    // Raw readback may be 720p while scaling is 2x; accelerated images
    // may change effective dimensions independently.
    const auto aa_source = Eden::Graphics::AaSourceExtent(
        use_accelerated, {framebuffer.width, framebuffer.height},
        {scaled_width, scaled_height});
    SetAntiAliasPass(device, {aa_source.width, aa_source.height});

    // Finish any pending renderpass
    scheduler.RequestOutsideRenderPassOperationContext();
    scheduler.Wait(resource_ticks[image_index]);
    // Each session may retain hundreds of Vulkan allocations/descriptors.
    // Do not release them until the matching presentation tick retires.
    if(image_index<neural_sessions.size())
        neural_sessions[image_index].reset();
    SCOPE_EXIT {
        resource_ticks[image_index] = scheduler.CurrentTick();
    };

    if (!use_accelerated) {
        UpdateRawImage(framebuffer, image_index);
    }

    VkImage source_image = texture_info ? texture_info->image : *raw_images[image_index];
    VkImageView source_image_view =
        texture_info ? texture_info->image_view : *raw_image_views[image_index];

    if (auto* fxaa = std::get_if<FXAA>(&anti_alias)) {
        fxaa->Draw(device, scheduler, image_index, &source_image, &source_image_view);
    } else if (auto* smaa = std::get_if<SMAA>(&anti_alias)) {
        smaa->Draw(device, scheduler, image_index, &source_image, &source_image_view);
    }

    auto crop_rect = Tegra::NormalizeCrop(framebuffer, texture_width, texture_height);
    const VkExtent2D render_extent{
        .width = scaled_width,
        .height = scaled_height,
    };

    if (auto* fsr = std::get_if<FSR>(&sr_filter)) {
        source_image_view = fsr->Draw(device, scheduler, image_index, source_image, source_image_view, render_extent, crop_rect);
        crop_rect = {0, 0, 1, 1};
    } else if (auto* sgsr = std::get_if<SGSR>(&sr_filter)) {
        source_image_view = sgsr->Draw(device, scheduler, image_index, source_image, source_image_view, render_extent, crop_rect);
        crop_rect = {0, 0, 1, 1};
    } else if (auto* a4k = std::get_if<Anime4K3D>(&sr_filter)) {
        if (const auto output = a4k->Draw(image_index, source_image, source_image_view,
                                          render_extent, crop_rect)) {
            source_image_view = *output;
            crop_rect = {0, 0, 1, 1};
        }
        // On incompatible crop/format/dimensions/budget, unchanged bilinear
        // presentation samples the original guest image.
    }

    // R09: the selected game's Original/Compact neural renderer is a
    // separate final image stage, not A4K, FSR or frame generation.
    // The native model plans presently exist for an exact 1920x1080
    // source without crop. Other geometries preserve existing rendering.
    const auto selected=Eden::NeuralRuntime::Current();
    if(last_neural_mode!=selected.mode){
        last_neural_mode=selected.mode;
        neural_model_failed=false;
    }
    const bool nr_selected=filters.allow_game_neural_rendering&&
        Eden::NeuralVideo::IsDlss(selected.mode);
    // Accelerated display can be the normal game path. The texture
    // cache supplies a real sampled image view and its post-scaling
    // dimensions. Only accept an exact 1080p physical view and full
    // crop; unknown source formats still fail the session's format gate.
    const bool nr_geometry=Eden::Graphics::CanR09CaptureDisplay({
        .accelerated=use_accelerated,
        .live_image=source_image!=VK_NULL_HANDLE&&
                    source_image_view!=VK_NULL_HANDLE,
        .native_width=texture_width,
        .native_height=texture_height,
        .sampled_width=render_extent.width,
        .sampled_height=render_extent.height,
        .crop_left=crop_rect.left,.crop_top=crop_rect.top,
        .crop_right=crop_rect.right,.crop_bottom=crop_rect.bottom,
        .single_sample=!use_accelerated||
            texture_info->sample_count==VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT});
    const bool nr_exclusive=
        std::holds_alternative<std::monostate>(anti_alias)&&
        std::holds_alternative<std::monostate>(sr_filter);
    if(nr_selected&&nr_geometry&&nr_exclusive&&
       !neural_model_failed&&image_index<neural_sessions.size()&&
       image_index<neural_images.size()&&image_index<neural_views.size()) {
        const bool original=selected.mode==Eden::NeuralVideo::kDlssOriginal;
        // Accept the exact upstream NRMODEL1 package filenames from the
        // MIT extractor, without requiring users to rename the output.
        // Never scan arbitrary paths or substitute a different model.
        const std::string model_dir=Eden::ConfigDir()+"/neural/";
        const std::string configured=model_dir+
            (original?"original.nrmodel":"compact.nrmodel");
        const std::string extracted=model_dir+
            (original?"dlssnr.bin":"dlssnr-small.bin");
        // R09 DLL import now runs at game admission in headless/main.cpp,
        // before this render thread starts. NEVER deserialize or extract
        // a large proprietary model payload on a guest frame. Cached data is
        // preflighted by the native model owner, otherwise fail closed.
        const std::string model_path=Eden::FileExists(configured)?
            configured:extracted;
        if(!Eden::FileExists(model_path)){
            LOG_WARNING(Render_Vulkan,
                "R09 DLSS-NR model pack not installed; checked {} and {}",
                configured,extracted);
            neural_model_failed=true;
        }else {
            try {
                // Allocated on the same Vulkan device, on the exact slot
                // whose previous GPU tick was waited for above.
                // Retire the previous slot's image view BEFORE its
                // underlying image. The GPU tick was waited above, but
                // destroying the image while a VkImageView still exists
                // violates Vulkan object lifetime rules.
                neural_views[image_index].reset();
                neural_images[image_index].reset();
                // The neural output is a compute storage image sampled by
                // the presenter, never a render-pass color attachment.
                // Do not require COLOR_ATTACHMENT support on RGBA32F.
                const VkImageCreateInfo neural_output_ci{
                    .sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_CREATE_INFO,
                    .pNext=nullptr,.flags=0u,
                    .imageType=VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D,
                    .format=VK_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_SFLOAT,
                    .extent={1920u,1080u,1u},
                    .mipLevels=1u,.arrayLayers=1u,
                    .samples=VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT,
                    .tiling=VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL,
                    .usage=VK_IMAGE_USAGE_STORAGE_BIT|
                           VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT,
                    .sharingMode=VK_SHARING_MODE_EXCLUSIVE,
                    .queueFamilyIndexCount=0u,
                    .pQueueFamilyIndices=nullptr,
                    .initialLayout=VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED,
                };
                neural_images[image_index]=
                    memory_allocator.CreateImage(neural_output_ci);
                // Native output allocations are not guaranteed to succeed,
                // particularly with the guest game's VRAM already in use.
                // Never dereference a missing Vulkan image or hand a null
                // view to an owner. The surrounding catch restores the
                // original game frame and retires slot resources normally.
                if (!neural_images[image_index]) {
                    throw std::runtime_error(
                        "R09 RGBA32F neural output image allocation failed");
                }
                neural_views[image_index]=CreateWrappedImageView(
                    device,neural_images[image_index],
                    VK_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_SFLOAT);
                if (!neural_views[image_index]) {
                    throw std::runtime_error(
                        "R09 RGBA32F neural output image view creation failed");
                }
                auto owner=std::make_unique<NrRdna2FrameSession>(
                    device,memory_allocator,scheduler);
                const auto plan=original?
                    Eden::NeuralPlans::Original:Eden::NeuralPlans::Compact;
                if(!owner->Initialize(
                       model_path,plan,source_image_view,sampler,
                       texture_info ? texture_info->sampled_format
                                    : GetFormat(framebuffer),
                       render_extent,
                       *neural_views[image_index],
                       VK_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_SFLOAT,{1920u,1080u},
                       1.0f,float(selected.strength)/100.0f)){
                    LOG_WARNING(Render_Vulkan,
                        "R09 DLSS-NR model/session preflight rejected: {} "
                        "phase={} (no neural commands recorded)",
                        original?"Original":"Compact",
                        owner->LastInitializePhaseName());
                    neural_model_failed=true;
                    // Initialize guarantees zero queued GPU commands. All
                    // provisional stage owners have already unwound, so
                    // return this unused output view/image immediately.
                    // Record failures take a different path below: those
                    // owners MUST survive until the scheduler tick retires.
                    neural_views[image_index].reset();
                    neural_images[image_index].reset();
                }else {
                    const VkImage target=*neural_images[image_index];
                    const VkImage guest_source=source_image;
                    // The live renderer may have written the accelerated
                    // guest surface as a color target, by transfer, or with
                    // compute before this present call. The existing
                    // presentation path samples GENERAL; order all prior
                    // writes before the new neural compute texture sample.
                    // This is required for the real game image, not just
                    // the host's pre-filled test texture.
                    scheduler.RequestOutsideRenderPassOperationContext();
                    scheduler.Record([target,guest_source](vk::CommandBuffer cmd){
                        const VkImageMemoryBarrier guest{
                            .sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER,
                            .pNext=nullptr,
                            .srcAccessMask=VK_ACCESS_MEMORY_WRITE_BIT,
                            .dstAccessMask=VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT,
                            .oldLayout=VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL,
                            .newLayout=VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL,
                            .srcQueueFamilyIndex=VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED,
                            .dstQueueFamilyIndex=VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED,
                            .image=guest_source,
                            .subresourceRange={
                                .aspectMask=VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT,
                                .baseMipLevel=0u,.levelCount=1u,
                                .baseArrayLayer=0u,.layerCount=1u}};
                        cmd.PipelineBarrier(VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT,
                            VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COMPUTE_SHADER_BIT,0u,guest);
                        // Fresh RGBA32F storage image. Never sample it
                        // before the neural compute-write barrier.
                        const VkImageMemoryBarrier image{
                            .sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER,
                            .pNext=nullptr,.srcAccessMask=0u,
                            .dstAccessMask=VK_ACCESS_SHADER_WRITE_BIT,
                            .oldLayout=VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED,
                            .newLayout=VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL,
                            .srcQueueFamilyIndex=VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED,
                            .dstQueueFamilyIndex=VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED,
                            .image=target,
                            .subresourceRange={
                                .aspectMask=VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT,
                                .baseMipLevel=0u,.levelCount=1u,
                                .baseArrayLayer=0u,.layerCount=1u}};
                        cmd.PipelineBarrier(VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TOP_OF_PIPE_BIT,
                            VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COMPUTE_SHADER_BIT,0u,image);
                    });
                    // Keep the owner live even after a failed Record:
                    // that failure may already have enqueued GPU work.
                    neural_sessions[image_index]=std::move(owner);
                    const bool r09_recorded=neural_sessions[image_index]->Record();
                    if(r09_recorded&&
                       neural_sessions[image_index]->ResultView()==
                           *neural_views[image_index]){
                        source_image_view=*neural_views[image_index];
                        crop_rect={0,0,1,1};
                    }else {
                        LOG_WARNING(Render_Vulkan,
                            "R09 DLSS-NR graph not accepted: phase={} "
                            "queued_scheduler_callbacks={} "
                            "(enqueue only, NOT GPU completion); "
                            "retaining the original guest image",
                            neural_sessions[image_index]->LastRecordPhaseName(),
                            neural_sessions[image_index]->EnqueuedSchedulerCallbacks());
                        neural_model_failed=true;
                    }
                }
            }catch(const std::exception& error){
                LOG_WARNING(Render_Vulkan,
                    "R09 DLSS-NR session failed safely: {}",error.what());
                neural_model_failed=true;
            }
        }
    }

    SetMatrixData(device, *out_push_constants, layout);
    SetVertexData(device, *out_push_constants, layout, crop_rect);

    UpdateDescriptorSet(device, source_image_view, sampler, image_index);
    *out_descriptor_set = descriptor_sets[image_index];
}

void Layer::CreateDescriptorPool(const Device& device) {
    descriptor_pool = CreateWrappedDescriptorPool(device, image_count, image_count);
}

void Layer::CreateDescriptorSets(const Device& device, VkDescriptorSetLayout layout) {
    const std::vector layouts(image_count, layout);
    descriptor_sets = CreateWrappedDescriptorSets(descriptor_pool, layouts);
}

void Layer::CreateStagingBuffer(const Device& device, const Tegra::FramebufferConfig& framebuffer) {
    const VkBufferCreateInfo ci{
        .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO,
        .pNext = nullptr,
        .flags = 0,
        .size = CalculateBufferSize(framebuffer),
        .usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT | VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT |
                 VK_BUFFER_USAGE_VERTEX_BUFFER_BIT | VK_BUFFER_USAGE_UNIFORM_BUFFER_BIT,
        .sharingMode = VK_SHARING_MODE_EXCLUSIVE,
        .queueFamilyIndexCount = 0,
        .pQueueFamilyIndices = nullptr,
    };

    buffer = memory_allocator.CreateBuffer(ci, MemoryUsage::Upload);
}

void Layer::CreateRawImages(const Device& device, const Tegra::FramebufferConfig& framebuffer) {
    const auto format = GetFormat(framebuffer);
    // ReleaseRawImages waited for every old timeline use. Reusing its tick
    // values after rebuilding the layer would cause redundant Wait calls on
    // newly allocated images, although those old fences have retired.
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    resource_ticks.assign(image_count, 0);
#else
    resource_ticks.resize(image_count);
#endif
    raw_images.resize(image_count);
    raw_image_views.resize(image_count);
    neural_sessions.resize(image_count);
    neural_images.resize(image_count);
    neural_views.resize(image_count);

    for (size_t i = 0; i < image_count; ++i) {
        raw_images[i] =
            CreateWrappedImage(memory_allocator, {framebuffer.width, framebuffer.height}, format);
        raw_image_views[i] = CreateWrappedImageView(device, raw_images[i], format);
    }
}

void Layer::RefreshResources(const Device& device, const Tegra::FramebufferConfig& framebuffer) {
    if (framebuffer.width == raw_width && framebuffer.height == raw_height &&
        framebuffer.pixel_format == pixel_format && !raw_images.empty() &&
        buffer.Mapped().size() == CalculateBufferSize(framebuffer)) {
        return;
    }
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    // Same dimensions and format, but the guest row pitch changed. Recycle
    // only the upload buffer after its last referenced GPU tick; AA images,
    // descriptors, renderpasses and pipelines remain valid. Do NOT trigger
    // a full-device WaitIdle or recreate the FXAA/SMAA pass on pitch changes.
    if (framebuffer.width == raw_width && framebuffer.height == raw_height &&
        framebuffer.pixel_format == pixel_format && !raw_images.empty()) {
        // All layer ticks share one monotonically increasing Vulkan GPU
        // timeline. Waiting for the maximum retires every earlier user of
        // the old upload staging buffer with one semaphore wait.
        const auto last_tick = std::max_element(resource_ticks.begin(), resource_ticks.end());
        if (last_tick != resource_ticks.end() && *last_tick != 0) {
            scheduler.Wait(*last_tick);
        }
        CreateStagingBuffer(device, framebuffer);
        return;
    }
#endif

    raw_width = framebuffer.width;
    raw_height = framebuffer.height;
    pixel_format = framebuffer.pixel_format;
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    if (!std::holds_alternative<std::monostate>(anti_alias)) {
        // Existing FXAA/SMAA images and descriptors may still be referenced
        // by command buffers submitted for prior presentation frames.
        scheduler.Finish();
        device.GetLogical().WaitIdle();
    }
#endif
    anti_alias.emplace<std::monostate>();

    ReleaseRawImages();
    CreateStagingBuffer(device, framebuffer);
    CreateRawImages(device, framebuffer);
}

void Layer::SetAntiAliasPass(const Device& device, VkExtent2D source_extent) {
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    // Invalid/unsupported zero-size input: avoid Vulkan allocations.
    const auto requested_aa =
        Eden::Graphics::AaValid({source_extent.width, source_extent.height})
        ? filters.get_anti_aliasing() : Settings::AntiAliasing::None;
    const bool enhanced = requested_aa == Settings::AntiAliasing::Fxaa &&
                          Eden::Graphics::EnhancedFxaa();
    // Disabled AA has no GPU resources to rebuild. The old guard skipped
    // only live FXAA/SMAA and reconstructed the monostate on every frame,
    // including when the filter remained disabled across thousands of draws.
    // A resize resets a live pass to monostate, so FXAA/SMAA still rebuild.
    if (anti_alias_setting == requested_aa &&
        fxaa_enhanced_setting == enhanced &&
        source_extent.width == anti_alias_extent.width &&
        source_extent.height == anti_alias_extent.height &&
        (!std::holds_alternative<std::monostate>(anti_alias) ||
         (requested_aa != Settings::AntiAliasing::Fxaa &&
          requested_aa != Settings::AntiAliasing::Smaa))) {
        return;
    }
    if (std::holds_alternative<std::monostate>(anti_alias) &&
        requested_aa == Settings::AntiAliasing::None) {
        anti_alias_setting = requested_aa;
        anti_alias_extent = source_extent;
        fxaa_enhanced_setting = enhanced;
        return;
    }
#else
    if (!std::holds_alternative<std::monostate>(anti_alias) && anti_alias_setting == filters.get_anti_aliasing())
        return;
#endif

#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    if (!std::holds_alternative<std::monostate>(anti_alias)) {
        // Swapping the AA variant frees GPU resources, not just host state.
        scheduler.Finish();
        device.GetLogical().WaitIdle();
    }
#endif
    anti_alias_setting = requested_aa;
    anti_alias_extent = source_extent;
    fxaa_enhanced_setting = enhanced;
    const VkExtent2D render_area = source_extent;

    switch (anti_alias_setting) {
    case Settings::AntiAliasing::Fxaa:
        anti_alias.emplace<FXAA>(device, memory_allocator, image_count, render_area, enhanced);
        break;
    case Settings::AntiAliasing::Smaa:
        anti_alias.emplace<SMAA>(device, memory_allocator, image_count, render_area);
        break;
    default:
        anti_alias.emplace<std::monostate>();
        break;
    }
}

void Layer::ReleaseRawImages() {
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    // On this single Vulkan GPU timeline, the latest presentation resource
    // tick subsumes all preceding image uses, including out-of-order slots.
    const auto last_tick = std::max_element(resource_ticks.begin(), resource_ticks.end());
    if (last_tick != resource_ticks.end() && *last_tick != 0) {
        scheduler.Wait(*last_tick);
    }
#else
    for (const u64 tick : resource_ticks) {
        scheduler.Wait(tick);
    }
#endif
    neural_sessions.clear();
    neural_views.clear();
    neural_images.clear();
    neural_model_failed=false;
    raw_image_views.clear();
    raw_images.clear();
    buffer.reset();
}

u64 Layer::CalculateBufferSize(const Tegra::FramebufferConfig& framebuffer) const {
    return GetSizeInBytes(framebuffer) * image_count;
}

u64 Layer::GetRawImageOffset(const Tegra::FramebufferConfig& framebuffer,
                             size_t image_index) const {
    return GetSizeInBytes(framebuffer) * image_index;
}

void Layer::SetMatrixData(const Device& device, PresentPushConstants& data, const Layout::FramebufferLayout& layout) const {
    data.modelview_matrix = MakeOrthographicMatrix(f32(layout.width), static_cast<f32>(layout.height));
}

void Layer::SetVertexData(const Device& device, PresentPushConstants& data, const Layout::FramebufferLayout& layout, const Common::Rectangle<f32>& crop) const {
    // Map the coordinates to the screen.
    const auto& screen = layout.screen;
    const auto x = f32(screen.left);
    const auto y = f32(screen.top);
    const auto w = f32(screen.GetWidth());
    const auto h = f32(screen.GetHeight());

    data.vertices[0] = ScreenRectVertex(x, y, crop.left, crop.top);
    data.vertices[1] = ScreenRectVertex(x + w, y, crop.right, crop.top);
    data.vertices[2] = ScreenRectVertex(x, y + h, crop.left, crop.bottom);
    data.vertices[3] = ScreenRectVertex(x + w, y + h, crop.right, crop.bottom);
}

void Layer::UpdateDescriptorSet(const Device& device, VkImageView image_view, VkSampler sampler, size_t image_index) {
    const VkDescriptorImageInfo image_info{
        .sampler = sampler,
        .imageView = image_view,
        .imageLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL,
    };

    const VkWriteDescriptorSet sampler_write{
        .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_WRITE_DESCRIPTOR_SET,
        .pNext = nullptr,
        .dstSet = descriptor_sets[image_index],
        .dstBinding = 0,
        .dstArrayElement = 0,
        .descriptorCount = 1,
        .descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER,
        .pImageInfo = &image_info,
        .pBufferInfo = nullptr,
        .pTexelBufferView = nullptr,
    };

    device.GetLogical().UpdateDescriptorSets(std::array{sampler_write}, {});
}

void Layer::UpdateRawImage(const Tegra::FramebufferConfig& framebuffer, size_t image_index) {
    const std::span<u8> mapped_span = buffer.Mapped();

#ifndef PS5_NATIVE
    const u64 image_offset = GetRawImageOffset(framebuffer, image_index);
#endif

    const DAddr framebuffer_addr = framebuffer.address + framebuffer.offset;
    const u8* const host_ptr = device_memory.GetPointer<u8>(framebuffer_addr);

    // TODO(Rodrigo): Read this from HLE
    constexpr u32 block_height_log2 = 4;
    const u32 bytes_per_pixel = GetBytesPerPixel(framebuffer);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    // This raw upload already resolved the guest pixel format above. Do not
    // decode that same format a second time through GetSizeInBytes every
    // time the CPU reads back a guest framebuffer.
    const u64 linear_size{
        static_cast<std::size_t>(framebuffer.stride) *
        static_cast<std::size_t>(framebuffer.height) * bytes_per_pixel};
    // Staging slots have the same guest row pitch: do not decode BPP again
    // through GetRawImageOffset for every non-accelerated presentation.
    const u64 image_offset = linear_size * image_index;
#else
    const u64 linear_size{GetSizeInBytes(framebuffer)};
#endif
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    // An unmapped guest framebuffer has no tiled source to measure.
    // Keep the exact raw-zero upload, but skip tiled-size/format arithmetic
    // on repeated missing-frame fallbacks (HUD, scene changes).
    const std::span<u8> linear_span = mapped_span.subspan(image_offset, linear_size);
    if (host_ptr) {
        const u64 tiled_size{Tegra::Texture::CalculateSize(
            true, bytes_per_pixel, framebuffer.stride, framebuffer.height, 1, block_height_log2, 0)};
#else
    const u64 tiled_size{Tegra::Texture::CalculateSize(
        true, bytes_per_pixel, framebuffer.stride, framebuffer.height, 1, block_height_log2, 0)};
    const std::span<u8> linear_span = mapped_span.subspan(image_offset, linear_size);
    if (host_ptr) {
#endif
        Tegra::Texture::UnswizzleTexture(
            linear_span, std::span(host_ptr, tiled_size),
            bytes_per_pixel, framebuffer.width, framebuffer.height, 1, block_height_log2, 0);
    } else {
        // Never upload stale staging bytes if the guest framebuffer is missing.
        std::fill(linear_span.begin(), linear_span.end(), u8{0});
    }
    buffer.Flush();  // Both the upload and missing-memory clear need visibility.

    const VkBufferImageCopy copy{
        .bufferOffset = image_offset,
        .bufferRowLength = 0,
        .bufferImageHeight = 0,
        .imageSubresource =
            {
                .aspectMask = VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT,
                .mipLevel = 0,
                .baseArrayLayer = 0,
                .layerCount = 1,
            },
        .imageOffset = {.x = 0, .y = 0, .z = 0},
        .imageExtent =
            {
                .width = framebuffer.width,
                .height = framebuffer.height,
                .depth = 1,
            },
    };
    scheduler.Record([this, copy, index = image_index](vk::CommandBuffer cmdbuf) {
        const VkImage image = *raw_images[index];
        const VkImageMemoryBarrier base_barrier{
            .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER,
            .pNext = nullptr,
            .srcAccessMask = 0,
            .dstAccessMask = 0,
            .oldLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL,
            .newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL,
            .srcQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED,
            .dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED,
            .image = image,
            .subresourceRange{
                .aspectMask = VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT,
                .baseMipLevel = 0,
                .levelCount = 1,
                .baseArrayLayer = 0,
                .layerCount = 1,
            },
        };
        VkImageMemoryBarrier read_barrier = base_barrier;
        read_barrier.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT;
        read_barrier.oldLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;
        read_barrier.newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL;

        VkImageMemoryBarrier write_barrier = base_barrier;
        write_barrier.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT;
        write_barrier.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT;
        write_barrier.oldLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL;

        cmdbuf.PipelineBarrier(VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_HOST_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, 0,
                               read_barrier);
        cmdbuf.CopyBufferToImage(*buffer, image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, copy);
        cmdbuf.PipelineBarrier(VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT,
                               VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_FRAGMENT_SHADER_BIT |
                                   VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COMPUTE_SHADER_BIT,
                               0, write_barrier);
    });
}

} // namespace Vulkan
```

```cpp
constexpr VkExtent2D CaptureImageSize{
    .width = VideoCore::Capture::LinearWidth,
    .height = VideoCore::Capture::LinearHeight,
};

#ifdef HAS_LSFG
[[nodiscard]] VkExtent2D GuestExtent(std::span<const Tegra::FramebufferConfig> framebuffers) {
    if (framebuffers.empty()) {
        return VkExtent2D{};
    }

    const auto& framebuffer = framebuffers.front();
    if (framebuffer.crop_rect.IsEmpty()) {
        return VkExtent2D{.width = framebuffer.width, .height = framebuffer.height};
    }
    return VkExtent2D{
        .width = static_cast<u32>(framebuffer.crop_rect.GetWidth()),
        .height = static_cast<u32>(framebuffer.crop_rect.GetHeight()),
    };
}
#endif

    .width = VideoCore::Capture::LinearWidth,
    .height = VideoCore::Capture::LinearHeight,
    .depth = VideoCore::Capture::LinearDepth,
};

std::string GetReadableVersion(u32 version) {
    return fmt::format("{}.{}.{}", VK_VERSION_MAJOR(version), VK_VERSION_MINOR(version),
                       VK_VERSION_PATCH(version));
}

std::string GetDriverVersion(const Device& device) {
    // Extracted from
    // https://github.com/SaschaWillems/vulkan.gpuinfo.org/blob/5dddea46ea1120b0df14eef8f15ff8e318e35462/functions.php#L308-L314
    const u32 version = device.GetDriverVersion();

    if (device.GetDriverID() == VK_DRIVER_ID_NVIDIA_PROPRIETARY) {
        const u32 major = (version >> 22) & 0x3ff;
        const u32 minor = (version >> 14) & 0x0ff;
        const u32 secondary = (version >> 6) & 0x0ff;
        const u32 tertiary = version & 0x003f;
        return fmt::format("{}.{}.{}.{}", major, minor, secondary, tertiary);
    }
    if (device.GetDriverID() == VK_DRIVER_ID_INTEL_PROPRIETARY_WINDOWS) {
        const u32 major = version >> 14;
        const u32 minor = version & 0x3fff;
        return fmt::format("{}.{}", major, minor);
    }
    return GetReadableVersion(version);
}

std::string BuildCommaSeparatedExtensions(
    const std::set<std::string, std::less<>>& available_extensions) {
    return fmt::format("{}", fmt::join(available_extensions, ","));
}

} // Anonymous namespace

Device CreateDevice(const vk::Instance& instance, const vk::InstanceDispatch& dld, VkSurfaceKHR surface) {
    const std::vector<VkPhysicalDevice> devices = instance.EnumeratePhysicalDevices();
    const u32 device_index = Settings::values.vulkan_device.GetValue();
    if (device_index >= u32(devices.size())) {
        LOG_ERROR(Render_Vulkan, "Invalid device index {}!", device_index);
        throw vk::Exception(VK_ERROR_INITIALIZATION_FAILED);
    }
    const vk::PhysicalDevice physical_device(devices[device_index], dld);
    return Device(*instance, physical_device, surface, dld);
}

RendererVulkan::RendererVulkan(Core::Frontend::EmuWindow& emu_window,
                               Tegra::MaxwellDeviceMemoryManager& device_memory_,
                               Tegra::GPU& gpu_,
                               std::unique_ptr<Core::Frontend::GraphicsContext> context_)
try
    : RendererBase(emu_window, std::move(context_))
    , device_memory(device_memory_)
    , gpu(gpu_)
    , library(OpenLibrary(context.get()))
    , dld()
    // Create raw Vulkan instance first
    , instance(CreateInstance(*library,
                            dld,
                            VK_API_VERSION_1_1,
                            render_window.GetWindowInfo().type,
                            Settings::values.renderer_debug.GetValue()))
    // Create debug messenger if debug is enabled
    , debug_messenger(Settings::values.renderer_debug ? CreateDebugUtilsCallback(instance)
                                                    : vk::DebugUtilsMessenger{})
    // Create surface
    , surface(CreateSurface(instance, render_window.GetWindowInfo()))
    , device(CreateDevice(instance, dld, *surface))
    , memory_allocator(device)
    , state_tracker()
    , scheduler(device, state_tracker)
    , swapchain(*surface,
                device,
                scheduler,
               render_window.GetFramebufferLayout().width,
               render_window.GetFramebufferLayout().height)
    , present_manager(instance,
                      render_window,
                      device,
                      memory_allocator,
                      scheduler,
                      swapchain,
                      surface)
    , blit_swapchain(device_memory,
                   device,
                   memory_allocator,
                   present_manager,
                   scheduler,
                   PresentFiltersForDisplay)
    , blit_capture(device_memory,
                   device,
                   memory_allocator,
                   present_manager,
                   scheduler,
                   PresentFiltersForDisplay)
    , blit_applet(device_memory,
                  device,
                  memory_allocator,
                  present_manager,
                  scheduler,
                  PresentFiltersForAppletCapture)
    , rasterizer(render_window, gpu, device_memory, device, memory_allocator, state_tracker, scheduler)
#ifdef HAS_LSFG
    , frame_gen(memory_allocator, scheduler)
#endif
{

    if (Settings::values.renderer_force_max_clock.GetValue() && device.ShouldBoostClocks()) {
        turbo_mode.emplace(instance, dld);
        scheduler.RegisterOnSubmit([this] { turbo_mode->QueueSubmitted(); });
    }

    PresentLoading();
    Report();
} catch (const vk::Exception& exception) {
    LOG_ERROR(Render_Vulkan, "Vulkan initialization failed with error: {}", exception.what());
    throw std::runtime_error{fmt::format("Vulkan initialization error {}", exception.what())};
}

RendererVulkan::~RendererVulkan() {
    scheduler.RegisterOnSubmit([] {});
    // Drain the scheduler's deferred recording worker BEFORE retiring
    // the private images, then wait for Vulkan completion in Destroy().
    // This runs only at renderer shutdown, never in the frame loop.
    scheduler.Finish();
    mihawk_native.reset();
    fsr3_optical.reset();
    void(device.GetLogical().WaitIdle());
}

void RendererVulkan::Composite(std::span<const Tegra::FramebufferConfig> framebuffers) {
    SCOPE_EXIT {
        render_window.OnFrameDisplayed();
    };

    RenderAppletCaptureLayer(framebuffers);

    if (!render_window.IsShown()) {
        return;
    }

    RenderScreenshot(framebuffers);
    // An observed source/composite callback is not an emulated guest FPS
    // measurement. Loading/splash work is accounted separately below.
    ::Eden::FrameMetrics::OnSourceComposite();
    if (::Eden::Display::SkipFrame()) {
        ::Eden::FrameMetrics::OnSourceSkipped();
        gpu.RendererFrameEndNotify();
        rasterizer.TickFrame();
        return;
    }
    Frame* frame = present_manager.GetRenderFrame();

    // Keep Encore's own overlay out of BOTH interpolation backends, not only
    // MihawkGen. Draw once AFTER generating on each image; guest HUD pixels
    // remain inseparable without per-game hooks.
    const int native_fg_method =
        Eden::Display::frame_generation_method.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
    const bool mihawk_selected = native_fg_method == 1 && !framebuffers.empty();
    const bool postprocess_hud_required =
        (native_fg_method >= 1 && native_fg_method <= 3) && !framebuffers.empty();
    const Eden::HudSnapshot postprocess_hud =
        postprocess_hud_required ? Eden::GetVulkanHud() : Eden::HudSnapshot{};
    scheduler.RequestOutsideRenderPassOperationContext();
    blit_swapchain.DrawToFrame(device, rasterizer, frame, framebuffers,
                               render_window.GetFramebufferLayout(), present_manager.SwapchainImageCount(),
                               present_manager.SwapchainImageViewFormat(), !postprocess_hud_required);

#ifdef HAS_LSFG
    // User-selected LSFG only. Do not mix a legacy generator with MihawkGen
    // or turn frame generation on merely because HAS_LSFG was compiled in.
    if (Eden::Display::frame_generation_method.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) == 3) {
    void(frame_gen.WantedGenerations(present_manager.MaxExtraFrames()));

    frame_gen.Process(device, frame, present_manager.SwapchainImageFormat(), GuestExtent(framebuffers));

    const size_t generated_frames = frame_gen.GeneratedFrameCount();
    for (size_t generation = 0; generation < generated_frames; ++generation) {
        Frame* generated = present_manager.GetRenderFrame();
        blit_swapchain.PrepareFrame(device, generated, render_window.GetFramebufferLayout());
        frame_gen.GenerateInto(device, generated, generation);
        // LSFG's shader output is in GENERAL. Native UI is post-composited
        // like MihawkGen, so it never enters optical-flow calculations.
        blit_swapchain.DrawHudOverlay(device, generated, postprocess_hud);
        scheduler.Flush(*generated->render_ready);
        present_manager.Present(generated);
        ::Eden::FrameMetrics::OnGeneratedQueued();
    }
    }
#endif

    // The AMD FSR3-derived optical-flow interpolator consumes only the real
    // game frame pair. Its private resources must be fenced before reuse;
    // the real frame is always presented even if generation drops out.
    Frame* fsr3_synthetic = nullptr;
    bool fsr3_generated = false;
    bool fsr3_captured = false;
    if (native_fg_method == 2 && !framebuffers.empty()) {
        ++fsr3_source_sequence;
        const u64 source_ns = static_cast<u64>(
            std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(
                std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count());
        const u64 delta_ns = source_ns > fsr3_previous_source_ns
            ? source_ns - fsr3_previous_source_ns : 0;
        fsr3_previous_source_ns = source_ns;
        if (!fsr3_optical)
            fsr3_optical = std::make_unique<Eden::FeatureLab::Fsr3OpticalSession>();
        const auto resize = Eden::FeatureLab::ChooseMihawkSessionAction(
            fsr3_optical->Ready(), fsr3_optical->Width(), fsr3_optical->Height(),
            fsr3_optical->Format(), frame->width, frame->height,
            present_manager.SwapchainImageFormat());
        if (resize == Eden::FeatureLab::MihawkSessionAction::RecreateAfterGpuIdle) {
            scheduler.Finish();
            present_manager.WaitPresent();
            fsr3_optical->Destroy();
            fsr3_init_attempted = false;
            fsr3_present_gate.Reset();
            fsr3_last_capture_tick = 0;
            fsr3_last_capture_id = 0;
        }
        if (resize != Eden::FeatureLab::MihawkSessionAction::InvalidTarget &&
            !fsr3_init_attempted) {
            fsr3_init_attempted = true;
            if (fsr3_optical->Create(
                    dld.vkGetInstanceProcAddr, *instance,
                    device.GetPhysical(), *device.GetLogical(),
                    frame->width, frame->height,
                    present_manager.SwapchainImageFormat()))
                fsr3_present_gate.Reset();
        }
        if (fsr3_optical->Ready()) {
            // The engine keeps TWO source images and one reusable output.
            // Do not touch them while the previous GPU submission is live.
            const bool previous_completed = fsr3_last_capture_tick &&
                scheduler.IsFree(fsr3_last_capture_tick);
            const bool consecutive = fsr3_last_capture_id &&
                fsr3_source_sequence == fsr3_last_capture_id + 1;
            if (!previous_completed || !consecutive)
                fsr3_present_gate.Reset();
            if (fsr3_last_capture_tick == 0 || previous_completed) {
                const int output_mhz =
                    Eden::Display::output_millihertz.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
                const unsigned output_hz = output_mhz > 0
                    ? static_cast<unsigned>((output_mhz + 500) / 1000) : 0U;
                const unsigned source_fps =
                    delta_ns >= 8'000'000 && delta_ns <= 100'000'000
                    ? static_cast<unsigned>(1'000'000'000ULL / delta_ns) : 0U;
                const Eden::FeatureLab::GraphicsCapabilities caps{
                    .native_vulkan = true,
                    .fsr3_optical_flow = true,
                    .game_fps = source_fps
                };
                const Eden::FeatureLab::PresentGateInput input{
                    .real_frame_id = fsr3_source_sequence,
                    .timestamp_ns = source_ns,
                    .width = frame->width,
                    .height = frame->height,
                    .output_hz = output_hz,
                    .display_mode_verified =
                        output_mhz > 0 && (output_hz == 60 || output_hz == 120)
                };
                const auto decision = fsr3_present_gate.OnRealFrame(
                    Eden::FeatureLab::FrameGeneration::Fsr3Vulkan, caps, input);
                if (decision.eligible() && previous_completed && consecutive) {
                    fsr3_synthetic = present_manager.TryReserveRenderFrame();
                    if (fsr3_synthetic &&
                        (fsr3_synthetic->width != frame->width ||
                         fsr3_synthetic->height != frame->height)) {
                        present_manager.CancelReservedRenderFrame(fsr3_synthetic);
                        fsr3_synthetic = nullptr;
                    }
                    fsr3_generated = fsr3_synthetic != nullptr;
                }
                // Always record the real source when the private GPU images
                // are free. The first copy only primes the optical history.
                scheduler.RequestOutsideRenderPassOperationContext();
                auto* session = fsr3_optical.get();
                const VkImage real_image = *frame->image;
                const VkImage extra_image =
                    fsr3_generated ? *fsr3_synthetic->image : VK_NULL_HANDLE;
                const bool synth = fsr3_generated;
                scheduler.Record([session, real_image, extra_image, synth](
                    vk::CommandBuffer cmd) {
                    (void)session->Record(*cmd, real_image, extra_image, synth);
                });
                fsr3_captured = true;
            }
        }
    } else {
        fsr3_present_gate.Reset();
        fsr3_previous_source_ns = 0;
    }

    // R08 native interpolation. The true guest composite is ALWAYS presented,
    // even when synthesis, GPU pacing, model load or extra FIFO slots fail.
    // The synthetic midpoint must precede the newest real frame in FIFO.
    Eden::FeatureLab::MihawkCapturePermit r08_capture{};
    Frame* r08_synthetic = nullptr;
    bool r08_generated = false;
    if (mihawk_selected) {
        // Zero steady-clock reads or interpolation allocations for the
        // default OFF path. Source IDs count actual compositor callbacks,
        // not generated frames or the game's requested VI cadence.
        ++mihawk_source_sequence;
        const u64 r08_source_ns = static_cast<u64>(
            std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(
                std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count());
        const u64 r08_delta_ns = r08_source_ns > mihawk_previous_source_ns
            ? r08_source_ns - mihawk_previous_source_ns : 0;
        mihawk_previous_source_ns = r08_source_ns;
        if (!mihawk_native)
            mihawk_native = std::make_unique<Eden::FeatureLab::MihawkNativeSession>();
        const auto session_action = Eden::FeatureLab::ChooseMihawkSessionAction(
            mihawk_native->Ready(),
            mihawk_native->Images().Width(), mihawk_native->Images().Height(),
            mihawk_native->Images().SourceFormat(),
            frame->width, frame->height, present_manager.SwapchainImageFormat());
        if (session_action == Eden::FeatureLab::MihawkSessionAction::RecreateAfterGpuIdle) {
            // Genuine extent / format change: drain queued commands FIRST.
            // Device-idle and neural network recreation are one-time work
            // per resize, not a hidden VkDeviceWaitIdle in the frame loop.
            scheduler.Finish();
            present_manager.WaitPresent();
            mihawk_native->Destroy();
            mihawk_capture_fences.ResetAfterDeviceIdle();
            mihawk_present_gate.Reset();
            mihawk_previous_source_ns = 0;
            mihawk_init_attempted = false;
        }
        if (session_action != Eden::FeatureLab::MihawkSessionAction::InvalidTarget &&
            !mihawk_init_attempted) {
            mihawk_init_attempted = true;
            const auto model = Eden::AppResourceFile("mihawkgen/network.fgw");
            if (mihawk_native->Create({
                .instance_proc = dld.vkGetInstanceProcAddr,
                .instance = *instance,
                .physical = device.GetPhysical(),
                .device = *device.GetLogical(),
                .compositor_format = present_manager.SwapchainImageFormat(),
                .width = frame->width,
                .height = frame->height,
                .model_path = model
            })) {
                mihawk_capture_fences.ResetAfterDeviceIdle();
                mihawk_present_gate.Reset();
            }
        }
        if (mihawk_native->Ready() &&
            mihawk_native->Images().Width() == frame->width &&
            mihawk_native->Images().Height() == frame->height &&
            mihawk_native->Images().SourceFormat() == present_manager.SwapchainImageFormat()) {
            r08_capture = mihawk_capture_fences.Acquire(
                [this](u64 tick) { return scheduler.IsFree(tick); });
            if (r08_capture.valid) {
                const auto& owned = mihawk_native->Images();
                const auto& private_history = owned.History(r08_capture.slot);
                const Eden::FeatureLab::MihawkSourceRecord source{
                    .source_real = *frame->image,
                    .history_owned = private_history.image,
                    .history_initialized = owned.Initialized(r08_capture.slot),
                    .width = frame->width,
                    .height = frame->height
                };

                if (Eden::FeatureLab::ValidateOwnedSnapshotInput(source)
                    == Eden::FeatureLab::MihawkRecordResult::Recorded) {
                    const int actual_output_mhz =
                        Eden::Display::output_millihertz.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
                    const unsigned actual_hz = actual_output_mhz > 0
                        ? static_cast<unsigned>((actual_output_mhz + 500) / 1000) : 0U;
                    // Observed compositor interval, NEVER the guest's requested VI
                    // clock or the synthetic display-frame counter.
                    const unsigned observed_fps = r08_delta_ns >= 8'000'000 &&
                        r08_delta_ns <= 100'000'000
                        ? static_cast<unsigned>(1'000'000'000ULL / r08_delta_ns) : 0U;
                    const Eden::FeatureLab::GraphicsCapabilities graphics{
                        .native_vulkan = true,
                        .mihawk_compute = mihawk_native->Ready(),
                        .model_weights_verified_and_loaded = mihawk_native->Ready(),
                        .game_fps = observed_fps
                    };
                    const Eden::FeatureLab::PresentGateInput input{
                        .real_frame_id = mihawk_source_sequence,
                        .timestamp_ns = r08_source_ns,
                        .width = frame->width,
                        .height = frame->height,
                        .output_hz = actual_hz,
                        .display_mode_verified =
                            actual_output_mhz > 0 && (actual_hz == 60 || actual_hz == 120),
                        .overlay_changed = false // Native overlay is applied after FG
                    };
                    const auto decision = mihawk_present_gate.OnRealFrame(
                        Eden::FeatureLab::FrameGeneration::MihawkGen, graphics, input);
                    const bool prior_snapshot_fenced =
                        mihawk_capture_fences.CanGenerate(
                            r08_capture, mihawk_source_sequence,
                            [this](u64 tick) { return scheduler.IsFree(tick); });

                    Eden::FeatureLab::MihawkGenerateRecord neural{};
                    if (decision.eligible() && prior_snapshot_fenced) {
                        // TryReserve never waits and never resets a fence until
                        // the synthetic image is fully prepared for submission.
                        r08_synthetic = present_manager.TryReserveRenderFrame();
                        if (r08_synthetic &&
                            r08_synthetic->width == frame->width &&
                            r08_synthetic->height == frame->height) {
                            const auto format = present_manager.SwapchainImageFormat();
                            const auto& previous = owned.History(r08_capture.slot ^ 1U);
                            neural = {
                                .context = mihawk_native->Context(),
                                .previous_owned = previous.image,
                                .current_owned = private_history.image,
                                .previous_view = previous.view,
                                .current_view = private_history.view,
                                .private_rgba_output = owned.RgbaOutput().image,
                                .private_rgba_view = owned.RgbaOutput().view,
                                .synthetic_present = *r08_synthetic->image,
                                .width = frame->width,
                                .height = frame->height,
                                .descriptor_slot = 0,
                                .context_slot_count = mihawk_native->DescriptorSlots(),
                                .output_was_blitted = mihawk_native->OutputWasBlitted(),
                                .capabilities = {
                                    .enabled = true,
                                    .native_vulkan = true,
                                    .compute_and_storage = mihawk_native->Ready(),
                                    .model_verified_and_loaded = mihawk_native->Ready(),
                                    .blit_rgba_to_present = true,  // probed by allocator
                                    .owned_history_pair = previous.image != private_history.image,
                                    .history_matches_source_format = owned.SourceFormat() == format,
                                    .private_output_rgba8_storage = owned.RgbaOutput().image != VK_NULL_HANDLE,
                                    .present_image_transfer_dst = true, // RecreateFrame usage
                                    .history_descriptor_slots_fenced = prior_snapshot_fenced,
                                    .present_queue_ordered = true, // same scheduler/queue
                                    .native_hud_absent = true, // absent from input snapshot
                                    .available_present_frames =
                                        static_cast<std::uint8_t>(
                                            std::min<std::size_t>(
                                                present_manager.MaxExtraFrames() + 1, 255)),
                                    .width = frame->width,
                                    .height = frame->height,
                                    .compositor_format =
                                        format == VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM
                                            ? Eden::FeatureLab::ColorFormat::Rgba8Unorm
                                            : format == VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM
                                                ? Eden::FeatureLab::ColorFormat::Bgra8Unorm
                                                : Eden::FeatureLab::ColorFormat::Other
                                }
                            };
                            r08_generated =
                                Eden::FeatureLab::ValidateNativeMihawkPairInput(neural) ==
                                Eden::FeatureLab::MihawkRecordResult::Recorded;
                        }
                        if (!r08_generated && r08_synthetic) {
                            // No fence reset, no GPU commands: return the slot as-is.
                            present_manager.CancelReservedRenderFrame(r08_synthetic);
                            r08_synthetic = nullptr;
                        }
                    }

                    scheduler.RequestOutsideRenderPassOperationContext();
                    // Scheduler::Record may invoke the callback through a
                    // const wrapper. Keep captured descriptors immutable and
                    // update local copies with the command buffer handle.
                    scheduler.Record([source, neural, r08_generated](vk::CommandBuffer cmd) {
                        auto recorded_source = source;
                        recorded_source.cmd = *cmd;
                        (void)Eden::FeatureLab::RecordOwnedSnapshot(recorded_source);
                        if (r08_generated) {
                            // Source and generated image remain in the same
                            // recorded command buffer and ordered submission.
                            auto recorded_neural = neural;
                            recorded_neural.cmd = *cmd;
                            (void)Eden::FeatureLab::RecordNativeMihawkPair(recorded_neural);
                        }
                    });
                } else {
                    mihawk_capture_fences.AbortUnsubmitted();
                    r08_capture = {};
                }
            }
        }
    } else {
        // Game/menu/renderer switch cannot reuse an old source pair.
        mihawk_present_gate.Reset();
        mihawk_previous_source_ns = 0;
    }

    // If generated, submit and queue the midpoint FIRST. The original real
    // frame is flushed and queued next. Both use existing PresentManager FIFO.
    if (r08_generated) {
        // Preserve interpolated pixels with a LOAD render pass, then add
        // Encore's native HUD. Framebuffer remains valid, no image copy.
        blit_swapchain.DrawHudOverlay(device, r08_synthetic, postprocess_hud);
        present_manager.ConfirmReservedRenderFrame(r08_synthetic);
        const u64 generated_tick = scheduler.Flush(*r08_synthetic->render_ready);
        if (r08_capture.valid) {
            if (mihawk_capture_fences.Commit(
                    r08_capture, generated_tick, mihawk_source_sequence, true)) {
                mihawk_native->Images().MarkInitialized(r08_capture.slot);
                mihawk_native->MarkOutputBlitted();
            } else {
                // The GPU command was submitted but its tick could not be
                // attested. Preserve quarantine: never reuse private images
                // or claim the output can be overwritten by the next frame.
                mihawk_present_gate.Reset();
            }
        }
        present_manager.Present(r08_synthetic);
        ::Eden::FrameMetrics::OnGeneratedQueued();
    }

    // Exactly one method can own synthetic presentation. The original
    // composite always follows any generated frame in PresentManager FIFO.
    if (fsr3_generated) {
        blit_swapchain.DrawHudOverlay(device, fsr3_synthetic, postprocess_hud);
        present_manager.ConfirmReservedRenderFrame(fsr3_synthetic);
        const u64 synthetic_tick = scheduler.Flush(*fsr3_synthetic->render_ready);
        present_manager.Present(fsr3_synthetic);
        ::Eden::FrameMetrics::OnGeneratedQueued();
        // The real frame flush below fences the full command sequence.
        (void)synthetic_tick;
    }

    // HUD is always restored on the true frame, including when no midpoint
    // could be generated; do not deprive the user of diagnostic overlay.
    if (postprocess_hud_required)
        blit_swapchain.DrawHudOverlay(device, frame, postprocess_hud);
    const u64 real_tick = scheduler.Flush(*frame->render_ready);
    if (fsr3_captured) {
        if (real_tick != 0 && real_tick > fsr3_last_capture_tick) {
            fsr3_last_capture_tick = real_tick;
            fsr3_last_capture_id = fsr3_source_sequence;
        } else {
            // The command was submitted but its GPU lifetime is unproven.
            // Quarantine the private history rather than reuse it.
            fsr3_last_capture_tick = std::numeric_limits<u64>::max();
            fsr3_last_capture_id = 0;
            fsr3_present_gate.Reset();
        }
    }
    if (r08_capture.valid && !r08_generated &&
        mihawk_capture_fences.Commit(
            r08_capture, real_tick, mihawk_source_sequence, false)) {
        mihawk_native->Images().MarkInitialized(r08_capture.slot);
    }
    present_manager.Present(frame);
    ::Eden::FrameMetrics::OnRealQueued();
    scheduler.DispatchWork();

    gpu.RendererFrameEndNotify();
    rasterizer.TickFrame();
}

// Runs on the existing GPU worker, before the first guest Composite. Reuse its
// swapchain and composition pass without guest captures or FPS notifications.
void RendererVulkan::PresentLoading() {
    Frame* frame = present_manager.GetRenderFrame();
    scheduler.RequestOutsideRenderPassOperationContext();
    blit_swapchain.DrawToFrame(device, rasterizer, frame, {},
                              render_window.GetFramebufferLayout(), present_manager.SwapchainImageCount(),
                              present_manager.SwapchainImageViewFormat(), true);
    scheduler.Flush(*frame->render_ready);
    present_manager.Present(frame);
    ::Eden::FrameMetrics::OnLoadingQueued();
}

void RendererVulkan::Report() const {
    using namespace Common::Literals;
    const std::string vendor_name{device.GetVendorName()};
    const std::string model_name{device.GetModelName()};
    const std::string driver_version = GetDriverVersion(device);
    const std::string driver_name = fmt::format("{} {}", vendor_name, driver_version);

    const std::string api_version = GetReadableVersion(device.ApiVersion());

    const std::string extensions = BuildCommaSeparatedExtensions(device.GetAvailableExtensions());

    const auto available_vram = static_cast<f64>(device.GetDeviceLocalMemory()) / f64{1_GiB};

    LOG_INFO(Render_Vulkan, "Driver: {}", driver_name);
    LOG_INFO(Render_Vulkan, "Device: {}", model_name);
    LOG_INFO(Render_Vulkan, "Vulkan: {}", api_version);
    LOG_INFO(Render_Vulkan, "Available VRAM: {:.2f} GiB", available_vram);
}

vk::Buffer RendererVulkan::RenderToBuffer(std::span<const Tegra::FramebufferConfig> framebuffers,
                                          const Layout::FramebufferLayout& layout, VkFormat format,
                                          VkDeviceSize buffer_size) {
    auto frame = [&]() {
        Frame f{};
        f.image =
            CreateWrappedImage(memory_allocator, VkExtent2D{layout.width, layout.height}, format);
        f.image_view = CreateWrappedImageView(device, f.image, format);
        f.framebuffer = blit_capture.CreateFramebuffer(device, layout, *f.image_view, format);
        return f;
    }();

    auto dst_buffer = CreateWrappedBuffer(memory_allocator, buffer_size, MemoryUsage::Download);
    blit_capture.DrawToFrame(device, rasterizer, &frame, framebuffers, layout, 1, format, true);

    scheduler.RequestOutsideRenderPassOperationContext();
    scheduler.Record([&](vk::CommandBuffer cmdbuf) {
        DownloadColorImage(cmdbuf, *frame.image, *dst_buffer,
                           VkExtent3D{layout.width, layout.height, 1});
    });

    // Ensure the copy is fully completed before saving the capture
    scheduler.Finish();

    // Copy backing image data to the capture buffer
    dst_buffer.Invalidate();
    return dst_buffer;
}

void RendererVulkan::RenderScreenshot(std::span<const Tegra::FramebufferConfig> framebuffers) {
    if (!renderer_settings.screenshot_requested) {
        return;
    }

    const auto screenshot_layers = Tegra::FilterLayerStack(
        framebuffers, renderer_settings.screenshot_layer_stack, screenshot_layer_scratch);

    const auto& layout{renderer_settings.screenshot_framebuffer_layout};
    const auto dst_buffer = RenderToBuffer(screenshot_layers, layout, VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM,
                                           layout.width * layout.height * 4);

    std::memcpy(renderer_settings.screenshot_bits, dst_buffer.Mapped().data(),
                dst_buffer.Mapped().size());
    renderer_settings.screenshot_complete_callback(false);
    renderer_settings.screenshot_requested = false;
}

std::vector<u8> RendererVulkan::GetAppletCaptureBuffer() {
    using namespace VideoCore::Capture;

    std::vector<u8> out(VideoCore::Capture::TiledSize);

    if (!applet_frame.image) {
        return out;
    }

    const auto dst_buffer =
        CreateWrappedBuffer(memory_allocator, VideoCore::Capture::TiledSize, MemoryUsage::Download);

    scheduler.RequestOutsideRenderPassOperationContext();
    scheduler.Record([&](vk::CommandBuffer cmdbuf) {
        DownloadColorImage(cmdbuf, *applet_frame.image, *dst_buffer, CaptureImageExtent);
    });

    // Ensure the copy is fully completed before writing the capture
    scheduler.Finish();

    // Swizzle image data to the capture buffer
    dst_buffer.Invalidate();
    Tegra::Texture::SwizzleTexture(out, dst_buffer.Mapped(), BytesPerPixel, LinearWidth,
                                   LinearHeight, LinearDepth, BlockHeight, BlockDepth);

    return out;
}

void RendererVulkan::RenderAppletCaptureLayer(
    std::span<const Tegra::FramebufferConfig> framebuffers) {
    const auto capture_layers = Tegra::FilterLayerStack(
        framebuffers, Service::Nvnflinger::LayerStackId::LastFrame, applet_capture_layers);

    if (capture_layers.empty())
        return;

    if (!applet_frame.image) {
        applet_frame.image = CreateWrappedImage(memory_allocator, CaptureImageSize, CaptureFormat);
        applet_frame.image_view = CreateWrappedImageView(device, applet_frame.image, CaptureFormat);
        applet_frame.framebuffer = blit_applet.CreateFramebuffer(device,
            VideoCore::Capture::Layout, *applet_frame.image_view, CaptureFormat);
    }

    scheduler.RequestOutsideRenderPassOperationContext();
    blit_applet.DrawToFrame(device, rasterizer, &applet_frame, capture_layers, VideoCore::Capture::Layout, 1,
                            CaptureFormat);
}

} // namespace Vulkan
namespace Eden {
void PresentVulkanLoading(VideoCore::RendererBase& renderer) {
    static_cast<Vulkan::RendererVulkan&>(renderer).PresentLoading();
}
}
```

`headless/vulkan_sgsr_r07.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright 2026 Eden Emulator Project
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later

#include <algorithm>

#include "common/common_types.h"
#include "common/div_ceil.h"
#include "common/settings.h"
#include "sgsr_sharpness_policy.h"

//#include "video_core/sgsr.h"
#include "video_core/host_shaders/sgsr1_shader_mobile_frag_spv.h"
#include "video_core/host_shaders/sgsr1_shader_mobile_edge_direction_frag_spv.h"
#include "video_core/host_shaders/sgsr1_shader_vert_spv.h"
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/present/sgsr.h"
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/present/util.h"
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_scheduler.h"
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_shader_util.h"
#include "video_core/vulkan_common/vulkan_device.h"

namespace Vulkan {

using PushConstants = std::array<u32, 4 + 2 + 2 + 1>;

SGSR::SGSR(const Device& device, MemoryAllocator& memory_allocator, size_t image_count, VkExtent2D extent, bool edge_dir)
    : m_memory_allocator{memory_allocator}
    , m_image_count{image_count}
    , m_extent{extent}
    , m_edge_dir{edge_dir}
{
    // Not finished yet initializing at ctor time?
    m_dynamic_images.resize(m_image_count);
    for (auto& images : m_dynamic_images) {
        images.image = CreateWrappedImage(m_memory_allocator, m_extent, VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT);
        images.image_view = CreateWrappedImageView(device, images.image, VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT);
    }

    m_renderpass = CreateWrappedRenderPass(device, VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT);
    for (auto& images : m_dynamic_images)
        images.framebuffer = CreateWrappedFramebuffer(device, m_renderpass, images.image_view, m_extent);

    m_sampler = CreateBilinearSampler(device);
    m_vert_shader = BuildShader(device, SGSR1_SHADER_VERT_SPV);
    m_stage_shader = m_edge_dir
        ? BuildShader(device, SGSR1_SHADER_MOBILE_EDGE_DIRECTION_FRAG_SPV)
        : BuildShader(device, SGSR1_SHADER_MOBILE_FRAG_SPV);
    // 2 descriptors, 2 descriptor sets per invocation
    m_descriptor_pool = CreateWrappedDescriptorPool(device,  m_image_count, m_image_count);
    m_descriptor_set_layout = CreateWrappedDescriptorSetLayout(device, {VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER});

    VkDescriptorSetLayout layout = *m_descriptor_set_layout;
    for (auto& images : m_dynamic_images)
        images.descriptor_sets = CreateWrappedDescriptorSets(m_descriptor_pool, layout);

    const VkPushConstantRange range{
        .stageFlags = VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT | VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT,
        .offset = 0,
        .size = sizeof(PushConstants),
    };
    VkPipelineLayoutCreateInfo ci{
        .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO,
        .pNext = nullptr,
        .flags = 0,
        .setLayoutCount = 1,
        .pSetLayouts = m_descriptor_set_layout.address(),
        .pushConstantRangeCount = 1,
        .pPushConstantRanges = &range,
    };
    m_pipeline_layout = device.GetLogical().CreatePipelineLayout(ci);
    m_stage_pipeline = CreateWrappedPipeline(device, m_renderpass, m_pipeline_layout, std::tie(m_vert_shader, m_stage_shader));
}

void SGSR::UpdateDescriptorSets(const Device& device, VkImageView image_view, size_t image_index) {
    Images& images = m_dynamic_images[image_index];
    std::vector<VkDescriptorImageInfo> image_infos;
    std::vector<VkWriteDescriptorSet> updates;
    image_infos.reserve(1);
    updates.push_back(CreateWriteDescriptorSet(image_infos, *m_sampler, image_view, images.descriptor_sets[0], 0));
    device.GetLogical().UpdateDescriptorSets(updates, {});
}

void SGSR::UploadImages(const Device& device, Scheduler& scheduler) {
    if (!m_images_ready) {
        scheduler.Record([&](vk::CommandBuffer cmdbuf) {
            for (auto& image : m_dynamic_images)
                ClearColorImage(cmdbuf, *image.image);
        });
        scheduler.Finish();
        m_images_ready = true;
    }
}

VkImageView SGSR::Draw(const Device& device, Scheduler& scheduler, size_t image_index, VkImage source_image, VkImageView source_image_view, VkExtent2D input_image_extent, const Common::Rectangle<f32>& crop_rect) {
    Images& images = m_dynamic_images[image_index];
    auto const output_image = *images.image;
    auto const descriptor_set = images.descriptor_sets[0];
    auto const framebuffer = *images.framebuffer;
    auto const pipeline = *m_stage_pipeline;

    VkPipelineLayout layout = *m_pipeline_layout;
    VkRenderPass renderpass = *m_renderpass;
    VkExtent2D extent = m_extent;

    const f32 input_image_width = f32(input_image_extent.width);
    const f32 input_image_height = f32(input_image_extent.height);
    const f32 crop_width = (crop_rect.right - crop_rect.left) * input_image_width;
    const f32 crop_height = (crop_rect.bottom - crop_rect.top) * input_image_height;
    // This is a spatial SGSR intensity, not RCAS stops. Preserve Encore's
    // 0–100% UI semantics: 0=off, 50=balanced, 100=maximum intensity.
    // The frontend already maps percent -> 200 - 2*percent.
    const f32 edge_sharpness = Eden::Graphics::SgsrEdgeIntensityFromInternal(
        Settings::values.fsr_sharpening_slider.GetValue());

    // layout( push_constant ) uniform constants {
    //     highp vec4 ViewportInfo[1];
    //     highp vec2 ResizeFactor;
    //     highp vec2 CropOffset;
    //     highp float EdgeSharpness;
    // };
    PushConstants viewport_con{};
    viewport_con[0] = std::bit_cast<u32>(1.f / input_image_width);
    viewport_con[1] = std::bit_cast<u32>(1.f / input_image_height);
    viewport_con[2] = std::bit_cast<u32>(input_image_width);
    viewport_con[3] = std::bit_cast<u32>(input_image_height);
    viewport_con[4] = std::bit_cast<u32>(crop_width / input_image_width);
    viewport_con[5] = std::bit_cast<u32>(crop_height / input_image_height);
    viewport_con[6] = std::bit_cast<u32>((std::min)(crop_rect.left, crop_rect.right));
    viewport_con[7] = std::bit_cast<u32>((std::min)(crop_rect.top, crop_rect.bottom));
    viewport_con[8] = std::bit_cast<u32>(edge_sharpness);

    UploadImages(device, scheduler);
    UpdateDescriptorSets(device, source_image_view, image_index);

    scheduler.RequestOutsideRenderPassOperationContext();
    scheduler.Record([=](vk::CommandBuffer cmdbuf) {
        TransitionImageLayout(cmdbuf, source_image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL);
        TransitionImageLayout(cmdbuf, output_image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL);
        BeginRenderPass(cmdbuf, renderpass, framebuffer, extent);
        cmdbuf.BindPipeline(VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, pipeline);
        cmdbuf.BindDescriptorSets(VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, layout, 0, descriptor_set, {});
        cmdbuf.PushConstants(layout, VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT | VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT, viewport_con);
        cmdbuf.Draw(3, 1, 0, 0);
        cmdbuf.EndRenderPass();
        TransitionImageLayout(cmdbuf, output_image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL);
    });
    return *images.image_view;
}

} // namespace Vulkan
```
