`tools/check-dualsense-rumble-lock-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
"""Compile the actual PS5 rumble consumer with host stubs and sanitizers.

No PS5 SDK, DualSense or FC27 runtime is exercised. The source-linked test
checks publication, concurrent producer/consumer, and unchanged motor levels.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
source = (root / "headless/pad.cpp").read_text()
start = source.index("bool PadEngine::TakeRumble(")
end = source.index("\nPad::Pad(", start)
method = source[start:end].strip()
assert method.count("std::scoped_lock lock(rumble_mutex);") == 1
lock_start = method.index("    {\n        std::scoped_lock lock(rumble_mutex);")
lock_end = method.index("\n    }\n", lock_start)
critical = method[lock_start:lock_end]
assert "sides = pending;" in critical
assert "pending.changed = false;" in critical
assert "rumble_pending[player].store(false, std::memory_order_release);" in critical
assert "std::pow" not in critical and "std::lround" not in critical
assert method.index("const auto level") > lock_end
assert method.index("out.large") > lock_end and method.index("out.small") > lock_end
producer = source.split("PadEngine::SetVibration(", 1)[1].split(
    "bool PadEngine::TakeRumble(", 1)[0]
assert "std::scoped_lock lock(rumble_mutex);" in producer
assert producer.index("sides.changed = true;") < producer.index(
    "rumble_pending[player].store(true, std::memory_order_release);")

fixture = r"""
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>
using u8 = std::uint8_t;
namespace Common::Input {
enum class VibrationAmplificationType { Linear, Exponential };
struct VibrationStatus {
    float low_amplitude{}, high_amplitude{};
    VibrationAmplificationType type{VibrationAmplificationType::Linear};
};
}
class PadEngine {
public:
    static constexpr unsigned kPlayers = 4;
    struct Rumble { u8 large = 0, small = 0; };
    struct Sides {
        Common::Input::VibrationStatus left{}, right{};
        bool changed = false;
    };
    std::mutex rumble_mutex;
    std::array<Sides, kPlayers> rumble{};
    std::array<std::atomic<bool>, kPlayers> rumble_pending{};
    void Publish(unsigned player, Sides sides) {
        std::scoped_lock lock(rumble_mutex);
        rumble[player] = sides;
        rumble[player].changed = true;
        rumble_pending[player].store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    }
    bool TakeRumble(std::size_t player, Rumble& out);
};
__ACTUAL_METHOD__
int main() {
    PadEngine engine;
    PadEngine::Rumble out{};
    assert(!engine.TakeRumble(0, out));
    assert(!engine.TakeRumble(4, out));
    PadEngine::Sides first{};
    first.left.low_amplitude = 1.0f;
    first.right.high_amplitude = 0.25f;
    engine.Publish(0, first);
    assert(engine.TakeRumble(0, out));
    assert(out.large == 255 && out.small > 0 && out.small < 255);
    assert(!engine.TakeRumble(0, out));
    // Two commands before a poll coalesce to the newest state, as before.
    PadEngine::Sides second{};
    second.left.low_amplitude = 0.0f;
    second.right.low_amplitude = 1.0f;
    second.left.high_amplitude = 1.0f;
    engine.Publish(0, first);
    engine.Publish(0, second);
    assert(engine.TakeRumble(0, out));
    assert(out.large == 255 && out.small == 255);
    // Exercise publication/consumption races under the real method body.
    std::thread producer([&] {
        for (int i = 0; i < 30000; ++i) {
            PadEngine::Sides next{};
            next.left.low_amplitude = i % 2 ? 0.5f : 1.0f;
            engine.Publish(1, next);
        }
    });
    for (int i = 0; i < 30000; ++i) engine.TakeRumble(1, out);
    producer.join();
    if (engine.rumble_pending[1].load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        assert(engine.TakeRumble(1, out));
    assert(!engine.rumble_pending[1].load(std::memory_order_acquire));
    assert(!engine.TakeRumble(1, out));
}
""".replace("__ACTUAL_METHOD__", method)
compiler = os.environ.get("CXX") or next(
    (c for c in ("clang++-18", "clang++", "g++") if shutil.which(c)), None)
if not compiler:
    raise SystemExit("C++20 compiler required")
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-ps5-rumble-lock-") as folder:
    src = Path(folder) / "rumble.cpp"
    src.write_text(fixture)
    for opt in ("0", "2"):
        exe = Path(folder) / ("rumble-" + opt)
        subprocess.run([compiler, "-std=c++20", "-O" + opt, "-pthread",
                        "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror",
                        "-fsanitize=address,undefined", "-fno-omit-frame-pointer",
                        str(src), "-o", str(exe)], check=True)
        subprocess.run([str(exe)], check=True, timeout=40)
print("PASS: actual TakeRumble, O0/O2 ASan+UBSan, lock scope, concurrent publication")
print("PS5 rumble latency and FC27 performance: UNMEASURED")
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Run production pinned-source cache repair with temporary synthetic snapshots."""
import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tarfile
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
script = root / "tools/refresh-eden-atomic-source-cache.py"
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("atomic_cache", script)
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
prep = (root / "tools/prepare-build.sh").read_text()
assert 'python3 -B "$root/tools/refresh-eden-atomic-source-cache.py" "$scratch"' in prep
assert prep.index("refresh-eden-atomic-source-cache.py") < prep.index(
    'if [[ ! -f $eden/CMakeLists.txt ]]; then')
def invoke(scratch, archive, owner, expect_success=True):
    cp = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-B", str(script), str(scratch),
                         str(archive), str(owner)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
    assert (cp.returncode == 0) == expect_success, (cp.stderr, cp.stdout)
    return cp

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-atomic-cache-regression-") as temp:
    # macOS uses /tmp -> /private/tmp. The production cache owner check uses
    # canonical paths; the synthetic test owner must use the same filesystem
    # spelling instead of falsely reporting a different checkout.
    temp = Path(temp).resolve()
    owner = temp / "repo"
    owner.mkdir()
    tar_input = temp / "pin" / "eden"
    (tar_input / "src/core").mkdir(parents=True)
    (tar_input / "CMakeLists.txt").write_text("project(EdenPin)\n")
    (tar_input / "src/core/device_memory_manager.h").write_text(
        "struct DeviceMemoryManager { int pristine; };\n")
    archive = temp / "pin.tar.gz"
    with tarfile.open(archive, "w:gz") as tar:
        tar.add(tar_input, arcname="eden")
    scratch = temp / "ps5-eden-headless.fixture"
    scratch.mkdir()
    (scratch / "owner").write_text(str(owner))
    source = scratch / "source"
    def make_old():
        (source / "src/core").mkdir(parents=True)
        (source / "CMakeLists.txt").write_text("project(OldCachedEden)\n")
        (source / "GIT-COMMIT").write_text(module.PIN + "\n")
        (source / "src/core/device_memory_manager.h").write_text(
            "\n".join(module.OLD) + "\n")
        for receipt in module.RECEIPTS:
            (source / receipt).write_text("old-patch-receipt\n")
    make_old()
    store = source / ".cache/cpm"
    store.mkdir(parents=True)
    (store / "sentinel").write_text("keep CPM packages")
    for dirname in ("sdk", "native-local", "radv"):
        (scratch / dirname).mkdir()
        (scratch / dirname / "sentinel").write_text("keep native cache")
    first = invoke(scratch, archive, owner)
    assert "EDEN_ATOMIC_CACHE_REFRESH" in first.stdout
    assert "pristine" in (source / "src/core/device_memory_manager.h").read_text()
    assert (source / ".cache/cpm/sentinel").read_text() == "keep CPM packages"
    for dirname in ("sdk", "native-local", "radv"):
        assert (scratch / dirname / "sentinel").read_text() == "keep native cache"
    assert not (scratch / ".eden-stale-atomic-backup").exists()
    invoke(scratch, archive, owner)  # modern cache: safe no-op
    shutil.rmtree(source)
    make_old()
    header = source / "src/core/device_memory_manager.h"
    header.write_text(header.read_text() + module.NEW[0] + "\n")
    invoke(scratch, archive, owner, False)
    assert module.OLD[0] in header.read_text()
    header.write_text("\n".join(module.OLD[:-1]))
    invoke(scratch, archive, owner, False)
    assert module.OLD[0] in header.read_text()
    header.write_text("\n".join(module.OLD))
    (source / "GIT-COMMIT").write_text("unknown-pin")
    invoke(scratch, archive, owner, False)
    (source / "GIT-COMMIT").write_text(module.PIN)
    (scratch / "owner").write_text("/unknown-owner")
    invoke(scratch, archive, owner, False)
print("PASS production R289 cached old atomic_ref source refresh; keep CPM/SDK/RADV/"
      "native caches, refuse mixed/incomplete/wrong owner/pin")
```

`tools/check-eden-audit-register.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Check the single native audit register for stale files, symbols and cycles.

An existence/graph check, NOT a hardware or runtime correctness certificate.
"""
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
import re

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
doc = (root / "docs/EDEN_CORE_AUDIT_DEPENDENCIES.md").read_text()
begin, end = "<!-- AUDIT_ROWS_START -->", "<!-- AUDIT_ROWS_END -->"
assert doc.count(begin) == doc.count(end) == 1
table = doc.split(begin, 1)[1].split(end, 1)[0]
valid_states = {"HOST", "SOURCE", "OPEN", "PARKED"}
entries = {}
state_totals = Counter()
records = []
for raw in table.splitlines():
    if not re.match(r"^\|\s*[A-Z][0-9]{2,3}\s*\|", raw):
        continue
    cells = [item.strip() for item in raw.strip().strip("|").split("|")]
    assert len(cells) == 9, (raw, len(cells))
    ident, priority, deps, source, symbols, state, evidence, acceptance, visual = cells
    assert ident not in entries, ("duplicate", ident)
    assert priority in {"P0", "P1", "P2"}, (ident, priority)
    assert state in valid_states, (ident, state)
    if state == "HOST":
        assert "img.shields.io/badge/" in visual and "2ea44f" in visual, ident
    else:
        assert "img.shields.io/badge/" not in visual, ident
    assert acceptance not in {"", "-", "TODO", "TBD"}, ident
    # U23 is a preserved historical audit identifier. The implementation
    # moved to the unified bounded JIT policy header; record the provenance
    # translation explicitly rather than reviving the old duplicate source.
    effective_source = (
        "headless/jit_memory_policy.h"
        if ident == "U23" and source == "headless/experimental_performance.h"
        else source
    )
    if ident == "U23":
        assert effective_source == "headless/jit_memory_policy.h"
        assert (root/"tools/ns2/check_unified_jit_cpu6_baseline_host.py").is_file()
    source_path = root / effective_source
    evidence_path = root / evidence
    assert source_path.is_file(), (ident, "missing source", source)
    assert evidence_path.is_file(), (ident, "missing evidence", evidence)
    body = source_path.read_text()
    symbols_list = [term.strip() for term in symbols.split(";")]
    assert all(symbols_list), (ident, symbols)
    for symbol in symbols_list:
        assert symbol in body, (ident, source, "missing symbol", symbol)
    entries[ident] = [d.strip() for d in deps.split(",") if d.strip() != "-"]
    state_totals[state] += 1
    records.append((priority, source, len(symbols_list), state))
assert len(entries) >= 62, len(entries)
# F01's selected descriptor-queue helper was renamed when its capacity
# check became exact. Audit entries must follow compiled symbols, not stale
# source-count snapshots that quietly block all host/native CI gates.
v42 = next((line for line in table.splitlines() if line.startswith("| V42 |")), "")
assert "PreflightExactGuestDraw" in v42 and "PreflightLargeGuestDraw" not in v42
assert doc.count("img.shields.io/badge/") >= 28
for ident, deps in entries.items():
    assert len(deps) == len(set(deps)), ("repeated dependency", ident)
    for dep in deps:
        assert dep in entries and dep != ident, (ident, dep)

visiting, done = set(), set()
def visit(ident):
    if ident in done:
        return
    assert ident not in visiting, ("cycle", ident)
    visiting.add(ident)
    for prerequisite in entries[ident]:
        visit(prerequisite)
    visiting.remove(ident)
    done.add(ident)
for ident in entries:
    visit(ident)

for ident in ("Q01", "T01", "T02", "J01", "H01", "H03", "V02", "V04", "M02", "S02"):
    assert ident in entries
# Every green historic test must point to a real file actually run by CI.
# Presence of a green badge does NOT imply console-game validation.
workflow = (root / ".github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml").read_text()
completed_rows = re.findall(r"^\| C\d\d \|.*$", doc, re.M)
assert len(completed_rows) >= 19
for row in completed_rows:
    assert row.count("img.shields.io/badge/") == 1, row[:60]
    assert "2ea44f" in row, row[:60]
    match = re.search(
        r"https://github\.com/niakw/Prospero\.Eden-Encore/blob/dev/ps5-sparse-jit/(tools/[^)]*\.py)",
        row,
    )
    assert match, ("missing hosted test link", row[:65])
    relative = match.group(1)
    assert (root / relative).is_file(), relative
    assert ("python3 -B " + relative) in workflow, ("green but not in CI", relative)


# The summary table is computed from the actual rows, not from a stale
# manually maintained snapshot. A new owner must update both layers at once.
def coverage(rows):
    return (len(rows), len({source for _, source, _, _ in rows}),
            sum(symbols for _, _, symbols, _ in rows))

def expect_coverage(label, rows, bold=False):
    numbers = coverage(rows)
    if bold:
        values = " | ".join(f"**{number}**" for number in numbers)
    else:
        values = " | ".join(str(number) for number in numbers)
    expected = f"| {label} | {values} |"
    assert expected in doc, ("stale quantified audit summary", expected, numbers)

expect_coverage("Graphe connu", records)
expect_coverage("HOST — preuve ciblée hôte", [r for r in records if r[3] == "HOST"])
expect_coverage("SOURCE — lecture effectuée, preuve insuffisante",
                [r for r in records if r[3] == "SOURCE"])
expect_coverage("OPEN — question technique non résolue",
                [r for r in records if r[3] == "OPEN"])
expect_coverage("PARKED — expérimentation suspendue",
                [r for r in records if r[3] == "PARKED"])
pending = [r for r in records if r[3] in {"SOURCE", "OPEN"}]
expect_coverage("**Encore à qualifier (SOURCE + OPEN)**", pending, bold=True)
expect_coverage("Dont priorité P0 (SOURCE + OPEN)",
                [r for r in pending if r[0] == "P0"])
pcount, pfiles, psymbols = coverage(pending)
assert f"{pcount} critères répartis sur\\n{pfiles} fichiers et {psymbols} mentions".replace("\\n", "\n") in doc
assert f"{state_totals['OPEN']} OPEN et {state_totals['SOURCE']} SOURCE." in doc

assert "bridge is still DISABLED" in doc
print("ENCORE_CORE_AUDIT_REGISTER_PASS", f"entries={len(entries)}",
      "statuses=" + ",".join(f"{key}:{state_totals[key]}" for key in sorted(valid_states)))
```

`tools/check-eden-audit-verification-matrix.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Audit EVERY mapped Eden Encore contract without inventing native proof.

Checks per-row evidence visibility/CI execution, dependencies, ownership
and the remaining qualification backlog. The existing audit-register,
source-inventory and source-parity checks are independent companion gates.

--json emits every graph row with its exact proof limits for review.
This audit never builds a game, marks SOURCE as HOST, or times PS5 frames.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from collections import Counter
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
REGISTER = ROOT / "docs/EDEN_CORE_AUDIT_DEPENDENCIES.md"
WORKFLOW = ROOT / ".github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml"
CATALOG = ROOT / "docs/EDEN_ACTIVE_SOURCE_CATALOG.md"
SOURCE_ROOT = ROOT / "vendor/encore-active"

LANES = {
    "B": "build", "Q": "native-lifecycle", "D": "dma",
    "V": "vulkan", "J": "jit-cpu", "H": "hle-scheduler",
    "M": "guest-memory", "S": "frame-progress",
    "T": "platform", "N": "gpu-nvdrv", "A": "audio",
    "F": "filesystem", "R": "radv", "U": "application-headers",
    "L": "launch-resources", "W": "network"
}
STATES = {
    "HOST": "specific-host-property-only",
    "SOURCE": "source-reviewed-not-runtime-qualified",
    "OPEN": "unresolved-behavior-or-ownership",
    "PARKED": "experiment-not-authorized-for-runtime"
}


def parse_rows(source: str) -> list[dict]:
    begin = "<!-- AUDIT_ROWS_START -->"
    end = "<!-- AUDIT_ROWS_END -->"
    assert source.count(begin) == source.count(end) == 1
    section = source.split(begin, 1)[1].split(end, 1)[0]
    rows = []
    for raw in section.splitlines():
        if not re.match(r"^\|\s*[A-Z][0-9]{2,3}\s*\|", raw):
            continue
        fields = [cell.strip() for cell in raw.strip().strip("|").split("|")]
        assert len(fields) == 9, ("malformed contract", raw[:120])
        key, priority, deps, path, symbols, status, evidence, acceptance, badge = fields
        assert re.fullmatch(r"[A-Z][0-9]{2,3}", key), key
        assert priority in {"P0", "P1", "P2"}, key
        assert status in STATES, key
        assert key[0] in LANES, key
        assert evidence and path and symbols and acceptance and badge, key
        rows.append({
            "id": key, "priority": priority,
            "prerequisites": [] if deps == "-" else [x.strip() for x in deps.split(",")],
            "path": path, "symbols": [x.strip() for x in symbols.split(";")],
            "status": status, "evidence": evidence, "acceptance": acceptance,
            "lane": LANES[key[0]],
        })
    assert len(rows) >= 477, ("lost previously indexed contracts", len(rows))
    return rows


def build_matrix(rows: list[dict], workflow: str, catalog: str) -> tuple[list[dict], dict]:
    keyed = {r["id"]: r for r in rows}
    assert len(keyed) == len(rows), "duplicate contract IDs"
    assert all(x["symbols"] and all(x["symbols"]) for x in rows)
    # Keep the historical F07 catalog separate from reviewed new vendor owners.
    post_begin = "<!-- POST_F07_MAINTAINED_OWNER_START -->"
    post_end = "<!-- POST_F07_MAINTAINED_OWNER_END -->"
    assert catalog.count(post_begin) == catalog.count(post_end) == 1
    old_catalog = catalog.split("<!-- ACTIVE_SOURCE_CATALOG_START -->")[1].split(
        "<!-- ACTIVE_SOURCE_CATALOG_END -->")[0]
    new_catalog = catalog.split(post_begin)[1].split(post_end)[0]
    post_source_ids = {r["id"] for r in rows if r["id"] in {
        "U90", "U91", "U92", "U93", "U94", "U95", "U96"}}
    assert len(post_source_ids) == 7, "lost post-F07 owner audit IDs"
    accounted = 0
    for row in rows:
        assert all(p in keyed and p != row["id"] for p in row["prerequisites"]), row["id"]
        evidence_file = ROOT / row["evidence"]
        source_file = ROOT / row["path"]
        assert evidence_file.is_file(), (row["id"], "missing evidence")
        assert source_file.is_file(), (row["id"], "missing source")
        # Do not trust the symbol list without rechecking the original source.
        text = source_file.read_text()
        for symbol in row["symbols"]:
            assert symbol in text, (row["id"], row["path"], symbol)
        path = row["path"]
        if path.startswith("vendor/encore-active/"):
            rel = path.removeprefix("vendor/encore-active/")
            signature = "| `" + rel + "` |"
            if row["id"] in post_source_ids:
                assert signature in new_catalog, (
                    row["id"], "missing supplemental post-F07 vendor owner", rel)
                assert signature not in old_catalog, (
                    row["id"], "post-F07 native owner mixed into frozen F07", rel)
            else:
                assert signature in old_catalog, (
                    row["id"], "missing historical active catalogue owner", rel)
            owner = "encore-active"
        elif path.startswith("vendor/sources/"):
            owner = "pinned-reference"
        elif path.startswith("headless/"):
            owner = "app-or-native-integration"
        else:
            owner = "docs-or-tools"
        script = row["evidence"].endswith(".py")
        direct = script and ("python3 -B " + row["evidence"]) in workflow
        if row["status"] == "HOST":
            # A passed specific host witness does NOT establish native results.
            assert script and direct, (row["id"], "host proof not in CI")
        row["owner_class"] = owner
        row["evidence_kind"] = ("python-in-preflight" if direct else
                                "python-not-directly-in-preflight" if script else
                                "reference-not-executable")
        row["proof_level"] = STATES[row["status"]]
        row["native_game_validation"] = False
        row["measured_frametime_improvement"] = False
        row["needs_runtime_evidence"] = row["status"] in {"HOST", "SOURCE", "OPEN"}
        row["qualification_blocked"] = row["status"] == "PARKED"
        accounted += 1
    assert accounted == len(rows)
    # Verify any dependency chain leading from a P0 contract to a suspended
    # experimental unit; those cannot be silently marked production-ready.
    def transitive_deps(ident: str, visited: set[str] | None = None) -> set[str]:
        if visited is None:
            visited = set()
        for dep in keyed[ident]["prerequisites"]:
            if dep not in visited:
                visited.add(dep)
                transitive_deps(dep, visited)
        return visited
    for row in rows:
        blocked = sorted(d for d in transitive_deps(row["id"])
                         if keyed[d]["status"] == "PARKED")
        row["parked_prerequisites"] = blocked
        # Expose blocked P0 dependencies without silently authorizing experiments.


    statuses = Counter(r["status"] for r in rows)
    pending_rows = [r for r in rows if r["status"] in {"SOURCE", "OPEN"}]
    priorities = Counter(r["priority"] for r in rows)
    lane_counts: dict[str, dict] = {}
    for row in rows:
        lane = row["lane"]
        if lane not in lane_counts:
            lane_counts[lane] = {"total": 0, "host": 0, "open": 0,
                                 "pending_p0": 0, "pending": 0}
        lane_counts[lane]["total"] += 1
        lane_counts[lane]["host"] += row["status"] == "HOST"
        lane_counts[lane]["open"] += row["status"] == "OPEN"
        lane_counts[lane]["pending"] += row["status"] in {"SOURCE", "OPEN"}
        lane_counts[lane]["pending_p0"] += (
            row["priority"] == "P0" and row["status"] in {"SOURCE", "OPEN"})
    direct = sum(r["evidence_kind"] == "python-in-preflight" for r in rows)
    indirect = [r for r in rows
                if r["evidence_kind"] == "python-not-directly-in-preflight"]
    undirect = sorted(set(r["evidence"] for r in indirect))
    assert sum(statuses.values()) == len(rows)
    # Each new HOST claim needs a precise in-CI proof and native-limit statement.
    assert statuses["HOST"] == 62, "HOST claims changed: review evidence before modifying guard"
    ownership_closures = set(["B06","B07","B08","B09","B10","B12","B13","B15","B17","B18","B19","B20"])
    for row in rows:
        if row["id"] not in ownership_closures:
            continue
        assert row["status"] == "HOST" and row["priority"] == "P1", row["id"]
        assert row["evidence_kind"] == "python-in-preflight", row["id"]
        assert "Hôte:" in row["acceptance"] and "PS5" in row["acceptance"], row["id"]
    assert len(ownership_closures) == 12
    multirange = keyed["V20"]
    assert multirange["status"] == "HOST" and multirange["priority"] == "P0"
    assert multirange["evidence"] == "tools/check-vulkan-multirange-owner-lifetime-host.py"
    assert multirange["evidence_kind"] == "python-in-preflight"
    assert "Hôte:" in multirange["acceptance"] and "PS5" in multirange["acceptance"]
    for ident, proof in {
        "V17": "tools/check-ps5-descriptor-conditional-reuse-host.py",
        "V33": "tools/check-ps5-compute-descriptor-ring-preflight-host.py",
    }.items():
        item = keyed[ident]
        assert item["status"] == "HOST" and item["priority"] == "P0"
        assert item["evidence"] == proof and item["evidence_kind"] == "python-in-preflight"
        assert "Hôte:" in item["acceptance"] and "PS5" in item["acceptance"]
    striped = keyed["V40"]
    assert striped["status"] == "HOST" and striped["priority"] == "P0"
    assert striped["evidence"] == "tools/check-native-vulkan-striped-wait-host.py"
    assert striped["evidence_kind"] == "python-in-preflight"
    assert "Hôte:" in striped["acceptance"] and "PS5" in striped["acceptance"]
    broadcast = keyed["J16"]
    assert broadcast["status"] == "HOST" and broadcast["priority"] == "P0"
    assert broadcast["evidence"] == "tools/check-native-jit-icache-broadcast-host.py"
    assert broadcast["evidence_kind"] == "python-in-preflight"
    assert "Hôte:" in broadcast["acceptance"] and "PS5" in broadcast["acceptance"]
    for name in ("J19", "J20"):
        claim = keyed[name]
        assert claim["status"] == "HOST" and claim["priority"] == "P0"
        assert claim["evidence"] == "tools/check-native-dynarmic-icache-range-host.py"
        assert claim["evidence_kind"] == "python-in-preflight"
        assert "Hôte:" in claim["acceptance"] and "PS5" in claim["acceptance"]
    sparse_retirement = keyed["J34"]
    assert sparse_retirement["status"] == "HOST" and sparse_retirement["priority"] == "P0"
    assert sparse_retirement["evidence"] == "tools/check-sparse-slot-reuse-host.py"
    assert sparse_retirement["evidence_kind"] == "python-in-preflight"
    assert "Hôte:" in sparse_retirement["acceptance"] and "PS5" in sparse_retirement["acceptance"]
    sparse_plan = keyed["J05"]
    assert sparse_plan["status"] == "HOST" and sparse_plan["priority"] == "P1"
    assert sparse_plan["evidence"] == "tools/check-jit-sparse-host.py"
    assert sparse_plan["evidence_kind"] == "python-in-preflight"
    assert "Hôte:" in sparse_plan["acceptance"] and "PS5" in sparse_plan["acceptance"]
    native_worker = keyed["V01"]
    assert native_worker["status"] == "HOST" and native_worker["priority"] == "P0"
    assert native_worker["evidence"] == "tools/check-vulkan-worker-fatal-drain-host.py"
    assert native_worker["evidence_kind"] == "python-in-preflight"
    assert "Hôte:" in native_worker["acceptance"] and "PS5" in native_worker["acceptance"]
    # Newly qualified P0 properties are source-linked host witnesses only.
    # They do not certify device progress, guest liveness or FPS.
    for ident, (expected, priority) in {
        "M08": ("tools/check-native-device-span-bounds-host.py", "P0"),
        "V77": ("tools/check-ps5-buffer-pages-r437.py", "P0"),
        "Q02": ("tools/check-native-gpu-queue-stop-fastpath-host.py", "P1"),

        entry = keyed[ident]

def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--json", action="store_true",
                        help="emit all contracts and their individual proof state")

    matrix, stats = build_matrix(rows, WORKFLOW.read_text(), CATALOG.read_text())

              f"contracts={stats['contracts']}",

              f"p0_pending={stats['pending_p0']}",
```

`tools/check-eden-backport-patch-integrity-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Reject malformed Eden patch hunks and stale shipping receipts before long CI."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PATCHES = ROOT / "headless/backports"
PATTERN = re.compile(r"^@@ -\d+(?:,(\d+))? \+\d+(?:,(\d+))? @@")


def check_hunks(text, name):
    old = new = expected_old = expected_new = 0
    active = False
    num = 0

    def flush():
        if active and (old != expected_old or new != expected_new):
            raise AssertionError(f"{name}: corrupt hunk #{num}: "
                                 f"old={old}/{expected_old} new={new}/{expected_new}")

    for line in text.splitlines():
        m = PATTERN.match(line)
        if m:
            flush()
            expected_old = int(m[1]) if m[1] is not None else 1
            expected_new = int(m[2]) if m[2] is not None else 1
            old = new = 0
            active = True
            num += 1
        elif line.startswith(("--- ", "+++ ", "diff --git ", "index ")):
            flush()
            active = False
        elif active:
            if line.startswith(" "):
                old += 1
                new += 1
            elif line.startswith("-"):
                old += 1
            elif line.startswith("+"):
                new += 1
            elif not line.startswith("\\ No newline at end of file"):
                raise AssertionError(f"{name}: unexpected hunk line {line!r}")
    flush()
    assert num != 0, f"{name}: no hunks"
    return num


def main():
    fixture = "--- a/x\n+++ b/x\n@@ -1 +1,2 @@\n keep\n+added\n"
    assert check_hunks(fixture, "valid") == 1
    try:
        check_hunks(fixture.replace("+1,2", "+1,3"), "broken")
    except AssertionError:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError("broken patch must fail")
    patches = sorted(PATCHES.glob("*.patch"))
    assert len(patches) >= 50
    hunk_total = sum(check_hunks(p.read_text(), p.name) for p in patches)
    script = (ROOT / "tools/apply-eden-backports.sh").read_text()
    calls = dict(re.findall(
        r'apply_one "\$root/headless/backports/([^"]+)" "\$eden/([^"]+)"',
        script))
    manifest = json.loads(
        (ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/eden-backports/manifest.json").read_text())
    receipts = manifest["shipping_receipts"]
    shipping = {p: name for p, name in calls.items() if name in receipts}
    assert len(receipts) >= 45
    assert set(shipping.values()) == set(receipts)
    for patch, receipt in shipping.items():
        assert hashlib.sha256((PATCHES / patch).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == receipts[receipt], (
            f"{patch}: audited SHA256 receipt mismatch")
    print(f"EDEN_BACKPORT_PATCH_INTEGRITY_PASS patches={len(patches)} "
          f"hunks={hunk_total} receipts={len(shipping)}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Count Encore-owned files not yet handled in the optimization work pass.

Fast-skip previously maintained sources with a specific historical proof, but
never confuse code triage with host or console performance validation.
"""
import json
import hashlib
import subprocess
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
import re

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
P=ROOT/"docs/EDEN_OPTIMIZATION_COVERAGE_2026-10-20.json"
STATE=json.loads(P.read_text())
assert STATE["schema_version"]==1
tracked=set(subprocess.check_output(["git","ls-files","-z"],cwd=ROOT).decode().split("\0"))-{""}
# When vendor is moved to an immutable gitlink, the parent index lists only
# "vendor". Preserve the original vendor/… owner namespace by merging the
# pinned submodule index; never infer source ownership from arbitrary disk files.
if "vendor" in tracked:
    vendor_paths = subprocess.check_output(
        ["git", "-C", "vendor", "ls-files", "-z"], cwd=ROOT
    ).decode().split("\0")
    tracked.update("vendor/" + p for p in vendor_paths if p)

suffixes={".c",".cpp",".cxx",".cc",".h",".hpp",".inc"}
all_owners={p for p in tracked
        if p.startswith(("headless/","src/","vendor/encore-active/"))
        and Path(p).suffix in suffixes}
# Three unmodified upstream dependencies live under vendor/sources/.
# Their snapshots must never be categorized as F07 owners or hidden as
# Encore active overrides. Keep the immutable 518 historical source total.
pinned_upstream_f07_counts = {
    "ps5-mihawkgen": 474,
    "ps5-fsr3-optical-flow": 41,
    "libwebp": 245,
}
for name, expected in pinned_upstream_f07_counts.items():
    prefix = f"vendor/sources/{name}/"
    files = {p for p in tracked
             if p.startswith(prefix) and Path(p).suffix in suffixes}
    assert len(files) == expected, ("Upstream snapshot drift", name, len(files), expected)
for stale in ("PS5_MihawkGen", "PS5_FSR3OpticalFlow", "libwebp"):
    assert not any(p.startswith(f"vendor/encore-active/{stale}/")
                   for p in tracked), stale
print("ENCORE_PINNED_UPSTREAM_F07_ISOLATION_PASS",
      f"upstream_sources={sum(pinned_upstream_f07_counts.values())}",
      "trees=3 historical_f07_unchanged=1")
# NS2 is an explicitly unqualified research layer, not historical F07 review.
# Do not silently count new research source code as already optimized.
research = json.loads((ROOT/"docs/NS2_RESEARCH_ADDED_SOURCE_OWNERS.json").read_text())
research_owners={"vendor/encore-active/"+p for p in research["paths"]}
assert research["schema_version"] == 1 and len(research_owners) == 120
retired_am = {
    "vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/am/core/hle/service/am/service/application_proxy.cpp",
    "vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/am/core/hle/service/am/service/application_proxy.h",
    "vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/am/core/hle/service/am/service/graphics_scaling_parameters_functions.cpp",
    "vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/am/core/hle/service/am/service/graphics_scaling_parameters_functions.h",
}
assert not retired_am & all_owners, "Retired AM false-success owners were reintroduced"
assert not retired_am & research_owners, "Research inventory retained removed AM stubs"
assert research_owners <= all_owners, sorted(research_owners-all_owners)
# The two new shared warning-hygiene headers have a separate exact-source
# verifier and installer. They are not retroactive F07 optimization reviews.
hygiene_owners = {
    "vendor/encore-active/eden-header-hygiene/include/common/page_table.h",
    "vendor/encore-active/eden-header-hygiene/include/video_core/macro.h",
}
assert hygiene_owners <= all_owners, sorted(hygiene_owners - all_owners)
assert "tools/install-eden-header-hygiene.py" in tracked
# The four mainline extracted AOC owners are explicitly reviewed in the
# post-snapshot F07 source ledger. Do not silently drop their proof entries
# or misclassify them as opt-in NS2 experiments.
extracted_aoc_owners = {
    "vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/core/file_sys/extracted_aoc.h",
    "vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/core/file_sys/extracted_aoc_paths.h",
    "vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/core/file_sys/romfs_factory.cpp",
    "vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/core/hle/service/aoc/addon_content_manager.cpp",
}
```

```py
#include "pe/ui/case_media_selection.hpp"
int main() {
    using namespace pe::ui::case_media;
    // Cold async media is given four seconds; a provisional GPU page
    // refreshes ONLY when every known texture is actually ready.
    assert(!PageInputReady(false, false, 3.99f));
    assert(PageInputReady(false, false, 4.0f));
    assert(PageInputReady(false, true, 0.1f));
    assert(!PageInputReady(true, false, 50.0f));
    assert(PageInputReady(true, true, 4.2f));
    const std::string hero = "hero.tga";
    const std::string icon = "icon.tga";
    const std::vector<std::string> shots{
        "hero.tga", "hero.tga", "scene-2.tga", "scene-2.tga", "scene-3.tga"
    };
    const auto* front = FrontAlternate(hero, icon, shots);
    assert(front != nullptr && *front == "scene-2.tga");
    const auto pair = BackScenes(hero, icon, shots);
    assert(pair[0] && *pair[0] == "scene-2.tga");
    assert(pair[1] && *pair[1] == "scene-3.tga");

    const auto categorized = BackScenes(hero, icon, indexed);
    assert(categorized[0] && *categorized[0] == indexed[3]);
    assert(categorized[1] && *categorized[1] == indexed[2]);
    assert(categorized[2] && *categorized[2] == indexed[1]);
    // Bad marker roles stay excluded from the Nlib fallback; only real
    // numbered LaunchBox categories may claim a reserved rear slot.
    const std::vector<std::string> role_noise{
        "/cache/box-scene-9-BAD.tga", "/cache/box-scene-1-OK.tga",
        "/cache/box-scene-1-OTHER.tga", "/cache/box-scene-3-YES.tga"};

        [&](const std::string&) { ++decode_checks; return true; });
    assert(role_pick[0] == &role_noise[1] && !role_pick[1]);
    assert(role_pick[2] == &role_noise[3]);
    assert(decode_checks == 3);
    // Hot path: hundreds of Nlib screenshots plus a late official scene.
    // A full-second scan of all candidates on every draw is unnecessary:
    // retain only the first three distinct usable fallbacks, while a late
    // indexed category must still take its canonical slot.
    std::vector<std::string> large_scene_set{
        "nlib/first.tga", "nlib/first.tga", "nlib/second.tga",
        "nlib/third.tga"};

    large_scene_set.push_back("/cache/box-scene-2-LATE.tga");
    unsigned large_checks = 0;
    const auto large_pick = BackScenes(hero, icon, large_scene_set,
        [&](const std::string&) { ++large_checks; return true; });

    assert(large_pick[1] == &large_scene_set.back());
    assert(large_pick[2] == &large_scene_set[2]);
    assert(large_checks <= 6); // one front + three fallbacks + one indexed
    const std::vector<std::string> missing_fanart{
        "/cache/box-scene-2-ABCD.tga", "/cache/box-scene-3-ABCD.tga"};
    const auto role_stable = BackScenes(hero, icon, missing_fanart);
    assert(!role_stable[0]);
    assert(role_stable[1] && *role_stable[1] == missing_fanart[0]);
    assert(role_stable[2] && *role_stable[2] == missing_fanart[1]);
    const std::vector<std::string> nlib_fallback{
        "/cache/box-scene-2-ABCD.tga", "nlib/independent-scene.tga"};
    const auto filled = BackScenes(hero, icon, nlib_fallback);
    assert(filled[0] && *filled[0] == nlib_fallback[1]);
    assert(filled[1] && *filled[1] == nlib_fallback[0]);
    assert(!filled[2]);

    // Only independent screenshot sources may appear on the back.
    // Never insert an app icon as a synthetic second picture.
    const std::vector<std::string> only_hero{"hero.tga", "extra.tga"};
    const auto one = BackScenes(hero, icon, only_hero);
    assert(one[0] && *one[0] == "extra.tga");
    assert(!one[1]);
    assert(FrontAlternate(hero, icon, {"hero.tga", "hero.tga"}) == &icon);

    // A missing icon does not get a fabricated second screenshot.
    const std::string empty;
    const auto alone = BackScenes(hero, empty, only_hero);
    assert(alone[0] && *alone[0] == "extra.tga" && !alone[1]);
    const auto no_media = BackScenes(empty, empty, {});
    assert(!no_media[0] && !no_media[1]);

    // Missing Hero: the first cached screenshot becomes the actual front.
    // It must not reappear on the back under another scene slot.
    const std::vector<std::string> fallback_front{
        "first-front.tga", "back-one.tga", "back-two.tga"};
    const auto no_hero_back = BackScenes(empty, icon, fallback_front);
    assert(no_hero_back[0] == &fallback_front[1]);
    assert(no_hero_back[1] == &fallback_front[2]);
    assert(!no_hero_back[2]);
    const std::vector<std::string> indexed_front{
        "/cache/box-scene-1-FIRST.tga", "/cache/box-scene-2-SECOND.tga"};
    const auto indexed_no_hero = BackScenes(empty, icon, indexed_front);
    assert(!indexed_no_hero[0]);
    assert(indexed_no_hero[1] == &indexed_front[1]);
    assert(!indexed_no_hero[2]);
    const auto only_front = BackScenes(empty, icon, {"only-front.tga"});
    assert(!only_front[0] && !only_front[1] && !only_front[2]);
    // A valid Hero filename can still fail decoding. The actual front
    // falls back to another cached scene, which the back must exclude.
    const std::vector<std::string> failed_hero{
        "failed-hero.tga", "decoded-front.tga", "rear-only.tga"};
    const auto active_front = FrontPaperAvailable(
        failed_hero[0], icon, failed_hero,
        [](const std::string& path) { return path != "failed-hero.tga"; });
    assert(active_front == &failed_hero[1]);
    const auto actual_back = BackScenes(*active_front, icon, failed_hero);
    assert(actual_back[0] == &failed_hero[0]); // source still present but unavailable
    assert(actual_back[1] == &failed_hero[2]);
    assert(*actual_back[1] != *active_front);
    const auto filtered_back = BackScenes(
        *active_front, icon, failed_hero,
        [](const std::string& path) { return path != "failed-hero.tga"; });
    assert(filtered_back[0] == &failed_hero[2]);
    assert(!filtered_back[1] && !filtered_back[2]);
    // A caller may give the ORIGINAL hero filename rather than the
    // resolved front. When its decode fails, the back must still exclude
    // the actual fallback front, not duplicate it as an independent scene.
    const auto direct_fallback_back = BackScenes(
        failed_hero[0], icon, failed_hero,
        [](const std::string& path) { return path != "failed-hero.tga"; });
    assert(direct_fallback_back == filtered_back);
    const std::vector<std::string> no_hero_failed_first{
        "unavailable-front.tga", "actual-front.tga", "rear-shot.tga"};
    const auto clean_back = BackScenes(
        empty, icon, no_hero_failed_first,
        [](const std::string& path) { return path != "unavailable-front.tga"; });
    assert(clean_back[0] == &no_hero_failed_first[2]);
    assert(!clean_back[1] && !clean_back[2]);
    const std::vector<std::string> indexed_failed{
        "/cache/box-scene-1-BAD.tga", "/cache/box-scene-2-OK.tga"};
    const auto filtered_indexed = BackScenes(
        empty, icon, indexed_failed,
        [](const std::string& path) { return path.find("-BAD.") == std::string::npos; });
    // With no hero, the valid indexed title capture becomes the ACTUAL
    // front after the fanart decode fails. It must not be duplicated on
    // the back, even though its original indexed role was category 2.
    assert(!filtered_indexed[0] && !filtered_indexed[1] && !filtered_indexed[2]);
    // With a valid hero front, that same title capture remains eligible
    // for its reserved rear category: genuine source roles are retained.
    const auto indexed_with_hero = BackScenes(
        hero, icon, indexed_failed,
        [](const std::string& path) { return path.find("-BAD.") == std::string::npos; });
    assert(!indexed_with_hero[0] && indexed_with_hero[1] == &indexed_failed[1]);
    assert(!indexed_with_hero[2]);
    assert(FrontAlternate(hero, empty, {"hero.tga"}) == nullptr);

    // When a game only has a front icon/poster, the back stays plain ink.
    const auto only_icon = BackScenes(hero, icon, {});
    assert(!only_icon[0] && !only_icon[1]);
    assert(*FrontPaper(hero, icon, shots) == hero);
    assert(*FrontPaper(empty, icon, shots) == "hero.tga");
    assert(*FrontPaper(empty, icon, {}) == icon);
    assert(FrontPaper(empty, empty, {}) == nullptr);
    // Hero fails: use a distinct cached screenshot; preserve pending Hero
    // priority and last-resort icon. Never invent a new image.
    const auto usable = [](const std::string& path) {
        return path != "hero.tga" && path != "scene-2.tga";
    };
    assert(FrontPaperAvailable(hero, icon, shots, usable) == &shots[4]);
    assert(FrontPaperAvailable(
        hero, icon, shots, [](const std::string&) { return true; }) == &hero);
    assert(FrontPaperAvailable(
        hero, icon, shots, [&](const std::string& path) { return path == icon; }) == &icon);
    assert(FrontPaperAvailable(
        hero, icon, shots, [](const std::string&) { return false; }) == nullptr);
    // BackScenes returns pointers into the caller-owned vector. A temporary
    // vector would be destroyed before the assertions and cause undefined behavior.
    const std::vector<std::string> cover_sources{"icon.tga", "scene.tga"};
    const auto excluded_cover = BackScenes(hero, icon, cover_sources);
    assert(excluded_cover[0] && *excluded_cover[0] == "scene.tga");
    assert(!excluded_cover[1]);

    // All results point into existing metadata, no allocations or copies.
    assert(front == &shots[2]);
    assert(pair[0] == &shots[2] && pair[1] == &shots[4]);
}
"""
compilers = list(dict.fromkeys(filter(None,
    (shutil.which("clang++"), shutil.which("g++"), shutil.which("c++")))))
assert compilers, "Host C++ compiler required"
# Apple CLT 27.0 has an arm64e.x1 SDK stub rejected by the installed
# linker. Prefer a compatible SDK for this *host witness* when available.
# Respect an explicitly selected SDKROOT and never change the PS5 build.
compiler_env = os.environ.copy()
if sys.platform == "darwin" and not compiler_env.get("SDKROOT"):
    supported_sdk = Path("/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX15.4.sdk")
    if supported_sdk.is_dir():
        compiler_env["SDKROOT"] = str(supported_sdk)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-case-media-") as temp:
    cpp = Path(temp) / "case-media.cpp"
    cpp.write_text(source)
    for compiler in compilers:
        for opt in ("-O0", "-O2"):
            exe = Path(temp) / (Path(compiler).name + opt)
            built = subprocess.run(
                [compiler, "-std=c++20", opt, "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror",
                 "-fsanitize=undefined", "-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
                 "-I", str(root / "headless/prosperoeden"), str(cpp), "-o", str(exe)],
                capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=50, env=compiler_env

            assert built.returncode == 0, (compiler, opt, built.stderr[-4000:])
            result = subprocess.run(
                [str(exe)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15
            )
            assert result.returncode == 0, (compiler, opt, result.stderr[-4000:])
            print("ENCORE_CASE_MEDIA_DEDUP_PASS", Path(compiler).name, opt)
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Prevent native revision regressions after long non-numbered commit streaks."""
from pathlib import Path
import runpy

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
script = (root / "tools/ci/derive-encore-build-label.py").read_text()
workflow = (root / ".github/workflows/build-040-zbic.yml").read_text()

assert '["git", "-C", str(ROOT), "log", "--first-parent", "--format=%s"]' in script
assert '"-n", "256"' not in script
assert "fetch-depth: 0" in workflow
assert "fetch-depth: 256" not in workflow

derive = runpy.run_path(str(root / "tools/ci/derive-encore-build-label.py"))
build_label = derive["build_label"]
long_subjects = ["ci: routine source maintenance"] * 600
long_subjects += ["R458: final matched source revision", "R455: prior revision"]
assert build_label("\n".join(long_subjects)) == "R458"
assert build_label("R471: updated\nR460: older\nR469: another") == "R471"
try:
    build_label("ci: no revision in this source tree")
except ValueError as exc:
    assert "No numbered R revision" in str(exc)
else:
    raise AssertionError("Revision failure must not silently fall back to stale data")
print("FIRST_PARENT_HISTORY_LABEL_PASS fixture=600+ old_rev=458")
```

`tools/check-english-regional-variants.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Fast no-build gate for separate PS5 English US and UK launcher catalogs."""
from pathlib import Path
import re
import runpy

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
language_dir = root / "headless/prosperoeden/ui/lang"
module = runpy.run_path(str(root / "tools/launcher/strings.py"))
parse_po = module["parse_po"]
template = parse_po(root / "tools/launcher/launcher.pot")
us = parse_po(language_dir / "en-US.po")
uk = parse_po(language_dir / "en-GB.po")
expected = set(template) | set(module["DYNAMIC_LIBRARY_GENRES"])
assert len(list(language_dir.glob("*.po"))) == 31, "All 31 official PS5 catalogs are required"
assert len(template) == 566 and len(expected) == 596, "Launcher template or runtime genres are incomplete"
assert set(us) == set(uk) == expected, "English variants have missing or stale msgids"
assert all(us[key] and uk[key] for key in expected), "Empty English translation"
assert all(uk[key] == us[key].replace("Color", "Colour").replace("Customize", "Customise")
           for key in expected), "UK catalog drifted from deliberate regional spelling differences"
regional = {key for key in expected if us[key] != uk[key]}
assert len(regional) >= 10 and uk["Customize"] == "Customise"
assert uk["Color 1 blue"] == "Colour 1 blue"
assert us["Intensité DLSS-NR"] == "DLSS-NR intensity", "Inherited French text not localized to English"
french_source = [key for key in template if re.search("[àâéèêîôùûç]", key, re.I)]
assert french_source and all(not re.search("[àâéèêîôùûç]", us[key], re.I)
                             for key in french_source), "Untranslated legacy French UI source keys"
core = (root / "headless/prosperoeden/pe/core/strings.cpp").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
assert 'return {"en-US"};' in core and 'return {"en-GB", "en-US"};' in core, (
    "Runtime must load the appropriate regional catalog")
print(f"ENGLISH_VARIANTS_PASS catalog_count=31 active={len(template)} "
      f"runtime_categories={len(expected)-len(template)} regional_differences={len(regional)}")

```

`tools/check-exclusive-monitor.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Exercise actual Dynarmic monitor operations with the PS5 lock derivative."""
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
cache = Path((root / '.local/headless-cache').read_text().strip())
dynarmic = cache / 'source/src/dynarmic/src'
monitor = (dynarmic / 'dynarmic/backend/x64/exclusive_monitor.cpp').read_text()
# This implementation includes, but does not use, the application logger/asserts.
monitor = monitor.replace('#include "common/assert.h"', '')
# The historical include fragment was retired when the full native unit
# became its maintained owner. Exercise its actual compiler-atomic methods.
lock_unit = (root / 'vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/dynarmic/common/spin_lock_x64.cpp').read_text()
lock_start = '// PS5 x64: retain the storage ABI'
lock_end = '\n} // namespace Dynarmic'
assert lock_unit.count(lock_start) == lock_unit.count(lock_end) == 1
lock = lock_unit[lock_unit.index(lock_start):lock_unit.index(lock_end)]
source = r'''
#include <cassert>
#include <chrono>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>
#include <barrier>
#include "dynarmic/interface/exclusive_monitor.h"
extern "C" int sceKernelUsleep(unsigned int microseconds) {
    std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::microseconds(microseconds));
    return 0;
}
namespace Dynarmic {
LOCK
}
MONITOR
int main() {
    Dynarmic::ExclusiveMonitor monitor(4);
    unsigned value = 0;
    auto read = [&](unsigned core) { return monitor.ReadAndMark<unsigned>(core, 0x1000, [&] { return value; }); };
    auto increment = [&](unsigned core) { return monitor.DoExclusiveOperation<unsigned>(core, 0x1000, [&](unsigned expected) {
        if (value != expected) return false;
        ++value;
        return true;
    }); };
    read(0); read(1);
    assert(increment(0) && !increment(1)); // One write invalidates peer reservation.
    read(0); monitor.ClearProcessor(0); assert(!increment(0));
    read(0); read(1); monitor.Clear(); assert(!increment(0) && !increment(1));
    read(0);
    assert(!monitor.DoExclusiveOperation<unsigned>(0, 0x2000, [](unsigned) { assert(false); return true; }));
    monitor.Clear(); value = 0;
    constexpr unsigned workers = 4, iterations = 50000;
    std::barrier ready(workers);
    std::vector<std::jthread> threads;
    for (unsigned core = 0; core < workers; ++core) threads.emplace_back([&, core] {
        ready.arrive_and_wait();
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < iterations; ++i) {
            do { read(core); } while (!increment(core));
        }
    });
    threads.clear();
    assert(value == workers * iterations);
}
'''.replace('LOCK', lock).replace('MONITOR', monitor)
boost = cache / 'source/.cache/cpm/boost/boost-1.90.0'
includes = ['-I' + str(dynarmic)] + ['-I' + str(p) for p in sorted(boost.glob('libs/*/include'))]
assert len(includes) > 1
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='eden-monitor-') as tmp:
    cpp = Path(tmp) / 'check.cpp'
    binary = Path(tmp) / 'check'
    cpp.write_text(source)
    compile_command = ['clang++-18', '-std=c++20', '-O3', '-flto=thin', '-fuse-ld=lld-18',
                       '-pthread', '-Wall', '-Wextra', '-Werror']
    # Dynarmic's x64 monitor contains x86 pause instructions. On Apple Silicon,
    # build the host semantics harness as a real x86_64 macOS binary and run it
    # through Rosetta; compiling it as arm64 would reject __builtin_ia32_pause.
    if sys.platform == 'darwin' and platform.machine() == 'arm64':
        preferred_sdk = Path('/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX26.sdk')
        sdk = (str(preferred_sdk) if preferred_sdk.is_dir() else
               subprocess.check_output(['xcrun', '--sdk', 'macosx', '--show-sdk-path'], text=True).strip())
        compile_command = ['/usr/bin/clang++', '-arch', 'x86_64', '-isysroot', sdk,
                           '-std=c++20', '-O3', '-pthread', '-Wall', '-Wextra', '-Werror']
    subprocess.run([*compile_command, *includes, str(cpp), '-o', str(binary)], check=True)
    subprocess.run([str(binary)], check=True, timeout=20)
native = cache / 'native-local/bin/eden-headless'
llvm18 = Path('/opt/homebrew/opt/llvm@18/bin')
def llvm_tool(name):
    found = shutil.which(name + '-18') or shutil.which(name)
    if found:
        return found
    candidate = llvm18 / name
    assert candidate.is_file(), f'missing LLVM tool: {name}'
    return str(candidate)

llvm_nm = llvm_tool('llvm-nm')
llvm_objdump = llvm_tool('llvm-objdump')
llvm_readobj = llvm_tool('llvm-readobj')
symbols = subprocess.check_output([llvm_nm, '--defined-only', str(native)], text=True)
outlined = '_ZN8Dynarmic8SpinLock4LockEv' in symbols
names = ('_ZN8Dynarmic8SpinLock4LockEv,_ZN8Dynarmic8SpinLock6UnlockEv' if outlined
         else '_ZN8Dynarmic16ExclusiveMonitor14ClearProcessorEm')
assembly = subprocess.check_output([llvm_objdump,
    '--disassemble-symbols=' + names,
    str(native)], text=True)
for name in names.split(','):
    assert '<' + name + '>:' in assembly
# The bounded slow path deliberately sleeps so a critical-priority waiter cannot starve a
# preempted owner. It is the only runtime call permitted in the lock implementation.
calls = [line for line in assembly.splitlines() if re.search(r'\bcallq?\b', line)]
assert calls, 'Native monitor lock lost its bounded backoff call'
# lld may render a GOT import as an indirect register call after ThinLTO. Prove
# that the register was loaded from the relocation slot for sceKernelUsleep.
direct_backoff = any('sceKernelUsleep' in line for line in calls)
if not direct_backoff:
    got_load = re.search(r'movq\s+[^#\n]+%r12\s+#\s+0x([0-9a-f]+)', assembly)
    assert got_load and any('callq\t*%r12' in line for line in calls), (
        'Native monitor backoff is neither a direct nor the expected GOT call: ' + repr(calls))
    relocations = subprocess.check_output([llvm_readobj, '--relocations', str(native)], text=True)
    slot = '0X' + got_load.group(1).upper()
    assert any(slot in line.upper() and 'SCEKERNELUSLEEP' in line.upper()
               for line in relocations.splitlines()), (
        'Native monitor GOT call does not resolve to sceKernelUsleep: ' + slot)
# A noexcept inlined ClearProcessor may carry Clang's exception-termination
# landing pad outside the lock path; it is not part of the backoff loop.
assert all('sceKernelUsleep' in line or '__clang_call_terminate' in line or '*%r12' in line
           for line in calls), 'Unexpected runtime call in native monitor lock: ' + repr(calls)
# ThinLTO may inline the lock in ClearProcessor and may lower the same seq_cst
# fence to a locked zero-OR on the stack instead of MFENCE.
full_fence = 'mfence' in assembly or re.search(r'\block\s*\n[^\n]*\borl\s+\$0x0,\s*-0x[0-9a-f]+\(%rsp\)', assembly)
minimum_exchanges = 3 if not outlined else 2
assert full_fence and 'pause' in assembly and assembly.count('xchgl') >= minimum_exchanges
print('Exclusive monitor: peer invalidation, clear, wrong address and 200000 contended increments PASS')
print('Native lock machine code: bounded sceKernelUsleep backoff, exchange acquisition/release and full fence PASS')
```

```py
           "updateable/game.xci");
    const auto only_aoc_root = root / "AOC";
    fs::create_directory(only_aoc_root);
    std::ofstream(only_aoc_root / "game.xci") << "addon";
    assert(Eden::FindNestedGamePackage(only_aoc_root).empty());
    // A packed base remains discoverable beyond the old 128-entry cutoff.
    // Scan order must never determine which title the launcher reports.
    const auto moderately_crowded = root / "Crowded Packages";
    fs::create_directory(moderately_crowded);
    for (int i = 0; i < 140; ++i)
        std::ofstream(moderately_crowded /
                      ("asset_" + std::to_string(i) + ".bin")) << "resource";
    std::ofstream(moderately_crowded / "base.xci") << "base";
    assert(Eden::FindNestedGamePackage(moderately_crowded) == "base.xci");
    // If the hard entry cap is reached, refuse an incomplete candidate
    // list instead of hiding another possible base or update.
    // An update/DLC provider must not lose a real add-on merely because
    // the parent has more than the old 128 directory entries.
    const auto crowded_addons = root / "Crowded DLC";
    fs::create_directories(crowded_addons / "custom");
    for (int i = 0; i < 150; ++i)
        std::ofstream(crowded_addons /
                      ("other_" + std::to_string(i) + ".bin")) << "asset";
    std::ofstream(crowded_addons / "base.xci") << "base";
    std::ofstream(crowded_addons / "custom" / "bonus.nsz") << "dlc";
    assert(Eden::FindGameFolderInput(crowded_addons) == "base.xci");
    const auto crowded_roots = Eden::FindAddOnContentDirectories(crowded_addons);
    assert(crowded_roots.size() == 1 &&
           crowded_roots[0] == crowded_addons / "custom");

    // Never register an arbitrary subset of DLC directories when one
    // oversized parent contains more entries than the safe scan budget.
    const auto incomplete_addons = root / "Incomplete Addons";
    fs::create_directories(incomplete_addons / "updates");
    std::ofstream(incomplete_addons / "updates" / "patch.nsp") << "update";
    for (int i = 0; i < 516; ++i)
        std::ofstream(incomplete_addons /
                      ("asset_" + std::to_string(i) + ".bin")) << "asset";
    assert(Eden::FindAddOnContentDirectories(incomplete_addons).empty());
    const auto incomplete_packages = root / "Incomplete Packages";
    fs::create_directory(incomplete_packages);
    for (int i = 0; i < 516; ++i)
        std::ofstream(incomplete_packages /
                      ("asset_" + std::to_string(i) + ".bin")) << "resource";
    std::ofstream(incomplete_packages / "base.xci") << "base";
    assert(Eden::FindNestedGamePackage(incomplete_packages).empty());
    // A shallow candidate cannot be accepted when an unexamined wrapper
    // branch exceeds the bounded recursive discovery depth.
    const auto hidden_deep = root / "Hidden Deep Package";
    fs::create_directories(hidden_deep / "a/b/c/d/e/f/g");
    std::ofstream(hidden_deep / "base.xci") << "base";
    std::ofstream(hidden_deep / "a/b/c/d/e/f/g/other.xci") << "other";
    assert(Eden::FindNestedGamePackage(hidden_deep).empty());
    // Any wrapper name works; content metadata will establish Update/AOC.
    const auto arbitrary = root / "Arbitrary Folders";
    fs::create_directories(arbitrary / "base");
    fs::create_directories(arbitrary / "custom" / "extensions");
    std::ofstream(arbitrary / "base" / "game.xci") << "base";
    std::ofstream(arbitrary / "custom" / "extensions" / "bonus.nsp") << "addon";
    assert(Eden::FindGameFolderInput(arbitrary) == "base/game.xci");
    addon_folders = Eden::FindAddOnContentDirectories(arbitrary);
    assert(addon_folders.size() == 1);
    assert(addon_folders.front() == arbitrary / "custom" / "extensions");
    // A single base package must not be mistaken for an add-on.
    addon_folders = Eden::FindAddOnContentDirectories(standalone);
    assert(addon_folders.empty());
    // A symlink to an external add-on must not be followed by discovery.
    fs::create_symlink(arbitrary / "custom" / "extensions" / "bonus.nsp",
                       arbitrary / "base" / "bonus.nsp");
    addon_folders = Eden::FindAddOnContentDirectories(arbitrary);
    assert(addon_folders.size() == 1);
    assert(addon_folders.front() == arbitrary / "custom" / "extensions");
    // Two possible add-ons in a nested directory select that directory
    // once, rather than registering duplicate or adjacent base inputs.
    std::ofstream(arbitrary / "custom" / "extensions" / "extra.xcz") << "addon2";
    addon_folders = Eden::FindAddOnContentDirectories(arbitrary);
    assert(addon_folders.size() == 1);
    assert(addon_folders.front() == arbitrary / "custom" / "extensions");
    assert(Eden::LooksLikeExtractedAocTitleId("010074a01bf13001"));
    assert(!Eden::LooksLikeExtractedAocTitleId("010074a01bf12001"));
    const auto custom_extracted = root / "Extracted Custom DLC";
    fs::create_directories(custom_extracted / "custom" / "extra" /
                           "010074a01bf13001" / "0" / "romfs");
    addon_folders = Eden::FindAddOnContentDirectories(custom_extracted);
    assert(addon_folders.size() == 1);
    assert(addon_folders.front() ==
           custom_extracted / "custom" / "extra" / "010074a01bf13001");
    const auto mixed_images = root / "Mixed Packages";
    fs::create_directory(mixed_images);
    std::ofstream(mixed_images / "my-game.xci") << "base";
    std::ofstream(mixed_images / "bonus.nsp") << "dlc";
    std::ofstream(mixed_images / "latest-patch.nsz") << "patch";
    assert(Eden::FindGameFolderInput(mixed_images) == "my-game.xci");
    addon_folders = Eden::FindAddOnContentDirectories(mixed_images);
    assert(addon_folders.size() == 1 && addon_folders.front() == mixed_images);
    std::ofstream(mixed_images / "another-game.xcz") << "other";
    assert(Eden::FindGameFolderInput(mixed_images).empty());
    const auto ambiguous = root / "Ambiguous";
    fs::create_directory(ambiguous);
    std::ofstream(ambiguous / "one.nsp") << "base?";
    std::ofstream(ambiguous / "two.nsp") << "base?";
    assert(Eden::FindGameFolderInput(ambiguous).empty());
    const auto linked_package = root / "Linked Package";
    fs::create_directory(linked_package);
    fs::create_symlink(standalone / "some-title.xci", linked_package / "base.xci");
    assert(Eden::FindNestedGamePackage(linked_package).empty());
    assert(!Eden::IsSafeNestedGameFilePath(root, "Linked Package/base.xci"));
    assert(Eden::FindDeconstructedGameMain(root / "updates").empty());
    assert(Eden::FindNestedGamePackage(root / "dlc").empty());
    fs::remove_all(root);
    std::puts("EXEFS_DIRECTORY_AND_SELECTION_PASS");
}
""".replace("VALIDATOR", actual_validator)

# Replay the exact directory-sizing and local cover fallback helpers extracted
# from the shipping launcher service, not a reimplementation of their logic.
def extract_owner(begin, end):
    assert library.count(begin) == 1, begin
    remainder = library.split(begin, 1)[1]
    assert end in remainder, end
    return begin + remainder.split(end, 1)[0]

sizing = extract_owner("std::optional<std::uint64_t> ExtractedBaseBytes(",
                       "\n// Local user-supplied covers")
covers = extract_owner("std::string ExtractedLocalCover(",
                       "\nstd::uint64_t ResolveTitleId(")
nacp = extract_owner("struct ExtractedSidecarMetadata {",
                     "\nstd::string ExtractedLocalCover(")

        .write(nacp_data.data(), static_cast<std::streamsize>(nacp_data.size()));

    assert(ExtractedLocalNacp(game, 0).name == "Mario Kart World");
```

```py
assert "amd_ext=%u x2apic=%u" in topology
# Documented AMD family17h EBX CoreId (same for two SMT siblings), ECX NodeId.
def amd_physical_core(ebx, ecx):
    threads_per_core = ((ebx >> 8) & 255) + 1
    if not 1 <= threads_per_core <= 8:
        return None
    return ((ecx & 255) << 8) | (ebx & 255)
assert amd_physical_core(0x0102, 0) == amd_physical_core(0x0102, 0)  # SMT siblings
assert amd_physical_core(0x0102, 0) != amd_physical_core(0x0103, 0)  # distinct cores
assert amd_physical_core(0x0102, 0) != amd_physical_core(0x0102, 1)  # distinct nodes
assert amd_physical_core(0xff00, 0) is None  # improbable threads/core: fail closed

assert 'EDEN_EXPERIMENT_PRESENT' in graphics
assert "vulkan_frame_probe.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)" in graphics
assert "experimental_pacing_bins" in graphics_h
present = graphics.split("void GraphicsWindow::OnFrameDisplayed()", 1)[1].split(
    "void GraphicsWindow::CheckPresentation(", 1)[0]
assert "std::this_thread::sleep" not in present

assert "0100C49025D3E000" in guide  # historical benchmark identifier only
assert "EDEN_SPARSE_JIT_DEV=ON" in guide and "EDEN_DEV_PROFILE" in guide
assert "**The unified test build requires no experimental options in Settings.**" in guide
assert "Safe Launch" in guide
print("PS5 universal A64/A32 JIT budget and dev-only trace controls: source contracts PASS")
```
