#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Source-extracted A32 window page bounds, including overflowing input spans."""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
source = (ROOT / "src/host_memory.cpp").read_text()
for constant in (
    "constexpr std::size_t GuestPage = 0x1000;",
    "constexpr std::size_t GuestPages = std::size_t{1} << 20;",
    "constexpr std::size_t WindowBytes = GuestPages * GuestPage;",
):
    assert constant in source, "requalify changed fastmem window dimensions"
begin = "    static bool Pages("
end = "\n    bool Aliasable("
assert source.count(begin) == source.count(end) == 1
method = begin + source.split(begin, 1)[1].split(end, 1)[0]
fixed = "last = (offset + std::min(length, WindowBytes - offset) - 1) / GuestPage;"
old = "last = (std::min(offset + length, WindowBytes) - 1) / GuestPage;"
assert method.count(fixed) == 1 and old not in method
baseline = method.replace(fixed, old)
cmake = (ROOT / "headless/CMakeLists.txt").read_text()
assert '"${PORT_ROOT}/src/host_memory.cpp"' in cmake
for name in ("Map", "Unmap", "Protect"):
    body = source.split("    void " + name + "(", 1)[1].split("\n    }", 1)[0]
    assert "if (!Pages(offset, length, first, last)) return;" in body
assert "python3 -B tools/check-fastmem-window-bounds-host.py" in (
    ROOT / ".github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml").read_text()

cpp = r"""
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <limits>
struct Window {
    static constexpr std::size_t GuestPage = 0x1000;
    static constexpr std::size_t GuestPages = std::size_t{1} << 20;
    static constexpr std::size_t WindowBytes = GuestPage * GuestPages;
METHOD
};
int main() {
    using W = Window;
    constexpr auto max = std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max();
    std::size_t first = 0, last = 0;
    assert(W::Pages(1, max, first, last));
    assert(first == 0 && last == W::GuestPages - 1);
    unsigned cases = 0;
    for (const auto offset : std::array<std::size_t, 10>{
             0, 1, 4095, 4096, 4097, W::WindowBytes - 4096,
             W::WindowBytes - 1, W::WindowBytes, W::WindowBytes + 1, max}) {
        for (const auto length : std::array<std::size_t, 9>{
                 0, 1, 2, 4095, 4096, 4097, W::WindowBytes, max - offset, max}) {
            first = last = 123;
            const bool valid = W::Pages(offset, length, first, last);
            assert(valid == (offset < W::WindowBytes && length != 0));
            if (valid) {
                assert(first == offset / W::GuestPage);
                assert(first <= last && last < W::GuestPages);
                // Independent oracle: clamp to the final page without adding
                // until the requested final byte is known to be in range.
                const auto expected = length - 1 >= W::WindowBytes - 1 - offset
                    ? W::GuestPages - 1 : (offset + length - 1) / W::GuestPage;
                assert(last == expected);
            } else {
                assert(first == 123 && last == 123);
            }
            ++cases;
        }
    }
    std::printf("FASTMEM_WINDOW_BOUNDS_PASS cases=%u full_span_no_overflow=1\n", cases);
}
"""
compiler = shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
assert compiler
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-fastmem-bounds-") as temp:
    folder = Path(temp)
    for name, body in (("original", baseline), ("maintained", method)):
        path, executable = folder / (name + ".cpp"), folder / name
        path.write_text(cpp.replace("METHOD", body))
        subprocess.run([compiler, "-std=c++20", "-O2", "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror",
                        "-fsanitize=address,undefined", "-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
                        str(path), "-o", str(executable)], check=True, timeout=60)
        result = subprocess.run([str(executable)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
        if name == "original":
            assert result.returncode != 0 and "Assertion" in result.stderr, result.stderr
            print("ORIGINAL_FASTMEM_WRAPPED_PAGE_WITNESS_PASS")
        else:
            assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr
            print(result.stdout, end="")
print("FASTMEM_WINDOW_HOST_ONLY native_PS5=unverified")

# Execute the real Own/Refresh methods against distinct access/map arrays.
# The production caller holds the window mutex across these stable arrays.
own = '    std::uint8_t Own(' + source.split('    std::uint8_t Own(', 1)[1].split(
    "    // A page's byte", 1)[0]
own = own.replace('const {\n', 'const {\n        ++calls;\n', 1)
refresh_source = (ROOT / 'src/host_memory.cpp').read_text()
refresh = '    void Refresh(' + refresh_source.split('    void Refresh(', 1)[1].split(
    '    void Block(', 1)[0]
previous_refresh = '''    void Before(std::size_t first, std::size_t last) {
        for (std::size_t page = first ? first - 1 : 0; page <= last; ++page)
            map[page] = Own(page) | Own(page + 1);
    }
'''
constants = refresh_source.split('namespace {\nconstexpr std::size_t GuestPage', 1)[1].split(
    'constexpr std::uint64_t ProbeMarker', 1)[0]
constants = 'constexpr std::size_t GuestPage' + constants
constants = '\n'.join(line for line in constants.splitlines() if not line.startswith(
    ('constexpr std::size_t WindowBytes', 'constexpr std::size_t MapBytes', 'constexpr std::size_t ReserveBytes')))
refresh_cpp = r'''
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>
CONSTANTS
struct TestWindow {
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> chunk_aliased, page_access, bytes;
    std::uint8_t* map;
    mutable std::size_t calls = 0;
    TestWindow() : chunk_aliased(Chunks), page_access(GuestPages),
                   bytes(GuestPages, 0xa5), map(bytes.data()) {
        for (std::size_t c = 0; c < Chunks; ++c) chunk_aliased[c] = (c % 3) != 0;
        for (std::size_t p = 0; p < GuestPages; ++p) page_access[p] = p % 4;
    }
OWN
BEFORE
AFTER
};
int main() {
    TestWindow old, current;
    const std::array<std::pair<std::size_t, std::size_t>, 6> ranges{{
        {0, 0}, {1, 1}, {3, 12}, {GuestPages-1, GuestPages-1},
        {GuestPages-8, GuestPages-1}, {0, GuestPages-1}}};
    for (const auto& [first, last] : ranges) {
        std::fill(old.bytes.begin(), old.bytes.end(), 0xa5);
        std::fill(current.bytes.begin(), current.bytes.end(), 0xa5);
        old.calls = current.calls = 0;
        old.Before(first, last);
        current.Refresh(first, last);
        assert(old.bytes == current.bytes);
        const auto begin = first ? first - 1 : 0;
        const auto n = last - begin + 1;
        assert(old.calls == 2*n && current.calls == n+1);
        for (std::size_t p = begin; p <= last; ++p) {
            const auto expected = old.Own(p) | old.Own(p+1);
            assert(current.bytes[p] == expected);
        }
    }
    std::printf("FASTMEM_REFRESH_PASS whole_window_before=%zu after=%zu "
                "output_bytes_identical=1\n", 2*GuestPages, GuestPages+1);
}
'''.replace('CONSTANTS', constants).replace('OWN', own).replace(
    'BEFORE', previous_refresh).replace('AFTER', refresh)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='encore-fastmem-refresh-') as temp:
    path, executable = Path(temp)/'refresh.cpp', Path(temp)/'refresh'
    path.write_text(refresh_cpp)
    subprocess.run([compiler, '-std=c++20', '-O2', '-Wall', '-Wextra', '-Werror',
                    '-fsanitize=address,undefined', '-fno-sanitize-recover=all',
                    str(path), '-o', str(executable)], check=True, timeout=60)
    subprocess.run([str(executable)], check=True, timeout=15)

# Exact source-extracted Window::Protect witness: one-page permission no-op
# leaves JIT map bytes unchanged and saves a Refresh; changed and cross-page
# requests continue to publish updated bytes under the same owner mutex.
protect_body = '    void Protect(' + source.split('    void Protect(', 1)[1].split('\n    }', 1)[0] + '\n    }'
assert protect_body.count('if (first == last && page_access[first] == access) return;') == 1
assert 'first / PagesPerGranule == last / PagesPerGranule' not in protect_body
assert 'first / PagesPerGranule != last / PagesPerGranule' not in protect_body
# The two old no-op branches were logically exhaustive for each short span:
# one granule has 4 guest pages, so any 2..16-page span is same or cross.
for first in range(0, 64):
    for count in range(1, min(64-first, 18)+1):
        last = first + count - 1
        old_same = (first < last and last - first < 4 and first // 4 == last // 4)
        old_cross = (first < last and last - first < 16 and first // 4 != last // 4)
        consolidated = first < last and last - first < 16
        assert (old_same or old_cross) == consolidated, (first, last)
assert protect_body.count('std::all_of(page_access.begin() + first') == 1
assert 'std::all_of(page_access.begin() + first, page_access.begin() + last + 1' in protect_body
assert 'first < last && last - first < 16' in protect_body
assert protect_body.index('std::lock_guard lock{mutex};') < protect_body.index(
    'if (first == last && page_access[first] == access) return;')
protect_cpp = r'''
#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <mutex>
#include <vector>
constexpr std::size_t GuestPage = 0x1000;
constexpr std::size_t GuestPages = 64;
constexpr std::size_t WindowBytes = GuestPage * GuestPages;
struct Counters { std::atomic<unsigned> protect_calls{0}; };
Counters counters;
struct TestWindow {
    std::mutex mutex;
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> page_access = std::vector<std::uint8_t>(GuestPages, 0);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> map = std::vector<std::uint8_t>(GuestPages, 0);
    unsigned refresh_calls = 0;
PAGES
    void Refresh(std::size_t first, std::size_t last) {
        ++refresh_calls;
        for (std::size_t page = first; page <= last; ++page)
            map[page] = page_access[page];
    }
PROTECT
};
int main() {
    TestWindow w;
    w.Protect(0x1000, 1, 0);
    assert(w.refresh_calls == 0 && counters.protect_calls == 1);
    w.Protect(0x1000, 1, 3);
    assert(w.refresh_calls == 1 && w.map[1] == 3);
    for (int i = 0; i < 20000; ++i) w.Protect(0x1000, 1, 3);
    assert(w.refresh_calls == 1 && counters.protect_calls == 20002);
    w.Protect(0x1000, 1, 1);
    assert(w.refresh_calls == 2 && w.map[1] == 1);
    w.Protect(0x1fff, 2, 2);
    assert(w.refresh_calls == 3 && w.page_access[1] == 2 &&
           w.page_access[2] == 2);
    w.Protect(0x1fff, 2, 2);
    assert(w.refresh_calls == 3); // same-granule repeat is now a no-op
    // A repeated access that crosses 16 KiB retains its original refresh.
    w.Protect(0x3fff, 2, 2);
    assert(w.refresh_calls == 4 && w.page_access[3] == 2 &&
           w.page_access[4] == 2);
    w.Protect(0x3fff, 2, 2);
    assert(w.refresh_calls == 4); // unchanged cross-granule guards
    w.Protect(0x3fff, 2, 1);
    assert(w.refresh_calls == 5); // changed cross-granule guards
    w.Protect(WindowBytes - 1, 1, 3);
    assert(w.refresh_calls == 6 && w.map[GuestPages - 1] == 3);
    w.Protect(WindowBytes, 1, 3);
    w.Protect(WindowBytes - 1, 0, 1);
    assert(w.refresh_calls == 6 && counters.protect_calls == 20009);
    TestWindow large;
    large.Protect(0, 16 * GuestPage, 3);
    assert(large.refresh_calls == 1);
    large.Protect(0, 16 * GuestPage, 3);
    assert(large.refresh_calls == 1); // bounded cross-granule no-op
    large.Protect(0, 17 * GuestPage, 3);
    large.Protect(0, 17 * GuestPage, 3);
    assert(large.refresh_calls == 3); // long requests always republish
    large.Protect(0, 16 * GuestPage, 1);
    assert(large.refresh_calls == 4); // any changed permission republished
    std::printf("FASTMEM_PROTECT_BOUNDED_NOOP_PASS repeated=20000 "
                "same16k=1 cross16k=1 changed=1 bounded16=1 bounds=1\n");
}
'''.replace('PAGES', method).replace('\nPROTECT\n', '\n' + protect_body + '\n')
assert '\nPROTECT\n' not in protect_cpp
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='encore-fastmem-protect-') as temp:
    path = Path(temp)/'protect.cpp'
    path.write_text(protect_cpp)
    for opt in ('-O0', '-O2'):
        executable = Path(temp)/('protect'+opt)
        subprocess.run([compiler, '-std=c++20', opt, '-Wall', '-Wextra', '-Werror',
                        '-pthread', '-fsanitize=address,undefined',
                        '-fno-sanitize-recover=all', str(path), '-o', str(executable)],
                       check=True, timeout=60)
        subprocess.run([str(executable)], check=True, timeout=20)

# Source-extracted fastmem Map/Unmap redundant single-page probes.
# Preserve a kernel retry when an otherwise-identical alias was NOT
# published: a previous fixed-map operation could have failed.
map_body = '    void Map(' + source.split('    void Map(', 1)[1].split('\n    }', 1)[0] + '\n    }'
unmap_body = '    void Unmap(' + source.split('    void Unmap(', 1)[1].split('\n    }', 1)[0] + '\n    }'
# Every short Map used to select one of two duplicate fast paths.
# Compare effective results (skip / refresh / Update) for one-page, same-
# granule, cross-granule, missing alias, changed backing and permissions,
# and the >=17-page fallback, without assuming console performance.
def map_old(first, last, live, backing, access, requested=3, host=17):
    if first == last:
        if live[first // 4] and backing[first] == host + 1:
            return "skip" if access[first] == requested else "refresh"
        return "update"
    if last - first < 4 and first // 4 == last // 4 and live[first // 4]:
        if all(backing[p] == host + (p-first) + 1 for p in range(first,last+1)):
            return ("skip" if all(access[p] == requested for p in range(first,last+1))
                    else "refresh")
    if last - first < 16 and first // 4 != last // 4:
        if all(live[p//4] and backing[p] == host + (p-first) + 1
               for p in range(first,last+1)):
            return ("skip" if all(access[p] == requested for p in range(first,last+1))
                    else "refresh")
    return "update"

def map_new(first, last, live, backing, access, requested=3, host=17):
    if first == last:
        if live[first//4] and backing[first] == host + 1:
            return "skip" if access[first] == requested else "refresh"
        return "update"
    if last-first < 16 and all(
        live[p//4] and backing[p] == host + (p-first) + 1
        for p in range(first,last+1)
    ):
        return ("skip" if all(access[p] == requested for p in range(first,last+1))
                else "refresh")
    return "update"

map_oracle_cases = 0
for first in range(64):
    for count in range(1, min(64-first, 32)+1):
        last = first + count-1
        for scenario in range(8):
            live = [bool(scenario & 1)]*16
            backing = [17+(p-first)+1 for p in range(64)]
            access = [3]*64
            if scenario & 2:
                live[first//4] = False
            if scenario & 4:
                backing[last] = 0
                access[first] = 1
            if scenario == 3:
                access[last] = 1
                live = [True]*16
            if scenario == 5:
                live = [True]*16
                access[first] = 1
            if scenario == 7:
                live = [True]*16
                backing[last] = 0
            assert map_old(first,last,live,backing,access) == map_new(
                first,last,live,backing,access), (first,last,scenario)
            map_oracle_cases += 1
print(f"FASTMEM_MAP_UNIFIED_BRANCH_ORACLE_PASS cases={map_oracle_cases} exact_outcome=1")
assert 'if (first == last && chunk_aliased[first / PagesPerGranule] &&' in map_body
assert "page_backing[first] == static_cast<std::uint32_t>(host + 1)) {" in map_body

map_cpp = r'''
#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <mutex>
#include <vector>
constexpr std::size_t GuestPage = 0x1000;
constexpr std::size_t GuestPages = 64;
constexpr std::size_t PagesPerGranule = 4;
constexpr std::size_t WindowBytes = GuestPages * GuestPage;
constexpr std::uint8_t Readable = 1, Writable = 2;
constexpr std::uint8_t ReadBlocked = 1, WriteBlocked = 2, Blocked = 3;
struct Counters {
    std::atomic<unsigned> map_calls{0}, unmap_calls{0}, mapped_pages{0};
};
Counters counters;
struct TestWindow {
    std::mutex mutex;
    std::vector<std::uint32_t> page_backing = std::vector<std::uint32_t>(GuestPages, 0);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> page_access = std::vector<std::uint8_t>(GuestPages, 0);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> chunk_aliased = std::vector<std::uint8_t>(GuestPages / PagesPerGranule, 0);
    unsigned updates = 0;
    unsigned guard_refreshes = 0;
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> map = std::vector<std::uint8_t>(GuestPages, 0);
PAGES
    void Update(std::size_t, std::size_t) { ++updates; }
SOURCE_OWN
SOURCE_REFRESH
MAP
UNMAP
};
int main() {
    TestWindow w;
    // A successful prior alias permits exact same-page Map to skip Update.
    w.Map(0, 0, GuestPage, 3);
    assert(w.updates == 1 && counters.mapped_pages == 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < 10000; ++i) w.Map(0, 0, GuestPage, 3);
    assert(w.updates == 10001); // not yet aliased: preserve kernel retry
    w.chunk_aliased[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < 10000; ++i) w.Map(0, 0, GuestPage, 3);
    assert(w.updates == 10001);
    w.Map(0, GuestPage, GuestPage, 3);
    assert(w.updates == 10002 && w.page_backing[0] == 2);
    w.Map(0, GuestPage, GuestPage, 1);
    assert(w.updates == 10002 && w.page_access[0] == 1);
    assert(w.guard_refreshes == 1);
    assert(w.map[0] == (w.Own(0) | w.Own(1)));
    w.Unmap(0, GuestPage);
    assert(w.updates == 10003 && counters.mapped_pages == 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < 10000; ++i) w.Unmap(0, GuestPage);
    assert(w.updates == 10003 && counters.unmap_calls == 10001);
    // Overlap and the exact end boundary retain ordinary range semantics.
    w.Map(GuestPage - 1, 0, 2, 3);
    assert(w.updates == 10004 && counters.mapped_pages == 2);
    w.Unmap(GuestPage - 1, 2);
    assert(w.updates == 10005 && counters.mapped_pages == 0);
    w.Map(WindowBytes, 0, 1, 3);
    w.Unmap(WindowBytes, 1);
    assert(w.updates == 10005);
    TestWindow two;
    two.Map(GuestPage, GuestPage, 2 * GuestPage, 3);
    assert(two.updates == 1 && counters.mapped_pages == 2);
    // No active fixed alias: an identical request must still reach Update.
    two.Map(GuestPage, GuestPage, 2 * GuestPage, 3);
    assert(two.updates == 2);
    two.chunk_aliased[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < 10000; ++i)
        two.Map(GuestPage, GuestPage, 2 * GuestPage, 3);
    assert(two.updates == 2);
    two.Map(GuestPage, GuestPage, 2 * GuestPage, 1);
    assert(two.updates == 2 && two.guard_refreshes == 1 &&
           two.page_access[1] == 1 && two.page_access[2] == 1);
    assert(two.map[0] == (two.Own(0) | two.Own(1)));
    assert(two.map[2] == (two.Own(2) | two.Own(3)));
    two.Unmap(GuestPage, 2 * GuestPage);
    assert(two.updates == 3 && counters.mapped_pages == 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < 10000; ++i) two.Unmap(GuestPage, 2 * GuestPage);
    assert(two.updates == 3);
    // A two-page operation that crosses a 16 KiB granule still updates.
    two.Map(3 * GuestPage, 3 * GuestPage, 2 * GuestPage, 3);
    assert(two.updates == 4 && counters.mapped_pages == 2);
    two.Map(3 * GuestPage, 3 * GuestPage, 2 * GuestPage, 3);
    assert(two.updates == 5); // second kernel chunk not aliased: retry
    two.chunk_aliased[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < 10000; ++i)
        two.Map(3 * GuestPage, 3 * GuestPage, 2 * GuestPage, 3);
    assert(two.updates == 5); // both existing aliases: no-op
    two.Map(3 * GuestPage, 3 * GuestPage, 2 * GuestPage, 1);
    assert(two.updates == 5 && two.guard_refreshes == 2); // only JIT guards
    assert(two.map[3] == (two.Own(3) | two.Own(4)));
    two.Unmap(3 * GuestPage, 2 * GuestPage);
    assert(two.updates == 6 && counters.mapped_pages == 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < 10000; ++i) two.Unmap(3 * GuestPage, 2 * GuestPage);
    assert(two.updates == 6);
    TestWindow short_span;
    short_span.Map(0, 0, 16 * GuestPage, 3);
    assert(short_span.updates == 1 && counters.mapped_pages == 16);
    for (std::size_t chunk = 0; chunk < 4; ++chunk) short_span.chunk_aliased[chunk] = 1;
    short_span.Map(0, 0, 16 * GuestPage, 3);
    assert(short_span.updates == 1);
    short_span.Unmap(0, 16 * GuestPage);
    short_span.Unmap(0, 16 * GuestPage);
    assert(short_span.updates == 2 && counters.mapped_pages == 0);
    // The bound protects large requests from speculative scans.
    short_span.Map(0, 0, 17 * GuestPage, 3);
    short_span.Map(0, 0, 17 * GuestPage, 3);
    assert(short_span.updates == 4 && counters.mapped_pages == 17);
    short_span.Unmap(0, 17 * GuestPage);
    short_span.Unmap(0, 17 * GuestPage);
    assert(short_span.updates == 6 && counters.mapped_pages == 0);
    // A crossed span must retry if any one kernel granule lacks a
    // published alias: changed access alone is not permission to skip it.
    TestWindow missing_cross_alias;
    missing_cross_alias.Map(3 * GuestPage, 3 * GuestPage, 2 * GuestPage, 3);
    missing_cross_alias.chunk_aliased[0] = 1;
    missing_cross_alias.Map(3 * GuestPage, 3 * GuestPage, 2 * GuestPage, 1);
    assert(missing_cross_alias.updates == 2 && missing_cross_alias.guard_refreshes == 0);
    // The first page in a native 16KiB granule changes the preceding
    // page's crossing guard as well as its own guard.
    TestWindow boundary;
    boundary.Map(4 * GuestPage, 4 * GuestPage, GuestPage, 3);
    boundary.chunk_aliased[0] = 1;
    boundary.page_access[3] = 3; // owned predecessor: its guard must change
    boundary.chunk_aliased[1] = 1;
    boundary.Map(4 * GuestPage, 4 * GuestPage, GuestPage, 1);
    assert(boundary.updates == 1 && boundary.guard_refreshes == 1);
    assert(boundary.map[3] == 2); // blocked guest write in page 4
    assert(boundary.map[3] == (boundary.Own(3) | boundary.Own(4)));
    assert(boundary.map[4] == (boundary.Own(4) | boundary.Own(5)));
    // The final page has no successor and must not index beyond the window.
    TestWindow tail;
    tail.Map((GuestPages - 1) * GuestPage, (GuestPages - 1) * GuestPage,
             GuestPage, 3);
    tail.chunk_aliased.back() = 1;
    tail.Map((GuestPages - 1) * GuestPage, (GuestPages - 1) * GuestPage,
             GuestPage, 1);
    assert(tail.updates == 1 && tail.guard_refreshes == 1);
    assert(tail.map.back() == (tail.Own(GuestPages - 1) | tail.Own(GuestPages)));
    // Failed native alias: unchanged backing MUST still retry Update.
    TestWindow missing_alias;
    missing_alias.Map(0, 0, GuestPage, 3);
    missing_alias.Map(0, 0, GuestPage, 1);
    assert(missing_alias.updates == 2 && missing_alias.guard_refreshes == 0);
    std::printf("FASTMEM_MAP_UNMAP_REPEAT_HOST_PASS nonaliased_retry=1 "
                "same_alias_noop=10000 unmap_noop=10000 same16k=1 "
                "cross16k=10000 permission_only=1 permission_batch=1 cross_permission_batch=1 predecessor_guard=1 bound16=1 O0_O2=1\n");
}
'''.replace('PAGES', method).replace('\nMAP\n', '\n' + map_body + '\n').replace(
    '\nUNMAP\n', '\n' + unmap_body + '\n').replace(
    'SOURCE_OWN', '    std::uint8_t Own(' + source.split('    std::uint8_t Own(', 1)[1].split(
        "    // A page's byte", 1)[0].rstrip()).replace(
    'SOURCE_REFRESH', ('    void Refresh(' + source.split('    void Refresh(', 1)[1].split(
        '    void Block(', 1)[0].rstrip()).replace(
            '    void Refresh(std::size_t first, std::size_t last) {',
            '    void Refresh(std::size_t first, std::size_t last) {\n        ++guard_refreshes;', 1))
assert '\nUNMAP\n' not in map_cpp and '\nMAP\n' not in map_cpp
assert 'SOURCE_OWN' not in map_cpp and 'SOURCE_REFRESH' not in map_cpp
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='encore-fastmem-map-unmap-') as temp:
    path = Path(temp)/'map.cpp'
    path.write_text(map_cpp)
    for opt in ('-O0', '-O2'):
        binary = Path(temp)/('map'+opt)
        subprocess.run([compiler, '-std=c++20', opt, '-Wall', '-Wextra',
                        '-Werror', '-pthread', '-fsanitize=address,undefined',
                        '-fno-sanitize-recover=all', str(path), '-o', str(binary)],
                       check=True, timeout=60)

# J01/C05: only a complete, unambiguous four-core peak witness is
# attributable to one reporting window. Do not mistake summed CPU nanoseconds
# from concurrent JIT cores for 200 ms of blocked presentation.
def peak_witness(frame=1005, jit3=400_000, scope="between_presents",
                 total_jit=1_000_000, include_fourth=True,
                 interval_ms=201.5, cache_wait_ns=5_000_000):
    cores = (100_000, 200_000, 300_000, jit3)
    values = [f"EDEN_PRESENT_INTERVAL_WITNESS frame={frame} interval_ms={interval_ms:.3f}",
              f"jit_ns={total_jit}", "jit_calls=7",
              *(f"jit{i}_ns={core}" for i, core in enumerate(cores)
                if i < 3 or include_fourth),
              "evacuations=1", f"cache_wait_ns={cache_wait_ns}",
              "gpu_fence_ns=2500000", "gpu_dispatch_ns=800000",
              f"guest_sync_ns=400000 scope={scope}"]
    return " ".join(values)

#include <array>
#include <cstdio>
struct IntervalWitness {
    unsigned peak_frame{1002};
    double peak_ms{180.5};
    std::array<unsigned long long, 24> peak_delta{};
};
int main() {
    IntervalWitness vulkan_interval_witness{};
    auto& counts = vulkan_interval_witness.peak_delta;
    counts[11] = 1000;
    counts[12] = 100; counts[13] = 200; counts[14] = 300; counts[15] = 400;
    counts[16] = 1; counts[17] = 2; counts[18] = 3; counts[19] = 4;
    counts[20] = 1; counts[21] = 2; counts[22] = 0; counts[23] = 3;
    counts[10] = 42; counts[2] = 3; counts[1] = 4; counts[6] = 5;
    const auto& d = vulkan_interval_witness.peak_delta;
    __ACTUAL_PRINTF__
}
""".replace("__ACTUAL_PRINTF__", actual_printf)

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="f07-jit4-peak-") as folder:
    source = Path(folder) / "peak.cpp"
    source.write_text(model)
    for opt in ("-O0", "-O2"):
        binary = Path(folder) / f"peak-{opt[1:]}"
        build = subprocess.run(
            [compiler, "-std=c++20", "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror", opt,
             "-fsanitize=undefined", "-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
             str(source), "-o", str(binary)],
            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=40,
        )

        run = subprocess.run([str(binary)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
        assert run.returncode == 0, (opt, run.stderr[-4000:])
        parsed = dict(re.findall(r"\b([a-z_0-9]+)=([0-9.]+)", run.stdout))
        assert {key: int(parsed[key]) for key in
                ("jit0_ns", "jit1_ns", "jit2_ns", "jit3_ns")} == {
                    "jit0_ns": 100, "jit1_ns": 200,
                    "jit2_ns": 300, "jit3_ns": 400,
                }, (opt, run.stdout)
        assert int(parsed["jit_ns"]) == sum(int(parsed[f"jit{i}_ns"]) for i in range(4))
        assert int(parsed["jit_calls"]) == 10
        assert int(parsed["evacuations"]) == 6
        assert int(parsed["frame"]) == 1002

`tools/check-fc27-f03-native-present-freshness-host.py`:

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
"""F03: one native C++ fixture ties TIC recovery to async Vulkan presentation.

Reuses the source-extracted selected TIC/sampler/feedback/descriptor program
from F03 plus the actual selected RendererVulkan::Composite and
PresentManager::GetRenderFrame/Present/WaitPresent/PresentThread. Mock GPU
render targets carry an explicit HUD frame-content revision, not real pixels.
The test proves no lost revision across source-backed CPU orchestration,
including 12 paused game ticks and a midstream texture remap. It is NOT
Vulkan device submission, WSI scanout, guest FC27 fidelity, or FPS evidence.
"""
import os
import sys
import ast
from pathlib import Path
import runpy
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
FAST=(ROOT/".github/workflows/encore-core-fast-gate.yml").read_text()
FULL=(ROOT/".github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml").read_text()
CMD="python3 -B tools/check-fc27-f03-native-present-freshness-host.py"
assert CMD in FAST and CMD in FULL
VULKAN_CMAKE=(ROOT/"headless/vulkan.cmake").read_text()
for name in ("vulkan_renderer.cpp","vulkan_present_manager.cpp","vk_graphics_pipeline"):
    assert name in VULKAN_CMAKE,name

# Run independent F03 source-extraction assertions and get its exact C++
# source (methods + descriptor loop), then splice the class definitions
# before the selected real renderer/presenter C++ host fixture.
stage=runpy.run_path(str(ROOT/"tools/check-fc27-f03-native-texture-feedback-chain-host.py"))
textures=stage["source"]
assert textures.count("int main(){")==1
texture_types=textures.split("int main(){",1)[0]
f05=(ROOT/"tools/check-native-vulkan-renderer-handoff-host.py").read_text()
tree=ast.parse(f05)
templates=[]
for stmt in tree.body:
    if isinstance(stmt,ast.Assign) and any(
        isinstance(target,ast.Name) and target.id=="cpp" for target in stmt.targets
    ) and isinstance(stmt.value,ast.Constant) and isinstance(stmt.value.value,str):
        templates.append(stmt.value.value)
assert len(templates)==1
template=templates[0]
RENDER=(ROOT/"vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_renderer.cpp").read_text()
PRESENT=(ROOT/"vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_present_manager.cpp").read_text()
def native(text,start):
    assert text.count(start)==1,start
    begin=text.index(start)
    opening=text.index("{",begin)
    depth=0
    for i in range(opening,len(text)):
        if text[i]=="{":depth+=1
        elif text[i]=="}":
            depth-=1
            if depth==0:return text[begin:i+1]
    raise AssertionError(start)
present_methods="\n\n".join(native(PRESENT,s) for s in (
    "Frame* PresentManager::GetRenderFrame() {",
    "void PresentManager::Present(Frame* frame) {",
    "void PresentManager::WaitPresent() {",
    "void PresentManager::PresentThread(std::stop_token token) {",
))
render_method=native(RENDER,"void RendererVulkan::Composite(")
assert "#ifdef PS5_NATIVE" in texture_types
assert "CopyToSwapchain(frame);" in present_methods
assert "present_in_flight = false;" in present_methods
assert "present_manager.Present(frame);" in render_method
assert "scheduler.DispatchWork();" in render_method
cpp=template.replace("__PRESENT_METHODS__",present_methods).replace("__RENDER_METHOD__",render_method)
anchor="static void Deliver(RendererVulkan& renderer,"
assert cpp.count(anchor)==1
cpp=cpp.replace(anchor,texture_types+"\n"+anchor)
inject=r"""
    // F03: the same source-selected TIC view and sampler that produced
    // feedback barriers enter the selected native renderer + async
    // presentation handoff in one executable, without an inferred ACK.
    PresentManager fresh_present{7};
    RendererVulkan fresh_renderer{fresh_present};
    TextureCache<int> texture;
    texture.channel.graphics_image_table.descriptor=27;
    texture.channel.graphics_sampler_table.descriptor=4;
    texture.fail_first_view_creation=true;
    assert(texture.gpu_memory==&texture.memory);
    assert(texture.channel_state==&texture.channel);
    assert(texture.VisitImageView(5,false)==NULL_IMAGE_VIEW_ID);
    assert(texture.VisitImageView(5,false)==127);
    assert(texture.texture_bindings_serial==1);
    Info texture_draw{{Descriptor{{{127,3},{127,3}},2}}};
    std::vector<std::pair<std::uint32_t,std::uint32_t>> fresh_expected;
    std::uint32_t fresh_game=100;
    constexpr unsigned hud_ticks=240;
    for(unsigned tick=0;tick<hud_ticks;++tick){
        const bool paused=tick>=100 && tick<112;
        if(!paused && tick%2==0)++fresh_game;
        if(tick==120){
            // Guest TIC unchanged while backing image is remapped.
            texture.slot_images[127].flags.remapped=true;
            texture.rt_depth_image_id=128;
        }
        const auto view=texture.VisitImageView(5,false);
        assert(view==(tick<120?127u:128u));
        texture_draw.texture_descriptors[0].handles={{view,3},{view,3}};
        const auto output=BuildDraw(texture,texture_draw);
        assert(output.views.size()==2 && output.views[0].id==view);
        assert(output.samplers.size()==2 && output.samplers[0]==304);
        texture.CheckFeedbackLoop(output.views);
        assert(texture.runtime.calls==tick+1);
        // A real Vulkan resource would contain the HUD at revision 'tick'.
        // The mock render target carries both its view identity and the
        // content revision to prove ordering through native PresentThread.
        const std::uint32_t hud_content=view*100000u+tick;
        Deliver(fresh_renderer,fresh_game,hud_content);
        fresh_expected.emplace_back(fresh_game,hud_content);
        if(paused)assert(fresh_game==150);
    }
    fresh_present.WaitPresent();
    assert(fresh_present.presented==fresh_expected);
    assert(fresh_present.copies==hud_ticks);
    assert(fresh_renderer.gpu.notifications==hud_ticks);
    assert(fresh_renderer.rasterizer.ticks==hud_ticks);
    assert(fresh_renderer.render_window.displayed==hud_ticks);
    assert(texture.texture_bindings_serial==2);
    assert(texture.views_created==3);
    assert(texture.samplers_found==1);
    assert(texture.runtime.calls==hud_ticks);

    // A second backing loss AFTER the first successful remap must clear the
    // old GPU view even though the guest TIC slot and cache key are unchanged.
    // Reappearance must create a new view and reach presentation as that new
    // identity, not silently reuse the retired HUD image.
    texture.slot_images[128].flags.remapped=true;
    texture.channel.graphics_image_table.descriptor=-1;
    assert(texture.VisitImageView(5,false)==NULL_IMAGE_VIEW_ID);
    assert(texture.channel.image_view_ids.at(5)==NULL_IMAGE_VIEW_ID);

"""F03: source-extracted TIC/TSC -> graphic descriptor -> feedback-barrier replay.

struct Descriptor {
    std::vector<std::pair<u32,u32>> handles;
    u32 count{};
};
struct Info {std::vector<Descriptor> texture_descriptors;};
struct Output {
    std::vector<ImageViewInOut> views;
    std::vector<u32> samplers;
};
static Output BuildDraw(TextureCache<int>& texture_cache,const Info& info){
    Output output;
    auto& views=output.views;
    auto& samplers=output.samplers;
    const auto read_handle=[](const Descriptor& d,u32 i){return d.handles.at(i);};
__MEMO__
__LOOP__
    return output;
}

    cache.channel.graphics_sampler_table.descriptor=4;
    cache.channel.graphics_image_table.descriptor=27;

    assert(cache.VisitImageView(hud_slot,false)==127);
    assert(cache.texture_bindings_serial==1);

    for(unsigned tick=0;tick<60;++tick){
        auto output=BuildDraw(cache,draw);
        assert(output.views.size()==2 && output.samplers.size()==2);
        assert(output.views[0].id==127 && output.views[1].id==127);
        assert(output.samplers[0]==304 && output.samplers[1]==304);
        assert(cache.samplers_found==1);
        cache.CheckFeedbackLoop(output.views);
        assert(cache.runtime.calls==tick+1);
    }
    assert(cache.views_created==2);
    // A remap retires the backing image without changing guest TIC bytes.
    cache.slot_images[127].flags.remapped=true;
    assert(cache.VisitImageView(hud_slot,false)==128);
    assert(cache.texture_bindings_serial==2);
    cache.rt_depth_image_id=128;
    draw.texture_descriptors[0].handles={{128,3},{128,3}};
    const auto revived=BuildDraw(cache,draw);
    cache.CheckFeedbackLoop(revived.views);
    assert(cache.runtime.calls==61);
    assert(cache.VisitImageView(hud_slot,false)==128);
    assert(cache.views_created==3);
    // Same TIC/TSC serial, different bound view -> discard cached true
    // feedback decision, then restore the depth view in the next draw.
    cache.slot_image_views[44].image_id=44;
    draw.texture_descriptors[0].handles={{44,3},{44,3}};
    const auto unrelated=BuildDraw(cache,draw);
    cache.CheckFeedbackLoop(unrelated.views);
    assert(cache.runtime.calls==61);
    draw.texture_descriptors[0].handles={{128,3},{128,3}};
    const auto restored=BuildDraw(cache,draw);
    cache.CheckFeedbackLoop(restored.views);
    assert(cache.runtime.calls==62);
    cache.CheckFeedbackLoop(std::span<const ImageViewInOut>{});
    cache.CheckFeedbackLoop(restored.views);
    assert(cache.runtime.calls==63);
    assert(cache.samplers_found==1);
    std::printf("F03_NATIVE_TIC_DESCRIPTOR_BARRIER_CHAIN_PASS "
                "frames=60 transient_recoveries=1 remapped_recoveries=1 "
                "sampler_lookups=1 barriers=63 native_functions=3 "

#!/usr/bin/env python3

"""F04 native-source DMA -> alias -> CPU invalidation, with byte payload checks.

The production-selected MaxwellDMA contiguous/row fallback fragment,

enum class ImageFlagBits : u32 {
    Rescaled=1, GpuModified=2, CpuModified=4, Tracked=8
};
struct Flags {
    u32 bits{};
    Flags operator&(ImageFlagBits bit) const {
        return {bits & static_cast<u32>(bit)};
    }
    Flags& operator|=(ImageFlagBits bit) {
        bits |= static_cast<u32>(bit);
        return *this;
    }
};
inline bool True(Flags f) {return f.bits != 0;}
struct ImageCopy {
    std::size_t dst_offset{}, src_offset{}, length{};
};

    ImageId id{};

using Image = ImageBase;
template<class P> struct TextureCache {
    std::vector<Image> slot_images{3};
    u64 modification_tick{};
    unsigned copies{}, untracks{};
    int fail_copy_before{-1};
    std::vector<ImageId> order;
    bool ImageCanRescale(Image&) {return true;}
    void ScaleUp(Image&) {}
    void ScaleDown(Image&) {}
    void CopyImage(ImageId dst_id, ImageId src_id, std::vector<ImageCopy> spans) {
        if (fail_copy_before == 0) throw std::runtime_error("injected GPU copy failure");
        if (fail_copy_before > 0) --fail_copy_before;
        assert(dst_id < slot_images.size() && src_id < slot_images.size());
        auto& dst = slot_images[dst_id].bytes;
        const auto& src = slot_images[src_id].bytes;
        for (const auto& span : spans) {
            assert(span.dst_offset <= dst.size() && span.src_offset <= src.size());
            assert(span.length <= dst.size()-span.dst_offset);
            assert(span.length <= src.size()-span.src_offset);
            std::copy_n(src.begin()+span.src_offset,span.length,
                        dst.begin()+span.dst_offset);
        }
        order.push_back(src_id);
        ++copies;
    }
    template<class F> void ForEachImageInRegion(DAddr addr, std::size_t size, F fn) {
        if (size == 0) return;
        for (ImageId id=0; id<slot_images.size(); ++id) {
            Image& img=slot_images[id];
            if (addr < img.cpu_addr + img.bytes.size() &&
                img.cpu_addr < addr + size) {
                fn(id,img);
            }
        }
    }
    void UntrackImage(Image& img, ImageId) {
        ++untracks;
        img.flags.bits &= ~static_cast<u32>(ImageFlagBits::Tracked);
    }
    void SynchronizeAliases(ImageId);
    void WriteMemory(DAddr,std::size_t);

struct MemoryManager {
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> bytes = std::vector<std::uint8_t>(4096);
    unsigned calls{};
    void CopyBlock(u64 dst,u64 src,std::size_t n) {
        assert(dst <= bytes.size() && src <= bytes.size());
        assert(n <= bytes.size()-dst && n <= bytes.size()-src);
        std::memmove(bytes.data()+dst,bytes.data()+src,n);
        ++calls;
    }
};

static void TestPitch(u64 src,u64 dst,u32 width,u32 rows,s64 in,s64 out,unsigned expected_calls) {
    MockDma engine;
    auto& bytes=engine.memory_manager.bytes;
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<bytes.size();++i)
        bytes[i]=static_cast<std::uint8_t>((i*37+11)%251);
    auto expected=bytes;
    // Deliberately independently execute the specified row-by-row result.
    for(u32 line=0;line<rows;++line) {
        const auto a=static_cast<u64>(static_cast<s64>(src)+line*in);
        const auto b=static_cast<u64>(static_cast<s64>(dst)+line*out);
        std::memmove(expected.data()+b,expected.data()+a,width);
    }
    engine.regs={src,dst,width,rows,in,out};
    engine.PitchCopy();
    assert(engine.memory_manager.calls==expected_calls);
    assert(bytes==expected);
}
int main() {
    u64 length{};
    assert(CanCoalescePitchDma(256,1024,64,4,64,64,length) && length==256);
    assert(!CanCoalescePitchDma(256,280,64,4,64,64,length));
    assert(!CanCoalescePitchDma(256,1024,64,4,72,72,length));
    TestPitch(256,1024,64,4,64,64,1);

    MockDma dma;

    dma.regs={256,1024,16,4,16,16};

    TextureCache<int> tc;
    auto& dst=tc.slot_images[0];
    auto& first=tc.slot_images[1];
    auto& second=tc.slot_images[2];
    dst.cpu_addr=0x1000;
    first.cpu_addr=0x2000;
    second.cpu_addr=0x3000;
    dst.bytes.fill(0xA5);
    std::copy_n(dma.memory_manager.bytes.begin()+1024,64,first.bytes.begin());
    second.bytes.fill(0x3C);
    dst.modification_tick=1;
    first.modification_tick=4;
    second.modification_tick=7;
    tc.modification_tick=7;
    first.flags |= ImageFlagBits::GpuModified;
    second.flags |= ImageFlagBits::GpuModified;
    // Reverse the source order; the native method must sort by modification tick.
    dst.aliased_images={{2,{{64,0,32}}},{1,{{0,0,64}}}};
    tc.SynchronizeAliases(0);
    assert((tc.order==std::vector<ImageId>{1,2}));

    for(std::size_t i=96;i<128;++i) assert(dst.bytes[i]==0xA5);
    tc.SynchronizeAliases(0);
    assert(tc.copies==2); // same tick: no redundant copy

    // Newer alias wins only its own region; untouched bytes remain untouched.
    first.modification_tick=8;
    tc.modification_tick=8;
    first.bytes.fill(0x5E);
    tc.SynchronizeAliases(0);
    assert(tc.copies==3 && tc.order.back()==1);
    assert(dst.modification_tick==8);
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<64;++i) assert(dst.bytes[i]==0x5E);
    for(std::size_t i=64;i<96;++i) assert(dst.bytes[i]==0x3C);
    for(std::size_t i=96;i<128;++i) assert(dst.bytes[i]==0xA5);

    // Failure after the first successful GPU copy: destination revision
    // remains old, so the next draw retries both aliases in tick order.
    TextureCache<int> rollback;
    auto& stale = rollback.slot_images[0];
    auto& source1 = rollback.slot_images[1];
    auto& source2 = rollback.slot_images[2];
    stale.modification_tick = 1;
    source1.modification_tick = 10;
    source2.modification_tick = 13;
    source1.flags |= ImageFlagBits::GpuModified;
    source2.flags |= ImageFlagBits::GpuModified;
    rollback.modification_tick = 13;
    stale.bytes.fill(0);
    source1.bytes.fill(0xA1);
    source2.bytes.fill(0xB2);
    stale.aliased_images = {{2,{{64,0,32}}},{1,{{0,0,64}}}};
    rollback.fail_copy_before = 1;
    bool copy_failed = false;
    try {
        rollback.SynchronizeAliases(0);
    } catch (const std::runtime_error&) {
        copy_failed = true;
    }
    assert(copy_failed);
    assert(rollback.copies == 1 && stale.modification_tick == 1);
    assert(!True(stale.flags & ImageFlagBits::GpuModified));
    rollback.fail_copy_before = -1;
    rollback.SynchronizeAliases(0);
    assert(rollback.copies == 3 && stale.modification_tick == 13);
    assert((rollback.order == std::vector<ImageId>{1,1,2}));
    assert(True(stale.flags & ImageFlagBits::GpuModified));
    for (unsigned i=0;i<64;++i) assert(stale.bytes[i]==0xA1);
    for (unsigned i=64;i<96;++i) assert(stale.bytes[i]==0xB2);

    first.flags |= ImageFlagBits::Tracked;
    tc.WriteMemory(first.cpu_addr+8,16);
    assert(True(first.flags & ImageFlagBits::CpuModified));
    assert(!True(first.flags & ImageFlagBits::Tracked));
    assert(tc.untracks==1);
    tc.WriteMemory(first.cpu_addr+8,16);
    assert(tc.untracks==1);
    tc.WriteMemory(0x5000,64);
    assert(tc.untracks==1);
    assert(!True(second.flags & ImageFlagBits::CpuModified));
    std::puts("F04_NATIVE_DMA_ALIAS_CONTENT_PASS ordered_aliases=2 updated_aliases=1 "
              "byte_regions=3 cpu_invalidations=1 alias_copy_failure_retry=1 "
              "scope=source_extracted_host_mock_gpu_bytes");
}
"""
fixture=(fixture.replace("__COALESCE__",coalesce)
        .replace("__PITCH__",pitch_body)
        .replace("__ALIAS__",alias)
        .replace("__WRITE__",write))

#include <algorithm>

using u32=std::uint32_t;

using ImageId=u32;
enum class ImageType {Linear,Tiled};
enum class ImageFlagBits : unsigned {None=0,Remapped=1,Strong=2};
ImageFlagBits operator&(ImageFlagBits a,ImageFlagBits b) {
    return ImageFlagBits(unsigned(a)&unsigned(b));
}
bool True(ImageFlagBits value) {return unsigned(value)!=0;}
struct ImageInfo {ImageType type{ImageType::Tiled};size_t pitch{128};int format{7};};
struct ImageBase {
    ImageInfo info{};
    GPUVAddr gpu_addr{42};
    ImageFlagBits flags{ImageFlagBits::None};
    std::uint64_t modification_tick{};
};
size_t CalculateGuestSizeInBytes(const ImageInfo&) {return 4096;}
bool IsPitchLinearSameSize(const ImageInfo& a,const ImageInfo& b,bool strict) {
    return a.pitch==b.pitch && (!strict || a.format==b.format);
}
bool IsViewCompatible(int a,int b,bool,bool) {return a==b;}
bool IsSubCopy(const ImageInfo& info,const ImageBase& image,GPUVAddr gpu_addr) {
    return info.type==image.info.type && image.gpu_addr==gpu_addr &&
           image.info.format==info.format;
}
struct Gpu {
    bool miss_first{},miss_all{};
    std::optional<DAddr> GpuToCpuAddress(GPUVAddr) {
        if(miss_first||miss_all)return {};
        return DAddr{42};
    }
    std::optional<DAddr> GpuToCpuAddress(GPUVAddr,size_t) {
        if(miss_all)return {};
        return DAddr{42};
    }
};
template<class P> struct TextureCache {
    Gpu* gpu_memory{};
    std::array<ImageBase,32> slot_images{};
    std::vector<ImageId> ids;
    template<class F> void ForEachImageInRegion(DAddr,size_t,F callback) {
        for(ImageId id:ids) (void)callback(id,slot_images[id]);
    }
    ImageId FindDMAImage(const ImageInfo&,GPUVAddr);
};
__METHOD__
int main() {
    Gpu gpu;TextureCache<int> c; c.gpu_memory=&gpu;
    ImageInfo linear{ImageType::Linear,128,7};
    for(unsigned i=1;i<32;++i) {
        c.slot_images[i].info=linear;
        c.slot_images[i].gpu_addr=42;
        c.slot_images[i].modification_tick=i*10;
    }
    assert(c.FindDMAImage(linear,42)==0);
    c.ids={1};
    assert(c.FindDMAImage(linear,42)==1);
    c.ids={1,3,2};
    assert(c.FindDMAImage(linear,42)==3);
    c.slot_images[2].modification_tick=30; // equal timestamp: FIRST wins
    c.ids={2,3,1};
    assert(c.FindDMAImage(linear,42)==2);
    c.slot_images[3].flags=ImageFlagBits::Remapped;
    c.ids={3,1};
    assert(c.FindDMAImage(linear,42)==1);
    c.slot_images[3].flags=ImageFlagBits::None;
    c.slot_images[3].info.pitch=256;
    assert(c.FindDMAImage(linear,42)==1); // invalid linear pitch excluded
    c.slot_images[3].info.pitch=128;
    c.slot_images[1].flags=ImageFlagBits::Strong;
    assert(c.FindDMAImage(linear,42)==3); // strongest compatible match
    gpu.miss_first=true;
    assert(c.FindDMAImage(linear,42)==3); // second GpuToCpu lookup
    gpu.miss_all=true;
    assert(c.FindDMAImage(linear,42)==0);
    gpu.miss_all=false;gpu.miss_first=false;
    ImageInfo tiled{ImageType::Tiled,128,7};
    c.slot_images[4].info=tiled;
    c.slot_images[5].info=tiled;
    c.slot_images[4].modification_tick=51;
    c.slot_images[5].modification_tick=53;
    c.ids={4,5};
    assert(c.FindDMAImage(tiled,42)==5);
    c.ids.clear();
    for(unsigned i=6;i<=20;i++){
        c.slot_images[i].info=tiled;
        c.ids.push_back(i);
    }
    assert(c.FindDMAImage(tiled,42)==20); // >8 matching images
    std::puts("F07_T01_DMA_SINGLE_SCAN_PASS");
}

static std::array<u8,64> Data(const Memory& m,GPUVAddr addr,bool converted=false){
    std::array<u8,64> out{};
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<out.size();++i)
        out[i]=converted ? m.bytes[addr+i]^u8{0xff} : m.bytes[addr+i];
    return out;
}
int main(){
    TextureCache<int> cache;
    Image image;
    cache.runtime.image_to_verify=&image;
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<cache.memory.bytes.size();++i)
        cache.memory.bytes[i]=static_cast<u8>((i*43+7)%251);
    auto& m=cache.memory;
    // Clean view has no upload, staging allocation, nor barrier.
    cache.RefreshContents(image,0);
    assert(cache.runtime.allocations==0 && cache.tracked==0);
    // CPU writes: a real image revision must reach staging and the GPU image
    // before the barrier announces that the revision is visible to sampling.
    Changed(image);
    cache.runtime.expected=Data(m,image.gpu_addr);
    cache.RefreshContents(image,0);
    assert(image.device_bytes==cache.runtime.expected);
    assert(image.uploads==1 && cache.runtime.barriers==1);
    assert(cache.runtime.allocations==1 && cache.tracked==1);
    assert(False(image.flags & ImageFlagBits::CpuModified));
    cache.RefreshContents(image,0);
    assert(image.uploads==1);
    // Later CPU content must replace the old texture instead of reusing a
    // previously valid TIC/view with stale bytes.
    for(unsigned i=0;i<64;++i)m.bytes[image.gpu_addr+i]=static_cast<u8>(0x90+i);
    Changed(image);
    cache.runtime.expected=Data(m,image.gpu_addr);
    cache.RefreshContents(image,0);
    assert(image.uploads==2 && cache.runtime.barriers==2);
    assert(cache.runtime.allocations==2 && cache.tracked==2);
    // Converted texture path must upload *converted* data, not original guest bytes.
    for(unsigned i=0;i<64;++i)m.bytes[image.gpu_addr+i]=static_cast<u8>(0x20+i);
    Changed(image);
    image.flags.bits|=static_cast<unsigned>(ImageFlagBits::Converted);
    cache.runtime.expected=Data(m,image.gpu_addr,true);
    cache.RefreshContents(image,0);
    assert(image.uploads==3 && cache.runtime.barriers==3);
    assert(image.device_bytes==cache.runtime.expected);
    image.flags.bits&=~static_cast<unsigned>(ImageFlagBits::Converted);
    // Accelerated upload must receive the source payload and publish it before barrier.
    for(unsigned i=0;i<64;++i)m.bytes[image.gpu_addr+i]=static_cast<u8>(0x40+i);
    Changed(image);
    image.flags.bits|=static_cast<unsigned>(ImageFlagBits::AcceleratedUpload);
    cache.runtime.expected=Data(m,image.gpu_addr);
    cache.RefreshContents(image,0);
    assert(cache.runtime.accelerated==1 && m.read_calls==1);
    assert(image.uploads==4 && cache.runtime.barriers==4);
    // Deferred async image has no immediate barrier or staging reuse.
    image.flags.bits&=~static_cast<unsigned>(ImageFlagBits::AcceleratedUpload);
    image.flags.bits|=static_cast<unsigned>(ImageFlagBits::AsynchronousDecode);
    Changed(image);
    cache.RefreshContents(image,0);
    assert(cache.async_decode==1 && image.uploads==4);
    assert(cache.runtime.barriers==4 && cache.runtime.allocations==4);
    // An older async job owns this texture. A new guest CPU revision must
    // stay dirty and must not queue a competing stale decode.
    image.flags |= ImageFlagBits::IsDecoding;
    Changed(image);
    const unsigned queued_before=cache.async_decode;
    const unsigned tracked_before=cache.tracked;
    cache.RefreshContents(image,0);
    assert(cache.async_decode==queued_before);
    assert(cache.tracked==tracked_before);
    assert(True(image.flags & ImageFlagBits::CpuModified));
    // After that job completes, the pending revision can be admitted.
    image.flags.bits&=~static_cast<unsigned>(ImageFlagBits::IsDecoding);
    cache.RefreshContents(image,0);
    assert(cache.async_decode==queued_before+1);
    assert(False(image.flags & ImageFlagBits::CpuModified));
    image.flags.bits&=~static_cast<unsigned>(ImageFlagBits::AsynchronousDecode);
    // Unsupported MSAA uploads must transition without pretending pixels changed.
    image.info.num_samples=4;
    cache.runtime.can_upload_msaa=false;
    Changed(image);
    cache.RefreshContents(image,0);
    assert(cache.runtime.transitions==1 && image.uploads==4);
    assert(cache.runtime.barriers==4 && cache.runtime.allocations==4);
    // Failure registering a CPU revision must not hide it from a later upload.
    image.info.num_samples=1;
    Changed(image);
    cache.fail_track=true;
    bool threw=false;
    try { cache.RefreshContents(image,0); }
    catch(const std::runtime_error&) { threw=true; }
    assert(threw && True(image.flags & ImageFlagBits::CpuModified));
    assert(False(image.flags & ImageFlagBits::Tracked));
    assert(image.uploads==4 && cache.runtime.barriers==4);
    cache.fail_track=false;
    cache.runtime.expected=Data(m,image.gpu_addr);
    cache.RefreshContents(image,0);
    assert(image.uploads==5 && cache.runtime.barriers==5);
    assert(False(image.flags & ImageFlagBits::CpuModified));
    for(unsigned i=0;i<64;++i)m.bytes[image.gpu_addr+i]=static_cast<u8>(0x60+i);
    Changed(image);
    cache.runtime.expected=Data(m,image.gpu_addr);
    cache.runtime.reject_staging=true;
    const auto before_uploads=image.uploads;
    const auto before_barriers=cache.runtime.barriers;
    cache.RefreshContents(image,0);
    assert(image.uploads==before_uploads && cache.runtime.barriers==before_barriers);
    assert(True(image.flags & ImageFlagBits::CpuModified));
    assert(False(image.flags & ImageFlagBits::Tracked));
    cache.runtime.reject_staging=false;
    cache.RefreshContents(image,0);
    assert(image.uploads==6 && cache.runtime.barriers==6);
    assert(image.device_bytes==cache.runtime.expected);
    assert(False(image.flags & ImageFlagBits::CpuModified));
    for(unsigned i=0;i<64;++i)m.bytes[image.gpu_addr+i]=static_cast<u8>(0x70+i);
    Changed(image);
    cache.runtime.expected=Data(m,image.gpu_addr);
    cache.runtime.short_staging=true;
    const auto prior_uploads=image.uploads;
    const auto prior_barriers=cache.runtime.barriers;
    cache.RefreshContents(image,0);
    assert(image.uploads==prior_uploads && cache.runtime.barriers==prior_barriers);
    assert(True(image.flags & ImageFlagBits::CpuModified));
    assert(False(image.flags & ImageFlagBits::Tracked));
    cache.runtime.short_staging=false;

    // texture. The guest revision must remain dirty until the next attempt.
    for(unsigned i=0;i<64;++i)m.bytes[image.gpu_addr+i]=static_cast<u8>(0x80+i);

    const auto before_null_barriers=cache.runtime.barriers;

    assert(True(image.flags & ImageFlagBits::CpuModified));
    assert(False(image.flags & ImageFlagBits::Tracked));

    assert(image.uploads==8 && cache.runtime.barriers==8);

constexpr u32 VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED=~u32{0};
constexpr u32 VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED=0;
constexpr u32 VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL=1;
constexpr u32 VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL=2;
constexpr u32 VK_ACCESS_SHADER_WRITE_BIT=1<<0;
constexpr u32 VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT=1<<1;
constexpr u32 VK_ACCESS_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT=1<<2;
constexpr u32 VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT=1<<3;
constexpr u32 VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT=1<<4;
constexpr u32 VK_ACCESS_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT=1<<5;
constexpr u32 VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT=1<<6;
constexpr u32 VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT=1<<7;
constexpr u32 VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_VERTEX_SHADER_BIT=1<<0;
constexpr u32 VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_FRAGMENT_SHADER_BIT=1<<1;
constexpr u32 VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_EARLY_FRAGMENT_TESTS_BIT=1<<2;
constexpr u32 VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_LATE_FRAGMENT_TESTS_BIT=1<<3;
constexpr u32 VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT=1<<4;
constexpr u32 VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COMPUTE_SHADER_BIT=1<<5;
constexpr u32 VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT=1<<6;
struct VkImageSubresourceLayers {
    u32 aspectMask{},mipLevel{},baseArrayLayer{},layerCount{};
};
struct VkImageSubresourceRange {
    u32 aspectMask{},baseMipLevel{},levelCount{},baseArrayLayer{},layerCount{};
};
struct VkBufferImageCopy {VkImageSubresourceLayers imageSubresource{};};
struct VkImageMemoryBarrier {
    u32 sType{};
    const void* pNext{};
    u32 srcAccessMask{},dstAccessMask{};
    VkImageLayout oldLayout{},newLayout{};
    u32 srcQueueFamilyIndex{},dstQueueFamilyIndex{};
    VkImage image{};
    VkImageSubresourceRange subresourceRange{};
};
struct Trace {
    u32 pre_src{},pre_dst{},post_src{},post_dst{};
    VkImageMemoryBarrier pre{},post{};
    std::vector<int> order;
    unsigned copies{}, regions{};
    VkBuffer buffer{};VkImage image{};
};
namespace vk {
struct CommandBuffer {
    Trace* trace{};
    void PipelineBarrier(u32 src,u32 dst,u32,
                         const VkImageMemoryBarrier& barrier) {
        assert(trace && trace->order.empty());
        trace->pre_src=src;trace->pre_dst=dst;
        trace->pre=barrier;trace->order.push_back(1);
    }
    void CopyBufferToImage(VkBuffer buffer,VkImage image,u32 layout,
                           std::span<const VkBufferImageCopy> copies) {
        assert(trace && trace->order.size()==1);
        assert(layout==VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL);
        trace->copies++;trace->regions+=static_cast<unsigned>(copies.size());
        trace->buffer=buffer;trace->image=image;trace->order.push_back(2);
    }
    void PipelineBarrier(u32 src,u32 dst,u32,std::nullptr_t,std::nullptr_t,
                         const VkImageMemoryBarrier& barrier) {
        assert(trace && trace->order.size()==2);
        trace->post_src=src;trace->post_dst=dst;
        trace->post=barrier;trace->order.push_back(3);
    }
};
}
__SOURCE__
static void Check(bool initialized){
    Trace result{};
    constexpr VkImage image=19;
    constexpr VkBuffer buffer=88;
    constexpr VkImageAspectFlags aspect=3;
    const std::array<VkBufferImageCopy,2> copies{{
        {{aspect,2,4,2}},
        {{aspect,3,6,1}}
    }};
    CopyBufferToImage(vk::CommandBuffer{&result},buffer,image,aspect,initialized,copies);
    assert((result.order==std::vector<int>{1,2,3}));

    assert(result.pre.newLayout==VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL);
    assert(result.post.oldLayout==VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL);

    assert((result.post_dst&VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_VERTEX_SHADER_BIT)!=0);
    assert((result.post_dst&VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_FRAGMENT_SHADER_BIT)!=0);

    assert((result.post_dst&VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT)!=0);

def method(text, sig):
    assert text.count(sig) == 1, sig
    begin = text.index(sig)
    brace = text.index("{", begin)
    depth = 0
    for end in range(brace, len(text)):
        if text[end] == "{": depth += 1
        elif text[end] == "}":
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0: return text[begin:end + 1]
    raise AssertionError(sig)

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <chrono>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <memory>

using s32 = std::int32_t;
using s64 = std::int64_t;
namespace Kernel {
struct KernelCore {};
struct KEvent {
    std::atomic<int> signals{};
    void Signal(KernelCore&) { signals.fetch_add(1); }
};
}
namespace Service::android {
enum class Status { NoError, InvalidOperation, NoBufferAvailable, PresentLater };
enum class BufferState {Free, Queued, Acquired};
struct GraphicBuffer { int id{}; };
struct BufferItem {
    s32 slot{};
    std::shared_ptr<GraphicBuffer> graphic_buffer{};
    bool is_auto_timestamp{};
    s64 timestamp{};
    bool acquire_called{};
};
struct BufferSlot {
    BufferState buffer_state{BufferState::Free};
    bool acquire_called{};
    bool needs_cleanup_on_release{};
    std::shared_ptr<GraphicBuffer> graphic_buffer{};
};
struct IProducerListener {
    virtual ~IProducerListener() = default;
    virtual void OnBufferReleased() = 0;
};
struct BufferQueueCore {
    std::mutex mutex{};
    std::array<BufferSlot, 4> slots{};
    std::vector<BufferItem> queue{};
    int max_acquired_buffer_count{};
    std::shared_ptr<IProducerListener> connected_producer_listener{};
    std::atomic<int> broadcasts{};
    bool StillTracking(const BufferItem& item) const {
        return slots[item.slot].graphic_buffer == item.graphic_buffer
            && item.graphic_buffer != nullptr;
    }
    void SignalDequeueCondition() { broadcasts.fetch_add(1); }
};
struct BufferQueueConsumer {
    std::shared_ptr<BufferQueueCore> core;
    std::array<BufferSlot,4>& slots;
    explicit BufferQueueConsumer(std::shared_ptr<BufferQueueCore> c)
        : core(std::move(c)), slots(core->slots) {}
    Status AcquireBuffer(BufferItem* out_buffer, std::chrono::nanoseconds expected_present);
};
__WAKE__
__ACQUIRE__
struct Delegate final : IProducerListener {
    BufferQueueCore& core;
    int callbacks{};
    bool unlocked{true};
    explicit Delegate(BufferQueueCore& c):core(c){}
    void OnBufferReleased() override {
        if (core.mutex.try_lock()) core.mutex.unlock();
        else unlocked = false;
        ++callbacks;
    }
};
}
int main() {
    using namespace Service::android;
    Kernel::KernelCore kernel;
    Kernel::KEvent event;
    auto core=std::make_shared<BufferQueueCore>();
    auto wake=std::make_shared<ProducerReleaseWake>(&event,kernel);
    auto delegate=std::make_shared<Delegate>(*core);
    wake->SetDelegate(delegate);
    core->connected_producer_listener=wake;
    BufferQueueConsumer c(core);
    // A deadline-aware acquire skips two queued frames and retains the last.
    for (int frame=0; frame<260; ++frame) {
        core->queue.clear();
        for (int slot=0;slot<3;++slot) {
            auto b=std::make_shared<GraphicBuffer>(GraphicBuffer{frame*3+slot});
            core->slots[slot].graphic_buffer=b;
            core->slots[slot].buffer_state=BufferState::Queued;
            core->slots[slot].acquire_called=false;
            core->queue.push_back(BufferItem{slot,b,false,1'500'000'000LL+slot*200'000'000LL,false});
        }
        BufferItem out{};
        assert(c.AcquireBuffer(&out,std::chrono::nanoseconds{2'000'000'000})==Status::NoError);
        assert(out.slot==2 && out.graphic_buffer->id==frame*3+2);
        assert(core->queue.empty());
        assert(core->slots[0].buffer_state==BufferState::Free);
        assert(core->slots[1].buffer_state==BufferState::Free);
        assert(core->slots[2].buffer_state==BufferState::Acquired);
        assert(core->broadcasts.load()==frame+1 && event.signals.load()==frame+1);
    }
    assert(delegate->callbacks==260 && delegate->unlocked);
    // Normal single acquire does NOT fabricate a producer-release event.
    core->slots[2].buffer_state=BufferState::Free;
    core->queue.push_back(BufferItem{2,core->slots[2].graphic_buffer,false,1'800'000'000,false});
    BufferItem out{};
    assert(c.AcquireBuffer(&out,std::chrono::nanoseconds{2'000'000'000})==Status::NoError);
    assert(event.signals.load()==260);
    // Deferred frame causes no release callback when nothing was dropped.
    core->slots[2].buffer_state=BufferState::Free;
    core->queue.push_back(BufferItem{2,core->slots[2].graphic_buffer,false,2'500'000'000,false});
    assert(c.AcquireBuffer(&out,std::chrono::nanoseconds{2'000'000'000})==Status::PresentLater);
    assert(event.signals.load()==260);
    core->slots[2].buffer_state=BufferState::Acquired;
    assert(c.AcquireBuffer(&out,std::chrono::nanoseconds{2'000'000'000})==Status::InvalidOperation);
    assert(event.signals.load()==260);
    // A removed entry whose buffer no longer matches its slot did not
    // free a tracked producer slot. Wake host dequeuers for queue progress,
    // but do not fabricate a guest Binder release notification.
    core->queue.clear();
    core->slots[2].buffer_state=BufferState::Free;
    auto old_slot_buffer=std::make_shared<GraphicBuffer>(GraphicBuffer{9000});
    auto untracked_buffer=std::make_shared<GraphicBuffer>(GraphicBuffer{9001});
    auto live_buffer=std::make_shared<GraphicBuffer>(GraphicBuffer{9002});
    core->slots[0].graphic_buffer=old_slot_buffer;
    core->slots[0].buffer_state=BufferState::Queued;
    core->slots[1].graphic_buffer=live_buffer;
    core->slots[1].buffer_state=BufferState::Queued;
    core->queue.push_back(BufferItem{0,untracked_buffer,false,1'500'000'000,false});
    core->queue.push_back(BufferItem{1,live_buffer,false,1'700'000'000,false});
    assert(c.AcquireBuffer(&out,std::chrono::nanoseconds{2'000'000'000})==Status::NoError);
    assert(out.slot==1 && core->queue.empty());
    assert(core->slots[0].buffer_state==BufferState::Queued);
    assert(core->slots[1].buffer_state==BufferState::Acquired);
    assert(core->broadcasts.load()==262);
    assert(event.signals.load()==260 && delegate->callbacks==260);
    wake->Stop();
    std::puts("F05_NATIVE_ACQUIRE_DROP_GUEST_WAKE_PASS frames=260 stale_drops=520 "
              "guest_event=260 callbacks_unlocked=1 normal_acquire_quiet=1 "
              "present_later_quiet=1 invalid_quiet=1 untracked_release_quiet=1 "
              "scope=source_extracted_mock_kernel");
}

# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
"""F05: source-extracted IHOSBinderDriver GetNativeHandle -> producer KEvent.

Executes real Binder IPC handler, BufferQueueProducer::GetNativeHandle and
ProducerReleaseWake C++ against a mock service registry, handle copy and
KReadableEvent. Validates handle identity, rejected IDs, level coalescing,

def method(src,signature):
    assert src.count(signature)==1,("source drift",signature)
    at=src.index(signature)
    opening=src.index("{",at)
    depth=0
    for i in range(opening,len(src)):
        if src[i]=="{":depth+=1
        elif src[i]=="}":
            depth-=1
            if depth==0:return src[at:i+1]
    raise AssertionError("unbalanced source "+signature)

#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
#include <unordered_map>
using s32=std::int32_t;
using u32=std::uint32_t;
enum class Result{Success,Unknown};
constexpr Result ResultUnknown=Result::Unknown;
#define R_UNLESS(expr,code) if(!(expr)) return code
#define R_SUCCEED() return Result::Success
#define LOG_DEBUG(...) ((void)0)
namespace Kernel {
struct KernelCore{};
class KReadableEvent {
 bool signaled{};
public:
 unsigned transitions{};
 unsigned resets{};
 void Signal(KernelCore&) {
  if(!signaled){signaled=true;++transitions;}
 }
 bool IsSignaled()const{return signaled;}
 void Reset(){assert(signaled);signaled=false;++resets;}
};
class KEvent {
 KReadableEvent readable{};
public:
 KReadableEvent& GetReadableEvent(){return readable;}
 void Signal(KernelCore& k){readable.Signal(k);}
};
}
template<typename T>struct OutCopyHandle {
 T** output{};
 T*& operator*(){assert(output);return *output;}
};
namespace Service::android {
class IBinder {
public:
 virtual ~IBinder()=default;
 virtual Kernel::KReadableEvent* GetNativeHandle(u32)=0;
};
class IProducerListener{
public:
 virtual ~IProducerListener()=default;
 virtual void OnBufferReleased()=0;
};
class BufferQueueProducer final : public IBinder {
public:
 Kernel::KEvent* buffer_wait_event{};
 unsigned handle_requests{};
 explicit BufferQueueProducer(Kernel::KEvent* e):buffer_wait_event(e){}
 Kernel::KReadableEvent* GetNativeHandle(u32 type_id) override;
};
__NATIVE_PRODUCER__
__NATIVE_WAKE__
}
namespace Service::Nvnflinger {
struct HosBinderDriverServer {
 std::unordered_map<s32,std::shared_ptr<Service::android::IBinder>> table{};
 unsigned lookups{};
 std::shared_ptr<Service::android::IBinder> TryGetBinder(s32 id) {
  ++lookups;
  const auto it=table.find(id);
  return it==table.end()?nullptr:it->second;
 }
};
class IHOSBinderDriver {
 std::shared_ptr<HosBinderDriverServer> m_server;
public:
 explicit IHOSBinderDriver(std::shared_ptr<HosBinderDriverServer> s):m_server(std::move(s)){}
 Result GetNativeHandle(s32,u32,OutCopyHandle<Kernel::KReadableEvent>);
};
__NATIVE_IPC__
}
int main() {
 Kernel::KernelCore kernel;
 Kernel::KEvent event;
 auto server=std::make_shared<Service::Nvnflinger::HosBinderDriverServer>();
 auto producer=std::make_shared<Service::android::BufferQueueProducer>(&event);
 server->table.emplace(77,producer);
 Service::Nvnflinger::IHOSBinderDriver ipc{server};
 Kernel::KReadableEvent* guest_handle=nullptr;
 OutCopyHandle<Kernel::KReadableEvent> copy{&guest_handle};
 assert(ipc.GetNativeHandle(66,0,copy)==Result::Unknown);
 assert(guest_handle==nullptr && server->lookups==1);
 assert(ipc.GetNativeHandle(77,0,copy)==Result::Success);
 assert(guest_handle==&event.GetReadableEvent());
 auto wake=std::make_shared<Service::android::ProducerReleaseWake>(&event,kernel);
 // Guest obtains its copy handle before producer->consumer releases frames.
 for(int i=0;i<260;++i) {
  assert(!guest_handle->IsSignaled());
  wake->OnBufferReleased();
  assert(guest_handle->IsSignaled());
  wake->OnBufferReleased();
  assert(guest_handle->transitions==static_cast<unsigned>(i+1));
  guest_handle->Reset();
 }

 assert(guest_handle->transitions==260);
 Kernel::KReadableEvent* second_handle=nullptr;
 OutCopyHandle<Kernel::KReadableEvent> second{&second_handle};
 assert(ipc.GetNativeHandle(77,1,second)==Result::Success);
 assert(second_handle==guest_handle);
 // Handle copies reference the same level-triggered kernel object.
 wake->OnBufferReleased();
 assert(second_handle->IsSignaled() && guest_handle->IsSignaled());
 second_handle->Reset();
 wake->Stop();
 wake->OnBufferReleased();
 assert(!guest_handle->IsSignaled());

  Kernel::KSynchronizationObject* wait_hud_objects[]{&readable};

  Kernel::KSynchronizationObject::ThreadListNode hud_node{nullptr,&guest_hud};

      hud_wait(kernel,wait_hud_objects,&hud_node,1);

No actual HID/IPC, guest scheduling, Vulkan GPU/WSI, game or console proof.

def native(text,signature):
    assert text.count(signature)==1,("source drift",signature)
    start=text.index(signature)
    brace=text.index("{",start)
    depth=0
    for i in range(brace,len(text)):
        if text[i]=="{":depth+=1
        if text[i]=="}":
            depth-=1
            if depth==0:return text[start:i+1]
    raise AssertionError("unbalanced source "+signature)

def fixture(path):
    parsed=ast.parse((ROOT/path).read_text())
    matches=[ast.literal_eval(node.value) for node in parsed.body
             if isinstance(node,ast.Assign)
             and any(isinstance(t,ast.Name) and t.id=="cpp" for t in node.targets)
             and isinstance(node.value,ast.Constant)
             and isinstance(node.value.value,str)]
    assert len(matches)==1,(path,len(matches))
    return matches[0]

def once(text,old,new,label):
    assert text.count(old)==1,(label,text.count(old))
    return text.replace(old,new)

static std::unique_ptr<PresentManager> pipeline_present;

    assert(pipeline_present && pipeline_renderer);

    pipeline_expected.emplace_back(g,h);
    Deliver(*pipeline_renderer,g,h);

extern "C" void F05PipeDrain(unsigned expected_count) {
    assert(pipeline_present && pipeline_renderer);
    pipeline_present->WaitPresent();
    assert(pipeline_expected.size()==expected_count);
    if(pipeline_present->presented!=pipeline_expected) {
        const auto& observed=pipeline_present->presented;
        const auto& expected=pipeline_expected;
        std::size_t first=0;
        while(first<observed.size() && first<expected.size() &&
              observed[first]==expected[first])++first;
        auto og=first<observed.size()?observed[first].first:0;
        auto oh=first<observed.size()?observed[first].second:0;
        auto eg=first<expected.size()?expected[first].first:0;
        auto eh=first<expected.size()?expected[first].second:0;

            "F05_NATIVE_PRESENT_MISMATCH expected_count=%zu actual_count=%zu "
            "first=%zu expected_game=%u expected_hud=%u "

            expected.size(),observed.size(),first,eg,eh,og,oh);
        assert(false && "guest layers and Vulkan-present image revisions diverged");

    assert(pipeline_present->copies==expected_count);
    assert(pipeline_renderer->render_window.displayed==expected_count);

"""F05: source-extracted QueueBuffer replacement frees tracked slot, wakes guest.

Runs the actual selected producer's queue replacement and notification block.
Mock core/event and consumer, not guest IPC, GPU or FC27 timing.

def queue_method(text):
    a = "Status BufferQueueProducer::QueueBuffer("
    b = "\nvoid BufferQueueProducer::CancelBuffer("
    assert text.count(a) == 1 and text.count(b) == 1
    return text[text.index(a):text.index(b,text.index(a))]

active = queue_method(PRODUCER)
pinned = queue_method(PINNED)

cpp=r"""
#include <array>
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
#include <vector>
using u64=std::uint64_t;
enum class BufferState {Free,Queued,Acquired};
struct GraphicBuffer{int id{};};
struct BufferItem{
    int slot{};
    std::shared_ptr<GraphicBuffer> graphic_buffer{};
    u64 frame_number{};
    bool is_droppable{};
};
struct Slot{
    BufferState buffer_state{BufferState::Free};
    u64 frame_number{};
    u64 queue_time{},presentation_time{};
    std::shared_ptr<GraphicBuffer> graphic_buffer{};
};
struct IConsumerListener{};
// Host lock-state model: try_lock on a nonrecursive std::mutex already
// owned by this thread would be UB, so use a tracked atomic lock instead.
struct TrackedMutex {
    std::atomic<bool> held{};
    void lock() {
        bool expected=false;
        assert(held.compare_exchange_strong(expected,true));
    }
    void unlock() { assert(held.exchange(false)); }
    bool try_lock() {
        bool expected=false;
        return held.compare_exchange_strong(expected,true);
    }
};
struct Core {
    TrackedMutex mutex{};
    std::array<Slot,4> slots{};
    std::vector<BufferItem> queue{};
    std::shared_ptr<IConsumerListener> consumer_listener{};
    u64 frame_counter{};
    bool buffer_has_been_queued{};
    std::atomic<int> host_wakes{};
    bool StillTracking(const BufferItem& item)const{
        return item.slot>=0 && item.slot<4 &&
            slots[item.slot].graphic_buffer!=nullptr &&
            slots[item.slot].graphic_buffer==item.graphic_buffer;
    }
    void UpdateHistory(u64,BufferState){}
    void PushHistory(u64,u64,u64,BufferState){}
    void SignalDequeueCondition(){host_wakes.fetch_add(1);}
};
struct Kernel{};
struct Event{
    Core* core{};
    std::atomic<int> guest_wakes{};
    void Signal(Kernel&){
        // This is the critical lock-order regression witness. Guest kernel
        // wake must never be published while BufferQueue mutex is held.
        assert(core->mutex.try_lock());
        core->mutex.unlock();
        guest_wakes.fetch_add(1);
    }
};
struct ServiceContext{Kernel kernel{};};
struct Harness{
    Core core_data{};
    Core* core{&core_data};
    std::array<Slot,4>& slots{core_data.slots};
    ServiceContext service_context{};
    Event event{&core_data};
    Event* buffer_wait_event{&event};
    void Publish(BufferItem item, int slot, bool record_buffer_history=false){
        std::shared_ptr<IConsumerListener> listener_available;
        std::shared_ptr<IConsumerListener> listener_replaced;
        bool recycled_queued_slot=false;
        {
            std::scoped_lock lock{core->mutex};
__PUBLISH__
        }
__WAKE__
        (void)listener_available;(void)listener_replaced;
    }
};
int main(){
    Harness h;
    auto old=std::make_shared<GraphicBuffer>(GraphicBuffer{100});
    auto new_buffer=std::make_shared<GraphicBuffer>(GraphicBuffer{101});
    h.slots[0].graphic_buffer=old;
    h.slots[0].buffer_state=BufferState::Queued;
    h.Publish(BufferItem{0,old,1,false},0);
    assert(h.core->queue.size()==1 && h.event.guest_wakes.load()==0);
    h.Publish(BufferItem{1,new_buffer,2,false},1);
    assert(h.core->queue.size()==2 && h.event.guest_wakes.load()==0);
    h.core->queue.clear();
    h.core->queue.push_back(BufferItem{0,old,1,true});
    h.Publish(BufferItem{1,new_buffer,3,false},1);
    assert(h.core->queue.size()==1 && h.core->queue.front().graphic_buffer==new_buffer);
    assert(h.slots[0].buffer_state==BufferState::Free);
    assert(h.event.guest_wakes.load()==1);
    // A queued frame no longer tracked in slots may be replaced, but it
    // cannot create a new reusable slot or a spurious guest wake.
    h.core->queue.clear();
    h.core->queue.push_back(BufferItem{0,old,4,true});
    h.slots[0].graphic_buffer=std::make_shared<GraphicBuffer>(GraphicBuffer{404});
    h.Publish(BufferItem{1,new_buffer,5,false},1);
    assert(h.event.guest_wakes.load()==1);
    // One guest event per freed queued slot even under frame replacement
    // bursts. The non-droppable path remains a normal queue append.
    for(int cycle=0;cycle<260;++cycle){
        h.core->queue.clear();
        h.slots[0].graphic_buffer=old;
        h.slots[0].buffer_state=BufferState::Queued;
        h.core->queue.push_back(BufferItem{0,old,(u64)cycle,true});
        h.Publish(BufferItem{1,new_buffer,(u64)cycle+1,false},1);
        assert(h.core->queue.size()==1 && h.slots[0].buffer_state==BufferState::Free);
    }
    assert(h.event.guest_wakes.load()==261);
    assert(h.core->host_wakes.load()==264);
    std::puts("F05_NATIVE_QUEUE_REPLACEMENT_GUEST_WAKE_PASS replacements=260 "
              "tracked_release_signal=1 untracked_quiet=1 regular_enqueue_quiet=1 "
              "callback_unlocked=1 scope=source_extracted_mock_guest_event");
}
""".replace("__PUBLISH__",segment).replace("__WAKE__",wake)
compiler=shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
assert compiler,"host C++20 compiler required"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-f05-queue-replace-") as tmp:
