```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
"""F05: real producer-release callback body -> mock guest kernel event, O0/O2.

The native listener and registration/consumer-release handoff are selected from
the shipping vendored sources. This does not emulate guest HIPC parcels, the
guest CPU scheduler, a real kernel wait, or FC27 itself.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PRODUCER = (ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/core/hle/service/nvnflinger/buffer_queue_producer.cpp").read_text()
CONSUMER = (ROOT / "vendor/sources/eden/src/core/hle/service/nvnflinger/buffer_queue_consumer.cpp").read_text()
CMAKE = (ROOT / "headless/CMakeLists.txt").read_text()
assert 'vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/core/hle/service/nvnflinger/buffer_queue_producer.cpp' in CMAKE
assert 'core->connected_producer_listener = wake;' in PRODUCER
assert 'wake->SetDelegate(listener);' in PRODUCER
assert 'listener = core->connected_producer_listener;' in CONSUMER
assert 'listener->OnBufferReleased();' in CONSUMER
assert 'return &buffer_wait_event->GetReadableEvent();' in PRODUCER
assert PRODUCER.index('if (wake) wake->Stop();') < PRODUCER.index('service_context.CloseEvent(buffer_wait_event);')
assert 'release_wakes.erase(it);' in PRODUCER

signature = "class ProducerReleaseWake final : public IProducerListener {"
assert PRODUCER.count(signature) == 1, "native release callback signature drift"
start = PRODUCER.index(signature)
end = PRODUCER.index("\n};", start) + len("\n};")
native_class = PRODUCER[start:end]
assert 'event->Signal(kernel);' in native_class
assert 'if (forward) forward->OnBufferReleased();' in native_class

cpp = r"""
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdio>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>
namespace Kernel {
struct KernelCore {};
struct KEvent {
    std::atomic<int> signals{0};
    std::atomic<bool> closed{false};
    void Signal(KernelCore&) {
        assert(!closed.load());
        signals.fetch_add(1);
    }
};
}
namespace Service::android {
class IProducerListener {
public:
    virtual ~IProducerListener() = default;
    virtual void OnBufferReleased() = 0;
};
__NATIVE_LISTENER__
struct Forward : IProducerListener {
    std::atomic<int> notified{0};
    void OnBufferReleased() override { notified.fetch_add(1); }
};
}
int main() {
    using namespace Service::android;
    Kernel::KernelCore kernel;
    Kernel::KEvent event;
    auto wake = std::make_shared<ProducerReleaseWake>(&event, kernel);
    auto delegate = std::make_shared<Forward>();
    wake->SetDelegate(delegate);
    for (int i=0; i<260; ++i) wake->OnBufferReleased();
    assert(event.signals.load() == 260);
    assert(delegate->notified.load() == 260);
    // The consumer callback must not recur into itself when wrapped.
    wake->SetDelegate(wake);
    wake->OnBufferReleased();
    assert(event.signals.load() == 261);
    assert(delegate->notified.load() == 260);
    wake->SetDelegate(delegate);

    // Race a copied consumer callback against producer destruction.
    std::atomic<int> attempted{0};
    std::thread consumer([&] {
        for (int i=0; i<30000; ++i) {
            attempted.fetch_add(1);
            wake->OnBufferReleased();
            if ((i % 64) == 0) std::this_thread::yield();
        }
    });
    while (attempted.load() < 100) std::this_thread::yield();
    wake->Stop();
    event.closed.store(true);
    consumer.join();

    // Once Stop returns, no callback is permitted to touch a closed event.
    const int sealed = event.signals.load();
    wake->OnBufferReleased();
    assert(event.signals.load() == sealed);
    assert(delegate->notified.load() <= sealed);
    std::printf("F05_PRODUCER_RELEASE_WAKE_HOST_PASS initial=260 forwarded=260 "
                "stop_before_close=1 concurrent_release=1 "
                "scope=source_extracted_listener_mock_guest_kernel_event\n");
}
""".replace("__NATIVE_LISTENER__", native_class)

compiler = shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
assert compiler, "C++20 compiler required"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-f05-release-wake-") as tmp:
    source = Path(tmp) / "release.cpp"
    source.write_text(cpp)
    for mode in ("-O0", "-O2"):
        output = Path(tmp) / ("release" + mode)
        build = subprocess.run(
            [compiler, "-std=c++20", mode, "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror",
             "-fsanitize=undefined", "-fno-sanitize-recover=all", "-pthread",
             str(source), "-o", str(output)],
            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=90)
        assert build.returncode == 0, (mode, build.stderr[-6000:])
        run = subprocess.run([str(output)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
        assert run.returncode == 0, (mode, run.stderr[-6000:], run.stdout)
        assert run.stdout.count("F05_PRODUCER_RELEASE_WAKE_HOST_PASS initial=260") == 1
        print(run.stdout.strip(), mode, flush=True)
print("F05_GUEST_IPC_SCHEDULING_AND_REAL_GAME_PROGRESS_NOT_PROVEN")
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
"""F06: one linked host executable, shipping PS5 pad -> guest Npad LIFO.

The source-selected native methods are compiled in TWO independent C++
translation units. A deliberately narrow fixture-only adapter forwards
virtual A/Plus edges into the mock emulated-controller state; this does NOT
claim production InputCommon wiring, guest HIPC reads, saved game actions
or real FC27 phase execution. No runtime input or game settings are changed.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PAD_FIXTURE = ROOT / "tools/check-fc27-f06-native-pad-transition-host.py"
NPAD_FIXTURE = ROOT / "tools/check-fc27-f06-native-npad-lifo-host.py"


def replace_once(source: str, old: str, new: str) -> str:
    count = source.count(old)
    assert count == 1, ("source fixture drift", old[:90], count)
    return source.replace(old, new, 1)


with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-f06-linked-") as tmp:
    folder = Path(tmp)
    pad_src, npad_src = folder / "pad.cpp", folder / "npad.cpp"
    for fixture, target in ((PAD_FIXTURE, pad_src), (NPAD_FIXTURE, npad_src)):
        run = subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, "-B", str(fixture), "--emit-cpp", str(target)],
            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60,
        )
        assert run.returncode == 0 and target.is_file(), (
            fixture.name, run.stderr[-4000:]
        )

    pad = pad_src.read_text()
    npad = npad_src.read_text()
    for method in ("void Pad::Consume(", "void PadEngine::SetButtonState("):
        assert method in pad, ("shipping pad source missing", method)
    for method in ("EmulatedController::GetNpadButtons()",
                   "NPad::RequestPadStateUpdate(", "NPad::OnUpdate("):
        assert method in npad, ("shipping npad source missing", method)

    # The adapter is injected only into the compiled test fixture's sink.
    # It is NEVER applied to headless/pad.cpp or the emulator's shipping HID.
    pad = replace_once(
        pad, "namespace Eden {",
        'extern "C" void F06_ForwardButton(int button, bool pressed);\n'
        'extern "C" void F06_PublishAndAssert(bool a, bool plus);\n'
        "namespace Eden {",
    )
    pad = replace_once(
        pad, "if(value) ++rises[player][button];",
        "if(value) ++rises[player][button];\n"
        "        if (player == 0) F06_ForwardButton(button, value);",
    )
    pad = replace_once(
        pad, "int main() {", 'extern "C" void F06_RunPadJourney() {',
    )
    pad = replace_once(
        pad, "using V = InputCommon::VirtualGamepad::VirtualButton;",
        "using V = InputCommon::VirtualGamepad::VirtualButton;\n"
        "    static_assert(static_cast<int>(V::ButtonA) == 0);\n"
        "    static_assert(static_cast<int>(V::ButtonPlus) == 10);",
    )
    pad = replace_once(
        pad, "pad.Consume({&state,1});",
        "pad.Consume({&state,1});\n"
        "        F06_PublishAndAssert(pad.engine->Get(V::ButtonA), "
        "pad.engine->Get(V::ButtonPlus));",
    )
    # The exported source has its standalone main replaced, not duplicated.
    npad = npad[:npad.index("\nint main() {")] + r"""
static Kernel::KernelCore f06_kernel{};
static Core::Timing::CoreTiming f06_timing{};
static Core::HID::EmulatedController f06_controller{};
static Service::HID::NPad f06_npad{};
static unsigned f06_guest_samples = 0;

extern "C" void F06_ForwardButton(int button, bool pressed) {
    using Core::HID::NpadButton;
    // The synthetic InputCommon handoff is intentionally explicit and
    // asserts that the originating virtual enum values have not shifted.
    NpadButton mapped = NpadButton::None;
    if (button == 0) mapped = NpadButton::A;
    if (button == 10) mapped = NpadButton::Plus;
    if (mapped == NpadButton::None) return;
    auto& raw = f06_controller.controller.npad_button_state.raw;
    const auto bits = static_cast<u64>(raw);
    const auto target = static_cast<u64>(mapped);
    raw = static_cast<NpadButton>(pressed ? (bits | target) : (bits & ~target));
}
extern "C" void F06_PublishAndAssert(bool expect_a, bool expect_plus) {
    using Core::HID::NpadButton;
    // The exact native NPad::OnUpdate() -> RequestPadStateUpdate()
    // -> GetNpadButtons() -> guest shared LIFO is exercised here.
    f06_npad.controller_data[0][0].device = &f06_controller;
    auto& guest = f06_npad.data.shared_memory_format
                  ->npad.npad_entry[0].internal_state;
    const int before = guest.fullkey_lifo.writes;
    f06_npad.OnUpdate(f06_kernel, f06_timing);
    assert(guest.fullkey_lifo.writes == before + 1);
    assert(guest.system_ext_lifo.writes == before + 1);
    const auto pad = guest.fullkey_lifo.ReadCurrentEntry().state;
    const auto system = guest.system_ext_lifo.ReadCurrentEntry().state;
    assert(pad.sampling_number == static_cast<u64>(before + 1));
    assert(system.sampling_number == pad.sampling_number);
    assert(system.npad_buttons.raw == pad.npad_buttons.raw);
    assert(((pad.npad_buttons.raw & NpadButton::A) != NpadButton::None)
           == expect_a);
    assert(((pad.npad_buttons.raw & NpadButton::Plus) != NpadButton::None)
           == expect_plus);
    ++f06_guest_samples;
}
extern "C" void F06_RunPadJourney();
int main() {
    F06_RunPadJourney();
    assert(f06_guest_samples >= 60);
    const auto& guest = f06_npad.data.shared_memory_format
                        ->npad.npad_entry[0].internal_state;
    assert(guest.fullkey_lifo.writes == static_cast<int>(f06_guest_samples));
    assert(guest.system_ext_lifo.writes == static_cast<int>(f06_guest_samples));
    std::printf("F06_NATIVE_PAD_NPAD_LIFO_BOUNDARY_PASS phases=5 "
                "samples=%u linked=1 mapping_locked=1 plus_release=1 "
                "scope=source_extracted_host_mock_virtual_bridge_no_real_guest_hipc\n",
                f06_guest_samples);
}
"""
    pad_src.write_text(pad)
    npad_src.write_text(npad)
    compiler = (shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++")
                or shutil.which("g++"))
    assert compiler, "A C++20 compiler is required"
    for mode in ("-O0", "-O2"):
        exe = folder / ("f06" + mode)
        build = subprocess.run(
            [compiler, "-std=c++20", mode, "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror",
             "-Wno-unused-parameter", "-fsanitize=undefined",
             "-fno-sanitize-recover=all", "-I", str(ROOT / "headless"),
             "-I", str(ROOT / "third_party"), str(pad_src), str(npad_src),
             "-o", str(exe)],
            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120,
        )
        assert build.returncode == 0, (mode, build.stderr[-8000:])
        run = subprocess.run(
            [str(exe)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=45,
        )
        assert run.returncode == 0, (mode, run.stderr[-8000:], run.stdout)
        assert run.stdout.count(
            "F06_NATIVE_PAD_NPAD_LIFO_BOUNDARY_PASS phases=5"
        ) == 1
        print(run.stdout.strip(), mode, flush=True)
print("F06_REAL_GAME_ACTION_MAPPING_HIPC_AND_FC27_PHASES_NOT_PROVEN")
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
"""F06: source-extracted DualSense -> virtual guest button transitions, O0/O2.

Execute shipping Pad::Consume and PadEngine::SetButtonState, not a rewritten
input map. Model title-controlled pause/half-time/end as repeated input phases;
no FC27 guest action save, HIPC consumption or console behavior is claimed.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PAD = (ROOT / "headless/pad.cpp").read_text()
HEADER = (ROOT / "headless/devices.h").read_text()
CMAKE = (ROOT / "headless/CMakeLists.txt").read_text()
assert "pad.cpp" in CMAKE
assert "void Consume(std::size_t player, std::span<const ps5::pad::Data> samples);" in HEADER

assert "const auto& active_mapping = ActiveMapping();" in PAD
assert "if (pad == pad_touchpad) continue;" in PAD
assert "constexpr unsigned kSelectTapPolls = 25;" in PAD
assert "constexpr unsigned kSelectHoldPolls = 60;" in PAD

def extract(signature: str) -> str:
    assert PAD.count(signature) == 1, ("native source drift", signature)
    start = PAD.index(signature)
    opening = PAD.index("{", start)
    depth = 0
    for end in range(opening, len(PAD)):
        if PAD[end] == "{":
            depth += 1
        elif PAD[end] == "}":
            depth -= 1
            if not depth:
                return PAD[start:end + 1]
    raise AssertionError("unbalanced native method " + signature)

consume_source = extract("void Pad::Consume(std::size_t player, std::span<const ps5::pad::Data> samples) {")
# Inverse 12-button scans are resolved before the sample loop; a session
# mapping cannot change while guest HID is open.
assert consume_source.count("MappedTo(active_mapping, pad_touchpad)") == 1
assert consume_source.count("MappedTo(active_mapping, pad_create)") == 1
assert consume_source.index("const int touch_button =") < consume_source.index("for (const auto& raw : samples)")
assert consume_source.index("const bool create_is_capture =") < consume_source.index("for (const auto& raw : samples)")

assert "std::array<bool, 256> trigger_pressed{};" in HEADER

assert "const auto axis = [this](u8 raw) { return stick_curve[raw]; };" in consume_source

curve_anchor = "    for (std::size_t raw = 0; raw < stick_curve.size(); ++raw) {"

native_methods = "\n\n".join(extract(signature) for signature in (
    "void PadEngine::SetButtonState(std::size_t player, int button, bool value) {",
    "void PadEngine::SetButtonState(std::size_t player, VirtualButton button, bool value) {",
    "void Pad::Consume(std::size_t player, std::span<const ps5::pad::Data> samples) {",
))

cpp = r"""
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <atomic>
#include <bit>
#include <cassert>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <memory>
#include <numbers>
#include <span>
#include <utility>
#include "button_mapping.h"
#include "ps5_guest_system_button_route.h"
#include "in_game_overlay.h"
#include "ps5_pad.hpp"
using u8 = std::uint8_t;
using u32 = std::uint32_t;
using u64 = std::uint64_t;
constexpr int kRightSL = 20;
constexpr int kRightSR = 21;
constexpr unsigned kSelectTapPolls = 25;
constexpr unsigned kSelectHoldPolls = 60;
namespace NativeLogs { inline bool Detailed() { return false; } }
namespace InputCommon {
struct VirtualGamepad {
    enum class VirtualButton {
        ButtonA, ButtonB, ButtonX, ButtonY, StickL, StickR, TriggerL,
        TriggerR, TriggerZL, TriggerZR, ButtonPlus, ButtonMinus, ButtonLeft,
        ButtonUp, ButtonRight, ButtonDown, ButtonSL, ButtonSR, ButtonHome,
        ButtonCapture
    };
};
}
namespace Eden {
struct EdgeDiagnostics { void Observe(...) {} };
class PadEngine {
public:
    using VirtualButton = InputCommon::VirtualGamepad::VirtualButton;
    static constexpr std::size_t kPlayers = 10;
    static constexpr int kTrackedButtons = 22;
    std::array<std::array<u8,kTrackedButtons>,kPlayers> button_cache{};
    std::array<std::array<bool,kTrackedButtons>,kPlayers> values{};
    std::array<std::array<unsigned,kTrackedButtons>,kPlayers> writes{};
    std::array<std::array<unsigned,kTrackedButtons>,kPlayers> rises{};
    std::atomic<unsigned long long> published_plus_edges{0};
    std::atomic<unsigned long long> published_home_edges{0};
    std::atomic<unsigned long long> published_capture_edges{0};
    PadEngine() { for(auto& b:button_cache) b.fill(2); }
    std::size_t Identifier(std::size_t player) const { return player; }
    void SetButton(std::size_t player,int button,bool value) {
        assert(player < kPlayers && button >= 0 && button < kTrackedButtons);
        values[player][button] = value;
        ++writes[player][button];
        if(value) ++rises[player][button];
    }
    void SetButtonState(std::size_t player,int button,bool value);
    void SetButtonState(std::size_t player,VirtualButton button,bool value);
    void SetStickPosition(std::size_t,int,float,float) {}
    void SetMotionAtRest(std::size_t) {}
    void SetMotionState(std::size_t,u64,float,float,float,float,float,float) {}
    bool Get(VirtualButton button) const {
        return values[0][static_cast<int>(button)];
    }
    unsigned Rising(VirtualButton button) const {
        return rises[0][static_cast<int>(button)];
    }
    unsigned Writes(VirtualButton button) const {
        return writes[0][static_cast<int>(button)];
    }
};
class Pad {
public:
    struct Slot {
        int user{-1};
        int handle{-1};
        u32 last_buttons{};
        u64 last_motion_us{};
        bool touch_chord{};
        GuestSystemButtonRoute guest_home{};
        bool select_held{};
        unsigned touch_polls{};
        unsigned select_pulse{};
    };
    std::shared_ptr<PadEngine> engine=std::make_shared<PadEngine>();
    std::array<Slot,4> slots{};
    ButtonMapping mapping=kDefaultMapping;
    float deadzone{0.08f},trigger_threshold{0.5f};
    std::array<float,256> stick_curve{};
    std::array<bool,256> trigger_pressed{};
    void RebuildCurve() {
__NATIVE_STICK_CURVE__
    }
    void RebuildTriggerLookup() {
__NATIVE_TRIGGER_LOOKUP__
    }
    Pad() { RebuildCurve(); RebuildTriggerLookup(); }
    bool return_to_menu{};
    std::atomic<bool> overlay_enabled{false};
    std::atomic<bool> overlay_open{false};
    std::atomic<std::uint32_t> overlay_actions{0};
    u64 options_edges{},create_edges{};
    EdgeDiagnostics face_edges{};
    const ButtonMapping& ActiveMapping() const noexcept {return mapping;}
    void SetMapping(const ButtonMapping& value) {
        if(slots[0].handle>=0) return;
        mapping=ValidMapping(value)?value:kDefaultMapping;
    }
    void Consume(std::size_t player,std::span<const ps5::pad::Data> samples);
    void Consume(std::span<const ps5::pad::Data> samples) {Consume(0,samples);}
};
__NATIVE_METHODS__
} // namespace Eden

int main() {
    using namespace Eden;
    using namespace ps5::pad;
    using V = InputCommon::VirtualGamepad::VirtualButton;
    Pad pad;
    // Exhaustive byte-for-byte equivalence with the old normalization,
    // including boundaries, midrange deadzones and extreme valid values.
    for (const float dz : {0.0f, 0.08f, 0.25f, 0.5f, 0.999f}) {
        Pad curve_pad;
        curve_pad.deadzone = dz;
        curve_pad.RebuildCurve();
        for (int byte = 0; byte < 256; ++byte) {
            const float x = (byte - 128) / (byte < 128 ? 128.0f : 127.0f);
            const float expected = std::abs(x) <= dz ? 0.0f :
                std::copysign((std::abs(x) - dz) / (1.0f - dz), x);
            assert(std::bit_cast<std::uint32_t>(curve_pad.stick_curve[byte]) ==
                   std::bit_cast<std::uint32_t>(expected));
        }
    }
    assert(pad.stick_curve[0] == -1.0f && pad.stick_curve[255] == 1.0f);
    assert(pad.stick_curve[128] == 0.0f);
    // Preserve every trigger byte's original floating-point comparison
    // for five legal calibration thresholds, including the extreme ends.
    for (const float threshold : {0.001f, 0.1f, 0.5f, 0.999f, 1.0f}) {
        Pad trigger_pad;
        trigger_pad.trigger_threshold = threshold;
        trigger_pad.RebuildTriggerLookup();
        for (int byte = 0; byte < 256; ++byte) {
            const bool expected = static_cast<float>(byte) / 255.0f >= threshold;
            assert(trigger_pad.trigger_pressed[byte] == expected);
        }
    }
    assert(!pad.trigger_pressed[127] && pad.trigger_pressed[128]);
    // A physical Circle now presses guest A; physical Cross presses guest B.
    const auto custom=Assign(kPlayStationMapping,game_a,pad_circle);
    assert(ValidMapping(custom));
    pad.SetMapping(custom);
    assert(pad.ActiveMapping()==custom);
    // Session lock cannot change gameplay mapping during the match.
    pad.slots[0].handle=3;
    pad.SetMapping(kSwitchMapping);
    assert(pad.ActiveMapping()==custom);
    u64 time=0;
    const auto step=[&](ButtonMask buttons, bool connected=true) {
        auto state=neutral_data(++time*4000);
        state.connected=connected?1:0;
        state.buttons=buttons;
        pad.Consume({&state,1});
    };
    // Five real input phases: no emulator-injected gameplay-style remap.
    for(const char* phase : {"kickoff","pause","half-time","resume","end"}) {

    assert(pad.overlay_open.load());
    assert(!pad.engine->Get(V::ButtonMinus));
    step(kButtonDown);

    assert((pad.overlay_actions.exchange(0) & QuickOverlay::down) != 0);
    step(kButtonTouchPad);
```

```py
def alpha_selector(method_name, support):

    return selected + "    const bool enable = pipeline != nullptr && pipeline->"+support+"();\n"
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Statically verify generic account/BSD/address HLE patches for every game.

Does NOT build, link, invoke CI or change the pinned Eden source/cache.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shlex
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PIN = (ROOT / '.local/headless-cache').read_text().strip() if (ROOT / '.local/headless-cache').exists() else ''
PATCH = ROOT / 'headless/backports/eden-fc27-hle-compat.patch'
assert PATCH.is_file()
source = Path(PIN) / 'source' if PIN else None
if source is None or not (source / 'GIT-COMMIT').exists():
    print('Universal HLE patch static markers only (no local pinned Eden source)')
    s = PATCH.read_text()
    for term in ('LoadOpenContext', 'Ioctl', 'guest_addrin.len', 'Errno::INVAL'):
        assert term in s, term
    assert s.count('+    write_buffer.resize(guest_addrin.len);') == 2
    # No `GetSockNameImpl` declaration is added by the patch: it modifies the
    # two existing handlers. Earlier CI incorrectly required this absent marker.
    print('Universal account/BSD/sockaddr patch markers: PASS')
    sys.exit(0)
assert (source / 'GIT-COMMIT').read_text().strip() == '5f142c7926d0c7fcbbd0ce30794d72f638a43b2a'
need = ('src/core/hle/service/acc/acc.h', 'src/core/hle/service/acc/acc.cpp',
        'src/core/hle/service/sockets/bsd.h', 'src/core/hle/service/sockets/bsd.cpp')
with TemporaryDirectory(prefix='encore-fc27-hle-') as temp:
    t = Path(temp)
    for rel in need:
        dest = t / rel
        dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copy2(source / rel, dest)
    subprocess.run(['git', 'apply', '--check', str(PATCH)], cwd=t, check=True)
    subprocess.run(['git', 'apply', str(PATCH)], cwd=t, check=True)
    acc = (t / need[1]).read_text()
    bsd = (t / need[3]).read_text()
    assert '{130, &ACC_U0::LoadOpenContext, "LoadOpenContext"}' in acc
    assert '{19, &BSD_USA::Ioctl, "Ioctl"}' in bsd
    assert bsd.count('write_buffer.resize(guest_addrin.len);') == 2
    for rel in (need[1], need[3]):
        assert (t / rel).stat().st_size > 0
    print('FC27 HLE pinned-source patch dry-run: 4/4 files PASS')
    if '--syntax' not in sys.argv:
        sys.exit(0)
    db = Path(PIN) / 'native-local/compile_commands.json'
    assert db.is_file(), f'Native compile DB unavailable: {db}'
    entries = json.loads(db.read_text())
    compiled = 0
    for rel in (need[1], need[3]):
        match = [entry for entry in entries if entry['file'].endswith('/' + rel)]
        assert len(match) == 1, (rel, len(match))
        cmd = shlex.split(match[0]['command'])
        filename = match[0]['file']
        assert cmd[0].endswith('clang++') or cmd[0].endswith('clang++-18'), cmd[0]
        opts=[]
        i=1
        while i < len(cmd):
            part=cmd[i]
            if part in ('-o','-MF','-MT','-MQ'):
                i+=2; continue
            if part in ('-c', '-MD', '-MMD', '-MP'):
                i+=1;continue
            if part == filename:
                i+=1;continue
            opts.append(part)
            i+=1
        args = [cmd[0], '-fsyntax-only', '-Werror', '-I' + str(t / 'src')]
        # Native DB was generated by an older CMake/LLVM combination. Its
        # '-Wno-error-all' is not an LLVM 18 warning group. Drop only that
        # unsupported compatibility flag; keep all PS5 target and include flags.
        args.extend(x for x in opts if x != '-Wno-error-all')
        args.append(str(t / rel))
        env = os.environ.copy()
        env.setdefault('SDKROOT', '/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX26.5.sdk')
        print('Checking PS5 C++ syntax:',rel, flush=True)
        subprocess.run(args, cwd=match[0]['directory'], env=env, check=True)
        compiled+=1
    print(f'FC27 HLE PS5 compiler syntax: {compiled}/{compiled} PASS (no build/link)')
```

```py
No emulator, synthetic screenshots, firmware, network or console required.

UNPROVEN_EXIT_EVIDENCE = {
    "F01-cache-contention": "same-workload contention/critical-section latency before-after, native selection",
    "F02-jit-invalidation": "per-core cold/repeat compilation and invalidation before-after, native selection",
    "F03-hud-freshness": "TIC/TSC -> view -> descriptor -> barrier -> present freshness replay",
    "F04-texture-integrity": "alias/remap -> DMA/upload -> byte-content integrity replay",

    # F01 is the first PRE-CONSOLE technical exit with its full source
    # A/B criterion: native selection, guarded allocation, equivalent sampler
    # results, same-draw critical-section timing under a competing mutex.
    # This does not certify any game-level improvement, which requires PS5.
    f01_technical_exit = (
        all(item["ok"] for item in status["F01-cache-contention"]) and
        "F01_payload_allocation_host_mock" in fixture_metrics and

        "F01_native_lock_budget_host" in fixture_metrics

    # before/after lock ownership. These are HOST technical proofs only:
    # guest translation cost and real PS5 performance remain unmeasured.

        all(item["ok"] for item in status["F02-jit-invalidation"]) and
        "F02_native_invalidation_lock_host" in fixture_metrics and
        "F02_cold_repeat_source_host" in fixture_metrics
    )
    # F03: technical HOST exit requires both selected TIC->feedback and
    # 240 ordinary frames plus a recovered frame in ONE C++ replay, with
    # unique HUD revisions, pause, remap and transient resource disappearance. Real pixels/device scanout are
    # still outside the pre-console evidence and must not be certified.
    f03_technical_exit = (
        all(item["ok"] for item in status["F03-hud-freshness"]) and
        "F03_tic_descriptor_feedback_host" in fixture_metrics and
        "F03_texture_to_present_host" in fixture_metrics
    )
    # F04 technical PRE-CONSOLE exit requires ONE real-source C++ replay
    # connecting cache map loss -> DMA -> invalidation -> alias -> staging,
    # as well as standalone Vulkan barrier/copy ownership regression checks.
    # The GPU address translation after unmap and device execution are mocked
    # and explicitly belong to F07, not this host technical certificate.
    f04_technical_exit = (
        f03_technical_exit and
        all(item["ok"] for item in status["F04-texture-integrity"]) and
        "F04_native_remap_dma_upload_host" in fixture_metrics
    )
    # F05 requires the linked end-to-end *source-host* replay, not merely
    # 14 independent green fixtures. Every Binder-forwarded frame must have
    # completed native consumer release -> KThread EndWait first. The actual
    # guest scheduler, HIPC packets and PS5 GPU still belong to F07.
    f05_technical_exit = (
        f04_technical_exit and
        all(item["ok"] for item in status["F05-guest-progress"]) and
        "F05_native_kthread_endwait_host" in fixture_metrics and
        "F05_binder_native_handle_ipc_host" in fixture_metrics and
        "F05_native_release_to_present_boundary_host" in fixture_metrics and
        "F05_linked_nvdisp_host1x_vulkan_present_host" in fixture_metrics
    )
    # F06 completes only the pre-console source-host linkage. Its phases are
    # synthetic: guest action settings, HIPC and a real FC27 match remain F07.
    f06_technical_exit = (
        f05_technical_exit and
        all(item["ok"] for item in status["F06-input-and-pause"]) and
        "F06_native_pad_transitions_host" in fixture_metrics and
        "F06_native_npad_handoff_host" in fixture_metrics and
        "F06_guest_lifo_publication_host" in fixture_metrics and
        "F06_pad_to_npad_lifo_boundary_host" in fixture_metrics
    )
    preconsole_exits = {
        "F01-cache-contention": bool(f01_technical_exit),
        "F02-jit-invalidation": bool(f02_technical_exit),
        "F03-hud-freshness": bool(f03_technical_exit),
        "F04-texture-integrity": bool(f04_technical_exit),
        "F05-guest-progress": bool(f05_technical_exit),
        "F06-input-and-pause": bool(f06_technical_exit),
    }
    remaining_exit_evidence = dict(UNPROVEN_EXIT_EVIDENCE)
    if f01_technical_exit:
        remaining_exit_evidence.pop("F01-cache-contention")
    if f02_technical_exit:
        remaining_exit_evidence.pop("F02-jit-invalidation")
    if f03_technical_exit:
        remaining_exit_evidence.pop("F03-hud-freshness")
    if f04_technical_exit:
        remaining_exit_evidence.pop("F04-texture-integrity")
    if f05_technical_exit:
        remaining_exit_evidence.pop("F05-guest-progress")
    if f06_technical_exit:
        remaining_exit_evidence.pop("F06-input-and-pause")
    summary = {"scope": "PRECONSOLE_HOST_TECHNICAL_NOT_GAMEPLAY",
               "f01_to_f06_closed": sum(preconsole_exits.values()),
               "preconsole_exit_status": preconsole_exits,
               "console_qualified": False, "gameplay_qualified": False,
               "host_subpaths_passed": sum(c["ok"] for cs in status.values() for c in cs),
               "host_subpaths_total": sum(len(cs) for cs in status.values()),
               "fixture_metrics": fixture_metrics,
               "unproven_exit_evidence": remaining_exit_evidence,
               "gates": status}
    print("FC27_SIX_GATES_HOST_CHECKPOINT=" +
          json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=True, separators=(",", ":")), flush=True)
    table = ["## FC27 F01-F06 — host checkpoint (NOT gameplay qualification)",
             "| Criterion | Source-derived witnesses |", "| --- | --- |"]
    for gate, checks in status.items():
        label = "PASS" if all(x["ok"] for x in checks) else "FAIL"
        table.append(f"| {gate} | {label} ({sum(x['ok'] for x in checks)}/{len(checks)}) |")
    table += ["", f"{sum(preconsole_exits.values())}/6 PRE-CONSOLE technical "
                    "exits verified on host (each requires native-source metrics); "
                    "this is NOT console or FC27 in-game certification.",
              "", "#### Critical unproven exit evidence"]
    for gate, missing in remaining_exit_evidence.items():
        table.append(f"- {gate}: {missing}")
    if "F01_payload_allocation_host_mock" in fixture_metrics:
        m = fixture_metrics["F01_payload_allocation_host_mock"]
        table += ["", f"F01 guarded first-use allocator fixture: "
                       f"{m['prior_locked_allocator_attempts']} attempted allocation "
                       f"under the cache pair without preflight vs "
                       f"{m['maintained_locked_allocator_attempts']} with preflight; "
                       "NOT elapsed mutex contention time."]
    if "F01_sampler_lookup_host_mock" in fixture_metrics:
        m = fixture_metrics["F01_sampler_lookup_host_mock"]
        table += ["", f"Measured narrow F01 fixture: {m['reference_calls']} direct "
                       f"sampler lookups vs {m['maintained_calls']} maintained "
                       f"lookups on {m['descriptors']} descriptors; "
                       "NOT a lock-time or FPS improvement."]
    if target := os.environ.get("GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"):
        with open(target, "a", encoding="utf-8") as output:
            output.write("\n".join(table) + "\n")
    return int(any(not x["ok"] for checks in status.values() for x in checks))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(run())
```

`tools/check-fc27-stutter-regimes.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Reproduce two independent FC27 failures from anonymized telemetry.

This is a *regression classifier and model sanity check*, not an emulator, nor
proof that changing GPU queue depth, mutex choice, JIT cache, or clocks fixes
the game. All guest buffer-mutex measurements are per-window sums across
threads, not a per-frame causal trace. No source, saves or console are read.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
from collections import Counter
import json
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import median

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
FIXTURE=ROOT/"tools/fixtures/fc27-2efd8b3c-stutter-windows.json"
STAGES=(("startup",0,6000),("gameplay",6000,32000),("still_presentation",32000,10**18))
FIELDS=("total","frames","seconds","fps","worst_ms","late50","late100",
        "late200","late500","cache_wait_ms","cache_contended","jit_ms",
        "guest_ipc_ms","guest_dequeue_ms","gpu_idle_ms","gpu_dispatch_ms",
        "gpu_fence_ms","gpu_full_ms","cache_buffer_wait_ms","cache_texture_wait_ms")

def load(path:Path)->list[dict[str,float]]:
    data=json.loads(path.read_text())
    assert data["source_sha"]=="2efd8b3c96608667a2b22f1751eed1a475091cce"
    assert data["fields"]==list(FIELDS)
    rows=[dict(zip(FIELDS,row,strict=True)) for row in data["rows"]]
    assert len(rows)==415 and rows[0]["total"]==130 and rows[-1]["total"]==60955
    assert all(b["total"]>a["total"] for a,b in zip(rows,rows[1:]))
    assert all(row["frames"]>0 and row["seconds"]>0 and
               row["worst_ms"]>=0 and row["late50"]>=row["late100"]>=
               row["late200"]>=row["late500"]>=0 for row in rows)
    return rows

def status(rows:list[dict])->dict:
    long50=sum(row["late50"] for row in rows)
    long500=sum(row["late500"] for row in rows)
    worst=max(row["worst_ms"] for row in rows)
    return {
        "late50_frames":round(long50),
        "late500_frames":round(long500),
        "worst_ms":round(worst,1),
        "stutter_sla":"FAIL" if long50>0 or worst>50 else "PASS",
        "gpu_queue_pressure_windows":sum(row["gpu_full_ms"]>0.01 for row in rows),
    }

def grouped(rows:list[dict])->dict:
    d={}
    for name,low,high in STAGES:
        subset=[v for v in rows if low<v["total"]<=high]
        assert subset
        def med(k):
            return round(median(x[k] for x in subset),3)
        d[name]={
            "windows":len(subset),
            "late50":round(sum(r["late50"] for r in subset)),
            "late500":round(sum(r["late500"] for r in subset)),
            "median_jit_ms_per_window":med("jit_ms"),
            "median_cache_wait_ms_per_window":med("cache_wait_ms"),
            "median_buffer_wait_ms_per_window":med("cache_buffer_wait_ms"),
            "median_gpu_idle_ms_per_window":med("gpu_idle_ms"),
        }
    return d

def bottleneck_signals(rows: list[dict]) -> dict:
    """Report independent observational signals, never frame-causality.

    Per-window jit_ms sums CPU work across multiple cores. cache_wait_ms
    sums blocked threads; neither may be equated to the worst present gap.
    Thresholds are triage bins, not prescriptions for JIT or GPU tuning.
    """
    near30 = [r for r in rows if r["fps"] >= 29.9]
    slow = [r for r in rows if r["fps"] < 25]
    extreme = [r for r in rows if r["worst_ms"] >= 500]
    high_jit = [r for r in rows if r["jit_ms"] >= 500]
    high_cache = [r for r in rows if r["cache_wait_ms"] >= 100]
    extreme_jit = [r for r in extreme if r["jit_ms"] >= 500]
    extreme_without_high_jit = [r for r in extreme if r["jit_ms"] < 500]
    assert len(rows) > 0
    return {
        "windows": len(rows),
        "near30_windows": len(near30),
        "near30_late50": round(sum(r["late50"] for r in near30)),
        "below25_windows": len(slow),
        "below25_late50": round(sum(r["late50"] for r in slow)),
        "high_jit_windows": len(high_jit),
        "high_cache_wait_windows": len(high_cache),
        "extreme_ge500ms_windows": len(extreme),
        "extreme_with_jit_ge500ms": len(extreme_jit),
        "extreme_without_jit_ge500ms": len(extreme_without_high_jit),
        "extreme_without_jit_ge500ms_frames": [
            round(r["total"]) for r in extreme_without_high_jit
        ],
        "gpu_queue_full_windows": sum(r["gpu_full_ms"] > 0.01 for r in rows),
        "proof_level": "five_second_association_only_not_frame_cause",
    }


def synthetic_progress_pause(ms:int,compositor_fps:int=30)->dict:
    """A deterministic counterexample: GPU can present stale images smoothly.

    The guest produces unique images at 30Hz. Its producer is paused 750ms
    around 1 second, whereas the compositor continues at 30Hz with the last
    buffer. No real frame arrival times or firmware behavior are asserted.
    """
    duration_ms=3000.0
    step=1000.0/compositor_fps
    produced_ms=0.0
    last_unique=-1
    repeated=0
    max_content_age=0.0
    frame_count=0
    t=0.0
    while t<duration_ms-0.001:
        # During the guest-side pause no new content is produced.
        if not (1000<=t<1000+ms):
            produced_ms=t
            last_unique=frame_count
        else:
            repeated+=1
        max_content_age=max(max_content_age,t-produced_ms)
        frame_count+=1
        t=frame_count*step
    return {"compositor_fps":compositor_fps,
            "compositor_late50":0,
            "guest_paused_ms":ms,
            "content_repeat_frames":repeated,
            "max_content_age_ms":round(max_content_age,1),
            "gpu_queue_pressure":0}

def self_test(rows):
    t=status(rows)
    stage=grouped(rows)
    assert t["stutter_sla"]=="FAIL"
    assert (t["late50_frames"],t["late500_frames"])==(858,10)
    assert t["worst_ms"]==1288.1
    assert t["gpu_queue_pressure_windows"]==0
    assert [stage[k]["windows"] for k,_,_ in STAGES]==[42,180,193]
    assert [stage[k]["late50"] for k,_,_ in STAGES]==[109,679,70]
    assert [stage[k]["late500"] for k,_,_ in STAGES]==[7,3,0]
    # A GPU-only queue-size check incorrectly calls this real baseline clean.
    signals = bottleneck_signals(rows)
    assert (signals["near30_windows"], signals["near30_late50"]) == (341, 5)
    assert (signals["below25_windows"], signals["below25_late50"]) == (28, 668)
    assert (signals["high_jit_windows"], signals["high_cache_wait_windows"]) == (25, 17)
    assert (signals["extreme_ge500ms_windows"],
            signals["extreme_with_jit_ge500ms"],
            signals["extreme_without_jit_ge500ms"]) == (10, 8, 2)
    assert signals["extreme_without_jit_ge500ms_frames"] == [19562, 19633]
    assert signals["gpu_queue_full_windows"] == 0
    assert signals["proof_level"] == "five_second_association_only_not_frame_cause"
    # The classifier must still report structural populations for a clean
    # set of present intervals, not invent a successful JIT/cache fix.
    assert bottleneck_signals(rows)["extreme_ge500ms_windows"] == 10
    assert stage["gameplay"]["median_jit_ms_per_window"] < 50
    assert stage["gameplay"]["median_cache_wait_ms_per_window"] > 10
    # A true clean fixture must not get a false alarm.
    good=[{**r,"late50":0,"late100":0,"late200":0,"late500":0,
           "worst_ms":33.334} for r in rows]
    assert status(good)["stutter_sla"]=="PASS"
    # Both an explicit producer pause and a smooth compositor can coexist.
    model=synthetic_progress_pause(750)
    assert model["compositor_late50"]==0
    assert model["gpu_queue_pressure"]==0
    assert model["content_repeat_frames"]>=20
    assert model["max_content_age_ms"]>=700
    # Catch false positives where high compiler work is mistaken for lateness.
    high_jit=[{**r,"jit_ms":3000} for r in good]
    assert status(high_jit)["stutter_sla"]=="PASS"
    print("STUTTER_REGRESSION_PASS: real 415-window baseline correctly FAILS smoothness SLA")
    print("GUEST_PROGRESS_MODEL_PASS: 30fps presentation can repeat unchanged content")
    return t,stage,model

def main():
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument("--self-test",action="store_true")
    p.add_argument("--json",action="store_true")
    args=p.parse_args()
    rows=load(FIXTURE)
    if args.self_test:
        t,st,model=self_test(rows)
    else:
        t,st,model=status(rows),grouped(rows),synthetic_progress_pause(750)
    result={"source_sha":"2efd8b3c96608667a2b22f1751eed1a475091cce",
            "known_bad_telemetry":t,"stage_summary":st,
            "bottleneck_signals":bottleneck_signals(rows),
            "independent_guest_pause_simulation":model,
            "limitations":"Five-second sums cannot assign cause to individual frames. "
            "No recent build was measured on console. GPU queue and content "
            "freshness are independent axes."}
    if args.json:print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
    else:
        print("REAL_CAPTURE",t)
        for k,v in st.items():print("STAGE",k,v)
        print("BOTTLENECK_SIGNALS",bottleneck_signals(rows))
        print("SYNTHETIC_CONTENT_LIVENESS",model)
        print("NO_GAMEPLAY_FIX_CLAIMED")

if __name__=="__main__":
    main()
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Offline synthetic liveness analysis regression; never builds the PS5 app."""
from pathlib import Path
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

tool = Path(__file__).with_name("analyze-fc27-trace.py")
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-fc27-trace-") as work:
    path = Path(work) / "repro.log"
    lines = [
        "EDEN_GAME_FRAME frames=150 seconds=5.000000 fps=30.000 worst_ms=34.000 total=150",
        "EDEN_DEV_HLE service=sm: cmd=3 calls=10 ns=5000000",
        "EDEN_DEV_QUEUE idle_ns=1000000 dispatch_ns=1000000",
        "EDEN_GAME_FRAME frames=1 seconds=6.000000 fps=0.167 worst_ms=6000.000 total=151",
    ]
    for i, (pc, t) in enumerate([("124AA117A8", 1), ("124AA117A8", 12),
                                   ("124AA117A8", 24), ("124AA117B0", 25)]):
        lines.append(f"EDEN_PERF_CPU_POINT core=2 mono_ns={t*1000000000} "
                     f"cpu_ns={i*1000000000} pc={pc} svc=0")
    for i, t in enumerate((1, 12, 24)):
        lines.append(f"EDEN_PERF_CPU_POINT core=0 mono_ns={t*1000000000} "
                     f"cpu_ns={i*1000000000} pc={['100','101','102'][i]} svc=0")
    path.write_text("\n".join(lines))
    proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-B", str(tool), str(path), "--json"],
                          capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
    result = json.loads(proc.stdout)
    assert abs(result["mean_present_fps"] - 151 / 11) < 0.01
    assert len(result["long_present_gaps"]) == 1
    assert result["repeated_guest_pc_spans"][0]["core"] == "2"
    assert result["repeated_guest_pc_spans"][0]["guest_pc"] == "124aa117a8"
    assert result["repeated_guest_pc_spans"][0]["hypothesis"] == "busy_guest_loop"
    assert result["can_prove_gameplay_liveness"] is False
    assert result["present_jitter_intervals"]["over_38ms"] == 0
    assert result["min_window_present_fps"] == 0.167
    # In release, one inexpensive aggregate every five seconds is enough to
    # measure 4-6 FPS dribble dips without spam or gameplay log overhead.
    jitter = Path(work) / "jitter.log"
    jitter.write_text("EDEN_VULKAN_FRAME frames=126 seconds=5 fps=25.2 worst_ms=140 total=126 late38=15 late50=8 late100=2\n"
                      "EDEN_VULKAN_FRAME frames=149 seconds=5 fps=29.8 worst_ms=35 total=275 late38=0 late50=0 late100=0\n")
    jitter_result = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(
        [sys.executable, "-B", str(tool), str(jitter), "--json"], text=True))
    assert jitter_result["mean_present_fps"] == 27.5
    assert jitter_result["min_window_present_fps"] == 25.2
    assert jitter_result["present_jitter_intervals"] == {
        "over_38ms": 15, "over_50ms": 8, "over_100ms": 2}
    assert len(result["most_expensive_hle_samples"]) == 1
    assert result["queue_samples"][-1]["idle_ns"] == 1000000
    healthy = Path(work) / "quiet.log"
    healthy.write_text("EDEN_GAME_FRAME frames=150 seconds=5 fps=30 worst_ms=33 total=150\n")
    quiet_result = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(
        [sys.executable, "-B", str(tool), str(healthy), "--json"], text=True))
    assert not quiet_result["repeated_guest_pc_spans"]
    assert not quiet_result["long_present_gaps"]
    assert quiet_result["mean_present_fps"] == 30
    # A repeated guest PC without CPU-time progress is not sufficient to
    # diagnose a busy loop; it could be a legitimate wait or a bad clock.
    waiting = Path(work) / "waiting.log"
    waiting.write_text("\n".join(
        f"EDEN_PERF_CPU_POINT core=3 mono_ns={sec*1000000000} "
        "cpu_ns=1000000 pc=00ABCDEF svc=0" for sec in (1, 13, 25)))
    wait_result = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(
        [sys.executable, "-B", str(tool), str(waiting), "--json"], text=True))
    assert wait_result["repeated_guest_pc_spans"][0]["hypothesis"] == "wait_or_unknown"
    assert wait_result["mean_present_fps"] is None

print("FC27 presentation vs sampled-guest-PC offline diagnostics: PASS")
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""C++ sanitizer witness from the actual two maintained Fermi2D address blocks.

The pre-widening source stays immutable as a historical regression witness.
A successful host test does not prove PS5 execution or close GitHub CodeQL.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
engines = root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/video_core/engines"
pinned = (root / "vendor/sources/eden/src/video_core/engines/fermi_2d.cpp").read_text()

blocks = []
for name in ("fermi_2d_observed.cpp", "fermi_2d_experimental.cpp"):
    data = (engines / name).read_text()
    assert old not in data, ("unwidened CodeQL product", name)
    start = data.index("    const auto need_align_to_pitch =")
    stop = data.index("\n    memory_manager.FlushCaching();", start)
    snippet = data[start:stop]
    assert "bytes_per_pixel != 0 &&" in snippet
    assert "static_cast<u64>(config.src_x0) *" in snippet

    assert "x_offset > ~u64{0} - base_address" in snippet
    blocks.append(snippet)
assert blocks[0] == blocks[1], "default and optional Fermi protections diverged"

assert "python3 -B tools/check-fermi2d-address-widening-host.py" in workflow

cpp = r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>
using u32 = std::uint32_t;
using u64 = std::uint64_t;
using s32 = std::int32_t;
namespace Tegra::Engines {
struct Fermi2D { enum class MemoryLayout { Pitch, Block }; };
}
struct Surface {
    Tegra::Engines::Fermi2D::MemoryLayout linear;
    u32 width, pitch;
    u64 address;
    u32 addr_upper{}, addr_lower{};
    u64 Address() const { return (static_cast<u64>(addr_upper) << 32) | addr_lower; }
    explicit Surface(Tegra::Engines::Fermi2D::MemoryLayout layout, u32 w,
                     u32 p, u64 a) : linear(layout), width(w), pitch(p),
                                       address(a), addr_upper(u32(a >> 32)),
                                       addr_lower(u32(a)) {}
};
struct Config { s32 src_x0, src_x1; };
static unsigned rejected = 0;
void AssertFailSoftImpl() { ++rejected; }
void Apply(Surface& src, Config& config, u32 bytes_per_pixel) {
__SOURCE__
}
int main() {
    using Layout = Tegra::Engines::Fermi2D::MemoryLayout;
    {
        Surface src{Layout::Pitch, 1024, 32, 0xffffffffULL};
        Config c{16, 1024};
        Apply(src, c, 4);
        assert(rejected == 0);
        assert(src.Address() == 0x10000003fULL && src.width == 1008);
        assert(c.src_x0 == 0 && c.src_x1 == 1008);
    }
    {
        // Prior implicit 32-bit multiplication would wrap and lose upper bits.
        Surface src{Layout::Pitch, 2147483647u, 8, 0x1000};
        Config c{2147483646, 2147483647};
        Apply(src, c, 16);
        assert(rejected == 0);
        assert(src.Address() == 0x1000ULL +
               static_cast<u64>(2147483646ULL) * 16ULL);
        assert(src.width == 1u && c.src_x0 == 0 && c.src_x1 == 1);
    }
    {
        Surface src{Layout::Pitch, 1024, 32, std::numeric_limits<u64>::max()-20};
        Config c{16, 1024};
        const u64 original = src.Address();
        Apply(src, c, 4);
        assert(rejected == 1);
        assert(src.Address() == original && src.width == 1024);
        assert(c.src_x0 == 16 && c.src_x1 == 1024);
    }
    {
        // Zero block size cannot reach pitch division, even on a pitch surface.
        Surface src{Layout::Pitch, 1024, 32, 0x1000};
        Config c{16, 1024};
        Apply(src, c, 0);
        assert(rejected == 1 && src.Address() == 0x1000);
    }
    {
        Surface src{Layout::Pitch, 1024, 32, 0x1000};
        Config c{-1, 1024};
        Apply(src, c, 4);
        assert(rejected == 1 && src.Address() == 0x1000);
    }
    {
        Surface src{Layout::Block, 1024, 32, 0x1000};
        Config c{16, 1024};
        Apply(src, c, 4);
        assert(rejected == 1 && src.Address() == 0x1000);
    }
}
""".replace("__SOURCE__", blocks[0])
clang = shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++")
assert clang, "Clang required for the sanitizer witness"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-fermi2d-widening-") as tmp:
    source = Path(tmp) / "fermi2d-widening.cpp"
    output = Path(tmp) / "witness"
    source.write_text(cpp)
    subprocess.run(
        [clang, "-std=c++20", "-O1", "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror",
         "-fsanitize=address,undefined", "-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
         str(source), "-o", str(output)], check=True, timeout=45)
    subprocess.run([str(output)], check=True, timeout=20)
print("FERMI2D_ADDRESS_WIDENING_HOST_PASS variants=2 offset64=1 carry=1 "
      "large_product=1 address_wrap_rejected=1 zero_bpp=1 guards=2 sanitizer=1")
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Exercise the exact writable-root proof used before Encore touches persistent storage."""
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
header = root / "headless/filesystem_probe.h"
source = r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <string>
#include "filesystem_probe.h"

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    assert(argc == 2);
    namespace fs = std::filesystem;
    const fs::path base = argv[1];
    fs::create_directories(base);

    // Clean install: the root is created and the temporary proof file is removed.
    const fs::path clean = base / "clean";
    assert(Eden::ProbeWritableRoot(clean.string()));
    assert(fs::is_directory(clean));
    for (const auto& entry : fs::directory_iterator(clean))
        assert(entry.path().filename().string().find(".encore-access-probe-") != 0);

    // Existing real directory remains usable.
    assert(Eden::ProbeWritableRoot(clean.string()));

    // A regular file can never become a storage root.
    const fs::path file = base / "file";
    std::ofstream(file) << "x";
    assert(!Eden::ProbeWritableRoot(file.string()));

    // Never follow a symlink supplied as the root.
    const fs::path target = base / "target";
    fs::create_directories(target);
    const fs::path link = base / "link";
    std::error_code error;
    fs::create_directory_symlink(target, link, error);
    if (!error)
        assert(!Eden::ProbeWritableRoot(link.string()));
}
"""
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-fs-probe-") as tmp:
    tmp = Path(tmp)
    cpp = tmp / "probe.cpp"
    exe = tmp / "probe"
    cpp.write_text(source)
    subprocess.run([
        "clang++-18", "-std=c++20", "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror",
        "-I", str(root / "headless"), str(cpp), "-o", str(exe)
    ], check=True)
    subprocess.run([str(exe), str(tmp / "root")], check=True)

print("Filesystem root proof: create, write, cleanup and symlink rejection PASS")
```

```py
}
int main(int argc, char** argv) {

  assert(Eden::ResolveFirmwarePath(SwitchFamily::Switch1)==(r/"firmware").string());

  assert(Eden::ResolveFirmwarePath(SwitchFamily::Switch2)==(r/"firmware/ns2").string());

  fs::remove_all(r / "firmware/ns2");

  assert(Eden::ResolveFirmwarePath(SwitchFamily::Switch2)==(r/"switch2/firmware").string());

  assert(Eden::ResolveKeysPath(SwitchFamily::Switch2)==(r/"keys/switch2").string());
  fs::remove_all(r / "keys/ns1");
  fs::remove_all(r / "keys/switch2");
  put(r / "keys/prod.keys");
  assert(Eden::ResolveKeysPath(SwitchFamily::Switch1)==(r/"keys").string());
  assert(Eden::ResolveKeysPath(SwitchFamily::Switch2)==(r/"keys").string());
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compile native ZIP firmware importer, verify deflate/CRC, safe paths and no overwrite."""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
import zipfile

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
COMPILER=shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
assert COMPILER
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-firmware-auto-") as temp:
    root=Path(temp)
    fixture=root/"firmware.zip"
    with zipfile.ZipFile(fixture,"w",compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
        z.writestr("firmware/",b"")
        z.writestr("__MACOSX/._firmware",b"mac metadata")
        z.writestr("firmware/.ns2jb-firmware-dump.json",b'{"kind":"ns2jb-system-code-dump"}')
        z.writestr("firmware/firmware-dump-named.json",b'{"entries":[]}')
        z.writestr("firmware/ncm-system-programs.bin",b"fake-index")
        z.writestr("firmware/0400000000000019/main.npdm",b"META"+b"A"*4096)
        z.writestr("firmware/0400000000000019/main",b"NSO0"+b"B"*655360)
    # A valid central directory must not authorize an inconsistent LOCAL
    # entry or a payload that runs into the ZIP's own index.
    first_member="firmware/0400000000000019/main.npdm"
    with zipfile.ZipFile(fixture) as z:
        info=z.getinfo(first_member)
    original=fixture.read_bytes()
    # A legitimate ZIP comment may contain the four-byte EOCD marker.
    # The importer must continue to the real end record, not stop at the
    # decoy signature and reject the user's firmware archive.
    commented=root/"comment-with-eocd-marker.zip"
    commented.write_bytes(original)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(commented,"a") as z:
        z.comment=b"Firmware notes PK\x05\x06" + b"padding-"*8
    # Python's zipfile parser itself uses a last-signature heuristic and
    # cannot reopen this valid EOCD-comment fixture. The native importer
    # under test must select the real end record and verify all entries.
    local=info.header_offset
    assert original[local:local+4] == b"PK\x03\x04"
    name_offset=local+30
    wrong_name=bytearray(original)
    wrong_name[name_offset]=ord("x")
    local_name=root/"bad-local-name.zip"
    local_name.write_bytes(wrong_name)
    wrong_crc=bytearray(original)
    crc_offset=local+14
    wrong_crc[crc_offset] ^= 0x01
    local_crc=root/"bad-local-crc.zip"
    local_crc.write_bytes(wrong_crc)
    directory=original.find(b"PK\x01\x02")
    assert directory>local
    central_entry=original.find(first_member.encode(),directory)
    assert central_entry>=directory+46
    central_header=central_entry-46
    assert original[central_header:central_header+4] == b"PK\x01\x02"
    wrong_extent=bytearray(original)
    # ZIP32 central compressed-length field, little endian.
    wrong_extent[central_header+20:central_header+24]=(directory).to_bytes(4,"little")
    oversized=root/"bad-central-extent.zip"
    oversized.write_bytes(wrong_extent)
    bad=root/"bad.zip"
    with zipfile.ZipFile(bad,"w",compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
        z.writestr("../evil",b"should be rejected")
    cpp=root/"fixture.cpp"
    cpp.write_text(r"""
#include "firmware_zip_import.h"
#include <cassert>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <string>
int main(int argc,char**argv) {
    assert(argc==7);
    namespace fs=std::filesystem;
    const fs::path archive=argv[1], unsafe=argv[2], destination=argv[6];
    std::string reason;
    if (!Eden::FirmwareZip::Import(archive,destination,&reason)) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "ZIP_IMPORT_FAIL: %s\\n", reason.c_str());
        return 2;
    }
    assert(fs::is_regular_file(destination/"firmware/0400000000000019/main"));
    assert(fs::file_size(destination/"firmware/0400000000000019/main")==655364);
    assert(!fs::exists(destination/"__MACOSX"));
    assert(fs::is_regular_file(archive));
    assert(!Eden::FirmwareZip::Import(archive,destination,&reason));
    assert(!Eden::FirmwareZip::Import(unsafe,destination.parent_path()/"invalid",&reason));
    assert(!fs::exists(destination.parent_path()/"evil"));
    assert(!fs::exists(destination.parent_path()/"invalid"));
    for (int i=3;i<6;++i) {
        const fs::path rejected=destination.parent_path()/
            ("rejected-"+std::to_string(i));
        assert(!Eden::FirmwareZip::Import(argv[i],rejected,&reason));
        assert(!fs::exists(rejected));
        assert(!fs::exists(rejected.string()+".incomplete"));
    }
}
""")
    output=root/"test"
    subprocess.run([COMPILER,"-std=c++20","-Wall","-Wextra","-Werror",
                    "-I",str(ROOT/"headless"),str(cpp),"-lz","-o",str(output)],
                   check=True,timeout=40)
    subprocess.run([str(output),str(fixture),str(bad),
                    str(local_name),str(local_crc),str(oversized),
                    str(root/"store/firmware/ns2/encore-imported-firmware")],
                   check=True,timeout=20)
    subprocess.run([str(output),str(commented),str(bad),
                    str(local_name),str(local_crc),str(oversized),
                    str(root/"store-commented/firmware/ns2/encore-imported-firmware")],
                   check=True,timeout=20)
print("ENCORE_FIRMWARE_ZIP_NATIVE_HOST_PASS deflate=1 dir_entries=1 crc=1 symlink_guard=1 overwrite=0 traversal=0")
```

```py
"""Run G11/X06 CMake source-generation matrix (host-only, no hardware proof)."""

import base64
import difflib
import hashlib
import json
import os

selector = cmake[cmake.index(live_begin):]
selector = selector[:selector.index('endforeach()')+len('endforeach()')]
assert 'list(APPEND core_sources "${EDEN_G11_SOURCE}")' in selector
assert recipe.count('write_derived("${derived}" "#include <bit>\\n${wrapper}")') == 1
assert 'include("${PORT_ROOT}/tools/fixtures/legacy-x06-native-jit-memory-read-guard.cmake")' in recipe
assert recipe.count("foreach(bits 32 64)") == 1

# Production installs these qualified I-cache owners into the prepared
# upstream tree BEFORE the native CMake recipe reads PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR.
# Starting from raw vendor/sources/eden would silently drop J19/J20.
backport_root = root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/core/arm/dynarmic"
pinned = {bits:(backport_root/f"arm_dynarmic_{bits}.cpp").read_text()
          for bits in (32,64)}
assert "Core::InvalidateInstructionCacheRange" in pinned[64]
assert '#include "core/arm/debug.h"' in pinned[64]
assert pinned[32].count("m_cb->last_code_addr = u64(-1);") >= 2
for bits in (32,64):
    existing = (root/f"vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/core/arm/dynarmic/arm_dynarmic_{bits}.cpp").read_text()
    assert "ConstructWithCapacityFallback" not in existing
    assert "if (!CheckMemoryAccess(vaddr" not in existing

# N76 is a native-only opt-in layered on the shared A64 owner. The pinned
# preparatory A64 source carries N76, while host G11 owners deliberately
# retain the exact NS1 counter path. Compare the complete G11 translation
# units after reversing ONLY this exact, guarded guest-clock overlay.
# Native variants must contain the guarded guest rate; host variants must not.
N76_HEADER = '#ifdef EDEN_NS2_GUEST_COUNTER\n#include "encore/guest_counter_policy.h"\n#endif\n'
N76_RATE = re.compile(
    r'^#ifdef EDEN_NS2_GUEST_COUNTER\n'
    r'(?:[ \t]*//[^\n]*\n)*'
    r'[ \t]*config\.cntfrq_el0 = static_cast<u32>\(Eden::GuestCounter::Rate\(\)\);\n'
    r'#else\n'
    r'(?P<legacy>[ \t]*config\.cntfrq_el0 = Hardware::CNTFREQ;)\n'
    r'#endif\n',
    re.M,
)

def reverse_exact_n76_clock(source: str, *, required: bool) -> str:
    if not required:
        assert "EDEN_NS2_GUEST_COUNTER" not in source, "host A64 gained NS2 guest clock"
        return source
    assert source.count(N76_HEADER) == 1, "N76 guest counter include guard drift"
    matches = list(N76_RATE.finditer(source))
    assert len(matches) == 1, "N76 guarded A64 counter/fallback drift"
    assert source.count("EDEN_NS2_GUEST_COUNTER") == 2, "Unexpected N76 macro sites"
    block = matches[0]
    return source.replace(N76_HEADER, "", 1).replace(
        block.group(0), block.group("legacy") + "\n", 1)

outputs = {}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-g11-matrix-") as tempdir:
    temp = Path(tempdir)
    prepared = temp/"prepared-core"
    for bits in (32,64):
        staged = prepared/f"src/core/arm/dynarmic/arm_dynarmic_{bits}.cpp"
        staged.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        staged.write_text(pinned[bits])
    for native in (False, True):
        for dev in (False, True):
            for inline in (False, True):
                label = f"{'native' if native else 'host'}_{'dev' if dev else 'normal'}_{'inline' if inline else 'monitor'}"
                project = temp/label
                project.mkdir()
                stage = project/"stage"
                stage.mkdir()
                (project/"empty.cpp").write_text("int g11_matrix_fixture() { return 0; }\n")
                setup = r'''cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(EncoreG11Matrix LANGUAGES CXX)
set(PORT_ROOT "__ROOT__")
set(PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR "__PREPARED__")
set(EDEN_PORT_DIR "__ROOT__/headless")
set(PORT_BUILD_DIR "__STAGE__")
set(PS5_NATIVE __NATIVE__)
set(EDEN_DEV_PROFILE __DEV__)
set(EDEN_INLINE_EXCLUSIVES __INLINE__ CACHE BOOL "G11 matrix" FORCE)
add_library(core STATIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/empty.cpp"
    arm/dynarmic/arm_dynarmic_32.cpp arm/dynarmic/arm_dynarmic_64.cpp)
function(write_derived path content)
    file(WRITE "${path}" "${content}")
endfunction()
'''
                setup = (setup.replace("__ROOT__", str(root))
                              .replace("__STAGE__", str(stage))
                              .replace("__PREPARED__", str(prepared))
                              .replace("__NATIVE__", "ON" if native else "OFF")
                              .replace("__DEV__", "ON" if dev else "OFF")
                              .replace("__INLINE__", "ON" if inline else "OFF"))
                (project/"CMakeLists.txt").write_text(setup + recipe + '''
# The real root CMake batches core_sources changes before applying the
# target property later. Reproduce that finalization in this focused fixture.
set_property(TARGET core PROPERTY SOURCES "${core_sources}")
get_target_property(g11_sources core SOURCES)
file(WRITE "${PORT_BUILD_DIR}/selected.txt" "${g11_sources}")
''')
                result = subprocess.run(
                    ["cmake","-S",str(project),"-B",str(project/"build")],
                    capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
                if result.returncode:
                    print(result.stdout[-3000:],result.stderr[-5500:])
                    raise AssertionError("G11 source matrix configure failed: "+label)
                owners = (stage/"selected.txt").read_text().split(";")
                for bits in (32,64):
                    src = (stage/f"arm_dynarmic_{bits}.cpp").read_text()
                    assert owners.count(str(stage/f"arm_dynarmic_{bits}.cpp")) == 1, (label,bits)
                    assert f"arm/dynarmic/arm_dynarmic_{bits}.cpp" not in owners, (label,bits)
                    assert len(src)>len(pinned[bits])-200, (label,bits)
                    assert src.startswith("#include <bit>\n"), (label,bits)
                    assert src.count("std::countl_zero(Common::PageTable::ATTRIBUTE_MASK)") == 1
                    assert "Common::PageTable::SIGN_BIT" not in src
                    if bits == 64:
                        assert "Core::InvalidateInstructionCacheRange" in src
                        assert '#include "core/arm/debug.h"' in src
                    else:
                        assert src.count("m_cb->last_code_addr = u64(-1);") >= 2
                    assert "std::uint32_t(512_MiB)" not in src
                    assert ('config.fastmem_exclusive_access = true;' in src) == inline, (label,bits)
                    assert ('/performance.h"' in src) == dev, (label,bits)
                    assert ("::Eden::Performance::CpuSampleDue" in src) == dev, (label,bits)
                    if native:
                        assert "ConstructWithCapacityFallback" in src, (label,bits)
                        assert "jit_memory_policy.h" in src, (label,bits)
                        assert "jit-startup-retry.h" in src, (label,bits)
                        assert src.count("if (!CheckMemoryAccess(vaddr") == (4 if bits==32 else 5)
                        assert ("::Eden::JitMemory::A32CacheBytes" in src) == (bits==32)
                        assert ("::Eden::JitMemory::A64CacheBytes" in src) == (bits==64)
                    else:
                        assert "ConstructWithCapacityFallback" not in src, (label,bits)
                        assert "if (!CheckMemoryAccess(vaddr" not in src, (label,bits)
                    if dev and bits==32:
                        assert "::Eden::Performance::CountJit(" in src
                        assert "::Eden::Watch::Hit(" not in src
                    if dev and bits==64:
                        assert "::Eden::Watch::Hit(" in src
                        assert "::Eden::CrashSite::Dump(" in src
                    # G11 candidate parity for every current CMake profile.
                    # Only absolute private includes and the compile-time
                    # inline/exclusive dispatch are normalized.
                    owner = root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/core/arm/dynarmic/g11"/(
                        f"arm_dynarmic_{bits}_{'native' if native else 'host'}_{'dev' if dev else 'normal'}.cpp")
                    candidate = owner.read_text()
                    expected = src
                    for header in ("jit_memory_policy.h", "performance.h",
                                   "jit-startup-retry.h", "crash_site.h", "watch.h"):
                        expected = expected.replace(
                            '#include "'+str(root/"headless"/header)+'"',
                            '#include "'+header+'"')
                    match = re.search(
                        r'(?m)^([ \t]*)#if defined\(EDEN_INLINE_EXCLUSIVES\) && EDEN_INLINE_EXCLUSIVES\n'
                        r'\1config\.fastmem_exclusive_access = true;\n'
                        r'\1#else\n'
                        r'(?P<fallback>[ \t]*config\.fastmem_exclusive_access = config\.fastmem_pointer +!= std::nullopt;)\n'
                        r'\1#endif', candidate)
                    assert match is not None, (label,bits,"inline guard missing")
                    chosen = (match.group(1)+"config.fastmem_exclusive_access = true;"
                              if inline else match.group("fallback"))
                    if bits == 64:
                        # The native-only N76 guest clock remains positively
                        # required above the legacy byte-for-byte parity gate.
                        # No unrelated G11 instruction, include or JIT fast path
                        # is excluded from the comparison.
                        expected = reverse_exact_n76_clock(expected, required=True)
                        candidate = reverse_exact_n76_clock(candidate, required=native)
                    else:
                        assert "EDEN_NS2_GUEST_COUNTER" not in expected + candidate
                    # The unified native fallback is bounds-checked for CPU6;
                    # historical generation used a four-entry array. Normalize
                    # only this separately UBSan-tested change for parity.
                    if native:
                        expected=expected.replace(
                            f'::Eden::JitMemory::kA{bits}Baseline[m_core_index]',
                            f'::Eden::JitMemory::A{bits}BaselineBytes(m_core_index)')
                    assert candidate.replace(match.group(0),chosen) == expected, (
                        label,bits,"G11 maintained source parity drift")
                    outputs[(native,dev,inline,bits)] = src
                    # One-time migration bridge: emit compact line-based
                    # deltas against pinned public sources in CI logs. They
                    # are reconstructed and committed as full Encore C++
                    # owners; this does not run on shipping builds.
                    if os.environ.get("ENCORE_EXPORT_G11_PATCHES") == "1" and not inline:
                        before_lines = pinned[bits].splitlines(keepends=True)
                        source_lines = src.splitlines(keepends=True)
                        matcher = difflib.SequenceMatcher(
                            None, before_lines, source_lines, autojunk=False)
                        edits = [[i1, i2, "".join(source_lines[j1:j2])]
                                 for tag,i1,i2,j1,j2 in matcher.get_opcodes()
                                 if tag != "equal"]
                        encoded = base64.b64encode(json.dumps(
                            edits, ensure_ascii=True, separators=(",",":")).encode("utf-8")).decode("ascii")
                        print("ENCORE_G11_PATCH_BEGIN", label, bits, len(encoded), flush=True)
                        for part in range(0, len(encoded), 2048):
                            print("ENCORE_G11_PATCH_CHUNK", label, bits,
                                  part // 2048, encoded[part:part+2048], flush=True)
                        print("ENCORE_G11_PATCH_END", label, bits, flush=True)

                assert len(owners) == 2, (label,owners)
                # Compare the new selector with historical generation
                # for every guest ISA, platform, DEV and inline option.
                live = temp/(label+"-selected")
                live.mkdir()
                live_stage = live/"stage"
                live_stage.mkdir()
                (live/"empty.cpp").write_text("int g11_live_fixture() { return 0; }\n")
                live_setup = setup.replace(str(stage),str(live_stage))
                (live/"CMakeLists.txt").write_text(live_setup+'''
get_target_property(core_sources core SOURCES)
'''+selector+'''
set_property(TARGET core PROPERTY SOURCES "${core_sources}")
get_target_property(g11_sources core SOURCES)
file(WRITE "${PORT_BUILD_DIR}/selected.txt" "${g11_sources}")
foreach(bits 32 64)
  set(name "${EDEN_G11_ROOT}/arm_dynarmic_${bits}_${EDEN_G11_PLATFORM}_${EDEN_G11_PROFILE}.cpp")
  get_source_file_property(macro "${name}" COMPILE_DEFINITIONS)
  file(WRITE "${PORT_BUILD_DIR}/compile${bits}.txt" "${macro}")
endforeach()
''')
                result_live = subprocess.run(["cmake","-S",str(live),"-B",str(live/"build")],
                                            capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60)
                if result_live.returncode:
                    print(result_live.stdout[-2500:], result_live.stderr[-4500:])
                    raise AssertionError("G11 maintained selector configure failed: "+label)
                live_sources = (live_stage/"selected.txt").read_text().split(";")
                # The fixture's own dummy TU remains alongside exactly
                # one A32 and one A64 Encore owner.
                assert len(live_sources) == 3, (label,live_sources)
                assert live_sources.count(str(live/"empty.cpp")) == 1, (label,live_sources)
                for bits in (32,64):
                    expected_owner = root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/core/arm/dynarmic/g11"/(
                        f"arm_dynarmic_{bits}_{'native' if native else 'host'}_normal.cpp")
                    assert live_sources.count(str(expected_owner)) == 1, (label,bits)
                    assert f"arm/dynarmic/arm_dynarmic_{bits}.cpp" not in live_sources
                    # The one production source graph is always the normal
                    # JIT and does not change with historical DEV/inline flags.
                    assert (live_stage/f"compile{bits}.txt").read_text() == "EDEN_INLINE_EXCLUSIVES=0"

    for bits in (32,64):
        assert len({hashlib.sha256(value.encode()).digest()
                    for (native,dev,inline,arch),value in outputs.items()
                    if arch == bits}) == 8
print("ENCORE_G11_MAINTAINED_SOURCE_PARITY_PASS variants=8 profiles=16 selectors=16")
print("ENCORE_G11_X06_REAL_CMAKE_PROFILE_MATRIX_PASS cases=8 units=16")
print("ENCORE_G11_NATIVE_MEMORY_READ_GUARD_MATRIX_PASS widths32=4 widths64=5")
print("ENCORE_G11_SOURCE_OWNER_MATRIX_PASS exact_core_owners=2 host_only=1")
```

```py
"""G19 kernel shutdown profile oracle (host-only; no console validation)."""
from pathlib import Path

    file(WRITE "${path}" "${content}")

                        .replace("__STAGE__", str(stage))

        maintained = root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/core/hle/kernel"/(
            "kernel_standard.cpp" if name == "standard" else "kernel_dev.cpp")
        assert maintained.read_text() == units[name], "G19 maintained kernel drift " + name
    print("ENCORE_G19_MAINTAINED_KERNEL_PARITY_PASS profiles=2")
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Host-only G21 source matrix: replay the real CMake GPU derivative.

This is a migration oracle, not graphics compilation or hardware qualification.
After G21 is retired, keep its historical recipe as a test-only fixture and
compare maintained translation units byte-for-byte in this same matrix.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
cmake = (root / "headless/CMakeLists.txt").read_text()
legacy = (root / "tools/fixtures/legacy-g21-gpu.cmake").read_text()
assert 'file(READ "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/video_core/gpu.cpp" gpu_source)' not in cmake
assert 'write_derived("${PORT_BUILD_DIR}/gpu.cpp"' not in cmake
assert 'list(APPEND video_sources "${EDEN_MAINTAINED_G21_GPU}")' in cmake

profiles = (
    ("gl_host", True, False, False),
    ("gl_host_dev", True, False, True),
    ("gl_native", True, True, False),
    ("gl_native_dev", True, True, True),
    ("vulkan_native", False, True, False),
    ("vulkan_native_dev", False, True, True),
)
results = {}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-g21-matrix-") as temporary:
    temp = Path(temporary)
    for name, gl, native, dev in profiles:
        directory = temp / name
        stage = directory / "stage"
        directory.mkdir()
        stage.mkdir()
        (directory / "empty.cpp").write_text("int g21_host_fixture() { return 0; }\n")
        prelude = """cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(EncoreG21Matrix LANGUAGES CXX)
set(PORT_ROOT "__ROOT__")
set(PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR "__ROOT__/vendor/sources/eden")
set(EDEN_PORT_DIR "__ROOT__/headless")
set(PORT_BUILD_DIR "__STAGE__")

    renderer_opengl/gl_buffer_cache.cpp renderer_opengl/gl_query_cache.cpp
    renderer_opengl/gl_texture_cache.cpp renderer_opengl/gl_rasterizer.cpp)
function(write_derived path content)
    file(WRITE "${path}.in" "${content}")
    configure_file("${path}.in" "${path}" COPYONLY)
endfunction()
"""
        prelude = (prelude.replace("__ROOT__", str(root))
                          .replace("__STAGE__", str(stage))
                          .replace("__GL__", "ON" if gl else "OFF")
                          .replace("__NATIVE__", "ON" if native else "OFF")
                          .replace("__DEV__", "ON" if dev else "OFF"))
        (directory / "CMakeLists.txt").write_text(
```
