```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Pin full A32/A64 emitters, shared RSB body and real CMake source selection."""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
owned = root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/dynarmic/backend/x64"
upstream = root / "vendor/sources/eden/src/dynarmic/src/dynarmic/backend/x64"
read = lambda base, name: (base / name).read_text()
cm = read(root / "headless", "CMakeLists.txt")
macros = read(root / "headless/dynarmic", "shared-jit.cmake")
orig32 = read(upstream, "a32_emit_x64.cpp")
orig64 = read(upstream, "a64_emit_x64.cpp")
orig_h = read(upstream, "a64_emit_x64.h")
a32 = read(owned, "a32_emit_x64.cpp")
a64 = read(owned, "a64_emit_x64_standard.cpp")
shared = read(owned, "a64_emit_x64_shared.cpp")
normal_h = read(owned, "a64_emit_x64_standard.h")
shared_h = read(owned, "a64_emit_x64_shared.h")
old_lookup = (
    "        code.DisableWriting();\n"
    "        (*fast_dispatch_table_lookup)(location.Value()) = {};\n"
    "        code.EnableWriting();"
)
new_lookup = (
    "        // The prelude stays RX while dispatch entries change.\n"
    "        (*fast_dispatch_table_lookup)(location.Value()) = {};"
)
assert orig32.count(old_lookup) == orig64.count(old_lookup) == 1
assert a32 == orig32.replace(old_lookup, new_lookup), "A32 original-to-maintained parity"
original = orig64.replace(old_lookup, new_lookup)
sig = "A64EmitX64::Emit(IR::Block& block) noexcept"
publish_sig = "A64EmitX64::Emit(IR::Block& block, bool publish) noexcept"
ending = "    code.DisableWriting();\n    shared_labels.clear();"
publish_end = "    if (publish) code.DisableWriting();\n    shared_labels.clear();"
assert original.count(sig) == original.count(ending) == 1
# Replace complete declarations: directives cannot split return type/name
# or share the #endif line with the function's opening brace.
full_sig = "A64EmitX64::BlockDescriptor " + sig + " {"
full_publish_sig = "A64EmitX64::BlockDescriptor " + publish_sig + " {"
assert original.count(full_sig) == 1
expected_std = original.replace(
    full_sig, "#if defined(EDEN_JIT_A64_PUBLISH)\n" + full_publish_sig
    + "\n#else\n" + full_sig + "\n#endif"
).replace(
    ending, "#if defined(EDEN_JIT_A64_PUBLISH)\n" + publish_end + "\n#else\n" + ending + "\n#endif"
)
assert a64 == expected_std, "A64 standard original-to-maintained parity"
proto = "    BlockDescriptor Emit(IR::Block& block) noexcept;"
pub_proto = "    BlockDescriptor Emit(IR::Block& block, bool publish = true) noexcept;"
assert orig_h.count(proto) == 1
assert normal_h == orig_h.replace(proto,
    "#if defined(EDEN_JIT_A64_PUBLISH)\n" + pub_proto
    + "\n#else\n" + proto + "\n#endif")
assert pub_proto in shared_h and proto not in shared_h
assert "JitGroup* eden_group = nullptr;" in shared_h
assert "eden_pending_sites" in shared_h
assert shared.count(publish_sig) == 1 and publish_end in shared
shared_root = root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-core/dynarmic/shared-jit"
assert read(shared_root, "jit_push_rsb.inc") in shared
assert read(shared_root, "jit_links.inc") in shared
assert "macro(eden_shared_jit_emitter_header)" not in macros
assert "macro(eden_shared_jit_emitter)" not in macros

# ABI contract: both caller and implementation must see publish signature.
# The unified PS5 target installs standard emitter/header unconditionally.
# Shared/Publish remain exact historical source+ABI host witnesses below;
# no caller-supplied DEV/JIT profile can alter the production source graph.
assert 'target_compile_definitions(dynarmic PRIVATE EDEN_JIT_A64_PUBLISH=1)' not in cm
assert 'if(EDEN_SHARED_JIT OR EDEN_JIT_COMPILE_BATCH)' not in cm
assert 'set(EDEN_A64_EMITTER_UNIT "${EDEN_MAINTAINED_EMIT_ROOT}/a64_emit_x64_standard.cpp")' in cm
assert 'set(EDEN_A64_EMITTER_HEADER "${EDEN_MAINTAINED_EMIT_ROOT}/a64_emit_x64_standard.h")' in cm
assert 'write_derived("${PORT_BUILD_DIR}/a${bits}_emit_x64.cpp"' not in cm
assert 'configure_file("${EDEN_EMITTER_UNIT}" "${PORT_BUILD_DIR}/a${bits}_emit_x64.cpp" COPYONLY)' in cm
assert shutil.which("cmake"), "CMake required"
start = cm.index('set(EDEN_MAINTAINED_EMIT_ROOT "')
stop = cm.index('foreach(bits 32 64)\n    if(bits EQUAL 64)', start)
selected_cmake = cm[start:stop]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-emitters-") as tmp:
    tmp = Path(tmp)
    for shared_mode in (False, True):
        for native in (False, True):
            for batch in (False, True):
                for dev in (False, True):
                    name = f"{int(shared_mode)}-{int(native)}-{int(batch)}-{int(dev)}"
                    output = tmp / name
                    output.mkdir()
                    script = tmp / (name + ".cmake")
                    script.write_text(
                        "cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)\n"
                        + f'set(PORT_ROOT "{root.as_posix()}")\n'
                        + f'set(PORT_BUILD_DIR "{output.as_posix()}")\n'
                        + f'set(EDEN_SHARED_JIT {"ON" if shared_mode else "OFF"})\n'
                        + f'set(PS5_NATIVE {"ON" if native else "OFF"})\n'
                        + f'set(EDEN_JIT_COMPILE_BATCH {"ON" if batch else "OFF"})\n'
                        + f'set(EDEN_DEV_PROFILE {"ON" if dev else "OFF"})\n'
                        + selected_cmake
                        + 'configure_file("${EDEN_A64_EMITTER_UNIT}" "${PORT_BUILD_DIR}/a64_emit_x64.cpp" COPYONLY)\n'
                        + 'configure_file("${EDEN_MAINTAINED_EMIT_ROOT}/a32_emit_x64.cpp" "${PORT_BUILD_DIR}/a32_emit_x64.cpp" COPYONLY)\n'
                    )
                    subprocess.run(["cmake", "-P", str(script)], check=True, timeout=30)
                    assert (output / "a32_emit_x64.cpp").read_text() == a32
                    assert (output / "a64_emit_x64.cpp").read_text() == a64
                    assert (output / "include/dynarmic/backend/x64/a64_emit_x64.h").read_text() == normal_h
print("ENCORE_EMITTER_OWNERS_PASS source=standard shared_source=reviewed profile_inputs_ignored=16")

# Compile actual header/implementation signature boundaries in both standard
# modes and the shared mode. Full-unit parity alone reproduced the malformed
# historical preprocessor placement and therefore could not detect this bug.
compiler = shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
assert compiler, "C++20 compiler required"
old_signature = "A64EmitX64::BlockDescriptor #if defined(EDEN_JIT_A64_PUBLISH)\n" + publish_sig + "\n#else\n" + sig + "\n#endif {\n"
normal_proto = "#if defined(EDEN_JIT_A64_PUBLISH)\n" + normal_h.split(
    "#if defined(EDEN_JIT_A64_PUBLISH)\n", 1)[1].split("#endif", 1)[0] + "#endif\n"
def signature(unit):
    return unit.split("A64EmitX64::~A64EmitX64() = default;", 1)[1].split(
        "    if (conf.very_verbose_debugging_output)", 1)[0]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-emit-signature-") as folder:
    folder = Path(folder)
    for mode, proto_text, implementation, flags in (
        ("old", normal_proto, old_signature, []),
        ("normal", normal_proto, signature(a64), []),
        ("publish", normal_proto, signature(a64), ["-DEDEN_JIT_A64_PUBLISH=1"]),
        ("shared", pub_proto, signature(shared), ["-DEDEN_JIT_A64_PUBLISH=1"]),
    ):
        path = folder / (mode + ".cpp")
        path.write_text("namespace IR { struct Block {}; }\n"
                        "struct A64EmitX64 { struct BlockDescriptor {};\n" + proto_text
                        + "\n};\n" + implementation + "    return {};\n}\n"
                        "int main() { IR::Block block; A64EmitX64 emitter; emitter.Emit(block); }\n")
        result = subprocess.run([compiler, "-std=c++20", "-Werror", "-fsyntax-only",
                                 *flags, str(path)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
        if mode == "old":
            assert result.returncode != 0 and "#" in result.stderr, result.stderr
        else:
            assert result.returncode == 0, (mode, result.stderr)
print("EMITTER_SIGNATURE_COMPILE_PASS modes=normal,publish,shared old_signature=rejected")
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""G20/P2.7 maintained GPU source parity (single shipping owner + retained DEV reference)."""
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
ACTIVE = ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/video_core"

def once(source, old, new):
    assert source.count(old) == 1, (old, source.count(old))
    return source.replace(old, new)

OLD_WAIT = "        sync_cv.wait(lk, [this]() { return synced; });"
WAIT = ("        while (!synced && !system.IsShuttingDown())\n"
        "            sync_cv.wait_for(lk, std::chrono::milliseconds(10));")

DMA_FAULT_WAIT = "        while (!synced && !system.IsShuttingDown()) {\n#ifdef PS5_NATIVE\n            // A failed GPU worker cannot deliver this pending fence.\n            if (auto failure = ::Eden::PeekGpuFailure())\n                std::rethrow_exception(failure);\n#endif\n            sync_cv.wait_for(lk, std::chrono::milliseconds(10));\n        }\n#ifdef PS5_NATIVE\n        // A failure published together with the final notification must not\n        // be mistaken for a successful DMA fence acknowledgement.\n        if (auto failure = ::Eden::PeekGpuFailure())\n            std::rethrow_exception(failure);\n#endif"
OLD_SEM = "    while (word != value) {"
SEM = "    while (word != value && !dma_pusher.system.IsShuttingDown()) {"

GPU_FAULT_INIT = """    const auto value = regs.semaphore_acquire;
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    // On a failed graphics worker, a stale GPU semaphore can never progress.
    // Sample failure once per 64 unsuccessful polls, starting with the first.
    unsigned acquire_polls = 0;

GPU_FAULT_LOOP = """    while (word != value && !dma_pusher.system.IsShuttingDown()) {

                std::rethrow_exception(failure);

    if kind == "dma":
        source = once(DMA, OLD_WAIT, WAIT + "\n        if (system.IsShuttingDown()) return false;")

# G20 pinned full-source parity is retained after P2.7's reviewed native

P27_NATIVE_FETCH = "#ifdef PS5_NATIVE\n        // Command headers are validated by NVDRV at submission, but the\n        // address space can change before the GPU worker consumes the live\n        // command words. def apply_reviewed_native_gpfifo_replay(source):
    lines = source.split("\n")
    rebuilt = []
    cursor = 0
    for hunk in G10_NATIVE_GPFIFO_REPLAY_HUNKS:
        start = hunk["at"]
        before = hunk["removed"]
        after = hunk["added"]
        assert cursor <= start <= len(lines), ("non-monotonic G10 source hunk", start)
        assert lines[start:start+len(before)] == before, (
            "reviewed native DMA source hunk drift", start)
        rebuilt.extend(lines[cursor:start])
        rebuilt.extend(after)
        cursor = start+len(before)
    rebuilt.extend(lines[cursor:])
    owner = "\n".join(rebuilt)
    assert owner.count("HasPendingNativeAcquire()") >= 2
    assert "ResumeNativeAcquire()" in owner
    assert "Native GPFIFO prefetch resume cursor invalid" in owner
    assert "Native GPFIFO entry shortened during acquire" in owner
    assert owner.count('throw std::runtime_error("Native GPFIFO method on unbound subchannel")') == 2
    return owner

for kind, name in (("dma", "dma_pusher"), ("puller", "engines/puller")):
    for dev in (False, True):
        path = name + ("_dev" if dev else "") + ".cpp"
        base = expected(kind, dev)
        expected_owner = (apply_reviewed_native_gpfifo_replay(expected_dma_unified(base)) if not dev else expected_dma_unified(base)) if kind == "dma" else base
        assert (ACTIVE / path).read_text() == expected_owner, path
assert "foreach(unit dma_pusher engines/puller)" not in CMAKE
assert 'write_derived("${PORT_BUILD_DIR}/${unit_name}.cpp" "${command_source}")' not in CMAKE
for marker in ('list(REMOVE_ITEM video_sources dma_pusher.cpp engines/puller.cpp)',
               'list(APPEND video_sources "${EDEN_MAINTAINED_GPU_DMA}" "${EDEN_MAINTAINED_GPU_PULLER}")',
               'target_include_directories(video_core PRIVATE "${EDEN_PORT_DIR}")',
               ):
    assert marker in CMAKE, marker
assert 'dma_pusher_dev.cpp' not in CMAKE
assert 'engines/puller_dev.cpp' not in CMAKE
print("ENCORE_G20_GUEST_GPU_PARITY_PASS normal=2 dev=2")
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Verify exact maintained allocator sources and the legacy heap injection.

The source identities and four host C syntax variants are tested; hardware is not.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import platform
import shutil
import subprocess

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
active = root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-build/tooling/native"
pinned = (root / "third_party/app_heap.c").read_text()
flat = (active / "app_heap_flat.c").read_text()
arenas = (active / "app_heap_arenas.c").read_text()
guard = (active / "heap_guard.h").read_bytes()
cmake = (root / "headless/CMakeLists.txt").read_text()
assert not (root / "headless/heap_arenas.inc").exists()
assert not (root / "headless/heap_guard.h").exists()

def git_blob(content: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(content)).encode() + b"\0" + content).hexdigest()

assert git_blob(guard) == "56e4b920c93878d15c05a920f0119c1a23934a80"
for old, new in (
    ("128 MiB", "3072 MiB"),
    ("(128u * 1024u * 1024u)", "(3072u * 1024u * 1024u)"),
    ("#include <sys/mman.h>", "#include <sys/mman.h>\nvoid *eden_heap_pages(size_t);\nvoid eden_heap_pages_free(void *, size_t);\nsize_t eden_heap_pages_physical_size(void *);"),
    ("mmap(NULL, PS5_OPENGL_HEAP_SIZE, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE,\n                    MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANON, -1, 0)", "eden_heap_pages(PS5_OPENGL_HEAP_SIZE)"),
    ("if (base == MAP_FAILED)", "if (base == NULL)"),
    ("munmap(base, PS5_OPENGL_HEAP_SIZE)", "eden_heap_pages_free(base, PS5_OPENGL_HEAP_SIZE)"),
    ('"PS5-OpenGL"', '"Eden-headless"'),
):
    assert old in pinned, ("pinned app heap drift", old)
    pinned = pinned.replace(old, new)
assert pinned.count("static atomic_int ps5_heap_state;") == 1
pinned = pinned.replace(
    "static atomic_int ps5_heap_state;",
    '#ifdef EDEN_HEAP_GUARD\n#include "heap_guard.h"\n#endif\nstatic atomic_int ps5_heap_state;',
)
assert flat == pinned, "flat source differs from former CMake output"
start = pinned.index("static int ps5_heap_ready(void) {")
end = pinned.index("void ps5_opengl_heap_stats_print(unsigned iteration) {", start)
assert arenas.startswith(pinned[:start]) and arenas.endswith(pinned[end:])
historical = arenas[len(pinned[:start]):len(arenas)-len(pinned[end:])]
assert git_blob(historical.encode()) == "939cba30d8838ffea10d307f27ca67b098d168cc", "arena fragment drift"
assert 'write_derived("${PORT_BUILD_DIR}/app_heap.c"' not in cmake
assert 'set(EDEN_ACTIVE_HEAP_DIR "${PORT_ROOT}/vendor/encore-active/eden-build/tooling/native")' in cmake
assert 'set(EDEN_HEAP_UNIT "app_heap_arenas.c")' in cmake
assert 'set(EDEN_HEAP_UNIT "app_heap_flat.c")' in cmake
assert '"${EDEN_HEAP_SOURCE}")' in cmake
# EDEN_HEAP_GUARD is a costly development quarantine, not a required
# production-mode compiler define. The unified app ships the maintained
# arenas allocator without creating a separate debug/DEV binary. Both
# source variants and both macro states still receive syntax validation.
assert 'APPEND PROPERTY COMPILE_DEFINITIONS EDEN_HEAP_GUARD=1' not in cmake
assert 'set(EDEN_HEAP_UNIT "app_heap_arenas.c")' in cmake
assert 'set(EDEN_HEAP_UNIT "app_heap_flat.c")' in cmake
assert 'target_compile_definitions(eden-headless PRIVATE PS5_NATIVE=1)' in cmake
assert '#ifdef EDEN_HEAP_GUARD\n#include "heap_guard.h"' in arenas
assert '#ifdef EDEN_HEAP_GUARD\n#include "heap_guard.h"' in flat
assert 'file(READ "${EDEN_PORT_DIR}/heap_arenas.inc"' not in cmake
compiler = next((c for c in ("clang-18", "clang", "cc") if shutil.which(c)), None)
if compiler is None:
    raise RuntimeError("C compiler unavailable for maintained native heap syntax")
if platform.machine().lower() not in ("x86_64", "amd64"):
    # PS5 mspace guard uses x86-only pauses. The exact source/blob and
    # production CMake owner checks above ran, but Apple Silicon cannot
    # certify the x86-only syntax branches. Linux CI compiles all four.
    print("ENCORE_HEAP_SOURCE_OWNER_PASS x86_64_syntax=NOT_RUN_ON_THIS_HOST")
    raise SystemExit(0)
for path in (active / "app_heap_flat.c", active / "app_heap_arenas.c"):
    for guarded in (False, True):
        args = [compiler, "-std=gnu11", "-fsyntax-only", "-I", str(active)]
        if guarded:
            args.append("-DEDEN_HEAP_GUARD=1")
        subprocess.run([*args, str(path)], check=True, timeout=45)
print("ENCORE_HEAP_SINGLE_SOURCE_PASS variants=2 guard_macro_tested=both selected=arenas default=unguarded historic_blob=exact")
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compare the maintained PRMT shader source to its retired CMake build product."""
from pathlib import Path
import json
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
pristine=(root/"vendor/sources/eden/src/shader_recompiler/frontend/maxwell/translate/impl/not_implemented.cpp").read_text()
actual=(root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/shader_recompiler/frontend/maxwell/translate/impl/not_implemented.cpp").read_text()
module=(root/"headless/gpu_native_observability.cmake").read_text()
helper,reference,imm_old,imm_new,reg_old,reg_new=json.loads(r'''["\nnamespace {\nunsigned EdenGpuBoundedSample(std::atomic<unsigned>& samples) noexcept {\n    unsigned current = samples.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);\n    while (current < 8u) {\n        if (samples.compare_exchange_weak(current, current + 1u,\n                                          std::memory_order_relaxed))\n            return current;\n    }\n    return 8u;\n}\n}\n","\nnamespace {\nconstexpr unsigned EdenPrmtIndexReference(unsigned a, unsigned b, unsigned selector) {\n    unsigned result = 0;\n    for (unsigned output = 0; output < 4; ++output) {\n        const unsigned nibble = (selector >> (4u * output)) & 15u;\n        const unsigned source = (nibble & 4u) ? b : a;\n        unsigned byte = (source >> (8u * (nibble & 3u))) & 255u;\n        if (nibble & 8u)\n            byte = (byte & 128u) ? 255u : 0u;\n        result |= byte << (8u * output);\n    }\n    return result;\n}\nstatic_assert(EdenPrmtIndexReference(0x11223344u, 0x55667788u, 0x3210u) == 0x11223344u);\nstatic_assert(EdenPrmtIndexReference(0x11223344u, 0x55667788u, 0x7654u) == 0x55667788u);\nstatic_assert(EdenPrmtIndexReference(0x80abcdefu, 0u, 0xbbbbu) == 0xffffffffu);\nstatic_assert(EdenPrmtIndexReference(0x11223344u, 0x55667788u, 0xffffu) == 0u);\n}\n","\nvoid TranslatorVisitor::PRMT_imm(u64) {\n    ThrowNotImplemented(Opcode::PRMT_imm);\n}\n","\nvoid TranslatorVisitor::PRMT_imm(u64 insn) {\n    // Maxwell SASS PRMT immediate (0x36c0) uses:\n    // A = R[8:15], B = R[39:46], selector = bits[20:35],\n    // mode = bits[48:50], D = R[0:7].\n    // Only mode 0 (index byte permutation) is translated here.\n    // Each nibble selects one of eight source bytes and its high bit\n    // requests *sign replication* of that byte, not its raw value.\n    const unsigned mode = static_cast<unsigned>((insn >> 48) & 7ULL);\n    if (mode != 0) {\n        static std::atomic<unsigned> unsupported_samples{0};\n        const unsigned index = EdenGpuBoundedSample(unsupported_samples);\n        if (index < 8)\n            std::fprintf(stderr, \"EDEN_GPU_PRMT_IMM raw=%016llx mode=%u sample=%u\\n\",\n                         static_cast<unsigned long long>(insn), mode, index + 1);\n        ThrowNotImplemented(Opcode::PRMT_imm);\n    }\n\n    const unsigned selector = static_cast<unsigned>((insn >> 20) & 0xffffULL);\n    const IR::U32 a{GetReg8(insn)};\n    const IR::U32 b{GetReg39(insn)};\n    IR::U32 result{ir.Imm32(0)};\n    for (unsigned output_byte = 0; output_byte < 4; ++output_byte) {\n        const unsigned nibble = (selector >> (output_byte * 4)) & 15u;\n        const IR::U32 source = (nibble & 4u) ? b : a;\n        const unsigned src_offset = (nibble & 3u) * 8u;\n        // When nibble[3] is set, the NVIDIA byte sign bit\n        // becomes either 0x00 or 0xff in the output.\n        const IR::U32 extracted = (nibble & 8u)\n            ? ir.BitFieldExtract(source, ir.Imm32(src_offset + 7u), ir.Imm32(1), true)\n            : ir.BitFieldExtract(source, ir.Imm32(src_offset), ir.Imm32(8), false);\n        const IR::U32 value = ir.BitwiseAnd(extracted, ir.Imm32(255));\n        const IR::U32 shifted = output_byte == 0 ? value :\n            IR::U32{ir.ShiftLeftLogical(value, ir.Imm32(output_byte * 8u))};\n        result = ir.BitwiseOr(result, shifted);\n    }\n    X(static_cast<IR::Reg>(insn & 255ULL), result);\n\n    static std::atomic<unsigned> implemented_samples{0};\n    const unsigned implemented = EdenGpuBoundedSample(implemented_samples);\n    if (implemented < 8)\n        std::fprintf(stderr, \"EDEN_GPU_PRMT_IMM_INDEX raw=%016llx selector=%04x sample=%u\\n\",\n                     static_cast<unsigned long long>(insn), selector, implemented + 1);\n}\n","\nvoid TranslatorVisitor::PRMT_reg(u64) {\n    ThrowNotImplemented(Opcode::PRMT_reg);\n}\n","\nvoid TranslatorVisitor::PRMT_reg(u64 insn) {\n    // Maxwell SASS PRMT register selector opcode (0x5bc0).\n    // Dynamic selector is R[20:27]; A=R8, B=R39, mode[48:50].\n    const unsigned mode = static_cast<unsigned>((insn >> 48) & 7ULL);\n    if (mode != 0) {\n        static std::atomic<unsigned> unsupported_samples{0};\n        const unsigned sample = EdenGpuBoundedSample(unsupported_samples);\n        if (sample < 8)\n            std::fprintf(stderr, \"EDEN_GPU_PRMT_REG_UNSUPPORTED raw=%016llx mode=%u sample=%u\\n\",\n                         static_cast<unsigned long long>(insn), mode, sample + 1);\n        ThrowNotImplemented(Opcode::PRMT_reg);\n    }\n\n    const IR::U32 a{GetReg8(insn)};\n    const IR::U32 b{GetReg39(insn)};\n    const IR::U32 selector{GetReg20(insn)};\n    IR::U32 result{ir.Imm32(0)};\n    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {\n        const IR::U32 nibble{ir.BitwiseAnd(\n            ir.ShiftRightLogical(selector, ir.Imm32(i * 4u)), ir.Imm32(15))};\n        const IR::U1 from_b{ir.INotEqual(\n            ir.BitwiseAnd(nibble, ir.Imm32(4)), ir.Imm32(0))};\n        const IR::U32 source{ir.Select(from_b, b, a)};\n        const IR::U32 byte_shift{ir.ShiftLeftLogical(\n            ir.BitwiseAnd(nibble, ir.Imm32(3)), ir.Imm32(3))};\n        const IR::U32 selected_byte{ir.BitwiseAnd(\n            ir.ShiftRightLogical(source, byte_shift), ir.Imm32(255))};\n        const IR::U1 signed_replication{ir.INotEqual(\n            ir.BitwiseAnd(nibble, ir.Imm32(8)), ir.Imm32(0))};\n        const IR::U1 negative{ir.INotEqual(\n            ir.BitwiseAnd(selected_byte, ir.Imm32(128)), ir.Imm32(0))};\n        const IR::U32 replicated{ir.Select(negative, ir.Imm32(255), ir.Imm32(0))};\n        const IR::U32 byte{ir.Select(signed_replication, replicated, selected_byte)};\n        const IR::U32 shifted{i == 0 ? byte :\n            IR::U32{ir.ShiftLeftLogical(byte, ir.Imm32(i * 8u))}};\n        result = ir.BitwiseOr(result, shifted);\n    }\n    X(static_cast<IR::Reg>(insn & 255ULL), result);\n    static std::atomic<unsigned> successes{0};\n    const unsigned sample = EdenGpuBoundedSample(successes);\n    if (sample < 8)\n        std::fprintf(stderr, \"EDEN_GPU_PRMT_REG_INDEX raw=%016llx sample=%u\\n\",\n                     static_cast<unsigned long long>(insn), sample + 1);\n}\n"]''')
assert pristine.count(imm_old)==1 and pristine.count(reg_old)==1
expected='#include <atomic>\n#include <cstdio>\n'+helper+"\n"+reference+"\n"+pristine.replace(imm_old,imm_new).replace(reg_old,reg_new)
assert actual==expected, "PRMT maintained shader is not the retired generated source"
# The reviewed shared CAS translator now owns ATOM_cas. Retaining its
# retired stub in the active native PRMT owner produces duplicate symbols
# and silently diverges from the actual source-generation oracle.
cas_owner=(root/"vendor/sources/eden/src/shader_recompiler/frontend/maxwell/translate/impl/atomic_operations_global_memory.cpp").read_text()
assert "void TranslatorVisitor::ATOM_cas(u64 insn)" in cas_owner
assert "void TranslatorVisitor::ATOM_cas(u64)" not in actual
assert "EdenGpuBoundedSample" in actual and "EdenPrmtIndexReference" in actual
assert "static_assert(EdenPrmtIndexReference" in actual
assert 'target_sources(shader_recompiler PRIVATE "${EDEN_MAINTAINED_NATIVE_PRMT}")' in module
assert 'write_derived("${PORT_BUILD_DIR}/maxwell_prmt_observed.cpp"' not in module
# Both Fermi2D variants now embed the bounded diagnostic helper directly.
# The native selector must not re-create it as an injected CMake fragment.
for variant in ("fermi_2d_observed.cpp", "fermi_2d_experimental.cpp"):
```

```py
    )
```

```py
    assert "EDEN_EXCLUSIVE_ADDRESS" not in original
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""OpenSSL CA bundle: maintained-source identity and atomic stage oracle.

This checks only provenance and byte-preservation. No host TLS network
probe, native firmware or end-to-end certificate-chain proof is claimed.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
maintained = root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-build/openssl/cert.h"
original = root / "vendor/sources/eden/.patch/openssl/0001-add-bundled-cert.patch"
script = root / "tools/materialize-openssl-cert.py"
build = (root / "tools/build-headless-native.sh").read_text()
assert 'materialize-openssl-cert.py' in build
source = maintained.read_bytes()
assert source.startswith(b"#ifndef CERT_H_\n#define CERT_H_")
assert b"inline constexpr char kCert[]" in source
assert source.count(b"-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----") == 147
assert source.count(b"-----END CERTIFICATE-----") == 147
assert b"CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER" not in source
assert 'source.read_bytes()' in script.read_text()
assert 'legacy != header' in script.read_text()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-ca-stage-") as directory:
    temp = Path(directory)
    staged = temp / "include/openssl/cert.h"
    args = [sys.executable, "-B", str(script), str(original), str(staged)]
    for i in range(2):
        result = subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)
        assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr
        assert staged.read_bytes() == source
    # A tampered pinned patch must not silently change the versioned trust
    # material. The build aborts rather than changing the CA chain.
    corrupted = temp / "invalid.patch"
    corrupted.write_bytes(original.read_bytes().replace(
        b"-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----", b"-----BEGIN ALTERED CERT-----", 1))
    bad = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-B", str(script),
                          str(corrupted), str(staged)],
                         capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)
    assert bad.returncode != 0 and staged.read_bytes() == source
print("ENCORE_MAINTAINED_OPENSSL_CA_SOURCE_PASS certificates=147 "
      "staged_identical=1 pinned_patch_parity=1 negative_test=1")
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Verify exact pinned G16 page-table replacement and source ownership."""
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
pinned = (root / "vendor/sources/eden/src/core/hle/kernel/k_page_table_base.cpp").read_text()
maintained = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/core/hle/kernel/k_page_table_base.cpp").read_text()

        KPageGroup pg(m_system.Kernel(), m_block_info_manager);
        this->MakePageGroup(pg, addr, size / PageSize);

        // Free the pages.
        pg.CloseAndReset(m_system.Kernel());
    };"""
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Check the maintained Xbyak v7.40.1 writable-alias header and selection.

Exact source replay runs when the pinned CPM dependency is present. Otherwise
validate the stored source identity and all eight changed regions without
requiring external network access during preflight.

import json
import re

edits = json.loads(r'''[["virtual void free(uint8_t *p) { AlignedFree(p); }","virtual uint8_t *writableAddress(uint8_t *p) { return p; }\n\tvirtual void free(uint8_t *p) { AlignedFree(p); }"],["uint8_t *top_;","uint8_t *top_;\n\tuint8_t *writeTop_;"],[", size_(0)",", writeTop_(type_ == USER_BUF ? top_ : alloc_->writableAddress(top_))\n\t\t, size_(0)"],["newTop[i] = top_[i]","alloc_->writableAddress(newTop)[i] = top_[i]"],["top_ = newTop;","top_ = newTop;\n\t\twriteTop_ = alloc_->writableAddress(top_);"],["top_[size_++] =","writeTop_[size_++] ="],["uint8_t *const data = top_ + offset;","uint8_t *const data = writeTop_ + offset;"],["const uint8_t *getCode() const { return top_; }","bool hasWritableAlias() const { return writeTop_ != top_; }\n\tuint8_t *writableAddress(const void *p) const { return writeTop_ + (static_cast<const uint8_t*>(p) - top_); }\n\tconst uint8_t *getCode() const { return top_; }"]]''')
def git_blob(raw: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(raw)).encode() + b"\0" + raw).hexdigest()
assert git_blob(maintained.read_bytes()) == "fa5e37041309cb18adb29bbf60ff79386b0250f8", "Maintained Xbyak source changed"
# The tag is herumi/xbyak v7.40.1, commit 964adcd198c716c0691c7d73f6c2be73db6682bd.
pinned = root / ".cache/cpm/xbyak/v7.40.1/xbyak/xbyak.h"
if pinned.is_file():
    original = pinned.read_text()
    assert git_blob(pinned.read_bytes()) == "5f8cbb5cdad9db9f480ec3cb9f3f7a9d050552e7", "Xbyak dependency pin changed"
    for old, new in edits:
        assert original.count(old) == 1, ("Xbyak pinned anchor changed", old)
        original = original.replace(old, new)
    assert original == text, "Maintained Xbyak header differs from the prior generator"
else:
    for old, new in edits:
        assert text.count(new) == 1, ("Maintained Xbyak edit missing or duplicated", new[:64])
    assert "XBYAK_XBYAK_H_" in text and "hasWritableAlias() const" in text
assert 'configure_file("${EDEN_MAINTAINED_XBYAK_HEADER}"' in selector
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compile real default-A64 invalidation handler for quiet/release/DEV.

Observes only successful application (full clear vs range batch), while
checking cache owner and RSB/halt behavior in both compilation profiles.
No simulated PS5 framerate or shared-JIT path.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

assert 'Eden::Performance::ResetJitDuplicateTrackingForTitle();' in MAIN

CPP=r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <mutex>
#include <cstdio>
using u64 = std::uint64_t;
enum class HaltReason { None=0, CacheInvalidation=1 };
bool Has(HaltReason given, HaltReason expected) { return given == expected; }
static bool detailed=false;
static unsigned reports[2]{};
static unsigned bad_core=0;
extern "C" bool eden_native_detailed_logging() noexcept __attribute__((weak));
extern "C" bool eden_native_detailed_logging() noexcept { return detailed; }
extern "C" void eden_jit_cache_event(unsigned,unsigned) __attribute__((weak));
extern "C" void eden_jit_cache_event(unsigned core,unsigned kind) {
    if (core!=2 || kind>1) { ++bad_core; return; }
    ++reports[kind];
}
struct Ranges {
    bool present=false;
    bool empty() const { return !present; }
    void clear() { present=false; }
    void swap(Ranges& other) { const bool original=present; present=other.present; other.present=original; }
};
namespace boost::icl {
template<class T> using interval_set = ::Ranges;
}
struct Code {
    int cleared=0;
    void ClearCache() { ++cleared; }
};
struct Emitter {
    int cleared=0, ranged=0;
    void ClearCache() { ++cleared; }
    void InvalidateCacheRanges(const Ranges& r) { assert(r.present); ++ranged; }
};
struct State {
    int rsb_resets=0;
    void ResetRSB() { ++rsb_resets; }
};
struct Conf { unsigned processor_id=2; };
struct Probe {
    std::mutex invalidation_mutex;
    bool invalidate_entire_cache=false;
    Ranges invalid_cache_ranges;
    Code block_of_code;
    Emitter emitter;
    State jit_state;
    Conf conf;
    int halts_cleared=0;
    void ClearHalt(HaltReason) { ++halts_cleared; }
INJECT
};
int main() {
    Probe p;
    p.PerformRequestedCacheInvalidation(HaltReason::None);
    assert(p.halts_cleared == 0 && !reports[0] && !reports[1]);
    p.PerformRequestedCacheInvalidation(HaltReason::CacheInvalidation);
    assert(p.halts_cleared == 1 && p.jit_state.rsb_resets == 0);
    detailed=true;
    p.invalid_cache_ranges.present=true;
    p.PerformRequestedCacheInvalidation(HaltReason::CacheInvalidation);
    assert(p.jit_state.rsb_resets == 1 && p.emitter.ranged == 1 &&
           !p.invalid_cache_ranges.present && p.block_of_code.cleared == 0);
    p.invalid_cache_ranges.present=true;
    p.invalidate_entire_cache=true;
    p.PerformRequestedCacheInvalidation(HaltReason::CacheInvalidation);
    assert(p.jit_state.rsb_resets == 2 && p.block_of_code.cleared == 1 &&
           p.emitter.cleared == 1 && p.emitter.ranged == 1 &&
           !p.invalid_cache_ranges.present && !p.invalidate_entire_cache);
#if defined(EDEN_JIT_A64_DEV_PROFILE)
    assert(reports[0] == 1 && reports[1] == 1);
#else
    assert(reports[0] == 0 && reports[1] == 0);
#endif
    detailed=false;
    p.invalid_cache_ranges.present=true;
    p.PerformRequestedCacheInvalidation(HaltReason::CacheInvalidation);
    assert(p.emitter.ranged == 2 && p.jit_state.rsb_resets == 3);
#if defined(EDEN_JIT_A64_DEV_PROFILE)
    assert(reports[0] == 1 && reports[1] == 1);
#endif
    assert(bad_core == 0);
    std::puts("ENCORE_DEFAULT_A64_JIT_CACHE_EVENTS_PASS");
}
""".replace("INJECT",snippet)
compiler=os.environ.get("CXX") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
assert compiler
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-default-jit-cache-") as tmp:
    d=Path(tmp)
    source=d/"test.cpp"
    source.write_text(CPP)
    for variant,flags in (("release",[]),("dev",["-DEDEN_JIT_A64_DEV_PROFILE=1"])):
        exe=d/variant
        compiled=subprocess.run(
            [compiler,"-std=c++20","-O1","-Wall","-Wextra",
             "-fsanitize=address,undefined","-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
             *flags,str(source),"-o",str(exe)],
            check=False,timeout=90,capture_output=True,text=True)
        assert compiled.returncode==0,(variant,compiled.stdout[-1500:],compiled.stderr[-4000:])
        result=subprocess.run([str(exe)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=20)
        assert result.returncode==0,(variant,result.stdout[-1000:],result.stderr[-2000:])
print("ENCORE_A64_CACHE_INVALIDATION_HOST_PASS source_extracted=1 dev=1 release=1 quiet=1")
```

```py
INJECT_TIMER
#endif
```

```py
namespace Dirty { enum : unsigned { VertexInput, LogicOpEnable, Count }; }

struct Maxwell3D {
    struct Regs {

            Type type{Type::Integer};
        };

        cb(cmd);
        ++records;

void RasterizerVulkan::UpdateDynamicStates() {
    auto& regs = maxwell3d->regs;
    auto& flags = maxwell3d->dirty.flags;

        using namespace Tegra::Engines;

    }
}
int main() {
    Tegra::Engines::Maxwell3D m{};
    RasterizerVulkan r{};
    unsigned driver_reads{};
    r.maxwell3d=&m;
    r.device.driver_reads=&driver_reads;

    m.dirty.flags[Dirty::LogicOpEnable]=true;

    assert(r.scheduler.records == 1);
    driver_reads = 0;
    r.UpdateDynamicStates();
    assert(driver_reads == 0 && r.scheduler.records == 1);

    r.device.driver=VkDriverIdKHR::VK_DRIVER_ID_AMD_OPEN_SOURCE;
    m.regs.vertex_attrib_format[0].type =
        Tegra::Engines::Maxwell3D::Regs::VertexAttribute::Type::Float;

    m.regs.vertex_attrib_format[0].type =
        Tegra::Engines::Maxwell3D::Regs::VertexAttribute::Type::Integer;
    m.dirty.flags[Dirty::VertexInput]=true;

    assert(r.scheduler.records == 3);

    m.regs.logic_op.enable=0;
    m.dirty.flags[Dirty::LogicOpEnable]=true;
    r.UpdateDynamicStates();

    assert(r.scheduler.records == 4);
    // A vertex change while guest logic op is already off does not rebind.
    m.dirty.flags[Dirty::VertexInput]=true;

    m.regs.logic_op.enable=1;

        Tegra::Engines::Maxwell3D::Regs::VertexAttribute::Type::Float;

    assert(r.scheduler.records == 5);
```

`tools/check-native-batched-buffer-invalidation-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Execute the selected native batched buffer-cache invalidation, no GPU driver."""
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile
root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
native_path = root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_rasterizer.cpp"
native = native_path.read_text()
begin = native.index("void RasterizerVulkan::InnerInvalidation(")
end = native.index("\nbool RasterizerVulkan::OnCPUWrite(", begin)
method = native[begin:end]
assert "bool buffer_may_overlap = false;" in method
assert "if (texture_may_overlap && buffer_may_overlap) break;" in method
preflight = method.split("bool texture_may_overlap = false;", 1)[1].split("if (texture_may_overlap) {", 1)[0]
assert preflight.count("for (const auto& [addr, size] : sequences)") == 1
assert "::Eden::BufferPages::NeverRegistered(addr, size)" in preflight
assert method.count("::Eden::BufferPages::NeverRegistered(addr, size)") == 2
assert "query_cache.InvalidateRegion(addr, size);" in method
assert "pipeline_cache.InvalidateRegion(addr, size);" in method
assert method.index("texture_cache.WriteMemory") < method.index("buffer_cache.WriteMemory") < method.index("query_cache.InvalidateRegion")
# The conservative witness MUST publish before page-table registration.
buffer_owner = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/video_core/buffer_cache/buffer_cache.h").read_text()
reg = buffer_owner[buffer_owner.index("void BufferCache<P>::ChangeRegister("):]
assert reg.index("::Eden::BufferPages::Mark(buffer.CpuAddr(), size);") < reg.index("page_table[page] = buffer_id;")
# Important: marking an unregistered CPU range is unnecessary for a future
# buffer's first upload because fresh WordManager pages start CPU-dirty.
word_owner = (root / "vendor/sources/eden/src/video_core/buffer_cache/word_manager.h").read_text()
assert "std::fill_n(heap.data() + size_t(Type::CPU) * num_words, num_words, ~u64{0});" in word_owner
generator = (root / "tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py").read_text()
assert "The shared preflight above still fails closed for" in generator
assert "One owner-witness traversal for the whole batch." in generator
host = r'''
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <mutex>
#include <span>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>
#include "buffer_pages.h"
using DAddr = std::uint64_t;
namespace Eden::ImagePages {
inline bool any_held = false;
inline unsigned probes = 0;
bool NeverHeld(DAddr, std::size_t) noexcept { ++probes; return !any_held; }
}
struct CountMutex {
  std::mutex impl;
  unsigned locks = 0;
  void lock() { impl.lock(); ++locks; }
  void unlock() { impl.unlock(); }
};
struct Cache {
  CountMutex mutex;
  std::vector<std::pair<DAddr, std::size_t>> written;
  void WriteMemory(DAddr address, std::size_t size) { written.emplace_back(address, size); }
};
struct Owner {
  unsigned calls = 0;
  void InvalidateRegion(DAddr, std::size_t) { ++calls; }
};
struct RasterizerVulkan {
  Cache texture_cache, buffer_cache;
  Owner query_cache, pipeline_cache;
  void InnerInvalidation(std::span<const std::pair<DAddr, std::size_t>>);
};
''' + method + r'''
int main() {
  using Pair = std::pair<DAddr, std::size_t>;
  // Never owned buffer or texture, but query and shader MUST invalidate.
  RasterizerVulkan empty;
  std::array<Pair, 1> unwritten{Pair{0x100000, 4096}};
  empty.InnerInvalidation(unwritten);
  assert(empty.buffer_cache.mutex.locks == 0);
  assert(empty.texture_cache.mutex.locks == 0);
  assert(empty.query_cache.calls == 1 && empty.pipeline_cache.calls == 1);

  // One registered buffer page in a batch with another previously empty page.
  Eden::BufferPages::Mark(0x200000, 4096);
  RasterizerVulkan mixed;
  std::array<Pair, 2> two{Pair{0x200000, 4096}, Pair{0x210000, 4096}};
  mixed.InnerInvalidation(two);
  assert(mixed.buffer_cache.mutex.locks == 1);
  assert(mixed.buffer_cache.written.size() == 1);
  assert(mixed.buffer_cache.written[0].first == 0x200000);
  assert(mixed.query_cache.calls == 2 && mixed.pipeline_cache.calls == 2);

  // A previously owned page cannot be skipped, even if now unregistered.
  mixed.InnerInvalidation(unwritten);
  assert(mixed.buffer_cache.written.size() == 1);
  std::array<Pair, 1> old{Pair{0x200000, 4096}};
  mixed.InnerInvalidation(old);
  assert(mixed.buffer_cache.written.size() == 2);

  // 128 KiB entirely unregistered: the two-word bitmap fast path
  // must skip the buffer mutex while still invalidating query/shader.
  RasterizerVulkan large;
  std::array<Pair, 1> broad{Pair{0x310000, 131072}};
  large.InnerInvalidation(broad);
  assert(large.buffer_cache.mutex.locks == 0);
  assert(large.buffer_cache.written.empty());
  assert(large.query_cache.calls == 1 && large.pipeline_cache.calls == 1);

  // Unknown or >256 KiB spans retain conservative cache invalidation.
  std::array<Pair, 1> oversized{Pair{0x310000, 256 * 1024 + 1}};
  large.InnerInvalidation(oversized);
  assert(large.buffer_cache.mutex.locks == 1);
  assert(large.buffer_cache.written.size() == 1);
  assert(large.query_cache.calls == 2 && large.pipeline_cache.calls == 2);

  // Texture-cache invalidation still occurs independently from buffer state.
  Eden::ImagePages::any_held = true;
  RasterizerVulkan texture;
  texture.InnerInvalidation(unwritten);
  assert(texture.texture_cache.written.size() == 1);
  assert(texture.buffer_cache.written.empty());
  assert(texture.pipeline_cache.calls == 1);

  // Many disjoint HUD/descriptor CPU-write ranges: exact selective cache
  // invalidation must survive a fused preflight and preserve original order.
  Eden::ImagePages::any_held = false;
  std::array<Pair, 256> batch{};
  std::vector<DAddr> expected;
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < batch.size(); ++i) {
    batch[i] = Pair{0x500000 + static_cast<DAddr>(i) * 4096, 4096};
    if (i % 17 == 0) {
      Eden::BufferPages::Mark(batch[i].first, batch[i].second);
      expected.push_back(batch[i].first);
    }
  }
  Eden::ImagePages::probes = 0;
  RasterizerVulkan many;
  many.InnerInvalidation(batch);
  assert(many.texture_cache.mutex.locks == 0);
  assert(many.buffer_cache.mutex.locks == 1);
  assert(many.query_cache.calls == batch.size() && many.pipeline_cache.calls == batch.size());
  assert(many.buffer_cache.written.size() == expected.size());
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < expected.size(); ++i)
    assert(many.buffer_cache.written[i] == Pair(expected[i], 4096));
  // Every unowned-image address is examined exactly once in the preflight.
  assert(Eden::ImagePages::probes == batch.size());
  // Both domains have positive hits: preflight stops once both were found,
  // while the original cache-locked rechecks still walk every guest range.
  Eden::ImagePages::any_held = true;
  Eden::ImagePages::probes = 0;
  RasterizerVulkan both;
  both.InnerInvalidation(batch);
  assert(both.texture_cache.mutex.locks == 1 && both.buffer_cache.mutex.locks == 1);
  assert(both.texture_cache.written.size() == batch.size());
  assert(both.buffer_cache.written.size() == expected.size());
  assert(both.query_cache.calls == batch.size() && both.pipeline_cache.calls == batch.size());

  // Outside address coverage, the witness must permanently fail open.
  Eden::BufferPages::Mark(Eden::BufferPages::kSpace, 4096);
  RasterizerVulkan unknown;
  unknown.InnerInvalidation(unwritten);
  assert(unknown.buffer_cache.written.size() == 1);
  assert(unknown.query_cache.calls == 1);
}
'''
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-batched-inv-") as tmp:
    source = Path(tmp) / "test.cpp"
    source.write_text(host)
    for opt in ("-O0", "-O2"):
        binary = Path(tmp) / ("binary" + opt)
        subprocess.run(["c++", "-std=c++20", opt, "-pthread",
                        "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror",
                        "-fsanitize=address,undefined", "-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
                        "-I", str(root / "headless"),
                        str(source), "-o", str(binary)], check=True)
        subprocess.run([str(binary)], check=True)
        print(f"EDEN_NATIVE_BATCHED_INVALIDATION_HOST_PASS profile={opt} asan_ubsan=1 fused_256=1")
```

`tools/check-native-bootstrap-permit-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Source-extracted bootstrap Initialize/Unload context permit ownership."""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
source = (ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/eden-threading/src/core/hle/kernel/k_scheduler.cpp").read_text()


def method(begin, end):
    assert source.count(begin) == source.count(end) == 1
    return begin + source.split(begin, 1)[1].split(end, 1)[0]


initialize = method("void KScheduler::Initialize(", "void KScheduler::Activate(")
unload = method("void KScheduler::Unload(", "void KScheduler::Reload(")
claim = """    // CPU workers enter the bootstrap fiber before the normal acquisition loop.
    // Its first Unload must return an owned context permit.
    if (!main_thread->m_context_guard.try_acquire()) {
        UNREACHABLE_MSG("Bootstrap thread context permit is already held");
    }

"""
assert initialize.count(claim) <= 1
original = initialize.replace(claim, "")
cpp = r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <semaphore>
using s32 = std::int32_t;
using u32 = std::uint32_t;
#define UNREACHABLE_MSG(...) std::abort()
namespace Kernel {
enum class DpcFlag : unsigned { Terminated = 1 };
struct KThread {
    std::binary_semaphore m_context_guard{1};
    struct Stack { unsigned dpc_flags = 0; } stack;
    Stack& GetStackParameters() { return stack; }
};
struct Core {
    unsigned saves = 0;
    void SaveContext(KThread* thread) { assert(thread); ++saves; }
};
struct KernelCore {
    Core core;
    Core& PhysicalCore(s32 id) { assert(id == 2); return core; }
};
struct KScheduler {
    s32 m_core_id = -1;
    KThread* m_idle_thread = nullptr;
    KThread* m_current_thread = nullptr;
    void Initialize(KernelCore&, KThread*, KThread*, s32);
    void Unload(KernelCore&, KThread*);
};
INITIALIZE
UNLOAD
}
int main() {
    using namespace Kernel;
    for (unsigned repeat = 0; repeat < 64; ++repeat) {
        KernelCore kernel;
        KThread bootstrap, idle;
        KScheduler scheduler;
        scheduler.Initialize(kernel, &bootstrap, &idle, 2);
        assert(scheduler.m_current_thread == &bootstrap && scheduler.m_idle_thread == &idle);
        // The first active fiber must already own its context permit.
        assert(!bootstrap.m_context_guard.try_acquire());
        assert(idle.m_context_guard.try_acquire());
        idle.m_context_guard.release();
        scheduler.Unload(kernel, &bootstrap);
        assert(kernel.core.saves == 1);
        assert(bootstrap.m_context_guard.try_acquire());
        assert(!bootstrap.m_context_guard.try_acquire());
        // A terminated context never returns a permit for reuse.
        bootstrap.stack.dpc_flags = unsigned(DpcFlag::Terminated);
        scheduler.Unload(kernel, &bootstrap);
        assert(kernel.core.saves == 2);
        assert(!bootstrap.m_context_guard.try_acquire());
    }
    std::puts("BOOTSTRAP_CONTEXT_PERMIT_PASS lifecycles=64 idle_free=1 terminated_not_reused=1");
}
"""
compiler = shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
assert compiler
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-bootstrap-permit-") as temp:
    folder = Path(temp)
    for label, body in (("original", original), ("maintained", initialize)):
        path, executable = folder / (label + ".cpp"), folder / label
        path.write_text(cpp.replace("INITIALIZE", body).replace("UNLOAD", unload))
        subprocess.run([compiler, "-std=c++20", "-O2", "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror",
                        "-Wno-unused-parameter", "-fsanitize=address,undefined",
                        "-fno-sanitize-recover=all", str(path), "-o", str(executable)],
                       check=True, timeout=60)
        result = subprocess.run([str(executable)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
        if label == "original":
            assert result.returncode != 0 and "Assertion" in result.stderr, result.stderr
            print("ORIGINAL_BOOTSTRAP_UNCLAIMED_PERMIT_WITNESS_PASS")
        else:
            assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr
            assert initialize.count(claim) == 1, "bootstrap claim missing"
            print(result.stdout, end="")
print("BOOTSTRAP_PERMIT_HOST_ONLY PS5_guest_progress=unverified")
```

`tools/check-native-buffer-pages-wide-probe-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Source-selected buffer-page bitmap guard: two-word 256 KiB guest writes."""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
head = (root / "headless/buffer_pages.h").read_text()
assert "size>256*1024" in head
assert "size>64*1024" not in head
assert "const auto first_word=first/64,last_word=last/64;" in head
assert "registered[first_word].load(std::memory_order_acquire)&first_mask" in head
assert "registered[last_word].load(std::memory_order_acquire)&Bits(0,last%64)" in head
assert "coverage_unknown.load(std::memory_order_acquire)" in head
assert "if(first_word==last_word){" in head.split("inline void Mark(",1)[1].split("inline bool NeverRegistered(",1)[0]
assert "registered[first_word].fetch_or(mask,std::memory_order_release)" in head
probe = head.split("inline bool NeverRegistered(", 1)[1]
assert probe.count("coverage_unknown.load(std::memory_order_acquire)") == 2
assert "if(coverage_unknown.load(std::memory_order_acquire))" not in probe
assert probe.count("return !coverage_unknown.load(std::memory_order_acquire);") == 2

code = r"""
#include "buffer_pages.h"
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
int main() {
    using namespace Eden::BufferPages;
    constexpr std::uint64_t page = 4096;
    constexpr std::uint64_t span = 256 * 1024;
    // A 256 KiB unaligned query can cross a 64-page bitmap word boundary,
    // but may only cover two words. No owner means lock elision is valid.
    constexpr std::uint64_t cross = 63 * page + 17;
    assert(NeverRegistered(cross, span));
    assert(NeverRegistered(cross, 64 * 1024 + 1));
    // The immediately preceding byte is NOT part of the query.
    Mark(cross - page, 1);
    assert(NeverRegistered(cross, span));
    // A newly registered interior page must disable lock elision.
    Mark(64 * page + 48, 1);
    assert(!NeverRegistered(cross, span));
    // Unrelated ranges must keep the fast path.
    constexpr std::uint64_t empty = 512 * page + 29;
    assert(NeverRegistered(empty, span));
    Mark(empty + span - 1, 1);
    assert(!NeverRegistered(empty, span));
    assert(NeverRegistered(empty + span + page, 64 * 1024));
    // Check a near-maximum query whose final page is across the word split.
    constexpr std::uint64_t shifted = 1023 * page + 2;
    assert(NeverRegistered(shifted, span));
    Mark(shifted + span - 1, 1);
    assert(!NeverRegistered(shifted, span));
    // The byte just beyond an unaligned query can still occupy the same
    // registered page. Only the NEXT entirely different page is unowned.
    constexpr std::uint64_t next_full_page = ((shifted + span + page - 1) / page) * page;
    assert(NeverRegistered(next_full_page, page));
    // A seven-page buffer in one bitmap word must mark its full mask.
    // The next word remains empty and eligible for skipping the cache lock.
    constexpr std::uint64_t within = 2048 * page + 9;
    Mark(within, 7 * page);
    assert(!NeverRegistered(within, 7 * page));
    assert(!NeverRegistered(within + 6 * page, 1));
    assert(NeverRegistered(within + 8 * page, 1));
    // An unaligned mark straddling the word edge remains fully registered.
    constexpr std::uint64_t edge = 3071 * page + 19;
    Mark(edge, 2 * page);
    assert(!NeverRegistered(3071 * page, 1));
    assert(!NeverRegistered(3072 * page, 1));
    assert(!NeverRegistered(3073 * page, 1));
    assert(NeverRegistered(3074 * page, 1));
    // Larger requests preserve the old conservative locking behavior.
    assert(!NeverRegistered(empty + 20 * span, span + 1));
    assert(!NeverRegistered(empty + 20 * span, 0));
    assert(!NeverRegistered(kSpace - 4096, 8192));
    assert(!NeverRegistered(kSpace, 1));
    assert(!coverage_unknown.load(std::memory_order_acquire));
    // Unknown global coverage is still a strict fail-closed fence. Both
    // one-page and 65-page unowned probes must now take the cache lock.
    Mark(kSpace + 1, 1);
    assert(coverage_unknown.load(std::memory_order_acquire));
    assert(!NeverRegistered(empty + 20 * span, 1));
    assert(!NeverRegistered(empty + 20 * span, span));
}
"""
compiler=shutil.which("c++") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
assert compiler
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-buffer-probe-") as folder:
    path=Path(folder)/"probe.cpp"
    path.write_text(code)
    for mode in ("-O0", "-O2"):
        exe=Path(folder)/("probe"+mode)
        subprocess.run([compiler,"-std=c++20",mode,"-Wall","-Wextra","-Werror",
                        "-fsanitize=undefined", "-I"+str(root/"headless"),
                        str(path),"-o",str(exe)],check=True,timeout=40)
        subprocess.run([str(exe)],check=True,timeout=20)
        print("BUFFER_PAGES_WIDE_PROBE_HOST_PASS",mode)
```

`tools/check-native-build-recipe.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Replay maintained, full native CMake and SCM files with repeat/rollback checks."""
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
script=root/"tools/install-vendored-eden-build-flags.py"
specs=(
    ("src/CMakeLists.txt",b"-Wno-error-all>",b"-Wno-error=all>"),
    ("src/common/scm_rev.cpp.in",b'#define BUILD_ID "@BUILD_ID@"',
     b'#ifdef BUILD_ID\n#undef BUILD_ID\n#endif\n#define BUILD_ID "@BUILD_ID@"'),
)
subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-B",str(script)],check=True,timeout=12)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-native-recipe-") as scratch:
    location=Path(scratch)
    original={}
    for relative,from_bytes,to_bytes in specs:
        source=root/"vendor/sources/eden"/relative
        active=root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-build"/relative
        old=source.read_bytes()
        assert old.count(from_bytes)==1
        expected=old.replace(from_bytes,to_bytes)
        assert active.read_bytes()==expected
        original[relative]=(old,expected)
        target=location/relative
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        target.write_bytes(old)
    for iteration in range(2):
        subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-B",str(script),str(location)],check=True,timeout=12)
        for relative,(_old,expected) in original.items():
            assert (location/relative).read_bytes()==expected,(iteration,relative)
    target=location/"src/CMakeLists.txt"
    target.write_bytes(b"unrecognized revision")
    refused=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-B",str(script),str(location)],
                           capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=12)
    assert refused.returncode!=0
    assert target.read_bytes()==b"unrecognized revision"
    # Compiler warning options MUST be recognized by the native Clang toolchain.
    assert b"-Wno-error-all" not in (location/"src/CMakeLists.txt").read_bytes()
    assert b"#undef BUILD_ID" in (location/"src/common/scm_rev.cpp.in").read_bytes()
print("PASS: full CMake & SCM sources installed byte-exact, idempotent, foreign revisions refused")
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compile actual selected device spans and registry; reject stale native forks."""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
native = (ROOT / 'vendor/encore-active/eden-core/overrides/core/device_memory_manager.inc').read_text()
backport = (ROOT / 'vendor/encore-active/eden-backports/src/core/device_memory_manager.inc').read_text()
pinned = (ROOT / 'vendor/sources/eden/src/core/device_memory_manager.inc').read_text()
header = (ROOT / 'vendor/encore-active/eden-backports/src/core/device_memory_manager.h').read_text()
# Whole-unit parity retains all atomic, remap, range and ASID fixes. Restoring
# only id_pool would compile while undoing the no-reuse/lifetime guarantees.
span_start = backport.index('template <typename Traits>\nu8* DeviceMemoryManager<Traits>::GetSpan(')
span_end = backport.index('template <typename Traits>\nvoid DeviceMemoryManager<Traits>::InnerGatherDeviceAddresses(', span_start)
original_span_block = backport[span_start:span_end]
old_return = '    return GetPointer<u8>(src_addr);'
new_return = ('    // Reuse the validated physical backing instead of loading the page again.\n'
              '    return GetPointerFromRaw<u8>((PAddr(backing - 1U) << page_bits) + (src_addr & page_mask));')
assert original_span_block.count(old_return) == 2
expected = backport[:span_start] + original_span_block.replace(old_return, new_return) + backport[span_end:]
# N50 is an opt-in, additive GPU continuity guard. Preserve byte-exact
# parity of the shipping NS1 device span/ASID owner after removing ONLY the
# two reviewed guarded map/unmap insertions and its single include.
ns2_header = '#ifdef EDEN_NS2_DEVICE_CONTINUITY\n#include "core/ns2_egl_continuity_guard.h"\n#endif\n'
ns2_cut = '''#ifdef EDEN_NS2_DEVICE_CONTINUITY
    // End a previously tracked physical run before mapping state changes.
    Eden::NS2::GpuMemory::CutContinuityAt(start_page_d,
        [&](size_t index) { return AtomicLoadContinuity(tracked_entries[index]); },
        [&](size_t index, u32 new_count) {
            AtomicStoreContinuity(tracked_entries.GetUnchecked(index), new_count);
        });
#endif
'''
assert native.count(ns2_header) == 1, 'N50 include duplicated or modified'
assert native.count(ns2_cut) == 2, 'N50 map/unmap continuity blocks drifted'
unqualified_native = native.replace(ns2_header, '', 1).replace(ns2_cut, '', 2)
assert unqualified_native == expected, 'Native device implementation drifted beyond the reviewed span reuse'
assert 'id_pool' not in native + header
map_body = native.split('void DeviceMemoryManager<Traits>::Map(', 1)[1].split('void DeviceMemoryManager<Traits>::Unmap(', 1)[0]
assert map_body.index('std::shared_lock registry_lk(process_registry_guard);') < map_body.index('std::unique_lock lk(mapping_guard);')

assert 'mutable std::shared_mutex process_registry_guard;' in header
cmake = (ROOT / 'headless/CMakeLists.txt').read_text()
assert 'target_include_directories(video_core BEFORE PRIVATE "${EDEN_NATIVE_DIRTY_HEADER_ROOT}")' in cmake
assert '"${EDEN_NATIVE_DIRTY_HEADER_ROOT}/core/device_memory_manager.inc"' in cmake


def methods(text, start, end):
    assert text.count(start) == text.count(end) == 1
    return start + text.split(start, 1)[1].split(end, 1)[0]


start = 'template <typename Traits>\nu8* DeviceMemoryManager<Traits>::GetSpan('
end = 'template <typename Traits>\nvoid DeviceMemoryManager<Traits>::InnerGatherDeviceAddresses('
old_spans = methods(pinned, start, end)
spans = methods(native, start, end)
registry = methods(native, 'template <typename Traits>\nAsid DeviceMemoryManager<Traits>::RegisterProcess(',
                   'template <typename Traits>\nvoid DeviceMemoryManager<Traits>::UpdatePagesCachedCountNoLock(')
atomic_load = methods(header, '    static u32 AtomicLoadPhysical(', '    static void AtomicStorePhysical(')
cpp = r'''
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <deque>
#include <limits>
#include <mutex>
#include <shared_mutex>
using u8 = std::uint8_t; using u32 = std::uint32_t;
using VAddr = std::uint64_t; using DAddr = std::uint64_t; using PAddr = std::uint64_t;
namespace Core {
namespace Memory { struct Memory {}; }
struct Asid { std::size_t id; };
struct Traits {};
template <typename T> struct DeviceMemoryManager {
    static constexpr std::size_t page_bits = 12, page_mask = 4095;
    static constexpr std::size_t device_as_size = std::size_t{1} << 34;
    // Exercise the real registry capacity expression with four possible IDs.
    static constexpr unsigned guest_max_as_bits = 62;
    struct TrackedEntry { VAddr cpu_backing_address{}; u32 continuity_tracker{}, compressed_physical_ptr{}; };
    std::array<TrackedEntry, 3> tracked_entries{};
    std::array<u32, 5> compressed_device_addr{};
    std::array<u8, 5 * 4096> storage{};
    mutable unsigned pointer_requests = 0, raw_requests = 0;
    mutable bool remap_on_pointer = false;
    template <class V> V* GetPointerFromRaw(PAddr offset) {
        ++raw_requests; assert(offset < storage.size());
        return reinterpret_cast<V*>(storage.data() + offset);
    }
    template <class V> const V* GetPointerFromRaw(PAddr offset) const {
        ++raw_requests; assert(offset < storage.size());
        return reinterpret_cast<const V*>(storage.data() + offset);
    }
    mutable std::shared_mutex process_registry_guard;
    std::deque<Memory::Memory*> registered_processes;
__ATOMIC__
    template <class V> V* GetPointer(DAddr address) {
        ++pointer_requests;
        // Deterministic remap at the old secondary lookup boundary.
        if (remap_on_pointer) {
            auto& entry = const_cast<TrackedEntry&>(tracked_entries[address >> page_bits]);
            entry.compressed_physical_ptr = 5;
        }
        auto physical = AtomicLoadPhysical(tracked_entries[address >> page_bits]);
        assert(physical && physical <= compressed_device_addr.size());
        return reinterpret_cast<V*>(storage.data() + (physical - 1) * 4096 + (address & page_mask));
    }
    template <class V> const V* GetPointer(DAddr address) const {
        ++pointer_requests;
        // Deterministic remap at the old secondary lookup boundary.
        if (remap_on_pointer) {
            auto& entry = const_cast<TrackedEntry&>(tracked_entries[address >> page_bits]);
            entry.compressed_physical_ptr = 5;
        }
        auto physical = AtomicLoadPhysical(tracked_entries[address >> page_bits]);
        assert(physical && physical <= compressed_device_addr.size());
        return reinterpret_cast<const V*>(storage.data() + (physical - 1) * 4096 + (address & page_mask));
    }
    u8* GetSpan(DAddr, std::size_t);
    const u8* GetSpan(DAddr, std::size_t) const;
    Asid RegisterProcess(Memory::Memory*);
    void UnregisterProcess(Asid);
};
__METHODS__
__REGISTRY__
}
int main(int argc, char**) {
    Core::DeviceMemoryManager<Core::Traits> mgr;
    const auto& read = mgr;
    auto& e = mgr.tracked_entries;
    e[0] = {0, 1, 1}; e[1] = {4096, 0, 2};
    if (argc > 1) {
        e[0] = {0, 2, 1}; e[1] = {4096, 1, 2}; e[2] = {8192, 0, 3};
        assert(mgr.GetSpan(0, 12288) == mgr.storage.data());
        // Leave stale predecessor hints while physically unmapping page 1.
        e[1].compressed_physical_ptr = 0; e[1].continuity_tracker = 0;
#ifdef CURRENT_DEVICE_SPAN
        assert(!mgr.GetSpan(0, 8192) && !read.GetSpan(0, 8192));
#else
        assert(mgr.GetSpan(0, 8192) == mgr.storage.data());
#endif
        // Default untracked remap to a different, noncontiguous physical page.
        e[1].compressed_physical_ptr = 5;
#ifdef CURRENT_DEVICE_SPAN
        assert(!mgr.GetSpan(0, 8192) && !read.GetSpan(0, 8192));
        assert(!mgr.GetSpan(4096, 8192) && !read.GetSpan(4096, 8192));
#else
        assert(mgr.GetSpan(0, 8192) == mgr.storage.data());
#endif
        assert(mgr.GetSpan(4096, 4096) == mgr.storage.data() + 4 * 4096);
        e[1].compressed_physical_ptr = 2; e[2].compressed_physical_ptr = 5;
#ifdef CURRENT_DEVICE_SPAN
        assert(!mgr.GetSpan(0, 12288) && !read.GetSpan(0, 12288));
#else
        assert(mgr.GetSpan(0, 12288) == mgr.storage.data());
#endif
        assert(mgr.GetSpan(0, 8192) == mgr.storage.data());
        std::puts("DEVICE_CONTINUITY_PASS partial_unmap=1 untracked_remap=1 const_mutable=2");
        return 0;
    }
#ifndef CURRENT_DEVICE_SPAN
    assert(mgr.GetSpan(1, std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) == mgr.storage.data() + 1);
    assert(read.GetSpan(1, std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) == mgr.storage.data() + 1);
    assert(mgr.GetSpan(0, 0) == mgr.storage.data());
#else
    assert(mgr.GetSpan(0, 4096) == mgr.storage.data());
    assert(read.GetSpan(1, 4096) == mgr.storage.data() + 1);
    assert(mgr.GetSpan(4094, 4) == mgr.storage.data() + 4094);
    for (const auto& [address, bytes] : std::array<std::pair<DAddr, std::size_t>, 9>{{
        {0, 8193}, {4095, 8193}, {0, 0}, {1, ~std::size_t{0}},
        {mgr.device_as_size, 1}, {mgr.device_as_size - 1, 2}, {~DAddr{0}, 4096},
        {8192, 1}, {8191, 2}}}) {
        assert(!mgr.GetSpan(address, bytes) && !read.GetSpan(address, bytes));
    }
    mgr.remap_on_pointer = true;
    assert(mgr.GetSpan(0, 8192) == mgr.storage.data());
    assert(read.GetSpan(0, 8192) == mgr.storage.data());
    assert(mgr.pointer_requests == 0 && mgr.raw_requests > 0);
    mgr.remap_on_pointer = false;
    e[0].compressed_physical_ptr = 6;
    assert(!mgr.GetSpan(0, 1) && !read.GetSpan(0, 1));
    e[0].compressed_physical_ptr = 5;
    assert(!mgr.GetSpan(4095, 2) && !read.GetSpan(4095, 2));
    Core::Memory::Memory a, b, c, d, extra;
    assert(mgr.RegisterProcess(nullptr).id == ~std::size_t{0});
    auto first = mgr.RegisterProcess(&a); assert(first.id == 0);
    mgr.UnregisterProcess(first); mgr.UnregisterProcess(first);
    mgr.UnregisterProcess({~std::size_t{0}});
    assert(mgr.RegisterProcess(&b).id == 1);
    assert(mgr.RegisterProcess(&c).id == 2);
    assert(mgr.RegisterProcess(&d).id == 3);
    assert(mgr.RegisterProcess(&extra).id == ~std::size_t{0});
    assert(mgr.registered_processes.size() == 4 && !mgr.registered_processes[0]);
#endif
    std::puts("DEVICE_BOUNDS_REGISTRY_PASS overflow=1 physical_capacity=1 tombstones=1 no_reuse=1");
}
'''
compiler = shutil.which('clang++-18') or shutil.which('clang++') or shutil.which('g++')
assert compiler
continuity = '--continuity' in sys.argv[1:]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='encore-device-span-') as temp:
    folder = Path(temp)
    variants = [('pinned', old_spans, False), ('native', spans, True)]
    if not continuity:
        variants.append(('secondary-lookup', original_span_block, True))
    for label, segment, current in variants:
        path, binary = folder / (label + '.cpp'), folder / label
        path.write_text(cpp.replace('__ATOMIC__', atomic_load).replace('__METHODS__', segment)
                        .replace('__REGISTRY__', registry if current else ''))
        flags = ['-DCURRENT_DEVICE_SPAN=1'] if current else []
        subprocess.run([compiler, '-std=c++20', '-O1', '-Wall', '-Wextra', '-Werror',
                        '-DPS5_NATIVE=1', *flags,
                        '-fsanitize=address,undefined', '-fno-sanitize-recover=all',
                        str(path), '-o', str(binary)], check=True, timeout=60)
        if label == 'secondary-lookup':
            result = subprocess.run([str(binary)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
            assert result.returncode != 0 and 'mgr.GetSpan(0, 8192)' in result.stderr, result.stderr
            print('ORIGINAL_DEVICE_SPAN_SECONDARY_RELOOKUP_REPRODUCED')
        else:
            subprocess.run([str(binary), *(['continuity'] if continuity else [])], check=True, timeout=15)
print('NATIVE_DEVICE_SELECTED_IMPLEMENTATION_PASS mode=' + ('continuity' if continuity else 'bounds-registry'))
```

`tools/check-native-dma-clear-span-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compile actual DMA clear/registration methods with byte-span witnesses."""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
source = (ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/video_core/buffer_cache/buffer_cache.h").read_text()


def method(name):
    begin = "template <class P>\nbool BufferCache<P>::" + name + "("
    assert source.count(begin) == 1
    return begin + source.split(begin, 1)[1].split("\ntemplate <class P>", 1)[0]


clear = method("DMAClear")
registered = method("IsRegionRegistered")
fixed = "IsRegionRegistered(*cpu_dst_address, size)"
original = clear.replace(fixed, "IsRegionRegistered(*cpu_dst_address, amount)")
cpp = r'''
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <optional>
#include <vector>
using u32 = std::uint32_t;
using u64 = std::uint64_t;
using DAddr = u64;
using GPUVAddr = u64;
using BufferId = unsigned;
namespace Common { u64 DivCeil(u64 n, u64 d) { return n / d + (n % d != 0); } }
struct Buffer {
    DAddr base{};
    std::size_t size{}, marked{};
    DAddr CpuAddr() { return base; }
    std::size_t SizeBytes() { return size; }
    u32 Offset(DAddr address) { assert(address >= base); return address - base; }
    void MarkUsage(u32 offset, std::size_t bytes) {
        assert(offset + bytes <= size); marked = bytes;
    }
};
struct Mapping {
    bool present = true;
    std::optional<DAddr> GpuToCpuAddress(GPUVAddr address) {
        return present ? std::optional<DAddr>(address) : std::nullopt;
    }
};
template <class P> struct BufferCache {
    static constexpr u32 CACHING_PAGEBITS = 16;
    static constexpr u64 CACHING_PAGESIZE = u64{1} << CACHING_PAGEBITS;
    std::array<BufferId, 4> page_table{};
    std::array<Buffer, 3> slot_buffers{};
    Mapping mapping;
    Mapping* gpu_memory = &mapping;
    struct Ranges { std::size_t bytes{}; unsigned calls{};
        void Subtract(DAddr, std::size_t size) { bytes = size; ++calls; }
    } gpu_modified_ranges;
    struct Runtime {
        std::vector<u32> image = std::vector<u32>(65536, 0x12345678);
        unsigned calls{};
        void ClearBuffer(Buffer& buffer, u32 offset, std::size_t size, u32 value) {
            assert(size % sizeof(u32) == 0);
            const auto first = (buffer.base + offset) / sizeof(u32);
            assert(first + size / sizeof(u32) <= image.size());
            std::fill_n(image.begin() + first, size / sizeof(u32), value);
            ++calls;
        }
    } runtime;
    unsigned downloads{}, finds{};
    std::size_t download_size{};
    void ClearDownload(DAddr, std::size_t size) { ++downloads; download_size = size; }
    BufferId FindBuffer(DAddr address, u32 size, bool insert) {
        assert(!insert); ++finds;
        slot_buffers[2] = Buffer{address, size, 0}; return 2;
    }
    bool DMAClear(GPUVAddr, u64, u32);
    bool IsRegionRegistered(DAddr, std::size_t);
};
__CLEAR__
__REGISTERED__
int main() {
    constexpr DAddr address = 4096;
    constexpr u64 words = 16384, bytes = words * sizeof(u32);
    constexpr u32 pattern = 0xaabbccdd;
    BufferCache<int> late;
    late.slot_buffers[1] = Buffer{65536, 65536, 0}; late.page_table[1] = 1;
    assert(!late.IsRegionRegistered(address, words));
    assert(late.IsRegionRegistered(address, bytes));
    // Only the last part overlaps an existing GPU buffer. A word count used
    // as bytes misses that buffer and leaves the registered GPU data stale.
    assert(late.DMAClear(address, words, pattern));
    assert(late.runtime.calls == 1 && late.finds == 1 && late.downloads == 1);
    assert(late.download_size == bytes && late.gpu_modified_ranges.bytes == bytes);
    assert(late.slot_buffers[2].marked == bytes);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < late.runtime.image.size(); ++i)
        assert(late.runtime.image[i] ==
               (i >= address / 4 && i < (address + bytes) / 4 ? pattern : 0x12345678));
    // No registered range: retain the caller's CPU fallback, no GPU work.
    BufferCache<int> absent;
    assert(!absent.DMAClear(address, words, pattern));
    assert(!absent.runtime.calls && !absent.finds && !absent.downloads);
    absent.mapping.present = false;
    assert(!absent.DMAClear(address, words, pattern));
    assert(!absent.runtime.calls && !absent.finds && !absent.downloads);
    // Registration at the beginning still takes the same accelerated route.
    BufferCache<int> early;
    early.slot_buffers[1] = Buffer{0, 65536, 0}; early.page_table[0] = 1;
    assert(early.DMAClear(address, 8, pattern));
    assert(early.download_size == 32 && early.runtime.calls == 1);
    for (const auto invalid : std::array<u64, 4>{0, (u64{1} << 30),
                                               (u64{1} << 30) + 1, ~u64{0}}) {
        BufferCache<int> bounded;
        bounded.slot_buffers[1] = Buffer{0, 65536, 0}; bounded.page_table[0] = 1;
        assert(!bounded.DMAClear(address, invalid, pattern));
        assert(!bounded.runtime.calls && !bounded.finds && !bounded.downloads);
        assert(!bounded.gpu_modified_ranges.calls);
    }
    std::puts("DMA_CLEAR_SPAN_PASS late_overlap=1 fallback_preserved=1 byte_range_exact=1");
}
'''
compiler = shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
assert compiler
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-dma-clear-") as temp:
    folder = Path(temp)
    for name, body in (("original", original), ("maintained", clear)):
        path, executable = folder / (name + ".cpp"), folder / name
        path.write_text(cpp.replace("__CLEAR__", body).replace("__REGISTERED__", registered))
        subprocess.run([compiler, "-std=c++20", "-O2", "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror",
                        "-fsanitize=address,undefined", "-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
                        str(path), "-o", str(executable)], check=True, timeout=60)
        result = subprocess.run([str(executable)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
        if name == "original":
            assert result.returncode != 0 and "Assertion" in result.stderr, result.stderr
            print("ORIGINAL_DMA_CLEAR_SHORT_SPAN_REPRODUCED")
        else:
            assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr
            assert fixed in clear, "DMA clear must check the complete byte span"
            print(result.stdout, end="")
print("DMA_CLEAR_HOST_ONLY native_GPU_and_gameplay=unverified")
```

```py
    if (pitch_wide > max_transfer ||
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Execute pinned DMA dispatcher, step and decoder to reject naive resume.

Host-only fixture supplies fake memory and method side effects. Tests expose
duplicate execution when DispatchCalls is restarted after a completed Step,
or when an exception interrupts ProcessCommands after a method side effect.
It deliberately proposes NO native fix and does not enable bridge #187.

from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

    assert pinned.count(end) == 1, end

prelude = r"""

}
struct FakeGPU {
    unsigned flushes = 0, command_list_ends = 0;
    void FlushCommands() { ++flushes; }
    void OnCommandListEnd() { ++command_list_ends; }
};
struct FakeSystem {
    int budget = 20;
    FakeGPU gpu;
    bool IsPoweredOn() { if (budget <= 0) return false; --budget; return true; }
    FakeGPU& GPU() { return gpu; }
};
namespace Tegra {
constexpr u32 MacroRegistersStart = 0xe00;
enum class SubmissionMode : u32 {
    Increasing = 1, NonIncreasing = 3, Inline = 4, IncreaseOnce = 5
};
struct CommandHeader {
    u32 argument = 0, method = 0, subchannel = 0;
    u32 arg_count = 0, method_count = 0;
    SubmissionMode mode = SubmissionMode::Inline;

        }

tests = r"""
static Tegra::CommandHeader Inline(u32 value) {
    Tegra::CommandHeader c;
    c.mode = Tegra::SubmissionMode::Inline;
    c.method = 0x50;
    c.arg_count = value;
    return c;
}
static Tegra::CommandList TwoSegments() {
    Tegra::CommandList c;
    c.command_lists.push_back({0x1000, 1, false});
    c.command_lists.push_back({0x2000, 1, false});
    return c;
}
static void InitMem(Tegra::MemoryManager& memory) {
    memory.ram[0x1000] = {Inline(11)};
    memory.ram[0x2000] = {Inline(22)};
}
static void CompleteNormally(bool safe) {
    test_safe = safe;
    FakeSystem sys;
    Tegra::MemoryManager mem;
    InitMem(mem);
    Tegra::DmaPusher dma(sys, mem);
    dma.Push(TwoSegments());
    dma.DispatchCalls();
    assert((dma.observed == std::vector<u32>{11, 22}));
    assert(dma.dma_pushbuffer.empty());
    assert(sys.gpu.flushes == 1 && sys.gpu.command_list_ends == 1);
}
static void RestartDispatcherDuplicatesStep(bool safe) {
    test_safe = safe;
    FakeSystem sys;
    sys.budget = 1; // Cut the dispatcher BETWEEN two completed Step calls.
    Tegra::MemoryManager mem;
    InitMem(mem);
    Tegra::DmaPusher dma(sys, mem);
    dma.Push(TwoSegments());
    dma.DispatchCalls();
    assert((dma.observed == std::vector<u32>{11}));
    assert(dma.dma_pushbuffer_subindex == 1);
    assert(!dma.dma_pushbuffer.empty());
    sys.budget = 10;
    dma.DispatchCalls(); // Native dispatcher unconditionally resets subindex.
    assert((dma.observed == std::vector<u32>{11, 11, 22}));
    assert(dma.dma_pushbuffer.empty());
    assert(sys.gpu.flushes == 2 && sys.gpu.command_list_ends == 2);
}
static void ThrowInsideMethodDuplicatesEffect(bool safe) {
    test_safe = safe;
    FakeSystem sys;
    Tegra::MemoryManager mem;
    InitMem(mem);
    Tegra::DmaPusher dma(sys, mem);
    dma.Push(TwoSegments());
    dma.pause_after_first_effect = true;
    bool caught = false;
    try { (void)dma.Step(); }
    catch (const Tegra::PauseAfterMethod&) { caught = true; }
    assert(caught && dma.dma_pushbuffer_subindex == 0);
    assert((dma.observed == std::vector<u32>{11}));
    assert(dma.Step() && dma.Step());
    assert((dma.observed == std::vector<u32>{11, 11, 22}));
}
static void StepCursorAloneDoesNotDuplicate(bool safe) {
    test_safe = safe;
    FakeSystem sys;
    Tegra::MemoryManager mem;
    InitMem(mem);
    Tegra::DmaPusher dma(sys, mem);
    dma.Push(TwoSegments());
    assert(dma.Step());
    assert(dma.dma_pushbuffer_subindex == 1);
    assert(dma.Step());
    assert((dma.observed == std::vector<u32>{11, 22}));
    assert(dma.dma_pushbuffer.empty());
    // Not a proposed production resume: Step by itself omits final
    // FlushCommands and OnCommandListEnd from DispatchCalls.
    assert(sys.gpu.flushes == 0 && sys.gpu.command_list_ends == 0);
}
int main() {
    for (bool safe : {false, true}) {
        CompleteNormally(safe);
        RestartDispatcherDuplicatesStep(safe);
        ThrowInsideMethodDuplicatesEffect(safe);
        StepCursorAloneDoesNotDuplicate(safe);
    }
    std::puts("PINNED_DMA_DISPATCH_RESTART_DUPLICATE_NEGATIVE_PASS");
    std::puts("PINNED_DMA_METHOD_PARTIAL_EFFECT_DUPLICATE_NEGATIVE_PASS");
    std::puts("PINNED_DMA_STEP_CURSOR_ONLY_INCOMPLETE_FINALIZATION_PASS");
    std::puts("DMA_RESUME_NATIVE_BRIDGE_NOT_QUALIFIED");
}
"""
compiler = shutil.which("g++") or shutil.which("clang++")
assert compiler, "C++20 compiler required"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-dma-resume-") as folder:
```

```py
u64& ContextRsp(void* p) noexcept { return static_cast<Context*>(p)->sp; }
```
