```py
#include "common/fiber.h"
#include <array>
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <new>
#include <semaphore>
#include <thread>
static std::atomic<std::size_t> large_bytes;
void* operator new(std::size_t bytes) {
    if (auto* p = std::malloc(bytes)) {
        if (bytes >= 1024 * 1024) large_bytes.fetch_add(bytes, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        return p;
    }
    throw std::bad_alloc{};
}
void operator delete(void* p) noexcept { std::free(p); }
void operator delete(void* p, std::size_t) noexcept { std::free(p); }
int main() {
    std::array<std::binary_semaphore, 2> turn{std::binary_semaphore{1}, std::binary_semaphore{0}};
    std::atomic<Common::Fiber*> active_host{};
    std::atomic<unsigned> active_worker{}, transitions{};
    std::array<unsigned, 2> visits{};
    std::shared_ptr<Common::Fiber> guest;
    guest = std::make_shared<Common::Fiber>([&] {
        for (;;) {
            ++visits[active_worker.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)];
            transitions.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
            Common::Fiber::YieldTo(guest, *active_host.load(std::memory_order_acquire));
        }
    });
    const auto guest_bytes = large_bytes.exchange(0);
    auto worker = [&](unsigned id) {
        auto host = Common::Fiber::ThreadToFiber();
        for (unsigned iteration = 0; iteration < 64; ++iteration) {
            turn[id].acquire();
            active_worker.store(id, std::memory_order_relaxed);
            active_host.store(host.get(), std::memory_order_release);
            Common::Fiber::YieldTo(host, *guest);
            turn[1 - id].release();
        }
        host->Exit();
    };
    std::thread a(worker, 0), b(worker, 1);
    a.join(); b.join();
    assert(transitions == 128 && visits[0] == 64 && visits[1] == 64);
    const auto host_bytes = large_bytes.load();
#ifdef OLD_STACK
    assert(guest_bytes >= 4 * 1024 * 1024 && host_bytes >= 8 * 1024 * 1024);
#else
    assert(guest_bytes >= 2 * 1024 * 1024 && guest_bytes < 2 * 1024 * 1024 + 4096);
    assert(host_bytes == 0);
#endif
    guest.reset();
    std::printf("FIBER_STACK_HOST_PASS switches=128 migrated_workers=2 guest_large_bytes=%zu "
                "host_large_bytes=%zu guards_and_exit=preserved\n", guest_bytes, host_bytes);
}
'''
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
"""F05: native nvdisp -> GPU::Impl -> Host1x syncpoint composite replay.

Compile the actual nvdisp::Composite/WaitForComposite, GPU::Impl
RequestComposite/WaitForComposite, and SyncpointManager RegisterAction /
IncrementGuest / Increment C++ bodies together. External GPU scheduler,
Vulkan renderer, driver nvmap and timing are explicitly mocked.
No emulator game/SDK, scanout, GPU completion or FC27 performance proof.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
NV = (ROOT/"vendor/sources/eden/src/core/hle/service/nvdrv/devices/nvdisp_disp0.cpp").read_text()
GPU = (ROOT/"vendor/sources/eden/src/video_core/gpu.cpp").read_text()
SYNC = (ROOT/"vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/video_core/host1x/syncpoint_manager.cpp").read_text()
FAST = (ROOT/".github/workflows/encore-core-fast-gate.yml").read_text()
FULL = (ROOT/".github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml").read_text()
NAME = "python3 -B tools/check-native-gpu-composite-syncpoint-host.py"
assert NAME in FAST and NAME in FULL

def extract(text, signature):
    assert text.count(signature) == 1, ("source drift", signature)
    start = text.index(signature)
    brace = text.index("{", start)
    depth = 0
    for end in range(brace, len(text)):
        if text[end] == "{":
            depth += 1
        elif text[end] == "}":
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0:
                return text[start:end+1]
    raise AssertionError(("unbalanced source", signature))

nv_methods = "\n".join(extract(NV, marker) for marker in (
    "void nvdisp_disp0::Composite(",
    "void nvdisp_disp0::WaitForComposite(",
))
gpu_methods = "\n".join(extract(GPU, marker) for marker in (
    "    void RequestComposite(",
    "    void WaitForComposite(",
))

sync_helpers=SYNC[hs:he].replace("std::array<std::recursive_mutex, 192>& HostDispatchLocks()", "[[maybe_unused]] std::array<std::recursive_mutex, 192>& HostDispatchLocks()")

sync_methods = "\n".join(extract(SYNC, marker) for marker in (
    "SyncpointManager::ActionHandle SyncpointManager::RegisterAction(",
    "void SyncpointManager::IncrementGuest(",
    "void SyncpointManager::Increment(",
))

cpp = r"""
#include <algorithm>

using u32 = std::uint32_t;

namespace Service::Nvidia {
struct NvFence { int id{-1}; u32 value{}; };
}
namespace Tegra {
enum class BlendMode { Opaque };
struct FramebufferConfig {
    u64 address{};
    int offset{},width{},height{},stride{},pixel_format{};
    int transform_flags{},crop_rect{};
    BlendMode blending{};
    int layer_stack_mask{};
};
namespace Host1x {
class SyncpointManager {
public:
    struct RegisteredAction {
        u32 expected_value{};
        std::function<void()> action;
        RegisteredAction(u32 v,std::function<void()>&& a)
            : expected_value(v),action(std::move(a)) {}
    };
    using ActionHandle=std::list<RegisteredAction>::iterator;
    std::array<std::atomic<u32>,192> syncpoints_guest{};
    std::array<std::list<RegisteredAction>,192> guest_action_storage;
    std::mutex guard;
    std::condition_variable wait_guest_cv;
    template<typename Func>
    ActionHandle RegisterGuestAction(u32 id,u32 expected,Func&& action) {
        return RegisterAction(syncpoints_guest[id],guest_action_storage[id],
                              expected,std::move(action));
    }
    ActionHandle RegisterAction(std::atomic<u32>&,std::list<RegisteredAction>&,
                                u32,std::function<void()>&&);
    void IncrementGuest(u32);
    void Increment(std::atomic<u32>&,std::condition_variable&,
                   std::list<RegisteredAction>&);
};
__SYNC_METHODS__
struct Host1x {
    SyncpointManager manager;
    SyncpointManager& GetSyncpointManager() {return manager;}
};
} // namespace Host1x

    }

class GPU {
public:
    struct Impl {
        Core::System& system;
        Renderer* renderer{};
        bool is_async{true};
        std::atomic_bool shutting_down{};
        u64 pending_composite_fence{};
        u64 last_sync_fence{};
        u64 signaled_sync_fence{};
        unsigned wait_calls{},tick_calls{};
        std::deque<std::function<void()>> operations;
        std::deque<size_t> free_swap_counters;
        std::deque<size_t> request_swap_counters;
        std::mutex request_swap_mutex;
        struct Scheduler {
            Impl* impl{};
            void TickGPU(bool){++impl->tick_calls;impl->Drain();}
        } gpu_thread{this};
        explicit Impl(Core::System& s,Renderer& r):system(s),renderer(&r){}
        template<class F> u64 RequestSyncOperation(F&& f) {
            operations.emplace_back(std::forward<F>(f));
            return ++last_sync_fence;
        }
        void Drain() {
            while(!operations.empty()){
                auto fn=std::move(operations.front());
                operations.pop_front();
                fn();
                ++signaled_sync_fence;
            }
        }
        void WaitForSyncOperation(u64 fence){
            ++wait_calls;
            assert(signaled_sync_fence>=fence);
        }
__GPU_METHODS__
    };
    Impl impl;
    explicit GPU(Core::System& s,Renderer& r):impl(s,r){}
    void RequestComposite(std::vector<FramebufferConfig>&& layers,
                          std::vector<Service::Nvidia::NvFence>&& fences) {
        impl.RequestComposite(std::move(layers),std::move(fences));
    }
    void WaitForComposite(){impl.WaitForComposite();}

static Service::Nvnflinger::HwcLayer MakeLayer(int handle,
                                              std::initializer_list<Service::Nvidia::NvFence> fences) {
    Service::Nvnflinger::HwcLayer layer{};
    layer.buffer_handle=handle;
    layer.width=1920;layer.height=1080;layer.stride=1920;
    layer.acquire_fence.num_fences=fences.size();
    assert(fences.size()<=layer.acquire_fence.fences.size());
    std::copy(fences.begin(),fences.end(),layer.acquire_fence.fences.begin());
    return layer;
}
int main() {
    Core::System system;
    Tegra::Renderer renderer;
    Tegra::GPU gpu(system,renderer);
    system.gpu=&gpu;
    Service::Nvidia::Devices::nvdisp_disp0 display(system);
    auto& sync=system.Host1x().GetSyncpointManager();
    using F=Service::Nvidia::NvFence;
    const auto submit=[&](std::initializer_list<Service::Nvnflinger::HwcLayer> layers){
        std::vector<Service::Nvnflinger::HwcLayer> list(layers);
        display.Composite(list);
        display.WaitForComposite();
    };
    // No guest fence => renderer receives native nvdisp mapping immediately.
    submit({MakeLayer(7,{})});
    assert(renderer.deliveries.size()==1);
    assert((renderer.deliveries.back()==std::vector<u64>{0x100007ULL}));
    assert(gpu.impl.request_swap_counters.empty());

    // Two distinct outstanding fences. RequestSyncOperation completes before
    // the raster work: WaitForComposite must NOT be treated as a present ACK.
    submit({MakeLayer(8,{F{4,1}}),MakeLayer(9,{F{5,1}})});
    assert(renderer.deliveries.size()==1 && gpu.impl.wait_calls==2);
    assert(gpu.impl.request_swap_counters.size()==1);
    sync.IncrementGuest(5);
    assert(renderer.deliveries.size()==1);
    sync.IncrementGuest(4);
    assert(renderer.deliveries.size()==2);
    assert((renderer.deliveries.back()==std::vector<u64>{0x100008ULL,0x100009ULL}));
    assert(gpu.impl.free_swap_counters.size()==1);

    // Duplicate syncpoint id, different thresholds, and invalid id filtering.
    submit({MakeLayer(10,{F{-1,123},F{6,1},F{6,2}})});
    assert(renderer.deliveries.size()==2);
    sync.IncrementGuest(6);
    assert(renderer.deliveries.size()==2);
    sync.IncrementGuest(6);
    assert(renderer.deliveries.size()==3 && renderer.deliveries.back()[0]==0x10000aULL);
    assert(gpu.impl.request_swap_counters.size()==1); // reuse released counter

    // Guest fence already satisfied at registration: real RegisterAction runs
    // it synchronously. Multiple callbacks must still publish only ONE frame.
    submit({MakeLayer(11,{F{4,1},F{5,1}})});
    assert(renderer.deliveries.size()==4);
    assert(renderer.deliveries.back()[0]==0x10000bULL);

    // Long stress: alternate deferred and immediate fence paths. No phantom
    // completion and no unbounded growth of request counter slots.
    for(u32 i=0;i<256;++i){
        const u32 required=i+1;
        submit({MakeLayer(100+static_cast<int>(i),{F{9,required},F{10,required}})});
        const auto prior=renderer.deliveries.size();
        sync.IncrementGuest(10);
        assert(renderer.deliveries.size()==prior);
        sync.IncrementGuest(9);
        assert(renderer.deliveries.size()==prior+1);
        assert(gpu.impl.request_swap_counters.size()==1);
        assert(gpu.impl.free_swap_counters.size()==1);
    }
    assert(system.perf.ended==260 && system.perf.begun==260);
    assert(system.limiter.calls==260);
    assert(Common::ADPF::reports==260);
    assert(gpu.impl.wait_calls==260);
    assert(gpu.impl.tick_calls==260);
    assert(renderer.deliveries.size()==260);
    std::puts("F05_NV_DISP_GPU_SYNCPOINT_SOURCE_PASS requests=260 delayed_and_immediate_fences=verified");
    std::puts("F05_PRESENT_ACK_NOT_PROVEN host_GPU_request_completion_precedes_guest_fence_callback");
}
"""
cpp=cpp.replace("__NV_METHODS__",nv_methods)
cpp=cpp.replace("__GPU_METHODS__",gpu_methods)
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compare actual dirty collectors: exact ordered coverage and callback cost."""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

fixture = r'''
#include "core/gpu_dirty_memory_manager.h"
#include "previous.h"
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdio>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>
using Range = std::pair<PAddr, std::size_t>;
using Ranges = std::vector<Range>;
template<class Manager>
Ranges Gather(Manager& manager) {
    Ranges result;
    std::function<void(PAddr, std::size_t)> callback = [&](PAddr a, std::size_t n) {
        assert(n && a % 64 == 0 && n % 64 == 0);
        result.emplace_back(a, n);
    };
    manager.Gather(callback);
    return result;
}
std::vector<PAddr> Expand(const Ranges& ranges, bool rasterizer = false) {
    std::vector<PAddr> cells;
    for (const auto& [a, n] : ranges) {
        if (rasterizer && a == 0) continue;
        for (PAddr p = a; p < a + n; p += 64) cells.push_back(p);
    }
    return cells;
}
void Check(const Ranges& writes, bool linear = false) {
    PreviousCore::GPUDirtyMemoryManager previous;
    Core::GPUDirtyMemoryManager current;
    for (unsigned epoch = 0; epoch < 2; ++epoch) {
        for (const auto& [a, n] : writes) {
            previous.Collect(a, n); current.Collect(a, n);
        }
        const auto before = Gather(previous), after = Gather(current);
        // Exact sequence includes duplicates, backward ranges and every gap.
        assert(Expand(before) == Expand(after));
        // Both actual rasterizers ignore callbacks starting at address zero.
        // Such a range must never swallow a following nonzero invalidation.
        assert(Expand(before, true) == Expand(after, true));
        assert(after.size() <= before.size());
        for (const auto& [a, n] : after) { (void)a; assert(n <= 256 * 1024); }
        assert(Gather(previous).empty() && Gather(current).empty());
        if (linear) {
            assert(before.size() == 1024 && after.size() == 8);
            assert(after.front() == Range(0x100000, 256 * 1024));
            if (!epoch) std::printf("GPU_DIRTY_GATHER_HOST_PASS contiguous_bytes=2097152 callbacks=%zu->%zu\n",
                                    before.size(), after.size());
        }
    }
}
int main() {
    Ranges sequential;
    for (PAddr a = 0x100000; a < 0x300000; a += 2048) sequential.emplace_back(a, 2048);
    Check(sequential, true);
    Check({{0, 2048}, {2048, 2048}, {4096, 2048}});
    Check({{0x1000, 64}, {0x1080, 64}, {0x17c0, 64}, {0x1800, 64},
           {0x2000, 64}, {0x1000, 192}, {0x800, 2048}, {0x4000, 2048}});
    Ranges scattered;
    std::uint64_t state = 0x516784352;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8192; ++i) {
        state ^= state << 13; state ^= state >> 7; state ^= state << 17;
        const PAddr base = ((state >> 11) % 64) * 2048;
        const auto offset = state % 2048;
        const auto size = 1 + (state >> 32) % (2048 - offset);
        scattered.emplace_back(base + offset, size);
    }
    Check(scattered);
    // Writes arriving from a callback belong to the next Gather epoch.
    Core::GPUDirtyMemoryManager current;
    current.Collect(0x2000, 2048); current.Collect(0x2800, 2048);
    unsigned calls = 0;
    std::function<void(PAddr, std::size_t)> callback = [&](PAddr a, std::size_t n) {
        assert(a == 0x2000 && n == 4096); ++calls;
        current.Collect(0x3000, 64);
    };
    current.Gather(callback);
    assert(calls == 1);
    assert((Gather(current) == Ranges{{0x3000, 64}}));
    assert(Gather(current).empty());
    std::puts("GPU_DIRTY_GATHER_COVERAGE_PASS randomized=8192 gaps=preserved order=preserved epochs=isolated");
}
'''
compiler = shutil.which('clang++-18') or shutil.which('clang++') or shutil.which('g++')
```

```py
"""Host sanitizer regression for 2-KiB GPU dirty mask boundaries.

Checks actual native source-derivation anchors and the exact 32-bit mask
construction on the split chunks. This is not a console/Vulkan test.

import shutil

# never CMake-generated replacements. Both ISA modes must retain the exact
# pre-mask split, rather than depending on a diagnostic build flag.

    (root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/core"/name).read_text()
    for name in ("memory_native_standard.cpp", "memory_native_a32.cpp")

# Embed the ACTUAL pinned original mask builder, rather than a
# hand-transcribed equivalent. The negative control must trip UBSan at 4KiB
# while the bounded splitter must keep every call within 32 mask bits.
mask_begin = "    template <typename T>" + chr(10) + "    T CreateMask("
mask_end = "    TransformAddress BuildTransform("

cpp = r"""
#include "gpu_dirty_region_split.h"
#include "core/gpu_dirty_memory_manager.h"
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <limits>
#include <set>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>
using namespace Eden::GpuDirty;
struct ActualPinnedMask {
@@MASK_SOURCE@@
};

// Independent historical splitter oracle: compare the exact ordered
// callback sequence, not just a final union of changed 64-byte cells.
void CompareOriginalSplit(std::uint64_t address, std::uint64_t bytes) {
    std::vector<std::pair<std::uint64_t, std::uint64_t>> expected, actual;
    std::uint64_t remaining = bytes, cursor = address;
    while (remaining != 0) {
        const auto span = std::min(remaining, kRegionBytes - (cursor & (kRegionBytes - 1)));
        expected.emplace_back(cursor, span);
        cursor += span;
        remaining -= span;
    }
    ForEachRegion(address, bytes, [&](std::uint64_t addr, std::uint64_t n) {
        actual.emplace_back(addr, n);
    });
    assert(expected == actual);
}

void Verify(std::uint64_t address, std::uint64_t bytes) {
    CompareOriginalSplit(address, bytes);
    std::uint64_t cursor = address, total = 0;
    unsigned emitted = 0;
    ForEachRegion(address, bytes, [&](std::uint64_t position, std::uint64_t size) {
        assert(position == cursor);
        assert(size > 0 && size <= kRegionBytes);
        assert(position / kRegionBytes == (position + size - 1) / kRegionBytes);
        const std::uint64_t offset = position % kRegionBytes;
        const auto low = offset / 64;
        const auto high = (offset + size + 63) / 64;
        // Exact GPUDirtyMemoryManager::CreateMask<u32> shifts.
        assert(high > 0 && high <= 32 && low < 32);
        const auto mask = ActualPinnedMask{}.CreateMask<std::uint32_t>(high, low);
        for (unsigned cell = 0; cell < 32; ++cell) {
            const bool covered = ((cell + 1) * 64 > offset) &&
                                 (cell * 64 < offset + size);
            assert(bool(mask & (std::uint32_t{1} << cell)) == covered);
        }
        cursor += size;
        total += size;
        ++emitted;
    });
    assert(total == bytes && cursor == address + bytes);
    assert((bytes == 0) == (emitted == 0));
}

// Unlike the mask-only fixture, this path executes the actual pinned
// GPUDirtyMemoryManager::Collect and Gather implementation after splitting.
void VerifyCollector(std::uint64_t address, std::uint64_t bytes) {
    Core::GPUDirtyMemoryManager manager;
    ForEachRegion(address, bytes, [&](std::uint64_t a, std::uint64_t n) {
        manager.Collect(a, static_cast<std::size_t>(n));
    });
    std::set<std::uint64_t> observed, expected;
    std::function<void(PAddr, std::size_t)> gather = [&](PAddr a, std::size_t n) {
        assert((a % 64) == 0 && n != 0 && (n % 64) == 0);
        for (std::uint64_t part = a; part < a + n; part += 64) {
            observed.insert(part);
        }
    };
    manager.Gather(gather);
    if (bytes) {
        for (std::uint64_t part = address & ~std::uint64_t{63};
             part < address + bytes; part += 64) {
            expected.insert(part);
        }
    }
    assert(observed == expected);
}

int main(int argc, char**) {
    if (argc > 1) {
        // Original 4KiB tracked write: top_bit=64 on a 32-bit mask.
        volatile std::size_t top_bit = 64;
        (void)ActualPinnedMask{}.CreateMask<std::uint32_t>(top_bit, 0);
        return 0; // UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer must abort first.
    }
    // The hot single-region path must call Collect exactly once; an
    // empty guest write must never publish an incorrect dirty mask.
    unsigned hot_calls = 0;
    ForEachRegion(0x1001, 8, [&](std::uint64_t addr, std::uint64_t count) {
        assert(addr == 0x1001 && count == 8);
        ++hot_calls;
    });
    assert(hot_calls == 1);
    ForEachRegion(0x1001, 0, [&](std::uint64_t, std::uint64_t) {
        ++hot_calls;
    });
    assert(hot_calls == 1);
    unsigned calls = 0;
    ForEachRegion(0x1000, 4096, [&](std::uint64_t a, std::uint64_t n) {
        assert(a == 0x1000 + calls * 2048 && n == 2048);
        ++calls;
    });
    assert(calls == 2);
    calls = 0;
    ForEachRegion(0x17fc, 16, [&](std::uint64_t a, std::uint64_t n) {
        if (calls == 0) assert(a == 0x17fc && n == 4);
        if (calls == 1) assert(a == 0x1800 && n == 12);
        ++calls;
    });
    assert(calls == 2);
    // Aligned full regions and one partial tail after the peeled fragment.
    calls = 0;
    ForEachRegion(0x1801, 3 * 2048 + 17, [&](std::uint64_t a, std::uint64_t n) {
        if (calls == 0) assert(a == 0x1801 && n == 2047);
        if (calls == 1) assert(a == 0x2000 && n == 2048);
        if (calls == 2) assert(a == 0x2800 && n == 2048);
        if (calls == 3) assert(a == 0x3000 && n == 18);
        ++calls;
    });
    assert(calls == 4);
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Deterministic atomic dirty-mask race: pinned negative vs maintained native header.

The test pauses a page switch *after* the old mask was copied to the replay
vector. Another producer atomically adds a bit to that old page. The pinned
header then loses that bit, whereas the native replacement captures the
actual displaced atomic value. A host result does not qualify console timing.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
pinned = (root / "vendor/sources/eden/src/core/gpu_dirty_memory_manager.h").read_text()
maintained = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-core/overrides/core/gpu_dirty_memory_manager.h").read_text()
cmake = (root / "headless/CMakeLists.txt").read_text()
workflow = (root / ".github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml").read_text()

old = "                    back_buffer.emplace_back(tmp);\\n                    current.exchange(t, std::memory_order_relaxed);"
fixed = """                    // A concurrent same-region CAS can extend the mask AFTER
                    // our initial load. Exchange first, then save the actual
                    // displaced value in the already reserved vector slot.
                    // This keeps the normal same-region CAS path lock-free.
                    back_buffer.emplace_back(tmp);
                    back_buffer.back() = current.exchange(t, std::memory_order_acq_rel);"""
assert pinned.count(old.replace("\\n", "\n")) == 1
sentinel_before = """    bool IsValid(PAddr address) {
        return address < (1ULL << 39);
    }"""
sentinel_after = """    bool IsValid(PAddr address) {
        // The packed address is u32. Its all-ones default sentinel is always
        // below 2^39, so the original range check took the mutex on EVERY
        // first Collect after Gather and queued an empty transform.
        return address != default_transform.address && address < (1ULL << 39);
    }"""
assert pinned.count(sentinel_before) == 1
expected = pinned.replace(old.replace("\\n", "\n"), fixed).replace(
    sentinel_before, sentinel_after
)
gather_prefix = """        // Collect splits writes into 2-KiB masks. Rejoin adjacent runs before
        // invalidating caches, without sorting or spanning clean gaps. Bound
        // each callback to the image-page probe limit and keep address zero
        // separate: rasterizers deliberately ignore invalidations starting there.
        constexpr size_t max_batch_size = 256 * 1024;
        static_assert(page_size <= max_batch_size);
        PAddr pending_address = 0;
        size_t pending_size = 0;
        const auto emit = [&](PAddr address, size_t size) {
            if (pending_size != 0 && pending_address != 0 &&
                pending_address + pending_size == address &&
                size <= max_batch_size - pending_size) {
                pending_size += size;
                return;
            }
            if (pending_size != 0) {
                callback(pending_address, pending_size);
            }
            pending_address = address;
            pending_size = size;
        };
"""
gather_deltas = (
    ('        for (auto& transform : front_buffer) {',
     gather_prefix + '        for (auto& transform : front_buffer) {'),
    ('                callback((static_cast<PAddr>(transform.address) << page_bits) + offset,\n'
     '                         continuous_bits << align_bits);',
     '                emit((static_cast<PAddr>(transform.address) << page_bits) + offset,\n'
     '                     continuous_bits << align_bits);'),
    ('        front_buffer.clear();',
     '        if (pending_size != 0) {\n'
     '            callback(pending_address, pending_size);\n'
     '        }\n        front_buffer.clear();'),
)
for before, after in gather_deltas:
    assert expected.count(before) == 1
    expected = expected.replace(before, after)
# The shipping PS5 header is a maintained owner. The unchanged pinned Eden
# source remains the exact negative-oracle baseline for these M09 rewrites.
# Serialize the consumer after preserving every existing Collect and batch
# behavior, rather than silently patching vendor/sources/eden.
gather_before = """    void Gather(std::function<void(PAddr, size_t)>& callback) {
        {
            std::scoped_lock lk(guard);"""
gather_after = """    void Gather(std::function<void(PAddr, size_t)>& callback) {
        // Video decode can gather GPU dirty regions off the graphics worker.
        // Keep the complete swap, callback walk and clear exclusive among
        // gatherers. Collect still runs under its independent producer guard.
        std::scoped_lock gather_lock(gather_guard);
        {
            std::scoped_lock lk(guard);"""
field_before = """    std::atomic<TransformAddress> current{};
    std::mutex guard;
    std::vector<TransformAddress> back_buffer;"""
field_after = """    std::atomic<TransformAddress> current{};
    std::mutex guard;
    std::mutex gather_guard;
    std::vector<TransformAddress> back_buffer;"""
# The pinned Eden source now already carries gather serialization. Verify
# that this protection is present and retain the maintained owner’s
# semantically identical implementation while replaying the M09 changes.
pinned_gather = """    void Gather(std::function<void(PAddr, size_t)>& callback) {
        // Video decode/host1x flushes can gather off the GPU thread.
        // A second gather must not swap or clear front_buffer while the
        // first is still iterating callbacks. Keep the lock through clear().
        std::scoped_lock gather_lock{gather_guard};
        {
            std::scoped_lock lk(guard);"""
assert expected.count(pinned_gather) == 1, "Pinned Gather source drift"
assert expected.count(field_after) == 1, "Pinned Gather mutex missing"
expected = expected.replace(pinned_gather, gather_after)
assert maintained == expected
assert 'set(EDEN_NATIVE_DIRTY_HEADER_ROOT' in cmake
assert 'target_include_directories(core BEFORE PUBLIC "${EDEN_NATIVE_DIRTY_HEADER_ROOT}")' in cmake
assert 'if(PS5_NATIVE)' in cmake.split('set(EDEN_NATIVE_DIRTY_HEADER_ROOT', 1)[0]
assert "python3 -B tools/check-native-gpu-dirty-transition-host.py" in workflow
assert maintained.count("back_buffer.back() = current.exchange(t, std::memory_order_acq_rel);") == 1

source = r"""
#include "core/gpu_dirty_memory_manager.h"
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <set>
#include <thread>

static std::atomic<int> phase{0};
void Core::PinnedRaceGate() {
    int expected = 0;
    assert(phase.compare_exchange_strong(expected, 1));
    while (phase.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != 2) {
        std::this_thread::yield();
    }
}
int main() {
    constexpr PAddr first = 0x2000, next = 0x2800;
    Core::GPUDirtyMemoryManager dirty;
    dirty.Collect(first, 64);
#ifdef EXPECT_FIXED
    assert(Core::sentinel_lock_hits.load() == 0);
#else
    assert(Core::sentinel_lock_hits.load() == 1);
#endif
    std::thread transition([&] { dirty.Collect(next, 64); });
    while (phase.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != 1) {
        std::this_thread::yield();
    }
    // This fast-path CAS updates the first page while the other thread
    // still holds the slow-page-transition mutex. Old code loses this bit.
    dirty.Collect(first + 64, 64);
    phase.store(2, std::memory_order_release);
    transition.join();

    std::set<PAddr> observed;
    std::function<void(PAddr, std::size_t)> receive =
        [&](PAddr a, std::size_t n) {
            assert(a % 64 == 0 && n % 64 == 0);
            for (PAddr p = a; p < a + n; p += 64) observed.insert(p);
        };
    dirty.Gather(receive);
    assert(observed.count(first) == 1);
    assert(observed.count(next) == 1);
#ifdef EXPECT_FIXED
    assert(observed.count(first + 64) == 1);
    assert(observed.size() == 3);
#else
    assert(observed.count(first + 64) == 0);
    assert(observed.size() == 2);
#endif
    // Each Gather resets the collector to its empty sentinel. The original
    // header enters the mutex/vector slow path anyway; the native header
    // must use the initial compare-and-swap, without losing any dirty cell.
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; ++i) {
        dirty.Collect(first, 64);
        dirty.Gather(receive);
    }
#ifdef EXPECT_FIXED
    assert(Core::sentinel_lock_hits.load() == 0);
#else
    assert(Core::sentinel_lock_hits.load() == 17);
#endif
}
"""
clang = shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++")
assert clang, "Clang C++20 required"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-dirty-race-") as tmp:
    stage = Path(tmp)
    unit = stage / "race.cpp"
    unit.write_text(source)
    include_stub = stage / "core"

    (include_stub / "device_memory_manager.h").write_text(

    for label, header, is_fixed in (
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""ASan/UBSan host witness for a cheaper GPU fence completion publication.

Compiles the exact store and acquire-load expressions from BOTH tracked GPU
worker variants, exercising ordered per-command payload publication. The
original pinned seq_cst store is the baseline. This is not an FPS benchmark,
not TSAN, and cannot certify PS5 GPU progress or device fences.
"""

import subprocess

QUIET=(ROOT/"vendor/encore-active/eden-gpu/gpu_thread_quiet.cpp").read_text()

# DEV worker still exists as an unselected regression witness for fence
# publication, not as a selectable PS5 build/profile.

#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>
using u64=std::uint64_t;
struct SynchState { std::atomic<u64> signaled_fence{}; };
struct Next { u64 fence{}; };
int main() {
    constexpr u64 limit=32768;
    std::vector<u64> payload(limit+1);
    SynchState state;
    std::thread worker([&] {
        Next next;
        for(u64 i=1;i<=limit;++i) {
            payload[i]=i^0x5a5a5a5aULL;
            next.fence=i;
            WRITE_EXPRESSION
        }
    });
    u64 inspected=0;
    while(inspected<limit) {
        // This is the actual maintained GPU PushCommand acquire expression.
        const u64 completed=READ_EXPRESSION;
        assert(completed<=limit);
        while(inspected<completed) {
            ++inspected;
            assert(payload[inspected]==(inspected^0x5a5a5a5aULL));
        }
        if (inspected<limit) std::this_thread::yield();
    }
    worker.join();
    assert(state.signaled_fence.load(std::memory_order_acquire)==limit);
    std::printf("GPU_FENCE_RELEASE_PUBLICATION_PASS commands=%llu\n",
                static_cast<unsigned long long>(limit));
}
"""
```

`tools/check-native-gpu-fifo-quiescence-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Fail-closed host witness: FIFO GPU tick behind a quiescence-blocked submit.

Shows a bounded no-progress wait cycle in the real GPU worker call graph.
The positive control models *conditionally eligible* control-plane work;
it does NOT authorize native command reordering or deferred bridge #187.
"""
from collections import deque
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
read = lambda p: (root / p).read_text()
worker = read("vendor/sources/eden/src/video_core/gpu_thread.cpp")
header = read("vendor/sources/eden/src/video_core/gpu_thread.h")
gpu = read("vendor/sources/eden/src/video_core/gpu.cpp")
physical = read("vendor/sources/eden/src/core/hle/kernel/physical_core.cpp")
replay = read("headless/gpu_deferred_replay.h")
workflow = read(".github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml")

# Source anchors: the real GPU worker cannot dispatch a later tick while
# execution of the current queue item is synchronously blocked.
assert "state.queue.PopWait(next, stop_token);" in worker
start = worker.index("if (auto* submit_list = std::get_if<SubmitListCommand>(&next.data))")
tick = worker.index("std::holds_alternative<GPUTickCommand>(next.data)")
end = worker.index("state.signaled_fence.store(next.fence);")
assert start < tick < end
assert "system.GPU().TickWork();" in worker[tick:end]
assert "PushCommand(GPUTickCommand(), false, is_async);" in worker
assert "using CommandQueue = Common::SPSCQueue<CommandDataContainer>;" in header
assert "const u64 fence = RequestSyncOperation(" in gpu
assert "gpu_thread.TickGPU(is_async);" in gpu
assert "WaitForSyncOperation(fence);" in gpu
assert "arm_interface->SignalInterrupt(thread);" in physical
assert "inline constexpr bool kNativePostStorePublicationReady = false;" in replay
assert "python3 -B tools/check-native-gpu-fifo-quiescence-host.py" in workflow


class Replay:
    def __init__(self):
        self.commands = deque(["dependent_submit", "sync_tick", "following_submit"])
        self.gpu_read_completed = False
        self.jit_exited = False
        self.executed = []
        self.pending = True
        self.failed = False

    def blocked_submit(self):
        # Quiescence request is pending until the JIT exits; that JIT
        # cannot exit until its pending GPU read synchronization completes.
        return not self.jit_exited

    def strict_fifo_step(self):
        if not self.commands:
            return False
        cmd = self.commands[0]
        if cmd == "dependent_submit" and self.blocked_submit():
            return False  # head-of-line: no later tick can run
        self.commands.popleft()
        self.executed.append(cmd)
        if cmd == "sync_tick":
            self.gpu_read_completed = True
            self.jit_exited = True
        return True

    def hypothetical_safe_control_pump(self, validated_independent):
        if not self.commands or self.commands[0] != "dependent_submit":
            return False
        if not validated_independent:
            self.failed = True
            return False  # never execute an unproven out-of-order flush
        if list(self.commands)[1] != "sync_tick":
            self.failed = True
            return False
        # NOT a native operation: models a separately proven safe control
        # path while leaving ordered graphics submits pending in the FIFO.
        self.commands.remove("sync_tick")
        self.executed.append("sync_tick")
        self.gpu_read_completed = True
        self.jit_exited = True
        return True


# Negative control: a blocking wait in SubmitListCommand prevents GPUTick
# from reaching GPU::TickWork. A bounded test avoids actually deadlocking CI.
blocked = Replay()
for _ in range(5):
    assert not blocked.strict_fifo_step()
assert not blocked.executed and not blocked.gpu_read_completed
assert not blocked.jit_exited and list(blocked.commands) == [
    "dependent_submit", "sync_tick", "following_submit"
]
print("GPU_FIFO_HOL_BLOCKED_TICK_NEGATIVE_REPRODUCED")

# Positive architectural condition, NOT native behavior: allow the requested
# CPU-read tick only after its independence from the blocked submit is proven.
possible = Replay()
assert possible.hypothetical_safe_control_pump(validated_independent=True)
assert possible.executed == ["sync_tick"]
assert list(possible.commands) == ["dependent_submit", "following_submit"]
assert possible.strict_fifo_step()
assert possible.strict_fifo_step()
assert possible.executed == ["sync_tick", "dependent_submit", "following_submit"]
assert possible.jit_exited and possible.gpu_read_completed
print("GPU_FIFO_QUALIFIED_CONTROL_PLANE_MODEL_PASS")

# Without proof of safe control bypass, fail closed rather than execute
# later commands or release graphics ordering incorrectly.
unsafe = Replay()
assert not unsafe.hypothetical_safe_control_pump(validated_independent=False)
assert unsafe.failed and not unsafe.executed and not unsafe.jit_exited
assert not unsafe.gpu_read_completed
assert list(unsafe.commands) == [
    "dependent_submit", "sync_tick", "following_submit"
]
print("GPU_FIFO_UNPROVEN_REORDER_FAIL_CLOSED")
print("GPU_FIFO_NATIVE_BRIDGE_NOT_QUALIFIED")
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Host regression for native GPU IsGranularRange offset and bounds.

Compiles the pinned method and the actual Encore-maintained native C++ method. The original
accepts a boundary-crossing continuous big-page span. No device/FPS claim.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
pinned = root / "vendor/sources/eden/src/video_core/memory_manager.cpp"
maintained = root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/video_core/memory_manager.cpp"

workflow = (root / ".github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml").read_text()

assert compiler and maintained.is_file()

def method(source):
    start = "bool MemoryManager::IsGranularRange(GPUVAddr gpu_addr, std::size_t size) const {"
    end = "bool MemoryManager::IsContinuousRange("
    assert source.count(start) == source.count(end) == 1
    return start + source.split(start, 1)[1].split(end, 1)[0].rstrip() + "\n"

prelude = r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstddef>
#include <limits>
#include <iostream>
using u64 = std::uint64_t;
using GPUVAddr = u64;
namespace Core {
constexpr std::size_t DEVICE_PAGESIZE = 4096;
constexpr std::size_t DEVICE_PAGEMASK = DEVICE_PAGESIZE - 1;
}
class MemoryManager {
public:
    enum class EntryType { Free, Mapped };
    GPUVAddr address_space_size = 1ULL << 20;
    std::size_t big_page_bits = 16;
    std::size_t big_page_size = 1ULL << 16;
    std::size_t big_page_mask = (1ULL << 16) - 1;
    mutable int entry_checks = 0;
    bool big_mapped = true, short_mapped = true, continuous = true;
    EntryType GetEntry(GPUVAddr, bool is_big) const {
        ++entry_checks;
        return (is_big ? big_mapped : short_mapped) ? EntryType::Mapped : EntryType::Free;
    }
    bool IsBigPageContinuous(std::size_t) const { return continuous; }
    bool IsGranularRange(GPUVAddr gpu_addr, std::size_t size) const;
};
"""
tests = r"""
int main() {
    MemoryManager m;
    assert(m.IsGranularRange(0x10020, 32));
    assert(m.IsGranularRange(0x1FFE0, 32));
#if EXPECT_FIXED
    assert(!m.IsGranularRange(0x1FFF0, 32));
    assert(!m.IsGranularRange(0xFFFFF, 2));
    assert(!m.IsGranularRange(0x10000, std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()));
    m.entry_checks = 0;
    assert(!m.IsGranularRange(1ULL << 20, 16));
    assert(m.entry_checks == 0);
    assert(!m.IsGranularRange(0x10000, 0));
#else
    assert(m.IsGranularRange(0x1FFF0, 32));
    assert(m.IsGranularRange(0xFFFFF, 2));
    assert(m.IsGranularRange(0x10000, std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()));
#endif
    m.continuous = false;
    assert(!m.IsGranularRange(0x10FF0, 32));
    assert(m.IsGranularRange(0x10FE0, 32));
    m.big_mapped = false;
    assert(m.IsGranularRange(0x10FE0, 32));
    assert(!m.IsGranularRange(0x10FF0, 32));
    m.short_mapped = false;
    assert(!m.IsGranularRange(0x10020, 32));
    std::cout << (EXPECT_FIXED
        ? "PINNED_NATIVE_GPU_GRANULAR_SPAN_GUARD_PASS\n"
        : "PINNED_GPU_GRANULAR_BOUNDARY_FALSE_POSITIVE_WITNESS_PASS\n");
}
"""
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-gpu-granularity-") as td:
    temp = Path(td)
    original = pinned.read_text()
    corrected = maintained.read_text()
    assert "page_index & big_page_mask) + size" in original
    assert "page_index & big_page_mask) + size" not in corrected

    for name, source, fixed in (
        ("pinned", original, False),

print("PINNED_GPU_GRANULAR_RANGE_HOST_ONLY_NO_DEVICE_PROOF")
```

`tools/check-native-gpu-queue-slot-lifetime-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Execute pinned GPU queue slot lifetime; reject a skipped moved-from destructor.

The original queue overwrites still-live preconstructed elements and leaks
resource owners. The maintained common GPU queue now has explicit Slot storage:
a successful push constructs its element, Pop destroys it *before* publishing
the free slot, and destruction of a nonempty queue visits only live entries.
The native-source fixture checks a valid move whose source retains ownership.
No console run or graphics timing claim.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
original = (root / "vendor/sources/eden/src/common/bounded_threadsafe_queue.h").read_text()
cmake = (root / "headless/CMakeLists.txt").read_text()
workflow = (root / ".github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml").read_text()
canonical_path = root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-gpu/include/common/bounded_threadsafe_queue.h"
canonical = canonical_path.read_text()
construct = "std::construct_at(std::addressof(m_data[pos]), std::forward<Args>(args)...);"
live_construct = "std::construct_at(std::addressof(m_data[pos].value), std::forward<Args>(args)...);"
live_destroy = "std::destroy_at(std::addressof(m_data[pos].value));"

# Keep the broken pinned source only as a negative regression witness. The
# corrected compiled queue must be the same full header selected in CMake.
assert original.count(construct) == 1
assert original.count("std::destroy_at(std::addressof(m_data[pos]));") == 0
assert canonical.count(construct) == 0
assert canonical.count(live_construct) == 2
assert canonical.count(live_destroy) == 1  # Pop; drain uses cursor-indexed slot
assert "union Slot {" in canonical
assert "std::array<Slot, Capacity> m_data;" in canonical
assert "t = std::move(m_data[pos].value);\n        // Destroy moved-from commands before the producer can reuse the slot.\n        " + live_destroy in canonical
assert "for (auto cursor = consumer.index.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);" in canonical
assert "std::destroy_at(std::addressof(m_data[cursor % Capacity].value));" in canonical
assert canonical.count("bool EmplaceWaitWithStopToken(") == 1
assert "producer.cv.wait(lock, stop_token" in canonical
assert "python3 -B tools/check-native-gpu-queue-slot-lifetime-host.py" in workflow
assert 'configure_file("${EDEN_ACTIVE_GPU}/include/common/bounded_threadsafe_queue.h"' in cmake
assert 'write_derived("${PORT_BUILD_DIR}/include/common/bounded_threadsafe_queue.h"' not in cmake
assert not (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-core/gpu-injections/gpu_queue_stop_wait.inc").exists()

program = r"""
#include <array>
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdio>
#include <memory>
#include <stop_token>
#include <thread>
#include <utility>
#include "common/bounded_threadsafe_queue.h"

struct Resource {
    static inline int living{};
    Resource() { ++living; }
    ~Resource() { --living; }
};
struct RetainedAfterMove {
    std::shared_ptr<Resource> payload;
    RetainedAfterMove() = default;
    explicit RetainedAfterMove(const std::shared_ptr<Resource>& resource)
        : payload(resource) {}
    // Valid move operations: the source deliberately keeps an owner.
    RetainedAfterMove(RetainedAfterMove&& other) noexcept
        : payload(other.payload) {}
    RetainedAfterMove& operator=(RetainedAfterMove&& other) noexcept {
        payload = other.payload;
        return *this;
    }
    RetainedAfterMove(const RetainedAfterMove&) = delete;
    RetainedAfterMove& operator=(const RetainedAfterMove&) = delete;
};

int main() {
    {
        Common::SPSCQueue<RetainedAfterMove, 2> q;
        RetainedAfterMove received;
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < 12; ++i) {
            auto resource = std::make_shared<Resource>();
            assert(q.TryEmplace(resource));
            assert(q.TryPop(received));
            assert(received.payload == resource);
            received.payload.reset();
            resource.reset();
        }
#if EXPECT_REPAIRED
        // Pop eagerly destroys each moved-from slot; no abandoned owner remains.
        assert(Resource::living == 0);
#else
        // Baseline has overwritten ten live moved-from owners, leaking each.
        assert(Resource::living == 12);
#endif
    }
#if EXPECT_REPAIRED
    assert(Resource::living == 0);
    std::puts("PINNED_GPU_QUEUE_SLOT_DESTRUCTOR_REUSE_PASS");
#else
    assert(Resource::living == 10);
    std::puts("PINNED_GPU_QUEUE_ORIGINAL_MOVED_FROM_OWNER_LEAK_WITNESS_PASS");
#endif
}
"""
compiler = shutil.which("g++") or shutil.which("clang++")
assert compiler, "C++20 compiler required"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-native-queue-lifetime-") as folder:
    temp = Path(folder)
    inc = temp / "common"
    inc.mkdir()
    # The upstream polyfill is not involved in the queue slot's semantics.
    (inc / "polyfill_thread.h").write_text("#pragma once\n#include <stop_token>\n")
    code = temp / "queue_lifetime.cpp"
    code.write_text(program)
    for name, source, repaired in (
        ("original", original, False),
        ("maintained", canonical, True),
    ):
        (inc / "bounded_threadsafe_queue.h").write_text(
            "#include <memory>\n#include <stop_token>\n" + source
        )
        binary = temp / name
        subprocess.run(
            [compiler, "-std=c++20", "-O2", "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror",
             "-pthread", "-I", str(temp), "-DEXPECT_REPAIRED=" + str(int(repaired)),
             str(code), "-o", str(binary)], check=True, timeout=30)
        result = subprocess.run([str(binary)], check=True, text=True,
                                capture_output=True, timeout=10)
        print(result.stdout, end="")

print("PINNED_GPU_QUEUE_NATIVE_SLOT_DESTRUCTION_SCOPE_ONLY")
```

`tools/check-native-gpu-queue-stop-fastpath-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Source-extracted GPU queue producer stop-aware fast path witness.

The maintained SPSCQueue has a single producer (protected by the parent GPU
thread manager). Verify slot reuse, already-freed fast case, full-queue wake
and stop request while full. Never infer improved console frame timings.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
header = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-gpu/include/common/bounded_threadsafe_queue.h").read_text()
workflow = (root / ".github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml").read_text()
producer = header.split("bool EmplaceWaitWithStopToken(", 1)[1].split("\n\n    bool TryPop(", 1)[0]
assert "python3 -B tools/check-native-gpu-queue-stop-fastpath-host.py" in workflow
early = "if ((write_index - consumer.index.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) >= Capacity)"
assert producer.count(early) == 1
assert producer.index(early) < producer.index("std::unique_lock lock{producer.cv_mutex};")
assert producer.index("if (stop_token.stop_requested()) return false;") < producer.index("const std::size_t pos")
assert "producer.cv.wait(lock, stop_token" in producer
# The canonical common queue uses uninitialised union slots. Producers may
# construct a free slot only; the consumer destroys the moved-from command
# before it publishes the slot as free. A legacy producer-side destroy would
# destroy an object that is no longer alive.
assert "union Slot {" in header
assert "std::array<Slot, Capacity> m_data;" in header
assert producer.count("std::construct_at(std::addressof(m_data[pos].value)") == 1
assert "std::destroy_at(" not in producer

assert consumer.count("std::destroy_at(std::addressof(m_data[pos].value));") == 1
assert consumer.index("std::destroy_at(std::addressof(m_data[pos].value));") < consumer.index("++consumer.index")
assert "std::destroy_at(std::addressof(m_data[cursor % Capacity].value));" in header

cpp = r"""
#include <array>
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdio>
#include <memory>
#include <stop_token>
#include <thread>
#include <utility>
#include "common/bounded_threadsafe_queue.h"
int main() {
    using namespace std::chrono_literals;
    {
        Common::SPSCQueue<int, 2> q;
        std::stop_source stop;
        int value = 0;
        assert(q.TryEmplace(10) && q.TryEmplace(20));
        assert(!q.TryEmplace(30));
        assert(q.TryPop(value) && value == 10);
        // The consumer just released a slot; this must never wait.
        assert(q.EmplaceWaitWithStopToken(stop.get_token(), 30));
        assert(q.TryPop(value) && value == 20);
        assert(q.TryPop(value) && value == 30);
        assert(!q.TryPop(value));
    }
    {
        Common::SPSCQueue<int, 2> q;
        std::stop_source stop;
        assert(q.TryEmplace(1) && q.TryEmplace(2));
        std::atomic<bool> running{false}, result{true};
        std::thread producer([&] {
            running.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
            result.store(q.EmplaceWaitWithStopToken(stop.get_token(), 3));
        });
        while (!running.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
            std::this_thread::yield();
        stop.request_stop();
        producer.join();
        assert(!result.load());
        int value = 0;
        assert(q.TryPop(value) && value == 1);
        assert(q.TryPop(value) && value == 2);
        assert(!q.TryPop(value));
    }
    {
        Common::SPSCQueue<int, 2> q;
        std::stop_source stop;
        assert(q.TryEmplace(11) && q.TryEmplace(12));
        std::atomic<bool> running{false}, result{false};
        std::thread producer([&] {
            running.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
            result.store(q.EmplaceWaitWithStopToken(stop.get_token(), 13));
        });
        while (!running.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
            std::this_thread::yield();
        int value = 0;
        assert(q.TryPop(value) && value == 11);
        producer.join();
        assert(result.load());
        assert(q.TryPop(value) && value == 12);
        assert(q.TryPop(value) && value == 13);
        assert(!q.TryPop(value));
    }
    {
        Common::SPSCQueue<int, 2> q;
        std::stop_source stop;
        stop.request_stop();
        assert(!q.EmplaceWaitWithStopToken(stop.get_token(), 100));
        int value = 0;
        assert(!q.TryPop(value));
    }
    {
        // Nonempty shutdown must drain live slots; an already-popped slot
        // must not be destroyed twice. Exercise shared ownership rather than
        // relying on source-string checks alone.
        auto resource = std::make_shared<int>(42);
        {
            Common::SPSCQueue<std::shared_ptr<int>, 2> q;
            assert(q.TryEmplace(resource));
            assert(resource.use_count() == 2);
        }
        assert(resource.use_count() == 1);
        {
            Common::SPSCQueue<std::shared_ptr<int>, 2> q;
            assert(q.TryEmplace(resource));
            std::shared_ptr<int> out;
            assert(q.TryPop(out));
            assert(out == resource);
            assert(resource.use_count() == 2);
            out.reset();
            assert(resource.use_count() == 1);
        }
        assert(resource.use_count() == 1);
    }
    std::puts("ENCORE_GPU_QUEUE_STOP_FASTPATH_PASS");
}
"""
compiler = shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
assert compiler, "C++20 compiler required"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-gpu-spsc-") as tmp:
    root_tmp = Path(tmp)
    common = root_tmp / "common"
    common.mkdir()
    (common / "polyfill_thread.h").write_text("#pragma once\n#include <stop_token>\n")
    # Copy real maintained source. The two portability prerequisites above
    # are also included by the full production translation unit.
    (common / "bounded_threadsafe_queue.h").write_text(header)
    src = root_tmp / "queue.cpp"
    exe = root_tmp / "queue"
    src.write_text(cpp)
    subprocess.run([compiler, "-std=c++20", "-O1", "-pthread", "-Wall", "-Wextra",
                    "-Werror", "-fsanitize=address,undefined",
                    "-fno-sanitize-recover=all", "-I", str(root_tmp),
                    str(src), "-o", str(exe)],
                   check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=90)
    result = subprocess.run([str(exe)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
    assert result.returncode == 0, (result.stdout[-1000:], result.stderr[-2500:])
print("NATIVE_GPU_QUEUE_STOP_FASTPATH_HOST_PASS source=active empty_fastpath=1 full_wait=1 cancelled=1 live_slot_drain=1 popped_slot_once=1 asan_ubsan=1")
```

```py
#include <stdexcept>

using DAddr = std::uint64_t;
using u64 = std::uint64_t;
namespace VideoCore {
struct RasterizerDownloadArea {
    DAddr start_address{};
    DAddr end_address{};
    bool preemtive{};
};
}
struct FakeRasterizer {
    VideoCore::RasterizerDownloadArea next_area{0x1000,0x2000,false};
    unsigned flushes{};
    VideoCore::RasterizerDownloadArea GetFlushArea(DAddr,u64) {
        return next_area;
    }
    void FlushRegion(DAddr a,u64 n) {
        assert(a == 0x1000 && n == 0x1000);
        ++flushes;
    }
};
struct FakeRenderer {
    FakeRasterizer raster;
    FakeRasterizer* ReadRasterizer() {return &raster;}
};
struct FakeThread {
    unsigned ticks{};
    void TickGPU(bool) {++ticks;}
};
struct FakeGPU {
    FakeRenderer store{};
    FakeRenderer* renderer = &store;
    FakeThread gpu_thread{};
    bool is_async = true;
    bool fail_wait = true;
    std::function<void()> pending{};
    template<class Fn> u64 RequestSyncOperation(Fn&& fn) {
        pending=std::forward<Fn>(fn);
        return 1;
    }
    void WaitForSyncOperation(u64 fence) {
        assert(fence == 1);
        if(fail_wait) throw std::runtime_error("GPU worker failure");
        assert(static_cast<bool>(pending));
        pending();
        pending={};
    }
@@METHOD@@
};
int main(int argc,char**) {
    if(argc > 1) {
        FakeGPU gpu;
        try {
            (void)gpu.OnCPURead(0x1100,16);
            assert(false && "wait should throw");
        } catch (const std::runtime_error&) {}
        assert(gpu.gpu_thread.ticks == 1);
        assert(gpu.store.raster.flushes == 0);
        // Simulate the pending callback outliving the failed caller stack.
        auto replay = std::move(gpu.pending);
        replay();
        assert(gpu.store.raster.flushes == 1);
        return 0;
    }
    FakeGPU gpu;
    gpu.fail_wait = false;
    auto area = gpu.OnCPURead(0x1100,16);
    assert(area.preemtive && gpu.gpu_thread.ticks == 1);
    assert(gpu.store.raster.flushes == 1 && !gpu.pending);
    gpu.store.raster.next_area.preemtive = true;
    auto fast = gpu.OnCPURead(0x1100,16);
    assert(fast.preemtive && gpu.gpu_thread.ticks == 1);
}
"""
```

```py
    std::atomic<unsigned> downloads{};
    VideoCore::RasterizerDownloadArea OnCPURead(DAddr address, std::size_t) {

    template <class Callback>

        assert(scratch.active.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_acq_rel) == 0);
        std::this_thread::yield();
        cb(0x12000);
        assert(scratch.active.fetch_sub(1, std::memory_order_release) == 1);
    }
};

    FakeDeviceMemory manager;
    FakeDeviceMemory& MemoryManager() { return manager; }
};

    FakeGpu gpu;

    FakeHost1x& Host1x() { return host; }

    FakeSystem& system;

    const u8* GetPointerImpl(VAddr, Miss&&, Cached&&) { return &data; }
@@METHOD@@

int main(int argc, char**) {
    FakeSystem sys;
    Fixture memory{sys};
    if (argc > 1) {
        tls_host_core = 255;  // Auxiliary host thread, outside four guest slots.
        memory.HandleRasterizerDownload(0x2000, 4);
        return 0;
    }
    tls_host_core = 2;
    memory.HandleRasterizerDownload(0x2000, 4);
    memory.HandleRasterizerDownload(0x2000, 4);
    assert(sys.gpu.downloads.load() == 1); // Guest core 2 cache preserved.
    tls_host_core = 3;
    memory.HandleRasterizerDownload(0x2000, 4);
    memory.HandleRasterizerDownload(0x2000, 4);
    assert(sys.gpu.downloads.load() == 2); // System guest core preserved.

    // separate slot. Each auxiliary must perform its OWN GPU read fence:
    // a cached flush range from another host thread is never inherited.
    std::vector<std::thread> threads;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {

            tls_host_core = (i % 2 == 0) ? 4 : 255;
            memory.HandleRasterizerDownload(0x2000, 4);
            memory.HandleRasterizerDownload(0x2000, 4);
        });
    }
    for (auto& worker : threads) worker.join();
    assert(sys.gpu.downloads.load() == 18);
```

```py
"""Compile both real GPU GetSpan overloads with checked page-table range fixture.

The original methods access the range-walking page table before validating
GPU address-space bounds. The native derived methods must reject invalid
ranges first, without altering the normal valid-range lookup sequence.
This is host-only; no graphics driver or console environment is required.

cpp = r"""
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>
#include <optional>
#include <stdexcept>
using u8 = std::uint8_t;
using GPUVAddr = std::uint64_t;
using DAddr = std::uint64_t;
struct FakeDevice {
    std::array<u8,8192> bytes{};
    u8* GetSpan(DAddr a, std::size_t n) {
        return a < bytes.size() && n <= bytes.size() - a
            ? bytes.data() + a : nullptr;
    }
    const u8* GetSpan(DAddr a, std::size_t n) const {
        return a < bytes.size() && n <= bytes.size() - a
            ? bytes.data() + a : nullptr;
    }
};
struct MemoryManager {
    static constexpr GPUVAddr address_space_size = 8192;
    FakeDevice memory;
    mutable unsigned probes{};
    std::array<int,2> page_table{1,1};
    bool IsContinuousRange(GPUVAddr addr, std::size_t) const {
        ++probes;
        // Mirrors the unguarded GetEntry indexed page-vector access.
        return page_table.at(static_cast<std::size_t>(addr >> 12)) != 0;
    }
    std::optional<DAddr> GpuToCpuAddress(GPUVAddr addr) const {
        if (addr >= address_space_size) return std::nullopt;
        return addr;
    }
    const u8* GetSpan(GPUVAddr addr,std::size_t size) const;
    u8* GetSpan(GPUVAddr addr,std::size_t size);
};
@@METHODS@@
int main() {
    MemoryManager m;
    const auto& c=static_cast<const MemoryManager&>(m);
    assert(m.GetSpan(0,4096)!=nullptr);
    assert(c.GetSpan(4096,4096)!=nullptr);
    assert(m.GetSpan(4095,2)!=nullptr);
#ifdef EXPECT_NATIVE
    auto prior=m.probes;
    assert(m.GetSpan(8192,1)==nullptr);
    assert(c.GetSpan(8192,1)==nullptr);
    assert(m.GetSpan(0,0)==nullptr);
    assert(c.GetSpan(0,0)==nullptr);
    assert(m.GetSpan(8191,2)==nullptr);
    assert(c.GetSpan(8191,2)==nullptr);
    assert(m.GetSpan(UINT64_MAX,2)==nullptr);
    assert(c.GetSpan(UINT64_MAX,2)==nullptr);
    assert(m.probes == prior); // Never walk unmapped/out-of-space vectors.
#else
    bool threw=false;
    try { (void)m.GetSpan(8192,1); }
    catch(const std::out_of_range&) { threw=true; }
    assert(threw);  // Original calls the page walk with invalid page index.
    threw=false;
    try { (void)c.GetSpan(8192,1); }
    catch(const std::out_of_range&) { threw=true; }
    assert(threw);
    assert(m.GetSpan(0,0)!=nullptr); // Original silently accepts zero span.
#endif
}
"""

#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>

struct MemoryManager {
    static constexpr GPUVAddr address_space_size = GPUVAddr{1} << 49;
    static constexpr std::size_t page_bits = 12;
    mutable unsigned page_probes{};
    std::optional<DAddr> GpuToCpuAddress(GPUVAddr, std::size_t) const;
    bool IsContinuousRange(GPUVAddr, std::size_t) const;

};

int main() {
    MemoryManager gpu;

    constexpr std::size_t huge = std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max();
    const std::array<std::pair<GPUVAddr, std::size_t>, 8> bad{{
        {0, 0}, {limit-1, 0}, {limit, 1}, {limit+1, 1},
        {limit-1, 2}, {limit-4096, 4097},

        assert(gpu.IsContinuousRange(addr, bytes));
        assert(gpu.IsFullyMappedRange(addr, bytes));
    }
    assert(gpu.page_probes == valid.size() * 3);
}
```

```py
#include <cassert>
#include <cerrno>
#include <memory>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <semaphore>
#include <stop_token>
#include <system_error>
#include <functional>
#include <thread>
#include "common/bounded_threadsafe_queue.h"
static int fault, attributes_live, joins;
static std::binary_semaphore* joining;
static int init(pthread_attr_t* a) {
    if (fault == 1) return ENOMEM;
    int result = pthread_attr_init(a); if (!result) ++attributes_live; return result;
}
static int stack(pthread_attr_t* a, size_t size) {
    assert(size == 1024 * 1024);
    return fault == 2 ? EINVAL : pthread_attr_setstacksize(a, size);
}
static int destroy(pthread_attr_t* a) { --attributes_live; return pthread_attr_destroy(a); }
static int create(pthread_t* t, const pthread_attr_t* a, void* (*f)(void*), void* p) {
    return fault == 3 ? EAGAIN : pthread_create(t, a, f, p);
}
static int join(pthread_t t, void** out) {
    ++joins;
    if (joining) joining->release();
    return pthread_join(t, out);
}
namespace VideoCore { struct RendererBase { void* ReadRasterizer() { return this; } }; }
namespace Core::Frontend { struct GraphicsContext {}; }
namespace Tegra::Control { struct Scheduler {}; }
namespace VideoCommon::GPUThread {
class ThreadManager {
public:
    ~ThreadManager() { Stop(); }
    void StartThread(VideoCore::RendererBase&, Core::Frontend::GraphicsContext&, Tegra::Control::Scheduler&);
    void Stop();
    using CommandDataContainer = int;
    struct { std::mutex write_lock; Common::SPSCQueue<int, 4> queue; } state;
    std::binary_semaphore ready{0};
    bool finished{};
    std::function<void()> command;
private:
    void RunWorker(VideoCore::RendererBase&, Core::Frontend::GraphicsContext&, Tegra::Control::Scheduler&) {
        pthread_attr_t a;
        assert(pthread_getattr_np(pthread_self(), &a) == 0);
        size_t size;
        assert(pthread_attr_getstacksize(&a, &size) == 0 && size == 1024 * 1024);
        assert(pthread_attr_destroy(&a) == 0);
        int value = 0;
        state.queue.PopWait(value, stop_source.get_token());
        assert(value == 42 && !stop_source.stop_requested());
        if (command) { command(); finished = true; return; }
        ready.release();
        state.queue.PopWait(value, stop_source.get_token());
        assert(stop_source.stop_requested());
        finished = true;
    }
    void* rasterizer{};
    pthread_t thread{};
    std::stop_source stop_source;
    bool thread_joinable{};
};
}
#define pthread_attr_init init
#define pthread_attr_setstacksize stack
#define pthread_attr_destroy destroy
#define pthread_create create
#define pthread_join join
LIFECYCLE
int main(int argc, char**) {
    VideoCore::RendererBase renderer;
    Core::Frontend::GraphicsContext context;
    Tegra::Control::Scheduler scheduler;
    using VideoCommon::GPUThread::ThreadManager;
    if (argc > 1) {
        ThreadManager manager;
        manager.command = [&] { manager.ready.release(); throw std::runtime_error("injected worker failure"); };
        manager.StartThread(renderer, context, scheduler);
        manager.state.queue.EmplaceWait(42);
        manager.ready.acquire();
        manager.Stop();
        assert(Eden::PeekGpuFailure());
        assert(Eden::TakeGpuFailure());
        assert(Eden::PeekGpuFailure() && !Eden::TakeGpuFailure());
        try { std::rethrow_exception(Eden::PeekGpuFailure()); }
        catch (const std::runtime_error& error) {
            assert(std::string(error.what()) == "injected worker failure");
            return 0;
        }
        return 1;
    }
    for (fault = 1; fault <= 3; ++fault) {
        ThreadManager manager;
        try { manager.StartThread(renderer, context, scheduler); assert(false); }
        catch (const std::system_error&) {}
        assert(attributes_live == 0 && joins == 0);
    }
    fault = 0;
    ThreadManager manager;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 3; ++i) {
        manager.finished = false;
        manager.state.queue.EmplaceWait(7);
        manager.StartThread(renderer, context, scheduler);
        manager.state.queue.EmplaceWait(42);
        manager.ready.acquire();
        manager.Stop();
        manager.Stop();
        assert(manager.finished && joins == i && attributes_live == 0);
    }
    { ThreadManager implicit;
      implicit.StartThread(renderer, context, scheduler);
      implicit.state.queue.EmplaceWait(42);
      implicit.ready.acquire(); }
    assert(joins == 4 && attributes_live == 0);
    // A command already executing must exit before the protected owner goes.
    // Old ordering deterministically exposes the cleared unique_ptr, without
    // dereferencing it or relying on a scheduling delay.
    for (bool early_join : {false, true}) {
        std::binary_semaphore entered{0}, release{0}, join_started{0};
        bool pointer_alive = false, owner_destroyed = false;
        struct Protected {
            ThreadManager worker;
            bool& destroyed;
            explicit Protected(bool& flag) : destroyed(flag) {}
            ~Protected() { worker.Stop(); destroyed = true; }
        };
        auto owner = std::make_unique<Protected>(owner_destroyed);
        owner->worker.command = [&] {
            entered.release();
            release.acquire();
            pointer_alive = owner != nullptr && !owner_destroyed;
        };
        owner->worker.StartThread(renderer, context, scheduler);
        owner->worker.state.queue.EmplaceWait(42);
        entered.acquire();
        joining = &join_started;
        std::thread teardown([&] {
            if (early_join) owner->worker.Stop();
            owner.reset();
        });
        join_started.acquire();
        assert(!owner_destroyed);
        release.release();
        teardown.join();
        joining = nullptr;
        assert(owner_destroyed && pointer_alive == early_join);
    }
}
'''
lifecycle = worker.split('// PS5-only ThreadManager lifecycle;', 1)[1]
lifecycle = lifecycle[lifecycle.index('namespace VideoCommon::GPUThread {'):]
code = code.replace('LIFECYCLE', lifecycle)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='eden-gpu-thread-') as folder:
    temp = Path(folder)
    (temp / 'check.cpp').write_text(code)
    subprocess.run(['c++', '-std=c++20', '-pthread', '-Wall', '-Wextra', '-Werror',
                    '-I', str(upstream), '-I', str(root / 'headless'), str(temp / 'check.cpp'),
                    '-o', str(temp / 'check')], check=True)
    subprocess.run([str(temp / 'check')], check=True, timeout=15)
    failed = subprocess.run([str(temp / 'check'), 'throw'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
    assert failed.returncode == 0 and '[ProsperoEden] GPU worker: injected worker failure' in failed.stderr
print('Native GPU stack, stop/wake/join, creation failures and blocked-command teardown ordering/rejection PASS')
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""ASan/UBSan regression: real native worker Stop drains queued work after join.

Both QUIET and DEV owners must be byte-equivalent for this method.
The test covers stop/join/discard/restart, not GPU hardware progress.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
quiet=(ROOT/"vendor/encore-active/eden-gpu/gpu_thread_quiet.cpp").read_text()

ci=(ROOT/".github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml").read_text()

tail="\n} // namespace VideoCommon::GPUThread"

    return text[text.index(anchor):text.index(tail,text.index(anchor))]

#include <array>
#include <atomic>

#include <cstdio>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>

#include <thread>
#include <utility>
#include "common/bounded_threadsafe_queue.h"
struct CommandDataContainer {
    std::uint64_t id{};
    std::shared_ptr<int> lifetime{};
    CommandDataContainer()=default;
    CommandDataContainer(std::uint64_t key,std::shared_ptr<int> ptr)
        :id(key),lifetime(std::move(ptr)){}
};
struct ThreadManager {
    struct SynchState {
        std::mutex write_lock;
        Common::SPSCQueue<CommandDataContainer,256> queue;
    } state;
    std::stop_source stop_source{};
    pthread_t thread{};
    bool thread_joinable=false;
    void Stop();
};
INJECT_STOP
int main(){
    ThreadManager manager;
    auto resource=std::make_shared<int>(17);
    std::weak_ptr<int> weak=resource;
    assert(manager.state.queue.TryEmplace(11,resource));
    assert(manager.state.queue.TryEmplace(12,resource));
    resource.reset();
    assert(!weak.expired());
    manager.Stop();
    assert(weak.expired()); // All skipped GPU commands release their owners.
    CommandDataContainer out{};
    assert(!manager.state.queue.TryPop(out));
    manager.Stop(); // Repeat shutdown is idempotent.
    manager.stop_source=std::stop_source{};
    assert(manager.state.queue.TryEmplace(31,std::shared_ptr<int>{}));
    assert(manager.state.queue.TryPop(out) && out.id==31);
    assert(!manager.state.queue.TryPop(out)); // Nothing survived from old run.
    std::atomic<bool> ready=false,exited=false;
    manager.stop_source=std::stop_source{};
    int rc=pthread_create(&manager.thread,nullptr,[](void* arg)->void* {
        auto& self=*static_cast<ThreadManager*>(arg);
        auto token=self.stop_source.get_token();
        auto* ready=&self;
        (void)ready;
        while(!token.stop_requested())std::this_thread::yield();
        return nullptr;
    },&manager);
    assert(rc==0);
    manager.thread_joinable=true;
    assert(manager.state.queue.TryEmplace(41,std::shared_ptr<int>{}));
    manager.Stop();
    assert(!manager.thread_joinable && manager.stop_source.stop_requested());
    assert(!manager.state.queue.TryPop(out));
    (void)ready; (void)exited;
    std::puts("ENCORE_GPU_WORKER_RESTART_DRAIN_HOST_PASS");
}
""".replace("INJECT_STOP",body)
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compile actual selected graphics binding methods against bounded shader slots."""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
current = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/video_core/buffer_cache/buffer_cache.h").read_text()
base = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-backports/src/video_core/buffer_cache/buffer_cache.h").read_text()
base_hdr = (root / "vendor/sources/eden/src/video_core/buffer_cache/buffer_cache_base.h").read_text()
assert "constexpr u32 NUM_STORAGE_BUFFERS = 16;" in base_hdr
assert "constexpr u32 NUM_TEXTURE_BUFFERS = 32;" in base_hdr
assert "constexpr u32 NUM_STAGES = 5;" in base_hdr

def grab(src, signature):
    assert src.count(signature) == 1
    start = src.index(signature)
    return src[start:src.index("\ntemplate <class P>", start + len(signature))].rstrip()

signatures = (
    "bool BufferCache<P>::BindGraphicsStorageBuffer(size_t",
    "void BufferCache<P>::BindGraphicsTextureBuffer(size_t",
    "void BufferCache<P>::BindComputeStorageBuffer(size_t",
)
sections = [grab(current, s) for s in signatures]
for index, section in enumerate(sections):
    assert "[[unlikely]]" in section
    if index < 2:  # Compute bindings have no graphics stage parameter.
        assert "stage >= NUM_STAGES" in section
        assert "stage >= NUM_STAGES" not in grab(base, signatures[index])
    else:
        assert "cbuf_index >= kepler_compute->launch_description.const_buffer_config.size()" not in grab(base, signatures[index])
assert "ssbo_index >= NUM_STORAGE_BUFFERS" in sections[0]
assert "tbo_index >= NUM_TEXTURE_BUFFERS" in sections[1]
assert "cbuf_index >= maxwell3d->state.shader_stages[stage].const_buffers.size()" in sections[0]
assert "cbuf_index >= kepler_compute->launch_description.const_buffer_config.size()" in sections[2]
assert sections[2].index("cbuf_index >= kepler_compute") < sections[2].index(">> cbuf_index")
assert "channel_state->compute_storage_buffers[ssbo_index] = NULL_BINDING;" in sections[2]
assert "written_compute_storage_buffers &= ~(1U << ssbo_index)" in sections[2]
assert sections[0].index("ssbo_index >= NUM_STORAGE_BUFFERS") < sections[0].index(">> ssbo_index")
assert sections[1].index("tbo_index >= NUM_TEXTURE_BUFFERS") < sections[1].index("<< tbo_index")

program = r"""
#include <array>
#include <bit>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <initializer_list>
using u32 = std::uint32_t;
using GPUVAddr = std::uint64_t;
constexpr size_t NUM_STAGES = 5;
constexpr size_t NUM_STORAGE_BUFFERS = 16;
constexpr size_t NUM_TEXTURE_BUFFERS = 32;
enum class PixelFormat { R8 };
#define LOG_ERROR(...) (void)0
#define LOG_WARNING(...) (void)0
struct StorageBinding {
    u32 buffer_id{};
};
constexpr StorageBinding NULL_BINDING{};
struct TextureBinding {
    u32 buffer_id{};
};
struct ConstBuffer { GPUVAddr address{100}; };
struct ShaderStage { std::array<ConstBuffer, 18> const_buffers{}; };
struct StageState { std::array<ShaderStage, NUM_STAGES> shader_stages{}; };
struct Maxwell { StageState state; };
struct ComputeConfig { GPUVAddr Address() const { return 100; } };
struct LaunchDescription {
    u32 const_buffer_enable_mask{0xff};
    std::array<ComputeConfig,8> const_buffer_config{};
};
struct Kepler { LaunchDescription launch_description{}; };
#define ASSERT(cond) assert(cond)
struct State {
    std::array<u32, NUM_STAGES> enabled_storage_buffers{};
    std::array<u32, NUM_STAGES> written_storage_buffers{};
    std::array<u32, NUM_STAGES> enabled_texture_buffers{};
    std::array<u32, NUM_STAGES> written_texture_buffers{};
    std::array<u32, NUM_STAGES> image_texture_buffers{};
    std::array<std::array<StorageBinding, NUM_STORAGE_BUFFERS>, NUM_STAGES> storage_buffers{};
    std::array<std::array<TextureBinding, NUM_TEXTURE_BUFFERS>, NUM_STAGES> texture_buffers{};
    u32 total_graphics_storage_buffers{};
    u32 enabled_compute_storage_buffers{};
    u32 written_compute_storage_buffers{};
    u32 total_compute_storage_buffers{};

    bool limit{};
    bool ShouldLimitDynamicStorageBuffers() const { return limit; }

    Kepler* kepler_compute{};
    Runtime runtime{};
    StorageBinding StorageBufferBinding(GPUVAddr, u32, bool) { return {1}; }
    TextureBinding GetTextureBufferBinding(GPUVAddr, u32, PixelFormat) { return {1}; }
    bool BindGraphicsStorageBuffer(size_t stage, size_t ssbo_index, u32 cbuf_index,
                                   u32 cbuf_offset, bool is_written);
    void BindGraphicsTextureBuffer(size_t stage, size_t tbo_index, GPUVAddr gpu_addr,
                                   u32 size, PixelFormat format, bool is_written, bool is_image);
    void BindComputeStorageBuffer(size_t ssbo_index, u32 cbuf_index,
                                  u32 cbuf_offset, bool is_written);
};
""" + "\n\n".join("template <class P>\n"+v for v in sections) + r"""
int main() {
    State state{};
    Maxwell maxwell{};
    Kepler compute{};
    BufferCache<void> cache{};
    cache.kepler_compute = &compute;
    cache.channel_state = &state;
    cache.maxwell3d = &maxwell;
    // Valid endpoints must keep their masks and exact descriptor slots.
    assert(cache.BindGraphicsStorageBuffer(4, 15, 0, 2, true));
    assert(state.enabled_storage_buffers[4] == (u32{1} << 15));
    assert(state.written_storage_buffers[4] == (u32{1} << 15));
    assert(state.storage_buffers[4][15].buffer_id == 1);
    cache.BindGraphicsTextureBuffer(4, 31, 120, 64, PixelFormat::R8, true, true);
    assert(state.enabled_texture_buffers[4] == (u32{1} << 31));
    assert(state.written_texture_buffers[4] == (u32{1} << 31));
    assert(state.texture_buffers[4][31].buffer_id == 1);
    const auto saved_storage = state.enabled_storage_buffers[4];
    const auto saved_texture = state.enabled_texture_buffers[4];
    const auto saved_total = state.total_graphics_storage_buffers;
    // Reject first overflowing index and arbitrary large index.
    for (size_t bad : {size_t{16}, size_t{32}, size_t{1024}}) {
        assert(!cache.BindGraphicsStorageBuffer(4, bad, 0, 2, true));
    }
    for (size_t bad : {size_t{32}, size_t{1024}}) {
        cache.BindGraphicsTextureBuffer(4, bad, 120, 64, PixelFormat::R8, true, true);
    }
    // Reject stage overrun, even for otherwise valid descriptor slots.
    assert(!cache.BindGraphicsStorageBuffer(5, 0, 0, 2, true));
    cache.BindGraphicsTextureBuffer(5, 0, 120, 64, PixelFormat::R8, true, true);
    assert(state.enabled_storage_buffers[4] == saved_storage);
    assert(state.enabled_texture_buffers[4] == saved_texture);
    assert(state.total_graphics_storage_buffers == saved_total);
    // Driver dynamic limit is still accounted only for live bindings.
    cache.runtime.limit = true;
    assert(cache.BindGraphicsStorageBuffer(2, 0, 0, 2, false));
    assert(state.total_graphics_storage_buffers == saved_total + 1);
    assert(!cache.BindGraphicsStorageBuffer(2, 16, 0, 2, false));
    assert(state.total_graphics_storage_buffers == saved_total + 1);
    // Graphics shader constant-buffer array has 18 entries, 0..17 inclusive.
    assert(cache.BindGraphicsStorageBuffer(0, 1, 17, 0, false));
    const auto gfx_before = state.enabled_storage_buffers[0];
    assert(!cache.BindGraphicsStorageBuffer(0, 2, 18, 0, true));
    assert(!cache.BindGraphicsStorageBuffer(0, 2, 1000, 0, true));
    assert(state.enabled_storage_buffers[0] == gfx_before);
    // Compute constant-buffer enable mask and its table only cover 0..7.
    cache.BindComputeStorageBuffer(0, 7, 0, true);
    assert(state.enabled_compute_storage_buffers == 1U);
    assert(state.written_compute_storage_buffers == 1U);
    assert(state.compute_storage_buffers[0].buffer_id == 1);
    auto comp_before = state.total_compute_storage_buffers;
    cache.BindComputeStorageBuffer(1, 8, 0, true);
    cache.BindComputeStorageBuffer(1, 1000, 0, true);
    assert(state.enabled_compute_storage_buffers == 1U);
    assert(state.total_compute_storage_buffers == comp_before);
    // Rebinding a previously valid SSBO from a disabled compute CBUF must
    // clear the previous launch's buffer and write tracking.
    cache.BindComputeStorageBuffer(2, 7, 0, true);
    assert(state.compute_storage_buffers[2].buffer_id == 1);
    assert((state.written_compute_storage_buffers & (1U << 2)) != 0);
    compute.launch_description.const_buffer_enable_mask = 0;
    cache.BindComputeStorageBuffer(2, 7, 0, true);
    assert(state.compute_storage_buffers[2].buffer_id == 0);
    assert((state.written_compute_storage_buffers & (1U << 2)) == 0);
    // The descriptor slot stays occupied to preserve host binding indices.
    assert((state.enabled_compute_storage_buffers & (1U << 2)) != 0);
}
"""
```

`tools/check-native-guest-memory-coherence-host.py`:
