```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compile pinned GuestMemory to qualify CPU/GPU flush/invalidation contracts.

Runs actual pinned C++ templates through direct spans and copy fallbacks.
No console build, no driver calls. The test is a contract witness, not a
measurement of native GPU fence completion.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
header = (root / "vendor/sources/eden/src/core/guest_memory.h").read_text()
gpu_guest = (root / "vendor/sources/eden/src/video_core/guest_memory.h").read_text()
workflow = (root / ".github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml").read_text()
for marker in (
    "m_memory->FlushRegion(m_addr, this->size_bytes());",
    "m_memory->ReadBlock(m_addr, this->data(), this->size_bytes());",
    "m_memory->WriteBlock(this->m_addr, this->data(), this->size_bytes());",
    "this->m_memory->InvalidateRegion(this->m_addr, this->size_bytes());",
    "if (u8* ptr = m_memory->GetSpan(m_addr, this->size_bytes()); ptr)",
):
    assert header.count(marker) == 1, marker
assert "using GpuGuestMemoryScoped = Core::Memory::GuestMemoryScoped<" in gpu_guest
assert "python3 -B tools/check-native-guest-memory-coherence-host.py" in workflow

source = r"""
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>
#include <span>
using u8=std::uint8_t;
using u32=std::uint32_t;
using u64=std::uint64_t;
#include "core/guest_memory.h"

struct FakeGpuMemory {
    static constexpr bool HAS_FLUSH_INVALIDATION=true;
    alignas(u32) std::array<u8,64> bytes{};
    bool contiguous=true;
    unsigned flushes=0, safe_reads=0, unsafe_reads=0;
    unsigned safe_writes=0, unsafe_writes=0, invalidations=0, cached_writes=0;
    FakeGpuMemory() {
        for (unsigned i=0;i<bytes.size();++i) bytes[i]=static_cast<u8>(i);
    }
    u8* GetSpan(u64 a, std::size_t n) {
        return contiguous && a <= bytes.size() && n <= bytes.size()-a
            ? bytes.data()+a : nullptr;
    }
    void FlushRegion(u64, std::size_t) { ++flushes; }
    void ReadBlock(u64 a,void* p,std::size_t n) {
        ++safe_reads;
        assert(a <= bytes.size() && n <= bytes.size()-a);
        std::memcpy(p,bytes.data()+a,n);
    }
    void ReadBlockUnsafe(u64 a,void* p,std::size_t n) {
        ++unsafe_reads;
        assert(a <= bytes.size() && n <= bytes.size()-a);
        std::memcpy(p,bytes.data()+a,n);
    }
    void WriteBlock(u64 a,const void* p,std::size_t n) {
        ++safe_writes;
        assert(a <= bytes.size() && n <= bytes.size()-a);
        std::memcpy(bytes.data()+a,p,n);
    }
    void WriteBlockUnsafe(u64 a,const void* p,std::size_t n) {
        ++unsafe_writes;
        assert(a <= bytes.size() && n <= bytes.size()-a);
        std::memcpy(bytes.data()+a,p,n);
    }
    void WriteBlockCached(u64 a,const void* p,std::size_t n) {
        ++cached_writes;
        assert(a <= bytes.size() && n <= bytes.size()-a);
        std::memcpy(bytes.data()+a,p,n);
    }
    void InvalidateRegion(u64,std::size_t) { ++invalidations; }
};
using namespace Core::Memory;

int main() {
    FakeGpuMemory a;
    {
        GuestMemory<FakeGpuMemory,u8,GuestMemoryFlags::SafeRead> data(a,4,8);
        assert(data.data() == a.bytes.data()+4);
        assert(data.size_bytes()==8 && data[0]==4);
    }
    assert(a.flushes==1 && a.safe_reads==0 && a.invalidations==0);
    {
        GuestMemoryScoped<FakeGpuMemory,u8,GuestMemoryFlags::SafeReadWrite> data(a,4,8);
        data[2]=99;
    }
    assert(a.flushes==2 && a.invalidations==1);
    assert(a.bytes[6]==99 && a.safe_writes==0);
    {
        GuestMemoryScoped<FakeGpuMemory,u8,GuestMemoryFlags::SafeWrite> data(a,8,8);
        data[0]=101;
    }
    assert(a.invalidations==2 && a.bytes[8]==101 && a.safe_writes==0);

    FakeGpuMemory b;
    b.contiguous=false;  // GetSpan null: force tracked copy fallback
    {
        GuestMemory<FakeGpuMemory,u8,GuestMemoryFlags::SafeRead> data(b,4,8);
        assert(data.data()!=b.bytes.data()+4 && data[0]==4);
    }
    assert(b.safe_reads==1 && b.flushes==0);
    {
        GuestMemoryScoped<FakeGpuMemory,u8,GuestMemoryFlags::SafeReadWrite> data(b,4,8);
        data[1]=77;
    }
    assert(b.safe_reads==2 && b.safe_writes==1 && b.invalidations==0);
    assert(b.bytes[5]==77);
    {
        GuestMemoryScoped<FakeGpuMemory,u8,GuestMemoryFlags::SafeWrite> data(b,8,8);
        data[0]=88;
    }
    assert(b.safe_writes==2 && b.bytes[8]==88 && b.invalidations==0);

    FakeGpuMemory c;
    {
        GuestMemoryScoped<FakeGpuMemory,u8,GuestMemoryFlags::SafeReadWrite> data(c,4,8);
        data.SetAddressAndSize(20,8);
    }
    assert(c.flushes==1 && c.safe_writes==1 && c.invalidations==0);
    assert(c.bytes[20]==4 && c.bytes[27]==11);

    // A safe guest command read can be a *live alias* after FlushRegion.
    // It does not freeze command words against later guest RAM mutation.
    FakeGpuMemory live_words;
    {
        GuestMemory<FakeGpuMemory,u32,GuestMemoryFlags::SafeRead>
            commands(live_words,16,2);
        assert(live_words.flushes==1 && live_words.safe_reads==0);
        assert(commands.data()==reinterpret_cast<u32*>(live_words.bytes.data()+16));
        const u32 observed=commands[0];
        const u32 replacement=0xdecafbad;
        std::memcpy(live_words.bytes.data()+16,&replacement,sizeof(replacement));
        assert(commands[0]==replacement && commands[0]!=observed);
    }

    // The copied fallback snapshots its source at construction time.
    FakeGpuMemory copied_words;
    copied_words.contiguous=false;
    {
        GuestMemory<FakeGpuMemory,u32,GuestMemoryFlags::SafeRead>
            commands(copied_words,16,2);
        assert(copied_words.safe_reads==1 && copied_words.flushes==0);
        const u32 observed=commands[0];
        const u32 replacement=0xdecafbad;
        std::memcpy(copied_words.bytes.data()+16,&replacement,sizeof(replacement));
        assert(commands[0]==observed && commands[0]!=replacement);
    }

    FakeGpuMemory d;
    {
        GuestMemory<FakeGpuMemory,u8,GuestMemoryFlags::UnsafeRead> data(d,4,8);
        assert(data[0]==4);
    }
    assert(d.flushes==0 && d.safe_reads==0 && d.unsafe_reads==0);
}
"""
clang=shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++")
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compile pinned Memory::IsValidVirtualAddressRange before/after native CMake guard.

Shows a wraparound false-positive in the original 64-bit range scan.
Host-only scope: no device, no guest mapping changes, no GPU/JIT barrier.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
pinned = root / "vendor/sources/eden/src/core/memory.cpp"
helper = root / "tools/fixtures/legacy-native-guest-range-overflow.cmake"
main_cmake = (root / "headless/CMakeLists.txt").read_text()
workflow = (root / ".github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml").read_text()
assert 'include("${EDEN_PORT_DIR}/native_guest_range_overflow.cmake")' not in main_cmake
assert 'set(EDEN_NATIVE_GUEST_SOURCE "${EDEN_NATIVE_MEMORY_ROOT}/memory_native_standard.cpp")' in main_cmake
assert "python3 -B tools/check-native-guest-range-overflow-host.py" in workflow
assert pinned.read_text().count("Common::ProcessAddress end = base + size;") == 1
assert helper.read_text().count("std::numeric_limits<u64>::max() - GetInteger(base)") == 1
compiler = shutil.which("g++") or shutil.which("clang++")
assert compiler and shutil.which("cmake")


def real_method(source):
    start = "bool Memory::IsValidVirtualAddressRange(Common::ProcessAddress base, u64 size) const {"
    stop = "\nu8* Memory::GetPointer("
    assert source.count(start) == source.count(stop) == 1
    return start + source.split(start, 1)[1].split(stop, 1)[0].strip("\n") + "\n"


prelude = r"""
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstddef>
#include <limits>
#include <cassert>
#include <iostream>
using u8 = std::uint8_t;
using u64 = std::uint64_t;
inline constexpr unsigned YUZU_PAGEBITS = 12;
inline constexpr u64 YUZU_PAGESIZE = 4096;
namespace Common {
using ProcessAddress = u64;
u64 AlignDown(u64 number, u64 alignment) {
    return number & ~(alignment - 1);
}
}
u64 GetInteger(Common::ProcessAddress address) { return address; }
namespace Core::Memory {
struct Memory {
    bool IsValidVirtualAddress(Common::ProcessAddress address) const {
        return address < 0x10000;
    }
    bool IsValidVirtualAddressRange(Common::ProcessAddress base, u64 size) const;
};
"""
postlude = r"""
} // namespace Core::Memory
int main() {
    Core::Memory::Memory memory;
    constexpr u64 base = std::numeric_limits<u64>::max() - 8;
    // The original wraps end below the beginning and scans zero pages.
#if EXPECT_FIXED
    assert(!memory.IsValidVirtualAddressRange(base, 32));
#else
    assert(memory.IsValidVirtualAddressRange(base, 32));
#endif
    assert(memory.IsValidVirtualAddressRange(0x2000, 0x100));
    assert(memory.IsValidVirtualAddressRange(0x1000, 0x1000));
    assert(!memory.IsValidVirtualAddressRange(0xFF00, 0x200));
    assert(memory.IsValidVirtualAddressRange(0, 0));
    std::cout << (EXPECT_FIXED
        ? "PINNED_NATIVE_GUEST_RANGE_OVERFLOW_REJECTED_PASS\n"
        : "PINNED_GUEST_RANGE_OVERFLOW_FALSE_POSITIVE_WITNESS_PASS\n");
}
"""
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-native-range-") as temp:
    folder = Path(temp)
    derived_path = folder / "derived.cpp"
    cmake_script = folder / "derive.cmake"
    cmake_script.write_text(
        f'file(READ "{pinned.as_posix()}" eden_cpu_memory)\n'
        f'include("{helper.as_posix()}")\n'
        f'file(WRITE "{derived_path.as_posix()}" "${{eden_cpu_memory}}")\n'
    )
    subprocess.run(["cmake", "-P", str(cmake_script)], check=True, timeout=20)
    original_source = pinned.read_text()

    maintained = (root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/core/memory_native_standard.cpp").read_text()
    assert real_method(maintained) == real_method(derived_source)
    assert derived_source.count("std::numeric_limits<u64>::max() - GetInteger(base)") == 1
    assert original_source.count("std::numeric_limits<u64>::max() - GetInteger(base)") == 0
    for name, src, fixed in (
        ("pinned", original_source, False),
        ("derived", derived_source, True),
    ):
        cpp = folder / f"{name}.cpp"
        exe = folder / name
        cpp.write_text(prelude + real_method(src) + postlude)
        subprocess.run(
            [compiler, "-std=c++20", "-O2", "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror",
             "-DEXPECT_FIXED=" + str(int(fixed)), str(cpp), "-o", str(exe)],
            check=True, timeout=30,
        )
        run = subprocess.run([str(exe)], capture_output=True, check=True, text=True,
                             timeout=10)
        print(run.stdout, end="")
```

`tools/check-native-guest-span-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Host regression for native memory GetSpan's exclusive-end page boundary.

Compile the actual two pinned GetSpan methods as the negative control and
both complete maintained native C++ sources as positive controls. No console build.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
memory = (root / "vendor/sources/eden/src/core/memory.cpp").read_text()
cmake = (root / "headless/CMakeLists.txt").read_text()
workflow = (root / ".github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml").read_text()

begin = "    [[nodiscard]] inline const u8* GetSpan("
end = "    bool WriteBlockImpl("
assert memory.count(begin) == 1 and memory.count(end) == 1
methods = begin + memory.split(begin, 1)[1].split(end, 1)[0]
old = (
    "        return (current_page_table->entries[addr >> YUZU_PAGEBITS].Block() "
    "== current_page_table->entries[(addr + size) >> YUZU_PAGEBITS].Block()) "
    "? GetPointerSilent(addr) : nullptr;"
)
assert methods.count(old) == 2
native_source = (root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/core/memory_native_standard.cpp").read_text()
a32_source = (root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/core/memory_native_a32.cpp").read_text()
assert 'memory_native_standard.cpp' in cmake and 'memory_native_a32.cpp' in cmake
assert 'write_derived("${eden_native_memory_tu}"' not in cmake
for unit in (native_source, a32_source):
    # The 27d087f crash hit ZeroBlock -> WalkBlock before SetCurrentPageTable.
    # Both runtime-selected implementations must fail closed, never deref null.
    assert unit.count("if (current_page_table == nullptr ||") == 1
    assert unit.count("!AddressSpaceContains(*current_page_table, addr, size)) {") == 1
assert native_source.count(begin) == a32_source.count(begin) == 1
maintained_methods = begin + native_source.split(begin,1)[1].split(end,1)[0]
a32_methods = begin + a32_source.split(begin,1)[1].split(end,1)[0]
assert maintained_methods == a32_methods, "native GetSpan must not vary by A32 profile"
assert maintained_methods.count("current_page_table == nullptr ||") == 1
assert maintained_methods.index("current_page_table == nullptr ||") < maintained_methods.index(
    "!AddressSpaceContains(*current_page_table, addr, size)")

assert maintained_methods.count("if (size == 0 || addr + (size - 1) < addr)") == 2
assert maintained_methods.count("start_page >= entries.size() || end_page >= entries.size()") == 2
assert old not in maintained_methods
assert "python3 -B tools/check-native-guest-span-host.py" in workflow

cpp = r"""
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
using VAddr = std::uint64_t;
using u8 = std::uint8_t;
static constexpr auto YUZU_PAGEBITS = 12;
struct Entry {
    int block{};
    int Block() const { return block; }
};
struct PageTable {
    std::array<Entry, 2> entries{};
};
struct MemoryFixture {
    PageTable* current_page_table{};
    u8 dummy{};
    u8* GetPointerSilent(VAddr) const {
        return const_cast<u8*>(&dummy);
    }
@@METHODS@@
};
int main(int argc, char**) {
    PageTable pages;
    pages.entries[0].block = 11;
    pages.entries[1].block = 22;
    MemoryFixture fixture{&pages};
    const MemoryFixture& read = fixture;
    if (argc > 2) {
        // The pinned final page probes a non-existent following entry.
        (void)fixture.GetSpan(4096, 4096);
        return 0; // Checked std::array indexing must abort.
    }
    if (argc > 1) {
        // At exact end of page 0, original code consults page 1.
        assert(fixture.GetSpan(0, 4096) == nullptr);
        assert(read.GetSpan(0, 4096) == nullptr);
        return 0;
    }
    assert(fixture.GetSpan(0, 4096) != nullptr);
    assert(read.GetSpan(0, 4096) != nullptr);
    assert(fixture.GetSpan(4096, 4096) != nullptr);
    assert(read.GetSpan(4096, 4096) != nullptr);
    assert(fixture.GetSpan(4095, 1) != nullptr);
    assert(read.GetSpan(4095, 1) != nullptr);
    assert(fixture.GetSpan(4095, 2) == nullptr);
    assert(read.GetSpan(4095, 2) == nullptr);
    assert(fixture.GetSpan(0, 0) == nullptr);
    assert(read.GetSpan(0, 0) == nullptr);
    assert(fixture.GetSpan(8192, 1) == nullptr);
    assert(read.GetSpan(8192, 1) == nullptr);
    assert(fixture.GetSpan(UINT64_MAX, 2) == nullptr);
    assert(read.GetSpan(UINT64_MAX, 2) == nullptr);
}
"""
clang = shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++")
assert clang, "Clang C++20 required"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-guest-span-") as tmp:
    work = Path(tmp)
    for label, text, negative in (
        ("pinned", methods, True),
        ("native", maintained_methods, False),
    ):

        binary = work / label
        source.write_text(cpp.replace("@@METHODS@@", text))

             "-Werror", "-D_GLIBCXX_ASSERTIONS", "-fsanitize=address,undefined",
             "-fno-sanitize-recover=all", str(source), "-o", str(binary)],
            check=True, timeout=45
        )
        command = [str(binary)] + (["--pinned"] if negative else [])
        subprocess.run(command, check=True, timeout=45)
        if negative:
            beyond = subprocess.run(
                [str(binary), "--pinned", "--past-last"], capture_output=True,
                text=True, timeout=45
            )
            assert beyond.returncode != 0, "Pinned last-page overrun was not caught"
            assert ("Assertion" in beyond.stderr or "out of range" in beyond.stderr
                    or "runtime error" in beyond.stderr), beyond.stderr
print("NATIVE_GUEST_SPAN_HOST_PASS original_exact_boundary_false_negative=1 native_const_mutable=2 original_last_page_checked_abort=1 last_page=1 crossing=1 zero=1 overflow=1 out_of_bounds=1")
```

`tools/check-native-guest-write-span-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Sanitizer witness for native guest write spans with mismatched sizes.

Compiles the actual pinned and maintained guest-memory template. A short
source span must trigger an ASan read overflow in the pinned version; the
native version copies only the intersection of source/destination lengths.
This is NOT a GPU scheduling or console performance test.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
pinned=(root/"vendor/sources/eden/src/core/guest_memory.h").read_text()
native=(root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-core/overrides/core/guest_memory.h").read_text()
cmake=(root/"headless/CMakeLists.txt").read_text()
workflow=(root/".github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml").read_text()
before="""    void Write(std::span<T> write_data) noexcept {
        if constexpr (FLAGS & GuestMemoryFlags::Cached) {
            m_memory->WriteBlockCached(m_addr, write_data.data(), this->size_bytes());
        } else if constexpr (FLAGS & GuestMemoryFlags::Safe) {
            m_memory->WriteBlock(m_addr, write_data.data(), this->size_bytes());
        } else {
            m_memory->WriteBlockUnsafe(m_addr, write_data.data(), this->size_bytes());
        }
    }"""
after="""    void Write(std::span<T> write_data) noexcept {
        // The supplied span may be shorter than the guest allocation.
        // Never read past its backing storage or write past the guest range.
        const std::size_t write_bytes = std::min(write_data.size_bytes(), this->size_bytes());
        if (write_bytes == 0) {
            return;
        }
        if constexpr (FLAGS & GuestMemoryFlags::Cached) {
            m_memory->WriteBlockCached(m_addr, write_data.data(), write_bytes);
        } else if constexpr (FLAGS & GuestMemoryFlags::Safe) {
            m_memory->WriteBlock(m_addr, write_data.data(), write_bytes);
        } else {
            m_memory->WriteBlockUnsafe(m_addr, write_data.data(), write_bytes);
        }
    }"""
assert pinned.count(before)==1
# Strict pinned-source oracle admits only three audited native changes:
# bounded span writes, empty-read stale pointer reset, and <algorithm>.
zero_before="        if (m_size == 0) {\n            m_is_data_copy = true;\n            return {};\n        }"
zero_after="        if (m_size == 0) {\n            // This object may be reused after a preceding direct alias or\n            // scratch copy. Never expose a stale pointer for an empty command.\n            m_data_span = {};\n            m_span_valid = false;\n            m_is_data_copy = true;\n            return {};\n        }"
assert pinned.count(zero_before)==1
```

```py
def extract_from(source_text: str, marker: str) -> str:
    assert source_text.count(marker) == 1, marker
    begin = source_text.index(marker)
    open_brace = source_text.index("{", begin)
    depth = 0
    for offset in range(open_brace, len(source_text)):
        if source_text[offset] == "{":
            depth += 1
        elif source_text[offset] == "}":
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0:
                return source_text[begin:offset + 1]
    raise AssertionError("Unterminated native source: " + marker)


def extract(marker: str) -> str:
    return extract_from(source, marker)

static android::BufferItem frame(int id, int interval) {
    android::BufferItem item;
    item.graphic_buffer = std::make_shared<android::GraphicBuffer>(
        android::GraphicBuffer{id});
    item.swap_interval = interval;
    item.fence.sequence = id;
    return item;
}
int main() {
    // Exact native swap-interval helper: the pinned 1 - INT_MIN expression
    // overflowed signed int in UBSan at both -O0 and -O2.
    volatile s32 minimum = std::numeric_limits<s32>::min();
    f32 edge_speed = 0;
    assert(NormalizeSwapInterval(&edge_speed, minimum) == 1);
    assert(std::isfinite(edge_speed) && edge_speed > 1.f);
    assert(NormalizeSwapInterval(&edge_speed, -1) == 1);
    assert(edge_speed == 4.f);
    assert(NormalizeSwapInterval(&edge_speed, 0) == 1);
    assert(edge_speed == 2.f);
    HardwareComposer composer;
    Display display;
    Nvidia::Devices::nvdisp_disp0 display_gpu;
    auto game_consumer = std::make_shared<MockConsumer>();
    auto hud_consumer = std::make_shared<MockConsumer>();
    auto game = std::make_shared<Layer>();
    game->consumer_id = 7;
    game->z_index = 0;
    game->buffer_item_consumer = game_consumer;
    auto hud = std::make_shared<Layer>();
    hud->consumer_id = 8;
    hud->is_overlay = true;
    hud->z_index = 1;
    hud->buffer_item_consumer = hud_consumer;
    display.stack.layers = {game, hud};
    game_consumer->pending.push_back(frame(10,2));
    hud_consumer->pending.push_back(frame(20,1));
    f32 speed=0;
    assert(composer.ComposeLocked(&speed, display, display_gpu) == 1);
    assert((display_gpu.composed == std::vector<std::vector<int>>{{10,20}}));
    assert((display_gpu.fences == std::vector<std::vector<int>>{{10,20}}));
    assert(speed == 1.0f);
    assert(composer.m_framebuffers[7].is_acquired);
    assert(composer.m_framebuffers[8].is_acquired);

    // No fresh game/HUD frame: game remains acquired at 2-vsync interval,
    // overlay is released and must never force stale composition.
    assert(composer.ComposeLocked(&speed, display, display_gpu) == 1);
    assert(display_gpu.composed.size() == 1);
    assert(game_consumer->releases == 0 && hud_consumer->releases == 1);

    // At game release frame, only the new HUD frame is available.
    // Never compose the previously released game buffer into the new HUD.
    hud_consumer->pending.push_back(frame(21,1));
    assert(composer.ComposeLocked(&speed, display, display_gpu) == 1);
    assert((display_gpu.composed == std::vector<std::vector<int>>{
        {10,20}, {21}}));
    assert(game_consumer->releases == 1);
    assert(!composer.m_framebuffers[7].is_acquired);
    assert(composer.m_framebuffers[8].is_acquired);

    // Now the game produces a new frame; previously released HUD buffer
    // must not reappear in the next composite.
    game_consumer->pending.push_back(frame(11,2));
    assert(composer.ComposeLocked(&speed, display, display_gpu) == 1);
    assert((display_gpu.composed == std::vector<std::vector<int>>{
        {10,20}, {21}, {11}}));
    assert(hud_consumer->releases == 2);

    // No new buffers: no hidden re-presentation of either released image.
    assert(composer.ComposeLocked(&speed, display, display_gpu) == 1);
    assert(display_gpu.composed.size() == 3);
    assert(display_gpu.wait_count == 5);

    // F05 sustained forward-progress: real source-extracted compositor,
    // one 30Hz guest game producer and one independent 60Hz HUD producer.
    // This is an ownership/cadence replay, not a PS5 timing measurement.
    HardwareComposer paced;
    Display paced_display;
    Nvidia::Devices::nvdisp_disp0 paced_gpu;
    auto paced_game_consumer = std::make_shared<MockConsumer>();
    auto paced_hud_consumer = std::make_shared<MockConsumer>();
    auto paced_game = std::make_shared<Layer>();
    paced_game->consumer_id = 37;
    paced_game->buffer_item_consumer = paced_game_consumer;
    auto paced_hud = std::make_shared<Layer>();
    paced_hud->consumer_id = 38;
    paced_hud->z_index = 1;
    paced_hud->is_overlay = true;
    paced_hud->buffer_item_consumer = paced_hud_consumer;
    paced_display.stack.layers = {paced_game, paced_hud};
    constexpr int steady_ticks = 240;
    int last_game = -1;
    for (int tick = 0; tick < steady_ticks; ++tick) {
        if (tick % 2 == 0) {
            last_game = 1000 + tick;
            paced_game_consumer->pending.push_back(frame(last_game, 2));
        }
        paced_hud_consumer->pending.push_back(frame(2000 + tick, 1));
        assert(paced.ComposeLocked(&speed, paced_display, paced_gpu) == 1);
        assert(paced_gpu.composed.size() == static_cast<std::size_t>(tick + 1));
        assert((paced_gpu.composed.back() ==
                std::vector<int>{last_game, 2000 + tick}));
        assert(paced_gpu.fences.back() == paced_gpu.composed.back());
        assert(paced_game_consumer->acquires == static_cast<unsigned>(tick / 2 + 1));
        assert(paced_game_consumer->releases == static_cast<unsigned>(tick / 2));
        assert(paced_hud_consumer->acquires == static_cast<unsigned>(tick + 1));
        assert(paced_hud_consumer->releases == static_cast<unsigned>(tick));
        assert(paced_gpu.wait_count == tick + 1);
        assert(paced.m_frame_number == static_cast<u64>(tick + 1));
    }
    assert(paced_game_consumer->pending.empty());
    assert(paced_hud_consumer->pending.empty());
    assert(paced_game_consumer->queue->consumer_listener->available ==
           steady_ticks / 2);
    assert(paced_hud_consumer->queue->consumer_listener->available ==
           steady_ticks);
    assert(paced_game_consumer->queue->consumer_listener->replaced == 0);
    assert(paced_hud_consumer->queue->consumer_listener->replaced == 0);
    assert(paced_game_consumer->queue->consumer_listener->observed_fences.front() == 1000);
    assert(paced_hud_consumer->queue->consumer_listener->observed_fences.back() ==
           2000 + steady_ticks - 1);
    assert(Common::g_wall_clock.calls == 0);

    // The guest stops supplying new game images during pause/half-time.
    // One still-owned two-vsync game frame can be reused ONCE; after
    // release it must never reappear in an overlay-only composition.
    constexpr int no_game_ticks = 12;
    const int prior_game = last_game;
    const std::size_t prior_composites = paced_gpu.composed.size();
    for (int tick = 0; tick < no_game_ticks; ++tick) {
        paced_hud_consumer->pending.push_back(frame(3000 + tick, 1));
        assert(paced.ComposeLocked(&speed, paced_display, paced_gpu) == 1);
        assert(paced_gpu.composed.size() == prior_composites + tick + 1);
        const auto& layers = paced_gpu.composed.back();
        assert(layers.back() == 3000 + tick);
        for (int handle : layers)
            assert(handle != prior_game); // released at the first paused tick
        assert(paced_gpu.wait_count == steady_ticks + tick + 1);
    }
    assert(!paced.m_framebuffers[37].is_acquired);
    assert(paced_game_consumer->releases == steady_ticks / 2);
    assert(paced_hud_consumer->releases == steady_ticks + no_game_ticks - 1);

    // Recover after the pause without resurrecting the old scan or HUD.
    paced_game_consumer->pending.push_back(frame(9001, 2));
    paced_hud_consumer->pending.push_back(frame(9002, 1));
    assert(paced.ComposeLocked(&speed, paced_display, paced_gpu) == 1);
    assert((paced_gpu.composed.back() == std::vector<int>{9001, 9002}));
    // acquire attempts also count the twelve expected NoBufferAvailable
    // polls while the guest is paused; successful game frames do not.
    assert(paced_game_consumer->acquires ==
           steady_ticks / 2 + no_game_ticks + 1);
    assert(paced_hud_consumer->releases == steady_ticks + no_game_ticks);
    assert(paced_gpu.wait_count == steady_ticks + no_game_ticks + 1);
    std::printf("F05_COMPOSITOR_CADENCE_REPLAY_PASS game_success=%d "
                "game_poll_attempts=%u hud_success=%d paused_polls=%d "
                "recovery=1 scope=source_extracted_host\\n",
                steady_ticks / 2 + 1, paced_game_consumer->acquires,
                steady_ticks + no_game_ticks + 1, no_game_ticks);
    std::puts("HARDWARE_COMPOSER_FULL_LIVENESS_PASS");
}
"""
fixture = fixture.replace("__CONSUMER_METHODS__", consumer_methods)
fixture = fixture.replace("__PRODUCER_PUBLISH__", producer_publish)
```

`tools/check-native-hle-suspend-noop-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""ASan/UBSan proof for the real KThread::UpdateState suspend-flag no-op fast path.

Compares pinned/maintained source, including the scheduler notification boundary.
Counts relaxed atomic operations; no guest execution / console FPS claim.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PIN = (ROOT / "vendor/sources/eden/src/core/hle/kernel/k_thread.cpp").read_text()
ACTIVE = (ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/eden-threading/src/core/hle/kernel/k_thread.cpp").read_text()
CMAKE = (ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/eden-threading/native-hle-overrides.cmake").read_text()
ORACLE = (ROOT / "tools/verify/hle/check-hle-overlay-layout.py").read_text()
FAST = (ROOT / ".github/workflows/encore-core-fast-gate.yml").read_text()
FULL = (ROOT / ".github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml").read_text()
SCRIPT = "python3 -B tools/check-native-hle-suspend-noop-host.py"
assert SCRIPT in FAST and SCRIPT in FULL
assert '"hle/kernel/k_thread.cpp" "core/hle/kernel/k_thread.cpp"' in CMAKE
assert "update_before" in ORACLE and "update_after" in ORACLE
assert "update_before, update_after" in ORACLE

START = "    void KThread::UpdateState(KernelCore& kernel) {"
END = "\n    void KThread::Continue(KernelCore& kernel) {"
def extract(source):
    assert source.count(START) == source.count(END) == 1
    return source[source.index(START):source.index(END)].rstrip()

old = extract(PIN)
new = extract(ACTIVE)
assert old.count("m_thread_state.store(new_state, std::memory_order_relaxed);") == 1
assert new.count("m_thread_state.store(new_state, std::memory_order_relaxed);") == 1
assert old.index("m_thread_state.store(new_state") < old.index("if (new_state != old_state)")
assert new.index("m_thread_state.store(new_state") > new.index("if (new_state != old_state)")
assert new.count("KScheduler::OnThreadStateChanged(kernel, this, old_state);") == 1
# Avoid accepting a broader behavioral drift from upstream in this test.
assert ACTIVE.count("void KThread::Continue(KernelCore& kernel)") == 1
assert PIN.count("void KThread::Continue(KernelCore& kernel)") == 1

CPP = r"""
#include <array>
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
using u16 = std::uint16_t;
#define ASSERT(x) assert(x)
enum class ThreadState : u16 {
    Initialized=0, Waiting=1, Runnable=2, Terminated=3,
    Mask=15, ProcessSuspended=16, ThreadSuspended=32, DebugSuspended=64
};
constexpr ThreadState operator&(ThreadState a, ThreadState b) {
    return static_cast<ThreadState>(static_cast<u16>(a)&static_cast<u16>(b));
}
constexpr ThreadState operator|(ThreadState a, ThreadState b) {
    return static_cast<ThreadState>(static_cast<u16>(a)|static_cast<u16>(b));
}
struct KernelCore { bool locked=true; };
struct KThread;
struct KScheduler {
    static bool IsSchedulerLockedByCurrentThread(KernelCore& k) { return k.locked; }
    static void OnThreadStateChanged(KernelCore&, KThread*, ThreadState);
};
struct TrackedAtomic {
    ThreadState value{};
    unsigned loads{}, stores{};
    ThreadState load(std::memory_order) { ++loads; return value; }
    void store(ThreadState v, std::memory_order) { ++stores; value=v; }
};
struct KThread {
    TrackedAtomic m_thread_state{};
    ThreadState requested{};
    ThreadState previous{};
    unsigned notifications{};
    ThreadState GetSuspendFlags() const { return requested; }
    void UpdateState(KernelCore&);
};
void KScheduler::OnThreadStateChanged(KernelCore& k, KThread* t, ThreadState old) {
    assert(k.locked);
    ++t->notifications;
    t->previous=old;
}
INJECT
int main() {
    KernelCore kernel{};
    constexpr std::array<u16, 5> flags{0,16,32,48,112};
    unsigned cases=0, noops=0, transitions=0;
    for (u16 old_flags: flags) {
      for (u16 next_flags: flags) {
        for (u16 state=0; state<4; ++state) {
            KThread t;
            const ThreadState old_state=static_cast<ThreadState>(old_flags|state);
            const ThreadState new_state=static_cast<ThreadState>(next_flags|state);
            t.m_thread_state.value=old_state;
            t.requested=static_cast<ThreadState>(next_flags);
            const bool changed=(new_state!=old_state);
            t.UpdateState(kernel);
            assert(t.m_thread_state.value==new_state);
            assert(t.m_thread_state.loads==1);
            assert(t.m_thread_state.stores==(changed ? 1u : NOOP_STORES));
            assert(t.notifications==(changed ? 1u : 0u));
            if (changed) assert(t.previous==old_state);
            const auto first_stores=t.m_thread_state.stores;
            t.UpdateState(kernel); // Now a no-op for every combination.
            assert(t.m_thread_state.value==new_state);
            assert(t.m_thread_state.loads==2);
            assert(t.m_thread_state.stores==first_stores+NOOP_STORES);
            assert(t.notifications==(changed ? 1u : 0u));
            if(changed) ++transitions; else ++noops;
            ++cases;
        }
      }
    }
    assert(cases==100 && transitions==80 && noops==20);
    std::printf("ENCORE_HLE_SUSPEND_NOOP_PASS cases=%u noop=%u transition=%u\n",
                 cases,noops,transitions);
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compile exact native HLE wake/cancel methods under ASan/UBSan.

A missing wait queue is an invariant violation, but should never become an
unchecked null dereference. Existing EndWait already implements this contract.
This covers defensive CPU-host behavior, not real title liveness.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
ACT=(ROOT/"vendor/encore-active/eden-threading/src/core/hle/kernel/k_thread.cpp").read_text()

assert "python3 -B tools/check-native-hle-wait-null-queue-host.py" in FAST

def get(s,method):
    marker="    void KThread::"+method+"("
    assert s.count(marker)==1
    return s[s.index(marker):].split("\n    }",1)[0]+"\n    }"
methods=["NotifyAvailable","CancelWait"]
for m in methods:
    assert "if (m_wait_queue == nullptr)" in get(ACT,m)
    assert "if (m_wait_queue == nullptr)" not in get(PIN,m)
    assert "ASSERT_MSG(false" in get(ACT,m)
cpp=r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdio>
struct KernelCore {};
struct KSynchronizationObject {};
using Result=int;
enum class ThreadState { Runnable, Waiting };
int diagnostic_hits=0;
#define ASSERT_MSG(cond, reason) do { if(!(cond)) ++diagnostic_hits; } while (false)
struct KScopedSchedulerLock { explicit KScopedSchedulerLock(KernelCore&) {} };
class KThread;
struct KThreadQueue {
    int wake_count=0,cancel_count=0;
    void NotifyAvailable(KernelCore&,KThread*,KSynchronizationObject*,Result){++wake_count;}
    void CancelWait(KernelCore&,KThread*,Result,bool){++cancel_count;}
};
class KThread {
public:
    ThreadState state=ThreadState::Waiting;
    KThreadQueue* m_wait_queue=nullptr;
    ThreadState GetState() const {return state;}
    void NotifyAvailable(KernelCore&,KSynchronizationObject*,Result);
    void CancelWait(KernelCore&,Result,bool);
};
INJECT_NOTIFY
INJECT_CANCEL
int main() {
    KernelCore kernel;
    KSynchronizationObject signal;
    KThread thread;
    // Both should report the broken invariant instead of dereferencing null.
    thread.NotifyAvailable(kernel,&signal,0);
    thread.CancelWait(kernel,0,true);
    assert(diagnostic_hits==2);
    KThreadQueue queue;
    thread.m_wait_queue=&queue;
    thread.NotifyAvailable(kernel,&signal,0);
    thread.CancelWait(kernel,0,true);
    assert(queue.wake_count==1 && queue.cancel_count==1);
    assert(diagnostic_hits==2);
    thread.state=ThreadState::Runnable;
    thread.m_wait_queue=nullptr;
    thread.NotifyAvailable(kernel,&signal,0);
    thread.CancelWait(kernel,0,true);
    assert(diagnostic_hits==2);
    std::puts("HLE_NULL_QUEUE_WAKE_CANCEL_PASS");
}
"""
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Source-extracted host proof: KThread wait queue exists at the state transition.

The scheduler can inspect waiting thread state while the kernel lock is held.
This test intentionally instruments SetState() to reject a transient waiting
state without a queue; the original pinned implementation is the negative
control. Hardware guest progress and title freezes remain unmeasured.
"""

import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

mark="    void KThread::BeginWait(KernelCore& kernel, KThreadQueue* queue) {"

    assert text.count(mark)==1
    return text[text.index(mark):].split("\n    }",1)[0]+"\n    }"

assert baseline.index("m_wait_queue = queue;") > baseline.index("this->SetState(kernel, ThreadState::Waiting);")
cpp=r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdio>
struct KernelCore {};
struct KThreadQueue {};
enum class ThreadState { Runnable, Waiting };
class KThread {
public:
    ThreadState state=ThreadState::Runnable;
    KThreadQueue* m_wait_queue=nullptr;
    unsigned state_observations=0;
    void SetState(KernelCore&,ThreadState next) {
        if(next==ThreadState::Waiting) {
            ++state_observations;
            assert(m_wait_queue!=nullptr &&
                   "Cannot enter Waiting before publishing the wake queue");
        }
        state=next;
    }
    void BeginWait(KernelCore&,KThreadQueue*);
};
INJECT
int main() {
    KernelCore kernel;
    KThreadQueue queue;
    KThread thread;
    thread.BeginWait(kernel,&queue);
    assert(thread.state==ThreadState::Waiting);
    assert(thread.m_wait_queue==&queue);
    assert(thread.state_observations==1);
    std::puts("ENCORE_HLE_QUEUE_PUBLICATION_PASS");
}
"""
compiler=shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")

        else:
```

```py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
"""Source-extracted process-page-size cache, host-only; not PS5 FPS evidence."""

#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdio>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>
#include <unistd.h>
std::atomic<unsigned> queries{};
long host_sysconf(int name) {
    assert(name == _SC_PAGESIZE);
    return queries.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed) == 0 ? -1 : 16384;
}
#define sysconf host_sysconf
namespace Common {
HELPER
}
#undef sysconf
int main() {
    assert(Common::CachedHostPageSize() == -1); // failure not cached
    assert(queries.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) == 1);
    assert(Common::CachedHostPageSize() == 16384);
    assert(queries.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) == 2);
    std::vector<std::thread> workers;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
        workers.emplace_back([] {
            for (unsigned n = 0; n < 20000; ++n)
                assert(Common::CachedHostPageSize() == 16384);
        });
    }
    for (auto& worker : workers) worker.join();
    assert(queries.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) == 2);
    std::puts("NATIVE_PAGE_SIZE_CACHE_PASS initial_error_retry=1 positive_reuse=160000 queries=2 concurrency=8");
}
""".replace("HELPER", helper)
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
"""N04/F05: native Host1x Increment claim/dispatch and cancellation witness.

Compile actual source-extracted Host1x C++ methods at -O0 and -O2. Callback
ordering and pending cancellation are preserved; ready actions are claimed
before releasing the mutex and cannot subsequently be cancelled. The pinned
source MUST fail reentrance. No GPU scanout/guest IPC or TSAN certification.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PIN=(ROOT/"vendor/sources/eden/src/video_core/host1x/syncpoint_manager.cpp").read_text()
ACT=(ROOT/"vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/video_core/host1x/syncpoint_manager.cpp").read_text()

FULL=(ROOT/".github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml").read_text()
COMMAND="python3 -B tools/check-native-host1x-increment-handoff-host.py"
assert COMMAND in FAST and COMMAND in FULL
assert 'list(APPEND video_sources "' in CM and "EDEN_MAINTAINED_HOST1X_SYNCPOINT" in CM
assert 'list(REMOVE_ITEM video_sources host1x/syncpoint_manager.cpp)' in CM
assert ACT.count("ready_actions.splice(")==1 and ACT.count("ready.action();")==1
assert ACT.index("ready.action();") < ACT.index("wait_cv.notify_all();", ACT.index("ready.action();"))
assert "ready_actions" not in PIN
hs=ACT.index("namespace {\n// Each domain")
he=ACT.index("\nSyncpointManager::ActionHandle",hs)
helpers=ACT[hs:he]
assert "GuestDispatchLocks()" in helpers and "HostDispatchLocks()" in helpers
def extract(source, name):
    assert source.count(name)==1,name
    a=source.index(name)
    opening=source.index("{",a)
    depth=0
    for k in range(opening,len(source)):
        if source[k]=="{":depth+=1
        elif source[k]=="}":
            depth-=1
            if not depth:return source[a:k+1]
    raise AssertionError(name)
signatures=("SyncpointManager::ActionHandle SyncpointManager::RegisterAction(",
            "void SyncpointManager::DeregisterAction(",
            "void SyncpointManager::DeregisterGuestAction(",
            "void SyncpointManager::DeregisterHostAction(",
            "void SyncpointManager::IncrementGuest(",
            "void SyncpointManager::IncrementHost(",
            "void SyncpointManager::Increment(",
            "void SyncpointManager::WaitGuest(",
            "void SyncpointManager::WaitHost(",
            "void SyncpointManager::Wait(")
def methods(src):
    return "\n\n".join(extract(src,n) for n in signatures)
CPP=r"""
#include <array>
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <chrono>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <functional>
#include <list>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>
using u32=std::uint32_t;
class SyncpointManager {
public:
 struct RegisteredAction {
    u32 expected_value;
    std::function<void()> action;
    RegisteredAction(u32 v,std::function<void()>&& a)
      :expected_value(v),action(std::move(a)){}
 };
 using ActionHandle=std::list<RegisteredAction>::iterator;
 std::array<std::atomic<u32>,192> syncpoints_guest{},syncpoints_host{};
 std::array<std::list<RegisteredAction>,192> guest_action_storage,host_action_storage;
 std::mutex guard;
 std::condition_variable wait_guest_cv,wait_host_cv;
 template<typename F> ActionHandle RegisterGuestAction(u32 id,u32 value,F&& f) {
    return RegisterAction(syncpoints_guest[id],guest_action_storage[id],
                          value,std::forward<F>(f));
 }
 template<typename F> ActionHandle RegisterHostAction(u32 id,u32 value,F&& f) {
    return RegisterAction(syncpoints_host[id],host_action_storage[id],
                          value,std::forward<F>(f));
 }
 ActionHandle RegisterAction(std::atomic<u32>&,std::list<RegisteredAction>&,
                             u32,std::function<void()>&&);
 void DeregisterAction(std::list<RegisteredAction>&,const ActionHandle&);
 void DeregisterGuestAction(u32,const ActionHandle&);
 void DeregisterHostAction(u32,const ActionHandle&);
 void IncrementGuest(u32);
 void IncrementHost(u32);
 void Increment(std::atomic<u32>&,std::condition_variable&,
                std::list<RegisteredAction>&);
 void WaitGuest(u32,u32);
 void WaitHost(u32,u32);
 void Wait(std::atomic<u32>&,std::condition_variable&,u32);
};
__NATIVE__
int main(){
 SyncpointManager m;
 std::atomic<unsigned> callbacks{},nested{},independent{};
 // The pinned Increment calls its callback while holding the action mutex.
 // This deterministic negative fails instead of deadlocking.
 m.RegisterGuestAction(1,1,[&]{
    assert(m.guard.try_lock());
    m.guard.unlock();
    m.RegisterGuestAction(4,0,[&]{++nested;});
    ++callbacks;
 });
 m.IncrementGuest(1);
 assert(callbacks==1 && nested==1);
 std::vector<u32> ordered;
 m.RegisterGuestAction(2,3,[&]{ordered.push_back(3);});
 m.RegisterGuestAction(2,1,[&]{ordered.push_back(1);});
 m.RegisterGuestAction(2,2,[&]{ordered.push_back(2);});
 auto removed=m.RegisterGuestAction(2,4,[&]{assert(false);});
 m.IncrementGuest(2);
 m.IncrementGuest(2);
 m.IncrementGuest(2);
 m.DeregisterGuestAction(2,removed);
 m.IncrementGuest(2);
 assert((ordered==std::vector<u32>{1,2,3}));
 // On the async GPU renderer path callback work can block. Claiming the
 // entire ready set under guard permits unrelated Host1x work to progress.
 std::mutex mutex;
 std::condition_variable cv;
 bool entered{},released{};
 std::atomic<unsigned> claimed{},cancelled{},progress{};
 // RegisterAction inserts equal thresholds at the front (LIFO).
 // Register the counted callback first, so the blocker becomes first.
 m.RegisterGuestAction(5,1,[&]{++claimed;});
 m.RegisterGuestAction(5,1,[&]{
    std::unique_lock lk(mutex);
    entered=true;
    cv.notify_all();
    cv.wait(lk,[&]{return released;});
 });
 auto future=m.RegisterGuestAction(5,3,[&]{++cancelled;});
 std::thread pending([&]{m.IncrementGuest(5);});
 {
    std::unique_lock lk(mutex);
    cv.wait(lk,[&]{return entered;});
 }
 // Preserve same-syncpoint order under concurrent IncrementGuest.
 // A second increment must not run its callback before the blocked first.
 std::atomic<unsigned> same_id{};
 m.RegisterGuestAction(5,2,[&]{
    std::lock_guard lk(mutex);
    assert(released);
    ++same_id;
 });
 std::atomic<bool> same_started{};
 std::thread same_increment([&]{
    same_started.store(true,std::memory_order_release);
    m.IncrementGuest(5);
 });
 while(!same_started.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) std::this_thread::yield();
 std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(4));
 assert(m.syncpoints_guest[5].load(std::memory_order_acquire)==1);
 assert(same_id==0);
 // The callback dispatch holds only THIS syncpoint's rendezvous
 // mutex, not the global action-list mutex. A cancellation of a pending
 // entry must wait for the in-flight callback before returning.
 std::atomic<bool> cancel_started{},cancel_finished{};
 std::thread canceller([&]{
    cancel_started.store(true,std::memory_order_release);
    m.DeregisterGuestAction(5,future);
    cancel_finished.store(true,std::memory_order_release);
 });
 while(!cancel_started.load(std::memory_order_acquire))std::this_thread::yield();
 std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(3));
 assert(!cancel_finished.load(std::memory_order_acquire));
 m.RegisterHostAction(7,1,[&]{++independent;});
 m.IncrementHost(7);
 m.WaitHost(7,1);
 assert(independent==1 && claimed==0 && cancelled==0);
 {
    std::lock_guard lk(mutex);
    released=true;
 }
 cv.notify_all();
 pending.join();
 same_increment.join();
 canceller.join();
 assert(cancel_finished.load(std::memory_order_acquire));
 assert(same_id==1);
 m.IncrementGuest(5);
 m.IncrementGuest(5);
 assert(claimed==1 && cancelled==0);
 assert(m.guest_action_storage[5].empty());
 // Queue reclamation must survive repeated claimed callbacks without
 // missing or double triggering frames.
 for(u32 i=1;i<=256;++i){
    m.RegisterGuestAction(9,i,[&]{++progress;});
    m.IncrementGuest(9);
 }
 assert(progress==256);
 std::printf("N04_HOST1X_INCREMENT_HANDOFF_PASS ordered=3 nested=1 "
             "claimed=1 pending_cancelled=1 independent=1 same_id_serial=1 stress=256\n");
}
"""
compiler=shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
assert compiler,"C++20 compiler required"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-host1x-handoff-") as tmp:
```

`tools/check-native-host1x-register-reentrant-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""N04: native Host1x late-ready callback reentrance with historical negative.

Extract real C++ methods from pinned and maintained TUs, compile at -O0/-O2,
and force a syncpoint update between initial and mutex-protected recheck.
This covers only RegisterAction: Increment still holds its action mutex.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PIN=(ROOT/"vendor/sources/eden/src/video_core/host1x/syncpoint_manager.cpp").read_text()
ACT=(ROOT/"vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/video_core/host1x/syncpoint_manager.cpp").read_text()
CM=(ROOT/"headless/CMakeLists.txt").read_text()
FAST=(ROOT/".github/workflows/encore-core-fast-gate.yml").read_text()
FULL=(ROOT/".github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml").read_text()
NAME="python3 -B tools/check-native-host1x-register-reentrant-host.py"
assert NAME in FAST and NAME in FULL
assert "list(REMOVE_ITEM video_sources host1x/syncpoint_manager.cpp)" in CM
assert "list(APPEND video_sources" in CM and "EDEN_MAINTAINED_HOST1X_SYNCPOINT" in CM
old="""    std::scoped_lock lk(guard);
    if (syncpoint.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) >= expected_value) {
        action();
        return {};
    }"""
new="""    std::unique_lock lk(guard);
    if (syncpoint.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) >= expected_value) {
        // The action can register or cancel other Host1x work.
        // Release the shared lock before invoking an already-ready callback.
        lk.unlock();
        action();
        return {};
    }"""
assert PIN.count(old)==ACT.count(new)==1
increment_old="    std::scoped_lock lk(guard);\n    auto it = action_storage.begin();\n    while (it != action_storage.end()) {\n        if (it->expected_value > new_value) {\n            break;\n        }\n        it->action();\n        it = action_storage.erase(it);\n    }\n    wait_cv.notify_all();"
increment_new="    // Claim ready callbacks atomically against deregistration without\n    // allocating or executing arbitrary callbacks under the Host1x guard.\n    std::list<RegisteredAction> ready_actions;\n    {\n        std::scoped_lock lk(guard);\n        auto it = action_storage.begin();\n        while (it != action_storage.end() && it->expected_value <= new_value) {\n            ++it;\n        }\n        ready_actions.splice(ready_actions.end(), action_storage,\n                             action_storage.begin(), it);\n    }\n    // Cancellation can prevent an action only before the claim above.\n    // Execute the already-claimed batch without holding the global guard.\n    for (auto& ready : ready_actions) {\n        ready.action();\n    }\n    // Preserve the original contract: guest/host waiters are notified\n    // only after all due callbacks have completed, never before dispatch.\n    wait_cv.notify_all();"
guest_old="void SyncpointManager::IncrementGuest(u32 syncpoint_id) {\n    Increment(syncpoints_guest[syncpoint_id], wait_guest_cv, guest_action_storage[syncpoint_id]);\n}"
guest_new="void SyncpointManager::IncrementGuest(u32 syncpoint_id) {\n    // The old global guard serialized callbacks for this id. Keep their\n    // submission order without blocking independent guest syncpoints.\n    std::scoped_lock dispatch_lock{GuestDispatchLocks()[syncpoint_id]};\n    Increment(syncpoints_guest[syncpoint_id], wait_guest_cv, guest_action_storage[syncpoint_id]);\n}"
host_old="void SyncpointManager::IncrementHost(u32 syncpoint_id) {\n    Increment(syncpoints_host[syncpoint_id], wait_host_cv, host_action_storage[syncpoint_id]);\n}"
host_new="void SyncpointManager::IncrementHost(u32 syncpoint_id) {\n    std::scoped_lock dispatch_lock{HostDispatchLocks()[syncpoint_id]};\n    Increment(syncpoints_host[syncpoint_id], wait_host_cv, host_action_storage[syncpoint_id]);\n}"
deregister_guest_old="void SyncpointManager::DeregisterGuestAction(u32 syncpoint_id, const ActionHandle& handle) {\n    DeregisterAction(guest_action_storage[syncpoint_id], handle);\n}"
deregister_guest_new="void SyncpointManager::DeregisterGuestAction(u32 syncpoint_id, const ActionHandle& handle) {\n    // Return only after an action already claimed on this id has finished.\n    // nvhost event teardown relies on this rendezvous for callback lifetime.\n    std::scoped_lock dispatch_lock{GuestDispatchLocks()[syncpoint_id]};\n    DeregisterAction(guest_action_storage[syncpoint_id], handle);\n}"
deregister_host_old="void SyncpointManager::DeregisterHostAction(u32 syncpoint_id, const ActionHandle& handle) {\n    DeregisterAction(host_action_storage[syncpoint_id], handle);\n}"
deregister_host_new="void SyncpointManager::DeregisterHostAction(u32 syncpoint_id, const ActionHandle& handle) {\n    std::scoped_lock dispatch_lock{HostDispatchLocks()[syncpoint_id]};\n    DeregisterAction(host_action_storage[syncpoint_id], handle);\n}"
dispatch_helpers="namespace {\n// Each domain/id serializes cancellation against callback completion.\n// Recursive: a running callback may cancel another pending action on its id.\n// The shared action-list guard is never held while a callback executes.\nstd::array<std::recursive_mutex, 192>& GuestDispatchLocks() {\n    static std::array<std::recursive_mutex, 192> locks{};\n    return locks;\n}\n\nstd::array<std::recursive_mutex, 192>& HostDispatchLocks() {\n    static std::array<std::recursive_mutex, 192> locks{};\n    return locks;\n}\n} // namespace\n"
assert PIN.replace("namespace Host1x {\n\n","namespace Host1x {\n\n"+dispatch_helpers+"\n").replace(old,new).replace(increment_old,increment_new).replace(guest_old,guest_new).replace(host_old,host_new).replace(deregister_guest_old,deregister_guest_new).replace(deregister_host_old,deregister_host_new)==ACT

helpers=dispatch_helpers.replace("std::array<std::recursive_mutex, 192>& HostDispatchLocks()", "[[maybe_unused]] std::array<std::recursive_mutex, 192>& HostDispatchLocks()")

def extract(text,name):
    assert text.count(name)==1,name
    start=text.index(name)
    opening=text.index("{",start)
    depth=0
    for i in range(opening,len(text)):
        if text[i]=="{":depth+=1
        elif text[i]=="}":
            depth-=1
            if depth==0:return text[start:i+1]
    raise AssertionError(name)

names=("SyncpointManager::ActionHandle SyncpointManager::RegisterAction(",
       "void SyncpointManager::DeregisterAction(",
       "void SyncpointManager::DeregisterGuestAction(",
       "void SyncpointManager::IncrementGuest(",
       "void SyncpointManager::Increment(")
def methods(src):
    parts=[extract(src,n) for n in names]
    marker="    if (syncpoint.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) >= expected_value) {"
    assert parts[0].count(marker)==1
    parts[0]=parts[0].replace(marker,marker+
        "\n        late_hits.fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_relaxed);")
    return "\n\n".join(parts)

CPP=r"""
#include <array>
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <chrono>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <functional>
#include <list>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>
using u32=std::uint32_t;
static std::atomic<unsigned> late_hits{};
class SyncpointManager {
public:
    struct RegisteredAction {
        u32 expected_value;
        std::function<void()> action;
        RegisteredAction(u32 n,std::function<void()>&& f)
            :expected_value(n),action(std::move(f)){}
    };
    using ActionHandle=std::list<RegisteredAction>::iterator;
    std::array<std::atomic<u32>,192> syncpoints_guest{};
    std::array<std::list<RegisteredAction>,192> guest_action_storage;
    std::mutex guard;
    std::condition_variable wait_guest_cv;
    template<typename F> ActionHandle RegisterGuestAction(u32 id,u32 expected,F&& f){
        return RegisterAction(syncpoints_guest[id],guest_action_storage[id],
                              expected,std::forward<F>(f));
    }
    ActionHandle RegisterAction(std::atomic<u32>&,std::list<RegisteredAction>&,
                                u32,std::function<void()>&&);
    void DeregisterAction(std::list<RegisteredAction>&,const ActionHandle&);
    void DeregisterGuestAction(u32,const ActionHandle&);
    void IncrementGuest(u32);
    void Increment(std::atomic<u32>&,std::condition_variable&,
                   std::list<RegisteredAction>&);
};
__METHODS__
int main(){
    SyncpointManager m;
    std::atomic<unsigned> late{},nested{};
    std::vector<u32> order;
    m.RegisterGuestAction(5,3,[&]{order.push_back(3);});
    m.RegisterGuestAction(5,1,[&]{order.push_back(1);});
    m.RegisterGuestAction(5,2,[&]{order.push_back(2);});
    auto cancelled=m.RegisterGuestAction(6,1,[&]{assert(false);});
    m.DeregisterGuestAction(6,cancelled);
    m.IncrementGuest(6);
    m.IncrementGuest(5);
    m.IncrementGuest(5);
    m.IncrementGuest(5);
    assert((order==std::vector<u32>{1,2,3}));
    for(unsigned k=0;k<24;k++){
        m.syncpoints_guest[0].store(0,std::memory_order_release);
        std::unique_lock hold{m.guard};
        std::atomic<bool> launched{};
        std::thread t([&]{
            launched.store(true,std::memory_order_release);
            m.RegisterGuestAction(0,1,[&]{
                // Pinned late callback fails; maintained unlocks before call.
                assert(m.guard.try_lock());
                m.guard.unlock();
                m.RegisterGuestAction(5,0,[&]{++nested;});
                ++late;
            });
        });
        while(!launched.load(std::memory_order_acquire))std::this_thread::yield();
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(3));
        // Increment publishes atomically before taking this same mutex.
        m.syncpoints_guest[0].store(1,std::memory_order_release);
        hold.unlock();
        t.join();
    }
    assert(late_hits>=1 && late==24 && nested==24);
    assert(m.guest_action_storage[0].empty());
    std::printf("N04_HOST1X_REENTRANT_LATE_PASS slow=%u callback=%u nested=%u\n",
                late_hits.load(),late.load(),nested.load());
}
"""
compiler=shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
assert compiler,"Host C++20 compiler required"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-host1x-") as tmp:
    for name,code,mode in (("current_O0",methods(ACT),"-O0"),
                           ("current_O2",methods(ACT),"-O2"),
                           ("pinned_negative",methods(PIN),"-O0")):
        source=Path(tmp)/(name+".cpp")
        exe=Path(tmp)/name
        source.write_text(CPP.replace("__METHODS__", (helpers if name!="pinned_negative" else "") + "\n" + code))
        built=subprocess.run([compiler,"-std=c++20",mode,"-Wall","-Wextra",
                              "-Werror","-pthread","-fsanitize=undefined",
                              "-fno-sanitize-recover=all",str(source),"-o",str(exe)],
                             capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=65)
        assert built.returncode==0,(name,built.stderr[-3000:])
        out=subprocess.run([str(exe)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=17)
        if name=="pinned_negative":
            assert out.returncode!=0 and "m.guard.try_lock()" in out.stderr,(name,out.stderr[-1200:])
            print("N04_HOST1X_PINNED_NEGATIVE_PASS guarded_callback_rejected")
        else:
            assert out.returncode==0,(name,out.stdout,out.stderr[-1500:])
            print(out.stdout.strip(),name)
print("N04_HOST1X_INCREMENT_CALLBACK_GUARD_UNCHANGED no_end_to_end_certification")
```

`tools/check-native-index-draw-dirty-span-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compile maintained Maxwell draw manager methods: dynamic index spans re-arm dirty."""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
native_path = "vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/video_core/engines/draw_manager.cpp"
pinned_path = "vendor/sources/eden/src/video_core/engines/draw_manager.cpp"
native = (root / native_path).read_text()
pinned = (root / pinned_path).read_text()
cmake = (root / "headless/CMakeLists.txt").read_text()
assert 'list(REMOVE_ITEM video_sources engines/draw_manager.cpp)' in cmake
assert 'list(APPEND video_sources "${EDEN_MAINTAINED_DRAW_MANAGER}")' in cmake
assert native_path in cmake

methods = (
    ("DrawIndex", "DrawArrayIndirect"),
    ("DrawIndexedIndirect", "SetInlineIndexBuffer"),
    ("DrawEnd", "DrawIndexSmall"),
)
def extract(text, method, next_method):
    start = "void Maxwell3D::DrawManager::" + method + "("
    end = "void Maxwell3D::DrawManager::" + next_method + "("
    assert text.count(start) == 1
    i = text.index(start)
    j = text.index(end, i + len(start))
    return text[i:j].rstrip()

# No other upstream draw manager logic is changed.
expected = pinned
for method, next_method in methods:
    old = extract(pinned, method, next_method)
    new = extract(native, method, next_method)
    assert new.count("changed_index_span") >= 2
    # DrawEnd already has the independent, always-dirty inline-index case.
    expected_dirty_marks = 2 if method == "DrawEnd" else 1
    assert new.count("maxwell3d.dirty.flags[VideoCommon::Dirty::IndexBuffer] = true;") == expected_dirty_marks
    expected = expected.replace(old, new)
assert expected == native, "Unexpected change outside the three reviewed draw entrypoints"

program = r"""
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>
using u32 = std::uint32_t;
namespace VideoCommon { namespace Dirty { constexpr size_t IndexBuffer = 0; } }
struct Maxwell3D {
    struct Regs {
        enum class PrimitiveTopology { Triangles };
        enum class IndexFormat { UnsignedInt };
        struct IndexBuffer { u32 first{}, count{}; IndexFormat format{}; };
        struct VertexBuffer { u32 count{}; };
        IndexBuffer index_buffer{};
        VertexBuffer vertex_buffer{};
        u32 global_base_instance_index{}, global_base_vertex_index{};
    } regs{};
    struct { std::array<bool, 1> flags{false}; } dirty{};
    struct DrawManager {
        enum class DrawMode { General, Instance, InlineIndex };
        struct State {
            Regs::PrimitiveTopology topology{};
            Regs::IndexBuffer index_buffer{};
            Regs::VertexBuffer vertex_buffer{};
            DrawMode draw_mode{DrawMode::General};
            bool draw_indexed{};
            u32 base_index{}, base_instance{};
            std::vector<std::uint8_t> inline_index_draw_indexes{};
        } draw_state{};
        unsigned new_index_bindings{}, executed_draws{}, executed_indirect{};
        void ProcessDraw(Maxwell3D& m, bool indexed, u32) {
            ++executed_draws;
            if (indexed && m.dirty.flags[VideoCommon::Dirty::IndexBuffer]) {
                ++new_index_bindings;
                m.dirty.flags[VideoCommon::Dirty::IndexBuffer] = false;
            }
        }
        void ProcessDrawIndirect(Maxwell3D& m) {
            ++executed_indirect;
            if (m.dirty.flags[VideoCommon::Dirty::IndexBuffer]) {
                ++new_index_bindings;
                m.dirty.flags[VideoCommon::Dirty::IndexBuffer] = false;
            }
        }
        void DrawIndex(Maxwell3D&, Regs::PrimitiveTopology, u32,u32,u32,u32,u32);
        void DrawIndexedIndirect(Maxwell3D&, Regs::PrimitiveTopology, u32,u32);
        void DrawEnd(Maxwell3D&, u32,bool);
    };
};
""" + "\n\n".join(extract(native, method, next_method) for method, next_method in methods) + r"""
int main() {
    Maxwell3D m{};
    Maxwell3D::DrawManager d{};
    using Topology = Maxwell3D::Regs::PrimitiveTopology;
    m.regs.index_buffer.count = 8;
    d.DrawIndex(m, Topology::Triangles, 0, 8, 0, 0, 1);
    assert(d.new_index_bindings == 1);
    d.DrawIndex(m, Topology::Triangles, 0, 8, 0, 0, 1);
    assert(d.new_index_bindings == 1); // same range: no unnecessary cache refresh
    d.DrawIndex(m, Topology::Triangles, 24, 48, 0, 0, 1);
    assert(d.new_index_bindings == 2);
    d.DrawIndexedIndirect(m, Topology::Triangles, 24, 48);
    assert(d.new_index_bindings == 2);
    d.DrawIndexedIndirect(m, Topology::Triangles, 32, 48);
    assert(d.new_index_bindings == 3);
    // Return from a macro draw to the register-owned general draw.
    d.draw_state.draw_mode = Maxwell3D::DrawManager::DrawMode::General;
    d.draw_state.draw_indexed = true;
    d.DrawEnd(m, 1, true);
    assert(d.new_index_bindings == 4);
    d.draw_state.draw_indexed = true;
    d.DrawEnd(m, 1, true);
    assert(d.new_index_bindings == 4);
    // The preexisting dirty register from a regular register write survives.
    m.dirty.flags[VideoCommon::Dirty::IndexBuffer] = true;
    d.DrawIndex(m, Topology::Triangles, 0, 8, 0, 0, 1);
    assert(d.new_index_bindings == 5);
    // Inline indices continue to set their own forced dirty bit.
    d.draw_state.draw_mode = Maxwell3D::DrawManager::DrawMode::InlineIndex;
    d.draw_state.inline_index_draw_indexes = {1, 2, 3, 4};
    d.DrawEnd(m, 1, true);
    assert(d.new_index_bindings == 6);
    assert(d.draw_state.inline_index_draw_indexes.empty());
}
"""
compiler = shutil.which("c++") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
assert compiler
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-draw-dirty-") as tmp:
    source = Path(tmp) / "draw.cpp"

    for opt in ("-O0", "-O2"):

                        "-fsanitize=undefined", "-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
                        str(source), "-o", str(out)], check=True, timeout=45)
        subprocess.run([str(out)], check=True, timeout=20)
        print("INDEX_DRAW_DIRTY_SPAN_PASS", opt)
```

`tools/check-native-indirect-draw-range-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Reject zero or truncated indirect-draw byte spans in the selected native GPU cache."""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
active = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/video_core/buffer_cache/buffer_cache.h").read_text()
backport = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-backports/src/video_core/buffer_cache/buffer_cache.h").read_text()
start = "template <class P>\nvoid BufferCache<P>::UpdateDrawIndirect() {"
end = "\ntemplate <class P>"
def method(text):
    assert text.count(start) == 1
    i = text.index(start)
    return text[i:text.index(end, i + len(start))]
native = method(active)
legacy = method(backport)
assert "if (size == 0 || size > static_cast<size_t>(~u32{0}))" in native
assert "if (size == 0 || size > static_cast<size_t>(~u32{0}))" not in legacy
assert native.index("if (size == 0") < native.index("GpuToCpuAddress(gpu_addr)")
assert native.count("binding = NULL_BINDING;") == 2

cpp = r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>
#include <optional>
using u32 = std::uint32_t;
using u64 = std::uint64_t;
using GPUVAddr = u64;
using DAddr = u64;
using BufferId = u32;
struct Binding { DAddr device_addr{}; u32 size{}; BufferId buffer_id{}; };
inline constexpr Binding NULL_BINDING{};
struct DrawIndirect {
    bool include_count{};
    GPUVAddr count_start_address{0x1000};
    GPUVAddr indirect_start_address{0x2000};
    size_t buffer_size{64};
};
struct Memory {
    bool mapped{true};
    unsigned translations{};
    std::optional<DAddr> GpuToCpuAddress(GPUVAddr addr) {
        ++translations;
        return mapped ? std::optional<DAddr>(addr + 0x10000) : std::nullopt;
    }
};
struct State {
    Binding count_buffer_binding{};
    Binding indirect_buffer_binding{};
};
template<class P> struct BufferCache {
    DrawIndirect* current_draw_indirect{};
    Memory* gpu_memory{};
    State* channel_state{};
    unsigned finds{};
    BufferId FindBuffer(DAddr, u32 size, bool) {
        assert(size != 0);
        ++finds;
        return 17;
    }
    void UpdateDrawIndirect();
};
""" + native + r"""
int main() {
    static_assert(sizeof(size_t) >= 8);
    DrawIndirect d{};
    Memory m{};
    State s{};
    BufferCache<void> c{&d,&m,&s};
    d.include_count = true;
    c.UpdateDrawIndirect();
    assert(c.finds == 2 && m.translations == 2);
    assert(s.count_buffer_binding.size == 4 && s.indirect_buffer_binding.size == 64);
    // A zero-byte subsequent command cannot retain the old indirect buffer.
    d.include_count = false;
    d.buffer_size = 0;
    c.UpdateDrawIndirect();
    assert(c.finds == 2 && m.translations == 2);
    assert(s.indirect_buffer_binding.size == 0);
    // A 4 GiB range used to wrap to zero at the u32 FindBuffer boundary.
    d.buffer_size = static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<u32>::max()) + 1;
    s.indirect_buffer_binding = Binding{.device_addr=1,.size=42,.buffer_id=17};
    c.UpdateDrawIndirect();
    assert(c.finds == 2 && m.translations == 2);
    assert(s.indirect_buffer_binding.size == 0 && s.indirect_buffer_binding.buffer_id == 0);
    // The largest representable nonzero range must retain the existing path.
    d.buffer_size = std::numeric_limits<u32>::max();
    c.UpdateDrawIndirect();
    assert(c.finds == 3 && s.indirect_buffer_binding.size == d.buffer_size);
    // Unmapped GPU memory still clears a previously live binding.
    m.mapped = false;
    d.buffer_size = 64;
    c.UpdateDrawIndirect();
    assert(c.finds == 3 && s.indirect_buffer_binding.size == 0);
    // Also reject size_t's maximum before GPU address translation.
    unsigned previous_translations = m.translations;
    d.buffer_size = std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max();
    c.UpdateDrawIndirect();
    assert(m.translations == previous_translations && c.finds == 3);
}
"""
compiler = shutil.which("c++") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
assert compiler, "C++ compiler required"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-indirect-range-") as tmp:
    source = Path(tmp) / "indirect.cpp"
    source.write_text(cpp)
    for opt in ("-O0", "-O2"):
        binary = Path(tmp) / ("indirect" + opt)
        subprocess.run([compiler, "-std=c++20", opt, "-Wall", "-Wextra",
                        "-Werror", "-fsanitize=undefined",
                        "-fno-sanitize-recover=all", str(source), "-o",
                        str(binary)], check=True, timeout=45)
        subprocess.run([str(binary)], check=True, timeout=20)
        print("NATIVE_INDIRECT_DRAW_RANGE_PASS", opt)
```

`tools/check-native-indirect-null-binding-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Native indirect-draw null sentinel: compile real cache binding/getter bodies."""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
cache = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/video_core/buffer_cache/buffer_cache.h").read_text()
raster = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_rasterizer.cpp").read_text()
legacy = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-backports/src/video_core/buffer_cache/buffer_cache.h").read_text()

def method(source, signature, end="\ntemplate <class P>"):
    at = source.index(signature)
    assert source.count(signature) == 1
    tail = source.find(end, at+len(signature))
    if tail < 0:
        # GetDrawIndirectBuffer is the final method before the namespace close.
        tail = source.index("\n} // namespace VideoCommon", at)
    return source[at:tail].rstrip()

names = [
    "void BufferCache<P>::BindHostDrawIndirectBuffers() {",
    "std::pair<typename BufferCache<P>::Buffer*, u32> BufferCache<P>::GetDrawIndirectCount() {",
    "std::pair<typename BufferCache<P>::Buffer*, u32> BufferCache<P>::GetDrawIndirectBuffer() {"
]
sections = [method(cache, name) for name in names]
assert all("NULL_BUFFER_ID || binding.size == 0" in sec for sec in sections)
assert all("NULL_BUFFER_ID || binding.size == 0" not in method(legacy, name)
           for sec, name in zip(sections, names))
draw = method(raster, "void RasterizerVulkan::DrawIndirect() {", "\nvoid RasterizerVulkan::DrawTexture()")
assert draw.index("if (!buffer)") < draw.index("buffer->Handle()")
assert draw.index("if (!draw_buffer)") < draw.index("draw_buffer->Handle()")
assert draw.count("if (!buffer)") == draw.count("if (!draw_buffer)") == 1
assert "buffer_cache.SetDrawIndirect(nullptr);" in draw
# Both native OpenGL profiles also use this shared BufferCache getter.
for profile in ("gl_rasterizer.cpp", "gl_rasterizer_dev.cpp"):
    gl = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/video_core/renderer_opengl" / profile).read_text()
    gl_draw = method(gl, "void RasterizerOpenGL::DrawIndirect() {", "\nvoid RasterizerOpenGL::DrawTexture()")
    assert gl_draw.index("if (!buffer)") < gl_draw.index("buffer->Handle()"), profile
    assert gl_draw.index("if (!draw_buffer)") < gl_draw.index("draw_buffer->Handle()"), profile

# Disabled post-store experiment must not reintroduce a null Vulkan submit.
deferred = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-core/guest-bridge/vulkan_rasterizer.cpp").read_text()
guest_draw = method(deferred, "void RasterizerVulkan::DrawIndirect() {", "\nvoid RasterizerVulkan::DrawTexture()")
# The native command worker checks the pipeline bound by ConfigureDraw;
# the disabled guest-bridge keeps its original CanExecuteDraw accessor.
# Only that intentional three-call accessor difference is permitted.
assert draw.count("CanExecuteRecordedDraw()") == 3
assert guest_draw.count("CanExecuteDraw()") == 3
# P2.4 introduces an additional *fail-closed* mesh indirect ABI guard.
# Replay that single exact addition before checking legacy null bindings;
# a data-format mismatch may never be submitted as an indexed draw.
native_indirect_mesh_guard = "        // A native mesh indirect command has a different buffer ABI.\n        // Reject it explicitly; invoking legacy DrawIndirect would use the\n        // wrong command format and could corrupt the render stream.\n        if (mesh_draw) {\n            ::Eden::Performance::RecordGraphicsDrawDrop(\n                ::Eden::Performance::GraphicsDrawDrop::ConfigureRejected);\n            LOG_ERROR(Render_Vulkan, \"Task/Mesh indirect draw unsupported\");\n            return;\n        }\n"
assert draw.count(native_indirect_mesh_guard) == 1
assert draw.index("if (mesh_draw)") < draw.index("GetDrawIndirectBuffer()")
without_mesh_guard = draw.replace(native_indirect_mesh_guard, "")
assert guest_draw.replace("CanExecuteDraw()", "CanExecuteRecordedDraw()") == without_mesh_guard


code = r"""
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <utility>
using u32 = std::uint32_t;
using DAddr = std::uint64_t;
using BufferId = u32;
constexpr BufferId NULL_BUFFER_ID = 0;
struct Binding { DAddr device_addr{}; u32 size{}; BufferId buffer_id{}; };
struct State { Binding count_buffer_binding{}; Binding indirect_buffer_binding{}; };
struct Indirect { bool include_count{}; };
template <class P> struct BufferCache {
    struct Buffer {
        u32 Offset(DAddr addr) { return static_cast<u32>(addr-100); }
    };
    std::array<Buffer,3> slot_buffers{};
    State* channel_state{};
    Indirect* current_draw_indirect{};
    unsigned touches{}, syncs{};
    void TouchBuffer(Buffer&, BufferId id) { assert(id); ++touches; }
    void SynchronizeBuffer(Buffer&, DAddr, u32 bytes) {
        assert(bytes); ++syncs;
    }
    void BindHostDrawIndirectBuffers();
    std::pair<Buffer*,u32> GetDrawIndirectCount();
    std::pair<Buffer*,u32> GetDrawIndirectBuffer();
};
""" + "\n\n".join("template <class P>\n"+s for s in sections) + r"""
int main() {
    State state{};
    Indirect params{};
    BufferCache<void> cache{};
    cache.channel_state = &state;
    cache.current_draw_indirect = &params;
    // Null sentinel must never be synchronized or used as a command buffer.
    auto empty = cache.GetDrawIndirectBuffer();
    assert(empty.first == nullptr && empty.second == 0);
    assert(cache.GetDrawIndirectCount().first == nullptr);
    params.include_count = true;
    cache.BindHostDrawIndirectBuffers();
    assert(cache.syncs == 0 && cache.touches == 0);
    // A real mapped indirect command is still synchronized and offset.
    state.indirect_buffer_binding = {112,64,1};
    assert(cache.GetDrawIndirectBuffer().first == &cache.slot_buffers[1]);
    assert(cache.GetDrawIndirectBuffer().second == 12);
    cache.BindHostDrawIndirectBuffers();
    assert(cache.syncs == 1 && cache.touches == 1);
    // Missing count buffer must not borrow the normal indirect buffer.
    assert(cache.GetDrawIndirectCount().first == nullptr);
    state.count_buffer_binding = {124,4,2};
    assert(cache.GetDrawIndirectCount().first == &cache.slot_buffers[2]);
    cache.BindHostDrawIndirectBuffers();
    assert(cache.syncs == 3 && cache.touches == 3);
    state.indirect_buffer_binding.size = 0;
    assert(cache.GetDrawIndirectBuffer().first == nullptr);
    cache.BindHostDrawIndirectBuffers();
    assert(cache.syncs == 4 && cache.touches == 4);
    // A non-count draw touches only the live indirect binding.
    state.indirect_buffer_binding = {112,64,1};
    params.include_count = false;
    cache.BindHostDrawIndirectBuffers();
    assert(cache.syncs == 5 && cache.touches == 5);
}
"""
compiler = shutil.which("c++") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
assert compiler, "C++ compiler required"
```
