`tools/check-native-ipc-wake-chain-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Real-source host witness for IPC enqueue and kernel wait-queue completion.

Extracts the current KServerSession::OnRequest and KThreadQueue::EndWait /
CancelWait definitions, compiles them as C++20 under ASan/UBSan, and tests
error, synchronous, asynchronous and timer paths. This is NOT an emulated
guest CPU run, a native console build, or proof that FC27 freezes are fixed.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SERVER = (ROOT / "vendor/sources/eden/src/core/hle/kernel/k_server_session.cpp").read_text()
CLIENT = (ROOT / "vendor/sources/eden/src/core/hle/kernel/k_client_session.cpp").read_text()
QUEUE = (ROOT / "vendor/sources/eden/src/core/hle/kernel/k_thread_queue.cpp").read_text()
FAST = (ROOT / ".github/workflows/encore-core-fast-gate.yml").read_text()
FULL = (ROOT / ".github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml").read_text()
INVOCATION = "python3 -B tools/check-native-ipc-wake-chain-host.py"
assert INVOCATION in FAST and INVOCATION in FULL

def extract(text: str, signature: str) -> str:
    marker = signature + " {"
    assert text.count(marker) == 1, (signature, "source drift")
    start = text.index(marker)
    brace = start + len(signature) + 1
    depth = 0
    for pos in range(brace, len(text)):
        if text[pos] == "{":
            depth += 1
        elif text[pos] == "}":
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0:
                return text[start:pos + 1]
    raise AssertionError("unbalanced extracted function " + signature)

server = extract(SERVER, "Result KServerSession::OnRequest(KernelCore& kernel, KSessionRequest* request)")
end = extract(QUEUE, "void KThreadQueue::EndWait(KernelCore& kernel, KThread* waiting_thread, Result wait_result)")
cancel = extract(QUEUE, "void KThreadQueue::CancelWait(KernelCore& kernel, KThread* waiting_thread, Result wait_result, bool cancel_timer_task)")
# These are source/edge invariants; the C++ fixture exercises the real bodies
# in addition to asserting that client-side request ownership is preserved.
sync = extract(CLIENT, "Result KClientSession::SendSyncRequest(KernelCore& kernel, uintptr_t address, size_t size)")
async_req = extract(CLIENT, "Result KClientSession::SendAsyncRequest(KernelCore& kernel, KEvent* event, uintptr_t address, size_t size)")
for src in (sync, async_req):
    assert src.index("request->Initialize(") < src.index("m_parent->OnRequest(kernel, request)")
    assert "request->Close(kernel)" in src and "KSessionRequest::Create(kernel)" in src
assert "request->Initialize(kernel, nullptr, address, size)" in sync
assert "request->Initialize(kernel, event, address, size)" in async_req
assert server.index("request->Open(kernel)") < server.index("m_request_list.push_back(*request)")
assert server.index("this->NotifyAvailable(kernel)") < server.index("GetCurrentThread(kernel).BeginWait")
assert end.index("SetWaitResult(") < end.index("SetState(") < end.index("ClearWaitQueue()")
assert cancel.index("SetWaitResult(") < cancel.index("SetState(") < cancel.index("ClearWaitQueue()")

CPP = r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <memory>
#include <string>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>
using std::string;
using std::vector;
enum Result {
    ResultSuccess=0, ResultSessionClosed=1,
    ResultTerminationRequested=2, ResultTimedOut=3,
    ResultInvalidState=4, ResultCancelled=5
};
#define R_UNLESS(test, err) do { if (!(test)) return err; } while (false)
#define R_SUCCEED_IF(test) do { if (test) return ResultSuccess; } while (false)
struct KThread;
struct KernelCore {
    KThread* thread{};
    int lock_depth{};
    vector<string> trace;
};
struct KScopedSchedulerLock {
    KernelCore& kernel;
    explicit KScopedSchedulerLock(KernelCore& k):kernel(k){++kernel.lock_depth;}
    ~KScopedSchedulerLock(){--kernel.lock_depth;}
};
struct KHardwareTimer {
    KernelCore& kernel;
    unsigned calls{};
    void CancelTask(KThread*) {++calls;kernel.trace.push_back("cancel_timer");}
};
enum class ThreadState {Waiting, Runnable};
enum class ThreadWaitReasonForDebugging { IPC };
struct KThreadQueue;
struct KThread {
    KernelCore& kernel;
    bool terminating{};
    bool wait_queue_active{};
    ThreadState state=ThreadState::Waiting;
    Result wait_result=ResultTimedOut;
    Result desired_result=ResultSuccess;
    unsigned begin_count{};
    explicit KThread(KernelCore& k):kernel(k){k.thread=this;}
    bool IsTerminationRequested() const { return terminating; }
    void SetWaitReasonForDebugging(ThreadWaitReasonForDebugging) {
        kernel.trace.push_back("reason");
    }
    void BeginWait(KernelCore&, KThreadQueue*);
    void SetWaitResult(Result r) { wait_result=r; kernel.trace.push_back("result"); }
    void SetState(KernelCore&, ThreadState s) {
        assert(kernel.lock_depth>0);
        state=s;
        kernel.trace.push_back("runnable");
    }
    void ClearWaitQueue() {wait_queue_active=false;kernel.trace.push_back("clear");}
    Result GetWaitResult() const {return wait_result;}
};
struct KThreadQueue {
    KHardwareTimer* m_hardware_timer{};
    explicit KThreadQueue(KernelCore&) {}
    void EndWait(KernelCore&, KThread*, Result);
    void CancelWait(KernelCore&, KThread*, Result, bool);
};
using ThreadQueueImplForKServerSessionRequest = KThreadQueue;
void KThread::BeginWait(KernelCore& k, KThreadQueue* queue) {
    assert(k.lock_depth>0);
    wait_queue_active=true;
    ++begin_count;
    k.trace.push_back("begin_wait");
    // Synchronous completion double, NOT a guest scheduler or fiber.
    queue->EndWait(k, this, desired_result);
}
struct KSessionRequest {
    KernelCore& kernel;
    bool has_event{};
    unsigned opens{};
    explicit KSessionRequest(KernelCore& k, bool event=false):kernel(k),has_event(event){}
    void* GetEvent() const {return has_event?reinterpret_cast<void*>(1):nullptr;}
    void Open(KernelCore& k) {assert(&k==&kernel);++opens;k.trace.push_back("open");}
};
struct KSessionParent {
    bool server_closed{};
    bool IsServerClosed() const {return server_closed;}
};
struct RequestList {
    KernelCore& kernel;
    vector<KSessionRequest*> elements;
    explicit RequestList(KernelCore& k):kernel(k){}
    bool empty() const {return elements.empty();}
    void push_back(KSessionRequest& req) {
        elements.push_back(&req);
        kernel.trace.push_back("push");
    }
};
struct KServerSession {
    KernelCore& owner;
    KSessionParent* m_parent{};
    RequestList m_request_list;
    unsigned notifications{};
    explicit KServerSession(KernelCore& k,KSessionParent& p):
        owner(k),m_parent(&p),m_request_list(k){}
    void NotifyAvailable(KernelCore& k) {
        assert(k.lock_depth>0);
        ++notifications;
        k.trace.push_back("notify");
    }
    Result OnRequest(KernelCore&, KSessionRequest*);
};
KThread& GetCurrentThread(KernelCore& k) {
    assert(k.thread);
    return *k.thread;
}
INJECT
static void check_trace(const KernelCore& k, const vector<string>& expected) {
    assert(k.trace==expected);
    assert(k.lock_depth==0);
}
int main() {
    unsigned checks=0;
    for(int iter=0;iter<24;++iter) {
      {
        KernelCore k; KThread thread(k); KSessionParent parent;
        KServerSession server(k,parent); KSessionRequest req(k);
        thread.desired_result=ResultCancelled;
        const Result result=server.OnRequest(k,&req);
        assert(result==ResultCancelled && thread.begin_count==1);
        assert(thread.state==ThreadState::Runnable && !thread.wait_queue_active);
        assert(server.notifications==1 && req.opens==1);
        assert(server.m_request_list.elements.size()==1);
        check_trace(k,{"open","push","notify","reason","begin_wait","result","runnable","clear"});
        ++checks;
      }
      {
        KernelCore k;KThread thread(k);KSessionParent parent;
        KServerSession server(k,parent);KSessionRequest req(k,true);
        assert(server.OnRequest(k,&req)==ResultSuccess);
        assert(thread.begin_count==0 && server.notifications==1 && req.opens==1);
        check_trace(k,{"open","push","notify"});
        ++checks;
      }
      {
        KernelCore k;KThread thread(k);KSessionParent parent;
        KServerSession server(k,parent);
        KSessionRequest first(k,true),second(k,true);
        assert(server.OnRequest(k,&first)==ResultSuccess);
        k.trace.clear();
        assert(server.OnRequest(k,&second)==ResultSuccess);
        assert(server.notifications==1 && second.opens==1);
        check_trace(k,{"open","push"});
        ++checks;
      }
      {
        KernelCore k;KThread thread(k);KSessionParent parent;
        parent.server_closed=true;
        KServerSession server(k,parent);KSessionRequest req(k);
        assert(server.OnRequest(k,&req)==ResultSessionClosed);
        assert(req.opens==0 && server.notifications==0 && thread.begin_count==0);
        check_trace(k,{});
        ++checks;
      }
      {
        KernelCore k;KThread thread(k);KSessionParent parent;
        thread.terminating=true;
        KServerSession server(k,parent);KSessionRequest req(k);
        assert(server.OnRequest(k,&req)==ResultTerminationRequested);
        assert(req.opens==0 && server.notifications==0 && thread.begin_count==0);
        check_trace(k,{});
        ++checks;
      }
      {
        KernelCore k;KThread thread(k);KThreadQueue queue(k);
        KHardwareTimer timer{k};queue.m_hardware_timer=&timer;
        KScopedSchedulerLock lock(k);
        thread.wait_queue_active=true;
        queue.EndWait(k,&thread,ResultSuccess);
        assert(thread.wait_result==ResultSuccess && !thread.wait_queue_active);
        assert(timer.calls==1 && thread.state==ThreadState::Runnable);
        assert(k.trace==(vector<string>{"result","runnable","clear","cancel_timer"}));
        ++checks;
      }
      for(bool cancel_task: {false,true}) {
        KernelCore k;KThread thread(k);KThreadQueue queue(k);
        KHardwareTimer timer{k};queue.m_hardware_timer=&timer;
        {
            KScopedSchedulerLock lock(k);
            thread.wait_queue_active=true;
            queue.CancelWait(k,&thread,ResultCancelled,cancel_task);
        }
        assert(thread.wait_result==ResultCancelled && !thread.wait_queue_active);
        assert(timer.calls==static_cast<unsigned>(cancel_task));
        assert(k.trace==(cancel_task?
           vector<string>{"result","runnable","clear","cancel_timer"}:
           vector<string>{"result","runnable","clear"}));
        ++checks;
      }
    }
    assert(checks==192);
    std::printf("ENCORE_IPC_WAKE_CHAIN_HOST_PASS cases=%u\n", checks);
}
"""
```

```py
"""C++20 ASan/UBSan check for real maintained JIT RX/RW alias lookups."""
```

```py
"""Source-selected C++ regression: JIT invalidation retires cross-page aliases."""
from pathlib import Path

import subprocess

#include <unordered_map>

    u64 value{};
    bool operator==(const LocationDescriptor& rhs) const {return value==rhs.value;}
};
}
namespace std {
template<> struct hash<Dynarmic::IR::LocationDescriptor> {
    size_t operator()(const Dynarmic::IR::LocationDescriptor& x) const noexcept {
        return hash<u64>{}(x.value);
    }
};
}
namespace Common {
template<class K,class V>using unordered_map=std::unordered_map<K,V>;
template<class K>using unordered_set=std::unordered_set<K>;
}
namespace Dynarmic::Backend {
template<class P> class BlockRangeInformation {
public:
    void AddRange(boost::icl::discrete_interval<P>,IR::LocationDescriptor);
    void ClearCache();
    ::Common::unordered_set<IR::LocationDescriptor>
        InvalidateRanges(const boost::icl::interval_set<P>&);
    size_t BucketSize(P page) const {
        const auto it=pages.find(page);
        return it==pages.end()?0:it->second.size();
    }
private:
    struct Entry { P first,last; IR::LocationDescriptor location; };
    static constexpr unsigned page_bits=12;
    ::Common::unordered_map<P,std::vector<Entry>> pages;
};
__ACTUAL_METHODS__
}
using Dynarmic::Backend::BlockRangeInformation;
using Dynarmic::IR::LocationDescriptor;
template<class P>
static boost::icl::interval_set<P> Range(P first,P last){
    boost::icl::interval_set<P> set;
    set.add(boost::icl::discrete_interval<P>::closed(first,last));
    return set;
}
int main() {
    BlockRangeInformation<u64> c;
    const LocationDescriptor a{17},b{23},s{29};
    c.AddRange(boost::icl::discrete_interval<u64>::closed(0x1ff0,0x2040),a);
    c.AddRange(boost::icl::discrete_interval<u64>::closed(0x2080,0x20ff),b);
    assert(c.BucketSize(1)==1 && c.BucketSize(2)==2);
    const auto old=c.InvalidateRanges(Range<u64>(0x1ff0,0x1fff));
    assert(old.size()==1 && old.contains(a));
    // In the old implementation page 2 still owned descriptor 'a'.
    assert(c.BucketSize(1)==0 && c.BucketSize(2)==1);
    c.AddRange(boost::icl::discrete_interval<u64>::closed(0x1000,0x107f),a);
    const auto stale=c.InvalidateRanges(Range<u64>(0x2010,0x2030));
    assert(stale.empty());
    assert(c.BucketSize(1)==1 && c.BucketSize(2)==1);
    const auto real=c.InvalidateRanges(Range<u64>(0x2080,0x2090));
    assert(real.size()==1 && real.contains(b));
    assert(c.BucketSize(2)==0);
    c.AddRange(boost::icl::discrete_interval<u64>::closed(0x2ff0,0x4010),s);
    assert(c.BucketSize(2)==1 && c.BucketSize(3)==1 && c.BucketSize(4)==1);
    auto overlap=Range<u64>(0x2ff0,0x3000);
    overlap.add(boost::icl::discrete_interval<u64>::closed(0x3008,0x300c));

    assert(hits.size()==1 && hits.contains(s));
    assert(c.BucketSize(2)==0 && c.BucketSize(3)==0 && c.BucketSize(4)==0);
    c.ClearCache();
    assert(c.BucketSize(1)==0 && c.BucketSize(2)==0);
```

```py
 assert(code.commits==2);
```

```py
"""F02: execute real pinned/Encore JIT lookup + invalidation C++ bodies.

A32 and default A64: cold blocks, repeated hits, partial invalidation,
recompilation, and full cache reset. Translators, code emitters and their

        "vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/dynarmic/backend/x64/a32_interface_native.cpp"),
 "A64":("vendor/sources/eden/src/dynarmic/src/dynarmic/backend/x64/a64_interface.cpp",
        "vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/dynarmic/backend/x64/a64_interface_standard.cpp"),

def extract(source,begin):
    assert source.count(begin)==1,begin
    a=source.index(begin)
    open_brace=source.index("{",a)
    depth=0
    for i in range(open_brace,len(source)):
        if source[i]=="{":depth+=1
        elif source[i]=="}":
            depth-=1
            if depth==0:return source[a:i+1]
    raise AssertionError(begin)

TEMPLATE=r"""
#include <array>
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <chrono>

#include <cstdint>

// for the same absent optional hook contract; never fabricate the callback.

#define ENCORE_HOST_WEAK __attribute__((weak_import))
#else
#define ENCORE_HOST_WEAK __attribute__((weak))
#endif
extern "C" void eden_jit_block(unsigned,unsigned long long,const void*,unsigned long long)
    ENCORE_HOST_WEAK;
extern "C" bool eden_native_detailed_logging() noexcept ENCORE_HOST_WEAK;
extern "C" void eden_jit_evacuation(unsigned) ENCORE_HOST_WEAK;
enum class HaltReason {None,CacheInvalidation};
bool Has(HaltReason a,HaltReason b){return a==b;}
namespace boost::icl {
template<class T> struct discrete_interval {
    T lo{},hi{};
    static discrete_interval closed(T a,T b){return {a,b};}
};
template<class T> struct interval_set {
    std::vector<discrete_interval<T>> spans;
    void add(discrete_interval<T> s){spans.push_back(s);}
    bool empty()const{return spans.empty();}
    void clear(){spans.clear();}
    void swap(interval_set& s){spans.swap(s.spans);}
};
}
namespace IR {
struct LocationDescriptor {
    u64 value{};
    explicit LocationDescriptor(u64 n=0):value(n){}
    u64 Value()const{return value;}
    bool operator<(const LocationDescriptor& rhs)const{return value<rhs.value;}
};
struct Block {
    u64 key{};
    template<class Loc> void Reset(Loc d){key=d.Value();}
};
}
namespace A32 {
struct LocationDescriptor:IR::LocationDescriptor {
    using IR::LocationDescriptor::LocationDescriptor;
    LocationDescriptor(IR::LocationDescriptor loc):IR::LocationDescriptor(loc){}

struct TranslateFlags {int arch_version{};bool unpredictable{},hints{};};
template<class Callback>
void Translate(IR::Block& block, LocationDescriptor d,Callback*,TranslateFlags){
    assert(block.key==d.Value());
}
}
namespace A64 {
struct LocationDescriptor:IR::LocationDescriptor {
    using IR::LocationDescriptor::LocationDescriptor;
    LocationDescriptor(IR::LocationDescriptor loc):IR::LocationDescriptor(loc){}
};
struct TranslateFlags {bool unpredictable{},wall_clock{};};
template<class GetCode>
void Translate(IR::Block& block, LocationDescriptor d,GetCode code,TranslateFlags){
    assert(block.key==d.Value());
    assert(code(d.Value())!=0);
}
}
struct Callbacks {u32 MemoryReadCode(u64 addr){return static_cast<u32>(addr|1u);}};
struct Conf {
    Callbacks* callbacks{};
    u32 processor_id{3},code_cache_size{32*1024*1024};
    int arch_version{8};
    bool define_unpredictable_behaviour{},hook_hint_instructions{},wall_clock_cntpct{};
};
namespace Optimization {
void Optimize(IR::Block& block,const Conf&,int){
    assert(block.key!=0);
}
}
struct BlockDescriptor {CodePtr entrypoint{};size_t size{};};
struct A32EmitX64 {using BlockDescriptor=::BlockDescriptor;};
struct CodeSpace {
    size_t capacity{64*1024*1024};
    unsigned commits{},clears{};
    size_t SpaceRemaining()const{return capacity;}
    void EnsureMemoryCommitted(size_t n){assert(n<=capacity);++commits;}
    void ClearCache(){++clears;}
};
struct Emitter {
    std::map<u64,BlockDescriptor> blocks;
    unsigned emits{},lookups{},invalidations{},clears{};
    std::atomic<u64> work{0};
    std::optional<BlockDescriptor> GetBasicBlock(IR::LocationDescriptor d){
        ++lookups;
        const auto it=blocks.find(d.Value());
        if(it==blocks.end())return std::nullopt;
        return it->second;
    }
    BlockDescriptor Emit(const IR::Block& ir){
        ++emits;
        u64 v=ir.key;
        for(unsigned i=0;i<2048;++i)
            v=(v*1664525ULL+1013904223ULL)^(v>>7);
        work.fetch_add(v,std::memory_order_relaxed);
        BlockDescriptor block{reinterpret_cast<CodePtr>((ir.key|1ULL)<<4),32};
        assert(blocks.emplace(ir.key,block).second);
        return block;
    }
    void InvalidateCacheRanges(const boost::icl::interval_set<ADDR>& intervals){
        ++invalidations;
        for(auto it=blocks.begin();it!=blocks.end();){
            bool remove=false;
            for(const auto& range:intervals.spans)
                if(it->first>=range.lo && it->first<=range.hi)remove=true;
            if(remove)it=blocks.erase(it);
            else ++it;
        }
    }
    void ClearCache(){++clears;blocks.clear();}
};
struct JitState{unsigned resets{};void ResetRSB(){++resets;}};
struct Probe {
    Callbacks callbacks;
    Conf conf;
    IR::Block ir_block;
    CodeSpace block_of_code;
    Emitter emitter;
    int polyfill_options{};
    JitState jit_state;
    bool invalidate_entire_cache{};
    boost::icl::interval_set<ADDR> invalid_cache_ranges;
    std::mutex invalidation_mutex;
    unsigned halts{},cleared_halts{};
    Probe(){conf.callbacks=&callbacks;}
    void HaltExecution(HaltReason){++halts;}
    void ClearHalt(HaltReason){++cleared_halts;}
    void ClearCache();
    void InvalidateCacheRange(ADDR,size_t);
    void PerformRequestedCacheInvalidation(HaltReason);
    BLOCK_RET BLOCK_METHOD(IR::LocationDescriptor);
};
__NATIVE__
static CodePtr Lookup(Probe& p,u64 location){
    IR::LocationDescriptor d{location};
#if defined(SCENARIO_A32)
    return p.GetBasicBlock(d).entrypoint;
#else
    return p.GetBlock(d);
#endif
}
int main(){
    Probe p;
    constexpr unsigned blocks=32,repeat=16;
    std::array<CodePtr,blocks> entries{};
    auto run_pass=[&](unsigned* new_emits){
        const auto before=p.emitter.emits;
        for(unsigned k=0;k<blocks;++k){
            CodePtr result=Lookup(p,0x1000+8*k);
            assert(result);
            if(!entries[k])entries[k]=result;
            else assert(result==entries[k]);
        }
        *new_emits=p.emitter.emits-before;
    };
    unsigned cold{},hot{},recompile{},cleared{};
    const auto start=Clock::now();
    run_pass(&cold);
    const auto after_cold=Clock::now();
    for(unsigned n=0;n<repeat;++n)run_pass(&hot);
    const auto after_hot=Clock::now();
    // Exactly eight blocks from the middle of the populated cache.
    p.InvalidateCacheRange(static_cast<ADDR>(0x1000+12*8),8*8);
    p.PerformRequestedCacheInvalidation(HaltReason::CacheInvalidation);
    assert(p.emitter.blocks.size()==24);
    run_pass(&recompile);
    assert(recompile==8);
    // A no-op drain must not force additional compilation or reset the RSB.
    const auto previous=p.jit_state.resets;
    p.PerformRequestedCacheInvalidation(HaltReason::CacheInvalidation);
    assert(p.jit_state.resets==previous);
    p.ClearCache();
    p.PerformRequestedCacheInvalidation(HaltReason::CacheInvalidation);
    assert(p.emitter.blocks.empty());
    run_pass(&cleared);
    assert(cold==32 && hot==0 && cleared==32);
    assert(p.emitter.emits==72 && p.emitter.blocks.size()==32);
    assert(p.emitter.work.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)!=0);
    const auto cold_ns=std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(
        after_cold-start).count();
    const auto hot_ns=std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(
        after_hot-after_cold).count();
    assert(cold_ns>0 && hot_ns>0);
    // Default JIT profile maintains independent per-core code namespaces.
    // A range write in one core must never evict another core's block.
    Probe core0,core1;
    const CodePtr one=Lookup(core0,0x5000);
    const CodePtr two=Lookup(core1,0x5000);
    assert(one==two && core0.emitter.emits==1 && core1.emitter.emits==1);
    core0.InvalidateCacheRange(static_cast<ADDR>(0x5000),4);
    core0.PerformRequestedCacheInvalidation(HaltReason::CacheInvalidation);
    assert(core0.emitter.blocks.empty() && core1.emitter.blocks.size()==1);
    assert(Lookup(core0,0x5000)==one);
    assert(Lookup(core1,0x5000)==two);
    assert(core0.emitter.emits==2 && core1.emitter.emits==1);
    std::printf("F02_JIT_NATIVE_COLD_REPLAY_PASS arch=ARCH impl=IMPL "
                "cold=32 repeated_hits=512 recompile=8 full_clear_compile=32 "
                "total_emissions=72 isolated_cores=2 cold_total_ns=%lld hot_total_ns=%lld "
                "scope=source_extracted_synthetic_translator\n",
                static_cast<long long>(cold_ns),
                static_cast<long long>(hot_ns));
}
"""
```

```py
"""Source-selected native JIT no-op invalidation must not alter RX/RW protections."""
from pathlib import Path
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
```

```py
"""F02: pinned-vs-selected A32/A64 real invalidation-method lock budgets.

Compile the actual historical and maintained source-derived C++ range
invalidation and drain methods. Compare lock-held duration on an identical
synthetic emitter workload with a real competing lock owner, cold requests,
repeat-empty drains and a subsequent invalidation. This is NOT compilation
latency, native PS5 timing, or a fully-qualified F02 exit gate.

import shutil

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

def extract(source:str,signature:str)->str:
    assert source.count(signature)==1,signature
    begin=source.index(signature)
    opening=source.index("{",begin)
    depth=0
    for i in range(opening,len(source)):
        if source[i]=="{":depth+=1
        elif source[i]=="}":
            depth-=1
            if depth==0:return source[begin:i+1]
    raise AssertionError(signature)
TEMPLATE=r"""
#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <functional>
#include <limits>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>
using u32=std::uint32_t;
using u64=std::uint64_t;
using Address=ADDRESS;
using Clock=std::chrono::steady_clock;
enum class HaltReason {None,CacheInvalidation};
bool Has(HaltReason a,HaltReason b){return a==b;}
namespace boost::icl {
template<typename T> struct discrete_interval {
    T lo{},hi{};
    static discrete_interval closed(T a,T b){return {a,b};}
};
template<typename T> struct interval_set {
    std::vector<discrete_interval<T>> spans;
    bool empty()const{return spans.empty();}
    void clear(){spans.clear();}
    void swap(interval_set& that){spans.swap(that.spans);}
    void add(discrete_interval<T> item){spans.push_back(item);}
};
}
struct TimedMutex {
    static thread_local unsigned depth;
    std::mutex mutex;
    std::atomic<u64> held_ns{0};
    std::atomic<u64> gets{0};
    Clock::time_point entered{};
    void lock() {
        mutex.lock();++depth;entered=Clock::now();
        gets.fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_relaxed);
    }
    void unlock() {
        const auto ns=std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(
            Clock::now()-entered).count();
        held_ns.fetch_add(static_cast<u64>(ns),std::memory_order_relaxed);
        --depth;mutex.unlock();
    }
    bool try_lock() {
        if(!mutex.try_lock())return false;
        ++depth;entered=Clock::now();
        gets.fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_relaxed);
        return true;
    }
};
thread_local unsigned TimedMutex::depth=0;
struct State {unsigned resets{};void ResetRSB(){++resets;}};
struct Code {
    unsigned cleared{};
    void ClearCache(){++cleared;}
};
struct Emitter {
    unsigned ranged{},cleared{},last_count{};
    std::atomic<u64> workload{0};
    TimedMutex* tracked{};
    bool executed_under_guard{};
    void InvalidateCacheRanges(const boost::icl::interval_set<Address>& spans){
        ++ranged;
        last_count=static_cast<unsigned>(spans.spans.size());
        assert(last_count==1);
        // try_lock from the owning thread on a non-recursive std::mutex is
        // undefined; track THIS thread's lock ownership explicitly.
        if (TimedMutex::depth) executed_under_guard=true;
        u64 v=static_cast<u64>(spans.spans[0].lo)+static_cast<u64>(spans.spans[0].hi);
        // Identical deterministic synthetic emitter cost for pinned/maintained.
        for(unsigned i=0;i<4096;++i)
            v=(v*1664525ULL+1013904223ULL)^(v>>7);
        workload.fetch_add(v,std::memory_order_relaxed);
    }
    void ClearCache(){++cleared;}
};
struct Probe {
    TimedMutex invalidation_mutex;
    boost::icl::interval_set<Address> invalid_cache_ranges;
    bool invalidate_entire_cache{};
    unsigned halts{},cleared_halts{};
    State jit_state;
    Code block_of_code;
    Emitter emitter;
    Probe(){emitter.tracked=&invalidation_mutex;}
    void HaltExecution(HaltReason){++halts;}
    void ClearHalt(HaltReason){++cleared_halts;}
    void InvalidateCacheRange(Address,size_t);
    void PerformRequestedCacheInvalidation(HaltReason);
};
__RANGE__
__APPLY__
int main(){
    Probe p;
    constexpr unsigned iterations=96;
    unsigned empty_repeats{};
    std::atomic<bool> running{true};
    std::atomic<unsigned> competitor_gets{};
    // Start the measured invalidation burst only AFTER the real competing
    // thread has acquired/released the mutex once. Without a handshake, a
    // fast -O2 source replay can finish all 96 drains before that thread is
    // ever scheduled; that is not evidence of a lock-budget regression.
    std::atomic<bool> competitor_started{false};
    std::thread competitor([&] {
        while(running.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)){
            {
                std::lock_guard<TimedMutex> lk{p.invalidation_mutex};
                ++competitor_gets;
            }
            if (!competitor_started.exchange(true,std::memory_order_release)) {
                competitor_started.notify_one();
            }
            std::this_thread::yield();
        }
    });
    competitor_started.wait(false,std::memory_order_acquire);
    assert(competitor_gets.load(std::memory_order_acquire)>0);
    for(unsigned i=0;i<iterations;++i){
        p.InvalidateCacheRange(static_cast<Address>(0x1000+i*8),4);
        p.PerformRequestedCacheInvalidation(HaltReason::CacheInvalidation);
        p.PerformRequestedCacheInvalidation(HaltReason::CacheInvalidation);
        ++empty_repeats;
    }
    running.store(false,std::memory_order_relaxed);
    competitor.join();
    assert(p.emitter.ranged==iterations);
    assert(p.jit_state.resets==iterations);
    assert(p.emitter.cleared==0);
    assert(p.emitter.workload.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)!=0);
    assert(empty_repeats==iterations);
    assert(competitor_started.load(std::memory_order_acquire));
    assert(competitor_gets.load(std::memory_order_acquire)>0);
    // The maintained code dispatches outside mutex; old code does not.
    assert(p.emitter.executed_under_guard==PINNED_EXPECTED);
    const auto held=p.invalidation_mutex.held_ns.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
    assert(held>0);
    std::printf("F02_JIT_NATIVE_INVALIDATION_BUDGET_PASS arch=ARCH "
                "impl=IMPL range_drains=%u empty_repeats=%u "
                "held_lock_ns=%llu pinned_dispatch_under_guard=%u "
                "scope=source_extracted_synthetic_emitter\n",
                p.emitter.ranged,empty_repeats,
                static_cast<unsigned long long>(held),
                unsigned(p.emitter.executed_under_guard));
}
"""
```

`tools/check-native-jit-invalidation-snapshot-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compile actual A32/A64 cache-invalidation entry and drain against reentrant requests.

The production method must release invalidation_mutex BEFORE emitter work.
A request arriving during the old drain must remain pending and must not be
silently cleared by the old operation. No title or console timing is inferred.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
owners = {
    "a32": root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/dynarmic/backend/x64/a32_interface_native.cpp",
    "a64": root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/dynarmic/backend/x64/a64_interface_standard.cpp",
}
shared = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-core/dynarmic/shared-jit/jit_impl.inc").read_text()
assert "ranges.swap(invalid_cache_ranges);" in shared

def method(src: str, name: str) -> str:
    marker = f"    void {name}("
    assert src.count(marker) == 1, name
    beg = src.index(marker)
    brace = src.index("{", beg)
    level = 0
    for i in range(brace, len(src)):
        if src[i] == "{":
            level += 1
        elif src[i] == "}":
            level -= 1
            if level == 0:
                return src[beg:i + 1]
    raise AssertionError("unterminated " + name)

for arch, path in owners.items():
    source = path.read_text()
    apply = method(source, "PerformRequestedCacheInvalidation")
    queue = method(source, "InvalidateCacheRange")

    # full-clear entry point as guest invalidations. The former unguarded
    # writes of invalidate_entire_cache introduced a data race.

extern "C" void eden_jit_cache_event(unsigned,unsigned) __attribute__((weak));
extern "C" bool eden_native_detailed_logging() noexcept {return detailed;}

    assert(core==2 && kind<2); ++reported[kind];

// The test fixture rejects writes to shared full-clear state without the

struct TrackedMutex {
    std::mutex inner;
    static thread_local unsigned depth;
    void lock() { inner.lock(); ++depth; }
    bool try_lock() { if (!inner.try_lock()) return false; ++depth; return true; }
    void unlock() { --depth; inner.unlock(); }
};
thread_local unsigned TrackedMutex::depth = 0;
struct TrackedFlag {
    bool state{};
    operator bool() const { return state; }
    TrackedFlag& operator=(bool next) {
        if (!TrackedMutex::depth) {
            std::fputs("UNSYNCHRONIZED_INVALIDATION_WRITE\n", stderr);
            std::abort();
        }
        state = next;
        return *this;
    }

    assert(!p.halted);
    p.PerformRequestedCacheInvalidation(HaltReason::None);
    assert(p.clear_halts==0);

    // Real emitter gets a snapshot of the first request. Its reentrant guest
    // write must NOT wait on invalidation_mutex nor disappear afterward.
    p.emitter.on_range=[&](){

        assert(unlocked);

    assert(p.invalid_cache_ranges.spans[0]==std::make_pair(Address(0x200),Address(0x203)));

    assert(p.emitter.last[0]==std::make_pair(Address(0x200),Address(0x203)));
    assert(!p.halted && p.invalid_cache_ranges.empty());

    // during that clear must be queued as the NEXT invalidation.

        assert(unlocked);

    };

    assert(p.emitter.ranged==3 && p.emitter.last[0]==std::make_pair(Address(0x300),Address(0x303)));
    assert(p.invalid_cache_ranges.empty() && !p.halted);
    assert(p.jit_state.resets==4);

    assert(reported[0]==1 && reported[1]==3);
#else

#endif
    // A redundant halt without a queued request is not an invalidation.
    auto old_resets=p.jit_state.resets;
    p.PerformRequestedCacheInvalidation(HaltReason::CacheInvalidation);
    assert(p.jit_state.resets==old_resets);

    // Test the TWO actual GetBlock pressure/commit-retry handoff snippets.
    // A new guest invalidation raised during an emitter clear remains queued
    // for the next drain; repeated pressure requests complete without loss.
    detailed = false;
    Probe pressured;
    pressured.emitter.on_full = [&]() {
        bool unlocked = pressured.invalidation_mutex.try_lock();
        assert(unlocked);
        pressured.invalidation_mutex.unlock();
        if (pressured.emitter.cleared == 1) {

            // invalidates its prior snapshot. Join would deadlock if the
            // JIT still owned invalidation_mutex across emitter.ClearCache.

                pressured.InvalidateCacheRange(Address(0x400), 4);

    assert(pressured.invalid_cache_ranges.spans[0] ==
           std::make_pair(Address(0x400), Address(0x403)));
    pressured.PerformRequestedCacheInvalidation(HaltReason::CacheInvalidation);
    assert(pressured.invalid_cache_ranges.empty() && !pressured.halted);
    pressured.CommitFailureEvacuation();
    assert(pressured.emitter.cleared == 2 && !pressured.halted);
    std::puts("NATIVE_JIT_INVALIDATION_SNAPSHOT_PASS");

    compiler = shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++") or shutil.which("c++")
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Host regression: actual pinned A32/A64 read callbacks must honor abort checks."""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
helper = root / "tools/fixtures/legacy-x06-native-jit-memory-read-guard.cmake"
cmake = (root / "headless/CMakeLists.txt").read_text()
workflow = (root / ".github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml").read_text()
assert 'native_jit_memory_read_guard.cmake")' not in cmake

compiler = shutil.which("g++") or shutil.which("clang++")
assert compiler and shutil.which("cmake")

def method(src, token):
    assert src.count(token) == 1, token
    start = src.index(token)
    brace = src.index("{", start)
    depth = 0
    for i in range(brace, len(src)):
        if src[i] == "{":
            depth += 1
        if src[i] == "}":
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0:
                return src[start:i+1]
    raise AssertionError(token)

prelude = """

    u16 Read16(u64) { ++reads; return 16; }
    u32 Read32(u64) { ++reads; return 32; }
    u64 Read64(u64) { ++reads; return 64; }

namespace Core {
```

`tools/check-native-jit-quiescence-model-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Source-anchored, host-only JIT run-quiescence model; never enables native bridge."""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
def read(path):
    return (root / path).read_text()

physical = read("vendor/sources/eden/src/core/hle/kernel/physical_core.cpp")
cpu = read("vendor/sources/eden/src/core/cpu_manager.cpp")
kernel = read("vendor/sources/eden/src/core/hle/kernel/kernel.cpp")
gpu = read("vendor/sources/eden/src/video_core/gpu.cpp")
a32 = read("vendor/sources/eden/src/core/arm/dynarmic/arm_dynarmic_32.cpp")
a64 = read("vendor/sources/eden/src/core/arm/dynarmic/arm_dynarmic_64.cpp")
replay = read("headless/gpu_deferred_replay.h")
workflow = read(".github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml")
for anchor in ("const auto EnterContext = [&]() {", "const auto ExitContext = [&]() {",
               "interface->RunThread(thread);", "interface->UnlockThread(thread);",
               "arm_interface->SignalInterrupt(thread);"):
    assert anchor in physical, anchor
assert "while (!physical_core->IsInterrupted())" in cpu
assert "while (!TryWait())" in kernel
assert "WaitForSyncOperation(fence);" in gpu
for jit in (a32, a64):
    assert "m_jit->HaltExecution(BreakLoop);" in jit
assert "inline constexpr bool kNativePostStorePublicationReady = false;" in replay
assert "python3 -B tools/check-native-jit-quiescence-model-host.py" in workflow

code = r"""
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <cstdio>
#include <mutex>
#include <semaphore>
#include <thread>
struct Gate {
    std::mutex m;
    std::condition_variable cv;
    unsigned in_flight = 0;
    bool pending = false, tracked = false, failed = false;
    std::atomic<bool> direct{true};
    std::atomic<int> ram{0};
    std::atomic<unsigned> callbacks{0};
    bool enter() {
        std::unique_lock lk(m);
        cv.wait(lk, [&] { return !pending || failed; });
        if (failed) return false;
        ++in_flight;
        return true;
    }
    void exit() {
        std::lock_guard lk(m);
        assert(in_flight > 0);
        --in_flight;
        cv.notify_all();
    }
    void request() {
        std::lock_guard lk(m);
        assert(!pending && !tracked && !failed);
        pending = true;
        direct.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
    }
    bool confirm() {
        std::lock_guard lk(m);
        if (!pending || in_flight || failed) return false;
        tracked = true;
        pending = false;
        cv.notify_all();
        return true;
    }
    void abort() {
        std::lock_guard lk(m);
        failed = true;
        pending = false;
        cv.notify_all();
    }
};
void exercise_gpu_wait_and_first_use() {
    Gate gate;
    std::binary_semaphore old_guard_read{0}, finish_old_store{0};
    std::binary_semaphore waiting_for_gpu{0}, complete_gpu_read{0};
    std::atomic<bool> new_run_started{false};
    std::thread writer([&] {
        assert(gate.enter());
        bool already_allowed = gate.direct.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        assert(already_allowed);
        old_guard_read.release();
        finish_old_store.acquire();
        if (already_allowed) gate.ram.store(17, std::memory_order_release);
        gate.exit();
    });
    std::thread gpu_waiter([&] {
        assert(gate.enter());
        waiting_for_gpu.release();
        complete_gpu_read.acquire();
        gate.exit();
    });
    old_guard_read.acquire();
    waiting_for_gpu.acquire();
    gate.request();
    assert(!gate.confirm());
    std::thread newcomer([&] {
        assert(gate.enter());
        new_run_started.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
        if (gate.direct.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
            gate.ram.store(99, std::memory_order_release);
        else
            gate.callbacks.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        gate.exit();
    });
    assert(!new_run_started.load(std::memory_order_acquire));
    // The GPU owner keeps servicing guest requests instead of waiting.
    complete_gpu_read.release();
    finish_old_store.release();
    gpu_waiter.join();
    writer.join();
    assert(gate.confirm());
    newcomer.join();
    assert(new_run_started && gate.tracked && gate.ram == 17);
    assert(gate.callbacks == 1);
    std::puts("JIT_QUIESCENCE_GPU_PROGRESS_AND_FIRST_USE_MODEL_PASS");
}
void exercise_reentrant_guest_request() {
    Gate gate;
    assert(gate.enter());
    gate.request();
    assert(!gate.confirm()); // Waiting here would deadlock on this very RUN.
    gate.ram.store(19);
    gate.exit();
    assert(gate.confirm() && gate.ram == 19);
    std::puts("JIT_QUIESCENCE_REENTRANT_NONBLOCKING_MODEL_PASS");
}
void exercise_abort() {
    Gate gate;
    assert(gate.enter());
    gate.request();
    gate.abort();
    gate.exit();
    assert(!gate.confirm() && !gate.enter());
    std::puts("JIT_QUIESCENCE_FAILURE_FAIL_CLOSED_MODEL_PASS");
}
int main() {
    exercise_gpu_wait_and_first_use();
    exercise_reentrant_guest_request();
    exercise_abort();
    std::puts("JIT_QUIESCENCE_NATIVE_UNQUALIFIED_GATE_CLOSED");
}
"""
compiler = shutil.which("g++") or shutil.which("clang++")
assert compiler, "C++20 host compiler required"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-jit-quiescence-") as folder:
    source = Path(folder) / "model.cpp"
    executable = Path(folder) / "model"
    source.write_text(code)
    subprocess.run([compiler, "-std=c++20", "-O2", "-Wall", "-Wextra",
                    "-Werror", "-pthread", str(source), "-o", str(executable)],
                   check=True)
    completed = subprocess.run([str(executable)], text=True, capture_output=True,
                               check=True, timeout=15)
    print(completed.stdout, end="")
```

`tools/check-native-jit-sparse-positive-cache-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Source-linked host regression for the PS5 sparse JIT positive commit memo.

The production function remains compiled end-to-end by check-jit-sparse-host.py.
This witness compiles the exact cache header and checks interleaved arenas,
growth, MRU eviction, and generation invalidation; no console FPS claim.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
source = (ROOT / "src/memory_pages.cpp").read_text()
assert '#include "jit-sparse-commit.h"' in source
assert "static thread_local ::Eden::Jit::SparseCommitPositiveCache local;" in source
assert "local.Covers(executable, required, generation)" in source
assert "local.Remember(executable, region.committed," in source
# A newly reserved region cannot invalidate hints for other live arenas.
# Only trimming committed pages or retiring an RX mapping can make an
# existing positive hint unsafe. Check the *real* owner method boundaries.
reserve_body = source.split("void* ReserveSparseJitCode(std::size_t size, void** writable_out) noexcept {", 1)[1].split(
    "bool IsSparseJitCode(", 1)[0]
trim_body = source.split("bool TrimSparseJitCode(void* executable, std::size_t live_code_end) noexcept {", 1)[1].split(
    "void ReleaseSparseJitCode(void* executable) noexcept {", 1)[0]
release_body = source.split("void ReleaseSparseJitCode(void* executable) noexcept {", 1)[1].split(
    "void FreeMemoryPages(void* pointer, std::size_t size) noexcept {", 1)[0]
epoch_bump = "sparse_jit_generation.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_acq_rel);"
assert epoch_bump not in reserve_body
assert trim_body.count(epoch_bump) == 1
assert release_body.count(epoch_bump) == 1
assert source.count(epoch_bump) == 2

cache_header = (ROOT / "headless/jit-sparse-commit.h").read_text()
assert "if (!entries[i].executable) return false;" in cache_header
assert "if (entries[0].executable == executable) {" in cache_header
assert "return required <= entries[0].committed;" in cache_header
assert "if (required > entries[i].committed) return false;" in cache_header
assert "if (i == 1 && !entries[2].executable) return true;" in cache_header
compiler = shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
assert compiler, "C++20 compiler required"
FIXTURE = r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <new>
#include <sys/mman.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include "jit-sparse-commit.h"
int main() {
    Eden::Jit::SparseCommitPositiveCache cache;
    void* arenas[5] = {
        reinterpret_cast<void*>(0x10000000ULL),
        reinterpret_cast<void*>(0x14000000ULL),
        reinterpret_cast<void*>(0x18000000ULL),
        reinterpret_cast<void*>(0x1c000000ULL),
        reinterpret_cast<void*>(0x20000000ULL)};
    constexpr std::size_t committed = 4 * 1024 * 1024;
    for (auto* arena : arenas) assert(!cache.Covers(arena, committed, 7));
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i) cache.Remember(arenas[i], committed, 7);
    std::size_t misses = 0;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 100000; ++i)
        if (!cache.Covers(arenas[i % 4], committed, 7)) ++misses;
    assert(misses == 0);
    // End of alternating probes leaves arena 3 hottest; arena 2 is cached
    // but requires another physical page. The failed probe must not promote.
    assert(!cache.Covers(arenas[2], committed + 1, 7));
    assert(cache.Covers(arenas[3], committed, 7));
    // The most frequent single-core hit is strictly read-only. Catch a
    // redundant self-promotion store even at -O0 by protecting the page.
    const long page_size = sysconf(_SC_PAGESIZE);
    assert(page_size > 0 && static_cast<std::size_t>(page_size) >= sizeof(cache));
    void* page = mmap(nullptr, static_cast<std::size_t>(page_size),
                      PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS, -1, 0);
    assert(page != MAP_FAILED);
    auto* readonly = new (page) Eden::Jit::SparseCommitPositiveCache{};
    readonly->Remember(arenas[0], committed, 7);
    readonly->Remember(arenas[1], committed, 7);
    assert(mprotect(page, static_cast<std::size_t>(page_size), PROT_READ) == 0);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 1000; ++i) {
        assert(readonly->Covers(arenas[1], committed, 7));
        // With exactly two active arenas, secondary hits must also be
        // read-only, even when alternated after a primary-core hit.
        assert(readonly->Covers(arenas[0], committed, 7));
        // Missing arena, hot-arena growth, and non-head arena growth are
        // read-only misses and must not mutate MRU while finding a false hit.
        assert(!readonly->Covers(arenas[2], committed, 7));
        assert(!readonly->Covers(arenas[1], committed + 1, 7));
        assert(!readonly->Covers(arenas[0], committed + 1, 7));
    }
    assert(mprotect(page, static_cast<std::size_t>(page_size), PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE) == 0);
    readonly->~SparseCommitPositiveCache();
    assert(munmap(page, static_cast<std::size_t>(page_size)) == 0);
    assert(!cache.Covers(arenas[2], committed + 1, 7));
    cache.Remember(arenas[2], committed * 2, 7);
    assert(cache.Covers(arenas[2], committed * 2, 7));
    assert(!cache.Covers(arenas[2], committed * 2 + 1, 7));
    // Reserving a third independent RX/RW arena preserves already live
    // positive entries at the unchanged reservation epoch. Physical trim or
    // release, unlike insertion, must invalidate those entries.
    Eden::Jit::SparseCommitPositiveCache preserved;
    preserved.Remember(arenas[0], committed, 70);
    preserved.Remember(arenas[1], committed, 70);
    assert(preserved.Covers(arenas[0], committed, 70));
    assert(preserved.Covers(arenas[1], committed, 70));
    assert(!preserved.Covers(arenas[0], committed, 71));
    assert(!preserved.Covers(arenas[1], committed, 71));
    // A later physical commit refreshes the same arena in-place.
    cache.Remember(arenas[2], committed * 4, 7);
    assert(cache.Covers(arenas[2], committed * 4, 7));
    assert(cache.Covers(arenas[0], committed, 7));
    cache.Remember(arenas[4], committed, 7);
    assert(!cache.Covers(arenas[1], committed, 7)); // LRU evicted
    assert(!cache.Covers(arenas[4], committed, 8)); // trim/release epoch
    assert(!cache.Covers(arenas[2], committed, 8));
    cache.Remember(arenas[4], committed, 8);
    assert(cache.Covers(arenas[4], committed, 8));
    assert(!cache.Covers(arenas[4], committed, 9)); // recycled VA
    // Two active slots after an epoch reset retain MRU order while all
    // negative lookups exit on the first never-populated entry.
    Eden::Jit::SparseCommitPositiveCache partial;
    partial.Remember(arenas[0], committed, 20);
    partial.Remember(arenas[1], committed, 20);
    assert(!partial.Covers(arenas[4], committed, 20));
    assert(partial.Covers(arenas[0], committed, 20));
    assert(partial.Covers(arenas[1], committed, 20));
    assert(!partial.Covers(arenas[2], committed, 21));
    // Deterministic state-machine oracle: four MRU entries, epoch reset,
    // positive hits, capacity changes, evictions and cold probes.
    struct Reference {
        struct Slot { void* key{}; std::size_t bytes{}; };
        std::array<Slot, 4> slots{};
        std::uint64_t epoch{};
        bool Covers(void* ptr, std::size_t bytes, std::uint64_t current) {
            if (epoch != current) return false;
            for (unsigned i = 0; i < slots.size(); ++i) {
                if (!slots[i].key) return false;
                if (slots[i].key != ptr || slots[i].bytes < bytes) continue;
                if (i == 1 && !slots[2].key) return true;
                const Slot hit = slots[i];
                for (unsigned j = i; j > 0; --j) slots[j] = slots[j - 1];
                slots[0] = hit;
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        }
        void Remember(void* ptr, std::size_t bytes, std::uint64_t current) {
            if (epoch != current) { slots = {}; epoch = current; }
            unsigned i = 0;
            while (i < slots.size() && slots[i].key != ptr) ++i;
            if (i == slots.size()) i = slots.size() - 1;
            for (; i > 0; --i) slots[i] = slots[i - 1];
            slots[0] = {ptr, bytes};
        }
    } reference;
    Eden::Jit::SparseCommitPositiveCache verified;
    std::uint64_t seed = 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL, epoch = 1;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 250000; ++i) {
        seed ^= seed << 13; seed ^= seed >> 7; seed ^= seed << 17;
        if ((seed & 0xffu) == 0u) ++epoch;
        void* ptr = reinterpret_cast<void*>(
            std::uintptr_t{0x30000000} + ((seed >> 11) & 15u) * 0x1000000u);
        const std::size_t bytes = ((seed >> 22) & 31u) * 0x200000u;
        if ((seed & 7u) <= 2u) {
            reference.Remember(ptr, bytes, epoch);
            verified.Remember(ptr, bytes, epoch);
        } else {
            assert(reference.Covers(ptr, bytes, epoch) == verified.Covers(ptr, bytes, epoch));
        }
    }
    std::printf("SPARSE_JIT_POSITIVE_CACHE_PASS alternating_misses=%zu epochs=1 growth=1 eviction=1 readonly_hit=1 readonly_two_arenas=1 cold_miss=1\n", misses);
}
"""
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-sparse-jit-mru-") as tmp:
    path = Path(tmp)
    (path / "test.cpp").write_text(FIXTURE)
    for opt in (0, 2, 3):
        exe = path / f"test-O{opt}"
        subprocess.run([compiler, "-std=c++20", f"-O{opt}", "-Wall", "-Wextra",
                        "-Werror", "-fsanitize=address,undefined", "-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
                        "-I", str(ROOT / "headless"), str(path / "test.cpp"),
                        "-o", str(exe)], check=True, timeout=90)
        subprocess.run([str(exe)], check=True, timeout=90)
print("SPARSE_JIT_POSITIVE_CACHE_HOST_PASS O0=1 O2=1 O3=1 source_linked=1 reservation_epoch=1 trim_release_epoch=1")
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""C++20 ASan/UBSan: production slab heap under concurrent Allocate/Free."""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
source=(root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-threading/src/core/hle/kernel/k_slab_heap.h").read_text()

fixture=r"""
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>
#include <unordered_set>
#include <vector>
#define YUZU_NON_COPYABLE(T) T(const T&)=delete;T& operator=(const T&)=delete;
#define YUZU_NON_MOVEABLE(T) T(T&&)=delete;T& operator=(T&&)=delete;
#define ASSERT(x) assert(x)
using u8=std::uint8_t;
namespace Common {
template<typename T> bool AtomicCompareAndSwap(T* p,T desired,T expected,T& old) {
 old=*p;
 if(old!=expected)return false;
 *p=desired;return true;
}
}
#include "core/hle/kernel/k_slab_heap.h"
int main() {
 constexpr int n=2048;
 alignas(64) Kernel::impl::KSlabHeapImpl::Node nodes[n]{};
 Kernel::impl::KSlabHeapImpl pool;
 pool.Initialize();
 for(auto& item:nodes)pool.Free(&item);
 std::mutex observed_mutex;
 std::unordered_set<void*> live;
 std::atomic<bool> collision{false};
 auto work=[&]{
  for(int i=0;i<10000;++i) {
   void* node=nullptr;
   while(!(node=pool.Allocate()))std::this_thread::yield();
   {
    std::lock_guard lock(observed_mutex);
    if(!live.insert(node).second)collision.store(true);
   }
   static_cast<Kernel::impl::KSlabHeapImpl::Node*>(node)->next=nullptr;
   {
    std::lock_guard lock(observed_mutex);
    if(live.erase(node)!=1)collision.store(true);
   }
   pool.Free(node);
  }
 };
 std::vector<std::thread> threads;
 for(int i=0;i<4;++i)threads.emplace_back(work);
 for(auto& t:threads)t.join();
 assert(!collision.load());
 assert(live.empty());
 std::unordered_set<void*> available;
 for(int i=0;i<n;++i){
  auto* node=pool.Allocate();
  assert(node&&available.insert(node).second);
 }
 assert(pool.Allocate()==nullptr);
 for(auto* ptr:available)pool.Free(ptr);
}
"""
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-kernel-slab-") as temp:
```

`tools/check-native-large-buffer-pages-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Prove a large valid buffer cannot poison all later never-owned writes."""
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import shutil
import tempfile

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
source=(root/"headless/buffer_pages.h").read_text()
assert "size>128ull*1024*1024" not in source
assert "if(address>=kSpace || size>kSpace-address)" in source
assert "registered[word].fetch_or(mask,std::memory_order_release)" in source
assert "coverage_unknown.store(true,std::memory_order_release)" in source
assert "coverage_unknown.load(std::memory_order_acquire)" in source
compiler=shutil.which("c++") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
assert compiler

program=r"""
#include "buffer_pages.h"
#include <cassert>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>
int main() {
  using namespace Eden::BufferPages;
  constexpr std::uint64_t mib=1024ull*1024ull;
  constexpr std::uint64_t kBig = 128*mib + 4096;
  constexpr std::uint64_t base=2*mib;
  assert(!coverage_unknown.load(std::memory_order_acquire));
  assert(NeverRegistered(base,4096));
  Mark(base,kBig);
  // A large VALID buffer is no longer a global disabling event.
  assert(!coverage_unknown.load(std::memory_order_acquire));
  assert(!NeverRegistered(base,4096));
  assert(!NeverRegistered(base+kBig-4096,4096));
  // Registration must not mark unrelated pages and unregistered writes
  // must still skip cache locking for the rest of the game.
  assert(NeverRegistered(base+kBig+2*4096,4096));
  assert(NeverRegistered(1ull*mib,4096));
  // Concurrent registration into one word must preserve both bitmaps.
  constexpr std::uint64_t other=512*mib;
  std::vector<std::thread> producers;
  for(unsigned t=0;t<4;++t)producers.emplace_back([t]{
    for(unsigned n=0;n<128;++n)
      Mark(other+(t*128+n)*4096,4096);
  });
  for(auto& x:producers)x.join();
  for(unsigned t=0;t<4;++t)
    assert(!NeverRegistered(other+t*128*4096,4096));
  assert(NeverRegistered(other+4*128*4096,4096));
  // Invalid or unrepresentable addresses retain conservative fallback.
  Mark(kSpace+1,4096);
  assert(coverage_unknown.load(std::memory_order_acquire));
  assert(!NeverRegistered(1ull*mib,4096));
}
"""
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-buffer-large-page-") as d:
    cpp=Path(d)/"witness.cpp"
    cpp.write_text(program)
    for opt in ("-O0","-O2"):
        exe=Path(d)/("witness"+opt)
        subprocess.run([compiler,"-std=c++20",opt,"-pthread","-Wall","-Wextra",
                        "-Werror","-fsanitize=undefined","-I"+str(root/"headless"),
                        str(cpp),"-o",str(exe)],check=True,timeout=40)
        subprocess.run([str(exe)],check=True,timeout=30)
        print("NATIVE_LARGE_BUFFER_PAGES_PASS",opt)
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Catch native launcher namespace and AppUpdateInfo aggregate failures on host.

Uses actual checked-in C++ declarations and initializer expressions. The
freestanding host syntax check does not need a PS5 SDK or a complete build.
"""

import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
MAIN = (ROOT / "headless/main.cpp").read_text()
SERVICES = (ROOT / "headless/prosperoeden/pe/ui/services.hpp").read_text()
LAUNCHER = (ROOT / "headless/prosperoeden/pe/ui/launcher.cpp").read_text()
LIBRARY = (ROOT / "headless/prosperoeden/pe/ui/library.cpp").read_text()

for symbol, header in (
    ("EncoreOverrides", "headless/encore_overrides_generated.h"),
    ("EncoreTextureProfiles", "headless/encore_texture_profiles.h"),
):
    assert f"namespace Eden::{symbol}" in (ROOT / header).read_text()
    assert not re.search(rf"(?<!Eden::)\b{symbol}::", MAIN), (
        "Unqualified native main.cpp namespace", symbol
    )
assert "Eden::EncoreTextureProfiles::ForTitle(launch_title_id, aniso_tier)" in MAIN
assert "Eden::EncoreOverrides::kAuthoredProfileCount" in MAIN

assert "const int base_filter =" not in LIBRARY, "Unused filter snapshot in native UI"
assert "EffectiveGameUpscalingFilter(game_settings_, prefs_, title_id)" in LIBRARY

decl = re.search(r"struct AppUpdateInfo\s*\{[\s\S]*?\n\};", SERVICES)
assert decl, "Native updater aggregate declaration disappeared"
fallbacks = re.findall(
    r"return\s+(\{\s*AppUpdateInfo::State::incompatible[\s\S]*?\});",
    SERVICES,
)
assert len(fallbacks) == 2, "Expected both disconnected updater fallbacks"
offline = re.findall(
    r"state->result\s*=\s*(\{\s*AppUpdateInfo::State::offline[\s\S]*?\});",
    LAUNCHER,
)
assert len(offline) == 1, "Expected detached update worker fallback"

source = (
    "#include <string>\n#include <cstdint>\nnamespace pe::ui {\n"
    + decl.group(0)
    + "\n"
    + "\n".join(
        f"AppUpdateInfo CheckFallback{i}(const std::string& current) "
        f"{{ return {initializer}; }}"
        for i, initializer in enumerate(fallbacks)
    )
    + "\nAppUpdateInfo CheckOffline() { AppUpdateInfo state; "
    f"state = {offline[0]}; return state; }}\n"
    + "}\n"
)
compiler = shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
assert compiler, "Host C++ compiler unavailable"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-updater-cxx-") as tmp:
    path = Path(tmp) / "check.cpp"
    path.write_text(source)
    done = subprocess.run(
        [compiler, "-std=c++20", "-Wall", "-Wextra",
         "-Wmissing-field-initializers", "-Werror",
         "-fsyntax-only", str(path)],
        capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30,
    )
    if done.returncode:
        raise AssertionError(done.stderr[-5000:])
print("NATIVE_LAUNCHER_CXX_HOST_PASS actual AppUpdateInfo aggregate, namespaces, filter")
```

```py

"""Compile the selected native dequeue call with the DEV timer on and off."""

import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

assert "guest_dequeue_blocked.fetch_sub(1, std::memory_order_acq_rel)" in scope

start = src.index("#ifdef " + profile + "\n        const auto dequeue_start")

fragment = src[start:end]
assert fragment.count("#ifdef " + profile) == 2
assert fragment.count("#endif") == 2
assert fragment.count("Status status = WaitForFreeSlotThenRelock(") == 1
assert fragment.count("::Eden::Performance::AddSince(") == 1
fixture = r"""
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <mutex>
using s32 = int;
enum class Status { NoError, BadValue };
#ifdef EDEN_NVNF_DEQUEUE_PROFILE
namespace Eden::Performance {
inline std::atomic<bool> detailed_gpu_profile{true};
inline std::atomic<int> clock_calls{};
inline std::atomic<int> add_calls{};
constexpr int guest_dequeue_wait = 1;
long long NowNs() { ++clock_calls; return 100; }
void AddSince(int key, long long stamp) {
    assert(key == guest_dequeue_wait && stamp == 100);
    ++add_calls;
}
}
#endif
struct Probe {
    std::mutex mutex;
    int calls{};
    Status WaitForFreeSlotThenRelock(bool async, s32* found, Status* flags,
                                     std::unique_lock<std::mutex>& lock) {
        assert(lock.owns_lock() && !async && found && flags);
        ++calls;
        return Status::NoError;
    }
    Status Run() {
        bool async = false;

condition_fixture = r"""
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <cstdio>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>
namespace Eden::Performance {
inline std::atomic<bool> detailed_gpu_profile{true};
inline std::atomic<unsigned> guest_dequeue_blocked{};
__SCOPE__
}
enum class Status { NoError };
struct BufferQueueCore {
    std::mutex mutex{};
    std::atomic<unsigned> dequeue_epoch{};
    std::condition_variable dequeue_condition{};
    void SignalDequeueCondition();
    bool WaitForDequeueCondition(std::unique_lock<std::mutex>&);
};
__CORE_METHODS__
struct Producer {
    BufferQueueCore* core;
    Status BlockOnce(std::atomic<int>& entered) {
        std::unique_lock lk{core->mutex};
        entered.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_release);
__BLOCK_PATH__
        return Status::NoError;
    }
};
int main() {
    using namespace Eden::Performance;
    BufferQueueCore core{};
    Producer producer{&core};
    std::atomic<int> entered{};
    std::vector<std::thread> waiters;
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
        waiters.emplace_back([&] { assert(producer.BlockOnce(entered) == Status::NoError); });
    }
    while (entered.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != 8)
        std::this_thread::yield();
    {
        // Owning this mutex proves that every prior waiter entered the
        // native condvar wait (and released the mutex) before broadcasting.
        std::scoped_lock lock{core.mutex};
#ifdef EDEN_NVNF_DEQUEUE_PROFILE
        assert(guest_dequeue_blocked.load(std::memory_order_acquire) == 8);
#else
        assert(guest_dequeue_blocked.load(std::memory_order_acquire) == 0);
#endif
        core.SignalDequeueCondition();
    }
    for (auto& waiter : waiters) waiter.join();
    assert(guest_dequeue_blocked.load(std::memory_order_acquire) == 0);
    assert(core.dequeue_epoch.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) == 1);
#ifdef EDEN_NVNF_DEQUEUE_PROFILE
    detailed_gpu_profile.store(false);
    entered.store(0);
    std::thread quiet([&] { assert(producer.BlockOnce(entered) == Status::NoError); });
    while (entered.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != 1)
        std::this_thread::yield();
    {
        std::scoped_lock lock{core.mutex};
        assert(guest_dequeue_blocked.load(std::memory_order_acquire) == 0);
        core.SignalDequeueCondition();
    }
    quiet.join();
    assert(guest_dequeue_blocked.load() == 0);
#endif
    std::puts("F05_NATIVE_DEQUEUE_CONDITION_INFLIGHT_PASS waiters=8 "
              "active_gauge_correct=1 restored=1 disabled_quiet=1 "
              "scope=source_extracted_native_condvar");
}
""".replace("__SCOPE__", scope).replace(
    "__CORE_METHODS__", core_methods).replace("__BLOCK_PATH__", block_path)
```

```py
fixture = r"""
#include <array>
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <chrono>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <cstdint>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>
using s32 = int;
using u32 = std::uint32_t;
enum class Status { NoError, BadValue, NoInit, NoMemory };
enum class BufferState { Free, Dequeued, Acquired };
struct Fence { int sequence{}; };
struct GraphicBuffer { int payload{}; };
struct BufferQueueDefs { static constexpr s32 NUM_BUFFER_SLOTS = 4; };
#define LOG_ERROR(...) (void)0
#define LOG_DEBUG(...) (void)0
struct IConsumerListener {
    int calls{};
    void OnBuffersReleased() { ++calls; }
};
struct BufferSlot {
    BufferState buffer_state{BufferState::Free};
    std::shared_ptr<GraphicBuffer> graphic_buffer{};
    u32 frame_number{};
    Fence fence{};
    bool request_buffer_called{};
    bool is_preallocated{};
};
struct BufferQueueCore {
    static constexpr s32 INVALID_BUFFER_SLOT = -1;
    std::mutex mutex{};
    std::array<BufferSlot, BufferQueueDefs::NUM_BUFFER_SLOTS> slots{};
    bool is_abandoned{};
    s32 override_max_buffer_count{};
    std::shared_ptr<IConsumerListener> consumer_listener{};
    std::condition_variable dequeue_condition{};
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> dequeue_epoch{};
    void WaitWhileAllocatingLocked() const {}
    s32 GetMinMaxBufferCountLocked(bool) const { return 1; }
    s32 GetPreallocatedBufferCountLocked() const { return 0; }
    void FreeAllBuffersLocked() {
        for (s32 i = 0; i < BufferQueueDefs::NUM_BUFFER_SLOTS; ++i) FreeBufferLocked(i);
    }
    void FreeBufferLocked(s32 index) {
        auto& slot = slots[index];
        slot.graphic_buffer.reset();
        slot.buffer_state = BufferState::Free;
        slot.frame_number = 0xffffffffu;
    }
    void SignalDequeueCondition();
    bool WaitForDequeueCondition(std::unique_lock<std::mutex>& lk);
};
struct MockKernel {};
struct MockEvent {
    std::atomic<int> signals{};
    std::mutex* queue_mutex{};
    void Signal(MockKernel&) {
        // Probe from a distinct thread: calling try_lock on a mutex this
        // same thread owns would be undefined behavior. Joining the probe
        // before return proves Signal did NOT run under core->mutex.
        assert(queue_mutex);
        std::atomic<bool> acquired{};
        std::thread probe([&] {
            // A host dequeuer may legitimately race the guest-event probe
            // after the producer drops the queue lock. Allow it to finish
            // instead of recording a spurious failure on a single try_lock.
            const auto deadline = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() +
                                  std::chrono::seconds(1);
            while (std::chrono::steady_clock::now() < deadline) {
                if (queue_mutex->try_lock()) {
                    queue_mutex->unlock();
                    acquired.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
                    return;
                }
                std::this_thread::yield();
            }
        });
        probe.join();
        assert(acquired.load(std::memory_order_acquire));
        signals.fetch_add(1);
    }
};
struct MockServiceContext {MockKernel kernel{};};
struct BufferQueueProducer {
    MockServiceContext service_context{};
    MockEvent event{};
    MockEvent* buffer_wait_event{&event};
    BufferQueueCore* core{};
    std::array<BufferSlot, BufferQueueDefs::NUM_BUFFER_SLOTS>& slots;
    explicit BufferQueueProducer(BufferQueueCore& c) : core(&c), slots(c.slots) {
        event.queue_mutex = &c.mutex;
    }
    Status DetachNextBuffer(std::shared_ptr<GraphicBuffer>* out_buffer, Fence* out_fence);
    Status DetachBuffer(s32 slot);
    Status SetBufferCount(s32 count);
    void CancelBuffer(s32 slot, const Fence& fence);
};
""" + "\n" + core_methods + "\n" + selected_single + "\n" + selected_count + "\n" + selected + "\n" + selected_cancel + r"""
int main() {
    BufferQueueCore core{};
    BufferQueueProducer p(core);
    std::shared_ptr<GraphicBuffer> output;
    Fence fence{};
    assert(p.DetachNextBuffer(nullptr, &fence) == Status::BadValue);
    assert(p.DetachNextBuffer(&output, nullptr) == Status::BadValue);
    assert(core.dequeue_epoch.load() == 0);
    assert(p.event.signals.load() == 0);
    assert(p.DetachNextBuffer(&output, &fence) == Status::NoMemory);
    assert(core.dequeue_epoch.load() == 0);
    // Oldest free graphic buffer is detached first. The active slot is
    // cleared BEFORE a single shared dequeue-generation wake is published.
    core.slots[0].graphic_buffer = std::make_shared<GraphicBuffer>(GraphicBuffer{123});
    core.slots[0].frame_number = 77;
    core.slots[0].fence = Fence{2};
    core.slots[1].graphic_buffer = std::make_shared<GraphicBuffer>(GraphicBuffer{456});
    core.slots[1].frame_number = 7;
    core.slots[1].fence = Fence{9};
    assert(p.DetachNextBuffer(&output, &fence) == Status::NoError);
    assert(output && output->payload == 456 && fence.sequence == 9);
    assert(core.slots[1].graphic_buffer == nullptr);
    assert(core.dequeue_epoch.load() == 1);
    assert(p.event.signals.load() == 1);
    assert(p.DetachNextBuffer(&output, &fence) == Status::NoError);
    assert(output && output->payload == 123 && fence.sequence == 2);
    assert(core.dequeue_epoch.load() == 2);
    assert(p.event.signals.load() == 2);
    assert(p.DetachNextBuffer(&output, &fence) == Status::NoMemory);
    assert(core.dequeue_epoch.load() == 2);
    assert(p.event.signals.load() == 2);
    core.is_abandoned = true;
    assert(p.DetachNextBuffer(&output, &fence) == Status::NoInit);
    assert(core.dequeue_epoch.load() == 2);
    assert(p.event.signals.load() == 2);

    // A second producer path detaches an owned dequeued slot, notifies the
    // host broadcast and the native guest event exactly once on success.
    BufferQueueCore single{};
    BufferQueueProducer owned(single);
    assert(owned.DetachBuffer(-1) == Status::BadValue);
    assert(owned.DetachBuffer(0) == Status::BadValue);
    single.slots[0].buffer_state = BufferState::Dequeued;
    single.slots[0].graphic_buffer = std::make_shared<GraphicBuffer>(GraphicBuffer{123});
    assert(owned.DetachBuffer(0) == Status::BadValue);
    single.slots[0].request_buffer_called = true;
    assert(owned.DetachBuffer(0) == Status::NoError);
    assert(single.slots[0].buffer_state == BufferState::Free);
    assert(!single.slots[0].graphic_buffer);
    assert(single.dequeue_epoch.load() == 1);
    assert(owned.event.signals.load() == 1);
    assert(owned.DetachBuffer(0) == Status::BadValue);
    assert(owned.event.signals.load() == 1);

    // The zero-count reset formerly signalled only host waiters, not the
    // Binder native event. Both zero and positive changes now wake the guest.
    BufferQueueCore sized{};
    BufferQueueProducer count_producer(sized);
    sized.consumer_listener = std::make_shared<IConsumerListener>();
    assert(count_producer.SetBufferCount(BufferQueueDefs::NUM_BUFFER_SLOTS+1) == Status::BadValue);
    assert(count_producer.event.signals.load() == 0);
    sized.slots[0].buffer_state = BufferState::Dequeued;
    assert(count_producer.SetBufferCount(0) == Status::BadValue);
    assert(count_producer.event.signals.load() == 0);
    sized.slots[0].buffer_state = BufferState::Free;
    assert(count_producer.SetBufferCount(0) == Status::NoError);
    assert(sized.override_max_buffer_count == 0);
    assert(count_producer.event.signals.load() == 1);
    assert(sized.dequeue_epoch.load() == 1);
    assert(sized.consumer_listener->calls == 0);
    assert(count_producer.SetBufferCount(2) == Status::NoError);
    assert(sized.override_max_buffer_count == 2);
    assert(count_producer.event.signals.load() == 2);
    assert(sized.dequeue_epoch.load() == 2);
    assert(sized.consumer_listener->calls == 1);

    // F05: CancelBuffer is another producer release that must notify the
    // mock guest kernel only after releasing core->mutex. MockEvent::Signal
    // executes a synchronous cross-thread try_lock witness for this.
    BufferQueueCore cancelled{};
    BufferQueueProducer canceller(cancelled);
    cancelled.slots[0].buffer_state = BufferState::Dequeued;
    canceller.CancelBuffer(-1, Fence{13});
    assert(canceller.event.signals.load() == 0);
    canceller.CancelBuffer(0, Fence{13});
    assert(cancelled.slots[0].buffer_state == BufferState::Free);
    assert(cancelled.slots[0].fence.sequence == 13);
    assert(cancelled.dequeue_epoch.load() == 1);
    assert(canceller.event.signals.load() == 1);
    canceller.CancelBuffer(0, Fence{15});
    assert(canceller.event.signals.load() == 1);
    cancelled.is_abandoned = true;
    cancelled.slots[0].buffer_state = BufferState::Dequeued;
    canceller.CancelBuffer(0, Fence{15});
    assert(canceller.event.signals.load() == 1);

    // Deterministically place TWO producers inside the actual core condition
    // wait: each must release the mutex for the next one to enter.
    // The selected DetachNextBuffer must broadcast its generation update.
    for (int round = 0; round < 50; ++round) {
        BufferQueueCore blocked{};
        BufferQueueProducer detacher(blocked);
        blocked.slots[0].graphic_buffer = std::make_shared<GraphicBuffer>(GraphicBuffer{round});
        blocked.slots[0].frame_number = 1;
        std::atomic<int> entered{};
        std::atomic<int> woke{};
        auto waiter = [&] {
            std::unique_lock lock(blocked.mutex);
            entered.fetch_add(1);
            const bool awakened = blocked.WaitForDequeueCondition(lock);
            if (awakened) woke.fetch_add(1);
        };
        std::thread first(waiter), second(waiter);
        while (entered.load() != 2) std::this_thread::yield();
        // Acquiring core mutex guarantees both waiters have entered wait().
        { std::unique_lock lock(blocked.mutex); }
        std::shared_ptr<GraphicBuffer> detached{};
        Fence detached_fence{};
        assert(detacher.DetachNextBuffer(&detached, &detached_fence) == Status::NoError);
        assert(detached && detached->payload == round);
        using namespace std::chrono_literals;
        const auto deadline = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() + 2s;
        while (woke.load() != 2 && std::chrono::steady_clock::now() < deadline)
            std::this_thread::yield();
        assert(woke.load() == 2);
        assert(blocked.dequeue_epoch.load() == 1);
        assert(detacher.event.signals.load() == 1);
        first.join();
        second.join();
    }
}
"""
compiler = shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++") or shutil.which("c++")
assert compiler, "host C++ compiler required"
```

```py
    return start + text.split(start, 1)[1].split(end, 1)[0]

        node.value for node in tree.body
        if isinstance(node, ast.Assign)
        and len(node.targets) == 1
        and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name)
        and node.targets[0].id == name
    ]
    assert len(matches) == 1, f"host fixture {name} changed"
    return ast.literal_eval(matches[0])
```

```py
"""Compile pinned PhysicalCore::RunThread / Interrupt / ClearInterrupt.

Deterministic host-only fake JIT shows that SignalInterrupt requests a
break but does not acknowledge ExitContext, and ClearInterrupt permits
another native RunThread admission with no tracked-page epoch guard.
NO native runtime hook, device fence, or #187 activation is implemented.

import subprocess
import tempfile

                "\n} // namespace Kernel")
```
