```py
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <mutex>
#include <semaphore>
#include <thread>
namespace Kernel { class KThread; class KProcess; class KernelCore; }
namespace Core {
enum class HaltReason : unsigned {
    StepThread=1, SupervisorCall=2, PrefetchAbort=4,
    InstructionBreakpoint=8, DataAbort=16, BreakLoop=32
};
constexpr HaltReason operator&(HaltReason x, HaltReason y) {
    return static_cast<HaltReason>(static_cast<unsigned>(x)&static_cast<unsigned>(y));
}
struct Debugger {
    void NotifyThreadStopped(Kernel::KThread*) {}
    void NotifyThreadWatchpoint(Kernel::KThread*, int) {}
};
struct System {
    Debugger debugger;
    bool DebuggerEnabled() const { return false; }
    Debugger& GetDebugger() { return debugger; }
};
class ArmInterface {
public:
    std::binary_semaphore entered{0}, release_run{0};
    std::atomic<unsigned> runs{0}, signals{0}, unlocks{0};
    int watchpoint=0;
    void Initialize() {}
    void LockThread(Kernel::KThread*) {}
    void UnlockThread(Kernel::KThread*) { ++unlocks; }
    HaltReason RunThread(Kernel::KThread*) {
        ++runs;
        entered.release();
        release_run.acquire();
        return HaltReason::BreakLoop;
    }
    HaltReason StepThread(Kernel::KThread*) { return HaltReason::StepThread; }
    void SignalInterrupt(Kernel::KThread*) { ++signals; }
    void GetContext(std::uint64_t&) {}
    void RewindBreakpointInstruction() {}
    void LogBacktrace(Kernel::KProcess*) {}
    int* HaltedWatchpoint() { return &watchpoint; }
    unsigned GetSvcNumber() const { return 0; }
};
}
constexpr bool True(Core::HaltReason reason) {
    return static_cast<unsigned>(reason) != 0;
}
namespace Kernel {
enum class StepState { None, StepPending, StepPerformed };
enum class SuspendType { Debug };
class KProcess {
public:
    explicit KProcess(Core::ArmInterface& arm): interface(&arm) {}
    Core::ArmInterface* GetArmInterface(std::size_t) { return interface; }
private:
    Core::ArmInterface* interface;
};
class KThread {
public:
    explicit KThread(KProcess& p) : process(&p) {}
    KProcess* GetOwnerProcess() { return process; }
    bool HasDpc() const { return false; }
    bool IsTerminationRequested() const { return false; }
    void Exit(KernelCore&) { std::abort(); }
    StepState GetStepState() const { return state; }
    void SetStepState(StepState v) { state=v; }
    void RequestSuspend(KernelCore&, SuspendType) {}
    std::uint64_t& GetContext() { return context; }
private:
    KProcess* process;
    StepState state{StepState::None};
    std::uint64_t context{};
};
class KernelCore {
public:
    explicit KernelCore(Core::System& s) : sys(s) {}
    Core::System& System() { return sys; }
private:
    Core::System& sys;
};
namespace Svc {
void Call(Core::System&, unsigned) {}
}
class PhysicalCore {
public:
    void RunThread(KernelCore&, KThread*);
    void Interrupt();
    void ClearInterrupt();
private:
    std::size_t m_core_index=0;
    std::mutex m_guard;
    std::condition_variable m_on_interrupt;
    Core::ArmInterface* m_arm_interface{};
    KThread* m_current_thread{};
    bool m_is_interrupted=false;
    bool m_is_single_core=false;
};
"""
postlude = r"""
} // namespace Kernel
int main() {
    Core::System system;
    Core::ArmInterface arm;
    Kernel::KernelCore kernel(system);
    Kernel::KProcess process(arm);
    Kernel::KThread thread(process);
    Kernel::PhysicalCore core;
    std::atomic<bool> returned{false};
    std::thread first([&] {
        core.RunThread(kernel, &thread);
        returned.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    });
    arm.entered.acquire();
    assert(arm.runs == 1 && arm.unlocks == 0);
    core.Interrupt();
    assert(arm.signals == 1);
    assert(!returned.load(std::memory_order_acquire));
    assert(arm.unlocks == 0); // Requested != acknowledged EXIT.
    std::puts("PINNED_PHYSICAL_CORE_INTERRUPT_REQUEST_NOT_EXIT_ACK_PASS");
    arm.release_run.release();
    first.join();
    assert(returned.load(std::memory_order_acquire));
    assert(arm.unlocks == 1);
    // The persistent interrupt prevents immediate restart.
    core.RunThread(kernel, &thread);
    assert(arm.runs == 1);
    std::puts("PINNED_PHYSICAL_CORE_INTERRUPT_BLOCKS_REENTRY_PASS");
    // Clearing the interrupt alone now allows a new run. There is no
    // native page-transition generation or GPU first-use admission fence.
    core.ClearInterrupt();
    std::thread second([&] { core.RunThread(kernel, &thread); });
    arm.entered.acquire();
    assert(arm.runs == 2 && arm.unlocks == 1);
    core.Interrupt();
    arm.release_run.release();
    second.join();
    assert(arm.signals == 2 && arm.unlocks == 2);
    std::puts("PINNED_PHYSICAL_CORE_CLEAR_ALLOWS_NEW_RUN_PASS");
    std::puts("PINNED_PHYSICAL_CORE_NATIVE_HANDOFF_UNQUALIFIED");
}
"""
compiler = shutil.which("g++") or shutil.which("clang++")
assert compiler, "C++20 host compiler required"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-physical-core-") as tmp:
    code = Path(tmp) / "physical.cpp"
    binary = Path(tmp) / "physical"
    code.write_text(prelude + "\n" + run + "\n" + interrupt + "\n" + clear + "\n" + postlude)
    subprocess.run([compiler, "-std=c++20", "-O2", "-Wall", "-Wextra",
                    "-Werror", "-pthread", str(code), "-o", str(binary)],
                   check=True, timeout=30)
    result = subprocess.run([str(binary)], check=True, capture_output=True,
                            text=True, timeout=15)
    print(result.stdout, end="")
```

```py
                           uint64_t,uint16_t,uint16_t,int8_t,int32_t) {
    assert((event==40 && gcr==0x30c && (data==1 || data==3)) ||
           (event==45 && gcr==12 && data==0));
    auto** pointers=(uint32_t**)cb; pointers[2]+=8; return pointers[2];
}
int sceAgcDriverSubmitDcb(void* s) {
    ++seen->submit; auto* words=*(uint32_t**)s; assert(words==storage);
    if (failure==1) return -1;
    if (!failure) { *(uint64_t*)(words+1024)=200; *(uint64_t*)(words+1040)=250; words[1056]=101; }
    return 0;
}
}
int main() {
    seen=(Counts*)mmap(nullptr,sizeof(*seen),PROT_READ|PROT_WRITE,MAP_SHARED|MAP_ANONYMOUS,-1,0);

        assert(seen->submit==(failure?1:64));
        assert(seen->unmap==2*!failure && seen->release==2*!failure);
        assert(seen->suspend==(failure?1:66));
    }
```

```py
"""Compile actual heap-commit function with/without DEV heap-growth logging."""

constexpr std::size_t LargePage=2u*1024u*1024u;
int timestamp_calls=0;
int logs=0;

    assert(bytes==LargePage && align==LargePage);
    *physical=1337; return 0;
}
int sceKernelMapDirectMemory(void** at, std::size_t bytes, int perm, int flags,
                             std::int64_t phys, std::size_t align) {
    assert(*at!=nullptr && bytes==LargePage && phys==1337 && align==LargePage);
    assert(perm==(PROT_READ|PROT_WRITE) && flags==MAP_FIXED);
    return 0;
}
int sceKernelReleaseDirectMemory(std::int64_t, std::size_t) {abort();}
bool cpu_mapping_range(const void*, std::size_t) {return true;}
void Note(const char*) {++logs;}
#define clock_gettime(clock, address) (++timestamp_calls, (void)(clock), (void)(address), 0)
__BODY__
#undef clock_gettime

int main() {
```

`tools/check-native-shader-cache-eligibility.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Read-only native shader-cache context; never infer cache hits from setup.

The production driver bypasses Mesa's real/effective credential gate on
__PROSPERO__, while preserving it on other OSes. A stale source pin is not
evidence of the active driver behavior. A configured directory is not proof
of shader cache writes or hits.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
EVENT = "EDEN_GPU_DISK_CACHE_CONTEXT"
FIELDS = ("uid_match", "gid_match", "directory_ready", "disable_env_present")
LINE = re.compile(r"\b([a-z_]+)=(\d+)\b")


def evaluate(log: str) -> dict:
    matches = [line for line in log.splitlines() if line.startswith(EVENT+" ")]
    if not matches:
        return {"status": "NOT_MEASURED", "cache_hits_proven": False}
    values = dict(LINE.findall(matches[-1]))
    if any(key not in values for key in FIELDS):
        return {"status": "INVALID_SAMPLE", "cache_hits_proven": False}
    flags = {k: int(values[k]) for k in FIELDS}
    if any(val not in (0, 1) for val in flags.values()):
        return {"status": "INVALID_SAMPLE", "cache_hits_proven": False}
    if not flags["directory_ready"]:
        status = "DIRECTORY_MISSING"
    elif flags["disable_env_present"]:
        status = "DISABLE_ENV_VALUE_UNCHECKED"
    elif not flags["uid_match"] or not flags["gid_match"]:
        # The native port bypasses __normal_user on PS5 specifically.
        status = "NATIVE_CREDENTIAL_MISMATCH_ALLOWED_NOT_HIT_VERIFIED"
    else:
        status = "NATIVE_CREDENTIALS_MATCH_NOT_HIT_VERIFIED"
    return {"status": status, "flags": flags, "cache_hits_proven": False}


def self_test():
    native = (ROOT / "headless/main.cpp").read_text()
    base = (ROOT / "vendor/sources/ps5-mesa/src/util/disk_cache_os.c").read_text()
    active = (ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/ps5-mesa/src/util/disk_cache_os.c").read_text()
    mesa = (ROOT / "vendor/sources/ps5-mesa/src/util/u_debug.h").read_text()
    assert "return geteuid() == getuid() && getegid() == getgid();" in mesa
    old = "   if (!__normal_user())\n      return false;"
    assert base.count(old) == 1
    assert active.count(old) == 1
    assert "#if !defined(__PROSPERO__)\n"+old+"\n#endif" in active
    assert 'MESA_SHADER_CACHE_DISABLE' in active
    assert native.count(EVENT) == 1
    assert "const bool cache_uid_match = getuid() == geteuid();" in native
    assert "const bool cache_gid_match = getgid() == getegid();" in native
    assert native.index(EVENT) < native.index('setenv("MESA_SHADER_CACHE_DIR"')
    assert "setegid(getgid())" not in native
    assert evaluate("EDEN_RADV_DISK_CACHE limit_mib=2048 free_mib=16384")["status"] == "NOT_MEASURED"
    line = EVENT+" uid_match={uid_match} gid_match={gid_match} directory_ready={directory_ready} disable_env_present={disable_env_present}"
    def check(status, **overrides):
        flags=dict(uid_match=1,gid_match=1,directory_ready=1,disable_env_present=0)
        flags.update(overrides)
        assert evaluate(line.format(**flags))["status"] == status
    check("NATIVE_CREDENTIALS_MATCH_NOT_HIT_VERIFIED")
    check("NATIVE_CREDENTIAL_MISMATCH_ALLOWED_NOT_HIT_VERIFIED", uid_match=0)
    check("NATIVE_CREDENTIAL_MISMATCH_ALLOWED_NOT_HIT_VERIFIED", gid_match=0)
    check("DIRECTORY_MISSING", directory_ready=0)
    check("DISABLE_ENV_VALUE_UNCHECKED", disable_env_present=1)
    assert evaluate(EVENT+" uid_match=1")["status"] == "INVALID_SAMPLE"
    print("NATIVE_SHADER_CACHE_CONTEXT_PASS native_guard_bypassed host_guard_kept no_cache_hits_assumed")


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--self-test", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("log", nargs="?", type=Path)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    if args.self_test:self_test()
    elif args.log:print(json.dumps(evaluate(args.log.read_text(errors="replace")),indent=2))
    else:parser.error("Provide --self-test or a read-only log path")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

```py
"""Compile selected native single-range GPU invalidation methods and test lock elision."""
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
src = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_rasterizer.cpp").read_text()
def take(begin, end):
    return src[src.index(begin):src.index(end, src.index(begin))]
inv = take("void RasterizerVulkan::InvalidateRegion(", "void RasterizerVulkan::InnerInvalidation(")
cache = take("void RasterizerVulkan::OnCacheInvalidation(", "void RasterizerVulkan::InvalidateGPUCache()")

#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <mutex>
#include <vector>
#include <utility>
#include "buffer_pages.h"
using DAddr = std::uint64_t;
using u64 = std::uint64_t;
namespace VideoCommon {
enum class CacheType: unsigned {
    BufferCache=1u, TextureCache=2u, QueryCache=4u, ShaderCache=8u
};
inline CacheType operator&(CacheType a, CacheType b) {
    return static_cast<CacheType>(static_cast<unsigned>(a)&static_cast<unsigned>(b));
}
}
inline bool True(VideoCommon::CacheType type) {
    return static_cast<unsigned>(type) != 0;
}
namespace Eden::ImagePages {
inline bool held = false;
inline bool NeverHeld(u64, u64) { return !held; }
}
struct CountMutex {
    std::mutex impl;
    unsigned locks = 0;
    void lock() { impl.lock(); ++locks; }
    void unlock() { impl.unlock(); }
};
struct Cache {
    CountMutex mutex;
    std::vector<std::pair<DAddr,u64>> written;
    void WriteMemory(DAddr a, u64 sz) { written.emplace_back(a,sz); }
};
struct Owner {
    unsigned calls=0;
    void InvalidateRegion(DAddr, u64) { ++calls; }
};
struct RasterizerVulkan {
    Cache texture_cache, buffer_cache;
    Owner query_cache, pipeline_cache;
    void InvalidateRegion(DAddr, u64, VideoCommon::CacheType);
    void OnCacheInvalidation(DAddr, u64);
};
''' + inv + cache + r'''
int main() {
    using VideoCommon::CacheType;
    using V = VideoCommon::CacheType;
    constexpr auto full = static_cast<V>(15);
    constexpr DAddr blank = 0x100000, prior = 0x200000;
    RasterizerVulkan empty;
    empty.InvalidateRegion(blank, 4096, full);
    assert(empty.buffer_cache.mutex.locks==0 && empty.buffer_cache.written.empty());
    assert(empty.texture_cache.mutex.locks==0);
    assert(empty.query_cache.calls==1 && empty.pipeline_cache.calls==1);
    empty.OnCacheInvalidation(blank,4096);
    assert(empty.buffer_cache.mutex.locks==0);
    assert(empty.pipeline_cache.calls==2);
    empty.InvalidateRegion(0,4096,full);
    empty.OnCacheInvalidation(blank,0);
    assert(empty.query_cache.calls==1 && empty.pipeline_cache.calls==2);
    // Existing or formerly-owned buffers must always take the lock.
    Eden::BufferPages::Mark(prior,4096);
    RasterizerVulkan known;
    known.InvalidateRegion(prior,4096,full);
    known.OnCacheInvalidation(prior,4096);
    assert(known.buffer_cache.mutex.locks==2 && known.buffer_cache.written.size()==2);
    assert(known.query_cache.calls==1 && known.pipeline_cache.calls==2);
    // Texture-only image ownership must not force buffer-cache work.
    Eden::ImagePages::held=true;
    RasterizerVulkan image;
    image.InvalidateRegion(blank,4096,full);
    image.OnCacheInvalidation(blank,4096);
    assert(image.texture_cache.written.size()==2);
    assert(image.buffer_cache.written.empty());
    assert(image.pipeline_cache.calls==2);
    Eden::ImagePages::held=false;
    // Registered-page bitmap queries now cover up to 256 KiB, with no
    // false buffer invalidation on an unowned 128 KiB span.
    RasterizerVulkan large;
    large.InvalidateRegion(0x300000,131072,full);
    large.OnCacheInvalidation(0x300000,131072);
    assert(large.buffer_cache.mutex.locks==0);
    assert(large.buffer_cache.written.empty());
    assert(large.query_cache.calls==1 && large.pipeline_cache.calls==2);
    // Larger requests must fail closed and keep the previous locking path.
    large.InvalidateRegion(0x300000,256*1024+1,full);
    large.OnCacheInvalidation(0x300000,256*1024+1);
    assert(large.buffer_cache.mutex.locks==2);
    assert(large.buffer_cache.written.size()==2);
    // Cache mask is respected: no unintended buffer invalidation.
    RasterizerVulkan isolated;
    isolated.InvalidateRegion(prior,4096,CacheType::ShaderCache);
    assert(isolated.buffer_cache.mutex.locks==0 && isolated.pipeline_cache.calls==1);
    // Unknown monotonic coverage forces the pre-existing buffer lock path.
    Eden::BufferPages::Mark(Eden::BufferPages::kSpace,4096);
    RasterizerVulkan unknown;
    unknown.InvalidateRegion(blank,4096,full);
    unknown.OnCacheInvalidation(blank,4096);
    assert(unknown.buffer_cache.mutex.locks==2);
    assert(unknown.query_cache.calls==1 && unknown.pipeline_cache.calls==2);
}
'''
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-unit-buffer-") as tmp:
```

`tools/check-native-source-syntax.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Fail early on native PS5 compilation errors without producing an application.

Reads the CMake compile database generated for the *current* tree and executes
Clang -fsyntax-only -Werror using each translation unit's real PS5 flags.
This is source validation, not a linker/package/hardware test.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shlex
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
TARGETS = (
    # The native release launcher owns runtime presentation telemetry. It must
    # compile with the real graphics backend, not merely pass host string tests.
    "headless/graphics.cpp",
    "headless/ps5_net_compat.c",
    "headless/network_domain_rules.c",
    "headless/network_audit.c",
    "headless/network_audit_sockets.c",
    "headless/main.cpp",
    "headless/performance.cpp",
    "headless/prosperoeden/eden_services.cpp",
    "headless/prosperoeden/pe/ui/home.cpp",
    "headless/prosperoeden/pe/ui/library.cpp",
    "headless/prosperoeden/pe/ui/launcher.cpp",
    "headless/prosperoeden/pe/ui/settings.cpp",
    "src/host_memory.cpp",
)
# These former generated units are now selected directly from maintained C++.
# Keep checking the actual sources instead of nonexistent historical outputs.
MAINTAINED_CORE_TARGETS = (
    "vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/shader_recompiler/frontend/maxwell/translate/impl/not_implemented.cpp",
    "vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/video_core/engines/fermi_2d_observed.cpp",
    "vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/video_core/engines/sw_blitter/blitter.cpp",
    "vendor/encore-active/eden-threading/src/core/hle/kernel/k_condition_variable.cpp",
    "vendor/encore-active/eden-threading/src/core/hle/kernel/k_scheduler.cpp",
    "vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/video_core/memory_manager.cpp",
    "vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/common/fiber.cpp",
)
# Native release renderer TUs share the selected CMake ABI header overlay.
# These use the pinned PS5 compiler's normal warning policy, not an extra
# blanket -Werror that would reject otherwise admissible legacy warnings.
NATIVE_GRAPHICS_TARGETS = (
    "headless/vulkan_blit_screen_r08.cpp",
    "headless/vulkan_renderer_r08.cpp",
    "headless/vulkan_window_adapt_r08.cpp",
    # The optical-flow wrapper must be checked with the *PS5* libc++:
    # unique_ptr's default constructor/destructor need the complete engine.
    "headless/fsr3_optical_session.cpp",
    # These graph owners must not disappear when CMake commits video_sources.
    "vendor/sources/ps5-fsr3-optical-flow/src/ps5_framegen.cpp",
    "headless/mihawk_native_session.cpp",
    "headless/lossless_dll_r08.cpp",
)
PINNED_CACHE_TARGETS = (
    "video_core/host1x/gpu_device_memory_manager.cpp",
    # First real native compiler failures in build #10 (881/1870). Keep
    # both source-owned ABI consumers inside the cheap PS5 syntax preflight.
    "video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_turbo_mode.cpp",
    "video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_texture_cache_base.cpp",
    # Explicit TextureCache<OpenGL> instantiation must reject native-only
    # image/view/sampler GPU pin methods at compile time (no fake pins).
    "video_core/renderer_opengl/gl_texture_cache_base.cpp",
)
GENERATED_TARGETS = (
    # Real PS5 PresentManager source compiled from the maintained Vulkan fork:
    # worker wakeups and waiter counters must match our selected header.
    "headless/vulkan_present_manager.cpp",
    "headless/vulkan_query_cache.cpp",
    "headless/a64_emit_x64.cpp",
    "headless/physical_core.cpp",
)

def syntax_check_flags(argv: list[str], generated: bool) -> list[str]:
    """Check with the actual target's warning policy, minus invalid Clang flags."""
    result = [flag for flag in argv if flag != "-Wno-error-all"]
    result += ["-fsyntax-only", "-ferror-limit=8"]
    if not generated:
        result.append("-Werror")
    return result


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("native_build_dir", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--allow-stale", action="store_true",
                        help="Local audit only: override cached source paths; never use for release CI")
    parser.add_argument("--only", action="append",
                        choices=(*TARGETS, *MAINTAINED_CORE_TARGETS, *NATIVE_GRAPHICS_TARGETS,
                                 *GENERATED_TARGETS, *PINNED_CACHE_TARGETS),
                        help="Compile just this real PS5 translation unit (repeatable)")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    db = args.native_build_dir.resolve() / "compile_commands.json"
    if not db.is_file():
        parser.error(f"native CMake compile database missing: {db}")
    records = json.loads(db.read_text())
    failures = []
    selected = tuple(args.only) if args.only else (
        *TARGETS, *MAINTAINED_CORE_TARGETS, *NATIVE_GRAPHICS_TARGETS,
        *GENERATED_TARGETS, *PINNED_CACHE_TARGETS)
    for relative in selected:
        source_root = (args.native_build_dir.resolve() if relative in GENERATED_TARGETS else
                       args.native_build_dir.resolve().parent / "source/src"
                       if relative in PINNED_CACHE_TARGETS else ROOT)
        source = source_root / relative
        entries = [row for row in records if Path(row["file"]).as_posix().endswith("/" + relative)]
        if not entries and args.allow_stale and relative.endswith(".c"):
            # Older cached CMake configuration predates the newly added native C unit.
            entries = [row for row in records if row["file"].endswith("/src/aligned_alloc.c")]
        if len(entries) != 1:
            failures.append(f"{relative}: expected one native compile command, got {len(entries)}")
            continue
        entry = entries[0]
        old = Path(entry["file"])
        if not args.allow_stale and old.resolve() != source.resolve():
            failures.append(f"{relative}: stale build command points at {old}")
            continue
        argv = list(entry["arguments"]) if "arguments" in entry else shlex.split(entry["command"])
        if "-c" not in argv or "-o" not in argv:
            failures.append(f"{relative}: expected compile-only CMake command")
            continue
        argv.pop(argv.index("-c"))
        pos = argv.index("-o")
        del argv[pos:pos + 2]
        # Last non-flag source argument in the original command is replaced with
        # the current fork path (even when using a deliberately stale local DB).
        previous = str(entry["file"])
        try:
            pos = argv.index(previous)
        except ValueError:
            failures.append(f"{relative}: source missing from compiler command")
            continue
        argv[pos] = str(source)
        if args.allow_stale:
            argv[1:1] = ["-I" + str(ROOT / "headless/prosperoeden"),
                         "-I" + str(ROOT / "headless"),
                         "-I" + str(ROOT / "src")]
        # The pinned Eden CMake flags contain "-Wno-error-all", which Clang 18
        # does not recognize. Ninja tolerates that diagnostic, but this
        # standalone preflight deliberately adds -Werror and would fail before
        # checking any generated GPU code. Drop only that unsupported flag.
        # Match real native warning severity: generated shader/Fermi objects
        # compile without -Werror, unlike the fork-owned launcher objects.
        argv = syntax_check_flags(
            argv, generated=relative in (*MAINTAINED_CORE_TARGETS, *NATIVE_GRAPHICS_TARGETS,
                                   *GENERATED_TARGETS, *PINNED_CACHE_TARGETS))
        try:
            check = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=entry["directory"], text=True,
                                   stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=120)
        except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as exc:
            failures.append(f"{relative}: {exc}")
            continue
        if check.returncode:
            failures.append(f"{relative}:\n{check.stderr[:3500]}")
        else:
            print(f"PS5 syntax PASS: {relative}", flush=True)
    if failures:
        print("\n".join(failures), file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
        return 1
    print(f"PS5 native syntax preflight PASS ({len(selected)} translation units; no app build)")
    return 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

```

`tools/check-native-sparse-decommit-lock-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
"""Compile actual sparse range lookup/decommit under concurrent range reuse.

The range's non-atomic end/owned metadata is protected by sparse_mutex.
Decommit must not scan the table before acquiring that mutex. Also verify
real host page zeroing, read-only remap and dense fallback.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
source = (root / "src/memory_pages.cpp").read_text()
lookup_anchor = "SparseRange* SparseRangeOf(std::uintptr_t address) {"
lookup_end = "\n#ifdef PS5_NATIVE\nstd::int64_t zero_block"
decommit_anchor = "void DecommitSparsePage(std::uintptr_t page) noexcept {"
decommit_end = "\n// Address space the sparse tables span"
assert source.count(lookup_anchor) == 1
assert source.count(decommit_anchor) == 1
assert "std::size_t sparse_used_prefix = 0;" in source
assert "std::uint64_t sparse_range_generation = 1;" in source
assert "last_negative_generation == sparse_range_generation" in source
assert "auto remaining_slots = sparse_live_slots;" in source
assert "std::countr_zero(remaining_slots)" in source
assert "std::countr_one(sparse_live_slots)" in source
lookup = lookup_anchor + source.split(lookup_anchor, 1)[1].split(lookup_end, 1)[0]
decommit = decommit_anchor + source.split(decommit_anchor, 1)[1].split(decommit_end, 1)[0]
assert decommit.count("SparseRangeOf(page)") == 1, "avoid the unlocked duplicate 64-slot scan"
assert decommit.index("const std::lock_guard lock{sparse_mutex};") < decommit.index(
    "SparseRangeOf(page)"), "range.end and range.owned must be read under sparse_mutex"
assert "range->owned[slot].store(false, std::memory_order_release);" in decommit
assert "sparse_committed.fetch_sub(SparseSlot, std::memory_order_relaxed);" in decommit
compiler = shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
assert compiler, "C++20 compiler required"

prefix = r'''
#include <array>
#include <atomic>
#include <bit>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>
#include <sys/mman.h>
#include <unistd.h>
const std::size_t SparseSlot = static_cast<std::size_t>(sysconf(_SC_PAGESIZE));
struct SparseRange {
    std::atomic<std::uintptr_t> begin{0};
    std::uintptr_t end = 0;
    std::atomic<bool>* owned = nullptr;
    std::int64_t* physical = nullptr;
};
std::array<SparseRange, 64> sparse_ranges{};
std::size_t sparse_used_prefix = 0;
std::uint64_t sparse_live_slots = 0;
std::uint64_t sparse_range_generation = 1; // same mutex-owned topology epoch as source
std::mutex sparse_mutex;
std::atomic<std::size_t> sparse_committed{0};
'''
suffix = r'''
int main() {
    auto* p = static_cast<unsigned char*>(mmap(nullptr, 2 * SparseSlot,
        PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS, -1, 0));
    auto* dense = static_cast<unsigned char*>(mmap(nullptr, SparseSlot,
        PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS, -1, 0));
    assert(p != MAP_FAILED && dense != MAP_FAILED);
    std::memset(p, 0xAB, 2 * SparseSlot);
    std::memset(dense, 0xCD, SparseSlot);
    std::atomic<bool> owned[2];
    owned[0].store(true); owned[1].store(true);
    std::int64_t physical[2]{0, 0};
    auto& range = sparse_ranges[0];
    range.owned = owned;
    range.physical = physical;
    range.end = reinterpret_cast<std::uintptr_t>(p) + 2 * SparseSlot;
    range.begin.store(reinterpret_cast<std::uintptr_t>(p), std::memory_order_release);
    sparse_used_prefix = 1; // slot zero is now published, matching production
    sparse_live_slots = 1; // same owner-lock publication as production
    ++sparse_range_generation;
    sparse_committed.store(2 * SparseSlot);
    DecommitSparsePage(reinterpret_cast<std::uintptr_t>(p));
    assert(!owned[0].load() && owned[1].load());
    assert(sparse_committed.load() == SparseSlot);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < SparseSlot; ++i) assert(p[i] == 0);
    DecommitSparsePage(reinterpret_cast<std::uintptr_t>(p)); // idempotent
    assert(sparse_committed.load() == SparseSlot);
    DecommitSparsePage(reinterpret_cast<std::uintptr_t>(p + SparseSlot));
    assert(!owned[1].load() && sparse_committed.load() == 0);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < SparseSlot; ++i) assert(p[SparseSlot + i] == 0);
    DecommitSparsePage(reinterpret_cast<std::uintptr_t>(dense)); // dense fallback
    DecommitSparsePage(reinterpret_cast<std::uintptr_t>(dense)); // exact negative memo
    assert(dense[0] == 0xCD && dense[SparseSlot - 1] == 0xCD);

    // Reuse the range slot while a dense lookup repeatedly scans it.
    // Writers and the source-extracted Decommit both use sparse_mutex.
    std::thread writer([&] {
        for (int i = 0; i < 4096; ++i) {
            std::lock_guard lock{sparse_mutex};
            range.begin.store(0, std::memory_order_release);
            sparse_live_slots = 0;
            range.end = reinterpret_cast<std::uintptr_t>(p) + 2 * SparseSlot;
            range.begin.store(reinterpret_cast<std::uintptr_t>(p), std::memory_order_release);
            sparse_live_slots = 1;
            ++sparse_range_generation; // retirement and re-registration invalidate misses
        }
    });
    for (int i = 0; i < 4096; ++i)
        DecommitSparsePage(reinterpret_cast<std::uintptr_t>(dense));
    writer.join();
    assert(sparse_committed.load() == 0);
    assert(munmap(p, 2 * SparseSlot) == 0);
    assert(munmap(dense, SparseSlot) == 0);
}
'''
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-sparse-decommit-") as tmp:
    path = Path(tmp) / "sparse-decommit.cpp"
    binary = Path(tmp) / "sparse-decommit"
    path.write_text(prefix + lookup + "\n" + decommit + "\n" + suffix)
    for optimization in ("-O0", "-O2"):
        subprocess.run([compiler, "-std=c++20", optimization, "-pthread", "-Wall", "-Wextra",
                        "-Werror", "-fsanitize=undefined", "-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
                        str(path), "-o", str(binary)], check=True)
        subprocess.run([str(binary)], check=True)
print("SPARSE_DECOMMIT_LOCK_PASS: source-extracted O0/O2 UBSan, single scan under lock, page reuse")
```

```py
"""Dev sparse JIT: exercise exact quiesced physical-tail trim and reuse policy.

The native source's guard/unmap/free ordering is compiled under a syscall
fixture, not rewritten as a Python approximation. Shipping sparse is native-only.
"""
from pathlib import Path

import subprocess
import tempfile

#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>

#include <sys/mman.h>
#include "jit-sparse-commit.h"
namespace Common {
constexpr std::size_t LargePage=2u<<20;
struct SparseJitRegion {
    void* writable{};
    std::size_t capacity{},committed{};
    std::vector<std::int64_t> physical;
};
std::mutex sparse_jit_mutex;
std::unordered_map<void*,SparseJitRegion> sparse_jit_regions;
std::size_t sparse_jit_committed=0;
std::atomic<std::size_t> sparse_jit_committed_live{0};
std::atomic<std::uint64_t> sparse_jit_generation{1};
std::size_t guarded{},released{};
int sceKernelReleaseDirectMemory(std::int64_t, std::size_t length) {
    assert(length==LargePage);
    assert(guarded==(released+1)*2); // BOTH aliases guarded before physical free
    ++released;
    return 0;
}
void* FakeGuard(void* addr,std::size_t length,int prot,int flags,int fd,long off) {
    assert(addr && length==LargePage && prot==PROT_NONE);
    assert(flags & MAP_FIXED);
    assert(fd==-1 && off==0);
    ++guarded;
    return addr;
}
#define mmap FakeGuard
""" + method + r"""
#undef mmap
} // namespace Common
int main() {
    using namespace Common;
    constexpr std::size_t capacity=256u<<20;
    const auto rx=::mmap(nullptr,capacity,PROT_NONE,MAP_PRIVATE|MAP_ANONYMOUS,-1,0);
    const auto rw=::mmap(nullptr,capacity,PROT_NONE,MAP_PRIVATE|MAP_ANONYMOUS,-1,0);
    assert(rx!=MAP_FAILED && rw!=MAP_FAILED);
    auto& state=sparse_jit_regions[rx];
    state.writable=rw;
    state.capacity=capacity;
    state.committed=128u<<20;
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<state.committed/LargePage;++i)
        state.physical.push_back(static_cast<std::int64_t>(i));
    sparse_jit_committed=state.committed;
    sparse_jit_committed_live.store(state.committed);
    const auto generation=sparse_jit_generation.load();
    assert(TrimSparseJitCode(rx,3u<<20));
    assert(state.committed==(6u<<20));
    assert(sparse_jit_committed==(6u<<20));
    assert(sparse_jit_committed_live.load()==(6u<<20));
    assert(released==61 && guarded==122);
    assert(sparse_jit_generation.load()>generation);
    // A stale positive fastpath from before clearing must no longer qualify.
    const auto old_generation=generation;
    assert(old_generation!=sparse_jit_generation.load());
    const auto next=Eden::Jit::PlanSparseCommit(state.committed,LargePage,capacity);
    assert(next.valid && next.bytes==(8u<<20));
    const auto no_more=Eden::Jit::PlanSparseTrim(3u<<20,state.committed,capacity,LargePage);
    assert(no_more.valid && no_more.release==0);
    assert(TrimSparseJitCode(rx,3u<<20));
    assert(released==61);
    assert(!TrimSparseJitCode(rx,7u<<20));
    assert(released==61);
    // The final 16-MiB arena must never decommit past a live 15-MiB prelude.
    const auto tiny=Eden::Jit::PlanSparseTrim(15u<<20,16u<<20,16u<<20,LargePage);
    assert(tiny.valid && tiny.release==0);
    assert(::munmap(rx,capacity)==0 && ::munmap(rw,capacity)==0);
}
"""
compiler=shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
```

```py
           sparse_ranges[sparse_used_prefix - 1].begin.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) == 0)

    body = source[source.index(function):]
    assert body.index("const std::lock_guard lock{sparse_mutex};") < body.index(
        "SparseRangeOf("), function
compiler = shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
assert compiler, "C++20 host compiler required"
fixture = r"""
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <atomic>
#include <bit>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstddef>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>
#include <cstdio>
#include <new>
#include <sys/mman.h>

inline std::atomic<unsigned> scans{0};
struct CountAtomic {
    std::atomic<std::uintptr_t> value{0};
    std::uintptr_t load(std::memory_order order) const noexcept {
        scans.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        return value.load(order);
    }
    void store(std::uintptr_t v, std::memory_order order) noexcept {
        value.store(v, order);
    }
};
struct SparseRange {
    CountAtomic begin;
    std::uintptr_t end{};
    std::atomic<bool>* owned{};
    std::int64_t* physical{};
};
std::array<SparseRange, 64> sparse_ranges{};
std::mutex sparse_mutex;
std::size_t sparse_used_prefix = 0;
std::uint64_t sparse_live_slots = 0;
std::uint64_t sparse_range_generation = 1;
constexpr std::size_t SparseSlot = 2u << 20;
std::atomic<std::size_t> sparse_reserved{0};
std::atomic<unsigned> dense_fallbacks{0};
std::atomic<bool> block_reserve{false}, reserve_entered{false}, allow_reserve{false};
std::atomic<bool> fail_reserve{false};
constexpr std::uintptr_t DenseSentinel = 0x77770000;
bool SparseAvailable() { return true; }
void* AllocateMemoryPages(std::size_t) {
    dense_fallbacks.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    return reinterpret_cast<void*>(DenseSentinel);
}
void Report(const char*) {}
void* ReserveSparse(std::size_t bytes) {
    if (block_reserve.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        reserve_entered.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
        while (!allow_reserve.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) std::this_thread::yield();
    }
    if (fail_reserve.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) return nullptr;
    void* p = mmap(nullptr, bytes, PROT_NONE, MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS, -1, 0);
    return p == MAP_FAILED ? nullptr : p;
}
__LOOKUP__
SparseRange* ChooseFreeRange() {
    std::lock_guard lock{sparse_mutex};
__SELECT_FREE__
    return free_range;
}
void Register(unsigned slot, std::uintptr_t begin) {
    std::lock_guard lock{sparse_mutex};
    assert(slot < sparse_ranges.size() && begin != 0);
    auto* free_range = &sparse_ranges[slot];
    assert(free_range->begin.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) == 0);
    free_range->end = begin + 4096;
    free_range->begin.store(begin, std::memory_order_release);
__PUBLISH_MASK__
__PUBLISH__
    ++sparse_range_generation;
}
void Release(unsigned slot) {
    std::lock_guard lock{sparse_mutex};
    SparseRange& range = sparse_ranges[slot];
    range.begin.store(0, std::memory_order_release);
__RETIRE_MASK__
__SHRINK__
    ++sparse_range_generation;
}
SparseRange* Lookup(std::uintptr_t address) {
    std::lock_guard lock{sparse_mutex};
    return SparseRangeOf(address);
}
__ALLOCATE__
void ReleaseAllocation(void* address) {
    std::lock_guard lock{sparse_mutex};
    SparseRange* range = SparseRangeOf(reinterpret_cast<std::uintptr_t>(address));
    assert(range != nullptr && range->owned && range->physical);
    const auto begin = reinterpret_cast<std::uintptr_t>(address);
    const auto span = range->end - begin;
    assert(munmap(address, span) == 0);
    delete[] range->owned;
    delete[] range->physical;
    range->owned = nullptr;
    range->physical = nullptr;
    range->begin.store(0, std::memory_order_release);
    sparse_live_slots &= ~(std::uint64_t{1} << static_cast<unsigned>(range - sparse_ranges.data()));
    ++sparse_range_generation;
    while (sparse_used_prefix > 0 &&
           sparse_ranges[sparse_used_prefix - 1].begin.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) == 0)
        --sparse_used_prefix;
    sparse_reserved.fetch_sub(span, std::memory_order_relaxed);
}
int main() {
    scans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 10000; ++i) assert(!Lookup(0x1000 + (i & 63)));
    assert(scans.load() == 0); // zero-prefix avoids TLS hints and all 64 slots
    assert(ChooseFreeRange() == &sparse_ranges[0] && scans.load() == 0);
    Register(0, 0x1000);
    scans = 0;
    assert(ChooseFreeRange() == &sparse_ranges[1] && scans.load() == 0);
    scans = 0;
    assert(Lookup(0x1000) == &sparse_ranges[0]);
    assert(scans.load() == 1 && sparse_used_prefix == 1);
    scans = 0;
    assert(!Lookup(0x2000));
    assert(scans.load() == 1);
    Register(1, 0x2000);
    // Same exact address was negatively cached before registration.
    assert(Lookup(0x2000) == &sparse_ranges[1]);
    assert(Lookup(0x2001) == &sparse_ranges[1]);
    assert(sparse_used_prefix == 2);
    scans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 10000; ++i)
        assert(Lookup(0x2000 + (i % 64)) == &sparse_ranges[1]);
    assert(scans.load() == 10000); // one load per adjacent in-range page
    Release(0);
    scans = 0;
    assert(ChooseFreeRange() == &sparse_ranges[0] && scans.load() == 0);
    assert(!Lookup(0x1001));
    assert(Lookup(0x2001) == &sparse_ranges[1]);
    assert(sparse_used_prefix == 2); // holes may not end the scan
    Register(0, 0x3000);
    assert(Lookup(0x3001) == &sparse_ranges[0]);
    assert(Lookup(0x2001) == &sparse_ranges[1]);
    Register(63, 0x5000);
    scans = 0;
    assert(ChooseFreeRange() == &sparse_ranges[2] && scans.load() == 0);
    assert(sparse_used_prefix == 64);
    // Slots 0, 1 and 63 are live; skip 61 empty begin atomics.
    scans = 0;
    assert(!Lookup(0xdead1000));
    assert(scans.load() <= 3);
    assert(Lookup(0x5001) == &sparse_ranges[63]);
    scans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 10000; ++i)
        assert(Lookup(0x5000 + (i % 64)) == &sparse_ranges[63]);
    assert(scans.load() == 10000); // previously 64 probes per high-slot hit
    // A worker alternating low/high page tables cannot afford a 64-slot
    // scan on every second access. Two hints stabilize after warmup without
    // mutating TLS on hits; both pointers stay range-locked and revalidated.
    scans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 10000; ++i) {
        assert(Lookup(0x3001) == &sparse_ranges[0]);
        assert(Lookup(0x5001) == &sparse_ranges[63]);
    }
    assert(scans.load() <= 40004); // <= 4 probes per alternating pair
    // Full-prefix misses cost up to 64 atomics; repeat the exact same
    // negative lookup without scanning the full table again.
    scans = 0;
    assert(!Lookup(0xdead0000));
    assert(scans.load() >= 3);
    scans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 10000; ++i) assert(!Lookup(0xdead0000));
    assert(scans.load() == 0); // same-epoch exact misses bypass positive atomics
    // Four alternating exact dense addresses must remain negative-cache
    // hits, without four repeated 64-entry scans each cycle.
    const std::uintptr_t dense_addresses[4]{
        0xcafe1000, 0xcafe2000, 0xcafe3000, 0xcafe4000
    };
    for (const auto address : dense_addresses) assert(!Lookup(address));
    scans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 10000; ++i)
        assert(!Lookup(dense_addresses[i & 3]));
    assert(scans.load() <= 10000); // cold four-way misses probe <=1 preferred positive atomic
    // A full negative ring must not slow the ordinary positive hot path:
    // 10k hits on the preferred live range require exactly one begin load.
    scans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 10000; ++i) assert(Lookup(0x5001) == &sparse_ranges[63]);
    assert(scans.load() == 10000); // no four-address scan before positive hit
    // A fifth distinct miss can evict the oldest negative hint safely.
    assert(!Lookup(0xcafe5000));
    assert(!Lookup(dense_addresses[0]));
    // A dense-region miss must not erase valid sparse-table hints. The
    // subsequent high-slot lookup needs at most two revalidated probes, not
    // a 64-slot scan. Stale aliases are still checked after release/reuse.
    assert(!Lookup(0xdead0000));
    scans = 0;
    assert(Lookup(0x5001) == &sparse_ranges[63]);
    assert(scans.load() <= 2);
    Release(63);
    assert(!Lookup(0x5001));
    assert(sparse_used_prefix == 2); // freed high tail is no longer scanned
    scans = 0;
    // A negative lookup now rechecks two retained hints (one retired)
    // plus the one live unhinted table. Preserve the hints for later hits.
    assert(!Lookup(0x5001) && scans.load() <= 2); // negative memo, hints only
    for (int j = 0; j < 2000; ++j) {
        Register(63, 0x5000);
        assert(Lookup(0x5001) == &sparse_ranges[63]);
        Release(63);
        assert(sparse_used_prefix == 2);
    }
    // The owner mutex serializes lookup with slot reuse and teardown.
    std::vector<std::thread> readers;
    for (int worker = 0; worker < 4; ++worker)
        readers.emplace_back([] {
            for (int j = 0; j < 10000; ++j) {
                const auto* p = Lookup(0x2001);
                assert(p == &sparse_ranges[1]);
            }
        });
    for (auto& worker : readers) worker.join();
    assert(Lookup(0x2001) == &sparse_ranges[1]);
    Release(1);
    assert(sparse_used_prefix == 1); // keep slot zero
    Release(0);
    assert(sparse_used_prefix == 0); // empty process, zero probe cost
    scans = 0;
    assert(!Lookup(0x2001) && scans.load() == 0);
    Register(63, 0x8000); // a later new high allocation re-expands safely
    assert(sparse_used_prefix == 64);
    assert(Lookup(0x8000) == &sparse_ranges[63]);
    assert(!Lookup(0x5001)); // former mapping must not match reused slot
    scans = 0;
    assert(Lookup(0x8001) == &sparse_ranges[63] && scans.load() == 1);
    Release(63);
    assert(sparse_used_prefix == 0);
    // Exercise every slot: first-free allocation, a hole in a full prefix,
    // saturation, and complete tail release without any kernel mappings.
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 64; ++i) {
        assert(ChooseFreeRange() == &sparse_ranges[i]);
        Register(i, 0x100000 + i * 0x2000);
    }
    scans = 0;
    assert(ChooseFreeRange() == nullptr && scans.load() == 0);
    // Sweep every one-hole bitmap including top bit 63, with all other
    // ranges live. Free-slot selection must touch zero begin atomics.
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 64; ++i) {
        Release(i);
        scans = 0;
        assert(ChooseFreeRange() == &sparse_ranges[i] && scans.load() == 0);
        Register(i, 0x100000 + i * 0x2000);
    }
    assert(ChooseFreeRange() == nullptr);
    Release(40);
    scans = 0;
    assert(ChooseFreeRange() == &sparse_ranges[40] && scans.load() == 0);
    Register(40, 0xdead0000);
    assert(Lookup(0xdead0000) == &sparse_ranges[40]); // epoch invalidated miss
    for (int i = 63; i >= 0; --i) Release(i);
    scans = 0;
    assert(sparse_used_prefix == 0 && ChooseFreeRange() == &sparse_ranges[0] && scans.load() == 0);
    // Reservation pauses mid-syscall: a concurrent lookup MUST still acquire
    // sparse_mutex. The former implementation held this lock here.
    block_reserve.store(true);
    reserve_entered.store(false);
    allow_reserve.store(false);
    void* slow = nullptr;
    std::thread allocator([&] { slow = AllocateSparsePages(2 * SparseSlot); });
    while (!reserve_entered.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) std::this_thread::yield();
    const bool lock_available = sparse_mutex.try_lock();
    if (lock_available) sparse_mutex.unlock();
    allow_reserve.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    allocator.join();
    assert(lock_available);
    assert(slow && reinterpret_cast<std::uintptr_t>(slow) != DenseSentinel);
    assert(Lookup(reinterpret_cast<std::uintptr_t>(slow) + 1) == &sparse_ranges[0]);
    ReleaseAllocation(slow);
    block_reserve.store(false);
    // Reserving on a full table must not publish over a live owner or leak VA.
    std::vector<void*> live;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 64; ++i) {
        void* p = AllocateSparsePages(2 * SparseSlot);
        assert(p && reinterpret_cast<std::uintptr_t>(p) != DenseSentinel);
        live.push_back(p);
    }
    assert(sparse_used_prefix == 64 && sparse_reserved == 64 * 2 * SparseSlot);
    assert(reinterpret_cast<std::uintptr_t>(AllocateSparsePages(2 * SparseSlot)) == DenseSentinel);
    assert(dense_fallbacks == 1);
    for (auto* p : live) ReleaseAllocation(p);
    assert(sparse_used_prefix == 0 && sparse_reserved == 0);
    // A kernel reservation failure also falls back outside the mutex.
    fail_reserve.store(true);
    assert(reinterpret_cast<std::uintptr_t>(AllocateSparsePages(2 * SparseSlot)) == DenseSentinel);
    assert(dense_fallbacks == 2 && sparse_used_prefix == 0);
}
""".replace("__LOOKUP__", lookup).replace("__SELECT_FREE__", selection).replace("__PUBLISH_MASK__", publish_mask).replace("__PUBLISH__", publish).replace("__RETIRE_MASK__", retire_mask).replace("__SHRINK__", shrink).replace("__ALLOCATE__", allocation)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-sparse-prefix-") as tmp:
```

```py
"""Fail fast if the pinned ASTC and Vulkan native GPU pin owners diverge.

Source-only ownership gate; real C++ instantiation is checked by the native
compiler preflight. Do not replace the shader/texture cache with a mock.

vulkan = (vendor / "eden-vulkan/vulkan-cache/video_core/texture_cache/texture_cache.h").read_text()

end = "\ntemplate <class P>\nImageViewId TextureCache<P>::VisitImageView("

def owner(text, path):
    assert text.count(start) == 1 and text.count(end) == 1, path
    return text.split(start, 1)[1].split(end, 1)[0].rstrip()

assert owner(astc, "ASTC") == owner(vulkan, "Vulkan"), (
    "ASTC and Vulkan cached native acquisition/lease owners diverged")

    assert "if constexpr (!(requires(Sampler& sampler)" in text
print("PS5_NATIVE_ASTC_VULKAN_PIN_PARITY_PASS")
```

`tools/check-native-tracked-page-handoff-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Deterministic host-only witness for the unclosed tracked-page/JIT handoff.

A deliberately paused checked-access guard stores after GPU tracking begins
without a callback. A separate run-level quiescence MODEL closes that specific
schedule. Neither witness qualifies native performance, reentrancy, lifetime,
the actual Dynarmic emitter, or GPU device fences. Native #187 stays OFF.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
read = lambda path: (root / path).read_text()
checked = read("vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/dynarmic/backend/x64/emit_x64_memory.h")
host = read("src/host_memory.cpp")
memory = read("vendor/sources/eden/src/core/memory.cpp")
page = read("vendor/sources/eden/src/common/page_table.h")
jit_test = read("headless/memory_check.cpp")
replay = read("headless/gpu_deferred_replay.h")
workflow = read(".github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml")

# Fail closed if any source contract of the negative witness changes.
assert "code.test(code.byte[r13 + index - checked_map_bytes], blocked_bit);" in checked
assert "std::fill(page_access.begin() + first, page_access.begin() + last + 1, access);" in host
assert "Refresh(first, last);" in host
assert "return raw.marked && !ignore_marked ? 0" in page
mark = memory.split("void RasterizerMarkRegionCached(", 1)[1].split("\n    /**", 1)[0]
assert mark.index("host_buffer->Protect(vaddr, size, perm);") < mark.index(
    "entry.MarkRasterizerCached();")
assert "GuestStoreOrderGate" not in mark
assert "static void StressFastmemA32()" in jit_test
assert "inline constexpr bool kNativePostStorePublicationReady = false;" in replay
assert "python3 -B tools/check-native-tracked-page-handoff-host.py" in workflow

cpp = r"""
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdio>
#include <mutex>
#include <semaphore>
#include <shared_mutex>
#include <thread>
struct Page {
    std::atomic<bool> writable{true};
    std::atomic<bool> tracked{false};
    std::atomic<int> ram{0};
    std::atomic<int> callbacks{0};
    std::atomic<int> first_gpu_view{-1};
};
void UnclosedTransition() {
    Page p;
    std::binary_semaphore checked{0}, release_store{0};
    std::thread jit([&] {
        const bool direct = p.writable.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        assert(direct);
        checked.release();
        release_store.acquire();
        if (direct) p.ram.store(7, std::memory_order_release);
        else p.callbacks.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    });
    checked.acquire();
    // Native sequence protects checked fastmem before marking the PTE.
    p.writable.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
    p.tracked.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    p.first_gpu_view.store(p.ram.load(std::memory_order_acquire));
    release_store.release();
    jit.join();
    assert(p.first_gpu_view == 0 && p.ram == 7 && p.callbacks == 0);
    std::puts("TRACKED_HANDOFF_NEGATIVE_STALE_GUARD_REPRODUCED");
}
void RunQuiescenceModelOnly() {
    Page p;
    std::shared_mutex run_gate;
    std::binary_semaphore checked{0}, release_store{0};
    std::atomic<bool> transition_requested{false};
    std::thread jit([&] {
        // Run-level lease: NOT PRESENT in native CPU/JIT implementation.
        std::shared_lock lease(run_gate);
        const bool direct = p.writable.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        assert(direct);
        checked.release();
        release_store.acquire();
        if (direct) p.ram.store(7, std::memory_order_release);
    });
    checked.acquire();
    std::thread gpu([&] {
        transition_requested.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
        std::unique_lock transition(run_gate);
        p.writable.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
        p.tracked.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
        p.first_gpu_view.store(p.ram.load(std::memory_order_acquire));
    });
    while (!transition_requested.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        std::this_thread::yield();
    assert(!p.tracked.load(std::memory_order_acquire));
    release_store.release();
    jit.join();
    gpu.join();
    assert(p.tracked && !p.writable && p.ram == 7 && p.first_gpu_view == 7);
    std::thread next([&] {
        std::shared_lock lease(run_gate);
        if (!p.writable.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
            p.callbacks.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        else p.ram.store(9, std::memory_order_release);
    });
    next.join();
    assert(p.callbacks == 1 && p.ram == 7);
    std::puts("TRACKED_HANDOFF_RUN_QUIESCENCE_MODELED_ONLY");
}
int main() {
    UnclosedTransition();
    RunQuiescenceModelOnly();
    std::puts("TRACKED_HANDOFF_NATIVE_UNQUALIFIED_GATE_CLOSED");
}
"""
compiler = shutil.which("g++") or shutil.which("clang++")
assert compiler, "C++20 compiler required for host-only interleaving witness"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-tracked-handoff-") as tmp:
    source = Path(tmp) / "handoff.cpp"
    binary = Path(tmp) / "handoff"
    source.write_text(cpp)
    subprocess.run([compiler, "-std=c++20", "-O2", "-Wall", "-Wextra",
                    "-Werror", "-pthread", str(source), "-o", str(binary)],
                   check=True)
    result = subprocess.run([str(binary)], check=True, capture_output=True,
                            text=True, timeout=15)
    print(result.stdout, end="")
```

```py
    unsigned stores{};

    TrackingMask& operator=(const Mask& other) { value=other; ++stores; return *this; }

    Mask fast_bound_uniform_buffers{};
    Mask dirty_uniform_buffers{};
    Mask uniform_buffer_binding_sizes{};

    static constexpr bool HAS_PERSISTENT_UNIFORM_BUFFER_BINDINGS=P::persistent;
    Channel channel{};
    Channel* channel_state=&channel;
```

```py
"""Source-selected unmapped shader cbuf must not dereference empty optional."""

    return text[text.index(start):text.index(end)]

#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>
using u32=std::uint32_t;
using DAddr=std::uint64_t;
using GPUVAddr=std::uint64_t;
using BufferId=u32;
struct Binding {
    DAddr device_addr{};
    u32 size{};
    BufferId buffer_id{};
};
inline constexpr Binding NULL_BINDING{.device_addr=0,.size=0,.buffer_id=0};
struct MockMemory {
    unsigned lookups{};
    bool mapped=true;
    std::optional<DAddr> GpuToCpuAddress(GPUVAddr addr) {
        ++lookups;
        if (!mapped) return std::nullopt;
        return DAddr{0x10000}+addr;
    }
};
struct State {
    std::array<std::array<Binding,4>,2> uniform_buffers{};
};
template<class P>
struct BufferCache {
    MockMemory* gpu_memory;
    State* channel_state;
    void BindGraphicsUniformBuffer(size_t,u32,GPUVAddr,u32);
    void DisableGraphicsUniformBuffer(size_t,u32);
};
""" + impl + r"""
int main() {
    MockMemory mem;
    State state;
    BufferCache<void> cache{&mem,&state};
    cache.BindGraphicsUniformBuffer(1,2,0x1200,512);
    const auto& live=state.uniform_buffers[1][2];
    assert(live.device_addr==0x11200 && live.size==512 && live.buffer_id==0);
    // A valid prior slot must not survive a now-unmapped GPU cbuf.
    state.uniform_buffers[1][2].buffer_id=17;
    mem.mapped=false;
    cache.BindGraphicsUniformBuffer(1,2,0x1200,512);
    const auto& unmapped=state.uniform_buffers[1][2];
    assert(unmapped.device_addr==0 && unmapped.size==0 && unmapped.buffer_id==0);
    // A later remap publishes new mapping normally.
    mem.mapped=true;
    cache.BindGraphicsUniformBuffer(1,2,0x1300,128);
    const auto& remapped=state.uniform_buffers[1][2];
    assert(remapped.device_addr==0x11300 && remapped.size==128 && remapped.buffer_id==0);
    assert(mem.lookups==3);
    cache.DisableGraphicsUniformBuffer(1,2);
    assert(state.uniform_buffers[1][2].size==0);
}
"""
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compile the real graphics pipeline ready-wait callback from the active fork.

When an async pipeline completes before queued GPU commands run, the callback
must not acquire a native lock. When incomplete it must still wait for the
builder's release publication. Models host callback behavior, NOT PS5 FPS.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SRC=(ROOT/"vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vk_graphics_pipeline_cost.cpp").read_text()
GEN=(ROOT/"tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py").read_text()

CPP=r"""
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <chrono>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>
namespace vk { using CommandBuffer = int; }
namespace Eden::Performance {
struct VulkanTimer { explicit VulkanTimer(int) {} ~VulkanTimer() {} void reset() {} };
enum class CachePhase { GraphicsPipelineWait };
inline std::atomic<bool> detailed_gpu_profile{true};
inline std::atomic<unsigned> measured_waits{0};
inline std::atomic<unsigned> completed_traces{0};
struct PipelineWaitTrace {
    // Source-extracted release/acquire tests keep diagnostics inert.
    // The keyed V01 source witness separately compiles the real timer.
    void MarkLockAcquired() noexcept {}
    // The production callback now distinguishes a real (>1ms) build-mutex
    // stall from a ready-on-recheck publication race. This host fixture
    // intentionally makes diagnostics inert, but must keep that API.
    bool WasBlockedOnMutex() const noexcept { return false; }
    void Complete(const char*, std::uint64_t, bool) {
        completed_traces.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    }
};
struct CachePhaseTimer {
    explicit CachePhaseTimer(CachePhase, bool active) {
        if (active) measured_waits.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    }
    void Stop() {}
};
}
struct CountingMutex {
    std::mutex internal;
    std::atomic<unsigned> count{0};
    std::function<void()> before_lock;
    void lock() {
        count.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        // A moved-from std::function is valid but is not required to be
        // empty. The publication hook locks this same mutex recursively on
        // another thread: swap with an empty hook BEFORE invoking it.
        // Otherwise the fixture can recursively create hundreds of threads
        // instead of testing the single publication race it intended.
        std::function<void()> hook;
        hook.swap(before_lock);
        if (hook) hook();
        internal.lock();
    }
    void unlock() { internal.unlock(); }
};
struct Scheduler {
    std::vector<std::function<void(vk::CommandBuffer)>> queued;
    template <class F> void Record(F&& fn) {
        queued.emplace_back(std::forward<F>(fn));
    }
};
struct Probe {
    std::atomic<bool> is_built{false};
    CountingMutex build_mutex;
    std::condition_variable_any build_condvar;
    Scheduler scheduler;
    struct Key { std::uint64_t Hash() const { return 0xBEEF; } } key;
    bool CanExecuteDraw() const { return is_built.load(std::memory_order_acquire); }
    void Publish() {
        { std::scoped_lock lock{build_mutex};
          is_built.store(true, std::memory_order_release); }
        build_condvar.notify_all();
    }
    void Queue() {
        if (!is_built.load(std::memory_order::relaxed)) {
INJECT
        }
    }
};
int main() {
    { Probe p; p.Publish(); p.Queue(); assert(p.scheduler.queued.empty()); }
    for (int i = 0; i < 120; ++i) {
        Probe p; p.Queue(); assert(p.scheduler.queued.size() == 1);
        p.Publish(); p.build_mutex.count.store(0);
        p.scheduler.queued[0](0);
        assert(p.build_mutex.count.load() == 0);
    }
    assert(Eden::Performance::measured_waits.load() == 0);
    // Force publication between the first acquire and the native mutex recheck.
    {
        Probe p; p.Queue();
        p.build_mutex.before_lock = [&p] {
            std::thread([&p] { p.Publish(); }).join();
        };
        p.scheduler.queued[0](0);
        assert(p.build_mutex.count.load() == 2);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
        assert(Eden::Performance::measured_waits.load() == 0);
#else
        assert(Eden::Performance::measured_waits.load() == 1);
#endif
        assert(Eden::Performance::completed_traces.load() == 0);
    }
    const auto baseline = Eden::Performance::measured_waits.load();
    for (int i = 0; i < 120; ++i) {
        Probe p; p.Queue();
        const auto before = Eden::Performance::measured_waits.load();
        std::thread publisher([&] {
            while (Eden::Performance::measured_waits.load() == before)
                std::this_thread::yield();
            p.Publish();
        });
        p.scheduler.queued[0](0);
        publisher.join();
        assert(p.build_mutex.count.load() >= 1);
    }
    assert(Eden::Performance::measured_waits.load() == baseline + 120);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(Eden::Performance::completed_traces.load() == 120);
#else
    assert(Eden::Performance::completed_traces.load() == 0);
#endif
    Eden::Performance::detailed_gpu_profile.store(false);
    {
        Probe p; p.Queue();
        std::thread publisher([&] {
            while (p.build_mutex.count.load() == 0)
                std::this_thread::yield();
            p.Publish();
        });
        p.scheduler.queued[0](0);
        publisher.join();
        assert(Eden::Performance::measured_waits.load() == baseline + 120);
    }
}
""".replace("INJECT",snippet)
compiler=os.environ.get("CXX") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
```

`tools/check-native-vulkan-renderer-handoff-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
"""F05: source-extracted Vulkan renderer -> async presentation ownership replay.

Compile real RendererVulkan::Composite plus PresentManager::{GetRenderFrame,
Present, WaitPresent, PresentThread} in ONE C++20 executable at -O0 and -O2.
Only GPU draw calls, swapchain/copy, scheduling and timing are host stand-ins.
This distinguishes OnFrameDisplayed callbacks from completed host copies.
No real Vulkan WSI, GPU work, HLE guest frame pacing, or PS5 gameplay proof.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys

RENDER = (ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_renderer.cpp").read_text()

FULL = (ROOT / ".github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml").read_text()

assert "vulkan_renderer.cpp" in (ROOT / "headless/vulkan.cmake").read_text()

def native(text: str, start: str) -> str:
    assert text.count(start) == 1, ("source drift", start)
    begin = text.index(start)
    brace = text.index("{", begin)
    depth = 0
    for index in range(brace, len(text)):
        if text[index] == "{":
            depth += 1
        elif text[index] == "}":
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0:
                return text[begin:index + 1]
    raise AssertionError("Unbalanced source: " + start)

methods = "\n\n".join(native(PRESENT, m) for m in (
    "Frame* PresentManager::GetRenderFrame() {",
    "void PresentManager::Present(Frame* frame) {",
    "void PresentManager::WaitPresent() {",
    "void PresentManager::PresentThread(std::stop_token token) {",
))
composite = native(RENDER, "void RendererVulkan::Composite(")
assert "SCOPE_EXIT" in composite and "render_window.OnFrameDisplayed();" in composite
assert composite.index("render_window.OnFrameDisplayed();") < composite.index("present_manager.Present(frame);")
assert "present_manager.GetRenderFrame()" in composite
assert "present_manager.Present(frame);" in composite
assert "scheduler.DispatchWork();" in composite
assert "if (::Eden::Display::SkipFrame())" in composite
assert "present_in_flight = false;" in methods
assert "CopyToSwapchain(frame);" in methods

#include "frame_metrics.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>

#include <cstdint>

#include <deque>

#include <vector>

namespace Common {
enum class ThreadPriority { High };
void SetCurrentThreadName(const char*) {}
void SetCurrentThreadPriority(ThreadPriority) {}
void SetCurrentThreadToPerformanceCores() {}
}
namespace Eden::Performance {
inline int gpu_present_wait{},gpu_present_free_wait{},gpu_present_fence_wait{};
struct DiagnosticTimer {explicit DiagnosticTimer(int&) {}};
}
namespace Eden::Display {
inline bool skip{};
bool SkipFrame() {return skip;}
}
template<class F> struct ScopeGuard {F f;~ScopeGuard(){f();}};
struct ScopeTag {};
template<class F> ScopeGuard<F> operator+(ScopeTag,F f) {return {std::move(f)};}
#define ENCORE_JOIN_IMPL(a,b) a##b
#define ENCORE_JOIN(a,b) ENCORE_JOIN_IMPL(a,b)
#define SCOPE_EXIT [[maybe_unused]] auto ENCORE_JOIN(_exit_,__LINE__) = ScopeTag{} + [&]()
namespace Tegra {
struct FramebufferConfig {std::uint64_t address{};};
}
struct Frame {
    std::uint32_t game{},hud{},index{};
    inline static int ready{};
    int* render_ready{&ready};
    struct PresentFence {void Wait(){}void Reset(){}} present_done;
};
struct Scheduler {
    unsigned flushes{},dispatches{},request_context{};
    template<class F> void Record(F&& f){f(vk::CommandBuffer{});}
    void WaitWorker(){}
    void Flush(int) {++flushes;}
    void DispatchWork(){++dispatches;}
    void RequestOutsideRenderPassOperationContext(){++request_context;}
};
class PresentManager {
public:
    Scheduler scheduler;
    std::deque<Frame*> present_queue,free_queue;
    std::condition_variable_any frame_cv;
    std::condition_variable_any present_ready_cv;
    std::condition_variable free_cv;
    std::mutex swapchain_mutex,queue_mutex,free_mutex;
    bool present_in_flight{};
    std::size_t present_waiters{}; // guarded by queue_mutex
    std::size_t free_waiters{}; // guarded by free_mutex
    bool use_present_thread{true};
    std::exception_ptr present_failure;
    std::jthread present_thread;
    std::vector<Frame> frames;
    std::vector<std::pair<std::uint32_t,std::uint32_t>> presented;
    std::mutex result_mutex;
    std::mutex hold_mutex;
    std::condition_variable hold_cv;
    bool hold_copy{};
    unsigned copies{};
    explicit PresentManager(size_t count):frames(count) {
        for(auto& f:frames)free_queue.push_back(&f);
        present_thread=std::jthread([this](std::stop_token token){PresentThread(token);});
    }
    ~PresentManager(){
        {
            std::lock_guard lock{hold_mutex};
            hold_copy=false;
        }
        hold_cv.notify_all();
        present_thread.request_stop();
        present_ready_cv.notify_all();
        if(present_thread.joinable())present_thread.join();
    }
    int SwapchainImageCount()const{return 3;}
    int SwapchainImageViewFormat()const{return 1;}
    Frame* GetRenderFrame();
    void Present(Frame*);
    void WaitPresent();

    void CopyToSwapchain(Frame* frame){
        // Deterministic blocked-copy path separates callback from delivery,
        // with no driver timing or fake FPS measurement.
        {
            std::unique_lock lock{hold_mutex};
            hold_cv.wait(lock,[this]{return !hold_copy;});
        }
        std::lock_guard lock{result_mutex};
        presented.emplace_back(frame->game,frame->hud);
        ++copies;
    }
};
__PRESENT_METHODS__
struct RenderWindow {
    bool shown{true};
    unsigned displayed{};
    void OnFrameDisplayed(){++displayed;}
    bool IsShown()const{return shown;}
    int GetFramebufferLayout()const{return 0;}
};
struct GPU {
    unsigned notifications{};
    void RendererFrameEndNotify(){++notifications;}
};
struct Rasterizer {
    unsigned ticks{};
    void TickFrame(){++ticks;}
};
struct Device {};
struct Blit {
    unsigned draws{};
    void DrawToFrame(Device&,Rasterizer&,Frame* frame,
                     std::span<const Tegra::FramebufferConfig> layers,
                     int,int,int,bool) {
        assert(layers.size()==2);
        frame->game=static_cast<std::uint32_t>(layers[0].address);
        frame->hud=static_cast<std::uint32_t>(layers[1].address);
        ++draws;
    }
};
class RendererVulkan {
public:
    PresentManager& present_manager;
    RenderWindow render_window;
    Scheduler scheduler;
    GPU gpu;
    Rasterizer rasterizer;
    Device device;
    Blit blit_swapchain;

    void RenderAppletCaptureLayer(std::span<const Tegra::FramebufferConfig>){++captures;}
    void RenderScreenshot(std::span<const Tegra::FramebufferConfig>){++screenshots;}
    void Composite(std::span<const Tegra::FramebufferConfig>);
};
__RENDER_METHOD__
static void Deliver(RendererVulkan& renderer,std::uint32_t game,std::uint32_t hud) {
    const Tegra::FramebufferConfig pair[]={{game},{hud}};
    renderer.Composite(pair);
}
int main(){
    PresentManager present{7};
    RendererVulkan renderer{present};
    // OnFrameDisplayed is a GPU-worker callback, not a swapchain ACK.
    // Hold the real PresentThread's copy while the callback returns.
    {
        std::lock_guard lock{present.hold_mutex};
        present.hold_copy=true;
    }
    Deliver(renderer,100,200);
    assert(renderer.render_window.displayed==1);
    assert(present.presented.empty());

        std::lock_guard lock{present.hold_mutex};
        present.hold_copy=false;
    }
    present.hold_cv.notify_all();
    present.WaitPresent();

    constexpr unsigned ticks=240;
    std::vector<std::pair<std::uint32_t,std::uint32_t>> expected={{100,200}};
    std::uint32_t game=100;
    for(unsigned tick=0;tick<ticks;++tick){
        const bool paused=tick>=100 && tick<112;
        if(!paused && tick%2==0) ++game; // game every 2 ticks, HUD every tick
        const std::uint32_t hud=2000+tick;
        Deliver(renderer,game,hud);
        expected.emplace_back(game,hud);
        if(paused) assert(game==150);

        assert(present.free_queue.size()==7);

    Eden::Display::skip=true;
    Deliver(renderer,900,901);
    Eden::Display::skip=false;

    renderer.render_window.shown=true;

    assert(renderer.render_window.displayed==ticks+3);

if sys.platform == "darwin":

    # std::stop_token/jthread. The CLT 26.5 C++ headers support them and
```
