`tools/check-native-vulkan-retire-allocation-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
"""P2.2: source-extracted Vulkan retire ownership under allocation failure.

Compile actual Image/View retirement methods. The host substitutes tiny Vulkan
owners and a throwing vector allocator to prove synchronisation occurs before
any moved resource can be destroyed. No PS5 build or GPU simulation claim.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
source = (ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vk_texture_cache_cost.cpp").read_text()

def method(first: str, following: str) -> str:
    assert source.count(first) == 1, ("runtime owner changed", first)
    following_text = source.split(first, 1)[1]
    assert following in following_text, ("runtime boundary changed", following)
    return first + following_text.split(following, 1)[0]

image_method = method(
    "void TextureCacheRuntime::RetireGpuImage(Image&& image) {",
    "\nvoid TextureCacheRuntime::RetireGpuImageView(",
)
view_method = method(
    "void TextureCacheRuntime::RetireGpuImageView(ImageView&& view) {",
    "\n#endif",
)
for name, extracted in (
    ("pending_retired_images", image_method),
    ("pending_retired_views", view_method),
):
    assert extracted.index(name + ".reserve(") < extracted.index(name + ".push_back("), (
        "throwing queue growth happens after Vulkan transfer", name)
    assert "scheduler.Finish();" in extracted

cpp = r"""
#include <algorithm>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <memory>
#include <new>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>
using u64 = std::uint64_t;
struct State {
    bool gpu_busy = true;
    int premature_destructions = 0;
    int gpu_drains = 0;
};
struct Owner {
    State* state = nullptr;
    explicit Owner(State& s) noexcept : state(&s) {}
    Owner(const Owner&) = delete;
    Owner& operator=(const Owner&) = delete;
    Owner(Owner&& old) noexcept : state(std::exchange(old.state, nullptr)) {}
    ~Owner() {
        if (state && state->gpu_busy) ++state->premature_destructions;
    }
};
struct Image : Owner {
    explicit Image(State& s) : Owner(s) {}
    Image(Image&&) noexcept = default;
    static inline bool fail_new = false;
    static void* operator new(std::size_t n) {
        if (fail_new) { fail_new = false; throw std::bad_alloc(); }
        return ::operator new(n);
    }
    static void operator delete(void* p) noexcept { ::operator delete(p); }
};
struct ImageView : Owner {
    explicit ImageView(State& s) : Owner(s) {}
    ImageView(ImageView&&) noexcept = default;
    static inline bool fail_new = false;
    static void* operator new(std::size_t n) {
        if (fail_new) { fail_new = false; throw std::bad_alloc(); }
        return ::operator new(n);
    }
    static void operator delete(void* p) noexcept { ::operator delete(p); }
};
struct AllocFailure {
    static inline bool next = false;
    static inline int vector_allocations = 0;
};
template<class T> struct ThrowAllocator {
    using value_type = T;
    ThrowAllocator() noexcept = default;
    template<class U> ThrowAllocator(const ThrowAllocator<U>&) noexcept {}
    T* allocate(std::size_t n) {
        if (AllocFailure::next) {
            AllocFailure::next = false;
            throw std::bad_alloc();
        }
        ++AllocFailure::vector_allocations;
        return std::allocator<T>{}.allocate(n);
    }
    void deallocate(T* ptr, std::size_t n) noexcept {
        std::allocator<T>{}.deallocate(ptr, n);
    }
    template<class U> bool operator==(const ThrowAllocator<U>&) const noexcept {
        return true;
    }
};
struct Scheduler {
    State* state;
    u64 CurrentTick() const noexcept { return 42; }
    void Finish() { state->gpu_busy = false; ++state->gpu_drains; }
};
template<class T> struct Retired {
    u64 tick{};
    u64 frame{};
    std::unique_ptr<T> resource;
};
struct TextureCacheRuntime {
    explicit TextureCacheRuntime(State& s) : scheduler{&s} {}
    Scheduler scheduler;
    u64 gpu_retire_frame = 13;
    std::vector<Retired<Image>, ThrowAllocator<Retired<Image>>> pending_retired_images;
    std::vector<Retired<ImageView>, ThrowAllocator<Retired<ImageView>>> pending_retired_views;
    void RetireGpuImage(Image&& image);
    void RetireGpuImageView(ImageView&& view);
};
""" + image_method + "\n" + view_method + r"""
int main() {
    // Throw from vector growth; old push_back(make_unique(move(owner)))
    // destroyed the moved owner before the catch had drained the GPU.
    {
        State state;
        TextureCacheRuntime cache(state);
        Image image(state);
        AllocFailure::next = true;
        bool rejected = false;
        try { cache.RetireGpuImage(std::move(image)); }
        catch (const std::bad_alloc&) { rejected = true; }
        assert(rejected && state.gpu_drains == 1);
        assert(state.premature_destructions == 0);
        assert(cache.pending_retired_images.empty());
    }
    {
        State state;
        TextureCacheRuntime cache(state);
        ImageView view(state);
        AllocFailure::next = true;
        bool rejected = false;
        try { cache.RetireGpuImageView(std::move(view)); }
        catch (const std::bad_alloc&) { rejected = true; }
        assert(rejected && state.gpu_drains == 1);
        assert(state.premature_destructions == 0);
        assert(cache.pending_retired_views.empty());
    }
    // Also protect allocation of the unique_ptr owner after vector reserve.
    {
        State state;
        TextureCacheRuntime cache(state);
        Image image(state);
        Image::fail_new = true;
        bool rejected = false;
        try { cache.RetireGpuImage(std::move(image)); }
        catch (const std::bad_alloc&) { rejected = true; }
        assert(rejected && state.gpu_drains == 1);
        assert(state.premature_destructions == 0);
    }
    {
        State state;
        TextureCacheRuntime cache(state);
        ImageView view(state);
        ImageView::fail_new = true;
        bool rejected = false;
        try { cache.RetireGpuImageView(std::move(view)); }
        catch (const std::bad_alloc&) { rejected = true; }
        assert(rejected && state.gpu_drains == 1);
        assert(state.premature_destructions == 0);
    }
    // Ordinary ownership remains pending until completion; no forced wait.
    {
        State state;
        TextureCacheRuntime cache(state);
        Image image(state);
        ImageView view(state);
        cache.RetireGpuImage(std::move(image));
        cache.RetireGpuImageView(std::move(view));
        assert(state.gpu_drains == 0);
        assert(cache.pending_retired_images.size() == 1);
        assert(cache.pending_retired_views.size() == 1);
        assert(cache.pending_retired_images[0].tick == 42);
        assert(cache.pending_retired_images[0].frame == 13);
        cache.scheduler.Finish();
        cache.pending_retired_views.clear();
        cache.pending_retired_images.clear();
        assert(state.premature_destructions == 0);
    }
    // Texture churn must amortize vector growth. The 128 Vulkan owners
    // are distinct allocations; count ONLY the retirement queue's allocator.
    // A reserve(size() + 1) regression does 128 full relocations here.
    {
        State state;
        TextureCacheRuntime cache(state);
        const int before = AllocFailure::vector_allocations;
        for (int i = 0; i < 128; ++i) {
            Image image(state);
            cache.RetireGpuImage(std::move(image));
        }
        assert(cache.pending_retired_images.size() == 128);
        assert(AllocFailure::vector_allocations - before <= 5);
        assert(state.gpu_drains == 0);
        cache.scheduler.Finish();
        cache.pending_retired_images.clear();
        assert(state.premature_destructions == 0);
    }
    {
        State state;
        TextureCacheRuntime cache(state);
        const int before = AllocFailure::vector_allocations;
        for (int i = 0; i < 128; ++i) {
            ImageView view(state);
            cache.RetireGpuImageView(std::move(view));
        }
        assert(cache.pending_retired_views.size() == 128);
        assert(AllocFailure::vector_allocations - before <= 5);
        assert(state.gpu_drains == 0);
        cache.scheduler.Finish();
        cache.pending_retired_views.clear();
        assert(state.premature_destructions == 0);
    }
    // An allocation failure while growing a NONEMPTY queue must retain all
    // earlier GPU owners and drain before the caller's new owner can die.
    {
        State state;
        TextureCacheRuntime cache(state);
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
            Image image(state);
            cache.RetireGpuImage(std::move(image));
        }
        AllocFailure::next = true;
        Image ninth(state);
        bool rejected = false;
        try { cache.RetireGpuImage(std::move(ninth)); }
        catch (const std::bad_alloc&) { rejected = true; }
        assert(rejected && state.gpu_drains == 1);
        assert(cache.pending_retired_images.size() == 8);
        assert(state.premature_destructions == 0);
    }
    {
        State state;
        TextureCacheRuntime cache(state);
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
            ImageView view(state);
            cache.RetireGpuImageView(std::move(view));
        }
        AllocFailure::next = true;
        ImageView ninth(state);
        bool rejected = false;
        try { cache.RetireGpuImageView(std::move(ninth)); }
        catch (const std::bad_alloc&) { rejected = true; }
        assert(rejected && state.gpu_drains == 1);
        assert(cache.pending_retired_views.size() == 8);
        assert(state.premature_destructions == 0);
    }
    std::puts("P2_2_GPU_RETIRE_ALLOCATION_FAILURE_PASS");
}
""";

compilers = list(dict.fromkeys(
    c for name in ("clang++", "g++") if (c := shutil.which(name))))
assert compilers, "host C++20 compiler required"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-gpu-retire-oom-") as temp:
    temp = Path(temp)
    path = temp / "gpu-retire.cpp"
    path.write_text(cpp)
    for compiler in compilers:
        for opt in ("-O0", "-O2"):
            executable = temp / (Path(compiler).name + opt)
            built = subprocess.run(
                [compiler, "-std=c++20", opt, "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror",

            assert built.returncode == 0, (compiler, opt, built.stderr[-4000:])
            ran = subprocess.run(
                [str(executable)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)
            assert ran.returncode == 0, (compiler, opt, ran.stderr[-4000:])
            assert "P2_2_GPU_RETIRE_ALLOCATION_FAILURE_PASS" in ran.stdout
            print("P2_2_GPU_RETIRE_ALLOCATION_FAILURE_PASS",
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Stress source-maintained Vulkan striped build waits under GCC and Clang.

Checks shared primitive ceilings and independent predicate wakeups. Not a

    assert "build_condvar.notify_all();" in code

cpp=r"""
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/striped_wait.h"
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdio>
#include <memory>
#include <set>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>
struct Pipeline {
    Eden::StripedCondition build_condvar;
    Eden::StripedMutex build_mutex;
    std::atomic_bool is_built{false};
};
int main() {
    constexpr int kPipelines=8192, kWaiters=96;
    auto p=std::make_unique<Pipeline[]>(kPipelines);
    std::set<void*> mutexes,conditions;
    for(int i=0;i<kPipelines;++i) {
        mutexes.insert(&Eden::StripedWait::MutexFor(&p[i].build_mutex));
        conditions.insert(&Eden::StripedWait::ConditionFor(&p[i].build_condvar));
    }
    assert(mutexes.size()<=64 && conditions.size()<=64);
    assert(mutexes.size()>1 && conditions.size()>1);
    std::atomic<int> entered{0},complete{0};
    std::vector<std::thread> threads;
    for(int i=0;i<kWaiters;++i)threads.emplace_back([&,i]{
        auto& item=p[i*5];
        std::unique_lock lock{item.build_mutex};
        entered.fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_release);
        item.build_condvar.wait(lock,[&item]{
            return item.is_built.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
        });
        assert(item.is_built.load(std::memory_order_acquire));
        complete.fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_release);
    });
    while(entered.load(std::memory_order_acquire)!=kWaiters)
        std::this_thread::yield();
    for(int i=kWaiters-1;i>=0;--i) {
        auto& item=p[i*5];
        {
            std::scoped_lock lock{item.build_mutex};
            item.is_built.store(true,std::memory_order_release);
        }
        // This must broadcast because other pipelines share the condition.
        item.build_condvar.notify_one();
    }
    for(auto& t:threads)t.join();
    assert(complete.load()==kWaiters);
    bool collision=false;
    for(int i=0;i<kPipelines && !collision;++i)
      for(int j=i+1;j<kPipelines;++j)
        if(&Eden::StripedWait::ConditionFor(&p[i].build_condvar)
           ==&Eden::StripedWait::ConditionFor(&p[j].build_condvar)){
           collision=true;break;
        }
    assert(collision);
    std::printf("NATIVE_VULKAN_STRIPED_PIPELINES_PASS count=%d waiters=%d locks=%zu conditions=%zu\n",
                kPipelines,kWaiters,mutexes.size(),conditions.size());
}
"""
compilers=[x for x in (shutil.which("g++"),shutil.which("clang++")) if x]
assert compilers
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compile real maintained pipeline striped locks under ASan/UBSan.

Two pipelines deliberately share a condition slot. A wake for one must
not release the other predicate or strand a waiter. Host-only semantics.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
HEADER=ROOT/"vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/include/video_core/renderer_vulkan/striped_wait.h"
SOURCE=HEADER.read_text()
GFX=(ROOT/"vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/include/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_graphics_pipeline.h").read_text()
COMPUTE=(ROOT/"vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/include/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_compute_pipeline.h").read_text()
CI=(ROOT/".github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml").read_text()
assert "python3 -B tools/check-native-vulkan-striped-wait-host.py" in CI
assert "::Eden::StripedCondition build_condvar;" in GFX and "::Eden::StripedMutex build_mutex;" in GFX
assert "::Eden::StripedCondition build_condvar;" in COMPUTE and "::Eden::StripedMutex build_mutex;" in COMPUTE
assert "inline constexpr std::size_t kSlots = 64;" in SOURCE
assert "ConditionFor(this).notify_all();" in SOURCE
assert "ConditionFor(this).wait(lock, std::move(predicate));" in SOURCE
CODE=r"""
#include <array>
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>
#include <type_traits>
#include <vector>
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/striped_wait.h"
struct Pipeline {
    Eden::StripedCondition condition;
    Eden::StripedMutex mutex;
    bool ready=false;
};
static_assert(sizeof(Eden::StripedCondition)==sizeof(std::condition_variable));
static_assert(sizeof(Eden::StripedMutex)==sizeof(std::mutex));
int main(){
    std::array<Pipeline*,Eden::StripedWait::kSlots> collisions{};
    std::vector<std::unique_ptr<Pipeline>> pipelines;
    Pipeline *a=nullptr,*b=nullptr;
    for(int i=0;i<4096 && !a;++i){
        auto p=std::make_unique<Pipeline>();
        auto slot=Eden::StripedWait::SlotOf(&p->condition);
        if(collisions[slot]){a=collisions[slot];b=p.get();}
        else collisions[slot]=p.get();
        pipelines.push_back(std::move(p));
    }
    assert(a && b && a!=b);
    assert(&Eden::StripedWait::ConditionFor(&a->condition)==
           &Eden::StripedWait::ConditionFor(&b->condition));
    std::atomic<int> entered{0};
    std::atomic<bool> done_a{false},done_b{false};
    auto worker=[&](Pipeline* p,std::atomic<bool>& flag){
        std::unique_lock<Eden::StripedMutex> guard{p->mutex};
        entered.fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_release);
        p->condition.wait(guard,[&]{return p->ready;});
        flag.store(true,std::memory_order_release);
    };
    std::thread ta(worker,a,std::ref(done_a));
    std::thread tb(worker,b,std::ref(done_b));
    using namespace std::chrono_literals;
    auto deadline=std::chrono::steady_clock::now()+4s;
    while(entered.load(std::memory_order_acquire)!=2 &&
          std::chrono::steady_clock::now()<deadline)std::this_thread::yield();
    assert(entered.load()==2);
    {std::scoped_lock lock{a->mutex};a->ready=true;}
    a->condition.notify_one();
    while(!done_a.load(std::memory_order_acquire) &&
          std::chrono::steady_clock::now()<deadline)std::this_thread::yield();
    assert(done_a.load() && !done_b.load());
    {std::scoped_lock lock{b->mutex};b->ready=true;}
    b->condition.notify_one();
    while(!done_b.load(std::memory_order_acquire) &&
          std::chrono::steady_clock::now()<deadline)std::this_thread::yield();
    assert(done_b.load());
    ta.join();tb.join();
    for(const auto& p:pipelines){
        const auto slot=Eden::StripedWait::SlotOf(&p->condition);
        assert(slot<Eden::StripedWait::kSlots);
    }
    return 0;
}
"""
compiler=shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
assert compiler
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-striped-wait-") as temp:
    root=Path(temp)
    src=root/"striped.cpp"
    exe=root/"striped"
    src.write_text(CODE)
    subprocess.run([compiler,"-std=c++20","-O1","-g","-pthread",
                    "-Wall","-Wextra","-Werror",
                    "-fsanitize=address,undefined","-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
                    "-I",str(HEADER.parents[2]),str(src),"-o",str(exe)],
                   check=True,timeout=90)
    subprocess.run([str(exe)],check=True,timeout=30)
print("ENCORE_VULKAN_STRIPED_WAIT_HOST_PASS; console latency unmeasured")
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Source-selected native indexed draw bytes must preserve wide GPU extents."""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
native=(root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/video_core/buffer_cache/buffer_cache.h").read_text()
backport=(root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-backports/src/video_core/buffer_cache/buffer_cache.h").read_text()
start="template <class P>\nvoid BufferCache<P>::UpdateIndexBuffer() {"
end="\ntemplate <class P>"
def method(s):
    assert s.count(start)==1
    p=s.index(start)
    return s[p:s.index(end,p+len(start))]
body=method(native)
legacy=method(backport)
assert "const u64 index_count" in body
assert "gpu_addr_end > gpu_addr_begin" in body
assert "static_cast<u64>(~u32{0})" in body
assert "const u32 address_size = static_cast<u32>(gpu_addr_end - gpu_addr_begin)" in legacy
assert "const u32 draw_size = (index_buffer_ref.count + index_buffer_ref.first)" in legacy
cpp=r"""
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstddef>
#include <optional>
#include <vector>
#include <unordered_map>
using u32=std::uint32_t;
using u64=std::uint64_t;
using DAddr=u64;
using GPUVAddr=u64;
using BufferId=u32;
namespace Dirty { constexpr u32 IndexBuffer=0; }
namespace Common {
template<class T> T AlignUp(T n,T block){return n%block ? n + block - (n%block) : n;}
}
struct Binding {
    DAddr device_addr{};
    u32 size{};
    BufferId buffer_id{};
};
constexpr Binding NULL_BINDING{};
constexpr BufferId NULL_BUFFER_ID=0;
struct IndexReference {
    GPUVAddr start{0x1000},end{0x2000};
    u32 count{16},first{};
    GPUVAddr StartAddress() const{return start;}
    GPUVAddr EndAddress() const{return end;}
    u32 FormatSizeInBytes() const{return 4;}
};
struct DrawState {
    std::vector<u32> inline_index_draw_indexes{};
    IndexReference index_buffer{};
};
struct Graphics {
    struct {DrawState draw_state{};} draw_manager{};
    struct {std::array<bool,1> flags{true};} dirty{};
};
struct Memory {
    bool mapped{true};
    unsigned queries{};
    std::optional<DAddr> GpuToCpuAddress(GPUVAddr addr){
        ++queries;
        if (!mapped) return std::nullopt;
        return addr+0x10000;
    }
};
struct TestBuffer {size_t sz{};size_t SizeBytes() const{return sz;}};
template<class P>struct BufferCache {
    static constexpr u32 CACHING_PAGESIZE=4096;
    Graphics* maxwell3d;
    Memory* gpu_memory;
    struct {Binding index_buffer{};}* channel_state;
    BufferId inline_buffer_id=NULL_BUFFER_ID;
    std::unordered_map<BufferId,TestBuffer> slot_buffers{};
    BufferId next_id=20;
    unsigned finds{};
    BufferId CreateBuffer(DAddr,u32 size,bool){
        const BufferId id=++next_id;
        slot_buffers.insert_or_assign(id,TestBuffer{size});
        return id;
    }
    BufferId FindBuffer(DAddr,u32 size,bool){
        assert(size>0);++finds;return 17;
    }
    void UpdateIndexBuffer();
};
""" + body + r"""
int main(){
    Graphics g;
    Memory mem;
    struct {Binding index_buffer{};} c;
    // Nested anonymous channel type cannot be named externally. Construct
    // the actual BufferCache and point at its own compatible state below.
}
"""
# Remove inline main and use the actual nested type through a pointer.
cpp=cpp[:cpp.index("int main(){")] + r"""
int main(){
    Graphics g;
    Memory mem;
    BufferCache<void> cache{};
    decltype(cache.channel_state) state_ptr{};
    (void)state_ptr;
    // Pointer's target is anonymous, so create the target via decltype.
    std::remove_pointer_t<decltype(cache.channel_state)> state{};
    cache.maxwell3d=&g;cache.gpu_memory=&mem;cache.channel_state=&state;
    auto& ref=g.draw_manager.draw_state.index_buffer;
    ref.start=0x2000;ref.end=0x3000;ref.first=0;ref.count=16;
    cache.UpdateIndexBuffer();
    assert(state.index_buffer.size==64 && cache.finds==1);
    // Previously end-start narrowed to zero before comparing draw bytes.
    // Every independent draw reasserts the IndexBuffer dirty register.
    g.dirty.flags[Dirty::IndexBuffer]=true;
    ref.start=0x100000000ull;ref.end=ref.start+0x100000000ull;
    cache.UpdateIndexBuffer();
    assert(state.index_buffer.size==64 && cache.finds==2);
    // Previously count+first overflowed to zero.
    // Every independent draw reasserts the IndexBuffer dirty register.
    g.dirty.flags[Dirty::IndexBuffer]=true;
    ref.start=0x2000;ref.end=0x3000;
    ref.count=0xffffffffu;ref.first=1u;
    cache.UpdateIndexBuffer();
    assert(state.index_buffer.size==4096 && cache.finds==3);
    // Invalid reversed GPU range safely disables the stale index binding.
    // Every independent draw reasserts the IndexBuffer dirty register.
    g.dirty.flags[Dirty::IndexBuffer]=true;
    ref.start=0x3000;ref.end=0x2fff;
    cache.UpdateIndexBuffer();
    assert(state.index_buffer.size==0 && cache.finds==3);
    // Translation failures remain null, no FindBuffer call.
    // Every independent draw reasserts the IndexBuffer dirty register.
    g.dirty.flags[Dirty::IndexBuffer]=true;
    mem.mapped=false;ref.start=0x2000;ref.end=0x3000;
    cache.UpdateIndexBuffer();
    assert(state.index_buffer.size==0 && cache.finds==3);
    // Inline index data still takes its original non-GPU-address route.
    // Every independent draw reasserts the IndexBuffer dirty register.
    g.dirty.flags[Dirty::IndexBuffer]=true;
    g.draw_manager.draw_state.inline_index_draw_indexes={0,1,2};
    cache.UpdateIndexBuffer();
    assert(state.index_buffer.size==3 && state.index_buffer.buffer_id!=0);
}
"""
cpp=cpp.replace("#include <unordered_map>","#include <unordered_map>\n#include <type_traits>")
compiler=shutil.which("c++") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
assert compiler
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-wide-index-") as d:
    path=Path(d)/"index.cpp";path.write_text(cpp)
    for opt in ("-O0","-O2"):
        exe=Path(d)/("index"+opt)
        subprocess.run([compiler,"-std=c++20",opt,"-Wall","-Wextra","-Werror",
                        "-fsanitize=undefined",str(path),"-o",str(exe)],
                       check=True,timeout=45)
        subprocess.run([str(exe)],check=True,timeout=20)
        print("NATIVE_WIDE_INDEX_RANGE_PASS",opt)
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Native vertex-buffer address ranges must not wrap through 32-bit extent."""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
native=(root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/video_core/buffer_cache/buffer_cache.h").read_text()
backport=(root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-backports/src/video_core/buffer_cache/buffer_cache.h").read_text()
start="template <class P>\nvoid BufferCache<P>::UpdateVertexBuffer(u32 index) {"
end="\ntemplate <class P>"
def extract(s):
    assert s.count(start)==1
    i=s.index(start)
    return s[i:s.index(end,i+len(start))]
body=extract(native)
old=extract(backport)
assert "const u64 address_size" in body
assert "gpu_addr_end > gpu_addr_begin" in body
assert "static_cast<u64>(~u32{0})" in body
assert "if (size == 0)" in body
assert "const u32 address_size = static_cast<u32>(gpu_addr_end - gpu_addr_begin)" in old
assert "UpdateVertexBufferSlot(index, NULL_BINDING);" in body
fixture=r"""
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>
using u32=std::uint32_t;
using u64=std::uint64_t;
using GPUVAddr=u64;
using DAddr=u64;
using BufferId=u32;
constexpr u64 operator""_MiB(unsigned long long n) {return n*1024ull*1024ull;}
namespace Dirty { constexpr u32 VertexBuffer0=0; }
struct Binding {
    DAddr device_addr{};
    u32 size{};
    BufferId buffer_id{};
};
constexpr Binding NULL_BINDING{};
struct Stream {
    GPUVAddr address{};
    bool enable{true};
    GPUVAddr Address() const {return address;}
};
struct GPURegs {
    std::array<Stream,2> vertex_streams{};
    std::array<Stream,2> vertex_stream_limits{};
};
struct GPUState {
    GPURegs regs{};
    struct {std::array<bool,2> flags{true,true};} dirty{};
};
struct Channel {std::array<Binding,2> vertex_buffers{};};
struct Memory {
    bool mapped{true},inside{true};
    u64 max_bytes{2*1024*1024};
    u32 ranges{},lookups{};
    std::optional<DAddr> GpuToCpuAddress(GPUVAddr addr) {
        ++lookups; if(!mapped)return std::nullopt;return DAddr{0x10000}+addr;
    }
    bool IsWithinGPUAddressRange(GPUVAddr) {return inside;}
    u64 MaxContinuousRange(GPUVAddr,u32 size) {
        ++ranges;
        return (std::min)(static_cast<u64>(size),max_bytes);
    }
};
template<class P>struct BufferCache {
    GPUState* maxwell3d;
    Memory* gpu_memory;
    Channel* channel_state;
    u32 finds{},updates{};
    Binding last{};
    BufferId FindBuffer(DAddr,u32 bytes,bool) {
        assert(bytes!=0);
        ++finds;return 17;
    }
    void UpdateVertexBufferSlot(u32,Binding b) {
        ++updates;last=b;
    }
    void UpdateVertexBuffer(u32 index);
};
""" + body + r"""
int main() {
    GPUState regs{};
    Channel channel{};
    Memory mem{};
    BufferCache<void> cache{&regs,&mem,&channel};
    auto set=[&](u64 first,u64 length) {
        regs.regs.vertex_streams[0].address=first;
        regs.regs.vertex_stream_limits[0].address=first+length-1;
    };
    set(0x2000,4096);
    cache.UpdateVertexBuffer(0);
    assert(channel.vertex_buffers[0].size==4096 && cache.finds==1);
    assert(channel.vertex_buffers[0].device_addr==0x12000);
    assert(mem.ranges==0);
    // Old u32 cast returned zero, dropping a valid (clipped) >=4GiB draw.
    set(0x100000000ull,0x100000000ull);
    cache.UpdateVertexBuffer(0);
    assert(channel.vertex_buffers[0].size==2*1024*1024);
    assert(cache.finds==2 && mem.ranges==1);
    // Old code returned 1 byte rather than a valid multi-megabyte range.
    set(0x200000000ull,0x100000001ull);
    cache.UpdateVertexBuffer(0);
    assert(channel.vertex_buffers[0].size==2*1024*1024);
    assert(cache.finds==3 && mem.ranges==2);
    // Inverted end never produces a wrapped unsigned range.
    regs.regs.vertex_streams[0].address=0x4000;
    regs.regs.vertex_stream_limits[0].address=0x3fff-1;
    cache.UpdateVertexBuffer(0);
    assert(channel.vertex_buffers[0].size==0 && cache.finds==3);
    // Empty post-clamp continuous memory must retire a previous binding.
    set(0x2000,128*1024*1024);
    mem.max_bytes=0;
    cache.UpdateVertexBuffer(0);
    assert(channel.vertex_buffers[0].size==0 && cache.finds==3);
    assert(cache.last.size==0);
    // Unmapped GPU addresses keep the original null slot semantics.
    mem.mapped=false;
    set(0x2000,4096);
    cache.UpdateVertexBuffer(0);
    assert(channel.vertex_buffers[0].size==0 && cache.finds==3);
    // Non-dirty ranges must not alter the state.
    regs.dirty.flags[0]=false;
    cache.UpdateVertexBuffer(0);
    assert(cache.finds==3);
}
"""
compiler=shutil.which("c++") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
assert compiler
```

`tools/check-native-zero-write-tick-fence-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Source-selected native BufferCache zero-tick GPU fence probe regression."""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
source = (root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/video_core/buffer_cache/buffer_cache.h").read_text()
backport = (root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-backports/src/video_core/buffer_cache/buffer_cache.h").read_text()
start="template <class P>\nvoid BufferCache<P>::SynchronizeBufferWrites("
assert source.count(start) == backport.count(start) == 1
def method(s):
    i=s.index(start)
    return s[i:s.index("\ntemplate <class P>",i+len(start))]
body=method(source)
previous=method(backport)
assert "buffer_tick != 0 && !runtime.IsFree(buffer_tick)" in body
assert "buffer_tick != 0" not in previous
assert body.replace(
    "        // New and never-GPU-written buffers have a zero fence tick.\n"
    "        // Scheduler::Wait(0) cannot wait; skip its IsFree semaphore probe.\n",
    "").replace("buffer_tick != 0 && !runtime.IsFree(buffer_tick)",
                "!runtime.IsFree(buffer_tick)") == previous
program=r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
using u64=std::uint64_t;
struct MockBuffer {
    u64 tick{};
    u64 getWriteTick() const noexcept {return tick;}
};
struct MockRuntime {
    unsigned probes{},waits{};
    u64 last_probe{},last_wait{};
    bool free=true;
    bool IsFree(u64 tick) {
        ++probes;last_probe=tick;return free;
    }
    void Wait(u64 tick) {
        ++waits;last_wait=tick;
        assert(tick != 0);
    }
};
template<class P>struct BufferCache {
    using Buffer=MockBuffer;
    static constexpr bool IS_OPENGL=false;
    MockRuntime runtime;
    void SynchronizeBufferWrites(Buffer&);
};
""" + body + r"""
int main() {
    BufferCache<void> cache;
    MockBuffer buffer{};
    cache.runtime.free=false;
    // Tick 0 means no pending GPU fence; no semaphore probe or wait.
    cache.SynchronizeBufferWrites(buffer);
    assert(cache.runtime.probes==0 && cache.runtime.waits==0);
    // A nonzero completed fence retains its ordinary IsFree call.
    buffer.tick=11;
    cache.runtime.free=true;
    cache.SynchronizeBufferWrites(buffer);
    assert(cache.runtime.probes==1 && cache.runtime.waits==0);
    assert(cache.runtime.last_probe==11);
    // A nonzero unfinished fence retains the same waiting semantics.
    buffer.tick=12;
    cache.runtime.free=false;
    cache.SynchronizeBufferWrites(buffer);
    assert(cache.runtime.probes==2 && cache.runtime.waits==1);
    assert(cache.runtime.last_probe==12 && cache.runtime.last_wait==12);
    // Never-written buffers stay fast even after unrelated waits.
    buffer.tick=0;
    cache.SynchronizeBufferWrites(buffer);
    assert(cache.runtime.probes==2 && cache.runtime.waits==1);
}
"""
compiler=shutil.which("c++") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
assert compiler
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-zero-fence-tick-") as tmp:
    source_file=Path(tmp)/"fence.cpp"
    source_file.write_text(program)
    for opt in ("-O0","-O2"):
        executable=Path(tmp)/("fence"+opt)
        subprocess.run([compiler,"-std=c++20",opt,"-Wall","-Wextra","-Werror",
                        "-fsanitize=undefined",str(source_file),"-o",str(executable)],
                       check=True,timeout=40)
        subprocess.run([str(executable)],check=True,timeout=20)
        print("NATIVE_ZERO_TICK_GPU_FENCE_PASS",opt)
```

`tools/check-ncz.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright 2026 Oliv3rmoon
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
"""Host check of the NCZ reader (headless/ncz.h) that lets NSZ and XCZ files be played.

It builds headless/ncz_check.cpp with AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer against the
system's zstd and OpenSSL (libcrypto: only the check's own reference encryption uses it) and runs
it: block and solid NCZs made up by the check must read back as the NCAs they were made from.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import os, shutil, subprocess, tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def flags(package):
    if shutil.which('pkg-config'):
        result = subprocess.run(['pkg-config', '--cflags', '--libs', package], capture_output=True, text=True)
        if result.returncode == 0:
            return result.stdout.split()
    return []


extra = flags('libzstd') + flags('libcrypto')
libraries = [library for library in ('-lzstd', '-lcrypto') if library not in extra]
# Homebrew keeps OpenSSL out of the default paths.
for prefix in ('/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@3', '/usr/local/opt/openssl@3', '/opt/homebrew', '/usr/local'):
    if Path(prefix, 'include').is_dir():
        extra += ['-I' + prefix + '/include', '-L' + prefix + '/lib']
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    exe = Path(tmp) / 'ncz-check'
    subprocess.run([os.environ.get('CXX', 'c++'), '-std=c++20', '-O1', '-g', '-Wall', '-Wextra', '-Werror',
                    '-fsanitize=address,undefined', '-fno-omit-frame-pointer', '-I' + str(root / 'headless'),
                    str(root / 'headless/ncz_check.cpp'), *extra, *libraries, '-o', str(exe)],
                   check=True)
    subprocess.run([str(exe)], check=True, timeout=600, env={**os.environ, 'NCZ_CHECK_DIR': tmp})
print('NCZ: PASS block and solid NCZs read back byte for byte (random reads, every section type, '
      'unpacking a large solid one), damaged files rejected')
```

`tools/check-net-cache-migration.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Regression: upgrading a restored Eden HTTP patch must not invalidate whole cache."""
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
migrator = root / "tools/migrate-net-user-agent-cache.py"
script = (root / "tools/apply-eden-backports.sh").read_text()
assert "7117c1c3f353157b7fa46a86c6f77226b1183d9b374462cefe8b8dc5f32bf613" in script
assert "python3 -B \"$root/tools/migrate-net-user-agent-cache.py\" \"$eden\"" in script

old = '''        httplib::Request request{ .method = "GET", .path = path };
        request.headers.emplace("User-Agent", "Prospero.Eden-Encore/1");
        request.headers.emplace("Accept", "*/*");
        if (!result) {
            LOG_ERROR(Common, "GET to {}{} returned null", url, path);
            return {};
        }
'''
for case in ("legacy-cache", "partially-upgraded", "unpatched-source", "unexpected-error"):
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-net-migrate-") as tmp:
        source = Path(tmp) / "src/common/net/net.cpp"
        source.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        initial = old
        if case == "partially-upgraded":
            initial = initial.replace(
                '            LOG_ERROR(Common, "GET to {}{} returned null", url, path);',
                '            LOG_ERROR(Common, "GET to {}{} returned null: {}", url, path,\n'
                '                      httplib::to_string(result.error()));',
            )
        elif case == "unpatched-source":
            initial = initial.replace('        request.headers.emplace("Accept", "*/*");\n', '')
        elif case == "unexpected-error":
            initial = initial.replace('returned null", url', 'other message", url')
        source.write_text(initial)
        result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-B", str(migrator), tmp],
                                capture_output=True, text=True)
        successful = case in ("legacy-cache", "partially-upgraded")
        assert (result.returncode == 0) == successful, (case, result.stdout, result.stderr)
        if successful:
            upgraded = source.read_text()
            assert upgraded.count('httplib::to_string(result.error())') == 1, case
            again = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-B", str(migrator), tmp],
                                   capture_output=True, text=True)
            assert again.returncode == 0 and source.read_text() == upgraded
        else:
            assert source.read_text() == initial, "migration modified an unrecognized source"
print("Cached Eden network-backport migration: four guarded scenarios PASS")

```

```py
c=r"""
#include "network_audit.h"
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
static int exists(const char* path) {
    FILE* f=fopen(path,"rb");
    if (!f) return 0;
    fclose(f); return 1;
}
static long bytes(const char* path) {
    FILE* f=fopen(path,"rb");
    assert(f);
    assert(fseek(f,0,SEEK_END)==0);
    long n=ftell(f); fclose(f); return n;
}
static int contains(const char* path,const char* phrase) {
    FILE* f=fopen(path,"rb"); assert(f);
    char row[640]; int found=0;
    while (fgets(row,sizeof(row),f)) if (strstr(row,phrase)) found=1;
    fclose(f); return found;
}
static void check_all_timestamps(const char* path) {
    FILE* f=fopen(path,"rb"); assert(f);
    char row[640],utc[32];
    unsigned records=0;
    while(fgets(row,sizeof(row),f)) {
        long long epoch=-1,mono=-1;
        memset(utc,0,sizeof(utc));
        assert(sscanf(row,"epoch=%lld utc=%31s mono_ns=%lld",&epoch,utc,&mono)==3);
        assert(epoch>0 && mono>0);
        assert(strlen(utc)==24 && utc[23]=='Z' &&
               utc[10]=='T' && utc[19]=='.');
        ++records;
    }
    fclose(f);
    assert(records>0);
}
int main(int argc,char** argv) {
    assert(argc==2);
    char logpath[640],oldpath[650];
    snprintf(logpath,sizeof(logpath),"%s/network-accepted.log",argv[1]);
    snprintf(oldpath,sizeof(oldpath),"%s.prev",logpath);
    assert(!eden_network_audit_active());
    assert(eden_network_audit_init(logpath,0)==0);
    eden_network_audit_event("launcher","dns-resolved","api.nlib.cc",0,0);
    eden_network_audit_event("guest","tx","fd:9",123,0);
    assert(!exists(logpath));
    eden_network_audit_enable(1);
    assert(eden_network_audit_active());
    eden_network_audit_event("launcher","dns-resolved","api.nlib.cc",0,0);
    eden_network_audit_event("guest","dns-denied","api.ea.com",0,1);
    // Same-second repeated denials are a diagnostic/audit storm only; they
    // must not do hundreds of writes or require a mutex for each repeat.
    // Accepted packet events are NEVER throttled.
    for (int i=0;i<500;i++)
        eden_network_audit_event("guest","dns-denied",
                                 "spring25.client.blazeredirector.ea.com",0,1);
    eden_network_audit_event("guest","tx","198.51.100.1:443",135,0);
    eden_network_audit_event("guest","tx","evil\nline",10,0);
    eden_network_audit_enable(0);
    assert(!eden_network_audit_active());
    assert(exists(logpath));
    assert(contains(logpath,"scope=launcher event=dns-resolved target=api.nlib.cc"));
    assert(contains(logpath,"scope=guest event=dns-denied target=api.ea.com"));
    assert(contains(logpath,"event=dns-denied-summary target=aggregated bytes=0 status=0 count="));
    check_all_timestamps(logpath);
    assert(contains(logpath,"target=spring25.client.blazeredirector.ea.com"));
    assert(contains(logpath,"scope=guest event=tx target=198.51.100.1:443 bytes=135"));
    assert(contains(logpath,"target=evil_line"));
    const long initial=bytes(logpath);
    eden_network_audit_event("guest","tx","no-quiet-write",500,0);
    assert(bytes(logpath)==initial);
    eden_network_audit_enable(1);
    for (int i=0;i<80000;i++)
        eden_network_audit_event("guest","tx","203.0.113.10:12345",1000,0);
    eden_network_audit_enable(0);
    assert(exists(logpath)&&exists(oldpath));
    assert(bytes(logpath)<=4*1024*1024);
    assert(bytes(oldpath)<=4*1024*1024+512);
    check_all_timestamps(logpath);
    check_all_timestamps(oldpath);
    puts("NETWORK_AUDIT_HOST_PASS: quiet, duplicate DNS throttle, native TX preservation, escaping, 4MiB rotation");
    return 0;
}
"""
compiler=shutil.which("clang-18") or shutil.which("clang") or shutil.which("cc")
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
"""Compile & execute the actual shared hosts matcher for launcher and guest.

Domain suffixes include the apex and arbitrary subdomains; '*' is label-safe.
All unexpected/missing/corrupted packaged policies fail closed.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
hosts = root / "headless/network-hosts.txt"
rules = [line.strip() for line in hosts.read_text().splitlines()
         if line.strip() and not line.lstrip().startswith("#")]
assert len(rules) >= 140
assert len(rules) == len(set(rules))
for domain in ("nintendo.com","nintendo.net","nintendoswitch.com.cn",
               "nintendods.cz","ea.com","epicgames.com","ubi-services.com",
               "microsoft.com","phoenix-api.wbagora.com",
               "xboxlive.com","pokemon.com","gogcdn.net",
               "scsi-upload-lp1.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com"):
    assert domain in rules
# Redundancy check: a nested domain already covered by a base rule is omitted.
for redundant in ("api.ea.com","accounts.nintendo.com",
                  "ctest.cdn.nintendo.net","shift.gearboxsoftware.com",
                  "api.epicgames.dev","gw.hac.lp1.vermillion.srv.nintendo.net"):
    assert redundant not in rules
assert "nlib.cc" not in rules and "github.com" not in rules
code = r"""
#include "network_domain_rules.h"
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdio.h>
static void yes(const char* name) { assert(eden_network_host_blocked(name) == 1); }
static void no(const char* name) { assert(eden_network_host_blocked(name) == 0); }
int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    assert(argc==3);
    // Before loading any rules, do not accidentally enable unfiltered DNS.
    yes("api.nlib.cc");
    assert(eden_network_filter_load("/no/such/network-hosts.txt") != 0);
    yes("not-yet-initialized.example");
    assert(eden_network_filter_load(argv[1]) == 0);
    assert(eden_network_filter_count() >= 140);
    yes("ea.com");
    yes("API.ea.com");
    yes("login.a.b.EA.COM.");
    yes("accounts.nintendo.com");
    yes("ctest-ul-lp1.cdn.nintendo.net");
    yes("scsi-upload-lp1.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com");
    yes("epicgames.dev");
    yes("api.epicgames.dev");
    yes("hub.gogcdn.net");
    yes("www.pokemon.co.jp");
    yes("forge.nintendods.cz");
    no("not-ea.com");
    // The old upstream hidden list is now removed. These two entries are
    // explicitly present in our own immutable packaged hosts policy.
    yes("microsoft.com");
    yes("login.microsoft.com");
    yes("cdn.login.microsoft.com");
    yes("phoenix-api.wbagora.com");
    yes("api.phoenix-api.wbagora.com");
    no("not-microsoft.com");
    no("phoenix-api.wbagora.com.evil.test");
    no("battlenet.com.evil.test");
    no("ea.com.evil.example");
    no("fake-nintendo.com");
    no("nintendowifi.net.evil.org");
    no("other.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com");
    no("api.nlib.cc");
    no("raw.githubusercontent.com");
    no("example.org");
    no("8.8.8.8"); // raw IP bypass is documented, not a domain security guarantee
    yes("broken..domain");
    yes(NULL);
    // Exact '*' patterns from the user's examples are tested separately.
    assert(eden_network_filter_load(argv[2]) != 0); // cannot mutate active policy
    puts("PASS: 145+ host rules, subdomains, canonical names, suffix boundaries and fail closed");
    return 0;
}
"""
wildcard = r"""
#include "network_domain_rules.h"
#include <assert.h>
int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    assert(argc==2);
    assert(eden_network_filter_load(argv[1])==0);
    assert(eden_network_host_blocked("alpha.test.fr"));
    assert(eden_network_host_blocked("api.alpha.test.fr"));
    assert(eden_network_host_blocked("api.test.org"));
    assert(eden_network_host_blocked("alpha.betatEst.fr"));
    assert(!eden_network_host_blocked("test.org"));
    assert(!eden_network_host_blocked("api.untested.org"));
    assert(!eden_network_host_blocked("hello.example"));
}
"""
c = shutil.which("clang") or shutil.which("cc")
assert c, "C compiler is required"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-network-hosts-") as dir:
    tmp=Path(dir)
    rules_fixture = tmp/"wildcard-hosts.txt"
    rules_fixture.write_text("*.test.*\n*.*test.fr\n")
    for which,source,arg in [
        ("main",code,[str(hosts),str(rules_fixture)]),
        ("wildcard",wildcard,[str(rules_fixture)]),
    ]:
        file=tmp/(which+".c")
        file.write_text(source)
        exe=tmp/which
        subprocess.run([c,"-std=c11","-O2","-Wall","-Wextra","-Werror",
                        "-I"+str(root/"headless"),
                        str(root/"headless/network_domain_rules.c"),
                        str(file),"-o",str(exe)],check=True)
        subprocess.run([str(exe),*arg],check=True,timeout=10)
print("Host network policy: compiled and passed (PS5 SDK & guest socket integration untested)")
```

```py
"""PS5 HTTPS uses Eden's complete pinned CA bundle and Encore identifies Nlib requests."""

    assert needle in compat, needle

                   "--defsym=freeaddrinfo=ps5_freeaddrinfo",
                   "--defsym=gai_strerror=ps5_gai_strerror"):
    assert redirected in link, redirected

# does not prove that the native two-pass lld invocation wraps fcntl.

assert 'link_native "$output" "$output.map"' in native_link

# The launcher's serial artwork downloads must not each wait 15 seconds on an offline Nlib endpoint.

assert "eden-ps5-launcher-fast-http.patch" in apply
assert 'extern "C" int sceNetInit();' in main
assert 'const int host_net_result = sceNetInit();' in main
assert 'host network init result=%d' in main
print("Encore PS5 HTTPS/Nlib CA + DNS/socket/native-network contract PASS")
```

```py
bool publish(int stat_error) {

        return false;
    }
    return true;
}
int main() {
    assert(publish(ENOENT) && publish(ENOTDIR));
    assert(!publish(EIO) && !publish(EACCES) && !publish(ENODEV));
}
```

`tools/check-ns1-ns2-component-owners-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""P0.3: reviewable NS1/NS2 source ownership; NOT an execution/console pass.

Read the checked-in inventory and verify concrete paths inside this repo and
its pinned vendor submodule. An owner change must update the mapping and the
corresponding host witness in the same change.
"""
import json
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SOURCE = ROOT / "docs/NS1_NS2_COMPONENT_OWNERS.json"
data = json.loads(SOURCE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
assert data["schema"] == 1
components = data["components"]
required = {
    "cpu-jit", "loader-content", "hos-ipc", "gmmu-buffer",
    "shader-translation", "vulkan-compute", "texture-cache",
    "frame-present", "launcher-library",
}
names = [entry["name"] for entry in components]
assert len(names) == len(set(names)) and set(names) == required, (
    "Component owner contract drift", names
)
shared_owners = set()
for entry in components:
    assert entry["scope"] in {"shared-with-generation-adapters", "shared-ui"}
    assert entry["remaining"].strip(), entry["name"]
    owner = entry["owner"]
    assert owner not in shared_owners, ("Duplicated canonical owner", owner)
    shared_owners.add(owner)
    paths = [owner, entry["witness"]]
    if entry["scope"] == "shared-with-generation-adapters":
        assert entry["ns2_adapter"] != owner, ("NS2 adapter shadowing common owner", owner)
        paths.append(entry["ns2_adapter"])
    else:
        assert "ns2_adapter" not in entry
    for path in paths:
        assert not path.startswith("/") and ".." not in Path(path).parts, path
        assert (ROOT / path).is_file(), ("Missing pinned component source/witness", path)
    assert entry["witness"].startswith("tools/"), entry["name"]

# The native Compute path must share Vulkan BufferCache and TextureCache;
# do not claim the current native path binds images: unsupported TIC/TSC
# descriptors deliberately fail closed until a real cache handoff exists.
rasterizer = (ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_rasterizer.cpp").read_text()
compute = (ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vk_compute_pipeline_cost.cpp").read_text()
qmd = (ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/ampere/shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/native_qmd_compute_environment.h").read_text()
assert "DispatchNativeCompute" in rasterizer and "ConfigureNative" in rasterizer
assert "ComputePipeline::ConfigureNative" in compute
assert "BufferCache& buffer_cache" in compute
assert "requires_tic_tsc" in qmd and "HasResolvedBufferBindings()" in qmd
assert "std::scoped_lock lock{buffer_cache.mutex}" in rasterizer

print(f"EDEN_NS1_NS2_SOURCE_OWNERS_PASS components={len(components)} "
      "tracked_paths=1 native_texture_handoff_unverified=1")

```

`tools/check-ns2-ampere-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compile both Ampere ISA/address-map and decoder probes from the ONE renderer-selected owner."""
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import shutil
import tempfile
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
SOURCE = ROOT / "tools/ns2/test_ampere_isa.cpp"
PROBE_TEST = ROOT / "tools/ns2/test_ampere_isa_probe.cpp"
OVERLAY=ROOT/"vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/ampere"
PROBE = OVERLAY / "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/probe.cpp"
EDEN=ROOT/"vendor/sources/eden/src"

def main()->int:
    compiler=shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
    if compiler is None:
        print("Missing compiler",file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-ampere-") as tmp:
        for opt in ("-O0","-O2"):
            for name, source in (("isa-address-map", SOURCE), ("isa-probe", PROBE_TEST)):
                binary=Path(tmp)/(name+opt)
                subprocess.run([compiler,"-std=c++20",opt,"-Wall","-Wextra","-Werror",
                                "-pedantic","-fsanitize=undefined","-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
                                "-I",str(OVERLAY),"-I",str(EDEN),
                                "-I",str(ROOT/"build-ns2-a64/fmt/include"),
                                str(source),str(PROBE),"-o",str(binary)],check=True)
                subprocess.run([str(binary)],check=True)
                print(f"Canonical Ampere {name} {opt}: PASS")
    print("Host ISA/address-map only; no shader rendering, Vulkan, or PS5 runtime proof.")
    return 0

if __name__=="__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compile the maintained BufferCache::FindBuffer with table/span boundary cases.

The native owner is extracted verbatim; the historical desktop backport must
remain untouched. This validates guest-buffer admission without a PS5 build.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
active = (ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/video_core/buffer_cache/buffer_cache.h").read_text()
backport = (ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/eden-backports/src/video_core/buffer_cache/buffer_cache.h").read_text()
needle = "template <class P>\nBufferId BufferCache<P>::FindBuffer(DAddr device_addr, u32 size, bool sparse_compatible) {"
assert active.count(needle) == backport.count(needle) == 1
begin = active.index(needle)
method = active[begin:active.index("\ntemplate <class P>", begin + len(needle))]
assert "page >= page_table.size()" in method
assert "size > (u64{page_table.size()} << CACHING_PAGEBITS) - device_addr" in method
assert method.index("page >= page_table.size()") < method.index("page_table[page]")
legacy = backport[backport.index(needle):]
legacy = legacy[:legacy.index("\ntemplate <class P>", len(needle))]
assert "page >= page_table.size()" not in legacy  # selected native-only change
fixture = r'''
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstddef>
#include <vector>
using u32 = std::uint32_t;
using u64 = std::uint64_t;
using DAddr = u64;
using BufferId = unsigned;
constexpr BufferId NULL_BUFFER_ID = 0;
namespace Settings { bool IsGPUFenceBehaviorAccurate() { return false; } }
struct Buffer {
    DAddr base{};
    u32 bytes{};
    bool IsInBounds(DAddr start, u32 count) const {
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Host regression: exact extracted NS2JB input and safe NPDM identity."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
import zipfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def main() -> None:
    module_path = ROOT / "tools/ns2/prepare_firmware_dump.py"
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("ns2_dump", module_path)
    assert spec and spec.loader
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    compiler = shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
    assert compiler
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-ns2-firmware-") as tmp:
        root = Path(tmp)
        payloads = {}
        def put(relative: str, data: bytes) -> dict:
            payloads["firmware/" + relative] = data
            return {"file": relative.replace("/", "\\"), "size": len(data),
                    "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}
        inventory = b"synthetic system-program inventory"
        put("ncm-system-programs.bin", inventory)
        entries = []
        for title, has_main in (("0400000000000019", True), ("0400000000000837", False)):
            npdm = bytearray(0xB0)
            npdm[:4] = b"META"
            npdm[0x70] = 0x80
            npdm[0x74] = 0x30
            npdm[0x80:0x84] = b"ACI0"
            npdm[0x90:0x98] = int(title, 16).to_bytes(8, "little")
            members = [put(title + "/main.npdm", bytes(npdm))]
            if has_main:
                members.append(put(title + "/main", b"NSO0" + b"0" * 32))
            code = put(title + "/code-info.bin", b"synthetic info")
            entries.append({"title": "0x" + title, "status": "captured", "version": 1,
                            "codeInfo": code, "files": members,
                            "absentFiles": [] if has_main else [{"name": "main", "result": 514}]})
        put(".ns2jb-firmware-dump.json", json.dumps({"kind": "ns2jb-system-code-dump"}).encode())
        put("firmware-dump-named.json",
            json.dumps({"complete": True, "counts": {"captured": len(entries)},
                        "inventory": {"rawFile": "ncm-system-programs.bin",
                                      "sha256": hashlib.sha256(inventory).hexdigest(),
                                      "total": len(entries),
                                      "keys": [{"id": e["title"], "version": e["version"],
                                                "type": 1, "installType": 1} for e in entries]},
                        "entries": entries}).encode())
        archive = root / "firmware.zip"
        with zipfile.ZipFile(archive, "w", compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
            for name, data in payloads.items():
                z.writestr(name, data)
            z.writestr("__MACOSX/junk", b"ignored")
        module.inspect(archive)
        dest = root / "ns2-extracted"
        module.inspect(archive, dest)
        assert (dest / "0400000000000019/main").read_bytes().startswith(b"NSO0")
        assert not (dest / "0400000000000837/main").exists()
        assert not (dest / "__MACOSX").exists()
        try:
            module.inspect(archive, dest)
        except FileExistsError:
            pass
        else:
            raise AssertionError("Existing import was overwritten")
        # Exercise the exact shipping failure probe on both ACID signature
        # prefixes without supplying protected Nintendo data.
        def access_fixture(name: str, prefix: int, fac_offset: int) -> Path:
            image = bytearray(0x1000)
            image[:4] = b"META"
            image[0x78:0x7c] = (0x200).to_bytes(4, "little")
            image[0x7c:0x80] = (0x600).to_bytes(4, "little")
            base = 0x200 + prefix
            image[base:base+4] = b"ACID"
            image[base+0x20:base+0x24] = fac_offset.to_bytes(4, "little")
            image[base+0x24:base+0x28] = (0x2c).to_bytes(4, "little")
            p = root / name
            p.write_bytes(image)
            return p
        ns1 = access_fixture("valid-ns1.npdm", 0x200, 0x240)
        ns2 = access_fixture("valid-ns2.npdm", 0x300, 0x340)
        bad_fac = access_fixture("invalid-ns2-fac.npdm", 0x300, 0x5f0)
        cpp = root / "npdm.cpp"
        cpp.write_text("""#include "extracted_npdm_identity.h"
#include <cassert>
int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    assert(argc == 6);
    assert(Eden::ExtractedNpdm::TitleId(argv[1]) == 0x0400000000000019ULL);
    assert(Eden::ExtractedNpdm::TitleId(argv[2]) == 0);
    const auto one = Eden::ExtractedNpdm::ProbeAccess(argv[3]);
    const auto two = Eden::ExtractedNpdm::ProbeAccess(argv[4]);
    const auto broken = Eden::ExtractedNpdm::ProbeAccess(argv[5]);
    assert(one.header_ok && one.acid_found && !one.extended && one.fac_valid);
    assert(two.header_ok && two.acid_found && two.extended && two.fac_valid);
    assert(broken.header_ok && broken.acid_found && broken.extended &&
           !broken.fac_valid);
}""")
        binary = root / "check-npdm"
        subprocess.run([compiler, "-std=c++20", "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror",
                        "-I", str(ROOT / "headless"), str(cpp), "-o", str(binary)],
                       check=True, timeout=40)
        invalid = root / "bad.npdm"
        invalid.write_bytes(b"META" + b"0" * 36)
        subprocess.run([str(binary),
                        str(dest / "0400000000000019/main.npdm"), str(invalid),
                        str(ns1), str(ns2), str(bad_fac)],
                       check=True, timeout=10)
    print("NS2_EXTRACTED_INPUTS_HOST_PASS validated=1 partial=1 npdm_aci0=1 acid_ns1=1 acid_ns2=1 invalid_fac=1 overwrite=0")
```

`tools/check-ns2-gmmu-va-layout-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compile the actual 4K GMMU partition helper and verify its source owner."""
from pathlib import Path
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
AS = ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/nvdrv_as"
OWNER = AS / "core/hle/service/nvdrv/devices/nvhost_as_gpu.cpp"
HELPER = AS / "core/hle/service/nvdrv/devices/native_gpu_va_layout.h"
TEST = ROOT / "tools/ns2/test_native_gpu_va_layout.cpp"

def main():
    if not all(p.is_file() for p in (OWNER, HELPER, TEST)):
        print("NS2 4K GMMU source owner missing", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    owner = OWNER.read_text()
    markers = (
        'PlanNativeGpuVaLayout(start, split, end, big_page_size)',
        'if (!layout) return NvResult::BadValue;',
        'vm.small_page_allocator.emplace(layout->small_begin, layout->small_end);',
        'vm.big_page_allocator.emplace(layout->big_begin, layout->big_end);',
        'if (!vm.initialised || !gmmu || !m_native_process)',
        'const std::scoped_lock lock{mutex, gpu_channel_device->channel_mutex};',
        'if (!session || session->process != m_native_process)',
        'if (channel.memory_manager && channel.memory_manager != gmmu.get())',
        'NativePinnedPhysicalSpan(pinned, source, size)',
        'NativePinnedPhysicalSpan(pinned, range.source_offset, range.size)',
    )
    if not all(x in owner for x in markers):
        print("NS2 real GMMU layout owner not wired to validated helper", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    if owner.count('NativePinnedPhysicalSpan(pinned, source, size)') != 2:
        print("Native 4K/image pin paths are not both checked", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    if owner.index('if (!NativePinnedPhysicalSpan(pinned, range.source_offset, range.size))') > owner.index('gmmu->MapSparse(range.address, range.size, false);'):
        print("Native sparse pin check runs after GPU publication", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    if '(vm.va_range_end - vm.va_range_split) >> vm.big_page_size_bits' in owner:
        print("Relative GPU VA allocator bound reintroduced", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    compiler = shutil.which("g++") or shutil.which("clang++")
    host_env = dict(os.environ)
    pinned_sdk = Path("/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX15.4.sdk")
    if pinned_sdk.is_dir():
        host_env["SDKROOT"] = str(pinned_sdk)
    if not compiler:
        print("C++20 compiler missing", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-ns2-gmmu-va-") as folder:
        for opt in ("-O0", "-O2"):
            exe = Path(folder) / ("test" + opt)
            command = [compiler, "-std=c++20", opt, "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror",
                       "-pedantic", "-fsanitize=undefined", "-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
                       "-I", str(AS), str(TEST), "-o", str(exe)]
            subprocess.run(command, check=True, env=host_env)
            subprocess.run([str(exe)], check=True,
                           env={**host_env, "UBSAN_OPTIONS": "halt_on_error=1"})
    print("Native GMMU bounds and absolute VA limit: PASS (O0/O2 UBSan)")
    print("No native GPU worker, Ampere shaders or PS5 first frame inferred.")
    return 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
```

```py
"""Test the exact scoped GPU HLE headers from pinned Eden-NS2 plus uploaded patch."""
from pathlib import Path
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
HEADERS=ROOT/"vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/hle"
NVDRV=ROOT/"vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/nvdrv"
EDEN=ROOT/"vendor/sources/eden/src"
SOURCE=ROOT/"tools/ns2/test_graphics_hle.cpp"
EXPECTED=[
    HEADERS/"core/hle/service/am/service/graphics_supervisor_protocol.h",
    HEADERS/"core/hle/service/am/service/native_image_layout.h",
    HEADERS/"core/hle/service/am/service/gpu_memory_registration.h",
    HEADERS/"core/hle/service/nvdrv/devices/native_gpu_kind.h",
    HEADERS/"core/hle/service/nvdrv/devices/native_sparse_remap.h",
    HEADERS/"core/hle/service/nvdrv/devices/native_gpu_context.h",
    HEADERS/"core/hle/service/am/service/graphics_syncpoint_cache.h",
    HEADERS/"core/hle/service/am/service/gpu_session_protocol.h",
    HEADERS/"core/hle/service/am/service/graphics_supervisor_bootstrap.h",
    HEADERS/"core/hle/service/am/service/gpu_worker_protocol.h",
]
def main()->int:
    if not all(f.is_file() for f in EXPECTED):
        print("NS2 graphics HLE overlay incomplete",file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    # The real research-only supervisor, not just the standalone protocol,
    # handles creation/bind/destruction; no synthetic GPU work is advertised.
    supervisor=ROOT/"vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/graphics_supervisor/core/hle/service/am/service/graphics_supervisor.cpp"
    text=supervisor.read_text()
    for command, method in ((111,"CreateNativeMemory"),(112,"DestroyNativeMemory"),(114,"BindNativeMemory")):
        assert '{'+str(command)+', &IGraphicsSupervisor::'+method in text
    assert 'm_native_memory.ValidateBind(' in text
    assert 'table.QueryInfo(&info, &page, cursor)' in text
    # Accept only formatting whitespace; the same native-memory guard is required.
    assert re.search(r'NativeMemoryError\s*\(\s*m_native_memory\.Bind\s*\(', text)
    assert 'm_native_memory.Destroy(' in text
    # GSV 111/112/114 must use real NVMap handle identity and kernel page locks,
    # not acknowledge metadata-only resources that cannot become GPU images.
    for source in (
        'nvmap.CreateHandle(size, handle)',
        'm_native_memory.Adopt(id, size)',
        'auto handle = nvmap.GetHandle(packet[2])',
        'handle.reset(); // FreeHandle',
        'nvmap.FreeHandle(packet[2], false)',
        'table.LockForMapDeviceAddressSpace(',
        'handle->Alloc(',
        'm_native_memory.Bind(id, address, size)',
        'UnlockForDeviceAddressSpace(',
        'm_native_module->GetContainer().CloseSession(',
    ):
        assert source in text, "Missing real GSV NVMap lifetime owner: " + source
    assert 'm_native_memory.Create(size)' not in text, "Synthetic GSV native memory ID in runtime"
    # Protocol 11 (VI2) and 12 (GPU session) must expose an event as
    # a TIPC COPY handle. Explicit errors carry no phantom null handle.
    vi_notify=text.split('void Event(HLERequestContext& ctx) {',1)[1].split('void VsyncEvent(',1)[0]
    assert 'IPC::ResponseBuilder rb{ctx,2,1,0};' in vi_notify
    assert 'rb.PushCopyObjects(ctx,m_event->GetReadableEvent());' in vi_notify
    assert 'AddMoveObject' not in vi_notify
    assert 'readable->Open(kernel)' not in vi_notify
    gpu_session=(ROOT/"vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/gpu_session/core/hle/service/am/service/gpu_session.cpp").read_text()
    gpu_notify=gpu_session.split('void IGpuSession::GetNotificationEvent(HLERequestContext& ctx) {',1)[1].split('IGpuSession::ResolveOpenedAddressSpace',1)[0]
    assert 'IPC::ResponseBuilder rb{ctx, 2, 1, 0};' in gpu_notify
    assert 'ctx.AddCopyObject(readable);' in gpu_notify
    assert gpu_notify.index('ctx.AddCopyObject(readable);') < gpu_notify.index(
        'IPC::ResponseBuilder rb{ctx, 2, 1, 0};')
```

`tools/check-ns2-homebrew-corpus.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Fetch an immutable, non-redistributed third-party GPU-app smoke corpus.

This is Vulkan GLSL/SPIR-V for the independent HBLauncher GPU-app ABI.
It is NOT a Nintendo NSO/NSP/XCI, native Ampere SM86 shader, or PS5 test.
Only download public original files; don't commit them or ship in a release.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import struct
import subprocess
import urllib.request

REPOSITORY = "CostelaCNX/blockfallns2"
REVISION = "a29ca2a16ace030499233a6fe8dfb1e6a73c614e"
# Git SHA-1 of original blobs, verified against the Git object prefix.
FILES = {
    "app.json": (410, "56b542037f2b68e88e70e3264a2576550b9bf39f"),
    "app.vert.spv": (852, "40018de425bc786553eaa8948e5072692958361f"),
    "app.frag.spv": (28252, "33a5297bbd898e5770d6456fc8534f9e2075a683"),
    "app.comp.spv": (56960, "95bf0c9412a291760a2d3495a28e27000aa26df1"),
}
# Explicit module type is checked both in the binary OpEntryPoint and by
# the Khronos SPIR-V validator; avoid treating any valid SPIR-V as a game.
STAGES = {"app.vert.spv": 0, "app.frag.spv": 4, "app.comp.spv": 5}

def git_blob_sha(data: bytes) -> str:
    prefix = b"blob " + str(len(data)).encode("ascii") + b"\0"
    return hashlib.sha1(prefix + data).hexdigest()

def parse_entrypoint_model(data: bytes) -> int:
    if len(data) < 20 or len(data) % 4 or len(data) > 1024 * 1024:
        raise ValueError("malformed SPIR-V module size")
    words = struct.unpack("<" + "I" * (len(data) // 4), data)
    if words[0] != 0x07230203 or words[3] == 0:
        raise ValueError("malformed SPIR-V header")
    index = 5
    entry = []
    while index < len(words):
        instruction = words[index]
        width, opcode = instruction >> 16, instruction & 0xFFFF
        if width < 1 or index + width > len(words):
            raise ValueError("malformed SPIR-V instruction span")
        if opcode == 15:  # OpEntryPoint
            if width < 4:
                raise ValueError("truncated SPIR-V entrypoint")
            entry.append(words[index + 1])
        index += width
    if len(entry) != 1:
        raise ValueError("expected exactly one shader entrypoint")
    return entry[0]

def fetch_exact(name: str, expected_size: int, expected_sha: str) -> bytes:
    uri = f"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/{REPOSITORY}/{REVISION}/{name}"
    request = urllib.request.Request(uri, headers={"User-Agent": "Eden-Encore-Research/1.0"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=30) as response:
        data = response.read(expected_size + 1)
    if len(data) != expected_size or git_blob_sha(data) != expected_sha:
        raise ValueError(f"{name}: upstream asset differs from pinned Git blob")
    return data

def self_test() -> None:
    blob = b"sample"
    assert git_blob_sha(blob) == hashlib.sha1(b"blob 6\0sample").hexdigest()
    for invalid in (b"", b"\0" * 20, b"\x03\x02\x23\x07" + b"\0" * 16):
        try:
            parse_entrypoint_model(invalid)
        except ValueError:
            continue
        raise AssertionError("corrupt SPIR-V accepted")
    print("NS2 immutable homebrew corpus parser: PASS")

def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--self-test", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, default=Path("build-ns2-homebrew"))
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.self_test:
        self_test()
        return
    args.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for name, (size, sha) in FILES.items():
        data = fetch_exact(name, size, sha)
        if name.endswith(".spv"):
            model = parse_entrypoint_model(data)
            if model != STAGES[name]:
                raise ValueError(f"{name}: unexpected shader stage {model}")
        else:
            manifest = json.loads(data)
            assert manifest["format"] == "hblauncher.gpu-app"
            assert manifest["abi"] == 1 and manifest["id"] == "blockfall"
            assert manifest["shaders"] == {
                "vertex": "app.vert.spv",
                "fragment": "app.frag.spv",
                "compute": "app.comp.spv",
            }
        target = args.output / name
        target.write_bytes(data)
        if name.endswith(".spv"):
            subprocess.run(["spirv-val", "--target-env", "vulkan1.0", str(target)],
                           check=True)
        print(f"{name}: original Git blob and ABI/stage/validator PASS", flush=True)
    print("External Blockfall Vulkan corpus verified; NOT a Switch 2 executable")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

```py
     "if (address == 0 || entry_size == 0 ||" in guard and
     "count > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max() / entry_size" in guard and
     "address > std::numeric_limits<std::uint64_t>::max() - bytes" in guard,
     "native kickoff maps every guest header with overflow-safe bounded helper, leaving NS1 unchanged"),
    (all(s in source for s in required_cpp), "native source uses exact caller FD"),
    (all(s in header for s in required_header), "native header exposes caller FD"),
    (all(s in native_puller for s in required_puller),
     "actual research Puller owns authenticated native 3D/Turing macro dispatch"),
    (binding_write not in bind_source.split(
        "if (engine_id == static_cast<EngineID>(0xc797)) {", 1)[0],
     "native classes do not commit binding before authentication"),
    (ampere_3d_bind.count(binding_write) == 1 and
     ampere_3d_bind.index(binding_write) > ampere_3d_bind.index("if (native_3d_failed || native_macro_method)"),
     "native 3D bind commits only after channel authorization and valid MME state"),
    (ampere_compute_bind.count(binding_write) == 1 and
     ampere_compute_bind.index(binding_write) > ampere_compute_bind.index("IsNative(") and
     "EngineTypes::KeplerCompute" in ampere_compute_bind and
     "retire_native_3d();" in ampere_compute_bind,
     "native compute class binds only after channel authorization and revokes previous 3D owner"),
    (ampere_dma_bind.count(binding_write) == 1 and
     ampere_dma_bind.index(binding_write) > ampere_dma_bind.index("IsNative("),
     "native DMA bind commits only after channel authorization"),
    ("UsesNativeAbi()" not in source + header, "no unscoped native ABI call"),
    (source.count("return SubmitGPFIFOImpl(params, std::move(entries), fd);") == 2,
     "both GPFIFO submit paths propagate FD"),
    ("output, fd);" in source, "inline submit passes FD"),
    ("for (const auto& [other_fd, session_id] : sessions)" in source,
     "native channel rejects mixed-process FDs before GPU queue work"),
]
errors = [message for passed, message in checks if not passed]
if errors:
    print("NS2 NVDRV per-FD ABI isolation: FAILED: " + "; ".join(errors), file=sys.stderr)
    raise SystemExit(1)
print("NS2 NVDRV per-FD ABI isolation source gate: PASS")
print("No NS2 GPU hardware or PS5 gameplay inference.")
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Run the real NS2 ACID layout header in standalone C++20 host regressions."""
from __future__ import annotations
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
HEADER_DIR = ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/ns2-helpers/include"
TEST = ROOT / "tools" / "ns2" / "test_npdm_layout.cpp"
SOURCE = ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/metadata/core/file_sys/program_metadata.cpp"
CMAKE = ROOT / "headless" / "CMakeLists.txt"

def main() -> int:
    compiler = shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
    if compiler is None:
        print("No C++20 compiler found", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    if 'FindAcidBody(' not in SOURCE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"):
        print("Production metadata reader not wired to the tested helper", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    if ('if(PS5_NATIVE)\n    set(EDEN_REVIEWED_DUAL_NPDM ON)' not in
            CMAKE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")):
        print("Shared NPDM native PS5 source selector missing", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-ns2-npdm-") as tmp:
        for opt in ("-O0", "-O2"):
            executable = Path(tmp) / ("test_" + opt[1:])
            command = [compiler, "-std=c++20", "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror",
                       "-pedantic", opt, "-fsanitize=undefined",
                       "-fno-sanitize-recover=all", "-I", str(HEADER_DIR),
                       str(TEST), "-o", str(executable)]
            subprocess.run(command, check=True)
            subprocess.run([str(executable)], check=True,
                           env={**os.environ, "UBSAN_OPTIONS": "halt_on_error=1"})
            print(f"NS1_NS2_SHARED_NPDM_ACID_HELPER {opt}: PASS")
    print("NOTE: parser helper tested; complete Eden core / native PS5 build NOT tested")
    return 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
```

`tools/check-ns2-real-ir-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compile the real pinned Eden Maxwell frontend and IR passes, with no spies."""
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed
from pathlib import Path
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
SRC = ROOT / "vendor/sources/eden/src"
SHADER = SRC / "shader_recompiler"
OUT = ROOT / "build-ns2-real-ir"
def run(args):
    p = subprocess.run(args,cwd=ROOT,capture_output=True,text=True)
    if p.returncode:
        print("FAILED:"," ".join(map(str,args)),file=sys.stderr)
        print(p.stdout[-5000:],p.stderr[-15000:],file=sys.stderr)
        raise RuntimeError("real IR build or run failed")
    return p
def main():
    cxx = shutil.which(os.environ.get("CXX","g++"))
    if not cxx: raise RuntimeError("missing C++ compiler")
    fmt = ROOT / "build-ns2-a64/fmt/include"
    cmake = SHADER / "CMakeLists.txt"
    if not cmake.is_file() or not (fmt / "fmt/format.h").is_file():
        raise RuntimeError("missing pinned submodules or fmt")
    listing = cmake.read_text().split("add_library(shader_recompiler STATIC",1)[1].split("\n)",1)[0]
    names = re.findall(r"^\s*((?:frontend|ir_opt)/[^\s()]+\.cpp)\s*$",listing,re.M)
    if len(names)<100 or "frontend/maxwell/translate_program.cpp" not in names:
        raise RuntimeError("unexpected pinned CMake shader source list")
    overlay = ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/ampere/shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere"
    sources = [SHADER / name for name in names] + [
        overlay / (name+".cpp") for name in
        ("ir_bridge","maxwell_environment","maxwell_image","lower_bridge","probe")
    ] + [SRC / "common/settings_common.cpp",
        ROOT / "tools/ns2/jit-host/common_shim.cpp",
         ROOT / "tools/ns2/test_ampere_real_ir.cpp"]
    if any(not x.is_file() for x in sources):
        raise RuntimeError("missing pinned shader source")
    OUT.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    flags = [cxx,"-std=c++20","-O0","-g0","-DFMT_HEADER_ONLY",
             "-ffunction-sections","-fdata-sections","-Wno-unused-parameter",
             "-pthread","-I"+str(fmt),"-I"+str(ROOT/"vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/ampere"),
             "-I"+str(SRC),"-I"+str(SRC/"dynarmic/src")]
    jobs = [(s,OUT/("%03d.o"%i)) for i,s in enumerate(sources)]
    print("Compile true Eden Maxwell/IR sources:",len(jobs),flush=True)
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
        future = {pool.submit(run,flags+["-c",str(src),"-o",str(obj)]):src for src,obj in jobs}
        for f in as_completed(future):
            try: f.result()
            except Exception:
                print("Source:",future[f],file=sys.stderr)
                for other in future: other.cancel()
                raise
    exe=OUT/"ns2-real-ir"
    run([cxx,"-pthread","-Wl,--gc-sections","-o",str(exe)]+
        [str(obj) for _,obj in jobs]+["-latomic"])
    print(run([str(exe)]).stdout,end="")
if __name__=="__main__":
    try: main()
    except Exception as exc:
        print(exc,file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Archived A64 RETAA/RETAB decoder oracle; production promotes LDAPR only."""
from __future__ import annotations
from pathlib import Path
import os

import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
BASE=ROOT/"vendor/encore-active/ns2-a64"
CMAKE=(ROOT/"headless/CMakeLists.txt").read_text()
BRANCH=(BASE/"dynarmic/frontend/A64/translate/impl/a64_branch.cpp").read_text()
DEC=(BASE/"dynarmic/frontend/A64/decoder/a64.inc").read_text()
HEADER=(BASE/"dynarmic/frontend/A64/decoder/a64.h").read_text()

def main() -> int:
    if ('EDEN_NS2_A64_EXPERIMENTAL' in CMAKE
        or 'set(EDEN_SHARED_NS2_A64_LDAPR ON)' not in CMAKE
        or 'target_include_directories(dynarmic BEFORE PRIVATE "${EDEN_A64_LDAPR_OUTPUT_ROOT}")' not in CMAKE
        or not (ROOT/"tools/ns2/check_shared_a64_ldapr_host.py").is_file()
        or '#include "./a64.inc"' not in HEADER
        or 'INST(RETA, "RETA", "110101100101111100001M1111111111")' not in DEC
        or 'INST(LDAPR, "LDAPR", "ss11100010111111110000nnnnnttttt")' not in DEC
        or any(('INST('+opcode+',') not in DEC for opcode in ('CAS','LDADD','LDCLR','LDEOR','LDSET','SWP','SWPB','SWPH'))
        or 'bool TranslatorVisitor::CAS(Imm<2> sz' not in (BASE/"dynarmic/frontend/A64/translate/impl/load_store_exclusive.cpp").read_text()
        or 'bool TranslatorVisitor::LDAPR(Imm<2> size, Reg Rn, Reg Rt)' not in (BASE/"dynarmic/frontend/A64/translate/impl/load_store_exclusive.cpp").read_text()
        or 'bool TranslatorVisitor::RETA(' not in BRANCH
        or 'return RET(Reg::R30);' not in BRANCH
        or '#if defined(EDEN_NS2_A64_EXPERIMENTAL)' not in BRANCH):
        print("Archived RETAA decoder or production LDAPR-only source ownership missing",file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    compiler=shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
    if not compiler:
```
