```py
        return 2
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="ns2-reta-") as tmp:
        for opt in ("-O0","-O2"):
            target=str(Path(tmp)/("test"+opt))
            cmd=[compiler,"-std=c++20","-Wall","-Wextra","-Werror","-pedantic",
                 "-fsanitize=undefined","-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
                 opt,"-I",str(BASE),
                 str(ROOT/"tools/ns2/test_reta_decode.cpp"),"-o",target]
            subprocess.run(cmd,check=True)
            subprocess.run([target],check=True,env={**os.environ,"UBSAN_OPTIONS":"halt_on_error=1"})
            print(f"NS2 A64 RETA/LDAPR/LSE opcode decoder table {opt}: PASS")
    print("Archived RETAA/LDAPR/LSE decoder only; production selects LDAPR, not PAC/LSE. No PS5 execution proof.")
    return 0

if __name__=="__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
```

`tools/check-ns2-source-selection.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Unified PS5 source-owner audit (P0.2) for NS1 and NS2.

Audits actual CMake selection, process ownership and ABI contracts. The
historical optional-overlay oracle is preserved in earlier Git revisions;
this check applies to the single current production source graph. Functional
shader/GMMU/NVDRV/IPC assertions are exercised by the separate host tests.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
CMAKE=(ROOT/'headless/CMakeLists.txt').read_text()
VENDOR=ROOT/'vendor/encore-active'

def require(ok: bool, reason: str) -> None:
    if not ok:
        raise AssertionError(reason)

def read(path: str) -> str:
    p=ROOT/path
    require(p.is_file(),f'missing source owner: {path}')
    return p.read_text()

def check() -> None:
    # No second runtime, switch by TitleID or release/DEV build selector.
    for forbidden in ('EDEN_NS2_VULKAN_SHADER_BRIDGE_EXPERIMENTAL',
                      'EDEN_NS2_NVDRV_EXPERIMENTAL',
                      'EDEN_NS2_GPU_SESSION_EXPERIMENTAL',
                      'EDEN_NS2_CPU6_EXPERIMENTAL',
                      'EDEN_NS2_EXEFS_EXPERIMENTAL',
                      'EDEN_NS2_AMPERE_PROBE_EXPERIMENTAL',
                      'EDEN_FINAL_RELEASE_PROFILE', 'EDEN_DEV_PROFILE',
                      'ns2-experimental/src/'):
        require(forbidden not in CMAKE,f'non-production source selector: {forbidden}')
    require(not re.search(r'^\s*option\(EDEN_NS2_',CMAKE,re.M),
            'alternate NS2 executable profile was reintroduced')
    require('if(PS5_NATIVE AND EDEN_REVIEWED_DUAL_NPDM)' in CMAKE,
            'hardware/NPDM guest-selection boundary missing')
    require('if(PS5_NATIVE AND EDEN_PS5_VULKAN)' in CMAKE,
            'normal Vulkan memory owners missing')
    require('include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/nup_v1_runtime.cmake")' in CMAKE,
            'NUP missing from the single normal content loader')
    require('set(EDEN_SHARED_NS2_EXEFS ON)' in CMAKE and
            'EDEN_NS2_METADATA_OVERLAY' in CMAKE,
            'unified NS1/NS2 ExeFS owner missing')
    for path in (
        'vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/metadata/core/file_sys/program_metadata.cpp',
        'vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/metadata/core/loader/loader.cpp',
        'vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/metadata/core/loader/nso.cpp',
        'vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/metadata/core/loader/deconstructed_rom_directory.cpp',
    ):
        read(path)

    # CPU6 and GPU access are runtime properties of the recorded process,
    # not flags that permit native commands for a foreign NS1 owner.
    cpu6=read('vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/cpu6/core/hardware_properties.h')
    monitor=read('vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/cpu6/dynarmic/interface/exclusive_monitor.h')
    require('NUM_CPU_CORES = 6' in cpu6 and
            'MAX_NUM_CPU_CORES = 6' in monitor and
            'include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/ns2_cpu6_source_bridge.cmake")' in CMAKE,
            'six-core CPU/JIT source graph missing')
    jit=read('headless/jit_memory_policy.h')
    require('A64BaselineBytes(std::size_t core)' in jit and
            'A32BaselineBytes(std::size_t core)' in jit,
            'six-core native JIT fallback is out-of-bounds')
    process=read('vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/process/core/hle/service/os/process.cpp')
    require('EDEN_NS2_PROCESS_RUN_GUARD' in process and
            'target_compile_definitions(core PRIVATE EDEN_NS2_PROCESS_RUN_GUARD=1)' in CMAKE,
            'native process Run admission omitted')
    svc=read('vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/gpu_access_svc/core/hle/kernel/svc.cpp')
    require('Eden::NS2::GpuAccess::Validate' in svc and
            'target_include_directories(core BEFORE PUBLIC "${EDEN_NS2_GPU_ACCESS_ROOT}")' in CMAKE and
            'EDEN_SHARED_NS2_WAIT64' in CMAKE,
            'shared SVC/Wait64 kernel owner missing')
    memory=read('vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/nvdrv_as/core/hle/service/nvdrv/devices/nvhost_as_gpu.cpp')
    require('MapNative4K' in memory and 'UnmapNative4K' in memory,
            '4 KiB native GMMU memory source missing')
    nvdrv=read('vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/nvdrv_gpu/core/hle/service/nvdrv/devices/nvhost_gpu.cpp')
    require('ValidateChannelOwner(' in nvdrv and
            nvdrv.count('ValidateChannelOwner(fd, program_id)')>=2 and
            'SubmitGPFIFOImpl' in nvdrv and
            'NativeGpuProcessRegistry' in nvdrv,
            'GPFIFO ownership/range preflight not selected')
    require('EDEN_NS2_NVDRV_GPU_SOURCE' in CMAKE and
            'EDEN_NS2_NVDRV_AS_SOURCE' in CMAKE,
            'the native NVDRV drivers are not selected')
    session=read('vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/gpu_session/core/hle/service/am/service/gpu_session.cpp')
    supervisor=read('vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/graphics_supervisor/core/hle/service/am/service/graphics_supervisor.cpp')
    require('EDEN_NS2_IPC owner=gpu_session' in session and
            'EDEN_NS2_IPC owner=graphics_supervisor' in supervisor and
            'EDEN_NS2_GPU_SESSION_SOURCE' in CMAKE and
            'EDEN_NS2_SUPERVISOR_ROOT' in CMAKE,
            'IPC native session/VI2 owners missing')
    puller=read('vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/gpu_dispatch/video_core/engines/puller.cpp')
    require('NativeGpuChannelRegistry::Instance().IsNative(' in puller and
            'ProcessNativeComputeQmdAt(' in puller and
            'pusher.rasterizer->DispatchNativeCompute(*launch)' in puller and
            'CaptureNativeComputeShader(' not in puller and
            'if (mapped && release_targets_mapped)' in puller,
            'native Ampere QMD3 single-dispatch graph missing or capture duplicated')
    require('EDEN_NS2_NATIVE_GPU_PULLER' in CMAKE and
            'EDEN_SHARED_NS2_AMPERE_CORE' in CMAKE and
            'EDEN_SHARED_NS2_SPIRV_COMPILER' in CMAKE,
            'unified Ampere SPIR-V sources not selected')
    qmd=read('vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/gpu_dispatch/video_core/native_qmd.h')
    require('class NativeQmdScheduler' in qmd and
            'std::unordered_map<Address, State> states;' in qmd and
            'NativeQmdReleaseTargetsMapped' in qmd,
            'QMD3 has lost its state and release-target validation')
    header=read('vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/vulkan_abi/video_core/rasterizer_interface.h')
    raster=read('vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_rasterizer.cpp')
    require('virtual bool DispatchNativeCompute(const Tegra::NativeComputeLaunch&)' in header and
            'bool RasterizerVulkan::DispatchNativeCompute(' in raster and
            'CaptureNativeComputeShader(' in raster and
            'if (!captured.Ready()' in raster and
            'configure_file("${EDEN_NS2_RASTERIZER_INTERFACE}"' in CMAKE and
            'EDEN_NS2_NATIVE_VULKAN' not in CMAKE,
            'native compute vtable not unified across core/renderer')
    # The selected PS5 rasterizer must enforce *live* QMD3 atomics against
    # the reflected storage plan; the compiler-side check is not enough.
    require('Shader::Ampere::NativeQmdAtomicSpansFitBindings(' in raster and
            'compiled.native_atomic_spans.data()' in raster and
            'resources->storage_buffers' in raster and
            'cmdbuf.Dispatch(dim[0], dim[1], dim[2])' in raster,
            'production Vulkan native atomic span admission missing')
    vk_select=read('headless/vulkan.cmake')
    require('file(COPY "${EDEN_ACTIVE_VULKAN}/" DESTINATION "${PORT_BUILD_DIR}")' in vk_select and
            '"${PORT_BUILD_DIR}/vulkan_rasterizer.cpp"' in vk_select,
            'production Vulkan renderer no longer uses maintained source')
    maxwell=read('vendor/sources/eden/src/video_core/buffer_cache/buffer_cache_base.h')
    ampere=read('vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/shader_resource/include/video_core/buffer_cache/buffer_cache_base.h')
    require('NUM_STORAGE_BUFFERS = 16;' in maxwell and
            'NUM_STORAGE_BUFFERS = 32;' in ampere,
            'NS1 Maxwell and NS2 Ampere storage ABIs no longer isolated')
    read('tools/ns2/check_unified_native_gpu_graph_host.py')
    read('tools/ns2/check_unified_jit_cpu6_baseline_host.py')

    # Configure the real selected source lists, not a hand-written substitute.
    proof=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B',
                          str(ROOT/'tools/ns2/check_unified_native_gpu_graph_host.py')],
                         cwd=ROOT,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=80)
    require(proof.returncode==0 and 'UNIFIED_NATIVE_GPU_SOURCE_GRAPH_PASS' in proof.stdout,
            'actual CMake source ownership failed: '+proof.stdout[-1700:]+proof.stderr[-1700:])

if __name__=='__main__':
    try:check()
    except (AssertionError,OSError,subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
        print('NS1_NS2_UNIFIED_SOURCE_OWNER_FAIL',error,file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    print('NS1_NS2_UNIFIED_SOURCE_OWNER_PASS cpu6=6 nvdrv=4k qmd=real nup=always maxwell=unchanged')
```

`tools/check-ns2-spirv-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build actual pinned Eden Maxwell/IR/SPIR-V and validate synthetic graphics modules.

Uses the upstream CMake source inventories, with real Sirit and SPIRV-Headers.
Does not attach this compiler to production Vulkan or Switch 1 shader caches.
"""
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed
from pathlib import Path
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
SRC = ROOT / "vendor/sources/eden/src"
SHADER = SRC / "shader_recompiler"
SIRIT = ROOT / "build-ns2-deps/sirit"
HEADERS = ROOT / "build-ns2-deps/spirv-headers"
FMT = ROOT / "build-ns2-a64/fmt/include"
OUT = ROOT / "build-ns2-real-spirv"

def run(cmd):
    result = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True)
    if result.returncode:
        print("FAILED:", " ".join(map(str, cmd)), file=sys.stderr)
        print(result.stdout[-6000:], result.stderr[-18000:], file=sys.stderr)
        raise RuntimeError("real SPIR-V build or validation failed")
    return result

def cmake_sources(file, prefix, pattern, minimum, required):
    cmake = file.read_text().split("add_library(" + prefix, 1)[1].split("\n)", 1)[0]
    names = re.findall(r"^\s*(" + pattern + r")\s*$", cmake, re.M)
    if len(names) < minimum or any(name not in names for name in required):
        raise RuntimeError("unexpected pinned CMake source inventory: " + str(file))
    return names

def main():
    cxx = shutil.which(os.environ.get("CXX", "g++"))
    validator = shutil.which("spirv-val")
    if not cxx or not validator:
        raise RuntimeError("requires C++20 compiler and spirv-val")
    if not (FMT / "fmt/format.h").is_file() or not (SIRIT / "include/sirit/sirit.h").is_file() or not (HEADERS / "include/spirv/unified1/spirv.hpp11").is_file():
        raise RuntimeError("pinned fmt/Sirit/SPIRV-Headers are missing")
    shaders = cmake_sources(
        SHADER / "CMakeLists.txt", "shader_recompiler STATIC",
        r"(?:frontend|ir_opt|backend/spirv)/[^\s()]+\.cpp", 135,
        ["frontend/maxwell/translate_program.cpp",
         "backend/spirv/emit_spirv.cpp",
         "backend/spirv/spirv_emit_context.cpp"])
    sirit_sources = cmake_sources(
        SIRIT / "src/CMakeLists.txt", "siritobj OBJECT",
        r"(?:instructions/)?[^\s()/]+\.cpp", 18,
        ["sirit.cpp", "instructions/type.cpp"])
    overlay = ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/ampere/shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere"
    mesh_root = ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/eden-shader/src"
    # Use the SAME production shader headers and translation units as the
    # single PS5 CMake shader target. Mixed pinned headers with native TES
    # emitters cannot compile and do not represent a real ABI witness.
    native_owners = {
        "backend/spirv/spirv_emit_context.cpp":
            ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/ampere/shader_recompiler/backend/spirv/spirv_emit_context.cpp",
        "backend/spirv/emit_spirv_context_get_set.cpp":
            ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/ampere/shader_recompiler/backend/spirv/emit_spirv_context_get_set.cpp",
        "backend/spirv/emit_spirv_image.cpp":
            ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/ampere/shader_recompiler/backend/spirv/emit_spirv_image.cpp",
    }
    mesh_owners = (
        "backend/spirv/emit_spirv.cpp",
        "backend/spirv/emit_spirv_special.cpp",
        "frontend/ir/ir_emitter.cpp",
        "frontend/ir/microinstruction.cpp",
        "frontend/ir/opcodes.cpp",
        "frontend/maxwell/decode.cpp",
        "frontend/maxwell/opcodes.cpp",
        "frontend/maxwell/structured_control_flow.cpp",
        "frontend/maxwell/translate/impl/internal_stage_buffer_entry_read.cpp",
        "frontend/maxwell/translate_program.cpp",
        "ir_opt/collect_shader_info_pass.cpp",
    )
    for name in mesh_owners:
        if name in native_owners:
            raise RuntimeError("native shader owner collision: " + name)
        native_owners[name] = mesh_root / "shader_recompiler" / name
    if any(shaders.count(name) != 1 for name in native_owners):
        raise RuntimeError("pinned SPIR-V/Task/Mesh source owner changed")
    # All three opcode owners must use the same table. An extra pseudo-opcode
    # shifts subsequent enum values, so mixing old names or decoder is unsafe.
    opcode_root = mesh_root / "shader_recompiler/frontend/maxwell"
    opcode_table = (opcode_root / "maxwell.inc").read_text()
    opcode_enum = (opcode_root / "opcodes.h").read_text()
    opcode_decoder = (opcode_root / "decode.cpp").read_text()
    opcode_names = (opcode_root / "opcodes.cpp").read_text()
    if ("INST(ISBE_nx2" not in opcode_table or
            '#include "maxwell.inc"' not in opcode_enum or
            '#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/maxwell/maxwell.inc"' not in opcode_decoder or
            '#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/maxwell/maxwell.inc"' not in opcode_names):
        raise RuntimeError("mixed native Maxwell/NS2 opcode table ABI")
    extra_mesh = mesh_root / "shader_recompiler/backend/spirv/emit_spirv_mesh.cpp"
    if not extra_mesh.is_file():
        raise RuntimeError("missing actual SPIR-V mesh emitter")
    sources = [native_owners.get(name, SHADER / name)
               for name in shaders] + [extra_mesh] + [
        overlay / (name + ".cpp") for name in
        ("ir_bridge", "renderer_spirv_bridge", "maxwell_environment", "maxwell_image", "lower_bridge", "probe")
    ] + [overlay / "capture.cpp",
         overlay / "translation_cache.cpp",
         ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/ampere/video_core/ns2_shader_spirv_compile.cpp",
         SRC / "common/settings_common.cpp",
         ROOT / "tools/ns2/jit-host/common_shim.cpp",
         ROOT / "tools/ns2/test_ampere_real_spirv.cpp"]
    sources += [SIRIT / "src" / name for name in sirit_sources]
    # Compile the host fixture FIRST: all source owners must still build,
    # but a local C++ fixture typo must fail in seconds rather than after
    # compiling ~150 unrelated shader objects.
    fixture = ROOT / "tools/ns2/test_ampere_real_spirv.cpp"
    if sources.count(fixture) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError("real SPIR-V host fixture owner missing or duplicated")
    sources = [fixture] + [source for source in sources if source != fixture]
    if len({str(p) for p in sources}) != len(sources):
        raise RuntimeError("duplicate SPIR-V translation unit")
    maintained_header = (mesh_root / "shader_recompiler/backend/spirv/spirv_emit_context.h").read_text()
    for name in ("input_tess_level_outer", "input_tess_level_inner",
                 "output_tess_level_outer", "output_tess_level_inner"):
        if name not in maintained_header:
            raise RuntimeError("maintained TES/TCS patch interface missing: " + name)
    missing = [str(p) for p in sources if not p.is_file()]
    if missing:
        raise RuntimeError("missing pinned shader sources: " + ", ".join(missing))
    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    flags = [cxx, "-std=c++20", "-O0", "-g0", "-DFMT_HEADER_ONLY",
             "-ffunction-sections", "-fdata-sections", "-Wno-unused-parameter",
             "-pthread", "-I" + str(FMT),
              "-I" + str(mesh_root),
             "-I" + str(ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/ampere"),
             "-I" + str(ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/gpu_dispatch"),
             "-I" + str(ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/hle"), "-I" + str(SRC),
             "-I" + str(SRC / "dynarmic/src"),
             "-I" + str(SIRIT / "include"), "-I" + str(SIRIT / "src"),
             "-I" + str(HEADERS / "include")]
    jobs = [(p, OUT / f"{i:03d}.o") for i, p in enumerate(sources)]
    print("Compiling true Maxwell, IR, SPIR-V and Sirit C++ units:", len(jobs), flush=True)
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
        futures = {pool.submit(run, flags + ["-c", str(src), "-o", str(obj)]): src
                   for src, obj in jobs}
        for item in as_completed(futures):
            try:
                item.result()
            except Exception:
                print("Failing source:", futures[item], file=sys.stderr)
                for other in futures:
                    other.cancel()
                raise
    binary = OUT / "ns2-real-spirv"
    run([cxx, "-pthread", "-Wl,--gc-sections", "-o", str(binary)] +
        [str(obj) for _, obj in jobs] + ["-latomic"])
    print(run([str(binary), str(OUT / "synthetic")]).stdout, end="")
    # Real live native LDC 0xb82 reaches QMD3 CBUF banks 0 and 7; BRX
    # reaches the actual Maxwell CFG/IR/Sirit loop+conditional dispatch.
    # Validate the executable-structure SPIR-V modules, not only headers or
    # reflected descriptor plans. No PS5 GPU work is submitted here.
    for mode in ("direct", "dispatcher", "fragment", "merged", "compute", "cbuf0", "cbuf7", "brx"):
        path = OUT / f"synthetic-{mode}.spv"
        print(run([validator, "--target-env", "spv1.5", str(path)]).stdout, end="")
        print(f"spirv-val SPIR-V 1.5 {mode}: PASS")
        print(run([validator, "--target-env", "vulkan1.2", str(path)]).stdout, end="")
        print(f"spirv-val Vulkan 1.2 {mode}: PASS")
    # The seven QMD3 floating atomic operations now reach the actual
    # maintained SPIR-V backend. Check emitted OpAtomicCompareExchange
    # bodies under BOTH SPIR-V 1.5 and Vulkan 1.2 validation rules.
    for kind in ("u32-cas", "f32-add", "f16x2-add", "f16x2-min", "f16x2-max",
                 "f32x2-add", "f32x2-min", "f32x2-max"):
        path = OUT / f"synthetic-{kind}.spv"
        for env in ("spv1.5", "vulkan1.2"):
            run([validator, "--target-env", env, str(path)])
            print(f"P2_3_REAL_FLOAT_CAS_SPIRV_VALIDATED {kind} {env}",flush=True)
    # G06: authentic native 64-bit global CAS router and CBUF/SSBO
    # addressing. Do not accept a header-only CAS conformance claim.
    for env in ("spv1.5", "vulkan1.2"):
        # Packed legacy U32/U32x2 UBO views require the explicit Vulkan 1.2
        # uniformBufferStandardLayout feature; the host Vulkan test must
        # independently query and ENABLE this feature on the real device.
        opts = ["--uniform-buffer-standard-layout"] if env == "vulkan1.2" else []
        run([validator, "--target-env", env, *opts,
             str(OUT / "synthetic-global-cas.spv")])
        print(f"G06_REAL_GLOBAL_CAS_SPIRV_VALIDATED {env} feature=standard_layout", flush=True)
    # P2.4: validate REAL EXT shader opcodes emitted from synthetic
    # Task and Mesh IR, not just a C++ compile or the legacy VertexB module.
    for stage in ("task", "mesh"):
        path = OUT / f"synthetic-{stage}.spv"
        for env in ("spv1.5", "vulkan1.2"):
            run([validator, "--target-env", env, str(path)])
            print(f"P2_4_REAL_{stage.upper()}_SPIRV_VALIDATED {env}", flush=True)
    # Actual SPIR-V descriptor-array module, not a stub header source check.
    for env in ("spv1.5", "vulkan1.2"):
        run([validator, "--target-env", env,
             str(OUT / "synthetic-texbuf-array.spv")])
        print(f"P2_2C_REAL_TEXTURE_BUFFER_ARRAY_VALIDATED {env}", flush=True)
    # G07: real native image-buffer reads are committed to an SSBO and
    # verified with Vulkan host dispatch + a completion fence (not PS5).
    g07_module = OUT / "synthetic-g07-texel-ssbo.spv"
    for env in ("spv1.5", "vulkan1.2"):
        run([validator, "--target-env", env, str(g07_module)])
        print(f"G07_NATIVE_TEXEL_SSBO_SPIRV_VALIDATED {env}", flush=True)
    g07_exe = OUT / "ns2-g07-vulkan"
    run([cxx, "-std=c++20", "-O2", "-DFMT_HEADER_ONLY",
         "-I" + str(ROOT / "vendor/sources/fmt/include"),
         "-I" + str(ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/ampere"),
         "-I" + str(ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/gpu_dispatch"),
         "-I" + str(ROOT / "vendor/sources/eden/src"),
         str(ROOT / "tools/ns2/test_g07_real_vulkan_texel.cpp"),
         "-o", str(g07_exe), "-lvulkan"])
    print(run([str(g07_exe), str(g07_module)]).stdout, end="")
    # G09: require real native EXT Task/Mesh graphics pipeline creation,
    # if (and only if) the host Vulkan device supports the extension.
    # An unavailable feature is recorded explicitly and never counted as proof.
    g09_exe = OUT / "ns2-g09-mesh-pipeline"
    run([cxx, "-std=c++20", "-O2",
         str(ROOT / "tools/ns2/test_g09_native_mesh_pipeline.cpp"),
         "-o", str(g09_exe), "-lvulkan"])
    print(run([str(g09_exe),
               str(OUT / "synthetic-task.spv"),
               str(OUT / "synthetic-mesh.spv")]).stdout, end="")
    # G02: the actual emitted VertexB split XFB module must pass the
    # SPIR-V 1.5 and Vulkan 1.2 structural/resource validation rules.
    # The emitted OpStores, component splits and two guest byte offsets are
    # verified by the C++ real-owner fixture above.
    for env in ("spv1.5", "vulkan1.2"):
        run([validator, "--target-env", env,
             str(OUT / "synthetic-xfb-split.spv")])
        print(f"P2_G02_REAL_XFB_SPIRV_VALIDATED {env}", flush=True)
    # G03: independently validate TCS output and TES input for all six
    # built-in tessellation patch levels, not merely C++ emitter symbols.
    for kind in ("tess-control", "tess-eval"):
        path = OUT / f"synthetic-{kind}.spv"
        for env in ("spv1.5", "vulkan1.2"):
            run([validator, "--target-env", env, str(path)])
            print(f"P2_4_REAL_{kind.upper().replace('-', '_')}_PATCH_VALIDATED {env}", flush=True)
    module_test = OUT / "ns2-vulkan-modules"
    run([cxx, "-std=c++20", "-O2",
         str(ROOT / "tools/ns2/test_ampere_vulkan_module.cpp"),
         "-o", str(module_test), "-lvulkan"])
    print(run([str(module_test),
               str(OUT / "synthetic-direct.spv"),
               str(OUT / "synthetic-dispatcher.spv"),
               str(OUT / "synthetic-fragment.spv"),
               str(OUT / "synthetic-merged.spv"),
               str(OUT / "synthetic-compute.spv"),
               str(OUT / "synthetic-u32-cas.spv"),
               str(OUT / "synthetic-global-cas.spv")]).stdout, end="")
    # G06: this genuine CAS shader runs a real Vulkan storage-buffer atomic
    # with old-value readback and fence-completed host memory visibility.
    print("SPIR-V validation and Vulkan CAS memory-readback passed; "
          "real PS5 Vulkan renderer not exercised.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        main()
    except Exception as error:
        print(error, file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Host compiler smoke for NS2 offline title identity + launcher integration."""
from pathlib import Path

# not a runtime URL. Extract the precise C++ assignment and compare entire
# trusted origins instead, including all URL components.
from urllib.parse import urlsplit
import re
hosts = re.search(
    r'const char\* image_host\s*=\s*r2\s*\?\s*"([^"\n]+)"\s*:\s*"([^"\n]+)"\s*;',
    services,
)

    parsed = urlsplit(candidate)
    assert parsed.scheme == "https" and parsed.netloc in (
        "gamesdb-images.launchbox.gg", "images.launchbox-app.com"
    )
    assert not (parsed.path or parsed.query or parsed.fragment or parsed.username or parsed.password)

assert 'WebPGetInfo(compressed, length, &checked_w, &checked_h)' in services

assert 'std::rename(staged.c_str(), destination.c_str())' in services

compiler=shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
if not compiler: raise SystemExit("No native C++20 compiler")
source=r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <string_view>
#include "ns2_title_catalog.h"
int main() {
    using Eden::Ns2Catalog::Find;
    static_assert(Eden::Ns2Catalog::kTitles.size() == 18);
    const auto* mkw = Find(0x0400C3F00006E000ULL);
    const auto* dk = Find(0x040074A01BF12000ULL);
    assert(mkw && mkw->name == "Mario Kart World");
    assert(dk && dk->name == "Donkey Kong Bananza");

    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < Eden::Ns2Catalog::kTitles.size(); ++i)
        for (std::size_t j = i+1; j < Eden::Ns2Catalog::kTitles.size(); ++j)
            assert(Eden::Ns2Catalog::kTitles[i].id != Eden::Ns2Catalog::kTitles[j].id);
}
"""

print("ENCORE_NS2_TITLE_CATALOG_HOST_PASS IDs=18 safety=1 launch_integration=1")
```

`tools/check-nup-v1-game-discovery.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Host-only proof: NUP is selectable in the regular game discovery path."""
from __future__ import annotations
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
# P3.4: a path deleted between iterator discovery and symlink_status
# cannot be silently skipped while the caller publishes a complete DLC map.
header = (ROOT / "headless/game_files.h").read_text()
scan = header.split("FindAddOnContentDirectories(", 1)[1]
assert "if (entry_error) {" in scan
assert "incomplete = true;\n                return;" in scan
assert "entry_error != std::errc::no_such_file_or_directory" not in scan
CODE = r"""
#include "game_files.h"
#include <cassert>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    assert(argc == 2);
    namespace fs = std::filesystem;
    // Repeated library scans classify ASCII names without heap allocations.
    // Keep mixed-case addon exclusion and ordinary base-name acceptance.
    assert(Eden::IsAddOnContainerName("UpDaTeS"));
    assert(Eden::IsAddOnContainerName("ADD-ON"));
    assert(!Eden::IsAddOnContainerName("updating"));
    assert(Eden::IsReservedAddOnPackageStem("DLc_MKW"));
    assert(Eden::IsReservedAddOnPackageStem("aoc-Bananza"));
    assert(!Eden::IsReservedAddOnPackageStem("updateable"));
    assert(Eden::IsExtractedAssetFolderName("EXEFS"));
    assert(Eden::IsExtractedAssetFolderName("RomFS"));
    assert(!Eden::IsExtractedAssetFolderName("romfs-old"));
    assert(!Eden::IsNestedGameFileSelection("MKW/DlC/extra.nsp"));
    assert(!Eden::IsNestedGameFileSelection("MKW/BASE/Patch_2.nsp"));
    assert(Eden::IsGameFile("game.nsp"));
    assert(Eden::IsGameFile("game.xci"));
    assert(Eden::IsGameFile("game.nsz"));
    assert(Eden::IsGameFile("game.xcz"));
    assert(!Eden::IsGameFile("update.zst"));
    assert(Eden::IsGameFile("game.NUP"));
    assert(Eden::IsNestedGameFileSelection("MyGame/base/game.nup"));
    assert(!Eden::IsNestedGameFileSelection("MyGame/dlc/a.nup"));
    assert(Eden::IsNestedGameFileSelection("MyGame/base/game.nsp"));
    assert(!Eden::IsNestedGameFileSelection("../game.nsp"));
    // One non-following status probe per entry must preserve the package
    // ranking, addon exclusion and symlink protection of both scan paths.
    const fs::path game = fs::path(argv[1]) / "Game";
    fs::create_directories(game / "base");
    fs::create_directories(game / "dlc");
    std::ofstream(game / "base" / "game.nsp").put('g');
    std::ofstream(game / "dlc" / "update.nsp").put('u');
    fs::create_directory_symlink(game / "base", game / "linked-base");
    assert(Eden::FindNestedGamePackage(game) == "base/game.nsp");
    assert(Eden::IsSafeNestedGameFilePath(game.parent_path(), "Game/base/game.nsp"));
    assert(!Eden::IsSafeNestedGameFilePath(game.parent_path(), "Game/linked-base/game.nsp"));
    bool complete = false;
    const auto addon_roots = Eden::FindAddOnContentDirectories(game, &complete);
    assert(complete && addon_roots.size() == 1 && addon_roots.front() == game / "dlc");
    // Traversing five wrapper levels is still allowed, and should discover
    // a nested DLC rather than treating it as a separate base game.
    const fs::path bounded = fs::path(argv[1]) / "Bounded";
    const auto allowed = bounded / "a" / "b" / "c" / "d" / "e" / "dlc";
    fs::create_directories(allowed);
    complete = false;
    const auto accepted = Eden::FindAddOnContentDirectories(bounded, &complete);
    assert(complete && accepted.size() == 1 && accepted.front() == allowed);
    // A deeper opaque branch cannot be treated as an empty add-on branch:
    // a partial inventory may hide updates, so fail the entire discovery.
    const fs::path deep = fs::path(argv[1]) / "Deep";
    fs::create_directories(deep / "dlc");
    std::ofstream(deep / "dlc" / "update.nsp").put('u');
    fs::create_directories(deep / "a" / "b" / "c" / "d" / "e" / "f");
    complete = true;
    assert(Eden::FindAddOnContentDirectories(deep, &complete).empty());
    assert(!complete);
    // A valid but empty title remains distinct from an unreadable title.
    const fs::path empty = fs::path(argv[1]) / "Empty";
    fs::create_directories(empty);
    complete = false;
    assert(Eden::FindAddOnContentDirectories(empty, &complete).empty());
    assert(complete);
    complete = true;
    assert(Eden::FindAddOnContentDirectories(empty / "missing", &complete).empty());
    assert(!complete);
    return 0;
}
"""

def main() -> None:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        root = Path(tmp)
        source = root / "nup-discovery.cpp"
        source.write_text(CODE, encoding="utf-8")
        exe = root / "nup-unified"
        cmd = [os.environ.get("CXX", "g++"), "-std=c++20",
               "-O2", "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror", "-pedantic",
               "-I", str(ROOT / "headless"),
               "-DEDEN_NUP_V1_RUNTIME=1"]
        subprocess.run(cmd + [str(source), "-o", str(exe)], check=True)
        subprocess.run([str(exe), str(root / "fixture-unified")], check=True)
    print("NUP game discovery: NUP and all prior game formats available together")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

`tools/check-nup-v1-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""NUP v1 *structural* preflight for unencrypted NS1/NS2 dump containers.

No game-specific exceptions, no extraction, no guest execution, no PS5 runtime hook.
Specification: https://github.com/a55uka/nup/blob/meow/SPEC.md
A successful check is NOT a substitute for full raw/zstd member SHA-256 verification.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from collections import deque

import argparse
import hashlib
import os
import struct
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

MAX_TOC = 64 * 1024 * 1024
MAX_NODES = 2_000_000
BAD = 0xFFFFFFFF


class InvalidNup(ValueError):
    pass


def require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise InvalidNup(message)


def record(data: bytes, offset: int, fmt: str) -> tuple:
    size = struct.calcsize(fmt)
    require(0 <= offset <= len(data) - size, "truncated TOC record")
    return struct.unpack_from(fmt, data, offset)


def check(path: Path) -> dict:
    total = path.stat().st_size
    require(total >= 0x80, "short superblock")
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        header = stream.read(0x80)
        require(header[:4] == b"NUP\x01", "not NUP v1")
        header_size, version = struct.unpack_from("<HH", header, 4)
        toc_offset, toc_size = struct.unpack_from("<QQ", header, 8)
        blob_offset, announced_size = struct.unpack_from("<QQ", header, 0x38)
        package_count, flags = struct.unpack_from("<II", header, 0x48)
        require(header_size == 0x80 and version == 1, "unsupported header revision")
        require(toc_offset == header_size, "wrong TOC offset")
        require(0 < toc_size <= MAX_TOC and toc_size % 16 == 0, "invalid TOC size")
        require(blob_offset % 16 == 0 and blob_offset >= toc_offset + toc_size,
                "invalid blob offset")
        require(announced_size == total and blob_offset <= total, "invalid file size")
        require(0 < package_count <= 65536 and flags == 0, "invalid package count/flags")
        require(header[0x60:0x80] == bytes(0x20), "nonzero reserved superblock")
        stream.seek(toc_offset)
        toc = stream.read(toc_size)
    require(len(toc) == toc_size, "truncated TOC")
    require(hashlib.sha256(toc).digest() == header[0x18:0x38], "TOC SHA-256 mismatch")
    require(toc[:4] == b"TOC\x01", "invalid TOC magic")

    count, dirs_count, files_count, pool_offset, pool_size, reserved = record(
        toc, 4, "<IQQQQQ"
    )
    require(count == package_count and reserved == 0, "TOC header inconsistency")
    require(dirs_count <= MAX_NODES and files_count <= MAX_NODES, "excessive node count")
    packages_end = 0x30 + 0x40 * count
    dirs_start = packages_end
    files_start = dirs_start + 0x18 * dirs_count
    slots_start = files_start + 0x50 * files_count
    require(slots_start <= pool_offset <= len(toc), "overlapping TOC tables")
    require(pool_size <= len(toc) - pool_offset, "invalid string pool")
    pool = memoryview(toc)[pool_offset:pool_offset + pool_size]

    def name(off: int, size: int, *, root: bool = False) -> str:
        require(off <= len(pool) and size <= len(pool) - off, "bad name bounds")
        raw = bytes(pool[off:off + size])
        require(not (b"/" in raw or b"\\" in raw or b"\0" in raw), "unsafe path component")
        try:
            text = raw.decode("utf-8", errors="strict")
        except UnicodeDecodeError as exc:
            raise InvalidNup("invalid UTF-8 in file tree") from exc
        require(text not in (".", "..") and (bool(text) or root), "empty/unsafe name")
        return text

    dirs = []
    slot_count = 0
    for i in range(dirs_count):
        off, size, first, count_children, zero = record(toc, dirs_start + i * 0x18, "<IIIIQ")
        require(zero == 0, "nonzero directory reserved bytes")
        dirs.append((name(off, size, root=True), first, count_children))
        slot_count += count_children
    require(slot_count <= MAX_NODES * 2, "excessive child references")
    require(slots_start + 4 * slot_count <= pool_offset, "children overlap string pool")
    slots = record(toc, slots_start, f"<{slot_count}I") if slot_count else ()
    slot_owners = [0] * slot_count
    for directory_name, first, number in dirs:
        require(first <= slot_count and number <= slot_count - first, "bad child span")
        child_names = []
        for slot in range(first, first + number):
            require(slot_owners[slot] == 0, "child slot has multiple owners")
            slot_owners[slot] = 1
            node = slots[slot]
            require(node < dirs_count + files_count, "child node out of bounds")
            if node < dirs_count:
                child_names.append(dirs[node][0])
            else:
                index = node - dirs_count
                x, y = record(toc, files_start + index * 0x50, "<II")
                child_names.append(name(x, y))
        require(child_names == sorted(set(child_names), key=lambda s: s.encode("utf-8")),
                "unsorted or duplicate child names")

    require(all(owner == 1 for owner in slot_owners), "unowned directory child slot")
    # A cyclic directory graph would recurse forever in a mounted VFS.
    # Topological traversal handles very deep trees without Python recursion.
    incoming = [0] * dirs_count
    for _, first, number in dirs:
        for node in slots[first:first + number]:
            if node < dirs_count:
                incoming[node] += 1
    for i, count in enumerate(incoming):
        require(count <= 1, "directory has multiple parents")
        if count:
            require(bool(dirs[i][0]), "empty nested directory name")
    pending = deque(i for i, count in enumerate(incoming) if count == 0)
    visited = 0
    while pending:
        index = pending.popleft()
        visited += 1
        _, first, number = dirs[index]
        for node in slots[first:first + number]:
            if node < dirs_count:
                incoming[node] -= 1
                if incoming[node] == 0:
                    pending.append(node)
    require(visited == dirs_count, "cyclic directory tree")

    for i in range(files_count):
        off = files_start + i * 0x50
        name_off, name_size, size, extent, stored = record(toc, off, "<IIQQQ")
        name(name_off, name_size)
        codec, codec_flags, res = record(toc, off + 0x40, "<BBH")
        require(codec in (0, 1) and codec_flags == 0 and res == 0, "unsupported codec")
        require(toc[off + 0x44:off + 0x50] == bytes(12), "nonzero file reserved bytes")
        if size == 0:
            require(extent == 0 and stored == 0 and codec == 0, "bad empty extent")
        else:
            require(stored > 0 and extent >= blob_offset and extent % 16 == 0,
                    "misaligned/empty extent")
            require(extent <= total and stored <= total - extent, "extent outside file")
            require(codec != 0 or stored == size, "raw extent size mismatch")

    packages = []
    signature = bytearray()
    base_packages = 0
    for i in range(package_count):
        off = 0x30 + i * 0x40
        title_id, root_dir, exefs, romfs, version_num = record(toc, off, "<QIIII")
        kind, pkg_flags, zero, zero2 = record(toc, off + 0x18, "<BBHI")
        meta_offset, meta_size = record(toc, off + 0x20, "<QI")
        require(kind <= 2 and (pkg_flags & ~1) == 0 and zero == zero2 == 0,
                "invalid package kind/flags/reserved")
        require(toc[off + 0x2C:off + 0x40] == bytes(20),
                "nonzero package reserved bytes")
        require(root_dir < dirs_count, "missing package root")
        require(all(x == BAD or x < dirs_count for x in (exefs, romfs)), "bad content root")
        require(kind == 1 or pkg_flags == 0, "standalone flag on non-update")
        if kind == 0:
            base_packages += 1
        if meta_size:
            require(meta_offset >= blob_offset and meta_offset <= total and
                    meta_size <= total - meta_offset, "metadata outside container")
        else:
            require(meta_offset == 0, "empty metadata with nonzero offset")
        signature.extend(struct.pack("<QIB", title_id, version_num, kind))
        packages.append({"title_id": f"{title_id:016X}", "version": version_num,
                         "kind": ("base", "update", "addon")[kind],
                         "standalone_update": bool(pkg_flags)})
    require(base_packages <= 1, "multiple base packages")
    # Base-less update-only packages require explicit standalone markers;
    # a normal base+update must not incorrectly claim to be standalone.
    for package in packages:
        if package["kind"] == "update":
            require(package["standalone_update"] == (base_packages == 0),
                    "inconsistent standalone-update flag")
    require(hashlib.sha256(signature).digest()[:16] == header[0x50:0x60],
            "content UUID mismatch")
    return {"packages": packages, "directories": dirs_count, "files": files_count,
            "toc_sha256_verified": True, "member_hashes_verified": False}


def self_test() -> None:
    package = bytearray(0x40)
    struct.pack_into("<QIIII", package, 0, 0x1000000000000000, 0, BAD, BAD, 1)
    directory = bytes(0x18)
    toc = bytearray(0x90)
    struct.pack_into("<4sIQQQQQ", toc, 0, b"TOC\x01", 1, 1, 0, 0x88, 0, 0)
    toc[0x30:0x70] = package
    toc[0x70:0x88] = directory
    head = bytearray(0x80)
    head[:4] = b"NUP\x01"
    struct.pack_into("<HHQQ", head, 4, 0x80, 1, 0x80, len(toc))
    head[0x18:0x38] = hashlib.sha256(toc).digest()
    struct.pack_into("<QQII", head, 0x38, 0x110, 0x110, 1, 0)
    head[0x50:0x60] = hashlib.sha256(struct.pack("<QIB", 0x1000000000000000, 1, 0)).digest()[:16]
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        path = Path(tmp) / "fixture.nup"
        valid = bytes(head + toc)
        path.write_bytes(valid)
        assert check(path)["toc_sha256_verified"]
        for offset in (0, 0x80, 0x18, 0x48, 0x50):
            damaged = bytearray(valid)
            damaged[offset] ^= 0x01
            path.write_bytes(damaged)
            try:
                check(path)
            except InvalidNup:
                pass
            else:
                raise AssertionError(f"damaged fixture accepted at {offset}")
        # Self-referencing root with a consistent TOC hash: only graph validation
        # should reject it (rather than magic, offsets or header validation).
        cyclic_toc = bytearray(valid[0x80:])
        struct.pack_into("<Q", cyclic_toc, 0x18, 0x8C)  # string pool starts after 1 slot
        struct.pack_into("<I", cyclic_toc, 0x7C, 1)  # root child_count
        struct.pack_into("<I", cyclic_toc, 0x88, 0)  # root -> root
        cyclic_header = bytearray(valid[:0x80])
        cyclic_header[0x18:0x38] = hashlib.sha256(cyclic_toc).digest()
        path.write_bytes(cyclic_header + cyclic_toc)
        try:
            check(path)
        except InvalidNup:
            pass
        else:
            raise AssertionError("cyclic directory tree accepted")
        update_toc = bytearray(valid[0x80:])
        update_toc[0x48] = 1  # package kind: update
        update_toc[0x49] = 1  # standalone update, no base
        update_header = bytearray(valid[:0x80])
        update_header[0x18:0x38] = hashlib.sha256(update_toc).digest()
        update_header[0x50:0x60] = hashlib.sha256(
            struct.pack("<QIB", 0x1000000000000000, 1, 1)).digest()[:16]
        path.write_bytes(update_header + update_toc)
        assert check(path)["packages"][0]["standalone_update"]
        update_toc[0x49] = 0  # same valid TOC, but forbidden base-less marker
        update_header[0x18:0x38] = hashlib.sha256(update_toc).digest()
        path.write_bytes(update_header + update_toc)
        try:
            check(path)
        except InvalidNup:
            pass
        else:
            raise AssertionError("base-less update without standalone marker accepted")
    print("NUP v1 host preflight: valid base/update fixtures + 7 corruption/cycle cases passed")


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("path", nargs="?", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--self-test", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.self_test:
        self_test()
        return 0
    if args.path is None:
        parser.error("supply a NUP filename or --self-test")
    try:
        import json
        print(json.dumps(check(args.path), indent=2))
        return 0
    except (OSError, InvalidNup) as exc:
        print(f"NUP validation failed: {exc}")
        return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
```

`tools/check-nup-v1-native-abi.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compile inactive NUP adapter against exact pinned vendor VFS headers (host only).

Only the native file, RomFS and loader API headers are fetched at the gitlink SHA.
This is a C++ ABI/source-signature preflight, NOT a full vendor/core/PS5 build.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
FILES = (
    "common/common_funcs.h",
    "common/common_types.h",
    "core/file_sys/fs_filesystem.h",
    "core/file_sys/common_funcs.h",
    "core/file_sys/romfs.h",
    "core/file_sys/vfs/vfs.h",
    "core/file_sys/vfs/vfs_types.h",
    "core/file_sys/vfs/vfs_vector.h",
    "common/bit_field.h",
    "common/swap.h",
    "core/file_sys/control_metadata.h",
    "core/file_sys/program_metadata.h",
    "core/loader/loader.h",
    "core/loader/deconstructed_rom_directory.h",
)

def main() -> None:
    pinned = subprocess.check_output(
        ["git", "-C", str(ROOT), "rev-parse", "HEAD:vendor"], text=True
    ).strip()
    assert len(pinned) == 40 and all(c in "0123456789abcdef" for c in pinned), pinned
    urlbase = ("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/niakw/"
               "Prospero.Eden-Encore-vendor/" + pinned + "/sources/eden/src/")
    # A locally mounted vendor submodule at the exact gitlink SHA is a
    # stronger and much faster source of truth than repeated HTTP downloads.
    # If absent in a CI sandbox, retain the original pinned-URL fallback.
    local_vendor = ROOT / "vendor/sources/eden/src"
    local_sha = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "-C", str(ROOT / "vendor"), "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
        capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)
    local_verified = (
        local_sha.returncode == 0 and local_sha.stdout.strip() == pinned)

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
        includes = Path(folder)
        for path in FILES:
            request = Request(urlbase + path, headers={"User-Agent": "EdenEncore-NUP-ABI-CI"})
            local_path = local_vendor / path
            if local_verified and local_path.is_file():
                data = local_path.read_bytes()
            else:
                with urlopen(request, timeout=20) as response:
                    data = response.read(128 * 1024 + 1)
            if len(data) > 128 * 1024 or not data.startswith(b"// SPDX-"):
                raise ValueError(f"Invalid pinned vendor header: {path}")
            target = includes / path
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_bytes(data)
        # Apple Clang diagnoses anonymous vendor ABI structs differently
        # from GCC. Suppress only this known extension diagnostic on macOS.
        vendor_abi_flags = ["-Wno-nested-anon-types"] if sys.platform == "darwin" else []
        subprocess.run([
            os.environ.get("CXX", "g++"), "-std=c++20", "-fsyntax-only",
            *vendor_abi_flags,
            # The actual vendor AppLoader header intentionally names unused
            # virtual-function parameters. Keep all other warnings fatal.
            "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror", "-Wno-unused-parameter", "-pedantic",
            "-I", str(includes),
            "-I", str(ROOT / "headless"),
            str(ROOT / "headless/nup_v1_native_vfs.cpp"),
            str(ROOT / "headless/nup_v1_native_content.cpp"),
            str(ROOT / "headless/nup_v1_native_aoc.cpp"),
            str(ROOT / "headless/nup_v1_native_loader.cpp"),
            str(ROOT / "headless/nup_v1_loader_route.cpp"),
        ], check=True)
    print(f"NUP native adapter compiles against pinned vendor VFS headers {pinned[:12]}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Test the inactive FileSys VFS adapter using a minimal host VFS ABI substitute."""
from __future__ import annotations
from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
import os
import subprocess
import tempfile
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent

def load_fixture_module():
    path = ROOT / "tools/check-nup-v1-vfs-host.py"
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("nup_vfs_fixtures", path)
    assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module

def main():
    fixtures = load_fixture_module()
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
        temp = Path(directory)
        binary = temp / "nup-native-host"
        command = [
            os.environ.get("CXX", "g++"), "-std=c++20", "-O1",
            "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror", "-pedantic",
            "-I", str(ROOT / "tools/nup-native-host-stub"),
            "-I", str(ROOT / "headless"),
            str(ROOT / "headless/nup_v1_vfs.cpp"),
            str(ROOT / "headless/nup_v1_native_vfs.cpp"),
            str(ROOT / "headless/nup_v1_native_content.cpp"),
            str(ROOT / "headless/nup_v1_native_aoc.cpp"),
            str(ROOT / "headless/nup_v1_native_loader.cpp"),
            str(ROOT / "headless/nup_v1_loader_route.cpp"),
            str(ROOT / "tools/nup-v1-native-host.cpp"),
            "-lcrypto", "-lzstd", "-lz", "-pthread", "-o", str(binary)
        ]
        if sys.platform == "darwin":
            for package in ("openssl@3", "zstd"):
                prefix = Path("/opt/homebrew/opt") / package
                if (prefix / "include").is_dir():
                    command += ["-I", str(prefix / "include")]
                if (prefix / "lib").is_dir():
                    command += ["-L", str(prefix / "lib"),
                                "-Wl,-rpath," + str(prefix / "lib")]
        subprocess.run(command, check=True)
        addon = temp / "addon.nup"
        addon.write_bytes(fixtures.layered_fixture(addon=True))
        standalone = temp / "standalone.nup"
        standalone.write_bytes(fixtures.layered_fixture(standalone=True))
        # A second, independently generated fixture has two addons, real
        # ExeFS/main + main.npdm and merged nested RomFS directories.
        path = ROOT / "tools/nup-v1-content-fixture.py"
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("nup_content_fixture", path)
        assert spec and spec.loader
        content_module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        spec.loader.exec_module(content_module)
        executable = temp / "executable.nup"
        executable.write_bytes(content_module.executable_fixture())
        foreign_update = temp / "foreign-update.nup"
        foreign_update.write_bytes(content_module.foreign_update_fixture())
        foreign_npdm = temp / "foreign-npdm.nup"
        foreign_npdm.write_bytes(content_module.mismatched_npdm_fixture())
        sibling_npdm = temp / "sibling-npdm.nup"
        sibling_npdm.write_bytes(content_module.sibling_npdm_fixture())
        malformed_meta = temp / "malformed-meta.nup"
        malformed_meta.write_bytes(content_module.bad_metadata_fixture())
        duplicate_locale = temp / "duplicate-locale.nup"
        duplicate_locale.write_bytes(content_module.duplicate_locale_fixture())
        addon_only = temp / "addon-only.nup"
        addon_only.write_bytes(content_module.add_on_only_fixture())
        oversized_npdm = temp / "oversized-npdm.nup"
        oversized_npdm.write_bytes(content_module.oversized_npdm_fixture())
        nacp_aoc = temp / "nacp-aoc.nup"
        nacp_aoc.write_bytes(content_module.nacp_aoc_fixture())
        nacp_extracted = temp / "nacp-extracted.nup"
        nacp_extracted.write_bytes(content_module.nacp_aoc_fixture(extracted=True))
        corrupt_nacp = temp / "nacp-corrupt.nup"
        corrupt_nacp.write_bytes(content_module.corrupt_extracted_nacp_fixture())
        short_nacp = temp / "nacp-short.nup"
        short_nacp.write_bytes(content_module.short_extracted_nacp_fixture())
        valid_compressed = temp / "nacp-compressed-valid.nup"
        valid_compressed.write_bytes(content_module.compressed_nacp_fixture(variant="valid"))
        overlong_compressed = temp / "nacp-compressed-overlong.nup"
        overlong_compressed.write_bytes(content_module.compressed_nacp_fixture(variant="overlong"))
        partial_compressed = temp / "nacp-compressed-partial.nup"
        partial_compressed.write_bytes(content_module.compressed_nacp_fixture(variant="partial-entry"))
        oversized_icon = temp / "oversized-exefs-icon.nup"
        oversized_icon.write_bytes(content_module.oversized_icon_fixture())
        large_raw = temp / "large-raw.nup"
        large_raw.write_bytes(content_module.large_raw_fixture())
        subprocess.run([str(binary), str(addon), str(standalone),
                        str(executable), str(foreign_update), str(foreign_npdm),
                        str(sibling_npdm), str(malformed_meta), str(duplicate_locale),
                        str(addon_only), str(oversized_npdm), str(nacp_aoc),
                        str(nacp_extracted), str(corrupt_nacp),
                        str(short_nacp), str(valid_compressed),
                        str(overlong_compressed), str(partial_compressed),
                        str(oversized_icon), str(large_raw)], check=True)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

`tools/check-nup-v1-payload-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Bounded NUP v1 payload integrity verification, independent of game or emulator.

Run the existing structural checker first; then stream every raw/zstd member through
SHA-256. Requires system libzstd for codec 1 (no Python packages required).
No extraction, execution, runtime registration, or format enablement is performed.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import ctypes
import ctypes.util
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import struct
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

BLOCK = 1 << 20
BAD = 0xFFFFFFFF


class InvalidPayload(ValueError):
    pass


def require(ok: bool, why: str) -> None:
    if not ok:
        raise InvalidPayload(why)


def structural_checker():
    path = Path(__file__).with_name("check-nup-v1-host.py")
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("nup_structure", path)
    require(spec is not None and spec.loader is not None, "missing structural checker")
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


class Zstd:
    class Input(ctypes.Structure):
        _fields_ = [("src", ctypes.c_void_p), ("size", ctypes.c_size_t),
                    ("pos", ctypes.c_size_t)]

    class Output(ctypes.Structure):
        _fields_ = [("dst", ctypes.c_void_p), ("size", ctypes.c_size_t),
                    ("pos", ctypes.c_size_t)]

    def __init__(self):
        library = ctypes.util.find_library("zstd")
        require(library is not None, "system libzstd required for zstd payloads")
        self.lib = ctypes.CDLL(library)
        l = self.lib
        l.ZSTD_getFrameContentSize.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_size_t]
        l.ZSTD_getFrameContentSize.restype = ctypes.c_ulonglong
        l.ZSTD_createDStream.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
        l.ZSTD_initDStream.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
        l.ZSTD_initDStream.restype = ctypes.c_size_t
        l.ZSTD_DCtx_setParameter.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int]
        l.ZSTD_DCtx_setParameter.restype = ctypes.c_size_t
        l.ZSTD_freeDStream.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
        l.ZSTD_freeDStream.restype = ctypes.c_size_t
        l.ZSTD_decompressStream.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.POINTER(self.Output),
                                           ctypes.POINTER(self.Input)]
        l.ZSTD_decompressStream.restype = ctypes.c_size_t
        l.ZSTD_isError.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t]
        l.ZSTD_isError.restype = ctypes.c_uint
        l.ZSTD_compressBound.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t]
        l.ZSTD_compressBound.restype = ctypes.c_size_t
        l.ZSTD_compress.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_void_p,
                                    ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_int]
        l.ZSTD_compress.restype = ctypes.c_size_t

    def ensure(self, result: int) -> None:
        require(not self.lib.ZSTD_isError(result), "invalid zstd frame")

    def compress_fixture(self, data: bytes) -> bytes:
        source = ctypes.create_string_buffer(data)
        bound = self.lib.ZSTD_compressBound(len(data))
        target = ctypes.create_string_buffer(bound)
        count = self.lib.ZSTD_compress(target, bound, source, len(data), 1)
        self.ensure(count)
        return target.raw[:count]

    def hash_extent(self, stream, offset: int, stored: int, expected: int) -> bytes:
        stream.seek(offset)
        head = stream.read(min(18, stored))
        hdr = ctypes.create_string_buffer(head)
        frame_size = self.lib.ZSTD_getFrameContentSize(hdr, len(head))
        require(frame_size == expected, "missing/wrong zstd frame content size")
        stream.seek(offset)
        decoder = self.lib.ZSTD_createDStream()
        require(bool(decoder), "cannot allocate zstd decoder")
        digest = hashlib.sha256()
        produced = 0
        remaining = stored
        try:
            self.ensure(self.lib.ZSTD_initDStream(decoder))
            self.ensure(self.lib.ZSTD_DCtx_setParameter(decoder, 100, 26))  # 64 MiB max window
            input_bytes = None
            src = self.Input(None, 0, 0)
            while True:
                if src.pos == src.size:
                    require(remaining > 0, "truncated zstd stream")
                    data = stream.read(min(BLOCK, remaining))
                    require(bool(data), "truncated zstd extent")
                    remaining -= len(data)
                    input_bytes = ctypes.create_string_buffer(data)
                    src = self.Input(ctypes.addressof(input_bytes), len(data), 0)
                output_bytes = ctypes.create_string_buffer(BLOCK)
                dst = self.Output(ctypes.addressof(output_bytes), BLOCK, 0)
                before = src.pos
                result = self.lib.ZSTD_decompressStream(decoder, ctypes.byref(dst),
                                                        ctypes.byref(src))
                self.ensure(result)
                produced += dst.pos
                require(produced <= expected, "zstd expansion exceeds declared size")
                digest.update(output_bytes.raw[:dst.pos])
                if result == 0:
                    require(remaining == 0 and src.pos == src.size,
                            "trailing bytes / multiple zstd frames")
                    break
                require(src.pos > before or dst.pos > 0, "stalled zstd decompressor")
            require(produced == expected, "zstd decompressed size mismatch")
            return digest.digest()
        finally:
            self.lib.ZSTD_freeDStream(decoder)


def verify(path: Path) -> dict:
    info = structural_checker().check(path)
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        header = stream.read(0x80)
        toc_off, toc_size = struct.unpack_from("<QQ", header, 8)
        blob_start = struct.unpack_from("<Q", header, 0x38)[0]
        stream.seek(toc_off)
        toc = stream.read(toc_size)
        _, dirs_count, files_count, _pool_start = struct.unpack_from("<IQQQ", toc, 4)
        files_start = 0x30 + 0x40 * len(info["packages"]) + 0x18 * dirs_count
        extents = {}
        verified_extents = {}
        ranges = []
        zstd = None
        for i in range(files_count):
            off = files_start + 0x50 * i
            size, extent, stored = struct.unpack_from("<QQQ", toc, off + 8)
            expected = toc[off + 0x20:off + 0x40]
            codec = toc[off + 0x40]
            if size == 0:
                digest = hashlib.sha256(b"").digest()
            else:
                require(extent >= blob_start, "file extent before blob region")
                identity = (size, stored, codec, expected)
                key = (extent, stored)
                require(key not in extents or extents[key] == identity,
                        "shared extent has incompatible digest/shape")
                extents[key] = identity
                if key in verified_extents:
                    digest = verified_extents[key]
                elif codec == 0:
                    stream.seek(extent)
                    digestor = hashlib.sha256()
                    remaining = stored
                    while remaining:
                        chunk = stream.read(min(remaining, BLOCK))
                        require(bool(chunk), "truncated raw extent")
                        digestor.update(chunk)
                        remaining -= len(chunk)
                    digest = digestor.digest()
                else:
                    if zstd is None:
                        zstd = Zstd()
                    digest = zstd.hash_extent(stream, extent, stored, size)
                verified_extents[key] = digest
                ranges.append((extent, extent + stored))
            require(digest == expected, f"member {i}: SHA-256 mismatch")
        unique_ranges = sorted(set(ranges))
        for (left, right), (next_left, next_right) in zip(unique_ranges, unique_ranges[1:]):
            require(right <= next_left, "overlapping non-identical extents")
        # Metadata may not alias payload extents or the TOC.
        for i in range(len(info["packages"])):
            meta_off, meta_len = struct.unpack_from("<QI", toc, 0x30 + 0x40 * i + 0x20)
            if meta_len:
                require(meta_off >= blob_start, "metadata outside blob region")
                for start, end in ranges:
                    require(meta_off + meta_len <= start or meta_off >= end,
                            "metadata overlaps payload extent")
                stream.seek(meta_off)
                meta = stream.read(meta_len)
                require(len(meta) == meta_len, "truncated metadata")
                pos = 0
                while pos < meta_len:
                    require(meta_len - pos >= 8, "truncated metadata TLV")
                    _, reserved, payload_len = struct.unpack_from("<HHI", meta, pos)
                    require(reserved == 0 and payload_len <= meta_len - pos - 8,
                            "invalid metadata TLV bounds")
                    pos += 8 + payload_len
    info["member_hashes_verified"] = True
    info["raw_zstd_integrity"] = "verified"
    return info


def fixture(codec: int, contents: bytes, *, tamper_digest=False, extra=b"") -> bytes:
    packed = contents if codec == 0 else Zstd().compress_fixture(contents)
    stored = packed + extra
    name = b"proof.bin"
    toc_size = 0xF0
    toc = bytearray(toc_size)
    struct.pack_into("<4sIQQQQQ", toc, 0, b"TOC\x01", 1, 1, 1, 0xDC, len(name), 0)
    struct.pack_into("<QIIII", toc, 0x30, 0x1234000000000000, 0, BAD, 0, 1)
    struct.pack_into("<IIIIQ", toc, 0x70, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0)
    struct.pack_into("<IIQQQ", toc, 0x88, 0, len(name), len(contents),
                     0x170 if contents else 0, len(stored))
    digest = bytearray(hashlib.sha256(contents).digest())
    if tamper_digest:
        digest[0] ^= 1
    toc[0xA8:0xC8] = digest
    toc[0xC8] = codec
    struct.pack_into("<I", toc, 0xD8, 1)
    toc[0xDC:0xDC + len(name)] = name
    header = bytearray(0x80)
    header[:4] = b"NUP\x01"
    struct.pack_into("<HHQQ", header, 4, 0x80, 1, 0x80, toc_size)
    header[0x18:0x38] = hashlib.sha256(toc).digest()
    struct.pack_into("<QQII", header, 0x38, 0x170, 0x170 + len(stored), 1, 0)
    header[0x50:0x60] = hashlib.sha256(
        struct.pack("<QIB", 0x1234000000000000, 1, 0)).digest()[:16]
    return bytes(header + toc + stored)


def dual_file_fixture(contents: bytes, *, overlap: bool = False) -> bytes:
    """Two sorted files, either sharing exactly one extent or partially overlapping."""
    require(len(contents) > 16, "fixture too small")
    toc = bytearray(0x140)
    names = b"a.binb.bin"
    struct.pack_into("<4sIQQQQQ", toc, 0, b"TOC\x01", 1, 1, 2, 0x130, len(names), 0)
    struct.pack_into("<QIIII", toc, 0x30, 0x1234000000000000, 0, BAD, 0, 1)
    struct.pack_into("<IIIIQ", toc, 0x70, 0, 0, 0, 2, 0)
    for index in (0, 1):
        sub = contents[16:] if overlap and index == 1 else contents
        off = 0x88 + 0x50 * index
        extent = 0x1C0 + (16 if overlap and index == 1 else 0)
        struct.pack_into("<IIQQQ", toc, off, index * 5, 5, len(sub), extent, len(sub))
        toc[off + 0x20:off + 0x40] = hashlib.sha256(sub).digest()
    struct.pack_into("<II", toc, 0x128, 1, 2)
    toc[0x130:0x13A] = names
    header = bytearray(0x80)
    header[:4] = b"NUP\x01"
    struct.pack_into("<HHQQ", header, 4, 0x80, 1, 0x80, len(toc))
    header[0x18:0x38] = hashlib.sha256(toc).digest()
    struct.pack_into("<QQII", header, 0x38, 0x1C0, 0x1C0 + len(contents), 1, 0)
    header[0x50:0x60] = hashlib.sha256(
        struct.pack("<QIB", 0x1234000000000000, 1, 0)).digest()[:16]
    return bytes(header + toc + contents)


def self_test() -> None:
    data = (b"NUP integrity streamed!" * 200_000) + b"end"
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        path = Path(tmp) / "test.nup"
        for codec in (0, 1):
            good = fixture(codec, data)
            path.write_bytes(good)
            require(verify(path)["member_hashes_verified"], "valid member not verified")
            for invalid in (fixture(codec, data, tamper_digest=True),
                            good[:-1] + bytes([good[-1] ^ 1])):
                path.write_bytes(invalid)
                try:
                    verify(path)
                except InvalidPayload:
                    pass
                else:
                    raise AssertionError(f"accepted corrupted payload (codec={codec})")
        for invalid in (fixture(1, data, extra=b"x"),
                        fixture(1, data, extra=Zstd().compress_fixture(b"second"))):
            path.write_bytes(invalid)
            try:
                verify(path)
            except InvalidPayload:
                pass
            else:
                raise AssertionError("accepted trailing zstd data/second frame")
        path.write_bytes(fixture(0, b""))
        require(verify(path)["member_hashes_verified"], "empty file rejected")
        path.write_bytes(dual_file_fixture(data))
        require(verify(path)["files"] == 2, "shared extent rejected")
        path.write_bytes(dual_file_fixture(data, overlap=True))
        try:
            verify(path)
        except InvalidPayload:
            pass
        else:
            raise AssertionError("accepted partially overlapping extents")
    print("NUP v1 payload host: raw/zstd/empty/dedup valid + 7 corruptions rejected")


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("path", nargs="?", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--self-test", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    try:
        if args.self_test:
            self_test()
        else:
            if args.path is None:
                parser.error("supply a NUP path or --self-test")
            print(json.dumps(verify(args.path), indent=2))
    except (InvalidPayload, ValueError, OSError) as exc:
        print(f"NUP payload verification failed: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
```

`tools/check-nup-v1-real-romfs-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compile actual pinned vendor RomFSBuildContext with the native NUP VFS.

RomFSBuildContext, CreateRomFS/ExtractRomFS, concat, VectorVFS and
OffsetVFS all use real pinned vendor sources; only the base abstract VFS API
and the unused IPS extension patching use small host stubs.
Neither the PS5 core nor renderer is built.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import importlib.util
import os
import shutil
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
SOURCES = (
    "core/file_sys/fsmitm_romfsbuild.cpp",
    "core/file_sys/fsmitm_romfsbuild.h",
    "common/alignment.h",
    "common/common_types.h",
    "core/file_sys/vfs/vfs_concat.cpp",
    "core/file_sys/vfs/vfs_concat.h",
    "core/file_sys/vfs/vfs_static.h",
    "core/file_sys/vfs/vfs_vector.h",
    "core/file_sys/vfs/vfs_vector.cpp",
    "core/file_sys/vfs/vfs_offset.h",
    "core/file_sys/vfs/vfs_offset.cpp",
    "core/file_sys/vfs/vfs_cached.h",
    "core/file_sys/romfs.cpp",
    "core/file_sys/romfs.h",
    "common/string_util.h",
    "common/swap.h",
)


def main() -> None:
    pinned = subprocess.check_output(
        ["git", "-C", str(ROOT), "rev-parse", "HEAD:vendor"], text=True
    ).strip()
    assert len(pinned) == 40
    urlbase = (
        "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/niakw/Prospero.Eden-Encore-vendor/"
        + pinned + "/sources/eden/src/"
    )
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
        "nup_content", ROOT / "tools/nup-v1-content-fixture.py"
    )
    assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
    fixtures = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(fixtures)

    # A locally mounted vendor submodule at the exact gitlink SHA is a
    # stronger and much faster source of truth than repeated HTTP downloads.
    # If absent in a CI sandbox, retain the original pinned-URL fallback.
    local_vendor = ROOT / "vendor/sources/eden/src"
    local_sha = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "-C", str(ROOT / "vendor"), "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
        capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)
    local_verified = (
        local_sha.returncode == 0 and local_sha.stdout.strip() == pinned)

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tempdir:
        temp = Path(tempdir)
        vendor = temp / "pinned-vendor"
        for path in SOURCES:
            local_path = local_vendor / path
            if local_verified and local_path.is_file():
                source = local_path.read_bytes()
            else:
                with urlopen(Request(urlbase + path, headers={
                    "User-Agent": "EdenEncore-NUP-RomFS-Host"
                }), timeout=20) as response:
                    source = response.read(128 * 1024 + 1)
            if len(source) > 128 * 1024 or not source.startswith(b"// SPDX-"):
                raise ValueError(f"invalid pinned RomFS vendor source: {path}")
            target = vendor / path
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_bytes(source)
        # Use the actual pinned Vector/Offset VFS declarations, while
        # retaining only the small generic host VfsFile/VfsDirectory ABI.
        overrides = temp / "real-vfs-api"
        for path in (
            "core/file_sys/vfs/vfs_vector.h",
            "core/file_sys/vfs/vfs_offset.h",
        ):
            target = overrides / path
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copyfile(vendor / path, target)
        test_archive = temp / "nested-updates-and-addons.nup"
        test_archive.write_bytes(fixtures.executable_fixture())

        binary = temp / "nup-real-romfs"
        cmd = [
            os.environ.get("CXX", "g++"), "-std=c++20", "-O1", "-g",
            "-fsanitize=address,undefined", "-fno-omit-frame-pointer",
            "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror", "-Wno-unused-parameter",
            "-pedantic", "-I", str(overrides),
            "-I", str(ROOT / "tools/nup-native-host-stub"),
            "-I", str(vendor), "-I", str(ROOT / "headless"),
            str(ROOT / "headless/nup_v1_vfs.cpp"),
            str(ROOT / "headless/nup_v1_native_vfs.cpp"),
            str(ROOT / "headless/nup_v1_native_content.cpp"),
            str(vendor / "core/file_sys/fsmitm_romfsbuild.cpp"),
            str(vendor / "core/file_sys/vfs/vfs_concat.cpp"),
            str(vendor / "core/file_sys/vfs/vfs_vector.cpp"),
            str(vendor / "core/file_sys/vfs/vfs_offset.cpp"),
            str(vendor / "core/file_sys/romfs.cpp"),
            str(ROOT / "tools/nup-v1-real-romfs-host.cpp"),
            "-lcrypto", "-lzstd", "-pthread", "-o", str(binary),
        ]
        if sys.platform == "darwin":
            # OpenSSL/zstd are keg-only under Homebrew. Keep Linux CI's
            # original system linkage and flags unchanged.
            for package in ("openssl@3", "zstd"):
                prefix = Path("/opt/homebrew/opt") / package
                if (prefix / "include").is_dir():
                    cmd += ["-I", str(prefix / "include")]
                if (prefix / "lib").is_dir():
                    cmd += ["-L", str(prefix / "lib"),
                            "-Wl,-rpath," + str(prefix / "lib")]
        subprocess.run(cmd, check=True)
        env = dict(os.environ,
                   ASAN_OPTIONS="halt_on_error=1:detect_leaks=0",
                   UBSAN_OPTIONS="print_stacktrace=1:halt_on_error=1")
        subprocess.run([str(binary), str(test_archive)], check=True, env=env)
        print(f"Pinned vendor full RomFS round-trip {pinned[:12]}: NUP overlay/AoC binary layout OK")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Configure-only test of unified native NUP source owners; no console build."""
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
TEMPLATE = r"""
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(EncoreNupGate LANGUAGES CXX)
set(EDEN_PORT_DIR "@NUP_ROOT@/headless")
set(PORT_ROOT "@WORK_ROOT@")
add_library(core STATIC
    "@WORK_ROOT@/core/loader/loader.cpp"
    "@WORK_ROOT@/core/file_sys/romfs_factory.cpp"
    "@WORK_ROOT@/core/hle/service/aoc/addon_content_manager.cpp")
add_library(libzstd_static INTERFACE)
add_library(ZLIB::ZLIB INTERFACE IMPORTED)
add_executable(eden-headless "@WORK_ROOT@/mock-headless.cpp")
add_library(eden-metadata STATIC "@WORK_ROOT@/mock-metadata.cpp")
include("@NUP_ROOT@/headless/nup_v1_runtime.cmake")
get_target_property(source_list core SOURCES)
if(NOT source_list MATCHES "nup_v1_loader_route[.]cpp")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "NUP factory source not attached")
endif()
if(NOT source_list MATCHES "nup_v1_native_aoc[.]cpp")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "NUP AoC source not attached")
endif()
if(NOT source_list MATCHES "nup_v1_aoc_service[.]cpp")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "NUP AoC service source not attached")
endif()
if(NOT source_list MATCHES "nup_v1_romfs_factory[.]cpp")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "NUP RomFS factory source not attached")
endif()
if(source_list MATCHES "/core/hle/service/aoc/addon_content_manager[.]cpp" OR
   source_list MATCHES "/core/file_sys/romfs_factory[.]cpp")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Duplicate original AoC/ROMFS source owners")
endif()
get_source_file_property(defs "@WORK_ROOT@/core/loader/loader.cpp"
    COMPILE_DEFINITIONS TARGET_DIRECTORY core)
if(NOT defs MATCHES "GetLoader=EdenOriginalGetLoader")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Original vendor GetLoader not aliased")
endif()
get_target_property(headless_defs eden-headless COMPILE_DEFINITIONS)
get_target_property(metadata_defs eden-metadata COMPILE_DEFINITIONS)
if(NOT headless_defs MATCHES "EDEN_NUP_V1_RUNTIME=1" OR
   NOT metadata_defs MATCHES "EDEN_NUP_V1_RUNTIME=1")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "NUP must be present in both unified native consumers")
endif()
"""

def configure(root: Path, label: str, *options: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
    return subprocess.run(
        ["cmake", "-S", str(root), "-B", str(root/label), *options],
        text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
        check=False,
    )

def main() -> None:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
        root = Path(temp)
        owner = root / "core/loader/loader.cpp"
        owner.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        owner.write_text("int noop() { return 0; }\n", encoding="utf-8")
        for relative in (
            "core/file_sys/romfs_factory.cpp",
            "core/hle/service/aoc/addon_content_manager.cpp",
        ):
            synthetic = root / relative
            synthetic.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            synthetic.write_text("int temporary_" + str(len(relative)) +
                                 "() { return 0; }\n", encoding="utf-8")
        (root / "mock-headless.cpp").write_text(
            "int main() { return 0; }\n", encoding="utf-8")
        (root / "mock-metadata.cpp").write_text(
            "int metadata() { return 0; }\n", encoding="utf-8")
        maintained = root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/core/file_sys"
        maintained.mkdir(parents=True)
        (maintained / "extracted_aoc.h").write_text("#pragma once\n", encoding="utf-8")
        content = TEMPLATE.replace("@NUP_ROOT@", ROOT.as_posix()).replace(
            "@WORK_ROOT@", root.as_posix())
        project = root / "CMakeLists.txt"
        project.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")
        normal = configure(root, "normal")
        assert normal.returncode == 0, f"unified NUP configure failed:\n{normal.stdout}"
        # No separate release/DEV/P5 switch is needed to compile NUP.
        legacy = configure(root, "old-switch-ignored", "-DEDEN_NUP_V1_RUNTIME=OFF",
                           "-DEDEN_FINAL_RELEASE_PROFILE=ON")
        assert legacy.returncode == 0, f"stale build options broke NUP:\n{legacy.stdout}"
        # A missing or renamed vendor factory cannot silently route through NUP.
        owner.rename(owner.with_name("renamed.cpp"))
        project.write_text(content.replace(
            "core/loader/loader.cpp", "core/loader/renamed.cpp"),
            encoding="utf-8")
        drift = configure(root, "drift")
        assert drift.returncode != 0 and (
            "exactly one pinned loader.cpp owner" in drift.stdout), drift.stdout
    print("NUP unified owners: mandatory, no release/P5 gate, source drift rejected")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
