`tools/check-ps5-async-present-source-stress.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
"""Stress REAL PresentManager queue/worker methods extracted from active Vulkan C++.

Builds the exact get-frame, enqueue, present-worker and drain methods with
host-only Vulkan/fence stand-ins. The scheduler.Record callback is invoked
immediately (optimistically), while CopyToSwapchain simulates measured
presentation latencies. Thus the test can prove a disconnect between the
COMPOSITOR CALLBACK and later PRESENTATION, not actual hardware jitter.
No game, driver, network, console or native executable is required.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
active=(root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_present_manager.cpp").read_text()
header=(root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/include/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_present_manager.h").read_text()
native_main=(root/"headless/main.cpp").read_text()
render=(root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_renderer.cpp").read_text()
assert "MAX_FRAMES_IN_FLIGHT = 7;" in active
assert "image_count = std::min<size_t>(swapchain.GetImageCount(), MAX_FRAMES_IN_FLIGHT);" in active
swap=(root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_swapchain.cpp").read_text()
assert "requested_image_count = (std::max)(requested_image_count, 3U);" in swap
assert "image_count = static_cast<u32>(images.size());" in swap
assert "std::jthread present_thread;" in header
assert "Settings::values.async_presentation = backend == Eden::GraphicsBackend::Vulkan;" in native_main
assert "SCOPE_EXIT {\n        render_window.OnFrameDisplayed();" in render
assert render.index("render_window.OnFrameDisplayed();") < render.index("present_manager.Present(frame);")

def method(start:str,stop:str):
    assert active.count(start)==1 and active.count(stop)==1, (start,stop)
    a=active.index(start)
    b=active.index(stop,a)
    return active[a:b]
methods=[
    method("Frame* PresentManager::GetRenderFrame() {","void PresentManager::Present(Frame* frame) {"),
    method("void PresentManager::Present(Frame* frame) {","size_t PresentManager::MaxExtraFrames() const {"),
    method("void PresentManager::WaitPresent() {","void PresentManager::PresentThread(std::stop_token token) {"),
    method("void PresentManager::PresentThread(std::stop_token token) {","void PresentManager::RecreateSwapchain(Frame* frame) {")
]
source=r"""
#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <chrono>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdio>
#include <deque>
#include <exception>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
#include <stop_token>
#include <thread>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>
using namespace std::chrono_literals;
namespace vk { struct CommandBuffer {}; }
namespace Common {
enum class ThreadPriority { High };
void SetCurrentThreadName(const char*) {}
void SetCurrentThreadPriority(ThreadPriority) {}
void SetCurrentThreadToPerformanceCores() {}
}
namespace Eden::Performance {
inline int gpu_present_wait=0, gpu_present_free_wait=0, gpu_present_fence_wait=0;
struct DiagnosticTimer { explicit DiagnosticTimer(int&) {} };
}
struct Frame {
  unsigned index{};
  std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point callback;
  struct PresentFence { void Wait(){} void Reset(){} } present_done;
};
struct Scheduler {
  template<class F> void Record(F&& f){ f(vk::CommandBuffer{}); }
  void WaitWorker(){}
};
using Clock=std::chrono::steady_clock;
using Tick=Clock::time_point;
double Millis(Tick a,Tick b){
  return std::chrono::duration<double,std::milli>(b-a).count();
}
class PresentManager {
public:
  Scheduler scheduler;
  std::deque<Frame*> present_queue,free_queue;
  std::condition_variable_any frame_cv;
  std::condition_variable_any present_ready_cv;
  std::condition_variable free_cv;
  std::mutex swapchain_mutex,queue_mutex,free_mutex;
  bool present_in_flight{};
  std::size_t present_waiters{}; // guarded by queue_mutex
  std::size_t free_waiters{}; // guarded by free_mutex
  bool use_present_thread{true};
  std::exception_ptr present_failure;
  std::jthread present_thread;
  std::vector<Frame> frames;
  std::vector<Tick> delivered;
  std::vector<double> latencies;
  std::mutex result_mutex;
  unsigned target_mode{};
  PresentManager(unsigned n,unsigned mode):frames(n),target_mode(mode) {
    for(unsigned i=0;i<n;i++){frames[i].index=i;free_queue.push_back(&frames[i]);}
    present_thread=std::jthread([this](std::stop_token token){PresentThread(token);});
  }
  ~PresentManager(){
    present_thread.request_stop();
    present_ready_cv.notify_all();
    if(present_thread.joinable())present_thread.join();
  }
  Frame* GetRenderFrame();
  void Present(Frame* frame);
  void WaitPresent();
  void PresentThread(std::stop_token token);
  void CopyToSwapchain(Frame* frame){
    // Baseline 2ms; a 130ms spike fits within a 7-frame 30Hz pool.
    // At mode=2 a 350ms spike should fill the pool and stall the callback.
    const unsigned ms=(frame->index==40 || frame->index==80 || frame->index==120)
      ? (target_mode==1?130u:target_mode==2?350u:2u):2u;
    std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(ms));
    std::scoped_lock lock{result_mutex};
    delivered.push_back(Clock::now());
    latencies.push_back(Millis(frame->callback,delivered.back()));
  }
};
__PRODUCTION_METHODS__
struct Outcome {
  double callback_max_ms{},present_gap_max_ms{},age_max_ms{};
  unsigned callback_count{},present_count{};
};
Outcome Run(unsigned mode,unsigned pool){
  PresentManager manager{pool,mode};
  constexpr unsigned count=150;
  constexpr auto cadence=std::chrono::microseconds(33333);
  std::vector<Tick> callbacks;
  const Tick start=Clock::now();
  for(unsigned i=0;i<count;i++){
    std::this_thread::sleep_until(start+i*cadence);
    Frame* frame=manager.GetRenderFrame();
    frame->index=i;
    frame->callback=Clock::now();
    // This event is "Composite callback" after enqueue, NOT a present ACK.
    manager.Present(frame);
    callbacks.push_back(Clock::now());
  }
  manager.WaitPresent();
  Outcome out{};
  out.callback_count=static_cast<unsigned>(callbacks.size());
  out.present_count=static_cast<unsigned>(manager.delivered.size());
  for(unsigned i=1;i<count;i++){
    out.callback_max_ms=std::max(out.callback_max_ms,Millis(callbacks[i-1],callbacks[i]));
  }
  for(unsigned i=1;i<manager.delivered.size();i++)
    out.present_gap_max_ms=std::max(out.present_gap_max_ms,
                                   Millis(manager.delivered[i-1],manager.delivered[i]));
  for(const double lag:manager.latencies) out.age_max_ms=std::max(out.age_max_ms,lag);
  return out;
}
int main(){
  const auto base3=Run(0,3);
  const auto short3=Run(1,3);
  const auto short7=Run(1,7);
  const auto oversize7=Run(2,7);
  for(auto [label,v]:{std::pair{"baseline_pool3",base3},std::pair{"130ms_pool3",short3},
                       std::pair{"130ms_pool7",short7},std::pair{"350ms_pool7",oversize7}}){
    std::printf("%s callbacks=%u presented=%u max_callback_gap_ms=%.2f "
                "max_present_gap_ms=%.2f max_async_age_ms=%.2f\n",label,
                v.callback_count,v.present_count,v.callback_max_ms,
                v.present_gap_max_ms,v.age_max_ms);
    assert(v.callback_count==150 && v.present_count==150);
  }
  // The tested 130ms intermittent present delay can remain INVISIBLE
  // to upstream callbacks, exactly as normal 30 FPS telemetry would.
  assert(short3.present_gap_max_ms>100.0);
  assert(short7.present_gap_max_ms>100.0);
  assert(short7.age_max_ms>125.0);
  // The actual swapchain image count is driver-returned. A small pool can
  // propagate the same delay upstream, a 7-image pool may conceal it.
  if(__STRICT_HOST_TIMING__) {
    // Wall-clock scheduling thresholds belong to a controlled local host run,
    // never an overloaded shared CI runner.
    assert(short3.callback_max_ms>55.0);
    assert(short7.callback_max_ms<50.0);
    assert(oversize7.callback_max_ms>60.0);
    assert(base3.present_gap_max_ms<80.0);
    std::puts("STRICT_HOST_TIMING_PASS: 3-vs-7 buffers differ under 130ms WSI hold");
  }
  std::puts("PASS: source-extracted presentation queues drain with 150/150 frames");
}
"""
source=source.replace("__PRODUCTION_METHODS__","\n".join(methods))
strict_host_timing = os.environ.get("EDEN_PRESENT_STRICT_HOST_TIMING") == "1"
source=source.replace("__STRICT_HOST_TIMING__","true" if strict_host_timing else "false")
assert "void PresentManager::PresentThread(std::stop_token token)" in source
assert "present_in_flight = false;" in source
assert "std::size_t present_waiters{}; // drain waiters, guarded by queue_mutex" in header
assert "std::size_t free_waiters{}; // guarded by free_mutex" in header
assert "std::size_t free_waiters{}; // guarded by free_mutex" in source
assert "std::size_t present_waiters{}; // guarded by queue_mutex" in source
assert "notify_drainers = present_waiters != 0 && present_queue.empty();" in source
assert "std::exchange(lock, std::unique_lock{swapchain_mutex})" in source
compiler=shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
assert compiler,"Host C++20 compiler required"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-async-present-replay-") as tmp:
    src=Path(tmp)/"present-replay.cpp"
```

```py
"""Compile the actual PS5 AudioOut diagnostic PCM scan outside its stream mutex.

# pointer pthread_t while the Linux host uses an integer pthread_t.

    r"(?:Eden::)?Crash::audio_worker_thread\.store\(\s*([^,]+),\s*std::memory_order_release\)"
)

#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <mutex>
using s16 = std::int16_t;
using u64 = std::uint64_t;
constexpr std::size_t kAudioOutGrain = 256;
std::mutex* active_mutex{};
int output_status{};
int sceAudioOutOutput(int handle, const s16* block) {
    assert(handle == 5 && block != nullptr && active_mutex);
    assert(active_mutex->try_lock());  // producer can enter during output
    active_mutex->unlock();
    return output_status;
}
u64 CountOutput(std::array<s16, kAudioOutGrain * 2>& block, int status) {
    std::mutex mutex;
    std::unique_lock lock(mutex);
    active_mutex = &mutex;
    output_status = status;
    const int handle = 5;
__EXTRACTED_SCAN__
    lock.lock();
    assert(lock.owns_lock());
    active_mutex = nullptr;
    return result < 0 ? 0 : nonzero_in_block;
}
int main() {
    std::array<s16, kAudioOutGrain * 2> samples{};
    assert(CountOutput(samples, 0) == 0);
    samples[0] = 1; samples[1] = 2;  // stereo pair counts once
    samples[5] = -1;                 // right-only channel
    samples[(kAudioOutGrain - 1) * 2] = 3;
    assert(CountOutput(samples, 0) == 3);
    assert(CountOutput(samples, -1) == 0); // failed output not counted
    samples.fill(1);
    assert(CountOutput(samples, 0) == kAudioOutGrain);

        ("integer", "unsigned long", "12345UL", "12345UL"),
```

```py
def dds(w, h, payload, fmt, masks=(0, 0, 0, 0)):
    header = bytearray(128)
    struct.pack_into('<I', header, 0, 0x20534444)
    struct.pack_into('<I', header, 4, 124)
    struct.pack_into('<I', header, 8, 0x1007)
    struct.pack_into('<II', header, 12, h, w)
    struct.pack_into('<I', header, 76, 32)
    struct.pack_into('<I', header, 84, fmt)
    struct.pack_into('<I', header, 88, 32 if fmt == 0 else 0)
    for idx, value in enumerate(masks):
        struct.pack_into('<I', header, 92 + idx * 4, value)
    return bytes(header) + payload
```

```py
"""F01: compile and execute the selected maintained upload path (O0/O2, UBSan).

The unchanged upstream dirty-range walk is checked alongside the new clean

guard_block = """#ifdef PS5_NATIVE

    // destructive upload-range walk and list rebuild unless CPU dirty bits
    // are present; never skip real dirty pages or GPU-overlap filtering.
    if (!memory_tracker.IsRegionCpuModified(device_addr, size)) {

"""

    "bfbac4c35e80488dfb846feab980f4781821f7e98eda6988e467cddd24a372aa")

# This test extracts the selected native method. Testing a stand-in algorithm
# without compiling the actual maintained source would not prove selection.
prologue = r"""
#include <algorithm>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <span>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>
using DAddr = std::uint64_t;
using u64 = std::uint64_t;
using u32 = std::uint32_t;
struct BufferCopy {u64 src_offset{}, dst_offset{}, size{};};
struct Buffer {DAddr cpu_addr_cached=0x1000;};
struct Tracker {
    bool dirty=false;
    int dirty_probes=0, upload_walks=0;
    bool IsRegionCpuModified(DAddr, u32 size) {++dirty_probes;return dirty && size != 0;}
    template<class Fn> void ForEachUploadRange(DAddr addr,u32 size,Fn fn) {
        ++upload_walks;
        const bool needs_upload=dirty;
        if(size) dirty=false; // a zero-size real range walk consumes nothing
        if(needs_upload && size) fn(addr,size);
    }
};
struct GpuDirty {
    std::vector<std::pair<u64,u64>> ranges;
    template<class Fn> void ForEachInRange(u64 addr,u64 size,Fn fn) {
        for(const auto& [start,end] : ranges) {
            const u64 lo=std::max(start,addr),hi=std::min(end,addr+size);
            if(lo<hi) fn(lo,hi);
        }
    }
};
struct Dummy {};
template<class P> struct BufferCache {
    Tracker memory_tracker;
    GpuDirty gpu_modified_ranges;
    std::vector<BufferCopy> upload_copies;
    bool any_buffer_uploaded=false;
    int uploads=0;
    u64 bytes_uploaded=0, last_largest=0;
    bool SynchronizeBuffer(Buffer& buffer,DAddr device_addr,u32 size);
    void UploadMemory(Buffer&,u64 total,u64 largest,std::span<BufferCopy> copies) {
        assert(!copies.empty());
        ++uploads;
        bytes_uploaded+=total;
        last_largest=largest;
        u64 sum=0;
        for(const auto& copy:copies) sum+=copy.size;
        assert(sum==total);
    }
};
"""
epilogue = r"""
int main() {
    BufferCache<Dummy> cache{};
    Buffer buffer{};
    // Native hot-draws skip the walk. Unmodified upstream must use the
    // original walk without the new probe (both produce identical results).
    for(int i=0;i<1024;i++) assert(cache.SynchronizeBuffer(buffer,0x1000,256));
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(cache.memory_tracker.dirty_probes==1024);
    assert(cache.memory_tracker.upload_walks==0);
#else
    assert(cache.memory_tracker.dirty_probes==0);
    assert(cache.memory_tracker.upload_walks==1024);
#endif
    const int clean_walks=cache.memory_tracker.upload_walks;
    assert(cache.uploads==0 && !cache.any_buffer_uploaded);
    // Dirty CPU data must still be uploaded and its dirty bits consumed.
    cache.memory_tracker.dirty=true;
    assert(!cache.SynchronizeBuffer(buffer,0x1000,256));
    assert(cache.memory_tracker.upload_walks==clean_walks+1);
    assert(cache.uploads==1 && cache.bytes_uploaded==256 && cache.last_largest==256);
    assert(!cache.memory_tracker.dirty && cache.any_buffer_uploaded);
    // With the CPU range clean again, the previous vector is not reused.
    assert(cache.SynchronizeBuffer(buffer,0x1000,256));
    assert(cache.uploads==1);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(cache.memory_tracker.upload_walks==clean_walks+1);
#else
    assert(cache.memory_tracker.upload_walks==clean_walks+2);
#endif
    // Aliased GPU-dirty bytes are *excluded* from the CPU upload.
    cache.memory_tracker.dirty=true;
    cache.gpu_modified_ranges.ranges={{0x1040,0x1080}};
    assert(!cache.SynchronizeBuffer(buffer,0x1000,256));
    assert(cache.uploads==2 && cache.bytes_uploaded==448);
    assert(cache.upload_copies.size()==2);
    assert(cache.upload_copies[0].dst_offset==0 && cache.upload_copies[0].size==64);
    assert(cache.upload_copies[1].dst_offset==128 && cache.upload_copies[1].size==128);
    // All bytes GPU-owned: dirty CPU marks are still consumed, no upload.
    cache.memory_tracker.dirty=true;
    cache.gpu_modified_ranges.ranges={{0x1000,0x1100}};
    assert(cache.SynchronizeBuffer(buffer,0x1000,256));
    assert(cache.uploads==2);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(cache.memory_tracker.upload_walks==clean_walks+3);
#else
    assert(cache.memory_tracker.upload_walks==clean_walks+4);
#endif
    assert(!cache.memory_tracker.dirty);
    // Zero-length requests never allocate or consume a retained dirty flag.
    cache.memory_tracker.dirty=true;
    assert(cache.SynchronizeBuffer(buffer,0x1000,0));
    assert(cache.memory_tracker.dirty);
}
"""
compilers = list(dict.fromkeys(filter(None, (
    shutil.which("clang++"), shutil.which("g++"), shutil.which("c++")))))
assert compilers, "C++20 compiler required"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-f01-clean-upload-") as temp:
    cpp = Path(temp) / "upload.cpp"
    cpp.write_text(prologue + "\ntemplate<class P>\n" + method + "\n" + epilogue)
```

```py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
"""Qualify active backport dequeue broadcast generation with 400 host waits.

This host test compiles the EXACT source methods from the active guest

# but must not forcibly flush or wait for file I/O in a frame callback.

fixture = r"""
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <chrono>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <cstdint>
#include <future>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>
#include <cstdio>
using u64=std::uint64_t;
class BufferQueueCore {
public:
    std::mutex mutex;
    std::condition_variable dequeue_condition;
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> dequeue_epoch{};
    void SignalDequeueCondition();
    bool WaitForDequeueCondition(std::unique_lock<std::mutex>& lk);
};
__REAL_METHODS__
int main() {
    using namespace std::chrono_literals;
    // Every waiter is already checking availability while holding mutex.
    // A concurrent wake must become visible to ALL who release it in wait.
    for (int round=0; round<100; ++round) {
        BufferQueueCore core;
        std::atomic<int> ready{0};
        std::atomic<int> done{0};
        constexpr int waiters=4;
        std::promise<void> all_done;
        auto result=all_done.get_future();
        std::vector<std::thread> threads;
        for (int i=0; i<waiters; ++i) {
            threads.emplace_back([&] {
                std::unique_lock lock{core.mutex};
                ++ready;
                assert(core.WaitForDequeueCondition(lock));
                if (++done == waiters) all_done.set_value();
            });
        }
        auto deadline=std::chrono::steady_clock::now()+3s;
        while (ready.load()!=waiters && std::chrono::steady_clock::now()<deadline)
            std::this_thread::yield();
        assert(ready.load()==waiters);
        {
            std::lock_guard lock{core.mutex};
            core.SignalDequeueCondition();
        }
        assert(result.wait_for(3s)==std::future_status::ready);
        for (auto& thread:threads) thread.join();
        assert(done.load()==waiters);
    }
    std::puts("PASS: 400 waiters on active backport broadcast-generation wake");
}
""".replace("__REAL_METHODS__", real_methods)

compiler = shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
```

```py
cpp=r"""
#include "buffer_pages.h"
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>
int main(){
 using namespace Eden::BufferPages;
 constexpr std::uint64_t p=4096;
 assert(NeverRegistered(0,1));
 assert(!NeverRegistered(0,0) && !NeverRegistered(kSpace,1));
 assert(!NeverRegistered(0,64*p+1) && !NeverRegistered(kSpace-1,2));
 Mark(0,1);
 assert(!NeverRegistered(0,1) && NeverRegistered(p,1));
 // A previously marked word stays marked on repeated registrations.
 Mark(100*p,1);
 const auto word = (100ull*p >> kPageBits) / 64;
 const auto previous = registered[word].load(std::memory_order_acquire);
 for(unsigned n=0;n<2000;++n) Mark(100*p,1);
 assert(registered[word].load(std::memory_order_acquire)==previous);
 // Concurrent overlapping and disjoint writers within one bitmap word
 // must never lose either registration on the conditional fast path.
 std::vector<std::thread> overlapping;
 for(unsigned t=0;t<8;++t)overlapping.emplace_back([t]{
   for(unsigned n=0;n<1000;++n) {
     Mark((128+t)*p, 1);
     Mark(128*p, 8*p);
   }
 });
 for(auto& task:overlapping)task.join();
 for(unsigned t=0;t<8;++t)assert(!NeverRegistered((128+t)*p,1));
 Mark(63*p+7,2*p);

 std::vector<std::thread> jobs;
 for(unsigned t=0;t<8;t++)jobs.emplace_back([t]{
    const auto b=(1000000ull+t*1000ull)*4096ull;
    for(unsigned n=0;n<512;n++)Mark(b+n*4096,1);
 });
 for(auto& j:jobs)j.join();
 for(unsigned t=0;t<8;t++){
   const auto b=(1000000ull+t*1000ull)*4096ull;
   assert(!NeverRegistered(b,1));
   assert(!NeverRegistered(b+511*p,1));
   assert(NeverRegistered(b+512*p,1));
 }
 // Compare against an independent page-by-page owner oracle, including
 // registered, empty, crossing, oversized, near-end and unaligned writes.
 auto oracle=[](std::uint64_t address,std::uint64_t size){
   if(coverage_unknown.load(std::memory_order_acquire) ||
      !size || size>256*1024 || address>=kSpace || size>kSpace-address)return false;
   auto first=address>>kPageBits;
   auto last=(address+size-1)>>kPageBits;
   for(auto page=first;page<=last;++page)
     if((registered[page/64].load(std::memory_order_acquire)>>(page%64))&1u)
       return false;
   return !coverage_unknown.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
 };
 std::uint64_t rng=0xfed3c689a5b72d41ull;
 constexpr std::uint64_t lens[]{0,1,2,7,4095,4096,4097,65536,262144,262145};
 for(unsigned i=0;i<18000;++i){
   rng^=rng<<13;rng^=rng>>7;rng^=rng<<17;
   const auto address=i%3==0 ? rng%(4096ull*12000) :
                      i%3==1 ? kSpace-1-rng%10000 : rng%kSpace;
   const auto bytes=lens[i%10];
   assert(NeverRegistered(address,bytes)==oracle(address,bytes));
 }
 for(std::uint64_t addr : std::array<std::uint64_t,5>{0,4095,63*p+4095,64*p,kSpace-1})
   for(std::uint64_t bytes : lens)
     assert(NeverRegistered(addr,bytes)==oracle(addr,bytes));
 // Marking a one-page span must publish the exact same bit as the
 // previous generic word-range algorithm, including the word boundary.
 Mark(192*p+1,4094);
 assert(!NeverRegistered(192*p,1) && NeverRegistered(193*p,1));
 Mark(kSpace+1,1);
 assert(!NeverRegistered(66*p,1));
}
"""
```

`tools/check-ps5-buffer-region-multipage-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Exact BufferCache region-ownership regression for partially covered first pages.

False negatives here can skip guest CPU writes and leave a later registered GPU
buffer stale, even though the monotonic BufferPages witness correctly says
the queried region MAY overlap some buffer.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
active = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/video_core/buffer_cache/buffer_cache.h").read_text()
backport = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-backports/src/video_core/buffer_cache/buffer_cache.h").read_text()
needle = "template <class P>\nbool BufferCache<P>::IsRegionRegistered(DAddr addr, size_t size) {"

def method(source):
    assert source.count(needle) == 1
    begin = source.index(needle)
    return source[begin:source.index("\ntemplate <class P>", begin + len(needle))]

body = method(active)
original = method(backport)
assert original.count("page = Common::DivCeil(end_addr, CACHING_PAGESIZE);") == 1
assert original.count("    const DAddr end_addr = addr + size;") == 1
expected = original.replace("bool BufferCache<P>::IsRegionRegistered(DAddr addr, size_t size) {\n    const DAddr end_addr = addr + size;", "bool BufferCache<P>::IsRegionRegistered(DAddr addr, size_t size) {\n    // An empty CPU write does not overlap any registered cache buffer.\n    if (size == 0) {\n        return false;\n    }\n    // The page_table has exactly 16 GiB of guest-physical address space.\n    // Reject unrepresentable/overflowing spans before addr + size or page_table[].\n    constexpr DAddr kTableAddressLimit = DAddr{1} << 34;\n    if (addr >= kTableAddressLimit || size > kTableAddressLimit - addr) {\n        return false;\n    }\n    const DAddr end_addr = addr + size;").replace(
    "        if (buf_start_addr < end_addr && addr < buf_end_addr) {\n            return true;\n        }\n        page = Common::DivCeil(end_addr, CACHING_PAGESIZE);", "        if (buf_start_addr < end_addr && addr < buf_end_addr) {\n            return true;\n        }\n        // The first page can contain a buffer ending before addr. A later\n        // page may belong to another registered buffer intersecting the span.\n        // Do not skip all remaining pages after one non-overlapping owner.\n        ++page;")
assert body == expected, "native ownership scan differs from reviewed backport transformation"
assert "if (size == 0)" in body
assert body.count("++page;") == 2
assert "page = Common::DivCeil(end_addr, CACHING_PAGESIZE);" not in body
fixture = r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>
using DAddr = std::uint64_t;
using u64 = std::uint64_t;
static constexpr u64 CACHING_PAGEBITS=12;
static constexpr u64 CACHING_PAGESIZE=1ull << CACHING_PAGEBITS;
namespace Common {
template<class T> T DivCeil(T a, T b) { return a / b + (a % b != 0); }
}
struct BufferId {
    std::size_t value{};
    operator std::size_t() const { return value; }
};
struct Buffer {
    DAddr address{};
    std::size_t size{};
    DAddr CpuAddr() const { return address; }
    std::size_t SizeBytes() const { return size; }
};
template<class P>
struct BufferCache {
    std::vector<BufferId> page_table;
    std::vector<Buffer> slot_buffers;
    bool IsRegionRegistered(DAddr addr, size_t size);
};
""" + body + r"""
int main() {
    BufferCache<void> b;
    b.page_table.resize(8);
    b.slot_buffers = {{}, {0x1000,0x400}, {0x2000,0x800}, {0x3100,0x700}};
    b.page_table[1] = {1};
    b.page_table[2] = {2};
    b.page_table[3] = {3};

    // Prior implementation jumped straight to the end when the first
    // registered page ended before the queried span's starting address.
    // The SECOND page is nevertheless a real overlap and must be visited.
    assert(b.IsRegionRegistered(0x1800,0x1000));
    // A gap must remain a gap; seeing a page owner isn't itself an overlap.
    assert(!b.IsRegionRegistered(0x1800,0x100));
    // Direct single-page overlap still succeeds.
    assert(b.IsRegionRegistered(0x1100,0x100));
    // Skipping an unowned intermediate page must not lose page three.
    b.page_table[2] = {};
    assert(b.IsRegionRegistered(0x1800,0x2000));
    // All actual owners absent from the queried range means false.
    assert(!b.IsRegionRegistered(0x1800,0x1600));
    // An empty write is not an overlapping write, even inside a buffer.
    assert(!b.IsRegionRegistered(0x1100,0));
    // Independent direct registration on the later page.
    assert(b.IsRegionRegistered(0x3200,0x80));
    // The actual native page_table is bounded to 16 GiB. Invalid spans
    // must return BEFORE attempting a page_table[] lookup; this small fixture
    // deliberately keeps only eight pages, and UBSan checks the range logic.
    constexpr DAddr limit = DAddr{1} << 34;
    assert(!b.IsRegionRegistered(limit, 1));
    assert(!b.IsRegionRegistered(limit + 0x1000, 1));
    assert(!b.IsRegionRegistered(limit - 0x80, 0x100));
    assert(!b.IsRegionRegistered(~DAddr{0} - 2, 8));
    assert(!b.IsRegionRegistered(~DAddr{0}, 1));
    // A zero-sized query at the maximum address remains a no-op.
    assert(!b.IsRegionRegistered(~DAddr{0}, 0));
}
"""
compiler = shutil.which("c++") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
assert compiler, "Host C++ compiler required"
```

`tools/check-ps5-closure.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Fail-closed native PS5 release/issue closure gate; read-only offline.

This check is intentionally NOT attached to CI or native build workflows.
It cannot prove test authenticity: a human must inspect the referenced
hardware captures, original game files, and library rights before promotion.
The current matrix explicitly refuses all closure (zero PS5 gates passed).
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import json
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DEFAULT=ROOT/"docs/PS5_CLOSURE_MATRIX.json"
EXPECTED={
    "fc27_and_launcher_frametime":(
        "fc27_boots_two_sessions_fw1360",
        "fc27_first_warm_same_match_frame_time_traces",
        "fc27_no_late_oom_or_bad_alloc_under_memory_pressure",
        "fc27_stalls_shaders_cache_measured_before_after",
        "launcher_held_navigation_no_122_175ms_decode_hitches",
        "playstation_auto_popup_and_true_menu_scene_behaviour",
    ),
    "sparse_JIT_dynarmic_a64_a32":(
        "native_sdk_build_link_sparse_enabled_for_dev_experiment",
        "fw1360_executable_rw_rx_alias_4m_bootstrap_and_increment",
        "fw1360_sparse_rollback_unmap_and_memory_pressure",
        "fw1360_a64_a32_4core_real_game_execution_and_cache_flush",
        "sparse_off_fallback_and_no_regression_on_second_game",
    ),
    "gpu_vulkan_and_compatibility":(
        "native_sdk_prmt_imm_reg_compiles_and_executes",
        "prmt_pixel_correct_golden_shader_capture",
        "fermi_z0_pitch_multilayer_golden_copy_capture",
        "unsupported_prmt_fermi_semantics_not_silently_masked",
        "no_gpu_sync_queue_regression_multi_game",
    ),
    "playstation_glyphs_inside_games":(
        "legitimate_original_mod_pack_binary_source_verified",
        "title_update_romfs_sha_and_layout_qualified",
        "format_safe_BNTX_Unity_CPK_or_other_repack_roundtrip",
        "playstation_ps5_game_art_in_match_menu_hud_fc27",
        "playstation_ps5_game_art_second_game_coverage",
        "signed_versioned_opt_in_pack_delivery_and_fallback",
    ),
    "release_integrity_and_ux":(
        "complete_early_source_and_native_build_after_final_diff",
        "fw1360_reinstall_launch_exit_relaunch",
        "approved_purple_launcher_visual_review",
        "release_shipping_branch_and_rights_review",
    ),
}
TITLE_ISSUES={"playstation_glyphs_inside_games":7}
REFERENCE=re.compile(r"(?:https://github\.com/niakw/Prospero\.Eden-Encore/(?:issues|actions|commit|blob)/\S+|sha256:[0-9a-f]{64})\Z")


def audit(data: dict) -> dict:
    if not isinstance(data, dict) or data.get("schema") != 1:
        raise ValueError("invalid closure matrix schema")
    if data.get("shipping_branch") != "fix/0.40-zbic-13.60" or \
       data.get("development_branch") != "dev/ps5-sparse-jit" or \
       data.get("approved_purple_launcher_unchanged_required") is not True or \
       data.get("shipping_unchanged_required") is not True:
        raise ValueError("protected release/approved UI contract was removed")
    workstreams=data.get("workstreams")
    if not isinstance(workstreams,list) or len(workstreams)!=len(EXPECTED):
        raise ValueError("missing or extra required workstream")
    seen=set()
    count=0
    passed=0
    blocked=[]
    for group in workstreams:
        if not isinstance(group,dict):
            raise ValueError("invalid workstream")
        gid=group.get("id")
        if gid not in EXPECTED or gid in seen:
            raise ValueError("unexpected/duplicate workstream")
        seen.add(gid)
        if group.get("issue") != TITLE_ISSUES.get(gid,8):
            raise ValueError("issue is improperly detached from required workstream")
        checks=group.get("acceptance")
        if not isinstance(checks,list) or len(checks)!=len(EXPECTED[gid]):
            raise ValueError("missing or extra acceptance evidence")
        ids=set()
        for check in checks:
            if not isinstance(check,dict):
                raise ValueError("bad acceptance item")
            key=check.get("id")
            if not isinstance(key,str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_]{10,90}",key) or key in ids:
                raise ValueError("bad/repeated acceptance id")
            ids.add(key)
            count+=1
            flag=check.get("passed")
            evidence=check.get("evidence_ref")
            if type(flag) is not bool:
                raise ValueError("acceptance must be explicit boolean")
            if flag:
                if not isinstance(evidence,str) or not REFERENCE.fullmatch(evidence):
                    raise ValueError("claimed pass lacks inspectable evidence link/hash")
                passed+=1
            else:
                if evidence is not None:
                    raise ValueError("failed/untested acceptance must have no passing evidence")
                blocked.append(key)
        if ids != set(EXPECTED[gid]):
            raise ValueError("required acceptance IDs changed or an essential test removed")
        if group.get("status") not in ("blocked","ready_for_review"):
            raise ValueError("invalid workstream status")
        if any(not c["passed"] for c in checks) and group["status"]!="blocked":
            raise ValueError("prematurely ready workstream")
    if set(EXPECTED)!=seen or count!=26:
        raise ValueError("required acceptance inventory changed")
    ready=(passed==count)
    if data.get("status") != ("ready_for_human_review" if ready else "blocked"):
        raise ValueError("matrix status contradicts hardware evidence")
    return {"workstreams":len(seen),"acceptance_total":count,"passed":passed,
            "blocked":blocked,"ready_for_human_review":ready,
            "issues_to_keep_open":[7,8] if not ready else [],
            "release_automatically_approved":False,
            "manual_hardware_and_licensing_review_always_required":True}


def main() -> int:
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    p.add_argument("--matrix",type=Path,default=DEFAULT)
    p.add_argument("--require-ready",action="store_true",
                   help="nonzero exit unless all 26 evidence gates passed")
    args=p.parse_args()
    try:
        if not args.matrix.is_file() or args.matrix.is_symlink() or args.matrix.stat().st_size>128*1024:
            raise ValueError("missing or unsafe closure matrix")
        data=json.loads(args.matrix.read_text("utf-8"))
        result=audit(data)
        print("EDEN_PS5_CLOSURE "+json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True))
        if args.require_ready and not result["ready_for_human_review"]:
            return 2
        return 0
    except (ValueError,OSError,UnicodeError) as e:
        print(f"EDEN_PS5_CLOSURE_INVALID: {e}",file=sys.stderr)
        return 1


if __name__=="__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
```

`tools/check-ps5-compute-descriptor-ring-preflight-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Source-backed compute descriptor ring preflights: exact native wait and allocation logic."""
from pathlib import Path
import ast
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
active = root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan"
ring = (active / "vulkan_descriptor_buffer.cpp").read_text()
compute_pipeline = (active / "vk_compute_pipeline_cost.cpp").read_text()
compute_header = (active / "include/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_compute_pipeline.h").read_text()
raster = (active / "vulkan_rasterizer.cpp").read_text()
gen = (root / "tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py").read_text()
workflow = (root / ".github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml").read_text()
tree = ast.parse(gen)

def methods(text, needle):
    start = text.index(needle)
    opened = text.index("{", start)
    nesting = 0
    for index in range(opened, len(text)):
        if text[index] == "{": nesting += 1
        if text[index] == "}":
            nesting -= 1
            if nesting == 0:
                return text[start:index + 1]
    raise AssertionError("unterminated source method")

def adapters(path):
    result=[]
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node,ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func,ast.Name) and node.func.id=="adapt":
            if len(node.args)>=3 and isinstance(node.args[0],ast.Constant) and node.args[0].value==path:
                for entry in node.args[2].elts:
                    try: result.append(ast.literal_eval(entry))
                    except (SyntaxError,ValueError,TypeError): continue
    return result

header_patches=adapters("src/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_compute_pipeline.h")
# The NS2 forward declaration is a separate, exact source adaptation.
# Do not mistake it for the F07 descriptor preflight replacement.
assert len(header_patches)==2 and all(len(entry)==2 for entry in header_patches)
assert header_patches[0][0] == "namespace Vulkan {"
assert "NativeQmdResourcePlan" in header_patches[0][1]
old,new=header_patches[1]

frame=methods(ring,"bool DescriptorBufferRing::PreflightFrameReuse(")
capacity=methods(ring,"bool DescriptorBufferRing::PreflightCapacity(")
allocation=methods(ring,"DescriptorBufferRing::Allocation DescriptorBufferRing::Allocate(")
cpp=r"""
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>
using u8 = std::uint8_t;
using u32 = std::uint32_t;
using u64 = std::uint64_t;
using VkDeviceSize = std::uint64_t;
#define ASSERT(expr) assert(expr)
#define LOG_DEBUG(...) ((void)0)
namespace Common {
template<typename T>T AlignUp(T n,T a){return (n+a-1)/a*a;}
}
static bool cache_locks_held=false;
struct Scheduler {
    u64 tick{291};
    u64 completed{};
    int waits{}, finishes{}, waits_under_lock{}, free_queries{};
    bool IsFree(u64 t) {++free_queries;return t<=completed;}
    void Wait(u64) { if (cache_locks_held) ++waits_under_lock; ++waits; }
    void Finish() { if(cache_locks_held) ++waits_under_lock; ++finishes; }
    u64 CurrentTick() const { return tick; }
};
struct DescriptorBufferRing {
    struct Allocation { u8* host{}; VkDeviceSize offset{}; u32 chunk{}; u64 generation{}; };
    bool PreflightFrameReuse(Scheduler&);
    bool PreflightCapacity(Scheduler&,VkDeviceSize);
    Allocation Allocate(Scheduler&,VkDeviceSize);
    bool CanAllocate(VkDeviceSize size) const {return Common::AlignUp(size,alignment)<=chunk_capacity;}
    u64 CurrentGeneration() const{return generation;}
    std::vector<int> chunks{1,2};
    std::array<std::array<u8,100>,2> data{};
    std::vector<u8*> chunk_hosts{data[0].data(),data[1].data()};
    std::array<u64,8> frame_ticks{};
    VkDeviceSize alignment{4},chunk_capacity{100},cursor{0};
    size_t frame_index{0},chunk_cursor{0},chunks_per_frame{2};
    u64 generation{8};
    bool frame_reused{};
};
struct Layout { VkDeviceSize size{16}; };
struct DescriptorUpdateEntry { u64 bits{}; };
struct Pipeline {
    DescriptorBufferRing& descriptor_buffer_ring;
    // Explicitly initialize the sole required dependency. Keep -Werror
    // enabled, including Clang's missing-field-initializers warning.
    explicit Pipeline(DescriptorBufferRing& ring) : descriptor_buffer_ring(ring) {}
    bool last_descriptor_buffer_valid{};
    u64 last_descriptor_buffer_generation{};
    std::vector<DescriptorUpdateEntry> last_descriptor_payload;
    bool uses_descriptor_buffer{true};
    Layout descriptor_buffer_layout{};
    size_t num_descriptor_entries{8};
__GETTER__
__RESERVATION__
};
__FRAME__
__CAPACITY__
__ALLOCATE__
int main() {
    Scheduler s;
    DescriptorBufferRing r;
    Pipeline p{r};
    assert(p.DescriptorRingPreflightSize()==16);
    p.last_descriptor_buffer_valid=true;
    p.last_descriptor_buffer_generation=r.CurrentGeneration();
    p.last_descriptor_payload.resize(p.num_descriptor_entries);
    assert(p.DescriptorRingPreflightSize()==0);
    p.last_descriptor_buffer_valid=false;
    assert(p.DescriptorEntryReservation()==8);
    // Spare capacity should not cause any early fence wait.
    assert(!r.PreflightFrameReuse(s));
    assert(!r.PreflightCapacity(s,p.DescriptorRingPreflightSize()));
    cache_locks_held=true;
    assert(r.Allocate(s,p.DescriptorRingPreflightSize()).host);
    cache_locks_held=false;
    assert(s.waits_under_lock==0&&s.waits==0&&s.finishes==0);
    // An eight-frame recycled ring waits on the previous tick, outside locks.
    r.frame_ticks[0]=128;
    r.frame_reused=true;
    assert(r.PreflightFrameReuse(s));
    assert(s.waits==1&&!r.frame_reused);
    cache_locks_held=true;
    assert(r.Allocate(s,p.DescriptorRingPreflightSize()).host);
    cache_locks_held=false;
    assert(s.waits_under_lock==0&&s.waits==1);
    // Recycled slot already completed: no wait, no forced guest shader
    // reselection. Allocations may still proceed normally.
    r.frame_reused=true;
    r.frame_ticks[0]=128;
    s.completed=128;
    assert(!r.PreflightFrameReuse(s) && s.waits==1 && !r.frame_reused);
    // No valid snapshot: full-ring allocation is guaranteed and pre-drained.
    r.chunk_cursor=1; r.cursor=96;
    assert(r.PreflightCapacity(s,p.DescriptorRingPreflightSize()));
    assert(s.finishes==1&&r.generation==9&&r.cursor==0&&r.chunk_cursor==0);
    cache_locks_held=true;
    auto allocation=r.Allocate(s,p.DescriptorRingPreflightSize());
    cache_locks_held=false;
    assert(allocation.host&&allocation.generation==9&&s.waits_under_lock==0);
    // No extension: no reservation and no early GPU fence required.
    p.uses_descriptor_buffer=false;
    assert(p.DescriptorRingPreflightSize()==0);
    assert(!r.PreflightCapacity(s,p.DescriptorRingPreflightSize()));
    // A later pipeline may use a different layout after a wait.
    p.uses_descriptor_buffer=true; p.descriptor_buffer_layout.size=40;
    assert(p.DescriptorRingPreflightSize()==40);
    assert(!r.PreflightCapacity(s,p.DescriptorRingPreflightSize()));
    // Independent pipeline capacities are tested independently.
    r.chunk_cursor=1;r.cursor=90;
    assert(r.PreflightCapacity(s,p.DescriptorRingPreflightSize()));
    cache_locks_held=true;
    assert(r.Allocate(s,p.DescriptorRingPreflightSize()).host);
    cache_locks_held=false;
    assert(s.waits_under_lock==0 && s.finishes==2);
}
""".replace("__GETTER__",getter).replace("__RESERVATION__",reservation).replace(
    "__FRAME__",frame).replace("__CAPACITY__",capacity).replace("__ALLOCATE__",allocation)
cc=shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++")
assert cc, "Clang C++20 required"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-compute-ring-") as temp:
    src=Path(temp)/"witness.cpp";exe=Path(temp)/"witness"
    src.write_text(cpp)
    subprocess.run([cc,"-std=c++20","-O1","-Wall","-Wextra","-Werror",
                    "-fsanitize=address,undefined","-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
                    str(src),"-o",str(exe)],check=True,timeout=45)
    subprocess.run([str(exe)],check=True,timeout=30)
print("COMPUTE_DESCRIPTOR_RING_PREFLIGHT_HOST_PASS frame_fence=1 full_ring=2 no_locked_wait=1 immutable_layout=1")
```

```py
    assert(compute_descriptor_scratch.views.capacity() >= 128);
    assert(compute_descriptor_scratch.samplers.capacity() >= 96);
    assert(!compute_descriptor_scratch.in_use);
    {
        ComputeDescriptorScratchLease first;
        assert(compute_descriptor_scratch.in_use);

        assert(zero.Views().empty() && zero.Samplers().empty());

}
```

```py
        assert(requested != 0 && requested != 0x400);

        worker();
        return true;

    void AcquireKnownEmpty(bool) { ++empties; }

}
```

`tools/check-ps5-compute-guest-descriptor-preflight-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Source-backed PS5 compute GPU descriptor overflow wait must precede guest cache mutexes."""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
raster = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_rasterizer.cpp").read_text()
header = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/include/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_update_descriptor.h").read_text()
generator = (root / "tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py").read_text()
workflow = (root / ".github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml").read_text()

compute = raster.split("void RasterizerVulkan::DispatchCompute() {", 1)[1].split(
    "\nvoid RasterizerVulkan::ResetCounter(", 1)[0]
preflight = ("guest_descriptor_queue.PreflightGuestDraw([this] { scheduler.WaitWorker(); },\n"
             "                                                pipeline->DescriptorEntryReservation())")
select = "pipeline_cache.CurrentComputePipeline()"
locks = "std::scoped_lock lock{texture_cache.mutex, buffer_cache.mutex};"
assert compute.count(preflight) == 1
assert "bool initial_compute_descriptor_drain = false;" in compute
assert "if (preflight == 0 && !initial_compute_descriptor_drain) break;" in compute
# The selected pipeline advertises an immutable descriptor count: select
# BEFORE preflight so an empty compute shader cannot wait for 1024 entries.
# Every real wait remains outside the paired guest buffer/texture mutexes.
first_select = compute.index("ComputePipeline* pipeline{" + select + "};")
first_preflight = compute.index(preflight)
first_lock = compute.index(locks)
assert compute.index("gpu_memory->FlushCaching();") < first_select < first_preflight < first_lock
assert ("if (pipeline->HasDescriptorEntries() &&\n        " + preflight) in compute
wait_guard_end = compute.index("#endif", first_preflight)
after = compute[first_preflight:wait_guard_end]
assert after.count("gpu_memory->FlushCaching();") == 1
assert after.count("pipeline = " + select + ";") == 1
assert "if (!pipeline) return;" in after
assert "if (!pipeline)" in compute[first_select:first_lock]
assert "ComputePipeline::Configure" not in after
# The generator must reproduce both the native guard and its oracle parity.
assert generator.count("Select first: descriptor-free compute dispatches") == 1
assert "Compute empty-descriptor native anchor changed" in generator
assert "python3 -B tools/check-ps5-compute-guest-descriptor-preflight-host.py" in workflow

start = "    template <typename WaitWorker>\n    [[nodiscard]] bool PreflightGuestDraw("
end = "    template <typename WaitWorker>\n    [[nodiscard]] bool PreflightExactGuestDraw("
assert header.count(start) == header.count(end) == 1
method = header[header.index(start):header.index(end)]
assert "wait_worker();" in method
assert "payload_cursor = payload_start;" in method
assert "size_t required_entries = 0x400" in method
assert "const size_t reserve = required_entries != 0 ? required_entries : 0x400;" in method
assert "pipeline->DescriptorEntryReservation()" in compute

cpp = r"""
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
struct Queue {
    static constexpr size_t frame_payload_size=4096;
    std::array<uint64_t,frame_payload_size> entries{};
    uint64_t* payload_start=entries.data();
    uint64_t* payload_cursor=entries.data();
__METHOD__
    void SetUsed(size_t n) { assert(n < frame_payload_size); payload_cursor=payload_start+n; }
    size_t Used() const { return size_t(payload_cursor-payload_start); }
};
int main() {
    Queue queue;
    int waits=0;
    bool cache_locks_held=false;
    auto wait_worker=[&] { assert(!cache_locks_held); ++waits; };
    // Common dispatch with plenty of descriptor space adds no GPU wait.
    queue.SetUsed(100);
    assert(!queue.PreflightGuestDraw(wait_worker));
    assert(queue.Used()==100 && waits==0);
    // The exact 0x400 reservation threshold must drain before lock acquire.
    queue.SetUsed(4096-0x400);
    assert(queue.PreflightGuestDraw(wait_worker));
    assert(queue.Used()==0 && waits==1);
    cache_locks_held=true;
    assert(queue.Used()+0x400<queue.frame_payload_size);
    cache_locks_held=false;
    // Repeated ordinary dispatches do not introduce new drains.
    assert(!queue.PreflightGuestDraw(wait_worker));
    assert(waits==1);
    // The selected compute pipeline asks for its exact 8 entries rather
    // than 1024. A near-full but sufficient payload does NOT drain.
    queue.SetUsed(4096-9);
    assert(!queue.PreflightGuestDraw(wait_worker, 8));
    assert(queue.Used()==4096-9 && waits==1);
    // The 8-entry threshold drains exactly where Acquire would run out.
    queue.SetUsed(4096-8);
    assert(queue.PreflightGuestDraw(wait_worker, 8));
    assert(queue.Used()==0 && waits==2);
    // The default reservation remains available to other legacy callers.
    queue.SetUsed(4095);
    assert(queue.PreflightGuestDraw(wait_worker));
    assert(queue.Used()==0 && waits==3);
    // Reject invalid reservations without waiting or rewriting the cursor.
    queue.SetUsed(25);
    assert(!queue.PreflightGuestDraw(wait_worker,4096));
    assert(queue.Used()==25 && waits==3);
}
""".replace("__METHOD__", method)
compiler=shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++")
assert compiler, "Clang is required for sanitizer regression"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-compute-descriptor-") as folder:
    source=Path(folder)/"compute.cpp"
    binary=Path(folder)/"compute"
    source.write_text(cpp)
    subprocess.run([compiler,"-std=c++20","-O1","-g","-Wall","-Wextra","-Werror",
                    "-fsanitize=address,undefined","-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
                    str(source),"-o",str(binary)],check=True,timeout=45)
    subprocess.run([str(binary)],check=True,timeout=30)
print("COMPUTE_DESCRIPTOR_PREFLIGHT_HOST_PASS ordinary_no_wait=1 boundary=1 outside_locks=1 select_before_preflight=1 reselection_after_wait=1")
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Exercise PS5 compute sampler memo extracted from the selected Vulkan source.

The bounded sampler lookup memo is LOCAL TO ONE Configure call. This compiles
the actual code fragment, checks collision handling and descriptor epochs,
and verifies generator/source parity. No console throughput claim.
"""

import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

    raster.index("void RasterizerVulkan::DispatchCompute()"))

code = r"""
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>
using u32 = std::uint32_t;
namespace VideoCommon {
struct SamplerId {
    std::uint32_t value{};
    bool operator==(const SamplerId&) const = default;
};
}
struct FakeTextureCache {
    std::uint32_t epoch{};
    int calls{};
    VideoCommon::SamplerId GetSamplerId(u32 handle, bool compute) {
        assert(compute);
        ++calls;
        return {epoch * 1000 + handle};
    }
};
static std::vector<VideoCommon::SamplerId> Run(FakeTextureCache& texture_cache,
                                                const std::vector<u32>& handles) {
""" + memo + r"""
    std::vector<VideoCommon::SamplerId> output;
    for (u32 handle : handles) {
        output.push_back(resolve_sampler(handle));
    }
    return output;
}
int main() {
    FakeTextureCache cache{};
    const std::vector<u32> handles{2,2,18,18,2,1,1,17,1,17};
    const auto first = Run(cache, handles);
    assert(first.size() == handles.size());
    assert(cache.calls == 4);  // four unique IDs, including old modulo-16 collisions
    for (size_t i = 0; i < first.size(); ++i)
        assert(first[i].value == handles[i]);
    cache.epoch = 42; // new dispatch: the same IDs must be re-read, not stale
    const auto next = Run(cache, handles);
    assert(cache.calls == 8);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < next.size(); ++i)
        assert(next[i].value == 42000 + handles[i]);
    // Same hash bucket with distinct sampler handles cannot alias IDs.
    // A braced initializer contains commas: never place it inside assert().
    const std::vector<u32> colliding_handles{0,16,32,48,0};
    const auto colliding = Run(cache, colliding_handles);
    assert(cache.calls == 12);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < colliding.size(); ++i)
        assert(colliding[i].value == 42000 + colliding_handles[i]);
    // Fill all 16 hash-collision slots, then overflow the memo. Repeated
    // 17th handle calls the original GetSamplerId again, never stale data.
    cache.epoch = 43;
    const std::vector<u32> all_collisions{
        0,256,512,768,1024,1280,1536,1792,
        2048,2304,2560,2816,3072,3328,3584,3840,4096,4096,0,256};
    const int before_full = cache.calls;
    const auto full = Run(cache, all_collisions);
    assert(full.size() == all_collisions.size());
    assert(cache.calls == before_full + 18); // 16 cached + 2 overflow
    for (size_t i = 0; i < full.size(); ++i)
        assert(full[i].value == 43000 + all_collisions[i]);
    // No sampler means neither an occupied slot nor a sampler cache lookup.
    const int before = cache.calls;
    assert(Run(cache, {}).empty());
    assert(cache.calls == before);
}
"""
compilers = list(dict.fromkeys(filter(None, (
    shutil.which("clang++"), shutil.which("g++"), shutil.which("c++")))))
```

`tools/check-ps5-compute-shader-handoff-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Source-extracted compute ShaderNotify transfer, failure-before/pass-after host."""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
src = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vk_compute_pipeline_cost.cpp").read_text()

ctor = src[src.index("ComputePipeline::ComputePipeline("):src.index("void ComputePipeline::PreflightDescriptorScratch()")]
mark = """    if (shader_notify) {
        shader_notify->MarkShaderBuilding();
    }
"""

a = ctor.index("#ifdef PS5_NATIVE\n    // Layout setup and worker queue admission")
b = ctor.index("#endif\n", a) + len("#endif\n")
guard = ctor[a:b]
start = "    if (thread_worker) {\n#ifdef PS5_NATIVE\n        // Reserve a slot BEFORE QueueWork:"
i = ctor.index(start)
j = ctor.index("\n}", i)
handoff = ctor[i:j]

assert handoff.index("pending_first_use_compute_builds.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_release);") < handoff.index("thread_worker->QueueWork([build = std::move(func)]")
assert handoff.index("thread_worker->QueueWork([build = std::move(func)]") < handoff.index("build_handed_off = true;")
assert handoff.count("pending_first_use_compute_builds.fetch_sub(1, std::memory_order_release);") == 2
assert "F07 counted compute worker handoff" in gen
assert "F07 compute shader build notification unwind" in gen
assert "F07 compute worker completion ownership transfer" in gen

test = r"""
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdio>
#include <functional>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <type_traits>
#include <utility>
std::atomic<unsigned> pending_first_use_compute_builds{0};
struct Maker {};
template<class F> struct ScopeGuard { F f; ~ScopeGuard() { f(); } };
template<class F> ScopeGuard<std::decay_t<F>> operator+(Maker, F&& f) {
    return {std::forward<F>(f)};
}
#define SCOPE_EXIT auto _scope = Maker{} + [&]
struct Notify {
    int start{}, done{}, pending{};
    void MarkShaderBuilding() { ++start; ++pending; }
    void MarkShaderComplete() { ++done; assert(pending > 0); --pending; }
};
struct Worker {
    std::function<void()> job;
    bool reject{};
    void QueueWork(std::function<void()> fn) {
        if (reject) throw std::runtime_error("queue");
        job = std::move(fn);
    }
};
void Build(Notify* shader_notify, Worker* thread_worker, bool fail_setup) {
MARK
#ifndef OLD_BUG
GUARD
#else
    [[maybe_unused]] bool build_handed_off = false;
#endif
    if (fail_setup) throw std::runtime_error("layout");
    auto func = [shader_notify] {
        if (shader_notify) shader_notify->MarkShaderComplete();
    };
HANDOFF
}
void Try(Notify* n, Worker* w, bool setup) {
    try { Build(n, w, setup); } catch (const std::runtime_error&) {}
}
int main() {
#ifdef OLD_BUG
    Notify old;
    Try(&old, nullptr, true);
    assert(old.start == 1 && old.done == 0 && old.pending == 1);
    std::puts("COMPUTE_NOTIFY_LEAK_BEFORE");
#else
    Notify a;
    Try(&a, nullptr, false);
    assert(a.start == 1 && a.done == 1 && a.pending == 0);
    Notify b;
    Try(&b, nullptr, true);
    assert(b.start == 1 && b.done == 1 && b.pending == 0);
    Worker bad;
    bad.reject = true;
    Notify c;
    Try(&c, &bad, false);
    assert(c.start == 1 && c.done == 1 && c.pending == 0 && !bad.job);
    assert(pending_first_use_compute_builds.load() == 0);
    Worker good;
    Notify d;
    Try(&d, &good, false);
    assert(d.start == 1 && d.done == 0 && d.pending == 1 && good.job);
    assert(pending_first_use_compute_builds.load() == 1);
    good.job();
    assert(d.done == 1 && d.pending == 0);
    assert(pending_first_use_compute_builds.load() == 0);
    Worker empty;
    Try(nullptr, &empty, false);
    assert(empty.job);
    empty.job();
    assert(pending_first_use_compute_builds.load() == 0);
    std::puts("COMPUTE_NOTIFY_HANDOFF_PASS");
#endif
}
"""
# Replace standalone placeholders only: never rewrite result strings containing HANDOFF.
test = (test.replace("\nMARK\n", "\n" + mark)
            .replace("\nGUARD\n", "\n" + guard)
            .replace("\nHANDOFF\n", "\n" + handoff + "\n"))
compiler = shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++") or shutil.which("c++")
assert compiler, "C++20 compiler required"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-compute-notify-") as directory:

            subprocess.run([compiler, "-std=c++20", opt, "-DPS5_NATIVE",
                            "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror", "-fsanitize=undefined",
                            "-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
                            *([] if not old else ["-DOLD_BUG"]), str(path), "-o", str(exe)],
                           check=True, timeout=40)
            result = subprocess.run([str(exe)], capture_output=True, text=True,

            assert ("COMPUTE_NOTIFY_LEAK_BEFORE" if old else
```

```py
    unsigned lookups{};
    u32 generation_offset{100};
    bool expensive_lookup{};
    std::uint64_t pressure{};
    VideoCommon::SamplerId GetSamplerId(u32 handle, bool compute) {
        assert(!compute);
        ++lookups;
        if (expensive_lookup) {
            // Fixed synthetic cost on BOTH paths. Never represent this as a
            // measurement of real GPU/driver cache lookup latency.
            std::uint64_t value = handle + generation_offset;
            for (unsigned i = 0; i < 1024; ++i)
                value = (value * 1664525ULL + 1013904223ULL) ^ (value >> 7);
            pressure += value;
        }
        return handle + generation_offset;
    }
};
struct View { u32 index{}; };
struct CaseResult {
    std::vector<View> views;
    std::vector<VideoCommon::SamplerId> samplers;
};
static CaseResult configure(const std::array<Info, 2>& stages,
                            TexCache& texture_cache) {
    CaseResult result;
    auto& views = result.views;
    auto& samplers = result.samplers;
    const auto read_handle = [](const auto& desc, u32 index) {
        return desc.handles.at(index);
    };
""" + memo + r"""
    for (const auto& info : stages) {
""" + loop + r"""
    }
    return result;
}
// Comparable direct-reference path: one sampler lookup per descriptor.
// This is an isolated fixture, not a replay of historical guest timing.
static CaseResult configure_reference(const std::array<Info, 2>& stages,
                                      TexCache& texture_cache) {
    CaseResult result;
    auto& views = result.views;
    auto& samplers = result.samplers;
    const auto read_handle = [](const auto& desc, u32 index) {
        return desc.handles.at(index);
    };
    for (const auto& info : stages) {
""" + pinned_loop + r"""
    }
    return result;
}
// Host-only same-draw lock A/B using native-extracted descriptor loops.
// Multiple medians and alternating order reduce scheduler/cache-warm-up bias.
struct LockBudget {std::uint64_t held_ns{}, wait_ns{}, checksum{}; unsigned lookups{};};
using Clock = std::chrono::steady_clock;
using Config = CaseResult(*)(const std::array<Info,2>&,TexCache&);
static LockBudget lock_budget(Config config, const std::array<Info,2>& stages) {
    TexCache cache{};
    cache.expensive_lookup = true;
    std::mutex mutex;
    std::atomic<bool> running{true};
    std::atomic<unsigned> contender_entries{};
    std::thread contender([&] {
        while (running.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
            {std::lock_guard lk(mutex);++contender_entries;}
            std::this_thread::yield();
        }
    });
    LockBudget result{};
    constexpr unsigned draws = 2048;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < draws; ++i) {
        const auto started=Clock::now();
        mutex.lock();
        const auto entered=Clock::now();
        const auto descriptors=config(stages,cache);
        const auto finished=Clock::now();
        mutex.unlock();
        result.wait_ns+=static_cast<std::uint64_t>(
            std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(entered-started).count());
        result.held_ns+=static_cast<std::uint64_t>(
            std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(finished-entered).count());
        assert((descriptors.samplers==std::vector<u32>{107,107,109,107,109,109,107}));
    }
    running.store(false,std::memory_order_relaxed);
    contender.join();
    result.lookups=cache.lookups;
    result.checksum=cache.pressure;
    assert(result.checksum != 0); // prevent benchmark optimizer eliminating lookup work
    // The waiter is a real concurrent mutex contender, not a virtual cost.
    assert(contender_entries.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)>0);
    return result;
}
static std::uint64_t median_held(std::array<std::uint64_t,5> ns) {
    std::sort(ns.begin(),ns.end());
    return ns[2];
}
int main() {
    TexCache cache{};
    std::array<Info, 2> stages{};
    auto empty = configure(stages, cache);
    assert(empty.views.empty() && empty.samplers.empty() && cache.lookups == 0);

    stages[0].texture_descriptors = {
        {{{1,7},{2,7},{3,9},{4,7},{5,9}},5},
    };
    stages[1].texture_descriptors = {
        {{{6,9},{7,7}},2},
    };
    auto a = configure(stages, cache);
    assert(cache.lookups == 2); // A,B,A,B across two shader stages.
    assert(a.views.size() == 7 && a.samplers.size() == 7);
    assert(a.views.front().index == 1 && a.views.back().index == 7);
    assert((a.samplers == std::vector<u32>{107,107,109,107,109,109,107}));

    // Quantify work eliminated on the SAME descriptor fixture. Direct lookup
    // has seven cache calls; the maintained per-draw memo has two. Equality
    // of views and IDs guards correctness instead of assuming less work is
    // always safe. No timing or FC27 frame gain is inferred from this mock.
    TexCache reference_cache{};
    const auto reference = configure_reference(stages, reference_cache);
    assert(reference.views.size() == a.views.size());
    for (std::size_t index = 0; index < a.views.size(); ++index)
        assert(reference.views[index].index == a.views[index].index);
    assert(reference.samplers == a.samplers);
    assert(reference_cache.lookups == 7 && cache.lookups == 2);
    std::printf("F01_SAMPLER_LOOKUP_FIXTURE descriptors=7 reference_calls=%u "
                "maintained_calls=%u avoided_calls=%u scope=host_mock\n",
                reference_cache.lookups, cache.lookups,
                reference_cache.lookups - cache.lookups);

    auto b = configure(stages, cache);
    assert(cache.lookups == 4); // No sampler ID outlives a draw.
    assert(b.samplers == a.samplers);

    // Colliding indices now retain both IDs within one draw.
    stages[0].texture_descriptors = {{{{1,7},{2,23},{3,7}},3}};
    stages[1].texture_descriptors = {{{{4,7}},1}};
    auto conflict = configure(stages, cache);
    assert(cache.lookups == 6); // 7,23 each resolved once, later hits.
    assert((conflict.samplers == std::vector<u32>{107,123,107,107}));

    // Texture identity is independent of the sampler identity.
    stages[0].texture_descriptors = {{{{1,7},{1,9},{2,7}},3}};
    stages[1].texture_descriptors.clear();
    auto same_view = configure(stages, cache);
    assert(cache.lookups == 8);
    assert((same_view.samplers == std::vector<u32>{107,109,107}));
    assert(same_view.views[0].index == same_view.views[1].index);

    // A later draw must never retain the previous descriptor generation.
    cache.generation_offset = 200;
    auto refreshed = configure(stages, cache);
    assert(cache.lookups == 10);
    assert((refreshed.samplers == std::vector<u32>{207,209,207}));

    // Restore the identical cross-stage seven-descriptor workload after
    // collision/generation correctness tests changed 'stages' above.
    std::array<Info,2> budget_stages{};
    budget_stages[0].texture_descriptors = {
        {{{1,7},{2,7},{3,9},{4,7},{5,9}},5},
    };
    budget_stages[1].texture_descriptors = {
        {{{6,9},{7,7}},2},
    };
    // Real mutex contender with a fixed synthetic GetSamplerId cost.
    std::array<std::uint64_t,5> old_hold{},current_hold{};
    std::array<std::uint64_t,5> old_wait{},current_wait{};
    for (unsigned round=0;round<5;++round) {
        const auto run_old = [&] {
            auto m=lock_budget(configure_reference,budget_stages);
            assert(m.lookups==2048*7);
            old_hold[round]=m.held_ns;old_wait[round]=m.wait_ns;
        };
        const auto run_new = [&] {
            auto m=lock_budget(configure,budget_stages);
            assert(m.lookups==2048*2);
            current_hold[round]=m.held_ns;current_wait[round]=m.wait_ns;
        };
        if (round%2) {run_new();run_old();}
        else {run_old();run_new();}
    }
    const auto old_median=median_held(old_hold);
    const auto new_median=median_held(current_hold);
    assert(old_median>new_median);
    // Guard against fixture regressions, not a claim of real PS5 gains.
    assert(new_median*10 < old_median*9);
    std::sort(old_wait.begin(),old_wait.end());
    std::sort(current_wait.begin(),current_wait.end());
    std::printf("F01_NATIVE_SOURCE_LOCK_BUDGET draws=2048 descriptors=7 "
                "prior_calls=14336 maintained_calls=4096 "
                "prior_held_ns=%llu maintained_held_ns=%llu "
                "prior_wait_ns=%llu maintained_wait_ns=%llu "
                "scope=host_synthetic_lookup_and_real_contender\n",
                static_cast<unsigned long long>(old_median),
                static_cast<unsigned long long>(new_median),
                static_cast<unsigned long long>(old_wait[2]),
                static_cast<unsigned long long>(current_wait[2]));
    std::puts("F01_NATIVE_SELECTION_SOURCE_PASS ps5_real_latency_unmeasured");
}
"""
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""R363: source-extracted host contract for guaranteed-only Vulkan ring preflight."""
from pathlib import Path
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
active = root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan"
ring = (active / "vulkan_descriptor_buffer.cpp").read_text()
cost = (active / "vk_descriptor_buffer_cost.cpp").read_text()
header = (active / "include/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_descriptor_buffer.h").read_text()
pipeline = (active / "include/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_graphics_pipeline.h").read_text()
raster = (active / "vulkan_rasterizer.cpp").read_text()
oracle = (root / "tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py").read_text()

def method(text, signature):
    begin = text.index(signature)
    opened = text.index("{", begin)
    level = 0
    for i in range(opened, len(text)):
        if text[i] == "{": level += 1
        elif text[i] == "}":
            level -= 1
            if level == 0:
                return text[begin:i+1]
    raise AssertionError("unterminated method")

preflight = method(ring, "bool DescriptorBufferRing::PreflightCapacity(")
getter = method(pipeline, "[[nodiscard]] VkDeviceSize DescriptorRingPreflightSize() const")
assert "PreflightCapacity(Scheduler& scheduler, VkDeviceSize size)" in header
assert "if (chunks.empty() || frame_reused || size == 0 || !CanAllocate(size))" in preflight
assert "needed <= chunk_capacity - cursor || chunk_cursor + 1 < chunks_per_frame" in preflight
assert "scheduler.Finish();" in preflight
assert preflight.index("scheduler.Finish();") < preflight.index("++generation;")
assert "DescriptorRingPreflightSize()" in raster
assert raster.index("descriptor_buffer_ring.PreflightCapacity(") < raster.index(
    "std::scoped_lock lock{buffer_cache.mutex, texture_cache.mutex};")

assert "DescriptorRingPreflight" in cost
assert "DescriptorRingPreflight" in oracle

# These are actual versioned method bodies, not a hand-written parallel
# algorithm. The fake GPU scheduler asserts Finish is not inside cache locks.
cpp = r"""
#include <algorithm>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>
using u64 = std::uint64_t;
using VkDeviceSize = std::uint64_t;
namespace Common {
template<typename T>
T AlignUp(T n, T a) { return (n + a - 1) / a * a; }
}
static bool cache_locks_held = false;
struct Scheduler {
    int finishes = 0;
    void Finish() { assert(!cache_locks_held); ++finishes; }
};
class DescriptorBufferRing {
public:
    bool PreflightCapacity(Scheduler&, VkDeviceSize);
    [[nodiscard]] bool CanAllocate(VkDeviceSize s) const {
        return Common::AlignUp(s, alignment) <= chunk_capacity;
    }
    [[nodiscard]] u64 CurrentGeneration() const noexcept { return generation; }
    std::vector<int> chunks{1,2};
    bool frame_reused = false;
    VkDeviceSize alignment = 4;
    VkDeviceSize chunk_capacity = 100;
    size_t chunk_cursor = 0, chunks_per_frame = 2;
    VkDeviceSize cursor = 0;
    u64 generation = 8;
};
struct DescriptorBufferLayout { VkDeviceSize size = 16; };
struct Pipeline {
    DescriptorBufferRing& descriptor_buffer_ring;
    bool uses_descriptor_buffer = true;
    int descriptor_set_layout = 1;
    size_t num_descriptor_entries = 4;
    std::vector<int> last_descriptor_payload{1,2,3,4};
    u64 last_descriptor_buffer_generation = 0;
    DescriptorBufferLayout descriptor_buffer_layout{};
    [[nodiscard]] bool CanUseDescriptorBuffer() const noexcept {
        return uses_descriptor_buffer && descriptor_set_layout;
    }
__GETTER__
};
__METHOD__
int main() {
    Scheduler s;
    DescriptorBufferRing r;
    Pipeline p{r};
    // Known old descriptor payload shape/gen or no extension: no pre-drain.
    p.last_descriptor_buffer_generation = r.generation;
    assert(p.DescriptorRingPreflightSize() == 0);
    p.last_descriptor_payload.pop_back();
    assert(p.DescriptorRingPreflightSize() == 16);
    p.last_descriptor_payload.push_back(4);
    p.last_descriptor_buffer_generation = 7;
    assert(p.DescriptorRingPreflightSize() == 16);
    p.uses_descriptor_buffer = false;
    assert(p.DescriptorRingPreflightSize() == 0);
    p.uses_descriptor_buffer = true;
    // Normal frames, exact fit, or another available chunk: no extra waits.
    r.cursor = 84;
    assert(!r.PreflightCapacity(s, 16) && s.finishes == 0);
    r.cursor = 88;
    assert(!r.PreflightCapacity(s, 12) && s.finishes == 0);
    assert(!r.PreflightCapacity(s, 16) && s.finishes == 0);
    r.chunk_cursor = 1;
    r.cursor = 88;
    // The old code's guaranteed drain now occurs BEFORE both guest locks.
    assert(p.DescriptorRingPreflightSize() == 16);
    assert(r.PreflightCapacity(s, p.DescriptorRingPreflightSize()));
    assert(s.finishes == 1 && r.cursor == 0 && r.chunk_cursor == 0);
    assert(r.generation == 9);
    assert(p.DescriptorRingPreflightSize() == 16); // old offset now invalid
    cache_locks_held = true;  // new allocation safely occurs after lock acquire
    cache_locks_held = false;
    assert(!r.PreflightCapacity(s, 16) && s.finishes == 1);
    // No preflight if frame reuse is pending, memory absent, payload
    // larger than one chunk or size 0; Allocate's original fallback stays.
    r.cursor = 99; r.chunk_cursor = 1;
    r.frame_reused = true;
    assert(!r.PreflightCapacity(s, 16));
    r.frame_reused = false;
    assert(!r.PreflightCapacity(s, 0));
    assert(!r.PreflightCapacity(s, 104));
    r.chunks.clear();
    assert(!r.PreflightCapacity(s, 16));
    assert(s.finishes == 1 && r.generation == 9);
    // A certain one-time draw does NOT require a drain when there is room.
    r.chunks.push_back(1);
    r.cursor = 96; r.chunk_cursor = 1;
    assert(r.PreflightCapacity(s, 8) && s.finishes == 2 && r.generation == 10);
}
""".replace("__GETTER__", getter).replace("__METHOD__", preflight)
env = os.environ.copy()

    old = Path("/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX15.4.sdk")
    if old.is_dir(): env["SDKROOT"] = str(old)
```

```py
This intentionally reproduces the remaining in-lock GPU Finish fallback.
It does NOT change native runtime behavior or claim to fix frame stalls.

def method(src: str, needle: str) -> str:
    start = src.index(needle)
    open_brace = src.index("{", start)
    depth = 0
    for index in range(open_brace, len(src)):
        if src[index] == "{":
            depth += 1
        elif src[index] == "}":
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0:
                return src[start:index + 1]
    raise AssertionError("unterminated method: " + needle)

preflight = method(ring, "bool DescriptorBufferRing::PreflightCapacity(")

code = r"""
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>
#include <vector>
using u64 = std::uint64_t;
using u32 = std::uint32_t;
using u8 = std::uint8_t;
using VkDeviceSize = std::uint64_t;
#define ASSERT(x) assert(x)
#define LOG_DEBUG(...) ((void)0)
namespace Common {
template <typename T>
T AlignUp(T n, T a) { return (n + a - 1) / a * a; }
}
struct Scheduler {
    bool cache_locks_held = false;
    int finishes_locked = 0;
    int finishes_unlocked = 0;
    void Finish() {
        if (cache_locks_held) ++finishes_locked;
        else ++finishes_unlocked;
    }
    void Wait(u64) { assert(!cache_locks_held); }
    [[nodiscard]] u64 CurrentTick() const { return 421; }
};
class DescriptorBufferRing {
public:
    struct Allocation {
        u8* host{};
        VkDeviceSize offset{};
        u32 chunk{};
        u64 generation{};
    };
    DescriptorBufferRing() = default;
    bool PreflightCapacity(Scheduler&, VkDeviceSize);
    Allocation Allocate(Scheduler&, VkDeviceSize);
    [[nodiscard]] u64 CurrentGeneration() const noexcept { return generation; }
    [[nodiscard]] bool CanAllocate(VkDeviceSize size) const noexcept {
        return Common::AlignUp(size, alignment) <= chunk_capacity;
    }
    std::vector<int> chunks{1, 2};
    std::array<std::array<u8, 100>, 2> storage{};
    std::vector<u8*> chunk_hosts{storage[0].data(), storage[1].data()};
    VkDeviceSize alignment{4};
    VkDeviceSize chunk_capacity{100};
    size_t chunks_per_frame{2};
    size_t frame_index{0};
    size_t chunk_cursor{1};
    VkDeviceSize cursor{90};
    u64 generation{8};
    std::array<u64, 8> frame_ticks{};
    bool frame_reused{false};
};
struct DescriptorBufferLayout { VkDeviceSize size{16}; };
struct Pipeline {
    DescriptorBufferRing& descriptor_buffer_ring;
    bool uses_descriptor_buffer = true;
    int descriptor_set_layout = 1;
    u64 last_descriptor_buffer_generation = 8;
    std::vector<int> last_descriptor_payload{1, 2, 3, 4};
    size_t num_descriptor_entries = 4;
    DescriptorBufferLayout descriptor_buffer_layout{};
    [[nodiscard]] bool CanUseDescriptorBuffer() const noexcept {
        return uses_descriptor_buffer && descriptor_set_layout;
    }
__GETTER__
};
__PREFLIGHT__
__ALLOCATE__
int main() {
    DescriptorBufferRing ring;
    Scheduler scheduler;
    Pipeline pipeline{ring};
    const std::array<int, 4> new_payload{1, 2, 3, 9};
    assert(pipeline.last_descriptor_buffer_generation == ring.CurrentGeneration());
    assert(pipeline.last_descriptor_payload.size() == pipeline.num_descriptor_entries);
    assert(std::memcmp(pipeline.last_descriptor_payload.data(), new_payload.data(),
                       sizeof(new_payload)) != 0);
    // Shape and generation agree, so preflight cannot prove an allocation.
    assert(pipeline.DescriptorRingPreflightSize() == 0);
    assert(!ring.PreflightCapacity(scheduler, pipeline.DescriptorRingPreflightSize()));
    assert(scheduler.finishes_unlocked == 0);
    // Payload differs: ConfigureDraw's real condition takes Allocate.
    scheduler.cache_locks_held = true;
    const auto allocated = ring.Allocate(scheduler, pipeline.descriptor_buffer_layout.size);
    scheduler.cache_locks_held = false;
    assert(allocated.host != nullptr);
    assert(scheduler.finishes_locked == 1);  // Known remaining in-lock wait.
    assert(ring.CurrentGeneration() == 9);

    // When a generation mismatch makes allocation certain, the existing
    // preflight drains outside the cache locks and Allocate cannot finish.
    DescriptorBufferRing certain_ring;
    Scheduler certain_scheduler;
    Pipeline certain_pipeline{certain_ring};
    certain_pipeline.last_descriptor_buffer_generation = 7;
    assert(certain_pipeline.DescriptorRingPreflightSize() == 16);
    assert(certain_ring.PreflightCapacity(certain_scheduler,
                                         certain_pipeline.DescriptorRingPreflightSize()));
    assert(certain_scheduler.finishes_unlocked == 1);
    assert(certain_ring.CurrentGeneration() == 9);
    certain_scheduler.cache_locks_held = true;
    const auto certain_alloc = certain_ring.Allocate(
        certain_scheduler, certain_pipeline.descriptor_buffer_layout.size);
    certain_scheduler.cache_locks_held = false;
    assert(certain_alloc.host != nullptr);
    assert(certain_scheduler.finishes_locked == 0);

    // Independent states with the SAME observable pre-lock state:
    // matching generation, count, full ring and previous payload.
    // A byte-identical guest payload will reuse the descriptor allocation.
    DescriptorBufferRing reuse_ring;
    Scheduler reuse_scheduler;
    Pipeline reuse_pipeline{reuse_ring};
    const std::array<int, 4> identical{1, 2, 3, 4};
    assert(reuse_pipeline.last_descriptor_buffer_generation == reuse_ring.CurrentGeneration());
    assert(reuse_pipeline.DescriptorRingPreflightSize() == 0);
    assert(!reuse_ring.PreflightCapacity(reuse_scheduler,
                                        reuse_pipeline.DescriptorRingPreflightSize()));
    // The real ConfigureDraw condition chooses the reuse branch here:
    // Allocate is NOT called and no GPU completion is needed.
    assert(std::memcmp(reuse_pipeline.last_descriptor_payload.data(), identical.data(),
                       sizeof(identical)) == 0);
    assert(reuse_scheduler.finishes_locked == 0);
    assert(reuse_scheduler.finishes_unlocked == 0);

    // If preflight blindly reserved capacity whenever the ring is full,
    // it would stall unnecessarily even for identical, reusable content.
    // Running production PreflightCapacity with the full size demonstrates
    // that cost; do not adopt this as a runtime behavior.
    DescriptorBufferRing blind_ring;
    Scheduler blind_scheduler;
    Pipeline blind_pipeline{blind_ring};
    assert(blind_pipeline.DescriptorRingPreflightSize() == 0);
    assert(blind_ring.PreflightCapacity(blind_scheduler,
                                        blind_pipeline.descriptor_buffer_layout.size));
    assert(blind_scheduler.finishes_unlocked == 1);
    assert(blind_scheduler.finishes_locked == 0);
    // A blind Finish also increments generation, invalidating the otherwise
    // valid cached allocation. The original unchanged path avoids both.
    assert(blind_ring.CurrentGeneration() != blind_pipeline.last_descriptor_buffer_generation);
}
"""
code = code.replace("__GETTER__", getter).replace("__PREFLIGHT__", preflight).replace("__ALLOCATE__", allocate)
compiler = shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++")
assert compiler, "Clang required for ASan/UBSan source regression"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-descriptor-conditional-reuse-") as tmp:
    path = Path(tmp) / "witness.cpp"
    binary = Path(tmp) / "witness"
    path.write_text(code)

                    str(path), "-o", str(binary)], check=True, timeout=45)
```
