```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""R319: pinned GPU descriptor overflow drain without guest-cache lock."""
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.request import urlopen, Request
import ast
import hashlib
import subprocess
import tempfile
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
pin="5f142c7926d0c7fcbbd0ce30794d72f638a43b2a"
paths={
 "src/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_update_descriptor.h":"9f30e65dbd1d08dc70d4a00053c7dd44b2653c1f",
 "src/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_rasterizer.cpp":"f43bea1220c262678b744f793876b7e5ea69bdff"
}
tree=ast.parse((root/"tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py").read_text())
adapt_calls=[x for x in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(x,ast.Call) and isinstance(x.func,ast.Name) and x.func.id=="adapt"]
def replacements(path):
    calls=[x for x in adapt_calls if isinstance(x.args[0],ast.Constant) and x.args[0].value==path]
    assert len(calls)==1, path
    result=[]
    for pair in calls[0].args[2].elts:
        try: result.append(ast.literal_eval(pair))
        except (ValueError, TypeError, SyntaxError): pass
    return result
patched={}
for path,sha in paths.items():
    url=f"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eden-emulator/mirror/{pin}/{path}"
    with urlopen(Request(url,headers={"User-Agent":"Eden-Encore-R319-pinned-source"}),timeout=25) as r:
        data=r.read(200000)
    git_blob=hashlib.sha1(b"blob "+str(len(data)).encode()+b"\0"+data).hexdigest()
    assert git_blob==sha, (path,git_blob,sha)
    patched[path]=data.decode()
header_path="src/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_update_descriptor.h"
raster_path="src/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_rasterizer.cpp"
hr=[x for x in replacements(header_path) if "PreflightGuestDraw" in x[1]]
# R382 preserves the already-inserted graphics preflight in its
# before/after scheduling-capacity replacement. The native compute path
# also now inserts an independent preflight. Select only the ORIGINAL
# graphics R319 insertion into the pinned upstream source.
rr=[x for x in replacements(raster_path)
    if "PreflightGuestDraw" in x[1] and "PreflightGuestDraw" not in x[0]
    and "GraphicsPipeline* const pipeline{pipeline_cache.CurrentGraphicsPipeline()}" in x[1]]
assert len(hr)==len(rr)==1
h_old,h_new=hr[0]
r_old,r_new=rr[0]
assert patched[header_path].count(h_old)==1
patched[header_path]=patched[header_path].replace(h_old,h_new)
assert patched[raster_path].count(r_old)==1
patched[raster_path]=patched[raster_path].replace(r_old,r_new)
header=patched[header_path]
raster=patched[raster_path]
assert "#ifdef PS5_NATIVE\n    // Exact zero-descriptor graphics pipeline:" in header
assert "void AcquireKnownEmpty(bool use_descriptor_buffer_) noexcept" in header
assert header.index("void AcquireKnownEmpty(") < header.index("template <typename WaitWorker>")
assert header.count("template <typename WaitWorker>") == 2
assert "guest_descriptor_queue.PreflightGuestDraw([this] { scheduler.WaitWorker(); })" in raster
assert raster.index("PreflightGuestDraw") < raster.index("GraphicsPipeline* const pipeline{pipeline_cache.CurrentGraphicsPipeline()}")
assert "gpu_memory->FlushCaching();\n    }\n#endif" in raster
# Acquire must retain its original worker wait (also handles exceptional
# reservations larger than 0x400 and non-PS5 builds).
impl=(urlopen(Request(
    f"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eden-emulator/mirror/{pin}/src/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_update_descriptor.cpp",
    headers={"User-Agent":"Eden-Encore-R319-pinned-source"}),timeout=25).read()).decode()
assert "scheduler.WaitWorker();" in impl
assert "if (used + reserve >= frame_payload_size)" in impl

code=r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <vector>
struct Queue {
    const size_t frame_payload_size=0x80000;
    std::vector<unsigned> buffer=std::vector<unsigned>(frame_payload_size);
    unsigned* payload_start=buffer.data();
    unsigned* payload_cursor=payload_start;
""" + method + r"""
    void consume(size_t n) { assert(size_t(payload_cursor-payload_start)+n<frame_payload_size); payload_cursor+=n; }
    void original_acquire_fallback(size_t n, int& waits) {
        if (size_t(payload_cursor-payload_start)+n>=frame_payload_size) {
            ++waits; payload_cursor=payload_start;
        }
        consume(n);
    }
};
int main(){
    Queue q;
    int waits=0;
    // Ordinary draw: no wait, cursor untouched.
    q.consume(1024);
    assert(!q.PreflightGuestDraw([&]{++waits;}));
    assert(waits==0 && q.payload_cursor-q.payload_start==1024);
    // Ring almost full: preflight waits before locks and restarts safely.
    q.consume(q.frame_payload_size-1024-500);
    assert(q.PreflightGuestDraw([&]{++waits;}));
    assert(waits==1 && q.payload_cursor==q.payload_start);
    q.original_acquire_fallback(1000, waits);
    assert(waits==1);
    // Exceptional draw with >0x400 descriptors still relies on original gate.
    q.consume(q.frame_payload_size-1000-1500);
    assert(!q.PreflightGuestDraw([&]{++waits;}));
    q.original_acquire_fallback(1600,waits);
    assert(waits==2);
    // Exactly at the boundary must pre-drain as in Acquire (>=).
    q.consume(q.frame_payload_size-1600-1024);
    assert(q.PreflightGuestDraw([&]{++waits;}));
    assert(waits==3 && q.payload_cursor==q.payload_start);
}
"""
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-r319-guest-descriptors-") as tmp:
    cpp=Path(tmp)/"preflight.cpp"
    cpp.write_text(code)
    exe=Path(tmp)/"preflight"
    subprocess.run(["c++","-std=c++20","-O2","-Wall","-Wextra","-Werror",str(cpp),"-o",str(exe)],check=True,timeout=30)
    subprocess.run([str(exe)],check=True,timeout=10)
print("PASS R319 pinned producer preflight, overflow worker fence, and original larger fallback")
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Check Vulkan descriptor ring rejects u64 oversize before AlignUp wraps.

Extract the actual native C++ predicate and compile against the pinned real
Common::AlignUp implementation under ASan/UBSan. This test is not evidence of
guest-game stalls or Vulkan GPU execution.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
native = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/include/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_descriptor_buffer.h").read_text()
pinned = (root / "vendor/sources/eden/src/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_descriptor_buffer.h").read_text()
generator = (root / "tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py").read_text()
workflow = (root / ".github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml").read_text()
old = """    [[nodiscard]] bool CanAllocate(VkDeviceSize size) const noexcept {
        return Common::AlignUp(size, alignment) <= chunk_capacity;
    }"""
new = """    [[nodiscard]] bool CanAllocate(VkDeviceSize size) const noexcept {
        // Validate unaligned size before AlignUp can overflow VkDeviceSize.
        return size <= chunk_capacity && Common::AlignUp(size, alignment) <= chunk_capacity;
    }"""

assert native.count(new) == 1
assert generator.count("return size <= chunk_capacity && Common::AlignUp(size, alignment) <= chunk_capacity;") == 1
assert 'python3 -B tools/check-ps5-descriptor-ring-overflow-host.py' in workflow
assert "[[nodiscard]] constexpr T AlignUp(T value_, size_t size)" in (root / "vendor/sources/eden/src/common/alignment.h").read_text()

# Compile the verbatim native predicate and original upstream predicate.
# The original admits UINT64_MAX because AlignUp wraps to zero.
cpp = r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>
#include "common/alignment.h"
using VkDeviceSize = std::uint64_t;
struct Ring {
    VkDeviceSize chunk_capacity;
    VkDeviceSize alignment;
__ACTUAL__
__PINNED__
};
int main() {
    constexpr auto max = std::numeric_limits<VkDeviceSize>::max();
    const Ring ring{4092, 16};
    assert(ring.CanAllocate(0));
    assert(ring.CanAllocate(1));
    assert(ring.CanAllocate(16));
    assert(ring.CanAllocate(4080));
    assert(!ring.CanAllocate(4081));
    assert(!ring.CanAllocate(4092));
    assert(!ring.CanAllocate(4096));
    assert(!ring.CanAllocate(max));
    assert(!ring.CanAllocate(max - 7));
    assert(!ring.CanAllocate(max - 15));
    assert(ring.CanAllocatePinned(max));
    const Ring disabled{0, 16};
    assert(!disabled.CanAllocate(max));
    const Ring exact{4096, 16};
    assert(exact.CanAllocate(4096));
    assert(!exact.CanAllocate(4097));
}
""".replace("__ACTUAL__", new).replace("__PINNED__", old.replace("CanAllocate(", "CanAllocatePinned("))
clang = shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++")
assert clang, "Clang C++20 needed"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-descriptor-overflow-") as tmp:
    source = Path(tmp) / "ring.cpp"
    binary = Path(tmp) / "ring"
    source.write_text(cpp)
    subprocess.run(
        [clang, "-std=c++20", "-O2", "-g", "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror",
         "-fsanitize=address,undefined", "-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
         "-I", str(root / "vendor/sources/eden/src"),
         str(source), "-o", str(binary)],
        check=True, timeout=45)
    subprocess.run([str(binary)], check=True, timeout=30)
print("DESCRIPTOR_RING_OVERFLOW_HOST_PASS normal=7 UINT64_MAX=3 pinned_wrap_reproduced=1")
```

```py
 assert(r.PreflightFrameReuse(s) && s.waits==2 && s.last==624);

 assert(s.waits==0);
```

`tools/check-ps5-dev-cache-contention.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Bounded GPU cache-lock contention mitigation, test/dev-only.

The 13-minute FC27 R236 trace shows 460k guest cache-lock waits while
three guest cores are compute-bound. Check the exact bounded retry path
and verify no release/shipping behavior changes. No FPS claim or PS5 run.
"""
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
main = (root / "headless/main.cpp").read_text()
locks = (root / "headless/performance.h").read_text()
policy = (root / "headless/encore_performance_policy.h").read_text()

assert "inline std::atomic<unsigned> cache_lock_spins{0};" in locks
assert "if (mutex.try_lock()) return;" in locks
assert "for (unsigned tries = cache_lock_spins.load(std::memory_order_relaxed); tries != 0; --tries)" in locks
assert "if (mutex.try_lock()) return;" in locks
assert "mutex.lock();" in locks
assert "cache_lock_contended.fetch_add(1" in locks
assert "cache_lock_blocked.fetch_add(1" in locks
setup = main.split("Settings::values.skip_cpu_inner_invalidation.SetValue(false);", 1)[1]
assert "#if defined(PS5_NATIVE) && defined(EDEN_DEV_PROFILE)" in setup
dev = setup.split("#if defined(PS5_NATIVE) && defined(EDEN_DEV_PROFILE)", 1)[1].split("#endif", 1)[0]
assert "Eden::Performance::cache_lock_spins.store(0, std::memory_order_relaxed);" in dev
assert "kTestCacheLockSpins = 8" not in main
assert "std::min(requested, 32ul)" in main
assert "max 32" in dev
assert "kTestCacheLockSpins" not in policy

# Model exact retry count: eight bounded tries never become an unbounded
# lock-free loop. Exhausted attempts ALWAYS enter the original mutex lock.
def acquire(available_on_try: int | None, limit: int) -> tuple[int, bool]:
    tries = 0
    if available_on_try == 0:
        return 1, False
    while tries < limit:
        tries += 1
        if available_on_try == tries:
            return 1 + tries, False
    return 1 + tries, True

assert acquire(0, 8) == (1, False)
assert acquire(1, 8) == (2, False)
assert acquire(8, 8) == (9, False)
assert acquire(None, 8) == (9, True)
assert acquire(None, 0) == (1, True)
print("PASS: conservative 0-spin default after matched FC27 A/B; optional capped <=32 trials, blocking mutex preserved")
print("PS5 performance improvement and soft-hang safety must still be measured on hardware")
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
"""Compile source-extracted PS5 direct extent cache against concurrent host mocks.

NOT a firmware test: exercises the real C++ helper and its positive-only
atomic cache on a Linux runner during the explicit next-build source gates.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
s = (root / "src/memory_pages.cpp").read_text()
begin = s.index("namespace {\n// This is the fixed addressable direct-memory EXTENT")
# The original anonymous namespace also contains the independent CPU VA
# reservation wrapper, which needs native mapping mocks from another harness.
# Extract only the direct-extent cache and allocator exercised here.
reservation_begin = s.index("void* ReserveCpuVirtualRange(", begin)
namespace_end = s.index("} // namespace\n#endif", begin)
assert reservation_begin < namespace_end
helper = s[begin:reservation_begin] + "} // namespace\n"
assert helper.count("sceKernelGetDirectMemorySize()") == 1
assert "cached_direct_memory_extent.store(current, std::memory_order_release)" in helper
assert "return extent > 0 ? sceKernelAllocateDirectMemory(" in helper
compiler = next((x for x in ("clang++-18", "clang++", "g++") if shutil.which(x)), None)
if not compiler:
    raise SystemExit("C++20 compiler required for direct-memory extent host gate")

head = r"""
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>

static std::atomic<unsigned> extent_queries{};
static std::atomic<unsigned> issued_allocations{};
static std::atomic<bool> fail_first{true};
static std::int64_t sceKernelGetDirectMemorySize() {
    extent_queries.fetch_add(1);
    return fail_first.exchange(false) ? -1 : (std::int64_t{12} << 30);
}
static std::int32_t sceKernelAllocateDirectMemory(
    std::int64_t begin, std::int64_t limit, std::size_t bytes,
    std::size_t alignment, int type, std::int64_t* physical) {
    assert(begin == 0 && limit == (std::int64_t{12} << 30));
    assert(bytes == 2u * 1024 * 1024 && alignment == bytes && type == 12);
    assert(physical);
    *physical = 0x12000;
    issued_allocations.fetch_add(1);
    return 0;
}
"""
tail = r"""
int main() {
    std::int64_t physical = -1;
    // An unknown/negative kernel response must not call the physical alloc.
    assert(AllocateDirectOwned(2u << 20, 2u << 20, &physical) != 0);
    assert(extent_queries.load() == 1 && issued_allocations.load() == 0);
    assert(AllocateDirectOwned(2u << 20, 2u << 20, &physical) == 0);
    assert(extent_queries.load() == 2 && issued_allocations.load() == 1);
    std::vector<std::thread> threads;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
        threads.emplace_back([] {
            for (unsigned j = 0; j < 20000; ++j) {
                std::int64_t owned = -1;
                assert(AllocateDirectOwned(2u << 20, 2u << 20, &owned) == 0);
                assert(owned == 0x12000);
            }
        });
    for (auto& thread : threads) thread.join();
    assert(extent_queries.load() == 2);
    assert(issued_allocations.load() == 1 + 8 * 20000u);
}
"""
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-dmem-extent-") as tmp:
    folder = Path(tmp)
    src, exe = folder / "extent.cpp", folder / "extent"
    src.write_text(head + helper + tail)
    subprocess.run([compiler, "-std=c++20", "-O2", "-pthread", "-Wall", "-Wextra",
                    "-Werror", str(src), "-o", str(exe)], check=True)
    subprocess.run([str(exe)], check=True)
print("PASS: real direct-memory extent cache retries initial error and reuses one positive result across 8 threads")
print("Firmware native direct-memory allocation and frame-time effect remain UNTESTED")
```

```py
code = r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>
#include "direct_pool_accounting.h"
#include "direct_pool_probe_policy.h"
#include "direct_pool_region_scan.h"
int main() {
    using namespace Eden::DirectPool;
    constexpr std::uint64_t MiB = 1024ULL * 1024;
    constexpr std::uint64_t GiB = 1024ULL * MiB;
    // Probe cadence must not ignore a missed sample or pressure; only the
    // kernel-confirmed high-headroom path may skip 100-ms/200-ms queries.
    static_assert(ProbeIntervalNs(false, 0, 12*GiB) == kProbeFastNs);
    static_assert(ProbeIntervalNs(true, 1, 12*GiB) == kProbeFastNs);
    static_assert(ProbeIntervalNs(true, 2, 12*GiB) == kProbeFastNs);
    static_assert(ProbeIntervalNs(true, 0, 4*GiB-MiB) == kProbeFastNs);
    static_assert(ProbeIntervalNs(true, 0, 4*GiB) == kProbeHighHeadroomNs);
    static_assert(ProbeIntervalNs(true, 0, 8*GiB) == kProbeHighHeadroomNs);
    // An invalid kernel-free span must never drive the dense JIT plan
    // or graphics admission. Check negative start, too-large length,
    // exact boundary, zero known availability and extreme integer values.
    static_assert(IsKernelFreeSpanValid(12*GiB, 0, 12*GiB));
    static_assert(IsKernelFreeSpanValid(12*GiB, 4*GiB, 8*GiB));
    static_assert(IsKernelFreeSpanValid(12*GiB, 12*GiB, 0));
    static_assert(!IsKernelFreeSpanValid(12*GiB, 4*GiB, 9*GiB));
    static_assert(!IsKernelFreeSpanValid(12*GiB, -1, 1));
    static_assert(!IsKernelFreeSpanValid(12*GiB, 12*GiB+1, 0));
    static_assert(!IsKernelFreeSpanValid(0, 0, 0));
    static_assert(!IsKernelFreeSpanValid(-1, 0, 0));
    static_assert(!IsKernelFreeSpanValid(12*GiB, 0, std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()));
    // Interrupted enumeration must not become a fictional pool budget.
    RegionScan partial{12*GiB};
    assert(partial.Include(1*GiB, 2*GiB));
    assert(partial.Include(4*GiB, 5*GiB));
    assert(partial.regions == 2);
    assert(partial.FreeUpperBound() == 10*GiB);
    assert(!partial.ReachedExtent()); // query stopped in an unmapped tail
    RegionScan overlap{12*GiB};
    assert(overlap.Include(1*GiB, 2*GiB));
    assert(!overlap.Include(1*GiB, 3*GiB));
    assert(!overlap.valid && overlap.FreeUpperBound() == -1);
    RegionScan bad_extent{12*GiB};
    assert(!bad_extent.Include(11*GiB, 13*GiB));
    assert(bad_extent.FreeUpperBound() == -1);
    RegionScan monotone{12*GiB};
    assert(monotone.Include(0, 2*GiB));
    assert(monotone.Include(3*GiB, 12*GiB));
    assert(monotone.ReachedExtent());
    assert(monotone.FreeUpperBound() == 1*GiB);
    // 16 GiB physically installed in PS5 is NOT what firmware gives Encore.
    // Old real FW 13.60 console directly exposed 12 GiB, and its Encore
    // Heap retained committed backing after title exit; excludes platform reservations.
    constexpr auto old = Summarize(12*GiB, {.heap_roots=1280*MiB});
    static_assert(old.extent_known && old.within_extent);
    static_assert(old.extent_bytes==12*GiB);
    static_assert(old.tracked_bytes==1280*MiB);
    static_assert(old.not_tracked_bytes==12*GiB-1280*MiB);
    // Separate direct owners are additive; virtual heap/JIT reservations
    // have no fields because they own no physical backing.
    constexpr auto populated = Summarize(12*GiB, {
        .heap_roots=1280*MiB,
        .heap_large=192*MiB,
        .sparse_tables=64*MiB,
        .jit_sparse=256*MiB,
        .jit_dense=384*MiB,
    });
    static_assert(populated.tracked_bytes==2176*MiB);
    static_assert(populated.not_tracked_bytes==12*GiB-2176*MiB);
    constexpr auto unknown = Summarize(-1, {.heap_roots=1280*MiB});
    static_assert(!unknown.extent_known && !unknown.within_extent);
    static_assert(unknown.tracked_bytes==1280*MiB);
    static_assert(unknown.not_tracked_bytes==0);
    constexpr auto exceeded = Summarize(512*MiB, {.heap_roots=600*MiB});
    static_assert(exceeded.extent_known && !exceeded.within_extent);
    static_assert(exceeded.not_tracked_bytes==0);
    constexpr auto overflowed = Summarize(12*GiB, {
        .heap_roots=std::numeric_limits<std::uint64_t>::max(),
        .heap_large=8192,
    });
    static_assert(overflowed.tracked_bytes==std::numeric_limits<std::uint64_t>::max());
    static_assert(!overflowed.within_extent);
    assert(populated.tracked_bytes + populated.not_tracked_bytes == 12*GiB);
}
"""
```

`tools/check-ps5-display-vs-guest-fps.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
"""Separate compositor callback FPS from delivered content and guest simulation age.

The real renderer reports OnFrameDisplayed() after Present(frame), while the
Vulkan presenter may be asynchronous. A nominal 30 callbacks/s does NOT prove
30 new visual states/s, scanout cadence, or timely response to guest input.
Source contracts below anchor the deterministic, host-only model in the real
PS5 native path; there is no GPU, console video-out or host streaming here.
"""
from collections import deque
from pathlib import Path
import json
import statistics

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
renderer=(root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_renderer.cpp").read_text()
manager=(root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_present_manager.cpp").read_text()
graphics=(root/"headless/graphics.cpp").read_text()
native_main=(root/"headless/main.cpp").read_text()
settings=(root/"vendor/sources/eden/src/common/settings.h").read_text()
swapchain=(root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_swapchain.cpp").read_text()
composer=(root/"vendor/sources/eden/src/core/hle/service/nvnflinger/hardware_composer.cpp").read_text()
data=json.loads((root/"tools/fixtures/native-load-20261013.json").read_text())
rows=[dict(zip(data["window_fields"],values)) for values in data["windows"]]
stable=[w for w in rows if 29.95<=w["fps"]<=30.05 and w["worst_ms"]<38]
assert len(stable)==36, "real captured smooth-callback windows changed"
assert all(abs(w["fps"]-30)<0.05 for w in rows[-10:])

start=renderer.index("void RendererVulkan::Composite(")
end=renderer.index("\nvoid RendererVulkan::",start+1)
composite=renderer[start:end]
assert "SCOPE_EXIT {\n        render_window.OnFrameDisplayed();\n    };" in composite
assert composite.index("SCOPE_EXIT {") < composite.index("if (!render_window.IsShown())")
assert composite.index("render_window.OnFrameDisplayed()") < composite.index("present_manager.Present(frame);")
assert "if (::Eden::Display::SkipFrame())" in composite  # even this path counts the callback
present_start=manager.index("void PresentManager::Present(Frame* frame) {")
present_end=manager.index("\nsize_t PresentManager::MaxExtraFrames",present_start)
present=manager[present_start:present_end]
assert "if (use_present_thread)" in present
assert "scheduler.Record([this, frame]" in present
assert "present_queue.push_back(frame);" in present
assert "CopyToSwapchain(frame);" not in present.split("} else {")[0]
worker=manager[manager.index("void PresentManager::PresentThread("):
               manager.index("\nvoid PresentManager::RecreateSwapchain(",manager.index("void PresentManager::PresentThread("))]
assert worker.index("present_queue.pop_front();")<worker.index("CopyToSwapchain(frame);")
assert "Settings::values.async_presentation = backend == Eden::GraphicsBackend::Vulkan;" in native_main
assert "++frame_total;" in graphics and "frame_sample_count / (now - frame_sample_start)" in graphics
assert "VK_PRESENT_MODE_FIFO_KHR" in swapchain
assert "FramePacingMode::Target_Auto" in settings # no assumption about user's runtime setting
# Guest compositor requests Composite only when a new BufferItem is acquired.
# New BufferItem/slot is NOT proof that new animation or scene content exists.
assert "if (result == CacheStatus::BufferAcquired) {" in composer
assert "has_acquired_buffer = true;" in composer
assert "if (has_acquired_buffer && !composition_stack.empty())" in composer
assert "nvdisp.Composite(composition_stack);" in composer
assert "return CacheStatus::CachedBufferReused;" in composer

CALLBACK_MS=1000.0/30
SCANOUT_MS=1000.0/60
N=150  # 5 seconds; 30.000 composite callbacks/s
callback=[i*CALLBACK_MS for i in range(N)]
assert abs((N-1)/(callback[-1]-callback[0])*1000-30)<0.000001

def run_model(present_delay, guest_content):
    # Serial presentation worker, FIFO scanout, at most 1 new completed item
    # per 60-Hz refresh. Content identity is a MODEL, never a pixel hash.
    # "Present" completion is treated optimistically as ready-for-next-scanout.
    ready=[]
    worker_time=0.0
    for i,t in enumerate(callback):
        worker_time=max(worker_time,t)+present_delay(i)
        ready.append((worker_time,i,guest_content(i)))
    ready.sort()
    pending=deque()
    available=0
    current_sequence=-1
    current_content=-1
    deliveries=[]
    displayed_times=[]
    unique_changes=[]
    displayed_age=[]
    for k in range(301):
        scan=k*SCANOUT_MS
        while available<len(ready) and ready[available][0]<=scan+1e-7:
            pending.append(ready[available])
            available+=1
        if pending:
            _,seq,content=pending.popleft()
            current_sequence=seq
            if content!=current_content:
                unique_changes.append(scan)
                current_content=content
        deliveries.append(current_content)
        displayed_times.append((scan,current_content))
        if current_sequence>=0:
            displayed_age.append(scan-callback[current_sequence])
    dwell=[b-a for a,b in zip(unique_changes,unique_changes[1:])]
    return {
        "display_timeline":displayed_times,
        "callback_fps":round((N-1)/(callback[-1]-callback[0])*1000,3),
        "actual_distinct_content":len(unique_changes),
        "longest_distinct_content_hold_ms":round(max(dwell),2),
        "p95_display_age_ms":round(sorted(displayed_age)[int(0.95*(len(displayed_age)-1))],2),
        "max_display_age_ms":round(max(displayed_age),2),
        "frames_delivered_to_model":max(0,current_sequence+1),
        "present_queue_left":len(pending)
    }

normal=run_model(lambda _:3.0,lambda i:i)
late_present=run_model(lambda i:120.0 if i%30==11 else 3.0,lambda i:i)
stale_guest=run_model(lambda _:3.0,lambda i:i-((i%20)-9 if 9<=i%20<=12 else 0))
def action_visual_latency_ms(display_timeline, input_at_ms, minimum_content_id):
    return min((t-input_at_ms for t,content in display_timeline
                if t>=input_at_ms and content>=minimum_content_id),default=float("inf"))
# Input just after frame 49: the first guest animation reflecting it would
# appear in frame 50 if the guest pipeline applied the action immediately.
input_at_ms=callback[49]+1.0
baseline_response=action_visual_latency_ms(normal["display_timeline"],input_at_ms,50)
stale_response=action_visual_latency_ms(stale_guest["display_timeline"],input_at_ms,50)
assert baseline_response<60.0
assert stale_response>130.0
print("CAPTURE nominal_30_windows=",len(stable),"of",len(rows))
print("INPUT_TO_VISIBLE_MODEL baseline_ms=",round(baseline_response,2),
      "stale_guest_ms=",round(stale_response,2))
print("SCREEN_MODEL baseline=",json.dumps({k:v for k,v in normal.items() if k!="display_timeline"},sort_keys=True))
print("SCREEN_MODEL delayed_async_present=",json.dumps({k:v for k,v in late_present.items() if k!="display_timeline"},sort_keys=True))
print("SCREEN_MODEL repeated_guest_content=",json.dumps({k:v for k,v in stale_guest.items() if k!="display_timeline"},sort_keys=True))
assert normal["callback_fps"]==late_present["callback_fps"]==stale_guest["callback_fps"]==30.0
assert normal["actual_distinct_content"]>=148
assert normal["longest_distinct_content_hold_ms"]<=50.1
assert late_present["longest_distinct_content_hold_ms"]>=100
assert late_present["p95_display_age_ms"]>normal["p95_display_age_ms"]
assert stale_guest["actual_distinct_content"]<normal["actual_distinct_content"]
assert stale_guest["longest_distinct_content_hold_ms"]>=100
print("PASS: two independent visible-stutter paths at exactly 30.000 compositor callbacks/s")
print("BOUNDARY: model deliberately cannot infer actual FC27 game-frame IDs or TV scanout from FTP counters")
```

```py
#include <cassert>

#include <mutex>
#include <optional>
#include <limits>
using u64 = std::uint64_t;
using u32 = std::uint32_t;
using DAddr = std::uint64_t;
using GPUVAddr = std::uint64_t;
struct Memory {
    unsigned translations=0;
    std::optional<DAddr> GpuToCpuAddress(GPUVAddr a) {

    // The core's range tracking begins after this point. The proof checks
    // that invalid lengths cannot reach it.
    return true;

    std::mutex inner;
    unsigned locks=0;
    void lock(){inner.lock();++locks;}
    void unlock(){inner.unlock();}
};

    unsigned copy_calls=0;

    BufferCache<int> inner;
    AccelerateDMA outer;
    for(const u64 size : {u64{0}, max+1, std::numeric_limits<u64>::max()}) {

    }
    assert(inner.owner.translations==4);
    assert(outer.buffer_cache.mutex.locks==2);
    assert(outer.buffer_cache.copy_calls==2);
```

```py
# manager sends a queued invalidation through the texture-cache mutex,
# proving that a late call would violate lock ownership.
body=draw[flush:targets+len("    texture_cache.UpdateRenderTargets(false);")]
cpp=r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <mutex>
struct TextureCache {
    std::mutex mutex;
    bool invalidated=false;
    unsigned syncs=0,targets=0;
    void WriteMemory(){invalidated=true;}
    void SynchronizeDescriptors(bool){assert(invalidated);++syncs;}
    void UpdateRenderTargets(bool){assert(invalidated);++targets;}
};
struct RasterizerVulkan;
struct MemoryManager {
    RasterizerVulkan* rasterizer{};
    bool queued=true;
    unsigned flushes=0;
    void FlushCaching();
};
struct RasterizerVulkan {
    TextureCache texture_cache;
    MemoryManager* gpu_memory{};
    unsigned works=0;
    void FlushWork(){++works;}
    void InnerInvalidation(){std::scoped_lock lock{texture_cache.mutex};
        texture_cache.WriteMemory();}
    void DrawTexturePreLock(){
__BODY__
    }
};
void MemoryManager::FlushCaching() {
    ++flushes;
    if (queued) {
        rasterizer->InnerInvalidation();
        queued=false;
    }
```

```py
def extract(source, start, open_brace):
    depth = 0
    for pos in range(open_brace, len(source)):
        if source[pos] == "{":
            depth += 1
        elif source[pos] == "}":
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0:
                return source[start:pos + 1]
    raise AssertionError("Unbalanced source method")

def loop(source):
    assert source.count(loop_tag) == 1
    start = source.index(loop_tag)
    return extract(source, start, source.index("{", start))

def branches(source):
    assert source.count(check_tag) == 2
    out = []
    at = 0
    while (start := source.find(check_tag, at)) >= 0:
        # Skip lambda braces in the callback argument.
        marker = source.index("DescriptorEntryReservation())) {", start)
        opening = source.index("{", marker)
        out.append(extract(source, start, opening))
        at = opening + 1
    return out

gl, cl = loop(graphics), loop(compute)
gb, cb = branches(graphics), branches(compute)

        if (switch_to_empty)
            scheduler.after_wait = [this] { pipeline_cache.selected = &empty; };

    void GraphReuse() { GRAPH_REUSE }

using Method = void (Rig::*)();
void check_native_preflight() {
    // Exercise the EXACT separate QMD3 pre-lock lambda from the maintained
    // Vulkan renderer; zero bindings must not wait or flush unnecessarily.
    Rig empty(0, 4095);
    empty.NativePreflight();
    assert(empty.scheduler.waits == 0 && empty.memory.flushes == 0);
    Rig one(1, 4095);
    one.NativePreflight();
    assert(one.scheduler.waits == 1 && one.memory.flushes == 1);
    assert(one.guest_descriptor_queue.payload_cursor ==
           one.guest_descriptor_queue.payload_start);
    Rig room(1, 4000);
    room.NativePreflight();
    assert(room.scheduler.waits == 0 && room.memory.flushes == 0);
    Rig many(2048, 3500);
    many.NativePreflight();
    assert(many.scheduler.waits == 1 && many.memory.flushes == 1);
}
void check(Method method) {
    // Even a nearly exhausted guest descriptor queue must not stall on
    // shaders that produce exactly zero descriptors.
    Rig empty(0, 4095);
    (empty.*method)();
    assert(empty.scheduler.waits == 0);
    assert(empty.guest_descriptor_queue.payload_cursor ==
           empty.guest_descriptor_queue.payload_start + 4095);

    // Exact parity with upstream Acquire: one entry at the last slot needs
    // the worker drain, including after a previous unrelated worker wait
    // has published a new small-descriptor shader.
    Rig one(1, 4095, true);
    (one.*method)();
    assert(one.scheduler.waits == 1);
    assert(one.pipeline == &one.empty);
    assert(one.guest_descriptor_queue.payload_cursor ==
           one.guest_descriptor_queue.payload_start);

    // When enough room remains, no speculative worker drain should occur.
    Rig room(1, 4000);
    (room.*method)();
    assert(room.scheduler.waits == 0);
    assert(room.guest_descriptor_queue.payload_cursor ==
           room.guest_descriptor_queue.payload_start + 4000);

    Rig many(2048, 3500, true);
    (many.*method)();
    assert(many.scheduler.waits == 1);
    assert(many.pipeline == &many.empty);
}
int main() {
    // The old helper could not pre-drain <1024 descriptors even with one
    // free entry remaining. The new helper matches Acquire's exact bound.
    Queue q;
    q.payload_cursor += 4095;
    int prior_waits = 0;
    assert(!q.OldLargePreflightDraw([&] { ++prior_waits; }, 1));
    assert(prior_waits == 0);
    int exact_waits = 0;
    assert(q.PreflightExactGuestDraw([&] { ++exact_waits; }, 1));
    assert(exact_waits == 1 && q.payload_cursor == q.payload_start);

    // The first/pre-lock preflight now uses the known exact count, not
    // the conservative 1024-entry default, avoiding a premature drain.
    Queue room;
    room.payload_cursor += 4000;
    int early_waits = 0;
    assert(!room.PreflightGuestDraw([&] { ++early_waits; }, 1));
    assert(early_waits == 0);
    assert(room.PreflightGuestDraw([&] { ++early_waits; }));
    assert(early_waits == 1);
    Queue edge;
    edge.payload_cursor += 4095;
    int edge_waits = 0;
    assert(edge.PreflightGuestDraw([&] { ++edge_waits; }, 1));
    assert(edge_waits == 1 && edge.payload_cursor == edge.payload_start);
    for (Method method : {
        &Rig::GraphLoop, &Rig::GraphReuse, &Rig::GraphCapacity,
        &Rig::ComputeLoop, &Rig::ComputeReuse, &Rig::ComputeCapacity
    }) check(method);
    check_native_preflight();
    std::puts("SEVEN_NATIVE_DESCRIPTOR_PREFLIGHT_EXACT_PARITY_PASS");
}

capacity_cpp = r"""
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <vector>
using u64 = std::uint64_t;
using VkDeviceSize = std::uint64_t;
namespace Common {
VkDeviceSize AlignUp(VkDeviceSize value, VkDeviceSize alignment) {
    return (value + alignment - 1) / alignment * alignment;
}
}
namespace Eden::Performance {
enum class CachePhase { DescriptorRingPreflight };
inline std::atomic<bool> detailed_gpu_profile{};
struct VulkanTimer { explicit VulkanTimer(int) {} ~VulkanTimer() {} };
struct CachePhaseTimer {
    CachePhaseTimer(CachePhase, bool) {}
    ~CachePhaseTimer() {}
};
}
struct Scheduler {
    unsigned finishes{};
    void Finish() { ++finishes; }
};
struct DescriptorBufferRing {
    std::vector<int> chunks{1};
    bool frame_reused{};
    VkDeviceSize chunk_capacity{256};
    VkDeviceSize alignment{16};
    VkDeviceSize cursor{};
    std::size_t chunk_cursor{};
    std::size_t chunks_per_frame{1};
    u64 generation{7};
    bool CanAllocate(VkDeviceSize size) const noexcept {
        return size <= chunk_capacity &&
               Common::AlignUp(size, alignment) <= chunk_capacity;
    }
    bool PreflightCapacity(Scheduler&, VkDeviceSize);
};
__CAPACITY_METHOD__
int main() {
    // The sole legal unconditional reuse happens when the last ring chunk
    // cannot hold another aligned payload. Its GPU fence must not be skipped.
    {
        Scheduler s;
        DescriptorBufferRing d;
        d.cursor = 240;
        assert(d.PreflightCapacity(s, 32));
        assert(s.finishes == 1);
        assert(d.cursor == 0 && d.chunk_cursor == 0 && d.generation == 8);
        assert(!d.PreflightCapacity(s, 32));
        assert(s.finishes == 1 && d.generation == 8);
    }
    // Exact fits, spare chunks, and wrong/zero payload requests do not drain.
    {
        Scheduler s;
        DescriptorBufferRing d;
        d.cursor = 240;
        assert(!d.PreflightCapacity(s, 16));
        assert(s.finishes == 0 && d.cursor == 240 && d.generation == 7);
        d.chunks_per_frame = 2;
        assert(!d.PreflightCapacity(s, 32));
        assert(s.finishes == 0 && d.generation == 7);
    }
    {
        Scheduler s;
        DescriptorBufferRing d;
        d.cursor = 240;
        for (const VkDeviceSize size : {VkDeviceSize{0}, VkDeviceSize{257}}) {
            assert(!d.PreflightCapacity(s, size));
        }
        assert(s.finishes == 0 && d.generation == 7);
        d.frame_reused = true;
        assert(!d.PreflightCapacity(s, 32));
        assert(s.finishes == 0 && d.generation == 7);
        d.frame_reused = false;
        d.chunks.clear();
        assert(!d.PreflightCapacity(s, 32));
        assert(s.finishes == 0 && d.generation == 7);
    }
    std::puts("DESCRIPTOR_CAPACITY_OWNER_PREFLIGHT_SOURCE_PASS");
}
""".replace("__CAPACITY_METHOD__", capacity_method)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-ring-capacity-") as folder:
```

```py
cpp = r"""
#include <atomic>
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
#include <new>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <span>
#include <vector>
using ImageId=std::size_t;
struct CheckedMutex {
    inline static unsigned lock_calls{};
    bool held{};
    void lock(){assert(!held);held=true;++lock_calls;}
    bool try_lock(){if(held)return false;held=true;++lock_calls;return true;}
    void unlock(){assert(held);held=false;}
    ~CheckedMutex(){assert(!held && "decode mutex destroyed while still locked");}
};
enum class ImageFlagBits:std::uint32_t{IsDecoding=1,CpuModified=2,Tracked=4,Remapped=8};
struct Flags{
    std::uint32_t bits{};
    Flags& operator&=(std::uint32_t n){bits&=n;return *this;}
    Flags& operator|=(ImageFlagBits b){bits|=static_cast<std::uint32_t>(b);return *this;}
};
std::uint32_t operator~(ImageFlagBits b){return ~static_cast<std::uint32_t>(b);}
std::uint32_t operator&(Flags f,ImageFlagBits b){return f.bits&static_cast<std::uint32_t>(b);}
bool True(std::uint32_t n){return n!=0;}
struct Staging{
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> bytes;
    std::span<std::uint8_t> mapped_span;
    bool buffer{};
    Staging() = default;
    explicit Staging(std::size_t n):bytes(n),mapped_span(bytes),buffer(true){}
};
struct Image{
    Flags flags{};
    std::size_t size{};
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> result;
    unsigned uploads{};
    bool reject_upload{};
    void UploadMemory(Staging& stage,const std::vector<int>&){
        if (reject_upload) throw std::runtime_error("mock Vulkan record failure");
        result=stage.bytes;++uploads;
    }
};
struct AsyncDecodeContext{
    ImageId image_id{};
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> decoded_data;
    std::vector<int> copies;
    CheckedMutex mutex;
    std::atomic_bool complete{false};
};
struct Runtime{
    unsigned staging_calls{},barriers{};
    unsigned reject_on_call{},short_on_call{},null_on_call{};
    bool fail_barrier{};
    Staging UploadStagingBuffer(std::size_t n){
        ++staging_calls;
        if (reject_on_call == staging_calls) throw std::bad_alloc{};
        if (short_on_call == staging_calls) return Staging(n - 1);
        if (null_on_call == staging_calls) {auto invalid=Staging(n); invalid.buffer=false; return invalid;}
        return Staging(n);
    }
    void InsertUploadMemoryBarrier(){
        if(fail_barrier)throw std::runtime_error("mock upload barrier rejected");
        ++barriers;
    }
};
const std::vector<int>& FixSmallVectorADL(const std::vector<int>& v){return v;}
template<class P>struct TextureCache{
    std::vector<std::unique_ptr<AsyncDecodeContext>> async_decodes;
    std::vector<Image> slot_images;
    Runtime runtime;
    unsigned untracked{};
    std::size_t MapSizeBytes(const Image& image){return image.size;}
    void UntrackImage(Image& image,ImageId){
        assert(True(image.flags&ImageFlagBits::Tracked));
        image.flags&=~ImageFlagBits::Tracked;
        ++untracked;
    }
    void TickAsyncDecode();
};

    // The GPU owner must not wait while holding the entire texture cache.

    assert(!True(failed_barrier.slot_images[0].flags&ImageFlagBits::IsDecoding));
}

#include <atomic>
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <mutex>
#include <span>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>
using u8 = std::uint8_t;
struct Scratch {
    std::vector<u8> data;
    void resize_destructive(std::size_t n) { data.resize(n); }
    std::size_t size() const { return data.size(); }
};
struct ImageInfo {};
struct Image { ImageInfo info{}; };
struct AsyncDecodeContext {
    Scratch decoded_data;
    std::vector<int> copies;
    std::mutex mutex;
    std::atomic_bool complete{false};
};
bool throw_conversion = false;
void ConvertImage(const std::vector<u8>& src, const ImageInfo&,
                  Scratch& dst, std::span<int> copy_spans) {
    assert(src.size() == 4 && copy_spans.size() == 1);
    if (throw_conversion) {
        if (!dst.data.empty()) dst.data[0] = 99; // partial old bytes
        throw std::runtime_error("mock conversion failure");
    }
    dst.data = src;
}
static void run_case(bool fail) {
    throw_conversion = fail;
    Image image{};
    AsyncDecodeContext decode{};
    AsyncDecodeContext* decode_ptr = &decode;
    std::size_t out_size = 4;
    std::vector<int> copies{1};
    std::vector<u8> local_unswizzle_data_buffer{3, 4, 5, 6};
""" + worker_source + r"""
    func();
    assert(decode.complete.load(std::memory_order_acquire));
    if (fail) {
        // TickAsyncDecode's size=0 sentinel must reject the partial revision.
        assert(decode.decoded_data.size() == 0);
    } else {
        assert(decode.decoded_data.size() == 4);
        assert((decode.decoded_data.data == std::vector<u8>{3,4,5,6}));
        assert((decode.copies == std::vector<int>{1}));
    }
}
int main() {
    run_case(false);
    run_case(true);
    run_case(false); // a subsequent decode is not poisoned by the failure
}
"""
```

```py
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <new>
#include <span>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <type_traits>

#include <vector>

namespace VideoCommon {struct BufferImageCopy {};}
struct Maker {};
template<class F> struct Guard {F fn;~Guard(){fn();}};
template<class F> Guard<std::decay_t<F>> operator+(Maker,F&& f) {
    return {std::forward<F>(f)};
}
#define SCOPE_EXIT auto cleanup_guard = Maker{} + [&]
struct BufferDownload {GPUVAddr addr;std::size_t size;};
struct PendingDownload {bool is_swizzle;std::size_t async_buffer_id;std::size_t object_id;};
struct SlotTable {
    std::size_t next{};
    std::unordered_map<std::size_t,BufferDownload> active;
    std::size_t insert(BufferDownload b) {
        const auto slot=next++;
        active.emplace(slot,b);
        return slot;
    }
    void erase(std::size_t slot) {assert(active.erase(slot)==1);}
};
struct Staging {std::size_t buffer{};std::size_t offset{};};
struct Runtime {
    bool fail_staging{};
    int releases{};
    Staging DownloadStagingBuffer(std::size_t size,bool deferred) {
        assert(size && deferred);
        if(fail_staging)throw std::bad_alloc{};
        return {100,0};
    }
    void FreeDeferredStagingBuffer(Staging& map) {
        assert(map.buffer);
        ++releases;
    }
};
struct Image {
    bool fail_submission{};
    template<class Buffers,class Offsets>
    void DownloadMemory(Buffers buffers,Offsets offsets,
                        std::span<const VideoCommon::BufferImageCopy> copies) {
        assert(buffers[0]==21 && buffers[1]==100);
        assert(offsets[0]==7 && offsets[1]==0);
        assert(copies.empty());
        if(fail_submission)throw std::runtime_error("recording rejected");
    }
};
template<class P> struct TextureCache {
    using Image=::Image;
    using BufferType=std::size_t;
    static constexpr bool IMPLEMENTS_ASYNC_DOWNLOADS=true;
    SlotTable slot_buffer_downloads;
    std::vector<PendingDownload> uncommitted_downloads;
    std::vector<Staging> uncommitted_async_buffers;
    Runtime runtime;
    void DownloadImageIntoBuffer(Image* image,BufferType buffer,
                                 std::size_t buffer_offset,
                                 std::span<const VideoCommon::BufferImageCopy> copies,
                                 GPUVAddr address,std::size_t size);
};
struct NativePolicy {};
__METHOD__
int main() {
    TextureCache<NativePolicy> ok;
    Image good;
    ok.DownloadImageIntoBuffer(&good,21,7,{},1000,128);
    assert(ok.slot_buffer_downloads.active.size()==1);
    assert(ok.uncommitted_downloads.size()==1);
    assert(ok.uncommitted_async_buffers.size()==1);
    assert(ok.runtime.releases==0);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    TextureCache<NativePolicy> rejected;
    rejected.runtime.fail_staging=true;
    bool threw=false;
    try {rejected.DownloadImageIntoBuffer(&good,21,7,{},1000,128);}
    catch(const std::bad_alloc&) {threw=true;}
    assert(threw);
    assert(rejected.slot_buffer_downloads.active.empty());
    assert(rejected.uncommitted_downloads.empty());
    assert(rejected.uncommitted_async_buffers.empty());

    threw=false;

    catch(const std::runtime_error&) {threw=true;}
    assert(threw);
    assert(failed_submission.slot_buffer_downloads.active.empty());
    assert(failed_submission.uncommitted_downloads.empty());
    assert(failed_submission.uncommitted_async_buffers.empty());
```

```py
cpp=r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <deque>
#include <new>
#include <limits>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <type_traits>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>
struct Maker {};
template<class F> struct Guard {F fn;~Guard(){fn();}};
template<class F> Guard<std::decay_t<F>> operator+(Maker,F&& fn) {
    return {std::forward<F>(fn)};
}
#define SCOPE_EXIT auto staging_guard = Maker{} + [&]
using ImageId=std::size_t;
namespace Common {
    std::size_t AlignUp(std::size_t value,std::size_t align) {
        return ((value+align-1)/align)*align;
    }
}
struct Staging {
    std::size_t buffer{};
    std::size_t offset{};
};
struct Image {
    ImageId info{};
    std::size_t unswizzled_size_bytes{128};
    bool fail_record{};
    int submitted{};
    void DownloadMemory(Staging& map,const std::vector<ImageId>& copies) {
        assert(map.buffer && copies.size()==1 && copies[0]==info);
        if(fail_record)throw std::runtime_error("GPU command recording failed");
        ++submitted;
    }
};
std::vector<ImageId> FullDownloadCopies(ImageId info) {return {info};}
std::vector<ImageId> FixSmallVectorADL(std::vector<ImageId> copies) {return copies;}
struct PendingDownload {
    bool is_swizzle{};
    std::size_t async_buffer_id{};
    ImageId object_id{};
};
struct Runtime {
    int releases{}, requests{};
    bool fail_request{};
    Staging DownloadStagingBuffer(std::size_t size,bool deferred) {
        assert(size && deferred);
        ++requests;
        if(fail_request)throw std::bad_alloc{};
        return {100,0};
    }
    void FreeDeferredStagingBuffer(Staging& buffer) {
        assert(buffer.buffer);
        ++releases;
    }

template<class P> struct TextureCache {
    static constexpr bool IMPLEMENTS_ASYNC_DOWNLOADS=true;
    using Image=::Image;
    std::vector<Image> slot_images;
    std::vector<PendingDownload> uncommitted_downloads;
    std::vector<Staging> uncommitted_async_buffers;
    struct CommittedQueue {
        std::deque<std::vector<PendingDownload>> values;
        bool reject_next{};
        template<class T> void emplace_back(T&& item) {
            if (reject_next) {
                reject_next=false;
                throw std::bad_alloc{};
            }
            values.emplace_back(std::forward<T>(item));
        }
        bool empty() const {return values.empty();}
        void pop_front() {values.pop_front();}
        std::size_t size() const {return values.size();}
        const std::vector<PendingDownload>& front() const {return values.front();}
    } committed_downloads;
    std::deque<std::vector<Staging>> async_buffers;
    Runtime runtime;
    void CommitAsyncFlushes();
    void PopEmptyAsyncFlushes() {
        const auto& download_ids = committed_downloads.front();
__EMPTY_POP__
    }
};
struct NativePolicy {};
__METHOD__
TextureCache<NativePolicy> MakeCache() {
    TextureCache<NativePolicy> cache;
    cache.slot_images={{0,128,false,0},{1,96,false,0}};
    cache.uncommitted_downloads={{true,0,0},{true,0,1}};
    return cache;
}

    auto normal=MakeCache();
    normal.CommitAsyncFlushes();
    assert(normal.uncommitted_downloads.empty());
    assert(normal.uncommitted_async_buffers.empty());
    assert(normal.committed_downloads.size()==1);

    assert(normal.async_buffers.size()==1 && normal.async_buffers.front().size()==1);

    assert(normal.slot_images[0].submitted==1 && normal.slot_images[1].submitted==1);

    auto rejected=MakeCache();
    rejected.runtime.fail_request=true;
    bool caught=false;

    assert(caught && rejected.runtime.releases==0);
    assert(rejected.uncommitted_downloads.size()==2);
    assert(rejected.committed_downloads.empty() && rejected.async_buffers.empty());
    rejected.runtime.fail_request=false;
    rejected.CommitAsyncFlushes();
    assert(rejected.committed_downloads.size()==1);
    auto partial=MakeCache();
    partial.slot_images[1].fail_record=true;
    caught=false;
    try{partial.CommitAsyncFlushes();}catch(const std::runtime_error&){caught=true;}
    assert(caught && partial.runtime.releases==1);
    assert(partial.uncommitted_downloads.size()==2);
    assert(partial.uncommitted_async_buffers.empty());
    assert(partial.committed_downloads.empty() && partial.async_buffers.empty());
    partial.slot_images[1].fail_record=false;
    partial.CommitAsyncFlushes();
    assert(partial.runtime.releases==1);
    assert(partial.committed_downloads.size()==1);
    // A second deque allocation can fail after async_buffers accepted its
    // matching vector. Both queues must remain aligned and retryable.
    auto pair_failure=MakeCache();
    pair_failure.committed_downloads.reject_next=true;
    caught=false;
    try{pair_failure.CommitAsyncFlushes();}catch(const std::bad_alloc&){caught=true;}
    assert(caught && pair_failure.runtime.releases==1);
    assert(pair_failure.committed_downloads.empty() && pair_failure.async_buffers.empty());
    assert(pair_failure.uncommitted_downloads.size()==2);
    assert(pair_failure.uncommitted_async_buffers.empty());
    pair_failure.CommitAsyncFlushes();
    assert(pair_failure.committed_downloads.size()==1);
    assert(pair_failure.async_buffers.size()==1 && pair_failure.async_buffers.front().size()==1);
    // An empty pending batch may still have staged DMA sources; failed
    // publication must never release or orphan those earlier buffers.

    empty_batch.uncommitted_async_buffers.push_back({777,0});

    caught=false;

    assert(empty_batch.committed_downloads.empty() && empty_batch.async_buffers.empty());
    assert(empty_batch.uncommitted_async_buffers.size()==1);
    assert(empty_batch.uncommitted_async_buffers.front().buffer==777);
    empty_batch.CommitAsyncFlushes();
    assert(empty_batch.committed_downloads.size()==1 && empty_batch.async_buffers.size()==1);
    assert(empty_batch.async_buffers.front()[0].buffer==777);
    empty_batch.PopEmptyAsyncFlushes();
    assert(empty_batch.runtime.releases==1);
    assert(empty_batch.committed_downloads.empty() && empty_batch.async_buffers.empty());
    TextureCache<NativePolicy> harmless_empty;

    assert(sum_overflow.committed_downloads.empty() && sum_overflow.async_buffers.empty());
```

```py
#include <bit>

using u32 = std::uint32_t;
using u64 = std::uint64_t;

std::mutex eden_attributeless_mutex;
struct TrackingSet {
    std::set<EdenVertexIdentity> keys;
    unsigned lookups{};
    bool contains(const EdenVertexIdentity& key) {
        ++lookups;
        return keys.contains(key);
    }
} eden_attributeless_vertex;
std::atomic<u32> eden_attributeless_generation{0};

__SOURCE__
int main() {

        const std::lock_guard lock{eden_attributeless_mutex};
        eden_attributeless_vertex.keys.insert(key);
        eden_attributeless_generation.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_release);
    };
    assert(!EdenAttributeless(a));
    for (int i = 0; i < 1024; ++i) assert(!EdenAttributeless(a));
    assert(bucket_reads == 1 && eden_attributeless_vertex.lookups == 1);
    publish(a);
    assert(EdenAttributeless(a)); // Stale negative must not survive publication.
    assert(eden_attributeless_vertex.lookups == 2);
    const auto reads_a = bucket_reads;
    for (int i = 0; i < 1024; ++i) assert(EdenAttributeless(a));
    assert(bucket_reads == reads_a); // Positive hot path skips bucket entirely.
    assert(!EdenAttributeless(b)); // Same four-way bucket, different shader.
    const auto miss_b = eden_attributeless_vertex.lookups;
    for (int i = 0; i < 256; ++i) assert(!EdenAttributeless(b));
    assert(eden_attributeless_vertex.lookups == miss_b);
    publish(b);
    assert(EdenAttributeless(b));
    const auto both = eden_attributeless_vertex.lookups;
    for (int i = 0; i < 512; ++i) {
        assert(EdenAttributeless(a));
        assert(EdenAttributeless(b));
    }
    assert(eden_attributeless_vertex.lookups == both); // Bucket keeps collisions.
    assert(!EdenAttributeless(d));
    const auto old_d = eden_attributeless_vertex.lookups;
    publish(c); // Unrelated publication invalidates negative, not positive.
    assert(!EdenAttributeless(d));
    assert(eden_attributeless_vertex.lookups == old_d + 1);
    assert(EdenAttributeless(a));
    const auto positive_reads = bucket_reads;
    for (int i = 0; i < 1024; ++i) assert(EdenAttributeless(a));
    assert(bucket_reads == positive_reads);
}
""".replace("__SOURCE__", fragment)
compiler = shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
```

```py
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
using u64=std::uint64_t;
struct Scheduler { unsigned waits{}; };
struct Queue {
    struct Descriptor { u64 buffer{},offset{},size{}; };
    Descriptor payload[7]{};
    unsigned cursor{};
    unsigned starting{};
    unsigned last_reservation{};
    void Acquire(Scheduler& scheduler,unsigned entries) {
        last_reservation=entries;
        if (cursor+entries>=7) {
            ++scheduler.waits;
            cursor=0;
        }
        starting=cursor;
    }
    void AddBuffer(u64 buffer,u64 offset,u64 size) {
        assert(cursor<7);
        payload[cursor++]={buffer,offset,size};
    }
};
struct Staging { u64 buffer=91,offset=8; };
struct Swizzle { u64 buffer_offset=16; };
struct Image {
    u64 guest_size_bytes=128;
    u64 compute_unswizzle_buffer_size=512;
    u64 output=67;
    u64* compute_unswizzle_buffer=&output;
};
struct Pass {
    Scheduler scheduler;
    Queue compute_pass_descriptor_queue;
    Staging swizzled;
    Swizzle sw;
    Image image;
    void Dispatch() {
""" + block + r"""
    }
};
int main() {

    for(int i=0;i<3;++i) {

        assert(q.payload[q.starting].offset==24);
        assert(q.payload[q.starting].size==112);
        assert(q.payload[q.starting+1].buffer==67);
        assert(q.payload[q.starting+1].size==512);

    assert(pass.compute_pass_descriptor_queue.cursor==2);
```

```py
        ++allocated;

    assert(run(at_end,0,1));
    Swizzle beyond[]{ {129} };
    assert(run(beyond,0,1));

    assert(run(sum_overflow,0,1,Staging{17,~VkDeviceSize{0}-7}));

    assert(!run({},0,1));
    assert(!run(std::span(valid,1),8,1));
```

```py
"""BCn3D VkDescriptorSet commit must execute on FIFO worker, not texture lock."""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil, subprocess, tempfile

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
source=(ROOT/"vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vk_compute_pass_cost.cpp").read_text()

cpp=r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <utility>
using VkDescriptorSet=std::uint64_t;
struct Allocator {
    unsigned calls{};
    unsigned owner_calls{};
    bool owner_locked{};
    VkDescriptorSet Commit() {
        ++calls;
        if (owner_locked) ++owner_calls;
        return calls;
    }
};
struct Device {
    unsigned updates{};
    unsigned last_set{};
    Device& GetLogical() { return *this; }
    void UpdateDescriptorSet(VkDescriptorSet set,int,const void*) {
        assert(set!=0);
        last_set=static_cast<unsigned>(set);
        ++updates;
    }
};
struct Pass {
    Allocator descriptor_allocator{};
    Device device{};
    int templ=3;
    int* descriptor_template=&templ;
    int payload=91;
    std::function<void()> queued{};
    void Enqueue(bool valid,bool reject=false) {
        descriptor_allocator.owner_locked=true;
        const void* descriptor_data=&payload;
""" + owner + r"""
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
        auto callback=[this,valid,descriptor_data]() {
#else
        auto callback=[this,set,valid,descriptor_data]() {
#endif
            if(!valid) return;
""" + worker + r"""
            device.GetLogical().UpdateDescriptorSet(set,*descriptor_template,descriptor_data);
        };
        descriptor_allocator.owner_locked=false;
        if(reject) throw std::runtime_error("simulated queue rejection");
        queued=std::move(callback);
    }
    void Execute() {
        assert(queued);
        auto work=std::move(queued);
        queued={};
        work();
    }
};
int main() {
    Pass pass;
    pass.Enqueue(true);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(pass.descriptor_allocator.calls==0);
#else
    assert(pass.descriptor_allocator.calls==1);
#endif
    pass.Execute();
    assert(pass.descriptor_allocator.calls==1);
    assert(pass.device.updates==1);
    pass.Enqueue(false);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(pass.descriptor_allocator.calls==1);
#else
    assert(pass.descriptor_allocator.calls==2);
#endif
    pass.Execute();
    assert(pass.device.updates==1);
    try { pass.Enqueue(true,true); assert(false); }
    catch(const std::runtime_error&) {}
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(pass.descriptor_allocator.calls==1);
#else
    assert(pass.descriptor_allocator.calls==3);
#endif
    pass.Enqueue(true);
    pass.Execute();
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(pass.descriptor_allocator.calls==2);
    assert(pass.descriptor_allocator.owner_calls==0);
#else
    assert(pass.descriptor_allocator.calls==4);
    assert(pass.descriptor_allocator.owner_calls==4);
#endif
    assert(pass.device.updates==2);
}
"""
compiler=shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
assert compiler
```

```py
struct MockComputeKey {
    int value{};
    MockComputeKey& operator=(int next) { value = next; return *this; }
    operator int() const noexcept { return value; }
    u64 Hash() const noexcept { return static_cast<u64>(value); }
};
class PipelineCache {
public:
    struct ComputeRetryState {
        std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point eligible_at{};
        bool attempted{};
    };
    std::map<int, std::unique_ptr<int>> compute_cache;

    MockComputeKey key{};
    int create_calls{};
    bool recover_on_second{};
    std::unique_ptr<int> CreateComputePipeline(int, const int*) {
        ++create_calls;
        if (recover_on_second && create_calls == 2)
            return std::make_unique<int>(42);

        const int* shader = &key.value;
""" + body + r"""
    }

    PipelineCache recovered;
    recovered.recover_on_second = true;
    recovered.Probe();
    assert(recovered.create_calls == 1 && recovered.failed_compute_retries.size() == 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < 1024; ++i) recovered.Probe();
    assert(recovered.create_calls == 1);
    recovered.failed_compute_retries[0].eligible_at =
        std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - std::chrono::seconds(1);
    recovered.Probe();

            std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - std::chrono::seconds(1);
        recycled.Probe();
        assert(!recycled.compute_cache.at(key));

        recycled.key = key;
        recycled.Probe();

    assert(recycled.create_calls == 64);  // no repeated failed dispatch retries
    recycled.key = 32;
    recycled.Probe();
```

```py
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <stop_token>
#include <functional>
#include <vector>
constexpr std::size_t kStartupPrewarmPipelines = 32;
struct Worker {
    bool alive=true;
    size_t done=0;
    std::vector<std::function<void()>> pending;
    void QueueWork(std::function<void()> job){ assert(alive); pending.push_back(std::move(job)); }
    void WaitForRequests(std::stop_token token={}) {
        if(token.stop_requested()) alive=false;
        for(auto& work:pending){work(); ++done;}
        pending.clear();
    }
};
std::size_t Run(std::size_t persisted, Worker& workers, bool init_only=false,
                bool cancel_title=false) {
    if(init_only) return 0;  // legacy setup-only compatibility
    std::stop_source startup_reader;
    std::size_t queued=0;
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<persisted && !startup_reader.stop_requested();++i) {
        workers.QueueWork([]{});
        ++queued;
        if(queued == kStartupPrewarmPipelines)
            startup_reader.request_stop();
    }
    // Mimic cancellation after at most 32 jobs were admitted.
    // Only the cache reader stops. The shader builder must remain alive.
    std::stop_source title;
    if(cancel_title) title.request_stop();
    workers.WaitForRequests();
    assert(!cancel_title || title.stop_requested());
    assert(workers.alive); // never forward startup_reader.get_token()
    return queued;
}
int main(){
    for(auto persisted:{0u,1u,7u,8u,9u,31u,32u,33u,128u,50000u}){
        Worker workers;
        auto count=Run(persisted,workers);
        assert(count==(persisted<kStartupPrewarmPipelines?persisted:kStartupPrewarmPipelines));
        assert(workers.done==count);
        // First-use compilation after prewarm must remain possible.
        workers.QueueWork([]{});
        workers.WaitForRequests();
        assert(workers.done==count+1);
        assert(Run(1, workers, true)==0);
        Worker canceled;
        assert(Run(persisted, canceled, false, true)==count);
        assert(canceled.alive && canceled.done==count);
        canceled.QueueWork([]{});
        canceled.WaitForRequests();
        assert(canceled.done==count+1);
    }
    Worker negative;
    std::stop_source canceled;
    canceled.request_stop();
    negative.WaitForRequests(canceled.get_token());
    assert(!negative.alive); // why reader token must NOT be sent to worker
}
"""
```

```py
        const DescriptorBufferRing::Allocation alloc{
            descriptor_buffer_ring.Allocate(scheduler, descriptor_buffer_layout.size)};
        if (!alloc.host) {
            LOG_DEBUG(Render_Vulkan, "Failed to reserve descriptor memory, skipping dispatch");
            return false;
        }
        WriteDescriptorBuffer(device, descriptor_buffer_layout, descriptor_data, alloc.host);
        descriptor_buffer_offset = alloc.offset;
        descriptor_buffer_chunk = alloc.chunk;
    }
'''
cpp=r'''
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>
#include <vector>
using u32=std::uint32_t; using u64=std::uint64_t; using VkDeviceSize=std::uint64_t;
#define LOG_DEBUG(...) ((void)0)
struct DescriptorUpdateEntry { u64 bits{}; };
struct DescriptorBufferLayout { VkDeviceSize size{16}; };
struct Device {}; struct Scheduler {};
struct GuestQueue {
    std::array<DescriptorUpdateEntry,2> entries{{{11},{22}}};
    const DescriptorUpdateEntry* UpdateData() const { return entries.data(); }
};
struct Ring {
    struct Allocation { unsigned char* host{}; VkDeviceSize offset{}; u32 chunk{}; u64 generation{}; };
    u64 generation{7}; unsigned count{},touched{}; bool reject{};
    std::array<std::array<unsigned char,16>,16> memory{};
    u64 CurrentGeneration() const {return generation;}
    Allocation Allocate(Scheduler&,VkDeviceSize size) {
        if(reject)return {};
        assert(size==16 && count<memory.size());
        const u32 index=count++;
        return {memory[index].data(),index*16u,index,generation};
    }
    void TouchFrame(Scheduler&){++touched;}
};
using DescriptorBufferRing=Ring;
void WriteDescriptorBuffer(const Device&,const DescriptorBufferLayout&,
    const DescriptorUpdateEntry* src,unsigned char* dst){std::memcpy(dst,src,16);}
struct Pipeline {
    Device device; Scheduler scheduler; GuestQueue guest_descriptor_queue;
    Ring descriptor_buffer_ring; DescriptorBufferLayout descriptor_buffer_layout;
    std::vector<DescriptorUpdateEntry> last_descriptor_payload;
    VkDeviceSize last_descriptor_buffer_offset{};
    u32 last_descriptor_buffer_chunk{}; u64 last_descriptor_buffer_generation{};
    bool last_descriptor_buffer_valid{}; u32 num_descriptor_entries{2};
    bool uses_descriptor_buffer{true};
    VkDeviceSize used_offset{}; u32 used_chunk{};
    bool Run() {
__BLOCK__
        used_offset=descriptor_buffer_offset; used_chunk=descriptor_buffer_chunk;
        return true;
    }
};
int main(){
    Pipeline p; p.last_descriptor_payload.reserve(2);
    assert(p.Run()); assert(p.descriptor_buffer_ring.count==1);
    const auto first=p.used_offset;
    (void)first; // Desktop still compiles with -Werror; only native reuses.
    assert(p.Run());
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(p.descriptor_buffer_ring.count==1 && p.descriptor_buffer_ring.touched==1);
    assert(p.used_offset==first);
#else
    assert(p.descriptor_buffer_ring.count==2);
#endif
    p.guest_descriptor_queue.entries[1].bits=23; assert(p.Run());
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(p.descriptor_buffer_ring.count==2);
#else
    assert(p.descriptor_buffer_ring.count==3);
#endif
    ++p.descriptor_buffer_ring.generation; assert(p.Run());
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(p.descriptor_buffer_ring.count==3 && p.last_descriptor_buffer_generation==8);
#else
    assert(p.descriptor_buffer_ring.count==4);
#endif
    p.descriptor_buffer_ring.reject=true;
    p.guest_descriptor_queue.entries[0].bits=55;
    assert(!p.Run());
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(p.last_descriptor_payload[0].bits==11);
#endif
    p.descriptor_buffer_ring.reject=false; assert(p.Run());
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(p.descriptor_buffer_ring.count==4 && p.last_descriptor_payload[0].bits==55);
#else
    assert(p.descriptor_buffer_ring.count==5);
#endif
}
'''
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""F07 P0.3: execute selected Vulkan compute-indirect command path on the host.

The source fragment is taken verbatim from active DispatchCompute. In PS5 mode
an absent guest buffer must return before recording barriers or using Handle().
Valid buffers, existing compute barriers, and desktop semantics are preserved.
No actual PS5 Vulkan device, guest compute program, or FC27 is emulated.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
path = ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_rasterizer.cpp"
active = path.read_text()
generator = (ROOT / "tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py").read_text()
pinned = (ROOT / "vendor/sources/eden/src/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_rasterizer.cpp")
fast = (ROOT / ".github/workflows/encore-core-fast-gate.yml").read_text()
preflight = (ROOT / ".github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml").read_text()
invocation = "python3 -B tools/check-ps5-f07-compute-indirect-binding-host.py"
assert invocation in fast and invocation in preflight
assert "F07 reject unmapped indirect compute buffer before Vulkan commands" in generator
assert "F07 compute indirect reject null Vulkan handles" in generator

method_start = "void RasterizerVulkan::DispatchCompute() {"
method_end = "\n}\n"
assert active.count(method_start) == 1
start = active.index(method_start)
end = active.index(method_end, start)
method = active[start:end]
branch_start = "    if (indirect_address) {\n"
branch_end = "    const std::array<u32, 3> dim{"
assert method.count(branch_start) == method.count(branch_end) == 1
chunk = method[method.index(branch_start):method.index(branch_end)]
assert chunk.count("buffer_cache.ObtainBuffer(*indirect_address, 12, sync_info, post_op)") == 1
assert chunk.count("if (!buffer || buffer->Handle() == VK_NULL_HANDLE) {") == 1
assert chunk.count("scheduler.RequestOutsideRenderPassOperationContext();") == 1
assert chunk.count("indirect_buffer = buffer->Handle()") == 1
assert chunk.index("if (!buffer || buffer->Handle() == VK_NULL_HANDLE) {") < chunk.index("scheduler.RequestOutsideRenderPassOperationContext();")
assert chunk.index("scheduler.RequestOutsideRenderPassOperationContext();") < chunk.index("indirect_buffer = buffer->Handle()")
assert "#ifdef PS5_NATIVE\n        // A guest indirect-command address" in chunk
assert "#endif\n        scheduler.RequestOutsideRenderPassOperationContext();" in chunk

cpp = r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>
#include <utility>
namespace VideoCommon {
enum class ObtainBufferSynchronize { FullSynchronize };
enum class ObtainBufferOperation { DiscardWrite };
}
namespace Eden::DevVulkan { inline bool compute_barriers = false; }
inline constexpr int VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COMPUTE_SHADER_BIT=1;
inline constexpr int VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_DRAW_INDIRECT_BIT=2;
inline constexpr int COMPUTE_INPUT_BARRIER=3;
inline constexpr int COMPUTE_CONSUMER_STAGES=4;
inline constexpr int COMPUTE_WRITE_BARRIER=5;
struct Counters {
    unsigned contexts{}, records{}, dispatches{}, barriers{};
    int handle{};
    std::size_t offset{};
};
namespace vk {
inline constexpr int PIPELINE_STAGE_GRAPHICS_COMPUTE_TRANSFER=6;
struct CommandBuffer {
    Counters* events{};
    void PipelineBarrier(int,int,int,int){++events->barriers;}
    void DispatchIndirect(int handle, std::size_t offset) {
        ++events->dispatches;
        events->handle=handle;
        events->offset=offset;
    }
};
}
inline constexpr int VK_NULL_HANDLE=0;
struct Buffer {int value{91};int Handle() const {return value;}};
struct BufferCache {
    Buffer* active{};
    std::pair<Buffer*,std::size_t> ObtainBuffer(
        std::uint64_t address,std::size_t size,
        VideoCommon::ObtainBufferSynchronize,
        VideoCommon::ObtainBufferOperation) {
        assert(address==48 && size==12);
        return {active,24};
    }
};
struct Pipeline {
    bool bound{true};
    bool IsBound() const {return bound;}
};
struct Scheduler {
    Counters events{};
    void RequestOutsideRenderPassOperationContext(){++events.contexts;}
    template<class Fn> void Record(Fn fn) {
        ++events.records;
        fn(vk::CommandBuffer{&events});
    }
};
struct Cache {
    Buffer storage{};
    BufferCache buffer_cache{&storage};
    Pipeline pipe{};
    Scheduler scheduler{};
    bool mapped{true};
    void Dispatch() {
        buffer_cache.active=mapped ? &storage : nullptr;
        auto* pipeline=&pipe;
        const std::optional<std::uint64_t> indirect_address{48};
__EXTRACTED_BRANCH__
        assert(false && "indirect compute unexpectedly fell through");
    }
};
int main(){
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    Cache missing;
    missing.mapped=false;
    missing.Dispatch();
    assert(missing.scheduler.events.contexts==0);
    assert(missing.scheduler.events.records==0);
    assert(missing.scheduler.events.dispatches==0);
    Cache missing_vk;
    missing_vk.storage.value=VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    missing_vk.Dispatch();
    assert(missing_vk.scheduler.events.contexts==0);
    assert(missing_vk.scheduler.events.records==0);
    assert(missing_vk.scheduler.events.dispatches==0);
#endif
    Cache valid;
    valid.Dispatch();
    assert(valid.scheduler.events.contexts==1);
    assert(valid.scheduler.events.records==1);
    assert(valid.scheduler.events.dispatches==1);
    assert(valid.scheduler.events.barriers==0);
    assert(valid.scheduler.events.handle==91);
    assert(valid.scheduler.events.offset==24);

    Eden::DevVulkan::compute_barriers=true;
    Cache with_barriers;
    with_barriers.Dispatch();
    assert(with_barriers.scheduler.events.contexts==1);
    assert(with_barriers.scheduler.events.records==2);
    assert(with_barriers.scheduler.events.dispatches==1);
    assert(with_barriers.scheduler.events.barriers==2);

    Cache not_bound;
    not_bound.pipe.bound=false;
    not_bound.Dispatch();
    assert(not_bound.scheduler.events.records==2);
    assert(not_bound.scheduler.events.dispatches==0);
```

```py
"""F07: compile actual GPU-owner compute-key positive lookup and publication.

A same-key healthy shader skips the CPU map hash/probe on PS5. Null entries
keep their retry path; developer tracing remains accurate; no cache survives
a PipelineCache instance. This does not measure game FPS.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

cpp = r"""
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <memory>
#include <map>
using u64 = std::uint64_t;
using u32 = std::uint32_t;
namespace Eden::DevVulkan { inline bool trace_pipelines = false; }
struct ComputePipeline { unsigned serial{}; };
struct ComputePipelineCacheKey {
    u64 unique_hash{};
    u32 shared_memory_size{};
    u32 workgroup_size[3]{};
    static inline unsigned equality_checks = 0;
    bool operator==(const ComputePipelineCacheKey& b) const noexcept {
        ++equality_checks;
        return unique_hash == b.unique_hash &&
               shared_memory_size == b.shared_memory_size &&
               workgroup_size[0] == b.workgroup_size[0] &&
               workgroup_size[1] == b.workgroup_size[1] &&
               workgroup_size[2] == b.workgroup_size[2];
    }
    bool operator<(const ComputePipelineCacheKey& b) const noexcept {
        if (unique_hash != b.unique_hash) return unique_hash < b.unique_hash;
        if (shared_memory_size != b.shared_memory_size) return shared_memory_size < b.shared_memory_size;
        for (int i=0;i<3;++i)
            if (workgroup_size[i] != b.workgroup_size[i]) return workgroup_size[i] < b.workgroup_size[i];
        return false;
    }
};
struct Map {
    std::map<ComputePipelineCacheKey, std::unique_ptr<ComputePipeline>> slots;
    unsigned probes{};
    auto try_emplace(ComputePipelineCacheKey key) {
        ++probes;
        return slots.try_emplace(key);
    }
};
struct Cache {
    Map compute_cache;
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    struct ComputePositive {
        ComputePipelineCacheKey key{};
        ComputePipeline* pipeline{};
    };
    std::array<ComputePositive, 4> recent_compute_pipelines{};
    unsigned next_compute_positive{};
    unsigned preferred_compute_positive{};
#endif
    ComputePipeline* Get(ComputePipelineCacheKey key) {
__LOOKUP__
        auto& pipeline{pair->second};
        if (is_new && key.unique_hash != 0xbad) {
            pipeline = std::make_unique<ComputePipeline>();
            pipeline->serial = static_cast<unsigned>(key.unique_hash);
        }
        // The real failure path is bounded/retryable; this miniature tests
        // only that an unsuccessful entry must NEVER be returned from memo.
__PUBLISH__
    }
};
int main() {
    Cache cache;
    ComputePipelineCacheKey a{17,32,{8,2,1}};
    ComputePipelineCacheKey b{18,32,{8,2,1}};
    ComputePipelineCacheKey same_shader_other_group{17,32,{16,1,1}};
    ComputePipelineCacheKey failed{0xbad,32,{8,2,1}};
    auto* first = cache.Get(a);
    assert(first && first->serial == 17 && cache.compute_cache.probes == 1);
    for (unsigned i=0;i<5000;++i) assert(cache.Get(a)==first);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(cache.compute_cache.probes == 1);
#else
    assert(cache.compute_cache.probes == 5001);
#endif
    const auto before = cache.compute_cache.probes;
    auto* second = cache.Get(b);
    assert(second && second != first && cache.compute_cache.probes == before+1);
    assert(cache.Get(same_shader_other_group) != first);
    assert(cache.Get(a)==first);
    // Two alternating keys never need to mutate the cache's preferred slot;
    // after the second insertion one remains the one-probe preferred key
    // and the other is only one additional read-only comparison away.
    Cache two_way;
    auto* one = two_way.Get(a);
    auto* other = two_way.Get(b);
    assert(one && other && one != other);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 20000; ++i)
        assert(two_way.Get((i & 1) ? b : a) == ((i & 1) ? other : one));
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(two_way.preferred_compute_positive == 1);
    assert(two_way.compute_cache.probes == 2);
#else
    assert(two_way.compute_cache.probes == 20002);
#endif
    // Four alternating live compute keys (including dispatch geometry)
    // must hit without repeated unordered-map probes once warmed.
    Cache alternating;
    ComputePipelineCacheKey keys[4]{
        {700,32,{8,2,1}}, {701,32,{8,2,1}},
        {700,32,{16,1,1}}, {702,64,{8,2,1}},
    };
    ComputePipeline* outputs[4]{};
    for (unsigned i=0; i<4; ++i) outputs[i]=alternating.Get(keys[i]);
    assert(alternating.compute_cache.probes == 4);
    for (unsigned i=0; i<20000; ++i)
        assert(alternating.Get(keys[i%4]) == outputs[i%4]);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(alternating.compute_cache.probes == 4);
    // Once the active shader is preferred, even after four keys were
    // admitted, a repeated dispatch must compare exactly one key.
    const auto comparisons = ComputePipelineCacheKey::equality_checks;
    for (unsigned i=0; i<10000; ++i)
        assert(alternating.Get(keys[3]) == outputs[3]);
    assert(ComputePipelineCacheKey::equality_checks == comparisons + 10000);
    assert(alternating.compute_cache.probes == 4);
#else
    assert(alternating.compute_cache.probes == 20004);
#endif
    // A fifth key may evict a positive hint, but must never return the wrong
    // shader. Keeping failed entries OUT of the memo protects healthy ones.
    ComputePipelineCacheKey fifth{703,32,{8,2,1}};
    auto* new_shader=alternating.Get(fifth);
    assert(new_shader && new_shader!=outputs[0]);
    const unsigned old_probes=alternating.compute_cache.probes;
    assert(alternating.Get(keys[0]) == outputs[0]);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(alternating.compute_cache.probes == old_probes+1);
#else
    assert(alternating.compute_cache.probes == old_probes+1);
#endif
    // A new PipelineCache must never inherit a raw pointer from the old one.
    Cache separate;
    assert(separate.Get(a) != first);
    // No memoization of failed shader entries: they still reach the map.
    const auto missed = cache.compute_cache.probes;
    assert(cache.Get(failed)==nullptr);
    assert(cache.Get(failed)==nullptr);
    assert(cache.compute_cache.probes == missed+2);
    // DEV pipeline first-use trace must keep the ordinary map path.
    Eden::DevVulkan::trace_pipelines = true;
    const auto traced = cache.compute_cache.probes;
    assert(cache.Get(a)==first);
    assert(cache.Get(a)==first);
    assert(cache.compute_cache.probes==traced+2);
}
""".replace("__LOOKUP__",lookup).replace("__PUBLISH__",publish)
```

```py
"""Compile and execute the actual F07 Vulkan compute wait callback in two races.

If shader completion precedes callback dispatch, do not grab the pipeline
build mutex. If not completed, retain the condition-variable wait in order.
Graphics already implements the same release/acquire fast path.

#include <cassert>
#include <chrono>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <mutex>

#include <utility>

// Real VulkanTimer is RAII and therefore not a trivial throwaway local.
// Mirror its destructor so -Werror does not reject the source-extracted timer.
namespace Eden::Performance {
struct VulkanTimer { explicit VulkanTimer(int) {} ~VulkanTimer() {} void reset() {} };
enum class CachePhase { ComputePipelineWait };
inline std::atomic<bool> detailed_gpu_profile{true};
inline std::atomic<unsigned> measured_waits{0};
```
