```py
struct PipelineWaitTrace {
    // The real V01 trace measures the lock phase; this fixture only
    // verifies release/acquire publication and the optional early exit.
    void MarkLockAcquired() noexcept {}
    bool WasBlockedOnMutex() const noexcept { return false; }
    void Complete(const char*, std::uint64_t, bool) {
        completed_traces.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    }
};
struct CachePhaseTimer {
    explicit CachePhaseTimer(CachePhase, bool enabled) {
        if (enabled) measured_waits.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    }
    void Stop() {}
};
}
struct CountingMutex {
    std::mutex inner;
    std::atomic<int> lock_calls{0};
    std::function<void()> before_lock;
    void lock() {
        ++lock_calls;
        auto hook = std::move(before_lock);
        if (hook) hook();
        inner.lock();
    }
    void unlock() { inner.unlock(); }
};
struct Scheduler {
    std::function<void(vk::CommandBuffer)> queued;
    template<class F> void Record(F&& fn) { queued = std::forward<F>(fn); }
    void run() { assert(queued); queued(vk::CommandBuffer{}); }
};
struct Compute {
    Scheduler scheduler;
    CountingMutex build_mutex;
    std::condition_variable_any build_condvar;
    std::atomic_bool is_built{false};
    int pipeline{};
    std::uint64_t diagnostic_cache_key_hash{0xC0FFEE};
    bool IsBound() const { return pipeline != 0; }
    void Queue() {
        if (!is_built.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
""" + callback + r"""
        }
    }
    void Publish(bool built) {
        { std::unique_lock lock{build_mutex};
          pipeline = built ? 93 : 0;
          is_built.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
        }
        build_condvar.notify_all();
    }
};
int main() {
    for (int i = 0; i < 120; ++i) {
        Compute c;
        c.Queue();
        std::thread producer([&] { c.Publish(true); });
        producer.join();
        c.build_mutex.lock_calls.store(0);
        c.scheduler.run();
        assert(c.build_mutex.lock_calls.load() == 0);
        assert(c.pipeline == 93);
    }
    assert(Eden::Performance::measured_waits.load() == 0);
    // Force publication between the first acquire and the mutex recheck.
    // The hook runs before the callback acquires build_mutex; Publish uses
    // the same mutex, then the callback observes the completed build.
    {
        Compute c;
        c.Queue();
        c.build_mutex.before_lock = [&c] {
            std::thread([&c] { c.Publish(true); }).join();
        };
        c.scheduler.run();
        assert(c.pipeline == 93);
        assert(c.build_mutex.lock_calls.load() == 2);

        assert(Eden::Performance::measured_waits.load() == 0);

        // The desktop timer intentionally retains its pre-lock placement.
        assert(Eden::Performance::measured_waits.load() == 1);
#endif
        assert(Eden::Performance::completed_traces.load() == 0);
    }
    const auto wait_baseline = Eden::Performance::measured_waits.load();
    for (int i = 0; i < 120; ++i) {
        Compute c;
        c.Queue();
        const auto previous = Eden::Performance::measured_waits.load();
        std::thread producer([&] {
            // Do not race the first acquire: publish only after the timer
            // proves the callback actually reached its wait path.
            while (Eden::Performance::measured_waits.load() == previous)
                std::this_thread::yield();
            c.Publish(true);

        producer.join();
        assert(c.build_mutex.lock_calls.load() >= 1);
        assert(c.pipeline == 93);

#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(Eden::Performance::completed_traces.load() == 120);
#else
    assert(Eden::Performance::completed_traces.load() == 0);
#endif
    Eden::Performance::detailed_gpu_profile.store(false);

        Compute c;
        c.Queue();
        std::thread producer([&] {
            std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(1));
            c.Publish(true);
        });
        c.scheduler.run();
        producer.join();

        assert(Eden::Performance::measured_waits.load() == wait_baseline + 120);

    assert(failed.build_mutex.lock_calls.load() == 0);
    assert(failed.pipeline == 0);
    assert(Eden::Performance::measured_waits.load() == wait_baseline + 120);
}
"""
```

```py
"""F07 P0.1/P0.2: foreground graphics/compute shader translation excludes optional optimization.

Extract the actual PS5 native RAII scope from the Vulkan pipeline cache and
compile it at O0/O2. Exercise cold foreground, disk-prewarm exclusion, nested

import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
source = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vk_pipeline_cache_cost.cpp").read_text()
compute = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vk_compute_pipeline_cost.cpp").read_text()
graphics = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vk_graphics_pipeline_cost.cpp").read_text()
generator = (root / "tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py").read_text()

scope_start = "struct ComputeTranslationPriorityScope {"
graphics_scope_start = "struct GraphicsTranslationPriorityScope {"
scope_end = "\n};"
assert source.count(scope_start) == source.count(graphics_scope_start) == 1
compute_start = source.index(scope_start)
graphics_start = source.index(graphics_scope_start)
scope = source[compute_start:source.index(scope_end, compute_start) + len(scope_end)]
graphics_scope = source[graphics_start:source.index(scope_end, graphics_start) + len(scope_end)]
assert compute_start < graphics_start
assert "#endif\nusing Shader::Backend::SPIRV::EmitSPIRV;" in source[graphics_start:]
assert scope.count("pending_first_use_compute_builds.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_release)") == 1
assert scope.count("pending_first_use_compute_builds.fetch_sub(1, std::memory_order_release)") == 1
method_start = "    PipelineStatistics* statistics, bool build_in_parallel) try {"
method_end = "    auto hash = key.Hash();\n    if (device.HasBrokenCompute()) {"
assert source.count(method_start) == 1
fragment = source[source.index(method_start) + len(method_start):source.index(method_end, source.index(method_start))]
assert "ComputeTranslationPriorityScope translation_priority{build_in_parallel};" in fragment
# MKW 5fdcbff: preserve the Vulkan driver's subgroup choice unless the
# guest shader actually observes lane-level/warp semantics. The PS5-derived
# renderer must agree with the pinned generator, leaving NS1 source intact.
warp_policy = ("device.IsExtSubgroupSizeControlSupported() && uses_warp_ops "
               "? &subgroup_size_ci : nullptr")
assert compute.count(warp_policy) == 1
assert generator.count(warp_policy) == 1
for flag in ("uses_subgroup_vote", "uses_subgroup_invocation_id",
             "uses_subgroup_shuffles", "uses_subgroup_mask",
             "uses_quad_shuffles", "uses_fswzadd"):
    assert f"info.{flag}" in compute and f"info.{flag}" in generator
assert "device.IsExtSubgroupSizeControlSupported() ? &subgroup_size_ci : nullptr" not in compute
assert "pending_first_use_compute_builds{0};" in compute
assert "pending_first_use_compute_builds.load(std::memory_order_acquire)" in graphics
assert "F07 foreground compute shader translation scope" in generator
assert "F07 compute CFG IR SPIRV fairness before driver queue" in generator
assert "std::atomic<unsigned> pending_first_use_compute_builds{0};" not in source
assert "std::atomic<unsigned> pending_first_use_graphics_builds{0};" not in source
assert "std::atomic<unsigned> pending_first_use_graphics_builds{0};" in graphics
assert "extern std::atomic<unsigned> pending_first_use_graphics_builds;" in source
assert "pending_first_use_graphics_builds.load(std::memory_order_acquire)" in graphics
assert graphics_scope.count("pending_first_use_graphics_builds.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_release)") == 1
assert graphics_scope.count("pending_first_use_graphics_builds.fetch_sub(1, std::memory_order_release)") == 1
assert "F07 graphics translation observes first-use worker counter" in generator
assert "F07 graphics shader translation priority scope" in generator
assert "F07 graphics environment first-use priority before shader translation" in generator
assert "F07 compute environment first-use priority before shader translation" in generator
# Runtime entrypoints reserve before reading the guest shader environment or
# resetting pools. Inner scopes stay active throughout CFG/IR/SPIR-V.
outer_gfx = source[source.index("std::unique_ptr<GraphicsPipeline> PipelineCache::CreateGraphicsPipeline() {"):
                   source.index("std::unique_ptr<ComputePipeline> PipelineCache::CreateComputePipeline(")]
assert outer_gfx.count("GraphicsTranslationPriorityScope first_use_preparation_priority{") == 1
assert outer_gfx.index("GraphicsTranslationPriorityScope first_use_preparation_priority{") < outer_gfx.index("GetGraphicsEnvironments(environments")
assert outer_gfx.index("GraphicsTranslationPriorityScope first_use_preparation_priority{") < outer_gfx.index("main_pools.ReleaseContents()")
assert "::Eden::DevVulkan::fast_first_pipelines" in outer_gfx
outer_cmp = source[source.index("std::unique_ptr<ComputePipeline> PipelineCache::CreateComputePipeline("):
                   source.index("std::unique_ptr<ComputePipeline> PipelineCache::CreateComputePipeline(\n    ShaderPools& pools")]
assert outer_cmp.count("ComputeTranslationPriorityScope first_use_preparation_priority{true};") == 1
assert outer_cmp.index("ComputeTranslationPriorityScope first_use_preparation_priority{true};") < outer_cmp.index("ComputeEnvironment env{")
assert outer_cmp.index("ComputeTranslationPriorityScope first_use_preparation_priority{true};") < outer_cmp.index("main_pools.ReleaseContents()")
assert "F07 reserve graphics translation before CFG IR SPIRV" in generator
graphics_method_start = "    bool build_in_parallel) try {\n#ifdef PS5_NATIVE\n    // The optional optimizer"
graphics_method_end = "    auto hash = key.Hash();\n    LOG_DEBUG(Render_Vulkan, \"{:#016x}\", hash);"
assert source.count(graphics_method_start) == source.count(graphics_method_end) == 1
graphics_fragment = source[source.index(graphics_method_start):source.index(graphics_method_end, source.index(graphics_method_start))]
assert "GraphicsTranslationPriorityScope translation_priority{" in graphics_fragment
assert "build_in_parallel && ::Eden::DevVulkan::fast_first_pipelines" in graphics_fragment
assert source.index("GraphicsTranslationPriorityScope translation_priority") < source.index(
    "Shader::Maxwell::Flow::CFG cfg(env, pools.flow_block, cfg_offset, index == 0);",
    source.index(graphics_method_start))

assert source.index("ComputeTranslationPriorityScope translation_priority") < source.index(
    "Shader::Maxwell::Flow::CFG cfg{env, pools.flow_block, env.StartAddress()};"
)

cpp = r"""
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <stdexcept>
namespace Vulkan {
std::atomic<unsigned> pending_first_use_compute_builds{0};
std::atomic<unsigned> pending_first_use_graphics_builds{0};
namespace {
""" + scope + "\n" + graphics_scope + r"""
}
void Check(bool foreground, bool fail) {
    const unsigned before = pending_first_use_compute_builds.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    ComputeTranslationPriorityScope translation_priority{foreground};
    assert(pending_first_use_compute_builds.load(std::memory_order_acquire) ==
           before + (foreground ? 1u : 0u));
    if (fail) throw std::runtime_error("shader translation failed");
}
void CheckGraphics(bool in_parallel, bool fast_first, bool fail) {
    const unsigned before = pending_first_use_graphics_builds.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    GraphicsTranslationPriorityScope translation_priority{in_parallel && fast_first};
    assert(pending_first_use_graphics_builds.load(std::memory_order_acquire) ==
           before + (in_parallel && fast_first ? 1u : 0u));
    if (fail) throw std::runtime_error("graphics shader CFG/IR translation failed");
}
void CheckInterleaved() {
    ComputeTranslationPriorityScope compute_priority{true};
    assert(pending_first_use_compute_builds.load()==1);
    GraphicsTranslationPriorityScope graphics_priority{true};
    assert(pending_first_use_graphics_builds.load()==1);
    Check(true, false);
    CheckGraphics(true, true, false);
    assert(pending_first_use_graphics_builds.load()==1);
    assert(pending_first_use_compute_builds.load()==1);
}
void CheckNested() {
    ComputeTranslationPriorityScope translation_priority{true};
    assert(pending_first_use_compute_builds.load(std::memory_order_acquire) == 1);
    Check(false, false);
    assert(pending_first_use_compute_builds.load(std::memory_order_acquire) == 1);
    Check(true, false);
    assert(pending_first_use_compute_builds.load(std::memory_order_acquire) == 1);
    ComputeTranslationPriorityScope extra{true};
    assert(pending_first_use_compute_builds.load(std::memory_order_acquire) == 2);
}
}
int main() {
    using namespace Vulkan;
    for (int i = 0; i < 200; ++i) {
        Check(false, false);
        assert(pending_first_use_compute_builds.load() == 0);
        Check(true, false);
        assert(pending_first_use_compute_builds.load() == 0);
        try { Check(true, true); }
        catch (const std::runtime_error&) {}
        assert(pending_first_use_compute_builds.load() == 0);
        CheckNested();
        assert(pending_first_use_compute_builds.load() == 0);
        CheckGraphics(false, true, false);     // disk preload
        CheckGraphics(true, false, false);     // dev optimizer disabled
        CheckGraphics(true, true, false);      // foreground graphics first use
        assert(pending_first_use_graphics_builds.load() == 0);
        try { CheckGraphics(true, true, true); }
        catch (const std::runtime_error&) {}
        assert(pending_first_use_graphics_builds.load() == 0);
        CheckInterleaved();
        assert(pending_first_use_compute_builds.load() == 0);
        assert(pending_first_use_graphics_builds.load() == 0);
    }
}
"""
compiler = shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
assert compiler, "C++20 compiler required"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-f07-compute-translation-") as d:
    source_file = Path(d) / "translation.cpp"
    source_file.write_text(cpp)
    for opt in ("-O0", "-O2"):
        exe = Path(d) / ("translation" + opt[1:])
        built = subprocess.run(
            [compiler, "-std=c++20", opt, "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror",
             "-fsanitize=undefined", "-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
             str(source_file), "-o", str(exe)],
            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=45)
        assert built.returncode == 0, (opt, built.stderr[-5000:])
        result = subprocess.run([str(exe)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)
        assert result.returncode == 0, (opt, result.stdout, result.stderr[-5000:])
print("F07_GRAPHICS_COMPUTE_TRANSLATION_PRIORITY_PASS runtime=1 disk_preload=0"
      " exception_unwind=1 nested=1 graphics_first_use=1 O0=1 O2=1")
```

`tools/check-ps5-f07-dma-clear-prelock-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Source-extracted PS5 DMA clear guard: zero/oversize requests avoid cache mutex."""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
active=(root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_rasterizer.cpp").read_text()
bridge=(root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-core/guest-bridge/vulkan_rasterizer.cpp").read_text()
core=(root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/video_core/buffer_cache/buffer_cache.h").read_text()
generator=(root/"tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py").read_text()
a="bool AccelerateDMA::BufferClear("
b="\nbool AccelerateDMA::BufferCopy("
def extract(text):
    start=text.index(a)
    return text[start:text.index(b,start)]
method=extract(active)
assert method==extract(bridge)
guard="if (amount == 0 || amount > static_cast<u64>(~u32{0}) / sizeof(u32))"
assert guard in method
assert method.index(guard) < method.index("std::scoped_lock lock{buffer_cache.mutex};")
assert "#ifdef PS5_NATIVE" in method and "#endif" in method
core_start=core.index("bool BufferCache<P>::DMAClear(")
core_guard=core[core_start:core.index("\ntemplate <class P>",core_start)]
assert guard in core_guard
assert "F07 reject invalid DMA clear words before the buffer mutex" in generator
for path in (".github/workflows/encore-core-fast-gate.yml",
             ".github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml"):
    assert "python3 -B tools/check-ps5-f07-dma-clear-prelock-host.py" in (root/path).read_text()

cpp=r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <mutex>
using u32=std::uint32_t;
using u64=std::uint64_t;
using GPUVAddr=u64;
struct CountMutex {
    std::mutex mutex;
    unsigned locks{};
    void lock() { ++locks; mutex.lock(); }
    void unlock() { mutex.unlock(); }
};
struct BufferCache {
    CountMutex mutex;
    unsigned dma_calls{};
    bool DMAClear(GPUVAddr, u64 count, u32) {
        ++dma_calls;
        return count != 0 && count <= static_cast<u64>(~u32{0})/sizeof(u32);
    }
};
struct AccelerateDMA {
    BufferCache buffer_cache;
    bool BufferClear(GPUVAddr,u64,u32);
};
""" + method + r"""
int main() {
    constexpr u64 valid_max=static_cast<u64>(~u32{0})/sizeof(u32);
    const auto check=[](u64 words,bool accepted,bool locked) {
        AccelerateDMA dma;
        const bool ok=dma.BufferClear(77,words,0xdeadbeefu);
        assert(ok==accepted);
        assert((dma.buffer_cache.mutex.locks != 0)==locked);
        assert((dma.buffer_cache.dma_calls != 0)==locked);
    };
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    check(0,false,false);
    check(valid_max+1,false,false);
    check(static_cast<u64>(~u32{0}),false,false);
#else
    check(0,false,true);
    check(valid_max+1,false,true);
    check(static_cast<u64>(~u32{0}),false,true);
#endif
    check(1,true,true);
    check(valid_max,true,true);
}
"""
compiler=shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
assert compiler, "C++20 compiler required"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="f07-clear-prelock-") as folder:
    src=Path(folder)/"clear.cpp"
    src.write_text(cpp)
    for native in (True,False):
        for opt in ("-O0","-O2"):
            exe=Path(folder)/(("native" if native else "desktop")+opt[1:])
            flags=["-DPS5_NATIVE=1"] if native else []
            build=subprocess.run([compiler,"-std=c++20",opt,"-Wall","-Wextra","-Werror",
                                  "-fsanitize=undefined","-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
                                  *flags,str(src),"-o",str(exe)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=45)
            assert build.returncode==0,(native,opt,build.stderr[-4000:])
            run=subprocess.run([str(exe)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15)
            assert run.returncode==0,(native,opt,run.stderr[-4000:])
print("F07_DMA_CLEAR_PRELOCK_PASS ps5_no_mutex_on_invalid=1 desktop_original=1 max_words=1 overflow=1 O0=1 O2=1 UBSan=1")
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""F07 native DMA image invalid byte spans must not wait on both caches."""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
source=(root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_rasterizer.cpp").read_text()
variant=(root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-core/guest-bridge/vulkan_rasterizer.cpp").read_text()
gen=(root/"tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py").read_text()
needle="bool AccelerateDMA::DmaBufferImageCopy("
a=source.index(needle)
b=source.index("    static constexpr auto sync_info",a)
prefix=source[a:b]
assert prefix==variant[variant.index(needle):variant.index("    static constexpr auto sync_info",variant.index(needle))]
assert "F07 native DMA image byte guard before paired cache mutex" in gen
guard=prefix.index("if (checked_bytes == 0 ||")
lock=prefix.index("std::scoped_lock lock{buffer_cache.mutex, texture_cache.mutex};")
assert guard < lock
assert prefix.count("const u32 buffer_size = ")==2
for flow in (".github/workflows/encore-core-fast-gate.yml",".github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml"):
    assert "python3 -B tools/check-ps5-f07-dma-image-prelock-span-host.py" in (root/flow).read_text()
cpp=r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <mutex>
using u32=std::uint32_t;using u64=std::uint64_t;
namespace Tegra { namespace DMA {
struct ImageCopy {};
struct BufferOperand {u32 pitch{};u32 height{};u64 address{};};
struct ImageOperand {};
} }
namespace VideoCommon { constexpr int NULL_IMAGE_ID=0; }
struct CountingMutex {
    std::mutex owned;
    int requests{};
    void lock(){++requests;owned.lock();}
    bool try_lock(){++requests;return owned.try_lock();}
    void unlock(){owned.unlock();}
};
struct BufferCacheMock {CountingMutex mutex;};
struct TextureCacheMock {
    CountingMutex mutex;
    int looked_up{};
    int DmaImageId(const Tegra::DMA::ImageOperand&,bool) {
        ++looked_up;
        return 1;
    }
};
struct AccelerateDMA {
    BufferCacheMock buffer_cache;
    TextureCacheMock texture_cache;
    template<bool IS_IMAGE_UPLOAD>
    bool DmaBufferImageCopy(const Tegra::DMA::ImageCopy&,
       const Tegra::DMA::BufferOperand&,
       const Tegra::DMA::ImageOperand&);
};
"""+"template <bool IS_IMAGE_UPLOAD>\n"+prefix+"""
    (void)buffer_size;
    (void)copy_info;
    return true;
}
"""+r"""
int main(){
    for(bool upload:{false,true}){
        const auto check=[&](u32 pitch,u32 height,bool valid){
            AccelerateDMA cache;
            Tegra::DMA::BufferOperand buffer{pitch,height,7};
            Tegra::DMA::ImageCopy copy{};
            Tegra::DMA::ImageOperand image{};
            const bool ok=upload?cache.DmaBufferImageCopy<true>(copy,buffer,image)
                                :cache.DmaBufferImageCopy<false>(copy,buffer,image);
            assert(ok==valid);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
            if(!valid){
                assert(cache.buffer_cache.mutex.requests==0);
                assert(cache.texture_cache.mutex.requests==0);
                assert(cache.texture_cache.looked_up==0);
            } else {
                assert(cache.texture_cache.looked_up==1);
                assert(cache.buffer_cache.mutex.requests>0);
            }
#else
            if(!valid)assert(cache.texture_cache.looked_up==1);
#endif
        };
        // Zero-length DMA is rejected before mutexes only on PS5.
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
        check(0,900,false);
        check(8,0,false);
#else
        check(0,900,true);
        check(8,0,true);
#endif
        check(0xffffffffu,2,false);
        check(64,32,true);
    }
}
"""
# The executable below already covers span validation; also pin the distinct
# Vulkan-handle guard and its position before image-cache lookup and upload.
dma_method = source[source.index(needle):source.index("\nbool AccelerateDMA::ImageToBuffer(",source.index(needle))]
dma_mirror = variant[variant.index(needle):variant.index("\nbool AccelerateDMA::ImageToBuffer(",variant.index(needle))]
assert dma_method == dma_mirror
assert dma_method.count("if (!buffer || buffer->Handle() == VK_NULL_HANDLE)") == 1
assert dma_method.index("if (!buffer || buffer->Handle() == VK_NULL_HANDLE)") < dma_method.index("texture_cache.DmaBufferImageCopy(")
assert "F07 DMA image reject null Vulkan handles" in gen
compiler=shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
assert compiler
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="f07-dma-image-prelock-") as folder:
    cppfile=Path(folder)/"dma.cpp"
    cppfile.write_text(cpp)
    for opt in ("-O0","-O2"):
        for native in (True,False):
            exe=Path(folder)/(("native" if native else "desktop")+opt[1:])
            cmd=[compiler,"-std=c++20",opt,"-Wall","-Wextra","-Werror",
                 "-fsanitize=undefined","-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
                 *(["-DPS5_NATIVE=1"] if native else []),str(cppfile),"-o",str(exe)]
            build=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=45)
            assert build.returncode==0,(native,opt,build.stderr[-4000:])
            result=subprocess.run([str(exe)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15)
            assert result.returncode==0,(native,opt,result.stderr[-4000:])

# Execute the exact DMA acquisition/handle guard from the active source. A
# valid guest buffer can still have no Vulkan allocation on PS5.
first="    static constexpr auto sync_info = VideoCommon::ObtainBufferSynchronize::FullSynchronize;"
last="    const auto [image, copy] = texture_cache.DmaBufferImageCopy("
def extract_guard(src):
    begin=src.index(needle)
    return src[src.index(first,begin):src.index(last,begin)]
guard_code=extract_guard(source)
assert guard_code==extract_guard(variant)
assert guard_code.count("if (!buffer || buffer->Handle() == VK_NULL_HANDLE)") == 1
cpp_guard=r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <utility>
#include <initializer_list>
using u32=std::uint32_t;
using u64=std::uint64_t;
inline constexpr int VK_NULL_HANDLE=0;
namespace VideoCommon {
enum class ObtainBufferSynchronize { FullSynchronize };
enum class ObtainBufferOperation { DoNothing, MarkAsWritten };
}
struct Buffer {int handle{9};int Handle()const{return handle;}};
struct BufferCache {
    Buffer* active{};
    std::pair<Buffer*,u32> ObtainBuffer(u64,u32,
        VideoCommon::ObtainBufferSynchronize,VideoCommon::ObtainBufferOperation){
        return {active,0};
    }
};
struct Driver {
    Buffer stored{};
    BufferCache buffer_cache{};
    template<bool IS_IMAGE_UPLOAD> bool Check(bool present,int handle) {
        stored.handle=handle;
        buffer_cache.active=present?&stored:nullptr;
        struct Operand {u64 address{};} buffer_operand{12};
        const u32 buffer_size=48;
""" + guard_code + r"""
        (void)offset;
        return true;
    }
};
int main(){
    for (bool upload:{true,false}) {
        const auto check=[&](bool present,int handle){
            Driver driver;
            return upload?driver.Check<true>(present,handle):
                          driver.Check<false>(present,handle);
        };
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
        assert(!check(false,9));
        assert(!check(true,VK_NULL_HANDLE));
#endif
        assert(check(true,9));
    }
}
"""
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="f07-dma-handle-") as folder:
    src=Path(folder)/"guard.cpp"
    src.write_text(cpp_guard)
    for opt in ("-O0","-O2"):

            flags=["-DPS5_NATIVE=1"] if native else []
            build=subprocess.run(
                [compiler,"-std=c++20",opt,"-Wall","-Wextra","-Werror",
                 "-fsanitize=undefined","-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
                 *flags,str(src),"-o",str(exe)],
                capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=45)
            assert build.returncode==0,(native,opt,build.stderr[-6000:])
            run=subprocess.run([str(exe)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15)
            assert run.returncode==0,(native,opt,run.stderr[-5000:])
print("F07_DMA_IMAGE_HANDLE_PASS ps5_null_pointer=1 ps5_null_vk_handle=1 both_directions=1 desktop_valid=1 O0=1 O2=1 UBSan=1")

print("F07_DMA_IMAGE_PRELOCK_SPAN_PASS native=1 desktop=1 O0=1 O2=1 zero=1 overflow=1 valid=1 paired_mutex_skipped=1")
```

`tools/check-ps5-f07-download-staging-runtime-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Replay the actual Vulkan readback staging guard in native/desktop builds."""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
src=(root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vk_texture_cache_cost.cpp").read_text()
gen=(root/"tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py").read_text()
start=src.index("StagingBufferRef TextureCacheRuntime::DownloadStagingBuffer(size_t size, bool deferred) {")
end=src.index("\n\nvoid TextureCacheRuntime::FreeDeferredStagingBuffer(",start)
method=src[start:end]
assert "F07 reject invalid Vulkan guest readback staging in runtime" in gen
assert "if (!map.buffer || map.mapped_span.size_bytes() < size)" in method
assert "if (deferred && map.buffer) staging_buffer_pool.FreeDeferred(map);" in method
assert "throw std::bad_alloc{};" in method
for flow in (".github/workflows/encore-core-fast-gate.yml",".github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml"):
    assert "python3 -B tools/check-ps5-f07-download-staging-runtime-host.py" in (root/flow).read_text()
cpp=r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstddef>
#include <new>
#include <span>
#include <vector>
enum class MemoryUsage {Download};
struct StagingBufferRef {
    std::uintptr_t buffer{};
    std::span<std::uint8_t> mapped_span{};
};
struct Pool {
    bool null_buffer{}, short_map{}, fail_request{};
    int releases{};
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> backing;
    StagingBufferRef Request(std::size_t count,MemoryUsage usage,bool deferred) {
        assert(usage==MemoryUsage::Download);
        (void)deferred;
        if(fail_request)throw std::bad_alloc{};
        backing.resize(count);
        return {null_buffer ? 0u : 1u,
                {backing.data(),count-(short_map && count ? 1u : 0u)}};
    }
    void FreeDeferred(StagingBufferRef& ref) {
        assert(ref.buffer);
        ++releases;
    }
};
struct TextureCacheRuntime {
    Pool staging_buffer_pool;
    StagingBufferRef DownloadStagingBuffer(std::size_t size,bool deferred);
};
__METHOD__
int main() {
    TextureCacheRuntime good;
    auto map=good.DownloadStagingBuffer(256,false);
    assert(map.buffer && map.mapped_span.size()==256);
    TextureCacheRuntime null_map;
    null_map.staging_buffer_pool.null_buffer=true;
    bool threw=false;
    try{(void)null_map.DownloadStagingBuffer(256,true);}catch(const std::bad_alloc&){threw=true;}
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(threw && null_map.staging_buffer_pool.releases==0);
#else
    assert(!threw && null_map.staging_buffer_pool.releases==0);
#endif
    TextureCacheRuntime short_deferred;
    short_deferred.staging_buffer_pool.short_map=true;
    threw=false;
    try{(void)short_deferred.DownloadStagingBuffer(256,true);}catch(const std::bad_alloc&){threw=true;}
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(threw && short_deferred.staging_buffer_pool.releases==1);
#else
    assert(!threw && short_deferred.staging_buffer_pool.releases==0);
#endif
    TextureCacheRuntime short_immediate;
    short_immediate.staging_buffer_pool.short_map=true;
    threw=false;
    try{(void)short_immediate.DownloadStagingBuffer(256,false);}catch(const std::bad_alloc&){threw=true;}
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(threw && short_immediate.staging_buffer_pool.releases==0);
#else
    assert(!threw && short_immediate.staging_buffer_pool.releases==0);
#endif
    TextureCacheRuntime failed;
    failed.staging_buffer_pool.fail_request=true;
    threw=false;
    try{(void)failed.DownloadStagingBuffer(256,true);}catch(const std::bad_alloc&){threw=true;}
    assert(threw && failed.staging_buffer_pool.releases==0);
}
""".replace("__METHOD__",method)
compiler=shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
assert compiler,"No C++20 compiler"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-f07-runtime-staging-") as directory:
```

```py
    PipelineCache normal;
    normal.QueueVulkanPipelineCacheFlush();
    assert(!normal.flush_in_flight.load());
    assert(normal.last_cache_size.load()==128);
    assert(normal.pipelines_since_flush==0);
    // Time gate must remain intact even after threshold reached.
    normal.pipelines_since_flush=127;
    normal.QueueVulkanPipelineCacheFlush();
    assert(normal.pipelines_since_flush==128);
    PipelineCache io;

    io.QueueVulkanPipelineCacheFlush();

    assert(io.last_cache_size.load()==0); // original time gate still active
    assert(!io.flush_worker_failed.load());
    io.last_flush-=std::chrono::seconds(31);
#else
    io.vulkan_pipeline_cache.throw_read=false;
    io.pipelines_since_flush=127;

    assert(io.pipelines_since_flush==0);

    queue.QueueVulkanPipelineCacheFlush();
    assert(queue.pipelines_since_flush==0 && queue.last_cache_size.load()==128);
```

```py
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdio>
#include <thread>
struct FakeVkPipeline {
    bool valid{};
    explicit operator bool() const noexcept { return valid; }
};
struct GraphicsPipeline {
    FakeVkPipeline pipeline{};
    std::atomic_bool is_built{false};
    std::atomic_bool optimized_ready{false};
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    bool worker_draw_bind_valid{};
#endif
    unsigned optimized_driver_handle{};
__ACTUAL_ADMISSION__
};
int main() {
    GraphicsPipeline p;
    assert(!p.CanExecuteDraw());
    p.pipeline.valid = true;
    assert(!p.CanExecuteDraw());  // build not yet published
    p.is_built.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    assert(p.CanExecuteDraw());   // primary pipeline works on both targets
    p.pipeline.valid = false;
    assert(!p.CanExecuteDraw());  // no valid pipeline at all

    // A background compiler can publish the replacement after the original
    // fast-first pipeline failed. The reader must acquire its handle safely.
    std::thread builder([&] {
        p.optimized_driver_handle = 0xBEEF;
        p.optimized_ready.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    });
    // Join is deterministic and synchronizes the mock driver's published
    // handle. The separate FIFO test below covers the earlier/later
    // ConfigureDraw race without a timing-dependent busy-spin.
    builder.join();
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(p.optimized_driver_handle == 0xBEEF && p.CanExecuteDraw());
#else
    assert(!p.CanExecuteDraw());  // desktop behavior remains unchanged
#endif
    p.is_built.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
    assert(!p.CanExecuteDraw());  // worker never submits a build in progress
    std::puts("F07_OPTIMIZED_RECOVERY_DRAW_PASS");
}
""".replace("__ACTUAL_ADMISSION__", admission)

fifo_cpp = r"""
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdio>
struct FakeVkPipeline {
    bool valid{};
    int value{};
    explicit operator bool() const noexcept { return valid; }
    int operator*() const { assert(valid); return value; }
};
constexpr int VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS = 0;
struct FakeCmd {
    int bound{};
    unsigned binds{};
    void BindPipeline(int, int value) { bound = value; ++binds; }
};
namespace Eden::Performance {
enum class GraphicsDrawDrop { WorkerPipelineFailed };
inline unsigned failed{};
inline void RecordGraphicsDrawDrop(GraphicsDrawDrop) { ++failed; }
}
struct GraphicsPipeline {
    FakeVkPipeline pipeline{}, optimized_pipeline{};
    std::atomic_bool is_built{true}, optimized_ready{false};
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    bool worker_draw_bind_valid{};
#endif
__ACTUAL_ADMISSION__
    void BindRecorded(FakeCmd& cmdbuf, bool bind_pipeline,
                      bool optimized_at_record) {
__ACTUAL_WORKER_BODY__
    }
};
int main() {
    GraphicsPipeline p;
    FakeCmd cmdbuf;
    assert(!p.CanExecuteRecordedDraw());
    p.BindRecorded(cmdbuf, true, false);
    assert(cmdbuf.binds == 0);
    assert(!p.CanExecuteRecordedDraw());
    // Later driver success is NOT a retroactive bind for the previous Draw.
    p.optimized_pipeline.valid = true;
    p.optimized_pipeline.value = 0xBEEF;
    p.optimized_ready.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(p.CanExecuteDraw() && !p.CanExecuteRecordedDraw());
#else
    assert(!p.CanExecuteDraw() && !p.CanExecuteRecordedDraw());
#endif
    // Next FIFO ConfigureDraw detects the newly published variant and binds it.
    p.BindRecorded(cmdbuf, false, false);
    assert(cmdbuf.binds == 1 && cmdbuf.bound == 0xBEEF);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(p.CanExecuteRecordedDraw());
#else
    assert(!p.CanExecuteRecordedDraw());
#endif
    // A valid initial Vulkan build is also a legal selection.
    p.optimized_ready.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
    p.pipeline.valid = true;
    p.pipeline.value = 0x1234;
    p.BindRecorded(cmdbuf, true, false);
    assert(cmdbuf.binds == 2 && cmdbuf.bound == 0x1234);
    assert(p.CanExecuteRecordedDraw());
    // Recheck failure on every ConfigureDraw: an earlier successful bind does
    // not entitle an invalid later command to reuse that old VkPipeline.
    p.pipeline.valid = false;
    p.BindRecorded(cmdbuf, true, false);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(!p.CanExecuteRecordedDraw());
#else
    assert(!p.CanExecuteRecordedDraw());
#endif
    assert(Eden::Performance::failed == 2);
    std::puts("F07_RECOVERED_WORKER_FIFO_BIND_PASS");
}
""".replace("__ACTUAL_ADMISSION__", admission).replace(
    "__ACTUAL_WORKER_BODY__", worker_segment)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-f07-recovered-worker-") as directory:
    path = Path(directory) / "recovered.cpp"
    path.write_text(fifo_cpp)
    for define in ([], ["-DPS5_NATIVE=1"]):
        for opt in ("-O0", "-O2"):
            binary = Path(directory) / ("fifo" + opt[1:] +
                                        ("-native" if define else "-desktop"))
            built = subprocess.run(
                [compiler, "-std=c++20", opt, "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror",

            ran = subprocess.run([str(binary)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)
```

```py
"""F07 C01/C03: actual frame-housekeeping lock-owner and wait phase fixture.

The frame callback retains texture-then-buffer lock ordering, no lock widening,

#include <array>
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>
namespace Common {
struct Clock {
    std::chrono::nanoseconds GetTimeNS() const {
        return std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(
            std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch());
    }
};
inline Clock g_wall_clock;
}
namespace Eden::Performance {
inline std::atomic<bool> detailed_gpu_profile{false};
__PHASE_SOURCE__
}
struct Tracker {
    std::mutex inner;
    std::atomic_bool held{false};
    void lock() {
        inner.lock();
        held.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    }
    void unlock() {
        held.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
        inner.unlock();
    }
};
struct SmallManager {
    std::vector<int>* sequence{};
    int number{};
    void TickFrame() { sequence->push_back(number); }
};
struct Cache {
    Tracker mutex;
    std::vector<int>* sequence{};
    int number{};
    void TickFrame() {
        assert(mutex.held.load(std::memory_order_acquire));
        sequence->push_back(number);
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::microseconds(150));
    }
};
class RasterizerVulkan {
public:
    int draw_counter{13};
    std::vector<int> sequence;
    SmallManager guest_descriptor_queue{&sequence, 1};
    SmallManager compute_pass_descriptor_queue{&sequence, 2};
    SmallManager descriptor_buffer_ring{&sequence, 3};
    SmallManager fence_manager{&sequence, 4};
    SmallManager staging_pool{&sequence, 5};
    Cache texture_cache{{}, &sequence, 6};
    Cache buffer_cache{{}, &sequence, 7};
    void TickFrame();
};
__REAL_TICK__
int main() {
    RasterizerVulkan raster;
    using namespace Eden::Performance;
    const auto samples = [](CachePhase phase) {
        return cache_phase_totals[static_cast<unsigned>(phase)].samples.load();
    };
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; ++i) raster.TickFrame();
    assert(raster.draw_counter == 0);
    assert(raster.sequence.size() == 16 * 7);
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 7; ++j) assert(raster.sequence[7*i+j] == j+1);
    }
    assert(samples(CachePhase::FrameTextureWait) == 0);
    assert(samples(CachePhase::FrameTextureHeld) == 0);
    assert(samples(CachePhase::FrameBufferWait) == 0);
    assert(samples(CachePhase::FrameBufferHeld) == 0);
    detailed_gpu_profile.store(true);
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; ++i) raster.TickFrame();
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(samples(CachePhase::FrameTextureWait) == 1);
    assert(samples(CachePhase::FrameTextureHeld) == 1);
    assert(samples(CachePhase::FrameBufferWait) == 1);
    assert(samples(CachePhase::FrameBufferHeld) == 1);
    assert(cache_phase_totals[static_cast<unsigned>(CachePhase::FrameTextureHeld)]
               .total_ns.load() > 0);
    assert(cache_phase_totals[static_cast<unsigned>(CachePhase::FrameBufferHeld)]
               .total_ns.load() > 0);
    // Next sampled frame: a real, independent holder blocks the acquisition.
    // Never unlock a std::mutex from a thread other than its owner.
    for (int i = 0; i < 15; ++i) raster.TickFrame();
    std::atomic_bool holding{false};
    std::thread holder([&] {
        raster.texture_cache.mutex.lock();
        holding.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(5));
        raster.texture_cache.mutex.unlock();
    });
    while (!holding.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) std::this_thread::yield();
    raster.TickFrame();
    holder.join();
    assert(samples(CachePhase::FrameTextureWait) == 2);
    assert(cache_phase_totals[static_cast<unsigned>(CachePhase::FrameTextureWait)]
               .max_ns.load() >= 2'000'000);
#else
    assert(samples(CachePhase::FrameTextureWait) == 0);
    assert(samples(CachePhase::FrameBufferHeld) == 0);
#endif
    detailed_gpu_profile.store(false);
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; ++i) raster.TickFrame();
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(samples(CachePhase::FrameTextureWait) == 2);
#endif
}
""".replace("__PHASE_SOURCE__", phase_source).replace("__REAL_TICK__", body)
```

`tools/check-ps5-f07-gc-pressure-probe-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Execute the PS5 native texture-GC pressure decision extracted from production.

This proves the maximum probe count, bounded refresh, critical bypass, and
post-eviction reset. It does not measure driver latency or console FPS.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
header = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan-cache/video_core/texture_cache/texture_cache.h").read_text()
generator = (root / "tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py").read_text()
start = header.index("void TextureCache<P>::RunGarbageCollector() {")
end = header.index("\ntemplate <class P>", start)
gc = header[start:end]
begin = gc.index("    constexpr unsigned kDirtyProbeReuse = 8;")
end = gc.index("\n#endif", begin)
decision = gc[begin:end]
assert "dirty_probe_remaining = kDirtyProbeReuse;" in decision
assert "total_used_memory >= critical_memory" in decision
assert gc.count("dirty_probe_remaining = 0;") == 3  # initial, after eviction, critical pass
assert "must_download && !DirtyEvictionsForCleanup()" in gc
assert "must_download && !DirtyEvictions()" in gc  # desktop remains untouched
assert "Pinned native GC pressure-probe anchor changed" in generator
assert "F07 bound native dirty GC pressure checks after clean-image rewrite" in generator
assert "gc = gc.replace(old, new)" in generator

compiler = next((x for x in ("clang++-18", "clang++", "g++") if shutil.which(x)), None)
if not compiler:
    raise SystemExit("Missing C++20 compiler")
cpp = r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
namespace Eden::Performance {
static unsigned calls = 0;
static bool keep_dirty = true;
bool KeepDirtyTextures() { ++calls; return keep_dirty; }
}
int main() {
    bool high_priority_mode = false;
    std::uint64_t total_used_memory = 90;
    const std::uint64_t critical_memory = 100;
""" + decision + r"""
    using Eden::Performance::calls;
    using Eden::Performance::keep_dirty;
    for (int i = 0; i < 64; ++i) assert(!DirtyEvictionsForCleanup());
    assert(calls == 0);
    high_priority_mode = true;
    keep_dirty = true;
    for (int i = 0; i < 32; ++i) assert(!DirtyEvictionsForCleanup());
    assert(calls == 4); // one kernel-backed probe per eight skipped candidates
    keep_dirty = false;
    assert(DirtyEvictionsForCleanup()); // next visit must refresh
    assert(calls == 5);
    for (int i = 0; i < 7; ++i) assert(DirtyEvictionsForCleanup());
    assert(calls == 5);
    // The production deletion path resets this budget after each eviction.
    dirty_probe_remaining = 0;
    keep_dirty = true;
    assert(!DirtyEvictionsForCleanup());
    assert(calls == 6);
    total_used_memory = critical_memory;
    for (int i = 0; i < 64; ++i) assert(DirtyEvictionsForCleanup());
    assert(calls == 6); // critical memory never trusts a cached keep decision
    total_used_memory = 90;
    dirty_probe_remaining = 0; // production critical-pass boundary
    keep_dirty = false;
    assert(DirtyEvictionsForCleanup());
    assert(calls == 7);
    return 0;
}
"""
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="f07-gc-pressure-") as tmp:
    src = Path(tmp) / "pressure.cpp"
    src.write_text(cpp)

                        "-fno-sanitize-recover=all", str(src), "-o", str(exe)],
                       check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
        subprocess.run([str(exe)], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
print("F07_GC_PRESSURE_PROBE_PASS")
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""F07 P0.3: compile actual Vulkan GC projected-eviction lambdas.

Regression for the ImageBase->Image type mismatch in the GC prefetch
accounting path. Checks source/oracle parity, old-code negative compilation,
scaled/transcoded accounting and desktop/PS5 O0/O2 with UBSan. Host only.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
source = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan-cache/video_core/texture_cache/texture_cache.h").read_text()
oracle = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan-oracles/vulkan_gc_downloads.inc").read_text()
generator = (root / "tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py").read_text()


def extract(text, marker, terminator):
    assert text.count(marker) == 1, f"missing/duplicate {marker}"
    start = text.index(marker)
    end = text.index(terminator, start) + len(terminator)
    return text[start:end]
```

```py
        assert(reused.Views().capacity() >= 384);
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""F07 C02: compile actual FillImageViews with stable, remapped and dirty HUD views.

This test must retain PrepareImageView on nonadjacent TIC memo hits; avoiding
the lookup does not justify skipping a modified guest image refresh. It also
exercises the existing retry/blacklist behavior, empty latch reset, and
desktop original algorithm using the *source-extracted* method, O0/O2 UBSan.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
file = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan-cache/video_core/texture_cache/texture_cache.h").read_text()
begin = file.index("void TextureCache<P>::FillImageViews(std::span<ImageViewInOut> views, bool compute, bool blacklist) {")
end = file.index("\n}\n", begin) + 2
actual = file[begin:end]
assert "if (views.empty()) {" in actual
assert "has_deleted_images = false;" in actual
assert "std::array<ViewMemo, 16> view_memo;" in actual
assert "u32 occupied_view_slots = 0;" in actual
assert "const bool memo_enabled = !blacklist && views.size() > 1;" in actual
assert "occupied_view_slots |= memo_bit;" in actual
assert "memo_slot && !has_deleted_images && view.id != NULL_IMAGE_VIEW_ID" in actual
assert "cached_view.IsBuffer()" in actual
assert "ImageFlagBits::Remapped" in actual
assert "PrepareImageView(cached.id, false, false);" in actual
assert "view.id = VisitImageView(view.index, compute);" in actual
assert "has_deleted_images || (blacklist && has_blacklisted)" in actual

code = r"""
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <span>
#include <optional>
#include <vector>
using u32 = std::uint32_t;
using ImageViewId = u32;
using ImageId = u32;
constexpr ImageViewId NULL_IMAGE_VIEW_ID{};
enum class ImageFlagBits : u32 { Remapped = 1 };
bool True(ImageFlagBits flags) { return static_cast<u32>(flags) != 0; }
ImageFlagBits operator&(u32 flags, ImageFlagBits bit) {
    return static_cast<ImageFlagBits>(flags & static_cast<u32>(bit));
}
struct ImageViewInOut {
    u32 index{};
    bool blacklist{};
    ImageViewId id{};
};
struct ImageViewBase {
    ImageId image_id{};
    bool is_buffer{};
    bool IsBuffer() const { return is_buffer; }
};
struct Image { u32 flags{}; u32 scale_rating{}; };
template<class P>
class TextureCache {
public:
    bool has_deleted_images = false;
    std::vector<ImageViewBase> slot_image_views{{}, {1}, {2}, {3}};
    std::vector<Image> slot_images{{}, {}, {}, {}};
    unsigned visit_calls{}, prepare_calls{}, refreshes{}, scales{};
    bool one_deleted_retry{}, one_blacklist_retry{};
    ImageViewId VisitImageView(u32 index, bool compute) {
        assert(index > 0 && index < 4);
        (void)compute;
        ++visit_calls;
        if (one_deleted_retry) {
            one_deleted_retry = false;
            has_deleted_images = true;
        }
        PrepareImageView(index, false, false);
        return index;
    }
    void PrepareImageView(ImageViewId id, bool, bool) {
        assert(id != NULL_IMAGE_VIEW_ID);
        ++prepare_calls;
        if (slot_images[slot_image_views[id].image_id].flags)
            ++refreshes;
    }
    bool ScaleDown(Image&) {
        ++scales;
        if (one_blacklist_retry) {
            one_blacklist_retry = false;
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
    void FillImageViews(std::span<ImageViewInOut> views, bool compute, bool blacklist);
};
template <class P>
__ACTUAL_FILL__
struct Mock {};
int main() {
    TextureCache<Mock> texture;
    std::array<ImageViewInOut, 4> repeated{{{1}, {2}, {1}, {2}}};
    texture.FillImageViews(repeated, false, false);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(texture.visit_calls == 2); // nonadjacent TIC lookup reuse
    assert(texture.prepare_calls == 4); // NEVER elide freshness preparation
#else
    assert(texture.visit_calls == 4 && texture.prepare_calls == 4);
#endif
    for (auto view : repeated) assert(view.id == view.index);
    texture.visit_calls = texture.prepare_calls = texture.refreshes = 0;
    texture.slot_images[1].flags = 1; // remapped guest texture
    std::array<ImageViewInOut, 3> remapped{{{1}, {2}, {1}}};
    texture.FillImageViews(remapped, false, false);
    assert(texture.visit_calls == 3); // memo cannot reuse remapped view
    assert(texture.refreshes == 2);
    texture.slot_images[1].flags = 0;
    texture.visit_calls = texture.prepare_calls = 0;
    texture.one_deleted_retry = true;
    std::array<ImageViewInOut, 2> deleted{{{1}, {2}}};
    texture.FillImageViews(deleted, false, false);
    assert(!texture.has_deleted_images);
    assert(texture.visit_calls == 4); // complete restart after deletion
    texture.one_blacklist_retry = true;
    texture.scales = texture.visit_calls = 0;
    std::array<ImageViewInOut, 2> blacklist{{{1,true}, {1,true}}};
    texture.FillImageViews(blacklist, false, true);
    assert(texture.scales == 4); // both iterations apply blacklist
    assert(texture.visit_calls == 4); // no unsafe memo reuse under blacklist
    texture.has_deleted_images = true;
    texture.visit_calls = 0;
    std::span<ImageViewInOut> empty;
    texture.FillImageViews(empty, false, false);
    assert(!texture.has_deleted_images);
    assert(texture.visit_calls == 0);
}
""".replace("__ACTUAL_FILL__", actual)
compiler = shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
assert compiler, "C++20 compiler required"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="f07-hud-tic-freshness-") as tmp:
    src = Path(tmp) / "fill.cpp"
    src.write_text(code)
    for native in (False, True):

            exe = Path(tmp) / f"{'ps5' if native else 'desktop'}-{opt[1:]}"
            build = subprocess.run(
```

```py
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>
#include <mutex>
#include <optional>
#include <span>
#include <vector>
#include "buffer_pages.h"
#include "image_pages.h"
using u8=std::uint8_t;
using u64=std::uint64_t;
using DAddr=u64;
using GPUVAddr=u64;
struct MockMemory {
    std::vector<u8> bytes=std::vector<u8>(2*1024*1024,0);
    bool mapped=true;
    unsigned unsafe_writes=0, fallback_writes=0;
    std::optional<DAddr> GpuToCpuAddress(GPUVAddr a) {
        return mapped ? std::optional<DAddr>{a} : std::nullopt;
    }
    void WriteBlock(GPUVAddr a,const void* src,std::size_t size) {
        assert(a<=bytes.size() && size<=bytes.size()-a);
        std::memcpy(bytes.data()+a,src,size);
        ++fallback_writes;
    }
    void WriteBlockUnsafe(GPUVAddr a,const void* src,std::size_t size) {
        assert(a<=bytes.size() && size<=bytes.size()-a);
        std::memcpy(bytes.data()+a,src,size);
        ++unsafe_writes;
    }
};
struct BufferCache {
    std::recursive_mutex mutex;
    MockMemory* memory{};
    unsigned inline_calls=0, writes=0;
    bool inline_accepted=false;
    bool InlineMemory(DAddr a,std::size_t size,std::span<const u8> bytes) {
        ++inline_calls;
        // Both first and subsequent inline DMA writes reach guest RAM first.
        assert(memory && memory->unsafe_writes>=1);
        assert(std::equal(bytes.begin(),bytes.begin()+size,memory->bytes.begin()+a));
        return inline_accepted;
    }
    void WriteMemory(DAddr,std::size_t) {++writes;}
};
struct TextureCache {
    std::recursive_mutex mutex;
    unsigned writes=0;
    void WriteMemory(DAddr,std::size_t) {++writes;}
};
struct Cache {
    unsigned writes=0;
    void InvalidateRegion(DAddr,std::size_t) {++writes;}
};
struct RasterizerVulkan {
    MockMemory storage;
    MockMemory* gpu_memory=&storage;
    BufferCache buffer_cache;
    TextureCache texture_cache;
    Cache pipeline_cache,query_cache;
    RasterizerVulkan() {buffer_cache.memory=&storage;}
    void AccelerateInlineToMemory(GPUVAddr,std::size_t,std::span<const u8>);
};
""" + selected + r"""

    constexpr DAddr formerly=0x20000;

    assert(fresh.storage.unsafe_writes==1 && fresh.storage.fallback_writes==0);

    // Old ownership is monotonic even after the GPU slot is evicted.

    assert(huge.pipeline_cache.writes==1 && huge.query_cache.writes==1);
```

```py
"""F07 V01: compile the actual native/desktop FIFO worker-wait callbacks.

Do not infer PS5 game stalls from these simulated build completions.
"""

import shutil
import subprocess

cpp = r"""
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <chrono>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <functional>
#include <mutex>
#include <optional>
#include <thread>
#include <utility>
using u64 = std::uint64_t;
namespace vk { struct CommandBuffer {}; }
namespace Eden::Performance {
inline std::atomic_bool detailed_gpu_profile{false};
enum class CachePhase { GraphicsPipelineWait, ComputePipelineWait };
struct Timer { ~Timer() {} };
inline std::optional<Timer> VulkanTimer(unsigned) { return std::optional<Timer>{std::in_place}; }
struct CachePhaseTimer {
    explicit CachePhaseTimer(CachePhase, bool) {}
    void Stop() noexcept {}
};
__REAL_TRACE__
}
struct Scheduler {
    std::function<void(vk::CommandBuffer)> callback;
    template<class F> void Record(F&& f) { callback = std::forward<F>(f); }
    void Run() { callback(vk::CommandBuffer{}); }
};
struct Key {
    std::size_t Hash() const noexcept { return 0x1234; }
};
struct Pipeline {
    Scheduler scheduler;
    std::atomic_bool is_built{false};
    std::mutex build_mutex;
    std::condition_variable build_condvar;
    Key key;
    u64 diagnostic_cache_key_hash{0xabcd};
    bool bound{true};
    std::function<void()> on_before_lock = [] {};
    std::function<void()> on_before_wait = [] {};
    bool CanExecuteDraw() const {
        return is_built.load(std::memory_order_acquire) && bound;
    }
    bool IsBound() const { return bound; }
    void Queue() {
        if (is_built.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) return;
__ACTUAL_CALLBACK__
    }
    void Publish() {
        { std::lock_guard lock{build_mutex};
          is_built.store(true, std::memory_order_release); }
        build_condvar.notify_all();
    }
};
int main() {
    using Eden::Performance::detailed_gpu_profile;
    // Quiet mode may wait, but must never add a wall-clock log.
    {
        Pipeline quiet;
        quiet.Queue();
        std::thread publisher([&]{ std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(4)); quiet.Publish(); });
        quiet.scheduler.Run();
        publisher.join();
    }
    detailed_gpu_profile.store(true);
    // Published after Record but before callback -> no actual blocking wait.
    {
        Pipeline already;
        already.Queue();
        already.Publish();
        already.scheduler.Run();
        assert(already.IsBound());
    }
    // The injected pre-lock publication hook exists only in the native branch.
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    // Publication between the first acquire and the mutex must not emit a false wait.
    {
        Pipeline raced;
        raced.Queue();
        raced.on_before_lock = [&] { raced.Publish(); };
        raced.scheduler.Run();
        assert(raced.IsBound());
    }
#endif
    // Publication really delayed while callback executes.
    {
        Pipeline blocked;
        blocked.Queue();
        std::thread publisher([&] { std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(6)); blocked.Publish(); });
        blocked.scheduler.Run();
        publisher.join();
    }
    // Failure must still publish and release waiting worker; usable=0.
    {
        Pipeline rejected;
        rejected.bound = false;
        rejected.Queue();
        std::thread publisher([&] { std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(5)); rejected.Publish(); });
        rejected.scheduler.Run();
        publisher.join();
    }
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    // Force a real build_mutex wait *before* the condition wait. The owner
    // stays locked until the measured callback reaches its pre-lock hook.
    // A timer incorrectly started AFTER mutex acquisition would undercount
    // this 14-ms phase as only the subsequent 9-ms builder delay.
    {
        Pipeline contended;
        contended.Queue();
        std::atomic<bool> holder_ready{false};
        std::atomic<bool> caller_at_lock{false};
        std::thread holder([&] {
            std::unique_lock mutex_hold{contended.build_mutex};
            holder_ready.store(true,std::memory_order_release);
            holder_ready.notify_one();
            caller_at_lock.wait(false,std::memory_order_acquire);
            std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(14));
        });
        holder_ready.wait(false,std::memory_order_acquire);
        contended.on_before_lock = [&] {
            caller_at_lock.store(true,std::memory_order_release);
            caller_at_lock.notify_one();
        };
        std::atomic<bool> callback_at_wait{false};
        contended.on_before_wait = [&] {
            callback_at_wait.store(true,std::memory_order_release);
            callback_at_wait.notify_one();
        };
        std::thread publisher([&] {
            holder.join();
            // Do not publish before the callback has passed its second
            // acquire check: otherwise the fast path can return without
            // a condition wait and this fixture would be schedule-dependent.
            callback_at_wait.wait(false,std::memory_order_acquire);
            std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(9));
            contended.Publish();
        });
        contended.scheduler.Run();
        publisher.join();
    }
    // A shader builder may finish WHILE the GPU worker waits for its mutex.
    // A real 14ms mutex stall must be traced without a condition wait.
    {
        Pipeline published_under_mutex;
        published_under_mutex.Queue();
        std::atomic<bool> locked{false};
        std::atomic<bool> gpu_at_mutex{false};
        std::thread publisher([&] {
            std::unique_lock hold{published_under_mutex.build_mutex};
            locked.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
            locked.notify_one();
            gpu_at_mutex.wait(false, std::memory_order_acquire);
            std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(14));
            published_under_mutex.is_built.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
            hold.unlock();
            published_under_mutex.build_condvar.notify_all();
        });
        locked.wait(false, std::memory_order_acquire);
        published_under_mutex.on_before_lock = [&] {
            gpu_at_mutex.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
            gpu_at_mutex.notify_one();
        };
        published_under_mutex.on_before_wait = [&] {assert(false);};
        published_under_mutex.scheduler.Run();
        publisher.join();
        assert(published_under_mutex.IsBound());
    }
#endif
    detailed_gpu_profile.store(false);
    {
        Pipeline no_work;
        no_work.Publish();
        no_work.Queue();
        assert(!no_work.scheduler.callback);
    }
}
""".replace("__REAL_TRACE__", trace)

compiler = shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="f07-v01-worker-keyed-") as tmp:

        source = Path(tmp) / f"{kind}.cpp"
        source.write_text(cpp.replace("__ACTUAL_CALLBACK__", callback.replace(
            "            std::unique_lock lock{build_mutex};",
            "            on_before_lock();\n            std::unique_lock lock{build_mutex};", 1).replace(
            "            build_condvar.wait(lock,",
            "            on_before_wait();\n            build_condvar.wait(lock,", 1)))
        for native in (False, True):
            for opt in ("-O0", "-O2"):
                exe = Path(tmp) / f"{kind}-{'ps5' if native else 'desktop'}-{opt[1:]}"
                cmd = [compiler, "-std=c++20", opt, "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror",
                       "-pthread", "-fsanitize=undefined", "-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
                       *(["-DPS5_NATIVE=1"] if native else []),
                       str(source), "-o", str(exe)]
                build = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=45)
                assert build.returncode == 0, (kind, native, opt, build.stderr[-4000:])
                out = subprocess.run([str(exe)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)
                assert out.returncode == 0, (kind, native, opt, out.stderr[-3000:])
                lines = [line for line in out.stdout.splitlines()
                         if line.startswith("EDEN_VULKAN_PIPELINE_WAIT ")]
                if native:
                    assert len(lines) == 4, (kind, opt, lines)
                    assert all(f"kind={kind}" in line for line in lines)
                    expected_key = "0000000000001234" if kind == "graphics" else "000000000000abcd"
                    assert all(f"key={expected_key}" in line for line in lines)
                    assert "usable=1" in lines[0]
                    assert "usable=0" in lines[1]
                    assert "usable=1" in lines[2]
                    assert "usable=1" in lines[3]
                    assert all(int(line.split("wait_ns=")[1].split()[0]) > 0 for line in lines)
                    # The new recorded wait combines the forced 14ms mutex
                    # ownership plus 9ms condition wait; the old trace only
                    # saw the latter. Use a conservative >=12ms floor.
                    assert int(lines[2].split("wait_ns=")[1].split()[0]) >= 12_000_000
                    for item in lines:
                        total = int(item.split("wait_ns=")[1].split()[0])
                        mutex = int(item.split("mutex_ns=")[1].split()[0])
                        post = int(item.split("post_mutex_ns=")[1].split()[0])
                        assert total == mutex + post, (kind, opt, item)
                    assert int(lines[2].split("mutex_ns=")[1].split()[0]) >= 12_000_000
                    assert int(lines[2].split("post_mutex_ns=")[1].split()[0]) >= 1_000_000
                    assert int(lines[3].split("mutex_ns=")[1].split()[0]) >= 12_000_000
                else:
                    assert not lines, (kind, opt, lines)
                print(f"F07_KEYED_PIPELINE_WAIT_PASS kind={kind} native={int(native)} {opt}")
print("HOST_ONLY no Sony SDK, real GPU worker, FIFO timing in FC27 or frame latency proof")
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""S01: compile actual per-key cold-shader phase timer and RAII attribution.

Host-only test. Native mode changes diagnostic attribution, not CPU scheduling,
Vulkan worker fences, shader outputs, or the quiet path.

from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

pipeline = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vk_pipeline_cache_cost.cpp").read_text()

stage_start = perf.index("struct ShaderMissStageCosts {")
stage_end = perf.index("inline thread_local ShaderMissStageCosts* shader_miss_stage_active{};", stage_start)
stage_end += len("inline thread_local ShaderMissStageCosts* shader_miss_stage_active{};")

timer_end = perf.index("\n};", timer_start) + len("\n};")

trace_end = pipeline.index("\n};\n#endif", trace_start) + len("\n};")
real_trace = pipeline[trace_start:trace_end]

assert real_trace in gen
assert "shader_miss_stage_active" in real_trace
assert "if (!enabled) return;" in real_trace
assert "std::chrono::steady_clock::now()" in real_trace
assert "shader_miss_stage_active = previous;" in real_trace
assert "EDEN_VULKAN_SHADER_MISS kind=%s key=%016llx" in real_trace
assert "env_ns=%llu pool_ns=%llu" in real_trace
assert "cfg_ns=%llu ir_ns=%llu spirv_ns=%llu module_ns=%llu" in real_trace
assert "phase(phase)" in real_timer
assert "if (auto* const keyed = shader_miss_stage_active)" in real_timer
for name in ("GraphicsShaderEnvironment", "ShaderPoolReset", "ShaderCfg", "ShaderIr",
             "ShaderSpirv", "ShaderModule"):
    assert "case CachePhase::" + name + ":" in real_timer, name
assert "stats->total_ns.fetch_add(ns, std::memory_order_relaxed);" in real_timer
assert "std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point" in real_trace
assert "stages: tuple[int, int, int, int, int, int] | None = None" in analyzer

cpp = r"""
#include <array>
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdint>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <string>
using u64 = std::uint64_t;

namespace Common {
struct FakeClock {
    std::chrono::nanoseconds now{};
    [[nodiscard]] std::chrono::nanoseconds GetTimeNS() const { return now; }
};
inline FakeClock g_wall_clock;
}
namespace Eden::Performance {
enum class CachePhase : unsigned {
    GraphicsShaderEnvironment, ShaderPoolReset, ShaderCfg, ShaderIr,
    ShaderSpirv, ShaderModule, Other, Count
};
struct CachePhaseTotal {
    std::atomic<unsigned long long> samples{}, total_ns{}, max_ns{};
};
inline std::array<CachePhaseTotal, static_cast<unsigned>(CachePhase::Count)> cache_phase_totals{};
inline thread_local bool cache_draw_sample_active = false;
inline std::atomic<bool> detailed_gpu_profile{false};
__STAGE_DECLARATIONS__
__REAL_TIMER__
}

#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
__REAL_TRACE__
#endif
void Stage(Eden::Performance::CachePhase phase, unsigned long long nanos) {
    Eden::Performance::CachePhaseTimer timer{phase, true};
    Common::g_wall_clock.now += std::chrono::nanoseconds(nanos);
    timer.Stop();
}
int main() {
    using namespace Eden::Performance;
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    // No session owner with quiet logging, even though the hot shader is
    // created. Unkeyed sampled phases must continue to work independently.
    {
        ColdShaderMissTrace quiet{"graphics", 1, false};
        assert(shader_miss_stage_active == nullptr);
        Stage(CachePhase::ShaderCfg, 2);
        quiet.Complete(true);
    }
    detailed_gpu_profile.store(true);
    {
        ColdShaderMissTrace cold{"graphics", 2, false};
        assert(shader_miss_stage_active == &cold.stages);
        Stage(CachePhase::GraphicsShaderEnvironment, 3);
        Stage(CachePhase::ShaderPoolReset, 5);
        Stage(CachePhase::ShaderCfg, 7);
        Stage(CachePhase::ShaderIr, 11);
        Stage(CachePhase::ShaderSpirv, 13);
        Stage(CachePhase::ShaderModule, 17);
        Stage(CachePhase::Other, 19);
        assert(cold.stages.env_ns == 3 && cold.stages.pool_ns == 5);
        assert(cold.stages.cfg_ns == 7 && cold.stages.ir_ns == 11);
        assert(cold.stages.spirv_ns == 13 && cold.stages.module_ns == 17);
        {
            ColdShaderMissTrace nested{"compute", 3, true};
            assert(shader_miss_stage_active == &nested.stages);
            Stage(CachePhase::ShaderCfg, 23);
            assert(nested.stages.cfg_ns == 23);
            assert(cold.stages.cfg_ns == 7);
            nested.Complete(false);
        }
        assert(shader_miss_stage_active == &cold.stages);
        Stage(CachePhase::ShaderCfg, 29);
        assert(cold.stages.cfg_ns == 36);
        cold.Complete(true);
        assert(shader_miss_stage_active == nullptr);
        Stage(CachePhase::ShaderModule, 31); // not part of the completed miss
        assert(cold.stages.module_ns == 17);
    }
    {
        ColdShaderMissTrace retry{"graphics", 4, true};
        Stage(CachePhase::ShaderModule, 37);
        retry.Complete(true);
        assert(retry.stages.module_ns == 37);
    }
    assert(shader_miss_stage_active == nullptr);
    try {
        ColdShaderMissTrace error{"compute", 5, false};
        Stage(CachePhase::ShaderIr, 41);
        throw std::runtime_error("exception within a cold translation");
    } catch (const std::runtime_error&) {
        assert(shader_miss_stage_active == nullptr);
    }
    detailed_gpu_profile.store(false);
    {
        ColdShaderMissTrace quiet_again{"compute", 6, true};
        assert(shader_miss_stage_active == nullptr);
        quiet_again.Complete(false);
    }
#else
    Stage(CachePhase::ShaderCfg, 2);
    assert(shader_miss_stage_active == nullptr);
#endif
    assert(cache_phase_totals[static_cast<unsigned>(CachePhase::ShaderCfg)]
               .samples.load() >= 1);
}
"""
cpp = cpp.replace("__STAGE_DECLARATIONS__", stage_declarations)
cpp = cpp.replace("__REAL_TIMER__", real_timer)
cpp = cpp.replace("__REAL_TRACE__", real_trace)

compiler = shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
assert compiler, "C++20 compiler required"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="f07-keyed-shader-stages-") as temp:
    src = Path(temp) / "probe.cpp"
    src.write_text(cpp)
    for native in (False, True):
        for opt in ("-O0", "-O2"):
            exe = Path(temp) / ("ps5" if native else "desktop") / opt[1:]
            exe.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
            build = subprocess.run(
                [compiler, "-std=c++20", opt, "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror",
                 "-fsanitize=undefined", "-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
                 *(["-DPS5_NATIVE=1"] if native else []),
                 str(src), "-o", str(exe)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=45
            )
            assert build.returncode == 0, (native, opt, build.stderr[-6000:])
            run = subprocess.run([str(exe)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
            assert run.returncode == 0, (native, opt, run.stdout, run.stderr[-4000:])
            if native:
                assert run.stdout.count("EDEN_VULKAN_SHADER_MISS") == 3
                assert "key=0000000000000002" in run.stdout
                assert "env_ns=3 pool_ns=5 cfg_ns=36 ir_ns=11 spirv_ns=13 module_ns=17" in run.stdout
                assert "key=0000000000000003" in run.stdout
                assert "cfg_ns=23" in run.stdout
                assert "key=0000000000000004" in run.stdout
                assert "module_ns=37" in run.stdout
                assert "key=0000000000000001" not in run.stdout
                assert "key=0000000000000005" not in run.stdout
                assert "key=0000000000000006" not in run.stdout
            else:
                assert "EDEN_VULKAN_SHADER_MISS" not in run.stdout
            print(f"F07_KEYED_SHADER_STAGES_PASS mode={'PS5' if native else 'desktop'} {opt}")
print("HOST_ONLY no shader output, Vulkan worker, FPS or console measurements")
```

```py
using u64=std::uint64_t;

struct LruCache {
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""F07 T04: source-extracted native MSAA upload scratch retirement on exceptions.

A checked-out image has tick UINT64_MAX. A failed upload after Acquire must
release it at CurrentTick (never immediately free for a still-pending GPU
command). Desktop keeps its original normal path. This is host-only proof.
"""

cpp = r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <limits>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <type_traits>
#include <utility>
using u64 = std::uint64_t;
using VkImage = int;
struct VkImageCreateInfo {};
struct ScopeTag {};
template<class F> struct ScopeExit {
    F fn;
    ~ScopeExit() { fn(); }
};
template<class F> ScopeExit<std::decay_t<F>> operator+(ScopeTag, F&& fn) {
    return {std::forward<F>(fn)};
}
#define SCOPE_EXIT auto guard = ScopeTag{} + [&]
struct Scheduler {
    u64 tick = 21;
    bool reject_preflight{};
    int prepare_calls{};
    u64 CurrentTick() const { return tick; }
    void RequestOutsideRenderPassOperationContext() {
        ++prepare_calls;
        if (reject_preflight) throw std::runtime_error("mock rejected preflight");
    }
};
struct Runtime {
    Scheduler& scheduler;
    u64 tick = (std::numeric_limits<u64>::max)();
    u64 completed_tick = 20;
    int acqs{}, releases{}, handle{41};
    VkImage AcquireMsaaScratchImage(const VkImageCreateInfo&) {
        ++acqs;
        tick = (std::numeric_limits<u64>::max)();
        return handle;
    }
    void ReleaseMsaaScratchImage(VkImage img) {
        assert(img == handle);
        ++releases;
        tick = scheduler.CurrentTick();
    }
    bool CanReuse() const {
        return tick <= completed_tick;
    }
};
struct Image {
    Runtime* runtime;
    Scheduler* scheduler;
    bool initialized{};
    void Upload(bool reject_after_record) {
        const VkImageCreateInfo image_ci{};
        const bool is_rescaled = false;
__SOURCE_GUARD__
        if (reject_after_record)
            throw std::runtime_error("mock GPU command failed after enqueue");
__SOURCE_RELEASE__
        (void)is_rescaled;
    }
};
int main() {
    {
        Scheduler scheduler;
        Runtime runtime{scheduler};
        Image image{&runtime, &scheduler};
        image.Upload(false);
        assert(image.initialized && runtime.acqs == 1 && runtime.releases == 1);
        assert(runtime.tick == 21 && !runtime.CanReuse());
        runtime.completed_tick = 21;
        assert(runtime.CanReuse());
    }
    for (const bool before_enqueue : {true, false}) {
        Scheduler scheduler;
        scheduler.reject_preflight = before_enqueue;
        Runtime runtime{scheduler};
        Image image{&runtime, &scheduler};
        bool threw = false;
        try { image.Upload(!before_enqueue); }
        catch (const std::runtime_error&) { threw = true; }
        assert(threw && !image.initialized && runtime.acqs == 1);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
        assert(runtime.releases == 1 && runtime.tick == 21);
        assert(!runtime.CanReuse());
        runtime.completed_tick = 21;
        assert(runtime.CanReuse());
#else
        // Desktop path deliberately unchanged by this native-only fix.
        assert(runtime.releases == 0);
#endif
    }
    std::puts("F07_MSAA_UPLOAD_RETIRE_HOST_PASS");
}
""".replace("__SOURCE_GUARD__", guard).replace("__SOURCE_RELEASE__", normal)

    bool operator==(const MsaaScratchKey&) const = default;

    int handle{};

    VkImage operator*() const noexcept { return handle; }
};

    MsaaScratchKey key{};

};

    MasterSemaphore& GetMasterSemaphore() { return semaphore; }
```
