```py
assert "std::erase_if(pending_resolve_shadows" in tick_frame
assert "scratch.unused_frames = 0;" in tick_frame
assert "++scratch.unused_frames > MAX_UNUSED_SCRATCH_FRAMES" in tick_frame
assert "scheduler.GetMasterSemaphore().KnownGpuTick()" in tick_frame
assert "pending_retired_views" in tick_frame and "pending_retired_images" in tick_frame
assert "gpu_retire_frame - pending.frame >= MIN_TEXTURE_RETIRE_FRAMES" in tick_frame
assert "F07 snapshot native MSAA scratch and resolve cleanup GPU completion" in generator
assert "F07 skip MSAA GPU probe when every scratch image is checked out" in generator

tick_cpp = r"""
#include <algorithm>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <limits>
#include <memory>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>
using u32 = std::uint32_t;
using u64 = std::uint64_t;
struct MsaaScratchImage {
    u64 tick{(std::numeric_limits<u64>::max)()};
    u32 unused_frames{};
};
struct MasterSemaphore {
    u64 completed{20};
    unsigned probes{};
    u64 KnownGpuTick() { ++probes; return completed; }
};
struct Scheduler {
    MasterSemaphore master;
    MasterSemaphore& GetMasterSemaphore() { return master; }
    bool IsFree(u64 tick) { return tick <= master.completed; }
};
struct TextureCacheRuntime {
    Scheduler scheduler;
    std::vector<MsaaScratchImage> msaa_scratch_images;
    std::vector<std::pair<u64,int>> pending_resolve_shadows;
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    struct NativeGpuPinWitness {
        bool pinned{};
        bool CanRetireNativeGpu() const noexcept { return !pinned; }
    };
    struct PendingRetiredOwner {
        u64 tick{};
        u64 frame{};
        // Mimic the *actual* native Image/ImageView lease, which the
        // source-extracted retirement lambda calls after timeline/frame.
        std::shared_ptr<NativeGpuPinWitness> resource =
            std::make_shared<NativeGpuPinWitness>();
    };
    u64 gpu_retire_frame{};
    std::vector<PendingRetiredOwner> pending_retired_views;
    std::vector<PendingRetiredOwner> pending_retired_images;
#endif
    void TickFrame();
};
__ACTUAL_TICKFRAME__
int main() {
    TextureCacheRuntime r;
    r.TickFrame();
    assert(r.scheduler.master.probes == 0);
    // Every scratch is checked out: a native frame does no semaphore query.
    r.msaa_scratch_images.push_back({});
    r.TickFrame();
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(r.scheduler.master.probes == 0);
#endif
    assert(r.msaa_scratch_images.size() == 1);
    assert(r.msaa_scratch_images[0].unused_frames == 0);

    // A resolve shadow may retire even when every scratch is checked out.
    r.pending_resolve_shadows.emplace_back(21, 42);
    r.TickFrame();
    assert(r.pending_resolve_shadows.size() == 1);
    r.scheduler.master.completed = 21;
    r.TickFrame();
    assert(r.pending_resolve_shadows.empty());
    assert(r.msaa_scratch_images.size() == 1);

    // Checked-out scratch must never expire even after 61 more frames.
    for (int i=0; i<61; ++i) r.TickFrame();
    assert(r.msaa_scratch_images.size() == 1);
    assert(r.msaa_scratch_images[0].unused_frames == 0);
    // A released scratch is not aged while its GPU readers are in flight.
    r.msaa_scratch_images[0].tick = 22;
    for (int i=0; i<61; ++i) r.TickFrame();
    assert(r.msaa_scratch_images.size() == 1);
    assert(r.msaa_scratch_images[0].unused_frames == 0);
    r.scheduler.master.completed = 22;
    for (int i=0; i<60; ++i) r.TickFrame();
    assert(r.msaa_scratch_images.size() == 1);
    assert(r.msaa_scratch_images[0].unused_frames == 60);
    r.TickFrame();
    assert(r.msaa_scratch_images.empty());
    // No work remains; native path must skip further GPU tick probes.
    const unsigned probes = r.scheduler.master.probes;
    r.TickFrame();
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(r.scheduler.master.probes == probes);
    // P2.2: completion alone cannot override the prior eight-frame
    // framebuffer lifetime; frame age alone cannot override GPU in-flight.
    const auto stamp = r.gpu_retire_frame;
    r.pending_retired_views.push_back({30, stamp});
    r.pending_retired_images.push_back({30, stamp});
    r.scheduler.master.completed = 30;
    for (int i = 0; i < 7; ++i) r.TickFrame();
    assert(r.pending_retired_views.size() == 1);
    assert(r.pending_retired_images.size() == 1);
    r.TickFrame(); // eight frames AND completed GPU tick
    assert(r.pending_retired_views.empty());
    assert(r.pending_retired_images.empty());
    r.pending_retired_views.push_back({31, r.gpu_retire_frame});
    r.pending_retired_images.push_back({31, r.gpu_retire_frame});
    for (int i = 0; i < 10; ++i) r.TickFrame();
    assert(r.pending_retired_views.size() == 1);
    assert(r.pending_retired_images.size() == 1);
    r.scheduler.master.completed = 31;
    r.TickFrame();
    assert(r.pending_retired_views.empty());
    assert(r.pending_retired_images.empty());
    // A completed timeline AND eight elapsed frames cannot reclaim an
    // Image still referenced by a native compute/graphics descriptor.
    r.pending_retired_images.push_back({32, r.gpu_retire_frame});
    assert(r.pending_retired_images[0].resource);
    r.pending_retired_images[0].resource->pinned = true;
    r.scheduler.master.completed = 32;
    for (int i = 0; i < 10; ++i) r.TickFrame();
    assert(r.pending_retired_images.size() == 1);
    r.pending_retired_images[0].resource->pinned = false;
    r.TickFrame();
    assert(r.pending_retired_images.empty());
#else
    (void)probes;
#endif
    std::puts("F07_MSAA_TICKFRAME_RETIRE_PASS");
}
""".replace("__ACTUAL_TICKFRAME__", tick_frame)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-f07-msaa-frame-retire-") as d:
```

```py
#include <cstdio>
using u64 = std::uint64_t;
using VkBuffer = u64;
struct Buffer {
    VkBuffer value{};
    explicit operator bool() const { return value != 0; }
    VkBuffer operator*() const { return value; }
};
struct MultiRangeRef { VkBuffer handle{}; };
struct Entry { Buffer sparse_handle{}, gathered{}; u64 address{}; };
struct Logical {
    int calls{};
    VkBuffer last{};
    u64 GetBufferDeviceAddress(VkBuffer h) {
        ++calls;
        last = h;
        return h + 100;
    }
};
struct Device {
    bool bda{};
    Logical logical{};
    bool IsBufferDeviceAddressSupported() const { return bda; }
    Logical& GetLogical() { return logical; }
};

__FRAGMENT__
    return MultiRangeRef{
        entry.sparse_handle ? *entry.sparse_handle : *entry.gathered
    };
}
int main() {

    assert(r.handle == 0);

#else
```

```py
A GPU completion after the snapshot may be collected next pass. Never free a
tick newer than the sampled completion or change the desktop IsFree path.
"""

import shutil

using u64=std::uint64_t;
struct Semaphore {
    u64 completed{};
    unsigned probes{};
    u64 KnownGpuTick(){++probes;return completed;}
};
struct Scheduler {
    Semaphore semaphore{};
    unsigned is_free_probes{};
    Semaphore& GetMasterSemaphore(){return semaphore;}
    bool IsFree(u64 tick) {
        ++is_free_probes;
        return tick<=semaphore.completed;
    }
};
struct Retired {int handle{};u64 tick{};};
struct MultiRangeBufferCache {
    std::vector<Retired> retired{};
    void DrainRetired(Scheduler&);
};
__SOURCE__

    MultiRangeBufferCache cache;
    scheduler.semaphore.completed=8;
    cache.DrainRetired(scheduler);

    assert(scheduler.semaphore.probes==0);
#else
    assert(scheduler.is_free_probes==0);
#endif
    cache.retired={{1,2},{2,11},{3,8},{4,5}};
    cache.DrainRetired(scheduler);
    assert(cache.retired.size()==1);
    assert(cache.retired.front().tick==11);

    cache.DrainRetired(scheduler);
    assert(cache.retired.empty());
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(scheduler.semaphore.probes==3);
    cache.DrainRetired(scheduler);
    assert(scheduler.semaphore.probes==3);
#endif
}
```

```py
                                     it->second.size,true,false};

            return MultiRangeRef{5,11,total,false,true};

        return MultiRangeRef{5,11,total,false,true};
```

```py
using VkDeviceSize=u64;

     const u64 geometry = HashSources(sources);

      source.handle=i+1;

      source.memory_offset=i*8192;
      source.offset=i*128;
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""F07: compile source-selected writable multi-range rejection under O0/O2.

The GPU source must avoid expensive gathered fallback allocation when sparse
binding is unavailable. Read-only gathers, sparse writes and desktop keep
the previous result and FIFO commands. No real PS5 GPU/FPS proof.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
source = (ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vk_buffer_cache_cost.cpp").read_text()
generator = (ROOT / "tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py").read_text()
fast = (ROOT / ".github/workflows/encore-core-fast-gate.yml").read_text()
pre = (ROOT / ".github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml").read_text()
call = "python3 -B tools/check-ps5-f07-multirange-write-preflight-host.py"
assert call in fast and call in pre
assert "F07 reject unsupported native writable multirange before fallback allocation" in generator

end = "\nvoid BufferCacheRuntime::BindIndexBuffer("

assert body.count("if (is_written && !ref.sparse)") == 1
assert "#ifdef PS5_NATIVE" in body and "std::array<VideoCommon::BufferCopy, 8> grouped_copies{};" in body
assert "if (source.handle != grouped_source || grouped_count == grouped_copies.size())" in body
assert "flush_group();" in body and "multi_range_buffers.MarkGathered(key);" in body
assert "last.src_offset + last.size == source.offset" in body
assert "last.dst_offset + last.size == dst_offset" in body

assert "F07 coalesce adjacent native multirange gather slices into bounded FIFO batches" in generator
cpp = r"""
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <span>
#include <vector>
using u64 = std::uint64_t;
using VkDeviceSize = std::uint64_t;
using VkBuffer = std::uint64_t;
constexpr VkBuffer VK_NULL_HANDLE=0;
namespace Eden::DevVulkan { inline bool disable_multi_range=false; }
struct Device {};
struct Scheduler {};
struct Allocator {};
struct MultiRangeSource { VkBuffer handle{2}; VkDeviceSize offset{}; VkDeviceSize size{8}; };
struct MultiRangeRef {
    VkBuffer handle{5};
    VkDeviceSize address{11},size{8};
    bool sparse{},needs_gather{true};
};
namespace VideoCommon {
struct BufferCopy { u64 src_offset{},dst_offset{}; std::size_t size{}; };
}
struct MultiRangeBufferCache {
    bool use_sparse{};
    unsigned gets{},marked{};
    MultiRangeRef Get(Device&,Scheduler&,Allocator&,u64,
                      const std::vector<MultiRangeSource>&,VkDeviceSize total) {
        ++gets;
        return MultiRangeRef{5,11,total,use_sparse,!use_sparse};
    }
    void MarkGathered(u64) {++marked;}
};
struct Queue {
    unsigned adds{};
    void AddBuffer(VkBuffer, VkDeviceSize, VkDeviceSize, VkDeviceSize){++adds;}
};
struct BufferCacheRuntime {
    Device device{};
    Scheduler scheduler{};
    Allocator memory_allocator{};
    MultiRangeBufferCache multi_range_buffers{};
    std::vector<MultiRangeSource> multi_range_sources{{}};
    VkDeviceSize multi_range_total{8};
    Queue guest_descriptor_queue{};
    struct ActualCopy { VkBuffer source{}; u64 src{}, dst{}, size{}; };
    std::vector<ActualCopy> recorded;
    std::vector<std::size_t> group_sizes;
    unsigned before{},after{},copies{};
    void PreCopyBarrier(){++before;}
    void PostCopyBarrier(){++after;}
    template<class T>
    void CopyBuffer(VkBuffer target,VkBuffer src,const T& regions,bool barrier) {
        assert(target==5 && !barrier);
        assert(!regions.empty() && regions.size() <= 8);
        ++copies;
        group_sizes.push_back(regions.size());
        for (const auto& v:regions)recorded.push_back({src,v.src_offset,v.dst_offset,v.size});
    }
    bool BindMultiRangeStorageBuffer(u64,bool);
};
__SOURCE__
int main() {
    {
        BufferCacheRuntime c;
        assert(!c.BindMultiRangeStorageBuffer(1,true));
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
        assert(c.multi_range_buffers.gets==0 && c.copies==0);
#else
        assert(c.multi_range_buffers.gets==1 && c.copies==0);
#endif
        assert(c.guest_descriptor_queue.adds==0);
    }
    {
        BufferCacheRuntime c;
        assert(c.BindMultiRangeStorageBuffer(1,false));
        assert(c.multi_range_buffers.gets==1 && c.copies==1);
        assert(c.before==1 && c.after==1);
        assert(c.recorded.size()==1 && c.recorded[0].source==2);
        assert(c.multi_range_buffers.marked==1 && c.guest_descriptor_queue.adds==1);
    }
    {
        // 3 repeated owner slices, 2 of a new owner, 9 of a third.
        // PS5: one + one + two bounded batches; desktop unchanged.
        BufferCacheRuntime c;
        c.multi_range_sources.clear();
        u64 total=0;
        std::vector<BufferCacheRuntime::ActualCopy> expected;
        for (unsigned i=0;i<14;++i) {
            const VkBuffer owner = i<3?2:(i<5?7:11);
            const u64 size = static_cast<u64>(i%5+1)*8;
            const u64 offset = static_cast<u64>(i*64);
            c.multi_range_sources.push_back({owner,offset,size});
            expected.push_back({owner,offset,total,size});
            total+=size;
        }
        c.multi_range_total=total;
        assert(c.BindMultiRangeStorageBuffer(5,false));
        assert(c.before==1 && c.after==1 && c.multi_range_buffers.marked==1);
        assert(c.recorded.size()==14 && c.guest_descriptor_queue.adds==1);
        for(std::size_t i=0;i<expected.size();++i) {
            const auto& actual=c.recorded[i];
            const auto& wanted=expected[i];
            assert(actual.source==wanted.source && actual.src==wanted.src &&
                   actual.dst==wanted.dst && actual.size==wanted.size);
        }
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
        assert(c.copies==4 && (c.group_sizes==std::vector<std::size_t>{3,2,8,1}));
#else
        assert(c.copies==14 && c.group_sizes.size()==14);
#endif
    }
    {
        // The source+destination must BOTH be contiguous to combine
        // bytes; a gap retains a distinct Vulkan region in the same group.
        BufferCacheRuntime c;
        c.multi_range_sources = {{2,0,8},{2,8,16},{2,24,8},
                                 {7,0,8},{7,16,8},{7,24,8}};
        c.multi_range_total=56;
        assert(c.BindMultiRangeStorageBuffer(12,false));
        assert(c.before==1 && c.after==1);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
        assert(c.copies==2 && (c.group_sizes==std::vector<std::size_t>{1,2}));
        assert(c.recorded.size()==3);
        assert(c.recorded[0].source==2 && c.recorded[0].src==0 &&
               c.recorded[0].dst==0 && c.recorded[0].size==32);
        assert(c.recorded[1].source==7 && c.recorded[1].src==0 &&
               c.recorded[1].dst==32 && c.recorded[1].size==8);
        assert(c.recorded[2].source==7 && c.recorded[2].src==16 &&
               c.recorded[2].dst==40 && c.recorded[2].size==16);
#else
        assert(c.copies==6 && c.recorded.size()==6);
#endif
        assert(c.multi_range_buffers.marked==1 && c.guest_descriptor_queue.adds==1);
    }
    {
        BufferCacheRuntime c;
        c.multi_range_buffers.use_sparse=true;
        assert(c.BindMultiRangeStorageBuffer(1,true));
        assert(c.multi_range_buffers.gets==1 && c.copies==0);
        assert(c.before==0 && c.after==0 && c.guest_descriptor_queue.adds==1);
    }
    {
        BufferCacheRuntime c;
        c.multi_range_sources.clear();
        assert(!c.BindMultiRangeStorageBuffer(1,true));
        assert(c.multi_range_buffers.gets==0);
    }
    {
        BufferCacheRuntime c;
        Eden::DevVulkan::disable_multi_range=true;
        assert(!c.BindMultiRangeStorageBuffer(1,true));
        assert(c.multi_range_buffers.gets==0);
        Eden::DevVulkan::disable_multi_range=false;
    }
}
""".replace("__SOURCE__",body)
compiler = shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
```

```py
"""F07: source-extracted release/acquire publication for async Vulkan pipelines.

The scheduler/build worker initializes its non-atomic pipeline handle, then
release-publishes is_built. Both IsBuilt() and CanExecuteDraw() consumers must
acquire before inspecting that handle; no fence, mutex or draw is skipped.

def extract_wait(source, function, stop):
    body = source[source.index(function):]
    first = body.index("    if (!is_built.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {")
    last = body.index(stop, first)
    snippet = body[first:last]

    assert snippet.count("first_use_wait_recorded = true;") == 1
    assert snippet.index("scheduler.Record([this]") < snippet.index("first_use_wait_recorded = true;")
    assert "if (!first_use_wait_recorded)" in snippet
    return snippet
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""F07 PS5 hot transition memo: compile exact selected Next() in four host modes.

A long overlay/scene transition list previously reread every prior full key on
each repeated transition. Verify two-entry memo uses stable INDICES (not a vector
pointer), preserves misses, short lists, self transitions and appends, and does
not affect non-PS5 builds. This is a CPU lookup optimization, not an FPS proof.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

end = "\n\n    [[nodiscard]] bool IsBuilt() const noexcept {"

assert "F07 graphics transition append rollback" in generator
assert "F07 optional transition OOM no-throw fallback" in generator
assert "F07 optional transition first append OOM guard" in generator
assert append_method.count("catch (...)") == 2

cpp = r"""
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <new>
#include <vector>
template <class T>
class FailPointerAppend : public std::vector<T> {
public:
    static inline bool reject_next{};
    void push_back(const T& element) {
        if (reject_next) {
            reject_next = false;
            throw std::bad_alloc{};
        }
        std::vector<T>::push_back(element);
    }
};
struct GraphicsPipelineCacheKey {
    int value{};
    static inline std::size_t comparisons = 0;
    bool operator==(const GraphicsPipelineCacheKey& other) const noexcept {
        ++comparisons;
        return value == other.value;
    }
};
struct GraphicsPipeline {
    GraphicsPipelineCacheKey key{};
    FailPointerAppend<GraphicsPipelineCacheKey> transition_keys;
    FailPointerAppend<GraphicsPipeline*> transitions;
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    std::array<size_t, 2> hot_transition_indices{};
#endif
""" + selected + r"""
    void AddTransition(GraphicsPipeline* other);
};
""" + append_method + r"""
int main() {
    GraphicsPipeline source{};
    source.key.value = -1;
    std::array<GraphicsPipeline, 64> targets{};
    for (int i = 0; i < 48; ++i) {
        targets[i].key.value = i;
        source.AddTransition(&targets[i]);
    }
    assert(source.Next(source.key) == &source);
    assert(source.Next(GraphicsPipelineCacheKey{999}) == nullptr);
    assert(source.Next(targets[35].key) == &targets[35]);
    for (int r = 0; r < 2000; ++r) {
        GraphicsPipelineCacheKey::comparisons = 0;
        assert(source.Next(targets[35].key) == &targets[35]);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
        assert(GraphicsPipelineCacheKey::comparisons == 2);
#else
        assert(GraphicsPipelineCacheKey::comparisons == 37);
#endif
    }
    // Prime two nonadjacent overlay/HUD targets in a 48-edge graph.
    assert(source.Next(targets[46].key) == &targets[46]);
    assert(source.Next(targets[35].key) == &targets[35]);
    for (int r = 0; r < 2000; ++r) {
        GraphicsPipelineCacheKey::comparisons = 0;
        assert(source.Next(targets[35].key) == &targets[35]);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
        assert(GraphicsPipelineCacheKey::comparisons <= 3);
#else
        assert(GraphicsPipelineCacheKey::comparisons == 37);
#endif
        GraphicsPipelineCacheKey::comparisons = 0;
        assert(source.Next(targets[46].key) == &targets[46]);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
        assert(GraphicsPipelineCacheKey::comparisons <= 3);
#else
        assert(GraphicsPipelineCacheKey::comparisons == 48);
#endif
    }
    assert(source.Next(targets[35].key) == &targets[35]);
    // Misses never poison a valid memo; target order remains unchanged.
    assert(source.Next(GraphicsPipelineCacheKey{900}) == nullptr);
    GraphicsPipelineCacheKey::comparisons = 0;
    assert(source.Next(targets[35].key) == &targets[35]);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(GraphicsPipelineCacheKey::comparisons == 2);
#endif
    // Replacing the hot target and appending must preserve earlier indices.
    assert(source.Next(targets[46].key) == &targets[46]);
    for (int i = 48; i < 64; ++i) {
        targets[i].key.value = i;
        source.AddTransition(&targets[i]);
    }
    assert(source.Next(targets[46].key) == &targets[46]);
    assert(source.Next(targets[63].key) == &targets[63]);
    assert(source.Next(targets[0].key) == &targets[0]);
    GraphicsPipeline small{};
    small.key.value = -10;
    small.AddTransition(&targets[0]);
    small.AddTransition(&targets[1]);
    assert(small.Next(targets[0].key) == &targets[0]);
    assert(small.Next(targets[1].key) == &targets[1]);
    assert(small.Next(targets[2].key) == nullptr);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    // Reproduce a real second-vector allocation failure AFTER the key was
    // appended. The original source kept an orphaned key and Next() could
    // read transitions[index] past its end; both arrays must remain aligned.
    GraphicsPipeline resilient{};
    resilient.key.value = -12;
    resilient.AddTransition(&targets[0]);
    FailPointerAppend<GraphicsPipeline*>::reject_next = true;
    // The optional transition memo failed, but the draw path must not throw.
    // The canonical graphics-cache lookup remains available on the next draw.
    resilient.AddTransition(&targets[1]);
    assert(!FailPointerAppend<GraphicsPipeline*>::reject_next);
    assert(resilient.transition_keys.size() == resilient.transitions.size());
    assert(resilient.transition_keys.size() == 1);
    assert(resilient.Next(targets[1].key) == nullptr);
    assert(resilient.Next(targets[0].key) == &targets[0]);
    resilient.AddTransition(&targets[1]);
    assert(resilient.transition_keys.size() == resilient.transitions.size());
    assert(resilient.Next(targets[1].key) == &targets[1]);
    // Failure of the FIRST vector append must also return without throwing.
    FailPointerAppend<GraphicsPipelineCacheKey>::reject_next = true;
    resilient.AddTransition(&targets[2]);
    assert(!FailPointerAppend<GraphicsPipelineCacheKey>::reject_next);
    assert(resilient.transition_keys.size() == 2);
    assert(resilient.transitions.size() == 2);
    assert(resilient.Next(targets[2].key) == nullptr);
    resilient.AddTransition(&targets[2]);
    assert(resilient.transition_keys.size() == resilient.transitions.size());
    assert(resilient.Next(targets[2].key) == &targets[2]);
#endif
}
"""
compiler = shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
assert compiler, "C++ compiler missing"

    path = Path(folder) / "test.cpp"
```

```py
"""F07: source-extracted native async readback consumption must remain retryable."""

#include <new>

namespace Common {
std::size_t AlignUp(std::size_t n,std::size_t a){return (n+a-1)/a*a;}
}
struct Maker {};
template<class F> struct ScopeGuard{F f;~ScopeGuard(){f();}};
template<class F> ScopeGuard<std::decay_t<F>> operator+(Maker,F&&f){return {std::forward<F>(f)};}
#define SCOPE_EXIT auto guard_pop = Maker{} + [&]
struct Memory{
    bool fail_swizzle{},fail_write{};
    unsigned swizzles{},writes{};
    void WriteBlockUnsafe(std::uint64_t,const u8*,std::size_t){
        if(fail_write)throw std::runtime_error("guest DMA rejected");
        ++writes;
    }
};
struct ImageInfo {};

    ImageInfo info{};
    std::uint64_t gpu_addr{};
    std::size_t unswizzled_size_bytes{32};
};
std::vector<int> FullDownloadCopies(const ImageInfo&){return {1};}
std::vector<int> FixSmallVectorADL(std::vector<int> v){return v;}
void SwizzleImage(Memory& mem,std::uint64_t,const ImageInfo&,const std::vector<int>&,
                  std::span<u8> span,std::vector<u8>&){
    assert(span.size()>=32);
    if(mem.fail_swizzle)throw std::runtime_error("swizzle rejected");
    ++mem.swizzles;
}
struct PendingDownload{bool is_swizzle{};std::size_t async_buffer_id{};unsigned object_id{};};
struct BufferDownload{std::uint64_t address{};std::size_t size{};};
struct Staging{
    std::size_t buffer{};
    std::size_t offset{};
    std::span<u8> mapped_span;
};
struct Cache{
    std::array<u8,128> staging_data{};
    Memory memory;
    Memory* gpu_memory{&memory};
    std::vector<ImageBase> slot_images{1};
    std::unordered_map<unsigned,BufferDownload> slot_buffer_downloads;
    std::vector<u8> swizzle_data_buffer;
    std::deque<std::vector<PendingDownload>> committed_downloads;
    std::deque<std::vector<Staging>> async_buffers;

    void Setup(){
        committed_downloads.push_back({{false,1,42},{true,0,0}});
        async_buffers.push_back({{111,64,staging_data},{222,0,staging_data}});
        slot_buffer_downloads.emplace(42,BufferDownload{55,12});

        const auto& download_ids=committed_downloads.front();
__BLOCK__
    }

    Cache swizzle_failure;
```

```py
    plain.Apply(1,false,1280,720);
    const Layer* const plain_first=&plain.layers.front();
    plain.Apply(3,false,1920,1080);
    assert(plain.idle_calls==0 && &plain.layers.front()==plain_first);

    // block until queued readers are complete, then rebuild exact actives.

    assert(budget.layers.size()==9 && budget.idle_calls==0);

    assert(budget.layers.size()==8 && budget.idle_calls==1);

    assert(budget.layers.size()==8 && budget.idle_calls==1);
```

```py
#include <cstddef>
```

```py
#include <limits>
#include <ranges>
#include <utility>

using VkImageAspectFlags=u32;
constexpr VkImageAspectFlags VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT=2;

struct Offset {std::int32_t x{};};
struct Extent {std::uint32_t width{},height{1},depth{1};};

struct ImageInfo {u32 format{};};

        if(copies.empty()) return;

        const VkImageAspectFlags src_aspect_mask=1;
        std::vector<ImageCopy> vk_in_copies(copies.size());
__PRODUCTION_TRANSFORM__

    // fits the signed offset. The PS5 variant must preserve 2^29.

    Probe rounded_to_zero;
    rounded_to_zero.Convert(16,1,{{{0},{1,1,1}}});
```

```py
cpp=r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>
#include <vector>
using u32=std::uint32_t;
using VkBuffer=std::size_t;
using VkImage=std::size_t;
constexpr VkBuffer VK_NULL_HANDLE=0;
inline constexpr bool ENABLE_MSAA_RESOLVE_CONSUME=true;
struct Extent {u32 width{},height{},depth{};};
struct ImageCopy {Extent extent{};};
struct ImageInfo {u32 format{};};
struct Offset2D {int x{},y{};};
struct Region2D {Offset2D start{},end{};};
struct Image {ImageInfo info{}; VkImage Handle() const {return 73;} };
u32 BytesPerBlock(u32 format) {return format;}
struct Runtime {
    std::size_t calls{},last_size{};
    std::size_t invalidates{},direct_copies{};
    bool null_scratch{};
    void InvalidateResolveShadow(VkImage image) {assert(image==73);++invalidates;}
    VkBuffer GetTemporaryBuffer(std::size_t bytes) {
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
        assert(bytes!=0);
#endif
        ++calls;
        last_size=bytes;
        return null_scratch ? VK_NULL_HANDLE : bytes;
    }
    void ReinterpretImage(Image& dst,const std::vector<ImageCopy>& copies) {
#ifndef PS5_NATIVE
        if (ENABLE_MSAA_RESOLVE_CONSUME) InvalidateResolveShadow(dst.Handle());
#endif
__SOURCE_EMPTY_GUARD__
__SOURCE_SIZE_GUARD__
        static_cast<void>(copy_buffer);
    }
    void CopyImage(Image& dst, Image& src, const std::vector<ImageCopy>& copies) {
__SOURCE_COPY_GUARD__
        if (BytesPerBlock(src.info.format) != BytesPerBlock(dst.info.format)) {
            ReinterpretImage(dst, copies);
        } else {
            ++direct_copies;
        }
    }
    std::size_t blits{};
    void BlitImage(const Region2D& dst_region, const Region2D& src_region) {
__SOURCE_BLIT_GUARD__
        // Desktop intentionally has no native guard; mark fixture parameters
        // used without altering either mode's source-extracted behavior.
        static_cast<void>(dst_region);
        static_cast<void>(src_region);
        ++blits;
    }
    std::size_t msaa_copies{};
    void CopyImageMSAA(const std::vector<ImageCopy>& copies) {
__SOURCE_MSAA_GUARD__
        // The pinned desktop has no MSAA no-op guard; retain its call,
        // but mark this reduced fixture's otherwise-unused parameter.
        static_cast<void>(copies);
        ++msaa_copies;
    }
};
int main() {
    Image normal{{4}};
    Runtime empty;
    empty.ReinterpretImage(normal,{});
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(empty.calls==0 && empty.invalidates==0);
#else
    assert(empty.calls==1 && empty.last_size==0);
#endif
    Runtime valid;
    valid.ReinterpretImage(normal,{{{4,5,1}},{{4,1,2}}});
    assert(valid.calls==1 && valid.last_size==112);
    assert(valid.invalidates==1);
    Runtime rejected_handle;
    rejected_handle.null_scratch=true;
    rejected_handle.ReinterpretImage(normal,{{{4,5,1}}});
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(rejected_handle.calls==1 && rejected_handle.invalidates==0);
#else
    assert(rejected_handle.calls==1 && rejected_handle.invalidates==1);
#endif
    Runtime empty_compatible;
    empty_compatible.CopyImage(normal,normal,{});
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(empty_compatible.calls==0 && empty_compatible.invalidates==0 &&
           empty_compatible.direct_copies==0);
#else
    // Desktop retains its historical empty-command and resolve invalidation.
    assert(empty_compatible.calls==0 && empty_compatible.invalidates==1 &&
           empty_compatible.direct_copies==1);
#endif
    Runtime blit;
    const Region2D valid_region{{0,0},{12,9}};
    const Region2D flipped_region{{12,9},{0,0}};
    const Region2D no_x{{4,0},{4,9}};
    const Region2D no_y{{0,4},{12,4}};
    blit.BlitImage(valid_region,valid_region);
    blit.BlitImage(flipped_region,valid_region);
    blit.BlitImage(valid_region,flipped_region);
    blit.BlitImage(no_x,valid_region);
    blit.BlitImage(no_y,valid_region);
    blit.BlitImage(valid_region,no_x);
    blit.BlitImage(valid_region,no_y);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(blit.blits==3);
#else
    assert(blit.blits==7);
#endif
    Runtime msaa_empty;
    msaa_empty.CopyImageMSAA({});
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(msaa_empty.msaa_copies==0);
#else
    assert(msaa_empty.msaa_copies==1);
#endif
    Runtime msaa_valid;
    msaa_valid.CopyImageMSAA({{{4,5,1}}});
    assert(msaa_valid.msaa_copies==1);
    Runtime mismatch;
    Image second_format{{8}};
    mismatch.CopyImage(normal,second_format,{{{4,5,1}}});
    assert(mismatch.calls==1 && mismatch.last_size==80);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(mismatch.invalidates==1);
#else
    assert(mismatch.invalidates==2);  // pinned desktop double invalidation
#endif
    Runtime mismatch_rejected;
    mismatch_rejected.null_scratch=true;
    mismatch_rejected.CopyImage(normal,second_format,{{{4,5,1}}});
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(mismatch_rejected.invalidates==0);  // valid previous resolve survives
#else
    assert(mismatch_rejected.invalidates==2);  // pinned desktop outer + inner invalidation
#endif
    Runtime direct;
    direct.CopyImage(normal,normal,{{{4,5,1}}});
    assert(direct.direct_copies==1 && direct.calls==0 && direct.invalidates==1);
    Image invalid_format{{0}};
    Runtime invalid;
    invalid.ReinterpretImage(invalid_format,{{{4,5,1}}});
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(invalid.calls==0 && invalid.invalidates==0);
#endif
    for (ImageCopy copy : {ImageCopy{{0,5,1}},ImageCopy{{4,0,1}},
                           ImageCopy{{4,5,0}}}) {
        Runtime zero;
        zero.ReinterpretImage(normal,{copy});
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
        assert(zero.calls==0 && zero.invalidates==0);
#endif

    Runtime product;
    product.ReinterpretImage(normal,{{{max,max,max}}});
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE

#endif

    // must also be rejected before GetTemporaryBuffer can index past it.

    Runtime above_slot;
    above_slot.ReinterpretImage(one_byte,{{{max,max,1}}});
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(above_slot.calls==0 && above_slot.invalidates==0);
#endif

    // the scratch slot ceiling normally rejects this sequence even earlier.
    Runtime aggregate;
    aggregate.ReinterpretImage(one_byte,{{{max,max,1}},{{max,max,1}}});
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(aggregate.calls==0 && aggregate.invalidates==0);
#endif
}
""".replace("__SOURCE_EMPTY_GUARD__",early).replace("__SOURCE_SIZE_GUARD__",size).replace("__SOURCE_COPY_GUARD__",copy_guard).replace("__SOURCE_MSAA_GUARD__",msaa_guard).replace("__SOURCE_BLIT_GUARD__",blit_guard)

struct Copy { unsigned pixels{}; };

gc_cpp=r"""
#include <algorithm>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <limits>
#include <memory>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>
using u32=std::uint32_t;
using u64=std::uint64_t;
using VkImage=u64;
struct VkImageCreateInfo {
    int format{},imageType{};
    struct {u32 width{},height{},depth{};} extent;
    u32 mipLevels{},arrayLayers{},usage{},flags{};
};
struct MsaaScratchKey {
    int format{},type{};
    u32 width{},height{},depth{},levels{},layers{},usage{},flags{};
    bool operator==(const MsaaScratchKey&) const = default;
};
struct MsaaScratchImage {
    MsaaScratchKey key{};
    std::shared_ptr<VkImage> image{};
    u64 tick{};
    u32 unused_frames{};
};
struct NativeGpuPinWitness {
    bool pinned{};
    bool CanRetireNativeGpu() const noexcept { return !pinned; }
};
struct PendingGpuResource {
    u64 tick{};
    u64 frame{};
    std::shared_ptr<NativeGpuPinWitness> resource =
        std::make_shared<NativeGpuPinWitness>();
};
struct Semaphore {
    u64 completed{};
    mutable u32 polls{};
    u64 KnownGpuTick() const {++polls;return completed;}
};
struct Scheduler {
    Semaphore semaphore{};
    u32 is_free_calls{};
    Semaphore& GetMasterSemaphore() {return semaphore;}
    bool IsFree(u64 tick) {++is_free_calls;return tick<=semaphore.KnownGpuTick();}
    u64 CurrentTick() {return 100;}
};
struct Allocator {
    u64 next=1;
    std::shared_ptr<VkImage> CreateImage(const VkImageCreateInfo&) {
        return std::make_shared<VkImage>(next++);
    }
};
struct TextureCacheRuntime {
    Scheduler scheduler{};
    Allocator memory_allocator{};
    std::vector<MsaaScratchImage> msaa_scratch_images{};
    std::vector<std::pair<u64,int>> pending_resolve_shadows{};
    std::vector<PendingGpuResource> pending_retired_views{};
    std::vector<PendingGpuResource> pending_retired_images{};
    u64 gpu_retire_frame{};
    VkImage AcquireMsaaScratchImage(const VkImageCreateInfo&);
    void TickFrame();
};
__GC_ACQUIRE__
__GC_TICK__
int main() {
    TextureCacheRuntime r;
    // Native has no pending MSAA objects at startup. Both operations must
    // avoid even the formerly unconditional GPU completion snapshot.
    r.TickFrame();
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(r.scheduler.semaphore.polls==0);
#endif
    // Checked-out scratch has no retired tick. Multiple GC frames must not
    // probe the GPU; releasing it must resume the original aging behavior.
    TextureCacheRuntime checked_out;
    checked_out.msaa_scratch_images.push_back(
        {{},std::make_shared<VkImage>(4242),std::numeric_limits<u64>::max(),0});
    checked_out.TickFrame();
    checked_out.TickFrame();
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(checked_out.scheduler.semaphore.polls==0);
    assert(checked_out.scheduler.is_free_calls==0);
#else
    assert(checked_out.scheduler.is_free_calls==2);
#endif
    assert(checked_out.msaa_scratch_images[0].unused_frames==0);
    checked_out.msaa_scratch_images[0].tick=5;
    checked_out.scheduler.semaphore.completed=5;
    checked_out.TickFrame();
    assert(checked_out.msaa_scratch_images[0].unused_frames==1);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(checked_out.scheduler.semaphore.polls==1);
#else
    assert(checked_out.scheduler.is_free_calls==3);
#endif
    VkImageCreateInfo ci{};
    ci.format=2;ci.imageType=3;ci.extent={64,32,1};
    ci.mipLevels=1;ci.arrayLayers=1;ci.usage=7;ci.flags=0;
    const MsaaScratchKey key{2,3,64,32,1,1,1,7,0};
    TextureCacheRuntime cold;
    assert(cold.AcquireMsaaScratchImage(ci)==1);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(cold.scheduler.semaphore.polls==0);
#endif
    // Nonempty cache, no matching image key: the native GPU semaphore must
    // not be sampled. The original desktop key rejection is unchanged.
    TextureCacheRuntime no_match;
    auto other_key=key;
    other_key.format=999;
    no_match.msaa_scratch_images.push_back(
        {other_key,std::make_shared<VkImage>(777),0,0});
    assert(no_match.AcquireMsaaScratchImage(ci)==1);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(no_match.scheduler.semaphore.polls==0);
#else
    assert(no_match.scheduler.is_free_calls==0);
#endif
    for (u64 i=0;i<8;++i)
        r.msaa_scratch_images.push_back({key,std::make_shared<VkImage>(100+i),
                                        i==0 ? u64{8} : u64{20}, 0});
    r.scheduler.semaphore.completed=5;
    assert(r.AcquireMsaaScratchImage(ci)==1);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(r.scheduler.semaphore.polls==1 && r.scheduler.is_free_calls==0);
#else
    assert(r.scheduler.is_free_calls==8);
#endif
    r.scheduler.semaphore.completed=8;
    assert(r.AcquireMsaaScratchImage(ci)==100);
    assert(r.msaa_scratch_images[0].tick==std::numeric_limits<u64>::max());
    r.msaa_scratch_images[1].tick=9;
    r.msaa_scratch_images[1].unused_frames=60;
    r.msaa_scratch_images[2].tick=10;
    r.msaa_scratch_images[2].unused_frames=60;
    r.msaa_scratch_images[3].tick=7;
    r.msaa_scratch_images[3].unused_frames=1;
    r.pending_resolve_shadows={{7,1},{9,2},{10,3}};
    r.scheduler.semaphore.completed=9;
    [[maybe_unused]] const auto before_polls=r.scheduler.semaphore.polls;
    const auto before_isfree=r.scheduler.is_free_calls;
    r.TickFrame();
    assert(r.msaa_scratch_images.size()==8);
    assert(r.pending_resolve_shadows.size()==1);
    assert(r.pending_resolve_shadows[0].first==10);
    const auto find_image=[&](u64 id) {
        return std::find_if(r.msaa_scratch_images.begin(),r.msaa_scratch_images.end(),
                            [id](const auto& s){return *s.image==id;});
    };
    assert(find_image(101)==r.msaa_scratch_images.end());
    assert(find_image(102)!=r.msaa_scratch_images.end());
    assert(find_image(102)->unused_frames==0);
    assert(find_image(103)->unused_frames==2);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(r.scheduler.semaphore.polls==before_polls+1);
    assert(r.scheduler.is_free_calls==before_isfree);
#else
    assert(r.scheduler.is_free_calls>before_isfree+3);
#endif
    r.scheduler.semaphore.completed=10;
    r.TickFrame();
    assert(r.pending_resolve_shadows.empty());
    // The first completed tick starts the 60-frame idle counter. The scratch
    // must NOT be retired after only one eligible frame (native and desktop).
    assert(find_image(102)!=r.msaa_scratch_images.end());
    assert(find_image(102)->unused_frames==1);
    for (u32 frame=0;frame<59;++frame) r.TickFrame();
    assert(find_image(102)!=r.msaa_scratch_images.end());
    assert(find_image(102)->unused_frames==60);
    r.TickFrame();
    assert(find_image(102)==r.msaa_scratch_images.end());
    // Also cover resolve-only cleanup, which must still query completion.
    TextureCacheRuntime resolve_only;
    resolve_only.pending_resolve_shadows={{1,1}};
    resolve_only.scheduler.semaphore.completed=1;
    resolve_only.TickFrame();
    assert(resolve_only.pending_resolve_shadows.empty());
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(resolve_only.scheduler.semaphore.polls==1);
    // Resource retirement shares the same GPU completion snapshot: a
    // view/image-only frame MUST NOT take the old empty-GC fast path.
    TextureCacheRuntime retirement;
    retirement.pending_retired_views.push_back({7, 0});
    retirement.pending_retired_images.push_back({8, 0});
    retirement.scheduler.semaphore.completed = 7;
    for (u32 i=0; i<7; ++i) retirement.TickFrame();
    assert(retirement.pending_retired_views.size()==1);
    assert(retirement.pending_retired_images.size()==1);
    retirement.TickFrame();
    assert(retirement.pending_retired_views.empty());
    assert(retirement.pending_retired_images.size()==1); // tick 8 not done
    retirement.scheduler.semaphore.completed = 8;
    retirement.TickFrame();
    assert(retirement.pending_retired_images.empty());
    assert(retirement.scheduler.semaphore.polls==9);
    // A completed timeline alone is not sufficient for an image that an
    // active native guest dispatch still holds. Verify the exact extracted
    // production predicate retains the REAL owner until the pin drops.
    TextureCacheRuntime pinned;
    pinned.pending_retired_images.push_back({2, 0});
    assert(pinned.pending_retired_images[0].resource);
    pinned.pending_retired_images[0].resource->pinned = true;
    pinned.scheduler.semaphore.completed = 2;
    for (u32 i=0; i<10; ++i) pinned.TickFrame();
    assert(pinned.pending_retired_images.size()==1);
    pinned.pending_retired_images[0].resource->pinned = false;
    pinned.TickFrame();
    assert(pinned.pending_retired_images.empty());
    assert(pinned.scheduler.semaphore.polls==11);
#else
    assert(resolve_only.scheduler.is_free_calls==1);
#endif
    std::puts("F07_MSAA_COMPLETION_SNAPSHOT_PASS");
}
```

`tools/check-ps5-f07-reinterpret-stencil-regions-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Execute actual PS5 reinterpret region scratch planner with C++ UBSan.

The snippet is extracted from the maintained Vulkan owner, not copied by hand.
It validates separated depth/stencil planes, region offsets, array layers,
overflow, format and aspect compatibility. This is NOT Vulkan GPU execution.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
owner = (ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vk_texture_cache_cost.cpp").read_text()
begin = "void TextureCacheRuntime::ReinterpretImage(Image& dst, Image& src,"
end = "\nvoid TextureCacheRuntime::BlitImage("
assert owner.count(begin) == owner.count(end) == 1
method = owner[owner.index(begin):owner.index(end, owner.index(begin))]
start = "#ifdef PS5_NATIVE\n    // Every VkBufferImageCopy must occupy"
stop = "    const VkBuffer copy_buffer = GetTemporaryBuffer(total_size);"
assert method.count(start) == method.count(stop) == 1
planner = method[method.index(start):method.index(stop)]
assert planner.startswith("#ifdef PS5_NATIVE") and planner.rstrip().endswith("#endif")
assert "if (src_both || dst_both)" not in planner
assert "const bool dual_planes = src_both && dst_both;" in planner
assert "const size_t layers = from.imageSubresource.layerCount;" in planner
assert "source_width * bpp_in != dest_width * bpp_out" in planner
assert "scratch_used += plane_bytes * (dual_planes ? 2U : 1U);" in planner
assert "from_stencil.imageSubresource.aspectMask = VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_STENCIL_BIT" in planner
assert "to_stencil.imageSubresource.aspectMask = VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_STENCIL_BIT" in planner
# Production owner returns void; adapt its rejection exits to the
# boolean witness without changing any decision or computation.
planner = re.sub(r"\breturn;", "return false;", planner)

cpp = r'''
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <limits>
#include <vector>
using u32 = std::uint32_t;
using VkImageAspectFlags = std::uint32_t;
using VkDeviceSize = std::uint64_t;
constexpr VkImageAspectFlags VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT = 1U;
constexpr VkImageAspectFlags VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT = 2U;
constexpr VkImageAspectFlags VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_STENCIL_BIT = 4U;
struct Extent {
    u32 width, height, depth;
};
struct Subresource {
    VkImageAspectFlags aspectMask;
    u32 layerCount;
};
struct VkBufferImageCopy {
    VkDeviceSize bufferOffset{};
    Subresource imageSubresource{};
    Extent imageExtent{};
};
struct Copy {};
struct Info {u32 format;};
struct Image {Info info;};
u32 BytesPerBlock(u32 format) {return format;}
bool Plan(const std::vector<Copy>& copies,
          const Image& src, const Image& dst,
          VkImageAspectFlags src_aspect_mask,
          VkImageAspectFlags dst_aspect_mask,
          u32 bpp_in, u32 bpp_out, u32 img_bpp,
          std::vector<VkBufferImageCopy>& vk_in_copies,
          std::vector<VkBufferImageCopy>& vk_out_copies,
          size_t& total_size) {
    constexpr size_t max_size = (std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max)();
__PLANNER__
    return true;
}
bool Run(VkImageAspectFlags src_aspect, VkImageAspectFlags dst_aspect,
         u32 src_bpp, u32 dst_bpp,
         std::vector<Extent> extents, u32 layer_count,
         std::vector<VkBufferImageCopy>& a,
         std::vector<VkBufferImageCopy>& b,
         size_t& budget,
         u32 src_width=0) {
    std::vector<Copy> copies(extents.size());
    // The production MakeBufferImageCopy stage has already normalized a
    // combined D/S mask to its Depth plane before this scratch planner.
    const auto normalized_src = src_aspect == (VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT|
        VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_STENCIL_BIT) ? VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT : src_aspect;
    const auto normalized_dst = dst_aspect == (VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT|
        VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_STENCIL_BIT) ? VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT : dst_aspect;
    for (auto extent:extents) {
        a.push_back({0,{normalized_src,layer_count},
                     {src_width ? src_width : extent.width,
                      extent.height,extent.depth}});
        b.push_back({0,{normalized_dst,layer_count},extent});
    }
    return Plan(copies,{{src_bpp}},{{dst_bpp}},src_aspect,dst_aspect,
                src_bpp,dst_bpp,dst_bpp,a,b,budget);
}
int main() {
    constexpr u32 color=VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT;
    constexpr u32 both=VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT|VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_STENCIL_BIT;
    std::vector<VkBufferImageCopy> a,b;
    size_t size=0;
    // Two ordinary regions must use independent offsets, not two 0s.
    assert(Run(color,color,4,4,{{4,5,1},{3,2,1}},1,a,b,size));
    assert(size==104 && a.size()==2 && b.size()==2);
    assert(a[0].bufferOffset==0 && a[1].bufferOffset==80);
    assert(a[1].bufferOffset==b[1].bufferOffset);
    assert(a[1].imageSubresource.aspectMask==color);
    a.clear();b.clear();size=0;
    // D24S8: 20 pixels, 80 depth bytes + separately aligned 80-byte
    // stencil budget (actual stencil content 20 B). Neither overwrites
    // the other; both planes use single Vulkan aspects.
    assert(Run(both,both,4,4,{{4,5,1}},1,a,b,size));
    assert(size==160 && a.size()==2 && b.size()==2);
    assert(a[0].bufferOffset==0 && a[1].bufferOffset==80);
    assert(b[0].bufferOffset==0 && b[1].bufferOffset==80);
    assert(a[0].imageSubresource.aspectMask==VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT);
    assert(b[0].imageSubresource.aspectMask==VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT);
    assert(a[1].imageSubresource.aspectMask==VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_STENCIL_BIT);
    assert(b[1].imageSubresource.aspectMask==VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_STENCIL_BIT);
    a.clear();b.clear();size=0;
    // D32S8: conservative 8B/texel per plane. Array-layer count
    // multiplies the budget: Vulkan copies all three full layers.
    assert(Run(both,both,8,8,{{4,5,1}},3,a,b,size));
    assert(size==960 && a.size()==2 && b.size()==2);
    assert(a[1].bufferOffset==480 && b[1].bufferOffset==480);
    a.clear();b.clear();size=0;
    assert(Run(both,both,4,4,{{4,5,1},{4,2,1}},1,a,b,size));
    assert(size==224 && a.size()==4 && b.size()==4);
    // First two slots are original depth regions; stencil regions append.
    assert(a[0].bufferOffset==0 && a[1].bufferOffset==160);
    assert(a[2].bufferOffset==80 && a[3].bufferOffset==192);
    // Valid cross-format color reinterpret has the same real byte count.
    a.clear();b.clear();size=0;
    assert(Run(color,color,8,4,{{8,2,1}},1,a,b,size,4));
    assert(size==64 && a[0].bufferOffset==b[0].bufferOffset);
    // Incompatible formats or aspects cannot silently lose stencil.
    a.clear();b.clear();size=0;
    assert(!Run(both,color,4,4,{{4,5,1}},1,a,b,size));
    a.clear();b.clear();size=0;
    assert(!Run(color,both,4,4,{{4,5,1}},1,a,b,size));
    a.clear();b.clear();size=0;
    assert(!Run(both,both,4,8,{{4,5,1}},1,a,b,size));
    // Pixel ratio mismatch is not a license to copy the wrong bytes.
    a.clear();b.clear();size=0;
    assert(!Run(color,color,8,4,{{7,2,1}},1,a,b,size,4));
    // Overflow in layer footprint and scratch slot budget fails closed.
    a.clear();b.clear();size=0;
    assert(!Run(color,color,8,8,{{0xffffffffU,0xffffffffU,1}},2,a,b,size));
    a.clear();b.clear();size=0;
    assert(!Run(both,both,8,8,{{0xffffffffU,0xffffffffU,1}},1,a,b,size));
    std::puts("F07_NATIVE_STENCIL_REGIONS_PASS disjoint_regions=1 "
              "dual_aspects=1 multilayer_budget=1 mixed_format_refused=1 "
              "overflow_refused=1 ns1_path_unchanged=1");
}
```

`tools/check-ps5-f07-sampler-memo-collisions-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
"""F07 C01/T01: compile real PS5 graphics and compute sampler memo hotpaths.

No GPU, firmware, or FPS claim. The source-extracted bounded table must avoid
repeated texture-cache lookups when handles collide in their low four bits,
preserve all 16 entries under overflow, and never persist a sampler across
draws/dispatches or after a failed lookup.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import ast
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
VULKAN = ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan"
graphics = (VULKAN / "vk_graphics_pipeline_cost.cpp").read_text()
compute = (VULKAN / "vk_compute_pipeline_cost.cpp").read_text()
generator = (ROOT / "tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py").read_text()
oracle = (ROOT / "tools/check-vendored-vulkan-fork.py").read_text()

def extract(source, first, last):
    assert source.count(first) == 1 and source.count(last) >= 1
    start = source.index(first)
    end = source.index(last, start)
    return source[start:end]

graphics_memo = extract(
    graphics, "    struct SamplerMemo {",
    "    const auto config_stage{[&](size_t stage) LAMBDA_FORCEINLINE {")
compute_memo = extract(
    compute, "    struct ComputeSamplerMemo {",
    "#endif\n    const auto read_handle{[&](const auto& desc, u32 index) {")
assert graphics.count("std::array<SamplerMemo, 16> sampler_memo;") == 1
assert "occupied_sampler_slots & bit" in graphics_memo
assert "occupied_sampler_slots |= bit;" in graphics_memo
assert compute.count("std::array<ComputeSamplerMemo, 16> sampler_memo;") == 1
assert compute.count("u32 occupied_sampler_slots{};") == 1
assert "occupied_sampler_slots & bit" in compute_memo
assert "occupied_sampler_slots |= bit;" in compute_memo
assert "entry.valid" not in compute_memo
assert "sampler_memo[handle & 15U]" not in graphics + compute
assert "return texture_cache.GetSamplerId(handle, false);" in graphics_memo
assert "return texture_cache.GetSamplerId(handle, true);" in compute_memo
assert "for (std::size_t offset = 0; offset < sampler_memo.size(); ++offset)" in graphics_memo
assert "for (std::size_t offset = 0; offset < sampler_memo.size(); ++offset)" in compute_memo
assert compute_memo in generator, "compute generator drift"
oracle_line = next(line for line in oracle.splitlines()
                   if line.startswith("    sampler_memo = "))
assert ast.literal_eval(oracle_line.split(" = ", 1)[1]).lstrip().startswith(
    "// Sampler table mapping")
assert graphics_memo in ast.literal_eval(oracle_line.split(" = ", 1)[1]), (
    "graphics reconstruction oracle drift")
assert compute.index("#ifdef PS5_NATIVE\n    // Descriptor synchronization") < compute.index(
    "    struct ComputeSamplerMemo")
assert compute.index("    struct ComputeSamplerMemo") < compute.index(
    "#endif\n    const auto read_handle")

CPP = r"""
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <stdexcept>
using u32=std::uint32_t;
namespace VideoCommon {using SamplerId=u32;}
struct FakeTextureCache {
    unsigned calls{};
    bool fail_once{};
    VideoCommon::SamplerId GetSamplerId(u32 handle, bool compute) {
        ++calls;
        if(fail_once) {fail_once=false;throw std::runtime_error("retry");}
        return handle+(compute ? 900000u : 100000u);
    }
};
int main() {
    FakeTextureCache texture_cache;
    {
__MEMO__
        // These 16 distinct handles all collided at handle & 15.
        for (u32 i=0;i<16;++i) {
            const u32 handle=0x100u+(i<<4);
            assert(resolve_sampler(handle)==handle+__BASE__);
        }
        assert(texture_cache.calls==16);
        // Old direct-mapped memo repeatedly looked up all 16 under lock.
        for(unsigned repeat=0;repeat<100;++repeat)
            for(u32 i=0;i<16;++i) {
                const u32 handle=0x100u+(i<<4);
                assert(resolve_sampler(handle)==handle+__BASE__);
            }
        assert(texture_cache.calls==16);
        // Saturation cannot overwrite valid earlier entries or invent IDs.
        assert(resolve_sampler(0x900)==0x900+__BASE__);
        assert(resolve_sampler(0x900)==0x900+__BASE__);
        assert(texture_cache.calls==18);
        for(u32 i=0;i<16;++i)
            assert(resolve_sampler(0x100u+(i<<4))==0x100u+(i<<4)+__BASE__);
        assert(texture_cache.calls==18);
    }
    {
__MEMO__
        // New draw/dispatch -> no cross-call memo: guest descriptor tables
        // may have changed, so even the same handle must be re-resolved.
        assert(resolve_sampler(0x100)==0x100+__BASE__);
        assert(texture_cache.calls==19);
        // Failed lookups must not publish a bogus cached sampler ID.
        texture_cache.fail_once=true;
        bool caught=false;
        try { (void)resolve_sampler(0xabcdefu); }
        catch(const std::runtime_error&) {caught=true;}
        assert(caught);
        assert(resolve_sampler(0xabcdefu)==0xabcdefu+__BASE__);
        const unsigned calls=texture_cache.calls;
        assert(resolve_sampler(0xabcdefu)==0xabcdefu+__BASE__);
        assert(texture_cache.calls==calls);
    }
}
"""
compiler = (shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++")
            or shutil.which("g++"))
assert compiler, "C++20 compiler unavailable"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-f07-sampler-memo-") as temp:
    folder = Path(temp)
    for kind, body, base in (
        ("graphics", graphics_memo, "100000u"),
        ("compute", compute_memo, "900000u"),
    ):
        code = CPP.replace("__MEMO__", body).replace("__BASE__", base)
        source = folder / f"{kind}.cpp"
        source.write_text(code)
        for opt in ("-O0", "-O2"):
            exe = folder / f"{kind}{opt}"
            build = subprocess.run(
                [compiler, "-std=c++20", opt, "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror",
                 "-fsanitize=undefined", "-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
                 str(source), "-o", str(exe)],
                capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=90)
            assert build.returncode == 0, (kind, opt, build.stderr[-4000:])
            run = subprocess.run([str(exe)], capture_output=True, text=True,
                                 timeout=35)
            assert run.returncode == 0, (kind, opt, run.stderr[-4000:])
            print(f"F07_SAMPLER_MEMO_PASS kind={kind} opt={opt} "
                  "collision16=1 overflow=1 new_scope=1 exception=1")
print("F07_SAMPLER_MEMO_HOST_PASS graphics=1 compute=1 source_extracted=1")
```

`tools/check-ps5-f07-scheduler-record-rollback-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""F07: a rejected Vulkan command record cannot preserve an unsubmitted binding memo."""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
header=(root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/include/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_scheduler.h").read_text()
implementation=(root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_scheduler.cpp").read_text()
generator=(root/"tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py").read_text()
begin="    template <typename T>\n        requires std::is_invocable_v<T, vk::CommandBuffer, vk::CommandBuffer>\n    void RecordWithUploadBuffer(T&& command) {"
stop="    template <typename T>\n        requires std::is_invocable_v<T, vk::CommandBuffer>\n    void Record(T&& c) {"
assert header.count(begin)==header.count(stop)==1
method=header[header.index(begin):header.index(stop)]
assert "#ifdef PS5_NATIVE" in method
assert "InvalidateState();" in method
assert "if (!chunk->Record(command)) {" in method
assert "throw std::bad_alloc{};" in method
assert "F07 reject native scheduler second record refusal after rollover" in generator
assert "F07 include bad_alloc declaration for native rejected scheduler rollover" in generator
assert "#include <new>" in header
assert method.index("} catch (...) {") > method.index("(void)chunk->Record(command)")
assert "F07 invalidate native Vulkan binding memo after rejected record" in generator
start=implementation.index("void Scheduler::InvalidateState() {")
invalidate=implementation[start:implementation.index("\n}",start)]
for required in ("state.graphics_pipeline = nullptr;",
                 "state.graphics_pipeline_optimized = false;",
                 "state.rescaling_defined = false;",
                 "state.descriptor_buffer_bound = false;"):
    assert required in invalidate
for path in (".github/workflows/encore-core-fast-gate.yml",
             ".github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml"):
    assert "python3 -B tools/check-ps5-f07-scheduler-record-rollback-host.py" in (root/path).read_text()

cpp=r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <initializer_list>
#include <new>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <type_traits>
namespace vk { struct CommandBuffer {}; }
struct MockChunk {
    bool refuse_once{};
    bool refuse_always{};
    bool throw_record{};
    unsigned recorded{};
    template<typename T> bool Record(T&) {
        if (throw_record) throw std::bad_alloc{};
        if (refuse_always) return false;
        if (refuse_once) { refuse_once=false; return false; }
        ++recorded;
        return true;
    }
};
struct Scheduler {
    MockChunk storage{};
    MockChunk* chunk=&storage;
    bool throw_dispatch{};
    bool pipeline_memo{true};
    bool rescaling_memo{true};
    bool descriptor_memo{true};
    bool renderpass_active{true};
    unsigned invalidations{};
    unsigned dispatches{};
    std::uint64_t recorded_command_serial{};
    void DispatchWork() {
        if (throw_dispatch) throw std::bad_alloc{};
        ++dispatches;
    }
    void InvalidateState() {
        pipeline_memo=false;
        rescaling_memo=false;
        descriptor_memo=false;
        ++invalidations;
    }
""" + method + r"""
};
int main() {
    const auto cmd=[](vk::CommandBuffer, vk::CommandBuffer){};
    {
        Scheduler normal;
        normal.RecordWithUploadBuffer(cmd);
        assert(normal.storage.recorded==1 && normal.invalidations==0);
        assert(normal.recorded_command_serial==1);
        assert(normal.pipeline_memo && normal.descriptor_memo);
    }
    {
        Scheduler rollover;
        rollover.storage.refuse_once=true;
        rollover.RecordWithUploadBuffer(cmd);
        assert(rollover.dispatches==1 && rollover.storage.recorded==1);
        assert(rollover.invalidations==0);
        assert(rollover.recorded_command_serial==1);
    }
    {
        // First and second record refuse: native must throw, clear pipeline
        // memos and allow a later draw to bind again. Desktop is unchanged.
        Scheduler denied_twice;
        denied_twice.storage.refuse_always=true;
        bool failed=false;
        try { denied_twice.RecordWithUploadBuffer(cmd); }
        catch(const std::bad_alloc&) { failed=true; }
        assert(denied_twice.dispatches==1 && denied_twice.storage.recorded==0);
        assert(denied_twice.recorded_command_serial==1);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
        assert(failed && denied_twice.invalidations==1);
        assert(!denied_twice.pipeline_memo && !denied_twice.descriptor_memo);
#else
        assert(!failed && denied_twice.invalidations==0);
#endif
        assert(denied_twice.renderpass_active);
        denied_twice.storage.refuse_always=false;
        denied_twice.RecordWithUploadBuffer(cmd);
        assert(denied_twice.storage.recorded==1);
        assert(denied_twice.recorded_command_serial==2);
    }
    for (bool fail_record : {true,false}) {
        Scheduler denied;
        denied.storage.throw_record=fail_record;
        denied.storage.refuse_once=!fail_record;
        denied.throw_dispatch=!fail_record;
        bool failed=false;
        try { denied.RecordWithUploadBuffer(cmd); }
        catch(const std::bad_alloc&) { failed=true; }
        assert(failed && denied.storage.recorded==0);
        assert(denied.recorded_command_serial==1);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
        assert(denied.invalidations==1);
        assert(!denied.pipeline_memo && !denied.rescaling_memo && !denied.descriptor_memo);
#else
        assert(denied.invalidations==0);
        assert(denied.pipeline_memo && denied.rescaling_memo && denied.descriptor_memo);
#endif
        assert(denied.renderpass_active);
        denied.storage.throw_record=false;
        denied.storage.refuse_once=false;
        denied.throw_dispatch=false;
        denied.RecordWithUploadBuffer(cmd);
        assert(denied.storage.recorded==1);
        assert(denied.recorded_command_serial==2);
    }
}
"""
compiler=shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
assert compiler
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="f07-record-memo-") as temp:
    unit=Path(temp)/"test.cpp"
    unit.write_text(cpp)
    for native in (True,False):
        for opt in ("-O0","-O2"):
            output=Path(temp)/(("ps5" if native else "desktop")+opt[1:])
            flags=["-DPS5_NATIVE=1"] if native else []
            built=subprocess.run([compiler,"-std=c++20",opt,"-Wall","-Wextra","-Werror",
                                  "-fsanitize=undefined","-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
                                  *flags,str(unit),"-o",str(output)],
                                  capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=40)
            assert built.returncode==0,(native,opt,built.stderr[-4000:])
            tested=subprocess.run([str(output)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15)
            assert tested.returncode==0,(native,opt,tested.stderr[-4000:])
print("F07_SCHEDULER_RECORD_ROLLBACK_PASS first_accept=1 rollover=1 reject_record=1 reject_dispatch=1 replay=1 renderpass_preserved=1 desktop_original=1 O0=1 O2=1 UBSan=1")
```

`tools/check-ps5-f07-shader-cache-drain-host.py`:

```py
"""Compile the selected Vulkan PipelineCache destructor with queued shader writes.

The PS5 shutdown path must drain accepted serializer jobs before saving the
driver pipeline cache; the desktop path retains its original behavior.
Check the generator reproduces the same order, no live-draw wait introduced.
"""

import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
shader=(root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vk_pipeline_cache_cost.cpp").read_text()
```

```py
cpp = r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <vector>
using VkDeviceSize = std::uint64_t;
using VkDeviceMemory = std::uint64_t;
struct MultiRangeSource { VkDeviceMemory memory; VkDeviceSize memory_offset,offset,size; };
struct VkSparseMemoryBind {
    VkDeviceSize resourceOffset{},size{};
    VkDeviceMemory memory{};
    VkDeviceSize memoryOffset{};
    std::uint32_t flags{};
};
using Src = std::vector<MultiRangeSource>;
using Binds = std::vector<VkSparseMemoryBind>;
Binds Actual(const Src& sources) {
    Binds binds;
    binds.reserve(sources.size());
    VkDeviceSize resource_offset = 0;
__EXTRACTED__
    return binds;
}
struct Page {
    VkDeviceMemory memory;
    VkDeviceSize offset;
    bool operator==(const Page&) const = default;
};
std::vector<Page> Reference(const Src& src) {
    std::vector<Page> out;
    for (const auto& s : src)
        for (VkDeviceSize p=0; p<s.size; p+=4096)
            out.push_back({s.memory,s.memory_offset+s.offset+p});
    return out;
}
std::vector<Page> Expanded(const Binds& binds) {
    std::vector<Page> out;
    VkDeviceSize target=0;
    for (const auto& b : binds) {
        assert(b.resourceOffset==target && b.size && b.size%4096==0 && b.flags==0);
        for (VkDeviceSize p=0; p<b.size; p+=4096)
            out.push_back({b.memory,b.memoryOffset+p});
        target+=b.size;
    }
    return out;
}
void Check(const Src& src, [[maybe_unused]] std::size_t native_count) {
    const auto binds=Actual(src);
    assert(Reference(src)==Expanded(binds));
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(binds.size()==native_count);
#else
    assert(binds.size()==src.size());
#endif
}
int main(){
    Src contiguous;
    for(std::uint64_t i=0;i<64;++i)contiguous.push_back({7,8192,i*4096,4096});
    Check(contiguous,1);
    Src mixed{{7,4096,0,4096},{7,4096,4096,4096},
              {9,0,0,4096},{9,0,8192,4096},
              {9,0,12288,4096},{9,8192,8192,4096},
              {10,0,0,4096}};
    Check(mixed,4);
    Src split{{5,4096,4096,4096},{5,8192,4096,4096},
              {5,8192,8192,4096}};
    Check(split,1);
    for(std::uint64_t n=1;n<=73;++n){
        Src cases;
        VkDeviceSize physical=0;
        for(std::uint64_t i=0;i<n;++i){
            if(i%17==0)physical=4096;
            else physical+=i%9==0?8192:4096;
            cases.push_back({5+i/17,0,physical,4096});
        }
        const auto binds=Actual(cases);
        assert(Reference(cases)==Expanded(binds) && !binds.empty());
        assert(binds.size()<=cases.size());
#ifndef PS5_NATIVE
        assert(binds.size()==cases.size());
#endif
    }
    std::puts("F07_SPARSE_BIND_PAGE_PARITY_PASS");
}
""".replace("__EXTRACTED__", loop)
compiler = shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
assert compiler
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="f07-sparse-merge-") as temp:

            command = [compiler,"-std=c++20",opt,"-Wall","-Wextra","-Werror",
                       "-fsanitize=address,undefined","-fno-sanitize-recover=all",

            built=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=50)
            assert built.returncode==0,(native,opt,built.stderr[-5000:])
            run=subprocess.run([str(binary)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=20)
            assert run.returncode==0,(native,opt,run.stdout,run.stderr[-5000:])
            print("F07_SPARSE_BIND_PHYSICAL_PARITY_PASS",int(native),opt)
print("HOST_ONLY: GPU allocation and FPS are not measured")
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Source-extracted F07 PS5 texel-descriptor deterministic byte reuse regression.

A VkBufferView only initializes part of DescriptorUpdateEntry. Reusing an
entry with stale union bytes must not force spurious payload reallocations
on identical FC27 HUD texel descriptors. Desktop source stays unchanged.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
header=(ROOT/"vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/include/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_update_descriptor.h").read_text()
generator=(ROOT/"tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py").read_text()
begin="    void AddTexelBuffer(VkBufferView texel_buffer) {"
end="\n\n    void AddTexelBuffer(VkBufferView texel_buffer, VkDeviceAddress"

method=header[header.index(begin):header.index(end,header.index(begin))]
assert "F07 zero unused native texel descriptor payload bytes" in generator
assert "F07 zero native image descriptor payload bytes for legacy and buffer reuse" in generator

image_end="\n\n    void AddBuffer(VkBuffer buffer,"
assert header.count(image_begin)==1 and image_end in header[header.index(image_begin):]
image_methods=header[header.index(image_begin):header.index(image_end,header.index(image_begin))]
assert image_methods.count("std::memset(entry, 0, sizeof(*entry));")==2
assert "if (use_descriptor_buffer)" not in image_methods
assert "std::memset(entry, 0, sizeof(*entry));" in method

assert "#else\n        *(payload_cursor++) = texel_buffer;\n#endif" in method
for workflow in (".github/workflows/encore-core-fast-gate.yml",
                 ".github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml"):
    assert "python3 -B tools/check-ps5-f07-texel-descriptor-stability-host.py" in (ROOT/workflow).read_text()

cpp=r"""
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>
using VkBufferView=std::uint64_t;
using VkImageView=std::uint64_t;
using VkSampler=std::uint64_t;
using VkImageLayout=std::uint32_t;
inline constexpr VkSampler VK_NULL_HANDLE=0;
inline constexpr VkImageLayout VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL=1;
struct VkDescriptorImageInfo {
    VkSampler sampler{};
    VkImageView imageView{};
    VkImageLayout imageLayout{};
};
struct DescriptorUpdateEntry {
    VkBufferView texel_buffer{};
    VkDescriptorImageInfo image{};
    std::uint64_t unused[2]{};
    DescriptorUpdateEntry()=default;
    DescriptorUpdateEntry(VkBufferView view) : texel_buffer{view} {}
    DescriptorUpdateEntry& operator=(VkDescriptorImageInfo info) {
        image=info;return *this;
    }
    DescriptorUpdateEntry& operator=(VkBufferView view) {texel_buffer=view;return *this;}
};
static_assert(sizeof(DescriptorUpdateEntry)>sizeof(VkBufferView));
struct Queue {
    std::array<DescriptorUpdateEntry,8> payload{};
    bool use_descriptor_buffer{};
    DescriptorUpdateEntry* payload_cursor=payload.data();
__METHOD__
__IMAGE_METHODS__
};
int main() {
    Queue q;
    // Deliberately reuse storage containing distinct previous-descriptor bytes.
    std::memset(reinterpret_cast<unsigned char*>(&q.payload[0]),0xa5,sizeof(q.payload[0]));
    std::memset(reinterpret_cast<unsigned char*>(&q.payload[1]),0x5a,sizeof(q.payload[1]));
    std::memset(reinterpret_cast<unsigned char*>(&q.payload[2]),0xa5,sizeof(q.payload[2]));
    q.AddTexelBuffer(0xabc);
    q.AddTexelBuffer(0xabc);
    q.AddTexelBuffer(0xdef);
    assert(q.payload_cursor==q.payload.data()+3);
    assert(q.payload[0].texel_buffer==0xabc && q.payload[1].texel_buffer==0xabc);
    assert(q.payload[2].texel_buffer==0xdef);
    const bool same=std::memcmp(&q.payload[0],&q.payload[1],sizeof(q.payload[0]))==0;
    const bool changed=std::memcmp(&q.payload[0],&q.payload[2],sizeof(q.payload[0]))!=0;
    assert(changed);
    // Image descriptors must have stable padding even when the PS5 uses the
    // legacy descriptor-set path rather than a descriptor buffer.
    for (bool descriptor_buffer : {false,true}) {
        Queue images;
        images.use_descriptor_buffer=descriptor_buffer;
        for(std::size_t i=0;i<images.payload.size();++i) {
            std::memset(reinterpret_cast<unsigned char*>(&images.payload[i]),
                        (i%2) ? 0x5a : 0xa5,sizeof(images.payload[i]));
        }
        images.AddImage(0x123);
        images.AddImage(0x123);
        images.AddSampledImage(0x456,0x789);
        images.AddSampledImage(0x456,0x789);
        assert(images.payload[0].image.imageView==0x123);
        assert(images.payload[1].image.imageView==0x123);
        assert(images.payload[2].image.sampler==0x789);
        assert(images.payload[3].image.sampler==0x789);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
        assert(std::memcmp(&images.payload[0],&images.payload[1],sizeof(images.payload[0]))==0);
        assert(std::memcmp(&images.payload[2],&images.payload[3],sizeof(images.payload[2]))==0);
#endif
    }
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(same);
    for(std::size_t i=sizeof(VkBufferView);i<sizeof(q.payload[0]);++i) {
        const auto* b=reinterpret_cast<const unsigned char*>(&q.payload[0]);
        assert(b[i]==0);
    }
#else
    assert(!same);
#endif
}
""".replace("__METHOD__",method).replace("__IMAGE_METHODS__",image_methods)
compiler=shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
```

```py
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <memory>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <type_traits>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>
struct Maker {};
template<class F> struct Guard{F fn;~Guard(){fn();}};
template<class F> Guard<std::decay_t<F>> operator+(Maker,F&& f){return {std::forward<F>(f)};}
#define SCOPE_EXIT auto scope_exit_guard = Maker{} + [&]
using ImageId = std::size_t;
enum class ImageFlagBits:unsigned {IsDecoding=1};
struct Flags {
    unsigned bits{};
    Flags& operator|=(ImageFlagBits b){bits|=static_cast<unsigned>(b);return *this;}
    Flags& operator&=(unsigned n){bits&=n;return *this;}
};
unsigned operator~(ImageFlagBits b){return ~static_cast<unsigned>(b);}
unsigned operator&(Flags f,ImageFlagBits b){return f.bits&static_cast<unsigned>(b);}
bool True(unsigned n){return n!=0;}
struct Image{Flags flags{};struct Info{int code{};} info{};};
struct AsyncDecodeContext{};
struct Worker {
    bool fail{};
    unsigned admitted{};
    void QueueWork(std::function<void()> fn) {
        if(fail) throw std::runtime_error("enqueue failure");
        ++admitted;
        fn();
    }
};
struct UnswizzleQueue {
    bool fail{};
    struct Pending{ImageId image_id;Image::Info info;};
    std::vector<Pending> pending;
    void push_back(Pending p){
        if(fail)throw std::runtime_error("push failure");
        pending.push_back(p);
    }
};
template<class P> struct TextureCache {
    std::vector<std::unique_ptr<AsyncDecodeContext>> async_decodes;
    Worker texture_decode_worker;
    UnswizzleQueue unswizzle_queue;
    void ProbeAdmission(Image& image,bool fail_prepare){
__GUARD__
        auto decode=std::make_unique<AsyncDecodeContext>();
        auto* decode_ptr=decode.get();
__POINTER__
        async_decodes.push_back(std::move(decode));
        if(fail_prepare)throw std::runtime_error("preparation failure");
        auto func=[]{};
__QUEUE__
    }
    void QueueAsyncUnswizzle(Image&,ImageId);
};
__UNSWIZZLE__
int main(){
    TextureCache<int> cache;
    Image image;
    bool caught=false;
    try{cache.ProbeAdmission(image,true);}
    catch(const std::runtime_error&){caught=true;}
    assert(caught && !True(image.flags&ImageFlagBits::IsDecoding));
    assert(cache.async_decodes.empty());
    caught=false;
    cache.texture_decode_worker.fail=true;
    try{cache.ProbeAdmission(image,false);}
    catch(const std::runtime_error&){caught=true;}
    assert(caught && !True(image.flags&ImageFlagBits::IsDecoding));
    assert(cache.async_decodes.empty() && cache.texture_decode_worker.admitted==0);
    cache.texture_decode_worker.fail=false;
    cache.ProbeAdmission(image,false);
    assert(True(image.flags&ImageFlagBits::IsDecoding));
    assert(cache.async_decodes.size()==1 && cache.texture_decode_worker.admitted==1);
    // If an older job already owns the flag, a later failed admission
    // must not clear it or erase the older decode's allocation.
    cache.texture_decode_worker.fail=true;
    caught=false;
    try{cache.ProbeAdmission(image,false);}
    catch(const std::runtime_error&){caught=true;}
    assert(caught && True(image.flags&ImageFlagBits::IsDecoding));
    assert(cache.async_decodes.size()==1);
    Image another;
    cache.unswizzle_queue.fail=true;
    caught=false;

    catch(const std::runtime_error&){caught=true;}

    assert(cache.unswizzle_queue.pending.empty());
    cache.unswizzle_queue.fail=false;
    cache.QueueAsyncUnswizzle(another,3);
    assert(True(another.flags&ImageFlagBits::IsDecoding));
    assert(cache.unswizzle_queue.pending.size()==1);
```

```py
    c.slot_images[0].info.size.depth=1;
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""F07 P0.4: source-extracted stale multi-frame unswizzle cancellation.

The test compiles the actual queue/cancel/throttle prefix of TickAsyncUnswizzle.
It proves deferred release of initialized staging, preservation of pending CPU
revisions, rejection of remapped bytes, and desktop's unchanged cooldown.
No claim is made about GPU command completion or console frame latency.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
active = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan-cache/video_core/texture_cache/texture_cache.h").read_text()
pinned = (root / "vendor/sources/eden/src/video_core/texture_cache/texture_cache.h").read_text()

method_end = "\n    if (!task.initialized) {"

end = active.index(method_end, start)

    assert(!True(unavailable.slot_images[0].flags&ImageFlagBits::IsDecoding));
```

```py
# not a Python approximation. A queued job after object destruction must see
# cancelled=true BEFORE any access to 'this'.
code = r"""
#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <exception>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>
#include <cassert>
#include <stdexcept>
#define LOG_WARNING(...) ((void)0)
using VkRenderPass = int;
using VkPipelineCreateFlags = int;
namespace vk { using Pipeline = int; }
namespace Common {
class ThreadWorker {
public:
    ThreadWorker(int count, const char*) { assert(count == 1); }
    inline static std::atomic_bool reject_next{false};
    template<class F> void QueueWork(F func) {
        if (reject_next.exchange(false)) throw std::runtime_error("queue rejected");
        jobs.emplace_back([func = std::move(func)]() mutable {
            std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(4));
            func();
        });
    }
    ~ThreadWorker() { for (auto& job : jobs) job.join(); }
    std::vector<std::thread> jobs;
};
}
class GraphicsPipeline {
public:
    struct OptimizeState {
        std::mutex mutex;
        std::condition_variable done;
        bool cancelled{false};
        bool running{false};
    };
    std::shared_ptr<OptimizeState> optimize_state;
    // Existing optimization tests construct a finished first-use baseline.
    // A separate scenario below forces the constructor's worker to stay queued.
    std::atomic_bool is_built{true};
    std::mutex build_mutex;
    std::condition_variable build_condvar;
    vk::Pipeline optimized_pipeline{};
    std::atomic_bool optimized_ready{false};
    ~GraphicsPipeline();
    void QueueOptimizedPipeline(VkRenderPass);
    void MakePipeline(VkRenderPass, VkPipelineCreateFlags, vk::Pipeline*);
};
""" + worker + r"""
    // The body above is the actual generated native TU method signature.
    // This stub models Vulkan CreateGraphicsPipeline on a worker and the
    // release/acquire transfer to the main GPU thread.
    if (render_pass == -1) throw std::runtime_error("mock driver exception");
    if (target) *target = render_pass == 0 ? 0 : render_pass + extra_flags + 44;
}
int main() {
    for (int i = 0; i < 100; ++i) {
        GraphicsPipeline p;
        p.QueueOptimizedPipeline(11);
        // The queued job is already counted before it can start.
        assert(p.optimize_state->running);
        if (i % 2 == 0) {
            // Destroy before a queued worker starts. Must cancel safely.
            continue;
        }

        assert(p.optimized_pipeline == 55);
    }
    for (int pass : {0, -1}) {

        std::unique_lock lock{state->mutex};
        state->done.wait(lock, [&] { return !state->running; });
        assert(!p.optimized_ready.load(std::memory_order_acquire));
```
