```py
    // Destroy a pipeline while its FIRST-use worker is still queued, before
    // the optimizer can publish optimize_state. Deletion must block until
    // initial pipeline publication; otherwise the worker retains a dead this.
    {
        auto* p = new GraphicsPipeline;
        p->is_built.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
        std::atomic_bool allow_build{false};
        std::atomic_bool destroy_started{false};
        std::atomic_bool destroyed{false};
        std::thread build([p, &allow_build] {
            while (!allow_build.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
                std::this_thread::yield();
            {
                std::scoped_lock lock{p->build_mutex};
                p->is_built.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
            }
            p->build_condvar.notify_all();
        });
        std::thread teardown([p, &destroy_started, &destroyed] {
            destroy_started.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
            delete p;
            destroyed.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
        });
        while (!destroy_started.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
            std::this_thread::yield();
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(8));
        assert(!destroyed.load(std::memory_order_acquire));
        allow_build.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
        build.join();
        teardown.join();
        assert(destroyed.load(std::memory_order_acquire));
    }
    {
        GraphicsPipeline p;
        Common::ThreadWorker::reject_next.store(true);
        bool rejected = false;
        try { p.QueueOptimizedPipeline(11); }
        catch (const std::runtime_error&) { rejected = true; }
        assert(rejected && !p.optimize_state->running);
    }
}
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
"""Compile the real PS5 A32 fastmem diagnostic census; preserve every bit."""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
source = (ROOT / "src/host_memory.cpp").read_text()
header = (ROOT / "src/fastmem.h").read_text()
assert "std::uint64_t direct_reads, direct_writes" in header
assert source.count("Stats WindowStats() noexcept {") == 1
method = "Stats WindowStats() noexcept {" + source.split(
    "Stats WindowStats() noexcept {", 1)[1].split(
    "\n}\n} // namespace Eden::Fastmem", 1)[0] + "\n}"
assert "std::memcpy(&guards, map + page, sizeof(guards));" in method
assert "std::popcount(guards & lane_bits)" in method
assert "std::popcount((guards >> 1) & lane_bits)" in method
assert "GuestPages % sizeof(std::uint64_t) == 0" in method
assert "for (std::size_t page = 0; page < GuestPages; ++page)" not in method
assert "python3 -B tools/check-ps5-fastmem-windowstats-host.py" in (
    ROOT / ".github/workflows/encore-core-fast-gate.yml").read_text()
assert "python3 -B tools/check-ps5-fastmem-windowstats-host.py" in (
    ROOT / ".github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml").read_text()

cpp = r"""
#include <array>
#include <atomic>
#include <bit>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <vector>
constexpr std::size_t GuestPages = std::size_t{1} << 20;
constexpr std::uint8_t ReadBlocked = 1, WriteBlocked = 2;
struct Stats {
    std::uint64_t window, mapped_pages, aliased_chunks;
    std::uint64_t direct_reads, direct_writes;
    std::uint64_t map_calls, unmap_calls, protect_calls;
    std::uint64_t kernel_calls, kernel_ns, failures;
};
struct Counters {
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> window{}, mapped_pages{}, aliased_chunks{};
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> map_calls{}, unmap_calls{}, protect_calls{};
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> kernel_calls{}, kernel_ns{}, failures{};
} counters;
std::atomic<const std::uint8_t*> current_map{nullptr};
namespace Eden::Fastmem {
METHOD
}
int main() {
    using Eden::Fastmem::WindowStats;
    const auto empty = WindowStats();
    assert(empty.direct_reads == 0 && empty.direct_writes == 0);
    // Force the source's 64-bit memcpy to work on deliberately misaligned
    // guest map bytes, and check every blocked bit against the old oracle.
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> storage(GuestPages + 9);
    auto* const map = storage.data() + 1;
    current_map.store(map, std::memory_order_release);
    counters.window.store(42);
    counters.mapped_pages.store(91);
    counters.aliased_chunks.store(9);
    counters.kernel_calls.store(3);
    std::uint64_t seed = 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
    for (unsigned mode = 0; mode < 8; ++mode) {
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < GuestPages; ++i) {
            seed ^= seed << 13; seed ^= seed >> 7; seed ^= seed << 17;
            map[i] = mode == 0 ? 0 : mode == 1 ? 3 :
                     mode == 2 ? 1 : mode == 3 ? 2 :
                     mode == 4 ? 0xff : mode == 5 ? 0xfc :
                     mode == 6 ? (i & 3) : static_cast<std::uint8_t>(seed >> 32);
        }
        std::uint64_t reads = 0, writes = 0;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < GuestPages; ++i) {
            reads += !(map[i] & ReadBlocked);
            writes += !(map[i] & WriteBlocked);
        }
        const auto stats = WindowStats();
        assert(stats.direct_reads == reads && stats.direct_writes == writes);
        assert(stats.window == 42 && stats.mapped_pages == 91 &&
               stats.aliased_chunks == 9 && stats.kernel_calls == 3);
    }
    current_map.store(nullptr, std::memory_order_release);
    const auto after = WindowStats();
    assert(after.direct_reads == 0 && after.direct_writes == 0);
    std::puts("FASTMEM_WINDOW_STATS_PASS patterns=8 pages=1048576 misaligned=1 counters=preserved");
}
""".replace("METHOD", method)
compiler = shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
assert compiler
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="f07-fastmem-windowstats-") as tmp:
    path = Path(tmp) / "windowstats.cpp"
    path.write_text(cpp)
    for opt in ("-O0", "-O2", "-O3"):
        executable = Path(tmp) / ("test_" + opt[1:])
        subprocess.run([compiler, "-std=c++20", opt, "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror",
                        "-fsanitize=address,undefined", "-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
                        str(path), "-o", str(executable)], check=True, timeout=60)
        subprocess.run([str(executable)], check=True, timeout=30)
print("FASTMEM_WINDOW_STATS_SOURCE_LINKED_PASS O0=1 O2=1 O3=1 console=unverified")
```

```py
"""Compile the selected native feedback-loop function without network access.

The pinned patch-replay test lives in check-ps5-feedback-loop-view-cache.py.
This additional preflight reads the *selected maintained source*, exercising
untextured -> sampled-depth -> untextured -> sampled-depth transitions.
It demonstrates no lost feedback barrier, not a console FPS improvement.
"""

import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
native = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan-cache/video_core/texture_cache/texture_cache.h").read_text()

# image-view identities while changed serials skip them. This test extracts
# the selected maintained function instead of its instrumented pinned replay,
# so install the SAME counter at the actual view comparison before compiling.

    (root / "tools/check-ps5-feedback-loop-view-cache.py").read_text())

    key_compare, "            ++view_key_comparisons;\n" + key_compare)

    // Avoid even the view-key comparison and snapshot for untextured draws.
    if (views.empty()) {
        last_feedback_loop_serial = render_targets_serial;
        last_feedback_texture_serial = texture_bindings_serial;
        last_feedback_loop_result = false;
        last_feedback_view_ids.clear();
        return;
    }
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compile REAL pinned native Vulkan BuiltPipeline() for PS5 and upstream desktop.

Covers a source-level draw-loss mechanism relevant to FC27 R400c:
nine no_pipeline events were logged but were not tagged with the exact cause.
Host test proves policy and worker completion contracts, not PS5 shader pixels.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
vk = (ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vk_pipeline_cache_cost.cpp").read_text()

# the optimized handle can already be published and valid. The worker still
# rejects a draw when neither handle is usable.

assert "if (!pipeline && !use_optimized)" in gp
assert "use_optimized ? *optimized_pipeline : *pipeline" in gp

fixture = r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
struct GraphicsPipeline {
    bool built;
    bool IsBuilt() const noexcept { return built; }
};
struct DrawState { struct { unsigned count; } index_buffer, vertex_buffer; };
struct Max3D { struct { DrawState draw_state; } draw_manager; };
struct PipelineCache {
    Max3D* maxwell3d;
    bool use_asynchronous_shaders;
    GraphicsPipeline* BuiltPipeline(GraphicsPipeline* pipeline) const noexcept;
};
""" + actual + r"""
int main() {
    Max3D maxwell{};
    PipelineCache cache{&maxwell, true};
    GraphicsPipeline waiting{false}, built{true};
    // Both full-screen-quads and larger HUD/glyph draw batches.
    maxwell.draw_manager.draw_state.index_buffer.count = 6;
    maxwell.draw_manager.draw_state.vertex_buffer.count = 6;
    assert(cache.BuiltPipeline(&waiting) == &waiting);
    maxwell.draw_manager.draw_state.index_buffer.count = 36;
    maxwell.draw_manager.draw_state.vertex_buffer.count = 24;
    assert(cache.BuiltPipeline(&built) == &built);
    cache.use_asynchronous_shaders = false;
    assert(cache.BuiltPipeline(&waiting) == &waiting);
    cache.use_asynchronous_shaders = true;
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    // With the previous policy, all nine synthetic pending draws would vanish.
    unsigned skipped = 0;
    for (unsigned i=0; i<9; ++i)
        skipped += cache.BuiltPipeline(&waiting) == nullptr;
    assert(skipped == 0);
#else
    // Preserve the non-console fast-first tradeoff exactly as before.
    assert(cache.BuiltPipeline(&waiting) == nullptr);
#endif
    return 0;
}
"""

cxx = next((tool for tool in ("clang++-18", "clang++", "g++") if shutil.which(tool)), None)
assert cxx, "C++20 toolchain required"
```

```py
def window(n: int, new: bool) -> str:
    items = [
        f"EDEN_VULKAN_FRAME frames={20+n} seconds=5.000 fps={4+n:.3f} worst_ms=180.000 late50=3 late100=1 late200=0",
        f"EDEN_DEV_GPU frame={20+n} cpu_ns={100_000_000*n} idle_ns={10_000_000*n} full_ns={1_000*n}",
        f"EDEN_DEV_GUEST cpu_write_calls={n} ipc_ns={1000*n} dequeue_ns={100*n} cache_lock_contended={n} cache_lock_blocked={n}",
    ]

        items.append(f"EDEN_PERF_CPU_POINT core={core} cpu_ns={1000000*n}")
        items.append(f"EDEN_PERF_PROGRESS mono_ns={n} core={core} compilations={2*n} compile_ns={2000*n}")
    if new:
        items.append(f"EDEN_MEMORY_LIVE frame={20+n} largest_last_confirmed={33554432*n} short={int(n==2)}")
        items.append(f"EDEN_JIT_SPARSE_MEMORY phase=dev-profile reserved={134217728} committed={2097152*n}")
        items.append(f"EDEN_DEV_SNAPSHOT_COST mono_ns={123456789*n} elapsed_ns={3500000*n}")
        items.append(f"EDEN_VULKAN_GC_SCAN frame={20+n} visits={200*n} skipped={150*n} evicted={10*n} cap=8192")
    return "\n".join(items) + "\n"

    assert not old.memory_live and not old.sparse and not old.snapshot_cost
    assert len(new.memory_live) == len(new.sparse) == len(new.snapshot_cost) == 2

    assert sample["direct_memory_short"] == 1

    # to each native stdout marker. It must still parse all nine streams.
```

`tools/check-ps5-freebsd11-ule-topology.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""R379: actual FreeBSD 11.4 ULE XML masks and SMT/HTT flag variants."""
from pathlib import Path
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
header=(root/'headless/ps5_cpu_topology.h').read_text()
assert 'FreeBsdMask(' in header
assert 'name=\\"SMT\\"' in header and 'name=\\"HTT\\"' in header
assert 'word != 0' in header
code=r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <string>
#include <array>
#include <cstdio>
#include "ps5_cpu_topology.h"
using Eden::CpuTopology::ParseSmtGroups;
using Eden::CpuTopology::FreeBsdMask;
std::string Xml(bool htt, bool mix, bool thread_only=false) {
    std::string xml="<groups>\n <group level=\"1\" cache-level=\"0\">\n"
                    " <cpu count=\"13\" mask=\"1fff,0,0,0\">all</cpu>\n"
                    " <children>\n";
    for(unsigned i=0;i<7;++i) {
        const unsigned long long mask=3ULL<<(2*i);
        char raw[100];
        std::snprintf(raw,sizeof(raw),"%llx,0,0,0",mask);
        xml+="<group level=\"2\" cache-level=\"1\">\n";
        xml+="<cpu count=\"2\" mask=\""+std::string(raw)+"\">siblings</cpu>\n";
        xml+="<flags><flag name=\"THREAD\">THREAD group</flag>";
        if(!thread_only) {
            const bool as_htt=htt && (!mix || i%2==0);
            xml+=as_htt?"<flag name=\"HTT\">HTT group</flag>"
                       :"<flag name=\"SMT\">SMT group</flag>";
        }
        xml+="</flags></group>\n";
    }
    xml+="</children></group></groups>\n";
    return xml;
}
int main(){
    constexpr unsigned long long allowed=0x1fff;
    std::array<int,64> ids{};
    auto expect=[&](const std::string& xml, bool ok) {
        assert(ParseSmtGroups(xml,allowed,ids)==ok);
        if(ok) {
            for(unsigned i=0;i<13;++i)
                assert(ids[i]==int(i&~1u)); // 13 allowed CPUs, 7 siblings
        } else {
            for(int id:ids)assert(id==-1);
        }
    };
    expect(Xml(false,false),true);
```

```py
#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
namespace Common {
struct Clock {
    std::atomic<long long> current{1'000'000};
    std::atomic<unsigned> reads{0};
    std::chrono::nanoseconds GetTimeNS() noexcept {
        reads.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        return std::chrono::nanoseconds{current.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)};
    }
};
inline Clock g_wall_clock;
}
namespace Eden::Performance {
struct Totals { std::atomic<unsigned long long> calls{}, nanoseconds{}, requested_bytes{}; };
inline std::atomic<bool> detailed_gpu_profile{false};
__IMPL__
}
int main() {
    using namespace Eden::Performance;
    Totals totals;
    std::atomic<long long> active{0};
    // When disabled or already satisfied, there are no clocks or writes.
    { DiagnosticActiveTimer t(totals, active, true); }
    assert(Common::g_wall_clock.reads == 0 && active == 0 && totals.calls == 0);
    detailed_gpu_profile = true;
    { DiagnosticActiveTimer t(totals, active, false); }
    assert(Common::g_wall_clock.reads == 0 && active == 0 && totals.calls == 0);
    {
        DiagnosticActiveTimer t(totals, active, true);
        assert(active == 1'000'000);
        Common::g_wall_clock.current = 10'000'000;
        assert(ActiveDiagnosticWaitNs(active) == 9'000'000);
    }
    assert(active == 0);
    assert(ActiveDiagnosticWaitNs(active) == 0);
    assert(totals.calls == 1 && totals.nanoseconds == 9'000'000);
    // A subsequent wait reuses the active slot without inventing stale time.
    Common::g_wall_clock.current = 12'000'000;
    { DiagnosticActiveTimer t(totals, active, true);
      Common::g_wall_clock.current = 12'250'000; }
    assert(totals.calls == 2 && totals.nanoseconds == 9'250'000);
    assert(active == 0);
}
""".replace("__IMPL__", impl)
compiler = next((v for v in ("clang++-18", "clang++", "g++") if shutil.which(v)), None)
if compiler is None:
    raise SystemExit("C++20 compiler not available")
env = os.environ.copy()

    sdk = Path("/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX15.4.sdk")
    if sdk.is_dir():
        env["SDKROOT"] = str(sdk)
```

`tools/check-ps5-gpu-producer-wake.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
"""Exercise PS5 stop-aware SPSC producer with full queue, cancellation and FIFO.

The template method is the real one selected from the maintained GPU source.
The host shim reproduces the pinned SPSC queue's indexes, CV protocols and live union-slot lifetime.
Native SDK compilation remains a separate PS5 build gate.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
# Extract the real producer method from the complete, shipping GPU header.
# The old gpu_queue_stop_wait.inc has been retired; the selected full queue header is authoritative.
active_gpu = root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-gpu"
header = (active_gpu / "include/common/bounded_threadsafe_queue.h").read_text()
quiet = (active_gpu / "gpu_thread_quiet.cpp").read_text()
dev = (active_gpu / "gpu_thread_dev.cpp").read_text()
cmake = (root / "headless/CMakeLists.txt").read_text()
method_start = "    template <typename... Args>\n    bool EmplaceWaitWithStopToken("
method_end = "\n\n    bool TryPop("
assert header.count(method_start) == 1
start = header.index(method_start)
end = header.find(method_end, start)
assert end > start, 'canonical GPU queue method boundary missing'
inc = header[start:end].strip()
assert "EmplaceWaitWithStopToken" in inc
assert "producer.cv.wait(lock, stop_token" in inc
assert "consumer.index.load(std::memory_order_acquire)" in inc
assert "std::construct_at" in inc
assert "consumer.cv.notify_one()" in inc
assert "union Slot {" in header
assert "std::array<Slot, Capacity> m_data;" in header
assert header.count("std::construct_at(std::addressof(m_data[pos].value)") == 2
assert header.count("std::destroy_at(std::addressof(m_data[pos].value));") == 1
assert "std::destroy_at(std::addressof(m_data[cursor % Capacity].value));" in header
for worker in (quiet, dev):
    assert "state.queue.TryEmplace(std::move(command_data), fence, block)" in worker
    assert "state.queue.EmplaceWaitWithStopToken(stop_source.get_token()," in worker
assert 'set(EDEN_ACTIVE_GPU "${PORT_ROOT}/vendor/encore-active/eden-gpu")' in cmake
assert 'configure_file("${EDEN_ACTIVE_GPU}/include/common/bounded_threadsafe_queue.h"' in cmake
assert 'configure_file("${EDEN_ACTIVE_GPU}/${EDEN_GPU_WORKER_VARIANT}"' in cmake
assert 'list(APPEND video_sources "${PORT_BUILD_DIR}/gpu_thread.cpp")' in cmake
assert 'file(READ "${PORT_ROOT}/vendor/encore-active/eden-core/gpu-injections/gpu_queue_stop_wait.inc"' not in cmake

cpp = r"""
#include <array>
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstddef>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <cstdio>
#include <future>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
#include <stop_token>
#include <thread>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

template <typename T, size_t Capacity> class Queue {
    static_assert(Capacity != 0 && (Capacity & (Capacity - 1)) == 0);
public:
    ~Queue() {
        const auto end = producer.index.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
        for (auto cursor = consumer.index.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
             cursor != end; ++cursor)
            std::destroy_at(std::addressof(m_data[cursor % Capacity].value));
    }
    template <typename... Args> bool TryEmplace(Args&&... args) noexcept {
        const auto write_index=producer.index.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
        if (write_index-consumer.index.load(std::memory_order_acquire)==Capacity)
            return false;
        std::construct_at(std::addressof(m_data[write_index%Capacity].value),std::forward<Args>(args)...);
        ++producer.index;
        std::scoped_lock lock{consumer.cv_mutex}; consumer.cv.notify_one();
        return true;
    }
    bool TryPop(T& target) noexcept {
        const auto read_index=consumer.index.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
        if (read_index==producer.index.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) return false;
        target=std::move(m_data[read_index%Capacity].value);
        std::destroy_at(std::addressof(m_data[read_index%Capacity].value));
        ++consumer.index;
        std::scoped_lock lock{producer.cv_mutex}; producer.cv.notify_one();
        return true;
    }
STOP_CODE
private:
    union Slot {
        Slot() noexcept {}
        ~Slot() {}
        T value;
    };
    std::array<Slot,Capacity> m_data;
    alignas(64) struct {
        std::atomic_size_t index{0};
        std::condition_variable_any cv;
        std::mutex cv_mutex;
    } producer;
    alignas(64) struct {
        std::atomic_size_t index{0};
        std::condition_variable_any cv;
        std::mutex cv_mutex;
    } consumer;
};
int main() {
    using namespace std::chrono_literals;
    {
        Queue<int,2> q;
        assert(q.TryEmplace(1) && q.TryEmplace(2) && !q.TryEmplace(3));
        std::stop_source src;
        std::promise<bool> complete;
        auto result=complete.get_future();
        std::thread waiter([&] {complete.set_value(q.EmplaceWaitWithStopToken(src.get_token(),3));});
        assert(result.wait_for(20ms)==std::future_status::timeout);
        src.request_stop();
        assert(result.wait_for(1s)==std::future_status::ready && !result.get());
        waiter.join();
        int v=0; assert(q.TryPop(v) && v==1); assert(q.TryPop(v) && v==2);
        assert(!q.TryPop(v));
    }
    {
        Queue<int,2> q;
        assert(q.TryEmplace(11) && q.TryEmplace(12));
        std::stop_source src;
        std::promise<bool> complete; auto result=complete.get_future();
        std::thread waiter([&] {complete.set_value(q.EmplaceWaitWithStopToken(src.get_token(),13));});
        assert(result.wait_for(20ms)==std::future_status::timeout);
        int v=0; assert(q.TryPop(v) && v==11);
        assert(result.wait_for(1s)==std::future_status::ready && result.get());
        waiter.join();
        assert(q.TryPop(v) && v==12); assert(q.TryPop(v) && v==13);
        assert(!q.TryPop(v));
    }
    // A 256-entry native queue absorbs long multi-draw submission bursts
    // while retaining bounded capacity, FIFO order and stop-aware backpressure.
    {
        Queue<int,256> q;
        for (int i=0; i<256; ++i) assert(q.TryEmplace(i));
        assert(!q.TryEmplace(256));
        std::stop_source src;
        std::promise<bool> completion;
        auto result=completion.get_future();
        std::thread producer([&] {
            completion.set_value(q.EmplaceWaitWithStopToken(src.get_token(),256));
        });
        assert(result.wait_for(20ms)==std::future_status::timeout);
        int value=-1;
        assert(q.TryPop(value) && value==0);
        assert(result.wait_for(1s)==std::future_status::ready && result.get());
        producer.join();
        for (int i=1; i<=256; ++i) {
            assert(q.TryPop(value) && value==i);
        }
        assert(!q.TryPop(value));
    }
    {
        Queue<int,8> q;
        std::stop_source src;
        constexpr int n=4000;
        std::thread producer([&] {
            for (int i=0;i<n;++i) {
                if (!q.TryEmplace(i))
                    assert(q.EmplaceWaitWithStopToken(src.get_token(),i));
            }
        });
        std::thread consumer([&] {
            for (int i=0;i<n;++i) {
                int value;
                while (!q.TryPop(value)) std::this_thread::yield();
                assert(value==i);
            }
        });
        producer.join(); consumer.join();
    }
    // 64 independent title-like lifecycles with bursty GPU producers and
    // deliberately delayed consumers. The native stop-aware method is
    // extracted from the maintained eden-gpu queue header, not reimplemented here.
    for (int session=0; session<64; ++session) {
        Queue<int,256> q;
        constexpr int items=384;
        std::stop_source src;
        std::thread producer([&] {
            for(int i=0; i<items; ++i) {
                if(!q.TryEmplace(i))
                    assert(q.EmplaceWaitWithStopToken(src.get_token(),i));
                if((i+session)%37==0) std::this_thread::yield();
            }
        });
        std::thread consumer([&] {
            for(int i=0; i<items; ++i) {
                int value{-1};
                while(!q.TryPop(value)) std::this_thread::yield();
                assert(value==i);
                if((i+session)%17==0)
                    std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::microseconds(25));
            }
        });
        producer.join();
        consumer.join();
        int last{};
        assert(!q.TryPop(last));
    }
    // Shutdown when producer is waiting on a full native command queue.
    // No command should be published after cancellation or outlive the queue.
    for (int cycle=0; cycle<64; ++cycle) {
        Queue<int,8> q;
        for(int i=0;i<8;i++) assert(q.TryEmplace(i));
        std::stop_source src;
        std::promise<bool> promise;
        auto future=promise.get_future();
        std::thread blocked([&] {
            promise.set_value(q.EmplaceWaitWithStopToken(src.get_token(),99));
        });
        assert(future.wait_for(1ms)==std::future_status::timeout);
        src.request_stop();
        assert(future.wait_for(2s)==std::future_status::ready);
        assert(!future.get());
        blocked.join();
        int value{-1};
        for(int i=0;i<8;i++) { assert(q.TryPop(value) && value==i); }
        assert(!q.TryPop(value));
    }
    {
        auto resource = std::make_shared<int>(42);
        {
            Queue<std::shared_ptr<int>,2> q;
            assert(q.TryEmplace(resource));
            assert(resource.use_count() == 2);
        }
        // All live queue slots are destroyed when the queue is retired.
        assert(resource.use_count() == 1);
    }
    std::puts("PASS: exact native SPSC wait: 4096 base + 24576 bursty commands, 64 cancelled/full sessions");
}
""".replace("STOP_CODE", inc)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-ps5-gpu-cv-wake-") as tmp:
    source = Path(tmp) / "queue.cpp"
    exe = Path(tmp) / "queue"
    source.write_text(cpp)
    compiler = shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
    assert compiler, "C++20 compiler missing"
    subprocess.run([compiler,"-std=c++20","-O1","-g","-pthread",
                    "-Wall","-Wextra","-Werror",
                    str(source),"-o",str(exe)], check=True)
    subprocess.run([str(exe)], check=True, timeout=30)
print("HOST ONLY: native producer method + live union-slot lifetime; console compiler/frame pacing not qualified")
```

```py
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <mutex>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <thread>
namespace Eden::Performance {
enum class GraphicsDrawDrop { WorkerPipelineFailed };
inline std::atomic<int> dropped{0};
void RecordGraphicsDrawDrop(GraphicsDrawDrop) { dropped.fetch_add(1); }
}
struct Pipeline {
    std::atomic<bool> is_built{false};
    bool pipeline{};
    std::atomic_bool optimized_ready{false};
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    bool worker_draw_bind_valid{};
#endif
__REAL_READY_METHOD__
};
using GraphicsPipeline = Pipeline;
void worker_record(GraphicsPipeline* pipeline, int& count) {
__REAL_FAIL_GUARD__
    ++count;
}
int main() {
    int draws=0;
    Pipeline failed;
    // Four queued call sites: draw, indirect byte-count, indirect count,
    // and indirect direct (indexed or nonindexed).
    for(int i=0;i<4;++i)worker_record(nullptr,draws);
    for(int i=0;i<4;++i)worker_record(&failed,draws);
    failed.is_built.store(true,std::memory_order_release);
    for(int i=0;i<4;++i)worker_record(&failed,draws);
    assert(draws==0 && Eden::Performance::dropped.load()==12);
    Pipeline ok;
    std::mutex m;
    std::condition_variable cv;
    std::thread waiter([&]{
        std::unique_lock lock(m);
        cv.wait(lock,[&]{return ok.is_built.load(std::memory_order::acquire);});
        for(int i=0;i<4;++i)worker_record(&ok,draws);
    });
    std::thread creator([&]{
        // Publish under the same mutex as cv.wait. Without this lock,
        // notify_all() may precede the waiter's actual sleep even though
        // its predicate is atomic, causing an intermittent host-test hang.
        {
            std::lock_guard lock(m);
            ok.pipeline=true;
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
            ok.worker_draw_bind_valid=true;
#endif
            ok.is_built.store(true,std::memory_order_release);
        }
        cv.notify_all();
    });
    waiter.join();creator.join();
    assert(draws==4 && Eden::Performance::dropped.load()==12);
}
""".replace('__REAL_READY_METHOD__',method).replace('__REAL_FAIL_GUARD__',guard)
env=os.environ.copy()
```

`tools/check-ps5-graphics-payload-preflight-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Source-extracted first-use descriptor snapshot allocation witness.

The selected GPU owner preflights storage before paired guest-cache locks.
A guarded allocator proves that the subsequent descriptor snapshot writes
do not allocate under that lock; original, un-preflighted behavior must fail.
This is a host correctness/critical-section proof, NOT console FPS evidence.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
NATIVE = (ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vk_graphics_pipeline_cost.cpp").read_text()
GENERATOR = (ROOT / "tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py").read_text()
RASTER = (ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_rasterizer.cpp").read_text()

def extract(src, signature):
    assert src.count(signature) == 1
    pos = src.index(signature)
    first = src.index("{", pos)
    depth = 0
    for j in range(first, len(src)):
        depth += (src[j] == "{") - (src[j] == "}")
        if depth == 0:
            return src[pos:j+1]
    raise AssertionError("unbalanced body")

signature = "void GraphicsPipeline::PreflightDescriptorScratch() {"
method = extract(NATIVE, signature)
assert "void PreflightDescriptorScratch();" in GENERATOR
assert signature in GENERATOR
assert "last_descriptor_payload.reserve(num_descriptor_entries);" in GENERATOR
assert "last_descriptor_payload.reserve(num_descriptor_entries);" in method
# The native selected implementation must be identical to the generator's
# complete C++ body, not merely contain the expected marker.
assert method.replace("\n", r"\n") in GENERATOR, "maintained pipeline preflight drifted from staging"
assert "if (scratch.in_use) return;" in method
assert "last_descriptor_payload.capacity() < num_descriptor_entries" in method
assert RASTER.index("pipeline->PreflightDescriptorScratch();") < RASTER.index(
    "std::scoped_lock lock{buffer_cache.mutex, texture_cache.mutex};"
)
# Descriptor reads and vector writes still execute under the paired locks.
assert NATIVE.index("last_descriptor_payload.assign(entries, entries + num_descriptor_entries)") > (
    NATIVE.index("bool GraphicsPipeline::ConfigureDraw(")
)
# All three real snapshots must be preflighted before paired cache locks:
# descriptor-buffer, desktop legacy, and PS5's post-Record legacy commit.
assert NATIVE.count("last_descriptor_payload.assign(entries, entries + num_descriptor_entries)") == 3
configure = NATIVE[NATIVE.index("bool GraphicsPipeline::ConfigureDraw("):]
record_at = configure.index("    scheduler.Record([this, descriptor_data")
assert configure.count("last_descriptor_payload.assign(entries, entries + num_descriptor_entries)") == 3
assert configure.index("#ifndef PS5_NATIVE") < record_at
assert configure.index("#ifdef PS5_NATIVE\n    // Descriptor-set updates are encoded") > record_at

# Recreate the exact previous selected preflight from the reviewed delta.
snapshot_guard = """
    // Allocate the per-pipeline descriptor snapshot BEFORE the buffer/texture
    // cache mutex pair. ConfigureDraw still reads, compares and publishes the
    // actual guest descriptors only after taking both locks.
    if (num_descriptor_entries != 0 && descriptor_set_layout &&
        (uses_descriptor_buffer || !uses_push_descriptor) &&
        last_descriptor_payload.capacity() < num_descriptor_entries) {
        last_descriptor_payload.reserve(num_descriptor_entries);
    }
"""
assert method.count(snapshot_guard) == 1
prior = method.replace(snapshot_guard, "").replace(
    "GraphicsPipeline::PreflightDescriptorScratch()", "GraphicsPipeline::OldPreflight()"
)
assert prior != method

mock = r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdio>
#include <memory>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <vector>

inline bool cache_pair_locked = false;
inline unsigned cache_pair_allocator_attempts = 0;
template<typename T>
struct GuardedAllocator {
    using value_type = T;
    GuardedAllocator() = default;
    template<typename U> GuardedAllocator(const GuardedAllocator<U>&) {}
    T* allocate(std::size_t n) {
        if (cache_pair_locked) {
            ++cache_pair_allocator_attempts;
            throw std::logic_error("ALLOC_DURING_CACHE_PAIR");
        }
        return std::allocator<T>{}.allocate(n);
    }
    void deallocate(T* p, std::size_t n) {
        std::allocator<T>{}.deallocate(p,n);
    }
};
struct Scratch {
    bool in_use{};
    std::vector<int> views, samplers;
};
static thread_local Scratch graphics_descriptor_scratch{};
static thread_local Scratch graphics_descriptor_nested_scratch{};
struct GraphicsPipeline {
    std::size_t num_image_elements{}, num_textures{}, num_descriptor_entries{};
    bool descriptor_set_layout{}, uses_descriptor_buffer{}, uses_push_descriptor{};
    std::vector<int, GuardedAllocator<int>> last_descriptor_payload;
    void PreflightDescriptorScratch();
    void OldPreflight();
};
"""
checks = r"""
void update_snapshot(GraphicsPipeline& pipeline, unsigned elements) {
    std::vector<int> descriptors(elements, 24);
    // ConfigureDraw is called with both guest cache mutexes held.
    const auto data = pipeline.last_descriptor_payload.data();
    cache_pair_locked = true;
    pipeline.last_descriptor_payload.assign(descriptors.begin(), descriptors.end());
    cache_pair_locked = false;
    assert(pipeline.last_descriptor_payload.data() == data);
}
int main() {
    GraphicsPipeline pipeline;
    pipeline.num_image_elements = 13;
    pipeline.num_textures = 8;
    pipeline.num_descriptor_entries = 16;
    pipeline.descriptor_set_layout = true;
    pipeline.uses_descriptor_buffer = true;
    pipeline.PreflightDescriptorScratch();
    assert(graphics_descriptor_scratch.views.capacity() >= 13);
    assert(graphics_descriptor_scratch.samplers.capacity() >= 8);
    assert(pipeline.last_descriptor_payload.capacity() >= 16);
    update_snapshot(pipeline, 16);
    pipeline.PreflightDescriptorScratch();
    update_snapshot(pipeline, 16);

    // Descriptor sets (as opposed to descriptor buffers) also snapshot data.
    GraphicsPipeline set_pipeline;
    set_pipeline.num_descriptor_entries = 4;
    set_pipeline.descriptor_set_layout = true;
    set_pipeline.PreflightDescriptorScratch();
    assert(set_pipeline.last_descriptor_payload.capacity() >= 4);
    update_snapshot(set_pipeline, 4);

    // Push-descriptor-only pipelines do not use this snapshot.
    GraphicsPipeline push_pipeline;
    push_pipeline.num_descriptor_entries = 4;
    push_pipeline.descriptor_set_layout = true;
    push_pipeline.uses_push_descriptor = true;
    push_pipeline.PreflightDescriptorScratch();
    assert(push_pipeline.last_descriptor_payload.capacity() == 0);

    GraphicsPipeline empty;
    empty.descriptor_set_layout = true;
    empty.uses_descriptor_buffer = true;
    empty.PreflightDescriptorScratch();
    assert(empty.last_descriptor_payload.capacity() == 0);

    // Nested shader work uses private scratch, without touching the first
    // draw's scratch. The descriptor payload reservation remains per pipeline.
    graphics_descriptor_scratch.in_use = true;
    GraphicsPipeline nested;
    nested.num_image_elements = 7;
    nested.num_textures = 3;
    nested.num_descriptor_entries = 5;
    nested.descriptor_set_layout = true;
    nested.uses_descriptor_buffer = true;
    nested.PreflightDescriptorScratch();
    assert(graphics_descriptor_nested_scratch.views.capacity() >= 7);
    assert(nested.last_descriptor_payload.capacity() >= 5);
    update_snapshot(nested, 5);
    graphics_descriptor_scratch.in_use = false;
    const unsigned maintained_locked_allocations = cache_pair_allocator_attempts;
    assert(maintained_locked_allocations == 0);

    // The old implementation didn't reserve last_descriptor_payload before
    // locking the caches. Our guarded allocator catches its first allocation.
    GraphicsPipeline old;
    old.num_descriptor_entries = 16;
    old.descriptor_set_layout = true;
    old.uses_descriptor_buffer = true;
    old.OldPreflight();
    assert(old.last_descriptor_payload.capacity() == 0);
    cache_pair_locked = true;
    bool rejected = false;
    try {
        old.last_descriptor_payload.assign(16, 12);
    } catch (const std::logic_error&) {
        rejected = true;
    }
    cache_pair_locked = false;
    assert(rejected);
    assert(cache_pair_allocator_attempts == maintained_locked_allocations + 1);
    std::printf("F01_PAYLOAD_ALLOCATION_FIXTURE prior_under_lock=%u "
                "maintained_under_lock=%u scope=host_mock\n",
                cache_pair_allocator_attempts - maintained_locked_allocations,
                maintained_locked_allocations);
    std::puts("GPU_DESCRIPTOR_PAYLOAD_PREFLIGHT_PASS");
}
"""
program = mock + method + "\n\n" + prior + "\n\n" + checks
compiler = shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++") or shutil.which("c++")
assert compiler, "C++20 compiler required"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-gpu-payload-preflight-") as folder:
    cpp = Path(folder) / "main.cpp"
    cpp.write_text(program)
    for opt in ("-O0", "-O2"):

        build = subprocess.run([

        ], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=45)
        assert build.returncode == 0, build.stderr[-4000:]

        assert run.returncode == 0, (run.stdout, run.stderr[-4000:])
        assert "GPU_DESCRIPTOR_PAYLOAD_PREFLIGHT_PASS" in run.stdout
        expected = ("F01_PAYLOAD_ALLOCATION_FIXTURE prior_under_lock=1 "

        assert expected in run.stdout, (opt, run.stdout)
        print(expected, opt, flush=True)
        print("GPU_DESCRIPTOR_PAYLOAD_PREFLIGHT_PASS", opt, "allocation-before-pair")
```

```py
    y.pipeline_cache.selected = &textured;
    y.guest_descriptor_queue.full = true;

    z.guest_descriptor_queue.full = true;

    assert(z.guest_descriptor_queue.exact_checks == 1);
    Rasterizer n;
    n.pipeline_cache.selected = nullptr;
    n.Test();
    assert(n.scheduler.waits == 0 && Eden::Performance::dropped == 1);
    Rasterizer unchanged;
    unchanged.pipeline_cache.selected = &textured;
    unchanged.Test();
    assert(unchanged.guest_descriptor_queue.checks == 1);
    assert(unchanged.guest_descriptor_queue.exact_checks == 0);

    // A native MSAA draw must use its exact-sample shader, never the
    // ordinary guest shader pipeline or hidden sample-register mutation.

    forced.pipeline_cache.forced = &textured;
    forced.native_samples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_4_BIT;
    forced.native_msaa_clear.emplace();
    forced.Test();

    assert(forced.pipeline_cache.selects == 0);
    assert(forced.native_samples == VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_4_BIT);

    // and return to the ordinary NS1/NS2 shader selection.

    fallback.pipeline_cache.selected = &textured;
    fallback.native_samples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_2_BIT;
    fallback.native_msaa_clear.emplace();
    fallback.Test();
    assert(fallback.pipeline_cache.forced_selects == 1);
    assert(fallback.pipeline_cache.selects == 1);
    assert(fallback.native_samples == VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT);
    assert(!fallback.native_msaa_clear.has_value());
}
```

`tools/check-ps5-guest-cache-domains.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""R364: source-extracted buffer/texture CPU guest cache lock accounting."""
from pathlib import Path
import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
perf=(root/'headless/performance.h').read_text()
report=(root/'headless/performance.cpp').read_text()
active=(root/'vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_rasterizer.cpp').read_text()
oracle=(root/'tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py').read_text()
start=perf.index('struct GuestCacheDomainTotals {')
end=perf.index('// R310:',start)
methods=perf[start:end]
assert 'GuestCacheLock(Mutex& mutex, bool texture_domain = false)' in methods
assert 'if (!detailed_gpu_profile.load(std::memory_order_relaxed))' in methods
assert methods.index('mutex.lock();\n        return;') < methods.index('mutex.try_lock()')
assert 'domain.contended.fetch_add(1' in methods
assert 'domain.blocked.fetch_add(1' in methods
assert 'domain.wait_ns.fetch_add' in methods
assert 'domain.waited_ge1ms.fetch_add' in methods
assert 'domain.waited_ge10ms.fetch_add' in methods
assert 'domain.max_wait_ns.compare_exchange_weak' in methods
assert 'EDEN_GUEST_CACHE_LOCK_TAIL frame=%u domain=%s' in report
assert 'wait_ge1ms=%llu wait_ge10ms=%llu max_wait_ns=%llu' in report
for source in (active,oracle):
    assert source.count('::Eden::Performance::GuestCacheLock(texture_cache.mutex, true);')==2
    assert source.count('::Eden::Performance::GuestCacheLock(buffer_cache.mutex, false);')==1
assert 'EDEN_GUEST_CACHE_DOMAIN frame=%u domain=%s' in report
assert 'window_contended=%llu window_blocked=%llu window_wait_ns=%llu' in report
assert report.index('if (detailed_gpu_profile.load') < report.index('EDEN_GUEST_CACHE_DOMAIN')

cpp=r"""
#include <array>
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdint>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>
#include <cstdio>
#if !defined(__x86_64__)
#define __builtin_ia32_pause() ((void)0) // PS5 native path is x86_64
#endif
namespace Common {
struct Clock {
    std::atomic<unsigned long long> reads{};
    std::chrono::nanoseconds GetTimeNS() noexcept {
        // Publish a read only AFTER capturing the blocked-start timestamp.
        // The harness can then wait until a worker is definitely timing its lock wait.
        const auto started = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        const auto ns = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(
            started.time_since_epoch());
        reads.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_release);
        return ns;
    }
};
inline Clock g_wall_clock;
}
namespace Eden::Performance {
inline std::atomic<bool> detailed_gpu_profile{false};
inline std::atomic<unsigned> cache_lock_spins{0};
inline std::atomic<unsigned long long> cache_lock_contended{0},cache_lock_blocked{0};
inline std::atomic<unsigned long long> cache_lock_wait_ns{0};
__METHODS__
}
int main() {
    using namespace Eden::Performance;
    std::mutex buffer_mutex,texture_mutex;
    // No instrumentation work in production/quiet path.
    for(int i=0;i<3000;i++) {
        GuestCacheLock(buffer_mutex,false);
        buffer_mutex.unlock();
        GuestCacheLock(texture_mutex,true);
        texture_mutex.unlock();
    }
    assert(cache_lock_contended.load()==0 && cache_lock_blocked.load()==0);
    assert(guest_cache_domain_totals[0].contended.load()==0);
    assert(guest_cache_domain_totals[1].contended.load()==0);
    assert(Common::g_wall_clock.reads.load()==0);
    detailed_gpu_profile.store(true);
    auto exercise=[](std::mutex& m,bool texture) {
        // A thread-start signal does NOT mean GuestCacheLock has reached its
        // timed blocking path. Slow CI runners could resume it only after
        // unlocking and spuriously report a wait shorter than 10 ms.
        const auto initial_reads=Common::g_wall_clock.reads.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        m.lock();
        std::thread worker([&] {
            GuestCacheLock(m,texture);
            std::lock_guard unlock{m,std::adopt_lock};
        });
        const bool profiling = detailed_gpu_profile.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
        bool timing_started = false;
        if (profiling) {
            // Only detailed mode reads the clock. Expecting a timed read in
            // quiet mode made the test fail despite correct blocking behavior.
            // Source checkout, sanitizer startup and heavy native-build
            // competition can starve a newly created test thread for
            // several seconds. Preserve the mandatory observed-clock
            // handshake; extend only its upper bound, never drop the
            // assertion or infer that a thread started timing.
            const auto deadline=std::chrono::steady_clock::now()+std::chrono::seconds(15);
            while (Common::g_wall_clock.reads.load(std::memory_order_acquire)==initial_reads &&
                   std::chrono::steady_clock::now()<deadline) std::this_thread::yield();
            timing_started =
                Common::g_wall_clock.reads.load(std::memory_order_acquire)>initial_reads;
            if (timing_started) std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(15));
        } else {
            std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(15));
        }
        m.unlock();
        worker.join();
        if (profiling) assert(timing_started);
    };
    exercise(buffer_mutex,false);
    assert(guest_cache_domain_totals[0].contended.load()==1);
    assert(guest_cache_domain_totals[0].blocked.load()==1);
    assert(guest_cache_domain_totals[0].wait_ns.load()>0);
    assert(guest_cache_domain_totals[1].contended.load()==0);
    exercise(texture_mutex,true);
    assert(guest_cache_domain_totals[1].contended.load()==1);
    assert(guest_cache_domain_totals[1].blocked.load()==1);
    assert(guest_cache_domain_totals[1].wait_ns.load()>0);
    assert(cache_lock_contended.load()==2 && cache_lock_blocked.load()==2);
    for (const auto& domain : guest_cache_domain_totals) {
        assert(domain.waited_ge1ms.load() == 1);
        assert(domain.waited_ge10ms.load() == 1);
        assert(domain.max_wait_ns.load() >= 10'000'000);
    }
    assert(cache_lock_wait_ns.load()==
           guest_cache_domain_totals[0].wait_ns.load() +
           guest_cache_domain_totals[1].wait_ns.load());
    const auto reads=Common::g_wall_clock.reads.load();
    detailed_gpu_profile.store(false);
    exercise(buffer_mutex,false);
    assert(Common::g_wall_clock.reads.load()==reads);
    assert(cache_lock_contended.load()==2);
    assert(cache_lock_blocked.load()==2);
    // Quiet path does not increment expensive profiling histograms.
    assert(guest_cache_domain_totals[0].waited_ge1ms.load()==1);
    assert(guest_cache_domain_totals[1].waited_ge10ms.load()==1);
}
""".replace('__METHODS__',methods)
env=os.environ.copy()
if sys.platform=='darwin' and not env.get('SDKROOT'):
    sdk=Path('/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX15.4.sdk')
    if sdk.is_dir():env['SDKROOT']=str(sdk)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='eden-r364-domains-') as d:
    src=Path(d)/'domains.cpp';binary=Path(d)/'domains';src.write_text(cpp)
    subprocess.run(['c++','-std=c++20','-O1','-pthread','-Wall','-Wextra','-Werror',
                    '-fsanitize=address,undefined',str(src),'-o',str(binary)],
                   check=True,env=env,timeout=40)
    subprocess.run([str(binary)],check=True,env=env,timeout=40)
print('PASS R364 actual GuestCacheLock C++: buffer/texture isolation, aggregate identity, no quiet clock/counters')
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""R393: test the EXACT production guest IPC attribution under ASan/UBSan.

No Sony SDK, no PS5 build. Cross-check generation and detailed-only gating.

cpp = r"""
#include <array>
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>
namespace Eden::Performance {
struct Totals {
    std::atomic<unsigned long long> calls{}, nanoseconds{}, requested_bytes{};
};
inline Totals guest_ipc_wait{};
__PRODUCTION__
}
int main() {
    using namespace Eden::Performance;
    constexpr unsigned workers = 8, per_worker = 500;
    std::vector<std::thread> pool;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < workers; ++i)
        pool.emplace_back([i] {
            const auto tid = 1ull + i * guest_ipc_thread_slots;  // force collision/probing
            for (unsigned n = 0; n < per_worker; ++n) {
                RecordGuestIpc(tid, n % 4 == 0 ? 1'000 : n % 4 == 1 ? 80'000 :
                                       n % 4 == 2 ? 2'000'000 : 9'000'000);
            }
        });
    for (auto& t : pool) t.join();
    assert(guest_ipc_wait.calls.load() == workers * per_worker);
    unsigned found = 0;
    for (const auto& t : guest_ipc_threads) {
        if (!t.calls.load()) continue;
        assert(t.calls.load() == per_worker);
        assert(t.max_ns.load() == 9'000'000);
        ++found;
    }
    assert(found == workers);
    for (const auto& bin : guest_ipc_hist)
        assert(bin.load() == workers * (per_worker / 4));
    assert(guest_ipc_overflow_calls.load() == 0);
    // Zero/unknown ID, negative elapsed and full-table overflow must be safe.
    RecordGuestIpc(0, -3);
    assert(guest_ipc_overflow_calls.load() == 1);
    // Fill every remaining independent slot, then enforce a bounded overflow.
    // The original 8 collision TIDs all hash to slot 1 and occupy slots 1..8.
    for (unsigned slot = 0; slot < guest_ipc_thread_slots; ++slot) {
        if (slot >= 1 && slot <= workers) continue;
        RecordGuestIpc(static_cast<unsigned long long>(slot) +
                       2ull * guest_ipc_thread_slots, 150);
    }
    unsigned occupied = 0;
    for (const auto& t : guest_ipc_threads) if (t.tid.load()) ++occupied;
    assert(occupied == guest_ipc_thread_slots);
    RecordGuestIpc(900000, 30'000'000);
    assert(guest_ipc_overflow_calls.load() == 2);
    // An active IPC becomes visible BEFORE it returns. A nested completion
    // must not erase the original (still pending) start timestamp.
    auto* active = BeginGuestIpc(1, 1'000'000);
    assert(active && active->active_since_ns.load() == 1'000'000);
    auto* nested = BeginGuestIpc(1, 2'000'000);
    assert(nested == active && active->active_since_ns.load() == 1'000'000);
    FinishGuestIpc(nested, 1, 2'000'000, 1'000);
    assert(active->active_since_ns.load() == 1'000'000);
    FinishGuestIpc(active, 1, 1'000'000, 5'000'000);
    assert(active->active_since_ns.load() == 0);
    assert(guest_ipc_wait.calls.load() ==
           workers * per_worker + (guest_ipc_thread_slots - workers) + 4);
}
""".replace("__PRODUCTION__", impl)

compiler = next((c for c in ("clang++-18", "clang++", "g++") if shutil.which(c)), None)
if not compiler:
    raise SystemExit("Host C++20 compiler unavailable")
```

```py
cpp = r"""
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>
using u64 = std::uint64_t;
using u8 = std::uint8_t;
constexpr unsigned YUZU_PAGEBITS = 12;
constexpr std::size_t YUZU_PAGESIZE = 4096;
namespace Common {
enum class PageType { Unmapped, Memory };
}
struct Entry {
    Common::PageType type = Common::PageType::Unmapped;
    u64 delta = 0;
    unsigned stores = 0;
    void Store(bool, Common::PageType t, unsigned, u64 d) {
        type = t;
        delta = d;
        ++stores;
    }
};
struct PageEntries {
    std::array<Entry, 8> pages{};
    void CommitRegion(std::size_t, std::size_t) {}
    Entry& GetUnchecked(std::size_t idx) { return pages.at(idx); }
};
struct PageTable {
    PageEntries entries;
};
struct DeviceBuffer {
    std::uintptr_t base = 0x3000;
    void* BackingBasePointer() const {
        return reinterpret_cast<void*>(base);
    }
};
struct DeviceMemory {
    DeviceBuffer buffer;
    template <typename T>
    T* GetPointer(u64 physical) {
        if (physical == 0x301000)
            return reinterpret_cast<T*>(0x3000); // legal guest/host VA alias
        if (physical == 0x302000)
            return reinterpret_cast<T*>(0x9000); // ordinary nonzero host delta
        return nullptr;                         // truly missing physical page
    }
};
struct System {
    DeviceMemory device;
    DeviceMemory& DeviceMemory() { return device; }
};
namespace Kernel::Board::Nintendo::Nx {
struct KSystemControl {
    struct Init {
        static std::size_t GetIntendedMemorySize() { return 8192; }
    };
};
}
namespace Eden::GpuFault {
unsigned missing_reports = 0;
bool ShouldReportGuestMapZero() {
    ++missing_reports;
    return true;
}
}
u64 GetInteger(u64 value) { return value; }
static unsigned log_count = 0;
static u64 bad_guest = 0;
static u64 bad_physical = 0;
static void report_missing(u64 guest, u64 physical) {
    ++log_count;
    bad_guest = guest;
    bad_physical = physical;
}
#define LOG_CRITICAL(_category, _format, guest, phys) report_missing(guest, phys)
struct Impl {
    System& system;
__ALIAS_METHOD__
    void Map() {
        PageTable page_table;
        std::size_t base = 2;
        constexpr std::size_t end = 5;
        u64 target = 0x300000;
        unsigned current_block = 1;
        Common::PageType type = Common::PageType::Memory;
        page_table.entries.CommitRegion(base, end);
        while (base != end) {
__GUARD__
            auto& entry = page_table.entries.GetUnchecked(base);
            entry.Store(false, type, current_block, host_ptr);
            base += 1;
            target += YUZU_PAGESIZE;
        }
        const auto& missing = page_table.entries.pages[2];
        const auto& alias = page_table.entries.pages[3];
        const auto& ordinary = page_table.entries.pages[4];
        assert(missing.type == Common::PageType::Unmapped);
        assert(missing.delta == 0 && missing.stores == 1);
        assert(alias.type == Common::PageType::Memory);
        assert(alias.delta == 0 && alias.stores == 1);
        assert(IsDirectBackingAlias(0x3000, 4096));
        assert(!IsDirectBackingAlias(0x2000, 4096));
        assert(!IsDirectBackingAlias(0x5000, 1));
        assert(!IsDirectBackingAlias(0x3000, 8193));
        assert(!IsDirectBackingAlias(std::numeric_limits<u64>::max(), 1));
        assert(ordinary.type == Common::PageType::Memory);
        assert(ordinary.delta == 0x5000 && ordinary.stores == 1);
        assert(log_count == 1 && Eden::GpuFault::missing_reports == 1);
        assert(bad_guest == 0x2000 && bad_physical == 0x300000);
        system.device.buffer.base = 0;
        assert(!IsDirectBackingAlias(0x3000, 4096));
    }
};
int main() {
    System system;
    Impl impl{system};
    impl.Map();
}
"""
cpp = cpp.replace("__GUARD__", guard).replace("__ALIAS_METHOD__", alias_method)
```

```py
"""Native-source-extracted guest CPU-write cache-lock elision regression.

ASan/UBSan host witness. Only never-held texture pages skip the texture
mutex; shader invalidation remains independent and unchanged.

from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess

cpp = r"""
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <mutex>
#include "image_pages.h"
#include "buffer_pages.h"
#include "buffer_write_ahead.h"
using DAddr = std::uint64_t;
using u64 = std::uint64_t;
#define DEBUG_ASSERT(expr) assert(expr)
namespace Eden::Performance {
enum class CachePhase {
    GuestWriteBufferWait, GuestWriteBufferWork,
    GuestWriteTextureWait, GuestWriteTextureWork,
    GuestWriteShaderInvalidate
};
struct BatchedGuestWriteTimer { ~BatchedGuestWriteTimer() {} };
struct CachePhaseTimer {
    CachePhaseTimer(CachePhase, bool) {}
    void Stop() {}
};
inline std::atomic<unsigned> cpu_write_ahead{0};
inline std::atomic<unsigned> texture_lock_calls{0};
bool ShouldSampleGuestWrite() { return false; }
void GuestCacheLock(std::recursive_mutex& mutex, bool texture) {
    if (texture) ++texture_lock_calls;
    mutex.lock();
}
}
struct MockBuffer {
    std::recursive_mutex mutex;
    bool early_exit{false};
    unsigned writes{0};
    bool OnCPUWrite(DAddr, u64) { ++writes; return early_exit; }
    bool IsRegionRegistered(DAddr, u64) { return true; }
};
struct MockTexture {
    std::recursive_mutex mutex;
    unsigned writes{0};
    void WriteMemory(DAddr, u64) { ++writes; }
};
struct MockPipeline {
    unsigned writes{0};
    void InvalidateRegion(DAddr, u64) { ++writes; }
};
class RasterizerVulkan {
public:
    MockBuffer buffer_cache;
    MockTexture texture_cache;
    MockPipeline pipeline_cache;
    bool OnCPUWrite(DAddr addr, u64 size);
};
__REAL_METHOD__
int main() {
    using namespace Eden;
    constexpr u64 page = 4096;
    RasterizerVulkan r;
    const auto write = [&](u64 addr, u64 size) { return r.OnCPUWrite(addr, size); };

    // No texture was registered: skip its mutex, but always invalidate shaders.
    assert(!write(100 * page, page));
    assert(r.texture_cache.writes == 0);
    assert(Performance::texture_lock_calls == 0);
    assert(r.pipeline_cache.writes == 1 && r.buffer_cache.writes == 0);

    // Once a texture ever occupied a page, the conservative locked path sticks.
    ImagePages::Mark(200 * page, page);
    assert(!write(200 * page, page));
    assert(!write(200 * page, page));
    assert(r.texture_cache.writes == 2);
    assert(Performance::texture_lock_calls == 2);
    assert(r.pipeline_cache.writes == 3);

    // Range spanning a formerly registered page cannot be skipped.
    assert(!write(199 * page, 2 * page));
    assert(r.texture_cache.writes == 3);
    assert(Performance::texture_lock_calls == 3);

    // Large / out-of-range writes must always use the original locked route.
    assert(!write(300 * page, 256 * 1024 + 1));
    assert(!write(ImagePages::kSpace, page));
    assert(r.texture_cache.writes == 5);
    assert(Performance::texture_lock_calls == 5);
    assert(r.pipeline_cache.writes == 6);
    // Above-cap and out-of-range writes intentionally fall back to the
    // original BUFFER mutex as well; count them separately from textures.
    assert(r.buffer_cache.writes == 2);

    // Buffer and texture ownership are independent evidence domains.
    BufferPages::Mark(400 * page, page);
    assert(!write(400 * page, page));
    assert(r.buffer_cache.writes == 3);
    assert(r.texture_cache.writes == 5);
    assert(r.pipeline_cache.writes == 7);

    // Original early-exit semantics: no downstream texture/shader invalidation.
    r.buffer_cache.early_exit = true;
    BufferPages::Mark(500 * page, page);
    assert(write(500 * page, page));
    assert(r.buffer_cache.writes == 4);
    assert(r.texture_cache.writes == 5);
    assert(r.pipeline_cache.writes == 7);
}
""".replace("__REAL_METHOD__", body)
compiler = shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++")
```

```py
"""Source-linked Vulkan HUD memo witness: no repeated glyph conversion per frame.

Host-only C++20 regression. Does not estimate GPU frame-time savings.
"""

#include "hud.h"
#include <cassert>
#include <limits>
#include <string_view>
int main() {
    Eden::HudSnapshotMemo memo{};
    Eden::HudClock clock{};
    double speed = 100.0;
    assert(memo.RefreshNeeded(clock, speed));
    auto current = Eden::MakeHudSnapshot(clock, speed);
    assert(current.glyphs == Eden::HudText("VLK F-- S-- W--"));
    for (int i = 0; i < 50000; ++i)
        assert(!memo.RefreshNeeded(clock, speed));
    clock.Present(1.0);
    assert(!memo.RefreshNeeded(clock, speed));
    clock.fps = 30.0;
    assert(memo.RefreshNeeded(clock, speed));
    current = Eden::MakeHudSnapshot(clock, speed);
    assert(current.glyphs == Eden::HudText("VLK F30 S100 W0"));
    assert(!memo.RefreshNeeded(clock, speed));
    clock.worst_ms = 200.0;
    assert(memo.RefreshNeeded(clock, speed));
    current = Eden::MakeHudSnapshot(clock, speed);
    assert(current.glyphs == Eden::HudText("VLK F30 S100 W200"));
    assert(!memo.RefreshNeeded(clock, speed));
    speed = 80.0;
    assert(memo.RefreshNeeded(clock, speed));
    current = Eden::MakeHudSnapshot(clock, speed);
    assert(current.glyphs == Eden::HudText("VLK F30 S80 W200"));
    assert(!memo.RefreshNeeded(clock, speed));
    // The real presentation clock advances every frame, even while the
    // formatter is memoized. The next one-second window must become visible.
    Eden::HudClock paced{};
    Eden::HudSnapshotMemo paced_memo{};
    paced.Present(100.0);
    assert(paced_memo.RefreshNeeded(paced, 100.0));
    for (int i = 1; i <= 60; ++i) {
        paced.Present(100.0 + i / 60.0);
        if (i < 60) assert(!paced_memo.RefreshNeeded(paced, 100.0));
    }
    assert(paced_memo.RefreshNeeded(paced, 100.0));
    assert(Eden::MakeHudSnapshot(paced, 100.0).glyphs ==
           Eden::HudText("VLK F60 S100 W17"));
    assert(!paced_memo.RefreshNeeded(paced, 100.0));
    // A hidden HUD never advances the clock. Reopening must restart
    // its interval and invalidate the memo, never display stale prior FPS.
    Eden::HudClock gated{};
    Eden::HudSnapshotMemo gated_memo{};
    bool tracking = false;
    unsigned sampled = 0;
    for (int frame = 0; frame < 20000; ++frame) {
        const bool visible = frame >= 10000 && frame < 10500;
        if (visible) {
            if (!tracking) {
                gated = {};
                gated_memo = {};
                tracking = true;
            }
            gated.Present(1000.0 + frame / 60.0);
            ++sampled;
            (void)gated_memo.RefreshNeeded(gated, 100.0);
        } else {
            tracking = false;
        }
    }
    assert(sampled == 500);
    assert(gated.frames > 0);
    assert(!tracking);
    assert(gated.fps >= 0.0);
    // A fresh activation may not inherit the pre-hide FPS window.
    gated = {};
    gated_memo = {};
    gated.Present(2000.0);
    assert(gated.fps < 0 && gated_memo.RefreshNeeded(gated, 100.0));
    // A new game must replace the previous title's loading snapshot.
    memo.Reset();
    assert(memo.RefreshNeeded(clock, speed));
    assert(!memo.RefreshNeeded(clock, speed));
    // NaN never appears as an unchanged stable cache key.
    clock.fps = std::numeric_limits<double>::quiet_NaN();
    assert(memo.RefreshNeeded(clock, speed));
    assert(memo.RefreshNeeded(clock, speed));
}
"""
```

```py
  assert(!NeverHeld(0,256*1024+1));
  Mark(p,1);
  assert(NeverHeld(p-1,1) && !NeverHeld(p,1) && !NeverHeld(2*p-1,1));
  assert(NeverHeld(2*p,1) && !NeverHeld(p-1,2));
  Mark(63*p+5,2*p);
  assert(!NeverHeld(63*p,1) && !NeverHeld(64*p,1) && !NeverHeld(65*p,1));
  assert(NeverHeld(66*p,p));
  Mark(1000*p,9000*p);
  assert(!NeverHeld(1000*p,1) && !NeverHeld(5000*p,1));
  assert(NeverHeld(10000*p,p));
  Mark(kSpace-1,1<<20);
  assert(!NeverHeld(kSpace-1,1) && !NeverHeld(kSpace-1,2));
  // Single-page fast publication, crossing a 64-bit word, and unaligned
  // two-page fallthrough must agree with the complete monotonic bitmap.
  Mark(14000*p+17,1);
  assert(!NeverHeld(14000*p,1) && NeverHeld(14001*p,1));
  Mark(14079*p+4095,2);
  assert(!NeverHeld(14079*p,1) && !NeverHeld(14080*p,1));
  // A seven-page unaligned image registration fits in one bitmap word,
  // whereas a similar one at the boundary takes the existing two-word path.
  Mark(18000*p+4000,6*p);
  assert(!NeverHeld(18000*p,1) && !NeverHeld(18006*p,1));
  assert(NeverHeld(18007*p,1));
  Mark(18047*p+4095,2*p);
  assert(!NeverHeld(18047*p,1) && !NeverHeld(18048*p,1));
  assert(!NeverHeld(18049*p,1) && NeverHeld(18050*p,1));
  // Simultaneous insertions of distinct bits in one word cannot be lost
  // by the load-before-fetch_or optimization.
  std::vector<std::thread> overlapped;
  for(unsigned t=0;t<8;++t) overlapped.emplace_back([t]{
    for(unsigned n=0;n<500;++n) {
      Mark((16000+t)*p,1);
      Mark(16000*p,8*p);
    }
  });
  for(auto& thread:overlapped) thread.join();
  for(unsigned t=0;t<8;++t) assert(!NeverHeld((16000+t)*p,1));
  assert(NeverHeld(16008*p,1));
  // Independent page-by-page baseline across all byte offsets, word
  // boundaries, empty spans, oversized ranges and partial ownership.
  // A false "never held" could suppress texture invalidation and leave
  // the guest HUD permanently stale.
  auto baseline = [](std::uint64_t address, std::uint64_t size) {
    if (!size) size = 1;
    if (address >= kSpace || size > kSpace-address || size > 256*1024) return false;
    const auto first = address >> kPageBits;
    const auto last = (address+size-1) >> kPageBits;
    for (auto page = first; page <= last; ++page)
      if ((held[page/64].load(std::memory_order_acquire) >> (page%64)) & 1u)
        return false;
    return true;
  };
  std::uint64_t rng = 0xa1c2b3d4f0012283ull;
  constexpr std::uint64_t lengths[]{0,1,2,17,4095,4096,4097,8193,65536,262144,262145};
  for (int i = 0; i < 12000; ++i) {
    rng ^= rng << 13; rng ^= rng >> 7; rng ^= rng << 17;
    const auto address = i%3 == 0 ? rng % (4096ull*12000) :
                         i%3 == 1 ? kSpace - 1 - rng % 10000 : rng % kSpace;
    const auto size = lengths[i%11];
    assert(NeverHeld(address,size) == baseline(address,size));
  }
  assert(NeverHeld(4095,2) == baseline(4095,2));
  assert(NeverHeld(63*p+4095,2) == baseline(63*p+4095,2));
  std::vector<std::thread> threads;
  std::atomic<unsigned> misses{0};
  for(unsigned i=0;i<8;++i) threads.emplace_back([i,&misses] {
    auto base=(1000000u+i*1000u)*4096ull;
    for(unsigned n=0;n<800;++n) {
      Mark(base+n*4096,p);
      if(NeverHeld(base+n*4096,1)) ++misses;
    }
  });
  for(auto& thread:threads) thread.join();
  assert(misses.load()==0);
  for(unsigned i=0;i<8;++i) {
    auto base=(1000000u+i*1000u)*4096ull;
    assert(!NeverHeld(base+799*p,1) && NeverHeld(base+800*p,1));
  }
}
"""
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-r433-image-pages-") as tmp:
    source = Path(tmp) / "test.cpp"
    exe = Path(tmp) / "test"
    source.write_text(fixture)
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Native-source-extracted inline GPU upload texture lock regression.

The CPU buffer tracker, guest memory write, query and shader invalidation
must follow the conservative texture and buffer ownership witnesses.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
main = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_rasterizer.cpp").read_text()

oracle = (root / "tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py").read_text()
workflow = (root / ".github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml").read_text()

def extract(text: str) -> str:
    assert text.count(anchor) == 1
    begin = text.index(anchor)
    end = text.index(last, begin)
    return text[begin:end]
body = extract(main)
old = extract(pinned)
assert body == extract(bridge), "inactive Vulkan bridge drifted from active C++"
assert body != old
assert body.count("::Eden::ImagePages::NeverHeld(*cpu_addr, copy_size)") == 1

assert body.index("::Eden::ImagePages::NeverHeld(") < body.index("texture_cache.WriteMemory(")

#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
#include <optional>
#include <span>
#include <vector>
#include "image_pages.h"
#include "buffer_pages.h"
using u8 = std::uint8_t;
using DAddr = std::uint64_t;
using GPUVAddr = std::uint64_t;
struct CountingMutex {
    std::recursive_mutex mutex;
    unsigned calls{};
    void lock() { mutex.lock(); ++calls; }
    void unlock() { mutex.unlock(); }
};
struct MockGpuMemory {
    std::optional<DAddr> cpu{std::nullopt};
    unsigned safe_writes{};
    unsigned unsafe_writes{};
    std::optional<DAddr> GpuToCpuAddress(GPUVAddr) { return cpu; }
    void WriteBlock(GPUVAddr, const u8*, std::size_t) { ++safe_writes; }
    void WriteBlockUnsafe(GPUVAddr, const u8*, std::size_t) { ++unsafe_writes; }
};
struct MockBufferCache {
    std::recursive_mutex mutex;
    bool handled{};
    unsigned inlines{};
    unsigned writes{};
    bool InlineMemory(DAddr, std::size_t, std::span<const u8>) {
        ++inlines;
        return handled;
    }
    void WriteMemory(DAddr, std::size_t) { ++writes; }
};
struct MockTextureCache {
    CountingMutex mutex;
    unsigned writes{};
    void WriteMemory(DAddr, std::size_t) { ++writes; }
};
struct MockInvalidations {
    unsigned calls{};
    void InvalidateRegion(DAddr, std::size_t) { ++calls; }
};
class RasterizerVulkan {
public:
    MockGpuMemory backing;
    MockGpuMemory* gpu_memory{&backing};
    MockBufferCache buffer_cache;
    MockTextureCache texture_cache;
    MockInvalidations pipeline_cache, query_cache;
    void AccelerateInlineToMemory(GPUVAddr, std::size_t, std::span<const u8>);
};
__REAL_METHOD__
int main() {
    RasterizerVulkan x;
    constexpr DAddr page = 4096;
    std::array<u8, 16> small{};
    x.backing.cpu = 10*page;
    // No prior texture OR buffer ownership: only guest RAM/shader/query update.
    x.AccelerateInlineToMemory(42, small.size(), small);
    assert(x.backing.unsafe_writes == 1 && x.buffer_cache.inlines == 0);
    assert(x.buffer_cache.writes == 0 && x.texture_cache.writes == 0);
    assert(x.texture_cache.mutex.calls == 0);
    assert(x.pipeline_cache.calls == 1 && x.query_cache.calls == 1);

    // An inline buffer upload returning handled still invalidates texture
    // and shader/query if a texture was ever registered.
    Eden::ImagePages::Mark(20*page, page);
    Eden::BufferPages::Mark(20*page, page);
    x.backing.cpu = 20*page;
    x.buffer_cache.handled = true;
    x.AccelerateInlineToMemory(42, small.size(), small);
    assert(x.buffer_cache.writes == 0 && x.buffer_cache.inlines == 1);
    assert(x.texture_cache.writes == 1 && x.texture_cache.mutex.calls == 1);
    assert(x.pipeline_cache.calls == 2 && x.query_cache.calls == 2);

    // Registered overlap is conservatively retained.
    x.backing.cpu = 20*page-1;
    x.buffer_cache.handled = false;
    x.AccelerateInlineToMemory(42, small.size(), small);
    assert(x.texture_cache.writes == 2 && x.texture_cache.mutex.calls == 2);
    assert(x.buffer_cache.writes == 1);

    // Large requests fail closed even when no pages were registered.
    std::vector<u8> large(256*1024+1);
    x.backing.cpu = 100*page;
    x.AccelerateInlineToMemory(42, large.size(), large);
    assert(x.texture_cache.writes == 3 && x.texture_cache.mutex.calls == 3);
    assert(x.buffer_cache.writes == 2);

    // Unknown/out-of-range CPU spans conservatively lock.
    x.backing.cpu = Eden::ImagePages::kSpace-4;
    x.AccelerateInlineToMemory(42, small.size(), small);
    assert(x.texture_cache.writes == 4 && x.texture_cache.mutex.calls == 4);
    assert(x.buffer_cache.writes == 3);

    // Translation failure still uses original safe guest block, then returns.
    x.backing.cpu = std::nullopt;
    x.AccelerateInlineToMemory(42, small.size(), small);
    assert(x.backing.safe_writes == 1 && x.backing.unsafe_writes == 5);
    assert(x.buffer_cache.inlines == 4 && x.buffer_cache.writes == 3);
    assert(x.texture_cache.writes == 4);
    assert(x.pipeline_cache.calls == 5 && x.query_cache.calls == 5);
}
""".replace("__REAL_METHOD__", body)
compiler = shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++")
assert compiler, "Clang required for ASan/UBSan C++ method test"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-inline-texture-elision-") as tmp:

      "registered_overlap=1 oversized=1 unknown=1 translation_fail=1 "
```

`tools/check-ps5-large-descriptor-preflight.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""R325: host-compile the generated atypical descriptor reservation pre-drain.

Only PS5 pipelines needing more than 0x400 entries can take this path. It
must precede the paired guest cache locks and preserve the original fallback.
"""
import ast
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
generator = (root / 'tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py').read_text()
program = ast.parse(generator)
adapters = {}
for node in program.body:
    if not isinstance(node, ast.Expr) or not isinstance(node.value, ast.Call):
        continue
    call = node.value
    if not isinstance(call.func, ast.Name) or call.func.id != 'adapt':
        continue
    if len(call.args) != 3 or not isinstance(call.args[0], ast.Constant):
        continue
    adapters.setdefault(call.args[0].value, []).append(call)

def pairs_for(rel):
    assert len(adapters[rel]) == 1, (rel, len(adapters[rel]))
    return [ast.literal_eval(n) for n in adapters[rel][0].args[2].elts
            if isinstance(n, ast.Tuple) and len(n.elts) == 2 and
            all(isinstance(item, ast.Constant) for item in n.elts)]

header_pairs = pairs_for('src/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_update_descriptor.h')
method_pairs = [(a,b) for a,b in header_pairs if 'PreflightExactGuestDraw' in b]
assert len(method_pairs) == 1
header = method_pairs[0][1]
assert 'PreflightGuestDraw' in header
begin = header.index('    template <typename WaitWorker>')
end = header.index('\n#endif', begin)
methods = header[begin:end]
assert methods.count('wait_worker();') == 2
assert 'entries >= frame_payload_size' in methods
raster_pairs = pairs_for('src/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_rasterizer.cpp')
# New compute dispatches also preflight large guest descriptors. R325 only
# reconstructs the ORIGINAL graphics preparation contract.
preflight_pairs = [(a,b) for a,b in raster_pairs
                   if 'PreflightExactGuestDraw(' in b
                   and 'pipeline_cache.CurrentGraphicsPipeline()' in b]
assert len(preflight_pairs) == 2
early = [b for a,b in preflight_pairs if 'for (unsigned preflight = 0;' in b]
late = [b for a,b in preflight_pairs if 'This GPU drain can change the selected pipeline' in b]
assert len(early) == len(late) == 1
for raster in (early[0], late[0]):
    # The actual versioned native draw body is checked for lock ordering below.
    # Generator replacement fragments may legitimately include nearby locks.
    assert 'pipeline = pipeline_cache.CurrentGraphicsPipeline();' in raster
    assert 'gpu_memory->FlushCaching();' in raster
    assert 'pipeline->DescriptorEntryReservation()' in raster
assert 'descriptor_buffer_ring.PreflightCapacity(' in late[0]
assert late[0].index('descriptor_buffer_ring.PreflightCapacity(') < late[0].rindex(
    'guest_descriptor_queue.PreflightExactGuestDraw(')
# The versioned native source also keeps the last check before both mutexes.
native = (root / 'vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_rasterizer.cpp').read_text()
native_draw = native.split('void RasterizerVulkan::PrepareDraw(', 1)[1].split(
    'void RasterizerVulkan::Draw(', 1)[0]
assert native_draw.count('guest_descriptor_queue.PreflightExactGuestDraw(') == 3
assert native_draw.index('descriptor_buffer_ring.PreflightCapacity(') < native_draw.rindex(
    'guest_descriptor_queue.PreflightExactGuestDraw(') < native_draw.index(
    'std::scoped_lock lock{buffer_cache.mutex, texture_cache.mutex};')
# The next original adaptation applies the paired locks to this same function.
assert 'std::scoped_lock lock{buffer_cache.mutex, texture_cache.mutex};' in generator
pipeline_pairs = pairs_for('src/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_graphics_pipeline.h')
getters = [(a,b) for a,b in pipeline_pairs if 'DescriptorEntryReservation() const noexcept' in b]
assert len(getters) == 1
assert 'num_descriptor_entries != 0 ? num_descriptor_entries : 0x400' in getters[0][1]
# Acquire remains the fall-through guard, so no invalid-sized descriptor gets silently accepted.
pinned = (root / 'tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py').read_text()
assert "src/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_update_descriptor.h" in pinned

cpp = '''#include <cassert>\n#include <cstddef>\n#include <vector>\nstruct Queue {\n    const size_t frame_payload_size=4096;\n    std::vector<int> backing = std::vector<int>(frame_payload_size);\n    int* payload_start=backing.data();\n    int* payload_cursor=payload_start;\n''' + methods + '''
    void set_used(size_t count) { assert(count<frame_payload_size); payload_cursor=payload_start+count; }
    size_t used() const { return size_t(payload_cursor-payload_start); }
};
int main() {
    Queue q;
    int waits=0;
    auto wait=[&] {++waits;};
    q.set_used(1000);
    assert(!q.PreflightGuestDraw(wait));
    assert(!q.PreflightExactGuestDraw(wait,1024));
    assert(!q.PreflightExactGuestDraw(wait,1500));
    assert(q.used()==1000 && waits==0);
    q.set_used(2596); // 2596 + 1500 = 4096, exactly full.
    assert(!q.PreflightGuestDraw(wait));
    assert(q.PreflightExactGuestDraw(wait,1500));
    assert(q.used()==0 && waits==1);
    q.set_used(2500);
    assert(!q.PreflightExactGuestDraw(wait,1500));
    assert(q.used()==2500 && waits==1);
    q.set_used(3072);
    assert(q.PreflightGuestDraw(wait));
    assert(q.used()==0 && waits==2);
    q.set_used(3096);
    assert(!q.PreflightExactGuestDraw(wait,0));
    assert(!q.PreflightExactGuestDraw(wait,4096));
    assert(!q.PreflightExactGuestDraw(wait,100));
    assert(q.used()==3096 && waits==2);
}
'''
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='eden-r325-descriptor-') as tmp:
    path = Path(tmp)
    (path/'check.cpp').write_text(cpp)
    exe = path/'check'
    env=os.environ.copy()
    if sys.platform == 'darwin' and not env.get('SDKROOT'):
        old_sdk=Path('/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX15.4.sdk')
        if old_sdk.exists(): env['SDKROOT']=str(old_sdk)
    subprocess.run(['c++','-std=c++20','-O2','-Wall','-Wextra','-Werror',
                    str(path/'check.cpp'),'-o',str(exe)],check=True,env=env,timeout=40)
    subprocess.run([str(exe)],check=True,timeout=10)
print('PASS R325 exact host C++ descriptor preflight: small / large / boundary / fallback')
```
