`tools/check-ps5-late-descriptor-preflight-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Clang ASan/UBSan: late pipeline reselection never waits under guest cache locks.

The active preflight implementation is compiled verbatim from its shipping header.
Source guards ensure the late call stays AFTER the ring drain's pipeline refresh
and BEFORE the two cache mutexes; the mock exercises an actual reservation gap.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
header=(root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/include/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_update_descriptor.h").read_text()
raster=(root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_rasterizer.cpp").read_text()
workflow=(root/".github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml").read_text()

start="    template <typename WaitWorker>\n    [[nodiscard]] bool PreflightGuestDraw("
last="    template <typename WaitWorker>\n    [[nodiscard]] bool PreflightExactGuestDraw("
end="\n#endif"
assert header.count(start)==header.count(last)==1
preflights=header[header.index(start):header.index(end,header.index(last))]
# Compile the exact maintained methods, not an older named helper. This
# preserves the >= ring-boundary drain and rejects zero/oversized reservations.
assert preflights.count("wait_worker();")==2
assert "used + reserve < frame_payload_size" in preflights
assert "reserve >= frame_payload_size" in preflights
assert "used + entries < frame_payload_size" in preflights
assert "entries == 0 || entries >= frame_payload_size" in preflights

start=raster.index("void RasterizerVulkan::PrepareDraw(")
end=raster.index("void RasterizerVulkan::Draw(",start)
draw=raster[start:end]
initial=draw.index("guest_descriptor_queue.PreflightGuestDraw(")
retry=draw.index("for (unsigned preflight = 0; preflight != 2; ++preflight)")
retry_exact=draw.index("guest_descriptor_queue.PreflightExactGuestDraw(",retry)
reuse=draw.index("descriptor_buffer_ring.PreflightFrameReuse(",retry_exact)
reuse_refresh=draw.index("pipeline = select_pipeline();",reuse)
reuse_preflight=draw.index("guest_descriptor_queue.PreflightExactGuestDraw(",reuse_refresh)
cap=draw.index("descriptor_buffer_ring.PreflightCapacity(",reuse_preflight)
reselection=draw.index("pipeline = select_pipeline();",cap)
late=draw.index("guest_descriptor_queue.PreflightExactGuestDraw(",reselection)
cache_lock=draw.index("std::scoped_lock lock{buffer_cache.mutex, texture_cache.mutex};")
# Both GPU ring drains must reselect shaders and revalidate *exact* positive
# descriptor demand before either guest cache mutex can be acquired.
assert initial < retry < retry_exact < reuse < reuse_refresh < reuse_preflight < cap < reselection < late < cache_lock
assert draw.count("guest_descriptor_queue.PreflightExactGuestDraw(")==3
assert draw.count("guest_descriptor_queue.PreflightGuestDraw(")==1
assert draw.count("pipeline->HasDescriptorEntries()")>=4
assert "gpu_memory->FlushCaching();" in draw[reuse:reuse_refresh]
for section in (draw[reuse_preflight:cap],draw[late:cache_lock]):
    assert "gpu_memory->FlushCaching();" in section
    assert "pipeline = select_pipeline();" in section
    assert "GraphicsDrawDrop::NoPipeline" in section
# Guard the bounded second preflight after a pipeline may have changed again.
# Reselect through the real MSAA-aware pipeline policy after every drain;
# checking only CurrentGraphicsPipeline() misses native forced-MSAA draws.
assert "pipeline_cache.CurrentGraphicsPipelineForMsaa(native_samples)" in draw
assert "return pipeline_cache.CurrentGraphicsPipeline();" in draw
assert draw.count("pipeline = select_pipeline();")>=4
assert "preflight != 2" in draw[retry:reuse]
assert "pipeline = select_pipeline();" in draw[retry_exact:reuse]
assert "check-ps5-late-descriptor-preflight-host.py" in workflow

cpp=r"""
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
struct DescriptorQueue {
  std::array<std::uint64_t,4096> payload{};
  const std::size_t frame_payload_size=payload.size();
  std::uint64_t* payload_start=payload.data();
  std::uint64_t* payload_cursor=payload.data();
__PREFLIGHT__
  void SetUsed(std::size_t n){assert(n<=frame_payload_size);payload_cursor=payload_start+n;}
  std::size_t Used()const{return static_cast<std::size_t>(payload_cursor-payload_start);}
};
int main(){
 DescriptorQueue q;
 unsigned waits=0;
 bool cache_locks_held=false;
 auto wait_worker=[&] { assert(!cache_locks_held);++waits; };
 // The original pipeline fits both the ordinary and large preflights.
 q.SetUsed(2596);
 assert(!q.PreflightGuestDraw(wait_worker));
 assert(!q.PreflightExactGuestDraw(wait_worker,0x400));
 assert(q.Used()==2596 && waits==0);
 // A descriptor-ring GPU drain followed by guest invalidation selects a
 // different pipeline (reservation 1700); Acquire would wait under locks.
 const std::size_t reselection_reserve=1700;
 assert(q.Used()+reselection_reserve>=q.frame_payload_size);
 assert(q.PreflightExactGuestDraw(wait_worker,reselection_reserve));
 assert(waits==1 && q.Used()==0);
 // The following Configure/Acquire now has no reason to wait under locks.
 cache_locks_held=true;
 assert(q.Used()+reselection_reserve<q.frame_payload_size);
 cache_locks_held=false;
 // No needless drains for the common reservation or adequate capacity.
 q.SetUsed(50);
 assert(!q.PreflightGuestDraw(wait_worker));
 assert(!q.PreflightExactGuestDraw(wait_worker,1700));
 assert(waits==1);
 // A frame-reuse fence may change shaders to a larger pipeline, too.
 q.SetUsed(3000);
 assert(!q.PreflightExactGuestDraw(wait_worker,1024));
 assert(q.PreflightExactGuestDraw(wait_worker,1200));
 assert(q.Used()==0 && waits==2);
 // Equality with the end boundary uses the same >= condition as Acquire.
 q.SetUsed(4096-1700);
 assert(q.PreflightExactGuestDraw(wait_worker,1700));
 assert(q.Used()==0 && waits==3);
 // Oversized reservations continue to be handled by Acquire's invariant.
 assert(!q.PreflightExactGuestDraw(wait_worker,4096));
 assert(waits==3);
 // The precise path must not drain for zero descriptors; reservations below
 // the old 1024-entry fallback still drain when they actually cross the end.
 q.SetUsed(4000);
 assert(!q.PreflightExactGuestDraw(wait_worker,0));
 assert(q.PreflightExactGuestDraw(wait_worker,128));
 assert(q.Used()==0 && waits==4);
}
"""
cc=shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++")
assert cc, "Clang C++20 required for host regression"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-late-descriptor-") as folder:
    code=Path(folder)/"test.cpp"
    exe=Path(folder)/"test"
    code.write_text(cpp.replace("__PREFLIGHT__",preflights))
    subprocess.run([cc,"-std=c++20","-O1","-g","-Wall","-Wextra","-Werror",
                    "-fsanitize=address,undefined","-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
                    str(code),"-o",str(exe)],check=True,timeout=45)
    subprocess.run([str(exe)],check=True,timeout=30)
print("LATE_DESCRIPTOR_PREFLIGHT_HOST_PASS old_preflight_gap=1 late_drain=1 frame_reuse_refresh=1 no_lock_wait=1 exact_boundary=1 zero_and_small_reservations=1 source_order=1")
```

`tools/check-ps5-launcher-audio-stream-ring-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
"""Source-linked PS5 launcher SPSC audio ring copy/wrap and publication regression."""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
header = (root / "headless/prosperoeden/pe/audio/stream_ring.hpp").read_text()
assert header.count("std::memcpy(") == 4
assert "head_.store(head + count, std::memory_order_release)" in header
assert "tail_.store(tail + count, std::memory_order_release)" in header
assert header.count("if (!count)") == 2
fixture = r"""
#include "pe/audio/stream_ring.hpp"
#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <deque>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>

void model(std::size_t cap) {
    pe::audio::StreamRing ring(cap);
    std::deque<float> reference;
    std::uint32_t seed = 0x35432u;
    std::size_t produced = 0;
    for (int iteration = 0; iteration < 4000; ++iteration) {
        seed = seed * 1664525u + 1013904223u;
        const std::size_t n = (seed >> 17) % 71;
        const unsigned mode = (seed >> 8) % 9;
        if (mode <= 4) {
            std::vector<float> input(n * 2);
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                input[i * 2] = float(produced + i);
                input[i * 2 + 1] = -float(produced + i);
            }
            const std::size_t expected = std::min(n, cap - reference.size() / 2);
            assert(ring.write(input.data(), n) == expected);
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < expected * 2; ++i) reference.push_back(input[i]);
            produced += expected;
        } else if (mode <= 7) {
            std::vector<float> out(n * 2 + 2, -987654.0f);
            const std::size_t expected = std::min(n, reference.size() / 2);
            assert(ring.read(out.data(), n) == expected);
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < expected * 2; ++i) {
                assert(out[i] == reference.front());
                reference.pop_front();
            }
            for (std::size_t i = expected * 2; i < out.size(); ++i)
                assert(out[i] == -987654.0f);
        } else {
            ring.drain();
            reference.clear();
        }
        assert(ring.available() == reference.size() / 2);
        assert(ring.space() == cap - reference.size() / 2);
    }
}
void concurrent() {
    pe::audio::StreamRing ring(257);
    constexpr std::size_t total = 100000;
    std::thread producer([&] {
        std::size_t index = 0;
        while (index != total) {
            std::size_t n = std::min<std::size_t>(11, total - index);
            std::vector<float> data(n * 2);
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                data[2 * i] = float(index + i);
                data[2 * i + 1] = -float(index + i);
            }
            const std::size_t done = ring.write(data.data(), n);
            index += done;
            if (done == 0) std::this_thread::yield();
        }
    });
    std::size_t index = 0;
    while (index != total) {
        float data[26]{};
        const std::size_t done = ring.read(data, 13);
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < done; ++i) {
            assert(data[i * 2] == float(index + i));
            assert(data[i * 2 + 1] == -float(index + i));
        }
        index += done;
        if (done == 0) std::this_thread::yield();
    }
    producer.join();
    assert(ring.available() == 0 && ring.space() == 257);
}
int main() {
    for (auto cap : {0u, 1u, 3u, 7u, 64u, 257u, 65536u})
        model(cap);
    concurrent();
}
"""
compiler = shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
assert compiler, "C++20 host compiler required"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-audio-ring-") as work:
    src = Path(work) / "test.cpp"
    src.write_text(fixture)
    for opt in ("-O0", "-O2"):
        exe = Path(work) / ("ring" + opt[1:])
        subprocess.run([compiler, "-std=c++20", opt, "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror",
                        "-pthread", "-fsanitize=address,undefined",
                        "-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
                        "-I", str(root / "headless/prosperoeden"),
                        str(src), "-o", str(exe)], check=True, timeout=60)
        subprocess.run([str(exe)], check=True, timeout=30)
        print("PS5_LAUNCHER_AUDIO_RING_PASS", opt)
print("Audio copy throughput on PS5 not yet measured")
```

```py
assert 'derive-encore-build-label.py" "$root/MEMORY.md"' not in native
assert 'fetch-depth: 0' in (root/'.github/workflows/build-040-zbic.yml').read_text()
current_result=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B',str(script)],
                              capture_output=True,text=True)
if current_result.returncode == 0:
    current=current_result.stdout.strip()
    assert re.fullmatch(r'R[0-9]+',current) and int(current[1:]) >= 457, current
else:
    # Lightweight source preflights may check out only HEAD. The native build
    # fetches the full first-parent history and still fails closed if no R exists.
    shallow=subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(root),'rev-parse','--is-shallow-repository'],
                           capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.strip()
    assert shallow=='true' and 'No numbered R revision' in current_result.stderr, current_result.stderr
print('R401 HERO STATIC PASS: one-line measured title, long synopsis only, two-line semantic clipping, 4 bounded chips')
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""R414: exercise actual vendored Mesa disk cache policy, PS5 vs ordinary host."""
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
rel = 'src/util/disk_cache_os.c'
original = (root/'vendor/sources/ps5-mesa'/rel).read_text()
active = (root/'vendor/encore-active/ps5-mesa'/rel).read_text()
old = '''   /* If running as a users other than the real user disable cache */
   if (!__normal_user())
      return false;'''
new = '''   /* A PS5 title can use launcher-assigned credentials (not setuid).
    * A host-only effective/real-user mismatch disabled RADV shader cache
    * silently on homebrew titles. Keep the safety guard on other OSes.
    * Source: mpereiraesaa/PS5_Mesa 2026-10-09 (MIT). */
#if !defined(__PROSPERO__)
   if (!__normal_user())
      return false;
#endif'''
assert original.count(old) == 1
assert active == original.replace(old, new, 1), 'Only the OS-specific guard is allowed to change'
start = active.index('bool\ndisk_cache_enabled()\n{')
end = active.index('\nvoid *\ndisk_cache_load_item_foz', start)
body = active[start:end]
assert '#if !defined(__PROSPERO__)' in body
assert 'MESA_SHADER_CACHE_DISABLE' in body
assert 'MESA_GLSL_DISABLE_IO_OPT' in body
source = r'''
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#define DETECT_OS_ANDROID 0
static int normal_user = 1;
static int cache_disabled = 0, io_disabled = 0;
static int __attribute__((unused)) __normal_user(void) {return normal_user;}
static char *os_get_option(const char *key) {
    if (!strcmp(key, "MESA_SHADER_CACHE_DISABLE")) return cache_disabled ? "1" : NULL;
    if (!strcmp(key, "MESA_GLSL_DISABLE_IO_OPT")) return io_disabled ? "1" : NULL;
    return NULL;
}
static bool debug_get_bool_option(const char *key, bool fallback) {
    const char *v = os_get_option(key);
    return v ? !strcmp(v,"1") : fallback;
}
''' + body + r'''
int main(void) {
    if (!disk_cache_enabled()) return 1;
    normal_user = 0;
#if defined(__PROSPERO__)
    if (!disk_cache_enabled()) return 2;
#else
    if (disk_cache_enabled()) return 2;
#endif
    normal_user = 1;
    cache_disabled = 1;
    if (disk_cache_enabled()) return 3;
    cache_disabled = 0;
    io_disabled = 1;
    if (disk_cache_enabled()) return 4;
    return 0;
}
'''
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-mesa-shader-cache-") as td:
    file = Path(td)/'check.c'
    file.write_text(source)
    for variant, macros in [('host', []), ('ps5', ['-D__PROSPERO__'])]:
        exe = Path(td)/variant
        subprocess.run(['cc','-std=c11','-O1','-Wall','-Wextra','-Werror',
                        '-fsanitize=address,undefined',*macros,str(file),'-o',str(exe)],
                       check=True,timeout=30,capture_output=True,text=True)
        subprocess.run([str(exe)],check=True,timeout=20,capture_output=True,text=True)
print('PASS R414: exact complete Mesa file, PS5 assigned credentials, host setuid guard, cache-off and IO-opt overrides (ASan/UBSan)')
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
"""Compile the EXACT generated native VkAcquireNextImageKHR body with fake WSI.

Tests healthy/suboptimal/outdated/error, transient unavailable images,
terminal 10-second budget, semaphore/index validity and fallback parity.
This does not pretend the host has a PS5 Vulkan driver or real wall time.
"""
import ast
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
pinned=(root/"vendor/sources/eden/src/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_swapchain.cpp").read_text()
tree=ast.parse((root/"tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py").read_text())
adapt_calls=[
    n.value for n in tree.body
    if isinstance(n,ast.Expr) and isinstance(n.value,ast.Call)
    and isinstance(n.value.func,ast.Name) and n.value.func.id=="adapt"
    and len(n.value.args)==3 and isinstance(n.value.args[0],ast.Constant)
    and n.value.args[0].value=="src/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_swapchain.cpp"

for before,after in replacements:
    assert generated.count(before)==1, f"Pinned Vulkan adapter drift: {before[:80]}"
    generated=generated.replace(before,after)
a=generated.index("bool Swapchain::AcquireNextImage() {")
b=generated.index("\nvoid Swapchain::Present(",a)
body=generated[a:b]
assert "constexpr u64 kAcquireSliceNs = 250'000'000ULL;" in body
assert "constexpr u32 kMaxAcquireTimeouts = 40;" in body
assert "throw vk::Exception(VK_TIMEOUT);" in body

assert "return IsSubOptimal() || NeedsPresentModeUpdate();" in swap_header

assert "#ifdef PS5_NATIVE" in body and "#else" in body and "#endif" in body
assert "vk::Check(result);" in body # actual fatal errors still propagated
assert "resource_ticks[image_index] = scheduler.CurrentTick();" in body

stub=r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <exception>
#include <limits>
#include <memory>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <vector>
using u64=std::uint64_t;
using u32=std::uint32_t;
enum VkResult : int { VK_SUCCESS=0,VK_NOT_READY=1,VK_TIMEOUT=2,
  VK_SUBOPTIMAL_KHR=1000001003,VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DATE_KHR=-1000001004,
  VK_ERROR_SURFACE_LOST_KHR=-1000000000 };
constexpr int VK_NULL_HANDLE=0;
#define LOG_ERROR(...) ((void)0)
const char* string_VkResult(VkResult){return "simulated";}
namespace vk {
struct Exception:std::exception{
  VkResult result;
  explicit Exception(VkResult value):result(value){}
  const char* what()const noexcept override{return "mock Vulkan error";}
  VkResult GetResult() const noexcept{return result;}
};
void Check(VkResult result){if(result!=VK_SUCCESS)throw Exception(result);}
}
namespace Settings {
enum class FramePacingMode{Target_Auto,Target_30,Target_60,Target_90,Target_120};
struct Mode {
 FramePacingMode value{FramePacingMode::Target_Auto};
 FramePacingMode GetValue() const{return value;}
};
struct Values{Mode frame_pacing_mode;};
inline Values values{};
}
struct FakeLogical {
  std::vector<VkResult> results;
  unsigned calls{};
  std::vector<u64> timeouts;
  unsigned successes{};
  VkResult AcquireNextImageKHR(int,u64 timeout,int,int,u32* index){
    ++calls;
    timeouts.push_back(timeout);
    if(calls>results.size())throw std::runtime_error("unscripted Vulkan acquire");
    VkResult result=results[calls-1];
    if(result==VK_SUCCESS||result==VK_SUBOPTIMAL_KHR){*index=1;++successes;}
    return result;
  }
};
struct Device {
  FakeLogical logical;
  FakeLogical& GetLogical(){return logical;}
};
struct Scheduler {
  unsigned waits{};
  std::vector<u64> ticks{7,8,9};
  u64 CurrentTick()const{return 77;}
  void Wait(u64, double=0){++waits;}
};
class Swapchain {
public:
  std::shared_ptr<int> swapchain{std::make_shared<int>(17)};
  std::vector<std::shared_ptr<int>> present_semaphores{std::make_shared<int>(4)};
  unsigned frame_index{};
  u32 image_index{std::numeric_limits<u32>::max()};
  bool is_suboptimal{},is_outdated{};
  Device device;
  Scheduler scheduler;
  std::vector<u64> resource_ticks{7,8,9};
  bool AcquireNextImage();
};
__REAL_METHOD__
int main(){
  {
    Swapchain s;
    s.device.logical.results={VK_SUCCESS};
    assert(!s.AcquireNextImage());
    assert(s.device.logical.calls==1 && s.device.logical.successes==1);
    assert(s.image_index==1 && s.resource_ticks[1]==77 && s.scheduler.waits==1);
  }
  {
    Swapchain s;
    s.device.logical.results={VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DATE_KHR};
    assert(s.AcquireNextImage() && s.is_outdated);
    assert(s.image_index==std::numeric_limits<u32>::max());
    assert(s.device.logical.successes==0 && s.scheduler.waits==0);
    assert(s.resource_ticks[1]==8);
  }
  {
    Swapchain s;
    s.device.logical.results={VK_SUBOPTIMAL_KHR};
    assert(!s.AcquireNextImage() && s.is_suboptimal && s.image_index==1);
    assert(s.scheduler.waits==1);
    assert(s.device.logical.successes==1);
    // Image remains valid until present; recreation is deferred to next pass.
  }
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
  {
    Swapchain s;
```

```py
"""Replay observed native GPU command counts under 1x/4x/8x host stress.

The native SPSC stop-aware producer method is extracted from the complete

# rather than a draw, CPU instruction, guest write or IPC service call.

test = r"""
int main() {
    using namespace std::chrono_literals;
    const std::array<unsigned,68> frames{__FRAMES__};
    const std::array<double,68> dispatch_ms{__DISPATCH__};
    const std::array<double,68> idle_ms{__IDLE__};
    unsigned total{};
    const unsigned recorded_draws=__DRAWS__;
    const unsigned recorded_guest_writes=__WRITES__;
    const unsigned recorded_guest_ipc=__IPC_START__;
    double dispatch{}, idle{};
    for (size_t i=0; i<frames.size(); ++i) {
        total+=frames[i];
        dispatch+=dispatch_ms[i];
        idle+=idle_ms[i];
        assert(frames[i]>=100 && frames[i]<=151);
        assert(dispatch_ms[i]>=0 && idle_ms[i]>=0);
    }
    assert(total==9479);
    assert(idle>dispatch*2.0); // GPU owner NOT saturated before freeze.
    // Real recorded command pacing AND a 4x/8x stress envelope, with a bounded
    // 32-slot native ring and simultaneous IPC/graphics/pad-like CPU demand.
    for (int factor : {1,4,8}) {
        Queue<unsigned,32> q;
        std::stop_source source;
        const unsigned expected=total*factor;
        std::atomic<unsigned> blocked{0};
        std::atomic<unsigned> drawn{0};
        std::atomic<unsigned long long> synthetic_draws{0}, synthetic_writes{0};
        std::atomic<unsigned long long> checksum{0};
        std::atomic<unsigned> background{0};
        std::thread producer([&] {
            unsigned seq=0;
            for(auto size:frames) {
                for(unsigned i=0;i<size*static_cast<unsigned>(factor);i++) {
                    if (!q.TryEmplace(seq)) {
                        blocked.fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_relaxed);
                        assert(q.EmplaceWaitWithStopToken(source.get_token(),seq));
                    }
                    ++seq;
                }
            }
            assert(seq==expected);
        });
        std::thread renderer([&] {
            unsigned long long work=0, draw_ops=0, write_ops=0;
            std::array<unsigned,8192> fake_guest_memory{};
            const unsigned long long total_draw_ops=static_cast<unsigned long long>(recorded_draws)*factor;
            const unsigned long long total_write_ops=static_cast<unsigned long long>(recorded_guest_writes)*factor;
            for(unsigned i=0;i<expected;i++) {
                unsigned value{};
                while (!q.TryPop(value)) std::this_thread::yield();
                assert(value==i); // FIFO, no duplicate/missing GPU command.
                // Synthetic cost variation; never equate host iterations with
                // firmware driver time. Helps expose producer/consumer races.
                unsigned long long acc=value+1;
                const unsigned long long n_draws=total_draw_ops/expected+(i<total_draw_ops%expected);
                const unsigned long long n_writes=total_write_ops/expected+(i<total_write_ops%expected);
                for(unsigned long long draw=0;draw<n_draws;draw++)
                    acc=(acc*6364136223846793005ULL+1442695040888963407ULL);
                for(unsigned long long j=0;j<n_writes;j++)
                    fake_guest_memory[(acc+j)&8191u]^=static_cast<unsigned>(i+j+1);
                draw_ops+=n_draws;
                write_ops+=n_writes;
                work^=acc;
                drawn.fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_relaxed);
            }
            for (auto value:fake_guest_memory) work ^= value;
            synthetic_draws.store(draw_ops,std::memory_order_release);
            synthetic_writes.store(write_ops,std::memory_order_release);
            checksum.store(work,std::memory_order_release);
        });
        std::thread ipc([&] {
            const unsigned loops=recorded_guest_ipc*factor;
            unsigned local=0;
            for(unsigned n=0;n<loops;n++)local+=(n&1);
            background.fetch_add(loops,std::memory_order_relaxed);
            assert(local==loops/2);
        });
        producer.join();renderer.join();ipc.join();
        unsigned value{};
        assert(!q.TryPop(value));
        assert(drawn.load()==expected);
        assert(background.load()==recorded_guest_ipc*factor);
        assert(synthetic_draws.load()==static_cast<unsigned long long>(recorded_draws)*factor);
        assert(synthetic_writes.load()==static_cast<unsigned long long>(recorded_guest_writes)*factor);
        std::printf("LOAD_FACTOR %dx command_units=%u draw_like_ops=%llu "
                    "guest_write_like_ops=%llu ipc_work=%u bounded_queue=32 "
                    "producer_waits=%u checksum=%llu\n",
                    factor,expected,synthetic_draws.load(),synthetic_writes.load(),
                    recorded_guest_ipc*factor,blocked.load(),checksum.load());
    }
    // Exact observed 1,669-second interval is VIRTUAL. Exercise actual
    // producer full-queue blocking while IPC + pad pathways keep progressing.
    // This mimics the observed counter *pattern*, NOT its missing GPU cause.
    {
        Queue<unsigned,32> q;
        for(unsigned i=0;i<32;i++) assert(q.TryEmplace(i));
        std::stop_source stop;
        std::promise<bool> done;
        auto response=done.get_future();
        std::thread blocked([&] {
            done.set_value(q.EmplaceWaitWithStopToken(stop.get_token(),32));
        });
        assert(response.wait_for(15ms)==std::future_status::timeout);
        std::atomic<unsigned> ipc{0},pads{0};
        std::thread ipc_thread([&] {
            for(unsigned i=0;i<1259768;i++)ipc.fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_relaxed);
        });
        std::thread pad_thread([&] {
            for(unsigned i=0;i<497500;i++)pads.fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_relaxed);
        });
        ipc_thread.join();pad_thread.join();
        assert(response.wait_for(1ms)==std::future_status::timeout);
        assert(ipc.load()==1259768 && pads.load()==497500);
        stop.request_stop();
        assert(response.wait_for(2s)==std::future_status::ready);
        assert(!response.get());
        blocked.join();
        unsigned value=0;
        for(unsigned i=0;i<32;i++)assert(q.TryPop(value) && value==i);
        assert(!q.TryPop(value));
        std::puts("VIRTUAL_FREEZE: zero GPU progress + 1259768 IPC + 497500 pad polls "
                  "with blocked native producer, safe cancellation");
    }
    std::puts("HOST STRESS PASS: native queue stays FIFO/bounded under record-derived load");
}
```

`tools/check-ps5-native-timing-replay.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
"""Virtual-time workload replay from real native 5-second frame windows.

This is a deliberately optimistic SINGLE-worker queueing model: arrivals
spaced by recorded presentation intervals, GPU service cost distributed
uniformly from measured GPU owner dispatch time. Worst-frame pauses can be
injected *on the GPU worker* as a hypothetical cause. It cannot prove driver,
guest producer, IPC, scheduler or Vulkan fence timing, since exact timestamps
of those operations were not recorded.
"""
from collections import deque
import json
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import median

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sample = json.loads((root/"tools/fixtures/native-load-20261013.json").read_text())
fields=sample["window_fields"]
rows=[dict(zip(fields,x)) for x in sample["windows"]]
assert len(rows)==68
assert sum(x["frames"] for x in rows)==9479
assert sum(x["late500"] for x in rows)==2

def replay(rate: int, inject_frame_max_on_worker: bool):
    # Pending frame-completion times for an optimistic serial GPU worker.
    # Ignore buffers freed by the guest, guest timeout/retry and kernel fences.
    pending=deque()
    backpressure=0
    longest=0
    startup=0.0
    latest_worker_finish=0.0
    for w in rows:
        ms=w["seconds"]*1000
        n=int(w["frames"])*rate
        assert n>0
        frame_spacing=ms/n
        # Assume each observed frame requires one modeled command; GPU
        # dispatch_ms is a sum, so distribute it uniformly across frames.
        service_ms=w["gpu_dispatch_ms"]/w["frames"]
        for idx in range(n):
            arrival=startup+idx*frame_spacing
            while pending and pending[0]<=arrival:
                pending.popleft()
            if len(pending)>=32:
                backpressure+=1
                arrival=max(arrival,pending[0])
                while pending and pending[0]<=arrival:
                    pending.popleft()
            # The recorded worst_ms is a frame interval, NOT an observed GPU
            # worker stall. Inject it only as a counterfactual upper-bound.
            pause=(w["worst_ms"] if idx==n//2 and inject_frame_max_on_worker else 0.0)
            complete=max(latest_worker_finish,arrival)+service_ms+pause
            pending.append(complete)
            latest_worker_finish=complete
            longest=max(longest,len(pending))
        startup+=ms
    return {"load_factor":rate,"hypothetical_worker_pauses":inject_frame_max_on_worker,
            "max_pending":longest,"queue_backpressure_events":backpressure,
            "virtual_tail_ms":round(max(0,latest_worker_finish-startup),2)}

base=replay(1,False)
spikes=replay(1,True)
quad=replay(4,False)
octo=replay(8,False)
print("MEASURED_OBSERVATIONS windows=68 total_frames=9479 worst_interval_ms=",
      max(w["worst_ms"] for w in rows),
      "median_gpu_dispatch_ms_5s=",round(median(w["gpu_dispatch_ms"] for w in rows),1),
      "median_gpu_idle_ms_5s=",round(median(w["gpu_idle_ms"] for w in rows),1))
for case in (base,spikes,quad,octo):
    print("VIRTUAL_QUEUE",json.dumps(case,sort_keys=True))
assert base["max_pending"]<=32
assert spikes["max_pending"]<=32, "one recorded maximum pause unexpectedly overfills 32 units"
assert octo["queue_backpressure_events"]>=quad["queue_backpressure_events"]>0
# With zero GPU consumption and continued production at a nominal 30 FPS,
# a 32-element queue fills after ~1.07 seconds, not after 28 minutes.
capacity=32
fps=30.0
fill_sec=capacity/fps
stall_sec=sample["stalls"][-1][0]/1000.0
assert stall_sec>1600 and 1<fill_sec<1.1
print(f"VIRTUAL_TOTAL_STALL age={stall_sec:.3f}s no_gpu_completions=1 "
      f"32_slot_fill_at_30fps={fill_sec:.3f}s if_producer_keeps_submitting=1")
print("MODEL LIMIT: no real Vulkan/guest driver or precise command arrival timestamps")
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Exercise the PS5 host DNS shim against stubbed native resolver APIs.

This builds ONLY a tiny host C test harness. It does not compile Encore or
trigger a PS5 build, and makes no live network requests.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import os
import shutil
import sys
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
compat = root / "headless/ps5_net_compat.c"
src = r'''
#include <assert.h>
#include <arpa/inet.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <netdb.h>
#include <netinet/in.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/socket.h>
static int pool_created, pool_destroyed, resolver_created, resolver_destroyed, queried;
int sceNetPoolCreate(const char *name, int size, int flags) {
    assert(strcmp(name, "encore_dns") == 0 && size >= 16384 && flags == 0);
    ++pool_created; return 23;
}
int sceNetPoolDestroy(int pool) { assert(pool == 23); ++pool_destroyed; return 0; }
int sceNetResolverCreate(const char *name, int pool, int flags) {
    assert(strcmp(name, "encore_dns") == 0 && pool == 23 && flags == 0);
    ++resolver_created; return 24;
}
int sceNetResolverStartNtoa(int resolver, const char *host, struct in_addr *address,
                            int timeout, int retries, int flags) {
    assert(resolver == 24 && timeout > 0 && retries > 0 && flags == 0);
    ++queried;
    if (strcmp(host, "api.nlib.cc")) return -1;
    assert(inet_pton(AF_INET, "203.0.113.7", address) == 1);
    return 0;
}
int sceNetResolverDestroy(int resolver) {
    assert(resolver == 24); ++resolver_destroyed; return 0;
}
int __real_fcntl(int fd, int command, ...) {
    (void)fd;
    if (command == F_DUPFD) {
        va_list ap;
        va_start(ap, command);
        const int lowest = va_arg(ap, int);
        va_end(ap);
        assert(lowest == 3);
        return 117;
    }
    errno = EINVAL; return -1;
}
static int nonblocking = 0;
static int mock_setsockopt(int fd, int level, int opt, const void *value, socklen_t length) {
    assert(fd == 17 && level == SOL_SOCKET && opt == 0x1200);
    assert(length == sizeof(int));
    nonblocking = *(const int *)value;
    return 0;
}
static int mock_getsockopt(int fd, int level, int opt, void *value, socklen_t *length) {
    assert(fd == 17 && level == SOL_SOCKET && opt == 0x1200);
    assert(*length == sizeof(int));
    *(int *)value = nonblocking;
    return 0;
}
#define setsockopt mock_setsockopt
#define getsockopt mock_getsockopt
#include "ps5_net_compat.c"
#undef setsockopt
#undef getsockopt
int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    assert(argc == 2);
    assert(eden_network_filter_load(argv[1]) == 0);
    assert(eden_network_audit_init("network-audit-host-unwritten.log", 0) == 0);
    assert(eden_network_filter_count() >= 140);
    struct addrinfo hints = {0}, *addr = NULL;
    hints.ai_family = AF_INET;
    hints.ai_socktype = SOCK_STREAM;
    assert(getaddrinfo("api.nlib.cc", "443", &hints, &addr) == 0);
    assert(addr && addr->ai_family == AF_INET && addr->ai_socktype == SOCK_STREAM);
    const struct sockaddr_in *sa = (const struct sockaddr_in *)addr->ai_addr;
    assert(sa && ntohs(sa->sin_port) == 443);
    char ip[INET_ADDRSTRLEN] = {0}, port[12] = {0};
    assert(getnameinfo(addr->ai_addr, addr->ai_addrlen, ip, sizeof(ip),
                       port, sizeof(port), NI_NUMERICHOST | NI_NUMERICSERV) == 0);
    assert(strcmp(ip, "203.0.113.7") == 0 && strcmp(port, "443") == 0);
    char short_host[3] = {0}, short_service[2] = {0};
    assert(getnameinfo(addr->ai_addr, addr->ai_addrlen, short_host, sizeof(short_host),
                       NULL, 0, NI_NUMERICHOST) == EAI_OVERFLOW);
    assert(getnameinfo(addr->ai_addr, addr->ai_addrlen, NULL, 0,
                       short_service, sizeof(short_service), NI_NUMERICSERV) == EAI_OVERFLOW);
    freeaddrinfo(addr);
    assert(queried == 1 && pool_created == pool_destroyed);
    assert(resolver_created == resolver_destroyed);
    // Both exact suffix and nested-subdomain blocks reject BEFORE sceNetResolver.
    assert(getaddrinfo("api.ea.com", "443", &hints, &addr) == EAI_NONAME);
    assert(getaddrinfo("c.test.cdn.nintendo.net", "443", &hints, &addr) == EAI_NONAME);
    assert(getaddrinfo("not-ea.com", "443", &hints, &addr) == EAI_NONAME);
    assert(queried == 2); // not-ea.com is NOT blocked: resolver mock was queried
    assert(gethostbyname("login.api.ea.com") == NULL);
    assert(queried == 2);

    assert(getaddrinfo("127.0.0.1", "80", &hints, &addr) == 0);
    assert(queried == 2);
    freeaddrinfo(addr);
    assert(getaddrinfo("127.0.0.1", "not-a-port", &hints, &addr) == EAI_SERVICE);
    assert(getaddrinfo("127.0.0.1", "65536", &hints, &addr) == EAI_SERVICE);
    assert(getaddrinfo("127.0.0.1", "-1", &hints, &addr) == EAI_SERVICE);
    assert(getaddrinfo("127.0.0.1", "999999999999999999999999999999", &hints, &addr) == EAI_SERVICE);
    assert(getaddrinfo(NULL, NULL, &hints, &addr) == EAI_NONAME);
    assert(getaddrinfo("127.0.0.1", "https", &hints, &addr) == 0);
    assert(ntohs(((struct sockaddr_in *)addr->ai_addr)->sin_port) == 443);
    freeaddrinfo(addr);
    hints.ai_flags = AI_NUMERICSERV;
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compile native RasterizerVulkan::UnmapMemory and check exact cache lock semantics."""
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
active=(root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_rasterizer.cpp").read_text()
bridge=(root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-core/guest-bridge/vulkan_rasterizer.cpp").read_text()
start="void RasterizerVulkan::UnmapMemory("
end="void RasterizerVulkan::ModifyGPUMemory("
def get(s):
    a=s.index(start)
    return s[a:s.index(end,a)]
source=get(active)
assert source==get(bridge), "DEV bridge must follow native Unmap source"
assert source.count("::Eden::BufferPages::NeverRegistered(addr, size)")==1
assert source.index("texture_cache.UnmapMemory(addr, size)") < source.index("buffer_cache.WriteMemory(addr, size)") < source.index("pipeline_cache.OnCacheInvalidation(addr, size)")
oracle=(root/"tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py").read_text()
assert "The CPU Unmap path may skip ONLY buffer invalidation" in oracle
owner=(root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/video_core/buffer_cache/buffer_cache.h").read_text()
fragment=owner[owner.index("void BufferCache<P>::ChangeRegister("):]
assert fragment.index("::Eden::BufferPages::Mark(buffer.CpuAddr(), size);") < fragment.index("page_table[page] = buffer_id;")
tracker=(root/"vendor/sources/eden/src/video_core/buffer_cache/word_manager.h").read_text()
assert "std::fill_n(heap.data() + size_t(Type::CPU) * num_words, num_words, ~u64{0});" in tracker
cmake=(root/"headless/vulkan.cmake").read_text()
assert '"${PORT_BUILD_DIR}/vulkan_rasterizer.cpp"' in cmake
host=r'''
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <mutex>
#include "buffer_pages.h"
using DAddr = std::uint64_t;
using u64 = std::uint64_t;
struct CountMutex {
    std::mutex backing;
    int locks=0;
    void lock() { backing.lock(); ++locks; }
    void unlock() { backing.unlock(); }
};
struct TextureCache {
    CountMutex mutex;
    int unmaps=0;
    void UnmapMemory(DAddr,u64) { ++unmaps; }
};
struct BufferCache {
    CountMutex mutex;
    int writes=0;
    void WriteMemory(DAddr,u64) { ++writes; }
};
struct PipelineCache {
    int invalidations=0;
    void OnCacheInvalidation(DAddr,u64) { ++invalidations; }
};
namespace Eden::ImagePages {
    inline bool held=false;
    bool NeverHeld(DAddr,u64) { return !held; }
}
struct RasterizerVulkan {
    TextureCache texture_cache;
    BufferCache buffer_cache;
    PipelineCache pipeline_cache;
    void UnmapMemory(DAddr,u64);
};
''' + source + r'''
int main() {
    constexpr DAddr never=0x100000, known=0x200000;
    RasterizerVulkan a;
    a.UnmapMemory(never,4096);
    assert(a.texture_cache.mutex.locks==0);
    assert(a.buffer_cache.mutex.locks==0 && a.buffer_cache.writes==0);
    assert(a.pipeline_cache.invalidations==1);
    Eden::BufferPages::Mark(known,4096);
    RasterizerVulkan b;
    b.UnmapMemory(known,4096);
    assert(b.buffer_cache.mutex.locks==1 && b.buffer_cache.writes==1);
    assert(b.pipeline_cache.invalidations==1);
    // A formerly owned buffer must not be optimized away after eviction.
    b.UnmapMemory(known,4096);
    assert(b.buffer_cache.mutex.locks==2 && b.buffer_cache.writes==2);
    // Independent image ownership never forces buffer invalidation.
    Eden::ImagePages::held=true;
    RasterizerVulkan c;
    c.UnmapMemory(never,4096);
    assert(c.texture_cache.mutex.locks==1 && c.texture_cache.unmaps==1);
    assert(c.buffer_cache.mutex.locks==0 && c.buffer_cache.writes==0);
    assert(c.pipeline_cache.invalidations==1);
    Eden::ImagePages::held=false;
    // A 128 KiB unowned CPU unmap now uses the two-word bitmap fast path.
    RasterizerVulkan d;
    d.UnmapMemory(0x300000,131072);
    assert(d.buffer_cache.mutex.locks==0 && d.buffer_cache.writes==0);
    assert(d.pipeline_cache.invalidations==1);
    // Oversized or unknown queries must still take the conservative lock.
    d.UnmapMemory(0x300000,256*1024+1);
    assert(d.buffer_cache.mutex.locks==1 && d.buffer_cache.writes==1);
    assert(d.pipeline_cache.invalidations==2);
    Eden::BufferPages::Mark(Eden::BufferPages::kSpace,4096);
    RasterizerVulkan e;
    e.UnmapMemory(never,4096);
    assert(e.buffer_cache.mutex.locks==1 && e.buffer_cache.writes==1);
    assert(e.pipeline_cache.invalidations==1);
}
'''
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-never-owned-unmap-") as tmp:
    src=Path(tmp)/"unit.cpp"
    src.write_text(host)
    for opt in ("-O0","-O2"):
        exe=Path(tmp)/opt
        subprocess.run(["c++","-std=c++20",opt,"-Wall","-Wextra","-Werror",
                        "-I",str(root/"headless"),str(src),"-o",str(exe)],check=True,timeout=30)
        subprocess.run([str(exe)],check=True,timeout=10)
        print("NEVER_OWNED_BUFFER_UNMAP_PASS",opt)
```

```py
struct Witness {
```

```py
    subprocess.run(["git", "apply", str(shared_patch)], check=True, cwd=d, timeout=10)
    text = target.read_text()

    assert fn.count("if (is_new_tc || pair->second == NULL_IMAGE_VIEW_ID)") == 2

                   fn.index("#endif", fn.index("if (it->second == NULL_IMAGE_VIEW_ID"))]

    # texture-cache harness: no manually reimplemented decision flow.
    head = r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <utility>
#define LOG_DEBUG(...) ((void)0)
using u32 = std::uint32_t;
using ImageViewId = int;
constexpr ImageViewId NULL_IMAGE_VIEW_ID = 0;
namespace Common { struct SlotId {static constexpr u32 TAGGED_VALUE=0x80000000;}; }
struct TICEntry {
    int value{};
    bool operator==(TICEntry const& rhs) const {return rhs.value==value;}
};
namespace std {template<> struct hash<TICEntry> {
    size_t operator()(TICEntry x) const noexcept {return std::hash<int>{}(x.value);}
};}
struct MemoryManager { bool mapped{}; };
bool IsValidEntry(MemoryManager& memory, TICEntry t) {
    return memory.mapped && t.value > 0;
}
struct DescriptorTable {
    u32 current_limit{15};
    TICEntry descriptor{3};
    bool changed{true};
    std::pair<TICEntry,bool> Read(MemoryManager const&,u32) {
        return {descriptor,changed};
    }
};
struct Channel {
    DescriptorTable compute_image_table, graphics_image_table;
    std::unordered_map<TICEntry,ImageViewId> image_views;
    std::unordered_map<u32,ImageViewId> image_view_ids;
};
struct Dummy{};
template<class P> struct TextureCache {
    Channel* channel_state;
    MemoryManager* gpu_memory;
    int next_id{1};
    int prepared{};
    u32 texture_bindings_serial{};
    int transient_create_failures{};
    ImageViewId VisitImageView(u32 index,bool compute);
    ImageViewId CreateImageView(TICEntry) {
        if (transient_create_failures > 0) {
            --transient_create_failures;
            return NULL_IMAGE_VIEW_ID;
        }
        return next_id++;
    }
    void PrepareImageView(ImageViewId id,bool,bool) {
        if (!id) return; // actual TextureCache::PrepareImageView short-circuits
        ++prepared;
    }
};
"""
    tail = r"""
int main() {
    Channel c{};
    MemoryManager gm{};
    TextureCache<Dummy> tc{&c,&gm};
    // Initially the descriptor is valid but its GPU pages are absent.
    assert(tc.VisitImageView(5,false)==NULL_IMAGE_VIEW_ID);
    assert(c.image_view_ids.at(5)==NULL_IMAGE_VIEW_ID);
    assert(tc.next_id==1);
    c.graphics_image_table.changed=false;
    gm.mapped=true; // Guest maps GPU pages; descriptor bytes do NOT change.
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE

    assert(c.image_view_ids.at(5)==1);
    assert(tc.prepared==1 && tc.texture_bindings_serial==1);
    assert(tc.VisitImageView(5,false)==1);
    assert(tc.prepared==2 && tc.texture_bindings_serial==1);
    assert(tc.next_id==2); // normal cached draw path never recreates
#else
    assert(tc.VisitImageView(5,false)==NULL_IMAGE_VIEW_ID);
    assert(tc.next_id==1); // original upstream behavior preserved
#endif
    // Two different indices may share descriptor bytes and the image_views
    // map. A transient first-creation failure must not poison the second
    // index's first bind (is_new=true). R314 alone only retries later.
    Channel shared{};

    assert(shared.image_views.at(TICEntry{3})==NULL_IMAGE_VIEW_ID);
    assert(reused.next_id==1);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(reused.VisitImageView(6,false)==1);
    assert(shared.image_view_ids.at(6)==1);
    assert(reused.next_id==2 && reused.prepared==1);
#else
    assert(reused.VisitImageView(6,false)==NULL_IMAGE_VIEW_ID);
    assert(reused.next_id==1);
#endif
    // A sparse/compute texture shares the TIC bytes but NOT the slot key.
    c.compute_image_table.changed=true;

    assert(c.image_view_ids.at(5|Common::SlotId::TAGGED_VALUE)==1);
    // Invalid format stays null even after remapping.
    c.graphics_image_table.changed=true;
    c.graphics_image_table.descriptor.value=0;
    assert(tc.VisitImageView(5,false)==NULL_IMAGE_VIEW_ID);
    c.graphics_image_table.changed=false;
    assert(tc.VisitImageView(5,false)==NULL_IMAGE_VIEW_ID);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    // A valid mapped TIC can nevertheless produce a null view if image
    // allocation fails temporarily. The descriptor stays identical afterward.
    Channel retry_state{};
    MemoryManager retry_mem{true};
    TextureCache<Dummy> retry{&retry_state, &retry_mem};
    retry.transient_create_failures=1;

    assert(retry.texture_bindings_serial==1);
    assert(retry.VisitImageView(5,false)==1);
    assert(retry.prepared==2 && retry.next_id==2);
    assert(retry.texture_bindings_serial==1);

}
"""
```

```py
#include "pad_diagnostics.h"
#include "ps5_pad.hpp"
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdio>
#include <type_traits>
int main() {
    static_assert(std::is_trivially_default_constructible_v<ps5::pad::Data>);
    static_assert(sizeof(ps5::pad::Data) * ps5::pad::kMaxSamples == 7680);
    // The real platform writes exactly the reported prefix. A zero/invalid
    // count must not expose stale data left by the previous controller.
    std::array<ps5::pad::Data, ps5::pad::kMaxSamples> scratch;
    for (int count : {64, 0, 3, -1, 65, 1}) {
        const bool valid = count >= 0 && count <= int(scratch.size());
        if (!valid) {
            const auto neutral = ps5::pad::neutral_data();
            assert(neutral.left_stick.x == 128);
            continue;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
            scratch[std::size_t(i)] = ps5::pad::neutral_data(std::uint64_t(i + 1));
            scratch[std::size_t(i)].buttons = std::uint32_t(i);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i)
            assert(scratch[std::size_t(i)].buttons == std::uint32_t(i) &&
                   scratch[std::size_t(i)].timestamp_us == std::uint64_t(i + 1));
    }
    // The optional heartbeat scan must not be necessary for game input.
    // Quiet batches do no diagnostics; the same 64 native samples are still
    // available to the unconditional Consume call.
    unsigned game_delivered = 0, diagnostic_count = 0, usable_count = 0;
    for (bool detailed : {false, true}) {
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < scratch.size(); ++i) {
            scratch[i] = ps5::pad::neutral_data(std::uint64_t(i + 1));
            scratch[i].connected = i % 2 ? 1 : 0;
        }
        if (detailed) {
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < scratch.size(); ++i) {
                const bool usable = ps5::pad::is_usable(scratch[i]);
                ++diagnostic_count;
                usable_count += usable;
            }
        }
        game_delivered += unsigned(scratch.size()); // same Consume prefix
    }
    assert(game_delivered == 128);
    assert(diagnostic_count == 64 && usable_count == 32);
    Eden::PadEdgeDiagnostics edges{};
    constexpr unsigned cross=1, circle=2, square=4, triangle=8;
    edges.Observe(0, 4, cross, circle, square, triangle);
    assert(edges.changes==1 && edges.square==1 && edges.triangle==0);
    edges.Observe(4, 4, cross, circle, square, triangle);
    assert(edges.changes==1 && edges.square==1);  // held does not recount
    edges.Observe(4, 12, cross, circle, square, triangle);
    assert(edges.changes==2 && edges.square==1 && edges.triangle==1);
    edges.Observe(12, 0, cross, circle, square, triangle);
    assert(edges.changes==3 && edges.square==1 && edges.triangle==1);
    edges.Observe(0, 3, cross, circle, square, triangle);
    assert(edges.changes==4 && edges.cross==1 && edges.circle==1);
    edges.Observe(3, 0, cross, circle, square, triangle);
    edges.Observe(0, 4, cross, circle, square, triangle);
    assert(edges.square==2 && edges.triangle==1 && edges.cross==1 && edges.circle==1);
    std::puts("R332 PASS: physical face rising edges, held/release, independent X/Y accounting");
}
'''
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='eden-r332-pad-') as tmp:
    path = Path(tmp)
    (path / 'test.cpp').write_text(unit)
    env = os.environ.copy()
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
"""Compile the real dev PcSignal handler with synthetic host register contexts.

Tests signal-handler ring wrap; no PS5 firmware, kernel signals, native
compilation, or actual concurrent guest execution is represented.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
perf = (root / "headless/performance.cpp").read_text()
start = perf.index("void PcSignal(int, siginfo_t*, void* context) {")
end = perf.index("\n}\n#endif\n#ifdef PS5_NATIVE", start) + 2

assert "sampled_pcs[slot].store(" in handler
assert "sampled_core_pcs[core_index % sampled_core_pcs.size()].store(" in handler
assert "pc_count.store(index + 1, std::memory_order_release);" in handler
assert "core_pc_count.store(core_index + 1, std::memory_order_release);" in handler
assert "#if defined(EDEN_DEV_WAIT_CALLERS) && defined(PS5_NATIVE)" in handler
assert "if (index >= sampled_pcs.size()) return;" in handler

if not compiler:
    raise SystemExit("C++20 compiler required for actual PC handler ring smoke")

prefix = r"""
#include <array>
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <csignal>
#include <cstdint>
#include <pthread.h>
namespace Eden::Performance {
namespace {
static_assert(std::atomic<uintptr_t>::is_always_lock_free);
std::array<std::atomic<uintptr_t>, 8192> sampled_pcs{};
std::atomic<unsigned> pc_count{};
std::array<std::atomic<uintptr_t>, 65536> sampled_core_pcs{};
std::atomic<unsigned> core_pc_count{};
pthread_t core_sample_thread{};
std::atomic<bool> core_sample_ready{};
"""
suffix = r"""
} // anonymous namespace
} // Eden::Performance

int main() {
    using namespace Eden::Performance;
    std::array<uintptr_t, 32> registers{};
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 10000; ++i) {
        registers[224 / sizeof(uintptr_t)] = i + 1;
        PcSignal(0, nullptr, registers.data());
    }
    assert(pc_count.load(std::memory_order_acquire) == 10000);
    for (unsigned i = 10000 - sampled_pcs.size(); i < 10000; ++i)
        assert(sampled_pcs[i % sampled_pcs.size()].load() == i + 1);
    core_sample_thread = pthread_self();
    core_sample_ready.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 90000; ++i) {
        registers[224 / sizeof(uintptr_t)] = 0x100000 + i;
        PcSignal(0, nullptr, registers.data());
    }
    assert(core_pc_count.load(std::memory_order_acquire) == 90000);
    assert(pc_count.load(std::memory_order_acquire) == 10000);
    for (unsigned i = 90000 - sampled_core_pcs.size(); i < 90000; ++i)
        assert(sampled_core_pcs[i % sampled_core_pcs.size()].load() == 0x100000 + i);
}
"""
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-pc-ring-") as folder:
    folder = Path(folder)
    src, exe = folder / "sample.cpp", folder / "sample"
    src.write_text(prefix + handler + suffix)
    subprocess.run([compiler, "-std=c++20", "-O2", "-pthread", "-Wall", "-Wextra",
                    "-Werror", str(src), "-o", str(exe)], check=True)
    subprocess.run([str(exe)], check=True)
print("PASS: source-extracted PcSignal PC-only ring wraps GPU/guest atomics across 10k/90k events")
print("No PS5 signals, SDK, firmware, running FC27, or linked native binary validated")
```

`tools/check-ps5-pipeline-build-handoff-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Verify selected Vulkan first-use shader completion ownership.

Extracts the actual early-construction RAII guard from the maintained C++
constructor. Host scenarios cover setup failures, queue failures, synchronous
and asynchronous worker completion. This is a source-contract/host proof only,
not a complete native pipeline compilation or a PS5 frame-time result.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
source = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vk_graphics_pipeline_cost.cpp").read_text()
begin = source.index("GraphicsPipeline::GraphicsPipeline(")
end = source.index("\nvoid GraphicsPipeline::AddTransition(", begin)
ctor = source[begin:end]

mark = """    if (shader_notify) {
        shader_notify->MarkShaderBuilding();
    }
"""
guard_begin = ctor.index("    bool build_handed_off = false;")
# A new forced-MSAA renderpass admission follows this RAII block in
# production. Extract ONLY the bounded SCOPE_EXIT guard into the mock.
# Treat the actual new renderpass owner as a separate positive source
# contract: the worker still must never race its creation.
guard_end = ctor.index("    };\n", guard_begin) + len("    };\n")
guard = ctor[guard_begin:guard_end]
renderpass_setup = ctor[guard_end:ctor.index("    for (size_t stage = 0;", guard_end)]
assert renderpass_setup.count("if (key.state.forced_color_resolve)") == 1
assert "native_render_pass = render_pass_cache.Get(MakeRenderPassKey(key.state, device));" in renderpass_setup
assert ctor.index("native_render_pass = render_pass_cache.Get(") < ctor.index("    for (size_t stage = 0;")
assert ctor.count(mark) == 1
assert "SCOPE_EXIT {" in guard
assert "if (!build_handed_off && shader_notify)" in guard
assert "shader_notify->MarkShaderComplete();" in guard
assert ctor.count("build_handed_off = true;") == 2
assert ctor.index("configure_func = ConfigureFunc(spv_modules, stage_infos);") < (
    ctor.index("worker_thread->QueueWork(")
)
assert ctor.index("configure_func = ConfigureFunc(spv_modules, stage_infos);") < (
    ctor.index("    if (worker_thread) {")
)
assert ctor.index("build_handed_off = true;") > ctor.index("worker_thread->QueueWork(")
assert ctor.index("build_handed_off = true;") < ctor.index("    } else {\n        // Synchronous func()")

# The exact real guard, including its destructor lambda, is compiled. Only
# descriptor preparation and worker queue ownership are stand-ins.
host = r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdio>
#include <functional>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <type_traits>
#include <utility>
struct Maker {};
template<class F> struct ScopeGuard {
    F f;
    ~ScopeGuard() { f(); }
};
template<class F> ScopeGuard<std::decay_t<F>> operator+(Maker, F&& f) {
    return {std::forward<F>(f)};
}
#define SCOPE_EXIT auto _guard = Maker{} + [&]
struct Notify {
    int building{}, complete{}, outstanding{};
    void MarkShaderBuilding() { ++building; ++outstanding; }
    void MarkShaderComplete() {
        ++complete;
        --outstanding;
        assert(outstanding >= 0);
    }
};
struct Queue {
    std::function<void()> work;
    bool fail{};
    void QueueWork(std::function<void()> job) {
        if (fail) throw std::runtime_error("queue");
        work = std::move(job);
    }
};
struct Case {
    bool setup_fail{}, configure_fail{}, async{}, build_fail{}, queue_fail{};
};
void Setup(Notify* shader_notify, Queue& queue, Case test) {
MARK
#ifndef NEGATIVE_CONTROL
GUARD
#else
    [[maybe_unused]] bool build_handed_off = false;
#endif
    if (test.setup_fail) throw std::runtime_error("setup");
    if (test.configure_fail) throw std::runtime_error("configure");
    const auto build = [shader_notify, fail = test.build_fail] {
        // The real worker uses its own SCOPE_EXIT to publish completion even
        // when Validate/MakePipeline throws; preserve that one-shot contract.
        if (shader_notify) shader_notify->MarkShaderComplete();
        if (fail) return;
    };
    if (test.async) {
        queue.fail = test.queue_fail;
        queue.QueueWork(build);
        build_handed_off = true;
    } else {
        build_handed_off = true;
        build();
    }
}
void try_setup(Notify& notify, Queue& queue, Case test) {
    try { Setup(&notify, queue, test); }
    catch (const std::runtime_error&) {}
}
int main() {
#ifdef NEGATIVE_CONTROL
    Notify n; Queue q;
    try_setup(n, q, {.setup_fail=true});
    assert(n.building == 1 && n.outstanding == 1 && n.complete == 0);
    std::puts("OLD_SHADER_NOTIFY_LEAK_REPRODUCED");
#else
    for (Case test : {
        Case{.setup_fail=true}, Case{.configure_fail=true},
        Case{.async=true, .queue_fail=true},
        Case{}, Case{.build_fail=true},
        Case{.async=true}, Case{.async=true, .build_fail=true}
    }) {
        Notify n; Queue q;
        try_setup(n, q, test);
        const bool deferred = test.async && !test.setup_fail &&
                              !test.configure_fail && !test.queue_fail;
        if (deferred) {
            assert(n.outstanding == 1 && n.complete == 0);
            assert(static_cast<bool>(q.work));
            q.work();
        }
        assert(n.building == 1 && n.outstanding == 0 && n.complete == 1);
    }
    Queue no_notify;
    Setup(nullptr, no_notify, {.async=true});
    assert(static_cast<bool>(no_notify.work));
    no_notify.work();
    std::puts("PIPELINE_BUILD_HANDOFF_HOST_PASS");
#endif
}
"""
host = host.replace("MARK", mark).replace("GUARD", guard)

compiler = shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++") or shutil.which("c++")
assert compiler, "C++20 compiler missing"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-pipeline-handoff-") as temp:
    cpp = Path(temp) / "handoff.cpp"
    cpp.write_text(host)
    for opt in ("-O0", "-O2"):
        flags = [compiler, "-std=c++20", opt, "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror",
                 "-fsanitize=undefined", "-fno-sanitize-recover=all"]
        for negative in (False, True):
            exe = Path(temp) / ("handoff" + opt + ("old" if negative else "new"))
            cmd = [*flags, *(["-DNEGATIVE_CONTROL=1"] if negative else []),
                   str(cpp), "-o", str(exe)]
            built = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=45)
            assert built.returncode == 0, (opt, built.stderr[-3000:])
            run = subprocess.run([str(exe)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
            expect = "OLD_SHADER_NOTIFY_LEAK_REPRODUCED" if negative else (
                "PIPELINE_BUILD_HANDOFF_HOST_PASS")
            assert run.returncode == 0 and expect in run.stdout, (
                opt, negative, run.stdout, run.stderr[-3000:])
            print("VULKAN_PIPELINE_BUILD_HANDOFF_PASS", opt,
                  "previous-leak" if negative else "maintained-scenarios")
```

`tools/check-ps5-pipeline-build-wait.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""R378: source-extracted Vulkan worker completion, no indefinite pipeline wait."""
from pathlib import Path
import os,subprocess,sys,tempfile

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
paths=[
    root/'vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vk_graphics_pipeline_cost.cpp',
    root/'vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vk_compute_pipeline_cost.cpp',
]
generator=(root/'tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py').read_text()
guards=[]
for path in paths:
    data=path.read_text()
    assert '#include "common/scope_exit.h"' in data,path
    start=data.index("        SCOPE_EXIT {",data.index("    auto func{[this, shader_notify"))
    stop=data.index("        };",start)+len("        };")
    guard=data[start:stop]
    assert "is_built.store(true, std::memory_order_release)" in guard
    assert "build_condvar.notify_all()" in guard
    assert "shader_notify->MarkShaderComplete()" in guard
    assert "std::scoped_lock lock{build_mutex}" in guard
    assert data.count("build_condvar.notify_all()")==1
    assert data.count("build_condvar.notify_one()")==0
    assert 'catch (const std::exception& exception)' in data
    assert 'catch (...)' in data
    assert "if (pipeline_statistics && pipeline)" in data
    guards.append(guard)
assert "build_condvar.notify_all()" in generator
assert '"common/scope_exit.h"' in generator

model=r"""
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <chrono>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <mutex>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <thread>
#include "common/scope_exit.h"

struct Notify {
    std::atomic<int> completes{};
    void MarkShaderComplete() noexcept {
        completes.fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_relaxed);
    }
};
struct Worker {
    std::mutex build_mutex;
    std::condition_variable build_condvar;
    std::atomic_bool is_built{false};
    void Build(int kind, Notify* shader_notify) {
__SOURCE_GUARD__
        try {
            if (kind==1) throw std::runtime_error("Vulkan/resource exception");
            if (kind==2) throw 42;  // non-std exception
            if (kind==3) return;    // unexpected early exit
        } catch (const std::exception&) {
        } catch (...) {
        }
    }
};
int main() {
    for(int kind=0;kind<4;++kind) {
        Worker p;
        Notify notify;
        std::atomic_bool released{false};
        std::thread waiter([&] {
            std::unique_lock lock{p.build_mutex};
            const bool ok=p.build_condvar.wait_for(
                lock,std::chrono::seconds(2),
                [&] {return p.is_built.load(std::memory_order_acquire);});
            released.store(ok,std::memory_order_release);
        });
        std::thread worker([&] {p.Build(kind,&notify);});
        worker.join();waiter.join();
        assert(released.load(std::memory_order_acquire));
        assert(p.is_built.load(std::memory_order_acquire));
        assert(notify.completes.load()==1);
    }
    Worker no_notifier;
    no_notifier.Build(2,nullptr);
    assert(no_notifier.is_built.load());
}
"""
env=os.environ.copy()
if sys.platform=='darwin' and not env.get('SDKROOT'):
    sdk=Path('/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX15.4.sdk')
    if sdk.is_dir():env['SDKROOT']=str(sdk)
```

```py
#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <thread>
#include <cassert>
#include <mutex>
#include <memory>
using namespace std::chrono;
std::atomic<unsigned> pending_first_use_graphics_builds{0};
std::atomic<unsigned> pending_first_use_compute_builds{0};
struct State { std::mutex mutex; bool cancelled{false}; };
void defer_optimizer(std::shared_ptr<State> state) {
""" + gate + """
}
int main() {
    auto state = std::make_shared<State>();
    pending_first_use_graphics_builds.store(1);
    std::thread release([] {
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(30ms);
        pending_first_use_graphics_builds.store(0, std::memory_order_release);
    });
    auto before = steady_clock::now();
    defer_optimizer(state);
    auto elapsed = duration_cast<milliseconds>(steady_clock::now() - before).count();
    release.join();
    assert(elapsed >= 16 && elapsed < 250);
    // R421 used to begin competing after 48 ms even if first-use compilation
    // took longer. Remain idle until the remaining compilation is done.
    pending_first_use_graphics_builds.store(1);
    std::thread release_late([] {
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(100ms);
        pending_first_use_graphics_builds.store(0, std::memory_order_release);
    });
    before = steady_clock::now();
    defer_optimizer(state);
    elapsed = duration_cast<milliseconds>(steady_clock::now() - before).count();
    release_late.join();
    assert(elapsed >= 75 && elapsed < 300);
    // A title may close while another compilation never completes. Do not
    // strand its optimized pipeline worker or dereference a destroyed title.
    pending_first_use_graphics_builds.store(1);
    std::thread cancel([state] {
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(15ms);
        std::scoped_lock lock{state->mutex};
        state->cancelled = true;
    });
    before = steady_clock::now();
    defer_optimizer(state);
    elapsed = duration_cast<milliseconds>(steady_clock::now() - before).count();
    cancel.join();
    assert(elapsed >= 8 && elapsed < 150);
    // A cold compute build must delay speculative graphics just as a cold
    // graphics build does; foreground work has priority over background jobs.
    pending_first_use_graphics_builds.store(0);
    pending_first_use_compute_builds.store(1);
    std::thread release_compute([] {
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(65ms);
        pending_first_use_compute_builds.store(0, std::memory_order_release);
    });
    before = steady_clock::now();
    defer_optimizer(std::make_shared<State>());
    elapsed = duration_cast<milliseconds>(steady_clock::now() - before).count();
    release_compute.join();
    assert(elapsed >= 45 && elapsed < 260);
    // Cancellation must also free teardown when a compute compiler stalls.
    auto blocked = std::make_shared<State>();
    pending_first_use_compute_builds.store(1);
    std::thread cancel_compute([blocked] {
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(15ms);
        std::scoped_lock lock{blocked->mutex};
        blocked->cancelled = true;
    });
    before = steady_clock::now();
    defer_optimizer(blocked);
    elapsed = duration_cast<milliseconds>(steady_clock::now() - before).count();
    cancel_compute.join();
    assert(elapsed >= 8 && elapsed < 150);
    pending_first_use_compute_builds.store(0);
    pending_first_use_graphics_builds.store(0);
    before = steady_clock::now();
    defer_optimizer(std::make_shared<State>());
    elapsed = duration_cast<milliseconds>(steady_clock::now() - before).count();
    assert(elapsed >= 12 && elapsed < 120);
    // Reset the idle countdown when a burst of compute first-use begins
    // AFTER the optional graphics worker observed empty queues.
    std::thread transient([] {
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(7ms);
        pending_first_use_compute_builds.store(1, std::memory_order_release);
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(24ms);
        pending_first_use_compute_builds.store(0, std::memory_order_release);
    });
    before = steady_clock::now();
    defer_optimizer(std::make_shared<State>());
    elapsed = duration_cast<milliseconds>(steady_clock::now() - before).count();
    transient.join();
    assert(elapsed >= 38 && elapsed < 200);
}
"""
```

```py
cpp=r'''
#include <algorithm>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <ranges>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>
using DAddr = std::uint64_t;
using ImageId = int;
using ImageMapId = int;
namespace boost::container {
template<class T,std::size_t N> using small_vector = std::vector<T>;
}
enum class ImageFlagBits : unsigned { Remapped=1u, CpuModified=2u, IsDecoding=4u };
constexpr unsigned operator|(ImageFlagBits a,ImageFlagBits b) {
    return static_cast<unsigned>(a)|static_cast<unsigned>(b);
}
constexpr unsigned operator&(unsigned a,ImageFlagBits b) {
    return a&static_cast<unsigned>(b);
}
bool True(unsigned flags) { return flags != 0; }
struct ImageMapView { int image_id{}; };
struct ImageBase {
    DAddr cpu_addr{};
    unsigned flags{};
    std::vector<int> image_view_ids;
    std::uint64_t modification_tick{};
};
struct Selector {
    std::unordered_map<int,ImageMapView> slot_map_views;
    std::unordered_map<int,ImageBase> slot_images;
    std::vector<ImageMapId> image_map_ids;
    std::vector<ImageId> Run(DAddr cpu_addr) {
        const auto& image_map_ids = this->image_map_ids;
__SOURCE_DECLARE__
__SOURCE_LOOP__
        auto GetImageViewForFramebuffer = [](ImageId id) {
            return std::vector<ImageId>{id};
        };
__SOURCE_SELECT__
    }
};
int main() {
    Selector c;
    constexpr DAddr guest = 0x9000;
    for(int i=1;i<=8;++i) {
        c.slot_map_views[i]={i};
        c.slot_images[i]={guest,0,{i},static_cast<std::uint64_t>(i)};
        c.image_map_ids.push_back(i);
    }
    c.slot_images[8].cpu_addr=guest+4096;
    c.slot_images[2].flags=static_cast<unsigned>(ImageFlagBits::CpuModified);
    c.slot_images[3].flags=static_cast<unsigned>(ImageFlagBits::Remapped);
    c.slot_images[4].image_view_ids.clear();
    c.slot_images[7].flags=ImageFlagBits::Remapped|ImageFlagBits::CpuModified;
    c.slot_images[6].flags=static_cast<unsigned>(ImageFlagBits::IsDecoding);
    // A clean candidate precedes a decoding view: do NOT present it.
    assert(c.Run(guest).empty());
    c.image_map_ids={6,1,2,3,4,5,7,8};
    assert(c.Run(guest).empty());
    c.image_map_ids={1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8};
    // No decode: a clean sibling still must NOT hide a CPU-dirty image.
    c.slot_images[6].flags=static_cast<unsigned>(ImageFlagBits::CpuModified);
    assert(c.Run(guest).empty());
    // A remapped sibling also makes otherwise clean accelerator views stale.
    c.slot_images[6].flags=0;
    c.slot_images[1].flags=static_cast<unsigned>(ImageFlagBits::Remapped);
    assert(c.Run(guest).empty());
    c.slot_images[5].flags=static_cast<unsigned>(ImageFlagBits::CpuModified);
    assert(c.Run(guest).empty());
    c.slot_images[2].flags=0;
    c.slot_images[3].flags=0;
    assert(c.Run(guest).empty());
    // Once all dirty/remapped siblings are refreshed, direct present returns.
    c.slot_images[1].flags=0;
    c.slot_images[5].flags=0;
    c.slot_images[7].flags=0;
    assert((c.Run(guest)==std::vector<int>{7}));
    // A dirty sibling without a view still invalidates the address.
    c.slot_images[4].flags=static_cast<unsigned>(ImageFlagBits::CpuModified);
    assert(c.Run(guest).empty());
    c.slot_images[4].flags=0;
    assert((c.Run(guest)==std::vector<int>{7}));
    // First equal-tick candidate wins, just like the original max_element.
    c.slot_images[2].modification_tick=100;
    c.slot_images[3].modification_tick=100;
    c.image_map_ids={2,3};
    assert((c.Run(guest)==std::vector<int>{2}));
    c.image_map_ids={3,2};
    assert((c.Run(guest)==std::vector<int>{3}));
    // More than the old inline capacity: bounded O(1) selection state.
    c.image_map_ids={1,2,3,4,5,6,7};
    for(int i=1;i<=7;++i) {
        c.slot_images[i].flags=0;
        c.slot_images[i].image_view_ids={i};
        c.slot_images[i].modification_tick=i;
    }
    assert((c.Run(guest)==std::vector<int>{7}));
    for(int i=1;i<=7;++i) c.slot_images[i].cpu_addr=guest+1;
    assert(c.Run(guest).empty());
}
'''.replace("__SOURCE_DECLARE__", declaration).replace("__SOURCE_LOOP__", loop).replace("__SOURCE_SELECT__", selection)

# Restore only the old sibling policy for a controlled failure-before witness.
unsafe_loop = loop.replace(
    "if (True(image.flags & (ImageFlagBits::Remapped | ImageFlagBits::CpuModified))) {\n"
    "            return {};",
    "if (True(image.flags & (ImageFlagBits::Remapped | ImageFlagBits::CpuModified))) {\n"
    "            continue;",
)
assert unsafe_loop != loop

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-f07-present-fresh-") as d:
    src=Path(d)/"fresh.cpp"
    for optimization in ("-O0","-O2"):
        for label, source_loop, should_pass in (
            ("repaired", loop, True),
            ("old_alias_policy", unsafe_loop, False),
        ):
            src.write_text(cpp.replace(loop,source_loop,1))
            out=Path(d)/(optimization + label)
            subprocess.run(["c++","-std=c++20",optimization,"-DPS5_NATIVE",
                            "-Wall","-Wextra","-Werror",str(src),"-o",str(out)],
                           check=True,timeout=60)
            run=subprocess.run([str(out)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15)
            if should_pass:
                assert run.returncode == 0,(optimization,label,run.stderr)
                print("F07_PRESENT_FRAMEBUFFER_FRESHNESS_PASS",optimization)
            else:
                assert run.returncode != 0,(optimization,label,"old policy unexpectedly passed")
                print("F07_PRESENT_STALE_SIBLING_OLD_EXPECTED_FAIL_PASS",optimization)
```

`tools/check-ps5-present-header-contract.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Verify the selected native PresentManager ABI against the pinned Vulkan owner.

Runs before toolchain installation: a real source-header ownership check, not
a replacement for C++ syntax, linking or execution on PS5.
"""
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
native_header = (root / "headless/vk_present_manager_r08.h").read_text()
owner_header = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/include/"
                "video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_present_manager.h").read_text()
owner_cpp = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/"
             "vulkan_present_manager.cpp").read_text()

# Only compare the shared worker state; Encore legitimately extends the
# public class with non-blocking frame-generation reservation methods.
fields = (
    "std::condition_variable_any frame_cv;",
    "std::condition_variable_any present_ready_cv;",
    "std::condition_variable free_cv;",
    "std::mutex swapchain_mutex;",
    "std::mutex queue_mutex;",
    "std::mutex free_mutex;",
    "std::size_t free_waiters{};",
    "bool present_in_flight{};",
    "std::size_t present_waiters{};",
    "std::exception_ptr present_failure;",
    "std::jthread present_thread;",
)
def statements(text):
    return [line.split("//", 1)[0].strip() for line in text.splitlines()]
for label, text in (("native header", native_header),
                    ("pinned owner header", owner_header)):
    selected = statements(text)
    indexes = []
    for field in fields:
        assert selected.count(field) == 1, f"{label}: missing or duplicated {field}"
        indexes.append(selected.index(field))
    assert indexes == sorted(indexes), f"{label}: synchronization state order drift"

required_source = (
    "++free_waiters;", "--free_waiters;",
    "++present_waiters;", "--present_waiters;",
    "present_ready_cv.notify_one();",
    "present_ready_cv.wait(lock, token,",
    "free_cv.wait(lock,", "frame_cv.wait(queue_lock,",
    "wake_free_waiter = free_waiters != 0;",
    "notify_drainers = present_waiters != 0 && present_queue.empty();",
)
for clause in required_source:
    assert clause in owner_cpp, f"Pinned presenter changed: {clause}"
assert "Frame* TryReserveRenderFrame()" in native_header
assert "void CancelReservedRenderFrame(Frame* frame)" in native_header
assert "void ConfirmReservedRenderFrame(Frame* frame)" in native_header
print("PS5_PRESENT_HEADER_OWNER_PARITY_PASS")
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""The first generated quad-index LUT needs no fence for an absent old VkBuffer."""
from pathlib import Path
import ast
import shutil
import subprocess

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

wrapper = (root / "vendor/sources/eden/src/video_core/vulkan_common/vulkan_wrapper.h").read_text()
workflow = (root / ".github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml").read_text()

    "num_indices = num_indices_;")

assert "buffer = memory_allocator.CreateBuffer(" in method

assert "const bool host_visible = buffer.IsHostVisible();" in method

# Confirm the guarded form is exactly an adapter applied after the existing
# VulkanTimer(7) instrumentation (unchanged exact upstream wait-site count).
gen=ast.parse(oracle)
# Locate the dict by its stable Vulkan source key, not the variable name
# used for the generator's performance probes.
# Another independently-owned deferred-copy dictionary now contains the
# same file key. Resolve the source-rewrite table by the actual LUT-fence
# invariant, rather than incorrectly requiring that file key to be unique.
tables=[node for node in ast.walk(gen) if isinstance(node,ast.Dict)
        and any(isinstance(key,ast.Constant) and key.value=="vk_buffer_cache"
                for key in node.keys)]
guard_tables=[]
for table in tables:
    entry=next(v for k,v in zip(table.keys,table.values)
               if isinstance(k,ast.Constant) and k.value=="vk_buffer_cache")
    pairs=[ast.literal_eval(n) for n in entry.elts
           if isinstance(n,ast.Tuple) and len(n.elts)==2]
    matching=[(before,after) for before,after in pairs if "very first LUT" in after]
    if matching:
        guard_tables.append(matching)
assert len(guard_tables)==1
guarded=guard_tables[0]
assert len(guarded)==1
before,after=guarded[0]
assert before.count("scheduler.Finish();")==after.count("scheduler.Finish();")==1
assert before in cost.replace(after,before)
assert after in cost
assert "('vk_buffer_cache', 7, 3)" in oracle

# Reuse the source EXACT guard in an independent host fixture. No GPU is
# needed to prove an absent VkBuffer requires no lifetime fence.
guard=after[after.index("        if (buffer) {"):after.index("\n\n        num_indices",after.index("        if (buffer) {"))]
cpp=r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
using u32=std::uint32_t;
namespace Eden::Performance {
struct VulkanTimer {explicit VulkanTimer(int) {} ~VulkanTimer() {}};
}
struct Scheduler {
    unsigned finishes=0;
    void Finish() {++finishes;}
};
struct Buffer {
    bool valid=false;
    explicit operator bool() const noexcept {return valid;}
};
struct LUT {
    Buffer buffer{};
    u32 num_indices=0;
    Scheduler& scheduler;
    void UpdateBuffer(u32 num_indices_) {
        if (num_indices_ <= num_indices) return;
__GUARD__
        num_indices=num_indices_;
        buffer.valid=true; // the newly created VkBuffer
    }
};
int main() {
    Scheduler scheduler;
    LUT lut{{},0,scheduler};
    lut.UpdateBuffer(16);
    assert(scheduler.finishes==0 && lut.num_indices==16);
    lut.UpdateBuffer(8);
    assert(scheduler.finishes==0 && lut.num_indices==16);
    lut.UpdateBuffer(32);
    assert(scheduler.finishes==1 && lut.num_indices==32);
    lut.UpdateBuffer(32);
    assert(scheduler.finishes==1);
    LUT second{{},0,scheduler};
    second.UpdateBuffer(128);
    assert(scheduler.finishes==1);
    second.UpdateBuffer(256);
    assert(scheduler.finishes==2);
}
""".replace("__GUARD__",guard)
cc=shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++")
assert cc, "Clang is required"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-quad-lut-fence-") as temp:
    src=Path(temp)/"case.cpp";binary=Path(temp)/"case"
    src.write_text(cpp)
    subprocess.run([cc,"-std=c++20","-O2","-Wall","-Wextra","-Werror",
                    "-fsanitize=address,undefined","-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
                    str(src),"-o",str(binary)],check=True,timeout=45)
    subprocess.run([str(binary)],check=True,timeout=30)
print("QUAD_INDEX_INITIAL_FENCE_HOST_PASS first_no_wait=2 resize_wait=2 stable_no_wait=2")
```
