```py
# Runtime toggle oracle: quiet -> first detailed window cannot emit an
# old-session worker delta; later detailed windows use the new baseline.
def windows(modes, values):
    previous = None
    valid = False
    outcomes = []
    for detail, current in zip(modes, values):
        if not detail:
            valid = False
            outcomes.append(None)
            continue
        outcomes.append(current - previous if valid else None)
        previous = current
        valid = True
    return outcomes
assert windows([False, True, True, False, True, True],
               [20, 25, 30, 150, 400, 405]) == [None, None, 5, None, None, 5]
# Even if the logger ends a five-second interval enabled, an OFF->ON
# transition inside it invalidates worker-counter attribution.
def windows_with_generation(modes, generations, values):
    prev = None
    was_detailed = False
    prev_generation = None
    outcomes = []
    for detailed, gen, now in zip(modes, generations, values):
        outcomes.append(now - prev if detailed and was_detailed and
                        gen == prev_generation else None)
        was_detailed = detailed
        if detailed:
            prev, prev_generation = now, gen
    return outcomes
assert windows_with_generation([True, True, True, True],
                               [0, 0, 2, 2], [100, 110, 300, 315]) == [None, 10, None, 15]
assert windows_with_generation([False, True, True, False, True],
                               [0, 1, 1, 2, 3], [10, 20, 24, 30, 40]) == [None, None, 4, None, None]

assert compiler
harness = r"""
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdio>
#include "present_interval_witness.h"
using Witness = Eden::FrameDiagnostics::PresentIntervalWitness<24>;
using Counts = Witness::Counts;
int main() {
    Witness witness{};
    Counts first{};
    witness.Observe(first, 0, 100);
    assert(witness.seeded && !witness.captured);
    Counts a = first;
    a[11] = 250000000; a[16] = 160; a[2] = 1000000;
    witness.Observe(a, 120.0, 101);
    assert(witness.captured && witness.peak_frame == 101);
    assert(witness.peak_delta[11] == 250000000 && witness.peak_delta[16] == 160);
    Counts b = a;
    b[11] += 100000000; b[16] += 60; b[2] += 4000000;
    witness.Observe(b, 111.0, 102);
    assert(witness.peak_frame == 101);
    Counts c = b;
    c[11] += 500000000; c[16] += 230; c[2] += 20000000;
    witness.Observe(c, 205.0, 103);
    assert(witness.peak_frame == 103 && witness.peak_delta[11] == 500000000);
    assert(witness.peak_delta[2] == 20000000);
    witness.NextWindow();
    assert(!witness.captured && witness.seeded);
    Counts d = c;
    d[11] += 999;
    witness.Observe(d, 99.9, 104);
    assert(!witness.captured);
    witness.Observe(first, 250.0, 105); // counter reset is not a negative delta
    assert(!witness.captured);
    witness.Observe(a, 125.0, 106);
    assert(witness.captured && witness.peak_delta[11] == 250000000);
    witness.Reset(); // profiling disabled at runtime
    assert(!witness.seeded && !witness.captured);
    witness.Observe(c, 400.0, 107); // no stale quiet-session baseline
    assert(!witness.captured);
    // Model the exact source gate: one reset on the transition to quiet,
    // none for subsequent quiet frames, and a fresh baseline on re-enable.
    unsigned quiet_resets = 0;
    const auto update = [&](bool enabled, const Counts& snapshot, double ms, unsigned frame) {
        if (enabled) witness.Observe(snapshot, ms, frame);
        else if (witness.seeded) {
            witness.Reset();
            ++quiet_resets;
        }
    };
    update(false, c, 0.0, 108);
    for (unsigned frame = 109; frame < 1009; ++frame)
        update(false, c, 0.0, frame);
    assert(quiet_resets == 1 && !witness.seeded);
    update(true, c, 200.0, 1009);
    assert(witness.seeded && !witness.captured);
    update(true, first, 120.0, 1010); // reset counters cannot create a false peak
    assert(!witness.captured);
    update(false, d, 0.0, 1011);
    update(false, d, 0.0, 1012);
    assert(quiet_resets == 2 && !witness.seeded);
    std::puts("PASS: passive native present-interval witness");
}
"""

    source.write_text(harness)
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
"""R301: execute the actual PS5-generated A32/A64 Dynarmic Run wrapper.

In quiet mode the wrapper must not evaluate GetPC/GetFpcr/Regs/Fpscr or
GetSvcNumber just to call a profiler which would immediately return.
The guest Run, CPU phase transitions and result translation must remain.
This is a C++20 host mock, NOT PS5 firmware or gameplay qualification.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

assert 'list(APPEND core_sources "${EDEN_G11_SOURCE}")' in cmake
assert 'string(REPLACE "    return TranslateHaltReason(m_jit->Run());"' not in cmake
assert "EDEN_G11_PROFILE" in cmake

def generated(bits: int) -> str:
    owned = root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/core/arm/dynarmic/g11"
    host_unit = (owned/f"arm_dynarmic_{bits}_host_dev.cpp").read_text()
    native_unit = (owned/f"arm_dynarmic_{bits}_native_dev.cpp").read_text()
    signature = f"HaltReason ArmDynarmic{bits}::RunThread(Kernel::KThread* thread) {{"
    def body(unit: str) -> str:
        assert unit.count(signature) == 1
        start = unit.index(signature) + len(signature)
        finish = unit.index("\n}", start)
        inner = unit[start:finish]
        assert inner.count("m_jit->ClearExclusiveState();") == 1
        return inner.split("m_jit->ClearExclusiveState();", 1)[1].lstrip("\n") + "\n"
    selected = body(host_unit)
    assert selected == body(native_unit), ("DEV JIT CPU sampling platform drift", bits)
    for token in ("const bool eden_detailed_cpu_sample =",
                  "cpu_state[m_core_index].phase.store(",
                  "return TranslateHaltReason(halt);"):
        assert token in selected
    assert selected.count("::Eden::Performance::SampleCpu(") == 2
    assert selected.count("m_jit->Run()") == 1
    assert selected.count("if (eden_detailed_cpu_sample &&") == 2
    return selected

    int run_calls=0, guest_phase_observed=0;

    int Run() {
        ++run_calls;
        if (Eden::Performance::cpu_state[0].phase.load() ==
            Eden::Performance::CpuPhase::Guest) ++guest_phase_observed;

A64_CODE
    }

A32_CODE
    }

    assert(fixture.jit.guest_phase_observed == 40000);
    assert(fixture.jit.get_pc == 0 && fixture.jit.get_fpcr == 0);
    assert(fixture.jit.regs_calls == 0 && fixture.jit.fpscr_calls == 0);
    assert(fixture.svc_calls == 0 && Eden::Performance::samples == 0);
    assert(Eden::Performance::due_checks == 0 && Kernel::lookups == 0);
    assert(Eden::Performance::cpu_state[0].phase.load() ==
           Eden::Performance::CpuPhase::Kernel);
    Eden::Performance::detailed_gpu_profile.store(true);
    assert(fixture.Run64()==77 && fixture.Run32()==77);
    assert(fixture.jit.get_pc == 2 && fixture.jit.get_fpcr == 2);
    assert(fixture.jit.regs_calls == 2 && fixture.jit.fpscr_calls == 2);
    assert(fixture.svc_calls == 4 && Eden::Performance::samples == 4);
    assert(Eden::Performance::due_checks == 4 && Kernel::lookups == 4);
    assert(Eden::Performance::last_thread == 789);
    Eden::Performance::sample_allowed.store(false);
    assert(fixture.Run64()==77 && fixture.Run32()==77);
    assert(Eden::Performance::due_checks == 8 && Kernel::lookups == 4);
    assert(fixture.svc_calls == 4 && Eden::Performance::samples == 4);
    Eden::Performance::detailed_gpu_profile.store(false);
    assert(fixture.Run64()==77 && fixture.Run32()==77);
    assert(fixture.jit.get_pc == 2 && fixture.jit.get_fpcr == 2);
    assert(fixture.jit.regs_calls == 2 && fixture.jit.fpscr_calls == 2);
```

```py
    struct {unsigned processor_id=2;} conf;
INJECT

        assert(eden_compile_timer.start!=std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point{});
```

`tools/check-ps5-radv-kick-coalescing.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Host stress for the real PS5 RADV AGC kick/submit code, no PS5 SDK required.

R396: submitters must not take a mutex or signal a condition for every DCB
when a kick is already pending. This test extracts the actual compiled native
functions rather than testing a separate hand-written algorithm.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SRC = ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/ps5-mesa/src/amd/vulkan/winsys/ps5/radv_ps5_platform.c"
GENERATOR = ROOT / "tools/patch-radv-wsi.py"
source = SRC.read_text()
generator = GENERATOR.read_text()
assert "#include <stdatomic.h>" in source
assert "static atomic_bool radv_ps5_kick_pending = ATOMIC_VAR_INIT(false);" in source
assert "atomic_exchange_explicit(&radv_ps5_kick_pending, true, memory_order_acq_rel)" in source
assert "atomic_load_explicit(&radv_ps5_kick_pending, memory_order_acquire)" in source
assert "atomic_store_explicit(&radv_ps5_kick_pending, false, memory_order_release)" in source
assert "p_atomic_add(&radv_ps5_submit_ns[0], flushed - started);" in source
assert "p_atomic_add(&radv_ps5_submit_ns[1], submitted - flushed);" in source
assert "radv_ps5_submit_ns[0] +=" not in source
assert "radv_ps5_submit_ns[1] +=" not in source
assert "atomic_exchange_explicit(&radv_ps5_kick_pending" in generator
# No speculative batching of DCBs or GPU fences: this only coalesces redundant
# userspace mutex/condition wakeups, not any actual driver command submissions.
assert source.count("sceAgcDriverSubmitDcb(&description)") == 1
assert source.count("sceAgcSuspendPoint()") == 1
start = source.index("static uint64_t radv_ps5_submit_ns[3];")
stop = source.index("\nvoid\nradv_ps5_submit_times(", start)
native = source[start:stop]
assert native.count("radv_ps5_submit(") == 1

host = r"""
#define _POSIX_C_SOURCE 200809L
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <threads.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

struct ps5_agc_submit_description {
    uint32_t *words;
    uint32_t word_count;
};
static atomic_ullong posted = ATOMIC_VAR_INIT(0);
static atomic_ullong visible = ATOMIC_VAR_INIT(0);
static atomic_uint kicks = ATOMIC_VAR_INIT(0);
static uint64_t os_time_get_nano(void) {
    struct timespec now;
    assert(clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &now) == 0);
    return (uint64_t)now.tv_sec * 1000000000ull + (uint64_t)now.tv_nsec;
}
#define p_atomic_add(p, n) ((void)__atomic_fetch_add((p), (n), __ATOMIC_RELAXED))
static void radv_ps5_cpu_flush(const void *address, size_t bytes) {
    (void)address; (void)bytes;
}
static int32_t sceAgcDriverSubmitDcb(
    const struct ps5_agc_submit_description *description) {
    assert(description && description->words && description->word_count == 4);
    atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&posted, 1, memory_order_release);
    return 0;
}
static int32_t sceAgcSuspendPoint(void) {
    // A kick makes every DCB submitted before this point visible.
    atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&kicks, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
    atomic_store_explicit(&visible, atomic_load_explicit(&posted, memory_order_acquire),
                          memory_order_release);
    const struct timespec delay = {0, 150000};
    thrd_sleep(&delay, NULL);
    return 0;
}
""" + native + r"""
static int producer(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    uint32_t commands[4] = {1, 2, 3, 4};
    for (int i=0; i<3000; ++i)
        assert(radv_ps5_submit(commands, 4, NULL, 0) == 0);
    return 0;
}
static void drain_accepted(void) {
    for (unsigned i=0; i<3000; ++i) {
        if (atomic_load_explicit(&visible, memory_order_acquire) ==
            atomic_load_explicit(&posted, memory_order_acquire)) return;
        const struct timespec delay={0, 1000000};
        thrd_sleep(&delay,NULL);
    }
    fprintf(stderr,"kick liveness failed: visible=%llu submitted=%llu\n",
        (unsigned long long)atomic_load(&visible),
        (unsigned long long)atomic_load(&posted));
    abort();
}
int main(void) {
    thrd_t producers[4];
    for (int i=0; i<4; ++i)
        assert(thrd_create(&producers[i], producer, NULL) == thrd_success);
    for (int i=0; i<4; ++i) {
        int code=-1;
        assert(thrd_join(producers[i], &code) == thrd_success);
        assert(code == 0);
    }
    drain_accepted();
    const unsigned kicks_first=atomic_load(&kicks);
    assert(atomic_load(&posted) == 12000);
    assert(kicks_first != 0 && kicks_first < 3000);
    // A submit after the previous request has drained MUST get a new kick.
    // An atomic coalescing implementation with a missed wake fails here.
    const struct timespec delay={0,20000000};
    thrd_sleep(&delay,NULL);
    assert(radv_ps5_submit((uint32_t[4]){1,2,3,4},4,NULL,0)==0);
    drain_accepted();
    assert(atomic_load(&posted)==12001 && atomic_load(&visible)==12001);
    assert(atomic_load(&kicks)>kicks_first);
    puts("PASS PS5 RADV actual kick source: 12K parallel DCBs, coalesced wakeups, idle-to-active liveness");
    return 0;
}
"""

compiler = shutil.which("clang-18") or shutil.which("clang") or shutil.which("cc")
assert compiler, "C11 compiler unavailable"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-r396-radv-kick-") as directory:
    work = Path(directory)
    (work / "kick.c").write_text(host)
    binary = work / "kick"
    subprocess.run([compiler, "-std=c11", "-O1", "-Wall", "-Wextra",
                    "-Werror", "-pthread", "-fsanitize=address,undefined",
                    str(work / "kick.c"), "-o", str(binary)], check=True, timeout=30)
    subprocess.run([str(binary)], check=True, timeout=30)
```

```py
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
struct Prefs { bool detailed_logging{}; };
namespace Eden::Performance {
inline std::atomic<bool> detailed_gpu_profile{false};
inline unsigned resets{};
inline unsigned sampled_draws{};
void ResetCachePhases() {
    ++resets;
    sampled_draws = 0;
}
bool SampleDraw() {
    if (!detailed_gpu_profile.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) return false;
    return (++sampled_draws & 15u) == 0u;
}
}
void StartGame(Prefs launch_preferences) {
""" + body + r"""
}
int main() {
    StartGame({false});
    assert(!Eden::Performance::detailed_gpu_profile.load());
    for (int i = 0; i < 32; ++i) assert(!Eden::Performance::SampleDraw());
    assert(Eden::Performance::sampled_draws == 0);
    StartGame({true});
    assert(Eden::Performance::detailed_gpu_profile.load());
    for (int i = 0; i < 15; ++i) assert(!Eden::Performance::SampleDraw());
    assert(Eden::Performance::SampleDraw());
    assert(Eden::Performance::sampled_draws == 16);
    // Another game title without detailed logs MUST not inherit last game's
    // profiling or counters; no duplicate launcher build is needed.
    StartGame({false});
    assert(!Eden::Performance::detailed_gpu_profile.load());
    assert(Eden::Performance::sampled_draws == 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < 32; ++i) assert(!Eden::Performance::SampleDraw());
    assert(Eden::Performance::resets == 3);
}
"""
```

`tools/check-ps5-remapped-texture-view-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""F03/F04 source-extracted TIC view remap recovery without stale textures.

The live cached TIC may point at a view whose ImageBase is Remapped. Exercise
normal reuse, remap/recreation, missing backing, new descriptor, buffer views
and per-slot mapping reconstruction. This is not a full PS5 GPU driver test.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
p = "src/video_core/texture_cache/texture_cache.h"
shipping = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-backports" / p).read_text()
native = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan-cache/video_core/texture_cache/texture_cache.h").read_text()
installer = (root / "tools/apply-eden-backports.sh").read_text()

    return text[start:text.index("\ntemplate <class P>", start)]

shipping_method = method(shipping)
native_method = method(native)

    stage = Path(td)
    target = stage / p
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
    target.write_text(shipping)

    # Reverse the last layer first, then replay the full native stack.
    for args in (["git","apply","--reverse","--check",str(slot_patch)],
                 ["git","apply","--reverse",str(slot_patch)],

                                text=True, timeout=18)
        assert result.returncode == 0, (args, result.stderr[-3000:])
    assert target.read_text() == shipping, "remap patch does not roundtrip"

prologue = r"""
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <utility>
// The source-extracted function retains the production invalid-index trace.
#define LOG_DEBUG(...) ((void)0)
#define HW_GPU 0
using u32=std::uint32_t;
using ImageViewId=u32;
constexpr ImageViewId NULL_IMAGE_VIEW_ID=0;
namespace Common {
struct SlotId {static constexpr u32 TAGGED_VALUE = 0x80000000U;};
}
enum class ImageFlagBits : u32 { Remapped=1 };
struct ImageFlags {bool remapped{};};
bool operator&(const ImageFlags& flags,ImageFlagBits) {return flags.remapped;}
bool True(bool yes) {return yes;}
struct ImageBase {ImageFlags flags{};};
struct ImageViewBase {
    u32 image_id{};
    bool buffer{};
    bool IsBuffer() const {return buffer;}
};
struct FakeMemory {bool valid=true;};
bool IsValidEntry(const FakeMemory& m,int) {return m.valid;}
struct DescriptorTable {
    u32 current_limit=128;
    int descriptor=17;
    bool is_new=true;
    std::pair<int,bool> Read(FakeMemory&,u32) const {return {descriptor,is_new};}
};
struct ChannelState {
    DescriptorTable graphics_image_table{};
    DescriptorTable compute_image_table{};
    std::unordered_map<int,ImageViewId> image_views;
    std::unordered_map<u32,ImageViewId> image_view_ids;
};
template<class P>struct TextureCache {
    FakeMemory mem{};
    FakeMemory* gpu_memory=&mem;
    ChannelState channel{};
    ChannelState* channel_state=&channel;
    std::array<ImageViewBase,40> slot_image_views{};
    std::array<ImageBase,40> slot_images{};
    u32 texture_bindings_serial{};
    int created{};
    int prepared{};
    int prepared_remapped{};
    ImageViewId CreateImageView(int descriptor) {
        const auto id = static_cast<ImageViewId>(++created);
        assert(id<slot_image_views.size());
        slot_image_views[id] = {.image_id=id,.buffer=descriptor==11};
        return id;
    }
    void PrepareImageView(ImageViewId id,bool,bool) {
        if (!id) return;
        ++prepared;
        if (slot_images[slot_image_views[id].image_id].flags.remapped)
            ++prepared_remapped;
    }
    ImageViewId VisitImageView(u32,bool);
};
"""
epilogue = r"""
int main() {
    TextureCache<int> tc;
    auto& table=tc.channel.graphics_image_table;
    const u32 slot=2;
    const auto first=tc.VisitImageView(slot,false);
    assert(first==1 && tc.created==1 && tc.prepared==1);
    table.is_new=false;
    assert(tc.VisitImageView(slot,false)==first);
    assert(tc.created==1 && tc.prepared==2);
    assert(tc.texture_bindings_serial==0);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    // Guest remapping changes image backing, NOT the TIC bytes.
    tc.slot_images[first].flags.remapped=true;
    const auto second=tc.VisitImageView(slot,false);
    assert(second==2 && tc.created==2 && tc.prepared_remapped==0);
    assert(tc.texture_bindings_serial==1);
    assert(tc.VisitImageView(slot,false)==second && tc.created==2);
    // Remap again, but residency has not returned: invalidate the old ID.
    tc.slot_images[second].flags.remapped=true;
    tc.mem.valid=false;
    const auto prepared=tc.prepared;
    const auto serial=tc.texture_bindings_serial;
    assert(tc.VisitImageView(slot,false)==NULL_IMAGE_VIEW_ID);
    assert(tc.prepared==prepared && tc.created==2);
    assert(tc.texture_bindings_serial==serial+1);
    tc.mem.valid=true;
    const auto third=tc.VisitImageView(slot,false);
    assert(third==3 && tc.created==3 && tc.prepared_remapped==0);
    // Descriptor gets invalidated and re-read but has unchanged bytes;
    // the shared descriptor-to-view mapping must reject the remapped ID.
    tc.slot_images[third].flags.remapped=true;
    table.is_new=true;
    const auto fourth=tc.VisitImageView(slot,false);
    assert(fourth==4 && tc.created==4 && tc.prepared_remapped==0);
    table.is_new=false;
    assert(tc.VisitImageView(slot,false)==fourth && tc.created==4);
    // Invalidated per-slot entry must be reconstructed without .end() UB.
    tc.channel.image_view_ids.erase(slot);
    assert(tc.VisitImageView(slot,false)==fourth);
    // Buffer texture views have no ImageBase dependency.
    table.descriptor=11;
    table.is_new=true;
    const auto buffer=tc.VisitImageView(slot,false);
    assert(buffer==5);
    tc.slot_images[buffer].flags.remapped=true;
    table.is_new=false;
    assert(tc.VisitImageView(slot,false)==buffer && tc.created==5);
    // Recovery of a NULL view is also required without a TIC rewrite.
    tc.channel.image_view_ids[slot]=NULL_IMAGE_VIEW_ID;
    assert(tc.VisitImageView(slot,false)==buffer && tc.created==5);
#else
    // The non-native upstream path is deliberately unchanged.
    tc.slot_images[first].flags.remapped=true;
    assert(tc.VisitImageView(slot,false)==first);
#endif
}
"""
compilers=list(dict.fromkeys(filter(None,(
    shutil.which("clang++"),shutil.which("g++"),shutil.which("c++")))))
assert compilers, "C++20 compiler required"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-view-remap-host-") as td:
    cpp=Path(td)/"view.cpp"
    # The shipping implementation also runs on PS5 and must tolerate
    # missing per-channel slots, not only the native Vulkan overlay.
    for owner, selected_method in (("shipping",shipping_method),("native",native_method)):
        cpp.write_text(prologue + "\ntemplate<class P>\n" + selected_method + epilogue)
        for compiler in compilers:
            for opt in ("-O0","-O2"):
                for label, flags in (("ps5",["-DPS5_NATIVE"]),("upstream",[])):
                    exe=Path(td)/(Path(compiler).name+opt+label+owner)
                    built=subprocess.run(
                        [compiler,"-std=c++20",opt,"-Wall","-Wextra","-Werror",
                         "-fsanitize=undefined","-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
                         *flags,str(cpp),"-o",str(exe)],
                        text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=60)
                    assert built.returncode==0,(compiler,opt,label,owner,built.stderr[-5000:])
                    ran=subprocess.run([str(exe)],text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=20)
                    assert ran.returncode==0,(compiler,opt,label,owner,ran.stderr[-5000:])
                    print("ENCORE_REMAP_TIC_VIEW_PASS",owner,Path(compiler).name,opt,label)
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""R382: source-extracted scheduler command capacity preflight and lock-order test."""
from pathlib import Path
import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
header=(root/'vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/include/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_scheduler.h').read_text()
raster=(root/'vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_rasterizer.cpp').read_text()
generator=(root/'tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py').read_text()
a=header.index('    bool PreflightDrawCommands() {')
b=header.index('\n    }\n#endif',a)+len('\n    }')
preflight=header[a:b]
a=header.index('        bool HasReserve(size_t bytes) const noexcept {')
b=header.index('\n        }\n#endif',a)+len('\n        }')
capacity=header[a:b]
assert preflight.count('DispatchWork();')==1
assert 'constexpr size_t kDrawCommandReserve = 4096;' in preflight
assert 'chunk->Empty()' in preflight and 'chunk->HasReserve(kDrawCommandReserve)' in preflight
assert 'alignof(std::max_align_t)' in capacity
assert 'command_offset <= data.size() - needed' in capacity
assert 'RecordWithUploadBuffer' in header and 'DispatchWork();' in header
assert 'PreflightDrawCommands' in generator
assert raster.count('scheduler.PreflightDrawCommands() &&') == 2
assert raster.count('scheduler_preflight_dispatches.fetch_add(')==2
assert 'detailed_gpu_profile.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)' in raster

performance=(root/'headless/performance.cpp').read_text()
assert r'EDEN_SCHEDULER_PREFLIGHT frame=%u dispatched=%llu\n' in performance
assert r'EDEN_SCHEDULER_PREFLIGHT frame=%u dispatched=%llu\\n' not in performance
assert 'scheduler_preflight_dispatches.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)' in performance
assert 'scheduler_preflight_dispatches{0};' in (root/'headless/performance.h').read_text()
assert raster.index('scheduler.PreflightDrawCommands() &&') < raster.index('std::scoped_lock lock{buffer_cache.mutex, texture_cache.mutex};')
block=raster[raster.index('void RasterizerVulkan::DispatchCompute() {'):]
assert block.index('scheduler.PreflightDrawCommands() &&') < block.index('std::scoped_lock lock{texture_cache.mutex, buffer_cache.mutex};')
assert raster.index('scheduler.PreflightDrawCommands() &&') < raster.index('gpu_memory->FlushCaching();')
assert block.index('scheduler.PreflightDrawCommands() &&') < block.index('gpu_memory->FlushCaching();')
code=r"""
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <memory>
class Scheduler {
public:
    class CommandChunk {
    public:
        std::size_t command_offset{};
        std::array<std::uint8_t,0x8000> data{};
        bool Empty() const {return command_offset==0;}
__HAS_RESERVE__
    };
    std::unique_ptr<CommandChunk> chunk{std::make_unique<CommandChunk>()};
    unsigned sent{};
    unsigned fence_waits{};
    void DispatchWork() {
        assert(!chunk->Empty());
        ++sent;
        chunk=std::make_unique<CommandChunk>();
    }
__PREFLIGHT__
};
int main() {
    Scheduler scheduler;
    assert(!scheduler.PreflightDrawCommands());
    assert(scheduler.sent==0 && scheduler.fence_waits==0);
    scheduler.chunk->command_offset=0x4000;
    assert(!scheduler.PreflightDrawCommands());
    assert(scheduler.sent==0);
    const auto boundary = scheduler.chunk->data.size() - 4096 - alignof(std::max_align_t);
    scheduler.chunk->command_offset=boundary;
    assert(!scheduler.PreflightDrawCommands());
    scheduler.chunk->command_offset=boundary + 1;
    assert(scheduler.PreflightDrawCommands());
    assert(scheduler.sent==1 && scheduler.chunk->Empty());
    assert(scheduler.fence_waits==0);
    assert(!scheduler.PreflightDrawCommands());
    scheduler.chunk->command_offset=0x7000;
    assert(scheduler.PreflightDrawCommands());
    assert(scheduler.sent==2);
    assert(scheduler.chunk->HasReserve(4096));
    assert(!scheduler.chunk->HasReserve(0x8000));
    scheduler.chunk->command_offset=0x7fff;
    assert(!scheduler.chunk->HasReserve(4096));
    assert(scheduler.PreflightDrawCommands());
    assert(scheduler.sent==3 && scheduler.fence_waits==0);
}
""".replace('__HAS_RESERVE__',capacity).replace('__PREFLIGHT__',preflight)
env=os.environ.copy()
if sys.platform=='darwin' and not env.get('SDKROOT'):
    sdk=Path('/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX15.4.sdk')
    if sdk.exists():env['SDKROOT']=str(sdk)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='eden-r382-command-') as td:
    source=Path(td)/'capacity.cpp'
    exe=Path(td)/'capacity'
    source.write_text(code)
    subprocess.run(['c++','-std=c++20','-O1','-Wall','-Wextra','-Werror',
                    '-fsanitize=address,undefined',str(source),'-o',str(exe)],
                   check=True,env=env,timeout=30)
    subprocess.run([str(exe)],check=True,env=env,timeout=15)
print('PASS R382 native scheduler preflight: 4KiB spare boundary, no empty dispatch, no GPU waits, outside cache locks')
```

`tools/check-ps5-scissor-extremes-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compile the selected Vulkan scissor code and reject the old overflow.

Normal viewport/scissor values must match the pinned source, while hostile
guest register extremes must not overflow before Vulkan clipping. This is a
host correctness witness, not a gameplay/FPS benchmark.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
ACTIVE = ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_rasterizer.cpp"
PINNED = ROOT / "vendor/sources/eden/src/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_rasterizer.cpp"


def extract(path: Path) -> str:
    text = path.read_text()
    start_marker = "VkRect2D GetScissorState("
    end_marker = "\nDrawParams MakeDrawParams("
    assert text.count(start_marker) == 1 and text.count(end_marker) == 1
    start = text.index(start_marker)
    end = text.index(end_marker, start)
    return text[start:end].strip()


active = extract(ACTIVE)
pinned = extract(PINNED)
assert active != pinned
assert "static_cast<s64>(src.max_x) - src.min_x" in active
assert "static_cast<s64>(clip_height) - src.max_y" in active
assert "down_shift < 32" in active
assert "bits >> down_shift" in active  # Pinned behavior: unsigned up_scale.
assert "as_i32 >> down_shift" not in active
assert "src.max_x - src.min_x" in pinned

mock = r"""
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <limits>
using s32 = std::int32_t;
using s64 = std::int64_t;
using u32 = std::uint32_t;
struct VkOffset2D { s32 x{}, y{}; };
struct VkExtent2D { u32 width{}, height{}; };
struct VkRect2D { VkOffset2D offset; VkExtent2D extent; };
struct Field {
    s32 value{};
    operator s32() const { return value; }
    s32 Value() const { return value; }
};
struct Maxwell {
    struct WindowOrigin {
        enum class Mode { UpperLeft, LowerLeft };
        Mode mode{Mode::UpperLeft};
    };
    struct Scissor {
        bool enable{true};
        Field min_x, max_x, min_y, max_y;
    };
    std::array<Scissor, 16> scissor_test{};
    WindowOrigin window_origin{};
    struct { s32 height{}; } surface_clip{};
};
"""

checks = r"""
int main() {
    Maxwell m;
    m.surface_clip.height = 1080;
    // Up-scale is unsigned in the pinned expression. A negative coordinate
    // multiplied by it is also unsigned and the shift yields -1 after the
    // existing clamp; a signed shift would silently change guest rendering.
    m.scissor_test[0] = {true, Field{-96}, Field{8}, Field{10}, Field{60}};
    const auto baseline_negative = BaselineScissor(m, 0, 1, 1);
    const auto scaled_negative = GetScissorState(m, 0, 1, 1);
    assert(baseline_negative.offset.x == -1);
    assert(scaled_negative.offset.x == baseline_negative.offset.x);
    for (int x = -96; x < 96; x += 11) {
        for (int y = 0; y < 100; y += 13) {
            for (u32 scale = 1; scale <= 4; ++scale) {
                for (u32 shift = 0; shift <= 2; ++shift) {
                    for (int origin = 0; origin < 2; ++origin) {
                        m.window_origin.mode =
                            origin ? Maxwell::WindowOrigin::Mode::LowerLeft
                                   : Maxwell::WindowOrigin::Mode::UpperLeft;
                        m.scissor_test[0] = {
                            true, Field{x}, Field{x+104}, Field{y}, Field{y+63}
                        };
                        const auto old = BaselineScissor(m, 0, scale, shift);
                        const auto now = GetScissorState(m, 0, scale, shift);
                        assert(old.offset.x == now.offset.x);
                        assert(old.offset.y == now.offset.y);
                        assert(old.extent.width == now.extent.width);
                        assert(old.extent.height == now.extent.height);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    volatile s32 low = std::numeric_limits<s32>::min();
    volatile s32 high = std::numeric_limits<s32>::max();
    m.scissor_test[0] = {
        true, Field{low}, Field{high}, Field{low}, Field{high}
    };
#ifdef NEGATIVE_OLD_SCISSOR
    // Previous source overflows the signed x-coordinate subtraction here.
    (void)BaselineScissor(m, 0, 2, 0);
    std::puts("OLD_SCISSOR_UNEXPECTEDLY_ACCEPTED_OVERFLOW");
#else
    for (u32 scale : {1U, 2U, 3U, 4U, std::numeric_limits<u32>::max()}) {
        for (u32 shift : {0U, 1U, 31U, 32U, 63U, 64U}) {
            for (int origin = 0; origin < 2; ++origin) {
                m.window_origin.mode =
                    origin ? Maxwell::WindowOrigin::Mode::LowerLeft
                           : Maxwell::WindowOrigin::Mode::UpperLeft;
                const auto result = GetScissorState(m, 0, scale, shift);
                assert(result.extent.width <= std::numeric_limits<s32>::max());
            }
        }
    }
    std::puts("PS5_SCISSOR_SOURCE_EXTRACTED_HOST_PASS");
#endif
}
"""

baseline_method = pinned.replace(
    "VkRect2D GetScissorState(", "VkRect2D BaselineScissor(", 1
)
source = mock + baseline_method + "\n\n" + active + "\n\n" + checks
compiler = shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++") or shutil.which("c++")
assert compiler is not None, "C++ compiler unavailable"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-scissor-") as temp:
    cpp = Path(temp) / "scissor.cpp"
    cpp.write_text(source)
    for opt in ("-O0", "-O2"):
        binary = Path(temp) / ("scissor" + opt)
        flags = [
            compiler, "-std=c++20", opt, "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror",
            "-fsanitize=undefined", "-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
        ]
        compile_result = subprocess.run(
            [*flags, str(cpp), "-o", str(binary)],
            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=45
        )
        assert compile_result.returncode == 0, compile_result.stderr[-5000:]
        result = subprocess.run(
            [str(binary)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15
        )
        assert result.returncode == 0, (opt, result.stdout, result.stderr)
        assert "PS5_SCISSOR_SOURCE_EXTRACTED_HOST_PASS" in result.stdout

        previous = Path(temp) / ("old" + opt)
        old_build = subprocess.run(
            [*flags, "-DNEGATIVE_OLD_SCISSOR=1", str(cpp), "-o", str(previous)],
            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=45
        )
        assert old_build.returncode == 0, old_build.stderr[-5000:]
        old = subprocess.run(
            [str(previous)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15
        )
        assert old.returncode != 0 and "signed integer overflow" in old.stderr, (
            "Uncorrected original failed to trigger UBSan", opt,
            old.stdout, old.stderr[-2000:]
        )
        print("PS5_SCISSOR_OVERFLOW_REGRESSION_PASS", opt,
              "normal-parity + extreme-safe + original-UBSan-failure")
```

```py
assert stl.count("WriteLocal(*this,")==4
assert "WriteLocal(*this, ir.IAdd(word_offset, ir.Imm32(i)), offset, X(reg + i)," in stl
assert "ir.IAdd(offset, ir.Imm32(i * 4))" not in stl
assert "ir.WriteLocal(" not in stl and "ir.LoadLocal(" not in stl
assert 'list(REMOVE_ITEM eden_shader_sources "frontend/maxwell/translate/impl/load_store_local_shared.cpp")' in cmake
assert 'list(APPEND eden_shader_sources "' in cmake
assert "check-ps5-shader-local-bounds-host.py" in ci

def method(src):
    first=src.index(marker if src == pinned else "IR::U1 LocalInBounds(")
    return src[first:src.index(end,first)]

template=r"""
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <stdexcept>
using u32=std::uint32_t;
namespace IR {
struct Value32 {
    u32 value{};
    bool immediate{};
    bool IsImmediate() const {return immediate;}
    u32 U32() const {return value;}
};
using U32=Value32;
struct U1 {bool value{};};
struct IREmitter {
    std::array<u32,4> memory{11,22,33,44};
    u32 reads{},writes{},comparisons{},selections{};
    U32 Imm32(u32 n){return {n,true};}
    U1 ILessThan(U32 a,U32 b,bool){++comparisons;return {a.value<b.value};}
    U32 Select(U1 cond,U32 a,U32 b){++selections;return cond.value?a:b;}
    U32 LoadLocal(U32 index){++reads; return {memory.at(index.value),false};}
    void WriteLocal(U32 index,U32 value){++writes;memory.at(index.value)=value.value;}
    U32 IAdd(U32 a,U32 b){return {static_cast<u32>(a.value+b.value),a.immediate && b.immediate};}
};
}
struct TranslatorVisitor {
    struct Environment {u32 bytes{16};u32 LocalMemorySize() const{return bytes;}} env;
    IR::IREmitter ir;
};
__METHOD__
int main() {
    TranslatorVisitor v;
    auto dyn=[](u32 x){return IR::U32{x,false};};
    [[maybe_unused]] auto imm=[](u32 x){return IR::U32{x,true};};
    assert(LoadLocal(v,dyn(3),dyn(12)).value==44);
#ifdef PINNED_UNSAFE
    bool throws=false;
    try {(void)LoadLocal(v,dyn(7),dyn(28));}
    catch(const std::out_of_range&){throws=true;}
    assert(throws);
#else
    assert(LoadLocal(v,dyn(7),dyn(28)).value==0);
    assert(LoadLocal(v,imm(7),imm(28)).value==0);
    // Constant and already-qualified byte addresses must not generate
    // the dynamic bounds-check/select IR in the recompiled shader.
    const auto comparisons_before=v.ir.comparisons, selections_before=v.ir.selections;
    const auto reads_immediate=v.ir.reads;
    assert(LoadLocal(v,imm(2),imm(8)).value==33);
    assert(v.ir.reads==reads_immediate+1);
    assert(v.ir.comparisons==comparisons_before);
    assert(v.ir.selections==selections_before);
    // Dynamic accesses still use guarded address + result selections.
    assert(LoadLocal(v,dyn(2),dyn(8)).value==33);
    assert(v.ir.comparisons==comparisons_before+1);
    assert(v.ir.selections==selections_before+2);
    assert(LoadLocal(v,dyn(3),dyn(0xFFFFFFFC)).value==0);
    WriteLocal(v,dyn(2),dyn(8),imm(999));
    assert(v.ir.memory[2]==999);
    WriteLocal(v,imm(3),imm(12),imm(777));
    assert(v.ir.memory[3]==777);
    const auto before=v.ir.memory;
    WriteLocal(v,dyn(7),dyn(28),imm(111));
    assert(v.ir.memory==before);
    WriteLocal(v,imm(4),imm(16),imm(321));
    assert(v.ir.memory==before);
    // A negative byte offset and its next word can wrap to zero, exactly
    // matching scratch word 0: this is the old unsafe multiword call pattern.
    constexpr u32 outside=0xFFFFFFFCu;
    assert(static_cast<u32>(outside + 4u)==0u);
    assert(v.ir.memory[0]==11);
    assert(LoadLocal(v,dyn(0),dyn(static_cast<u32>(outside+4u))).value==11);
    // Pass the ORIGINAL byte offset and the word's advance instead.
    // Neither the read nor the store can now alias scratch word 0.
    const auto reads_before=v.ir.reads, writes_before=v.ir.writes;
    assert(LoadLocal(v,dyn(0),dyn(outside),4).value==0);
    assert(LoadLocal(v,imm(0),imm(outside),4).value==0);
    WriteLocal(v,dyn(0),dyn(outside),imm(555),4);
    WriteLocal(v,imm(0),imm(outside),imm(555),4);
    assert(v.ir.memory==before);
    // Dynamic masked operations still read/rewrite valid word zero; they
    // must preserve its VALUE, not skip the modeled memory instructions.
    assert(v.ir.writes==writes_before+1);
    assert(v.ir.reads==reads_before+2);
    // A word whose base starts in bounds but whose tail crosses 16 bytes.
    assert(LoadLocal(v,dyn(0),dyn(12),4).value==0);
    WriteLocal(v,dyn(0),dyn(12),imm(456),4);
    assert(v.ir.memory==before);
    // Positive controls: a second and fourth word still work when they fit.
    assert(LoadLocal(v,dyn(3),dyn(8),4).value==777);
    WriteLocal(v,dyn(3),dyn(8),imm(654),4);
    assert(v.ir.memory[3]==654);
    v.ir.memory[3]=777;
    assert(LoadLocal(v,dyn(3),dyn(0),12).value==777);
    assert(LoadLocal(v,dyn(0),dyn(0),16).value==0);
    WriteLocal(v,dyn(0),dyn(0),imm(666),16);
    assert(v.ir.memory==before);
    v.env.bytes=0;
    const auto r=v.ir.reads,w=v.ir.writes;
    assert(LoadLocal(v,dyn(0),dyn(0)).value==0);
    WriteLocal(v,dyn(0),dyn(0),imm(888));
    assert(v.ir.reads==r && v.ir.writes==w);
    assert(v.ir.memory==before);
#endif
}
"""
compiler=shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++")
assert compiler, "Clang required for bounds regression"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-shader-local-") as folder:
    for name,src,flags in (("pinned",pinned,["-DPINNED_UNSAFE"]),("fixed",active,[])):
        cpp=Path(folder)/(name+".cpp")
        exe=Path(folder)/name
        cpp.write_text(template.replace("__METHOD__",method(src)))
        subprocess.run([compiler,"-std=c++20","-O1","-g","-Wall","-Wextra","-Werror",
            "-fsanitize=address,undefined","-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
            *flags,str(cpp),"-o",str(exe)],check=True,timeout=45)
        subprocess.run([str(exe)],check=True,timeout=30)
print("SHADER_LOCAL_BOUNDS_HOST_PASS pinned_bad_load=1 dynamic_guard=1 immediate_tail=1 store_preserve=1 zero_scratch=1 tail_wrap=1 tail_cross=1 tail_inrange=1")
```

```py
"""Regression: sparse virtual capacity persists, physical demand stays sparse.

R237 measured the largest DIRECT-memory extent drop from 11,824 MiB to
4,128 MiB across relaunch, shrinking the VIRTUAL JIT arena 2,176 -> 656 MiB.
Only verified sparse RX/RW dual-mapped allocations may retain the earlier
largest verified extent. Dense physical arenas ALWAYS plan from current RAM.
Staged only; no execution without explicit user authorization.

    "} // namespace", 1)[0]
```

```py
    b.channel.graphics_image_table.changed=true;
    b.channel.graphics_image_table.descriptor=6;
    assert(b.VisitImageView(7,false)==106);
    assert(b.views_created==2);
    // Compute uses a different tagged entry and cannot replace graphics.
    b.channel.compute_image_table.descriptor=9;
    assert(b.VisitImageView(7,true)==109);
    assert(b.channel.image_view_ids.at(7)==106);
    assert(b.channel.image_view_ids.at(7|Common::SlotId::TAGGED_VALUE)==109);
    // A sampler's cached descriptor may also survive mapping replacement.
    b.channel.graphics_sampler_table.descriptor=4;
    assert(b.GetSamplerId(3,false)==304);
    assert(b.samplers_found==1);
    assert(b.GetSamplerId(3,false)==304);
    assert(b.samplers_found==1);
    b.channel.compute_sampler_table.descriptor=8;
    assert(b.GetSamplerId(3,true)==308 && b.samplers_found==2);
    // A cached descriptor can have failed to create a GPU image view
    // without any guest TIC rewrite. The NEXT lookup must retry creation,
    // publish a fresh binding serial, and avoid reusing the cached NULL.
    TextureCache<int> transient;
    transient.channel.graphics_image_table.descriptor=27;
    transient.fail_first_view_creation=true;
    assert(transient.VisitImageView(1,false)==NULL_IMAGE_VIEW_ID);
    assert(transient.channel.image_views.at(27)==NULL_IMAGE_VIEW_ID);
    assert(transient.channel.image_view_ids.at(1)==NULL_IMAGE_VIEW_ID);
    assert(transient.texture_bindings_serial==0 && transient.views_created==1);
    assert(transient.VisitImageView(1,false)==127);
    assert(transient.channel.image_view_ids.at(1)==127);
    assert(transient.texture_bindings_serial==1 && transient.views_created==2);
    assert(transient.VisitImageView(1,false)==127);
    assert(transient.views_created==2); // once live, never recreate each draw

    // A different TIC slot sharing a previously NULL descriptor must
    // also revive the original ImageView mapping with its own real view ID.
    TextureCache<int> shared;
    shared.channel.graphics_image_table.descriptor=29;
    shared.fail_first_view_creation=true;
    assert(shared.VisitImageView(1,false)==NULL_IMAGE_VIEW_ID);
    assert(shared.VisitImageView(2,false)==129);
    assert(shared.VisitImageView(1,false)==129);
    assert(shared.channel.image_view_ids.at(1)==129);
    assert(shared.channel.image_view_ids.at(2)==129);
    assert(shared.views_created==2);

    // Invalid indexes preserve the NULL return, not an out-of-range lookup.
    assert(b.VisitImageView(99,false)==NULL_IMAGE_VIEW_ID);
    assert(b.GetSamplerId(99,false)==NULL_SAMPLER_ID);
}
"""
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-channel-mapping-") as tmp:
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Host ASan/UBSan: source-extracted native Vulkan invalidation mutex gating.

Compile actual maintained methods, including original buffer/query/shader
invalidation paths. An unowned texture range may skip ONLY texture work.
A mixed batch retains the texture mutex but skips each provably unowned texture lookup.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
raster = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_rasterizer.cpp").read_text()
bridge = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-core/guest-bridge/vulkan_rasterizer.cpp").read_text()
pinned = (root / "vendor/sources/eden/src/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_rasterizer.cpp").read_text()
oracle = (root / "tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py").read_text()
workflow = (root / ".github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml").read_text()
image_cache = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan-cache/video_core/texture_cache/texture_cache.h").read_text()
assert "python3 -B tools/check-ps5-texture-invalidation-elision-host.py" in workflow
assert image_cache.index("::Eden::ImagePages::Mark(image.cpu_addr") < image_cache.index(
    "slot_map_views.insert(image.gpu_addr")
assert image_cache.index("::Eden::ImagePages::Mark(cpu_addr, size)") < image_cache.index(
    "slot_map_views.insert(gpu_addr, cpu_addr")
start = "void RasterizerVulkan::InvalidateRegion(DAddr addr, u64 size, VideoCommon::CacheType which) {"
mid = "bool RasterizerVulkan::OnCPUWrite(DAddr addr, u64 size) {"
end0 = "void RasterizerVulkan::OnCacheInvalidation(DAddr addr, u64 size) {"
end1 = "void RasterizerVulkan::InvalidateGPUCache() {"
def methods(source):
    assert source.count(start) == source.count(mid) == source.count(end0) == source.count(end1) == 1
    return (source.split(start, 1)[1].split(mid, 1)[0],
            source.split(end0, 1)[1].split(end1, 1)[0])
new = methods(raster)
assert methods(bridge) == new, "inactive bridge invalidation methods drifted"
assert new[0].count("::Eden::BufferPages::NeverRegistered(addr, size)") == 3
assert "bool buffer_may_overlap = false;" in new[0]
assert "if (buffer_may_overlap)" in new[0]

original = methods(pinned)
assert new != original
assert new[0].count("::Eden::ImagePages::NeverHeld(addr, size)") == 3
assert new[1].count("::Eden::ImagePages::NeverHeld(addr, size)") == 1
assert "bool texture_may_overlap = false;" in new[0]
assert "bool buffer_may_overlap = false;" in new[0]
assert "if (texture_may_overlap && buffer_may_overlap) break;" in new[0]
# The two monotonic owner domains must share ONE bounded preflight range walk.
prefetch = new[0].split("bool texture_may_overlap = false;", 1)[1].split("if (texture_may_overlap) {", 1)[0]
assert prefetch.count("for (const auto& [addr, size] : sequences)") == 1
assert prefetch.index("::Eden::ImagePages::NeverHeld(addr, size)") < prefetch.index("::Eden::BufferPages::NeverRegistered(addr, size)")
assert "if (texture_may_overlap && buffer_may_overlap) break;" in oracle
assert "Recheck under the texture mutex" in new[0]
assert "if (texture_may_overlap)" in new[0]
assert "R: skip provably unnecessary Vulkan texture-cache invalidation locks" in oracle
assert oracle.count("texture_may_overlap = false;") == 1
assert "Recheck under the texture mutex" in oracle
for source in (raster, bridge):
    assert "void RasterizerVulkan::InnerInvalidation(" in source
    assert source.index("if (texture_may_overlap)") < source.index(
        "std::scoped_lock lock{texture_cache.mutex};", source.index("if (texture_may_overlap)"))
    assert source.count("pipeline_cache.InvalidateRegion(addr, size);") >= 2

real_methods = (start + new[0] + end0 + new[1])
code = r"""
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <mutex>
#include <span>
#include <utility>
#include "image_pages.h"
#include "buffer_pages.h"
using DAddr = std::uint64_t;
using u64 = std::uint64_t;
namespace VideoCommon {
enum class CacheType : unsigned { TextureCache = 1, BufferCache = 2,
                                  QueryCache = 4, ShaderCache = 8 };
}
constexpr VideoCommon::CacheType operator&(VideoCommon::CacheType a, VideoCommon::CacheType b) {
    return static_cast<VideoCommon::CacheType>(static_cast<unsigned>(a) & static_cast<unsigned>(b));
}
constexpr bool True(VideoCommon::CacheType which) { return static_cast<unsigned>(which) != 0; }
struct CountingMutex {
    std::mutex m;
    int locks{};
    std::function<void()> before_lock;
    void lock() {
        // Deterministically model image registration after batch precheck
        // but before acquiring the cache lock.
        if (before_lock) {
            auto publish = std::move(before_lock);
            before_lock = {};
            publish();
        }
        m.lock();
        ++locks;
    }
    void unlock() { m.unlock(); }
};
struct Cache {
    CountingMutex mutex;
    int writes{};
    void WriteMemory(DAddr, u64) { ++writes; }
};
struct QueryCache {
    int writes{};
    void InvalidateRegion(DAddr, u64) { ++writes; }
};
struct PipelineCache {
    int writes{};
    void InvalidateRegion(DAddr, u64) { ++writes; }
};
class RasterizerVulkan {
public:
    Cache texture_cache, buffer_cache;
    QueryCache query_cache;
    PipelineCache pipeline_cache;
    void InvalidateRegion(DAddr, u64, VideoCommon::CacheType);
    void InnerInvalidation(std::span<const std::pair<DAddr, std::size_t>>);
    void OnCacheInvalidation(DAddr, u64);
};
__EXTRACT__
int main() {
    constexpr u64 p = 4096;
    using namespace Eden;
    RasterizerVulkan x;
    const auto all = static_cast<VideoCommon::CacheType>(15);
    const auto tex = VideoCommon::CacheType::TextureCache;
    // Never-owned range: both image/buffer locks are omitted.
    x.InvalidateRegion(10*p, p, all);
    assert(x.texture_cache.mutex.locks == 0 && x.texture_cache.writes == 0);
    assert(x.buffer_cache.mutex.locks == 0 && x.buffer_cache.writes == 0);
    assert(x.query_cache.writes == 1 && x.pipeline_cache.writes == 1);
    x.InvalidateRegion(0, p, all);
    x.InvalidateRegion(10*p, 0, all);
    assert(x.pipeline_cache.writes == 1 && x.texture_cache.mutex.locks == 0);

    ImagePages::Mark(20*p, p);
    BufferPages::Mark(20*p, p); // Independently registered GPU buffer
    x.InvalidateRegion(20*p, p, tex);
    x.InvalidateRegion(19*p, 2*p, tex);
    assert(x.texture_cache.mutex.locks == 2 && x.texture_cache.writes == 2);
    x.InvalidateRegion(60*p, 256*1024+1, tex);
    x.InvalidateRegion(ImagePages::kSpace - 2, 4, tex);
    assert(x.texture_cache.mutex.locks == 4 && x.texture_cache.writes == 4);

    // OnCacheInvalidation preserves shader notification and known buffer writes.
    x.OnCacheInvalidation(40*p, p);
    assert(x.texture_cache.mutex.locks == 4 && x.texture_cache.writes == 4);
    assert(x.buffer_cache.writes == 0 && x.pipeline_cache.writes == 2);
    x.OnCacheInvalidation(20*p, p);
    assert(x.texture_cache.mutex.locks == 5 && x.texture_cache.writes == 5);
    assert(x.buffer_cache.writes == 1 && x.pipeline_cache.writes == 3);
    x.OnCacheInvalidation(0, p);
    assert(x.buffer_cache.writes == 1 && x.pipeline_cache.writes == 3);

    // Entirely unregistered batches skip both GPU cache locks; query/shader remain.
    std::array<std::pair<DAddr, std::size_t>, 2> clean{{
        {100*p, p}, {110*p, p}
    }};
    x.InnerInvalidation(clean);
    assert(x.texture_cache.mutex.locks == 5 && x.texture_cache.writes == 5);
    assert(x.buffer_cache.writes == 1 && x.query_cache.writes == 3);
    assert(x.buffer_cache.mutex.locks == 1);
    assert(x.pipeline_cache.writes == 5);

    // A mixed batch keeps the mutex but skips image-free individual ranges.
    std::array<std::pair<DAddr, std::size_t>, 2> mixed{{
        {120*p, p}, {20*p, p}
    }};
    x.InnerInvalidation(mixed);
    assert(x.texture_cache.mutex.locks == 6 && x.texture_cache.writes == 6);
    assert(x.buffer_cache.writes == 2 && x.query_cache.writes == 5);
    assert(x.buffer_cache.mutex.locks == 2);
    assert(x.pipeline_cache.writes == 7);

    // An unknown/large range still gets texture invalidation, unlike a
    // separate provably unowned page in the same mixed batch.
    std::array<std::pair<DAddr, std::size_t>, 2> uncertain{{
        {130*p, p}, {140*p, 256*1024+1}
    }};
    x.InnerInvalidation(uncertain);
    assert(x.texture_cache.mutex.locks == 7 && x.texture_cache.writes == 7);
    assert(x.buffer_cache.writes == 3 && x.query_cache.writes == 7);
    assert(x.buffer_cache.mutex.locks == 3);
    assert(x.pipeline_cache.writes == 9);
    // A concurrent registration can publish its monotonic page bit after
    // the outer mixed-batch scan, before we own the texture mutex.
    // The inner check MUST observe it and keep its invalidation.
    x.texture_cache.mutex.before_lock = [&] { ImagePages::Mark(150*p, p); };
    std::array<std::pair<DAddr, std::size_t>, 2> newly_registered{{
        {150*p, p}, {20*p, p}
    }};
    x.InnerInvalidation(newly_registered);
    assert(x.texture_cache.mutex.locks == 8 && x.texture_cache.writes == 9);
    assert(x.buffer_cache.writes == 4 && x.query_cache.writes == 9);
    assert(x.buffer_cache.mutex.locks == 4);
    assert(x.pipeline_cache.writes == 11);
    // Buffer registration may publish after the outer scan but before
    // acquiring the buffer lock in a mixed batch. Recheck under the mutex.
    x.buffer_cache.mutex.before_lock = [&] { BufferPages::Mark(160*p, p); };
    std::array<std::pair<DAddr, std::size_t>, 2> newly_registered_buffer{{
        {160*p, p}, {20*p, p}
    }};
    x.InnerInvalidation(newly_registered_buffer);
    assert(x.buffer_cache.writes == 6 && x.query_cache.writes == 11);
    assert(x.pipeline_cache.writes == 13);
    assert(x.buffer_cache.mutex.locks == 5);
    assert(x.texture_cache.mutex.locks == 9);
    std::array<std::pair<DAddr, std::size_t>, 0> empty{};
    x.InnerInvalidation(empty);
    assert(x.texture_cache.mutex.locks == 9 && x.buffer_cache.writes == 6);
    assert(x.buffer_cache.mutex.locks == 5);
}
""".replace("__EXTRACT__", real_methods)
compiler = shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++")
assert compiler, "Clang required for ASan/UBSan source-extracted C++ witness"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-invalidation-elision-") as td:
    source = Path(td) / "invalidation.cpp"
    binary = Path(td) / "test"
    source.write_text(code)
    subprocess.run([compiler, "-std=c++20", "-O1", "-pthread",
                    "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror", "-fsanitize=address,undefined",
                    "-fno-sanitize-recover=all", "-I"+str(root/"headless"),
                    str(source), "-o", str(binary)], check=True, timeout=55)
    subprocess.run([str(binary)], check=True, timeout=20)
print("VULKAN_TEXTURE_INVALIDATION_ELISION_HOST_PASS real_methods=3 "
      "never_registered=1 known=1 mixed_batch=1 oversized=1 out_of_range=1 "
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""F03/F04: verify exact ordered PS5 texture-view shipping patch stack.

Reverse four PS5 view/remap patches from shipping, confirm the reviewed
pre-F04 source, and replay with Git to reproduce exact shipping bytes.
Also verify source/receipt SHA-256 contracts. Not a full console build.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
REL = Path("src/video_core/texture_cache/texture_cache.h")
ACTIVE = ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/eden-backports"
MANIFEST = json.loads((ACTIVE / "manifest.json").read_text())
SOURCE = ACTIVE / REL
BYTES = SOURCE.read_bytes()

def sha256(raw: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()

owner = MANIFEST["entries"][REL.as_posix()]
assert owner["active"] == sha256(BYTES), "shipping texture cache digest mismatch"
assert owner["bytes"] == len(BYTES), "shipping texture cache size mismatch"

PATCH_NAMES = (
    "eden-ps5-texture-tic-layer-bounds.patch",
    "eden-ps5-texture-remapped-view-rebind.patch",
    "eden-ps5-texture-remap-target-invalidation.patch",
    "eden-ps5-texture-missing-channel-slot-guard.patch",
)
installer = (ROOT / "tools/apply-eden-backports.sh").read_text()
positions = [
    installer.index(f'apply_one "$root/headless/backports/{name}"')
    for name in PATCH_NAMES
]
assert positions == sorted(positions), "texture patch replay order changed"
patches = [ROOT / "headless/backports" / name for name in PATCH_NAMES]
for file in patches:
    receipt = f".encore-backport-{file.stem.removeprefix('eden-')}.sha256"
    assert MANIFEST["shipping_receipts"].get(receipt) == sha256(file.read_bytes()), (
        "stale texture patch receipt", receipt
    )

PRE_F04_SHA256 = "3c129bb7ecf389d6f95c852ac9afbf1956fcc6e31d19bbeccaef757228af450a"
PRE_F04_BYTES = 117051

def run(stage: Path, args: list[str]) -> None:
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "apply", *args], cwd=stage, text=True,
        capture_output=True, timeout=25,
    )
    assert result.returncode == 0, (args, result.stderr[-3500:])

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-texture-stack-replay-") as td:
    stage = Path(td)
    target = stage / REL
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
    shutil.copyfile(SOURCE, target)

    for patch in reversed(patches):
        run(stage, ["--reverse", "--check", str(patch)])
        run(stage, ["--reverse", str(patch)])
    baseline = target.read_bytes()
    assert len(baseline) == PRE_F04_BYTES, "unexpected pre-F04 texture source size"
    assert sha256(baseline) == PRE_F04_SHA256, "unexpected pre-F04 texture source"
    print("ENCORE_F03_F04_TEXTURE_BASELINE_PASS", len(baseline))

    for patch in patches:
        run(stage, ["--check", str(patch)])
        run(stage, [str(patch)])
    assert target.read_bytes() == BYTES, "four-patch roundtrip changed source"
    print("ENCORE_F03_F04_TEXTURE_PATCH_REPLAY_PASS", len(BYTES), len(patches))
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compile the actual maintained CPU/GPU image page traversals.

Pinned source/patch replay and native/non-native valid-range equivalence.
Reject zero/wrapping guest page spans on PS5; no console FPS claim.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
pinned = (root / "vendor/sources/eden/src/video_core/texture_cache/texture_cache_base.h").read_text()
active = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-backports/src/video_core/texture_cache/texture_cache_base.h").read_text()
patch = root / "headless/backports/eden-ps5-texture-page-range-guards.patch"
shipping = (root / "tools/apply-eden-backports.sh").read_text()
assert 'apply_one "$root/headless/backports/eden-ps5-texture-page-range-guards.patch"' in shipping
guard = "if (size == 0 || size - 1 > (std::numeric_limits<u64>::max)() - addr)"
trait = "std::is_same_v<std::invoke_result_t<Func, u64>, bool>"
assert active.count(guard) == 2
assert active.count(trait) == 2
assert pinned.count(guard) == 0

def method(text, name):
    # The dependent Func template parameter belongs to this declaration.
    # Extract the preceding template line as well as the method body.
    start = text.index("    template <typename Func>\n    static void " + name + "(")
    end = text.index("\n    }\n", start) + len("\n    }\n")
    return text[start:end]

names = ("ForEachCPUPage", "ForEachGPUPage")
for name in names:
    original = method(pinned, name)
    selected = method(active, name)
    assert selected.count("#ifdef PS5_NATIVE") == 2
    assert selected.count(guard) == 1
    assert selected.count(trait) == 1
    assert selected.index(trait) < selected.index(guard) < selected.index("const u64 page_end =")
    # Both the native-only type-trait repair and the range guard must be
    # reversible into the exact pinned, non-PS5 iterator.
    trait_block = ("""#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
        // invoke_result is the trait struct, not the callback return type.
        // Respect early-stop bool callbacks after the first matching image.
        static constexpr bool RETURNS_BOOL = std::is_same_v<std::invoke_result_t<Func, u64>, bool>;
#else
        static constexpr bool RETURNS_BOOL = std::is_same_v<std::invoke_result<Func, u64>, bool>;
#endif
""")
    guard_block = ("""#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
        // A zero byte region has no pages. An overflowing exclusive end
        // cannot refer to a valid guest mapping: do not wrap into a huge
        // page scan (notably addr=0, size=0).
        if (size == 0 || size - 1 > (std::numeric_limits<u64>::max)() - addr) {
            return;
        }
#endif
""")
    assert selected.count(trait_block) == 1
    assert selected.count(guard_block) == 1
    old_trait = "        static constexpr bool RETURNS_BOOL = std::is_same_v<std::invoke_result<Func, u64>, bool>;\n"
    assert selected.replace(trait_block, old_trait).replace(guard_block, "") == original

# Apply the *real* git patch to the pinned header and verify both selected
# method bodies. The full file may have other reviewed shipping backports.
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-texture-page-replay-") as tmp:
    stage = Path(tmp)
    target = stage / "src/video_core/texture_cache/texture_cache_base.h"
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
    target.write_text(pinned)
    for command in (["git", "apply", "--check", str(patch)],
                    ["git", "apply", str(patch)]):
        done = subprocess.run(command, cwd=stage, text=True,
                              capture_output=True, timeout=20)
        assert done.returncode == 0, (command, done.stderr[-3000:])
    applied = target.read_text()
    for name in names:
        assert method(applied, name) == method(active, name)
    print("ENCORE_TEXTURE_PAGE_PINNED_PATCH_REPLAY_PASS")

code = r"""

#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>
#include <type_traits>
#include <vector>
using u64 = std::uint64_t;
using DAddr = u64;
using GPUVAddr = u64;
inline constexpr unsigned YUZU_PAGEBITS = 12;
struct PageOps {
""" + method(active, names[0]) + method(active, names[1]) + r"""
};
template<class Walk>
static void valid_cases(Walk&& walk) {
    std::vector<u64> pages;
    walk(4095,2,[&](u64 page){pages.push_back(page);});
    assert((pages == std::vector<u64>{0,1}));
    pages.clear();
    walk(4096,4096,[&](u64 page){pages.push_back(page);});
    assert((pages == std::vector<u64>{1}));
    pages.clear();
    walk(4096,4097,[&](u64 page){pages.push_back(page);});
    assert((pages == std::vector<u64>{1,2}));
    pages.clear();
    walk(0,1,[&](u64 page){pages.push_back(page);});
    assert((pages == std::vector<u64>{0}));
    pages.clear();
    walk((std::numeric_limits<u64>::max)()-3,4,
         [&](u64 page){pages.push_back(page);});
    assert(pages.size()==1);
    assert(pages[0]==(std::numeric_limits<u64>::max)()>>12);
    pages.clear();
    walk(4095,8193,[&](u64 page)->bool {pages.push_back(page);return true;});

    assert((pages == std::vector<u64>{0}));

    // Pinned source had an inactive BOOL_BREAK trait; the native-only fix
    // intentionally leaves the upstream traversal byte-for-byte unchanged.
    assert((pages == std::vector<u64>{0,1,2}));
#endif
}
int main() {
    valid_cases([](auto addr,auto size,auto fn) {
        PageOps::ForEachCPUPage(addr,size,fn);
    });
    valid_cases([](auto addr,auto size,auto fn) {
        PageOps::ForEachGPUPage(addr,size,fn);
    });
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    // Both zero-length and invalid ranges must be rejected without callback.
    // Before F03/F04, (0,0) scanned a near-infinite number of pages.
    for (auto walk : {0,1}) {
        int calls=0;
        const auto count=[&](u64){++calls;};
        auto run=[&](u64 addr,u64 size) {
            if(walk==0) PageOps::ForEachCPUPage(addr,size,count);
            else PageOps::ForEachGPUPage(addr,size,count);
        };
        run(0,0);
        run(4096,0);
        run((std::numeric_limits<u64>::max)()-3,5);
        run((std::numeric_limits<u64>::max)(),2);
        assert(calls==0);
    }
#endif
}
"""
compilers=list(dict.fromkeys(filter(None,(
```

`tools/check-ps5-texture-unmap-elision-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""ASan/UBSan native-method witness: CPU texture-page unmap lock elision.

Never infer GPU-addressed image mapping from CPU-addressed occupancy.
Known GPU buffer writes and pipeline notifications must still execute.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
main = (root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_rasterizer.cpp").read_text()
bridge = (root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-core/guest-bridge/vulkan_rasterizer.cpp").read_text()
pinned = (root/"vendor/sources/eden/src/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_rasterizer.cpp").read_text()
oracle = (root/"tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py").read_text()
workflow = (root/".github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml").read_text()
cache = (root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan-cache/video_core/texture_cache/texture_cache.h").read_text()
begin = "void RasterizerVulkan::UnmapMemory(DAddr addr, u64 size) {"
end = "\nvoid RasterizerVulkan::SignalFence("
def method_pair(s):
    assert s.count(begin) == s.count(end) == 1
    return s[s.index(begin):s.index(end,s.index(begin))]
body = method_pair(main)
assert body == method_pair(bridge)
assert body != method_pair(pinned)
assert body.count("::Eden::ImagePages::NeverHeld(addr, size)") == 1
assert body.count("::Eden::BufferPages::NeverRegistered(addr, size)") == 1
assert body.index("::Eden::ImagePages::NeverHeld(addr, size)") < body.index(
    "texture_cache.UnmapMemory(addr, size)")
assert body.index("texture_cache.UnmapMemory(addr, size)") < body.index(
    "buffer_cache.WriteMemory(addr, size)")
assert body.index("buffer_cache.WriteMemory(addr, size)") < body.index(
    "pipeline_cache.OnCacheInvalidation(addr, size)")
gpu_part = body.split("void RasterizerVulkan::ModifyGPUMemory(",1)[1]
assert "ImagePages::NeverHeld" not in gpu_part
assert "texture_cache.UnmapGPUMemory(as_id, addr, size)" in gpu_part
assert "buffer_cache.UnmapGPUMemory(as_id, addr, size)" in gpu_part
assert cache.index("::Eden::ImagePages::Mark(image.cpu_addr") < cache.index(
    "slot_map_views.insert(image.gpu_addr")
assert cache.index("::Eden::ImagePages::Mark(cpu_addr, size)") < cache.index(
    "slot_map_views.insert(gpu_addr, cpu_addr")
assert "CPU-addressed unmapping: do not lock an image cache" in oracle
assert "python3 -B tools/check-ps5-texture-unmap-elision-host.py" in workflow

cpp = r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <mutex>
#include "image_pages.h"
#include "buffer_pages.h"
using DAddr = std::uint64_t;
using GPUVAddr = std::uint64_t;
using u64 = std::uint64_t;
struct CountingMutex {
  std::recursive_mutex underlying;
  unsigned locks{};
  void lock() {underlying.lock(); ++locks;}
  void unlock() {underlying.unlock();}
};
struct TextureCache {
  CountingMutex mutex;
  unsigned cpu_unmaps{}, gpu_unmaps{};
  void UnmapMemory(DAddr, u64) {++cpu_unmaps;}
  void UnmapGPUMemory(std::size_t, GPUVAddr, u64) {++gpu_unmaps;}
};
struct BufferCache {
  CountingMutex mutex;
  unsigned write_calls{}, gpu_unmaps{};
  void WriteMemory(DAddr, u64) {++write_calls;}
  void UnmapGPUMemory(std::size_t, GPUVAddr, u64) {++gpu_unmaps;}
};
struct PipelineCache {
  unsigned invalidations{};
  void OnCacheInvalidation(DAddr, u64) {++invalidations;}
};
class RasterizerVulkan {
public:
  TextureCache texture_cache;
  BufferCache buffer_cache;
  PipelineCache pipeline_cache;
  void UnmapMemory(DAddr addr, u64 size);
  void ModifyGPUMemory(std::size_t as_id, GPUVAddr addr, u64 size);
};
__METHODS__
int main() {
  constexpr DAddr page=4096;
  RasterizerVulkan x;
  x.UnmapMemory(100*page,page);
  assert(x.texture_cache.cpu_unmaps==0 && x.texture_cache.mutex.locks==0);
  assert(x.buffer_cache.write_calls==0 && x.buffer_cache.mutex.locks==0);
  assert(x.pipeline_cache.invalidations==1);
  // An image ever registered at this CPU page must still be removed.
  Eden::ImagePages::Mark(200*page,page);
  Eden::BufferPages::Mark(200*page,page);
  x.UnmapMemory(200*page,page);
  x.UnmapMemory(199*page,2*page);
  assert(x.texture_cache.cpu_unmaps==2 && x.texture_cache.mutex.locks==2);
  assert(x.buffer_cache.write_calls==2 && x.buffer_cache.mutex.locks==2);
  assert(x.pipeline_cache.invalidations==3);
  // Unknown, oversized and out-of-range ranges use the legacy mutex.
  x.UnmapMemory(300*page,256*1024+1);
  x.UnmapMemory(Eden::ImagePages::kSpace-2,4);
  assert(x.texture_cache.cpu_unmaps==4 && x.texture_cache.mutex.locks==4);
  assert(x.buffer_cache.write_calls==4 && x.buffer_cache.mutex.locks==4);
  assert(x.pipeline_cache.invalidations==5);
  // GPU unmapping must NEVER consult CPU page witness.
  x.ModifyGPUMemory(7,700*page,page);
  assert(x.texture_cache.gpu_unmaps==1 && x.texture_cache.mutex.locks==5);
  assert(x.buffer_cache.gpu_unmaps==1);
  assert(x.buffer_cache.write_calls==4 && x.buffer_cache.mutex.locks==4);
  assert(x.pipeline_cache.invalidations==5);
}
""".replace("__METHODS__",body)
compiler=shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++")
assert compiler,"clang++ sanitizer host compiler required"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-unmap-cache-") as tmp:
    f=Path(tmp)/"unmap.cpp"
    exe=Path(tmp)/"test"
    f.write_text(cpp)
    subprocess.run([compiler,"-std=c++20","-O1","-pthread","-Wall","-Wextra",
                    "-Werror","-fsanitize=address,undefined",
                    "-fno-sanitize-recover=all","-I"+str(root/"headless"),
                    str(f),"-o",str(exe)],check=True,timeout=55)
    subprocess.run([str(exe)],check=True,timeout=20)
print("VULKAN_TEXTURE_UNMAP_ELISION_HOST_PASS actual_methods=2 unowned=1 registered=1 "
      "overlap=1 unknown=1 large=1 gpu_address_separate=1 buffer_shader_kept=1 asan_ubsan=1")
```

`tools/check-ps5-tfb-counter-stability.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Guard native PS5 Vulkan transform-feedback counter begin/end symmetry.

This checks the actually vendored Vulkan C++ translation unit AND the
generator's source-to-output replacement. The full fork equivalence gate
independently compares all 40 active Vulkan files to generated sources.
No PS5 compilation, GPU device or gameplay inference.
"""
import ast
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
active = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_query_cache.cpp").read_text()
generator = (root / "tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py").read_text()
base = (root / "vendor/sources/eden/src/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_query_cache.cpp").read_text()
begin = active.split("    void FlushBeginTFB() {", 1)[1].split("    void FlushEndTFB() {", 1)[0]
end = active.split("    void FlushEndTFB() {", 1)[1].split("    void UpdateBuffers() {", 1)[0]

assert begin.count("UpdateBuffers();") == 1, "UpdateBuffers must run before BeginTFB"
assert "BeginTransformFeedbackEXT(" in begin
assert "EndTransformFeedbackEXT(" in end
assert end.count("UpdateBuffers();") == 0, "TFB end must preserve begin-time counter count"
assert "has_flushed_end_pending = false;" in end
assert "if (buffers_count == 0)" in end

old = ("        // Refresh buffer state before ending transform feedback to ensure counters_count is up-to-date.\n"
       "        UpdateBuffers();\n")
tree = ast.parse(generator)
found = 0
for node in ast.walk(tree):
    if not (isinstance(node, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func, ast.Name) and node.func.id == "adapt"):
        continue
    if not node.args or not isinstance(node.args[0], ast.Constant):
        continue
    if node.args[0].value != "src/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_query_cache.cpp":
        continue
    assert len(node.args) == 3 and isinstance(node.args[2], ast.List)
    for pair in node.args[2].elts:
        if not isinstance(pair, ast.Tuple) or len(pair.elts) != 2:
            continue
        before, after = pair.elts
        if (isinstance(before, ast.Constant) and before.value == old):
            assert isinstance(after, ast.Constant) and after.value == ""
            found += 1
assert found == 1, "generator must remove exactly the same two lines as active C++"
assert base.count(old) == 1
assert active.count(old) == 0
print("PASS: pinned source has old EndTFB refresh; generator removes it once; compiled fork refreshes only on BeginTFB")

```

```py
    assert all(line.startswith("EDEN_PS5_THREAD_SCHED") for line in records), records

                    str(cpp), "-o", str(exe)], check=True)
    release = subprocess.run([str(exe)], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
    records = release.stdout.strip().splitlines()
    assert len(records) == 3, records
    assert all("rr_attempted=1" in line for line in records), records
    assert all("rr_verified=1" in line for line in records[:2]), records
    assert "role=FallbackWorker" in records[-1] and "rr_verified=0" in records[-1], records

    # Ordinary desktop builds have no native scheduling side effects.
    subprocess.run(["c++", "-std=c++20", "-pthread", str(cpp), "-o", str(exe)], check=True)
    host = subprocess.run([str(exe)], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
    assert not host.stdout, host.stdout
```

```py
namespace fmt {
template <typename T> std::string Value(const T& v) {
  if constexpr (std::is_integral_v<T>) {
    std::ostringstream o;
    o << std::uppercase << std::hex << std::setfill('0') << std::setw(16) << v;
    return o.str();
  } else {
    return std::string(v);
  }
}
template <typename... Ts> std::string format(const char* p, const Ts&... vs) {
  const std::array<std::string, sizeof...(Ts)> args{Value(vs)...};
  std::string out;
  std::size_t cursor=0, arg=0;
  while (p[cursor]) {
    if (p[cursor] != '{') { out += p[cursor++]; continue; }
    auto close = cursor+1;
    while (p[close] && p[close] != '}') ++close;
    assert(p[close] == '}' && arg < args.size());
    out += args[arg++];
    cursor = close + 1;
  }
  assert(arg == args.size());
  return out;
}

  static std::string GetSaveDataSpaceIdPath(SaveDataSpaceId s) {

  }
};

#ifdef PINNED_LEGACY
 assert(a0 == b0 && a0 == "/user/save/cache/0000000000000000");
#else

 assert(a0 == "/user/save/cache/01007EF00011E000");
 assert(b0 == "/user/save/cache/0100C49025D3E000");
#endif
 const auto explicit_a=path(a,SaveDataType::Cache,0x1234);
 assert(explicit_a == path(b,SaveDataType::Cache,0x1234));
 assert(explicit_a == "/user/save/cache/0000000000001234");

   assert(path(a,type,0)==path(a,type,a));
   assert(path(a,type,0)!=path(b,type,0));

 assert(path(a,SaveDataType::System,0)==path(b,SaveDataType::System,0));
```

`tools/check-ps5-ui-stream-buffer.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Host regression: PS5 launcher must not orphan the same GPU stream buffer every frame.

Compile the pure capacity policy and check exact renderer glue. No PS5 SDK or
hardware timing is exercised; only a real console replay can prove FPS gains.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
header = (ROOT / "headless/prosperoeden/pe/gfx/gl_batch.hpp").read_text()
source = (ROOT / "headless/prosperoeden/pe/gfx/gl_batch.cpp").read_text()
policy = (ROOT / "headless/prosperoeden/pe/gfx/stream_ring_policy.hpp").read_text()

assert "std::array<GLuint, kStreamBufferSlots> vaos_{};" in header
assert "std::array<GLuint, kStreamBufferSlots> buffers_{};" in header
assert "std::array<std::size_t, kStreamBufferSlots> capacities_{};" in header
assert "next_slot_ = 0;" in header
assert "std::size_t slot = next_slot_++ % kStreamBufferSlots;" in source
assert "glBindBuffer(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, buffers_[slot]);" in source
assert "if (capacity != capacities_[slot])" in source
assert source.count("glBufferData(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER,") == 1
assert "glBindVertexArray(vaos_[slot]);" in source
assert "glDeleteBuffers(static_cast<GLsizei>(buffers_.size()), buffers_.data());" in source
assert "glDeleteVertexArrays(static_cast<GLsizei>(vaos_.size()), vaos_.data());" in source
assert "capacities_.fill(0);" in source
assert "constexpr std::size_t kStreamBufferSlots = 3;" in policy

cxx = next((x for x in ("clang++-18", "clang++", "g++") if shutil.which(x)), None)
if not cxx:
    raise SystemExit("C++20 compiler needed for UI buffer capacity regression")
cpp = r"""
#include "pe/gfx/stream_ring_policy.hpp"
#include <cassert>
#include <limits>
using namespace pe::gfx;
int main() {
    static_assert(kStreamBufferSlots == 3);
    static_assert(StreamCapacity(0, 0) == 0);
    static_assert(StreamCapacity(0, 1) == 512);
    static_assert(StreamCapacity(0, 512) == 512);
    static_assert(StreamCapacity(0, 513) == 1024);
    static_assert(StreamCapacity(1024, 130) == 1024);
    static_assert(StreamCapacity(512, 700) == 1024);
    static_assert(StreamCapacity(1024, 2049) == 4096);
    static_assert(StreamCapacity(std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max() / 2 + 1,
                                 std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) ==
                  std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max());
    std::size_t capacities[kStreamBufferSlots]{};
    std::size_t allocations = 0;
    const std::size_t frame_sizes[] = {100,100,100,100,130,200,330,330,330,900,
                                       900,900,300,300,300,700,700,700};
    for (std::size_t frame = 0; frame < sizeof(frame_sizes)/sizeof(*frame_sizes); ++frame) {
        const auto slot = frame % kStreamBufferSlots;
        const auto desired = StreamCapacity(capacities[slot], frame_sizes[frame]);
        assert(desired >= frame_sizes[frame]);
        if (desired != capacities[slot]) ++allocations;
        capacities[slot] = desired;
    }
    // For 18 frames on 3 buffers only initial allocation and genuine
    // capacity upgrades cause GL storage reallocation.
    assert(allocations == 6);
}
"""
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-ps5-gl-ring-") as d:
    file = Path(d) / "ring.cpp"
    output = Path(d) / "ring"
    file.write_text(cpp)
    subprocess.run([cxx, "-std=c++20", "-O2", "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror",
                    "-I", str(ROOT / "headless/prosperoeden"), str(file),
                    "-o", str(output)], check=True)
    subprocess.run([str(output)], check=True)
print("PASS: rotating 3 renderer VBO/VAO pairs with allocation only on growth")
print("Real PS5 UI draw latency remains to be verified on hardware")
```

```py
"""Compile the actual untextured graphics descriptor gate with cache doubles."""

        ::Eden::Performance::CachePhaseTimer cost{
            ::Eden::Performance::CachePhase::TextureDescriptorSync};
        texture_cache.SynchronizeDescriptors(false);
```
