`tools/check-ps5-vertex-identity-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""C++20 sanitizer regression for actual maintained merged vertex identity."""
import ast
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import shutil
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
active = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vk_pipeline_cache_cost.cpp").read_text()
generator = (root / "tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py").read_text()
header = (root / "headless/dev_vulkan.h").read_text()
shader_costs = None
for node in ast.parse(generator).body:
    if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and any(
        isinstance(name, ast.Name) and name.id == "shader_costs"
        for name in node.targets
    ):
        shader_costs = ast.literal_eval(node.value)
        break
assert shader_costs is not None
fragment = next(new for old, new in shader_costs
                if old == "GraphicsPipeline* PipelineCache::CurrentGraphicsPipeline() {")
start = "std::mutex eden_attributeless_mutex;"
end = "// A static key without attributes"
helper = active.split(start, 1)[1].split(end, 1)[0]
generated_helper = fragment.split(start, 1)[1].split(end, 1)[0]
assert helper == generated_helper
assert "using EdenVertexIdentity = std::array<u64, 2>;" in helper
assert "std::set<EdenVertexIdentity> eden_attributeless_vertex" in helper
assert "EdenResetStaticVertexInputBinding() noexcept" in helper
assert "struct Bucket {" in helper
assert "std::array<Lookup, 4> ways{}" in helper
assert "static thread_local std::array<Bucket, 16> buckets{}" in helper
assert "bucket.next_slot = (bucket.next_slot + 1) & (bucket.ways.size() - 1);" in helper
assert "lookup.hash == vertex_hash &&" in helper
assert "(lookup.result || lookup.generation == generation)" in helper
# Instrument ONLY the shader memo's locked lookup; do not change any production
# branch. In a warmed four-key collision sequence, all subsequent hits must
# take zero set mutexes, not merely return the same values.
slow_anchor = "    const std::scoped_lock lock{eden_attributeless_mutex};\n    const bool result = eden_attributeless_vertex.contains(vertex_hash);"
assert helper.count(slow_anchor) == 1
instrumented_helper = helper.replace(slow_anchor,
    "    slow_lookups.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);\n" + slow_anchor)
for text in (active, generator):
    assert "EdenAttributeless({graphics_key.unique_hashes[0], graphics_key.unique_hashes[1]})" in text
    assert "EdenRecordAttributeless({key.unique_hashes[0], key.unique_hashes[1]}, programs[1].info)" in text
    assert "EdenResetStaticVertexInputBinding();" in text
assert "static_vertex_input = true;" in header.split("inline void ResetForTitle() noexcept {", 1)[1]
compiler = shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++")
assert compiler, "clang++ required"
cpp = r"""
#include <array>
#include <atomic>
#include <bit>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <mutex>
#include <set>
#include "dev_vulkan.h"
using u64=std::uint64_t; using u32=std::uint32_t;
namespace Shader {
namespace IR { constexpr std::size_t NUM_GENERICS=32; }
struct Info {
 struct Loads {
   u32 bits{};
   bool Generic(std::size_t i) const { return bool(bits & (u32{1} << i)); }
 } loads;
};
}
std::atomic<std::uint64_t> slow_lookups{0};
__EXACT_HELPER__
int main() {
 Shader::Info without{}, with{};
 with.loads.bits=1;
 EdenRecordAttributeless({0x10,0x55}, without);
 assert(EdenAttributeless({0x10,0x55}));
 assert(!EdenAttributeless({0x20,0x55}));
 EdenRecordAttributeless({0x20,0x55}, with);
 assert(!EdenAttributeless({0x20,0x55}));
 assert(EdenAttributeless({0x10,0x55}));
 EdenRecordAttributeless({0x30,0x55}, without);
 assert(EdenAttributeless({0x30,0x55}));
 assert(!EdenAttributeless({0x20,0x55}));
 assert(!EdenAttributeless({0x30,0x56}));
 // A memoized negative answer must turn positive after a worker publishes it.
 assert(!EdenAttributeless({0x70,0x88}));
 EdenRecordAttributeless({0x70,0x88}, without);
 assert(EdenAttributeless({0x70,0x88}));
 // Deliberate 64-slot collisions must never reuse a different shader result.
 for(u64 i=0;i<256;++i) {
   const u64 key=0x1000+i*64;
   if((i & 1)==0) EdenRecordAttributeless({key,0x55}, without);
   assert(EdenAttributeless({key,0x55})==((i&1)==0));
 }
 for(u64 i=0;i<256;++i) {
   const u64 key=0x1000+i*64;
   assert(EdenAttributeless({key,0x55})==((i&1)==0));
 }
 // Four colliding shader keys, all built before warmup: no generation
 // change while the hot draw loop alternates among world/HUD variants.
 for(u64 i=0;i<4;++i) EdenRecordAttributeless({0x99000+i*64,0x55}, without);
 const auto before=slow_lookups.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
 for(u64 i=0;i<4;++i) assert(EdenAttributeless({0x99000+i*64,0x55}));
 const auto warmed=slow_lookups.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
 assert(warmed-before<=4);
 for(unsigned j=0;j<20000;++j)
   assert(EdenAttributeless({0x99000+u64(j%4)*64,0x55}));
 assert(slow_lookups.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)==warmed);
 // Positive identities are monotonic: publication of an unrelated shader
 // must not force the same four successful shaders back under the mutex.
 EdenRecordAttributeless({0x12345601,0x7a}, without);
 const auto after_publication=slow_lookups.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
 for(unsigned j=0;j<20000;++j)
   assert(EdenAttributeless({0x99000+u64(j%4)*64,0x55}));
 assert(slow_lookups.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)==after_publication);
 // A negative answer is NOT monotonic; it must be refreshed when a new
 // shader is registered under that exact key after a generation change.
 constexpr EdenVertexIdentity formerly_negative{0x12349876,0x47};
 assert(!EdenAttributeless(formerly_negative));
 const auto neg_warm=slow_lookups.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
 assert(!EdenAttributeless(formerly_negative));
 assert(slow_lookups.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)==neg_warm);
 EdenRecordAttributeless(formerly_negative, without);
 assert(EdenAttributeless(formerly_negative));
 assert(slow_lookups.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)>neg_warm);
 // The fifth colliding key may evict a memo entry, but must not alias a
 // different shader or suppress generation-based invalidation.
 assert(!EdenAttributeless({0x99000+u64{4}*64,0x55}));
 EdenRecordAttributeless({0x99000+u64{4}*64,0x55}, without);
 assert(EdenAttributeless({0x99000+u64{4}*64,0x55}));
 eden_static_vertex_input_bound=true;
 EdenResetStaticVertexInputBinding();
 assert(!eden_static_vertex_input_bound);
 Eden::DevVulkan::static_vertex_input=false;
 Eden::DevVulkan::ResetForTitle();
 assert(Eden::DevVulkan::static_vertex_input);
}
""".replace("__EXACT_HELPER__", start + instrumented_helper)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-vertex-identity-") as folder:
    path = Path(folder)
    src = path / "identity.cpp"
    src.write_text(cpp)
    for opt in ("-O0", "-O2"):
        exe = path / ("identity"+opt)
        subprocess.run([compiler,"-std=c++20",opt,"-g","-pthread","-Wall",
                        "-Wextra","-Werror","-fsanitize=address,undefined",
                        "-fno-sanitize-recover=all","-I",str(root/"headless"),
                        str(src),"-o",str(exe)],check=True,timeout=45)
        subprocess.run([str(exe)],check=True,timeout=30)
```

`tools/check-ps5-virtual-reservation-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
"""Source-extracted CPU virtual-range reservation ownership replay (host only).

Exercises the *actual* wrapper against mocked Sony reserve APIs and real host
mmap/munmap. The PS5 firmware error-output contract remains UNQUALIFIED.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
native = (root / "src/memory_pages.cpp").read_text()
start = native.index("void* ReserveCpuVirtualRange(")
end = native.index("} // namespace", start)
helper = native[start:end]
assert "sceKernelReserveVirtualRange(&address, bytes, 0, alignment)" in helper
assert "if (address != reinterpret_cast<void*>(cpu_mapping_hint)) std::abort();" in helper
assert "if (!cpu_mapping_range(address, bytes))" in helper
assert "munmap(address, bytes) != 0" in helper
compiler = next((name for name in ("clang++-18", "clang++", "g++") if shutil.which(name)), None)
if not compiler:
    raise SystemExit("C++20 compiler required for PS5 VA reservation host gate")

prefix = r"""
#ifndef _GNU_SOURCE
#define _GNU_SOURCE 1
#endif
#include <cassert>
#include <cerrno>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <csignal>
#include <sys/mman.h>
#include <sys/resource.h>
#include <sys/wait.h>
#include <unistd.h>

namespace {
constexpr std::uintptr_t cpu_mapping_hint = 0x1000000000ull;
static int reserve_scenario = 0;
static void* last_mapping = nullptr;
static bool cpu_mapping_range(void* address, std::size_t bytes) {
    return reserve_scenario != 3 && address != nullptr && address != MAP_FAILED &&
           bytes == (2u << 20);
}
static int sceKernelReserveVirtualRange(void** address, std::size_t bytes,
                                         int flags, std::size_t align) {
    assert(address && flags == 0 && bytes == (2u << 20) && align == bytes);
    if (reserve_scenario == 1) return -1; // expected normal unchanged hint
    last_mapping = mmap(nullptr, bytes, PROT_NONE,
                        MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS, -1, 0);
    assert(last_mapping != MAP_FAILED);
    *address = last_mapping;
    return reserve_scenario == 2 ? -1 : 0; // failed but mutated output
}
"""
tail = r"""
} // namespace

int main() {
    constexpr std::size_t page = 2u << 20;
    reserve_scenario = 1;
    assert(ReserveCpuVirtualRange(page, page) == nullptr);
    reserve_scenario = 0;
    void* owned = ReserveCpuVirtualRange(page, page);
    assert(owned && owned == last_mapping);
    assert(munmap(owned, page) == 0);
    // Successful non-CPU-window VA must be released before rejecting it.
    reserve_scenario = 3;
    assert(ReserveCpuVirtualRange(page, page) == nullptr);
    unsigned char resident = 0;
    errno = 0;
    assert(mincore(last_mapping, 4096, &resident) != 0 && errno == ENOMEM);
    // Failed reserve that mutates the output cannot prove alias ownership:
    // fail closed instead of continuing with uncertain address-space state.
    const pid_t child = fork();
    assert(child >= 0);
    if (child == 0) {
        rlimit no_dump{0, 0};
        (void)setrlimit(RLIMIT_CORE, &no_dump);
        reserve_scenario = 2;
        (void)ReserveCpuVirtualRange(page, page);
        _exit(77); // abort expected
    }
    int status = 0;
    assert(waitpid(child, &status, 0) == child);
    assert(WIFSIGNALED(status) && WTERMSIG(status) == SIGABRT);
}
"""
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-ps5-va-") as temporary:
    folder = Path(temporary)
    src, exe = folder / "va.cpp", folder / "va"
    src.write_text(prefix + helper + tail)
    subprocess.run([compiler, "-std=c++20", "-O2", "-Wall", "-Wextra",
                    "-Werror", str(src), "-o", str(exe)], check=True)
    subprocess.run([str(exe)], check=True)
print("PASS: source-extracted native VA wrapper accepts valid ranges, rejects normal failures, cleans invalid addresses, aborts on mutated errors")
print("PS5 firmware VA ABI and real CPU window remain UNTESTED")
```

`tools/check-ps5-vulkan-chunk-allocation-lock-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
"""Vulkan scheduler: source-extracted recycled chunk vs cold allocation lock test.

The slow constructor represents a pageable PS5 host allocation. Its only
purpose is to prove the GPU worker can recycle a chunk concurrently; this
host fixture is NOT an FC27 frame-time or PS5 performance measurement.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
src = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_scheduler.cpp").read_text()
generator = (root / "tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py").read_text()
start = "void Scheduler::AcquireNewChunk() {"
end = "\n} // namespace Vulkan"
assert src.count(start) == 1 and end in src[src.index(start):]
method = src[src.index(start):src.index(end, src.index(start))].rstrip()
assert "chunk_reserve.empty()" in method
assert method.index("std::scoped_lock rl{reserve_mutex};") < method.index("chunk_reserve.back()")
assert method.index("chunk_reserve.pop_back();") < method.index("std::make_unique<CommandChunk>();")
assert "std::make_unique<CommandChunk>();" in method
assert method.count("return;") == 1
assert "The producer can reuse a completed command chunk immediately." in generator
assert "Allocation can page fault or invoke allocator locks." in generator

cpp = r"""
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>
struct CommandChunk {
    static inline std::atomic<bool> block{false};
    static inline std::atomic<bool> entered{false};
    CommandChunk() {
        if (block.load()) {
            entered.store(true);
            while (block.load()) std::this_thread::yield();
        }
    }
};
class Scheduler {
public:
    std::mutex reserve_mutex;
    std::vector<std::unique_ptr<CommandChunk>> chunk_reserve;
    std::unique_ptr<CommandChunk> chunk;
    void AcquireNewChunk();
};
__NATIVE_ACQUIRE__
int main() {
    for (int run=0; run<8; ++run) {
        Scheduler scheduler;
        auto recycled = std::make_unique<CommandChunk>();
        CommandChunk* const recycled_owner = recycled.get();
        CommandChunk::entered.store(false);
        CommandChunk::block.store(true);
        // The producer cannot finish allocation until the fixture releases
        // the simulated allocator. The GPU recycler must remain unblocked.
        std::thread producer([&] { scheduler.AcquireNewChunk(); });
        for (unsigned i=0; i<2000000 && !CommandChunk::entered.load(); ++i)
            std::this_thread::yield();
        assert(CommandChunk::entered.load());
        {
            std::unique_lock<std::mutex> recycle_lock{
                scheduler.reserve_mutex, std::try_to_lock};
            assert(recycle_lock.owns_lock());
            scheduler.chunk_reserve.push_back(std::move(recycled));
        }
        CommandChunk::block.store(false);
        producer.join();
        assert(scheduler.chunk);
        assert(scheduler.chunk_reserve.size()==1);
        scheduler.AcquireNewChunk();
        assert(scheduler.chunk.get()==recycled_owner);
        assert(scheduler.chunk_reserve.empty());
    }
}
""".replace("__NATIVE_ACQUIRE__", method)
compiler = shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
assert compiler, "C++20 compiler required"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-vulkan-chunk-allocation-") as tmp:
    source = Path(tmp) / "chunk.cpp"
    source.write_text(cpp)
    for opt in ("-O0", "-O2"):
        binary = Path(tmp) / ("chunk_" + opt[1:])
        subprocess.run([compiler, "-std=c++20", opt, "-pthread", "-Wall", "-Wextra",
                        "-Werror", "-fsanitize=address,undefined",
                        "-fno-sanitize-recover=all", str(source), "-o", str(binary)],
                       check=True, timeout=50)
        subprocess.run([str(binary)], check=True, timeout=25)
        print(f"VULKAN_CHUNK_ALLOC_OUTSIDE_RECYCLER_PASS {opt} no_worker_stall=1 reuse=1")
print("PS5 allocation latency and FPS not measured")
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""R309: compile the exact C++ Vulkan FlushWork replacement and exercise cadence.

The pinned Eden source used to test its 512-draw ceiling only on the mask's

assert "dev-settings dispatch_draws=8" in main  # documented rollback; 64 still accepted by the full 8..512 parser
assert "draws >= 8 && draws <= 512 && (draws & (draws - 1)) == 0" in main

# Native C++ harness: use the exact generated function body, not a retyped Python model.
cpp = r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
using u32 = std::uint32_t;
struct Scheduler {
    unsigned dispatches{};
    unsigned flushes{};
    void DispatchWork() { ++dispatches; }
    void Flush() { ++flushes; }
};
struct Device {
    Scheduler scheduler{};
    u32 draw_counter{};
    u32 mask{};
    void Step() {
        static constexpr u32 DRAWS_TO_DISPATCH = 512;
        const u32 CHECK_MASK = mask;
__EXACT_BODY__
    }
};
int main() {
    for (const u32 batch : {8u, 16u, 32u, 64u, 128u, 256u, 512u}) {
        Device device{{}, 0u, batch - 1};
        for (u32 i = 1; i <= 2048; ++i) {
            device.Step();
            assert(device.draw_counter < 512);
            assert(device.scheduler.flushes == i / 512);
            assert(device.scheduler.dispatches == (i / 512) * (512 / batch)
                                                + ((i % 512) + 1) / batch);
        }
        std::printf("PASS batch=%u flushes=%u dispatches=%u\n", batch,
                    device.scheduler.flushes, device.scheduler.dispatches);
    }
}
""".replace("__EXACT_BODY__", "\n".join("        " + line for line in new.splitlines()))
```

```py
int main() {
    {

        assert(drains==1 && hazards==0 && mock.layers.size()==2);

'''

def run(label: str, fragment: str, expected: int):
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='eden-layer-lifetime-') as tmp:
        file = Path(tmp) / 'layer.cpp'
        binary = Path(tmp) / 'layer'
        file.write_text(header + fragment + tail)
        env = os.environ.copy()
        if sys.platform == 'darwin' and not env.get('SDKROOT'):
            sdk = Path('/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX15.4.sdk')
            if sdk.exists(): env['SDKROOT'] = str(sdk)
        subprocess.run(['c++', '-std=c++20', '-DPS5_NATIVE', '-O2', '-Wall', '-Wextra', '-Werror',
                        str(file), '-o', str(binary)], check=True, timeout=40, env=env)
        result = subprocess.run([str(binary)], timeout=10, capture_output=True, text=True)
        if expected is None:
            assert result.returncode != 0, (label, 'original branch unexpectedly passed')
            print(label, 'EXPECTED FAIL: released resource while GPU still in flight')
        else:
            assert result.returncode == expected, (label, result.returncode, result.stderr)
            print(label, result.stdout.strip())

# Use NDEBUG-independent checks for the negative control to avoid an abort signal.
run('PS5 fixed:', changed + original_suffix, 0)
# The native branch is precisely the one that lacked a drain. Verify its source ordering.
run('Unfixed pinned:', old + original_suffix, None)
print('PASS R327 negative-control source and corrected branch')
```

`tools/check-ps5-vulkan-layer-max-tick-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
"""Source-extracted Vulkan layer timeline retirement, PS5 and desktop.

A single max tick on a monotonic GPU semaphore retires all earlier layer
resources. Host sanitizers validate nonmonotonic slot order, empty slots and
pitch-only staging replacement. This is not a PS5 latency measurement.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
native = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_present_layer.cpp").read_text()
generator = (root / "tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py").read_text()
def extract(start, end):
    assert native.count(start) == 1, (start, native.count(start))
    return native[native.index(start):native.index(end, native.index(start))].rstrip()
refresh = extract("void Layer::RefreshResources(", "\nvoid Layer::SetAntiAliasPass(")
release = extract("void Layer::ReleaseRawImages() {", "\nu64 Layer::CalculateBufferSize(")
max_tick = "std::max_element(resource_ticks.begin(), resource_ticks.end())"
assert refresh.count(max_tick) == release.count(max_tick) == 1
assert "scheduler.Wait(*last_tick);" in refresh and "scheduler.Wait(*last_tick);" in release
assert refresh.index("scheduler.Wait(*last_tick);") < refresh.index("CreateStagingBuffer(device, framebuffer);")
assert release.index("scheduler.Wait(*last_tick);") < release.index("raw_image_views.clear();")
assert release.index("raw_image_views.clear();") < release.index("raw_images.clear();")
assert "#ifdef PS5_NATIVE" in release and "#else" in release
assert generator.count(max_tick) >= 2
cpp = r"""
#include <algorithm>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <span>
#include <variant>
#include <vector>
using u32=std::uint32_t;
using u64=std::uint64_t;
namespace Tegra {
struct FramebufferConfig { u32 width{},height{},stride{}; int pixel_format{}; };
}
struct Device {
    struct Logical { void WaitIdle() const {++wait_idle_calls;} };
    inline static unsigned wait_idle_calls{};
    const Logical& GetLogical() const {static Logical x; return x;}
};
struct Scheduler {
    std::vector<u64> calls;
    u64 completed_tick{};
    unsigned finishes{};
    void Wait(u64 tick) { calls.push_back(tick); completed_tick=std::max(completed_tick,tick); }
    void Finish() { ++finishes; }
};
struct AA {};
struct Buffer {
    std::vector<unsigned char> bytes;
    std::span<unsigned char> Mapped() {return bytes;}
    void reset(){bytes.clear();}
};
class Layer {
public:
    u32 raw_width{},raw_height{};
    int pixel_format{};
    std::vector<int> raw_images,raw_image_views;
    std::vector<u64> resource_ticks;
    std::variant<std::monostate,AA> anti_alias;
    Buffer buffer;
    Scheduler scheduler;
    std::size_t image_count{6};
    unsigned allocations{};
    std::size_t CalculateBufferSize(const Tegra::FramebufferConfig& fb) const {
        return static_cast<std::size_t>(fb.stride)*fb.height*4*image_count;
    }
    void CreateStagingBuffer(const Device&,const Tegra::FramebufferConfig& fb) {
        buffer.bytes.resize(CalculateBufferSize(fb));++allocations;
    }
    void CreateRawImages(const Device&,const Tegra::FramebufferConfig&) {
        raw_images.assign(image_count,1);raw_image_views.assign(image_count,1);
    }
    void ReleaseRawImages();
    void RefreshResources(const Device&,const Tegra::FramebufferConfig&);
};
__RELEASE__
__REFRESH__
int main() {
    Device device;
    Layer layer;
    Tegra::FramebufferConfig fb{640,360,704,1};
    layer.RefreshResources(device,fb);
    assert(layer.allocations==1 && layer.raw_images.size()==6);
    layer.anti_alias.emplace<AA>();
    // Frame-ring slots are not in tick order. Waiting for 8 must retire
    // every resource (3,0,8,2,8,1), even if the last slot is older.
    layer.resource_ticks={3,0,8,2,8,1};
    layer.scheduler.calls.clear();
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    fb.stride=768;
    layer.RefreshResources(device,fb);
    assert(layer.allocations==2);
    assert(std::holds_alternative<AA>(layer.anti_alias));
    assert(layer.scheduler.calls.size()==1 && layer.scheduler.calls[0]==8);
    for(const u64 tick:layer.resource_ticks)
        assert(tick<=layer.scheduler.completed_tick);
    assert(layer.scheduler.finishes==0 && Device::wait_idle_calls==0);
    assert(layer.buffer.Mapped().size()==layer.CalculateBufferSize(fb));
    layer.scheduler.calls.clear();
    layer.ReleaseRawImages();
    assert(layer.scheduler.calls.size()==1 && layer.scheduler.calls[0]==8);
#else
    layer.ReleaseRawImages();
    assert(layer.scheduler.calls==layer.resource_ticks);
#endif
    assert(layer.raw_images.empty() && layer.raw_image_views.empty());
    assert(layer.buffer.Mapped().empty());
    layer.resource_ticks.clear();
    layer.scheduler.calls.clear();
    layer.ReleaseRawImages();
    assert(layer.scheduler.calls.empty());
    layer.resource_ticks={0,0,0};
    layer.ReleaseRawImages();
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(layer.scheduler.calls.empty());
#else
    assert(layer.scheduler.calls.size()==3);
#endif
}
""".replace("__RELEASE__",release).replace("__REFRESH__",refresh)
compiler=shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
assert compiler,"Host C++20 compiler required"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-layer-max-tick-") as td:
    path=Path(td)/"layer.cpp"
    path.write_text(cpp)
    for mode,defines in (("PS5",["-DPS5_NATIVE=1"]),("desktop",[])):
        for opt in ("-O0","-O2"):
            binary=Path(td)/f"{mode}_{opt[1:]}"
            subprocess.run([compiler,"-std=c++20",opt,"-pthread","-Wall","-Wextra",
                            "-Werror","-fsanitize=address,undefined",
                            "-fno-sanitize-recover=all",*defines,str(path),"-o",str(binary)],
                           check=True,timeout=55)
            subprocess.run([str(binary)],check=True,timeout=20)
            print(f"F07_VULKAN_LAYER_MAX_TICK_PASS mode={mode} opt={opt} source=1")
print("HOST-ONLY: PS5 frame times and output not verified")
```

`tools/check-ps5-vulkan-missing-raw-tiled-size-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
"""PS5 raw missing-frame path avoids unused tiled-size calculation.

C++ source-extracted raw staging operation exercises zeroing, guest return,
mapped-size arithmetic and mandatory flush on both native and desktop.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SOURCE=(ROOT/"vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_present_layer.cpp").read_text()
GEN=(ROOT/"tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py").read_text()
start="#ifdef PS5_NATIVE\n    // An unmapped guest framebuffer has no tiled source to measure."
end="    buffer.Flush();  // Both the upload and missing-memory clear need visibility."
assert SOURCE.count(start)==1 and SOURCE.count(end)==1

assert segment.count("Tegra::Texture::CalculateSize(")==2
assert segment.count("Tegra::Texture::UnswizzleTexture(")==1

cpp=r"""
#include <algorithm>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <span>
#include <vector>
using u8=std::uint8_t;
using u32=std::uint32_t;
using u64=std::uint64_t;
struct Framebuffer { u32 stride{4},width{4},height{4}; };
namespace Tegra::Texture {
inline unsigned tiled_size_calls{};
inline unsigned unswizzles{};
u64 CalculateSize(bool, u32,u32,u32,u32,u32,u32) {
    ++tiled_size_calls;return 64;
}
void UnswizzleTexture(std::span<u8> dst,std::span<const u8> src,
                      u32,u32,u32,u32,u32,u32) {
    ++unswizzles;
    assert(dst.size()==src.size());
    std::copy(src.begin(),src.end(),dst.begin());
}
}
struct Buffer { unsigned flushes{};void Flush(){++flushes;} };
void ReplayFrame(std::span<u8> mapped_span,const u8* host_ptr,
                 Framebuffer framebuffer,Buffer& buffer) {
    constexpr u32 block_height_log2=4;
    const u32 bytes_per_pixel=4;
    const u64 linear_size=64;
    const u64 image_offset=8;
__NATIVE_RAW_OPERATION__
}
int main() {
    std::vector<u8> raw(80,0xCC), guest(64,0x7F);
    std::span<u8> mapped_span(raw);
    Framebuffer fb;
    Buffer buffer;
    for (int i=0;i<100;++i) {
        raw.assign(80,0xEE);
        ReplayFrame(mapped_span,nullptr,fb,buffer);
        assert(std::all_of(raw.begin()+8,raw.begin()+72,[](u8 b){return b==0;}));
        assert(raw[7]==0xEE && raw[72]==0xEE);
    }
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(Tegra::Texture::tiled_size_calls==0);
#else
    assert(Tegra::Texture::tiled_size_calls==100);
#endif
    ReplayFrame(mapped_span,guest.data(),fb,buffer);
    assert(std::equal(raw.begin()+8,raw.begin()+72,guest.begin()));
    assert(Tegra::Texture::unswizzles==1);
    for (int i=0;i<100;++i) {
        ReplayFrame(mapped_span,nullptr,fb,buffer);
        assert(std::all_of(raw.begin()+8,raw.begin()+72,[](u8 b){return b==0;}));
    }
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(Tegra::Texture::tiled_size_calls==1);
#else
    assert(Tegra::Texture::tiled_size_calls==201);
#endif
    assert(buffer.flushes==201);
```

`tools/check-ps5-vulkan-oom-source.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""F07: verify the shipping PS5 allocator emits allocation-specific OOM evidence.

This deliberately checks the actual fork staged by CMake, not a source snippet
that is absent from the native binary. Runtime memory data remains console-only.
"""
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
cmake = (root / "headless/vulkan.cmake").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
original = (root / "vendor/sources/eden/src/video_core/vulkan_common/vulkan_memory_allocator.cpp").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
fork = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_memory_allocator.cpp").read_text(encoding="utf-8")

assert 'vulkan_common/vulkan_memory_allocator.cpp' in cmake
assert '"${PORT_BUILD_DIR}/vulkan_memory_allocator.cpp"' in cmake
assert 'file(COPY "${EDEN_ACTIVE_VULKAN}/" DESTINATION "${PORT_BUILD_DIR}")' in cmake
assert 'vk::Check(vmaCreateImage(' in original  # upstream pinned unchanged

def valid(source: str) -> bool:
    begin = source.index("vk::Image MemoryAllocator::CreateImage(")
    # The generic sparse allocator is a separate, independently tested API.
    marker = "vk::Image MemoryAllocator::CreateSparseImage("
    end = source.index(marker, begin) if marker in source else (
        source.index("vk::Buffer MemoryAllocator::CreateBuffer(", begin))
    f = source[begin:end]
    contract = (
        "VMA_ALLOCATION_CREATE_WITHIN_BUDGET_BIT" in f
        and "const VkResult result = vmaCreateImage(" in f
        and "#ifdef PS5_NATIVE" in f
        and "result == VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DEVICE_MEMORY" in f
        and "result == VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_HOST_MEMORY" in f
        and 'EDEN_VULKAN_IMAGE_ALLOC_FAILED' in f
        and 'EDEN_VULKAN_IMAGE_HEAP' in f
        and "ci.extent.width, ci.extent.height, ci.extent.depth" in f
        and "ci.mipLevels, ci.arrayLayers" in f
        and "vmaGetHeapBudgets(allocator, budgets.data())" in f
        and "std::fflush(stderr)" in f
        and "vk::Check(result);" in f
        and "vmaAllocateMemory(" not in f
    )
    if not contract:
        return False
    return (f.index("vmaCreateImage(") < f.index("if (result == VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DEVICE_MEMORY")
            < f.index("vmaGetHeapBudgets(") < f.index("std::fflush(stderr)")
            < f.index("vk::Check(result);"))

# Sparse APIs are separately checked against their maintained vendor owners.
# Reverse these additive methods exactly before the pinned OOM-source oracle.
# This is a stronger oracle than generic source/token assertions.
reconstructed = fork.replace("#include <array>\n#include <cstdio>\n", "")
# NS2's sparse allocation methods exist only under an explicit research
# compile gate. Reverse the WHOLE guarded block, not just the methods: a
# dangling preprocessor guard would invalidate the strict F07 source witness.
guard = "#ifdef EDEN_NS2_SPARSE_CACHE_PROBE\n"
tail_guard = "#endif // EDEN_NS2_SPARSE_CACHE_PROBE\n\n"
# Validate BOTH possible tracked vendor layouts: a complete guarded research
# sparse block, or the release allocator with NO sparse methods. An incomplete
# research block must fail; normal F07 source parity remains exact below.
sparse_methods = (
    "vk::Image MemoryAllocator::CreateSparseImage(",
    "bool MemoryAllocator::AllocateSparseMemory(",
    "void MemoryAllocator::ReleaseSparseMemory(",
)
if guard in reconstructed or tail_guard in reconstructed:
    assert reconstructed.count(guard) == reconstructed.count(tail_guard) == 1
    start_sparse = reconstructed.index(guard)
    method_start = reconstructed.index(sparse_methods[0], start_sparse)
    assert method_start == start_sparse + len(guard)
    end_sparse = reconstructed.index("vk::Buffer MemoryAllocator::CreateBuffer(", method_start)
    assert reconstructed[end_sparse-len(tail_guard):end_sparse] == tail_guard
    added_sparse = reconstructed[method_start:end_sparse-len(tail_guard)]
    for method in sparse_methods:
        assert added_sparse.count(method) == 1
    assert "VMA_ALLOCATION_CREATE_WITHIN_BUDGET_BIT" in added_sparse
    assert "if (!device.IsSparseResidencyImage2DSupported()" in added_sparse
    assert "vmaFreeMemory(allocator, allocation)" in added_sparse
    reconstructed = reconstructed[:start_sparse] + reconstructed[end_sparse:]
else:
    assert all(method not in reconstructed for method in sparse_methods)
    assert "EDEN_NS2_SPARSE_CACHE_PROBE" not in reconstructed

start = reconstructed.index("    const VkResult result = vmaCreateImage(")
end = reconstructed.index("    vk::Check(result);", start) + len("    vk::Check(result);")
upstream_call = "    vk::Check(vmaCreateImage(allocator, &ci, &alloc_ci, &handle, &allocation, &alloc_info));"
reconstructed = reconstructed[:start] + upstream_call + reconstructed[end:]
assert reconstructed == original, "native allocator diverges from pinned upstream outside F07 diagnostic"

assert valid(fork), "F07 native OOM allocation proof missing"
assert not valid(fork.replace("vk::Check(result);", "// missing exception"))
assert not valid(fork.replace("#ifdef PS5_NATIVE", "// missing PS5 guard"))
assert not valid(fork.replace("vmaGetHeapBudgets(allocator, budgets.data())", "// removed budgets"))
print("PASS F07: production VMA image OOM emits exact image and heap evidence before exception")
```

`tools/check-ps5-vulkan-present-submit-contention.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
"""Prove shared native Vulkan submit lock couples WSI present to GPU submission.

This is a source-anchored C++ scheduling counterexample with a MOCK blocking
WSI: NOT evidence that RADV actually blocks 130ms in FC27. Vulkan VkQueue
host external synchronization must be preserved, especially when the
graphics and presentation queue handles refer to the same VkQueue.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
swap=(root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_swapchain.cpp").read_text()
scheduler=(root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_scheduler.cpp").read_text()
device=(root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_device.cpp").read_text()
s=swap[swap.index("void Swapchain::Present(VkSemaphore render_semaphore) {"):]
s=s[:s.index("\nbool Swapchain::")]
b=s.index("std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock{scheduler.submit_mutex, std::defer_lock};")
assert "if (device.GetGraphicsFamily() == device.GetPresentFamily()) lock.lock();" in s
assert "std::scoped_lock lock{scheduler.submit_mutex};" not in s
assert s.count("scheduler.submit_mutex") == 1  # no hidden second presenter lock
assert "if (device.GetGraphicsFamily() == device.GetPresentFamily()) lock.lock();" in (root/"tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py").read_text()
a=s.index("present_queue.Present(present_info)")
assert b<a
worker=scheduler[scheduler.index("u64 Scheduler::SubmitExecution("):]
worker=worker[:worker.index("\nvoid Scheduler::",5)]
assert worker.index("std::scoped_lock lock{submit_mutex};") < worker.index("master_semaphore->SubmitQueue(")
assert "graphics_queue = logical.GetQueue(graphics_family);" in device
assert "present_queue = logical.GetQueue(present_family);" in device
assert "::Common::unordered_set<u32> unique_queue_families{graphics_family, present_family};" in device
assert ".queueCount = 1," in device
# It is UNSAFE to just strip the mutex: both operations can use the same
# Vulkan VkQueue when graphics_family == present_family.
src=r"""
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdio>
#include <latch>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>
using Clock=std::chrono::steady_clock;
using namespace std::chrono_literals;
double Ms(Clock::time_point a,Clock::time_point b) {
  return std::chrono::duration<double,std::milli>(b-a).count();
}
struct Result {double submit_delay_ms;unsigned long long independent_ipc;};
Result Run(unsigned mock_wsi_block_ms,bool same_queue){
    std::mutex submit_mutex;
    std::latch present_entered{1};
    std::atomic<bool> running{true};
    std::atomic<unsigned long long> independent_ipc{0};
    std::thread guest_ipc([&]{
      while(running.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)){
        independent_ipc.fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_relaxed);
        std::this_thread::yield();
      }
    });
    std::thread present([&]{
      // Stand-in for the actual Swapchain::Present's RAII critical section.
      std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock{submit_mutex,std::defer_lock};
      if(same_queue) lock.lock();
      present_entered.count_down();
      std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(mock_wsi_block_ms));
    });
    present_entered.wait();
    const auto before=Clock::now();
    std::thread gpu_submit([&]{
      // Same RAII lock as actual Scheduler::SubmitExecution.
      std::scoped_lock lock{submit_mutex};
    });
    gpu_submit.join();
    const auto elapsed=Ms(before,Clock::now());
    present.join();
    running.store(false,std::memory_order_relaxed);
    guest_ipc.join();
    return {elapsed,independent_ipc.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)};
}
int main(){
  const auto normal=Run(5,true);
  const auto hitch=Run(130,true);
  const auto hard_stall=Run(350,true);
  const auto separate=Run(350,false);
  std::printf("MOCK_WSI 5ms gpu_submit_wait=%.2fms ipc=%llu\n",
              normal.submit_delay_ms,normal.independent_ipc);
  std::printf("MOCK_WSI 130ms gpu_submit_wait=%.2fms ipc=%llu\n",
              hitch.submit_delay_ms,hitch.independent_ipc);
  std::printf("MOCK_WSI 350ms gpu_submit_wait=%.2fms ipc=%llu\n",
              hard_stall.submit_delay_ms,hard_stall.independent_ipc);
  assert(hitch.submit_delay_ms>90);
  assert(hard_stall.submit_delay_ms>275);
  assert(separate.submit_delay_ms<200);
  assert(separate.submit_delay_ms<hard_stall.submit_delay_ms*0.7);
  assert(hitch.independent_ipc>0 && hard_stall.independent_ipc>0);
  std::puts("PASS: same-queue WSI lock maintained, cross-family GPU submit independent");
}
"""
compiler=shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
assert compiler,"Host C++20 compiler required"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-vulkan-present-submit-lock-") as tmp:
    source=Path(tmp)/"mutex.cpp";exe=Path(tmp)/"mutex"
    source.write_text(src)
    subprocess.run([compiler,"-std=c++20","-O2","-pthread","-Wall","-Wextra",
                    "-Werror",str(source),"-o",str(exe)],check=True,timeout=40)
    subprocess.run([str(exe)],check=True,timeout=8)
print("CONSTRAINT: independent queue benefit requires distinct Vulkan queue families; native WSI unmeasured")
```

`tools/check-ps5-vulkan-texture-tu-syntax-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compile the REAL PS5/NS1/NS2 Vulkan texture cache owner, host-only.

Unlike the extracted F07 math tests, this verifies that the production TU
actually parses with all active pinned shader/cache/Boost/Vulkan interfaces.
No PS5 ELF, host object, native shader, CI poll or GPU command is generated.

On an Apple Silicon developer host, SDK 26.5 headers are deliberately used
because older macOS command-line libc++ omits std::stop_token/std::jthread.
The tiny builtin alias is syntax-only to permit the x86 pause intrinsic in
an arm64 parse; it does not modify the production owner or emit machine code.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import os
import platform
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OWNER = ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vk_texture_cache_cost.cpp"

def require_file(path: Path) -> Path:
    assert path.is_file(), f"Missing pinned Vulkan owner/dependency: {path}"
    return path

def require_dir(path: Path) -> Path:
    assert path.is_dir(), f"Missing pinned Vulkan include directory: {path}"
    return path

def run() -> None:
    require_file(OWNER)
    source = OWNER.read_text()
    required = (
        "const bool dual_planes = src_both && dst_both;",
        "from_stencil.imageSubresource.aspectMask = VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_STENCIL_BIT;",
        "to_stencil.bufferOffset = scratch_used + plane_bytes;",
        "scratch_used += plane_bytes * (dual_planes ? 2U : 1U);",
        "VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, vk_out_copies);",
    )
    for marker in required:
        assert marker in source, f"Missing maintained owner: {marker}"
    for workflow in ("encore-core-fast-gate.yml", "encore-core-preflight.yml"):
        contents = (ROOT / ".github/workflows" / workflow).read_text()
        assert ("python3 -B tools/check-ps5-vulkan-texture-tu-syntax-host.py"
                in contents), f"Missing full Vulkan texture TU gate in {workflow}"

    cxx = (shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++"))
    assert cxx, "A real Clang C++20 host compiler is required"
    pinned = ROOT / "vendor/sources/eden-cpm"
    includes = [
        ROOT / "headless",
        # Select the reviewed, byte-diff-pinned hygiene header instead of
        # the immutable upstream [[nodiscard]] void declaration (Clang warning).
        ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/eden-header-hygiene/include",
        ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/include",
        ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/ns2-astc/include",
        ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/ns2-helpers/include",
        ROOT / "vendor/sources/eden/src",
        pinned / "vulkanheaders/v1.4.345/include",
        pinned / "vulkanmemoryallocator/v3.3.0/include",
        pinned / "fmt/12.1.0/include",
        pinned / "sirit/v1.0.5/include",
        pinned / "spirv-headers/vulkan-sdk-1.4.341.0/include",
    ]
    boost = pinned / "boost/boost-1.90.0/libs"
    require_dir(boost)
    boost_modules = sorted(boost.glob("*/include"))
    assert len(boost_modules) >= 90, "Incomplete pinned modular Boost headers"
    includes.extend(boost_modules)
    for inc in includes:
        require_dir(inc)
    command = [
        cxx, "-std=c++20", "-O0", "-fsyntax-only",
        *[f"-I{inc}" for inc in includes],
    ]
    environment = os.environ.copy()
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-vk-owner-syntax-") as folder:
        if platform.system() == "Darwin":
            # Use a CLT SDK with C++20 stop_token support; no developer or
            # toolkit system headers are copied into the deliverable.
            sdks = [
                Path("/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX26.5.sdk"),
                Path("/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX27.0.sdk"),
            ]
            sdk = next((candidate for candidate in sdks
                        if (candidate / "usr/include/c++/v1/__thread/jthread.h").is_file()), None)
            assert sdk is not None, "macOS 26.5+ libc++ SDK needed for real C++20 owner parse"
            environment["SDKROOT"] = str(sdk)
            shim = Path(folder) / "arm64-pause-syntax.h"
            shim.write_text(
                "#pragma once\n"
                "#ifdef __aarch64__\n"
                "#ifndef __builtin_ia32_pause\n"
                '#define __builtin_ia32_pause() __asm__ __volatile__("yield")\n'
                "#endif\n#endif\n")
            command += [
                "-target", "arm64-apple-macos15", "-nostdinc++",
                "-isystem", str(sdk / "usr/include/c++/v1"),
                "-include", str(shim),
            ]

        modes = [
            ("desktop_ns1", []),
            ("native_shared_ps5", ["-DPS5_NATIVE=1"]),
            # Research-only N73 must compile only with the separately pinned
            # N72 scheduler bridge. Both remain OFF in the release profile.
            ("native_research_sparse_syntax_only", [
                "-DPS5_NATIVE=1",
                "-DEDEN_NS2_ASTC_LAYER_DECODE=1",
                "-DEDEN_NS2_SPARSE_CACHE_PROBE=1",
                "-DEDEN_NS2_SPARSE_QUEUE_BRIDGE=1",
                "-DEDEN_NS2_VIEW_DIMENSION_GUARD=1",
            ]),
        ]
        for mode, flags in modes:
            cmd = command + flags + [str(OWNER)]
            result = subprocess.run(
                cmd, cwd=ROOT, env=environment, capture_output=True,
                text=True, timeout=100,
            )
            if result.returncode:
                raise AssertionError(
                    f"Real Vulkan TU syntax failed for {mode}:\n"
                    + result.stdout[-2000:] + result.stderr[-8000:]
                )
            print(f"F07_REAL_VULKAN_TEXTURE_TU_PASS mode={mode} "
                  "owner=maintained pinned_dependencies=1 syntax_only=1")
    print("P2_2C_REAL_TEXTURE_CACHE_OWNER_HOST_PASS "
          "desktop_ns1=1 native_ps5=1 research_interface_only=1 "
          "gpu_execution=NOT_TESTED")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    run()
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""R357: native Vulkan Scheduler drain notifications, exact-source host fixture."""
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import shutil
import tempfile
import ast

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
header = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/include/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_scheduler.h").read_text()
source = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_scheduler.cpp").read_text()
generator = (root / "tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py").read_text()
ast.parse(generator)
assert "unsigned queue_drain_waiters{};" in header
assert "bool worker_in_flight{};" in header
assert "wake_worker = work_queue.empty() && !worker_in_flight;" in source
assert "if (wake_worker) event_cv.notify_all();" in source
assert "worker_in_flight = false;" in source and "worker_in_flight = true;" in source
assert "bool worker_in_flight{};" in generator
assert "wake_worker = work_queue.empty() && !worker_in_flight;" in generator
assert "++queue_drain_waiters;" in source
assert "--queue_drain_waiters;" in source
assert "if (work_queue.empty() && queue_drain_waiters != 0)" in source
assert "event_cv.notify_all();" in source
assert "queue_drain_waiters" in generator
# Capture the actual production WaitWorker body and queue-pop lambda rather
# than silently testing a separately retyped version.
wait_start = source.index("void Scheduler::WaitWorker() {")
wait_end = source.index("\nvoid Scheduler::DispatchWork()", wait_start)
native_wait = source[wait_start:wait_end]
worker_start = source.index("    const auto TryPopQueue{[this](auto& work) -> bool {")
worker_end = source.index("\n    while (!stop_token.stop_requested())", worker_start)
native_pop = source[worker_start:worker_end]
dispatch_start = source.index("void Scheduler::DispatchWork() {")
dispatch_end = source.index("\nvoid Scheduler::BeginRenderPassImpl(", dispatch_start)
native_dispatch = source[dispatch_start:dispatch_end]
cpp = r"""
#include <array>
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <chrono>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <future>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
#include <queue>
#include <stop_token>
#include <utility>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>
#include <cstdio>
using namespace std::chrono_literals;
struct CommandChunk {
    unsigned sequence;
    bool Empty() const { return false; }
};
struct MeasuredCV {
    std::condition_variable_any cv;
    std::atomic<unsigned> notifications{0};
    void notify_all() { notifications.fetch_add(1); cv.notify_all(); }
    template<class Lock, class Predicate>
    void wait(Lock& lock, Predicate&& predicate) {
        cv.wait(lock, std::forward<Predicate>(predicate));
    }
    template<class Lock, class Predicate>
    bool wait(Lock& lock, std::stop_token token, Predicate&& predicate) {
        return cv.wait(lock, token, std::forward<Predicate>(predicate));
    }
};
class Scheduler {
public:
    std::queue<std::unique_ptr<CommandChunk>> work_queue;
    std::mutex queue_mutex, execution_mutex;
    MeasuredCV event_cv;
    unsigned queue_drain_waiters{};
    bool worker_in_flight{};
    std::unique_ptr<CommandChunk> chunk;
    std::atomic<bool> pause_worker{false};
    std::atomic<bool> worker_paused{false};
    std::atomic<unsigned> executed{0};
    std::atomic<unsigned> empty_notifications{0};
    std::jthread worker;
    Scheduler() : worker([this](std::stop_token token) { WorkerThread(token); }) {}
    ~Scheduler() {
        worker.request_stop();
        event_cv.notify_all();
        worker.join();
    }
    void AcquireNewChunk() { chunk.reset(); }
    void DispatchWork();
    void WaitWorker();
    void Enqueue(unsigned sequence) {
        assert(!chunk);
        chunk = std::make_unique<CommandChunk>(CommandChunk{sequence});
        DispatchWork();
    }
    void WorkerThread(std::stop_token stop_token) {
__NATIVE_POP__
        while (!stop_token.stop_requested()) {
            std::unique_ptr<CommandChunk> work;
            { std::unique_lock lock{queue_mutex};
              worker_in_flight = false;
              event_cv.wait(lock, stop_token, [&] { return TryPopQueue(work); });
              if (stop_token.stop_requested()) return;
              worker_in_flight = true;
            }
            { std::lock_guard lock{execution_mutex};
              if (pause_worker.load()) {
                  worker_paused.store(true);
                  while (pause_worker.load()) std::this_thread::yield();
              }
              assert(work->sequence == executed.fetch_add(1));
            }
        }
    }
};
__NATIVE_WAIT__
__NATIVE_DISPATCH__
int main() {
    Scheduler scheduler;
    constexpr unsigned rounds = 100, each = 40;
    for (unsigned batch = 0; batch < rounds; ++batch) {
        for (unsigned i=0; i<each; ++i) scheduler.Enqueue(batch*each + i);
        // WaitWorker can start while the worker is actively popping.
        auto completion = std::async(std::launch::async,
                                     [&] { scheduler.WaitWorker(); });
        assert(completion.wait_for(4s) == std::future_status::ready);
        completion.get();
        assert(scheduler.executed.load() == (batch+1)*each);
    }
    // Real native WaitWorker body under overlapping guest sync demand:
    // three independent waiters must all observe the same queue drain,
    // including when the last queued work is already executing.
    for (unsigned wave=0; wave<64; ++wave) {
        for (unsigned i=0; i<64; ++i) scheduler.Enqueue(rounds*each + wave*64 + i);
        std::array<std::future<void>, 3> waiters;
        for (auto& waiter : waiters) {
            waiter = std::async(std::launch::async, [&] { scheduler.WaitWorker(); });
        }
        for (auto& waiter : waiters) {
            assert(waiter.wait_for(4s) == std::future_status::ready);
            waiter.get();
        }
        assert(scheduler.executed.load() == rounds*each + (wave+1)*64);
    }
    // Deterministic burst while the Vulkan worker is executing a chunk:
    // its queue can be empty but it is NOT sleeping on event_cv. Avoid
    // waking drain waiters or broadcasting for each queued successor.
    scheduler.pause_worker.store(true);
    const unsigned before_burst = rounds*each + 64*64;
    scheduler.Enqueue(before_burst);
    for (unsigned spin = 0; spin < 1000000 && !scheduler.worker_paused.load(); ++spin)
        std::this_thread::yield();
    assert(scheduler.worker_paused.load());
    const unsigned wake_before = scheduler.event_cv.notifications.load();
    for (unsigned i = 1; i <= 64; ++i) scheduler.Enqueue(before_burst+i);
    assert(scheduler.event_cv.notifications.load() == wake_before);
    scheduler.pause_worker.store(false);
    scheduler.WaitWorker();
    assert(scheduler.executed.load() == before_burst + 65);
    // WaitWorker must also return when queue already empty, without notification.
    scheduler.WaitWorker();
    assert(scheduler.queue_drain_waiters == 0);
    std::puts("PASS: real WaitWorker exact source, 4000 base tasks + 4096 competing three-waiter tasks, FIFO, no missed wakeups");
}
""".replace("__NATIVE_POP__", native_pop).replace("__NATIVE_WAIT__", native_wait).replace("__NATIVE_DISPATCH__", native_dispatch)
compiler = shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
assert compiler, "C++20 compiler required"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-r357-worker-") as tmp:
    path = Path(tmp) / "worker.cpp"
    exe = Path(tmp) / "worker"
    path.write_text(cpp)
    subprocess.run([compiler, "-std=c++20", "-O1", "-pthread",
                    "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror", str(path), "-o", str(exe)],
                   check=True)
    subprocess.run([str(exe)], timeout=30, check=True)
print("Vulkan worker stop-notify remains unconditional; queue drain wakeups are conditional")
```

`tools/check-ps5-worker-lifetime-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
"""Host replay of native worker registration destructor and stale-ID protection.

Extracts the real WorkerRegistration C++ source; does not run a PS5 title or
prove the kernel signal-vs-teardown race is absent.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
perf = (root / "headless/performance.cpp").read_text()
begin = perf.index("struct WorkerRegistration {")
end = perf.index("thread_local WorkerRegistration owned_worker;", begin)
body = perf[begin:end + len("thread_local WorkerRegistration owned_worker;")]
assert "if (entry.registered && pthread_equal(entry.thread, owner))" in body
assert "entry.registered = false;" in body
assert "std::lock_guard lock(workers_mutex)" in body
compiler = next((name for name in ("clang++-18", "clang++", "g++") if shutil.which(name)), None)
if not compiler:
    raise SystemExit("C++20 compiler required for source-extracted worker exit test")
prefix = r"""
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <future>
#include <mutex>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <thread>
#include <string_view>

namespace Eden::Performance {
namespace {
constexpr std::array names{"CPUCore_0", "CPUCore_1", "CPUCore_2", "CPUCore_3",
                           "GPU", "HostTiming", "VSyncThread"};
struct Worker { pthread_t thread{}; bool registered = false; };
std::mutex workers_mutex;
std::array<Worker, names.size()> workers;
"""
suffix = r"""
} // namespace
} // namespace Eden::Performance

int main() {
    using namespace Eden::Performance;
    // Thread exit must clear its own worker slot.
    std::thread first([] {
        owned_worker.owner = pthread_self();
        owned_worker.index = 4;
        std::lock_guard lock(workers_mutex);
        workers[4] = Worker{pthread_self(), true};
    });
    first.join();
    assert(!workers[4].registered);

    // Owner A exits after owner B has registered into the same slot.
    // A's stale TLS cleanup must not clear B's current identity.
    std::promise<void> first_ready, second_ready;
    std::promise<void> let_first_exit, let_second_exit;
    auto first_wait = let_first_exit.get_future();
    auto second_wait = let_second_exit.get_future();
    std::thread old([&] {
        owned_worker.owner = pthread_self();
        owned_worker.index = 4;
        {
            std::lock_guard lock(workers_mutex);
            workers[4] = Worker{pthread_self(), true};
        }
        first_ready.set_value();
        first_wait.wait();
    });
    first_ready.get_future().wait();
    std::thread newer([&] {
        owned_worker.owner = pthread_self();
        owned_worker.index = 4;
        {
            std::lock_guard lock(workers_mutex);
            workers[4] = Worker{pthread_self(), true};
        }
        second_ready.set_value();
        second_wait.wait();
    });
    second_ready.get_future().wait();
    let_first_exit.set_value();
    old.join();
    assert(workers[4].registered);
    let_second_exit.set_value();
    newer.join();
    assert(!workers[4].registered);
}
"""
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-worker-exit-") as temporary:
    folder = Path(temporary)
    src, exe = folder / "worker.cpp", folder / "worker"
    src.write_text(prefix + body + suffix)
    subprocess.run([compiler, "-std=c++20", "-O2", "-pthread", "-Wall",
                    "-Wextra", "-Werror", str(src), "-o", str(exe)], check=True)
    subprocess.run([str(exe)], check=True)
print("PASS: actual worker TLS exit clears its slot, never clears a newer thread owner")
print("PS5 kernel pthread reuse/signal race and firmware build remain UNTESTED")
```

`tools/check-python-source-syntax.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
"""Fail before expensive PS5 setup if any in-tree Python source is unparseable.

Python's ast.parse compiles no C++, imports no project modules, executes no
scripts and writes no pyc files. This protects template/generator scripts too:
a C++ // comment outside a triple-quoted replacement broke Vulkan generation.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import ast
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sources = sorted(
    set((root / "tools").rglob("*.py")) | set((root / "headless").rglob("*.py"))
)
count = 0
for path in sources:
    # No dependencies, cache or hidden directories; only authored repo source.
    if any(part.startswith(".") for part in path.relative_to(root).parts):
        continue
    try:
        ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), filename=str(path.relative_to(root)))
    except (SyntaxError, UnicodeError) as error:
        raise SystemExit(f"Python syntax invalid in {path.relative_to(root)}: {error}") from error
    count += 1
assert count > 0, "source Python inventory is empty"
print(f"PYTHON_SOURCE_SYNTAX_PASS files={count}")

```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Check actual pinned/maintained GS dropped-draw blocks under Clang sanitizers."""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil

#include <cassert>
using uint=unsigned int;
#define global
struct Vertex{std::uintptr_t output_buffer{};};
struct Geometry{uint *count_buffer{},*output_index_buffer{};};
struct Draw{std::uintptr_t ro_sink{0x1000};};
int main(){
    Vertex v{};Geometry g{};Draw d{};
    [[maybe_unused]] auto* vp=&v;
    [[maybe_unused]] auto* p=&g;

    uint vertex_count=10,instance_count=3;
    __BLOCK__
    assert(vertex_count==0 && instance_count==0);

    assert(v.output_buffer==0 && g.count_buffer==nullptr && g.output_index_buffer==nullptr);

    assert(reinterpret_cast<std::uintptr_t>(g.count_buffer)==0x1000);
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""R399 source-backed Mesa immutable sampler lifetime with ASan/UBSan proof.

Source/replay equivalence and extracted C copy/advance test are useful
regressions; they do not establish FC27 runtime usage or native PS5 results.
"""
from pathlib import Path
from radv_official_immutable_sampler_fix import patch_c, patch_h
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
BASE = ROOT/'vendor/sources/ps5-mesa/src/amd/vulkan'
ACTIVE = ROOT/'vendor/encore-active/ps5-mesa/src/amd/vulkan'
NAMES = ('radv_descriptor_update_template.c', 'radv_descriptor_update_template.h')
base_c, base_h = ((BASE/n).read_text() for n in NAMES)
active_c, active_h = ((ACTIVE/n).read_text() for n in NAMES)
assert patch_c(base_c) == active_c
assert patch_h(base_h) == active_h
assert 'const uint32_t *immutable_samplers;' in base_h
assert 'const uint8_t *immutable_samplers;' in active_h
assert active_c.count('immutable_sampler_count += entry->descriptorCount;') == 1
assert active_c.count('memcpy(immutable_samplers_data, src_samplers, entry->descriptorCount * RADV_SAMPLER_DESC_SIZE);') == 1
assert active_c.count('templ->entry[i].immutable_samplers + RADV_SAMPLER_DESC_SIZE * j') == 2
assert 'templ->entry[i].immutable_samplers + 4 * j' not in active_c
assert active_c.index('immutable_sampler_count += entry->descriptorCount') < active_c.index('templ = vk_alloc2')
generator = (ROOT/'tools/patch-radv-wsi.py').read_text()
installer = (ROOT/'tools/install-vendored-radv.py').read_text()
for n in NAMES:
    path = 'src/amd/vulkan/' + n
    assert "'"+path+"': []" in generator
    assert "'"+path+"'," in installer

# Compile and run the exact Mesa statements extracted from active source.
# The source descriptor layout is poisoned and freed before all reads.
copy = next(x.strip() for x in active_c.splitlines() if 'memcpy(immutable_samplers_data, src_samplers,' in x)
advance = next(x.strip() for x in active_c.splitlines() if 'immutable_samplers_data += entry->descriptorCount' in x)
fixture = r'''#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#define RADV_SAMPLER_DESC_SIZE 16
struct entry { unsigned descriptorCount; const uint8_t *immutable_samplers; };
int main(void) {
    struct entry items[2] = {{2, 0}, {3, 0}};
    uint8_t copied[80] = {0};
    uint8_t *immutable_samplers_data = copied;
    uint32_t *layout = malloc(24 * sizeof(uint32_t));
    if (!layout) return 10;
    for (unsigned i=0; i<24; i++) layout[i] = i+101;
    for (unsigned i=0; i<2; i++) {
        struct entry *entry = &items[i];
        const uint32_t *src_samplers = layout + (i ? 12 : 0);
        COPY_LINE
        entry->immutable_samplers = immutable_samplers_data;
        ADVANCE_LINE
    }
    memset(layout, 0xcc, 24 * sizeof(uint32_t));
    free(layout);
    for (unsigned i=0; i<2; i++) {
        for (unsigned j=0; j<items[i].descriptorCount * 4; j++) {
            uint32_t value = 0;
            memcpy(&value, items[i].immutable_samplers + j*4, sizeof(value));
            if (value != (i ? 12 : 0) + j + 101) return 11;
        }
    }
    if (immutable_samplers_data != copied+sizeof(copied)) return 12;
    puts("PASS retained immutable descriptors after layout release");
    return 0;
}
'''.replace('COPY_LINE',copy).replace('ADVANCE_LINE',advance)
cc = shutil.which('clang-18') or shutil.which('clang') or shutil.which('cc')
assert cc, 'Host C compiler is required'
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='encore-r399-') as td:
    src,exe = Path(td)/'fixture.c',Path(td)/'fixture'
    src.write_text(fixture)
    subprocess.run([cc,'-std=c11','-O1','-g','-fsanitize=address,undefined',
                    '-fno-omit-frame-pointer',str(src),'-o',str(exe)],
                   check=True,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
    subprocess.run([str(exe)],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
print('R399 PASS: immutable sampler original/active replay and ASan/UBSan lifetime')
```

```py
D, S = 0x2, 0x4
```

`tools/check-radv-native.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Verify the combined native link's selected driver and platform ownership."""
from pathlib import Path
import json
import subprocess

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
cache = Path((root/'.local/headless-cache').read_text().strip())
build = cache/'native-local'
config = (build/'CMakeCache.txt').read_text()
for option in ('EDEN_PS5_OPENGL:BOOL=ON', 'EDEN_PS5_VULKAN:BOOL=ON',
               'EDEN_VULKAN_DRIVER:STRING=RADV'):
    assert option in config, option
symbols = {}
for line in subprocess.check_output(['nm', str(build/'bin/eden-headless')], text=True).splitlines():
    parts = line.split()
    if len(parts) == 3:
        symbols[parts[2]] = (parts[0], parts[1])
for name in ('__wrap_malloc', '__wrap_free', '__wrap_pthread_create', '__wrap_pthread_join',
             'ps5_fp_ieee', 'ps5___cxa_thread_atexit_impl', 'eglGetProcAddress',
             'radv_GetInstanceProcAddr', 'vkGetInstanceProcAddr'):
    assert symbols[name][1] == 't', (name, symbols.get(name))
assert symbols['vkGetInstanceProcAddr'] == symbols['radv_GetInstanceProcAddr']
assert 'ps5vk_private_open_memstream' not in symbols
# The SDK's static libc defines these as direct syscalls, which native titles may not make;
# the libkernel imports (fcntl(F_DUPFD), pipe) must be used instead.
for name in ('dup', 'pipe2'):
    assert name not in symbols, f'{name} links the SDK libc direct syscall'
link = (build/'bin/eden-headless.map').read_text()
assert 'heap_wrap' not in link, 'A second SDK heap wrapper owner was linked'
assert 'libps5vk.a' not in link and 'libpsbc.a' not in link, 'Old Vulkan implementation linked'
assert 'libvulkan_radeon.ps5.a' in link and 'libps5_opengl_core33.a' in link
# Mesa's generated dispatch tables use weak references for optional entrypoints.
# A PS5 title has no ELF dynamic loader for those: they must resolve to NULL at
# static link time, not survive as imports for the native package converter.
dyn_undefined = subprocess.check_output(
    ['llvm-nm-18', '-D', '--undefined-only', str(build/'bin/eden-headless')], text=True)
weak_undefined = [line for line in dyn_undefined.splitlines()
                  if len(line.split()) >= 2 and line.split()[-2].lower() in ('w', 'v')]
assert not weak_undefined, 'weak native imports survived static link:\n' + '\n'.join(weak_undefined)
sdk = root.parent/'mihawk-vulkan-review/.deps/native/ps5-payload-sdk'
for name in ('libc++.a', 'libc++abi.a', 'libunwind.a'):
    subprocess.run(['cmp', str(cache/'sdk/target/lib'/name), str(sdk/'target/lib'/name)], check=True)
crt_path = root/'vendor/encore-active/eden-build/tooling/native/app_crt_radv.cpp'
records = json.loads((build/'compile_commands.json').read_text())
crt_entries = [entry for entry in records
               if Path(entry['file']).name == 'app_crt_radv.cpp']
assert len(crt_entries) == 1 and Path(crt_entries[0]['file']).resolve() == crt_path.resolve(), (
    'Native RADV startup must compile its maintained owner', crt_entries)
crt = crt_path.read_text()
assert crt.index('ps5_fp_ieee();', crt.index('void _init()')) < crt.index('__preinit_array_start', crt.index('void _init()'))
print('RADV/OpenGL native link: driver selection, entrypoints, heap ownership, C++/unwind ABI and IEEE startup PASS')
```

```py
"""Upstream Mesa 26.2.2 zero-indirect-count regression against actual PS5 RADV.

Upstream: a2f2518a9febf1b3b791cd2df079dbd25e56939b.
The byte-equivalence gate covers *all* 11 draw call sites, the PS5 custom
GS-compute raster draw, and four approved 64-bit index offsets; this must
match the complete generator output, not silently reject CodeQL fixes.
"""
from importlib.util import module_from_spec, spec_from_file_location
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

base = (ROOT/"vendor/sources/ps5-mesa/src/amd/vulkan/radv_cmd_buffer.c").read_text()
active = (ROOT/"vendor/encore-active/ps5-mesa/src/amd/vulkan/radv_cmd_buffer.c").read_text()
script = ROOT/"tools/radv_official_indirect_draw_fix.py"
spec = spec_from_file_location("upstream_indirect", script)
assert spec and spec.loader
module = module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
old = "extent.height = MAX2(extent.width, pdev->info.gfx_level >= GFX12 ? 128 : 64);"
new = "extent.height = MAX2(extent.height, pdev->info.gfx_level >= GFX12 ? 128 : 64);"
assert base.count(old) == 1
expected = module.patch(base.replace(old, new))
# Exactly one additional, reviewed GS-compute pointer initialization is
# permitted on top of the official bin-height and zero-indirect corrections.
gs_anchor = ("   poly_vertex_params_init(vp, gsc->vs_outputs, wg_size);\n"
             "   poly_geometry_params_init(gp, mode, wg_size);\n")
gs_sink = (
    "   /* GPU-side setup can drop a draw. Never leave its output pointers at 0. */\n"
```

```py
"""Native release: locale-ranked physical cases keep order without N^2 dedup.

Compiles actual selected C++ SafeCaseFilename/SafeCaseCandidate/

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cctype>
#include <cstddef>
#include <string>
#include <unordered_set>
#include <vector>
namespace Eden {
static constexpr const char* kLanguageKeys[]={"en-US","fr","en-GB"};
}
""" + actual + r"""
std::vector<std::string> reference(const std::vector<std::string>& entries,
                                    int language_choice, int face) {
  // Previous linear duplicate elimination for a given region-ranked input.
  // Compare with source first-pass insertion order, including equal priorities.
  const std::string locale=Eden::kLanguageKeys[language_choice];
  std::vector<std::string> regions;
  if(locale=="fr")regions={"fr","eu","world","uk","ca","us"};
  else if(locale=="en-GB")regions=face==1?
      std::vector<std::string>{"uk","us","ca","world","eu"}:
      std::vector<std::string>{"uk","eu","us","world","ca"};
  else regions={"us","ca","world","uk","eu","fr"};
  struct Candidate{int priority;std::size_t order;std::string file;};
  std::vector<Candidate> choices;
  for(std::size_t i=0;i<entries.size();++i) {
    const auto& token=entries[i];
    if(!SafeCaseCandidate(token))continue;
    const auto colon=token.find(':');
    const std::string region=colon==std::string::npos?"other":token.substr(0,colon);
    const std::string file=colon==std::string::npos?token:token.substr(colon+1);
    int priority=100;
    for(std::size_t p=0;p<regions.size();++p)if(regions[p]==region){priority=int(p);break;}
    choices.push_back({priority,i,file});
  }
  std::stable_sort(choices.begin(),choices.end(),[](const auto& a,const auto& b){
    return a.priority < b.priority;
  });
  std::vector<std::string> sorted;
  for(const auto& c:choices)
    if(std::find(sorted.begin(),sorted.end(),c.file)==sorted.end())sorted.push_back(c.file);
  return sorted;
}
int main() {
  const std::string a(36,'A'),b(36,'B'),c(36,'C');
  std::vector<std::string> examples{
    "us:"+a+".jpg","fr:"+b+".png","eu:"+a+".jpg",
    "world:"+c+".jpg","us:"+b+".png","other:"+c+".jpg",
    "invalid/../../"+a+".jpg","eu:"+a+".jpg",
    a+".jpg"};
  for(int lang=0;lang<3;++lang)
    for(int face=0;face<2;++face) {
      auto expected=reference(examples,lang,face);
      auto produced=LocaleCaseCandidates(examples,lang,face);
      assert(produced==expected);
      assert(produced.size()==3);
    }
  std::vector<std::string> many;
  many.reserve(1200);
  for(int i=0;i<1200;++i) {
    std::string name(36,char('A'+(i%26)));
    many.push_back(std::string(i%3==0?"fr:":i%3==1?"us:":"eu:")+name+".jpg");
  }
  for(int lang=0;lang<3;++lang)
    for(int face=0;face<2;++face)
      assert(LocaleCaseCandidates(many,lang,face)==reference(many,lang,face));
  assert(LocaleCaseCandidates({},0,0).empty());
}
""";
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Source-extracted release Font::fit - check codepoint output and no prefix copies."""
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess, tempfile
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
s=(root/"headless/prosperoeden/pe/gfx/font.cpp").read_text()
assert "pe/gfx/font.cpp" in (root/"headless/CMakeLists.txt").read_text()
start="std::string Font::fit(std::string_view text, float size, float max_width, float tracking) const"
assert s.count(start)==1
real=start+s.split(start,1)[1].split("\n}\n\n} // namespace pe::gfx",1)[0]+"\n}"
assert "result.append(text.substr(start, index - start));" in real
assert "result.resize(previous_size);" in real
assert "std::string candidate =" not in real
cpp=r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>
namespace pe::gfx {
char32_t next_codepoint(std::string_view s,std::size_t* i) {
 const auto lead=(unsigned char)s[*i];
 if(lead<128){++*i;return lead;}
 if((lead&0xe0)==0xc0&&*i+1<s.size()){*i+=2;return 0xe9;}
 if((lead&0xf0)==0xe0&&*i+2<s.size()){*i+=3;return 0x301;}
 if((lead&0xf8)==0xf0&&*i+3<s.size()){*i+=4;return 0x1f600;}
 ++*i;return '?';
}
namespace bidi {bool attaches(char32_t c){return c==0x301;}}
class Font {
public:
 float measure(std::string_view s,float size,float tracking)const {
   float width=0;
   for(std::size_t p=0;p<s.size();) {next_codepoint(s,&p);width+=size+tracking;}
   return width;
 }
 std::string fit(std::string_view,float,float,float)const;
};
""" + real + r"""
std::string before(const Font& f,std::string_view text,float size,float max_width,float tracking) {
 if(f.measure(text,size,tracking)<=max_width)return std::string(text);
 static constexpr std::string_view ellipsis="\xE2\x80\xA6";
 float room=max_width-f.measure(ellipsis,size,tracking)-tracking;
 std::string result;
 for(std::size_t index=0;index<text.size();) {
   const std::size_t start=index;
   next_codepoint(text,&index);
   for(std::size_t next=index;next<text.size();) {
     if(!bidi::attaches(next_codepoint(text,&next)))break;
     index=next;
   }
   const std::string candidate=result+std::string(text.substr(start,index-start));
   if(f.measure(candidate,size,tracking)>room)break;
   result=candidate;
 }
 while(!result.empty()&&result.back()==' ')result.pop_back();
 return result+std::string(ellipsis);
}
}
int main() {
 pe::gfx::Font font;
 const std::vector<std::string> cases={"FC27 player career mode",
 "Zelda Breath of the Wild", "Éden a\xCC\x81 feat. HUD",
 "menu menu menu menu menu menu",
 "  with trailing spaces  ","", "\xF0\x9F\x98\x80 emoji"};
 for(const auto& s:cases)for(float w:{-1.f,0.f,2.f,6.f,20.f,100.f})
 for(float track:{-.2f,0.f,.4f})
  assert(font.fit(s,1.f,w,track)==pe::gfx::before(font,s,1.f,w,track));
 for(int n=0;n<120;++n){
  const std::string s(n,'A');
  assert(font.fit(s,1.f,n/2.f,0)==pe::gfx::before(font,s,1.f,n/2.f,0));
 }
}
""";
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-font-fit-") as tmp:
 p=Path(tmp)/"fit.cpp";p.write_text(cpp)
 for opt in ("-O0","-O2"):
  exe=Path(tmp)/("fit"+opt[2:])
  subprocess.run(["c++","-std=c++20","-Wall","-Wextra","-Werror",opt,
                  str(p),"-o",str(exe)],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True)
  subprocess.run([str(exe)],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True)
print("ENCORE_RELEASE_FONT_FIT_HOST_PASS source=1 O0=1 O2=1 no_temp_candidate=1")
```

```py
#include <algorithm>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>
namespace pe::gfx {
char32_t next_codepoint(std::string_view s, std::size_t* i) {
    const auto lead = static_cast<unsigned char>(s[*i]);
    int width = (lead & 0x80) == 0 ? 1 : (lead & 0xe0) == 0xc0 ? 2 :
                (lead & 0xf0) == 0xe0 ? 3 : (lead & 0xf8) == 0xf0 ? 4 : 1;
    if (*i + width > s.size()) width = 1;
    char32_t cp = width == 1 ? lead : lead & ((1 << (7-width))-1);
    for (int n = 1; n < width; ++n)
        cp = (cp << 6) | (static_cast<unsigned char>(s[*i+n]) & 0x3f);
    *i += width;
    return cp;
}
bool breaks_between(char32_t before, char32_t now) {
    return before >= 0x4e00 && before <= 0x9fff &&
           now >= 0x4e00 && now <= 0x9fff;
}
namespace bidi {
bool attaches(char32_t cp) { return cp == 0x301 || cp == 0x308; }
int paragraph_level(const std::vector<char32_t>& text) {
    for (auto cp: text) if (cp >= 0x590 && cp <= 0x5ff) return 1;
    return 0;
}
}
class Font {
public:
    float measure(std::string_view text, float size) const {
        float w = 0;
        for (std::size_t p = 0; p < text.size();) {
            auto cp = next_codepoint(text, &p);
            if (bidi::attaches(cp)) continue;
            w += cp >= 0x4e00 && cp <= 0x9fff ? size * 1.5f : size;
        }
        return w;
    }
    const void* shaped(std::string_view text) const {
        return text.find("\xd7") == std::string_view::npos ? nullptr : this;
    }
    std::vector<std::string> wrap(std::string_view, float, float) const;
};
class LegacyFont : public Font {
public:
    std::vector<std::string> wrap(std::string_view, float, float) const;
};
""" + real + "\n" + legacy + r"""
}
int main() {
    const pe::gfx::Font actual;
    const pe::gfx::LegacyFont previous;
    const std::vector<std::string> cases = {
        "", " ", "   ", "one", "FC27 player career HUD scoreboard",
        "Zelda Breath of the Wild", "superlongunbreakablewordtestcase",
        "word    lots   of spaces", "alpha\n\nbeta", "\ntrailing\n",
        "Éden a\xcc\x81 team", "a\xcc\x81\xcc\x88" "bc a\xcc\x81 xyz",
        "\xe4\xbd\xa0\xe5\xa5\xbd\xe4\xb8\x96\xe7\x95\x8c", // Chinese
        "\xd7\x90\xd7\x91\xd7\x92 \xd7\x93\xd7\x94  abc", // RTL
        "\xe4\xb8\xad\xe5\x9b\xbd hello \xe4\xb8\x96\xe7\x95\x8c"
    };
    for (const auto& sample : cases)
        for (float size : {0.5f, 1.f, 2.5f})
            for (float width : {-1.f, 0.f, 0.5f, 1.f, 2.f, 4.f, 6.f, 16.f, 100.f})
                assert(actual.wrap(sample,size,width) ==
                       previous.wrap(sample,size,width));
    for (int n = 0; n < 130; ++n) {
        const std::string sample(n,'A');
        assert(actual.wrap(sample,1.f,n/3.f) ==
               previous.wrap(sample,1.f,n/3.f));
    }

""";
```
