```py
# P1.3: the production-owner CloseSession now refuses out-of-range IDs,
# duplicate final closes, inactive sessions, and null process owners BEFORE
# decrementing or unmapping. Reconstruct the exact ten-line addition from
# the pinned historical unit; all earlier edits retain strict byte parity.
original_close = (
    "    std::unique_lock lk(impl->session_guard);\n"
    "    auto& session = impl->sessions[session_id.id];\n"
    "    if (--session.ref_count > 0) {\n"
)
checked_close = (
    "    std::unique_lock lk(impl->session_guard);\n"
    "    // SessionId originates in the NVDRV FD table; stale and malformed FDs\n"
    "    // must not index outside the stable deque or close a reused ASID twice.\n"
    "    // Keep the existing lock through NvMap cleanup: the cleanup may call\n"
    "    // GetSession recursively and already depends on that ordering.\n"
    "    if (session_id.id >= impl->sessions.size()) {\n"
    "        return;\n"
    "    }\n"
    "    auto& session = impl->sessions[session_id.id];\n"
    "    if (!session.is_active || session.ref_count <= 0 || !session.process) {\n"
    "        return;\n"
    "    }\n"
    "    if (--session.ref_count > 0) {\n"
)

# P1.3: GetSession guards malformed and closed guest FDs before returning a
# borrowed process/session. Preserve byte-for-byte parity with the complete
# maintained vendor owner instead of relaxing the frozen source comparison.
original_get = (
    "Session* Container::GetSession(SessionId session_id) {\n"
    "    std::atomic_thread_fence(std::memory_order_acquire);\n"
    "    return &impl->sessions[session_id.id];\n"
    "}"
)
guarded_get = (
    "Session* Container::GetSession(SessionId session_id) {\n"
    "    // FD-derived IDs must not index past the deque or borrow closed sessions.\n"
    "    // This is a lookup guard, not a lifetime lease across concurrent Close.\n"
    "    std::atomic_thread_fence(std::memory_order_acquire);\n"
    "    if (session_id.id >= impl->sessions.size()) {\n"
    "        return nullptr;\n"
    "    }\n"
    "    auto& session = impl->sessions[session_id.id];\n"
    "    return session.is_active && session.process ? &session : nullptr;\n"
    "}"
)

# A single canonical override root does not mean every native frontend .inc

def single_source_table(begin_tag, end_tag):
    assert single_source_doc.count(begin_tag) == single_source_doc.count(end_tag) == 1
    return [
        line.split("`", 2)[1]
        for line in single_source_doc.split(begin_tag)[1].split(end_tag)[0].splitlines()
        if line.startswith("| `headless/")
    ]

candidates_fragments = sorted(p.relative_to(root).as_posix() for p in (root/"headless").rglob("*.inc"))

    "undocumented headless CMake code/override module", candidates_modules)
assert single_source_table("<!-- SINGLE_SOURCE_FRAGMENTS_START -->", "<!-- SINGLE_SOURCE_FRAGMENTS_END -->") == candidates_fragments, (
    "undocumented headless injected fragment", candidates_fragments)
# Both module and fragment inventories are checked by exact path equality above;
# a second migration-stage numeric assertion would become stale after deletions.

    (name, target)
    for name in candidates_modules
    for target in re.findall(
        r'^\s*write_derived\(\s*"([^"]+)"',
        (root / name).read_text(), re.M
    )
]

# Byte-exact relocation of six shared-JIT inputs. Do not permit another
# physical owner under headless after moving the authoritative source.
import subprocess


def check_canonical_git_object(source, expected, label):
    """Prove stored Git object identity and working-tree consistency."""
    relative = source.relative_to(root).as_posix()
    # Git stores vendor sources under the submodule's own HEAD once the
    # parent tracks vendor as a 160000 gitlink. Keep the same canonical
    # blob assertion in both layouts rather than weakening the proof.
    vendor_entry = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "ls-tree", "HEAD", "--", "vendor"], cwd=root,
        check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
    is_gitlink = vendor_entry.startswith("160000 commit ") and vendor_entry.endswith("\tvendor")
    repository = root / "vendor" if is_gitlink and relative.startswith("vendor/") else root
    git_path = relative.removeprefix("vendor/") if repository != root else relative
    actual = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "rev-parse", f"HEAD:{git_path}"], cwd=repository,
        check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
    assert actual == expected, (label, "Git source blob drift", relative, actual)
    # git diff uses tracked text filters, so this does not mistake a
    # checkout EOL conversion for an intentional source modification.
    result = subprocess.run(["git", "diff", "--quiet", "HEAD", "--", git_path], cwd=repository)
    assert result.returncode == 0, (label, "dirty canonical source", relative)

# GPU memory manager: exact reconstruction of the retired native CMake source.
# This is an offline witness, never an alternate generated production file.
gpu_expected = (root / "vendor/sources/eden/src/video_core/memory_manager.cpp").read_text()
gpu_hunks = [
    ('#include "memory_manager.h"\n', "", 1),
    ("    if (!IsContinuousRange(src_addr, size)) {", "    if (size == 0 || src_addr >= address_space_size ||\n        size > address_space_size - src_addr ||\n        !IsContinuousRange(src_addr, size)) {", 2),
    ("bool MemoryManager::IsGranularRange(GPUVAddr gpu_addr, std::size_t size) const {\n", "bool MemoryManager::IsGranularRange(GPUVAddr gpu_addr, std::size_t size) const {\n    if (gpu_addr >= address_space_size || size == 0 || size > address_space_size - gpu_addr) {\n        return false;\n    }\n", 1),
    ("            const std::size_t page{(page_index & big_page_mask) + size};\n            return page <= big_page_size;", "            return size <= big_page_size - (gpu_addr & big_page_mask);", 1),
    ("const std::size_t page{(gpu_addr & Core::DEVICE_PAGEMASK) + size};\n", "", 2),
    ("return page <= Core::DEVICE_PAGESIZE;", "return size <= Core::DEVICE_PAGESIZE - (gpu_addr & Core::DEVICE_PAGEMASK);", 2),
]
for index, (before, after, expected_count) in enumerate(gpu_hunks):
    assert gpu_expected.count(before) == expected_count, ("GPU pinned anchor drift", index)
    gpu_expected = gpu_expected.replace(before, after)
gpu_maintained = active / "eden-core/src/video_core/memory_manager.cpp"
assert gpu_maintained.is_file()
gpu_actual = gpu_maintained.read_text()
if gpu_actual != gpu_expected:
    # N51 optional changed-PTE batching is in the same production source owner.
    # Both *complete* source identities must remain exact; no regex deletion
    # or blind acceptance of other video_core/memory_manager.cpp changes.
    import hashlib
    def git_blob_id(text):
        raw = text.encode()
        return hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(raw)).encode() + b"\0" + raw).hexdigest()
    assert git_blob_id(gpu_expected) == "f30099dfb5df01d9cd787d199e3e61f28205669a", (
        "pre-NS2 GPU source baseline drift")
    # The N51 GPU batching owner has one later, independently reviewed P1.2
    # revision. P1.2 adds checked cross-page scalars and a physical-backing
    # fallback. Match the *entire* canonical blob; do not accept a general
    # source variant or declare the historical five-hunk oracle identical.
    owner_sha = git_blob_id(gpu_actual)
    if "All old mappings have been evicted" in gpu_actual:
        # Reverse the precise P1.2/N51 pre-invalidation patch and prove
        # byte-for-byte identity with the previous fully reviewed owner.
        import runpy
        recover_preinvalidate = runpy.run_path(
            str(root / "tools/ns2/native_gpu_preinvalidate_review.py")
        )["recover_prior_memory_manager"]
        gpu_actual = recover_preinvalidate(gpu_actual)
        owner_sha = git_blob_id(gpu_actual)
        assert owner_sha == "b43eae6863527b47b98892f5bfa68b7f685c0b28"
        assert (root / "tools/ns2/check_native_gpu_pte_remap_host.py").is_file()
    if '#include "native_gpu_page_remap.h"' in gpu_actual:
        # The reviewed change is confined to remapping a still-Mapped GPU
        # VA to a different physical page. Reconstruct the exact previous
        # P1.2/N51 owner, then run every historical parity assertion on it.
        import runpy
        recover_remap = runpy.run_path(
            str(root / "tools/ns2/native_gpu_pte_remap_review.py")
        )["recover_prior_memory_manager"]
        gpu_actual = recover_remap(gpu_actual)
        owner_sha = git_blob_id(gpu_actual)
        assert owner_sha == "836c0653652957a996db89ba7a7d5c48db1350a8", (
            "P1.2 physical remap diff exceeds reviewed small/big PTE changes")
        assert (root / "tools/ns2/check_native_gpu_pte_remap_host.py").is_file()
        assert (active / "eden-core/src/video_core/native_gpu_page_remap.h").is_file()
    n51_sha = "c7923dbbef27a9088dbfcb33c162e3c7069679c1"
    p12_sha = "7dba34b3e300515cd5b0a8579fe893072cb70b24"
    # Complete P1.2 successor reviewed against the historical generated TU:
    # bounds checks on unmap, sparse walks and GMMU address ranges; physical
    # device-backed block fallbacks and scalar paging are preserved. This is
    # an exact blob admission, never a general substring-based exception.
    p12_bounded_sha = "b5caf9fa5b0477b005249d4b87bac89934bf4c50"
    p12_walk_guarded_sha = "836c0653652957a996db89ba7a7d5c48db1350a8"
    assert owner_sha in (n51_sha, p12_sha, p12_bounded_sha, p12_walk_guarded_sha), (
        "unreviewed changed-PTE/P1.2 GPU source drift", owner_sha)
    assert "#ifdef EDEN_NS2_GPU_RANGE_BATCH" in gpu_actual
    if owner_sha in (p12_sha, p12_bounded_sha, p12_walk_guarded_sha):
        assert '#include "native_paged_scalar.h"' in gpu_actual
        assert "Eden::GpuScalar::Read(addr, value" in gpu_actual
        assert "Eden::GpuScalar::Write(addr, data" in gpu_actual
        assert gpu_actual.count("memory.GetSpan(dev_addr_base, copy_amount)") == 4
        assert "memory.ReadBlockUnsafe(dev_addr_base, dest_buffer, copy_amount)" in gpu_actual
        assert "memory.WriteBlockUnsafe(dev_addr_base, src_buffer, copy_amount)" in gpu_actual
        if owner_sha in (p12_bounded_sha, p12_walk_guarded_sha):
            assert gpu_actual.count("size > address_space_size -") >= 7
            assert "const size_t page_last{((addr + size - 1) >> page_bits) + 1};" in gpu_actual
            assert "GetSubmappedRangeImpl<true>(gpu_addr, size, result);" in gpu_actual
    if owner_sha == p12_walk_guarded_sha:
        # Not just a new allowlist entry: remove precisely the three audited
        # range guards and prove the complete previous owner blob reappears.
        # Any other code mutation would break this replay even if someone
        # inadvertently updated an opaque hash in the inventory.
        exact_guards = (
            """    // Every mapped/unmapped guest region traverses this common PTE walker.
    // Neither a wrapped 64-bit range nor a span past the configured 40/49-bit
    // guest VA limit may probe the backing page table, even via SafeRead.
    if (size == 0 || gpu_src_addr >= address_space_size ||
        size > address_space_size - gpu_src_addr) return;
""",
            """    // Invalid GPU command spans follow the existing unmapped-read contract:
    // return zero bytes without visiting an out-of-range PTE or stale page.
    if (size == 0) return;
    if (gpu_src_addr >= address_space_size ||
        size > address_space_size - gpu_src_addr) {
        std::memset(dest_buffer, 0, size);
        return;
    }
""",
            """    // A refused write must not queue a dirty interval with a wrapping address.
    if (size == 0 || gpu_dest_addr >= address_space_size ||
        size > address_space_size - gpu_dest_addr) return;
""",
        )
        previous_owner = gpu_actual
        for guard in exact_guards:
            assert previous_owner.count(guard) == 1, "missing P1.2 walker guard"
            previous_owner = previous_owner.replace(guard, "")
        assert git_blob_id(previous_owner) == p12_bounded_sha, (
            "P1.2 GPU PTE walker mutation exceeds exactly reviewed guards")
        walker_test = root / "tools/ns2/check_native_gpu_memory_walker_bounds_host.py"
        assert walker_test.is_file() and "MemoryOperation" in walker_test.read_text()
    # N51's independent source-normalisation witness must also pin both
    # complete blobs and recheck all batching operands after removing N51.
    n51_guard = (root / "tools/ns2/check_egl_gpu_range_batch.py").read_text()
    assert f'n51_original = "{n51_sha}"' in n51_guard
    assert f'p12_protected = "{p12_sha}"' in n51_guard
    assert f'p12_bounded = "{p12_bounded_sha}"' in n51_guard
    assert f'p12_walk_guarded = "{p12_walk_guarded_sha}"' in n51_guard
    assert 't.count("memory.GetSpan(dev_addr_base, copy_amount)") == 4' in n51_guard

assert 'list(APPEND video_sources "${EDEN_NATIVE_GPU_MEMORY_MANAGER}")' in c
assert c.count('list(REMOVE_ITEM video_sources "memory_manager.cpp")') == 1
assert 'write_derived("${eden_gpu_span_tu}"' not in c
print("MAINTAINED_GPU_MEMORY_MANAGER_PARITY_PASS patches=5 sites=8 selection=video_core")

# Exact historical CMake generation witness; never produces production code.
network_original = (root / "vendor/sources/eden/src/core/internal_network/network.cpp").read_text()
network_old_start = "void Initialize() {\n    if (pipe("
network_old_end = "void Finalize() {\n    if (interrupt_pipe_fd"
network_init = "void Initialize() {\n    if (socketpair(AF_UNIX, SOCK_STREAM, 0, interrupt_pipe_fd) != 0)\n        throw std::runtime_error(\"Native wakeup socketpair failed\");\n    try {\n        unsigned char value = 0x5a, received = 0;\n        errno = 0;\n        const auto written = send(interrupt_pipe_fd[1], &value, 1, MSG_DONTWAIT);\n        const int write_error = errno;\n        errno = 0;\n        const auto count = recv(interrupt_pipe_fd[0], &received, 1, MSG_DONTWAIT);\n        const int read_error = errno;\n        std::printf(\"EDEN_SOCKET_PRIME write=%lld write_errno=%d read=%lld read_errno=%d value=%u\\n\",\n            static_cast<long long>(written), write_error, static_cast<long long>(count), read_error, received);\n        if (written != 1 || count != 1 || received != value)\n            throw std::runtime_error(\"Native wakeup socketpair initialization failed\");\n    } catch (...) {\n        for (int& fd : interrupt_pipe_fd) { close(fd); fd = -1; }\n        throw;\n    }\n}\n\n"
network_interrupt = "    errno = 0;\n    const auto written = send(interrupt_pipe_fd[1], &value, sizeof(value), MSG_DONTWAIT);\n    const int write_error = errno;\n    // A full nonblocking stream already has a pending wakeup for poll().\n    if (written == -1 && (write_error == EAGAIN || write_error == EWOULDBLOCK)) return;\n    if (written != 1) std::fprintf(stderr, \"EDEN_SOCKET_INTERRUPT result=%lld errno=%d\\n\",\n        static_cast<long long>(written), write_error);\n    ASSERT(written == 1);\n"
assert network_original.count("namespace Network {") == 1

    "namespace Network {\\n#ifndef IPPROTO_DCCP\\nconstexpr int IPPROTO_DCCP = 33;\\n#endif".replace("\\n", "\n"))

ending = network_expected.index(network_old_end, begin)
network_expected = network_expected[:begin] + network_init + network_expected[ending:]
old_write = "    ASSERT(write(interrupt_pipe_fd[1], &value, sizeof(value)) == 1);"
old_read = "ssize_t ret = read(interrupt_pipe_fd[0], &value, sizeof(value));"
assert network_expected.count(old_write) == 1 and network_expected.count(old_read) == 1

# R428 per-layer ASTC scratch is now a canonical, selected C++ source. Its
# Git blob was derived by applying the single historical CMake raw-string
# replacement against the pinned Eden texture utility.
astc_maintained = active / "eden-core/src/video_core/texture_cache/util.cpp"
# Preserve the complete R428 source except named 3D-layout/policy changes.
import hashlib
astc_previous = astc_maintained.read_text()
# This selected translation unit now includes the native-only R312 texture
# descriptor guard. Verify its complete semantics, then reverse *only* this
# reviewed delta before comparing against the pinned R428 ASTC git blob.
# Any other change to the texture owner continues to fail closed.
tic_begin = astc_previous.index("bool IsValidEntry(")
tic_end = astc_previous.index("\nboost::container::small_vector<BufferImageCopy", tic_begin)
tic_active = astc_previous[tic_begin:tic_end]
tic_baseline = (root / "vendor/sources/eden/src/video_core/texture_cache/util.cpp").read_text()
tic_base_start = tic_baseline.index("bool IsValidEntry(")
tic_base_end = tic_baseline.index("\nboost::container::small_vector<BufferImageCopy", tic_base_start)
tic_baseline = tic_baseline[tic_base_start:tic_base_end]
expected_tic_native = '''bool IsValidEntry(const Tegra::MemoryManager& gpu_memory, const TICEntry& config) {
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    // The zero TIC format is invalid. Reject it before constructing a
    // fallback RGBA image view (which can sample unrelated guest backing).
    if (config.format == static_cast<Tegra::Texture::TextureFormat>(0)) {
        return false;
    }
#endif
    const GPUVAddr address = config.Address();
    if (address == 0) {
        return false;
    }
    if (address >= (1ULL << 40)) {
        return false;
    }
    if (gpu_memory.GpuToCpuAddress(address).has_value()) {
        return true;
    }
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    // The range overload can succeed when only a *later* page is mapped.
    // That is not proof the first page of a non-sparse texture exists.
    if (config.is_sparse == 0) {
        return false;
    }
#endif
    const ImageInfo info{config};
    const size_t guest_size_bytes = CalculateGuestSizeInBytes(info);
    return gpu_memory.GpuToCpuAddress(address, guest_size_bytes).has_value();
}'''
assert tic_active == expected_tic_native + '\n', 'native TIC guard unreviewed drift'
assert astc_previous.count(tic_active) == 1
astc_previous = astc_previous.replace(tic_active, tic_baseline)
astc_layout_edits = [
    ('    u32 output_offset = 0;\n    Common::ScratchBuffer<u8> decode_scratch;\n\n    const Extent2D tile_size = DefaultBlockSize(info.format);', '    if (copies.empty()) {\n        return;\n    }\n    u32 output_offset = 0;\n    Common::ScratchBuffer<u8> decode_scratch;\n\n    // One conversion must use one format policy for all its mip levels.\n    const auto recompression_setting = Settings::values.astc_recompression.GetValue();\n    const bool astc = IsPixelFormatASTC(info.format);\n    const Extent2D tile_size = DefaultBlockSize(info.format);'),
    ('        const auto recompression_setting = Settings::values.astc_recompression.GetValue();\n        const bool astc = IsPixelFormatASTC(info.format);\n\n        if (astc && recompression_setting == Settings::AstcRecompression::Uncompressed) {', '        if (astc && recompression_setting == Settings::AstcRecompression::Uncompressed) {'),
    ('                             copy.image_subresource.num_layers *\n                             BytesPerBlock(PixelFormat::A8B8G8R8_UNORM);', '                             copy.image_extent.depth * copy.image_subresource.num_layers *\n                             BytesPerBlock(PixelFormat::A8B8G8R8_UNORM);'),
    ('                             copy.image_subresource.num_layers *\n                             ConvertedBytesPerBlock(info.format);', '                             copy.image_extent.depth * copy.image_subresource.num_layers *\n                             ConvertedBytesPerBlock(info.format);'),
]
for before, after in reversed(astc_layout_edits):
    assert astc_previous.count(after) == 1, 'texture layout delta drift'
    astc_previous = astc_previous.replace(after, before)
astc_blob = astc_previous.encode()
assert hashlib.sha1(b'blob ' + str(len(astc_blob)).encode() + b'\0' + astc_blob).hexdigest() == '8f393887e88d7e38681fea109074338bba5b26fc', 'unreviewed texture utility drift'
assert 'list(APPEND video_sources "${EDEN_MAINTAINED_TEXTURE_UTIL}")' in c
assert 'set(EDEN_MAINTAINED_TEXTURE_UTIL' in c
assert 'write_derived("${PORT_BUILD_DIR}/texture_cache_util.cpp"' not in c
assert 'file(READ "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/video_core/texture_cache/util.cpp" eden_texture_util)' not in c
assert 'set(eden_astc_decode_old [=[' not in c
print("MAINTAINED_ASTC_TEXTURE_PARITY_PASS R428")

# P2.4 NVN mesh-stage admission is additive to the shipping shader cache
# owner. Reverse only the three exact authenticated-graphics additions and
# still require byte-for-byte parity with the generated historical source.
shader_mesh = shader_maintained.read_text()
mesh_include = '''#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
#include "core/hle/service/nvdrv/devices/native_gpu_channel_registry.h"
#endif
'''
assert shader_mesh.count(mesh_include) == 1
shader_mesh = shader_mesh.replace(mesh_include, '')
mesh_select = '''#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    // NVC597 SET_MESH_CONTROL (0x114c) replaces the vertex stage with
    // Task or Mesh. Only a verified native 0xC797 engine may select it.
    const auto& regs = maxwell3d->regs;
    const bool native_mesh =
        Service::Nvidia::Devices::NativeGpuChannelRegistry::Instance()
            .CaptureGraphicsTicket(maxwell3d).has_value() &&
        (regs.reg_array[0x114c / 4] & 1U) != 0;
    const bool has_task = native_mesh &&
        regs.IsShaderConfigEnabled(Maxwell::ShaderType::TessellationInit);
#else
    constexpr bool native_mesh = false;
    constexpr bool has_task = false;
#endif
'''
assert shader_mesh.count(mesh_select) == 1
shader_mesh = shader_mesh.replace(mesh_select, '')
mesh_stage = '''    if (native_mesh &&
        (program == Maxwell::ShaderType::VertexB ||
         program == Maxwell::ShaderType::TessellationInit)) {
        // Physical banks: VertexB=0 (Task or solo Mesh); TCS=1 (Mesh
        // only with Task). No reinterpretation of ordinary NS1 stages.
        stage = program == Maxwell::ShaderType::VertexB && has_task
                    ? Shader::Stage::Task : Shader::Stage::Mesh;
        mesh_registers = {maxwell3d->regs.reg_array[0x1150 / 4],
                          maxwell3d->regs.reg_array[0x1154 / 4],
                          maxwell3d->regs.reg_array[0x1158 / 4]};
        if (stage == Shader::Stage::Mesh &&
            maxwell3d->regs.IsShaderConfigEnabled(Maxwell::ShaderType::Geometry)) {
            // NVC597 uses Geometry only as a per-primitive output map
            // header. Do not compile a phantom geometry shader.
            const auto& geometry = maxwell3d->regs.pipelines[
                static_cast<std::size_t>(Maxwell::ShaderType::Geometry)];
            const GPUVAddr address =
                (GPUVAddr{geometry.reserved[0] & 0xffU} << 32) |
                GPUVAddr{geometry.reserved[1]};
            if (!gpu_memory->IsFullyMappedRange(address, sizeof(mesh_primitive_header))) {
                throw std::out_of_range("Native mesh primitive-output header unmapped");
            }
            gpu_memory->ReadBlock(address, &mesh_primitive_header,
                                  sizeof(mesh_primitive_header));
        }
    }
'''
assert shader_mesh.count(mesh_stage) == 1
shader_mesh = shader_mesh.replace(mesh_stage, '')
assert shader_mesh == shader_expected, "Shader cache source differs after exact P2.4 stage normalization"
print("ENCORE_P24_AUTHENTICATED_SHADER_ENVIRONMENT_PARITY_PASS",
      "mesh_source=versioned native_only=1 ns1_baseline=unchanged")
assert reader_maintained.is_file() and not (root / "headless/shader_cache_reader.inc").exists()
check_canonical_git_object(reader_maintained, "5d652ca5cd6d8ec919c04902a18d87247673e523", "shader cache reader")

assert 'write_derived("${PORT_BUILD_DIR}/shader_environment.cpp"' not in c

# BufferCache header. FindBuffer/SynchronizeBuffer narrow their spans to u32.
copy_before = ("bool BufferCache<P>::DMACopy(GPUVAddr src_address, GPUVAddr dest_address, u64 amount) {\n"

copy_after = ("bool BufferCache<P>::DMACopy(GPUVAddr src_address, GPUVAddr dest_address, u64 amount) {\n"
              "    // FindBuffer and SynchronizeBuffer accept u32 byte spans. Never truncate\n"
              "    // a wider DMA request: the caller can take its ordinary software path.\n"
              "    // Reject empty copies before dirty-range bookkeeping as well.\n"
              "    if (amount == 0 || amount > static_cast<u64>(~u32{0})) {\n"
              "        return false;\n"

    clear_old, '    // FindBuffer accepts a u32 byte span; never truncate or issue an empty fill.\n'

    '    // The DMA amount counts u32 values; registration is measured in bytes.\n'

# Native-only buffer registration fix: a non-overlapping owner in the
# first partial page must not hide another owner on a subsequent page.
region_before = "bool BufferCache<P>::IsRegionRegistered(DAddr addr, size_t size) {\n    const DAddr end_addr = addr + size;"
region_after = "bool BufferCache<P>::IsRegionRegistered(DAddr addr, size_t size) {\n    // An empty CPU write does not overlap any registered cache buffer.\n    if (size == 0) {\n        return false;\n    }\n    // The page_table has exactly 16 GiB of guest-physical address space.\n    // Reject unrepresentable/overflowing spans before addr + size or page_table[].\n    constexpr DAddr kTableAddressLimit = DAddr{1} << 34;\n    if (addr >= kTableAddressLimit || size > kTableAddressLimit - addr) {\n        return false;\n    }\n    const DAddr end_addr = addr + size;"
region_skip_before = "        if (buf_start_addr < end_addr && addr < buf_end_addr) {\n            return true;\n        }\n        page = Common::DivCeil(end_addr, CACHING_PAGESIZE);"

mask_write_after = "    if (channel_state->enabled_uniform_buffer_masks != mask) {\n        channel_state->fast_bound_uniform_buffers.fill(0);\n        if constexpr (HAS_PERSISTENT_UNIFORM_BUFFER_BINDINGS) {\n            channel_state->dirty_uniform_buffers.fill(~u32{0});\n            channel_state->uniform_buffer_binding_sizes.fill({});\n        }\n        // A repeat pipeline already has the mask: avoid rewriting all stage\n        // entries on every draw while the buffer/texture cache locks are held.\n        channel_state->enabled_uniform_buffer_masks = mask;\n    }\n    // Equal enabled masks do not imply equal uniform sizes across pipelines.\n    channel_state->uniform_buffer_sizes = sizes;"
assert r437_expected.count(mask_write_before) == 1
r437_expected = r437_expected.replace(mask_write_before, mask_write_after)
# Reproduce the five later F07 native-only buffer-cache deltas independently
# from the pinned backport. Keep these strict anchors in sync with the R437
# source-extracted witness; the complete maintained header is compared below.
# Native buffer-cache memory budget sampling: mirror texture-cache policy
# under low pressure, but never delay an above-watermark GC probe.
budget_old = "    // If we can obtain the memory info, use it instead of the estimate.\n    if (runtime.CanReportMemoryUsage()) {\n        total_used_memory = runtime.GetDeviceMemoryUsage();\n    }\n    if (total_used_memory >= minimum_memory) {\n        RunGarbageCollector();\n    }"
budget_new = "    // If we can obtain the memory info, use it instead of the estimate.\n    if (runtime.CanReportMemoryUsage()) {\n#ifdef PS5_NATIVE\n        // Memory-budget queries use the driver while the buffer cache mutex\n        // is held. Under low pressure, probe on alternating frames; near\n        // the GC watermark, preserve every-frame sampling and prompt reclaim.\n        const bool near_gc_watermark =\n            total_used_memory >= minimum_memory - minimum_memory / 3;\n        if (near_gc_watermark || (frame_tick & 1u) == 0) {\n            total_used_memory = runtime.GetDeviceMemoryUsage();\n        }\n#else\n        total_used_memory = runtime.GetDeviceMemoryUsage();\n#endif\n    }\n    if (total_used_memory >= minimum_memory) {\n        RunGarbageCollector();\n    }"
assert r437_expected.count(budget_old) == 1
r437_expected = r437_expected.replace(budget_old, budget_new)
# Preserve overlapping rolling uniform-hit windows without forward-copy UB.
history_old = "    std::copy_n(channel_state->uniform_cache_hits.begin(),\n                channel_state->uniform_cache_hits.size() - 1,\n                channel_state->uniform_cache_hits.begin() + 1);\n    std::copy_n(channel_state->uniform_cache_shots.begin(),\n                channel_state->uniform_cache_shots.size() - 1,\n                channel_state->uniform_cache_shots.begin() + 1);"
history_new = "    // History shifts overlap their source ranges. Copy from the back so\n    // each previous interval is retained exactly once, even under -O2.\n    std::copy_backward(channel_state->uniform_cache_hits.begin(),\n                       channel_state->uniform_cache_hits.end() - 1,\n                       channel_state->uniform_cache_hits.end());\n    std::copy_backward(channel_state->uniform_cache_shots.begin(),\n                       channel_state->uniform_cache_shots.end() - 1,\n                       channel_state->uniform_cache_shots.end());"
assert r437_expected.count(history_old) == 1
r437_expected = r437_expected.replace(history_old, history_new)
# Do not underflow unsigned frame age during early-pressure buffer GC.
gc_age_old = "    const u64 ticks_to_destroy = aggressive_gc ? 60 : 120;\n    int num_iterations = aggressive_gc ? 64 : 32;"
gc_age_new = "    const u64 ticks_to_destroy = aggressive_gc ? 60 : 120;\n#ifdef PS5_NATIVE\n    // Before a buffer reaches the GC age, subtracting from this unsigned\n    // frame tick wraps to a huge LRU threshold. On startup/pressure bursts\n    // that wrongly evicts young buffers and can force guest downloads.\n    if (frame_tick < ticks_to_destroy) {\n        return;\n    }\n#endif\n    int num_iterations = aggressive_gc ? 64 : 32;"
assert r437_expected.count(gc_age_old) == 1
r437_expected = r437_expected.replace(gc_age_old, gc_age_new)
# A fresh driver memory snapshot can be smaller than the previous buffer's
# rounded size. Unregistering it must never underflow the shared usage counter.
unregister_budget_before = "    } else {\n        total_used_memory -= Common::AlignUp(size, 1024);\n        lru_cache.Free(buffer.getLRUID());\n    }"
unregister_budget_after = "    } else {\n#ifdef PS5_NATIVE\n        // The driver budget snapshot is not an allocation ledger. A stale or\n        // smaller snapshot must not wrap unsigned usage to UINT64_MAX when\n        // removing a previously registered buffer (and trigger GC storms).\n        const u64 accounted_bytes = Common::AlignUp(size, 1024);\n        total_used_memory = total_used_memory >= accounted_bytes\n                                ? total_used_memory - accounted_bytes : 0;\n#else\n        total_used_memory -= Common::AlignUp(size, 1024);\n#endif\n        lru_cache.Free(buffer.getLRUID());\n    }"
assert r437_expected.count(unregister_budget_before) == 1
r437_expected = r437_expected.replace(unregister_budget_before, unregister_budget_after)
# Channel-less homebrew/title teardown must still advance deferred GPU
# staging and destruction on PS5; desktop's original early exit is unchanged.
no_channel_old = "    // Homebrew console apps don't create or bind any channels, so this will be nullptr.\n    if (!channel_state) {\n        return;\n    }\n    runtime.TickFrame(slot_buffers);"
no_channel_new = "    // Homebrew console apps don't create or bind any channels, so this will be nullptr.\n    if (!channel_state) {\n#ifdef PS5_NATIVE\n        // The final channel can disappear while native Vulkan buffers and\n        // deferred staging remain alive. Advance the GPU lifetime scan and\n        // retirement rings even without uniform-cache statistics.\n        runtime.TickFrame(slot_buffers);\n        ++frame_tick;\n        delayed_destruction_ring.Tick();\n        for (auto& buffer : async_buffers_death_ring) {\n            runtime.FreeDeferredStagingBuffer(buffer);\n        }\n        async_buffers_death_ring.clear();\n#endif\n        return;\n    }\n    runtime.TickFrame(slot_buffers);"
assert r437_expected.count(no_channel_old) == 1
r437_expected = r437_expected.replace(no_channel_old, no_channel_new)
```

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
entry="$(git ls-tree HEAD -- vendor)"
case "$entry" in
  "160000 commit "*"vendor") ;;
  *) echo "Expected vendor/ gitlink (160000): $entry" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
expected="$(printf '%s\n' "$entry" | awk '{print $3}')"
test -n "$expected"
mods="$(git ls-tree -r HEAD | awk '$1=="160000" {print $4}')"
test "$mods" = vendor || { echo "External Gitlinks remain: $mods" >&2; exit 1; }
test "$(grep -c "^\[submodule " .gitmodules)" -eq 1
test ! -e vendor/.gitmodules
test -f vendor/README.md
test -f vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_rasterizer.cpp
test -d vendor/sources/eden-cpm
actual="$(git -C vendor rev-parse HEAD)"
test "$actual" = "$expected" || { echo "Submodule SHA mismatch: $expected != $actual" >&2; exit 1; }
git -C vendor diff --quiet
# Pin source-only third-party trees and keep encore-active reserved for overrides.
python3 -B tools/graphics/check-internalized-ps5-deps.py
echo "vendor gitlink and file paths verified at $actual"
```

`tools/check-vendored-deps.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
"""Proof that all pinned build inputs live in this source checkout, not upstream URLs."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
ITEMS=json.loads((ROOT/'tools/deps.json').read_text())['items']
V=ROOT/'vendor'
def digest(path):
 h=hashlib.sha256()
 with open(path,'rb') as f:
  for part in iter(lambda:f.read(1024*1024),b''):h.update(part)
 return h.hexdigest()

def assert_blob(name, expected_sha=None, expected_sha512=None):
 folder=V/'objects'/name
 spec=json.loads((folder/'chunks.json').read_text())
 assert spec['name']==name,(name,spec.get('name'))
 sha=hashlib.sha256();sha512=hashlib.sha512();length=0
 for ch in spec['chunks']:
  assert 0<ch['size']<=40*1024*1024,(name,ch)
  file=folder/ch['file']
  assert file.is_file() and file.stat().st_size==ch['size'],file
  assert digest(file)==ch['sha256'],file
  with open(file,'rb') as f:
   for block in iter(lambda:f.read(1024*1024),b''):
    sha.update(block);sha512.update(block);length+=len(block)
 assert length==spec['size'] and sha.hexdigest()==spec['sha256'],name
 if expected_sha:assert spec['sha256']==expected_sha,(name,'manifest SHA256 mismatch')
 if expected_sha512:assert sha512.hexdigest()==expected_sha512,(name,'manifest SHA512 mismatch')
 return spec

for item in ITEMS:
 name=item['name'];src=V/'sources'/name
 if item['kind']=='git':
  lock=json.loads((src/'VENDOR-ORIGIN.json').read_text())
  assert lock['name']==name and lock['commit']==item['commit'],name
  assert (src/'.git').exists() is False,name
  bundle=assert_blob(name)
  header=(V/'objects'/name/bundle['chunks'][0]['file']).open('rb').read(180)
  assert header.startswith(b'# v2 git bundle\n') and (item['commit']+' HEAD').encode() in header,name
 elif item['kind']=='archive':
  # Compare against independent dependency pins, not only vault-local hashes.
  assert_blob(name,item.get('sha256'),item.get('sha512'))
  if name!='pacbrew':
   meta=json.loads((src/'VENDOR-ORIGIN.json').read_text())
   assert meta['name']==name,name
 elif item['kind']=='files':
  for entry in item['files']:
   p=src/entry['name'];assert p.is_file() and digest(p)==entry['sha256'],p
 for idx,extra in enumerate(item.get('setup_prefetch',())):
  assert_blob(name+f'-setup-{idx}',extra['sha256'])
print(f'VENDOR_COMPLETE_OK pinned={len(ITEMS)} source_roots={sum((V / 'sources' / i['name']).is_dir() for i in ITEMS)} archive_bundles={sum((V / 'objects' / i['name'] / 'chunks.json').is_file() for i in ITEMS)} bootstrap_objects={sum(len(i.get('setup_prefetch',())) for i in ITEMS)} all_hashes_valid')

# Prove the actual loader can hydrate a new build checkout without user cache,
# DNS, or original upstream. Leave canonical sources untouched: compilers and
# backport generators must receive disposable working trees, not symlinks.
import tempfile
import sys
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'tools'))
import deps
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='eden-vendor-airgap-') as tmp:
 isolated=Path(tmp)
 # Keep the extra git dependency inside this temporary airgap, not in /tmp
 # next to unrelated build jobs and not on the user's persistent filesystem.
 import os
 os.environ['PROSPEROEDEN_GIT_DEPS_ROOT']=str(isolated/'repos')
 deps.ROOT=isolated
 deps.CACHE=isolated/'empty-source-cache'
 deps.OFFLINE=True
 for name in ('eden','fmt','compiler-rt','zbic','encore-overrides'):
  dep=next(x for x in ITEMS if x['name']==name)
  deps.fetch(dep)
  assert deps.present(dep),name
  target=deps.location(dep) if dep['kind'] in ('git','files') else isolated/dep['creates']
  assert not target.is_symlink(),f'{name}: source must be a mutable isolated copy'
 assert (isolated/'.deps/eden-5f142c79.tar.gz').is_file()
 assert (isolated/'.deps/fmt-12.1.0.tar.gz').is_file()
 assert deps.revision(isolated/'.deps/zbic-11b08f27')=='11b08f2712264bbed731545085cbd9702096ceb7'
 assert deps.revision(isolated/'repos/encore-overrides-review')=='95f21edf13bfbd2888602f2b419dd856d6d0fbfa'
 boilerplate=next(x for x in ITEMS if x['name']=='boilerplate')
 sdk=boilerplate['setup_prefetch'][1]
 archive=deps.download(sdk['url'],'sha256',sdk['sha256'],'boilerplate-ps5-payload-sdk.zip')
 assert archive.is_file() and hashlib.sha256(archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==sdk['sha256']
print('VENDOR_AIRGAP_OK empty-cache Eden tar + isolated source, fmt, compiler-rt, original Git SHA, PS5 SDK 0.42')
# Upstream source files cannot be rewritten just to satisfy our own formatting
# policy. GitHub source CI must validate our changes while exempting only
# verbatim third-party sources and binary Git/archive objects.
preflight=(ROOT/'.github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml').read_text()
assert 'git diff --check FETCH_HEAD HEAD -- .' in preflight
assert "':(exclude)vendor/sources/**'" in preflight
assert "':(exclude)vendor/objects/**'" in preflight
assert "':(exclude)vendor/encore-active/**'" in preflight
print('VENDOR_SOURCE_DIFF_POLICY_OK native Encore changes checked, pristine upstream excluded')
```

`tools/check-vendored-eden-cache-rebase-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Replayed Eden native build-cache source install with immutable pin safety.

A scratch cache may contain generated older code from a previous build.
Never loosen manifest source hashes or overwrite arbitrary user checkouts.
This test runs the real installer against a tiny owned source-cache fixture.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
import tempfile

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
script=root/"tools/install-vendored-eden-backports.py"
module=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("encore_vendored_cache",script)
assert module and module.loader
app=importlib.util.module_from_spec(module)
module.loader.exec_module(app)
assert "--repair-owned-cache" in script.read_text()
assert "tools/install-vendored-eden-backports.py --repair-owned-cache" in (
    root/"tools/prepare-build.sh").read_text()
rel="src/video_core/texture_cache/texture_cache.h"
added="src/core/added.cpp"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-owned-cache-replay-") as tmp:
    here=Path(tmp)
    src=here/"immutable"
    active=here/"reviewed"
    cache=here/"ps5-eden-headless.fixture"
    native=cache/"source"
    other=here/"unowned"/"source"
    cache.mkdir()
    (cache/"owner").write_text(str(root.resolve())+"\n")
    for place in (src,active,native,other):
        place.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    old=b"immutable pinned source bytes"
    approved=b"reviewed shipping patched bytes"
    obsolete=b"prior generated source from cached build"
    new=b"new source checked into the reviewed overlay"
    for folder,relpath,content in (
        (src,rel,old),(active,rel,approved),(active,added,new),
        (native,rel,obsolete),(other,rel,obsolete)):
        target=folder/relpath
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        target.write_bytes(content)
    for location in (native,other):
        (location/"GIT-COMMIT").write_text(app.PIN+"\n")
    manifest={
        "entries":{
            rel:{"upstream":app.sha(old),"active":app.sha(approved)},
            added:{"upstream":None,"active":app.sha(new)},
        },
        "shipping_receipts":{".encore-backport-fixture.sha256":"fixture"},
    }
    app.ORIGINAL=src
    app.ACTIVE=active
    app.verify=lambda:manifest
    assert app.is_owned_cached_source(native)
    assert not app.is_owned_cached_source(other)
    # Strict default MUST refuse unknown cached modifications.
    try:
        app.install(native)
    except RuntimeError as exc:
        assert "Unknown previous source modifications" in str(exc)
    else:
        raise AssertionError("Unrecognized cache content was silently accepted")
    assert (native/rel).read_bytes()==obsolete
    try:
        app.install(other,repair_owned_cache=True)
    except RuntimeError as exc:
        assert "owner-stamped" in str(exc)
    else:
        raise AssertionError("Unowned source was changed")
    assert (other/rel).read_bytes()==obsolete
    app.install(native,repair_owned_cache=True)
    assert (native/rel).read_bytes()==approved
    assert (native/added).read_bytes()==new
    backup=cache/".eden-stale-overlay-backup"/(rel+"."+app.sha(obsolete)[:16])
    assert backup.read_bytes()==obsolete
    assert (src/rel).read_bytes()==old and (active/rel).read_bytes()==approved
    # Repeated make prepare must be idempotent, not create new backups.
    app.install(native,repair_owned_cache=True)
    assert len(list((cache/".eden-stale-overlay-backup").rglob("*.h.*")))==1
    # Reject a symlinked target inside an authorized scratch cache.
    (native/rel).unlink()
    (native/rel).symlink_to(other/rel)
    try:
        app.install(native,repair_owned_cache=True)
    except RuntimeError as exc:
        assert "Symlinked" in str(exc)
    else:
        raise AssertionError("Symlinked cached code accepted")
    assert (other/rel).read_bytes()==obsolete
    (native/rel).unlink()
    (native/rel).write_bytes(approved)
    # Refuse a foreign pin even inside an otherwise authorized cache.
    (native/"GIT-COMMIT").write_text("wrong revision\n")
    try:
        app.install(native,repair_owned_cache=True)
    except RuntimeError as exc:
        assert "wrong Eden source version" in str(exc)
    else:
        raise AssertionError("Foreign source version accepted")
    # Check the original has not been changed by the rebase.
    assert (src/rel).read_bytes()==old
    # A stale backup with different bytes may NEVER authorize replacement.
    (native/"GIT-COMMIT").write_text(app.PIN+"\n")
    bad_backup = cache/".eden-stale-overlay-backup"/(rel+"."+app.sha(obsolete)[:16])
    bad_backup.write_bytes(b"corrupted saved copy")
    (native/rel).write_bytes(obsolete)
    try:
        app.install(native,repair_owned_cache=True)
    except RuntimeError as exc:
        assert "Stale backup hash mismatch" in str(exc)
    else:
        raise AssertionError("Corrupted backup accepted as replay authorization")
    assert (native/rel).read_bytes()==obsolete
    bad_backup.write_bytes(obsolete)
print("EDEN_VENDORED_CACHE_REBASE_HOST_PASS pinned=1 owned_only=1 backup=1"
      " idempotent=1 symlink_rejected=1 wrong_pin_rejected=1")
```

`tools/check-vendored-fiber-source.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Prove the migrated PS5 fiber handoff compiles the exact previously derived code.

This byte-exact check prevents ABI/runtime drift when replacing CMake
string(REPLACE) generation with vendor/encore-active source.
"""
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
pinned = (root/"vendor/sources/eden/src/common/fiber.cpp").read_text()
active = (root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/common/fiber.cpp").read_text()
cmake = (root/"headless/CMakeLists.txt").read_text()
first = "    to.impl->previous_fiber = weak_from.lock();"
old = '    // "from" might no longer be valid if the thread was killed\n    if (auto from = weak_from.lock()) {'
new = '    if (auto* from = static_cast<Fiber*>(transfer.data)) {'
assert pinned.count(first) == 1
assert pinned.count(old) == 1
expected = pinned.replace(first, first + "\n    ASSERT(to.impl->previous_fiber);\n    weak_from.reset();")
expected = expected.replace(old, new)
stack_before = 'struct Fiber::FiberImpl {\n    FiberImpl() {}\n\n    u32 canary_1 = CANARY_VALUE;\n    std::array<u8, DEFAULT_STACK_SIZE> stack{};\n    std::array<u8, DEFAULT_STACK_SIZE> rewind_stack{};\n    u32 canary_2 = CANARY_VALUE;\n'
stack_after = 'namespace {\nstruct FiberStack {\n    // Native thread stacks need writable storage, not zero-filled payloads.\n    // Keep both canaries adjacent to the allocated stack itself.\n    FiberStack() noexcept : canary_1{CANARY_VALUE}, canary_2{CANARY_VALUE} {}\n    u32 canary_1;\n    std::array<u8, DEFAULT_STACK_SIZE> bytes;\n    u32 canary_2;\n};\n} // namespace\n\nstruct Fiber::FiberImpl {\n    FiberImpl() = default;\n\n    // Host-thread fibers already use their OS stack. Guest/switch fibers\n    // allocate just their active stack; the old rewind array was unused.\n    std::unique_ptr<FiberStack> stack;\n'
assert expected.count(stack_before) == 1
expected = expected.replace(stack_before, stack_after)
for before, after in (
    ('    impl->stack_limit = impl->stack.data();\n    impl->rewind_stack_limit = impl->rewind_stack.data();',
     '    impl->stack = std::make_unique<FiberStack>();\n    impl->stack_limit = impl->stack->bytes.data();'),
    ('make_fcontext(stack_base, impl->stack.size(),', 'make_fcontext(stack_base, impl->stack->bytes.size(),'),
    ('ASSERT(fiber->impl->canary_1 == CANARY_VALUE);', 'ASSERT(fiber->impl->stack->canary_1 == CANARY_VALUE);'),
    ('ASSERT(fiber->impl->canary_2 == CANARY_VALUE);', 'ASSERT(fiber->impl->stack->canary_2 == CANARY_VALUE);'),
):
    assert expected.count(before) == 1
    expected = expected.replace(before, after)
assert active == expected, "tracked fiber source differs beyond the reviewed stack/lifetime changes"
assert 'set(EDEN_FIBER_ACTIVE "${PORT_ROOT}/vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/common/fiber.cpp")' in cmake
assert 'list(APPEND common_sources "${EDEN_FIBER_ACTIVE}")' in cmake
assert 'write_derived("${PORT_BUILD_DIR}/fiber.cpp"' not in cmake
assert 'list(APPEND common_sources "${PORT_BUILD_DIR}/fiber.cpp")' not in cmake
print("PASS: exact fiber transition and weak-ref cleanup moved from CMake generation to tracked C++")
```

`tools/check-vendored-gpu-thread.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Verify the shipping GPU worker and headers against actual native CMake copies.

The previous GPU synthesis in the non-native else branch was unreachable.
The four tracked Encore files, not a reconstructed generator, are authority.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SOURCE = ROOT / 'vendor/sources/eden'
TARGET = ROOT / 'vendor/encore-active/eden-gpu'
CMAKE_SOURCE = ROOT / 'headless/CMakeLists.txt'


def expected_files() -> dict[str, bytes]:
    names = (
        'gpu_thread_quiet.cpp', 'gpu_thread_dev.cpp',
        'include/video_core/gpu_thread.h', 'include/common/bounded_threadsafe_queue.h',
    )
    present = {str(p.relative_to(TARGET)) for p in TARGET.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
    assert present == set(names), (present - set(names), set(names) - present)
    result = {name: (TARGET / name).read_bytes() for name in names}
    queue = result['include/common/bounded_threadsafe_queue.h']
    assert b'union Slot {' in queue
    assert b'std::array<Slot, Capacity> m_data;' in queue
    assert queue.count(
        b'std::construct_at(std::addressof(m_data[pos].value)') == 2
    assert queue.count(
        b'std::destroy_at(std::addressof(m_data[pos].value));') == 1
    assert queue.count(
        b'std::destroy_at(std::addressof(m_data[cursor % Capacity].value));') == 1
    assert b'std::destroy_at(std::addressof(m_data[pos]));' not in queue
    return result


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--materialize', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    generated = expected_files()
    if args.materialize:
        print('Sources maintained in encore-active: no regeneration permitted.')
    present = {str(p.relative_to(TARGET)): p for p in TARGET.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
    assert present.keys() == generated.keys(), (generated.keys() - present.keys(), present.keys() - generated.keys())
    for relative, content in generated.items():
        assert present[relative].read_bytes() == content, f'R345 maintained GPU source mismatch: {relative}'
    assert b'SPSCQueue<CommandDataContainer, 256>' in generated['include/video_core/gpu_thread.h']
    assert b'EmplaceWaitWithStopToken' in generated['include/common/bounded_threadsafe_queue.h']
    assert b'DiagnosticTimer' in generated['gpu_thread_dev.cpp']
    assert b'DiagnosticTimer' not in generated['gpu_thread_quiet.cpp']
    # The historical headless/native_gpu_thread.inc was already byte-identical
    # to the common tail of both maintained full compilation units. It must
    # never return as a parallel third implementation of the native worker.
    marker = b'#include <memory>\\n'.replace(b'\\n', b'\n')
    quiet, dev = (generated[f'gpu_thread_{kind}.cpp'] for kind in ('quiet', 'dev'))
    assert quiet.count(marker) == dev.count(marker) == 1
    native_quiet = quiet[quiet.index(marker):]
    native_dev = dev[dev.index(marker):]
    assert native_quiet == native_dev, 'GPU worker lifecycle differs across maintained variants'
    assert native_quiet.count(b'void ThreadManager::StartThread(') == 1
    assert native_quiet.count(b'void ThreadManager::Stop()') == 1
    assert b'pthread_join(thread, nullptr)' in native_quiet
    assert not (ROOT / 'headless/native_gpu_thread.inc').exists(), 'obsolete duplicate GPU worker reintroduced'
    cmake = CMAKE_SOURCE.read_text()
    assert 'vendor/encore-active/eden-gpu' in cmake
    assert cmake.count('configure_file("${EDEN_ACTIVE_GPU}/') == 3
    assert 'EDEN_GPU_WORKER_VARIANT "gpu_thread_dev.cpp"' not in cmake
    assert 'EDEN_GPU_WORKER_VARIANT "gpu_thread_quiet.cpp"' in cmake
    assert 'write_derived("${PORT_BUILD_DIR}/gpu_thread.cpp"' not in cmake
    assert 'write_derived("${PORT_BUILD_DIR}/include/common/bounded_threadsafe_queue.h"' not in cmake
    # Execute the real PS5 CMake path in script mode, not merely a source-text
    # assertion: the resulting compiler inputs must match both committed
    # variants, and none may require the historical replacement pipeline.
    marker='    if(PS5_NATIVE)\n        set(EDEN_ACTIVE_GPU'
    after='    else()\n    # PS5 GPU queue is already copied from the complete eden-gpu source above.'
    assert cmake.count(marker)==cmake.count(after)==1
    native=cmake[cmake.index(marker):cmake.index(after,cmake.index(marker))]+'    endif()\n'
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='eden-gpu-cmake-contract-') as d:
        work=Path(d)
        for profile in ('quiet',):
            build=work/profile
            build.mkdir()
            script=work/f'{profile}.cmake'
            script.write_text(f'cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)\n'
                              f'set(PORT_ROOT "{ROOT.as_posix()}")\n'
                              f'set(PORT_BUILD_DIR "{build.as_posix()}")\n'
                              f'set(PS5_NATIVE ON)\n'
                              f'set(EDEN_DEV_PROFILE {"ON" if profile=="dev" else "OFF"})\n'
                              f'set(video_sources "gpu_thread.cpp")\n'
                              f'set(gpu_source "original")\n'+native)
            subprocess.run(['cmake','-P',str(script)],cwd=ROOT,check=True,timeout=30)
            assert (build/'gpu_thread.cpp').read_bytes()==generated['gpu_thread_quiet.cpp']
            for name in ('include/video_core/gpu_thread.h', 'include/common/bounded_threadsafe_queue.h'):
                assert (build/name).read_bytes()==generated[name], (profile,name)
    print('VENDORED_GPU_CMAKE_NATIVE_BRANCH_OK native_quiet=selected dev=unselected; historical variant bytes verified')
    print('VENDORED_GPU_THREAD_EQUIVALENT_OK', len(generated),
          'bounded 256-slot FIFO, stop-aware worker, dev/quiet source variants')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Byte-for-byte pinned Mesa adaptation replay and production installer checks."""
from __future__ import annotations
import filecmp
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import shutil
import os

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
ACTIVE = ROOT / 'vendor/encore-active/ps5-mesa'
SOURCE = ROOT / 'vendor/sources/ps5-mesa'
assert (SOURCE / 'VENDOR-ORIGIN.json').is_file()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='eden-radv-fork-equivalence-') as tmp:
    temp = Path(tmp)
    subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', str(ROOT / 'tools/patch-radv-wsi.py'), '--oracle',
                    str(SOURCE), str(temp)], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
    before = {str(p.relative_to(temp)): p for p in temp.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
    after = {str(p.relative_to(ACTIVE)): p for p in ACTIVE.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
    assert len(before) == len(after) == 12
    assert before.keys() == after.keys(), f'changed file list: {before.keys() ^ after.keys()}'
    for relative in before:
        assert filecmp.cmp(before[relative], after[relative], shallow=False), relative
    print('VENDORED_RADV_FORK_EQUIVALENT_OK count=12 patch_oracle_matches_active_sources')

    # Replay installation from the EXACT original pinned inputs, then retry
    # idempotently. Unexpected prior modifications must fail closed.
    from importlib.util import spec_from_file_location, module_from_spec
    spec = spec_from_file_location('install_active_radv', ROOT / 'tools/install-vendored-radv.py')
    module = module_from_spec(spec)
    assert spec and spec.loader
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    source_stage = temp / 'staged'
    for relative in before:
        file = source_stage / relative
        file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copy2(SOURCE / relative, file)
    provenance = temp / 'PROVENANCE.txt'
    provenance.write_text('upstream native build receipt')
    # Simulate restored Ninja object files newer than this source. A content
    # rewrite must explicitly refresh its mtime or Ninja can skip recompiling.
    wsi_input = source_stage / 'src/vulkan/wsi/wsi_common_videoout.c'
    assert module.digest(wsi_input) != module.digest(ACTIVE / 'src/vulkan/wsi/wsi_common_videoout.c')
    os.utime(wsi_input, ns=(1_000_000_000, 1_000_000_000))
    # copy2 alone would preserve the checkout timestamp on the canonical
    # source. Verify that installation makes the compiled input newer than
    # those unchanged source bytes; comparing to a wall-clock nanosecond
    # sampled just before os.utime can race filesystem clock precision.
    canonical_mtime_ns = (ACTIVE / 'src/vulkan/wsi/wsi_common_videoout.c').stat().st_mtime_ns
    module.install(source_stage, provenance)
    assert wsi_input.stat().st_mtime_ns > canonical_mtime_ns, 'Native source changed but Ninja input timestamp stayed stale'
    assert not provenance.exists() and provenance.with_suffix('.base.txt').exists()
    module.install(source_stage, provenance)
    for relative in before:
        assert filecmp.cmp(source_stage / relative, ACTIVE / relative, shallow=False)
    # A restored actions/cache can contain multiple R343 active RADV units
    # simultaneously. Test the entire mixed-generation staging tree: old
    # complete files -> canonical current inputs, then enforce idempotence.
    historical = {
        'src/vulkan/wsi/wsi_common_videoout.c':
            ROOT / 'tools/fixtures/ps5-r398-wsi-videoout.c',
        'src/amd/vulkan/radv_cmd_buffer.c':
            ROOT / 'tools/fixtures/ps5-r343-radv-cmd-buffer.c',
        'src/amd/vulkan/radv_physical_device.c':
            ROOT / 'tools/fixtures/ps5-r343-radv-physical-device.c',
        'src/amd/vulkan/winsys/ps5/radv_ps5_winsys.c':
            ROOT / 'tools/fixtures/ps5-r343-radv-winsys.c',
        'src/amd/vulkan/winsys/ps5/radv_ps5_platform.c':
            ROOT / 'tools/fixtures/ps5-r343-radv-platform.c',
    }
    assert set(module.LEGACY_COMPILER_SHA256) == set(historical)
    for relative, fixture in historical.items():
        old_sha = module.digest(fixture)
        assert old_sha in module.LEGACY_COMPILER_SHA256[relative], relative
        assert module.approved_compiler_input(
            relative, old_sha, module.digest(SOURCE / relative),
            module.digest(ACTIVE / relative))
        for unrelated in before:
            if unrelated == relative:
                continue
            assert not module.approved_compiler_input(
                unrelated, old_sha, module.digest(SOURCE / unrelated),
                module.digest(ACTIVE / unrelated)), (relative, unrelated)
        shutil.copy2(fixture, source_stage / relative)
    module.install(source_stage, None)
    module.install(source_stage, None)
    for relative in before:
        assert filecmp.cmp(source_stage / relative, ACTIVE / relative, shallow=False), relative

    # R447: cache from a previous R400..R439 native build is verified
    # byte-for-byte against the source we committed BEFORE Pereira's R440 WSI.
    # The 4175... hash appeared in R446 and blocked an otherwise valid build.
    pre_r440 = ROOT / 'tools/fixtures/ps5-r439-wsi-videoout.c'
    wsi = 'src/vulkan/wsi/wsi_common_videoout.c'
    assert module.digest(pre_r440) in module.PRE_R440_COMPILER_SHA256[wsi]
    assert module.approved_compiler_input(
        wsi, module.digest(pre_r440), module.digest(SOURCE / wsi),
        module.digest(ACTIVE / wsi))
    shutil.copy2(pre_r440, source_stage / wsi)
    module.install(source_stage, None)
    assert filecmp.cmp(source_stage / wsi, ACTIVE / wsi, shallow=False)
    # Do not quietly clobber unknown source changes in a fresh driver export.
    invalid = source_stage / next(iter(before))
    invalid.write_bytes(b'unexpected unknown upstream revision')
    try:
        module.install(source_stage, None)
    except RuntimeError as exc:
        assert 'Unrecognized RADV compiler input' in str(exc), str(exc)
    else:
        raise AssertionError('unexpected Mesa source rewrite was accepted')

build = (ROOT / 'tools/build-radv-dependencies.sh').read_text()
assert 'install-vendored-radv.py' in build
assert 'python3 "$root/tools/patch-radv-wsi.py"' not in build
assert build.count('bash "$vulkan/tools/build-radv.sh" release') == 2
assert 'src/util/disk_cache_os.c' in module.PATHS
assert 'EDEN_WSI_SHA256' in build
print('VENDORED_RADV_ACTIVE_INSTALL_OK immutable Mesa pin, mixed R343/R398 cached inputs, unknown-source rejection')
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Verify tracked native Vulkan C++ fork exactly matches validated R337 source generator."""
from pathlib import Path
import filecmp
import json
import hashlib
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
active=root/'vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan'
upstream=root/'vendor/sources/eden'
assert (upstream/'VENDOR-ORIGIN.json').exists()
assert (active/'vulkan_renderer.cpp').exists()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='eden-vulkan-fork-compare-') as d:
    temp=Path(d)
    # The *production* renderer has always consumed Eden AFTER the ordered
    # 43 shipping backports, not the pristine archive. Reproduce that exact
    # working source before comparing the versioned Vulkan C++ translation
    # units; otherwise stale GPU lifetime / texture-cache patches leak in.
    patched=temp/'patched-eden'
    shutil.copytree(upstream,patched,symlinks=True)
    (patched/'GIT-COMMIT').write_text('5f142c7926d0c7fcbbd0ce30794d72f638a43b2a\n')
    backport_install = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, '-B',
         str(root / 'tools/install-vendored-eden-backports.py'), str(patched)],
        timeout=50, capture_output=True, text=True)
    if backport_install.returncode:
        # A captured CalledProcessError alone concealed the failing source
        # path after the graphics merge. Keep strict failure and show the
        # actual bounded installer diagnostics for reproducible repair.
        raise RuntimeError(
            'Vulkan backport staging failed: ' +
            backport_install.stderr[-2800:] + ' ' +
            backport_install.stdout[-1200:])
    # Pin shader input text separately from binary reproducibility. Avoid
    # depending on a nondeterministic host glslangValidator version in CI.
    expected_shaders={
        'vert':'b7efb0f17a2cfb2ac044d0d678dfd7f970323deef86c10d25dde8ed723ef0290',
        'frag':'3f5287326b7554164449f5f849f46aae3d2f69ff3a0b4c5c822055bd1877c6d6',
    }
    for stage, digest in expected_shaders.items():
        source=root/'headless'/f'vulkan_hud.{stage}'
        assert hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,source
        assert (active/f'vulkan_hud.{stage}.spv').is_file()
    # The reviewed 2026-11-08 palette/contrast shader source must match
    # its real glslang-compiled, spirv-val-checked Vulkan 1.1 artifact.
    # A source-only pin is insufficient: the old 2026-10-30 SPIR-V was stale.
    assert hashlib.sha256((active/'vulkan_hud.frag.spv').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==(
        '029a4bb7c594cc3beadefc731a67768e9f80987ae10a2cb20a5a197a8ebea10b'
    ), 'Vulkan HUD SPIR-V has drifted from the validated palette shader'
    env=os.environ.copy()
    env['EDEN_VULKAN_ORACLE_SPV_DIR']=str(active)
    oracle_script=(root/'tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py').read_text()
    vulkan_cmake=(root/'headless/vulkan.cmake').read_text()
    assert "vulkan_oracle = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan-oracles'" in oracle_script
    for part in ("vulkan_loading.inc", "vulkan_hud_prepare.inc", "vulkan_hud_draw.inc",
                 "vulkan_gc_downloads.inc", "vulkan_download_batch.inc"):
        assert (root/'vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan-oracles'/part).is_file()
        assert not (root/'headless'/part).exists()
        assert (f"vulkan_oracle / '{part}'") in oracle_script
        assert part not in vulkan_cmake, ("oracle accidentally tracked as compiled Vulkan input", part)
    subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B',str(root/'tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py'),str(patched),str(temp/'generated')],check=True,timeout=150,env=env)
    actual={str(p.relative_to(temp/'generated')):p for p in (temp/'generated').rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
    expected={str(p.relative_to(active)):p for p in active.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
    # Two intentional native-only sources are not generator outputs:
    # a synchronization helper and the F07 Vulkan allocator OOM diagnostics.
    # All generated Vulkan translation units still remain byte-identical.
    helper='include/video_core/renderer_vulkan/striped_wait.h'
    allocator='vulkan_memory_allocator.cpp'
    # Shared native GPU budget admission owner, usable by both NS1 and NS2.
    # It is additive, never regenerated from the original upstream Vulkan.
    pool_policy='include/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_shared_gpu_budget.h'
    # A common NS1/NS2 SPIR-V reflection primitive. The generator owns both
    # call sites, but this standalone header has no upstream equivalent.
    storage_layout='include/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_compute_storage_layout.h'
    assert storage_layout not in actual, 'common storage layout falsely regenerated'
    assert subprocess.check_output(
        ['git','hash-object',str(expected[storage_layout])],text=True
    ).strip() == 'f1cb4c7d91a30c56d55807ae62d796702ad1362f', (
        'common compute reflection owner drift')
    assert pool_policy not in actual, 'native GPU budget leaked into generator'
    assert subprocess.check_output(
        ['git','hash-object',str(expected[pool_policy])],text=True
    ).strip() == '85cc400399ee8daf82037dfc0f070d3d66eebb68', 'shared GPU policy drift'
    oom_check = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, '-B', str(root/'tools/check-ps5-vulkan-oom-source.py')],
        timeout=15, capture_output=True, text=True)
    if oom_check.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError('F07 allocator source parity failed (code %d):\n%s\n%s' % (
            oom_check.returncode, oom_check.stdout, oom_check.stderr))
    assert allocator not in actual, 'generated Vulkan port unexpectedly owns the allocator'
    # The native Task/Mesh device extension header is a genuine maintained
    # header; require exact two-hunk parity with the pinned vendor snapshot.
    native_mesh_device_header='include/video_core/vulkan_common/vulkan_device.h'
    assert native_mesh_device_header not in actual
    mesh_device = expected[native_mesh_device_header].read_text()
    mesh_feature_line = "    FEATURE(EXT, MeshShader, MESH_SHADER, mesh_shader)                                             \\\n"
    mesh_feature_method = "    /// Returns true if the device supports task and mesh shaders (VK_EXT_mesh_shader).\n    bool IsExtMeshShaderSupported() const {\n        return extensions.mesh_shader && features.mesh_shader.taskShader &&\n               features.mesh_shader.meshShader;\n    }\n\n"
    # The N58 sparse-residency header is an independently reviewed
    # additive feature. Our single Vulkan Device ABI must retain BOTH that
    # feature and Task/Mesh. Prove both deltas against immutable Eden.
    pinned_device = (upstream/'src/video_core/vulkan_common/vulkan_device.h').read_text()
    sparse_device = (root/'vendor/encore-active/ns2-helpers/include/video_core/vulkan_common/vulkan_device.h').read_text()
    sparse_start = sparse_device.index('    // N58: image sparse residency')
    sparse_end = sparse_device.index('    /// Returns true for tile-based deferred renderers.', sparse_start)
    sparse_delta = sparse_device[sparse_start:sparse_end]
    assert sparse_device.count(sparse_delta) == 1 and sparse_device.replace(sparse_delta, '') == pinned_device, (
        "N58 source ABI must be a complete exact additive sparse residency guard")
    assert mesh_device.count(mesh_feature_line) == 1
    assert mesh_device.count(mesh_feature_method) == 1
    assert mesh_device.count(sparse_delta) == 1, (

    assert (mesh_device.replace(mesh_feature_line, '')

    approved_native_additions = {

        for row in additive_manifest.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()
        if row.strip() and not row.lstrip().startswith('#')
    }
    assert len(approved_native_additions) == 238, (
        'Reviewed native additive inventory count changed',
        len(approved_native_additions))
    assert not set(actual) - set(expected), (
        'Generator emitted a Vulkan file absent from the active vendor',
        sorted(set(actual) - set(expected)))

        'Vulkan active native additive inventory drift',
        'unreviewed:', sorted(unexpected_additions - approved_native_additions),
        'missing:', sorted(approved_native_additions - unexpected_additions))
    # Byte-for-byte parity of every generated owner remains mandatory below.
    helper_file=expected[helper]

        '16749faa8c0f1047de0485af53ff2de65d66be7d'), 'upstream wait primitive drift'
    for name in (
        'include/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_graphics_pipeline.h',
        'include/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_compute_pipeline.h',
    ):
        source=actual[name].read_text()
        old='    std::condition_variable build_condvar;\n    std::mutex build_mutex;'
        new='    ::Eden::StripedCondition build_condvar;\n    ::Eden::StripedMutex build_mutex;'

    # and DMA image now also require a live Vulkan handle, not just Buffer*.
    # Verify all three paths independently, not a combined obsolete count.
    assert raster.count("if (!buffer)") == 1, "draw indirect pointer guard drift"

    # P2.3: reconstruct the exact reviewed mutable-QMD CBUF/SSBO

    # P2.2b generator now reproduces the entire historical QMD owner and

    # still take the exact previous patch chain below. Full-file parity is
    # checked afterward in both cases: no source bypass or vendor copy.
    if "native_images.reserve(typed_descriptors->size())" in raster:
        assert "texture_cache.PinNativeImageView(id)" in raster
        assert "std::move(pinned_lifetime)" in raster
    else:
        qmd_binding_previous = "        scheduler.RequestOutsideRenderPassOperationContext();\n        {\n            std::scoped_lock lock{buffer_cache.mutex};\n            if (!pipeline->ConfigureNative(\n                    *resources, *gpu_memory, scheduler, buffer_cache)) return false;\n        }\n        if (!registry.IsComputeCurrent(kepler_compute, *ticket)) {"

    sampler_memo = "    // Sampler table mapping is stable while the paired guest cache locks are\n    // held. A direct-mapped memo re-resolved each alternating\n    // handle under the GPU texture-cache mutex. Open addressing has no heap\n    // allocations; saturation falls back to the original lookup, never a\n    // stale ID. Descriptor invalidation cannot cross this draw-local scope.\n    struct SamplerMemo {\n        u32 handle;\n        VideoCommon::SamplerId id;\n    };\n    // A single occupancy mask replaces per-entry valid-byte clearing on\n    // every graphics draw.     def n3m_hash(data):
        value = 0xcbf29ce484222325
        for byte in data.encode('ascii'):
            value = ((value ^ byte) * 0x100000001b3) & 0xffffffffffffffff
        return f'{value:016x}'

    # P2.4: the Vulkan Task/Mesh changes are versioned as exact reversible

    def git_blob_sha(text):
        data=text.encode('utf-8')
        return hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(data)).encode()+b'\0'+data).hexdigest()
    def reverse_native_kepler_pointer_abi(name, text, verify_hash):
        # The maintained native QMD3 renderer uses RasterizerInterface's
        # KeplerCompute pointer, not a reference. Reverse only 5 member
        # accesses, 6 borrowed-reference calls and the null admission guard.
        # Recreate the ORIGINAL reviewed blob byte-for-byte before P24 reversal,
        # so we never bless unrelated vendor changes or weaken the hash oracle.
        if name != 'vulkan_rasterizer.cpp':
            return text
        start_marker = 'bool RasterizerVulkan::DispatchNativeCompute('
        assert text.count(start_marker) == 1, 'Native QMD3 renderer ABI owner moved'
        start = text.index(start_marker)
        finish = text.index('\nvoid RasterizerVulkan::', start)
        part = text[start:finish]
        guard = (
            '    // ChannelStateCache binds a KeplerCompute pointer; only native process\n'
            '    // tickets authorize dereference, and the channel may be unbound.\n'
            '    if (!kepler_compute) return false;\n'
        )
        assert part.count(guard) == 1, 'Native compute null-guard drift'
        assert part.count('kepler_compute->regs') == 5, 'QMD3 registers ABI drift'
        assert part.count('*kepler_compute, *gpu_memory') == 6, 'QMD3 texture owner ABI drift'
        part = part.replace(guard, '')
        part = part.replace('kepler_compute->regs', 'kepler_compute.regs')
        part = part.replace('*kepler_compute, *gpu_memory', 'kepler_compute, *gpu_memory')
        baseline = text[:start] + part + text[finish:]
        if verify_hash:
            assert git_blob_sha(baseline) == p24_by_path[name]['maintained_blob_sha'], (
                'Unreviewed native KeplerCompute ABI edit', name)
        return baseline

    def reverse_p24(name, text, verify_hash=True):
        receipt=p24_by_path.get(name)
        if receipt is None:
            return text
        # G07 write-commit is an independently reviewed post-P24 production
        # fix, not a historical Task/Mesh or MSAA source change. Reverse its
        # one exact hunk before checking the IMMUTABLE old raw-blob receipt.
        # Any unrelated edit still fails the original Git blob SHA check.
        if name == 'vulkan_rasterizer.cpp':
            before = "            if (!resources->ValidateGpuBufferMappings(\n                    [this](u64 address, u32 bytes) {\n                        return Shader::Ampere::NativeQmdContiguousGpuSpan(\n                            address, bytes, [this](u64 page) {\n                                return gpu_memory->GpuToCpuAddress(page);\n                            });\n                    }))\n                return false;"
            after = "            // A VA can stay mapped while a guest remaps its physical pages.\n            // Recheck the exact pre-staging backing here, under the commit\n            // lock, not merely contiguous coverage. Matches also validates\n            // the full 49-bit span, so no second mapping walk is needed.\n            if (!staged_buffer_mappings.Matches(\n                    *resources, [this](u64 address) {\n                        return gpu_memory->GpuToCpuAddress(address);\n                    }))\n                return false;"
            assert text.count(after) == 1, (
                'G07 physical-backing write-commit reversible hunk drift', name)
            text = text.replace(after, before, 1)
        later=post_by_path.get(name)
        if later and verify_hash:
            assert git_blob_sha(text) == later['post_change_raw_blob_sha'], (
                'Post-P24 reviewed Vulkan raw source drift', name)
        # Keep the separate native KeplerCompute pointer ABI proof. Its
        # normalization happens before reversing the later MSAA additions.
        text = reverse_native_kepler_pointer_abi(name, text, verify_hash=False)
        if later:
            for hunk in reversed(later['reverse_hunks']):
                assert text.count(hunk['after']) == 1, (
                    'Post-P24 MSAA reverse hunk drift', name)
                text=text.replace(hunk['after'],hunk['before'])
        if verify_hash:
            assert git_blob_sha(text) == receipt['maintained_blob_sha'], (
                'Task/Mesh maintained owner drift after MSAA reversal', name)
        for hunk in reversed(receipt['hunks']):
            assert text.count(hunk['after']) == 1, ('Task/Mesh delta hunk drift',name)
            text=text.replace(hunk['after'],hunk['before'])
        if verify_hash:
            assert git_blob_sha(text) == receipt['pinned_blob_sha'], (
                'Task/Mesh source reverse parity failed', name)
        return text
    # Verify EVERY owner and show precise refusals without weakening the
    # historical SHA or accepting a changed vendor submodule by coincidence.

    for name in p24_by_path:

    # Distinguish maintained SOURCE evolution from the historical test
```
