```py
            "dae3449987b134683664d94b5bc13c72724700c2",
            [(
                "    // The sampled native image's exact view format and sample count are\n"
                "    // needed for strict neural LDR/HDR and MSAA source admission.\n"
                "    VkFormat sampled_format{VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED};\n"
                "    VkSampleCountFlagBits sample_count{VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT};\n",
                "",
            )],
        ),
        "include/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_pipeline_cache.h": (
            "343383c7b5ed55f181cee9d840e6b59fae0409d0",
            [(
                "    // Shared 1x/2x/4x/8x/16x selector. The default NS1 path calls this\n"
                "    // with VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT; PS5-native retains authenticated GMMU\n"
                "    // shader capture and the strict forced-MSAA admission path.\n"
                "    [[nodiscard]] GraphicsPipeline* CurrentGraphicsPipelineForMsaa(\n"
                "        VkSampleCountFlagBits requested_samples);\n",
                "    // Creates/selects a distinct native MSAA variant without modifying guest\n"
                "    // registers, image sample counts, or the ordinary 1x pipeline cache key.\n"
                "    // Caller must prove a clear, single colour RT, no depth/aliasing.\n"
                "    [[nodiscard]] GraphicsPipeline* CurrentGraphicsPipelineForMsaa(\n"
                "        VkSampleCountFlagBits samples);\n",
            )],
        ),
    }
    for name, (raw_sha, edits) in post_generator_headers.items():
        raw = expected[name].read_text()
        assert git_blob_sha(raw) == raw_sha, (
            "Unexpected shipping Vulkan ABI header; no historical normalization", name)
        normalized = raw
        for added, former in edits:
            assert normalized.count(added) == 1, (
                "Reviewed Vulkan ABI header delta moved or duplicated", name)
            normalized = normalized.replace(added, former)
        output = temp/'normalized-vendor-post-generator-headers'/name
        output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        output.write_text(normalized)
        normalized_expected[name] = output
    # N73's strict source normalizer already reverses the SIX native guest
    # colour-attachment capture statements in the maintained texture TU.
    # The historic generator emits these exact statements; reverse them
    # there too, rather than misreporting an otherwise equal texture owner.
    # The real production TU and its N57/N73 SHA receipts are untouched.
    from ns2.native_astc_vendor_parity import strip_post_n73_msaa_framebuffer_source
    tex_name = 'vk_texture_cache_cost.cpp'
    generated_texture = normalized_generated[tex_name].read_text()
    baseline_texture = strip_post_n73_msaa_framebuffer_source(generated_texture)
    assert baseline_texture != generated_texture, (
        "Historical generator has unexpectedly lost native MSAA capture")
    tex_output = temp/'normalized-generated-post-n73'/tex_name
    tex_output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    tex_output.write_text(baseline_texture)
    normalized_generated[tex_name] = tex_output
    print("ENCORE_POST_GENERATOR_REVIEWED_SOURCE_PARITY",
          "headers=2", "native_texture_capture_statements=6",
          "current_vulkan_source_preserved=1", flush=True)
    # The maintained native MSAA path superseded three historical
    # generator owners. Reconstruct the CI-observed exact source delta
    # instead of weakening parity or rewriting the old generation oracle.
    # BOTH input (original generated) and output (current normalized vendor)
    # must have independently pinned SHA256 from the same real CI run.
    # This recognizes a reviewed post-generator integration layer; it does
    # not claim that the old generator directly emits the new implementation.
    resolve_receipt = json.loads(
        (root / 'tools/fixtures/p04-post-generator-native-resolve-parity.json').read_text())
    assert resolve_receipt['schema_version'] == 1
    assert resolve_receipt['source_vendor_gitlink'] == post['source_vendor_gitlink']
    resolve_paths = {x['path'] for x in resolve_receipt['files']}
    assert resolve_paths == {
        'include/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_rasterizer.h',
        'include/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_scheduler.h',
        'vulkan_scheduler.cpp',
    }
    resolve_hunks = 0
    for entry in resolve_receipt['files']:
        name = entry['path']
        generated_text = normalized_generated[name].read_text()
        shipping_text = normalized_expected.get(name, expected[name]).read_text()
        digest = lambda x: hashlib.sha256(x.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()
        assert digest(generated_text) == entry['generated_sha256'], (
            'Unreviewed Vulkan historical generator drift', name)
        assert digest(shipping_text) == entry['normalized_maintained_sha256'], (
            'Unreviewed Vulkan maintained scheduler/MSAA source drift', name)
        normalized = generated_text
        assert 1 <= len(entry['hunks']) <= 4
        for patch in entry['hunks']:
            assert patch['before'] != patch['after']
            assert patch['before'] and patch['after']
            assert normalized.count(patch['before']) == 1, (
                'Native MSAA generator reconstruction anchor drift', name)
            normalized = normalized.replace(patch['before'], patch['after'], 1)
            resolve_hunks += 1
        assert digest(normalized) == entry['normalized_maintained_sha256'], (
            'Native MSAA reconstruction changed a non-reviewed byte', name)
        assert normalized == shipping_text, (
            'Vulkan generated/native resolve source mismatch', name)
        out = temp/'normalized-generator-post-native-resolve'/name
        out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        out.write_text(normalized)
        normalized_generated[name] = out
    print('ENCORE_NATIVE_MSAA_GENERATOR_RECONSTRUCTION_PASS',
          f'owners={len(resolve_paths)}',
          f'exact_hunks={resolve_hunks}',
          'source_sha256_pinned=1',
          'historical_generator_unchanged=1', flush=True)
    # Native G07: exact production-only pipeline/descriptor-layout gate.
    # The older reviewed source generator does not include this later fail-
    # closed QMD3 path; reverse ONLY its actual hunk for strict byte parity.
    # A changed generator or any unrelated maintained byte still fails.
    compute_name = 'vk_compute_pipeline_cost.cpp'
    g07_previous = "        if (!pipeline) return false;"
    g07_current = "        // A successful native QMD3 dispatch must have both the Vulkan\n        // pipeline layout and every required descriptor-set layout. The\n        // recorded lambda would otherwise silently skip descriptor binding\n        // while the renderer could still mark guest SSBOs as GPU-written.\n        // Empty shaders are allowed to omit a descriptor-set layout.\n        if (!pipeline || !pipeline_layout ||\n            (num_descriptor_entries && !descriptor_set_layout))\n            return false;"
    active_compute = expected[compute_name].read_text()
    assert active_compute.count(g07_current) == 1, (
        'G07 native compute pipeline-layout fail-closed hunk drift')
    historical_compute = active_compute.replace(g07_current, g07_previous, 1)
    native_pipeline_path = temp / 'normalized-vendor-g07' / compute_name
    native_pipeline_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    native_pipeline_path.write_text(historical_compute)
    normalized_expected[compute_name] = native_pipeline_path
    print('ENCORE_G07_COMPUTE_LAYOUT_REVERSE_PARITY_PASS',
          'historical_generator=immutable', 'native_guard=fail_closed', flush=True)

    mismatches=[name for name in sorted(actual) if not filecmp.cmp(normalized_generated[name],normalized_expected.get(name, expected[name]),shallow=False)]
    if mismatches:
        # Print a tightly bounded exact diff before failing. The generator and
        # active files previously looked equivalent in high-level assertions,
        # forcing repeated CI runs to diagnose a single byte of drift.
        from difflib import unified_diff
        from itertools import islice
        for name in mismatches:
            generated, versioned = normalized_generated[name], normalized_expected.get(name, expected[name])
            # Print BOTH exact bytes' SHA for every failing owner. Without this,
            # the earlier first-five display hid the scheduler and HUD drift,
            # forcing multiple long CI cycles to identify a known mismatch.
            print("VULKAN_ORACLE_OWNER_SHA",
                  name,
                  "generated_sha256=" + hashlib.sha256(generated.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                  "maintained_normalized_sha256=" + hashlib.sha256(versioned.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                  flush=True)
            if not name.endswith(('.cpp', '.h', '.py', '.cmake')):
                print(f'VULKAN_ORACLE_BINARY_DIFF {name} SHA256={hashlib.sha256(generated.read_bytes()).hexdigest()} '
                      f'active_SHA256={hashlib.sha256(versioned.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}', flush=True)
                continue
            diff = unified_diff(generated.read_text().splitlines(keepends=True),
                                versioned.read_text().splitlines(keepends=True),
                                fromfile=f'generated/{name}', tofile=f'active/{name}')
            for line in islice(diff, 130):
                print(line, end='', flush=True)
        raise AssertionError(f'vendored Vulkan C++ differs from pinned generated source: {mismatches}')
    # Versioned code must compile after fresh clone at a different checkout
    # path: forbids CMake/host absolute paths embedded in generated C++.
    for name, file in expected.items():
        if name.endswith(('.cpp', '.h')):
            data=file.read_text()
            assert '#include "/private/tmp/' not in data and '#include "/home/runner/' not in data,(name,'checkout-specific include')
    assert '#include "performance.h"' in expected['vk_pipeline_cache_cost.cpp'].read_text()
    assert len(actual)>=35
    cmake=(root/'headless/vulkan.cmake').read_text()
    assert 'vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan' in cmake
    assert 'file(COPY "${EDEN_ACTIVE_VULKAN}/" DESTINATION "${PORT_BUILD_DIR}")' in cmake
    assert 'execute_process(COMMAND python3 "${PORT_ROOT}/tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py"' not in cmake
    print(f'VENDORED_VULKAN_FORK_EQUIVALENT_OK files={len(actual)} active=versioned not regenerated')
```

`tools/check-vulkan-buffer-frame-tick-snapshot-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Source-extracted frame-reclamation tick snapshot, ASan/UBSan (host only)."""
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import shutil
import tempfile
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
ACTIVE=(ROOT/"vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vk_buffer_cache_cost.cpp").read_text()
PIN=(ROOT/"vendor/sources/eden/src/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_buffer_cache.cpp").read_text()
GEN=(ROOT/"tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py").read_text()
FAST=(ROOT/".github/workflows/encore-core-fast-gate.yml").read_text()
FULL=(ROOT/".github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml").read_text()
assert "python3 -B tools/check-vulkan-buffer-frame-tick-snapshot-host.py" in FAST
assert "python3 -B tools/check-vulkan-buffer-frame-tick-snapshot-host.py" in FULL
assert "Capture the completed GPU tick once" in GEN
start="void BufferCacheRuntime::TickFrame("
end="\n\nu64 BufferCacheRuntime::CurrentTick()"
def extract(s):
    assert s.count(start)==1 and s.count(end)==1
    return s[s.index(start):s.index(end,s.index(start))]
original=extract(PIN)
modified=extract(ACTIVE)
assert "scheduler.IsFree(it->LastUsageTick())" in original
assert "scheduler.GetMasterSemaphore().KnownGpuTick()" in modified
assert "scheduler.IsFree(it->LastUsageTick())" not in modified
assert "#ifdef PS5_NATIVE\n    // No tracked buffers" in modified
assert modified.index("if (slot_buffers.begin() == slot_buffers.end())") < modified.index("KnownGpuTick()")
assert "No tracked buffers: avoid even the GPU-completion semaphore snapshot" in GEN
assert "sampled_completed_tick" in modified
assert modified.index("if (last_tick == 0)") < modified.index("KnownGpuTick();", modified.index("for (auto it = slot_buffers.begin()"))
cpp=r"""
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <vector>
using u64=std::uint64_t;
namespace Common { template<class T> struct SlotVector:std::vector<T>{}; }
struct Buffer {
  u64 tick;
  bool tracking=true;
  u64 LastUsageTick() const noexcept {return tick;}
  void ResetUsageTracking() noexcept {
    tracking=false;
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    // The selected Buffer::ResetUsageTracking retires the usage tick too.
    tick=0;
#endif
  }
};
struct MasterSemaphore {
  u64 completed=0;
  mutable unsigned reads=0;
  u64 KnownGpuTick() const noexcept {++reads;return completed;}
};
struct Scheduler {
  MasterSemaphore& m;
  bool IsFree(u64 tick)const noexcept{return m.KnownGpuTick()>=tick;}
  MasterSemaphore& GetMasterSemaphore()const noexcept{return m;}
};
struct BufferCacheRuntime {
  Scheduler& scheduler;
  void TickFrame(Common::SlotVector<Buffer>&) noexcept;
};
INJECT
int main(){
  MasterSemaphore sem{7,0};
  Scheduler scheduler{sem};
  BufferCacheRuntime cache{scheduler};
  Common::SlotVector<Buffer> buffers;
  for(u64 tick:std::array<u64,6>{0,3,6,7,8,12})
    buffers.push_back(Buffer{tick,tick!=0});
  cache.TickFrame(buffers);
  for(unsigned i=0;i<buffers.size();++i)
    assert(buffers[i].tracking==(i>=4));
  assert(sem.reads==FRAME_READS);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
  // The initial unused buffer has tick zero, not a pending GPU use.
  assert(buffers[0].tick==0);
  for(unsigned i=1;i<4;++i)assert(buffers[i].tick==0);
  assert(buffers[4].tick==8 && buffers[5].tick==12);
#endif
  sem.completed=12;
  cache.TickFrame(buffers);
  for(const auto& buffer:buffers)assert(!buffer.tracking);
  assert(sem.reads==2*FRAME_READS);
  // Every resident buffer has now retired, but the container is nonempty.
  // The PS5 path must not poll the GPU semaphore on subsequent idle frames.
  cache.TickFrame(buffers);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
  assert(sem.reads==2*FRAME_READS);
#else
  assert(sem.reads==3*FRAME_READS);
#endif
  buffers.clear();
  cache.TickFrame(buffers);
  assert(sem.reads==
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
         EMPTY_NATIVE_READS
#else
         EMPTY_READS
#endif
  );
  std::puts("ENCORE_BUFFER_FRAME_TICK_SNAPSHOT_PASS");
}
"""
compiler=shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
assert compiler
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-tick-snapshot-") as d:
    folder=Path(d)
    for name,body,reads,empty,native_empty,ps5 in (
        ("pinned",original,6,18,18,False),
        ("maintained-desktop",modified,1,4,4,False),
        ("maintained-ps5",modified,1,4,2,True),
    ):
        src=folder/(name+".cpp")
        binary=folder/name
        program=(cpp.replace("INJECT",body)
                    .replace("EMPTY_NATIVE_READS",str(native_empty))
                    .replace("FRAME_READS",str(reads))
                    .replace("EMPTY_READS",str(empty)))
        src.write_text(program)
        subprocess.run([compiler,"-std=c++20","-O1","-g","-Wall","-Wextra","-Werror",
                        "-fsanitize=address,undefined","-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
                        *(["-DPS5_NATIVE=1"] if ps5 else []),
                        str(src),"-o",str(binary)],check=True,timeout=90)
        subprocess.run([str(binary)],check=True,timeout=30)
print("VULKAN_BUFFER_TICK_SNAPSHOT_HOST_PASS no_empty_ps5_poll=1 idle_resident_no_poll=1 desktop_unchanged=1; PS5 FPS unmeasured")
```

`tools/check-vulkan-buffer-usage-reset-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Native Vulkan per-buffer GPU usage retirement; source-extracted O0/O2 UBSan."""
import ast
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
active=(ROOT/"vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vk_buffer_cache_cost.cpp").read_text()
pinned=(ROOT/"vendor/sources/eden/src/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_buffer_cache.h").read_text()
generator=(ROOT/"tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py").read_text()
tree=ast.parse(generator)
header_replacements=[]
for statement in tree.body:
    if not isinstance(statement, ast.Expr) or not isinstance(statement.value, ast.Call):
        continue
    node=statement.value
    if not isinstance(node.func,ast.Name) or node.func.id!="adapt" or len(node.args)!=3:
        continue
    try:
        name=ast.literal_eval(node.args[0])
        dest=ast.literal_eval(node.args[1])
    except (ValueError,TypeError):
        continue
    if name=="src/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_buffer_cache.h":
        assert dest=="include/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_buffer_cache.h"
        header_replacements=ast.literal_eval(node.args[2])
assert len(header_replacements)==1
old, new=header_replacements[0]
assert old in pinned and pinned.count(old)==1
assert "last_usage_tick = 0;" in new and "#ifdef PS5_NATIVE" in new
header=pinned.replace(old,new)
# The selected shipping Vulkan fork must contain the same native header
# replayed from the installed Eden backport (not merely a test-only mock).
backport=(ROOT/"vendor/encore-active/eden-backports/src/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_buffer_cache.h").read_text()
maintained=(ROOT/"vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/include/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_buffer_cache.h").read_text()
assert backport.count(old)==1
assert maintained==backport.replace(old,new)
start=header.index("    void ResetUsageTracking() noexcept {")
stop=header.index("    [[nodiscard]] u64 LastUsageTick()",start)
reset=header[start:stop].strip()
assert "#ifdef PS5_NATIVE" in reset
runtime_start="void BufferCacheRuntime::TickFrame("
runtime_end="\nu64 BufferCacheRuntime::CurrentTick()"
assert active.count(runtime_start)==active.count(runtime_end)==1
method=active[active.index(runtime_start):active.index(runtime_end,active.index(runtime_start))]
assert "if (last_tick <= completed_tick)" in method
assert "if (last_tick == 0)" in method
assert "sampled_completed_tick" in method
assert "scheduler.GetMasterSemaphore().KnownGpuTick()" in method
for workflow in ("encore-core-fast-gate.yml","encore-core-preflight.yml"):
    assert "check-vulkan-buffer-usage-reset-host.py" in (ROOT/".github/workflows"/workflow).read_text()
cpp=r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>
using u64=std::uint64_t;
namespace Common {template<typename T>struct SlotVector:std::vector<T>{};}
struct Tracker {
    int resets{};
    bool active{};
    void Reset() {++resets;active=false;}
};
struct Buffer {
    Tracker tracker{};
    u64 last_usage_tick{};
__RESET__
    u64 LastUsageTick() const noexcept {return last_usage_tick;}
    void MarkUsage(u64 tick){tracker.active=true;last_usage_tick=tick;}
};
struct MasterSemaphore {
    u64 completed{};
    int samples{};
    u64 KnownGpuTick(){++samples;return completed;}
};
struct Scheduler {
    MasterSemaphore& sem;
    MasterSemaphore& GetMasterSemaphore(){return sem;}
};
struct BufferCacheRuntime {
    Scheduler& scheduler;
    void TickFrame(Common::SlotVector<Buffer>&) noexcept;
};
__TICK__
int main(){
    MasterSemaphore semaphore{15,0};
    Scheduler scheduler{semaphore};
    BufferCacheRuntime runtime{scheduler};
    Common::SlotVector<Buffer> buffers;
    buffers.resize(3);
    buffers[0].last_usage_tick=0; // idle from construction
    buffers[1].MarkUsage(10);
    buffers[2].MarkUsage(20);
    runtime.TickFrame(buffers);
    assert(semaphore.samples==1);
    assert(!buffers[1].tracker.active && buffers[1].tracker.resets==1);
    assert(buffers[2].tracker.active && buffers[2].tracker.resets==0);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(buffers[0].tracker.resets==0);
    assert(buffers[1].last_usage_tick==0);
#endif
    runtime.TickFrame(buffers);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(buffers[0].tracker.resets==0 && buffers[1].tracker.resets==1);
#else
    assert(buffers[0].tracker.resets==2 && buffers[1].tracker.resets==2);
#endif
    assert(buffers[2].tracker.resets==0);
    semaphore.completed=20;
    runtime.TickFrame(buffers);
    assert(!buffers[2].tracker.active && buffers[2].tracker.resets==1);
    buffers[1].MarkUsage(25); // reactivation must reset on NEXT completion
    runtime.TickFrame(buffers);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(buffers[1].tracker.active && buffers[1].tracker.resets==1);
#endif
    semaphore.completed=25;
    runtime.TickFrame(buffers);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(!buffers[1].tracker.active && buffers[1].tracker.resets==2);
    assert(buffers[1].last_usage_tick==0);
    assert(buffers[2].tracker.resets==1);
    // All buffers are now retired; no outstanding GPU work merits polling.
    const auto sampled=semaphore.samples;
    runtime.TickFrame(buffers);
    assert(semaphore.samples==sampled);
#else
    assert(!buffers[1].tracker.active && buffers[1].tracker.resets==4);
#endif
}
""".replace("__RESET__",reset).replace("__TICK__",method)
compiler=shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
assert compiler,"C++20 compiler required"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-vulkan-buffer-reset-") as d:
    source=Path(d)/"runtime.cpp"
    source.write_text(cpp)
    for native in (False,True):
        for opt in ("-O0","-O2"):
            out=Path(d)/f"runtime-{native}-{opt}"
            cmd=[compiler,"-std=c++20",opt,"-Wall","-Wextra","-Werror",
                 "-fsanitize=undefined","-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
                 *(['-DPS5_NATIVE=1'] if native else []),str(source),"-o",str(out)]
            built=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=45)
            assert built.returncode==0,(native,opt,built.stderr[-3000:])
            run=subprocess.run([str(out)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15)
            assert run.returncode==0,(native,opt,run.stderr[-3000:])
print("F07_BUFFER_USAGE_RESET_PASS O0=1 O2=1 native_retires_once=1 idle_skip_gpu_probe=1 reactivation=1 desktop_original=1")
```

`tools/check-vulkan-cache-atomic.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compile the EXACT PS5 Vulkan driver-cache serializer injected by the port.

Mocks only the vk::PipelineCache driver blob and logging. Tests replacement
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compile the real Vulkan Queue -> IsSignaled -> Wait fence path, host only.

Both pinned and maintained implementations use the real extracted C++ methods,
including FenceManager delegation. No native semaphore timing or PS5 FPS claim.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
ACTIVE = (ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vk_fence_manager_cost.cpp").read_text()
PINNED = (ROOT / "vendor/sources/eden/src/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_fence_manager.cpp").read_text()
GENERATOR = (ROOT / "tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py").read_text()
FAST = (ROOT / ".github/workflows/encore-core-fast-gate.yml").read_text()
FULL = (ROOT / ".github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml").read_text()

assert "python3 -B tools/check-vulkan-fence-completed-wait-host.py" in FAST
assert "python3 -B tools/check-vulkan-fence-completed-wait-host.py" in FULL
assert "'vk_fence_manager': [" in GENERATOR
assert "scheduler.IsFree(wait_tick)" in GENERATOR

SIGNATURES = (
    "void InnerFence::Queue()",
    "bool InnerFence::IsSignaled() const",
    "void InnerFence::Wait()",
    "void FenceManager::QueueFence(Fence& fence)",
    "bool FenceManager::IsFenceSignaled(Fence& fence) const",
    "void FenceManager::WaitFence(Fence& fence)",
)


def extract_method(source: str, signature: str) -> str:
    marker = signature + " {"
    assert source.count(marker) == 1, signature
    start = source.index(marker)
    opening = start + len(signature) + 1
    depth = 0
    for pos in range(opening, len(source)):
        if source[pos] == "{":
            depth += 1
        elif source[pos] == "}":
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0:
                return source[start:pos + 1]
    raise AssertionError("unbalanced C++ method: " + signature)


original = [extract_method(PINNED, symbol) for symbol in SIGNATURES]
maintained = [extract_method(ACTIVE, symbol) for symbol in SIGNATURES]
assert original[:2] == maintained[:2] and original[3:] == maintained[3:]
assert "scheduler.IsFree(wait_tick)" in maintained[2]
assert "scheduler.IsFree(wait_tick)" not in original[2]
assert original[2].count("scheduler.Wait(wait_tick);") == 1
assert maintained[2].count("scheduler.Wait(wait_tick);") == 1
# The real instrumentation timer has a destructor; the host double simply
# counts construction, so tell -Wunused-variable that this is intentional.
maintained[2] = maintained[2].replace(
    "auto timer = Eden::Performance::VulkanTimer(6)",
    "[[maybe_unused]] auto timer = Eden::Performance::VulkanTimer(6)",
)

cpp = r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <memory>

struct Scheduler {
    std::uint64_t current{9};
    std::uint64_t completed{5};
    mutable unsigned queries{};
    unsigned samples{}, flushes{}, waits{};
    std::uint64_t CurrentTick() { ++samples; return current; }
    void Flush() { ++flushes; }
    bool IsFree(std::uint64_t tick) const {
        ++queries;
        return tick <= completed;
    }
    void Wait(std::uint64_t tick) {
        ++waits;
        if (completed < tick) completed = tick;
    }
};

namespace Eden::Performance {
struct VulkanTimer {
    static inline unsigned starts{};
    explicit VulkanTimer(unsigned) { ++starts; }
};
}

struct InnerFence {
    Scheduler& scheduler;
    bool is_stubbed{};
    std::uint64_t wait_tick{};
    InnerFence(Scheduler& s, bool stubbed) : scheduler(s), is_stubbed(stubbed) {}
    void Queue();
    bool IsSignaled() const;
    void Wait();
};
using Fence = std::shared_ptr<InnerFence>;
struct FenceManager {
    void QueueFence(Fence&);
    bool IsFenceSignaled(Fence&) const;
    void WaitFence(Fence&);
};

INJECT

int main() {
    Scheduler scheduler;
    FenceManager manager;

    Fence stubbed = std::make_shared<InnerFence>(scheduler, true);
    manager.QueueFence(stubbed);
    assert(manager.IsFenceSignaled(stubbed));
    manager.WaitFence(stubbed);
    assert(scheduler.samples == 0 && scheduler.flushes == 0);
    assert(scheduler.waits == 0 && scheduler.queries == 0);

    Fence pending = std::make_shared<InnerFence>(scheduler, false);
    manager.QueueFence(pending);
    assert(pending->wait_tick == 9);
    assert(scheduler.samples == 1 && scheduler.flushes == 1);
    // Changing the producer tick cannot change an already queued fence.
    scheduler.current = 17;
    assert(!manager.IsFenceSignaled(pending));
    manager.WaitFence(pending);
    assert(scheduler.completed == 9 && scheduler.waits == 1);
    assert(manager.IsFenceSignaled(pending));
    manager.WaitFence(pending);

    // A newly queued fence can refer to a tick already completed.
    scheduler.current = 3;
    Fence completed = std::make_shared<InnerFence>(scheduler, false);
    manager.QueueFence(completed);
    assert(completed->wait_tick == 3);
    assert(manager.IsFenceSignaled(completed));
    manager.WaitFence(completed);

    assert(scheduler.samples == 2 && scheduler.flushes == 2);
    assert(scheduler.waits == EXPECTED_WAITS);
    assert(scheduler.queries == EXPECTED_QUERIES);
    assert(Eden::Performance::VulkanTimer::starts == EXPECTED_TIMERS);
    std::puts("ENCORE_VULKAN_FENCE_FULL_HANDOFF_HOST_PASS");
}
"""

compiler = shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
assert compiler, "host C++20 compiler unavailable"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-vulkan-fence-handoff-") as tmp:
    root = Path(tmp)
    for name, methods, waits, queries, timers in (
        ("pinned", original, 3, 3, 0),
        ("native", maintained, 1, 6, 1),
    ):
        src = root / (name + ".cpp")
        exe = root / name
        code = cpp.replace("INJECT", "\n\n".join(methods))
        code = code.replace("EXPECTED_WAITS", str(waits))
        code = code.replace("EXPECTED_QUERIES", str(queries))
        code = code.replace("EXPECTED_TIMERS", str(timers))
        src.write_text(code)
        subprocess.run(
            [compiler, "-std=c++20", "-O1", "-g", "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror",
             "-fsanitize=address,undefined", "-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
             str(src), "-o", str(exe)],
            check=True, timeout=90,
        )
        subprocess.run([str(exe)], check=True, timeout=30)

print("VULKAN_FENCE_HANDOFF_HOST_PASS; native GPU waits and PS5 FPS unmeasured")
```

```py
source = r"""
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <initializer_list>
#include <limits>
#include <thread>
#include "vulkan_gc_budget.h"
#include "vulkan_pool_capacity.h"
using Eden::VulkanMemory::AfterProjectedEviction;
static_assert(AfterProjectedEviction(0, 0) == 0);
static_assert(AfterProjectedEviction(0, 1) == 0);
static_assert(AfterProjectedEviction(1, 2) == 0);
static_assert(AfterProjectedEviction(100, 100) == 0);
static_assert(AfterProjectedEviction(100, 99) == 1);
static_assert(AfterProjectedEviction(UINT64_MAX, UINT64_MAX) == 0);
static_assert(AfterProjectedEviction(UINT64_MAX, 1) == UINT64_MAX - 1);
static_assert(AfterProjectedEviction(1, UINT64_MAX) == 0);
using Eden::VulkanMemory::OldestEvictionTick;
static_assert(OldestEvictionTick(0, 10) == 0);
static_assert(OldestEvictionTick(9, 10) == 0);
static_assert(OldestEvictionTick(10, 10) == 0);
static_assert(OldestEvictionTick(11, 10) == 1);
static_assert(OldestEvictionTick(24, 25) == 0);
static_assert(OldestEvictionTick(49, 50) == 0);
static_assert(OldestEvictionTick(50, 50) == 0);
static_assert(OldestEvictionTick(51, 50) == 1);
static_assert(OldestEvictionTick(UINT64_MAX, UINT64_MAX) == 0);
static_assert(OldestEvictionTick(UINT64_MAX, 10) == UINT64_MAX - 10);
int main() {
    // Transient kernel failure at VkDevice construction used to latch zero
    // capacity for the whole title and distort Vulkan texture GC thresholds.
    // Now one later VALID kernel observation repairs the capacity without
    // an extra probe, and the next title resets its own session baseline.
    Eden::VulkanMemory::PoolCapacityLatch capacity;
    assert(capacity.Value() == 0);
    assert(capacity.Observe(0) == 0);
    assert(capacity.Observe(512ULL << 20) == (512ULL << 20));
    assert(capacity.Observe(1ULL << 30) == (512ULL << 20));
    capacity.Reset(0);
    assert(capacity.Observe(0) == 0);
    assert(capacity.Observe(2ULL << 30) == (2ULL << 30));
    capacity.Reset(3ULL << 30);
    assert(capacity.Observe(1ULL << 30) == (3ULL << 30));
    // Multiple GPU/driver callers may observe the first available result.
    // Only one wins; immutable thereafter until explicit device reset.
    capacity.Reset(0);
    std::array<std::thread, 8> contenders;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < contenders.size(); ++i)
        contenders[i] = std::thread([&capacity, i] {
            for (int n = 0; n < 500; ++n) {
                const std::uint64_t offered = (i + 1) * (128ULL << 20);
                const auto seen = capacity.Observe(offered);
                assert(seen >= (128ULL << 20) && seen <= (1ULL << 30));
            }
        });
    for (auto& thread : contenders) thread.join();
    const auto locked = capacity.Value();
    assert(locked >= (128ULL << 20) && locked <= (1ULL << 30));
    assert(capacity.Observe(4ULL << 30) == locked);
    capacity.Reset(0);
    assert(capacity.Value() == 0);
    // Reproduce the actual startup path: frame_tick begins at zero, while
    // immediate VRAM pressure can enter the texture collector before frame 50.
    // For a new image touched on this frame, the cutoff must NEVER select it
    // as older than any age; the old wrap made cutoff enormous.
    for (std::uint64_t frame = 0; frame < 110; ++frame)
    for (std::uint64_t age : {10ULL, 25ULL, 50ULL}) {
        const auto cutoff = OldestEvictionTick(frame, age);
        const auto expected = frame >= age ? frame - age : 0;
        assert(cutoff == expected);
        assert(cutoff <= frame);
        if (frame < age)
            assert(cutoff == 0);
        if (frame > age)
            assert(cutoff < frame);
        // The real pinned LeastRecentlyUsedCache::ForEachItemBelow compares
        // an inclusive cutoff against the entry's touch tick. A zero cutoff
        // without the explicit frame>=age guard would evict first-frame data.
        const bool should_run_gc = frame >= age;
        const std::uint64_t initial_tick = 0;
        const bool frame_zero_texture_selected =
            should_run_gc && initial_tick <= cutoff;
        assert(frame_zero_texture_selected == (frame >= age));
        const bool current_frame_texture_selected =
            should_run_gc && frame <= cutoff;
        if (age != 0)
            assert(!current_frame_texture_selected);
    }

    std::uint64_t state = 0x534F4E5950533530ULL;
    constexpr auto next = [](std::uint64_t& x) {
        x ^= x << 13; x ^= x >> 7; x ^= x << 17;
        return x;
    };
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 200000; ++i) {
        auto used = next(state), reclaimed = next(state);
        const auto got = AfterProjectedEviction(used, reclaimed);
        const auto reference = reclaimed >= used ? 0 : used - reclaimed;
        assert(got == reference);
        assert(got <= used);
        assert(AfterProjectedEviction(got, reclaimed) <= got);
        const auto frame = next(state), age = next(state);
        const auto cutoff = OldestEvictionTick(frame, age);
        assert(cutoff == (frame >= age ? frame - age : 0));
        assert(cutoff <= frame);
    }
}
"""
```

```py
#include <boost/container/small_vector.hpp>

#include <vector>
struct ScopeExitMaker {};
template<class F> struct ScopeExit {
    F callback;
    ~ScopeExit() { callback(); }
};
template<class F> ScopeExit<std::decay_t<F>> operator+(ScopeExitMaker, F&& callback) {
    return {std::forward<F>(callback)};
}
#define SCOPE_EXIT auto scope_guard = ScopeExitMaker{} + [&]
#include "vulkan_gc_budget.h"

using ImageId = std::size_t;
using u64 = std::uint64_t;
namespace Eden::Performance {
bool KeepDirtyTextures() { return true; }
}
constexpr std::size_t operator""_MiB(unsigned long long size) {
    return static_cast<std::size_t>(size) * 1024 * 1024;
}
namespace Vulkan {
struct StagingBufferRef {
    std::size_t index{};
    std::size_t buffer{};
    std::span<std::uint8_t> mapped_span;
};
static_assert(std::is_trivially_copyable_v<StagingBufferRef>);
struct TextureCacheRuntime {
    std::size_t issued{}, completed{}, finishes{}, freed{}, queued_max{};
    std::vector<std::unique_ptr<std::uint8_t[]>> storage;
    std::vector<bool> deferred;
    bool short_first{}, throw_first{}, null_first{};
    StagingBufferRef DownloadStagingBuffer(std::size_t size, bool is_deferred = false) {
        assert(is_deferred);
        if (throw_first) {throw_first=false;throw std::bad_alloc{};}
        if (null_first) {
            null_first=false;
            // A null Vulkan buffer can still report a full CPU mapping.
            storage.push_back(std::make_unique<std::uint8_t[]>(size));
            return {0,0,{storage.back().get(),size}};
        }
        storage.push_back(std::make_unique<std::uint8_t[]>(size));
        deferred.push_back(true);
        ++issued;
        if(short_first) {short_first=false;return {issued,issued,{storage.back().get(),size-1}};}
        return {issued,issued,{storage.back().get(),size}};
    }
    void Finish() { completed = issued; ++finishes; }
    void FreeDeferredStagingBuffer(StagingBufferRef& ref) {
        assert(completed >= queued_max); // cannot release in-flight GPU readers
        assert(ref.index > 0 && ref.index <= issued);
        assert(deferred[ref.index - 1]);
        deferred[ref.index - 1] = false;
        ++freed;
    }
};
}
struct Info {
    ImageId id{};
    unsigned num_samples{1};
    bool no_regions{};
};
std::vector<ImageId> FullDownloadCopies(Info info) {
    if (info.no_regions) return {};
    return {info.id};
}
std::vector<ImageId> FixSmallVectorADL(std::vector<ImageId> copies) {
    return copies;
}
struct Image {
    Info info;
    std::size_t unswizzled_size_bytes;
    bool dirty;
    bool scaled = false;
    std::vector<ImageId> aliased_images;
    std::vector<ImageId> overlapping_images;
    u64 reclaimed_bytes{};
    bool decoding{false}, costly{false};
    unsigned fail_mode{}; // 1: bad_alloc, 2: invalid_argument, 3: unexpected runtime failure
    Vulkan::TextureCacheRuntime* recording_runtime{};
    bool HasScaled() const { return scaled; }
    void DownloadMemory(Vulkan::StagingBufferRef& map,
                        const std::vector<ImageId>& copies) {
        assert(copies.size() == 1 && copies[0] == info.id);
        assert(map.mapped_span.size() == unswizzled_size_bytes);
        if (recording_runtime) recording_runtime->queued_max = map.index;
        if (fail_mode == 1) throw std::bad_alloc{};
        if (fail_mode == 2) throw std::invalid_argument("mock invalid copy");
        if (fail_mode == 3) throw std::runtime_error("mock unexpected driver failure");
        if (!map.mapped_span.empty()) {
            map.mapped_span.front() = 0x19;
            map.mapped_span.back() = 0x37;
        }
    }
};
using ImageBase = Image;
struct Scenario {
    std::vector<Image> images;
    explicit Scenario(std::vector<Image> values) : images(std::move(values)) {}
    void Test(std::size_t expected, std::vector<ImageId> ids,
              std::size_t eviction_budget = 40,
              u64 initial_usage = 1000_MiB,
              std::size_t expected_scanned = 0,
              bool short_first=false, bool throw_first=false, bool null_first=false,
              unsigned fail_second=0) {
        Vulkan::TextureCacheRuntime runtime;
        runtime.short_first=short_first;
        runtime.throw_first=throw_first;
        runtime.null_first=null_first;
        if (fail_second) {
            assert(images.size() >= 2);
            images[1].fail_mode = fail_second;
        }
__PRODUCTION_DECLARATION__
        [[maybe_unused]] const auto ReleaseDownloads = [&] {
            for (auto& [id, map] : gc_downloads) {
                (void)id;
                runtime.FreeDeferredStagingBuffer(map);
            }
            gc_downloads.clear();
        };
        std::size_t bytes = 0;
        u64 usage = initial_usage;
        constexpr u64 critical_memory = 100_MiB;
        constexpr u64 expected_memory = 80_MiB;
        const bool aggressive_mode = true;
        const auto ReclaimedBytes = [](const ImageBase& image) -> u64 {
            return image.reclaimed_bytes;
        };
__PRODUCTION_PROJECTION__
        std::size_t scanned = 0;
        std::size_t remaining = eviction_budget;
        bool rethrew_unexpected = false;
        for (ImageId id = 0; id < images.size(); ++id) {
            if (remaining == 0 || scanned >= 8192) break;
            ++scanned;
            auto& image = images[id];
            image.recording_runtime = &runtime;
            // R442: decoding and costly-load images are visited but are not
            // eviction candidates; their presence cannot exhaust the budget.
            if (image.decoding || image.costly) continue;
            --remaining;
            const bool dirty = image.dirty;
            const auto scan_one = [&]() -> bool {
__PRODUCTION_RECORD__
                return NoteProjectedEviction(image);
            };
            try {
                if (scan_one()) break;
            } catch (const std::runtime_error&) {
                // Non-recoverable errors must still drain and retire EVERY
                // previously accepted map, then propagate to the caller.
                if (fail_second != 3) throw;
                rethrew_unexpected = true;
                break;
            }
            assert(bytes <= 32_MiB);
            assert(gc_downloads.size() <= gc_prefetch_limit);
            if (!fail_second)
                assert(runtime.freed == (short_first ? 1u : 0u));
        }
        assert(scanned <= 8192);
        assert(rethrew_unexpected == (fail_second == 3));
        if (expected_scanned != 0) assert(scanned == expected_scanned);
        assert(gc_downloads.size() == expected);
        std::vector<ImageId> actual;
        for (auto& entry : gc_downloads) actual.push_back(entry.first);
        assert(actual == ids);
        if (!gc_downloads.empty()) runtime.Finish();
        for (auto& [id, ref] : gc_downloads) {
            assert(id == images[id].info.id);
            assert(ref.mapped_span.empty() ||
                   (ref.mapped_span.front() == 0x19 &&
                    ref.mapped_span.back() == 0x37));
            runtime.FreeDeferredStagingBuffer(ref);
        }
        gc_downloads.clear();
        const auto rejected=short_first ? 1u : 0u;
        const auto rolled_back=fail_second ? 2u : 0u;
        assert(runtime.freed == expected + rejected + rolled_back);
        assert(runtime.issued == expected + rejected + rolled_back);
        assert(runtime.finishes == (expected ? 1u : 0u) + (fail_second ? 1u : 0u));
        if (fail_second)
            assert(runtime.completed == 2 && runtime.queued_max == 2);
    }
};
Image ImageFor(ImageId id, bool dirty, std::size_t size = 1024) {
    return {Info{id, 1}, size, dirty, false, {}, {}};
}
int main() {
    {
        auto clean = ImageFor(0, false);
        auto dirty = ImageFor(1, true);
        Scenario({clean, dirty}).Test(1, {1});
    }
    {

            if (i >= 16 && i < 40) ids.push_back(i);
        }

            images.push_back(std::move(item));

        // The 32-MiB staging budget is not enlarged to upstream's 64-MiB.
        std::vector<Image> images;

            scaled.scaled = true;

            if (i < 32) ids.push_back(i);

        Scenario(std::move(images)).Test(32, std::move(ids), 40, 1000_MiB, 33);
    }
    {
        // An oversized dirty image must use Cleanup's individual download.
        // It must not prevent the next independent small images from sharing
        // one Finish. The first huge image still consumes one scanned slot.
        std::vector<Image> images;
        std::vector<ImageId> ids;
        images.push_back(ImageFor(0, true, 33_MiB));
        for (ImageId i = 1; i <= 40; ++i) {
            images.push_back(ImageFor(i, true));
            if (i < 40) ids.push_back(i);
        }
        Scenario(std::move(images)).Test(39, std::move(ids));
    }

        // projected memory to remove pressure. No later dirty readback
        // should be submitted speculatively.
        std::vector<Image> images;
        images.push_back(ImageFor(0, false));
        images[0].reclaimed_bytes = 31_MiB;
        for (ImageId i = 1; i < 10; ++i)
            images.push_back(ImageFor(i, true));
        Scenario(std::move(images)).Test(0, {}, 40, 130_MiB, 1);
    }

        // eligible dirty readbacks. Stop at the third, before queuing a
        // fourth readback that Cleanup need not execute.
        std::vector<Image> images;
        images.push_back(ImageFor(0, false));
        images[0].reclaimed_bytes = 20_MiB;
        for (ImageId i = 1; i <= 10; ++i) {
            images.push_back(ImageFor(i, true));
            images.back().reclaimed_bytes = 5_MiB;
        }
        Scenario(std::move(images)).Test(3, {1, 2, 3}, 40, 130_MiB, 4);
    }

        // candidates no longer prevent their shared GPU Finish().
        std::vector<Image> images;
        for (ImageId i = 0; i < 185; ++i) {
            auto image = ImageFor(i, i >= 180);
            if (i < 120) image.decoding = true;
            else if (i < 180) image.costly = true;
            images.push_back(std::move(image));
        }

        std::vector<ImageId> ids;
        for (ImageId i = 0; i < 41; ++i) {
            images.push_back(ImageFor(i, true));
            if (i < 40) ids.push_back(i);
        }
        Scenario(std::move(images)).Test(40, std::move(ids));

    // projected as evicted. Continue to the NEXT valid dirty LRU image.
    {
        auto unsupported = ImageFor(0, true);
        unsupported.info.no_regions = true;
        Scenario({unsupported, ImageFor(1, true)}).Test(1, {1}, 40, 1000_MiB, 2);

    // downloads before recording GPU copies; real Cleanup can retry.

        0,{},40,1000_MiB,1,false,true);

    Scenario({ImageFor(0,true),ImageFor(1,true)}).Test(

    // both deferred maps MUST be fenced and freed, and no dirty image may
    // be advertised to Cleanup as prefetched.
    Scenario({ImageFor(0,true),ImageFor(1,true)}).Test(

        0,{},40,1000_MiB,2,false,false,false,2);

    // The same pending map retirement happens BEFORE the rethrow.
    Scenario({ImageFor(0,true),ImageFor(1,true)}).Test(
        0,{},40,1000_MiB,2,false,false,false,3);

        std::vector<ImageId> ids;

            if (i < 16) ids.push_back(i);
        }
        Scenario(std::move(images)).Test(16, std::move(ids));

}
```

```py
    std::size_t index{};
    std::span<std::uint8_t> mapped_span{};
};

struct TextureCacheRuntime {
    std::size_t issued{}, completed{}, finishes{}, freed{};
    std::vector<std::unique_ptr<std::uint8_t[]>> backing;
    std::vector<bool> deferred;
    StagingBufferRef DownloadStagingBuffer(std::size_t size, bool deferred_request = false) {
        assert(deferred_request);

        deferred.push_back(true);

    void FreeDeferredStagingBuffer(StagingBufferRef& map) {
        assert(map.index > 0 && map.index <= completed);
        assert(deferred[map.index - 1]);
        deferred[map.index - 1] = false;
        ++freed;
    }
};

        if (!map.mapped_span.empty()) {
            map.mapped_span.front() = 19;
            map.mapped_span.back() = 37;
        }
    }

    Runtime runtime;
    std::vector<Image> images;

    std::size_t bytes = 0;
    for (ImageId id = 0; id < images.size(); ++id) {
        auto& image = images[id];
        if (__ACTUAL_PREDICATE__) break;
        auto map = runtime.DownloadStagingBuffer(image.unswizzled_size_bytes, true);
        gc_downloads.emplace_back(id, map);
        image.DownloadMemory(map);

        assert(gc_downloads.size() <= gc_prefetch_limit);
        assert(runtime.freed == 0);
```

```py
    return true;
```

```py
    c.block_size=0; assert(!c.CanBindSparse(valid)); c.block_size=B;
```

`tools/check-vulkan-multirange-owner-lifetime-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compile maintained Vulkan multi-range retirement and ownership under ASan/UBSan.

Qualifies only native C++ host semantics: both sparse and gathered source
owners trigger retired-tick protection, with no early release while pending.
Not a measurement of real GPU queue completion or console frametimes.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SRC=(ROOT/"vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vk_multi_range_buffer_cost.cpp").read_text()
PIN=(ROOT/"vendor/sources/eden/src/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_multi_range_buffer.cpp").read_text()
GEN=(ROOT/"tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py").read_text()
FLOW=(ROOT/".github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml").read_text()
assert "python3 -B tools/check-vulkan-multirange-owner-lifetime-host.py" in FLOW
anchor="    entry.owners.reserve(sources.size());"
sparse="    if (CanBindSparse(sources)) {"
assert SRC.count(anchor)==PIN.count(anchor)==1
assert SRC.index(anchor) < SRC.index(sparse,SRC.index("MultiRangeRef MultiRangeBufferCache::Get("))
assert PIN.index(anchor) > PIN.index(sparse,PIN.index("MultiRangeRef MultiRangeBufferCache::Get("))
assert "DropOwner cannot retire a gathered buffer" in SRC
assert "DropOwner cannot retire a gathered buffer" in GEN
first=SRC.index(anchor)
end=SRC.index(sparse,first)
owners=SRC[first:end]
for n in ("entry.owners.reserve(sources.size());","entry.owners.push_back(source.handle);"):
    assert n in owners

def extract(start,end):
    assert SRC.count(start)==1 and SRC.count(end)==1, (start,end)
    return SRC[SRC.index(start):SRC.index(end,SRC.index(start))]
retire=extract("void MultiRangeBufferCache::RetireEntry(","void MultiRangeBufferCache::DrainRetired(")
# In production this RAII timer is meaningful through its real destructor.
# The host double has no destructor side effect; suppress only its warning.
retire=retire.replace("auto timer = Eden::Performance::VulkanTimer(11);",
                      "[[maybe_unused]] auto timer = Eden::Performance::VulkanTimer(11);")
drain=extract("void MultiRangeBufferCache::DrainRetired(","MultiRangeRef MultiRangeBufferCache::Get(")
drop=extract("void MultiRangeBufferCache::DropOwner(","void MultiRangeBufferCache::Invalidate(")
invalidate=SRC[SRC.index("void MultiRangeBufferCache::Invalidate("):SRC.rindex("} // namespace Vulkan")]

cpp=r"""
#include <algorithm>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <memory>
#include <span>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>
#include <boost/container/static_vector.hpp>
using u64=std::uint64_t;using VkBuffer=u64;
constexpr VkBuffer VK_NULL_HANDLE=0;
namespace Eden {
namespace Performance {struct VulkanTimer { explicit VulkanTimer(int){} };}
namespace DevVulkan {inline bool trace_pipelines=false;}
void Report(const char*,const char*){}
}
namespace Vulkan {
struct MultiRangeSource {VkBuffer handle{};};
struct Handle {
    std::shared_ptr<int> value{};
    Handle()=default;
    explicit Handle(int x):value(std::make_shared<int>(x)){}
    explicit operator bool() const {return bool(value);}
};
struct Scheduler {
    u64 now=1,completed=0;
    unsigned waits=0;
    u64 CurrentTick() const{return now;}
    bool IsFree(u64 tick) const{return tick<=completed;}
    void Wait(u64 tick) {assert(tick<=now);completed=std::max(completed,tick);++waits;}
};
class MultiRangeBufferCache {
public:
    static constexpr size_t MAX_RETIRED=256;
    struct Entry {
        Handle sparse_handle,gathered;
        std::vector<VkBuffer> owners;
        bool dirty=true;
    };
    struct Retired {Handle handle,gathered;u64 tick{};};
    std::unordered_map<u64,Entry> entries;
    boost::container::static_vector<Retired,MAX_RETIRED> retired;
    void Track(Entry& entry,std::span<const MultiRangeSource> sources) {
INJECT_OWNERS
    }
    void RetireEntry(Scheduler&,Entry&);
    void DrainRetired(Scheduler&);
    void DropOwner(Scheduler&,VkBuffer);
    void Invalidate(u64);
};
INJECT_RETIRE
INJECT_DRAIN
INJECT_DROP
INJECT_INVALIDATE
}
int main() {
    using namespace Vulkan;
    MultiRangeBufferCache cache;
    Scheduler sched;
    const MultiRangeSource source1{17},source2{23};
    auto add=[&](u64 key,VkBuffer handle,bool sparse,int id){
        MultiRangeBufferCache::Entry entry{};
        if(sparse)entry.sparse_handle=Handle(id);
        else entry.gathered=Handle(id);
        const MultiRangeSource sources[]={MultiRangeSource{handle}};
        cache.Track(entry,sources);
        assert(entry.owners.size()==1 && entry.owners[0]==handle);
        auto weak=std::weak_ptr<int>(sparse?entry.sparse_handle.value:entry.gathered.value);
        cache.entries.emplace(key,std::move(entry));
        return weak;
    };
    auto gathered=add(1,source1.handle,false,111);
    auto sparse=add(2,source1.handle,true,222);
    auto independent=add(3,source2.handle,false,333);
    cache.entries[3].dirty=false;
    cache.Invalidate(3);
    assert(cache.entries[3].dirty);
    cache.DropOwner(sched,0); // null owner is a no-op
    assert(cache.entries.size()==3);
    cache.DropOwner(sched,source1.handle);
    assert(cache.entries.size()==1 && cache.retired.size()==2);
    assert(!gathered.expired() && !sparse.expired() && !independent.expired());
    cache.DrainRetired(sched);
    assert(cache.retired.size()==2); // no premature GPU-free
    sched.completed=sched.now;
    cache.DrainRetired(sched);
    assert(cache.retired.empty() && gathered.expired() && sparse.expired());
    assert(!independent.expired());
    cache.DropOwner(sched,source2.handle);
    assert(cache.entries.empty() && cache.retired.size()==1);
    sched.completed=sched.now;
    cache.DrainRetired(sched);
    assert(independent.expired());
    // Saturate the fixed retirement queue and prove oldest-tick backpressure
    // reclaims safely without exceeding static_vector capacity.
    sched.completed=0;
    for(u64 i=0;i<300;++i){
        sched.now=i+20;
        auto w=add(i+100,900+i,(i%2)==0,1000+int(i));
        cache.DropOwner(sched,900+i);
        assert(cache.entries.empty());
        assert(cache.retired.size()<=MultiRangeBufferCache::MAX_RETIRED);
        if(i>=256)assert(sched.waits>0);
        if(i>=256)assert(!w.expired());
    }
    sched.completed=sched.now;
    cache.DrainRetired(sched);
    assert(cache.retired.empty() && sched.waits>0);
    std::puts("ENCORE_MULTIRANGE_OWNER_RETIREMENT_PASS");
}
""".replace("INJECT_OWNERS",owners).replace("INJECT_RETIRE",retire).replace(
    "INJECT_DRAIN",drain).replace("INJECT_DROP",drop).replace(
    "INJECT_INVALIDATE",invalidate)
compiler=shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
assert compiler,"C++20 compiler required"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-vulkan-owner-lifetime-") as name:
    folder=Path(name);source=folder/"test.cpp";exe=folder/"test"
    source.write_text(cpp)
    subprocess.run([compiler,"-std=c++20","-O1","-g","-Wall","-Wextra","-Werror",
                    "-fsanitize=address,undefined","-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
                    str(source),"-o",str(exe)],check=True,timeout=90)
    subprocess.run([str(exe)],check=True,timeout=30)
print("HOST_MULTIRANGE_OWNER_RETIREMENT_PASS native_fence_progress=unverified")
```

`tools/check-vulkan-pipeline-persistence.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Source contracts for PS5 foreground Vulkan pipeline caching.

Do not cancel the persistent compiler worker pool while initializing a title's
disk cache. This checks integration only; runtime PS5 result is not proven.
"""
import ast
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
main=(root/"headless/main.cpp").read_text()
port=(root/"tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py").read_text()
ast.parse(port)
assert 'Settings::values.use_disk_shader_cache = game;' in main
assert 'Settings::values.use_vulkan_driver_pipeline_cache = game;' in main
assert '#ifdef EDEN_PS5_VULKAN\n                if (game && Settings::values.use_disk_shader_cache.GetValue())' in main
assert 'lazy_cache.request_stop();' not in main
assert 'LoadDiskResources(\n                            title_id, std::stop_token{},' in main
assert 'mode=bounded-prewarm32' in main
assert 'EDEN_VULKAN_SHADER_CACHE title=' in main
assert 'if shader_source.count(lazy_vulkan_cache_anchor) != 1:' in port
assert 'if (stop_loading.stop_requested()) {' in port
assert 'LOG_INFO(Render_Vulkan, "PS5 lazy shader cache ready' in port
assert port.index('if (stop_loading.stop_requested()) {') < port.index('shader_source = shader_source.replace(lazy_vulkan_cache_anchor')
# An early return only after pipeline filenames and driver cache creation,
# before emitting any queue/wait/cancel commands: the worker pool survives.
v=port.split("lazy_vulkan_cache_replacement = '''",1)[1].split("'''",1)[0]
assert v.index('LoadVulkanPipelineCache(') < v.index('if (stop_loading.stop_requested())')
assert v.index('if (stop_loading.stop_requested())') < v.index('    struct {')
assert 'workers.WaitForRequests' not in v
# Quota implementation appears AFTER the lazy initialization branch in the
# pinned generator, so an intentional canceled token stays setup-only.
for i in range(5):
    assert f'f07_warm_before_{i}' in port
    assert f'f07_warm_after_{i}' in port
assert 'kStartupPrewarmPipelines = 32' in port
assert 'startup_reader.request_stop();' in port
assert 'workers.WaitForRequests(stop_loading);' in port
assert 'const std::stop_token reader_token{startup_reader.get_token()};' in port
assert 'VideoCommon::LoadPipelines(reader_token' in port
assert 'workers.WaitForRequests(reader_token)' not in port
assert 'vulkan_cache_create_anchor' in port
assert 'vulkan_cache_create_replacement' in port
assert 'if shader_source.count(vulkan_cache_create_anchor) != 1:' in port
assert 'if (data_size == 0) throw;' in port
assert 'Ignoring incompatible driver pipeline cache' in port
assert 'pipeline_cache_ci.initialDataSize = 0;' in port
assert 'if shader_source.count(vulkan_cache_save_anchor) != 1:' in port
assert 'vulkan_cache_save_replacement' in port
assert 'std::filesystem::rename(staging, filename, rename_error);' in port
assert 'std::lock_guard save_lock{save_mutex};' in port
assert 'file.flush();' in port and 'file.close();' in port
assert 'Retained old driver cache after failed save' in port
# PS5 branch must never remove an existing valid cache after an interrupted save.
# Reproduce the REAL patch order applied during native CMake generation:
# transactional PS5 driver-cache saving is injected BEFORE pipeline timer
# instrumentation. In build #37843116788 this changed the function from
# ") try {" to ") {" and an obsolete later shader_costs anchor aborted CMake.
# This regression must run before make prepare, not only after a failed build.
def literal(name: str):
    tree = ast.parse(port)
    for node in tree.body:
        if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and any(
                isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == name
                for target in node.targets):
            return ast.literal_eval(node.value)
    raise AssertionError(f"Missing Vulkan patch assignment: {name}")

original_save = literal("vulkan_cache_save_anchor")
rewritten_save = literal("vulkan_cache_save_replacement")
costs = literal("shader_costs")
timer_sites = [(old, new) for old, new in costs if "cache_version" in old]
assert len(timer_sites) == 1
timer_old, timer_new = timer_sites[0]
assert original_save.count("cache_version) try {") == 1
assert rewritten_save.count("cache_version) {") == 1
# This was the exact exception thrown by prepare-vulkan-port.py before any
# native C++ compilation. Match the generated *final* function, not upstream.
assert rewritten_save.count(timer_old) == 1
instrumented = rewritten_save.replace(timer_old, timer_new)
assert instrumented.count("Eden::Performance::VulkanTimer(18)") == 1
assert instrumented.count("std::filesystem::rename(staging, filename, rename_error)") == 1
assert instrumented.index("Eden::Performance::VulkanTimer(18)") < instrumented.index("#ifdef PS5_NATIVE")

saving = port.split("vulkan_cache_save_replacement = '''", 1)[1].split("'''", 1)[0]
native = saving.split("#ifdef PS5_NATIVE", 1)[1].split("#else", 1)[0]
assert 'std::filesystem::remove(filename' not in native
assert 'Common::FS::RemoveFile(filename)' not in native
assert 'std::filesystem::remove(staging, cleanup_error)' in native
print("PASS Vulkan PS5 bounded shader prewarm and non-destructive persistent worker pool")
print("Driver cache / filesystem correctness on real PS5: NOT TESTED")
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Validate release/acquire pipeline readiness on both native Vulkan paths.

Extracts the real pre-wait guard from the maintained graphics and compute
translation units. Host C++20 ASan/UBSan exercises already-built and racing
builder paths with shared non-atomic payload. Does NOT prove PS5 FPS.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess

#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>
struct TestPipeline {
    std::atomic_bool is_built{false};
    std::mutex build_mutex;
    std::condition_variable build_condvar;
    std::uint64_t handle{};
    unsigned took_wait_path{};
    void Build() {
        handle=0x8a55ff0011223344ULL;
        {
            std::scoped_lock lock{build_mutex};
            is_built.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
        }
        build_condvar.notify_all();
    }
    void WaitReady() {
GUARD_INJECT
            ++took_wait_path;
            std::unique_lock lock{build_mutex};
            build_condvar.wait(lock, [this] {
                return is_built.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
            });
        }
        assert(handle==0x8a55ff0011223344ULL);
    }
};
int main(){
    constexpr unsigned repeats=192;
    unsigned fast{},wait{};
    for(unsigned i=0;i<repeats;++i){
        TestPipeline p;
        p.Build();
        p.WaitReady();
        assert(p.took_wait_path==0);
        ++fast;
    }
    for(unsigned i=0;i<repeats;++i){
        TestPipeline p;
        std::thread worker([&]{p.WaitReady();});
        // Ensure the waiter can actually block and then be notified;
        // immediate publication is also a correct race outcome.
        std::this_thread::yield();
        p.Build();
        worker.join();
        if(p.took_wait_path) ++wait;
    }
    assert(fast==repeats);
    std::printf("VULKAN_PIPELINE_PUBLICATION_PASS ready=%u racing=%u slow=%u\n",
                fast,repeats,wait);
}
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""C++20 ASan/UBSan/TSan check of actual debug-only pipeline trace registry.

The exact generator strings are AST-extracted to verify both PS5 graphics and
compute pipeline-cache sites use the shared epoch/mutex helper and do not
retain unprotected function-static unordered_sets. This is NOT a GPU SDK run.
"""
import ast
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
generator = (root / "tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py").read_text()
tree = ast.parse(generator)
shader_costs = None
for node in tree.body:
    if (isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and any(
            isinstance(x, ast.Name) and x.id == "shader_costs"
            for x in node.targets)):
        shader_costs = ast.literal_eval(node.value)
        break
assert shader_costs
generated = "\n".join(rhs for lhs, rhs in shader_costs)
assert "PipelineTrace::graphics_first_use.Record(" in generated
assert "PipelineTrace::compute_first_use.Record(" in generated
assert generated.count("gpu_time_session.load(std::memory_order_acquire)") == 2
assert "traced.insert" not in generated and "traced.size()" not in generated
assert '#include "pipeline_trace_registry.h"' in generated
header = (root / "headless/pipeline_trace_registry.h").read_text()
assert "std::lock_guard lock(mutex_)" in header
assert "seen_.clear()" in header
assert "if (seen_.size() >= kMaxPipelinesPerTitle)" in header
assert "return inserted ? seen_.size() : 0;" in header

compiler = next((c for c in ("clang++-18", "clang++", "g++")
                 if shutil.which(c)), None)
if compiler is None:
    raise SystemExit("Missing C++20 compiler; no valid pipeline trace host proof")

cpp = r"""
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>
#include "pipeline_trace_registry.h"
using Eden::PipelineTrace::FirstUseRegistry;

int main() {
    std::vector<int> addresses(256);
    FirstUseRegistry registry;
    std::atomic<unsigned> first_use_count{0};
    std::vector<std::thread> workers;
    constexpr unsigned kWorkers = 16;
    for (unsigned worker = 0; worker < kWorkers; ++worker) {
        workers.emplace_back([&, worker] {
            for (unsigned trial = 0; trial < 256; ++trial) {
                const auto index = (worker * 13 + trial) % addresses.size();
                const auto ordinal = registry.Record(1, &addresses[index]);
                if (ordinal) {
                    assert(ordinal <= addresses.size());
                    first_use_count.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
                }
            }
        });
    }
    for (auto& worker : workers) worker.join();
    assert(first_use_count.load() == addresses.size());
    assert(registry.CountForTest() == addresses.size());
    assert(registry.Record(1, &addresses[5]) == 0);
    assert(registry.Record(2, &addresses[5]) == 1); // reused pointer, new game
    assert(registry.CountForTest() == 1);
    assert(registry.Record(2, nullptr) == 0);

    // Bound long-lived debug allocation without mutating normal Vulkan paths.
    std::vector<int> many(FirstUseRegistry::kMaxPipelinesPerTitle + 1);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < many.size(); ++i) {
        auto ordinal = registry.Record(3, &many[i]);
        if (i < FirstUseRegistry::kMaxPipelinesPerTitle)
            assert(ordinal == i + 1);
        else
            assert(ordinal == 0);
    }
    assert(registry.CountForTest() == FirstUseRegistry::kMaxPipelinesPerTitle);
    assert(registry.Record(4, &many.back()) == 1);
    assert(registry.CountForTest() == 1);

    // No accidental sharing of compute/graphics debug IDs.
    assert(Eden::PipelineTrace::graphics_first_use.Record(5, &many[0]) == 1);
    assert(Eden::PipelineTrace::compute_first_use.Record(5, &many[0]) == 1);
    assert(Eden::PipelineTrace::graphics_first_use.Record(5, &many[0]) == 0);
    assert(Eden::PipelineTrace::compute_first_use.Record(6, &many[0]) == 1);
}
"""
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-vk-trace-") as folder:
    file = Path(folder) / "trace.cpp"
    file.write_text(cpp)
    flags = [compiler, "-std=c++20", "-O1", "-g", "-pthread",
             "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror",
             "-fno-sanitize-recover=all", "-I", str(root / "headless")]
    binary = Path(folder) / "trace-asan"
    subprocess.run([*flags, "-fsanitize=address,undefined",
                    str(file), "-o", str(binary)], check=True, timeout=90)
    subprocess.run([str(binary)], check=True, timeout=180)
    if platform.system() == "Linux" and platform.machine() in ("x86_64", "aarch64"):
        tsan = Path(folder) / "trace-tsan"
        subprocess.run([*flags, "-fsanitize=thread",
                        str(file), "-o", str(tsan)], check=True, timeout=90)
        subprocess.run([str(tsan)], check=True, timeout=180)
print("PASS thread-safe Vulkan pipeline first-use trace: 16 workers, epoch reset, 65536 max, ASan/UBSan/TSan")
print("No native PS5 compiler/renderer tested")
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Host C++ sanitizer stand-in for the pinned PS5 Vulkan present waiter/error contract.

Also assert the EXACT source-generator fragments. Not a PS5 driver/build test.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
generator = (root / "tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py").read_text()
checks = (
    "bool present_in_flight{}; // guarded by queue_mutex",
    "std::size_t present_waiters{}; // drain waiters, guarded by queue_mutex",
    "std::size_t free_waiters{}; // guarded by free_mutex",
    "++free_waiters;",
    "--free_waiters;",
    "if (wake_free_waiter) free_cv.notify_one();",
    "notify_drainers = present_waiters != 0 && present_queue.empty();",
    "if (notify_drainers) frame_cv.notify_all();",
    "++present_waiters;",
    "--present_waiters;",
    "present_queue.pop_front();\\n            present_in_flight = true;",
    "present_in_flight = false;",
    "(present_queue.empty() && !present_in_flight)",
    "if (present_failure) std::rethrow_exception(present_failure);",
    "lock.unlock();\\n",
    "frame_cv.notify_all();",
    "present_ready_cv.notify_one();",
    "std::condition_variable_any present_ready_cv;",
)
for token in checks:
    assert token in generator, token
assert generator.count("present_in_flight = false;") == 2
# The GetRenderFrame consumer must unlock the free queue before waiting
# on its own dequeued frame's GPU fence. Otherwise the presentation producer
# stalls while attempting to recycle unrelated completed frames.
assert "'    free_queue.pop_front();\\n'" in generator
assert "'    lock.unlock();')," in generator
assert generator.index("    free_queue.pop_front();\\n") < generator.index("    lock.unlock();'),")
assert generator.index("lock.unlock();\\n") < generator.index("present_in_flight = false;\\n")
assert "return present_failure || present_queue.empty(); });" not in generator
# Prove the installed, maintained native presenter carries these same
# waiter and ownership boundaries. The former `... not in generator or True`
# assertion was tautological, allowing a broken native source to pass.

    assert native.count(start) == 1, start
    return native.split(start, 1)[1].split(end, 1)[0]

# on enqueue could choose the drain waiter and leave the worker asleep.

                  "size_t PresentManager::MaxExtraFrames() const {")

    "present_in_flight = false;")


code = r"""
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <deque>
#include <exception>
#include <mutex>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <thread>
struct Gate {
    std::mutex queue_mutex, free_mutex, swapchain_mutex;
    std::condition_variable frame_cv, free_cv;
    std::condition_variable_any present_ready_cv;
    std::deque<int> present_queue, free_queue;
    std::exception_ptr present_failure;
    bool present_in_flight{};
    unsigned present_waiters{};
    unsigned free_waiters{};
    std::atomic<unsigned> drain_wake_calls{0};
    std::atomic<unsigned> wait_entered{0};
    std::atomic<int> completed{0};
    std::atomic<unsigned> presenter_wakes{0};
    void Queue(int id) {
        bool wake_presenter{};
        {
            std::lock_guard lock{queue_mutex};
            if (present_failure) return;
            wake_presenter = present_queue.empty() && !present_in_flight;
            present_queue.push_back(id);
        }
        if (wake_presenter) {
            presenter_wakes.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
            present_ready_cv.notify_one();
        }
    }
    void CopyOne(bool fault) {
        std::unique_lock lock{queue_mutex};
        assert(!present_queue.empty());
        const int id = present_queue.front();
        present_queue.pop_front();
        present_in_flight = true;
        std::unique_lock swapchain_lock{swapchain_mutex};
        lock.unlock();
        if (fault) throw std::runtime_error("present worker failure");
        bool wake_free_waiter{};
        {
            std::scoped_lock fl{free_mutex};
            free_queue.push_back(id);
            wake_free_waiter = free_waiters != 0;
        }
        if (wake_free_waiter) free_cv.notify_one();
        swapchain_lock.unlock();
        bool notify_drainers{};
        {
            std::lock_guard queue_lock{queue_mutex};
            present_in_flight = false;
            notify_drainers = present_waiters != 0 && present_queue.empty();
        }
        ++completed;
        if (notify_drainers) {
            drain_wake_calls.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
            frame_cv.notify_all();
        }
    }
    void Fail(std::exception_ptr error) {
        {
            std::scoped_lock lock{queue_mutex, free_mutex};
            present_failure = error;
            present_queue.clear();
            present_in_flight = false;
        }
        free_cv.notify_all();
        frame_cv.notify_all();
    }
    void WaitPresent() {
        {
            std::unique_lock queue_lock{queue_mutex};
            if (!present_failure && (!present_queue.empty() || present_in_flight)) {
                ++present_waiters;
                wait_entered.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_release);
                frame_cv.wait(queue_lock, [this] {
                    return present_failure || (present_queue.empty() && !present_in_flight);
                });
                --present_waiters;
            }
            if (present_failure) std::rethrow_exception(present_failure);
        }
        std::scoped_lock swapchain_lock{swapchain_mutex};
    }
    void WaitFree() {
        std::unique_lock lock{free_mutex};
        if (free_queue.empty() && !present_failure) {
            ++free_waiters;
            free_cv.wait(lock, [this] { return present_failure || !free_queue.empty(); });
            --free_waiters;
        }
        if (present_failure) std::rethrow_exception(present_failure);
    }
};
struct FrameFence {
    std::mutex mutex;
    std::condition_variable cv;
    bool entered = false, complete = false;
    void Wait() {
        std::unique_lock lock{mutex};
        entered = true;
        cv.notify_all();
        cv.wait(lock, [this] { return complete; });
    }
    void UntilEntered() {
        std::unique_lock lock{mutex};
        cv.wait(lock, [this] { return entered; });
    }
    void Signal() {
        std::lock_guard lock{mutex};
        complete = true;
        cv.notify_all();
    }
};
struct FrameReuse {
    std::mutex free_mutex;
    std::condition_variable free_cv;
    std::deque<int> free_queue{1};
    FrameFence fence;
    int GetRenderFrame() {
        std::unique_lock lock{free_mutex};
        free_cv.wait(lock, [this] { return !free_queue.empty(); });
        const int frame = free_queue.front();
        free_queue.pop_front();
        // Same split as production: never hold this mutex across GPU wait.
        lock.unlock();
        fence.Wait();
        return frame;
    }
};
int main() {
    // The drain and presenter wait on separate CVs.
    // Enqueue wakes only the presenter; completion wakes the drain.
    for (int run=0; run<30; ++run) {
        Gate g;
        // The present worker is actually parked on present_ready_cv until
        // the first enqueue. Marking it in-flight before the queue has work
        // falsely suppressed its only wakeup (a nondeterministic deadlock).
        std::thread drain{[&] { g.WaitPresent(); }};
        std::thread worker{[&] {
            std::unique_lock lock{g.queue_mutex};
            g.present_ready_cv.wait(lock, [&] { return !g.present_queue.empty(); });
            lock.unlock();
            g.CopyOne(false);
        }};
        g.Queue(99);
        drain.join();
        worker.join();
        assert(g.completed == 1);
        assert(g.presenter_wakes == 1);
    }
    // An idle queue has no drain waiter: repeated frame completions
    // must not awaken any thread. With a registered drain waiter, the
    // completion notification must be delivered before the join.
    for (unsigned run=0; run<24; ++run) {
        Gate quiet;
        for (int i=0; i<20; ++i) {
            quiet.Queue(i);
            quiet.CopyOne(false);
        }
        assert(quiet.drain_wake_calls == 0);
        quiet.WaitPresent();
        assert(quiet.drain_wake_calls == 0);
        Gate waiting;
        waiting.Queue(10);
        std::thread drain{[&] { waiting.WaitPresent(); }};
        bool observed = false;
        for (unsigned tries=0; tries<1000000; ++tries) {
            if (waiting.wait_entered.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != 0) {
                observed = true;
                break;
            }
            std::this_thread::yield();
        }
        assert(observed);
        waiting.CopyOne(false);
        drain.join();
        assert(waiting.drain_wake_calls == 1);
        assert(waiting.present_waiters == 0);
    }
    // With a pending burst and a registered drain waiter, intermediate
    // completions MUST NOT wake a thread whose FIFO drain cannot succeed.
    for (unsigned run=0; run<24; ++run) {
        Gate burst;
        for (int i=0; i<32; ++i) burst.Queue(i);
        std::thread drain{[&] { burst.WaitPresent(); }};
        bool observed = false;
        for (unsigned tries=0; tries<1000000; ++tries) {
            if (burst.wait_entered.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != 0) {
                observed = true;
                break;
            }
            std::this_thread::yield();
        }
        assert(observed);
        for (int i=0; i<31; ++i) {
            burst.CopyOne(false);
            assert(burst.drain_wake_calls == 0);
        }
        burst.CopyOne(false);
        drain.join();
        assert(burst.drain_wake_calls == 1);
        assert(burst.present_waiters == 0);
    }
    // If GPU fence wait keeps the free queue locked, the producer cannot
    // recycle an independent frame. Probe with try_lock while consumer is
    // definitely blocked in the fence.
    for (int run=0; run<30; ++run) {
        FrameReuse reuse;
        std::atomic<int> claimed{-1};
        std::thread consumer{[&] { claimed = reuse.GetRenderFrame(); }};
        reuse.fence.UntilEntered();
        {
            std::unique_lock lock{reuse.free_mutex, std::try_to_lock};
            assert(lock.owns_lock());
            assert(reuse.free_queue.empty());
            reuse.free_queue.push_back(2);
        }
        reuse.free_cv.notify_one();
        reuse.fence.Signal();
        consumer.join();
        assert(claimed == 1);
        std::lock_guard lock{reuse.free_mutex};
        assert(reuse.free_queue.size() == 1 && reuse.free_queue.front() == 2);
    }
    for (int run=0; run<30; ++run) {
        Gate g;
        g.Queue(1); g.Queue(2);
        std::thread t{[&] { g.CopyOne(false); g.CopyOne(false); }};
        g.WaitPresent();
        t.join();
        assert(g.completed == 2);
        g.WaitFree();
    }
    // The existing worker is already active. Enqueueing its successor
    // while the deque is empty must not issue a redundant CV notification.
    // The worker loops and observes the successor without waiting.
    for (unsigned run = 0; run < 32; ++run) {
        Gate active;
        {
            std::lock_guard guard{active.queue_mutex};
            active.present_in_flight = true;
        }
        active.Queue(500);
        assert(active.presenter_wakes == 0);
        active.CopyOne(false);
        active.WaitPresent();
        assert(active.completed == 1);
    }
        // A queued burst requires exactly one presenter wake, regardless
    // of the number of frames already pending behind its first element.
    for (unsigned run = 0; run < 32; ++run) {
        Gate g;
        for (int id = 0; id < 32; ++id) g.Queue(id);
        assert(g.presenter_wakes == 1);
        for (int id = 0; id < 32; ++id) g.CopyOne(false);
        assert(g.completed == 32 && g.free_queue.size() == 32);
        assert(g.presenter_wakes == 1);
        g.WaitPresent();
        g.Queue(100);
        assert(g.presenter_wakes == 2); // empty->nonempty after drain
        g.CopyOne(false);
        g.WaitPresent();
    }
    // Empty queue does NOT mean that popped, now-failing frame completed.
    for (int run=0; run<30; ++run) {
        Gate g; g.Queue(17);
        std::thread t{[&] {
            try { g.CopyOne(true); }
            catch (...) { g.Fail(std::current_exception()); }
        }};
        bool threw = false;
        try { g.WaitPresent(); }
        catch (const std::runtime_error&) { threw = true; }
        t.join();
        assert(threw && g.completed == 0);
        threw = false;
        try { g.WaitFree(); }
        catch (const std::runtime_error&) { threw = true; }
        assert(threw);
    }
    Gate g; g.Queue(7); g.Queue(8);
    std::thread t{[&] {
        g.Fail(std::make_exception_ptr(std::runtime_error("present dead")));
    }};
    bool threw = false;
    try { g.WaitPresent(); } catch (const std::runtime_error&) { threw = true; }
    t.join();
    assert(threw);
}
"""
compiler = next((x for x in ("clang++-18", "clang++", "g++") if shutil.which(x)), None)
if not compiler:
    raise SystemExit("C++20 compiler required for Vulkan present-state regression")
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-present-") as tmp:

    for label, opts in (("asan-ubsan", ["-fsanitize=address,undefined"]),

                        "-Werror", "-pthread", *opts, "-fno-sanitize-recover=all",

        subprocess.run([str(binary)], check=True, timeout=120)

print("PASS host GetRenderFrame: free mutex not held during GPU fence wait")
print("PS5 firmware/GPU queue/FPS not qualified")
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Count real query-sync destination allocations and preserve locked acquisitions.

Executes the pinned and maintained buffer-acquisition blocks under ASan/UBSan.
No Vulkan driver, guest progress or PS5 frame-time measurement is performed.

    begin, end = "    // Vulkan part.", "\n    VkBuffer src_buffer"

    tail = text.split(begin, 1)[1]
    assert tail.count(end) == 1
    body = tail.split(end, 1)[0]
    if "    // Prepare all query metadata" in text:
```
