```py
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>
using u32 = std::uint32_t;
using VkBuffer = std::uint64_t;
using VkDeviceSize = std::uint64_t;
using DAddr = std::uint64_t;
static bool locked = false;
static unsigned allocations = 0, locked_allocations = 0;
template <class T> struct Allocator : std::allocator<T> {
    template <class U> struct rebind { using other = Allocator<U>; };
    T* allocate(std::size_t n) {
        ++allocations;
        locked_allocations += locked;
        return std::allocator<T>::allocate(n);
    }
};
struct Mutex {
    void lock() { assert(!locked); locked = true; }
    void unlock() { assert(locked); locked = false; }
};
namespace VideoCommon {
enum class ObtainBufferSynchronize { FullSynchronize };
enum class ObtainBufferOperation { DoNothing };
}
struct Buffer {
    VkBuffer handle{};
    VkBuffer Handle() const { return handle; }
};
struct Cache {
    Mutex mutex;
    Buffer buffer;
    unsigned operations = 0;
    std::vector<std::pair<DAddr, u32>> requests;
    template <class F> void BufferOperations(F&& f) {
        assert(locked);
        ++operations;
        f();
    }
    auto ObtainCPUBuffer(DAddr address, u32 size,
                         VideoCommon::ObtainBufferSynchronize sync,
                         VideoCommon::ObtainBufferOperation op) {
        assert(locked);
        assert(sync == VideoCommon::ObtainBufferSynchronize::FullSynchronize);
        assert(op == VideoCommon::ObtainBufferOperation::DoNothing);
        requests.emplace_back(address, size);
        buffer.handle = address + 17;
        return std::pair{&buffer, address % 4096};
    }
};
using Destinations = std::vector<std::pair<VkBuffer, VkDeviceSize>,
                                 Allocator<std::pair<VkBuffer, VkDeviceSize>>>;
struct Impl {
    std::vector<std::pair<DAddr, DAddr>> little_cache;
    Destinations buffers_to_upload_to;
    Cache buffer_cache;
};
void baseline(Impl* impl) {
PINNED
}
void maintained(Impl* impl) {
ACTIVE
}
int main() {
    unsigned worst_before = 0;
    for (const std::size_t count : {0U, 1U, 2U, 17U, 1024U}) {
        Impl old, current;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
            const DAddr address = 8192 * i + 4096;
            old.little_cache.emplace_back(address, address + 4096);
        }
        current.little_cache = old.little_cache;
        for (unsigned repeat = 0; repeat < 3; ++repeat) {
            allocations = locked_allocations = 0;
            baseline(&old);
            const auto before = locked_allocations;
            assert(!locked && allocations == before);
            allocations = locked_allocations = 0;
            maintained(&current);
            assert(!locked && locked_allocations == 0);
            assert(allocations == (count ? 1U : 0U));
            assert(old.buffer_cache.requests == current.buffer_cache.requests);
            assert(old.buffer_cache.operations == repeat + 1);
            assert(current.buffer_cache.operations == repeat + 1);
            assert(old.buffers_to_upload_to == current.buffers_to_upload_to);
            assert(current.buffers_to_upload_to.size() == count);
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
                assert(current.buffers_to_upload_to[i].first ==
                       current.little_cache[i].first + 17);
                assert(current.buffers_to_upload_to[i].second == 0);
            }
            if (count == 1024) {
                assert(before > 1);
                worst_before = before;
            }
            // The production Record lambda owns these vectors until execution.
            // Swap guarantees an empty fresh vector for the next mock batch.
            Destinations old_recorded, recorded;
            old_recorded.swap(old.buffers_to_upload_to);
            recorded.swap(current.buffers_to_upload_to);
            assert(old_recorded == recorded);
        }
    }
    std::printf("QUERY_DESTINATIONS_PASS ranges=1024 before_locked=%u "
                "after_locked=0 after_total=1 repeated_batches=3\n", worst_before);
}
""".replace("PINNED", pinned).replace("ACTIVE", active)
```

```py
A single VkBuffer/VkDeviceSize can support either inverted or normal
comparison. Reusing it must re-record the flags when equality flips.
```

`tools/check-vulkan-query-copy-plan-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Execute the complete real query-sync method, including deferred copy ownership."""
from pathlib import Path
import ast
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
source = (ROOT / 'vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_query_cache.cpp').read_text()
start = source.index('void QueryCacheRuntime::SyncValues(')
method = source[start:source.index('\n} // namespace Vulkan', start)]
# Preserve the exact preceding implementation as an allocation/locking witness.
oracle = ast.parse((ROOT / 'tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py').read_text())
for node in ast.walk(oracle):
    if isinstance(node, ast.Tuple) and len(node.elts) == 2:
        if all(isinstance(x, ast.Constant) and isinstance(x.value, str) for x in node.elts):
            before, after = (x.value for x in node.elts)
            if before.startswith('    // Vulkan part.') and after.startswith('    // Prepare all query metadata'):
                assert method.count(after) == 1
                previous = method.replace(after, before)
                break
else:
    raise AssertionError('complete historical copy block missing')
cpp = r'''
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <functional>
#include <limits>
#include <map>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
#include <random>
#include <span>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>
using u32 = std::uint32_t; using u64 = std::uint64_t; using DAddr = u64;
using VkBuffer = u64; using VkDeviceSize = u64;
struct VkBufferCopy { u64 srcOffset, dstOffset, size; };
namespace Core { constexpr DAddr DEVICE_PAGESIZE = 4096; }
namespace Common { DAddr AlignDown(DAddr n, DAddr a) { return n - n % a; } }
namespace VideoCommon {
enum class ObtainBufferSynchronize { FullSynchronize };
enum class ObtainBufferOperation { DoNothing };
}
static bool locked;
static unsigned copy_allocations, locked_copies, locked_uploads;
void CopyBytes(void* destination, const void* source, std::size_t bytes) {
    if (locked) ++locked_uploads;
    std::memcpy(destination, source, bytes);
}
template <class T> struct CopyAllocator : std::allocator<T> {
    template <class U> struct rebind { using other = CopyAllocator<U>; };
    CopyAllocator() = default;
    template <class U> CopyAllocator(const CopyAllocator<U>&) {}
    T* allocate(std::size_t n) {
        ++copy_allocations; if (locked) ++locked_copies;
        return std::allocator<T>::allocate(n);
    }
    template <class U> bool operator==(const CopyAllocator<U>&) const { return true; }
};
using Copies = std::vector<VkBufferCopy, CopyAllocator<VkBufferCopy>>;
struct Mutex {
    void lock() { assert(!locked); locked = true; }
    void unlock() { assert(locked); locked = false; }
};
struct Registry {
    std::map<VkBuffer, std::vector<unsigned char>> sources;
    struct Destination { DAddr address; u64 offset; };
    std::map<VkBuffer, Destination> destinations;
    std::map<DAddr, unsigned char> written, expected;
    VkBuffer next_source = 100, next_destination = 10000;
};
namespace vk {
struct CommandBuffer {
    Registry* registry;
    template <class Range> void CopyBuffer(VkBuffer src, VkBuffer dst, const Range& copies) {
        assert(!locked);
        const auto& bytes = registry->sources.at(src);
        const auto destination = registry->destinations.at(dst);
        for (const auto& copy : copies) {
            assert(copy.srcOffset <= bytes.size() && copy.size <= bytes.size() - copy.srcOffset);
            assert(copy.dstOffset >= destination.offset);
            const auto address = destination.address + copy.dstOffset - destination.offset;
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < copy.size; ++i)
                registry->written[address + i] = bytes[copy.srcOffset + i];
        }
    }
};
}
enum class MemoryUsage { Upload };
struct StagingBufferRef { VkBuffer buffer{}; u64 offset{}; std::span<unsigned char> mapped_span; };
struct StagingPool {
    Registry* registry;
    StagingBufferRef Request(std::size_t size, MemoryUsage) {
        assert(locked); // Preserve staging tick assignment after buffer acquisition.
        const auto buffer = registry->next_source++;
        auto& bytes = registry->sources[buffer]; bytes.resize(size + 32);
        return {buffer, 32, std::span<unsigned char>(bytes).subspan(32)};
    }
};
struct BufferCache {
    Mutex mutex;
    Registry* registry;
    bool repeat_next = false, merged = false;
    struct Buffer { VkBuffer handle; VkBuffer Handle() const { return handle; } } current;
    template <class F> void BufferOperations(F&& operation) {
        assert(locked); operation();
        if (repeat_next) {
            registry->destinations.clear(); // previous handles were invalidated by a merge
            repeat_next = false; merged = true; operation();
        }
    }
    auto ObtainCPUBuffer(DAddr address, u32 size, VideoCommon::ObtainBufferSynchronize,
                         VideoCommon::ObtainBufferOperation) {
        assert(locked && size && address % 4096 == 0);
        if (merged) {
            current.handle = 1;
            registry->destinations[1] = Registry::Destination{0, 0};
            return std::pair{&current, address};
        }
        current.handle = registry->next_destination++;
        registry->destinations.emplace(current.handle, Registry::Destination{address, 64});
        return std::pair{&current, u64{64}};
    }
};
struct Scheduler {
    Registry* registry;
    std::vector<std::function<void(vk::CommandBuffer)>> commands;
    void RequestOutsideRenderPassOperationContext() { assert(locked); }
    template <class F> void Record(F&& command) {
        assert(locked); commands.emplace_back(std::forward<F>(command));
    }
    void Execute() {
        for (auto& command : commands) command(vk::CommandBuffer{registry});
        commands.clear();
    }
};
struct Impl {
    Registry registry;
    std::vector<std::pair<DAddr, DAddr>> little_cache;
    std::vector<std::pair<VkBuffer, VkDeviceSize>> buffers_to_upload_to;
    std::vector<std::size_t> redirect_cache, sync_order, copy_offsets, copy_cursors;
#ifdef OLD_COPY_SETUP
    std::vector<Copies> copies_setup;
#else
    Copies copies_setup;
#endif
    BufferCache buffer_cache{{}, &registry, false, false, {}};
    StagingPool staging_pool{&registry};
    Scheduler scheduler{&registry, {}};
};
struct QueryCacheRuntime {
    Impl storage;
    Impl* impl = &storage;
    template <class T> void SyncValues(std::span<T>, VkBuffer);
};
template <class SyncValuesType>
__METHOD__
template <bool Upload> struct Value {
    static constexpr bool GeneratesBaseBuffer = Upload;
    DAddr address; std::size_t size; u64 value; u64 offset;
};
template <bool Upload> void Queue(QueryCacheRuntime& runtime, unsigned count, unsigned seed) {
    auto& registry = runtime.storage.registry;
    auto& base = registry.sources[7]; base.resize(65536);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < base.size(); ++i) base[i] = static_cast<unsigned char>(i * 17);
    std::vector<Value<Upload>> values;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < count; ++i)
        values.push_back({u64(i) * 8192 + (seed ? 4092 : 16), i % 2 ? 4u : 8u,
                          0xabcd123400000000ULL + i, u64(i) * 16});
    if (seed) { std::mt19937 rng(seed); std::shuffle(values.begin(), values.end(), rng); }
    // Multiple query results at one address must retain their original order.
    if (seed && count) {
        values.push_back(values.front()); values.back().value ^= 0x12345678;
        values.back().offset += 8;
    }
    for (const auto& value : values) {
        const auto* bytes = Upload ? reinterpret_cast<const unsigned char*>(&value.value)
                                   : base.data() + value.offset;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < value.size; ++i) registry.expected[value.address + i] = bytes[i];
    }
    runtime.SyncValues(std::span(values), 7);
    assert(!locked);
    // Input objects now die; recorded commands must own all copy metadata.
}
int main(int argc, char**) {
    QueryCacheRuntime runtime;
    if (argc > 1) {
        runtime.storage.buffer_cache.repeat_next = true;
        Queue<true>(runtime, 2, 0);
        runtime.storage.scheduler.Execute();
        assert(runtime.storage.registry.written == runtime.storage.registry.expected);
        std::puts("QUERY_COPY_REBUILD_PASS stale_handles_discarded=1");
        return 0;
    }
    Queue<true>(runtime, 1024, 0);
#ifdef OLD_COPY_SETUP
    assert(copy_allocations == 1024 && locked_copies == 1024 && locked_uploads == 1024);
#else
    assert(copy_allocations == 1 && locked_copies == 0 && locked_uploads == 1024);
#endif
    const auto first_allocations = copy_allocations;
    Queue<false>(runtime, 128, 31);
    Queue<true>(runtime, 17, 19);
    Queue<false>(runtime, 0, 0);
    // Scratch vectors have been overwritten by multiple later batches before
    // any worker command executes; captures must still contain the old plan.
    runtime.storage.scheduler.Execute();
    assert(runtime.storage.registry.written == runtime.storage.registry.expected);
    std::printf("QUERY_COPY_PLAN_PASS first_allocations=%u locked_copy_allocations=%u "
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Prove query page coverage/redirects and count grouping comparisons on host."""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

# either algorithm. The remaining query-copy loops must retain original order.

        ROOT / ".github/workflows" / workflow).read_text()

cpp = r"""
#include <algorithm>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <limits>
#include <numeric>
#include <random>
#include <span>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>
using DAddr = std::uint64_t;
using u32 = std::uint32_t;
namespace Core { constexpr DAddr DEVICE_PAGESIZE = 4096; }
namespace Common { DAddr AlignDown(DAddr n, DAddr a) { return n - n % a; } }
struct Value { DAddr address; std::size_t size; };
struct Impl {
    std::vector<std::size_t> redirect_cache, sync_order;
    std::vector<std::pair<DAddr, DAddr>> little_cache;
};
struct Plan {
    Impl data;
    Impl* impl = &data;
    std::size_t comparisons = 0;
    void Before(std::span<const Value> values) {
BASELINE
        (void)total_size;
    }
    void After(std::span<const Value> values) {
ACTIVE
        (void)total_size;
    }
};
void Verify(const Plan& plan, const std::vector<Value>& values) {
    const auto& ranges = plan.data.little_cache;
    assert(plan.data.redirect_cache.size() == values.size());
    std::size_t pages = 0;
    for (const auto& value : values)
        pages = std::max(pages, std::size_t((value.address + value.size - 1) / 4096 + 1));
    std::vector<unsigned> expected(pages), actual(pages);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < values.size(); ++i) {
        const auto& value = values[i];
        const auto group = plan.data.redirect_cache[i];
        assert(group < ranges.size());
        assert(ranges[group].first <= value.address);
        assert(ranges[group].second >= value.address + value.size);
        for (auto p = value.address / 4096; p <= (value.address + value.size - 1) / 4096; ++p)
            expected[p] = 1;
    }
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < ranges.size(); ++i) {
        const auto& [begin, end] = ranges[i];
        assert(begin < end && begin % 4096 == 0 && end % 4096 == 0);
        if (i) assert(ranges[i - 1].second < begin);
        for (auto p = begin / 4096; p < end / 4096; ++p) {
            assert(p < actual.size());
            ++actual[p];
        }
    }
    assert(actual == expected); // no dropped pages, gaps introduced or overlap
}
int main() {
    Plan old, current;
    std::vector<Value> separated;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 1024; ++i) separated.push_back({8192ULL * i, 8});
    old.Before(separated);
    assert(old.comparisons == 1024 * 1023 / 2);
    current.After(separated);
    Verify(current, separated);
    assert(current.comparisons < old.comparisons / 8);
    assert(current.comparisons == 1023);
    const auto comparisons = current.comparisons;
    // A crossing result connects existing page 0 and page 2 groups. Results
    // themselves are disjoint; this exercises page-span coalescing only.
    const std::vector<Value> bridge{{0, 8}, {8192 + 8, 8}, {8192 - 4, 8}};
    old.Before(bridge);
    assert(old.data.little_cache.size() == 2);
    current.After(bridge);
    Verify(current, bridge);
    assert(current.data.little_cache.size() == 1);
    assert(current.data.redirect_cache == std::vector<std::size_t>({0, 0, 0}));
    std::mt19937 rng(187);
    for (unsigned repeat = 0; repeat < 32; ++repeat) {
        std::shuffle(separated.begin(), separated.end(), rng);
        current.After(separated);
        Verify(current, separated);
    }
    std::reverse(separated.begin(), separated.end());
    current.After(separated);
    Verify(current, separated);
    current.After({});
    Verify(current, {});
    std::vector<Value> same_page;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 1024; ++i) same_page.push_back({(1023 - i) % 4096, 1});
    current.comparisons = 0;
    current.After(same_page);
    Verify(current, same_page);
    assert(current.comparisons == 1023 && current.data.little_cache.size() == 1);
    const std::vector<Value> duplicate_pages{{12, 8}, {40, 8}, {4, 8}, {8192, 8}};
    current.After(duplicate_pages);
    Verify(current, duplicate_pages);
    std::printf("QUERY_GROUPING_PASS ranges=1024 before_comparisons=523776 "
                "after_comparisons=%zu shuffled_batches=32 bridge_groups_before=2 after=1\n",
                comparisons);
}
""".replace("BASELINE", baseline).replace("ACTIVE", active)
compiler = shutil.which("clang++-18") or shutil.which("clang++") or shutil.which("g++")
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compile the EXACT PS5 Vulkan DownloadMemory readback batch under sanitizers.

Unlike the small_vector-only check, this includes the actual source snippet
from the byte-matched Encore-maintained readback snippet inside a mocked texture cache and
checks GPU Finish ordering, image byte integrity, 40-map/32-MiB batching,
zero-sized images, and oversized standalone transfers. Not a native PS5 run.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
snippet = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan-oracles/vulkan_download_batch.inc").read_text()
maintained = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan-cache/video_core/texture_cache/texture_cache.h").read_text()
assert snippet in maintained, "compiled readback differs from historical integration oracle"
generator = (root / "tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py").read_text()
assert "boost::container::small_vector<std::pair<ImageId, Map>, readback_batch_limit> pending;" in snippet
assert "constexpr size_t readback_batch_limit = 40;" in snippet
assert "runtime.Finish();" in snippet
assert "bytes > batch_limit - batch_bytes" in snippet
assert "pending.size() == readback_batch_limit" in snippet
assert "(vulkan_oracle / 'vulkan_download_batch.inc').read_text()" in generator
compiler = next((c for c in ("clang++-18", "clang++", "g++")
                 if shutil.which(c)), None)
if not compiler:
    raise SystemExit("C++20 compiler unavailable; refusing unexecuted Vulkan batch PASS")

cpp = r"""
#include <boost/container/small_vector.hpp>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <memory>
#include <span>
#include <type_traits>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

using ImageId = std::size_t;
constexpr std::size_t operator""_MiB(unsigned long long n) {
    return static_cast<std::size_t>(n) * 1024 * 1024;
}
struct Monitor {
    std::size_t issued{};
    std::size_t completed{};
    std::size_t finishes{};
    std::size_t batch_bytes{};
    std::size_t max_batch_bytes{};
    std::vector<std::size_t> image_tickets;
};
namespace Vulkan {
struct TextureCacheRuntime {
    std::shared_ptr<Monitor> monitor;
    // Pinned vk_staging_buffer_pool.h defines a trivially-copyable
    // non-owning StagingBufferRef; the runtime's pool owns each allocation.
    struct Map {
        std::size_t index;
        std::span<std::uint8_t> mapped_span;
    };
    static_assert(std::is_trivially_copyable_v<Map>);
    std::vector<std::unique_ptr<std::vector<std::uint8_t>>> backing;
    Map DownloadStagingBuffer(std::size_t n) {
        monitor->batch_bytes += n;
        monitor->max_batch_bytes = std::max(monitor->max_batch_bytes,
                                            monitor->batch_bytes);
        backing.push_back(std::make_unique<std::vector<std::uint8_t>>(n));
        return Map{backing.size(), *backing.back()};
    }
    void Finish() {
        monitor->completed = monitor->issued;
        monitor->batch_bytes = 0;
        ++monitor->finishes;
    }
};
}
struct Info { std::size_t id{}; };
std::vector<std::size_t> FullDownloadCopies(Info info) {
    return {info.id};
}
std::vector<std::size_t> FixSmallVectorADL(std::vector<std::size_t> copies) {
    return copies;
}
struct Image {
    std::shared_ptr<Monitor> monitor;
    Info info{};
    std::size_t gpu_addr{};
    std::size_t unswizzled_size_bytes{};
    void DownloadMemory(Vulkan::TextureCacheRuntime::Map& map,
                        const std::vector<std::size_t>& copies) const {
        assert(copies.size() == 1 && copies[0] == info.id);
        assert(map.index != 0);
        assert(map.mapped_span.size() == unswizzled_size_bytes);
        auto bytes = map.mapped_span;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < bytes.size(); ++i) {
            bytes[i] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>((info.id * 13 + i) % 251);
        }
        monitor->image_tickets[info.id] = ++monitor->issued;
    }
};
struct MockGpuMemory {
    std::shared_ptr<Monitor> monitor;
    std::vector<std::vector<std::uint8_t>> written;
    std::vector<std::size_t> write_order;
};
void SwizzleImage(MockGpuMemory& gpu, std::size_t address, Info info,
                  const std::vector<std::size_t>& copies,
                  std::span<const std::uint8_t> span,
                  std::vector<std::uint8_t>& scratch) {
    assert(copies.size() == 1 && copies[0] == address);
    assert(info.id == address);
    assert(gpu.monitor->image_tickets[info.id] <= gpu.monitor->completed);
    assert(gpu.monitor->finishes > 0);
    assert(gpu.written[address].empty());
    gpu.written[address].assign(span.begin(), span.end());
    gpu.write_order.push_back(address);
    scratch.clear();
}
struct MockCache {
    using Runtime = Vulkan::TextureCacheRuntime;
    Runtime runtime;
    MockGpuMemory gpu;
    MockGpuMemory* gpu_memory;
    std::vector<Image> slot_images;
    std::vector<ImageId> images;
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> swizzle_data_buffer;
    explicit MockCache(std::vector<std::size_t> sizes)
        : runtime{std::make_shared<Monitor>(), {}},
          gpu{runtime.monitor, std::vector<std::vector<std::uint8_t>>(sizes.size()), {}},
          gpu_memory(&gpu) {
        runtime.monitor->image_tickets.resize(sizes.size());
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < sizes.size(); ++i) {
            slot_images.push_back(Image{runtime.monitor, Info{i}, i, sizes[i]});
            images.push_back(i);
        }
    }
    void Run() {
#include "vulkan_download_batch.inc"
    }
    void Check() const {
        assert(gpu.write_order.size() == images.size());
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < images.size(); ++i) {
            const auto id = images[i];
            assert(gpu.write_order[i] == id);
            const auto& contents = gpu.written[id];
            const std::size_t bytes = slot_images[id].unswizzled_size_bytes;
            assert(contents.size() == bytes);
            for (std::size_t j = 0; j < contents.size(); ++j)
                assert(contents[j] == static_cast<std::uint8_t>((id * 13 + j) % 251));
        }
        assert(runtime.monitor->completed == runtime.monitor->issued);
    }
};
void Test(std::vector<std::size_t> bytes, std::size_t expected_finishes) {
    MockCache cache(std::move(bytes));
    cache.Run();
    cache.Check();
    assert(cache.runtime.monitor->finishes == expected_finishes);
}
int main() {
    Test({}, 0);
    Test({1, 2, 3}, 1);
    Test(std::vector<std::size_t>(17, 1), 1);
    Test(std::vector<std::size_t>(40, 1), 1);
    Test(std::vector<std::size_t>(41, 1), 2);
    Test({20_MiB, 14_MiB, 1}, 2); // 32-MiB staging boundary
    Test({33_MiB, 1}, 2); // large texture is standalone
    Test({32_MiB, 1}, 2); // exact cap, then next submission
    Test({0, 0, 0}, 1);
}
"""
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-gpu-readback-batch-") as temp:
    src = Path(temp) / "readback-batch.cpp"
    exe = Path(temp) / "readback-batch"
    src.write_text(cpp, encoding="utf-8")
    subprocess.run([compiler, "-std=c++20", "-O1", "-g",
                    "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror",
                    "-fsanitize=address,undefined", "-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
                    "-I", str(root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan-oracles"), str(src), "-o", str(exe)],
                   check=True, timeout=120)
    subprocess.run([str(exe)], check=True, timeout=180)
print("PASS production Vulkan guest readback batch C++: ordered publication, 40 POD maps, 32MiB, Finish fences, oversized cases")
```

```py
#include <boost/container/small_vector.hpp>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <type_traits>
#include <utility>

struct NonOwningMap { int ticket; };
static_assert(std::is_trivially_copyable_v<NonOwningMap>);
int main() {
    using ImageId = unsigned;
    using Map = NonOwningMap;
    using Pending = boost::container::small_vector<std::pair<ImageId, Map>, 40>;
    static_assert(Pending::static_capacity == 40);
    Pending pending;
    assert(pending.capacity() >= 40);
    for (int batch = 0; batch < 1000; ++batch) {
        for (unsigned id = 0; id < 40; ++id) {
            assert(pending.size() < 40);
            pending.emplace_back(id, Map{static_cast<int>(id + batch)});
        }
        assert(pending.size() == 40);
        for (auto& [id, map] : pending) {
            assert(map.ticket == static_cast<int>(id + batch));
        }
        pending.clear();
        assert(pending.empty());
        assert(pending.capacity() >= 40);
    }
}
"""
```

```py
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <limits>

struct VkClearValue { std::uint64_t marker{}; };

static void Probe(const VkClearValue* clear_values, u32 clear_value_count, u32 expected) {
    // Mirror the shipping zero-clear branch: a null pointer or zero count
    // does not enter the bounded 9-element copy path.
    if (!clear_values || clear_value_count == 0) {
        assert(expected == 0);
        return;
    }

    assert(bounded_clear_value_count == expected);

    Probe(nullptr, std::numeric_limits<u32>::max(), 0);
    Probe(items.data(), 0, 0);
    Probe(items.data(), 1, 1);
```

```py
"""Execute the exact generated Vulkan shader worker admission policy on host.

Extracts the C++ replacement from prepare-vulkan-port.py (rather than
reimplementing the policy), replacing only the hardware concurrency hint with

native build and makes no claim about actual console CPU affinity.

import subprocess
import tempfile

matches = [
    node.value.value
    for node in tree.body
    if isinstance(node, ast.Assign)
    and any(isinstance(t, ast.Name) and t.id == "pipeline_worker_replacement"
            for t in node.targets)
    and isinstance(node.value, ast.Constant)
    and isinstance(node.value.value, str)

assert "const size_t reported" in policy
assert "constexpr size_t max_pipeline_workers = 6;" in policy
assert "PinnedWorkerMask()" in policy and "VerifiedSecondaryPlacementMask()" in policy
# Substitute the configurable hint *only* for deterministic host testing.
policy = policy.replace("std::thread::hardware_concurrency()", "MockReported()")

prefix = r"""
#include <algorithm>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <thread>
using cpuset_t = std::uint64_t;
#define CPU_LEVEL_WHICH 1
#define CPU_WHICH_TID 1

#undef CPU_ISSET
#endif
#define CPU_ISSET(cpu,ptr) (((*(ptr)) >> (cpu)) & 1ULL)

static int affinity_failure = 0;

    assert(length == 8 && out != nullptr);
    *out = allowed_mask;

std::uint64_t PinnedWorkerMask() { return ::primary_mask; }

    (void)max_core_threads;
#ifndef ANDROID
"""
suffix = r"""
int main() {
    constexpr std::uint64_t full13 = (1ULL << 13) - 1;
    constexpr std::uint64_t primary5 = 0x1F;
    constexpr std::uint64_t secondary8 = full13 & ~primary5;
    assert(__builtin_popcountll(full13) == 13);
    assert(__builtin_popcountll(secondary8) == 8);

    primary_mask = primary5;
    secondary_mask = 0;
    allowed_mask = full13;
    reported_hint = 16;
    affinity_failure = 0;
    assert(ActualShaderWorkerPolicy(8) == 6);

    allowed_mask = secondary8; // shader thread has *already* excluded primary
    assert(ActualShaderWorkerPolicy(8) == 6);

    reported_hint = 4; // hardware_concurrency is a hint, not a CPU mask
    assert(ActualShaderWorkerPolicy(8) == 6);
    reported_hint = 2;
    assert(ActualShaderWorkerPolicy(8) == 6);

    primary_mask = 0;
    secondary_mask = secondary8;
    reported_hint = 16;
    assert(ActualShaderWorkerPolicy(8) == 6); // verified logical-only split

    secondary_mask = 0;  // no isolation evidence
    assert(ActualShaderWorkerPolicy(8) == 1); // fail conservatively
    affinity_failure = -1;
    assert(ActualShaderWorkerPolicy(8) == 1);
    affinity_failure = 0;

    allowed_mask = (std::uint64_t{1} << 8) - 1;
    primary_mask = 0x3; // two primaries are actually in the shader mask
    assert(ActualShaderWorkerPolicy(8) == 4); // 8 - (2 + 2)
    allowed_mask = 0;
    primary_mask = 0;
    assert(ActualShaderWorkerPolicy(8) == 1);

    allowed_mask = full13;
    reported_hint = 16;
    primary_mask = primary5;
    assert(ActualShaderWorkerPolicy(8) == 6);
    std::puts("PASS actual generated shader worker admission: 16 hardware, 13 allowed, 8 secondary, 6 builders");
}
"""
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Source-only regression: shader pool must not double-reserve CPU slots.

R237 recorded 16 hardware concurrency, 8 allowed secondary CPU slots,
but only ONE shader builder because the old pool deducted seven primary
workers that were ALREADY removed from its inherited secondary mask.
This stages host/source tests only. DO NOT run until user explicitly says GO.

from pathlib import Path
import ast

assert "worker_topology_ready = count == cores.size() && physical_ids_plausible;" in performance
assert "std::uint64_t PinnedWorkerMask() noexcept;" in header
assert "std::uint64_t VerifiedSecondaryPlacementMask() noexcept;" in header
assert "std::atomic<std::uint64_t> verified_secondary_placement_mask{0};" in performance

assert "std::atomic<std::uint64_t> verified_physical_worker_mask{0};" in performance
assert "verified_physical_worker_mask.store(0, std::memory_order_release);" in performance

# The unverified logical-only trial must not fabricate physical topology
# or pin workers to assumed SMT sibling pairs.
start = performance.index("void EnableExperimentalLogicalPlacementImpl() {")
end = performance.index("void PlaceSecondary(", start)
logical_fallback = performance[start:end]
assert "result=skipped" in logical_fallback
assert "worker_topology_ready = true;" not in logical_fallback
assert "worker_cpus =" not in logical_fallback
assert "secondary_cpus =" not in logical_fallback
assert "cpuset_setaffinity(" not in logical_fallback

def workers(reported: int, allowed: set[int], primary: set[int] | None,
            secondary: set[int] | None = None) -> int:
    # OS-verified affinity wins over std::thread::hardware_concurrency hint.
    schedulable = len(allowed) if allowed else min(reported, 4)
    isolated = bool(allowed and secondary and allowed.issubset(secondary))
    reserved = (len(allowed.intersection(primary)) + 2 if primary is not None
                else 2 if isolated else 7)
    return max(1, min(max(0, schedulable - reserved), 6))

primary = set(range(5))
assert workers(16, set(range(13)), primary) == 6   # full app mask
assert workers(16, set(range(5, 13)), primary) == 6  # PS5 R237 secondary mask
assert workers(4, set(range(5, 13)), primary) == 6  # OS mask overrides under-reported hint
assert workers(2, set(range(13)), primary) == 6  # no artificial 2-thread hardware cap
assert workers(16, set(range(5, 13)), primary) == 6  # 6 builders + 2 secondary service slots
assert workers(16, set(range(5, 13)), None) == 1  # fail-closed unverified
assert workers(16, set(range(5, 13)), None, set(range(5, 13))) == 6  # verified logical split
assert workers(16, set(range(5, 13)), None, set(range(5, 12))) == 1  # one guest overlap -> refuse
assert workers(16, set(range(5, 13)), None, set()) == 1  # no kernel evidence
assert workers(8, set(range(5, 9)), None, set(range(5, 9))) == 2  # keep two logical service slots
assert workers(16, set(range(10)), primary) == 3
assert workers(16, set(range(13)), None) == 6
assert workers(16, set(range(1, 7)), primary) == 1
assert workers(16, set(), primary) == 2  # successful empty affinity: fallback 4 slots minus 2 headroom
assert workers(16, set(), None) == 1  # unavailable/unverified affinity: reserve 7
```

```py
"""Run real source-extracted synchronous/async Vulkan Present and GetRenderFrame.

A recycled frame must be pushed under free_mutex and wake consumers only

Host ASan/UBSan, not a native-console performance experiment.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import os
import shutil
import subprocess

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SOURCE=(ROOT/"vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_present_manager.cpp").read_text()

CPP=r"""
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <chrono>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <cstddef>
#include <deque>
#include <exception>
#include <functional>
#include <mutex>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <thread>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>
namespace vk { using CommandBuffer=int; }
namespace Eden::Performance {
inline constexpr int gpu_present_wait=0;
inline constexpr int gpu_present_free_wait=1;
inline constexpr int gpu_present_fence_wait=2;
struct DiagnosticTimer { explicit DiagnosticTimer(int) {} };
}
struct Frame {
    struct Fence {
        unsigned waits=0, resets=0;
        void Wait() { ++waits; }
        void Reset() { ++resets; }
    } present_done;
};
struct CheckedMutex {
    std::mutex mutex;
    std::atomic<bool> locked{false};
    std::atomic<unsigned> locks{0};
    void lock() {
        mutex.lock();
        locked.store(true);
        locks.fetch_add(1);
    }
    void unlock() {
        locked.store(false);
        mutex.unlock();
    }
};
struct CheckedFrames {
    CheckedMutex* gate=nullptr;
    std::deque<Frame*> items;
    bool empty() const { return items.empty(); }
    Frame* front() { assert(gate->locked.load()); return items.front(); }
    void pop_front() { assert(gate->locked.load()); items.pop_front(); }
    void push_back(Frame* frame) {
        assert(gate->locked.load() && "free_queue writer must own free_mutex");
        items.push_back(frame);
    }
};
struct FreeCV {
    std::condition_variable_any condition;
    std::atomic<bool> entered{false};
    std::atomic<unsigned> notifications{0};
    template <class Lock, class Predicate> void wait(Lock& lock, Predicate&& pred) {
        entered.store(true);
        condition.wait(lock, std::forward<Predicate>(pred));
    }
    void notify_one() { ++notifications; condition.notify_one(); }
};
struct PresentReadyCV {
    std::atomic<unsigned> notifications{0};
    void notify_one() { notifications.fetch_add(1); }
};
struct Scheduler {
    unsigned drains=0;
    std::vector<std::function<void(vk::CommandBuffer)>> queued;
    void WaitWorker() { ++drains; }
    template <class F> void Record(F&& f) { queued.emplace_back(std::forward<F>(f)); }
};
struct PresentManager {
    explicit PresentManager(bool async)
        : use_present_thread(async) { free_queue.gate=&free_mutex; }
    bool use_present_thread=false;
    bool throw_copy=false;
    unsigned copies=0;
    CheckedMutex free_mutex;
    FreeCV free_cv;
    std::size_t free_waiters{}; // guarded by free_mutex
    CheckedFrames free_queue;
    std::mutex queue_mutex;
    std::deque<Frame*> present_queue;
    // Mirrors the queue-mutex-guarded state read by the extracted Present().
    bool present_in_flight{};
    std::condition_variable frame_cv;
    PresentReadyCV present_ready_cv;
    std::exception_ptr present_failure;
    Scheduler scheduler;
    void CopyToSwapchain(Frame*) {
        assert(!free_mutex.locked.load() && "no free mutex during GPU copy");
        ++copies;
        if (throw_copy) throw std::runtime_error("native copy failed");
    }
    Frame* GetRenderFrame();
    void Present(Frame*);
};

int main() {
    {
        PresentManager p(false);
        Frame frame;
        std::atomic<Frame*> received{nullptr};
        std::thread waiter([&] { received.store(p.GetRenderFrame()); });
        const auto deadline=std::chrono::steady_clock::now()+std::chrono::seconds(4);
        // The waiter publishes entered just before condition_variable_any
        // releases free_mutex. Observe both events, not just the flag.
        while ((!p.free_cv.entered.load() || p.free_mutex.locked.load()) &&
               std::chrono::steady_clock::now()<deadline)
            std::this_thread::yield();
        assert(p.free_cv.entered.load() && !p.free_mutex.locked.load());
        p.Present(&frame);
        waiter.join();
        assert(received.load()==&frame && frame.present_done.waits==1);
        assert(frame.present_done.resets==1 && p.scheduler.drains==1);
        assert(p.copies==1 && p.free_cv.notifications.load()==1);
        assert(p.present_ready_cv.notifications.load()==0);
        assert(p.free_waiters==0);
        assert(p.free_mutex.locks.load()>=2 && p.free_queue.empty());
    }
    {
        PresentManager p(false);
        Frame frame;
        p.throw_copy=true;
        bool threw=false;
        try { p.Present(&frame); } catch (const std::runtime_error&) { threw=true; }
        assert(threw && p.scheduler.drains==1 && p.copies==1);
        assert(p.free_queue.empty() && p.free_cv.notifications.load()==0);
    }
    {
        PresentManager p(true);
        Frame frame;
        p.Present(&frame);
        assert(p.scheduler.drains==0 && p.copies==0);
        assert(p.free_queue.empty() && p.scheduler.queued.size()==1);
        p.scheduler.queued.front()(0);
        assert(p.present_queue.size()==1 && p.present_queue.front()==&frame);
        assert(p.free_cv.notifications.load()==0);
        assert(p.present_ready_cv.notifications.load()==1);
    }
}
""".replace("INJECT_METHODS",METHODS)
```

```py
    enum Kind { Ordinary, ThrowExecute, ThrowAllocate };
    Kind kind=Ordinary;
    std::atomic<unsigned>* completed=nullptr;
    bool HasSubmit() const { return kind==ThrowAllocate; }
    void ExecuteAll(int,int) {

        if(completed) completed->fetch_add(1);

        event_cv.notify_all();

        command->kind=kind;
        command->completed=&completed;

            caught=std::string(e.what())=="Vulkan command callback";
        }
        assert(caught && scheduler.queue_drain_waiters==0);
        assert(scheduler.completed.load()==0 && Eden::PeekGpuFailure());
        assert(Eden::TakeGpuFailure());
        assert(Eden::PeekGpuFailure());
```

```py
 std::memcpy(oldp,xml->c_str(),length);
 *oldlen=length;
 return 0;
}

static unsigned __get_cpuid_max(unsigned base, void*) {
 return base >= 0x80000000u ? (amd_vendor ? 0x8000001eu : 0x80000000u) : max_leaf;
}
static void mock_cpuid(unsigned leaf,unsigned& a,unsigned& b,unsigned& c,unsigned& d) {
 a=b=c=d=0;
 if(leaf==0) {
  a=max_leaf;
```

`tools/ci/build-release.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
# Release build helper: `make release` in this checkout. The hosted workflow is .github/workflows/build-040-zbic.yml.
# EDEN_DEV_CHECKOUT optionally names a development checkout whose inputs are reused instead of
# fetched: its sibling repositories and .deps inputs are linked in (never copied or modified),
# and its Eden package cache seeds this checkout's. See docs/BUILDING.md.
set -euo pipefail
root=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd -P)
cd "$root"
if [[ -n ${EDEN_DEV_CHECKOUT:-} ]]; then
    dev=$(cd -- "$EDEN_DEV_CHECKOUT" && pwd)
    if [[ $dev != "$root" ]]; then
        for sibling in ps5-native-app-boilerplate ps5-opengl-review mihawk-vulkan-review mihawk-mesa-review mihawk-sdk-review; do
            if [[ ! -e ../$sibling && -d $dev/../$sibling ]]; then
                ln -s "$(cd -- "$dev/../$sibling" && pwd)" "../$sibling"
            fi
        done
        mkdir -p .deps build
        for input in "$dev"/.deps/eden-5f142c79.tar.gz "$dev"/.deps/mirror-* "$dev"/.deps/ffmpeg-* \
                     "$dev"/.deps/fmt-12.1.0 "$dev"/.deps/compiler-rt-18.1.8 "$dev"/.deps/pacbrew-*; do
            [[ -e $input && ! -e .deps/${input##*/} ]] && ln -s "$input" ".deps/${input##*/}"
        done
        [[ -e build/radv-isolated || ! -d $dev/build/radv-isolated ]] || ln -s "$dev/build/radv-isolated" build/radv-isolated
        if [[ -f $dev/.local/headless-cache ]]; then
            export EDEN_CPM_CACHE_SEED="$(cat "$dev/.local/headless-cache")/source/.cache/cpm"
        fi
    fi
fi
# A release must never silently consume a sibling checkout at a different revision.
python3 -B tools/deps.py fetch
python3 -B tools/deps.py verify
make release
```

`tools/ci/check-all-on-test-binary.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Fail closed if a PS5 development artifact silently reverted to release mode.

This is a build-output verification, not proof that physical PS5 firmware
supports sparse RX/RW aliases, the game runs smoothly, or in-game PS art works.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
CACHE = ROOT / "build/headless-native/CMakeCache.txt"
FRONTEND = ROOT / "build/headless-native/frontend.json"
REQUIRED = {
    "EDEN_DEV_PROFILE:BOOL": "ON",
    "EDEN_SPARSE_JIT_DEV:BOOL": "ON",
    "EDEN_PS5_VULKAN:BOOL": "ON",
    "EDEN_DEV_VULKAN:BOOL": "ON",
    "EDEN_VULKAN_DRIVER:STRING": "RADV",
    "EDEN_SHARED_JIT:BOOL": "ON",
    "EDEN_JIT_COMPILE_BATCH:BOOL": "ON",
}


def audit(app: Path, title_id: str) -> dict:
    if app.resolve() != (ROOT / "build/dev/PPSA99008").resolve():
        raise ValueError("not the isolated test app staging path")
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-fA-F]{16}", title_id):
        raise ValueError("invalid requested title ID")
    if not app.is_dir() or not CACHE.is_file() or not FRONTEND.is_file():
        raise ValueError("missing compiled app/receipt")
    profile = {}
    for line in CACHE.read_text("utf-8").splitlines():
        if not line.startswith(("#", "//")) and "=" in line:
            name, value = line.split("=", 1)
            profile[name] = value
    for key, expected in REQUIRED.items():
        if profile.get(key) != expected:
            raise ValueError(f"compiled profile mismatch: {key} wanted {expected}, got {profile.get(key)!r}")
    if profile.get("EDEN_DEV_ROM_ID:STRING", "").upper() != title_id.upper() or \
       profile.get("EDEN_DEV_PROFILE_TITLE:STRING", "").upper() != title_id.upper():
        raise ValueError("test build compiled a different game autoboot ID")
    receipt = json.loads(FRONTEND.read_text("utf-8"))
    if receipt.get("development_backend") != "Vulkan" or \
       receipt.get("vulkan_driver") != "RADV" or \
       receipt.get("hardware_qualified") is not False or \
       receipt.get("development_rom_id", "").upper() != title_id.upper():
        raise ValueError("development frontend receipt mismatch")
    if not (app / "eboot.bin").is_file() or (app / "eboot.bin").stat().st_size < 1048576:
        raise ValueError("missing compiled PS5 executable")
    return {
        "status": "compiled_test_artifact_flags_verified",
        "title_id": title_id.upper(),
        "jit_sparse_compiled": True,
        "jit_shared_compiled": True,
        "jit_successor_batch_compiled": True,
        "dev_frame_diagnostics_compiled": True,
        "native_ps5_execution_verified": False,
        "sparse_alias_probe_result": None,
        "gpu_shader_pixels_verified": False,
        "playstation_game_art_verified": False,
        "shipping_branch_changed": False,
    }


def main() -> int:
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        print("usage: check-all-on-test-binary.py build/dev/PPSA99008 TITLE_ID", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    try:
        app = Path(sys.argv[1])
        data = audit(app, sys.argv[2])
        print("EDEN_PS5_TEST_BUILD " + json.dumps(data, sort_keys=True))
        return 0
    except (ValueError, OSError, TypeError) as exc:
        print(f"EDEN_PS5_TEST_BUILD_REJECTED: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

```

`tools/ci/check-ftp-archive-root.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Validate installable Eden Encore ZIP member roots without unpacking them.

The canonical distribution ZIP additionally carries legal/readme files at its
root; the dedicated FTP ZIP MUST carry only PPSA99008/ runtime paths.
"""
import argparse
import io
import json
import pathlib
import re
import zipfile

TITLE = "PPSA99008"
REQUIRED = {f"{TITLE}/eboot.bin", f"{TITLE}/sce_sys/param.json"}
# Match the exact filename emitted by make-dist.py/resolve-encore-release.py.
# Never silently accept an old/foreign title or a different R revision.
FTP_NAME = re.compile(r"Eden-Encore-(R[1-9][0-9]{0,5})-([0-9a-f]{8})-FTP-PPSA99008[.]zip")
FULL_NAME = re.compile(r"Prospero[.]Eden-Encore-(R[1-9][0-9]{0,5})[.]zip")
LEGACY_FTP_NAME = "Eden-Encore-56293953-FTP-PPSA99008.zip"


def select_archives(paths: list[pathlib.Path]) -> tuple[pathlib.Path, pathlib.Path]:
    """Require one matching full+FTP distribution pair with consistent R."""
    ftp = sorted(path for path in paths if FTP_NAME.fullmatch(path.name)
                 or path.name == LEGACY_FTP_NAME)
    full = sorted(path for path in paths if FULL_NAME.fullmatch(path.name))
    if len(ftp) != 1 or len(full) != 1:
        raise ValueError(f"Expected one FTP and one full ZIP: {ftp}, {full}")
    full_revision = FULL_NAME.fullmatch(full[0].name).group(1)
    match = FTP_NAME.fullmatch(ftp[0].name)
    if match:
        if match.group(1) != full_revision:
            raise ValueError(f"FTP/full R revision mismatch: {ftp[0].name}, {full[0].name}")
    elif full_revision != "R1":
        raise ValueError("Legacy FTP file only allowed for the original R1 release")
    return ftp[0], full[0]


def inspect(blob: bytes, ftp_only: bool) -> int:
    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(blob)) as z:
        names = z.namelist()
        assert len(names) == len(set(names)), "Duplicate archive entries"
        files = {name for name in names if not name.endswith("/")}
        assert REQUIRED <= files, f"Missing {REQUIRED-files}"
        assert "eboot.bin" not in files, "Flattened title directory"
        assert f"{TITLE}/{TITLE}/eboot.bin" not in files, "Nested title directory"
        assert all(not name.startswith("/") and "\\" not in name and
                   not {"", ".", ".."} & set(pathlib.PurePosixPath(name).parts)
                   for name in names), "Unsafe archive member path"
        if ftp_only:
            assert all(name.startswith(f"{TITLE}/") for name in names), "FTP archive has extra root content"
            assert not any(name.lower().endswith(".zip") for name in names), "Nested zip prohibited"
        param = json.loads(z.read(f"{TITLE}/sce_sys/param.json"))
        assert param["titleId"] == TITLE, "PS5 metadata title differs from folder"
        assert z.getinfo(f"{TITLE}/eboot.bin").file_size > 0, "Missing binary payload"
        return len(files)


def self_test() -> None:
    def build(prefix: str, extra: bool = False):
        output = io.BytesIO()
        with zipfile.ZipFile(output, "w") as z:
            z.writestr(prefix+"eboot.bin", b"\x7fELF")
            z.writestr(prefix+"sce_sys/param.json", '{"titleId":"PPSA99008"}')
            if extra:
                z.writestr("README.md", "full release docs")
        return output.getvalue()
    assert inspect(build("PPSA99008/"), True) == 2
    assert inspect(build("PPSA99008/", True), False) == 3
    for bad in ["", "PPSA99008/PPSA99008/", "WrongFolder/"]:
        try:
            inspect(build(bad), True)
        except AssertionError:
            pass
        else:
            raise AssertionError(f"Incorrect ZIP root accepted: {bad!r}")
    try:
        inspect(build("PPSA99008/", True), True)
    except AssertionError:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError("Unrelated root-level file in FTP ZIP was accepted")
    # Historical naming drift caused a false-negative after signed stage.
    good = [pathlib.Path("Prospero.Eden-Encore-R457.zip"),
            pathlib.Path("Eden-Encore-R457-2c75956d-FTP-PPSA99008.zip")]
    assert select_archives(good) == (good[1], good[0])
    assert select_archives([pathlib.Path("Prospero.Eden-Encore-R1.zip"),
                            pathlib.Path(LEGACY_FTP_NAME)])[0].name == LEGACY_FTP_NAME
    for wrong in (
        [pathlib.Path("Prospero.Eden-Encore-R456.zip"), good[1]],
        [good[0], pathlib.Path("Prospero.Eden-Encore-R457-2c75956d-FTP.zip")],
        [good[0], pathlib.Path("Eden-Encore-R458-2c75956d-FTP-PPSA99008.zip")],
        [good[0], pathlib.Path("Eden-Encore-R457-2c75956d-FTP-WRONG.zip")],
        [good[0], good[1], pathlib.Path("Eden-Encore-R457-ffffffff-FTP-PPSA99008.zip")],
    ):
        try:
            select_archives(wrong)
        except ValueError:
            pass
        else:
            raise AssertionError(f"Mismatched distribution filenames accepted: {wrong}")
    print("ENCORE_PPSA99008_ZIP_LAYOUT_HOST_PASS flat=reject nested=reject extra=reject")


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("dist", nargs="?", type=pathlib.Path)
    parser.add_argument("--self-test", action="store_true")
    opts = parser.parse_args()
    if opts.self_test:
        self_test()
        return
    if opts.dist is None:
        parser.error("provide dist folder or --self-test")
    try:
        ftp_file, full_file = select_archives(list(opts.dist.glob("*.zip")))
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise SystemExit(str(exc)) from exc
    print(f"ENCORE_FTP_ZIP_ROOT_OK PPSA99008/ files={inspect(ftp_file.read_bytes(), True)}")
    print(f"ENCORE_FULL_ZIP_ROOT_OK PPSA99008/ files={inspect(full_file.read_bytes(), False)}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

`tools/ci/check-native-boilerplate-setup.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Guard against a partial pinned native bootstrap being mistaken for a complete one."""
from pathlib import Path
import json
import tempfile
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tools"))
from deps import missing_setup_outputs

items = json.loads((ROOT / "tools/deps.json").read_text())["items"]
boilerplate = next(item for item in items if item["name"] == "boilerplate")
expected = {
    ".deps/native/ps5-payload-sdk/bin/prospero-clang",
    ".deps/native/zlib/root/usr/lib/libz.a",
    ".deps/native/zlib/root/usr/include/zlib.h",
    ".deps/native/zlib/root/.source-version",
}
declared = {boilerplate["setup_creates"], *boilerplate["setup_requires"]}
assert declared == expected
assert boilerplate["setup_version_stamps"] == {
    ".deps/native/zlib/root/.source-version": "1.3.2"
}
assert boilerplate["setup"] == ["bash", "tools/setup-native-dependencies.sh"]
for rel in expected:
    value = Path(rel)
    assert not value.is_absolute() and ".." not in value.parts, rel

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-native-bootstrap-") as temp:
    root = Path(temp)
    for rel in expected:
        file = root / rel
        file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        file.write_text("1.3.2" if file.name == ".source-version" else "fixture")
    assert missing_setup_outputs(boilerplate, root) == []
    for removed in sorted(expected):
        file = root / removed
        content = file.read_bytes()
        file.unlink()
        assert missing_setup_outputs(boilerplate, root) == [removed], removed
        file.write_bytes(content)
    stamp = root / ".deps/native/zlib/root/.source-version"
    stamp.write_text("0.0.0")
    assert missing_setup_outputs(boilerplate, root) == [".deps/native/zlib/root/.source-version"]
    stamp.write_text("1.3.2")
    assert missing_setup_outputs(boilerplate, root) == []

build = (ROOT / "tools/build-native-tool.sh").read_text()
assert '"$zlib/usr/lib/libz.a"' in build
assert '"$zlib/usr/include/zlib.h"' in build
source = (ROOT / "tools/deps.py").read_text()
assert "if 'setup' in item and missing_setup_outputs(item, path):" in source
assert "missing = missing_setup_outputs(item, path)" in source
assert "for missing in missing_setup_outputs(item, location(item)):" in source
print("ENCORE_NATIVE_BOOTSTRAP_CONTRACT_PASS sdk=1 zlib_archive=1 zlib_header=1 zlib_stamp=1")
```

`tools/ci/check-release-experiments.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Verify actual compiled native release experiments (never claim console FPS).

Run after build-package.sh release-stage, before release distribution uploads.
The marker strings in eboot.bin alone do not prove CMake conditionals are ON.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import sys
import tempfile
import re
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
CACHE = ROOT / "build/headless-native/CMakeCache.txt"
RELEASE = ROOT / "build/release/PPSA99008"
REQUIRED = {
    # One native PS5 product irrespective of guest platform; release is
    # a packaging decision, not a different CPU/GPU feature profile.
    "CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE:STRING": "Release",
    "EDEN_PS5_VULKAN:BOOL": "ON",
    "EDEN_VULKAN_DRIVER:STRING": "RADV",
    "EDEN_PS5_OPENGL:BOOL": "ON",
}
NATIVE_SETTING = "PS5_NATIVE"
# These old diagnostic selectors are not the product configuration. The
# unselected CMake modules must not be activated by an inherited build cache.
DISALLOWED_ACTIVE = ("EDEN_GUEST_WRITE_BRIDGE_DEV", "EDEN_UNQUALIFIED_FERMI2D_COPY")
OFF_VALUES = {"OFF", "FALSE", "0", ""}

# Sparse fallback diagnostics may be linked from maintained JIT source even
# when runtime sparse selection is OFF. Strings alone are not activation proof.
# The compiled CMakeCache policy is checked fail-closed below.
MARKERS = (
    b"EDEN_EXPERIMENT_DEFAULTS sparse=%u logical_cpu=%u frame_probe=%u safe=%u",
    b"EDEN_JIT_SPARSE_TRIM released=",
    b"EDEN_PS5_JIT_POLICY scope=all_titles",
    b"EDEN_GPU_REPORT_STALLED age_ms=",
)

def verify(cache: str, eboot: bytes) -> None:
    config = {}
    for line in cache.splitlines():
        if line and not line.startswith(("#", "//")) and "=" in line:
            k, v = line.split("=", 1)
            config[k] = v
    mismatches = [
        f"{k}={config.get(k)!r} (expected {want!r})"
        for k, want in REQUIRED.items() if config.get(k) != want
    ]
    # The native toolchain can declare this -D switch BOOL or leave it as
    # UNINITIALIZED. Validate its value independently of CMake's type.
    native = [value for key, value in config.items()
              if key.split(':', 1)[0] == NATIVE_SETTING]
    if len(native) != 1 or native[0] != "ON":
        mismatches.append(f"{NATIVE_SETTING}={native!r} (expected one ON)")
    # Reject active deprecated research flags and diagnostic subsystems.
    # The old DEV/release profile names are intentionally NOT REQUIRED.
    for key, value in config.items():
        selector = key.split(':', 1)[0]
        if (re.fullmatch(r"EDEN_NS2_.*_EXPERIMENTAL", selector) or
                selector in DISALLOWED_ACTIVE):
            if value.upper() not in OFF_VALUES:
                mismatches.append(f"{key}={value!r} (must be inactive)")
    if mismatches:
        raise ValueError("release compile profile mismatch: " + ", ".join(mismatches))
    missing = [value.decode() for value in MARKERS if value not in eboot]
    if missing:
        raise ValueError("release binary lacks runtime markers: " + ", ".join(missing))

def self_test() -> None:
    valid = "\n".join([*(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in REQUIRED.items()),
                       "PS5_NATIVE:UNINITIALIZED=ON"])
    eboot = b"".join(MARKERS)
    verify(valid, eboot)
    for key, value in REQUIRED.items():
        incorrect = valid.replace(f"{key}={value}", f"{key}=INVALID")
        try:
            verify(incorrect, eboot)
        except ValueError as exc:
            assert key in str(exc)
        else:
            raise AssertionError(f"unnoticed compiler flag mismatch: {key}")
    for injected in (
        "EDEN_NS2_FUTURE_UNREVIEWED_EXPERIMENTAL:BOOL=ON",
        "EDEN_NS2_EXEFS_EXPERIMENTAL:BOOL=ON",
        "EDEN_GUEST_WRITE_BRIDGE_DEV:BOOL=ON",
        "EDEN_UNQUALIFIED_FERMI2D_COPY:BOOL=ON",
    ):
        try:
            verify(valid + "\n" + injected, eboot)
        except ValueError as exc:
            assert injected.split("=", 1)[0] in str(exc)
        else:
            raise AssertionError(f"unreviewed NS2 release selector accepted: {injected}")
    for wrong_native in ("OFF", "FALSE", "INVALID"):
        try:
            verify(valid.replace("PS5_NATIVE:UNINITIALIZED=ON",
                                 f"PS5_NATIVE:UNINITIALIZED={wrong_native}"), eboot)
        except ValueError as exc:
            assert "PS5_NATIVE" in str(exc)
        else:
            raise AssertionError("non-native PS5 configuration accepted")
    verify(valid.replace("PS5_NATIVE:UNINITIALIZED=ON", "PS5_NATIVE:BOOL=ON"), eboot)
    # A non-NS2 flag must not accidentally match the catch-all checker.
    verify(valid + "\nEDEN_UNRELATED_FEATURE:BOOL=ON", eboot)
    for marker in MARKERS:
        try:
            verify(valid, eboot.replace(marker, b""))
        except ValueError as exc:
            assert marker.decode() in str(exc)
        else:
            raise AssertionError(f"missing binary marker accepted: {marker!r}")
    print("PASS: one native compiled application, independently controlled publishing, strict GPU configuration and markers")

def main() -> int:
    if len(sys.argv) == 2 and sys.argv[1] == "--self-test":
        self_test()
        return 0
    if len(sys.argv) != 2:
        print("usage: check-release-experiments.py build/release/PPSA99008", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    app = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
    if app != RELEASE.resolve():
        print(f"REJECTED: expected native release staging path {RELEASE}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    try:
        if not CACHE.is_file() or not (app / "eboot.bin").is_file():
            raise ValueError("compiled CMake cache or staged native executable missing")
        verify(CACHE.read_text("utf-8"), (app / "eboot.bin").read_bytes())
    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
        print(f"EDEN_RELEASE_EXPERIMENTS_REJECTED: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    print("EDEN_RELEASE_EXPERIMENTS_COMPILED: sparse=on native_profile=release "
          "cross_core_shared_jit=off batch=off alias_runtime_probe=pending hardware=untested")
    return 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
```

`tools/ci/check-repo-hygiene.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Prevent first-party build debris and dangling workflow script references.

Pinned source vaults and legal/media assets are deliberately left untouched.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
tracked = set(filter(None, subprocess.check_output(
    ["git", "ls-files", "-z"], cwd=ROOT).decode("utf-8").split("\0")))
# Treat maintained vendor overlays as first-party-owned code. Leave immutable
# vendor/sources and vendor/objects unmodified (some source archives contain
# upstream test logs and binary fixtures by design).
owned = {path for path in tracked if not path.startswith("vendor/")}
maintained = {path for path in tracked if path.startswith("vendor/encore-active/")}
checked = owned | maintained
errors = []
junk_dir = {"__pycache__", "node_modules", ".pytest_cache", ".mypy_cache",
            ".ruff_cache", ".tox", ".nox", ".venv", ".idea", ".vscode",
            "CMakeFiles", "Testing", "coverage"}
junk_names = {".DS_Store", "Thumbs.db", "CMakeCache.txt", "cmake_install.cmake",
              "compile_commands.json", ".ninja_deps", ".ninja_log", ".coverage"}
junk_extensions = (".pyc", ".pyo", ".swp", ".swo", ".tmp", ".bak", ".orig",
                   ".rej", ".o", ".obj", ".log", ".gcda", ".gcno", ".profraw", ".profdata")
# The two former editable source-background paths carried the same Git blob.
# Keep one original for future design edits; package art uses encore-background.jpg.
if "assets/launch-background-source.png" in tracked:
    errors.append("redundant legacy background source reintroduced")
if "assets/background-source.png" not in tracked:
    errors.append("canonical editable background source missing")
for name in sorted(checked):
    path = Path(name)
    if (any(part in junk_dir for part in path.parts)
            or path.name in junk_names or path.name.startswith("._")
            or name.endswith(junk_extensions)):
        errors.append("tracked disposable artefact: " + name)
    if (path.name in {"prod.keys", "title.keys"}
            or path.suffix.lower() in {".nsp", ".xci", ".nsz", ".ncz", ".fpkg", ".pkg"}):
        errors.append("tracked console/private package material: " + name)

# Verify literal CI tool invocations. Avoid treating comments and arbitrary
# documentation links as mandatory run steps.
pattern = re.compile(r"\b(?:python3\s+(?:-B\s+)?|bash\s+)"
                     r"(tools/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+\.(?:py|sh))")
checks = 0
workflows = sorted((ROOT / ".github/workflows").glob("*.yml"))
for workflow in workflows:
    source = workflow.read_text()
    if not re.search(r"(?m)^permissions:\s*$", source):
        errors.append("workflow without explicit permissions: " + workflow.name)
    for candidate in pattern.findall(source):
        checks += 1
        if candidate not in tracked:
            errors.append(f"{workflow.name}: missing tracked tool {candidate}")

if errors:
    raise SystemExit("\n".join(errors))
print(f"ENCORE_REPO_HYGIENE_PASS first_party={len(owned)} maintained_vendor={len(maintained)} workflows_checked={len(workflows)} tool_refs={checks} immutable_vault_untouched=1")

```

`tools/ci/derive-encore-build-label.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Derive the native launcher's R revision from first-parent Git commit subjects.

MEMORY.md is a historical engineering log and can lag behind the source.
Never silently fall back to its latest heading: a stale footer is worse than
failing the native build with an actionable diagnostic. Walk all first-parent
subjects: documentation and CI commits may exceed the old 256-commit cutoff.

For host regression tests, a single optional path contains newline-separated
commit subjects (newest first), using exactly the same R-prefix matching.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
REVISION = re.compile(r"^R([0-9]{2,6})(?=[: -]|$)")


def build_label(subjects: str) -> str:
    numbers = [
        int(match.group(1))
        for subject in subjects.splitlines()
        if (match := REVISION.match(subject.strip()))
    ]
    if not numbers:
        raise ValueError("No numbered R revision in Git history; fetch more first-parent commits")
    return f"R{max(numbers)}"


def main() -> None:
    if len(sys.argv) > 2:
        raise SystemExit("Usage: derive-encore-build-label.py [fixture-subjects.txt]")
    if len(sys.argv) == 2:
        subjects = Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    else:
        proc = subprocess.run(
            ["git", "-C", str(ROOT), "log", "--first-parent", "--format=%s"],
            check=True, capture_output=True, text=True,
        )
        subjects = proc.stdout
    try:
        print(build_label(subjects))
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise SystemExit(str(exc)) from exc


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

`tools/ci/diagnose-image-repro.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Byte-offset diagnostic for nonidentical release images (does not waive failure)."""
import argparse
import pathlib

CHUNK_BYTES = 1024 * 1024
MAX_DIFFERENCES = 8

def scan_bytes(first: pathlib.Path, second: pathlib.Path) -> tuple[int | None, list[tuple[int, int | None, int | None]]]:
    """Find first differences with bounded memory, including unequal lengths."""
    differences = []
    offset = 0
    with first.open("rb") as left, second.open("rb") as right:
        while True:
            a = left.read(CHUNK_BYTES)
            b = right.read(CHUNK_BYTES)
            if not a and not b:
                break
            if a != b:
                for index in range(max(len(a), len(b))):
                    av = a[index] if index < len(a) else None
                    bv = b[index] if index < len(b) else None
                    if av != bv:
                        differences.append((offset + index, av, bv))
                        if len(differences) >= MAX_DIFFERENCES:
                            break
                if len(differences) >= MAX_DIFFERENCES:
                    break
            offset += max(len(a), len(b))
    if not differences:
        return None, differences
    return differences[0][0], differences

def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("first", type=pathlib.Path)
    parser.add_argument("second", type=pathlib.Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    first, second = args.first, args.second
    if not first.is_file() or not second.is_file():
        parser.error("two existing image files are required")
    offset, differences = scan_bytes(first, second)
    print(f"FFPFSC_IMAGE_REPRO_DIFF first_size={first.stat().st_size} "
          f"second_size={second.stat().st_size} first_different_offset={offset}")
    if offset is not None:
        for at, before, after in differences:
            print(f"FFPFSC_IMAGE_REPRO_BYTE offset=0x{at:x} "
                  f"a={'EOF' if before is None else f'{before:02x}'} "
                  f"b={'EOF' if after is None else f'{after:02x}'}")
    return 0 if offset is None else 1

if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

```

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
# GitHub Actions cannot cache relative paths containing "..". Keep the heavy pinned sibling
# checkouts under this repository's cacheable .deps tree and expose their historical sibling names
# through symlinks. Existing real sibling checkouts are never replaced.
set -euo pipefail
root=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd -P)
store="${PROSPEROEDEN_GIT_DEPS_ROOT:-.deps/repos}"
[[ "$store" = /* ]] || store="$root/$store"
mkdir -p "$store"

for name in ps5-native-app-boilerplate ps5-opengl-review mihawk-vulkan-review mihawk-mesa-review mihawk-sdk-review; do
    link="$root/../$name"
    target="$store/$name"
    if [[ -e "$link" && ! -L "$link" ]]; then
        echo "Refusing to replace real sibling checkout: $link" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    rm -f "$link"
    ln -s "$target" "$link"
done

echo "Encore CI sibling cache links: ready under $store"
```

`tools/ci/make-dist.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
"""Release files from a built PPSA99008 folder (make release, make image).

  tools/ci/make-dist.py [--image-only] APP_DIR

dist/Prospero.Eden-Encore-RN.zip (the folder plus README, INSTALL, SECURITY, LICENSE,
THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES and LICENSES/; fixed timestamps, so equal inputs give equal bytes),
dist/Eden-Encore-RN-<source-sha8>-FTP-PPSA99008.zip (minimal PPSA99008 folder for manual FTP installs:
runtime files only, without installed legal texts or ShadowMount-only .txt language companions),
SHA256SUMS and release-notes.md (no FFPFSC by default).
"""
import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import zipfile

root = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
args = sys.argv[1:]
image_only = args[:1] == ['--image-only']
if image_only:
    args = args[1:]
if len(args) != 1:
    sys.exit(__doc__.strip())
app = pathlib.Path(args[0]).resolve()
# The compiled app, not a hardcoded header or workflow HEAD, determines R.
import importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("resolve_encore_release",
                                            root / "tools/ci/resolve-encore-release.py")
resolver = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(resolver)
attestation_file = app / "encore-release.json"
if not attestation_file.is_file():
    raise SystemExit("Cannot package unversioned native app: encore-release.json missing")
attestation = json.loads(attestation_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
source_sha = attestation.get("source_sha")
if not isinstance(source_sha, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[a-f0-9]{40}", source_sha):
    raise SystemExit("Invalid source SHA in release attestation")
try:
    release_info = resolver.resolve(app, source_sha)
except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError) as exc:
    raise SystemExit(f"Native release attestation rejected: {exc}") from exc
release = release_info["label"]
dist = root / 'dist'
image = dist / f'Prospero.Eden-Encore-{release}.ffpfsc'
if image_only:
    dist.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    subprocess.run(['bash', str(root / 'tools/ci/package-image.sh'), str(app), str(image)], check=True)
    print(f'{image} {hashlib.sha256(image.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}')
    sys.exit(0)
shutil.rmtree(dist, ignore_errors=True)
dist.mkdir()
archive = dist / f'Prospero.Eden-Encore-{release}.zip'
files = [(p, 'PPSA99008/' + p.relative_to(app).as_posix()) for p in sorted(app.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()]
files += [(root / name, name) for name in
          ('README.md', 'INSTALL.md', 'SECURITY.md', 'LICENSE', 'THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md')
          if (root / name).exists()]
files += [(p, 'LICENSES/' + p.name) for p in sorted((root / 'LICENSES').iterdir()) if p.is_file()]
with zipfile.ZipFile(archive, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED, compresslevel=9) as zip_file:
    for path, name in files:
        info = zipfile.ZipInfo(name, (2026, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0))
        info.compress_type = zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED
        info.external_attr = 0o644 << 16
        zip_file.writestr(info, path.read_bytes())
digest = hashlib.sha256(archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

# Manual PS5 FTP servers commonly support binary STOR only. FileZilla may switch .txt files to
# ASCII automatically, so publish a separate runtime-only folder archive for manual FTP installs.
# The full ZIP retains legal notices; the FTP ZIP is the update install target.
# FFPFSC is an explicit --image-only developer command, never a release asset.
ftp_archive = dist / release_info['zip']
ftp_files = []
for path in sorted(app.rglob('*')):
    if not path.is_file():
        continue
    relative = path.relative_to(app)
    posix = relative.as_posix()
    if posix == 'legal' or posix.startswith('legal/'):
        continue
    if relative.parent.as_posix() == 'ui/lang' and relative.suffix == '.txt':
        continue
    ftp_files.append((path, 'PPSA99008/' + posix))
with zipfile.ZipFile(ftp_archive, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED, compresslevel=9) as zip_file:
    for path, name in ftp_files:
        info = zipfile.ZipInfo(name, (2026, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0))
        info.compress_type = zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED
        info.external_attr = 0o644 << 16
        zip_file.writestr(info, path.read_bytes())
ftp_digest = hashlib.sha256(ftp_archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

# The standard distribution is folder-based. Do not generate or advertise
# .ffpfsc image files, since an image cannot be replaced by the updater.
(dist / 'SHA256SUMS').write_text(
    f'{digest}  {archive.name}\n'
    f'{ftp_digest}  {ftp_archive.name}\n'
)
# The unstripped executable of this release, to name the functions in a crash report later
# (tools/symbolize-crash.py). Kept out of dist/: it is not a release file.
unstripped = root / 'build/headless-native/llvm-pie.elf'
if unstripped.exists():
    symbols = root / 'build/symbols' / f'Prospero.Eden-Encore-{release}.elf'
    symbols.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy2(unstripped, symbols)
    print(f'{symbols} (keep it with the release: crash reports are read with it)')
readme = (root / 'README.md').read_text()
heading = f'Encore {release}'
match = re.search(rf'^## Changes in {re.escape(heading)}\n(.*?)(?=^## )', readme, re.M | re.S)
if match:
    (dist / 'release-notes.md').write_text(match.group(1).strip() + '\n')
else:
    # Do not publish outdated R1 notes for an R25 artifact.
    (dist / 'release-notes.md').write_text(
        f'# Eden Encore {release} — native PS5 build\n\n'
        f'Compiled source SHA: {source_sha}\n\n'
        'Package metadata and checksums are bound to this artifact. '
        'A successful build does not establish gameplay or console stability.\n'
    )
print(f'{archive} {digest}')
print(f'{ftp_archive} {ftp_digest}')
```

`tools/ci/native-content-version.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Map new Encore revisions R1..R999 to native PS5 01.400.001..01.400.999.

The already-published legacy R1 artifact (01.000.041) is immutable and
handled only by the separately pinned legacy resolver exception.
"""

import re
import sys

NATIVE_MAJOR = 1
NATIVE_MINOR = 400
MAX_REVISION = 999


def package_version(revision: str) -> str:
    if not re.fullmatch(r"R[1-9][0-9]{0,5}", revision):
        raise ValueError("invalid native Encore release revision")
    number = int(revision[1:])
    if number > MAX_REVISION:
        raise ValueError("R revision exceeds the supported 01.400.xxx format")
    return f"{NATIVE_MAJOR:02d}.{NATIVE_MINOR:03d}.{number:03d}"


def main() -> None:
    if len(sys.argv) != 2:
        raise SystemExit("Usage: native-content-version.py R<number>")
    try:
        print(package_version(sys.argv[1]))
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise SystemExit(str(exc)) from exc


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
