`tools/graphics/Dockerfile.r09-full-host`:

```r09-full-host
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# No proprietary model data, game capture, or executable is copied in image.
# Ubuntu 24.04 amd64 matches the architecture of the linked R09 artifact.
FROM ubuntu:24.04
# Fail the image build if a builder silently chooses the Mac arm64 rootfs.
# The linked R09 host requires x86_64 glibc, Vulkan ICD and C++ headers.
RUN test "$(dpkg --print-architecture)" = amd64
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
RUN apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends \
    ca-certificates g++ python3 ffmpeg \
    libvulkan1 mesa-vulkan-drivers \
    libavcodec-dev libavformat-dev libavutil-dev libavfilter-dev \
    libswresample-dev libswscale-dev libssl-dev libopus-dev \
    liblz4-dev libzstd-dev libusb-1.0-0-dev libasound2-dev \
    libunwind-dev libx11-dev libxcb1-dev libxext-dev libxrandr-dev \
```

`tools/graphics/build-fsr31-amd-shaders.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compile AMD FidelityFX FSR 3.1.4 compute passes to validated SPIR-V.

Inputs: unmodified MIT-licensed GPU shaders/headers vendored in
vendor/encore-active/amd-fsr31 (tag v1.1.4, AMD commit c6efa6bf...).
Host tool only. Vulkan backend dispatch/source integration is separate.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import struct
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
VARIANTS = (
    ("prepare_inputs","prepare_inputs",False,False),
    ("luma_pyramid","luma_pyramid",False,False),
    ("luma_pyramid_nowave","luma_pyramid",True,False),
    ("shading_change_pyramid","shading_change_pyramid",False,False),
    ("shading_change_pyramid_nowave","shading_change_pyramid",True,False),
    ("shading_change","shading_change",False,False),
    ("prepare_reactivity","prepare_reactivity",False,False),
    ("luma_instability","luma_instability",False,False),
    ("accumulate","accumulate",False,False),
    ("accumulate_sharpen","accumulate",False,True),
    ("rcas","rcas",False,False),
)
FLAGS = (
    "FFX_GPU=1","FFX_GLSL=1",
    "FFX_FSR3UPSCALER_OPTION_UPSAMPLE_SAMPLERS_USE_DATA_HALF=0",
    "FFX_FSR3UPSCALER_OPTION_ACCUMULATE_SAMPLERS_USE_DATA_HALF=0",
    "FFX_FSR3UPSCALER_OPTION_REPROJECT_SAMPLERS_USE_DATA_HALF=1",
    "FFX_FSR3UPSCALER_OPTION_POSTPROCESSLOCKSTATUS_SAMPLERS_USE_DATA_HALF=0",
    "FFX_FSR3UPSCALER_OPTION_UPSAMPLE_USE_LANCZOS_TYPE=2",
    "FFX_FSR3UPSCALER_OPTION_REPROJECT_USE_LANCZOS_TYPE=0",
    "FFX_FSR3UPSCALER_OPTION_HDR_COLOR_INPUT=1",
    "FFX_FSR3UPSCALER_OPTION_LOW_RESOLUTION_MOTION_VECTORS=1",
    "FFX_FSR3UPSCALER_OPTION_JITTERED_MOTION_VECTORS=0",
    "FFX_FSR3UPSCALER_OPTION_INVERTED_DEPTH=1",
)

def build_one(args):
    name, base, no_wave, sharpen, gpu, passes, glslang, validator, out, keep_binary = args
    source=passes/("ffx_fsr3upscaler_"+base+"_pass.glsl")
    if not source.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(source)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-fsr31-") as temp:
        binary=Path(temp)/(name+".spv")
        command=[glslang,"-V","--quiet","-S","comp","--target-env","spirv1.3",
                 "-I"+str(gpu), "-I"+str(gpu/"fsr3upscaler")]
        command.extend("-D"+value for value in FLAGS)
        if no_wave:command.append("-DFFX_SPD_NO_WAVE_OPERATIONS=1")
        command.append("-DFFX_FSR3UPSCALER_OPTION_APPLY_SHARPENING="+("1" if sharpen else "0"))
        command.extend(["-o",str(binary),str(source)])
        subprocess.run(command,check=True,capture_output=True,text=True)
        subprocess.run([validator,"--target-env","spv1.3",str(binary)],
                       check=True,capture_output=True,text=True)
        data=binary.read_bytes()
        if len(data)%4!=0 or data[:4]!=b"\x03\x02\x23\x07":
            raise ValueError("Not a valid little-endian SPIR-V module")
        words=struct.unpack("<"+str(len(data)//4)+"I",data)
        variable="FSR3_UPSCALER_"+name.upper()+"_COMP_SPV"
        header=out/("fsr3_upscaler_"+name+"_comp_spv.h")
        body=(f"// AMD FidelityFX SDK v1.1.4 FSR3.1.4 -- generated, no edits\n"
              f"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\n#pragma once\n#include <cstdint>\n"
              f"inline constexpr std::uint32_t {variable}[] = {{\n")
        for i in range(0,len(words),8):
            body+="    "+", ".join(f"0x{word:08x}" for word in words[i:i+8])+",\n"
        body+="};\n"
        header.write_text(body,encoding="utf-8")
        if keep_binary:shutil.copyfile(binary,out/("fsr3_upscaler_"+name+".spv"))
        return {"pass":name,"bytes":len(data),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--vendor",type=Path,
                        default=ROOT/"vendor"/"encore-active"/"amd-fsr31")
    parser.add_argument("--output",type=Path,required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--keep-spv",action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--jobs",type=int,default=4)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    gpu=args.vendor/"include/FidelityFX/gpu"
    passes=args.vendor/"shaders/fsr3upscaler"
    if not (args.vendor/"LICENSE.txt").is_file() or not (gpu/"ffx_core.h").is_file():
        parser.error("Missing pinned AMD FSR3.1.4 subset and MIT license in vendor")
    glslang=shutil.which("glslangValidator")
    validator=shutil.which("spirv-val")
    if not glslang or not validator:
        parser.error("Host glslangValidator and spirv-val required")
    args.output.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    work=[(*item,gpu,passes,glslang,validator,args.output,args.keep_spv)
          for item in VARIANTS]
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max(1,min(4,args.jobs))) as pool:
        results=list(pool.map(build_one,work))
    print(json.dumps(results,indent=2))
    print("AMD_FSR31_11_VALID_SPIRV_PASSES")
if __name__=="__main__":
    main()
```

`tools/graphics/check-fsr31-spirv-abi.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compare the 11 AMD FSR 3.1.4 SPIR-V descriptor ABIs with Eden C++ layouts.

Checks actual OpVariable/OpTypeImage and Vk descriptor type rather than
merely counting binding numbers or trusting shader source comments.
Requires SPIRV-Tools spirv-dis, and SPV binaries produced by
build-fsr31-amd-shaders.py --keep-spv. Host-only static verification.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import subprocess

PASS_ARRAY={
    "prepare_inputs":"PREPARE_INPUTS",
    "luma_pyramid":"LUMA_PYRAMID",
    "luma_pyramid_nowave":"LUMA_PYRAMID",
    "shading_change_pyramid":"SHADING_CHANGE_PYRAMID",
    "shading_change_pyramid_nowave":"SHADING_CHANGE_PYRAMID",
    "shading_change":"SHADING_CHANGE",
    "prepare_reactivity":"PREPARE_REACTIVITY",
    "luma_instability":"LUMA_INSTABILITY",
    "accumulate":"ACCUMULATE",
    "accumulate_sharpen":"ACCUMULATE",
    "rcas":"RCAS",
}

def expected_layouts(source: str) -> dict[str,list[str]]:
    matches=dict(re.findall(
        r"constexpr std::array\s+([A-Z_]+)\s*\{([^{}]+)\};",source))
    result={}
    for name in set(PASS_ARRAY.values()):
        if name not in matches:
            raise ValueError(f"missing host descriptor layout: {name}")
        kinds=[x.strip() for x in matches[name].split(",")]
        if not kinds or any(x not in ("T","I","U") for x in kinds):
            raise ValueError(f"invalid host layout {name}: {kinds}")
        result[name]=kinds
    return result

def parse_spirv_abi(disassembly: str) -> dict[int,str]:
    lines=disassembly.splitlines()
    bindings={}
    descriptor_sets={}
    pointers={}
    types={}
    vars={}
    for line in lines:
        m=re.search(r"OpDecorate\s+(%\S+)\s+Binding\s+(\d+)",line)
        if m:
            bindings[m[1]]=int(m[2])
        m=re.search(r"OpDecorate\s+(%\S+)\s+DescriptorSet\s+(\d+)",line)
        if m:
            descriptor_sets[m[1]]=int(m[2])
        m=re.match(r"\s*(%\S+)\s*=\s*OpTypePointer\s+(\w+)\s+(%\S+)",line)
        if m:
            pointers[m[1]]=(m[2],m[3])
        m=re.match(r"\s*(%\S+)\s*=\s*OpTypeSampler\b",line)
        if m:
            types[m[1]]="S"
        m=re.match(r"\s*(%\S+)\s*=\s*OpTypeImage\s+(.+)",line)
        if m:
            tokens=m[2].split()
            if len(tokens)<7:
                raise ValueError(f"malformed OpTypeImage: {line}")
            sampled=tokens[5]  # Sampled operand after sampled type/dim/depth/array/MS
            types[m[1]]={"1":"T","2":"I"}.get(sampled,"UNKNOWN_IMAGE")
        m=re.match(r"\s*(%\S+)\s*=\s*OpVariable\s+(%\S+)\s+(\w+)",line)
        if m:
            vars[m[1]]=(m[2],m[3])
    out={}
    for var,bind in bindings.items():
        if var not in vars:
            raise ValueError(f"decorated binding has no variable: {var}")
        if descriptor_sets.get(var)!=0:
            raise ValueError(f"unexpected descriptor set {descriptor_sets.get(var)}")
        if bind in out:
            raise ValueError(f"duplicate SPIR-V binding {bind}")
        ptr,storage=vars[var]
        ptr_storage,pointee=pointers[ptr]
        if ptr_storage!=storage:
            raise ValueError(f"inconsistent storage class {var}")
        if storage=="Uniform":
            actual="U"
        elif storage=="UniformConstant":
            actual=types.get(pointee,"UNKNOWN")
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"unsupported storage class {var}: {storage}")
        if actual not in ("U","T","I","S"):
            raise ValueError(f"unrecognised descriptor type {var}: {actual}")
        out[bind]=actual
    return out

def host_uniform_offsets(source: str) -> dict[str,list[int]]:
    result={}
    for host,spirv in (("Constants","cbFSR3UPSCALER_t"),
                       ("SpdConstants","cbSPD_t"),
                       ("RcasConstants","cbRCAS_t")):
        match=re.search(r"struct\s+"+host+r"\s*\{(.*?)\};",source,re.S)
        if not match:
            raise ValueError(f"host C++ uniform struct missing: {host}")
        fields=re.findall(
            r"^\s*(?:std::array<(?:s32|f32|u32),\s*(\d+)>|(s32|u32|f32))\s+\w+\s*;",
            match[1],re.M)
        if not fields:
            raise ValueError(f"host C++ uniform fields missing: {host}")
        offset=0
        offsets=[]
        for length,scalar in fields:
            offsets.append(offset)
            offset+=4*(int(length) if length else 1)
        result[spirv]=offsets
    if len(result["cbFSR3UPSCALER_t"])!=23 or (
        result["cbFSR3UPSCALER_t"][-1]!=144):
        raise ValueError("FSR3.1 C++ uniform ABI drift")
    return result


def verify_uniform_abi(shader: str, asm: str, offsets: dict[str,list[int]]) -> set[str]:
    seen=set()
    for spirv,expected in offsets.items():
        members={int(i):int(off) for i,off in re.findall(
            r"OpMemberDecorate\s+%"+re.escape(spirv)+r"\s+(\d+)\s+Offset\s+(\d+)",asm)}
        if not members:
            continue
        seen.add(spirv)
        if sorted(members)!=list(range(len(expected))):
            raise ValueError(f"{shader}: {spirv} uniform member count mismatch")
        actual=[members[i] for i in range(len(expected))]
        if actual!=expected:
            raise ValueError(f"{shader}: {spirv} uniform offsets wrong; GPU={actual} CPU={expected}")
    return seen

def verify_bindings(shader: str, gpu: dict[int, str], host: list[str]) -> None:
    # Every host descriptor must exist in the actual SPIR-V; a missing shader
    # binding could previously pass by only inspecting reflected entries.
    required = set(range(len(host))) | {1000, 1001}
    found = set(gpu)
    if found != required:
        missing = sorted(required - found)
        extra = sorted(found - required)
        raise ValueError(f"{shader}: incomplete SPIR-V bindings missing={missing} extra={extra}")
    for binding, actual in gpu.items():
        want = "S" if binding in (1000, 1001) else host[binding]
        if actual != want:
            raise ValueError(f"{shader}: binding {binding} SPIR-V {actual}, C++ {want}")


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--shader-dir",type=Path,required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--backend-source",type=Path,required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--spirv-dis",default=shutil.which("spirv-dis"))
    args=parser.parse_args()
    executable=args.spirv_dis
    if not executable:
        parser.error("spirv-dis is required for host descriptor ABI checks")
    cpp=args.backend_source.read_text()
    expected=expected_layouts(cpp)
    uniform_offsets=host_uniform_offsets(cpp)
    seen_uniforms=set()
    all_bindings=0
    for shader,layout in PASS_ARRAY.items():
        binary=args.shader_dir/f"fsr3_upscaler_{shader}.spv"
        if not binary.is_file():
            raise FileNotFoundError(binary)
        asm=subprocess.run([executable,str(binary)],check=True,
                           capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
        current=parse_spirv_abi(asm)
        seen_uniforms.update(verify_uniform_abi(shader,asm,uniform_offsets))
        host=expected[layout]
        verify_bindings(shader, current, host)
        all_bindings+=len(current)
        print(f"ABI_OK {shader} reflected={len(current)} host={len(host)}")
    if "cbFSR3UPSCALER_t" not in seen_uniforms or "cbSPD_t" not in seen_uniforms:
        raise ValueError("AMD GPU shaders did not expose FSR3.1 / SPD uniforms")
    print(f"FSR31_SPIRV_DESCRIPTOR_ABI_OK passes={len(PASS_ARRAY)} reflected_bindings={all_bindings} uniform_structs={len(seen_uniforms)}")

if __name__=="__main__":
    main()
```

```py
    raise SystemExit("Host shader tools glslangValidator and spirv-val required")

    std=source

        std=std.replace(high,base)

                       text=True,check=True)
        subprocess.run([spirv_val,"--target-env","spv1.3",str(output)],
                       check=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        binaries.append(output.read_bytes())
```

`tools/graphics/r09_authentic_preview_png.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
"""Export real before/after PNG previews from a completed R09 Vulkan readback.

This tool NEVER synthesizes a frame, performs inference, validates 152 GPU
operations, or claims NVIDIA-reference image quality. Inputs MUST be actual
files produced by a separately executed authentic R09 session.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import math
from pathlib import Path
import struct
import sys
import zlib

WIDTH, HEIGHT = 1920, 1080
INPUT_SIZE = WIDTH * HEIGHT * 4
OUTPUT_SIZE = WIDTH * HEIGHT * 4 * 4
PNG_SIGNATURE = b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"

def digest(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

def read_exact(path: Path, length: int) -> bytes:
    if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file() or path.stat().st_size != length:
        raise ValueError(f"R09_REAL_PREVIEW_SIZE_OR_FILE_REJECTED: {path}")
    data = path.read_bytes()
    if len(data) != length:
        raise ValueError(f"R09_REAL_PREVIEW_SHORT_READ: {path}")
    return data

def chunk(tag: bytes, payload: bytes) -> bytes:
    return (struct.pack(">I", len(payload)) + tag + payload +
            struct.pack(">I", zlib.crc32(tag + payload) & 0xffffffff))

def png(rows: list[bytes]) -> bytes:
    if len(rows) != HEIGHT or any(len(row) != WIDTH * 3 for row in rows):
        raise ValueError("R09_REAL_PREVIEW_ROW_GEOMETRY_REJECTED")
    scanlines = b"".join(b"\0" + row for row in rows)
    compressed = zlib.compress(scanlines, 6)
    header = struct.pack(">IIBBBBB", WIDTH, HEIGHT, 8, 2, 0, 0, 0)
    return (PNG_SIGNATURE + chunk(b"IHDR", header) +
            chunk(b"IDAT", compressed) + chunk(b"IEND", b""))

def source_rgb_rows(rgba8: bytes) -> list[bytes]:
    result = []
    stride = WIDTH * 4
    for start in range(0, len(rgba8), stride):
        row = rgba8[start:start + stride]
        rgb = bytearray(WIDTH * 3)
        rgb[0::3] = row[0::4]
        rgb[1::3] = row[1::4]
        rgb[2::3] = row[2::4]
        result.append(bytes(rgb))
    return result

def neural_rgb_rows(rgba32f: bytes) -> tuple[list[bytes], int, float, float]:
    rows = []
    clipped = 0
    minimum, maximum = math.inf, -math.inf
    values = struct.iter_unpack("<4f", rgba32f)
    for y in range(HEIGHT):
        row = bytearray(WIDTH * 3)
        for x in range(WIDTH):
            pixel = next(values)
            if not all(math.isfinite(value) for value in pixel):
                raise ValueError(f"R09_REAL_PREVIEW_NONFINITE_OUTPUT at ({x},{y})")
            for channel in range(3):
                value = pixel[channel]
                minimum = min(minimum, value)
                maximum = max(maximum, value)
                if value < 0.0 or value > 1.0:
                    clipped += 1
                row[x * 3 + channel] = max(
                    0, min(255, round(max(0.0, min(value, 1.0)) * 255.0)))
        rows.append(bytes(row))
    return rows, clipped, minimum, maximum

def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--input-rgba8", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output-rgba32f", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--before-png", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--after-png", required=True, type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    try:
        if args.before_png == args.after_png:
            raise ValueError("R09_REAL_PREVIEW_OUTPUT_PATH_ALIAS")
        if any(path.exists() for path in (args.before_png, args.after_png)):
            raise ValueError("R09_REAL_PREVIEW_WOULD_OVERWRITE")
        original = read_exact(args.input_rgba8, INPUT_SIZE)
        result = read_exact(args.output_rgba32f, OUTPUT_SIZE)
        before_rows = source_rgb_rows(original)
        after_rows, clipped, minimum, maximum = neural_rgb_rows(result)
        before_image = png(before_rows)
        after_image = png(after_rows)
        # Never write a preview for a non-finite or geometrically invalid
        # GPU result. A valid all-black capture remains a diagnostic image.
        args.before_png.write_bytes(before_image)
        args.after_png.write_bytes(after_image)
        print("R09_REAL_RGBA32F_PREVIEW_EXPORT_ONLY_NOT_A_152_OP_PROOF")
        print(f"source_sha256={digest(original)} output_sha256={digest(result)}")
        print(f"before_png_sha256={digest(before_image)}")
        print(f"after_png_sha256={digest(after_image)}")
        print(f"neural_range=[{minimum:.8g},{maximum:.8g}] clipped_channels={clipped}")
        print("Color mapping: direct clamp of normalized floats to 8-bit RGB; "
              "not an independent NVIDIA DLSS-NR reference.")
        return 0
    except (ValueError, OSError, struct.error) as exc:
        print("R09_REAL_PREVIEW_REJECTED", exc, file=sys.stderr)
        return 20

if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
```

`tools/graphics/r09_export_evidence.py`:

```py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
"""PNG images of the actual R09 Vulkan before/after framebuffer smoke.
Synthetic fixture, NOT game footage and NOT complete neural inference.
No third-party packages; PNG uses the Python standard library.
"""
import base64
from pathlib import Path
import struct
import zlib

BASE=Path(".build-r09-gpu")
W,H=80,45

def png_from_gpu_ppm(name):
    ppm=(BASE/name).read_bytes()
    header=f"P6\n{W} {H}\n255\n".encode("ascii")
    if not ppm.startswith(header):
        raise ValueError("GPU evidence must be P6 in exact expected geometry")
    rgb=ppm[len(header):]
    if len(rgb)!=W*H*3:
        raise ValueError("Readback PPM length mismatch")
    scanlines=b"".join(
        b"\0"+rgb[row*W*3:(row+1)*W*3] for row in range(H))
    def chunk(tag,payload):
        return (struct.pack(">I",len(payload))+tag+payload+
                struct.pack(">I",zlib.crc32(tag+payload)&0xffffffff))
    png=(b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"+
         chunk(b"IHDR",struct.pack(">IIBBBBB",W,H,8,2,0,0,0))+
         chunk(b"IDAT",zlib.compress(scanlines,9))+
         chunk(b"IEND",b""))
    out=BASE/(name.replace(".ppm",".png"))
    if not png.startswith(bytes.fromhex("89504e470d0a1a0a")):
        raise ValueError("PNG signature invalid")
    out.write_bytes(png)
    return out,png

def main():
    for name,label in [
        ("r09_before.ppm","BEFORE"),
        ("r09_after_gpu.ppm","AFTER_REAL_GPU")]:
        path,png=png_from_gpu_ppm(name)
        print(f"R09_EVIDENCE_FILE_{label}: {path}")
        print(f"R09_EVIDENCE_PNG_{label}={base64.b64encode(png).decode('ascii')}")
if __name__=="__main__":
    main()
```

`tools/graphics/r09_full_gpu_host.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Linux host entrypoint for authentic, user-owned DLSS-NR Original model.
// Needs a host build linked to the maintained Eden video_core Vulkan runtime.
// NEVER use a synthetic fixture as the authentic test's input or output.
// Eden's NvResult declares Success/BadValue, both global X11 macros.
// Parse that upstream enum before the Vulkan platform headers import X.h.
#include "core/hle/service/nvdrv/nvdata.h"
#include "r09_native_plans.h"
#include "nr_dll_launch_preflight.h"
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/nr_rdna2_frame_session.h"
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/nr_rdna2_frame_readback.h"
// The Linux Vulkan header includes X11/X.h, whose Success macro must not
// replace Eden's enum Service::Nvidia::NvResult::Success further below.
#ifdef Success
#undef Success
#endif
#ifdef BadValue
#undef BadValue
#endif
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/present/util.h"
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_scheduler.h"
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_state_tracker.h"
#include "video_core/vulkan_common/vulkan_device.h"
#include "video_core/vulkan_common/vulkan_instance.h"
#include "video_core/vulkan_common/vulkan_library.h"
#include "video_core/vulkan_common/vulkan_memory_allocator.h"
#include <cstdint>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <limits>
#include <span>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <iostream>
#include <iterator>
#include <stdlib.h> // Linux mkdtemp: private 0700 model extraction directory
#include <fcntl.h>  // O_EXCL: never overwrite the user's DLL or source capture
#include <unistd.h> // close, write, unlink
#include <stdexcept>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace vk = Vulkan::vk;
namespace {
constexpr std::uint32_t kWidth = 1920u;
constexpr std::uint32_t kHeight = 1080u;
constexpr VkExtent2D kExtent{kWidth, kHeight};
constexpr std::uint64_t kInputBytes = std::uint64_t(kWidth) * kHeight * 4u;

// The public runner may consume one user-supplied original model DLL directly.
// Import as DATA (never execute a Windows DLL), authenticate the 599 learned
// tensors, and delete the extracted ~141 MiB pack on every exit path.
struct PrivateModelCache {
    std::filesystem::path directory{};
    ~PrivateModelCache() {
        if (!directory.empty()) {
            std::error_code ignored;
            std::filesystem::remove_all(directory, ignored);
        }
    }
};

std::filesystem::path ResolvePrivateOriginal(
    const std::filesystem::path& input, PrivateModelCache& cache) {
    if (input.extension() != ".dll") return input;
    std::error_code ec;
    const auto status = std::filesystem::symlink_status(input, ec);
    if (ec || !std::filesystem::is_regular_file(status) ||
        std::filesystem::is_symlink(status)) {
        throw std::runtime_error("R09_HOST_PRIVATE_DLL_NOT_REGULAR");
    }
    auto pattern = (std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() /
                    "eden-r09-original-XXXXXX").string();
    char* directory = ::mkdtemp(pattern.data());
    if (!directory) {
        throw std::runtime_error("R09_HOST_PRIVATE_MODEL_DIRECTORY_FAILED");
    }
    cache.directory = directory;
    const auto model = cache.directory / "original.nrmodel";
    const auto imported = Eden::NRDllImport::ImportOriginal(
        input, model, Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2::R09OriginalManifest);
    if (!imported.imported) {
        throw std::runtime_error("R09_HOST_PRIVATE_DLL_ORIGINAL_IMPORT_REJECTED");
    }
    return model;
}

std::vector<std::uint8_t> ReadRawRgba8(const std::filesystem::path& path) {
    if (!std::filesystem::is_regular_file(path) ||
        std::filesystem::file_size(path) != kInputBytes) {
        throw std::runtime_error("R09_HOST_INPUT_NOT_REAL_RGBA8_1920X1080");
    }
    std::ifstream stream{path, std::ios::binary};
    if (!stream) throw std::runtime_error("R09_HOST_INPUT_READ_FAILED");
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> contents(kInputBytes);
    stream.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(contents.data()),
                static_cast<std::streamsize>(contents.size()));
    if (!stream || stream.gcount() != static_cast<std::streamsize>(contents.size())) {
        throw std::runtime_error("R09_HOST_INPUT_SHORT_READ");
    }
    return contents;
}

vk::Image MakeImage(Vulkan::MemoryAllocator& allocator, VkFormat format,
                    VkImageUsageFlags usage) {
    const VkImageCreateInfo ci{
        .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_CREATE_INFO,
        .pNext = nullptr,
        .flags = 0u,
        .imageType = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D,
        .format = format,
        .extent = {kWidth, kHeight, 1u},
        .mipLevels = 1u,
        .arrayLayers = 1u,
        .samples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT,
        .tiling = VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL,
        .usage = usage,
        .sharingMode = VK_SHARING_MODE_EXCLUSIVE,
        .queueFamilyIndexCount = 0u,
        .pQueueFamilyIndices = nullptr,
        .initialLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED,
    };
    auto result = allocator.CreateImage(ci);
    if (!result) throw std::runtime_error("R09_HOST_VULKAN_IMAGE_ALLOCATION_FAILED");
    return result;
}

void Run(const std::filesystem::path& original_model_or_dll,
         const std::filesystem::path& input_path,
         const std::filesystem::path& output_path) {
    PrivateModelCache private_cache{};
    const auto model_path = ResolvePrivateOriginal(
        original_model_or_dll, private_cache);
    if (!std::filesystem::is_regular_file(model_path)) {
        throw std::runtime_error("R09_HOST_AUTHENTIC_MODEL_MISSING");
    }
    // The shipping importer checks all 599 public learned-tensor digests.
    // Never accept a syntactically valid synthetic NRMODEL1 as Original.
    if (!Eden::Graphics::R09UsableCachedPack(
            model_path, Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2::R09ModelVariant::Original)) {
        throw std::runtime_error("R09_HOST_AUTHENTIC_599_TENSOR_SHA256_REJECTED");
    }
    // Check real capture bytes before spending Vulkan memory. No generated
    // color bars or fixture mode is supported in this program.
    if (!private_cache.directory.empty()) {
        std::cout << "R09_HOST_AUTHENTIC_DLL_IMPORT_AND_599_HASH_PASS\n";
    }
    const auto source_pixels = ReadRawRgba8(input_path);
    auto library = Vulkan::OpenLibrary();
    vk::InstanceDispatch dispatch{};
    auto instance = Vulkan::CreateInstance(*library, dispatch, VK_API_VERSION_1_1);
    const auto physical_devices = instance.EnumeratePhysicalDevices();
    if (physical_devices.empty()) {
        throw std::runtime_error("R09_HOST_NO_VULKAN_PHYSICAL_DEVICE");
    }
    Vulkan::Device device{*instance,
                          vk::PhysicalDevice(physical_devices.front(), dispatch),
                          VK_NULL_HANDLE, dispatch};
    Vulkan::MemoryAllocator allocator{device};
    Vulkan::StateTracker state_tracker{};
    Vulkan::Scheduler scheduler{device, state_tracker};
    auto source_image = MakeImage(allocator, VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM,
                                  VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT |
                                  VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT);
    auto target_image = MakeImage(allocator, VK_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_SFLOAT,
                                  VK_IMAGE_USAGE_STORAGE_BIT |
                                  VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT |
                                  VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT);
    auto source_view = Vulkan::CreateWrappedImageView(
        device, source_image, VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM);
    auto target_view = Vulkan::CreateWrappedImageView(
        device, target_image, VK_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_SFLOAT);
    auto source_sampler = Vulkan::CreateWrappedSampler(device);
    if (!source_view || !target_view || !source_sampler) {
        throw std::runtime_error("R09_HOST_VULKAN_VIEW_OR_SAMPLER_FAILED");
    }
    // True Vulkan upload to GENERAL, followed by a completed GPU tick.
    Vulkan::UploadImage(device, allocator, scheduler, source_image,
                        kExtent, VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM,
                        std::span<const std::uint8_t>{source_pixels});
    // The neural present shader expects the destination in GENERAL.
    scheduler.RequestOutsideRenderPassOperationContext();
    const VkImage target = *target_image;
    scheduler.Record([target](vk::CommandBuffer command) {
        Vulkan::TransitionImageLayout(
            command, target, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL,
            VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED);
    });
    scheduler.Finish();
    Vulkan::NrRdna2FrameSession frame{device, allocator, scheduler};
    if (!frame.Initialize(
        model_path.string(), Eden::NeuralPlans::Original,
        *source_view, *source_sampler, VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM, kExtent,
        *target_view, VK_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_SFLOAT, kExtent,
        1.0f, 1.0f)) {
        throw std::runtime_error(
            std::string("R09_HOST_ORIGINAL_INIT_REJECTED phase=") +
            std::string(frame.LastInitializePhaseName()));
    }
    Vulkan::NrRdna2FrameGpuReadback evidence{};
    if (!Vulkan::ExecuteR09FrameAndReadback(
            frame, allocator, scheduler, target,
            *target_view, kExtent, evidence) ||
        !evidence.readback_completed) {
        throw std::runtime_error(
            std::string("R09_HOST_ORIGINAL_GPU_FAILED phase=") +
            evidence.record_phase);
    }
    // Output size is fixed by the true shader target. The separate
    // r09_verify_full_gpu_evidence tool must still compare an independent
    // oracle and reject incomplete per-operation GPU traces.
    constexpr std::uint64_t output_size = kInputBytes * sizeof(float);
    if (evidence.rgba32f_le.size() != output_size) {
        throw std::runtime_error("R09_HOST_RGBA32F_SIZE_MISMATCH");
    }
    // A successful queue fence is not sufficient proof of a neural image.
    // Reject NaNs/infinities and a constant RGB readback before publishing
    // bytes; alpha cannot hide a completely degenerate color result.
    float min_rgb = std::numeric_limits<float>::infinity();
    float max_rgb = -std::numeric_limits<float>::infinity();
    for (std::size_t byte = 0u; byte < evidence.rgba32f_le.size();
         byte += sizeof(float)) {
        float value{};
        std::memcpy(&value, evidence.rgba32f_le.data() + byte,
                    sizeof(value));
        if (!std::isfinite(value)) {
            throw std::runtime_error("R09_HOST_RGBA32F_NONFINITE");
        }
        if ((byte / sizeof(float)) % 4u != 3u) {
            min_rgb = std::min(min_rgb, value);
            max_rgb = std::max(max_rgb, value);
        }
    }
    if (!(max_rgb - min_rgb > 0.001f)) {
        throw std::runtime_error("R09_HOST_RGBA32F_DEGENERATE_RGB");
    }
    // An accidental OUTPUT=DLL or OUTPUT=CAPTURE must never truncate the
    // only genuine model/capture. Open exclusively (0600) rather than using
    // std::ofstream(trunc), including against symlinks and existing outputs.
    const int fd = ::open(output_path.c_str(),
                          O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_EXCL | O_CLOEXEC, 0600);
    if (fd < 0) throw std::runtime_error("R09_HOST_OUTPUT_EXISTS_OR_UNWRITABLE");
    struct ExclusiveOutput {
        int fd;
        std::filesystem::path path;
        bool complete{};
        ~ExclusiveOutput() {
            if (fd >= 0) ::close(fd);
            if (!complete) ::unlink(path.c_str());
        }
    } output{fd, output_path};
    std::size_t written = 0u;
    while (written < evidence.rgba32f_le.size()) {
        const auto left = evidence.rgba32f_le.size() - written;
        const auto requested = std::min(left, static_cast<std::size_t>(1u << 20));
        const auto done = ::write(output.fd, evidence.rgba32f_le.data() +
                                             written, requested);
        if (done <= 0) throw std::runtime_error("R09_HOST_OUTPUT_WRITE_FAILED");
        written += static_cast<std::size_t>(done);
    }
    if (::fsync(output.fd) != 0) {
        throw std::runtime_error("R09_HOST_OUTPUT_FLUSH_FAILED");
    }
    if (::close(output.fd) != 0) {
        output.fd = -1;
        throw std::runtime_error("R09_HOST_OUTPUT_CLOSE_FAILED");
    }
    output.fd = -1;
    output.complete = true;
    // Bind the actual bytes, not just claimed dimensions, into the host log.
    // These digests permit an offline verifier to identify the exact capture
    // and GPU readback without ever publishing proprietary model tensors.
    Eden::GlyphIntegrity::Sha256 input_hash;
    input_hash.Update(source_pixels.data(), source_pixels.size());
    Eden::GlyphIntegrity::Sha256 output_hash;
    output_hash.Update(evidence.rgba32f_le.data(),
                       evidence.rgba32f_le.size());
    std::cout << "R09_HOST_REAL_FRAME_VULKAN_READBACK "
              << evidence.rgba32f_le.size()
              << " bytes; scheduler_callbacks="
              << evidence.enqueued_callbacks << "\n"
              << "R09_HOST_CAPTURE_SHA256=" << input_hash.FinishHex() << "\n"
              << "R09_HOST_GPU_READBACK_SHA256=" << output_hash.FinishHex() << "\n"
              << "NOT_A_VERIFIED_152_OPERATION_TRACE_OR_INDEPENDENT_ORACLE\n";
}
} // namespace

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    if (argc != 4) {
        std::cerr << "Usage: r09_full_gpu_host ORIGINAL.nrmodel|nvngx_dlssnr.dll "
                  << "CAPTURE_1920x1080.rgba8 OUTPUT.rgba32f\n";
        return 64;
    }
    try {
        Run(argv[1], argv[2], argv[3]);
        return 0;
    } catch (const std::exception& failure) {
        std::cerr << "R09_FULL_GPU_HOST_REJECTED: " << failure.what() << "\n";
        return 70;
    }
}
```

`tools/graphics/r09_generate_host_spirv.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build ALL maintained R09 GPU shader headers from actual Vulkan-1.1 SPIR-V.

No model DLL, weights, fixtures, or user captures are read. The generated
headers contain only shader machine code for the open-source RDNA2 path.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from pathlib import Path
import re
import struct
import subprocess
import sys

def main() -> None:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--vendor", type=Path, required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    args = ap.parse_args()
    root = args.vendor / "encore-active/eden-vulkan"
    shaders = sorted((root / "r09_rdna2_nr").glob("*_rdna2.comp"))
    owners = sorted(root.glob("nr_rdna2_*.cpp"))
    if len(shaders) < 35 or len(owners) < 73:
        raise RuntimeError("incomplete production R09 source inventory")
    args.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    produced = {}
    for shader in shaders:
        stem = shader.name.removesuffix("_rdna2.comp")
        public_name = "ffwd3" if stem == "ffwd3_group" else stem
        symbol = "RDNA2_NR_" + public_name.upper() + "_COMP_SPV"
        header = args.output / f"rdna2_nr_{public_name}_comp_spv.h"
        if public_name in produced:
            raise RuntimeError(f"duplicate R09 shader symbol {public_name}")
        produced[public_name] = header
        # Fail if even one shader is absent, fails compilation or fails SPIR-V validation.
        spv = args.output / (public_name + ".spv")
        subprocess.run(["glslangValidator", "-V", "--target-env", "vulkan1.1",
                        "-S", "comp", "-o", str(spv), str(shader)],
                       check=True, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        subprocess.run(["spirv-val", "--target-env", "vulkan1.1",
                        str(spv)], check=True)
        data = spv.read_bytes()
        if not data or len(data) % 4:
            raise RuntimeError(f"invalid SPIR-V byte count: {shader.name}")
        words = struct.unpack("<" + "I" * (len(data) // 4), data)
        lines = ["// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT", "#pragma once",
                 "#include <array>", "#include <cstdint>",
                 f"inline constexpr std::array<std::uint32_t, {len(words)}> {symbol} = {{"]
        for i in range(0, len(words), 8):
            lines.append("    " + ", ".join(
                f"0x{word:08x}u" for word in words[i:i + 8]) + ",")
        lines.append("};")
        header.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        spv.unlink()  # No unnecessary binary duplicate in the public artifact.
    includes = set()
    for owner in owners:
        for included in re.findall(
                r'#include\s+["<]video_core/host_shaders/([^">]+)[">]',
                owner.read_text(encoding="utf-8")):
            includes.add(included)
            if not (args.output / included).is_file():
                raise RuntimeError(f"unbuilt shader required by {owner.name}: {included}")
    if len(includes) < 30:
        raise RuntimeError("R09 expected shader dependencies not present")
    print(f"R09_REAL_SHADERS_HEADER_BUILD_PASS shaders={len(shaders)} "
          f"owners={len(owners)} includes={len(includes)}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        main()
    except (OSError, RuntimeError, subprocess.CalledProcessError) as exc:
        print("R09_HOST_SHADER_BUILD_FAILED", exc, file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

```

`tools/graphics/r09_prepare_host_warning_overlays.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Strict opt-in warning-only header overlays for the R09 Linux host build.

The SHA-pinned Eden source tree must remain byte-identical. The substitutions
are allowed only inside a disposable CMake binary directory; count-based
guards refuse unexpected upstream changes rather than silently patching.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import sys

PATCHES = {
    "common/page_table.h": [
        ("        constexpr void Store(bool marked, PageType type, u16 block, uintptr_t pointer) noexcept {",
         "        void Store(bool marked, PageType type, u16 block, uintptr_t pointer) noexcept {"),
        ("        constexpr void MarkRasterizerCached() noexcept {",
         "        void MarkRasterizerCached() noexcept {"),
        ("        constexpr void MarkDebug(u64 ptr, u16 block) noexcept {",
         "        void MarkDebug(u64 ptr, u16 block) noexcept {"),
    ],
    "core/hle/kernel/k_address_arbiter.h": [
        (
            "    Result WaitForAddress(uint64_t addr, Svc::ArbitrationType type, s64 value, s64 timeout) {\n"
            "        switch (type) {",
            "    Result WaitForAddress(uint64_t addr, Svc::ArbitrationType type, s64 value, s64 timeout) {\n"
            "        // HOS AArch64 ABI tag 3 is WaitIfEqual64; pinned enum remains immutable.\n"
            "        if (type == static_cast<Svc::ArbitrationType>(3)) {\n"
            "            R_RETURN(WaitIfEqual(addr, value, timeout, true));\n"
            "        }\n"
            "        switch (type) {",
        ),
        (
            "        // HOS AArch64 ABI tag 3 is WaitIfEqual64. The svc_types.h owner\n"
            "        // is an immutable verified backport, so decode this ABI value here.\n"
            "        case static_cast<Svc::ArbitrationType>(3):\n"
            "            R_RETURN(WaitIfEqual(addr, value, timeout, true));\n",
            "",
        ),
    ],
    "video_core/macro.h": [
        ("    [[nodiscard]] inline void SetMethodAddress(u32 address) noexcept {",
         "    inline void SetMethodAddress(u32 address) noexcept {"),
    ],
}


def main() -> int:
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        raise SystemExit("usage: r09_prepare_host_warning_overlays.py EDEN_PINNED_SRC HOST_COMPAT_DIR")
    source = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
    target = Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve()
    if not (source / "common/common_types.h").is_file():
        raise SystemExit("R09_HOST_WARNING_PINNED_EDEN_SOURCE_MISSING")
    if not target.is_dir() or target == source or source in target.parents:
        raise SystemExit("R09_HOST_WARNING_OVERLAY_MUST_BE_SEPARATE_BUILD_DIR")
    for rel, edits in PATCHES.items():
        original = source / rel
        data = original.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        for before, after in edits:
            if data.count(before) != 1:
                raise SystemExit("R09_HOST_WARNING_UPSTREAM_ABI_DRIFT " + rel)
            data = data.replace(before, after)
        destination = target / rel
        destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        destination.write_text(data, encoding="utf-8")
    print("R09_LINUX_HOST_WARNING_OVERLAYS_PINNED_ONLY",
          len(PATCHES), "headers; original Eden unchanged")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

```

`tools/graphics/r09_private_model_import.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// User-private CPU import for the last linked R09 Linux host binary.
// Reads the user-supplied Windows model DLL as data; never executes code or emits weights.
#include "nr_dll_launch_preflight.h"
#include <filesystem>
#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    if (argc != 3 || std::string(argv[1]) == "--help") {
        std::cerr << "Usage: r09-private-model-import nvngx_dlssnr.dll original.nrmodel\n";
        return 64;
    }
    namespace NR = Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;
    namespace fs = std::filesystem;
    const fs::path dll = argv[1];
    const fs::path output = argv[2];
    std::error_code ec;
    const auto status = fs::symlink_status(dll, ec);
    if (ec || fs::is_symlink(status) || !fs::is_regular_file(status) ||
        fs::exists(output)) {
        std::cerr << "R09_PRIVATE_IMPORT_INPUT_OR_OUTPUT_REJECTED\n";
        return 65;
    }
    const auto result = Eden::NRDllImport::ImportOriginal(
        dll, output, NR::R09OriginalManifest);
    if (!result.imported) {
        fs::remove(output, ec);
        std::cerr << "R09_PRIVATE_IMPORT_REJECTED: " << result.reason << "\n";
        return 66;
    }
    if (!Eden::Graphics::R09UsableCachedPack(output, NR::R09ModelVariant::Original)) {
        fs::remove(output, ec);
        std::cerr << "R09_PRIVATE_IMPORT_599_SHA256_REJECTED\n";
        return 67;
    }
    fs::permissions(output, fs::perms::owner_read | fs::perms::owner_write,
                    fs::perm_options::replace, ec);
    if (ec) {
        fs::remove(output, ec);
        std::cerr << "R09_PRIVATE_IMPORT_PERMISSIONS_REJECTED\n";
        return 68;
    }
    std::cout << "R09_PRIVATE_ORIGINAL_599_SHA256_PASS\n";
    return 0;
}
```

`tools/graphics/r09_real_original_preflight.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// R09 CPU-only gate for an authentic user-owned Original NRMODEL1 pack.
// No weight bytes are committed, uploaded to CI, or printed in diagnostics.
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/nr_rdna2_session_preflight.h"
#include <cstdint>
#include <fstream>
#include <iostream>
#include <iterator>
#include <string>

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    if (argc == 2 && std::string(argv[1]) == "--help") {
        std::cout << "Usage: r09_real_original_preflight MODEL_PATH ORIGINAL_PLAN.txt\n";
        return 0;
    }
    if (argc != 3) {
        std::cerr << "Pass a private user NRMODEL1 file and a public native plan.\n";
        return 64;
    }
    std::ifstream plan_file(argv[2], std::ios::binary);
    if (!plan_file) {
        std::cerr << "R09_REAL_ORIGINAL_PREFLIGHT_PLAN_MISSING\n";
        return 65;
    }
    const std::string text((std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(plan_file)),
                           std::istreambuf_iterator<char>());
    namespace NR = Eden::Graphics::NeuralRDNA2;
    NR::R09SessionCPUPlan ready{};
    if (!NR::PreflightR09Session(argv[1], text,
                                 1920u, 1080u, 1920u, 1080u, ready)) {
        std::cerr << "R09_REAL_ORIGINAL_PREFLIGHT_REJECTED\n";
        return 66;
    }
    if (ready.model.Entries().size() != 599u || ready.graph.count != 4u ||
        ready.routes.run_count != 2u || ready.vit_route.count != 8u ||
        ready.raster_width != 1080u || ready.raster_height != 1920u) {
        std::cerr << "R09_REAL_ORIGINAL_PREFLIGHT_GRAPH_MISMATCH\n";
        return 67;
    }
    // Do not describe the index/graph as GPU-ready until all four
    // genuine upsample matrices and recovered learned gain vectors load.
    if (!NR::ValidateR09LearnedUpsampleInputs(ready)) {
        std::cerr << "R09_REAL_ORIGINAL_LEARNED_UPSAMPLE_PREFLIGHT_REJECTED\n";
        return 68;
    }
    std::cout << "R09_REAL_ORIGINAL_CPU_GRAPH_PREFLIGHT_PASS "
              << ready.model.Entries().size() << " tensors, "
              << ready.graph.count << " UNet depths, "
              << ready.routes.run_count << " Split runs, "
              << ready.vit_route.count << " ViT blocks\n";
    std::cout << "R09_REAL_ORIGINAL_LEARNED_UPSAMPLE_PREFLIGHT_PASS\n";
    std::cout << "This is CPU-only. No Vulkan dispatch or final image is proven.\n";
    return 0;
}
```

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# Mac M1/M2: real attempt of R09 Original entire Vulkan session.
# IMPORTANT: legacy linked 2026-11-08 Linux amd64 binary, not a new build.
# Proprietary DLL, tensor pack, capture and readback never leave the Mac.
set -euo pipefail
umask 077

usage() {
  cat <<'EOF'
Usage:
  bash tools/graphics/r09_run_full_network_mac.sh \
    "$HOME/Downloads/nvngx_dlssnr.dll.zip" \
    "$HOME/Downloads/real-game-screenshot.png"

Second argument optional: if omitted, capture the Mac screen locally.
The user file must be the supported Windows model DLL or a ZIP containing it.
This script executes the real full-network ENTRYPOINT (not the old R09
partial fixture runner). A finished readback is not proof of 152 correct
operations, nor an independently validated reference-quality image.
Requires: macOS, Docker (running), gh CLI (authenticated), python3.
EOF
}
if [[ "${1:-}" == "--help" || "${1:-}" == "-h" ]]; then usage; exit 0; fi
if [[ "$(uname -s)" != "Darwin" ]]; then
  echo "R09_MAC_HOST_REQUIRED: this wrapper is intended for macOS." >&2
  exit 64
fi
if [[ $# -gt 2 ]]; then usage >&2; exit 64; fi

repo="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd -P)"
dll_input="${1:-$HOME/Downloads/nvngx_dlssnr.dll.zip}"
capture_input="${2:-}"
github_repo="niakw/ProsperoEden-Encore"
# The previous artifact 42465459699 was GDB-confirmed to dereference
# a null query cache before the first Vulkan dispatch. Refuse it forever.
# The default points to the ONE corrected, vendor-pinned public host link.
# Its exact binary SHA is included in the same GitHub Actions artifact
# together with engine/vendor commits; no user weights ever enter GitHub.
linked_run="${R09_HOST_LINKED_RUN_ID:-42488585951}"
expected_engine="${R09_HOST_EXPECTED_ENGINE_SHA:-27e782902a06659691d857a1df0e802abd1dbef4}"
expected_vendor="0f47339c219087801bb75075a7bcc862b39f5bfd"
required_binary_sha="${R09_HOST_LINKED_SHA256:-}"
image="eden-r09-original-host:ubuntu2404-amd64"

if [[ "$linked_run" == "42465459699" ]]; then
  echo "R09_HOST_OBSOLETE_CRASHING_BINARY_REJECTED" >&2
  exit 78
fi
if [[ ! "$linked_run" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ||
      ! "$expected_engine" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ||
      ( -n "$required_binary_sha" && ! "$required_binary_sha" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ) ]]; then
  echo "R09_HOST_RELINK_INPUT_INVALID: use pinned run and valid SHA inputs" >&2
  exit 78
fi

for tool in docker gh python3 shasum; do
  if ! command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "R09_MAC_MISSING_TOOL=$tool" >&2
    [[ "$tool" == "gh" ]] && echo "Install with brew install gh; then gh auth login" >&2
    exit 65
  fi
done
docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || {
  echo "R09_MAC_DOCKER_NOT_RUNNING: start Docker Desktop or Colima." >&2
  exit 66
}
# A Linux ARM64 Colima VM with the legacy builder silently ignores the
# requested amd64 image target. An x86_64 *VM* is required to use the
# linked R09 Linux binary reliably; never damage/change the default VM.
docker_context="$(docker context show)"
docker_server_arch="$(docker info --format '{{.Architecture}}' 2>/dev/null || true)"
echo "R09_DOCKER_CONTEXT=$docker_context server_arch=$docker_server_arch"
case "$docker_context" in
```

`tools/graphics/r09_verify_full_gpu_evidence.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Fail-closed verifier for a REAL R09 Vulkan full-network evidence bundle.

This does not execute any inference or synthesize a model output.
No weights or input images are uploaded.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
from array import array
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import re
import sys

from r09_verify_model_pack import ModelRejected, policy_for, verify_model

class Reject(Exception):
    pass

def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise Reject(message)

def sha256(path):
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1 << 20), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()

def rgba32f(path, width, height):
    length = width * height * 4
    require(sys.byteorder == "little", "little-endian host required")
    require(path.stat().st_size == length * 4,
            "RGBA32F buffer has wrong size")
    pixels = array("f")
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        pixels.fromfile(stream, length)
    require(len(pixels) == length, "short RGBA32F readback")
    require(all(math.isfinite(v) for v in pixels),
            "non-finite pixel output")
    return pixels

def verify(args):
    obj = json.loads(args.evidence.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    require(type(obj) is dict, "missing JSON evidence object")
    for name, expected in (
        ("schema", "EDEN_R09_FULL_GPU_V1"),
        ("source", "NrRdna2FrameSession"),
        ("variant", "original"),
        ("backend", "vulkan"),
        ("format", "RGBA32F_LE"),
        ("readback", "vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer_after_completed_fence"),
    ):
        require(obj.get(name) == expected, "unexpected " + name)
    # Verify the actual original capture, not a self-reported input hash.
    # A claimed capture in JSON alone is not provenance evidence.
    require(args.input.is_file() and args.input.stat().st_size == 1920 * 1080 * 4,
            "missing or wrongly sized 1920x1080 RGBA8 capture")
    require(obj.get("source_image_sha256") == sha256(args.input),
            "capture SHA-256 differs from actual input bytes")
    for key, path in (
        ("model_sha256", args.model),
        ("plan_sha256", args.plan),
        ("output_sha256", args.output),
    ):
        require(obj.get(key) == sha256(path), "bad " + key)
    if args.reference is not None:
        require(args.reference.is_file(), "reference image missing")
        require(not args.reference.samefile(args.output),
                "self-reference cannot prove independent output")
        require(sha256(args.reference) != obj["output_sha256"],
                "bit-identical reference cannot establish independence")
    # An arbitrary model SHA embedded in the evidence is not authenticity.
    # Independently verify every actual learned tensor against the 599 public
    # Original digests BEFORE accepting any GPU trace or framebuffer claim.
    # No private weights are ever bundled into this verifier.
    try:
        verify_model(args.model, policy_for("original"))
    except ModelRejected as error:
        raise Reject("Original 599-tensor SHA-256 authenticity failed: "
                     + str(error)) from error
    require(obj.get("gpu_device") and obj.get("gpu_driver"),
            "missing Vulkan device/driver")
    require(obj.get("scheduler_record_succeeded") is True,
            "full graph not recorded")
    require(obj.get("queue_submitted") is True and
            obj.get("fence_wait_succeeded") is True,
            "GPU completion not demonstrated")
    require(obj.get("input_is_real_capture") is True,
            "test fixture is not a true guest image")
    require(obj.get("source_image_sha256") and
            obj["source_image_sha256"] != obj["output_sha256"],
            "source/output identity invalid")
    require(obj.get("width") == 1920 and obj.get("height") == 1080,
            "full Original output must be 1920x1080")
    plan = [row.strip() for row in args.plan.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
            if row.strip() and not row.lstrip().startswith("#")]
    require(len(plan) == 152, "native Original plan must have 152 rows")
    require(all(re.match(r"^\d+\s+\d+\s+", row) for row in plan),
            "invalid plan syntax")
    operations = obj.get("operations")
    require(type(operations) is list and len(operations) == 152,
            "missing per-operation GPU trace (152 rows)")
    for i, (row, operation) in enumerate(zip(plan, operations)):
        require(type(operation) is dict and operation.get("ordinal") == i,
                f"operation ordinal {i} missing")
        require(operation.get("native_plan_row") == row,
                f"operation {i} does not match public plan")
        require(operation.get("vk_dispatch_recorded") is True and
                operation.get("queue_submission_completed") is True,
                f"operation {i} has no GPU completion proof")
        shader = operation.get("shader")
        require(isinstance(shader, str) and shader.endswith(".spv"),
                f"operation {i} has no SPIR-V identity")
    output = rgba32f(args.output, 1920, 1080)
    require(max(output) - min(output) > 0.001,
            "nearly constant output")
    print("R09_REAL_152_TRACE_AND_GPU_READBACK_PRESENT")
    require(args.reference is not None,
            "no independent reference; NOT a complete image validation")
    reference = rgba32f(args.reference, 1920, 1080)
    maximum = max(abs(a - b) for a, b in zip(output, reference))
    mse = sum((a-b)**2 for a, b in zip(output, reference)) / len(output)
    print(f"R09_IMAGE_REFERENCE max_abs={maximum:.8g} mse={mse:.8g}")
    require(maximum <= args.maximum_error,
            "image differs from independent oracle")
    print("R09_FULL_GPU_152_AND_REFERENCE_IMAGE_PASS")

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    for field in ("evidence", "model", "plan", "input", "output"):
        parser.add_argument("--" + field, required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--reference", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--maximum-error", type=float, default=1e-3)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    try:
        require(math.isfinite(args.maximum_error) and
                0 <= args.maximum_error <= 0.01,
                "unreasonable tolerance")
        verify(args)
        return 0
    except (Reject, OSError, KeyError, ValueError, OverflowError) as error:
        print("R09_FULL_GPU_PROOF_REJECTED:", error, file=sys.stderr)
        return 20

if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
```

`tools/graphics/r09_verify_model_pack.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Verify a user-supplied NRMODEL1 against pinned upstream per-tensor SHA-256.

Only public hashes are distributed here, never proprietary learned weights.
No GPU or PS5 build is performed. Any missing, corrupted, substituted,
truncated, overlapping or misnamed tensor fails closed.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from dataclasses import dataclass
import hashlib
import hmac
from pathlib import Path
import re
import struct
import sys


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
REFERENCE = {
    "original": (599, "r09_weights_original.sha256", "R09OriginalManifest"),
    "compact": (255, "r09_weights_compact.sha256", "R09CompactManifest"),
}


class ModelRejected(ValueError):
    pass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ModelPolicy:
    count: int
    hashes: dict[str, str]


def load_hashes(path: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
    hashes: dict[str, str] = {}
    for line in path.read_text(encoding="ascii").splitlines():
        match = re.fullmatch(r"([0-9a-f]{64})  ([^\s]+)", line)
        if not match or match[2] in hashes:
            raise ModelRejected("invalid or duplicated reference SHA-256 metadata")
        hashes[match[2]] = match[1]
    if not hashes:
        raise ModelRejected("empty reference SHA-256 metadata")
    return hashes


def policy_for(variant: str) -> ModelPolicy:
    count, name, _ = REFERENCE[variant]
    hashes = load_hashes(Path(__file__).with_name(name))
    if len(hashes) != count:
        raise ModelRejected(f"{variant}: expected {count} distinct reference hashes")
    return ModelPolicy(count, hashes)


def check_reference_manifest() -> None:
    manifest = ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/include/video_core/renderer_vulkan/nr_rdna2_model_manifest.h"
    text = manifest.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    for variant, (count, _, symbol) in REFERENCE.items():
        block = re.search(
            rf"\b{symbol}\s*=\s*\{{(.*?)\}};", text, flags=re.DOTALL)
        if block is None:
            raise ModelRejected(f"model manifest missing: {symbol}")
        names = re.findall(r'"([^"]+\.bin)"', block[1])
        expected = policy_for(variant).hashes
        if len(names) != count or set(names) != set(expected):
            raise ModelRejected(f"{variant}: source manifest differs from pinned upstream reference")
        print(f"R09_{variant.upper()}_REFERENCE_NAMES_PASS {count}/{count}")


def valid_name(name: str) -> bool:
    if (not name or name.startswith("/") or name.endswith("/") or
            "\\" in name or ":" in name or
            any(ord(c) < 32 or ord(c) == 127 for c in name)):
        return False
    return all(piece not in ("", ".", "..") for piece in name.split("/"))


def read_exact(file, size: int) -> bytes:
    raw = file.read(size)
    if len(raw) != size:
        raise ModelRejected("truncated NRMODEL1 index or tensor")
    return raw


def verify_model(path: Path, policy: ModelPolicy) -> None:
    if not path.is_file():
        raise ModelRejected("model pack not found")
    with path.open("rb") as file:
        # Use the length of the same descriptor that supplies the bytes.
        # pack_model.py aligns each payload offset, but does NOT specify
        # a canonical total length. Hardcoded guessed sizes reject genuine
        # packs despite every tensor matching the official SHA-256 list.
        file_bytes = file.seek(0, 2)
        file.seek(0)
        if file_bytes < 16:
            raise ModelRejected("model pack shorter than NRMODEL1 header")
        if read_exact(file, 8) != b"NRMODEL1":
            raise ModelRejected("invalid NRMODEL1 magic")
        count, reserved = struct.unpack("<II", read_exact(file, 8))
        if count != policy.count or reserved != 0:
            raise ModelRejected("wrong model variant/count or invalid header")
        entries: list[tuple[str, int, int]] = []
        seen: set[str] = set()
        for _ in range(count):
            (length,) = struct.unpack("<I", read_exact(file, 4))
            if not 1 <= length <= 4096:
                raise ModelRejected("invalid tensor name size")
            try:
                name = read_exact(file, length).decode("utf-8")
            except UnicodeDecodeError as exc:
                raise ModelRejected("invalid UTF-8 weight name") from exc
            offset, size = struct.unpack("<QQ", read_exact(file, 16))
            if not valid_name(name) or name not in policy.hashes or name in seen:
                raise ModelRejected("unlisted, duplicated or unsafe weight name")
            seen.add(name)
            entries.append((name, offset, size))
        index_end = file.tell()
        first_payload = (index_end + 255) & ~255
        if seen != policy.hashes.keys():
            raise ModelRejected("incomplete canonical tensor inventory")
        ordered = sorted(entries, key=lambda e: e[1])
        if first_payload > file_bytes:
            raise ModelRejected("model index exceeds file length")
        previous_end = first_payload
        for name, offset, length in ordered:
            if (offset % 256 != 0 or length == 0 or length > (256 << 20) or
                    offset < previous_end or offset > file_bytes or
                    length > file_bytes - offset):
                raise ModelRejected(f"overlapping, out-of-range or misaligned tensor: {name}")
            previous_end = offset + length
        # The index has been checked completely before any content digest.
        for name, offset, length in entries:
            file.seek(offset)
            digest = hashlib.sha256()
            pending = length
            while pending:
                piece = read_exact(file, min(pending, 1 << 20))
                digest.update(piece)
                pending -= len(piece)
            if not hmac.compare_digest(digest.hexdigest(), policy.hashes[name]):
                raise ModelRejected(f"incorrect canonical SHA-256 for {name}")


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--check-reference", action="store_true",
                        help="check that both pinned upstream SHA inventories match the current vendor model manifest")
    parser.add_argument("--model", type=Path, help="user-owned extracted NRMODEL1 model")
    parser.add_argument("--variant", choices=tuple(REFERENCE))
    args = parser.parse_args()
    try:
        if args.check_reference:
            check_reference_manifest()
            if args.model is None:
                return 0
        if args.model is None or args.variant is None:
            parser.error("--model and --variant are required together")
        policy = policy_for(args.variant)
        verify_model(args.model, policy)
        print(f"R09_{args.variant.upper()}_AUTHENTIC_PACK_SHA256_PASS "
              f"{policy.count}/{policy.count} files, {args.model.stat().st_size} bytes")
        return 0
    except (ModelRejected, OSError) as error:
        print(f"R09_AUTHENTIC_PACK_REJECTED: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
```

```cpp
// Run the R09 texture->native proxy->sampleable Vulkan image path on a
// genuine Vulkan compute queue, including barriers and pixel readback.
// This intentionally does NOT execute a neural network or an emulator.
#include <vulkan/vulkan.h>
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/nr_rdna2_model_file.h"
#include "nr_dll_launch_preflight.h"
```
