`tools/graphics/test-rdna2-noise-spv.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Validate the RDNA2 noise-field shader ABI and generate the PS5 C++ SPIR-V header."""
import argparse
import re
import struct
import subprocess
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

def validate(shader: Path, header: Path | None) -> None:
    text = shader.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    for forbidden in ("cooperative_matrix", "shader_float8",
                      "GL_EXT_shader_explicit_arithmetic_types_float16",
                      "GL_EXT_shader_16bit_storage"):
        assert forbidden not in text, forbidden
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-rdna2-noise-") as temp:
        binary = Path(temp) / "noise_field.spv"
        subprocess.run(["glslangValidator", "-V", "--target-env", "vulkan1.1",
                        "-S", "comp", "-o", str(binary), str(shader)],
                       check=True, capture_output=True)
        subprocess.run(["spirv-val", "--target-env", "vulkan1.1", str(binary)],
                       check=True, capture_output=True)
        asm = subprocess.check_output(["spirv-dis", str(binary)], text=True)
        assert "OpExecutionMode %main LocalSize 8 8 1" in asm
        assert re.search(r"OpDecorate %result_noise Binding 0\b", asm)
        assert re.search(r"OpDecorate %result_noise DescriptorSet 0\b", asm)
        for n in range(5):
            assert re.search(rf"OpMemberDecorate %Dispatch {n} Offset {4*n}\b", asm), n
        assert re.findall(r"OpCapability ([A-Za-z0-9_]+)", asm) == ["Shader"]
        assert "OpTypeCooperativeMatrix" not in asm
        if header:
            payload = binary.read_bytes()
            words = struct.unpack("<" + "I" * (len(payload) // 4), payload)
            lines = ["// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT",
                     "// RDNA2 noise field: MIT adaptation of DLSSNR-AMD.",
                     "#pragma once", "#include <array>", "#include <cstdint>",
                     f"inline constexpr std::array<std::uint32_t, {len(words)}> RDNA2_NR_NOISE_FIELD_COMP_SPV = {{"]
            for i in range(0, len(words), 8):
                lines.append("    " + ", ".join(f"0x{x:08x}u" for x in words[i:i+8]) + ",")
            lines.append("};")
            header.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            header.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        print("RDNA2_NOISE_FIELD_SPIRV_ABI_PASS", binary.stat().st_size)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument("--vendor", type=Path, required=True)
    p.add_argument("--header", type=Path)
    a = p.parse_args()
    validate(a.vendor / "encore-active/eden-vulkan/r09_rdna2_nr/noise_field_rdna2.comp",
             a.header)
```

`tools/graphics/test-rdna2-nr-spv.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""R09 RDNA2: shader-only Vulkan fallback proof and ABI check.

This does NOT attest DLSS compatibility or PS5 performance.
Requires glslangValidator, spirv-val and spirv-dis on build host.
"""
import argparse
import re
import struct
import subprocess
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

def validate(shader: Path, header: Path | None):
    assert shader.is_file(), shader
    source=shader.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "cooperative_matrix" not in source.lower(), "RDNA4-only instruction"
    assert "shader_float8" not in source.lower(), "RDNA4-only extension"
    assert "GL_EXT_shader_explicit_arithmetic_types_float8" not in source, "FP8 extension"
    assert "shared float a_tile[16][16]" in source
    assert "shared float w_tile[16][16]" in source
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-rdna2-nr-") as directory:
        spv=Path(directory)/"projection.spv"
        subprocess.run(
            ["glslangValidator","-V","--target-env","vulkan1.1","-S","comp",
             "-o",str(spv),str(shader)],
            check=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        subprocess.run(["spirv-val","--target-env","vulkan1.1",str(spv)],
                       check=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        asm=subprocess.check_output(["spirv-dis",str(spv)],text=True)
        assert re.search(r"OpExecutionMode %main LocalSize 16 16 1", asm)
        expected={"activations":0,"weights":1,"output_tensor":2}
        for variable,binding in expected.items():
            assert re.search(rf"OpDecorate %{variable} Binding {binding}\b",asm), variable
            assert re.search(rf"OpDecorate %{variable} DescriptorSet 0\b",asm), variable
        for i in range(8):
            assert re.search(
                rf"OpMemberDecorate %Dispatch {i} Offset {4*i}\b",asm), i
        capabilities=re.findall(r"OpCapability ([A-Za-z0-9_]+)",asm)
        assert capabilities == ["Shader"], capabilities
        assert "OpTypeCooperativeMatrixKHR" not in asm
        assert "OpTypeFloat8EXT" not in asm
        assert spv.stat().st_size > 512
        if header:
            binary=spv.read_bytes()
            assert len(binary)%4==0
            words=struct.unpack("<"+"I"*(len(binary)//4),binary)
            lines=[
                "// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT",
                "// Generated RDNA2 Vulkan fallback projection. No proprietary model.",
                "#pragma once",
                "#include <array>",
                "#include <cstdint>",
                f"inline constexpr std::array<std::uint32_t, {len(words)}> "
                "RDNA2_NR_FP8_PROJ_COMP_SPV = {",
            ]
            for i in range(0,len(words),8):
                lines.append("    "+", ".join(f"0x{n:08x}u" for n in words[i:i+8])+",")
            lines.append("};")
            header.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
            header.write_text(chr(10).join(lines)+chr(10))
        print("RDNA2_SCALAR_FP8_GEMM_VULKAN_1_1_SPIRV_ABI_PASS",
              f"shader_bytes={spv.stat().st_size}")

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--vendor",type=Path,required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--header",type=Path,default=None)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    validate(args.vendor/"encore-active/eden-vulkan/r09_rdna2_nr/fp8_proj_rdna2.comp",
             args.header)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

`tools/graphics/test-rdna2-repack-spv.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""RDNA2 NR: validate tile-byte permutation SPIR-V, no FP8 storage or WMMA."""
import argparse
import re
import struct
import subprocess
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

def validate(shader: Path, header: Path | None) -> None:
    content=shader.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    for forbidden in ("cooperative_matrix","shader_float8","GL_EXT_shader_8bit_storage",
                      "GL_EXT_shader_explicit_arithmetic_types_int8"):
        assert forbidden not in content, forbidden
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-rdna2-repack-") as tmp:
        binary=Path(tmp)/"repack.spv"
        subprocess.run(["glslangValidator","-V","--target-env","vulkan1.1",
                        "-S","comp","-o",str(binary),str(shader)],
                       check=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        subprocess.run(["spirv-val","--target-env","vulkan1.1",str(binary)],
                       check=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        asm=subprocess.check_output(["spirv-dis",str(binary)],text=True)
        assert "OpExecutionMode %main LocalSize 64 1 1" in asm
        assert re.search(r"OpDecorate %arena Binding 0\b",asm)
        assert re.search(r"OpDecorate %arena DescriptorSet 0\b",asm)
        for i in range(6):
            assert re.search(rf"OpMemberDecorate %Push {i} Offset {4*i}\b",asm),i
        assert re.findall(r"OpCapability ([A-Za-z0-9_]+)",asm)==["Shader"]
        assert "OpTypeCooperativeMatrix" not in asm
        if header:
            data=binary.read_bytes()
            words=struct.unpack("<"+"I"*(len(data)//4),data)
            lines=[
                "// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT",
                "// MIT adaptation from mochizuki0323/DLSSNR-AMD token layout.",
                "#pragma once",
                "#include <array>",
                "#include <cstdint>",
                f"inline constexpr std::array<std::uint32_t, {len(words)}> "
                "RDNA2_NR_REPACK_TOKENS_COMP_SPV = {",
            ]
            for j in range(0,len(words),8):
                lines.append("    "+", ".join(f"0x{x:08x}u" for x in words[j:j+8])+",")
            lines.append("};")
            header.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
            header.write_text(chr(10).join(lines)+chr(10))
        print("RDNA2_TOKEN_REPACK_SPIRV_ABI_PASS",f"shader_bytes={binary.stat().st_size}")

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--vendor",type=Path,required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--header",type=Path)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    shader=args.vendor/"encore-active/eden-vulkan/r09_rdna2_nr/repack_tokens_rdna2.comp"
    validate(shader,args.header)

if __name__=="__main__":
    main()
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compile portable RDNA2 1.1 ViT activation/residual SPV and check ABI."""
import argparse
from pathlib import Path
import re
import struct
import subprocess
import tempfile

def compile_one(root: Path, name: str, slots: tuple[str,...],
                count: int, output: Path | None) -> None:
    source=root/f"r09_rdna2_nr/{name}_rdna2.comp"
    contents=source.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    for ext in ("GL_EXT_shader_8bit_storage","cooperative_matrix",
                "GL_EXT_shader_explicit_arithmetic_types_float16",
                "GL_KHR_shader_subgroup"):
        assert ext not in contents, ext
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix=f"eden-{name}-") as d:
        spv=Path(d)/f"{name}.spv"
        subprocess.run(["glslangValidator","-V","--target-env","vulkan1.1",
                        "-S","comp","-o",str(spv),str(source)],
                       check=True,capture_output=True)
        subprocess.run(["spirv-val","--target-env","vulkan1.1",
                        str(spv)],check=True,capture_output=True)
        asm=subprocess.check_output(["spirv-dis",str(spv)],text=True)
        assert "OpExecutionMode %main LocalSize 128 1 1" in asm
        for i,var in enumerate(slots):
            assert re.search(rf"OpDecorate %{var} DescriptorSet 0\b",asm),var
            assert re.search(rf"OpDecorate %{var} Binding {i}\b",asm),var
        for i in range(count):
            assert re.search(
                rf"OpMemberDecorate %Params {i} Offset {i*4}\b",asm),i
        assert re.findall(r"OpCapability ([A-Za-z0-9_]+)",asm)==["Shader"]
        if output:
            raw=spv.read_bytes()
            words=struct.unpack("<"+"I"*(len(raw)//4),raw)
            symbol="RDNA2_NR_"+name.upper()+"_COMP_SPV"
            lines=["// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT","#pragma once",
                   "#include <array>","#include <cstdint>",
                   f"inline constexpr std::array<std::uint32_t, {len(words)}> {symbol} = {{"]
            for i in range(0,len(words),8):
                lines.append("    "+", ".join(
                    f"0x{x:08x}u" for x in words[i:i+8])+",")
            lines.append("};")
            output.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
            (output/f"rdna2_nr_{name}_comp_spv.h").write_text(
                "\n".join(lines)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"RDNA2_{name.upper()}_SPIRV_ABI_PASS")

def main():
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument("--vendor",type=Path,required=True)
    p.add_argument("--output",type=Path)
    a=p.parse_args()
    root=a.vendor/"encore-active/eden-vulkan"
    compile_one(root,"vit_activation",("source","output_tensor"),4,a.output)
    compile_one(root,"vit_residual",
                ("source","residual","gains","output_tensor"),6,a.output)
if __name__=="__main__":
    main()
```

```cpp
static std::string Read(const char* path) {
 std::ifstream f(path);
 return {std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(f),{}};
}
int main() {
 char f[]="/tmp/eden-fg-preferences-XXXXXX";
 const int fd=mkstemp(f); assert(fd>=0); close(fd);
 Eden::Preferences p = Eden::LoadPreferences(f);
 assert(p.frame_generation==0);
 p.frame_generation=1;
 assert(Eden::SavePreferences(p,f));
 assert(Eden::LoadPreferences(f).frame_generation==1);
 assert(Read(f).find("\"frame_generation\": \"mihawkgen\"")!=std::string::npos);
 p.frame_generation=2;
 assert(Eden::SavePreferences(p,f));
 assert(Eden::LoadPreferences(f).frame_generation==2);
 p.frame_generation=3;
 assert(Eden::SavePreferences(p,f));
 assert(Eden::LoadPreferences(f).frame_generation==3);
 p.frame_generation=4;
 assert(!Eden::SavePreferences(p,f));
 assert(Eden::LoadPreferences(f).frame_generation==3);
 constexpr auto tid=0x0100000000010000ull;
 Eden::GameSettings g=Eden::LoadGameSettings(tid,f);
 assert(g.frame_generation==-1);
 g.frame_generation=0;
 assert(Eden::SaveGameSettings(tid,g,f));
 assert(Eden::LoadGameSettings(tid,f).frame_generation==0);
 g.frame_generation=1;
 assert(Eden::SaveGameSettings(tid,g,f));
 assert(Eden::LoadGameSettings(tid,f).frame_generation==1);
 g.frame_generation=2;
 assert(Eden::SaveGameSettings(tid,g,f));
 assert(Eden::LoadGameSettings(tid,f).frame_generation==2);
 g.frame_generation=3;
 assert(Eden::SaveGameSettings(tid,g,f));
 assert(Eden::LoadGameSettings(tid,f).frame_generation==3);
 g.frame_generation=4;
 assert(!Eden::SaveGameSettings(tid,g,f));
 g.frame_generation=-1;
 assert(Eden::SaveGameSettings(tid,g,f));
 assert(Eden::LoadGameSettings(tid,f).frame_generation==-1);
 const std::string unknown=std::string(f)+".unknown";
 std::ofstream(unknown)<<R"({"video":{"frame_generation":"bogus"},"games":{"0100000000010000":{"frame_generation":"bogus"}}})";
 assert(Eden::LoadPreferences(unknown).frame_generation==0);
 assert(Eden::LoadGameSettings(tid,unknown).frame_generation==-1);
 std::remove(f);
 std::remove(unknown.c_str());
```

`tools/graphics/test_neural_video_policy.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#include "neural_video_policy.h"
#include <cassert>
using namespace Eden::NeuralVideo;
int main() {
    static_assert(kModeCount==6);
    static_assert(kOff==0&&kA4kDetail==1&&kA4kSoft==2&&
                  kA4kDenoise==3&&kDlssOriginal==4&&kDlssCompact==5);
    assert(Check(kOff,1,0,1,0)==Reason::Disabled);
    for(int mode=kA4kDetail;mode<=kA4kDenoise;++mode) {
        assert(IsA4k(mode));
        assert(InternalA4kFilter(mode)==mode+6);
        assert(ModeFromLegacyA4kFilter(mode+6)==mode);
        assert(CanSelect(mode,1,0,1,0));
        assert(!CanSelect(mode,1,1,1,0));
        assert(!CanSelect(mode,0,0,1,0));
        assert(!CanSelect(mode,1,0,4,0));
        assert(!CanSelect(mode,1,0,1,2));
        assert(RuntimeParametersEnabled(mode));
        assert(!HasStrength(mode));
    }
    for(int mode=kDlssOriginal;mode<=kDlssCompact;++mode) {
        assert(IsDlss(mode)&&HasStrength(mode));
        assert(Check(mode,1,0,1,0)==Reason::EngineIncomplete);
        assert(CanSelect(mode,1,0,1,0)); // UI selection != GPU proof
        assert(!RuntimeParametersEnabled(mode));
        for(int aa=0;aa<=3;++aa) {
            assert(CanSelect(mode,1,0,aa,0));
            assert(EffectiveAntiAliasing(aa,1,mode,true)==0);
        }
        // A rejected model must never unexpectedly change the AA policy.
        assert(EffectiveAntiAliasing(1,1,mode,false)==1);
    }
    assert(EffectiveAntiAliasing(1,1,kOff,false)==1);
    assert(EffectiveAntiAliasing(3,1,kA4kDetail,true)==3);
    assert(EffectiveAntiAliasing(5,0,kOff,false)==0);
    assert(DlssModelIndex(kDlssOriginal)==0&&DlssModelIndex(kDlssCompact)==1);
    assert(!CanEnable(1,0,1,0));
    assert(FramegenMethodSelectable(0,1,kDlssOriginal,false));
    assert(!FramegenMethodSelectable(2,1,kDlssOriginal,true));
    assert(FramegenMethodSelectable(2,1,kOff,true));
    assert(!UpscaleSelectable(7,1,kOff));
    assert(!UpscaleSelectable(1,1,kA4kDetail));
    assert(UpscaleSelectable(0,1,kA4kSoft));
    assert(!AntiAliasingSelectable(4,1,kDlssCompact));
    assert(AntiAliasingSelectable(2,1,kDlssCompact));
    assert(PresetsMayBeStored(0,0)&&!PresetsMayBeStored(2,100));
}
```

`tools/graphics/test_r09_full_gpu_evidence.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Negative-only regression: incomplete, fixture or fake GPU proofs MUST fail."""
from __future__ import annotations
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
TOOL = ROOT / "tools/graphics/r09_verify_full_gpu_evidence.py"

def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def run(folder, name, payload, expected_reason=None, reference=None):
    e = folder / "evidence.json"
    e.write_text(json.dumps(payload), encoding="utf-8")
    command = [sys.executable, str(TOOL), "--evidence", str(e),
               "--model", str(folder / "model.nrmodel"),
               "--plan", str(folder / "plan.txt"),
               "--input", str(folder / "input.rgba8"),
               "--output", str(folder / "output.rgba32f")]
    if reference is not None:
        command.extend(("--reference", str(reference)))
    p = subprocess.run(
        command,
        capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)
    assert p.returncode == 20, (name, p.stdout, p.stderr)
    assert "R09_FULL_GPU_152_AND_REFERENCE_IMAGE_PASS" not in p.stdout
    if expected_reason is not None:
        assert expected_reason in p.stderr, (name, p.stdout, p.stderr)
    print("R09_FULL_GPU_EVIDENCE_NEGATIVE_PASS", name)

def main():
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="r09-gpu-proof-neg-") as tmp:
        root = Path(tmp)
        (root / "model.nrmodel").write_bytes(b"not an authentic model")
        rows = [f"{n} 0 1 1920 1080 placeholder" for n in range(152)]
        (root / "plan.txt").write_text("\n".join(rows) + "\n")
        (root / "output.rgba32f").write_bytes(b"\0" * 16)
        # Negative test inputs must exist so the verifier can bind hashes
        # to bytes without claiming that this is a real game capture.
        with (root / "input.rgba8").open("wb") as source:
            source.truncate(1920 * 1080 * 4)
        base = {
            "schema": "EDEN_R09_FULL_GPU_V1",
            "source": "NrRdna2FrameSession",
            "variant": "original",
            "backend": "vulkan",
            "format": "RGBA32F_LE",
            "readback": "vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer_after_completed_fence",
            "model_sha256": sha(root / "model.nrmodel"),
            "plan_sha256": sha(root / "plan.txt"),
            "output_sha256": sha(root / "output.rgba32f"),
            "gpu_device": "TEST-ONLY",
            "gpu_driver": "TEST-ONLY",
            "scheduler_record_succeeded": True,
            "queue_submitted": True,
            "fence_wait_succeeded": True,
            "input_is_real_capture": True,
            "source_image_sha256": sha(root / "input.rgba8"),
            "width": 1920, "height": 1080,
            "operations": [
                {"ordinal": n, "native_plan_row": row,
                 "vk_dispatch_recorded": True, "queue_submission_completed": True,
                 "shader": "not-a-real-shader.spv"}
                for n, row in enumerate(rows)],
        }
        run(root, "empty-evidence", {})
        run(root, "fake-readback", base,
            "Original 599-tensor SHA-256 authenticity failed")
        wrong_capture = dict(base, source_image_sha256="f" * 64)
        run(root, "unverified-capture-hash", wrong_capture,
            "capture SHA-256 differs from actual input bytes")
        run(root, "self-reference-output", base,
            "self-reference cannot prove independent output",
            reference=root / "output.rgba32f")
        fixture = dict(base, input_is_real_capture=False)
        run(root, "fixture-refused", fixture)
        truncated = dict(base, operations=base["operations"][:-1])
        run(root, "incomplete-151-ops", truncated)
    return 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
```

`tools/graphics/test_r09_native_digest_inventory.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
"""Keep native R09 launch-time SHA-256 inventories aligned with public hashes."""
from pathlib import Path
import re

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
NATIVE=(ROOT/"headless/nr_dll_tensor_digests.h").read_text()
VENDOR=(ROOT/"vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/include/video_core/renderer_vulkan/nr_rdna2_model_manifest.h").read_text()
for name,size in (("Original",599),("Compact",255)):
    expected={}
    path=ROOT/f"tools/graphics/r09_weights_{name.lower()}.sha256"
    for raw in path.read_text().splitlines():
        raw=raw.strip()
        if not raw: continue
        m=re.fullmatch(r"([0-9a-f]{64})\s+(.+)",raw)
        assert m,(name,raw)
        assert m[2] not in expected,(name,m[2])
        expected[m[2]]=m[1]
    marker=f"R09{name}Manifest = {{"
    assert marker in VENDOR,name
    manifest=VENDOR.split(marker,1)[1].split("};",1)[0]
    names=re.findall(r'"([^"]+)"',manifest)
    marker=f"R09{name}TensorDigests = {{"
    assert marker in NATIVE,name
    values=re.findall(r'"([0-9a-f]{64})"',NATIVE.split(marker,1)[1].split("};",1)[0])
    assert len(names)==len(values)==len(expected)==size,(name,len(names),len(values),len(expected))
    for label,hash_value in zip(names,values):
        assert expected[label]==hash_value,(name,label)
    print(f"R09_{name.upper()}_TENSOR_SHA256_REFERENCE_SYNC_PASS {size}/{size}")
```

`tools/graphics/test_r09_verify_model_pack.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Non-proprietary NRMODEL1 verifier regression fixtures."""
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import struct
import tempfile
import unittest

from r09_verify_model_pack import (ModelPolicy, ModelRejected, load_hashes,
                                   policy_for, verify_model, check_reference_manifest)


def model_bytes(entries):
    header = bytearray(b"NRMODEL1" + struct.pack("<II", len(entries), 0))
    start = 16 + sum(4 + len(name.encode()) + 16 for name, _ in entries)
    offset = (start + 255) & ~255
    blobs = []
    payload_end = offset
    for name, raw in entries:
        encoded = name.encode()
        header += struct.pack("<I", len(encoded)) + encoded
        header += struct.pack("<QQ", offset, len(raw))
        blobs.append((offset, raw))
        payload_end = offset + len(raw)
        offset = (payload_end + 255) & ~255
    # Match the upstream packer's real EOF, not the next aligned offset.
    full = bytearray(max(payload_end, len(header)))
    full[:len(header)] = header
    for position, raw in blobs:
        full[position:position+len(raw)] = raw
    return full


class VerifyModelPack(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="r09-model-check-")
        self.path = Path(self.temp.name) / "test.nrmodel"
        self.entries = [
            ("unpacked-preblock/block0.layer0.layer.input_lift.bin", b"\x01\x02\x03\x04"),
            ("unpacked-postblock/block70.layer0.layer.out_project.bin", b"\x05\x06\x07\x08"),
        ]
        self.bytes = model_bytes(self.entries)
        self.policy = ModelPolicy(
            len(self.entries),
            {name: hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() for name, data in self.entries})
        self.path.write_bytes(self.bytes)

    def tearDown(self):
        self.temp.cleanup()

    def reject(self, raw, policy=None):
        self.path.write_bytes(raw)
        with self.assertRaises(ModelRejected):
            verify_model(self.path, policy or self.policy)

    def test_valid_and_corrupt_weight(self):
        verify_model(self.path, self.policy)
        modified = bytearray(self.bytes)
        modified[256] ^= 1
        self.reject(modified)

    def test_index_corruption_and_wrong_variant(self):
        damaged = bytearray(self.bytes)
        damaged[0] ^= 1
        self.reject(damaged)
        damaged = bytearray(self.bytes)
        damaged[8:12] = struct.pack("<I", 3)
        self.reject(damaged)
        self.reject(self.bytes, ModelPolicy(255, self.policy.hashes))

    def test_index_alias_and_truncation(self):
        damaged = bytearray(self.bytes)
        name = self.entries[0][0].encode()
        first_offset_pos = 16 + 4 + len(name)
        damaged[first_offset_pos:first_offset_pos+8] = struct.pack("<Q", 0)
        self.reject(damaged)
        self.reject(self.bytes[:-1])

    def test_packer_total_size_not_fixed(self):
        # Padding does not alter the expected model tensors.
        self.path.write_bytes(self.bytes + bytes(240))
        verify_model(self.path, self.policy)
        # A larger but authentic tensor changes the pack's total length.
        extended = [self.entries[0],
                    (self.entries[1][0], bytes(range(18)))]
        extended_bytes = model_bytes(extended)
        self.assertNotEqual(len(self.bytes), len(extended_bytes))
        digest = {name: hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
                  for name, raw in extended}
        self.path.write_bytes(extended_bytes)
        verify_model(self.path, ModelPolicy(2, digest))

    def test_wrong_inventory_and_wrong_digest(self):
        wrong = dict(self.policy.hashes)
        wrong[self.entries[0][0]] = "0" * 64
        self.reject(self.bytes, ModelPolicy(2, wrong))
        wrong = dict(self.policy.hashes)
        wrong.pop(self.entries[0][0])
        self.reject(self.bytes, ModelPolicy(2, wrong))

    def test_canonical_public_metadata(self):
        check_reference_manifest()
        self.assertEqual(len(policy_for("original").hashes), 599)
        self.assertEqual(len(policy_for("compact").hashes), 255)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

```cpp
    // IDs remain frozen (existing user preferences are never renumbered).
    {

        int value=kUpscalingQualityOrder[0];
        for (int expected: {5,1,4,2,0,3,6}) {

            assert(value==expected);
        }
        value=-1;
        for(int expected: {6,5,1,4,2,0,3,-1}) {
            value=CycleQualityRanked(value,1,kUpscalingQualityOrder,true,all);
            assert(value==expected);
        }
        value=kAntiAliasingQualityOrder[0];
        for(int expected: {3,1,0,2}) {
            value=CycleQualityRanked(value,1,kAntiAliasingQualityOrder,false,all);
            assert(value==expected);
        }
        auto allowed_opengl=[](int option) { return option!=5 && option!=6; };
        value=-1;
        assert(CycleQualityRanked(value,1,kUpscalingQualityOrder,true,allowed_opengl)==1);
        value=-1;
        assert(CycleQualityRanked(value,-1,kUpscalingQualityOrder,true,allowed_opengl)==3);
        auto aa_opengl=[](int option) { return option!=3; };
        assert(CycleQualityRanked(2,1,kAntiAliasingQualityOrder,false,aa_opengl)==1);
    }
    // A future curated Title ID can safely load new spatial/AA keys

    {

            {"anti_aliasing","fxaa_quality"},{"fsr_sharpness",50},
            {"refresh_rate_hz",60},{"console_mode","docked"}
        };
        auto p=Eden::EncoreOverridesRuntime::ParseProfile(live);
        assert(p && p->filter==6 && p->anti_aliasing==3 && p->renderer==1);
        live["upscaling_filter"]="sgsr";
        p=Eden::EncoreOverridesRuntime::ParseProfile(live);
        assert(p && p->filter==5);
        live["upscaling_filter"]="lanczos";
        p=Eden::EncoreOverridesRuntime::ParseProfile(live);
        assert(p && p->filter==4);
        live["renderer"]="opengl";
        p=Eden::EncoreOverridesRuntime::ParseProfile(live);
        assert(!p);
        live["anti_aliasing"]="fxaa";
        p=Eden::EncoreOverridesRuntime::ParseProfile(live);
        assert(p && p->renderer==0 && p->filter==4);
        live["upscaling_filter"]="sgsr_edge";
        p=Eden::EncoreOverridesRuntime::ParseProfile(live);
        assert(!p);
    }

    assert(UpscalingFilterSelectable(4,0));  // Lanczos on OpenGL too.
    assert(UpscalingFilterSelectable(4,1));
    assert(UpscalingFilterSelectable(5,1));  // SGSR Vulkan only.

    assert(!UpscalingFilterSelectable(5,0));
    assert(!UpscalingFilterSelectable(6,0));

    // FXAA+ is an additional quality shader, not an alias to SMAA.

           Eden::EncoreTextureProfiles::ForTitle(0,1));

    assert(Eden::LoadGameSettings(fc27,filename).texture_anisotropy==4);
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""R08: verify the pinned framegen *source* without claiming a PS5 renderer."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import shutil
import subprocess
import os

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
module = root / "vendor/sources/ps5-mihawkgen"
expected_sha = "c57232a9f16bcb6df5fe07c9bb631518f2b1cc0e"
expected_network = "31ecc7d69af1e9defd62b9abad71bc3430cd8a0a4d2f4eafcabaafa48c34bf6b"

def check(condition: bool, message: str):
    if not condition:
        raise AssertionError(message)

tree_sha = subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(root/"vendor"), "rev-parse", "HEAD:sources/ps5-mihawkgen"], text=True).strip()
check(tree_sha == "e3b42f5b89775469bec04795b93f048b74aff207", f"Vendored MihawkGen tree mismatch: {tree_sha}")
check(expected_sha in (root/"vendor/docs/PS5_INTERNAL_DEPENDENCY_ORIGINS_2026-11-10.md").read_text(), "Missing original upstream commit")
network = module / "framegen/models/network.fgw"
check(network.stat().st_size == 1757240, "Unexpected MihawkGen model size")
check(hashlib.sha256(network.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected_network,
      "Unexpected MihawkGen model hash")
sources = [module / f"framegen/src/fg_{name}.cpp" for name in
           ("common", "neural", "splat", "vulkan")]
for source in sources:
    check(source.is_file(), f"Missing native source: {source}")
shaders = sorted((module / "framegen/shaders").glob("*.spv"))
check(len(shaders) == 21, f"Unexpected SPIR-V count: {len(shaders)}")
if validator := shutil.which("spirv-val"):
    for shader in shaders:
        subprocess.run([validator, "--target-env", "vulkan1.3", str(shader)], check=True)
    print(f"SPIR-V: {len(shaders)} Vulkan 1.3 shaders validated")
else:
    print("SPIR-V: validation unavailable (spirv-val not installed)")
compiler = os.environ.get("CXX") or shutil.which("clang++")
if compiler:
    cmd = [compiler, "-std=c++20", "-fsyntax-only", "-Wno-missing-designated-field-initializers",
           "-DVK_NO_PROTOTYPES", "-I" + str(module / "framegen/include"),
           "-I" + str(module / "framegen/src"),
           "-I" + str(module / "external"), "-include",
           str(module / "ps5/third_party/volk/volk.h")]
    subprocess.run(cmd + [str(src) for src in sources], check=True)
    print("C++: four MihawkGen core sources passed host syntax")
else:
    print("C++: source compilation unavailable (clang++ not installed)")
print("R08 SOURCE PASS: pinned modules and model verified; NO native PS5 execution")
```

`tools/host-env.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
# Normalizes the host build environment without changing the Linux CI contract.
eden_host_env() {
    local root=$1
    local base=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
    if [[ $(uname -s) == Darwin && -d /opt/homebrew ]]; then
        local llvm=/opt/homebrew/opt/llvm@18/bin
        local shim="$root/.local/llvm18-bin"
        mkdir -p "$shim"
        if [[ -d $llvm ]]; then
            local tool
            for tool in clang clang++ ld.lld ld64.lld llvm-ar llvm-ranlib llvm-nm llvm-objdump llvm-readobj llvm-objcopy llvm-strip; do
                [[ -x "$llvm/$tool" ]] || continue
                ln -sf "$llvm/$tool" "$shim/${tool}-18"
            done
            # Source-check harnesses inherited from the Linux workflow invoke generic GCC/C++
            # names and need the host C++20 library (not the PS5 cross libc++). Current CLT 27
            # TAPI files are newer than the bundled Apple linker on this machine, while SDK 26
            # is fully compatible and exposes std::jthread. Keep this host-only choice isolated.
            local host_sdk=/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX26.sdk
            if [[ -d $host_sdk ]]; then
                rm -f "$shim/cc" "$shim/gcc" "$shim/c++" "$shim/g++"
                printf '#!/bin/sh\nexec /usr/bin/clang -isysroot %s "$@"\n' "$host_sdk" > "$shim/cc"
                cp "$shim/cc" "$shim/gcc"
                printf '#!/bin/sh\nexec /usr/bin/clang++ -isysroot %s "$@"\n' "$host_sdk" > "$shim/c++"
                cp "$shim/c++" "$shim/g++"
                chmod +x "$shim/cc" "$shim/gcc" "$shim/c++" "$shim/g++"
            fi
        fi
        local py_prefix=
        [[ -x "$root/.local/host-venv/bin/python3" ]] && py_prefix="$root/.local/host-venv/bin:"
        export PATH="${py_prefix}$shim:/opt/homebrew/opt/llvm@18/bin:/opt/homebrew/opt/coreutils/libexec/gnubin:/opt/homebrew/opt/make/libexec/gnubin:/opt/homebrew/opt/bison/bin:/opt/homebrew/opt/flex/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/opt/homebrew/sbin:$base"
    else
        # GitHub Actions installs the release-pinned Meson in ~/.local/bin. Preserve that explicit
        # tool location while still discarding unrelated inherited PATH entries.
        local user_prefix=
        [[ -d "$HOME/.local/bin" ]] && user_prefix="$HOME/.local/bin:"
        export PATH="${user_prefix}$base"
    fi
}

eden_host_jobs() {
    if command -v nproc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        nproc
    elif command -v sysctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        sysctl -n hw.logicalcpu
    elif command -v getconf >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        getconf _NPROCESSORS_ONLN
    else
        echo 4
    fi
}
```

`tools/install-active-core-backports.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Install maintained CPU I-cache and host service-wait sources unconditionally.

Production copies complete checked-in sources from vendor/encore-active.
The two historical patches are replayed only into a temporary comparison
tree to prove byte-for-byte parity. Any difference fails closed.
The quarantined dummy-thread workaround remains excluded (unsafe wait queue).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
ORIGINAL = ROOT / "vendor/sources/eden"
ACTIVE = ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/eden-core"
PATCHES = (
    ROOT / "headless/backports/eden-dynarmic-icache-coherence.patch",
    ROOT / "headless/backports/eden-sm-host-wait.patch",
)
PIN = "5f142c7926d0c7fcbbd0ce30794d72f638a43b2a"


def sha(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def affected() -> list[str]:
    names = set()
    for patch in PATCHES:
        data = patch.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        for line in data.splitlines():
            if line.startswith("+++ b/"):
                rel = line[6:]
                if not rel.startswith("src/") or ".." in Path(rel).parts:
                    raise RuntimeError(f"Invalid target in {patch}: {rel}")
                names.add(rel)
    if len(names) != 5:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Expected exactly five core patch sources: {sorted(names)}")
    return sorted(names)


def derive() -> dict[str, tuple[bytes, bytes]]:
    files = affected()
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-active-core-") as temp:
        stage = Path(temp)
        for relative in files:
            source = ORIGINAL / relative
            target = stage / relative
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copyfile(source, target)
        for patch in PATCHES:
            result = subprocess.run(
                ["patch", "--batch", "--fuzz=0", "-p1", "-d", str(stage)],
                input=patch.read_bytes(), capture_output=True, timeout=20,
            )
            if result.returncode:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    f"{patch.name}: pinned source does not accept patch: "
                    f"{result.stderr.decode(errors='replace')[-1200:]} "
                    f"{result.stdout.decode(errors='replace')[-1200:]}"
                )
        result = {}
        for relative in files:
            old = (ORIGINAL / relative).read_bytes()
            new = (stage / relative).read_bytes()
            if old == new:
                raise RuntimeError(f"Unapplied active patch: {relative}")
            result[relative] = (old, new)
        return result


# CI 41258590941 identified one previous local A64 overlay in the disposable
# owned source cache. Recover only that exact SHA-256, never arbitrary bytes.
KNOWN_STALE_A64_SHA256 = "08ae577aa069b589faaa8cc6659baa66c80661d78abc15381907d63b343c17b0"
A64_OWNER = "src/core/arm/dynarmic/arm_dynarmic_64.cpp"


def preserve_known_owned_cache_source(destination: Path, target: Path, digest: str) -> None:
    scratch = destination.parent
    owner = scratch / "owner"
    if (digest != KNOWN_STALE_A64_SHA256 or destination.is_symlink() or
            destination.name != "source" or scratch.is_symlink() or
            not scratch.name.startswith("ps5-eden-headless.") or
            not owner.is_file() or owner.is_symlink() or
            owner.read_text().strip() != str(ROOT.resolve()) or
            target.is_symlink() or
            not target.parent.resolve().is_relative_to(destination.resolve())):
        raise RuntimeError("Refusing repair outside the exact owner-stamped A64 cache")
    backup_dir = scratch / ".eden-known-stale-a64"
    if backup_dir.is_symlink():
        raise RuntimeError("Cached A64 backup path is a symlink")
    backup_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    backup = backup_dir / f"arm_dynarmic_64.cpp.{digest[:16]}"
    if backup.is_symlink():
        raise RuntimeError("Cached A64 backup file is a symlink")
    if not backup.exists():
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=backup_dir, delete=False) as handle:
            staged = Path(handle.name)
        try:
            shutil.copyfile(target, staged)
            if sha(staged.read_bytes()) != digest:
                raise RuntimeError("Cached A64 bytes changed during backup")
            staged.replace(backup)
        finally:
            staged.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    elif sha(backup.read_bytes()) != digest:
        raise RuntimeError("Cached A64 backup has a different SHA-256")
    print(f"EDEN_KNOWN_STALE_A64_PRESERVED sha256={digest}", flush=True)


def stage_source(destination: Path, expected: dict[str, tuple[bytes, bytes]], *, check: bool, repair_owned_cache: bool = False) -> None:
    if (destination / "GIT-COMMIT").read_text().strip() != PIN:
        raise RuntimeError("Wrong pinned core revision")
    changed = 0
    for relative, (old, new) in expected.items():
        target = destination / relative
        # The old patches are replayed to a temporary tree as a parity oracle.
        # The source installed into the native build comes only from Encore.
        maintained = ACTIVE / relative
        if not maintained.is_file():
            raise RuntimeError(f"Missing maintained active-core source: {relative}")
        maintained_bytes = maintained.read_bytes()
        if maintained_bytes != new:
            # N76 is a guarded, exact additive extension of the canonical
            # A64 JIT source; reject all other source drift.
            if relative != "src/core/arm/dynarmic/arm_dynarmic_64.cpp":
                raise RuntimeError(f"Unreviewed active-core patch drift: {relative}")
            header = "#ifdef EDEN_NS2_GUEST_COUNTER\n#include \"encore/guest_counter_policy.h\"\n#endif\n".encode()
            guest_counter = "#ifdef EDEN_NS2_GUEST_COUNTER\n    // Set before JIT is instantiated; never hardcode a game-specific name.\n    config.cntfrq_el0 = static_cast<u32>(Eden::GuestCounter::Rate());\n#else\n    config.cntfrq_el0 = Hardware::CNTFREQ;\n#endif".encode()
            original_counter = b"    config.cntfrq_el0 = Hardware::CNTFREQ;"
            if (maintained_bytes.count(header) != 1 or
                    maintained_bytes.count(guest_counter) != 1 or
                    maintained_bytes.replace(header, b"").replace(
                        guest_counter, original_counter) != new):
                raise RuntimeError("N76 modified unrelated native A64 source")
        current = target.read_bytes()
        if current == maintained_bytes:
            continue
        # --check is a pure validator: never rewrite a staged source.
        if check:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"Active source check found non-maintained revision: {relative} "
                f"current={sha(current)} active={sha(maintained_bytes)}"
            )
        if current not in (old, new):
            # Only the exact previously observed pre-N76 cached A64 bytes
            # may be repaired; keep a content-addressed copy for diagnosis.
            if (check or not repair_owned_cache or relative != A64_OWNER or
                    sha(current) != KNOWN_STALE_A64_SHA256):
                raise RuntimeError(
                    f"Active source missing/unknown revision: {relative} "
                    f"current={sha(current)} base={sha(old)} active={sha(maintained_bytes)}"
                )
            preserve_known_owned_cache_source(destination, target, sha(current))
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=target.parent, delete=False) as handle:
            tmp = Path(handle.name)
        try:
            shutil.copyfile(maintained, tmp)
            tmp.replace(target)
        finally:
            tmp.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        changed += 1
    print(f"EDEN_ACTIVE_CORE_BACKPORTS files={len(expected)} changed={changed} "
          "icache=on service_wait=on dummy_wait=quarantined")


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("destination", nargs="?", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--repair-owned-cache", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    expected = derive()
    if args.destination:
        stage_source(args.destination, expected, check=args.check,
                     repair_owned_cache=args.repair_owned_cache)
    else:
        print(f"EDEN_ACTIVE_CORE_PATCH_REPLAY_OK files={len(expected)} "
              "icache=on service_wait=on")
if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

`tools/install-eden-header-hygiene.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Install warning-free shared Eden headers without editing pinned upstream source snapshots.

Only exact reviewed C++-semantic-neutral changes are permitted: non-constexpr
atomic methods and removal of nodiscard from a void method. Original vendored
upstream files remain immutable and hash-verifiable. Both host and PS5 builds
compile maintained active headers, not a throwaway generated rewrite.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PIN = "5f142c7926d0c7fcbbd0ce30794d72f638a43b2a"
ORIGINAL = ROOT / "vendor/sources/eden/src"
ACTIVE = ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/eden-header-hygiene/include"
FIXES = {
    "common/page_table.h": (
        ("constexpr void Store(bool marked, PageType type, u16 block, uintptr_t pointer) noexcept",
         "void Store(bool marked, PageType type, u16 block, uintptr_t pointer) noexcept"),
        ("constexpr void MarkRasterizerCached() noexcept",
         "void MarkRasterizerCached() noexcept"),
        ("constexpr void MarkDebug(u64 ptr, u16 block) noexcept",
         "void MarkDebug(u64 ptr, u16 block) noexcept"),
    ),
    "video_core/macro.h": (
        ("[[nodiscard]] inline void SetMethodAddress(u32 address) noexcept",
         "inline void SetMethodAddress(u32 address) noexcept"),
    ),
}


def verify_sources() -> dict[str, tuple[bytes, bytes]]:
    verified = {}
    for relative, replacements in FIXES.items():
        original = (ORIGINAL / relative).read_bytes()
        expected = original
        for old_text, new_text in replacements:
            old, new = old_text.encode(), new_text.encode()
            if expected.count(old) != 1:
                raise RuntimeError(f"Unexpected pinned Eden revision: {relative} {old_text}")
            expected = expected.replace(old, new)
        maintained = (ACTIVE / relative).read_bytes()
        if maintained != expected or original == expected:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Unreviewed active header drift: {relative}")
        verified[relative] = original, expected
    return verified


def install(destination: Path, verified: dict[str, tuple[bytes, bytes]], *, check: bool) -> None:
    if (destination / "GIT-COMMIT").read_text().strip() != PIN:
        raise RuntimeError("Incorrect pinned Eden source checkout")
    changed = 0
    for relative, (original, expected) in verified.items():
        target = destination / "src" / relative
        if not target.is_file():
            raise RuntimeError(f"Missing native Eden source: {relative}")
        current = target.read_bytes()
        if check:
            if current != expected:
                raise RuntimeError(f"Shared header was not installed: {relative}")
            continue
        if current == expected:
            continue
        if current != original:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Unexpected native source revision: {relative}")
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=target.parent, delete=False) as out:
            temp = Path(out.name)
        try:
            shutil.copyfile(ACTIVE / relative, temp)
            temp.replace(target)
        finally:
            temp.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        changed += 1
    print(f"ENCORE_SHARED_HEADER_HYGIENE_PASS sources={len(verified)} changed={changed} check={check}")


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("destination", nargs="?", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--verify", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.check and args.destination is None:
        parser.error("--check requires a prepared Eden source destination")
    if args.verify and args.destination is not None:
        parser.error("--verify does not accept a destination")
    verified = verify_sources()
    if args.destination is not None:
        install(args.destination, verified, check=args.check)
    else:
        print(f"ENCORE_SHARED_HEADER_HYGIENE_SOURCE_PASS sources={len(verified)}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

`tools/install-ftp.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
"""Copies a built PPSA99008 folder to a console over FTP (make install).

  tools/install-ftp.py HOST APP_DIR [--port 2121]

Needs a running FTP server on the console (for example the Payload SDK's ftpsrv) and
ProsperoEden closed. Every file goes to /data/homebrew/PPSA99008 under a temporary name and is
renamed into place once complete. Executables are read back and compared when the server offers
raw SELF transfers. Files already on the console that the package does not contain (your
settings, saves and logs live elsewhere) are left alone.
"""
import argparse
import ftplib
import hashlib
import pathlib
import sys

REMOTE = '/data/homebrew/PPSA99008'
EXECUTABLES = {'eboot.bin', 'sce_module/libc.prx', 'sandbox-elevator.elf'}


def connect(host, port):
    client = ftplib.FTP()
    client.connect(host, port, timeout=60)
    client.login()
    return client


def ensure_directories(client, relative):
    path = REMOTE
    for part in pathlib.PurePosixPath(relative).parent.parts:
        path += '/' + part
        try:
            client.mkd(path)
        except ftplib.error_perm:
            pass  # already there


def main(argv):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.strip().splitlines()[0])
    parser.add_argument('host')
    parser.add_argument('app', type=pathlib.Path)
    parser.add_argument('--port', type=int, default=2121)
    options = parser.parse_args(argv)
    host, port, app = options.host, options.port, options.app
    if not (app / 'eboot.bin').is_file():
        sys.exit(f'{app} is not a built PPSA99008 folder (run make package)')
    files = sorted(p for p in app.rglob('*') if p.is_file())
    with connect(host, port) as client:
        try:
            client.mkd(REMOTE)
        except ftplib.error_perm:
            pass
        for local in files:
            relative = local.relative_to(app).as_posix()
            ensure_directories(client, relative)
            target = f'{REMOTE}/{relative}'
            with local.open('rb') as source:
                client.storbinary(f'STOR {target}.partial', source)
            try:
                client.delete(target)
            except ftplib.error_perm:
                pass
            client.rename(f'{target}.partial', target)
            print(f'copied {relative}', flush=True)
    with connect(host, port) as client:
        # First verify the complete install inventory by size. This catches partial folder copies
        # (notably ui/lang/*.po): a build can be valid while a manual FTP transfer silently omits
        # nested files, leaving the launcher in English.
        client.voidcmd('TYPE I')
        missing = []
        mismatched = []
        for local in files:
            relative = local.relative_to(app).as_posix()
            try:
                remote_size = client.size(f'{REMOTE}/{relative}')
            except (ftplib.error_perm, OSError):
                remote_size = None
            if remote_size is None:
                missing.append(relative)
            elif remote_size != local.stat().st_size:
                mismatched.append((relative, local.stat().st_size, remote_size))
        if missing or mismatched:
            sys.exit(f'Incomplete FTP install: missing={missing[:12]} size_mismatch={mismatched[:12]}')
        language_files = [p for p in files if p.relative_to(app).as_posix().startswith('ui/lang/') and p.suffix == '.po']
        if language_files and not any(p.name == 'fr-FR.po' for p in language_files):
            sys.exit('Package has language catalogs but fr-FR.po is missing')
        if len(language_files) != 31:
            sys.exit(f'Package must contain all 31 official PS5 launcher catalogs, found {len(language_files)}')
        # Size alone can miss a stale same-length catalog. These files are small enough to verify
        # byte identity after FTP, which makes a partial/stale language install impossible to miss.
        for local in language_files:
            relative = local.relative_to(app).as_posix()
            digest = hashlib.sha256()
            try:
                client.retrbinary(f'RETR {REMOTE}/{relative}', digest.update)
            except (ftplib.error_perm, OSError) as error:
                sys.exit(f'Could not verify language catalog {relative}: {error}')
            if digest.hexdigest() != hashlib.sha256(local.read_bytes()).hexdigest():
                sys.exit(f'{relative} differs on the console after the copy')

        try:
            client.sendcmd('SELF')  # raw transfers of executables, where supported
        except ftplib.error_perm:
            print(f'Installed and size-verified {len(files)} files in {REMOTE} on {host}; raw SELF verification unavailable.')
            return
        for relative in sorted(EXECUTABLES):
            local = app / relative
            if not local.is_file():
                continue
            digest = hashlib.sha256()
            client.retrbinary(f'RETR {REMOTE}/{relative}', digest.update)
            if digest.hexdigest() != hashlib.sha256(local.read_bytes()).hexdigest():
                sys.exit(f'{relative} differs on the console after the copy')
    print(f'Installed and verified {len(files)} files in {REMOTE} on {host}.')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main(sys.argv[1:])

```

`tools/install-vendored-eden-backports.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Install ALL shipping Eden backports as actual, complete, versioned sources.

Usage:
 python3 tools/install-vendored-eden-backports.py --materialize PATCHED_SOURCE
 python3 tools/install-vendored-eden-backports.py --check [--replay]
 python3 tools/install-vendored-eden-backports.py INSTALL_SOURCE

The pinned original remains pristine; no git apply is used in production.
The separately unsafe dummy-thread workaround remains excluded by policy;
I-cache and service-manager fixes are installed by install-active-core-backports.py.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
ORIGINAL=ROOT/'vendor/sources/eden'
ACTIVE=ROOT/'vendor/encore-active/eden-backports'
PIN='5f142c7926d0c7fcbbd0ce30794d72f638a43b2a'
EXPERIMENT=('EDEN_EXPERIMENTAL_DUMMY_THREAD_WAITS',)

def sha(content:bytes)->str:return hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()

def changed(patched:Path)->dict[str,dict]:
    results={}
    for f in sorted((patched/'src').rglob('*')):
        if not f.is_file():continue
        relative=str(f.relative_to(patched))
        before=ORIGINAL/relative
        prior=before.read_bytes() if before.is_file() else None
        new=f.read_bytes()
        if prior==new:continue
        results[relative]={'upstream':sha(prior) if prior is not None else None,
                           'active':sha(new),'bytes':len(new)}
    return results

def materialize(patched:Path)->None:
    entries=changed(patched)
    if len(entries)<65:raise RuntimeError(f'Unexpectedly few shipping Eden backports: {len(entries)}')
    ACTIVE.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    for path in entries:
        destination=ACTIVE/path
        destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copy2(patched/path,destination)
    receipts={p.name:p.read_text().strip() for p in patched.glob('.encore-backport-*.sha256')}
    if len(receipts)<30:raise RuntimeError(f'Backport receipts unexpectedly incomplete: {len(receipts)}')
    spec={'pinned_eden_commit':PIN,'source':'tools/apply-eden-backports.sh',
          'entries':entries,'shipping_receipts':dict(sorted(receipts.items())),
          'excluded_experimental':list(EXPERIMENT)}
    (ACTIVE/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(spec,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
    print(f'MATERIALIZED_EDEN_BACKPORTS files={len(entries)} verified_patch_receipts={len(receipts)}')

def lock()->dict:
    data=json.loads((ACTIVE/'manifest.json').read_text())
    if data['pinned_eden_commit']!=PIN:raise RuntimeError('Wrong pinned Eden revision')
    if set(data['excluded_experimental'])!=set(EXPERIMENT):raise RuntimeError('Shipping/experimental policy changed')
    return data

def verify()->dict:
    meta=lock()
    for path,contract in meta['entries'].items():
        target=ACTIVE/path
        if sha(target.read_bytes())!=contract['active']:
            raise RuntimeError(f'Vendored patched source hash mismatch: {path}')
        old=ORIGINAL/path
        if (sha(old.read_bytes()) if old.is_file() else None)!=contract['upstream']:
            raise RuntimeError(f'Vendored upstream has changed: {path}')
    if len(meta['entries'])<65 or len(meta['shipping_receipts'])<30:
        raise RuntimeError('Missing shipping Eden patches')
    print(f'EDEN_PATCHED_SOURCES_OK {len(meta["entries"])} complete files; {len(meta["shipping_receipts"])} patch checksums')
    return meta

def is_owned_cached_source(destination:Path)->bool:
    """Only the disposable, owner-stamped Encore native source may be rebased."""
    if destination.is_symlink() or destination.name!='source':
        return False
    scratch=destination.parent
    if not scratch.name.startswith('ps5-eden-headless.') or scratch.is_symlink():
        return False
    owner=scratch/'owner'
    return owner.is_file() and not owner.is_symlink() and (
        owner.read_text().strip()==str(ROOT.resolve()))

def install(destination:Path, *, repair_owned_cache:bool=False)->None:
    spec=verify()
    if (destination/'GIT-COMMIT').read_text().strip()!=PIN:
        raise RuntimeError('Refusing to patch wrong Eden source version')
    if repair_owned_cache and not is_owned_cached_source(destination):
        raise RuntimeError('Cache repair limited to an owner-stamped native build source')
    # Validate ALL unexpected paths before modifying any target. A restored
    # source tree can contain an older generated texture/cache overlay, but
    # canonical vendor/sources and the shipping reviewed overlay stay immutable.
    stale=[]
    for rel,contract in spec['entries'].items():
        if Path(rel).is_absolute() or '..' in Path(rel).parts:
            raise RuntimeError(f'Unsafe vendored source path: {rel}')
        target=destination/rel
        if target.is_symlink() or not target.parent.resolve().is_relative_to(destination.resolve()):
            raise RuntimeError(f'Symlinked or escaping build source: {rel}')
        current=sha(target.read_bytes()) if target.is_file() else None
        if current in (contract['upstream'],contract['active']):
            continue
        if not repair_owned_cache:
            raise RuntimeError(f'Unknown previous source modifications at {rel}: {current}')
        if current is None:
            raise RuntimeError(f'Missing previously managed cached source: {rel}')
        stale.append((rel,current))
    if stale:
        # Preserve exact unknown cached bytes for diagnosis before overlaying.
        # Never repair arbitrary source trees or replace an immutable pin.
        backup_root=destination.parent/'.eden-stale-overlay-backup'
        if backup_root.is_symlink():
            raise RuntimeError('Stale overlay backup path is symlinked')
        for rel,digest in stale:
            target=destination/rel
            backup=backup_root/(rel+'.'+digest[:16])
            backup.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
            if backup.is_symlink():
                raise RuntimeError(f'Stale backup is symlinked: {rel}')
            if backup.exists():
                if sha(backup.read_bytes())!=digest:
                    raise RuntimeError(f'Stale backup hash mismatch: {rel}')
            else:
                staged=backup.with_name(backup.name+f'.new-{os.getpid()}')
                try:
                    shutil.copy2(target,staged)
                    if sha(staged.read_bytes())!=digest:
                        raise RuntimeError(f'Cached source changed during backup: {rel}')
                    staged.replace(backup)
                finally:staged.unlink(missing_ok=True)
            print(f'EDEN_STALE_SOURCE_PRESERVED path={rel} prior_sha256={digest}',flush=True)
    # Only the exact unknown hashes that were just preserved in our owned
    # scratch cache are authorized to be replaced. An unknown file in any
    # other destination still fails closed. Re-hash before each replacement
    # so a concurrent cache modification cannot slip in after the backup.
    saved_stale=dict(stale)
    changed_count=0
    for rel,contract in spec['entries'].items():
        target=destination/rel
        current=sha(target.read_bytes()) if target.is_file() else None
        if current==contract['active']:continue
        if current!=contract['upstream'] and (
            not repair_owned_cache or saved_stale.get(rel)!=current):
            raise RuntimeError(f'Unknown previous source modifications at {rel}: {current}')
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        temp=target.with_name(target.name+f'.active-{os.getpid()}')
        try:
            shutil.copy2(ACTIVE/rel,temp)
            temp.replace(target)
        finally:temp.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        changed_count+=1
    for receipt,digest in spec['shipping_receipts'].items():
        (destination/receipt).write_text(digest+'\n')
    print(f'EDEN_ACTIVE_SOURCE_INSTALLED total={len(spec["entries"])} changed={changed_count} stale_rebased={len(stale)} no_git_apply')

def replay()->None:
    spec=verify()
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='eden-backports-replay-') as tmp:
        stage=Path(tmp)/'source'
        shutil.copytree(ORIGINAL,stage,symlinks=True)
        (stage/'GIT-COMMIT').write_text(PIN+'\n')
        env=os.environ.copy()
        for key in EXPERIMENT:env[key]='OFF'
        result=subprocess.run(['bash',str(ROOT/'tools/apply-eden-backports.sh'),str(stage)],
                              cwd=ROOT,env=env,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=240)
        if result.returncode:
            raise RuntimeError(f'Audited Eden patch replay failed: {result.stderr[-1400:]} {result.stdout[-1400:]}')
        observed=changed(stage)
        if observed!=spec['entries']:
            missing=sorted(set(observed)-set(spec['entries']))
            extra=sorted(set(spec['entries'])-set(observed))
            mismatched=sorted(n for n in observed.keys()&spec['entries'].keys() if observed[n]!=spec['entries'][n])
            # A hash alone does not show which reviewed source edit drifted.
            # Keep the parity gate strict and include a bounded textual diff
            # for the FIRST mismatch so a native backport can be repaired at
            # its source instead of copying the generated tree over it.
            import difflib
            sample = ''
            if mismatched:
                name = mismatched[0]
                generated = (stage / name).read_text(errors='replace').splitlines()
                maintained = (ACTIVE / name).read_text(errors='replace').splitlines()
                sample = '\n'.join(list(difflib.unified_diff(
                    maintained, generated, fromfile=f'maintained/{name}',
                    tofile=f'replayed/{name}', lineterm='', n=4))[:100])
            raise RuntimeError(f'Active Eden backports differ from full replay: missing={missing},extra={extra},mismatched={mismatched}\n{sample}')
        receipts={p.name:p.read_text().strip() for p in stage.glob('.encore-backport-*.sha256')}
        if receipts!=spec['shipping_receipts']:raise RuntimeError('Missing or stale patch receipts')
        print(f'EDEN_COMPLETE_PATCH_REPLAY_OK files={len(observed)} receipts={len(receipts)}')

if __name__=='__main__':
    arg=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    arg.add_argument('--materialize',type=Path)
    arg.add_argument('--check',action='store_true')
    arg.add_argument('--replay',action='store_true')
    arg.add_argument('--repair-owned-cache',action='store_true',help='Preserve/rebase old overlays only inside owner-stamped native cache')
    arg.add_argument('destination',nargs='?',type=Path)
    args=arg.parse_args()
    if args.materialize:materialize(args.materialize)
    if args.check or args.replay:verify()
    if args.replay:replay()
    if args.destination:install(args.destination,repair_owned_cache=args.repair_owned_cache)
    if not(any((args.materialize,args.check,args.replay,args.destination))):arg.error('requires an action')
```

`tools/install-vendored-eden-build-flags.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Install complete, maintained build recipes instead of source-text CMake rewrites.

Only source stage copies change; original upstream inputs remain immutable.
Both transforms are compared byte for byte with the pinned original.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import shutil
import tempfile

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
specs=(
    ("src/CMakeLists.txt",b"-Wno-error-all>",b"-Wno-error=all>"),
    ("src/common/scm_rev.cpp.in",b'#define BUILD_ID "@BUILD_ID@"',
     b'#ifdef BUILD_ID\n#undef BUILD_ID\n#endif\n#define BUILD_ID "@BUILD_ID@"'),
)
expected_sources=[]
for relative,before,after in specs:
    original=root/"vendor/sources/eden"/relative
    active=root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-build"/relative
    old=original.read_bytes()
    assert old.count(before)==1, f"pinned source changed: {relative}"
    expected=old.replace(before,after)
    assert active.read_bytes()==expected, f"maintained build source diverged: {relative}"
    expected_sources.append((relative,old,expected,active))
ap=argparse.ArgumentParser()
ap.add_argument("source",nargs="?")
args=ap.parse_args()
if args.source is None:
    print(f"EDEN_NATIVE_BUILD_RECIPES_PASS files={len(expected_sources)} byte-exact tracked sources")
else:
    stage=Path(args.source)
    for relative,old,expected,active in expected_sources:
        target=stage/relative
        assert target.is_file(), target
        current=target.read_bytes()
        if current==expected:
            print(f"EDEN_NATIVE_BUILD_RECIPE_ALREADY_ACTIVE {relative}")
            continue
        assert current==old, f"refusing to overwrite unknown revision: {relative}"
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=target.parent,delete=False) as file:
            temp=Path(file.name)
        try:
            shutil.copyfile(active,temp)
            temp.replace(target)
        finally:
            temp.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        print(f"EDEN_NATIVE_BUILD_RECIPE_INSTALLED {relative}")
```
