```py
#include <cassert>
#include <map>
#include <vector>
struct Graphics {
    unsigned waits{};
    void WaitForIdle() {++waits;}
};
struct System {
    Graphics graphics;
    Graphics& GPU() {return graphics;}
};
struct Ledger {
    std::map<unsigned,unsigned> mappings;
    const auto& Mappings() const {return mappings;}
};
struct Worker {
    System system;
    std::map<unsigned,unsigned> m_dense_regions;
    Ledger m_mappings;
    std::vector<unsigned> m_memory;
    void Destroy() {
__POLICY__
    }
};
int main() {
    for (unsigned dense=0;dense<2;++dense)
    for (unsigned mapped=0;mapped<2;++mapped)
    for (unsigned memory=0;memory<2;++memory) {
        Worker worker;
        if(dense)worker.m_dense_regions.emplace(2,1);
        if(mapped)worker.m_mappings.mappings.emplace(3,1);
        if(memory)worker.m_memory.push_back(4);
        worker.Destroy();
        assert(worker.system.graphics.waits==(dense||mapped||memory ? 1U:0U));
    }
}
```

`tools/ns2/check_h01_joined_kprocess_process_host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""H01 joined maintained-owner witness: authentic public NPDM/NSO through
KProcess::LoadFromMetadata -> Initialize -> LoadModule -> OS Process::Initialize
and Process::Run/Finalize on the SAME KProcess/guest pages.

Kernel allocations, page backing and RomFS registration are controlled host
stand-ins; no complete SDK update/DLC loading, console boot or PS5 claim.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
import test_real_kprocess_init_guest_rollback as kernel_host

PROCESS_SOURCE=(ROOT/"vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/process/core/hle/service/os/process.cpp").read_text()

def extract_owner(start,stop):
    assert PROCESS_SOURCE.count(start)==1 and stop in PROCESS_SOURCE.split(start,1)[1]
    return start+PROCESS_SOURCE.split(start,1)[1].split(stop,1)[0]

real_os_initialize=extract_owner("bool Process::Initialize(", "\nvoid Process::Finalize()")
real_os_finalize=extract_owner("void Process::Finalize() {","\nbool Process::Run()")
real_os_run=extract_owner("bool Process::Run() {","\nvoid Process::Terminate()")
real_os_terminate=extract_owner("void Process::Terminate() {","\nvoid Process::ResetSignal()")
for snippet in (real_os_initialize,real_os_finalize,real_os_run):
    assert "m_process" in snippet and "Finalize()" in snippet

base=kernel_host.PREFIX
def replace_once(old,new):
    global base
    assert base.count(old)==1,("KProcess host fixture drift",old[:80],base.count(old))
    base=base.replace(old,new)

replace_once("#include <array>", "#include <array>\n#include <atomic>\n#include <memory>\n#include <new>\n#include <optional>\n#include <cstdio>")
replace_once("struct KernelCore;\nstruct KSystemResource", "struct KernelCore;\nstruct KProcess;\nstruct KSystemResource")
replace_once("    u64 next_pid{200};",
             """    u64 next_pid{200};
    bool fail_append{};
    unsigned registers{},appends{},removes{};
    KProcess* latest{};
    void AppendNewProcess(KProcess*);
    void RemoveProcess(KProcess*);""")
replace_once("struct KProcess {\n    bool m_is_application=false;",
             """struct KProcess {
    unsigned references{1},opens{},closes{},terminations{},runs{};
    bool fail_run{};
    static KProcess* Create(KernelCore&);
    static void Register(KernelCore&,KProcess*);
    void Open(KernelCore&);
    void Close(KernelCore&);
    Result Run(KernelCore&,int,std::size_t);
    Result Terminate(KernelCore&);
    u64 GetProcessId()const{return m_process_id;}
    bool m_is_application=false;""")
kernel_addons=r"""
inline KProcess* KProcess::Create(KernelCore& kernel) {
    auto* process=new(std::nothrow) KProcess{};
    kernel.latest=process;
    return process;
}
inline void KProcess::Register(KernelCore& kernel,KProcess* process) {
    assert(process==kernel.latest);
    ++kernel.registers;
}
inline void KProcess::Open(KernelCore&) {
    assert(references==1);
    ++references;++opens;
}
inline void KProcess::Close(KernelCore&) {
    assert(references);
    --references;++closes;
    if(!references) {
        m_page_table.Finalize();
        m_memory.image.clear();
    }
}
inline Result KProcess::Run(KernelCore&,int,std::size_t) {
    ++runs;
    return fail_run?Result{88}:Result{};
}
inline Result KProcess::Terminate(KernelCore&) {
    ++terminations;return {};
}
inline void KernelCore::AppendNewProcess(KProcess* p) {
    assert(p==latest && p->m_memory.writes==1);
    if(fail_append)throw std::bad_alloc{};
    ++appends;
}
inline void KernelCore::RemoveProcess(KProcess* p) {
    assert(p==latest && !p->references && !p->m_page_table.mapped_pages);
    ++removes;
}

} // namespace Service
std::pair<Loader::ResultStatus,std::optional<Loader::LoadParameters>>
Loader::AppLoader::Load(Kernel::KProcess& process,Core::System& system) {
    if(malformed_npdm || malformed_nso)
        return {ResultStatus::ErrorLoadingNSO,{}};
    FileSys::ProgramMetadata metadata;
    Kernel::CodeSet image;
    std::size_t bytes{};
    try {
        metadata=ParseKnownPublicFixture(npdm);
        bytes=CodeBytesFromKnownNso(nso);
        image=PrepareGuestImage(nso,bytes);
    }catch(const std::runtime_error&) {
        return {ResultStatus::ErrorLoadingNSO,{}};
    }
    Kernel::h01_init_succeeded=false;
    auto result=process.LoadFromMetadata(system.Kernel(),metadata,bytes,
                                         0x200000,0x4000);
    if(result.IsError())return {ResultStatus::ErrorUnableToParseKernelMetadata,{}};
    // Exact maintained LoadModule writes public NSO segments after the
    // real KProcess page-table owner admitted its mapping and KAC.
    process.LoadModule(system.Kernel(),image,process.captured.code_address);
    system.filesystem.RegisterProcess(process.GetProcessId());
    Eden::NS2::SvcTrace::Register(process.GetProcessId());
    if(fail_late)return {ResultStatus::ErrorLoadingNSO,{}};
    if(missing_params)return {ResultStatus::Success,{}};
    return {ResultStatus::Success,Loader::LoadParameters{44,0x8000}};
}
static void ResetTrace() {
    Eden::NS2::SvcTrace::active_pid=0;
    Eden::NS2::SvcTrace::registrations=0;
    Eden::NS2::SvcTrace::retirements=0;
}
static void JoinedCase(const std::vector<u8>& npdm,
                       const std::vector<u8>& nso,unsigned mode) {
    Kernel::KernelCore kernel;
    Core::System sys{kernel,{}};
    Service::Process service{sys};
    Loader::AppLoader loader{npdm,nso};
    loader.malformed_npdm=mode==1;
    loader.malformed_nso=mode==2;
    loader.fail_late=mode==3;
    loader.missing_params=mode==4;
    kernel.fail_append=mode==5;
    ResetTrace();
    Loader::ResultStatus status=Loader::ResultStatus::Success;
    bool initialized=false,appended_failure=false;
    try {
        initialized=service.Initialize(loader,status);
    }catch(const std::bad_alloc&) {
        appended_failure=true;
    }
    auto* p=kernel.latest;
    Require(p && kernel.registers==1,"KProcess owner not registered");
    if(mode==0 || mode==6) {
        Require(initialized && status==Loader::ResultStatus::Success &&
                service.m_process==p && p->references==1 &&
                p->m_page_table.mapped_pages==4 && p->m_memory.writes==1 &&
                p->m_memory.image==PrepareGuestImage(nso,0x4000).memory &&
                kernel.appends==1 &&
                sys.filesystem.owner==p->GetProcessId(),
                "real joined KProcess not published with original guest NSO");
        if(mode==6)p->fail_run=true;
        if(mode==0) {
            Require(service.Run() && !service.Run() && p->runs==1,
                    "real OS Process::Run changed successful NS2 lifecycle");
            service.Finalize();
        }else {
            Require(!service.Run() && !service.Run() && p->runs==1 &&
                    service.m_process_started && !service.m_process,
                    "real OS Process::Run did not rollback failed guest launch");
        }
        Require(kernel.removes==1 && !sys.filesystem.owner &&
                !p->references && p->m_page_table.mapped_pages==0 &&
                p->m_memory.image.empty() &&
                Eden::NS2::SvcTrace::active_pid==0,
                "valid or late failing OS process did not retire guest pages");
    }else {
        Require(!initialized && !service.m_process && kernel.appends==0 &&
                !p->references && p->m_page_table.mapped_pages==0 &&
                p->m_memory.image.empty() && !sys.filesystem.owner &&
                Eden::NS2::SvcTrace::active_pid==0,
                "rejected process left guest pages, trace or RomFS behind");
        Require(appended_failure==(mode==5),
                "late OS process append OOM did not hit expected boundary");
        if(mode==1 || mode==2)Require(p->m_memory.writes==0,
                "malformed NPDM/NSO already wrote untrusted guest pages");
        if(mode==3 || mode==4 || mode==5)
            Require(p->m_memory.writes==1,
                    "late failure did not exercise REAL guest code write");
    }
    Require(p->closes>=1 && Eden::NS2::SvcTrace::active_pid==0 &&
            sys.filesystem.registered==sys.filesystem.unregistered,
            "joined resource ownership leaked after complete failure");
    delete p;
}
int main(int argc,char** argv) {
    try {
        Require(argc==3,"H01 expected public main.npdm and NSO");
        auto npdm=Bytes(argv[1]),nso=Bytes(argv[2]);
        Require(CodeBytesFromKnownNso(nso)==0x4000,
                "wrong independently built public NSO");
        for(unsigned mode=0;mode<=6;++mode)JoinedCase(npdm,nso,mode);
        std::puts("H01_JOINED_REAL_KPROCESS_OS_PROCESS_HANDOFF_PASS"
                  " KProcess_metadata=real KProcess_init=real"
                  " KProcess_LoadModule=real OS_Process_Initialize=real"
                  " OS_Process_Run_Finalize=real public_npdm_nso=1"
                  " guest_bytes=exact guest_page_late_rollback=1"
                  " failed_append_oom=rolled_back missing_params=refused"
                  " malformed_nso_npdm=refused launch_fail=rolled_back"
                  " host_page_and_loader_shims=1 PS5=not_exercised");
        return 0;
    }catch(const std::exception& e) {
        std::fprintf(stderr,"H01_JOINED_OWNER_FAIL: %s\n",e.what());
        return 1;
    }
}
"""
main_helpers=kernel_host.TEST.split("static void VerifyCase(",1)[0]
```

```py
"""G10: run the actual native Ampere SEM_EXECUTE owner on real host C++.

A 49-bit aligned VA must also belong to a live GMMU mapping before RELEASE

#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <utility>
#include "video_core/engines/native_ampere_semaphore.h"
using u32=std::uint32_t;
using GPUVAddr=std::uint64_t;
using namespace Tegra::Engines;
namespace VideoCommon {
enum class QueryType { Payload };
enum class QueryPropertiesFlags { IsAFence };
}
struct MemoryManager {
    bool mapped{true};
    bool cpu_alias{true};
    u32 word{7};
    unsigned admission_checks{};
    bool IsFullyMappedRange(GPUVAddr address, std::size_t bytes) {
        ++admission_checks;
        assert(bytes==4);
        return mapped && address==0x1000;
    }
    std::optional<GPUVAddr> GpuToCpuAddress(GPUVAddr address,std::size_t bytes) {
        return IsFullyMappedRange(address,bytes) && cpu_alias
            ? std::optional<GPUVAddr>{0x9000} : std::nullopt;
    }
};
struct Rasterizer {
    int releases{}, queries{};
    GPUVAddr last_address{};
    u32 last_payload{};
    void Query(GPUVAddr a, VideoCommon::QueryType type,
               VideoCommon::QueryPropertiesFlags flags, u32 value, u32) {
        assert(type==VideoCommon::QueryType::Payload);
        assert(flags==VideoCommon::QueryPropertiesFlags::IsAFence);
        ++queries;last_address=a;last_payload=value;
    }
    void ReleaseFences() {++releases;}
};
struct DmaPusher {
    MemoryManager memory_manager{};
    Rasterizer* rasterizer{};
};
struct CoherentNativeSemaphoreValue {u32 value; GPUVAddr cpu_address;};
static CoherentNativeSemaphoreValue ReadCoherentNativeSemaphore(DmaPusher& pusher, GPUVAddr addr) {
    if(!pusher.memory_manager.IsFullyMappedRange(addr,sizeof(u32)))
        throw std::runtime_error("coherent read not mapped");
    return {pusher.memory_manager.word, 0x9000};
}
struct Puller {
    struct Regs {
        std::array<u32,64> reg_array{};
    } regs;
    struct PendingNativeAcquire { GPUVAddr address; u32 value; u32 operation; GPUVAddr cpu_address; };
    std::optional<PendingNativeAcquire> pending_native_acquire{};

int main() {
    Puller owner;
    Rasterizer rasterizer;
    DmaPusher pusher;
    pusher.rasterizer=&rasterizer;
    owner.regs.reg_array[0x17]=0x1000;
    owner.regs.reg_array[0x18]=0;
    owner.regs.reg_array[0x19]=7;
    auto rejected=[&](u32 control) {
        try { owner.ProcessNativeSemaphoreExecute(pusher,control); }
        catch(const std::runtime_error&) {return true;}
        return false;
    };
    pusher.memory_manager.mapped=false;
    assert(rejected(1)); // release to unmapped memory never produces a fence
    assert(rasterizer.queries==0 && rasterizer.releases==0);
    assert(rejected(0)); // unmapped wait must not park a completed queue
    assert(!owner.pending_native_acquire);
    assert(rasterizer.queries==0 && rasterizer.releases==0);
    pusher.memory_manager.mapped=true;
    owner.regs.reg_array[0x17]=0x2000;
    assert(rejected(1));
    assert(!owner.pending_native_acquire && rasterizer.queries==0);
    owner.regs.reg_array[0x17]=0x1000;
    pusher.memory_manager.cpu_alias=false;
    assert(rejected(1)); // GMMU resident, Vulkan query has no CPU backing
    assert(rasterizer.queries==0 && rasterizer.releases==0);
    pusher.memory_manager.cpu_alias=true;
    owner.ProcessNativeSemaphoreExecute(pusher,1);
    assert(rasterizer.queries==1 && rasterizer.last_address==0x1000);
    assert(rasterizer.last_payload==7 && !owner.pending_native_acquire);
    owner.ProcessNativeSemaphoreExecute(pusher,0);
    assert(rasterizer.releases==1 && !owner.pending_native_acquire);
    pusher.memory_manager.word=6;
    owner.ProcessNativeSemaphoreExecute(pusher,2);
    assert(rasterizer.releases==2 && owner.pending_native_acquire);
    assert(owner.pending_native_acquire->operation==2 &&
           owner.pending_native_acquire->address==0x1000 &&
           owner.pending_native_acquire->cpu_address==0x9000);
    owner.pending_native_acquire.reset();
    const auto flushed_before_invalid = rasterizer.releases;
    assert(rejected(6));
    assert(rejected(7));
    // A rejected native control may not submit queued writes/guest fences.
    assert(rasterizer.releases == flushed_before_invalid);
    assert(!owner.pending_native_acquire && rasterizer.queries==1);
    assert(pusher.memory_manager.admission_checks>=6);
}
""".replace("__REAL_OWNER__",owner)
compilers=list(dict.fromkeys(x for x in (shutil.which("clang++"),shutil.which("g++")) if x))
```

`tools/ns2/check_native_ampere_sem_linked_host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""G10: execute REAL native Ampere puller acquire/release/resume C++ owners.

Two channel owners share a mapped guest semaphore. The mock rasterizer keeps
the real GPU fence write PENDING until an explicit GPU-completion event.
Neither this mock nor the host proves a real Vulkan QMD3 completion: G10
remains open until that linked execution is qualified.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
NATIVE=ROOT/"vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/gpu_dispatch"
source=(NATIVE/"video_core/engines/puller.cpp").read_text()
begin="struct CoherentNativeSemaphoreValue {"
end="void Puller::ProcessSemaphoreAcquire("
assert source.count(begin)==source.count(end)==1
owner=begin+source.split(begin,1)[1].split(end,1)[0]
for required in ("ReadCoherentNativeSemaphore", "bool Puller::ResumeNativeAcquire(",
                 "void Puller::ProcessNativeSemaphoreExecute(",
                 "parked acquire backing remapped",
                 "acquire page remapped during read"):
    assert required in owner,required
header=(NATIVE/"video_core/engines/puller.h").read_text()
assert "u64 cpu_address{};" in header

fixture=r"""
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <optional>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <utility>
#include "video_core/engines/native_ampere_semaphore.h"
using u32=std::uint32_t;
using u64=std::uint64_t;
using GPUVAddr=u64;
using namespace Tegra::Engines;
namespace VideoCommon {
enum class QueryType {Payload};
enum class QueryPropertiesFlags {IsAFence};
enum class CacheType {BufferCache};
}
struct MemoryManager {
    bool mapped{true};
    bool cpu_alias{true};
    bool remap_during_read{};
    u64 cpu_address{0x9000};
    u32 word{2};
    unsigned gpu_lookups{}, guest_reads{};
    bool IsFullyMappedRange(GPUVAddr addr,std::size_t count) const {
        return mapped && addr==0x1000 && count==sizeof(u32);
    }
    std::optional<u64> GpuToCpuAddress(GPUVAddr addr,std::size_t count) {
        ++gpu_lookups;
        if(!IsFullyMappedRange(addr,count) || !cpu_alias)return {};
        return cpu_address;
    }
    template<typename T> T Read(GPUVAddr addr) {
        assert(addr==0x1000 && mapped);
        ++guest_reads;
        if(remap_during_read){
            cpu_address+=0x1000;
            remap_during_read=false;
        }
        return static_cast<T>(word);
    }
};
struct Rasterizer {
    MemoryManager* memory{};
    std::optional<u32> pending_gpu_release{};
    int queries{}, releases{}, buffer_flushes{};
    bool buffer_dirty{};
    void Query(GPUVAddr addr,VideoCommon::QueryType type,
               VideoCommon::QueryPropertiesFlags flags,u32 value,u32) {
        assert(addr==0x1000 && type==VideoCommon::QueryType::Payload &&
               flags==VideoCommon::QueryPropertiesFlags::IsAFence);
        ++queries;
        pending_gpu_release=value;
    }
    void CompleteGpuFence() {
        assert(pending_gpu_release.has_value() && memory);
        memory->word=*pending_gpu_release;
        pending_gpu_release.reset();
        buffer_dirty=true;
    }
    bool MustFlushRegion(u64 address,std::size_t bytes,VideoCommon::CacheType cache) {
        assert(bytes==4 && cache==VideoCommon::CacheType::BufferCache);
        assert(address==memory->cpu_address);
        return buffer_dirty;
    }
    void FlushRegion(u64 address,std::size_t bytes,VideoCommon::CacheType cache) {
        assert(address==memory->cpu_address && bytes==4 &&
               cache==VideoCommon::CacheType::BufferCache);
        ++buffer_flushes;
        buffer_dirty=false;
    }
    void ReleaseFences(){++releases;}
};
struct DmaPusher {
    MemoryManager& memory_manager;
    Rasterizer* rasterizer{};
};
struct Puller {
    struct Regs {std::array<u32,64> reg_array{};} regs;
    struct PendingNativeAcquire {
        GPUVAddr address{};
        u32 value{},operation{};
        u64 cpu_address{};
    };
    std::optional<PendingNativeAcquire> pending_native_acquire{};
    bool ResumeNativeAcquire(DmaPusher&);
    void ProcessNativeSemaphoreExecute(DmaPusher&,u32);
};
__REAL_OWNER__
int main(){
    // A is suspended. B can release while A's later commands must not run.
    MemoryManager memory;
    Rasterizer gpu{&memory};
    DmaPusher a_push{memory,&gpu},b_push{memory,&gpu};
    Puller channel_a,channel_b;
    channel_a.regs.reg_array[0x17]=0x1000;
    channel_a.regs.reg_array[0x19]=17;
    channel_b.regs.reg_array[0x17]=0x1000;
    channel_b.regs.reg_array[0x19]=17;
    channel_a.ProcessNativeSemaphoreExecute(a_push,0);
    assert(channel_a.pending_native_acquire);
    assert(channel_a.pending_native_acquire->cpu_address==0x9000);
    assert(!channel_a.ResumeNativeAcquire(a_push));
    channel_b.ProcessNativeSemaphoreExecute(b_push,1);
    assert(gpu.queries==1 && gpu.pending_gpu_release==17 && memory.word==2);
    assert(!channel_a.ResumeNativeAcquire(a_push)); // queued release is not GPU completion
    assert(channel_a.pending_native_acquire && memory.word==2);
    gpu.CompleteGpuFence();
    assert(memory.word==17);
    assert(channel_a.ResumeNativeAcquire(a_push));
    assert(!channel_a.pending_native_acquire && gpu.buffer_flushes==1);
    assert(channel_a.ResumeNativeAcquire(a_push));

    // A parked wait cannot consume an unrelated physical page under the
    // SAME mapped GPU VA, even when the new page has its expected value.
    memory.word=2;
    channel_a.regs.reg_array[0x19]=50;
    channel_a.ProcessNativeSemaphoreExecute(a_push,2);
    assert(channel_a.pending_native_acquire);
    const int released_before_stale=gpu.releases;
    memory.cpu_address=0xa000;memory.word=50;
    bool refused=false;
    try{(void)channel_a.ResumeNativeAcquire(a_push);}
    catch(const std::runtime_error&){refused=true;}
    assert(refused && channel_a.pending_native_acquire &&
           gpu.releases==released_before_stale);
    memory.cpu_address=0x9000;
    assert(channel_a.ResumeNativeAcquire(a_push));
    assert(!channel_a.pending_native_acquire);

    // A remap during a supposedly coherent CPU-side semaphore read must
    // reject the value even if its numeric payload accidentally matches.
    memory.word=77;
    channel_a.regs.reg_array[0x19]=77;
    memory.remap_during_read=true;
    refused=false;
    try{channel_a.ProcessNativeSemaphoreExecute(a_push,0);}
    catch(const std::runtime_error&){refused=true;}
    assert(refused && !channel_a.pending_native_acquire);
    memory.cpu_address=0x9000;

    // Unsupported methods and revoked GMMU addresses do not create real
    // GPU write queries or falsely complete a parked queue.
    auto invalid=[&](u32 control){
        try{channel_b.ProcessNativeSemaphoreExecute(b_push,control);}
        catch(const std::runtime_error&){return true;}
        return false;
    };
    const int writes_before=gpu.queries, flush_before=gpu.releases;
    memory.cpu_alias=false;
    assert(invalid(1)); // Resident GMMU, no CPU view for QueryCache
    assert(gpu.queries==writes_before && !channel_b.pending_native_acquire);
    memory.cpu_alias=true;
    assert(invalid(6) && invalid(7));
    assert(gpu.queries==writes_before && gpu.releases==flush_before);
    memory.mapped=false;
    assert(invalid(1) && invalid(0));
    assert(gpu.queries==writes_before && !channel_b.pending_native_acquire);
    std::puts("G10_REAL_PARKED_SEMAPHORE_OWNER_PASS channels=2 "
              "release_before_gpu_retire=not_completed resume_after_gpu_retire=1 "
              "page_rebind=refused mid_read_rebind=refused cpu_alias_missing=refused"
              " invalid=refused "
              "Vulkan_gpu_dispatch=not_exercised");
}
""".replace("__REAL_OWNER__",owner)
compilers=list(dict.fromkeys(filter(None,(shutil.which("clang++"),shutil.which("g++")))))
assert compilers
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-g10-two-channel-") as temp:
    src=Path(temp)/"real_puller.cpp"
```

`tools/ns2/check_native_ampere_sem_real_vulkan_host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""G10: real Vulkan fence retirement across actual Ampere SEM_EXECUTE owners.

Source-extracted maintained puller is executed with two independent channels.
The release is implemented as a real vkCmdFillBuffer + vkQueueSubmit + VkFence
against a coherent guest semaphore word, not a synthetic CompleteGpuFence().
This DOES NOT execute native QMD3 nor prove PS5 guest queue completion.
"""

            // the runner's resources. An unsupported ICD is NOT retryable.
            if (instance_status != VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_HOST_MEMORY &&
                instance_status != VK_ERROR_INITIALIZATION_FAILED) break;

namespace VideoCommon {
enum class QueryType {Payload};
enum class QueryPropertiesFlags {IsAFence};
enum class CacheType {BufferCache};

struct MemoryManager {
    VulkanGuestWord& guest;
    bool mapped{true};
    bool cpu_alias{true};
    bool IsFullyMappedRange(GPUVAddr address,std::size_t bytes) const {
        return mapped && address==0x1000 && bytes==4;
    }
    std::optional<u64> GpuToCpuAddress(GPUVAddr address,std::size_t bytes) const {
        return cpu_alias && IsFullyMappedRange(address,bytes)
            ?std::optional<u64>{0x9000}:std::nullopt;
    }
    template<class T> T Read(GPUVAddr address) const {
        Check(IsFullyMappedRange(address,sizeof(T)),"guest semaphore read");
        return static_cast<T>(guest.Get());
    }
    u32* GetPointer(GPUVAddr address) const {
        return cpu_alias && IsFullyMappedRange(address,sizeof(u32))
            ?guest.Pointer():nullptr;
    }
    template<class T>void Write(GPUVAddr address,T value) {
        if(!GetPointer(address))
            throw std::runtime_error("guest semaphore backing revoked");
        guest.Set(static_cast<u32>(value));
    }
};
namespace Eden {
inline std::exception_ptr fatal;
void RecordGpuFailure(std::exception_ptr why){fatal=why;}
}
struct Rasterizer {
    VulkanGuestWord& guest;
    std::function<void()> completion;
    bool dirty{};
    unsigned queries{},flushes{},release_fences{};
    void SignalFence(std::function<void()>&& callback) {
        assert(!completion);
        completion=std::move(callback);++queries;
    }
    void CompleteQueuedVulkanWork() {
        assert(completion);
        // The actual GPU queue finishes before the shipping fence callback
        // may write into the selected guest-owned mapped semaphore word.
        guest.FillAndRetire(guest.Get());
        auto callback=std::move(completion);
        completion={};
        callback();
        dirty=true;
    }
    bool MustFlushRegion(u64 addr,std::size_t size,VideoCommon::CacheType) {
        assert(addr==0x9000 && size==4);return dirty;
    }
    void FlushRegion(u64 addr,std::size_t size,VideoCommon::CacheType) {
        assert(addr==0x9000 && size==4);dirty=false;++flushes;
    }
    void ReleaseFences(){++release_fences;}
};
namespace Service::Nvidia::Devices {
class NativeGpuChannelRegistry {
    inline static int process_owner=1;
    u64 channel_a_epoch{4};
    bool active{true};
public:
    struct Ticket {
        const void* process{};
        u64 generation{},channel_generation{};
    };
    static NativeGpuChannelRegistry& Instance() {
        static NativeGpuChannelRegistry owner;
        return owner;
    }
    std::optional<Ticket> CaptureTicket(const int* channel) const {
        if (!active || !channel) return std::nullopt;
        return Ticket{&process_owner,7,*channel==1?channel_a_epoch:u64{8}};
    }
    bool IsCurrent(const int* channel,const Ticket& ticket) const {
        const auto now=CaptureTicket(channel);
        return now && now->process==ticket.process &&
               now->generation==ticket.generation &&
               now->channel_generation==ticket.channel_generation;
    }
    void RebindFirstChannel(){++channel_a_epoch;}
};
}
struct DmaPusher{
    MemoryManager& memory_manager;
    Rasterizer* rasterizer{};
    int channel_state{};
};
struct Puller{
    struct Regs{std::array<u32,64> reg_array{};} regs;
    struct PendingNativeAcquire{
        GPUVAddr address{};
        u32 value{},operation{};
        u64 cpu_address{};
        const void* process{};
        u64 process_generation{},channel_generation{};
    };
    std::optional<PendingNativeAcquire> pending_native_acquire{};
    bool ResumeNativeAcquire(DmaPusher&);
    void ProcessNativeSemaphoreExecute(DmaPusher&,u32);
};
__REAL_OWNER__
int main() {
    VulkanGuestWord guest;
    MemoryManager memory{guest};
    Rasterizer gpu{guest};
    DmaPusher a{memory,&gpu,1},b{memory,&gpu,2};
    Puller channel_a,channel_b;
    for(auto* p:{&channel_a,&channel_b}){
        p->regs.reg_array[0x17]=0x1000;
        p->regs.reg_array[0x18]=0;
        p->regs.reg_array[0x19]=17;
    }
    channel_a.ProcessNativeSemaphoreExecute(a,0); // pending wait
    assert(channel_a.pending_native_acquire && guest.Get()==2);
    assert(!channel_a.ResumeNativeAcquire(a));
    channel_b.ProcessNativeSemaphoreExecute(b,1); // real native release owner
    assert(gpu.queries==1 && gpu.completion && guest.Get()==2);
    assert(!channel_a.ResumeNativeAcquire(a)); // unsubmitted GPU work isn't complete
    gpu.CompleteQueuedVulkanWork(); // genuine vkCmdFillBuffer, vkQueueSubmit, VkFence
    assert(guest.Get()==17);
    assert(channel_a.ResumeNativeAcquire(a)); // same owner, guest word actually signalled
    assert(!channel_a.pending_native_acquire);
    assert(gpu.flushes==1);
    // Valid host fence never permits a stale page alias to satisfy a new
    // parked wait; this second round refuses a revoked CPU backing.
    channel_a.regs.reg_array[0x19]=19;
    channel_a.ProcessNativeSemaphoreExecute(a,2);
    assert(channel_a.pending_native_acquire);
    memory.cpu_alias=false;
    bool rejected=false;
    try{(void)channel_a.ResumeNativeAcquire(a);}
    catch(const std::runtime_error&){rejected=true;}
    assert(rejected && channel_a.pending_native_acquire);
    memory.cpu_alias=true;
    // Even a completed Vulkan write must not wake a parked GPFIFO channel
    // when the process-owned channel has been unbound and rebound at the
    // same address. This previously had no epoch check at semaphore resume.
    channel_b.regs.reg_array[0x19]=19;
    channel_b.ProcessNativeSemaphoreExecute(b,1);
    gpu.CompleteQueuedVulkanWork();
    assert(guest.Get()==19);
    Service::Nvidia::Devices::NativeGpuChannelRegistry::Instance()
        .RebindFirstChannel();
    bool stale_epoch_rejected=false;
    try{(void)channel_a.ResumeNativeAcquire(a);}
    catch(const std::runtime_error&){stale_epoch_rejected=true;}
    assert(stale_epoch_rejected && channel_a.pending_native_acquire);
    // A valid bound channel with a revoked backing cannot publish a late
    // release, even after its Vulkan commands have genuinely retired.
    channel_b.regs.reg_array[0x19]=23;
    channel_b.ProcessNativeSemaphoreExecute(b,1);
    assert(gpu.completion && guest.Get()==19);
    memory.cpu_alias=false;
    gpu.CompleteQueuedVulkanWork();
    assert(guest.Get()==19 && Eden::fatal);
    memory.cpu_alias=true;
    std::puts("G10_REAL_VULKAN_SEMAPHORE_OWNER_PASS"
              " channels=2 vkCmdFillBuffer=1 vkQueueSubmit=1"
              " VkFence_retired=1 guest_write_observed=17"
              " parked_replay=1 stale_alias_refused=1"
              " retired_channel_epoch=refused genuine_vk_fence_after_rebind=1"
              " revoked_release_backing=no_guest_write fatal_latched=1"
              " QMD3_dispatch=not_exercised PS5=not_exercised");
}
```

```py
using namespace Tegra::Engines::NativeSemaphore;
int main() {
  assert(Address(0x10001,0x1043)==0x1000100001040ULL);

  assert(!AcquireReady(7,0,0).has_value());
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""G10: replay the actual Ampere Compute semaphore-report admission and retire owner.

A resident GMMU mapping WITHOUT the CPU alias required by QueryCache may
not queue a guest semaphore completion. Exercise 4- and 16-byte reports,
reduction, unmap and revoked-owner paths with the real owner C++ method.
GPU completion is deliberately controlled by a mock, not a Vulkan claim.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
NATIVE=ROOT/"vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/gpu_dispatch"
source=(NATIVE/"video_core/engines/puller.cpp").read_text()
begin="void Puller::ProcessNativeComputeReportSemaphore("

    "GpuToCpuAddress(address, write_bytes)")
assert owner.index("GpuToCpuAddress(address, write_bytes)") < owner.index(
    "if (reduction_enabled) {")
assert owner.index("GpuToCpuAddress(address, write_bytes)") < owner.index(
    "pusher.rasterizer->Query(")
assert "Native Compute report semaphore missing CPU backing" in owner
harness=r"""
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <functional>
#include <memory>
#include <optional>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <utility>
#include "video_core/native_qmd.h"
using u32=std::uint32_t;
using u64=std::uint64_t;
using GPUVAddr=u64;
#define LOG_ERROR(...) ((void)0)
[[maybe_unused]] constexpr int HW_GPU=1;
namespace VideoCommon {
enum class QueryType {Payload};
enum class QueryPropertiesFlags {IsAFence,HasTimeout};
}
struct ComputeEngine {
    struct {std::array<u32,0x700> reg_array{};} regs;
};
struct Payload {ComputeEngine kepler_compute;};
struct Channel {
    std::shared_ptr<Payload> payload=std::make_shared<Payload>();
};
namespace Service::Nvidia::Devices {
class NativeGpuChannelRegistry {
public:
    struct Ticket {int process{1},generation{2},channel_generation{3};};
    bool alive{true};
    static NativeGpuChannelRegistry& Instance() {
        static NativeGpuChannelRegistry r; return r;
    }
    std::optional<Ticket> CaptureTicket(const Channel*) {
        return alive?std::optional<Ticket>{Ticket{}}:std::nullopt;
    }
    std::optional<Ticket> CaptureComputeTicket(const ComputeEngine*) {
        return alive?std::optional<Ticket>{Ticket{}}:std::nullopt;
    }
    bool IsComputeCurrent(const ComputeEngine*,const Ticket&)const{return alive;}
    bool IsCurrent(const Channel*,const Ticket&)const{return alive;}
};
}
struct MemoryManager {
    bool mapped{true},cpu_alias{true};
    u32 word{5};
    unsigned writes{};
    bool IsFullyMappedRange(GPUVAddr address,std::size_t bytes)const{
        return mapped && address==0x1000 && (bytes==4 || bytes==16);
    }
    std::optional<u64> GpuToCpuAddress(GPUVAddr address,std::size_t bytes)const{
        if (!cpu_alias || !IsFullyMappedRange(address,bytes))return std::nullopt;
        return 0x9000;
    }
    template<class T> T Read(GPUVAddr a)const{
        assert(mapped&&a==0x1000);return static_cast<T>(word);
    }
    template<class T> void Write(GPUVAddr a,T val){
        assert(mapped&&a==0x1000);word=val;++writes;
    }
};
struct Rasterizer {
    unsigned queries{},fences{};
    std::optional<u32> pending_payload{};
    std::function<void()> pending_fence{};
    void Query(GPUVAddr a,VideoCommon::QueryType type,
               VideoCommon::QueryPropertiesFlags flag,u32 payload,u32) {
        assert(a==0x1000&&type==VideoCommon::QueryType::Payload);
        assert(flag==VideoCommon::QueryPropertiesFlags::IsAFence ||
               flag==VideoCommon::QueryPropertiesFlags::HasTimeout);
        ++queries;pending_payload=payload;
    }
    void SignalFence(std::function<void()> callback) {
        ++fences;pending_fence=std::move(callback);
    }
    void CompleteGpu(MemoryManager& mem){
        if(pending_fence){auto callback=std::move(pending_fence);
            pending_fence={};callback();}
        if(pending_payload){mem.word=*pending_payload;pending_payload.reset();++mem.writes;}
    }
};
struct DmaPusher {
    Channel channel_state;
    MemoryManager memory_manager;
    Rasterizer* rasterizer{};
};
namespace Tegra::Engines {
struct Puller {
    void ProcessNativeComputeReportSemaphore(DmaPusher&,u32);
};
__ACTUAL_OWNER__
}
int main(){
    using namespace Service::Nvidia::Devices;
    DmaPusher pusher;
    Rasterizer gpu;
    pusher.rasterizer=&gpu;
    auto& regs=pusher.channel_state.payload->kepler_compute.regs.reg_array;
    regs[0x6c0]=0;regs[0x6c1]=0x1000;regs[0x6c2]=17;
    Tegra::Engines::Puller puller;
    auto denied=[&](u32 control){
        try {puller.ProcessNativeComputeReportSemaphore(pusher,control);}
        catch(const std::runtime_error&){return true;}
        return false;
    };
    const u32 one=1U<<28;
    const u32 reduce=1U<<3;
    pusher.memory_manager.cpu_alias=false;
    assert(denied(one)&&denied(0)&&denied(reduce|one));
    assert(gpu.queries==0&&gpu.fences==0&&pusher.memory_manager.writes==0);
    pusher.memory_manager.cpu_alias=true;
    pusher.memory_manager.mapped=false;
    assert(denied(one)&&denied(reduce|one));
    pusher.memory_manager.mapped=true;
    assert(denied(3|one)); // invalid native operation (control & 3)
    assert(gpu.queries==0&&gpu.fences==0);
    // Release must not become a guest-visible value until host GPU retires.
    puller.ProcessNativeComputeReportSemaphore(pusher,one);
    assert(gpu.queries==1&&gpu.pending_payload==17);
    assert(pusher.memory_manager.word==5);
    gpu.CompleteGpu(pusher.memory_manager);
    assert(pusher.memory_manager.word==17&&pusher.memory_manager.writes==1);
    // Reduction is registered after admission, never written synchronously.
    regs[0x6c2]=2;
    puller.ProcessNativeComputeReportSemaphore(pusher,reduce|one);
    assert(gpu.fences==1&&pusher.memory_manager.word==17);
    gpu.CompleteGpu(pusher.memory_manager);
    assert(pusher.memory_manager.word==19&&pusher.memory_manager.writes==2);
    // Revoked authenticated GPU epoch: pending completion cannot write guest.
    puller.ProcessNativeComputeReportSemaphore(pusher,reduce|one);
    assert(gpu.fences==2);
    NativeGpuChannelRegistry::Instance().alive=false;
    gpu.CompleteGpu(pusher.memory_manager);
    assert(pusher.memory_manager.word==19&&pusher.memory_manager.writes==2);
    assert(denied(one));
    std::puts("G10_NATIVE_COMPUTE_REPORT_REAL_OWNER_PASS"
              " no_cpu_alias=refused unmapped=refused invalid=refused"
              " release_after_retirement=1 reduction_after_retirement=1"
              " revoked_epoch_no_write=1 real_vulkan_qmd=not_exercised");
}
""".replace("__ACTUAL_OWNER__",owner)
compilers=list(dict.fromkeys(x for x in
    (shutil.which("clang++"),shutil.which("g++")) if x))
assert compilers
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-g10-report-") as temp:

                                 timeout=60,env=os.environ.copy())
            assert built.returncode==0,(cc,built.stderr[-6000:])
            result=subprocess.run([str(exe)],capture_output=True,text=True,
                                  timeout=20,env=os.environ.copy())
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""P1.2/P4.2 real GPU-only 214 ledger reservation and nonallocating GMMU commit."""
from pathlib import Path
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
SRC=(ROOT/'vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/gpu_session/core/hle/service/am/service/gpu_worker.cpp').read_text()

    'bool IGpuWorker::RetireGpuOnlyRegion(',1)[0]

stop='    std::unique_ptr<Kernel::KPageGroup> pages;'

end='    m_dense_bytes += size;'
commit_start='    pending_region.begin()->second ='
assert method.count(commit_start)==method.count(end)==1
commit=method[method.index(commit_start):method.index(end)+len(end)]
assert method.index(start)<method.index('memory.AllocateAndOpen(')
assert method.index('pending_region.try_emplace(')<method.index('RemapNativeSparse(')
assert method.index('RemapNativeSparse(')<method.index('m_dense_regions.merge(pending_region);')

cpp=r'''
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <map>
#include <memory>
#include <new>
#include <utility>
using u32=std::uint32_t;
using u64=std::uint64_t;
namespace Kernel {constexpr int ResultOutOfResource=42;}
constexpr int ResultSuccess=0;
static int fail_allocation{};
void* operator new(std::size_t bytes) {
    if (fail_allocation && --fail_allocation == 0) throw std::bad_alloc{};
    if (void* ptr = std::malloc(bytes)) return ptr;
    throw std::bad_alloc{};
}
// Keep the test allocator/deallocator as a real ABI boundary. GCC 13 at
// -O2 would otherwise inline free() into a new/delete expression and emit
// a spurious -Wmismatched-new-delete under -Werror.
[[gnu::noinline]] void operator delete(void* pointer) noexcept { std::free(pointer); }
[[gnu::noinline]] void operator delete(void* pointer,std::size_t) noexcept { std::free(pointer); }
u64 GetInteger(u64 value) { return value; }
struct DenseRegion {
    u64 address{}, size{}, alias{};
    u32 nvmap_handle{};
    std::unique_ptr<int> pages;
    std::weak_ptr<void> nvmap_lifetime;
    bool nvmap_released{}, gmmu_released{};
};
struct Owner {
    std::map<std::pair<u32,u64>,DenseRegion> m_dense_regions;
    u64 m_dense_bytes{};
    bool guest_remapped{};
    int Stage(u32 address_space,u64 address,u64 size,bool simulate_post_remap_oom) {
        if (m_dense_regions.contains({address_space,address}))
            return Kernel::ResultOutOfResource;
__RESERVE__
        auto pages=std::make_unique<int>(101);
        const u64 alias=0x400000;
        const u32 handle_id=88;
        auto live_handle=std::make_shared<int>(42);
        const std::weak_ptr<void> nvmap_lifetime{live_handle};
        guest_remapped=true;
        if (simulate_post_remap_oom) fail_allocation=1;
__COMMIT__
        fail_allocation=0;
        return ResultSuccess;
    }
};
int main() {
    Owner owner;
    fail_allocation=1;
    assert(owner.Stage(1,0x20000,0x1000,false)==Kernel::ResultOutOfResource);
    assert(!owner.guest_remapped && owner.m_dense_regions.empty() && !owner.m_dense_bytes);
    assert(owner.Stage(1,0x20000,0x1000,true)==ResultSuccess);
    assert(owner.guest_remapped && owner.m_dense_regions.size()==1 &&
           owner.m_dense_bytes==0x1000 && !fail_allocation);
    assert(owner.m_dense_regions.begin()->second.pages &&
           *owner.m_dense_regions.begin()->second.pages==101);
    assert(owner.Stage(1,0x20000,0x1000,false)==Kernel::ResultOutOfResource);
    assert(owner.Stage(1,0x30000,0x2000,true)==ResultSuccess);
    assert(owner.m_dense_regions.size()==2 && owner.m_dense_bytes==0x3000);
}
'''.replace('__RESERVE__',reserve).replace('__COMMIT__',commit)
env=dict(os.environ)
sdk=Path('/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX15.4.sdk')
if sdk.exists():env['SDKROOT']=str(sdk)
compilers=list(dict.fromkeys(filter(None,(shutil.which('clang++'),shutil.which('g++')))))

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='encore-dense-ledger-') as temp:

            assert built.returncode==0,(compiler,built.stderr[-2800:])
            run=subprocess.run([str(exe)],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15)
```

`tools/ns2/check_native_dma_unbound_subchannel_host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Exercise the real maintained DmaPusher method paths with an unbound engine.

An invalid guest GPFIFO must not dereference a null subchannel in either the
shipping or DEV owner. The normal bound and puller paths must still dispatch.
This is source-executed host validation, NOT proof of GPU execution on PS5.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
OWNERS = ROOT / 'vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/video_core'
START = 'void DmaPusher::CallMethod(u32 argument) {'
END = '\nvoid DmaPusher::BindRasterizer('

cpp = r'''
#include <array>
#include <bitset>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>
using u32 = std::uint32_t;
using u64 = std::uint64_t;
static unsigned errors{};
#define HW_GPU 0
#define LOG_ERROR(...) (++errors)
namespace Core { struct System {}; }
namespace Service::Nvidia::Devices {
struct NativeGpuChannelRegistry {
    bool native{};
    static NativeGpuChannelRegistry& Instance() {
        static NativeGpuChannelRegistry registry;
        return registry;
    }
    bool IsNative(const void*) const { return native; }
};
}
class DmaPusher;
namespace Engines {
struct Puller {
    struct MethodCall {u32 method, argument, subchannel, count;};
    unsigned calls{}, multi_calls{};
    void CallPullerMethod(DmaPusher&, MethodCall) { ++calls; }
    void CallMultiMethod(DmaPusher&, u32, u32, const u32*, u32, u32) { ++multi_calls; }
};
}
struct Engine {
    std::bitset<65536> execution_mask{};
    std::vector<std::pair<u32,u32>> method_sink{};
    u64 current_dma_segment{};
    unsigned consumed{}, singles{}, multiples{};
    void ConsumeSink(Core::System&) { ++consumed; method_sink.clear(); }
    void CallMethod(Core::System&, u32 method, u32 arg, bool last) {
        assert(method == 0x100 && arg == 0xab && last);
        ++singles;
    }
    void CallMultiMethod(Core::System&, u32 method, const u32* src, u32 count, u32 pending) {
        assert(method == 0x100 && src && count == 2 && pending == 2);
        ++multiples;
    }
};
class DmaPusher {
public:
    struct State {u32 method{}, subchannel{}, method_count{}; u64 dma_get{}, dma_word_offset{}; bool is_last_call{};};
    static constexpr u32 non_puller_methods = 0x40;
    State dma_state{};
    Core::System system{};
    Engines::Puller puller{};
    std::array<Engine*,8> subchannels{};
    u32 channel_state{};
    void CallMethod(u32 argument);
    void CallMultiMethod(const u32* start, u32 num_methods);
};
__REAL_METHODS__
int main() {
    DmaPusher dma;
    dma.dma_state.method = 0x100;
    dma.dma_state.subchannel = 7;
    dma.dma_state.method_count = 2;
    dma.dma_state.is_last_call = true;
    dma.dma_state.dma_get = 100;
    dma.dma_state.dma_word_offset = 12;
    const u32 words[] = {0xab, 0xbb};
    dma.CallMethod(words[0]);
    dma.CallMultiMethod(words, 2);
    assert(errors == 2 && dma.puller.calls == 0 && dma.puller.multi_calls == 0);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    // The ACTUAL native method owners must RETIRE the bad GPFIFO, not
    // merely log a missing bound engine and let a guest fence complete.
    auto& native=Service::Nvidia::Devices::NativeGpuChannelRegistry::Instance();
    native.native=true;
    unsigned retired{};
    try { dma.CallMethod(words[0]); }
    catch (const std::runtime_error&) { ++retired; }
    try { dma.CallMultiMethod(words,2); }
    catch (const std::runtime_error&) { ++retired; }
    assert(retired==2 && errors==4);
    native.native=false; // same source still preserves the Maxwell path.
#endif
    Engine engine;
    dma.subchannels[7] = &engine;
    dma.CallMethod(words[0]);
    assert(engine.method_sink.size() == 1 && engine.singles == 0);
    engine.execution_mask[0x100] = true;
    dma.CallMethod(words[0]);
    assert(engine.consumed == 1 && engine.singles == 1);
    assert(engine.current_dma_segment == 112);
    dma.CallMultiMethod(words, 2);
    assert(engine.multiples == 1 && engine.consumed == 2);
    dma.dma_state.method = 0x20;
    dma.CallMethod(words[0]);
    dma.CallMultiMethod(words, 2);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    constexpr unsigned expected_errors=4;
#else
    constexpr unsigned expected_errors=2;
#endif
    assert(dma.puller.calls == 1 && dma.puller.multi_calls == 1 &&
           errors == expected_errors);
    std::puts("P2_7_DMA_UNBOUND_GUEST_METHOD_GUARD_PASS");
}
'''


def source_methods(name: str) -> str:
    source = (OWNERS / name).read_text()
    assert source.count(START) == 1 and source.count(END) == 1
    methods = source.split(START, 1)[1].split(END, 1)[0]
    methods = START + methods
    assert methods.count('if (!subchannel) {') == 2, name
    assert methods.count('LOG_ERROR(HW_GPU,') == 2, name
    assert methods.count('throw std::runtime_error("Native GPFIFO method on unbound subchannel")') == 2, name
    assert methods.count('subchannel->ConsumeSink(system);') == 2, name
    return methods


def main() -> None:
    # Both the normal and DEV owners must implement the same dispatch safety.
    normal = source_methods('dma_pusher.cpp')
    dev = source_methods('dma_pusher_dev.cpp')
    assert normal == dev, 'Normal and DEV DMA method owners diverged'
    compilers = [p for p in (shutil.which('clang++'), shutil.which('g++')) if p]
    assert compilers, 'host C++20 compiler missing'
    env = os.environ.copy()
    sdk = Path('/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX15.4.sdk')
    if sdk.is_dir():
        env['SDKROOT'] = str(sdk)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='encore-native-unbound-') as temp:
        test_src = Path(temp) / 'test.cpp'
        test_src.write_text(cpp.replace('__REAL_METHODS__', normal))
        for compiler in dict.fromkeys(compilers):
            for opt in (0, 2):
                for ps5 in (False, True):
                    exe = Path(temp) / f'test-{Path(compiler).name}-{opt}-{int(ps5)}'
                    cmd = [compiler, '-std=c++20', f'-O{opt}', '-Wall', '-Wextra',
                           '-Werror', '-fsanitize=undefined', '-fno-sanitize-recover=all']
                    if ps5:
                        cmd.append('-DPS5_NATIVE=1')
                    cmd.extend((str(test_src), '-o', str(exe)))
                    build = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True,
                                           env=env, timeout=45)
                    assert build.returncode == 0, build.stderr[-2800:]
                    run = subprocess.run([str(exe)], capture_output=True,
                                         text=True, env=env, timeout=15)
                    assert run.returncode == 0, run.stderr[-2800:]
                    assert 'P2_7_DMA_UNBOUND_GUEST_METHOD_GUARD_PASS' in run.stdout
                    print('P2_7_DMA_UNBOUND_GUARD_HOST_PASS', Path(compiler).name,
                          'O'+str(opt), 'PS5_NATIVE' if ps5 else 'NS1',
                          'real_methods=2 variants=2', flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

`tools/ns2/check_native_gpfifo_command_spans_host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""P2.7: execute real NVDRV native GPFIFO command-span admission on host.

A readable ioctl array does not prove each nested command VA is mapped.
Tests the actual owner guard before InitChannel/Bind/fence mutations, including
partial page holes, 49-bit overflow, and legacy NS1 unchanged.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
OWNER = ROOT/'vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/nvdrv_gpu/core/hle/service/nvdrv/devices/nvhost_gpu.cpp'
source = OWNER.read_text()
submit_begin = 'NvResult nvhost_gpu::SubmitGPFIFOImpl('
submit_end = '\nCore::Memory::Memory& nvhost_gpu::GetSessionMemory('
assert source.count(submit_begin) == source.count(submit_end) == 1
impl = source[source.index(submit_begin):source.index(submit_end)]
start = '    // P2.7: every native GPFIFO entry must refer to a fully mapped GMMU'
end = '    // Lazily initialize channel when address space is available'
assert impl.count(start) == impl.count(end) == 1
real = impl[impl.index(start):impl.index(end)]
assert 'if (native && channel_state->memory_manager)' in real
assert 'if (command.size == 0) continue;' in real
assert 'static_cast<u64>(command.size) * sizeof(Tegra::CommandHeader)' in real
assert 'IsFullyMappedRange(address, bytes)' in real
assert 'return NvResult::InvalidSize;' in real
assert impl.index(start) < impl.index('system.GPU().InitChannel(')
assert impl.index(start) < impl.index('NativeGpuChannelRegistry::Instance().Bind(')
assert impl.index(start) < impl.index('IncrementSyncpointMaxExt(')
assert '#include "video_core/memory_manager.h"' in source

cpp = r'''
#include <algorithm>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <memory>
#include <set>
#include <vector>
using u32 = std::uint32_t;
using u64 = std::uint64_t;
namespace Tegra {
struct CommandHeader { u32 argument{}; };
static_assert(sizeof(CommandHeader)==4);
struct CommandListHeader { u64 addr{}; u32 size{}; };
struct CommandList { std::vector<CommandListHeader> command_lists; };
}
constexpr u64 GpuLimit = u64{1} << 49;
struct MappedMemory {
    std::set<u64> physical_pages{};
    mutable unsigned reads{};
    bool IsFullyMappedRange(u64 address,u64 bytes) const {
        ++reads;
        if (!bytes || address >= GpuLimit || bytes > GpuLimit - address) return false;
        const u64 first=address & ~u64{4095};
        const u64 last=(address+bytes-1) & ~u64{4095};
        for (u64 page=first;page<=last;page+=4096) {
            if (!physical_pages.contains(page)) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }
};
struct Channel { MappedMemory* memory_manager{}; };
enum class NvResult { Success, InvalidSize, InvalidState };
static unsigned failures{};
#define Service_NVDRV 0
#define LOG_ERROR(...) (++failures)
struct Submission {
    Channel channel{};
    Channel* channel_state{&channel};
    bool is_native{true};
    unsigned init{},bind{},fences{};
    NvResult Submit(Tegra::CommandList entries) {
        const bool native=is_native;
__REAL_GUARD__
        if (native && !channel_state->memory_manager) return NvResult::InvalidState;
        ++init; ++bind; ++fences;
        return NvResult::Success;
    }
};
int main() {
    MappedMemory memory;
    memory.physical_pages={0x1000,0x2000,0x4000,GpuLimit-4096};
    Submission engine;
    engine.channel.memory_manager=&memory;
    auto reject=[&](Tegra::CommandList entries) {
        const unsigned before=memory.reads;
        assert(engine.Submit(std::move(entries))==NvResult::InvalidSize);
        assert(memory.reads>before);
        assert(engine.init==0 && engine.bind==0 && engine.fences==0);
    };
    // One mapped page does not make the second page mapped.
    reject({{{0x2ffc,2}}});
    reject({{{0x2000,1},{0x3000,1}}});
    reject({{{0,1}}});
    reject({{{GpuLimit-4096,2048}}});
    reject({{{GpuLimit,1}}});
    assert(failures==5);
    // Every page must be mapped, including unaligned range endpoints.
    assert(engine.Submit({{{0x1000,1},{0x1ffc,2}}})==NvResult::Success);
    assert(engine.init==1 && engine.bind==1 && engine.fences==1);
    // A zero-word header is legitimate and must not spuriously read GPU RAM.
    const unsigned before=memory.reads;
    assert(engine.Submit({{{0,0},{0x2000,0}}})==NvResult::Success);
    assert(memory.reads==before);
    engine.is_native=false;
    const unsigned legacy_reads=memory.reads;
    assert(engine.Submit({{{0x3000,1}}})==NvResult::Success);
    assert(memory.reads==legacy_reads);
    engine.is_native=true;
    engine.channel.memory_manager=nullptr;
    assert(engine.Submit({{{0x1000,1}}})==NvResult::InvalidState);
    assert(engine.init==3 && engine.bind==3 && engine.fences==3);
    std::puts("P2_7_NATIVE_GPFIFO_NESTED_MAPPED_SPANS_PASS");
}
'''.replace('__REAL_GUARD__',real)


def main() -> None:
    env=os.environ.copy()
    sdk=Path('/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX15.4.sdk')
    if sdk.is_dir():env['SDKROOT']=str(sdk)
    compilers=list(dict.fromkeys(c for c in (shutil.which('clang++'),shutil.which('g++')) if c))
    assert compilers
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='encore-gpfifo-spans-') as temp:
        source_file=Path(temp)/'actual_guard.cpp'
        source_file.write_text(cpp)
        for compiler in compilers:
            for opt in (0,2):
                exe=Path(temp)/f'{Path(compiler).name}-O{opt}'
                build=subprocess.run([compiler,'-std=c++20',f'-O{opt}','-Wall','-Wextra',
```

```py
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>
#include <span>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>
using u32 = std::uint32_t;
using DeviceFD = int;
namespace Tegra {
struct CommandListHeader { std::uint64_t word{}; };
struct CommandList {
    explicit CommandList(std::size_t count): command_lists(count) {}
    std::vector<CommandListHeader> command_lists;
};
}
enum class NvResult { Success, InvalidSize, InvalidState };
struct IoctlSubmitGpfifo {
    std::uint64_t address{};
    u32 num_entries{};
};
#define UNIMPLEMENTED() ((void)0)
struct GuestRam {
    std::array<Tegra::CommandListHeader,3> src{{{11},{22},{33}}};
    unsigned reads{};
    void ReadBlock(std::uint64_t address,void* out,std::size_t bytes) {
        assert(address == 0x1000 && bytes == sizeof(src));
        assert(out != nullptr);
        ++reads;
        std::memcpy(out,src.data(),bytes);
    }
};
struct StubMemory {
    bool IsValidVirtualAddressRange(std::uint64_t address, std::size_t bytes) const {
        return address == 0x1000 && bytes == 3 * sizeof(Tegra::CommandListHeader);
    }
};
struct StubProcess { StubMemory memory; const StubMemory& GetMemory() const { return memory; } };
template <typename Mapped>
bool NativeGpfifoGuestHeadersReadable(std::uint64_t address, std::size_t count,
                                     std::size_t size, Mapped&& mapped) {
    if (count == 0) return true;
    if (!address || count > (UINT64_MAX / size)) return false;
    const auto bytes = count * size;
    return address <= UINT64_MAX - bytes && mapped(address, bytes);
}
struct StubSession { StubProcess* process{}; };
struct StubCore {
    StubProcess process;
    StubSession session{&process};
    StubSession* GetSession(int id) { return id == 1 ? &session : nullptr; }
};
class nvhost_gpu {
public:
    bool UsesNativeAbi(DeviceFD) const { return true; }
    GuestRam memory;
    StubCore core;
    std::unordered_map<DeviceFD,int> sessions{{42,1}};
    std::vector<Tegra::CommandListHeader> captured;
    unsigned submissions{};
    GuestRam& GetSessionMemory(DeviceFD) { return memory; }
    NvResult SubmitGPFIFOImpl(IoctlSubmitGpfifo&,Tegra::CommandList&& list,DeviceFD) {
        captured=std::move(list.command_lists);
        ++submissions;
        return NvResult::Success;
    }
    NvResult SubmitGPFIFOBase1(IoctlSubmitGpfifo&,
                               std::span<Tegra::CommandListHeader>,DeviceFD,bool);
    NvResult SubmitGPFIFOBase2(IoctlSubmitGpfifo&,
                               std::span<const Tegra::CommandListHeader>,DeviceFD);
};

    nvhost_gpu gpu;
    IoctlSubmitGpfifo pointer{0x1000,3};
    // H:0x1b uses guest RAM, not its empty variable span.
    assert(gpu.SubmitGPFIFOBase1(pointer, {}, 42, true) == NvResult::Success);
    assert(gpu.memory.reads == 1 && gpu.submissions == 1);
    assert(gpu.captured.size() == 3 && gpu.captured[0].word == 11 &&
           gpu.captured[1].word == 22 && gpu.captured[2].word == 33);

    // The old H:0x8 inline command list remains subject to its byte count.
    std::array<Tegra::CommandListHeader,3> inline_entries{{{7},{8},{9}}};

    assert(gpu.SubmitGPFIFOBase1(inline_params, inline_entries, 42, false)
           == NvResult::Success);

    assert(gpu.captured.size() == 3 && gpu.captured[0].word == 7);
    inline_params.num_entries = 4;
    assert(gpu.SubmitGPFIFOBase1(inline_params, inline_entries, 42, false)
           == NvResult::InvalidSize);

    // An arbitrary guest-provided count must not allocate gigabytes.
    IoctlSubmitGpfifo oversized{0x1000,65537};

           == NvResult::InvalidSize);

    // unrelated application's address space for a native kickoff.

           == NvResult::InvalidState);
    gpu.sessions[42]=1;

    assert(gpu.SubmitGPFIFOBase1(stale_fd, {}, 42, true)
           == NvResult::InvalidState);
    assert(gpu.memory.reads == 1 && gpu.submissions == 2);
    gpu.core.session.process = &gpu.core.process;
    // Fence-only submissions can legitimately have no GPFIFO entries.
    // Neither the pointer-backed nor inline path may read a null buffer.
    IoctlSubmitGpfifo empty{0,0};

           == NvResult::Success);

           gpu.submissions == 3);

           == NvResult::Success);

           == NvResult::InvalidSize);
```

```py
"""Exercise the REAL native GPFIFO admission block before GPU mutations.

Extracts the verified owner source block and executes it with process, FD,
fence and channel stand-ins. Native invalid flags and cross-process FDs

Desktop/NS1 remains governed by its old submission rules.

cpp = r'''
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <map>
#include <optional>
#include "core/hle/service/nvdrv/devices/native_gpu_submission.h"
using u32 = std::uint32_t;
using Service::Nvidia::Devices::PlanNativeSubmission;
using Service::Nvidia::Devices::NativeSubmissionPlan;
namespace Kernel { struct KProcess { int identity{}; }; }
enum class NvResult { Success, BadParameter, InvalidState, NotImplemented };
struct SubmissionFlags {
    u32 raw{};
    struct FenceWait {
        bool set{};
        bool Value() const { return set; }
    } fence_wait{};
};
struct Fence { u32 value{}; };
struct SyncpointManager {
    bool satisfied{};
    bool IsFenceSignalled(const Fence&) const { return satisfied; }
};
struct Params { SubmissionFlags flags{}; Fence fence{}; };
struct Session { const Kernel::KProcess* process{}; };
struct SessionRegistry {
    std::map<int, Session> entries;
    const Session* GetSession(int id) const {
        auto it = entries.find(id);
        return it == entries.end() ? nullptr : &it->second;
    }
};
struct Gpu {
    bool native{};
    std::map<int,int> sessions;
    SessionRegistry core;
    SyncpointManager syncpoint_manager;
    unsigned initializations{}, binds{}, enqueues{}, reservations{};
    bool UsesNativeAbi(int) const { return native; }
    NvResult Submit(Params& params,int fd) {
__ADMISSION__
        ++initializations;
        if (native) ++binds;
        ++reservations;
        ++enqueues;
        return NvResult::Success;
    }
};
static_assert(!PlanNativeSubmission(0x400, 0, true));
static_assert(!PlanNativeSubmission(0x101, 1, true));
static_assert(PlanNativeSubmission(0x102, 64, true)->increment_total == 66);
int main() {
    Kernel::KProcess alice{1},bob{2};
    Gpu gpu;
    gpu.native=true;
    gpu.sessions[42]=1;
    gpu.core.entries[1]={&alice};
    auto denied=[&](u32 flags,u32 count,NvResult expected) {
        Params p{{flags,{(flags&1U)!=0}},{count}};
        assert(gpu.Submit(p,42)==expected);
        assert(gpu.initializations==0 && gpu.binds==0 &&
               gpu.enqueues==0 && gpu.reservations==0);
    };
    denied(0x400,0,NvResult::BadParameter); // unknown native bit
    denied(0x100,65,NvResult::BadParameter); // too many completions
    denied(0x101,1,NvResult::BadParameter);  // waiting while completing
    denied(0xFFFF'FFFFU,0,NvResult::BadParameter);
    gpu.sessions[77]=2;
    gpu.core.entries[2]={&bob};
    denied(0x102,3,NvResult::InvalidState); // other FD foreign process
    gpu.sessions[77]=1;                    // other FD same process allowed
    denied(0x102,65,NvResult::BadParameter);
    gpu.core.entries.erase(1);
    denied(0x102,3,NvResult::InvalidState); // retired session
    gpu.core.entries[1]={&alice};
    // Execute the newly integrated REAL owner wait admission: no fake
    // native queue publication when the input syncpoint is unsatisfied.
    denied(0x1,7,NvResult::NotImplemented);
    Params valid{{0x102},{64}};
    assert(gpu.Submit(valid,42)==NvResult::Success);
    assert(gpu.initializations==1 && gpu.binds==1 &&
           gpu.reservations==1 && gpu.enqueues==1);
    const auto plan=PlanNativeSubmission(valid.flags.raw,valid.fence.value,true);
    assert(plan && plan->increment_total==66 && plan->completion_count==64);
    // Signalled input fence is admitted without a synthetic wait packet.
    gpu.syncpoint_manager.satisfied=true;
    Params ready{{0x1,{true}},{7}};
    assert(gpu.Submit(ready,42)==NvResult::Success);
    assert(gpu.initializations==2 && gpu.binds==2 &&
           gpu.reservations==2 && gpu.enqueues==2);
    Gpu maxwell;
    maxwell.native=false;
    Params legacy{{0x400},{65}};
    assert(maxwell.Submit(legacy,42)==NvResult::Success);
    assert(maxwell.initializations==1 && maxwell.binds==0 &&
           maxwell.reservations==1 && maxwell.enqueues==1);
    std::puts("P2_7_GPFIFO_PREINIT_NATIVE_REJECTION_PASS flags=4 foreign_fd=1 "
              "retired_fd=1 max_completion=64 ns1_unchanged=1 native_wait_refused=1 signalled_wait=1");
}
'''.replace("__ADMISSION__", admission)
includes = ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/hle"
```

`tools/ns2/check_native_gpu_acquire_worker_oom_host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""H06: execute the actual native AcquireWorker move-handle IPC owner.

Inject outgoing-descriptor std::bad_alloc AFTER a real KClientSession
reference was opened. Validate error reply without moved handles, exact
ref-count rollback, subsequent successful retry and legacy invalid packets.
This is an extracted production method under a kernel lifecycle harness.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
vendor=ROOT/"vendor"
source=(vendor/"encore-active/ns2-runtime/gpu_session/core/hle/service/am/service/gpu_session.cpp").read_text()

end="void IGpuSession::GetNotificationRange("

owner=begin+source.split(begin,1)[1].split(end,1)[0]
assert "client->Open(kernel);" in owner
assert "ctx.AddMoveObject(client);" in owner
assert "client->Close(kernel);" in owner
assert owner.index("ctx.AddMoveObject(client);") < owner.index("result = ResultSuccess;")
assert owner.index("ctx.AddMoveObject(client);") < owner.index("IPC::ResponseBuilder rb{ctx, 2, 0, 1};")

assert "IPC::ResponseBuilder rb{ctx, 2};" in owner

harness=r"""
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <mutex>
#include <new>
#include <span>
#include "core/hle/service/am/service/gpu_session_protocol.h"
using u32=std::uint32_t;
struct Result {
    u32 raw{};
    constexpr bool IsSuccess() const noexcept { return raw==0; }
};
inline constexpr Result ResultSuccess{0};
namespace Kernel {
inline constexpr Result ResultInvalidCombination{1},
    ResultInvalidState{2},ResultOutOfResource{3};
struct KernelCore {};
struct KClientSession {
    int refs{1},opens{},closes{};
    void Open(KernelCore&) { ++refs;++opens; }
    void Close(KernelCore&) { assert(refs>0);--refs;++closes; }
};
}
struct HLERequestContext {
    std::array<u32,2> command{};
    bool fail_move{};
    Kernel::KClientSession* transferred{};
    unsigned transfer_count{},response_words{},response_moves{};
    u32 reply_code{~u32{0}};
    const u32* CommandBuffer() const { return command.data(); }
    void AddMoveObject(Kernel::KClientSession* client) {
        assert(client);
        if(fail_move)throw std::bad_alloc{};
        transferred=client;
        ++transfer_count;
    }
};
namespace IPC {
struct ResponseBuilder {
    HLERequestContext& ctx;
    ResponseBuilder(HLERequestContext& context,unsigned words,
                    unsigned copies=0,unsigned moves=0):ctx{context} {
        assert(!copies && words==2);
        ctx.response_words=words;
        ctx.response_moves=moves;
    }
    void Push(u32 value) { ctx.reply_code=value; }
};
}
namespace Service::AM {
namespace GP=GpuSessionProtocol;
struct IGpuSession {
    std::mutex m_lock{};
    Kernel::KernelCore kernel{};
    Kernel::KClientSession* m_worker{};
    void AcquireWorker(HLERequestContext&);
};
__OWNER__
}
int main(){
    using Service::AM::IGpuSession;
    IGpuSession owner;
    Kernel::KClientSession client;
    {
        HLERequestContext ctx{{0x25,0}};
        owner.AcquireWorker(ctx);
        assert(ctx.reply_code==Kernel::ResultInvalidCombination.raw);
        assert(ctx.response_words==2 && ctx.response_moves==0);
        assert(ctx.transfer_count==0 && client.refs==1);
    }
    {
        HLERequestContext ctx{{0x26,0}};
        owner.AcquireWorker(ctx);
        assert(ctx.reply_code==Kernel::ResultInvalidState.raw);
        assert(ctx.response_words==2 && ctx.response_moves==0);
        assert(ctx.transfer_count==0 && client.refs==1);
    }
    owner.m_worker=&client;
    {
        HLERequestContext ctx{{0x26,0},true};
        owner.AcquireWorker(ctx);
        assert(ctx.reply_code==Kernel::ResultOutOfResource.raw);
        assert(ctx.response_words==2 && ctx.response_moves==0);
        assert(ctx.transferred==nullptr && ctx.transfer_count==0);
        assert(client.refs==1 && client.opens==1 && client.closes==1);
    }
    {
        HLERequestContext ctx{{0x26,0}};
        owner.AcquireWorker(ctx);
        assert(ctx.reply_code==ResultSuccess.raw);
        assert(ctx.response_words==2 && ctx.response_moves==1);
        assert(ctx.transferred==&client && ctx.transfer_count==1);
        assert(client.refs==2 && client.opens==2 && client.closes==1);
        client.Close(owner.kernel); // guest consumes transferred move handle
        assert(client.refs==1 && client.opens==2 && client.closes==2);
    }
    {
        HLERequestContext ctx{{0x26,1}};
        owner.AcquireWorker(ctx);
        assert(ctx.reply_code==Kernel::ResultInvalidCombination.raw);
        assert(ctx.response_moves==0 && ctx.transfer_count==0);
        assert(client.refs==1 && client.opens==2);
    }
}
""".replace("__OWNER__",owner)
compilers=list(dict.fromkeys(x for x in (shutil.which("clang++"),shutil.which("g++")) if x))

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-h06-acquire-worker-") as d:
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""P0.2: execute actual native QMD and per-engine shader cache owners on OOM.

Extracts three complete C++ class method bodies, unchanged, from maintained
vendor sources; supplies small opaque native session/cache types on host. The
process/channel generation and ownership classes are REAL maintained headers.
No PS5 render, link, or GPU dispatch is inferred from the host test.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
PULLER=ROOT/'vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/gpu_dispatch/video_core/engines/puller.cpp'
SHADER=ROOT/'vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/ampere/video_core/native_shader_capture.cpp'
REGISTRY=ROOT/'vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/nvdrv_gpu/core/hle/service/nvdrv/devices/native_gpu_channel_registry.h'
PROCESS=ROOT/'vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/hle/core/hle/service/nvdrv/devices/native_gpu_process_registry.h'
assert all(p.is_file() for p in (PULLER,SHADER,REGISTRY,PROCESS))

def owner(source:Path,methods:tuple[str,...])->str:
    full=source.read_text()
    prefix='namespace Service::Nvidia::Devices {'
    suffix='} // namespace Service::Nvidia::Devices'
    assert full.count(prefix)==1
    block=full.split(prefix,1)[1].split(suffix,1)[0]
    assert all(block.count(name+'(')==1 for name in methods)
    assert block.count('catch (const std::bad_alloc&)')==len(methods)
    assert '#include <new>' in full
    return prefix+'\n'+block+'\n'+suffix+'\n'

source=owner(PULLER,('NativeGpuChannelRegistry::AcquireNativeQmdSession',))
source+=owner(SHADER,('NativeGpuChannelRegistry::AcquireGraphicsTranslationCache',
                      'NativeGpuChannelRegistry::AcquireComputeTranslationCache'))
assert 'qmd_sessions[ticket.process] = {ticket.generation, session};' in source
assert source.count('std::make_shared<Shader::Ampere::NativeTranslationCache>')==2
assert 'last_channel_generation + 1' in REGISTRY.read_text()

HOST=r'''
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <memory>
#include <new>
#include <cstdio>
namespace Kernel { class KProcess {}; }
namespace Tegra {
struct NativeQmdSession { unsigned proof{42}; };
namespace Control { struct ChannelState {}; }
}
namespace Shader::Ampere {
class NativeTranslationCache {
public:
    NativeTranslationCache(std::size_t limit,std::size_t count) {
        assert(limit==4*1024*1024 && count==32);
    }
};
}
#include "core/hle/service/nvdrv/devices/native_gpu_channel_registry.h"
namespace {
std::atomic<int> fail_at{0};
std::atomic<int> allocation_index{0};
void FailAt(int n) { allocation_index.store(0);fail_at.store(n); }
void StopFailure() {fail_at.store(0);allocation_index.store(0);}
void ConfirmUsed(int n) { assert(allocation_index.load()>=n); StopFailure(); }
}
void* operator new(std::size_t size) {
    int index=allocation_index.fetch_add(1)+1;
    if (index == fail_at.load()) throw std::bad_alloc{};
    if (void* ptr=std::malloc(size?size:1)) return ptr;
    throw std::bad_alloc{};
}
void operator delete(void* ptr) noexcept {std::free(ptr);}
void operator delete(void* ptr,std::size_t) noexcept {std::free(ptr);}
__ACTUAL_OWNER_METHODS__
int main() {
    using namespace Service::Nvidia::Devices;
    auto& processes=NativeGpuProcessRegistry::Instance();
    auto& channels=NativeGpuChannelRegistry::Instance();
    Kernel::KProcess p{};
    Tegra::Control::ChannelState c{};
    int graphics{},compute{};
    assert(processes.Register(&p));
    assert(channels.Bind(&c,&p));
    const auto ticket=channels.CaptureTicket(&c);
    assert(ticket);
    assert(channels.BindGraphicsEngine(&c,&graphics,1));
    assert(channels.BindComputeEngine(&c,&compute,2));
    // QMD allocation 1: make_shared; allocation 2: process-owned map node.
    FailAt(1);
    assert(!channels.AcquireNativeQmdSession(&c));
    ConfirmUsed(1);
    FailAt(2);
    assert(!channels.AcquireNativeQmdSession(&c));
    ConfirmUsed(2);
    const auto qmd=channels.AcquireNativeQmdSession(&c);
    assert(qmd && qmd->proof==42);
    assert(channels.AcquireNativeQmdSession(&c)==qmd);
    assert(channels.IsCurrent(&c,*ticket));
    // Both shader domains refuse allocation without corrupting their
    // existing bind epochs, then retain separate per-engine caches.
    FailAt(1);
    assert(!channels.AcquireGraphicsTranslationCache(&graphics,*ticket));
    ConfirmUsed(1);
    const auto gcache=channels.AcquireGraphicsTranslationCache(&graphics,*ticket);
    assert(gcache && channels.AcquireGraphicsTranslationCache(&graphics,*ticket)==gcache);
    FailAt(1);
    assert(!channels.AcquireComputeTranslationCache(&compute,*ticket));
    ConfirmUsed(1);
    const auto ccache=channels.AcquireComputeTranslationCache(&compute,*ticket);
    assert(ccache && ccache!=gcache &&
           channels.AcquireComputeTranslationCache(&compute,*ticket)==ccache);
    channels.Unbind(&c);
    assert(!channels.AcquireNativeQmdSession(&c));
    assert(!channels.AcquireGraphicsTranslationCache(&graphics,*ticket));
    assert(!channels.AcquireComputeTranslationCache(&compute,*ticket));
    assert(channels.Bind(&c,&p));
    const auto new_ticket=channels.CaptureTicket(&c);
    assert(new_ticket && new_ticket->channel_generation != ticket->channel_generation);
    assert(!channels.AcquireGraphicsTranslationCache(&graphics,*ticket));
    assert(!channels.AcquireComputeTranslationCache(&compute,*ticket));
    const auto new_qmd=channels.AcquireNativeQmdSession(&c);
    assert(new_qmd && new_qmd!=qmd);
    channels.Unbind(&c);
    processes.Unregister(&p);
    std::puts("P0_2_GPU_REAL_QMD_AND_SHADER_CACHE_OWNER_OOM_PASS");
}
'''

compiler=shutil.which('clang++') or shutil.which('g++')
assert compiler
sdk=Path('/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX15.4.sdk')
env=os.environ.copy()
if sdk.is_dir():env['SDKROOT']=str(sdk)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='encore-gpu-cache-alloc-') as temp:
    generated=Path(temp)/'source_methods.cpp'

    for opt in (0,2):

                 '-fsanitize=undefined','-fno-sanitize-recover=all',
                 '-I'+str(ROOT/'vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/hle'),
                 '-I'+str(ROOT/'vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/nvdrv_gpu'),
                 str(generated),'-o',str(exe)]
        build=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True,env=env,timeout=70)
        assert build.returncode==0,build.stderr[-5300:]
        run=subprocess.run([str(exe)],capture_output=True,text=True,env=env,timeout=20)
        assert run.returncode==0,run.stderr[-5300:]
        assert 'P0_2_GPU_REAL_QMD_AND_SHADER_CACHE_OWNER_OOM_PASS' in run.stdout
        print('P0_2_NATIVE_GPU_CACHE_ALLOC_HOST_PASS',Path(compiler).name,f'O{opt}',flush=True)
```

```py
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <unordered_set>
#include <optional>
#include <cstdio>
namespace Service::Nvidia::Devices {
using u64=std::uint64_t;
using DeviceFD=int;
enum class NvResult { Success, InvalidState };
struct FakeProcess {
    u64 id{};
    u64 GetProgramId() const {return id;}
};
struct FakeSession { FakeProcess* process{}; };
struct FakeCore {
    std::unordered_map<int,FakeSession> pool;
    const FakeSession* GetSession(int id) const {
        auto it=pool.find(id);
        return it==pool.end()?nullptr:&it->second;
    }
};
class NativeGpuProcessRegistry {
    std::unordered_set<const FakeProcess*> owners;
public:
    static NativeGpuProcessRegistry& Instance() {static NativeGpuProcessRegistry one;return one;}
    bool Contains(const FakeProcess* process) const {return owners.contains(process);}
    void Register(const FakeProcess* process) {owners.insert(process);}
    void Unregister(const FakeProcess* process) {owners.erase(process);}
};
class nvhost_gpu {
public:
    explicit nvhost_gpu(FakeCore& core_):core(core_){}
    NvResult ValidateChannelOwner(DeviceFD fd,u64& program_id) const;
    FakeCore& core;

};
__OWNER_BODY__
}
int main() {
    using namespace Service::Nvidia::Devices;
    FakeCore core;
    FakeProcess legacy{1001},legacy2{1002}, native{2001},native2{2002};
    core.pool.emplace(10,FakeSession{&legacy});
    core.pool.emplace(11,FakeSession{&legacy2});
    core.pool.emplace(20,FakeSession{&native});
    core.pool.emplace(21,FakeSession{&native});
    core.pool.emplace(22,FakeSession{&native2});
    core.pool.emplace(30,FakeSession{nullptr});
    nvhost_gpu gpu(core);
    auto& native_registry=NativeGpuProcessRegistry::Instance();
    constexpr u64 sentinel=0xdeadbeef;
    u64 program=sentinel;
    // Missing FD must not insert ghost key or modify program identity.
    assert(gpu.ValidateChannelOwner(9,program)==NvResult::InvalidState);
    assert(gpu.sessions.empty() && program==sentinel);
    // Stale session ID and null process fail without modifying caller output.
    gpu.sessions.emplace(3,777);
    assert(gpu.ValidateChannelOwner(3,program)==NvResult::InvalidState);
    assert(program==sentinel && gpu.sessions.size()==1);
    gpu.sessions.clear();
    gpu.sessions.emplace(4,30);
    assert(gpu.ValidateChannelOwner(4,program)==NvResult::InvalidState);
    assert(program==sentinel);
    gpu.sessions.clear();
    // Two unrelated LEGACY FDs preserve historical Maxwell compatibility.
    gpu.sessions.emplace(5,10);
    gpu.sessions.emplace(6,11);
    assert(gpu.ValidateChannelOwner(5,program)==NvResult::Success && program==1001);
    assert(gpu.ValidateChannelOwner(6,program)==NvResult::Success && program==1002);
    // A native FD may never initialise a shared channel from a foreign
    // legacy session, and a legacy FD must refuse the same native channel.
    native_registry.Register(&native);
    gpu.sessions.emplace(7,20);
    program=sentinel;
    assert(gpu.ValidateChannelOwner(7,program)==NvResult::InvalidState);
    assert(program==sentinel);
    assert(gpu.ValidateChannelOwner(5,program)==NvResult::InvalidState);
    assert(program==sentinel);
    gpu.sessions.clear();
    gpu.sessions.emplace(7,20);
    gpu.sessions.emplace(8,21);
    assert(gpu.ValidateChannelOwner(7,program)==NvResult::Success && program==2001);
    assert(gpu.ValidateChannelOwner(8,program)==NvResult::Success && program==2001);

    assert(gpu.ValidateChannelOwner(9,program)==NvResult::InvalidState && program==sentinel);
    native_registry.Unregister(&native2);

    gpu.sessions.emplace(9,999);
    assert(gpu.ValidateChannelOwner(7,program)==NvResult::InvalidState && program==sentinel);
    gpu.sessions.erase(9);
    assert(gpu.ValidateChannelOwner(7,program)==NvResult::Success && program==2001);

    gpu.sessions.emplace(6,11);
```

```py
"""G10: execute actual native Scheduler Push/Resume/Declare owners, Clang/GCC.

Tests the host GPFIFO ownership transition when a driver reuses a channel
bind_id, without ever producing guest completion for its retired generation.
This is not a guest shader, PS5 Vulkan, or complete G10 fence qualification.
"""

import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
OWNER=ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/gpu_dispatch/video_core/control/scheduler.cpp"
source=OWNER.read_text()
def extract(start: str, stop: str) -> str:
    assert source.count(start)==1 and source.count(stop)==1, (start, stop)
    return start + source.split(start,1)[1].split(stop,1)[0]

push=extract("void Scheduler::Push(", "void Scheduler::ResumePendingNative(")
resume=extract("void Scheduler::ResumePendingNative(", "void Scheduler::DeclareChannel(")
declare=extract("void Scheduler::DeclareChannel(", "} // namespace Tegra::Control")

assert 'std::runtime_error("Native GPFIFO: missing channel owner")' in push
```
