```py
assert resume.index("gpu_lock(gpu_submit_guard)") < resume.index("gpu.BindChannel(")
assert resume.index("gpu_lock(gpu_submit_guard)") < resume.index("pending_lock(pending_guard)")

fixture=r"""
#include <algorithm>
#include <cassert>
#include <functional>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
#include <shared_mutex>
#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <thread>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

namespace Tegra {
using s32=int;
struct CommandList {};
struct GPU {
    int current{-1};
    unsigned binds{};
    void BindChannel(s32 id) { current=id; ++binds; }
};
namespace Control {
struct TestSystem { bool IsPoweredOn() const { return true; } };
struct Pusher {
    TestSystem system{};
    bool pending{}, ready{};
    unsigned pushes{}, dispatches{}, retries{};
    std::function<void()> after_dispatch{};
    void Push(CommandList&&) { ++pushes; }
    void DispatchCalls() { ++dispatches; if (after_dispatch) after_dispatch(); }
    bool HasPendingNativeAcquire() const { return pending; }
    bool ResumeNativeAcquire() {
        ++retries;
        if (!pending) return true;
        if (!ready) return false;
        pending=false;
        return true;
    }
};
struct Payload { Pusher dma_pusher; };
struct ChannelState {
    s32 bind_id{};
    std::shared_ptr<Payload> payload{std::make_shared<Payload>()};
};
class Scheduler {
public:
    void Push(GPU&, s32, CommandList&&);
    void ResumePendingNative(GPU&);
    void DeclareChannel(std::shared_ptr<ChannelState>);
    bool HasPendingNativeChannels() const noexcept {
        const std::scoped_lock lock(pending_guard);
        return !pending_native_channels.empty();
    }
private:
    std::unordered_map<s32,std::shared_ptr<ChannelState>> channels;
    std::vector<std::shared_ptr<ChannelState>> pending_native_channels;
    std::shared_mutex scheduling_guard;
    std::mutex gpu_submit_guard;
    mutable std::mutex pending_guard;
};
__REAL_OWNER__
}
}
using namespace Tegra;
using namespace Tegra::Control;
static std::shared_ptr<ChannelState> channel(int id) {
    auto c=std::make_shared<ChannelState>();
    c->bind_id=id;
    return c;
}
int main() {
    GPU gpu;
    Scheduler scheduler;
    auto previous=channel(7);
    previous->payload->dma_pusher.pending=true;
    scheduler.DeclareChannel(previous);
    scheduler.Push(gpu, 7, CommandList{});
    assert(scheduler.HasPendingNativeChannels());
    assert(previous->payload->dma_pusher.dispatches==1);
    const unsigned before_old=previous->payload->dma_pusher.dispatches;

    auto current=channel(7); // Driver reuses numeric bind ID.
    scheduler.DeclareChannel(current);
    assert(!scheduler.HasPendingNativeChannels());
    previous->payload->dma_pusher.ready=true;
    scheduler.ResumePendingNative(gpu);
    assert(previous->payload->dma_pusher.dispatches==before_old);
    scheduler.Push(gpu, 7, CommandList{});
    assert(current->payload->dma_pusher.dispatches==1);
    assert(previous->payload->dma_pusher.dispatches==before_old);

    // Re-registering the exact SAME generation must preserve its wait.
    auto& cur=current->payload->dma_pusher;
    cur.pending=true;
    cur.ready=false;
    scheduler.Push(gpu, 7, CommandList{});
    assert(scheduler.HasPendingNativeChannels());
    scheduler.DeclareChannel(current);
    assert(scheduler.HasPendingNativeChannels());
    const unsigned before_resume=cur.dispatches;
    cur.ready=true;
    scheduler.ResumePendingNative(gpu);
    assert(!scheduler.HasPendingNativeChannels());
    assert(cur.dispatches==before_resume+1);

    // Missing/invalid owners must fail before binding or enqueuing.
    const unsigned binds=gpu.binds;
    bool rejected=false;
    try { scheduler.Push(gpu, 99, CommandList{}); }
    catch (const std::runtime_error&) { rejected=true; }
    assert(rejected && gpu.binds==binds);
    rejected=false;
    try { scheduler.DeclareChannel(nullptr); }
    catch (const std::runtime_error&) { rejected=true; }
    assert(rejected);
    rejected=false;
    auto missing_payload=channel(12);
    missing_payload->payload.reset();
    try { scheduler.DeclareChannel(missing_payload); }
    catch (const std::runtime_error&) { rejected=true; }
    assert(rejected);

    // Two valid parked owners: later channel releases an earlier one;
    // scheduler retries and processes the first without a busy-wait.
    auto a=channel(22), b=channel(23);
    auto& aw=a->payload->dma_pusher;
    auto& bw=b->payload->dma_pusher;
    aw.pending=true; aw.ready=false;
    bw.pending=true; bw.ready=false;
    scheduler.DeclareChannel(a);
    scheduler.DeclareChannel(b);
    scheduler.Push(gpu,22,CommandList{});
    scheduler.Push(gpu,23,CommandList{});
    assert(scheduler.HasPendingNativeChannels());
    bw.ready=true;
    bw.after_dispatch=[&] { aw.ready=true; };
    scheduler.ResumePendingNative(gpu);
    assert(aw.dispatches>=2 && bw.dispatches>=2);
    assert(!aw.pending && !bw.pending && !scheduler.HasPendingNativeChannels());

    // A service thread must never swap a live channel epoch while a GPU
    // worker is inside the original native DispatchCalls owner.
    auto in_flight=channel(35), replacement=channel(35);
    scheduler.DeclareChannel(in_flight);
    std::atomic<bool> entered{false}, allowed{false}, swapped{false};
    in_flight->payload->dma_pusher.after_dispatch=[&] {
        entered.store(true);
        while (!allowed.load()) std::this_thread::yield();
    };
    std::thread worker([&] { scheduler.Push(gpu,35,CommandList{}); });
    while (!entered.load()) std::this_thread::yield();
    std::thread registrar([&] {
        scheduler.DeclareChannel(replacement);
        swapped.store(true);
    });
    std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds{12});
    assert(!swapped.load()); // Exclusive epoch lease still blocked.
    allowed.store(true);
    worker.join();
    registrar.join();
    assert(swapped.load());
    scheduler.Push(gpu,35,CommandList{});
    assert(replacement->payload->dma_pusher.dispatches==1);

    // Two live channels may have independent epoch readers, but the GPU
    // has one mutable BindChannel context. Submissions must not interleave
    // the binding of channel 42 into channel 41's in-flight DispatchCalls.
    auto first=channel(41), second=channel(42);
    scheduler.DeclareChannel(first);
    scheduler.DeclareChannel(second);
    std::atomic<bool> first_entered{false}, first_allowed{false}, second_entered{false};
    first->payload->dma_pusher.after_dispatch=[&] {
        assert(gpu.current==41);
        first_entered.store(true);
        while (!first_allowed.load()) std::this_thread::yield();
        assert(gpu.current==41);
    };
    second->payload->dma_pusher.after_dispatch=[&] {
        assert(gpu.current==42);
        second_entered.store(true);
    };
    std::thread t1([&] { scheduler.Push(gpu,41,CommandList{}); });
    while (!first_entered.load()) std::this_thread::yield();
    std::thread t2([&] { scheduler.Push(gpu,42,CommandList{}); });
    std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds{12});
    assert(!second_entered.load()); // Binding may not change mid-dispatch.
    first_allowed.store(true);
    t1.join();
    t2.join();
    assert(second_entered.load());

    // An idle semaphore replay owns the same GPU binding as a fresh push.
    auto parked=channel(51), fresh=channel(52);
    scheduler.DeclareChannel(parked);
    scheduler.DeclareChannel(fresh);
    parked->payload->dma_pusher.pending=true;
    parked->payload->dma_pusher.ready=false;
    scheduler.Push(gpu,51,CommandList{});
    assert(scheduler.HasPendingNativeChannels());
    parked->payload->dma_pusher.ready=true;
    std::atomic<bool> replay_entered{false}, replay_allowed{false}, fresh_done{false};
    parked->payload->dma_pusher.after_dispatch=[&] {
        assert(gpu.current==51);
        replay_entered.store(true);
        while (!replay_allowed.load()) std::this_thread::yield();
        assert(gpu.current==51);
    };
    std::thread replay([&] { scheduler.ResumePendingNative(gpu); });
    while (!replay_entered.load()) std::this_thread::yield();
    std::thread submit([&] {
        scheduler.Push(gpu,52,CommandList{});
        fresh_done.store(true);
    });
    std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds{12});
    assert(!fresh_done.load());
    replay_allowed.store(true);
    replay.join();
    submit.join();
    assert(fresh_done.load());
    assert(!scheduler.HasPendingNativeChannels());
}
""".replace("__REAL_OWNER__",push+"\n"+resume+"\n"+declare)

compilers=list(dict.fromkeys(c for c in (shutil.which("clang++"),shutil.which("g++")) if c))
```

```py
For a process-generation-authorized native NS2 channel, SafeRead must be

#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
struct ChannelState {};
namespace Settings {
inline bool default_level{},high{},safe{};
bool IsDMALevelDefault() { return default_level; }
bool IsGPULevelHigh() { return high; }
bool IsDMALevelSafe() { return safe; }
}
namespace Service::Nvidia::Devices {
struct NativeGpuChannelRegistry {
    inline static bool authorized{};
    inline static unsigned calls{};
    static NativeGpuChannelRegistry& Instance() { static NativeGpuChannelRegistry r; return r; }
    bool IsNative(const ChannelState* channel) {
        assert(channel);
        ++calls;
        return authorized;
    }
};
}
struct Dma {
    ChannelState channel_state;
    bool SafeRead() {
__POLICY__
        return use_safe;
    }
};
int main() {
    Dma dma;
    auto& registry=Service::Nvidia::Devices::NativeGpuChannelRegistry::Instance();
    for (unsigned default_level=0;default_level<2;++default_level)
    for (unsigned high=0;high<2;++high)
    for (unsigned safe=0;safe<2;++safe)
    for (unsigned authorized=0;authorized<2;++authorized) {
        Settings::default_level=default_level;
        Settings::high=high;
        Settings::safe=safe;
        registry.authorized=authorized;
        const unsigned before=registry.calls;
        const bool historical=default_level ? bool(high) : bool(safe);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
        assert(dma.SafeRead()==(historical || authorized));
        assert(registry.calls==before+1);
#else
        assert(dma.SafeRead()==historical);
        assert(registry.calls==before);
#endif
    }
}
```

```py
fixture = r"""

    u64 big_page_bits = 12;
    u64 cpu_page_bits = 12;
    std::array<u32, 16> page_table{};
    std::array<u32, 16> big_page_table_dev{};
    std::array<bool, 16> mapped{};

    template <typename Map, typename Reserve, typename Unmap>
    void MemoryOperation(GPUVAddr address, std::size_t bytes, bool is_big,
                         Map&& on_map, Reserve&& on_reserved, Unmap&& on_unmap) const {
        ++page_walks;
        (void)is_big;
        for (std::size_t visited = 0; visited < bytes;) {
            const u64 pos = address + visited;
            const auto page = static_cast<std::size_t>(pos >> 12);
            const auto offset = static_cast<std::size_t>(pos & 4095);
            const auto chunk = std::min<std::size_t>(bytes - visited, 4096 - offset);
            if (page >= mapped.size()) {
                if (on_reserved(page, offset, chunk)) break;
            } else if (!mapped[page]) {
                if (on_unmap(page, offset, chunk)) break;
            } else if (on_map(page, offset, chunk)) {
                break;
            }
            visited += chunk;
        }
    }
    std::size_t MaxContinuousRange(GPUVAddr address, std::size_t bytes) const;
};
__EXTRACTED_RANGE__
} // namespace Tegra
int main() {
    using Tegra::MemoryManager;
    MemoryManager a{4};
    a.mapped[0] = a.mapped[1] = true;
    a.big_page_table_dev[0] = 0x30;
    a.big_page_table_dev[1] = 0x31;
    assert(a.MaxContinuousRange(0, 8192) == 8192);
    assert(a.page_walks == 1);
    // The second native SSBO bind must not rewalk 2 x 4 KiB PTEs.
    assert(a.MaxContinuousRange(0, 8192) == 8192 && a.page_walks == 1);
    // A device backing remap must invalidate the old contiguous answer.
    a.big_page_table_dev[1] = 0x91;
    Tegra::gpu_page_table_revision.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_release);
    assert(a.MaxContinuousRange(0, 8192) == 4096 && a.page_walks == 2);
    assert(a.MaxContinuousRange(0, 8192) == 4096 && a.page_walks == 2);
    a.big_page_table_dev[1] = 0x31;
    Tegra::gpu_page_table_revision.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_release);
    assert(a.MaxContinuousRange(0, 8192) == 8192 && a.page_walks == 3);

    // Two guests with equal GPU addresses cannot share physical backing.
    MemoryManager b{5};
    b.mapped[0] = b.mapped[1] = true;
    b.big_page_table_dev[0] = 0x20;
    b.big_page_table_dev[1] = 0x91;
    assert(b.MaxContinuousRange(0, 8192) == 4096 && b.page_walks == 1);
    assert(b.MaxContinuousRange(0, 8192) == 4096 && b.page_walks == 1);
    assert(a.MaxContinuousRange(0, 8192) == 8192 && a.page_walks == 4);

    // A freed GPU page must produce zero contiguous backing, never stale bytes.
    a.mapped[0] = false;
    Tegra::gpu_page_table_revision.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_release);
    const auto before_unmap = a.page_walks;
    assert(a.MaxContinuousRange(0, 8192) == 0 && a.page_walks > before_unmap);
    // The unmap path itself walks both big and short PTE tiers; its exact
    // number of nested operations is irrelevant to cache correctness.
    const auto after_unmap = a.page_walks;
    assert(a.MaxContinuousRange(0, 8192) == 0 && a.page_walks == after_unmap);
    a.mapped[0] = true;
    a.big_page_table_dev[0] = 0x30;
    Tegra::gpu_page_table_revision.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_release);
    assert(a.MaxContinuousRange(0, 8192) == 8192 &&
           a.page_walks == after_unmap + 1);
    // A map mutation in a different guest also invalidates cache entries.
    b.big_page_table_dev[1] = 0x21;
    Tegra::gpu_page_table_revision.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_release);
    assert(a.MaxContinuousRange(0, 8192) == 8192 &&
           a.page_walks == after_unmap + 2);
    assert(b.MaxContinuousRange(0, 8192) == 8192);
    std::puts("P1_2_SHARED_GPU_CONTIGUOUS_RANGE_CACHE_PASS");
}
"""
fixture = fixture.replace("__EXTRACTED_RANGE__", start + actual_range_function)
sdk = Path("/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX15.4.sdk")
env = os.environ.copy()
if sdk.is_dir():

    (shutil.which("clang++"), shutil.which("g++")))))

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-contiguous-range-") as temp:

            assert built.returncode == 0, (compiler, built.stderr[-3200:])
            ran = subprocess.run([str(binary)], text=True, capture_output=True,

            assert ran.returncode == 0, (compiler, ran.stderr[-3200:])
            assert "P1_2_SHARED_GPU_CONTIGUOUS_RANGE_CACHE_PASS" in ran.stdout
```

```py
#include <memory>
#include <set>
#include "core/hle/service/am/service/gpu_session_protocol.h"

namespace Kernel { struct KProcess { int pid{}; }; }
namespace Nvidia {
using DeviceFD = int;
enum class NvResult { Success, InvalidState };
namespace Devices {
struct nvdevice { virtual ~nvdevice() = default; };
struct nvhost_as_gpu : nvdevice {
    Kernel::KProcess* process{};
    bool OwnsNativeProcess(Kernel::KProcess* p) const { return p == process; }
};
struct foreign_device : nvdevice {};
}
struct Module {
    std::map<int, std::shared_ptr<Devices::nvdevice>> live;
    std::set<int> valid;
    NvResult VerifyFD(DeviceFD fd) const {
        return valid.contains(fd) ? NvResult::Success : NvResult::InvalidState;
    }
    template <class T> std::shared_ptr<T> GetDevice(DeviceFD fd) const {
        auto it = live.find(fd);
        if (it == live.end()) return {};
        return std::static_pointer_cast<T>(it->second);
    }
};
}
namespace Service::AM {
struct GpuWorkerSharedState {
    GpuSessionProtocol::AddressSpaceSlots address_spaces{};
    std::shared_ptr<Nvidia::Module> module{std::make_shared<Nvidia::Module>()};
    std::map<std::uint32_t, std::weak_ptr<Nvidia::Devices::nvhost_as_gpu>> opened_gpu_as{};
    Kernel::KProcess* native_process{};
    std::shared_ptr<Nvidia::Devices::nvhost_as_gpu>
        FindOwnedAddressSpace(std::uint32_t id) const;
};
__REAL_OWNER__
}

int main() {
    using Service::AM::GpuWorkerSharedState;
    using Service::AM::GpuSessionProtocol::Status;
    using Nvidia::Devices::nvhost_as_gpu;
    Kernel::KProcess first{1}, foreign{2};
    GpuWorkerSharedState shared;
    shared.native_process = &first;
    auto owned = std::make_shared<nvhost_as_gpu>();
    owned->process = &first;
    assert(shared.address_spaces.Add(17) == Status::Success);
    shared.opened_gpu_as.emplace(17, owned);
    shared.module->valid.insert(17);
    shared.module->live[17] = owned;
    assert(shared.FindOwnedAddressSpace(17) == owned);

    assert(!shared.FindOwnedAddressSpace(0));
    assert(!shared.FindOwnedAddressSpace(std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max()));
    // A valid live device is not enough: the session must own that slot.
    shared.module->valid.insert(18);
    shared.module->live[18] = owned;
    assert(!shared.FindOwnedAddressSpace(18));
    shared.module->valid.erase(18);
    shared.module->live.erase(18);

    shared.module->valid.erase(17);
    assert(!shared.FindOwnedAddressSpace(17)); // guest already closed FD
    shared.module->valid.insert(17);
    shared.module->live[17] = std::make_shared<Nvidia::Devices::foreign_device>();
    assert(!shared.FindOwnedAddressSpace(17)); // recycled FD with foreign type
    auto replacement = std::make_shared<nvhost_as_gpu>();
    replacement->process = &first;
    shared.module->live[17] = replacement;
    assert(!shared.FindOwnedAddressSpace(17)); // recycled with same device type
    shared.module->live[17] = owned;

    shared.native_process = &foreign;
    assert(!shared.FindOwnedAddressSpace(17)); // different guest KProcess
    shared.native_process = &first;
    assert(shared.FindOwnedAddressSpace(17) == owned);

    shared.opened_gpu_as.erase(17);
    assert(!shared.FindOwnedAddressSpace(17)); // no registered original identity
    shared.opened_gpu_as.emplace(17, owned);
    shared.module->live.erase(17);
    owned.reset(); // only a weak entry remains
    assert(!shared.FindOwnedAddressSpace(17)); // original owner expired
}
""".replace("__REAL_OWNER__", owner)

compilers = list(dict.fromkeys(x for x in (shutil.which("clang++"), shutil.which("g++")) if x))
assert compilers, "Clang or GCC C++20 compiler required"
```

```py
"""P2.7: execute real DMA command-list fence policy for both maintained paths.

A native authenticated guest GPU barrier must never depend on a host NS1
performance toggle. Does not claim hardware completion or real guest output.
"""

import os
import shutil
import subprocess

    assert source.count(start)==1

#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
struct ChannelState {};
namespace Settings {
struct Setting {bool value{};bool GetValue() const {return value;}};
struct Values {Setting sync_memory_operations;};
inline Values values;
}
namespace Service::Nvidia::Devices {
struct NativeGpuChannelRegistry {
    inline static bool authorized{};
    inline static unsigned probes{};
    static NativeGpuChannelRegistry& Instance() {
        static NativeGpuChannelRegistry registry;
        return registry;
    }
    bool IsNative(const ChannelState* state) {
        assert(state);
        ++probes;
        return authorized;
    }
};
}
struct DmaPusher {
    struct Header {bool sync;};
    struct Commands {std::array<Header,2> command_lists;};
    Commands command_list{};
    ChannelState channel_state;
    std::size_t dma_pushbuffer_subindex{1};
    bool signal_sync{};
    void NextListFence() {
__POLICY__
    }
};
int main() {
    using Service::Nvidia::Devices::NativeGpuChannelRegistry;
    auto& registry=NativeGpuChannelRegistry::Instance();
    for(int explicit_sync=0;explicit_sync<2;++explicit_sync)
    for(int user_sync=0;user_sync<2;++user_sync)
    for(int native=0;native<2;++native) {
        DmaPusher dma;
        dma.command_list.command_lists[1].sync=explicit_sync!=0;
        Settings::values.sync_memory_operations.value=user_sync!=0;
        registry.authorized=native!=0;
        const unsigned before=registry.probes;
        dma.signal_sync=true; // stale state must never bypass a false barrier
        dma.NextListFence();
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
        const bool expected=explicit_sync && (user_sync || native);
        // Deferred native authorization is not needed unless an explicit
        // GPU barrier is present and the host setting did not already wait.
        assert(registry.probes-before==(explicit_sync && !user_sync));
#else
        const bool expected=explicit_sync && user_sync;
        assert(registry.probes==before);
#endif
        assert(dma.signal_sync==expected);
    }
}
'''.replace('__POLICY__',policies[0])
env=dict(os.environ)
sdk=Path('/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX15.4.sdk')
```

```py
"""Compile the real NS2 native GPU class binder with fake channel ownership.

An unknown class on an authenticated NS2 channel must never retain a stale
DmaPusher engine pointer. Legacy NS1 invalid-class behavior is unchanged.
This is a source-executed host test, not proof of hardware execution.

#include <array>
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <memory>
#include <stdexcept>
using u32 = std::uint32_t;
static unsigned rejected{};
#define HW_GPU 0
#define LOG_DEBUG(...) ((void)0)
#define LOG_ERROR(...) ((void)0)
#define UNIMPLEMENTED_MSG(...) (++rejected)
struct Engine {};
namespace Tegra {
struct NativeAmpereMacroState {};
enum class EngineID : u32 {
    NV01_TIMER=0x0004, FERMI_TWOD_A=0x902d, MAXWELL_B=0xb197,
    KEPLER_COMPUTE_B=0xb1c0, KEPLER_INLINE_TO_MEMORY_B=0xa140,
    MAXWELL_DMA_COPY_A=0xb0b5,
};
namespace Control {
struct Payload {
    Engine fermi_2d, maxwell_3d, kepler_compute, maxwell_dma, kepler_memory, nv01_timer;
};
struct ChannelState {
    std::shared_ptr<Payload> payload = std::make_shared<Payload>();
};
}
namespace Engines {
enum class EngineTypes : u32 {
    Nv01Timer, KeplerCompute, Maxwell3D, Fermi2D, MaxwellDMA, KeplerMemory
};
}
struct DmaPusher {
    Control::ChannelState channel_state;
    std::array<Engine*,8> subchannels{};
    std::array<Engines::EngineTypes,8> kinds{};
    void BindSubchannel(Engine* engine,u32 index, Engines::EngineTypes kind) {
        assert(index<8);
        subchannels[index]=engine;
        kinds[index]=kind;
    }
};
}
namespace Service::Nvidia::Devices {
struct NativeGpuChannelRegistry {
    bool native=true, allow_graphics=true, allow_compute=true;
    unsigned retired_graphics=0, retired_compute=0, bound_graphics=0, bound_compute=0;
    static NativeGpuChannelRegistry& Instance() {
        static NativeGpuChannelRegistry r;
        return r;
    }
    bool IsNative(const Tegra::Control::ChannelState*) const { return native; }
    bool BindGraphicsEngine(const Tegra::Control::ChannelState*, Engine*, u32) {
        if (!allow_graphics || !native) return false;
        ++bound_graphics;
        return true;
    }
    bool BindComputeEngine(const Tegra::Control::ChannelState*, Engine*,u32) {
        if (!allow_compute || !native) return false;
        ++bound_compute;
        return true;
    }
    void UnbindGraphicsSubchannel(const Tegra::Control::ChannelState*,Engine*,u32) {
        ++retired_graphics;
    }
    void UnbindComputeSubchannel(const Tegra::Control::ChannelState*,Engine*,u32) {
        ++retired_compute;
    }
};
}
namespace Tegra::Engines {
constexpr u32 Gf100BindClassMask = 0xffff;
constexpr u32 Gf100BindValidMask = 0x1f0000 | Gf100BindClassMask;
class Puller {
public:
    struct MethodCall { u32 method{},argument{},subchannel{},method_count{}; };
    std::array<EngineID,8> bound_engines{};
    std::unique_ptr<Tegra::NativeAmpereMacroState> native_3d{};
    u32 native_macro_method{};
    bool native_3d_failed{};

__REAL_METHOD__

int main() {
    using namespace Tegra;
    Engines::Puller puller;
    DmaPusher dma;
    auto& registry=Service::Nvidia::Devices::NativeGpuChannelRegistry::Instance();
    unsigned native_faults{};
    const auto bind=[&](u32 klass) {
        try {
            puller.ProcessBindMethod(dma, {0,klass,2,0});
        } catch (const std::runtime_error&) {
            ++native_faults;
        }
    };
    // Existing ordinary GPU binding; native rejected class revokes pointer.
    bind(static_cast<u32>(EngineID::MAXWELL_B));
    assert(dma.subchannels[2] == &dma.channel_state.payload->maxwell_3d);
    bind(0xdead);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(dma.subchannels[2] == nullptr && rejected==0 && native_faults==1);
#else
    assert(dma.subchannels[2] == nullptr && rejected==1 && native_faults==0);
#endif
    bind(static_cast<u32>(EngineID::KEPLER_COMPUTE_B));
    assert(dma.subchannels[2] == &dma.channel_state.payload->kepler_compute);
    bind(0xc797);
    assert(dma.subchannels[2] == &dma.channel_state.payload->maxwell_3d);
    assert(registry.bound_graphics==1);
    bind(0x5678);
    assert(dma.subchannels[2] == nullptr && registry.retired_graphics==1);
    bind(0xc7c0);
    assert(dma.subchannels[2] == &dma.channel_state.payload->kepler_compute);
    assert(registry.bound_compute==1);
    bind(0xfff1);
    assert(dma.subchannels[2] == nullptr && registry.retired_compute==1);
    bind(0xc7b5);
    assert(dma.subchannels[2] == &dma.channel_state.payload->maxwell_dma);
    bind(0xfff1);
    assert(dma.subchannels[2] == nullptr);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(native_faults==4 &&
           "native SET_OBJECT unsupported class must fault before queue completion");
#else
    assert(native_faults==0);
#endif
    // Invalid class and forbidden Ampere bind must not alter old NS1 behavior.
    registry.native=false;
    bind(static_cast<u32>(EngineID::MAXWELL_B));
    assert(dma.subchannels[2] == &dma.channel_state.payload->maxwell_3d);
    bind(0x5678);
    assert(dma.subchannels[2] == &dma.channel_state.payload->maxwell_3d);
    bind(0xc797);
    assert(dma.subchannels[2] == &dma.channel_state.payload->maxwell_3d);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    assert(native_faults==4 && "NS1 must not inherit native fatal binding policy");
#endif
    // An invalid owner/failed native 3D bind must not disturb current owner.
    registry.native=true;
    registry.allow_graphics=false;
    bind(0xc797);
    assert(dma.subchannels[2] == &dma.channel_state.payload->maxwell_3d);
    std::puts("P2_7_NATIVE_GPU_INVALID_CLASS_FAIL_CLOSED_PASS");
}
'''


def main() -> None:
    env=os.environ.copy()
    sdk=Path('/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX15.4.sdk')
    if sdk.is_dir(): env['SDKROOT']=str(sdk)
    compilers=list(dict.fromkeys(x for x in (shutil.which('clang++'),shutil.which('g++')) if x))
    assert compilers
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='encore-native-class-') as folder:
        src=Path(folder)/'class.cpp'
        src.write_text(cpp.replace('__REAL_METHOD__',method))
        for compiler in compilers:
            for opt in (0,2):
                for ps5 in (False,True):
                    exe=Path(folder)/f'{Path(compiler).name}-{opt}-{int(ps5)}'
                    cmd=[compiler,'-std=c++20',f'-O{opt}','-Wall','-Wextra',
                         '-Werror','-fsanitize=undefined','-fno-sanitize-recover=all']
                    if ps5:cmd.append('-DPS5_NATIVE=1')
                    cmd.extend((str(src),'-o',str(exe)))
                    build=subprocess.run(cmd,env=env,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=45)
                    assert build.returncode==0,build.stderr[-3500:]
                    run=subprocess.run([str(exe)],env=env,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=15)
                    assert run.returncode==0,run.stderr[-3500:]
                    assert 'P2_7_NATIVE_GPU_INVALID_CLASS_FAIL_CLOSED_PASS' in run.stdout
                    print('P2_7_NATIVE_INVALID_CLASS_HOST_PASS',Path(compiler).name,
                          f'O{opt}', 'PS5' if ps5 else 'host',flush=True)


if __name__=='__main__':
    main()
```

```py
"""P1.2: exercise actual shared GPU small/big PTE Map/Unmap functions.

The previous implementation notified the rasterizer only if PTE *status*
changed. Mapped->Mapped to a different physical page silently reused stale
```

`tools/ns2/check_native_gpu_registration_alloc_host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Prove native GPU process/channel/engine fail-closed allocation semantics.

Injects real std::bad_alloc at each native admission map through global new,
then tests process/channel generation epochs and NS1-unbound state. Host only.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
```

```py
    bool fail_oom{}, fail_ioctl{};
    int malformed_mode{}; // injected NVDRV protocol replies, not synthetic owners
    unsigned calls{};
    NvResult Ioctl1(DeviceFD fd,Ioctl command,std::span<const u8> input,
                    std::span<u8> output) {
        ++calls;
        assert(fd==9 && command.raw==0xc0404108U);
        assert(input.size()==64 && output.size()==64);
        if(fail_oom)throw std::bad_alloc{};
        if(fail_ioctl)return NvResult::InvalidState;
        std::array<Devices::nvhost_as_gpu::VaRegion,2> regions{{
            {0x10000,4096,0,2},{0x20000,4096,0,2}
        }};
        if(malformed_mode==1) regions[0].pages=0; // missing first extent
        if(malformed_mode==2) {regions[0].offset=~u64{0}-3;regions[0].pages=2;} // overflow
        if(malformed_mode==3) regions[0].offset=0x30000; // reversed bounds
        if(malformed_mode==4) regions[0].pages=256; // first extent beyond second
        if(malformed_mode==5) {regions[0].offset=0x1f000;regions[0].pages=2;} // overlaps second region
        if(malformed_mode==6) regions[1].pages=0; // missing second extent
        if(malformed_mode==7) {regions[1].offset=~u64{0}-3;regions[1].pages=2;} // second overflow
        std::memcpy(output.data()+16,regions.data(),sizeof(regions));
        return NvResult::Success;
    }
```

```py
    struct Dense {bool gmmu_released{};};
    std::map<std::pair<u32,u64>,Dense> m_dense_regions{};
    System system{};
    Kernel::KernelCore kernel{};
    unsigned dense_retires{};
    bool RetireGpuOnlyRegion(u32 as,u64 address) {
        ++dense_retires;
        m_dense_regions.erase({as,address});
        return true;
    }
    void DestroySparseRegion(HLERequestContext&);
};
__TRANSLATE__
__REAL_OWNER__
}
static HLERequestContext packet(u32 notification=3) {
    return {{0xe7,7,7,0x20000,0,0x21fff,0,0,notification}};
}
int main() {
    using Service::AM::IGpuWorker;
    using Service::AM::GW::LedgerStatus;
    IGpuWorker w;
    Kernel::KEvent e{};
    w.m_shared->events[3]=&e;
    assert(w.m_shared->address_spaces.Add(7)==Service::AM::GpuSessionProtocol::Status::Success);
    assert(w.m_mappings.RecordSparse(7,1,0x20000,0x2000)==LedgerStatus::Success);
    auto& as=*w.m_shared->as;
    as.next=Service::Nvidia::NvResult::InsufficientMemory;
    auto oom=packet();
    w.DestroySparseRegion(oom);
    assert(oom.words==2 && oom.reply.size()==1);
    assert(oom.reply[0]==Kernel::ResultOutOfResource.raw);
    assert(w.m_mappings.CanReleaseSparse(7,0x20000,0x2000)==LedgerStatus::Success);
    assert(as.releases==1 && e.signals==0 && w.system.gpu.waits==1);
    as.next=Service::Nvidia::NvResult::Success;
    auto retry=packet();
    w.DestroySparseRegion(retry);
    assert(retry.reply[0]==0 && as.releases==2 && e.signals==1);
    assert(w.m_mappings.Count()==0);
    auto replay=packet();
    w.DestroySparseRegion(replay);
    assert(replay.reply[0]==Kernel::ResultNotFound.raw && as.releases==2);
    assert(e.signals==1);

    // Retry of an already-released dense reservation retires physical
    // ownership without issuing a second destructive GMMU free.
    assert(w.m_mappings.RecordSparse(7,1,0x20000,0x2000)==LedgerStatus::Success);
    w.m_dense_regions.emplace(std::make_pair(7U,u64{0x20000}),IGpuWorker::Dense{true});
    auto dense=packet();
    w.DestroySparseRegion(dense);
    assert(dense.reply[0]==0 && w.dense_retires==1 && as.releases==2);
    assert(w.m_mappings.Count()==0 && e.signals==2);

    auto unknown=packet(4);
    w.DestroySparseRegion(unknown);
    assert(unknown.reply[0]==Kernel::ResultNotFound.raw && as.releases==2);
}
""".replace("__TRANSLATE__",translate).replace("__REAL_OWNER__",method)
```

```py
def actual_function(marker):
    assert source.count(marker)==1
    start=source.index(marker)
    at=source.index('{',start)
    depth=0
    for end in range(at,len(source)):
        if source[end]=='{':depth+=1
        elif source[end]=='}':
            depth-=1
            if depth==0:return source[start:end+1]
    raise AssertionError('unbalanced source')

   assert(system.time.gpu_reads==0 && system.time.ns_reads==1);
   const u64 finish=ns+5'000'000, present=finish+200'000+calibration_offset;
   assert(present-(actual+5'000'000+calibration_offset)==200'000);
  }
  system.time.ns=std::chrono::nanoseconds{-1};
  system.time.gpu_reads=system.time.ns_reads=0;
  assert(impl.GetTicks()==0);
  assert(system.time.gpu_reads==0 && system.time.ns_reads==1);
```

```py
    assert(missing.reply.size()==2 && missing.reply[0]==Kernel::ResultNotFound.raw);

    assert(oom.reply[0]==Kernel::ResultOutOfResource.raw && oom.reply[1]==0);
    assert(as.map_calls==1 && w.m_mappings.Count()==0 && event.signals==0);

    auto first=valid_map();
    w.NormalMapGpuMemory4K(first);
    assert(first.words==3 && first.reply.size()==2 && first.reply[0]==0);
    assert(first.reply[1]==0 && as.map_calls==2 && event.signals==1);
    assert(w.m_mappings.Count()==1);
    auto overlap=valid_map();
    w.NormalMapGpuMemory4K(overlap);
    assert(overlap.reply[0]==Kernel::ResultInvalidState.raw);
    assert(as.map_calls==2 && w.m_mappings.Count()==1 && event.signals==1);

    auto failed_modify=valid_modify();

    assert(failed_modify.reply[0]==Kernel::ResultInvalidState.raw);
    assert(failed_modify.reply[1]==0 && as.modify_calls==1 && event.signals==1);
    as.next_modify=Service::Nvidia::NvResult::Success;
```

```py
from pathlib import Path
```

`tools/ns2/check_native_nso_arguments_host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""H01: run the actual NSO LoadModule argument admission block, Clang/GCC.

The shared NS1/NS2 loader uses a fixed NSO_ARGUMENT_DATA_ALLOCATION_SIZE;
an oversized program_args string must be denied in both layout and materialize
passes before any codeset allocation or guest memcpy.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
VENDOR=ROOT/"vendor"
owner=(VENDOR/"encore-active/ns2-runtime/metadata/core/loader/nso.cpp").read_text()
header=(VENDOR/"sources/eden/src/core/loader/nso.h").read_text()
start="    // Both NS1 and NS2 use this fixed guest argument allocation."
end="    // N3t: native NSO entry gate"
assert owner.count(start)==owner.count(end)==1
real=owner.split(start,1)[1].split(end,1)[0]
# The prose marker begins inside a multi-line C++ comment; extract the
# exact executable owner IF, not the continuation prose ("A hostile ...").
real=real[real.index("    if (should_pass_arguments &&"):]
assert "Settings::values.program_args.GetValue().size()" in real
assert "NSO_ARGUMENT_DATA_ALLOCATION_SIZE - sizeof(NSOArgumentHeader)" in real
assert real.index("if (should_pass_arguments &&") < real.index("return std::nullopt;")
assert owner.index(start) < owner.index("const u64 initialized_size =")
assert "std::memcpy(codeset.memory.data() + end_offset + sizeof(NSOArgumentHeader)," in owner
assert "arg_data.data(), arg_data.size()" in owner
m=re.search(r"constexpr u32 NSO_ARGUMENT_DATA_ALLOCATION_SIZE\s*=\s*(0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+|\d+);",header)
assert m, "original NSO argument capacity not found"
capacity=int(m.group(1),0)
assert 0 < capacity < 0xffffffff
fixture=r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
using u32=std::uint32_t;
constexpr u32 NSO_ARGUMENT_DATA_ALLOCATION_SIZE=__CAPACITY__;
struct NSOArgumentHeader{
    u32 allocated_size{},actual_size{};
    unsigned char reserved[24]{};
};
static_assert(sizeof(NSOArgumentHeader)==32);
namespace Settings {
struct Arg{
    std::string value{};
    const std::string& GetValue() const{return value;}
};
inline struct Values {Arg program_args;} values;
}
std::optional<int> RealNsOArgsAdmission(bool should_pass_arguments){
__REAL_OWNER__
    return 1;
}
int main(){
    constexpr std::size_t allowed=NSO_ARGUMENT_DATA_ALLOCATION_SIZE-
        sizeof(NSOArgumentHeader);
    static_assert(allowed>0);
    using namespace Settings;
    assert(RealNsOArgsAdmission(true).has_value()); // empty
    values.program_args.value.assign(allowed,'X');
    assert(RealNsOArgsAdmission(true).has_value()); // exact boundary
    values.program_args.value.push_back('Y');
    assert(!RealNsOArgsAdmission(true).has_value());
    assert(RealNsOArgsAdmission(false).has_value()); // no copy requested
    values.program_args.value.assign(NSO_ARGUMENT_DATA_ALLOCATION_SIZE*2,'Z');
    assert(!RealNsOArgsAdmission(true).has_value());
    values.program_args.value.assign(1,'A');
    assert(RealNsOArgsAdmission(true).has_value());
}
""".replace("__CAPACITY__",str(capacity)).replace("__REAL_OWNER__",real)
compilers=list(dict.fromkeys(cc for cc in (shutil.which("clang++"),shutil.which("g++")) if cc))
assert compilers
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-h01-nso-args-") as temp:
    cpp=Path(temp)/"real.cpp";cpp.write_text(fixture)
    for cc in compilers:
        for opt in ("-O0","-O2"):
            exe=Path(temp)/(Path(cc).name+opt)
            args=[cc,"-std=c++20",opt,"-Wall","-Wextra","-Werror",
                  "-fsanitize=undefined","-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
                  str(cpp),"-o",str(exe)]
            built=subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=65,
                                 env=os.environ.copy())
            assert built.returncode==0,(cc,built.stderr[-4500:])
            tested=subprocess.run([str(exe)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15)
            assert tested.returncode==0,(cc,tested.stderr[-4500:])
            print("H01_REAL_NSO_ARGUMENT_ADMISSION_PASS",Path(cc).name,opt,
                  "max_valid=1 over_capacity=refused no_copy_unaffected=1",
                  flush=True)
```

`tools/ns2/check_native_nso_patch_extent_host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""H01: execute actual NSO patched-image copy owner against adversarial IPS size.

The original CodeSet has a fixed authenticated segment layout. Reject resized
IPS/IPSwitch output before writing a byte to guest executable staging. The
real production copy block is extracted, compiled and executed by two C++20
compilers with UBSan in O0/O2. This is not full KProcess admission.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
SOURCE=ROOT/"vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/metadata/core/loader/nso.cpp"
source=SOURCE.read_text()
start="    // Apply patches if necessary\n    if (patched || full_image) {"
end="\n#ifdef HAS_NCE\n    // If we are computing"
assert source.count(start)==source.count(end)==1
owner=source.split(start,1)[1].split(end,1)[0]
body="    if (patched || full_image) {"+owner
assert owner.count("pi_header = pm->PatchNSO(pi_header, name);")==1
assert owner.count("if (module_start >= codeset.memory.size())")==1
assert owner.index("if (module_start >= codeset.memory.size())") < owner.index(
    "std::span<u8> patchable_section(")
assert owner.count("if (pi_header.size() != sizeof(NSOHeader) + patchable_section.size())")==1
assert owner.index("if (pi_header.size() !=") < owner.index("std::copy(pi_header.begin()")
assert "return std::nullopt;" in owner

cpp=r"""
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <optional>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
using u8=std::uint8_t;
struct NSOHeader {std::array<u8,256> bytes{};};
struct PatchManager {
    enum class Change {Same,Expand,Truncate,Unchanged};
    Change change{Change::Same};
    std::vector<u8> PatchNSO(std::vector<u8> bytes, const std::string&) const {
        if(change==Change::Expand) bytes.push_back(0xFE);
        if(change==Change::Truncate) bytes.resize(bytes.size()-1);
        if(change==Change::Same)
            for(std::size_t i=sizeof(NSOHeader);i<bytes.size();++i)bytes[i]=0xAB;
        return bytes;
    }
};
struct CodeSet {std::vector<u8> memory;};
std::optional<int> TestRealOwner(const PatchManager* pm,CodeSet& codeset,
                                  const NSOHeader& nso_header,bool patched,
                                  bool full_image,std::size_t module_start,
                                  const std::string& name) {
__OWNER__
    return 1;
}
void Unmodified(const std::vector<u8>& bytes,u8 expected) {
    for(u8 b:bytes) assert(b==expected);
}
int main(){
    NSOHeader hdr{};
    PatchManager pm{};
    const std::string name{"main"};
    constexpr std::size_t region=1024;
    const auto check=[&](PatchManager::Change change,bool expected_ok){
        CodeSet image{std::vector<u8>(region,0x34)};
        pm.change=change;
        const auto result=TestRealOwner(&pm,image,hdr,true,false,0,name);
        assert(result.has_value()==expected_ok);
        if(expected_ok)Unmodified(image.memory,0xAB);
        else Unmodified(image.memory,0x34);
    };
    check(PatchManager::Change::Same,true);
    check(PatchManager::Change::Expand,false);
    check(PatchManager::Change::Truncate,false);
    // A no-patch layout does not dereference an absent patch manager.
    CodeSet raw{std::vector<u8>(region,0x34)};
    assert(TestRealOwner(nullptr,raw,hdr,false,false,0,name));
    Unmodified(raw.memory,0x34);
    // Header-only result is still invalid if it truncates even one payload
    // byte; ensure zero-length payload cannot cause pointer overrun.
    CodeSet empty{std::vector<u8>{}};
    pm.change=PatchManager::Change::Unchanged;
    assert(!TestRealOwner(&pm,empty,hdr,true,false,0,name));
    pm.change=PatchManager::Change::Expand;
    assert(!TestRealOwner(&pm,empty,hdr,true,false,0,name));
    assert(empty.memory.empty());
    // Valid smallest section retains bytes; rejecting layout past the end
    // must occur before any pointer arithmetic or mutation.
    CodeSet one{std::vector<u8>{0x34}};
    pm.change=PatchManager::Change::Unchanged;
    assert(TestRealOwner(&pm,one,hdr,true,false,0,name));
    assert(one.memory[0]==0x34);
    assert(!TestRealOwner(&pm,one,hdr,true,false,1,name));
    assert(!TestRealOwner(&pm,one,hdr,true,false,2,name));
    assert(one.memory[0]==0x34);
    std::puts("H01_REAL_NSO_PATCH_EXTENT_PASS in_place=1"
              " oversized=refused truncated=refused"
              " no_patch=1 empty_section=refused invalid_start=refused"
              " guest_bytes_preserved=1");
}
""".replace("__OWNER__",body)
compilers=list(dict.fromkeys(c for c in
    (shutil.which("clang++"),shutil.which("g++")) if c))
assert compilers,"C++20 compiler required"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-h01-nso-ips-") as tmp:
    src=Path(tmp)/"real_nso_ips.cpp";src.write_text(cpp)
    for cc in compilers:
        for opt in ("-O0","-O2"):
            exe=Path(tmp)/(Path(cc).name+opt)
            cmd=[cc,"-std=c++20",opt,"-Wall","-Wextra","-Werror",
                 "-fsanitize=undefined","-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
                 str(src),"-o",str(exe)]
            build=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60,
                                 env=os.environ.copy())
            assert build.returncode==0,(cc,build.stderr[-5000:])
            run=subprocess.run([str(exe)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=20)
            assert run.returncode==0,(cc,run.stderr[-5000:])
            print(Path(cc).name,opt,run.stdout.strip(),flush=True)
```

```py
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <deque>
#include <limits>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
struct SessionId {std::size_t id;};
struct Session {bool is_active{};int ref_count{};void* process{};};
struct ContainerImpl {
    std::mutex session_guard;
    std::deque<Session> sessions;
    unsigned cleanup_calls{};
};
struct Container {
    std::unique_ptr<ContainerImpl> impl=std::make_unique<ContainerImpl>();
    void CloseSession(SessionId id);
};
__REAL_CLOSE_PREFLIGHT__
    // All GPU unmaps/ASID release/process Close happen only after this point.
    ++impl->cleanup_calls;
    session.is_active=false;
    session.process=nullptr;
}
int main(){
    Container c;
    c.CloseSession({0});
    c.CloseSession({(std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max)()});
    assert(c.impl->cleanup_calls==0 && c.impl->sessions.empty());
    c.impl->sessions.push_back({true,2,reinterpret_cast<void*>(0x1)});
    c.CloseSession({0});
    assert(c.impl->sessions[0].ref_count==1 && c.impl->cleanup_calls==0);
    c.CloseSession({8});
    assert(c.impl->sessions[0].ref_count==1 && c.impl->cleanup_calls==0);
    c.CloseSession({0});
    assert(c.impl->cleanup_calls==1 && c.impl->sessions[0].ref_count==0);
    c.CloseSession({0});
    assert(c.impl->cleanup_calls==1 && c.impl->sessions[0].ref_count==0);
    c.impl->sessions.push_back({false,1,reinterpret_cast<void*>(0x2)});
    c.CloseSession({1});
    assert(c.impl->sessions[1].ref_count==1 && c.impl->cleanup_calls==1);
    c.impl->sessions[1]={true,2,nullptr};
    c.CloseSession({1});
    assert(c.impl->sessions[1].ref_count==2 && c.impl->cleanup_calls==1);
    c.impl->sessions[1]={true,0,reinterpret_cast<void*>(0x2)};
    c.CloseSession({1});
    assert(c.impl->sessions[1].ref_count==0 && c.impl->cleanup_calls==1);
    c.impl->sessions[1]={true,1,reinterpret_cast<void*>(0x3)};
    c.CloseSession({1});
    assert(c.impl->cleanup_calls==2 && c.impl->sessions[1].ref_count==0);
    assert(c.impl->sessions[0].ref_count==0);
}
'''.replace('__REAL_CLOSE_PREFLIGHT__',head)
compiler=shutil.which('clang++-18') or shutil.which('clang++') or shutil.which('g++')
```

`tools/ns2/check_native_nvdrv_allocation_range_host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""P1.2/NS2 NVDRV: real fixed/remap allocation owner + C++ range oracle."""
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
vendor = root / "vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/nvdrv_as"
header = vendor / "core/hle/service/nvdrv/devices/native_gpu_allocation_range.h"
source = (vendor / "core/hle/service/nvdrv/devices/nvhost_as_gpu.cpp").read_text()
assert header.is_file()
assert 'native_gpu_allocation_range.h' in source
assert source.count("NativeGpuAllocation::FindContaining(") == 2
assert "alloc-- == allocation_map.begin()" not in source
assert "if (alloc == allocation_map.end())" in source
assert "bytes > gpu_limit - address" in header.read_text()
assert "bytes > it->second.size - offset" in header.read_text()
assert "it == allocations.begin()" in header.read_text()
assert "ContainsSubrange(" in header.read_text()

# The research 4-KiB GPU owner can outlive its GMMU (session teardown /
# invalidated address space). A VM initialised bit is NOT evidence of a
# still-bound GMMU. The lifetime gate must precede all side effects.
for entrypoint in (
    "MapNative4K", "MapNativeImage", "ReserveNativeSparse4K",
    "RemapNativeSparse", "ReleaseNativeSparse4K",
    "UnmapNative4K", "ModifyNativeKind",
):
    marker = "NvResult nvhost_as_gpu::" + entrypoint + "("
    assert source.count(marker) == 1, ("Missing native GPU owner", entrypoint)
    body = source.split(marker, 1)[1].split("\nNvResult nvhost_as_gpu::", 1)[0]
    gate = body.find("!vm.initialised || !gmmu")
    assert gate >= 0, ("Native GMMU can be dereferenced without an owner", entrypoint)
    lock = body.find("const std::scoped_lock lock{mutex};")
    assert lock >= 0 and lock < gate, ("Native GMMU check must hold AS mutex", entrypoint)
    for mutation in ("gmmu->", "vm.small_page_allocator->AllocateFixed(",
                     "nvmap.PinHandle(", "FreeMappingLocked("):
        first = body.find(mutation)
        assert first == -1 or gate < first, (
            "Native GMMU lifetime gate must precede side effects",
            entrypoint, mutation)
remap = source.split("NvResult nvhost_as_gpu::MapBufferEx(", 1)[1].split(
    "NvResult nvhost_as_gpu::UnmapBuffer(", 1)[0]
assert remap.index("NativeGpuAllocation::ContainsSubrange(handle->orig_size") < remap.index(
    "nvmap.PinHandle(params.handle, false)")
assert remap.index("fixed_alloc = NativeGpuAllocation::FindContaining(") < remap.index(
    "nvmap.PinHandle(params.handle, false)")
assert "nvmap.UnpinHandle(params.handle); // Allocation failed after NvMap pin." in remap
assert "NativeGpuAllocation::ContainsSubrange(" in remap.split(
    "auto handle{nvmap.GetHandle(params.handle)};", 1)[0]

env = os.environ.copy()
sdk = Path("/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX15.4.sdk")
if sdk.is_dir():
    env["SDKROOT"] = str(sdk)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-nvdrv-range-") as tmp:
    for compiler in ("clang++", "g++"):
        for opt in ("-O0", "-O2"):
            exe = Path(tmp) / f"allocation-{compiler}-{opt}"
            args = [compiler, "-std=c++20", opt, "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror",
                    "-fsanitize=address,undefined", "-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
                    "-I", str(vendor),
                    str(root / "tools/ns2/test_native_nvdrv_allocation_range.cpp"),
                    "-o", str(exe)]
            result = subprocess.run(args, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
            assert result.returncode == 0, (compiler, opt, result.stderr[-5000:])
            run_env = {**env, "ASAN_OPTIONS": "detect_leaks=0", "UBSAN_OPTIONS": "halt_on_error=1"}
            result = subprocess.run([str(exe)], env=run_env,
                                    capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
            assert result.returncode == 0, (compiler, opt, result.stderr[-5000:])
            assert "P1_2_NVDRV_ALLOCATION_RANGE_HOST_PASS" in result.stdout
            print(f"P1_2_NVDRV_RANGE_PASS compiler={compiler} opt={opt} "
                  "before_begin=guarded overflow=guarded zero=refused "
                  "source_owners=2 ASAN_UBSAN=pass")
```

```py
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <list>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
#include <optional>
#define LOG_ERROR(...) ((void)0)

struct Handle {
 std::mutex mutex;
 std::optional<Queue::iterator> unmap_queue_entry{};
 DAddr d_address{};
};
struct Smmu {
 std::size_t remaining{};
 unsigned allocations{};
 DAddr Allocate(std::size_t size) {
  ++allocations;
  if (remaining<size) return 0;
  remaining-=size;
  return DAddr{0x100000}+allocations*0x10000;
 }
 void Free(std::size_t size) {remaining+=size;}
};
struct NvMap {
 Queue unmap_queue{};
 std::mutex unmap_queue_lock{};
 Smmu smmu{};
 unsigned reclaimed{};
 void Enqueue(const std::shared_ptr<Handle>& h) {
  unmap_queue.push_back(h);
  if(h) h->unmap_queue_entry=std::prev(unmap_queue.end());
 }
 void UnmapHandle(Handle& h) {
  assert(h.unmap_queue_entry && h.d_address);
  unmap_queue.erase(*h.unmap_queue_entry);
  h.unmap_queue_entry.reset();
  h.d_address=0;
  smmu.Free(4096);
  ++reclaimed;
 }
 DAddr TryPin(const std::shared_ptr<Handle>& handle_description,
              std::size_t aligned_up) {
  DAddr address{};
  auto& smmu=this->smmu;
__REAL_LOOP__
  return address;
 }
};
int main() {
 auto h=std::make_shared<Handle>();
 NvMap empty;

 assert(empty.smmu.allocations==1 && empty.reclaimed==0);

 auto old=std::make_shared<Handle>();old->d_address=0x8000;
 one.Enqueue(old);
 assert(one.TryPin(h,4096)!=0);
 assert(old->d_address==0 && !old->unmap_queue_entry && one.unmap_queue.empty());
 assert(one.reclaimed==1 && one.smmu.allocations==2);
 NvMap two;
 auto a=std::make_shared<Handle>();a->d_address=0x8000;

 two.Enqueue(a);two.Enqueue(b);
 assert(two.TryPin(h,8192)!=0 && two.reclaimed==2);
 assert(two.unmap_queue.empty());
 NvMap stale;
 stale.Enqueue(std::shared_ptr<Handle>{});
 auto zero=std::make_shared<Handle>();stale.Enqueue(zero);
 auto valid=std::make_shared<Handle>();valid->d_address=0xa000;stale.Enqueue(valid);
 assert(stale.TryPin(h,4096)!=0 && stale.reclaimed==1);
 assert(stale.unmap_queue.empty() && !zero->unmap_queue_entry);
 NvMap self;
 self.Enqueue(h);
 assert(self.TryPin(h,4096)==0 && !h->unmap_queue_entry && self.unmap_queue.empty());
 NvMap exhausted;
 exhausted.Enqueue(std::shared_ptr<Handle>{});
 assert(exhausted.TryPin(h,8192)==0 && exhausted.smmu.allocations==2);

 busy.Enqueue(locked);

  std::unique_lock guard(locked->mutex);
  assert(busy.TryPin(h,4096)==0 && busy.reclaimed==0);
  assert(busy.unmap_queue.size()==1);

  assert(mixed.TryPin(h,4096)!=0 && mixed.reclaimed==1);
  assert(mixed.unmap_queue.size()==1);
  assert(mixed.unmap_queue.front().get()==busy_first.get());
 }
 assert(mixed.TryPin(h,4096)!=0 && mixed.reclaimed==2);
}
'''.replace('__REAL_LOOP__',loop)
```

```py
        // Cross-owner single transaction. The host's Close() fixture
        // models last KProcess reference and page-table ownership.
        for(unsigned fault=0;fault<5;++fault) {

                        !process.m_process && obj->released &&

                        "H01 late rejection leaked KProcess, pages or RomFS");
                if(fault!=3)
                    Require(obj->m_memory.writes==1,
                            "H01 expected real guest NSO write before late failure");

                    Require(obj->m_memory.writes==0,

                  << " accepted_pid_romfs=1 late_faults=rolled_back"
                  << " guest_pages_and_trace=retired host_kernel_fs=stubs"
                  << " PS5=not_exercised\n";
"""
```

`tools/ns2/check_native_puller_semaphore_shutdown_host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Execute the genuine native GPU puller Acquire semaphore loop on host.

Tests completed waits, shutdown, and GPU-worker failure against the same
loop as shared NS1. This never claims hardware/GPU-fence completion on PS5.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
NATIVE = ROOT/'vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/gpu_dispatch/video_core/engines/puller.cpp'
SHARED = ROOT/'vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/video_core/engines/puller.cpp'
DEV = ROOT/'vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/video_core/engines/puller_dev.cpp'
START = 'void Puller::ProcessSemaphoreAcquire(DmaPusher& dma_pusher) {'
END = '\n/// Calls a GPU puller method.'


def get_method(path: Path) -> str:
    source = path.read_text()
    assert source.count(START) == 1 and source.count(END) == 1, path
    return START + source.split(START, 1)[1].split(END, 1)[0]

native = get_method(NATIVE)
shared = get_method(SHARED)
assert native == shared, 'NS2 native puller diverged from shipping NS1 wait semantics'
assert '#ifdef PS5_NATIVE\n#include "gpu_failure.h"\n#endif' in NATIVE.read_text()
assert 'IsShuttingDown()' in native and '::Eden::PeekGpuFailure()' in native
# DEV has a timing diagnostic wrapper only; it must retain the same safety checks.
assert 'IsShuttingDown()' in get_method(DEV)
assert '::Eden::PeekGpuFailure()' in get_method(DEV)

cpp = r'''
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <exception>
#include <stdexcept>
using u32 = std::uint32_t;
namespace Eden {
static unsigned checks = 0;
static bool failed = false;
std::exception_ptr PeekGpuFailure() {
    ++checks;
    if (failed) return std::make_exception_ptr(std::runtime_error("worker failed"));
    return {};
}
}
struct SemaphoreAddressRegister {
    constexpr u32 SemaphoreAddress() const { return 0x1234; }
};
struct FakeMemory {
    u32 word = 0;
    unsigned reads = 0;
    template <typename T> T Read(u32 addr) {
        assert(addr == 0x1234);
        ++reads;
        return static_cast<T>(word);
    }
};
struct FakeSystem {
    bool stopping = false;
    bool IsShuttingDown() const { return stopping; }
};
struct DmaPusher;
struct FakeRasterizer {
    DmaPusher* pusher = nullptr;
    unsigned releases = 0;
    unsigned complete_at = 0;
    unsigned stop_at = 0;
    unsigned fail_at = 0;
    void ReleaseFences();
};
struct DmaPusher {
    FakeMemory memory_manager{};
    FakeSystem system{};
    FakeRasterizer* rasterizer = nullptr;
};
void FakeRasterizer::ReleaseFences() {
    ++releases;
    if (complete_at != 0 && releases == complete_at)
        pusher->memory_manager.word = 77;
    if (stop_at != 0 && releases == stop_at)
        pusher->system.stopping = true;
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    if (fail_at != 0 && releases == fail_at)
        Eden::failed = true;
#endif
}
class Puller {
public:
    struct Registers {
        SemaphoreAddressRegister semaphore_address{};
        u32 semaphore_acquire = 77;
        bool acquire_active{}, acquire_mode{}, acquire_source{};
        u32 acquire_value{};
    } regs;
    void ProcessSemaphoreAcquire(DmaPusher& dma_pusher);
};
__REAL_METHOD__
int main() {
    FakeRasterizer gpu;
    DmaPusher dma;
    dma.rasterizer = &gpu;
    gpu.pusher = &dma;
    Puller puller;
    // Already satisfied: no needless queue release or failure probe.
    dma.memory_manager.word = 77;
    puller.ProcessSemaphoreAcquire(dma);
    assert(dma.memory_manager.reads == 1 && gpu.releases == 0);
    // The GPU genuinely advances a wait; no artificial success is returned.
    dma.memory_manager.word = 0;
    dma.memory_manager.reads = 0;
    gpu.complete_at = 3;
    puller.ProcessSemaphoreAcquire(dma);
    assert(gpu.releases == 3 && dma.memory_manager.reads == 4);
    assert(puller.regs.acquire_active && puller.regs.acquire_value == 77);
    // An unsatisfied guest wait cannot strand shutdown forever.
    dma.memory_manager.word = 0;
    gpu.complete_at = 0;
    gpu.releases = 0;
    gpu.stop_at = 2;
    puller.ProcessSemaphoreAcquire(dma);
    assert(gpu.releases == 2 && dma.system.stopping);
    gpu.releases = 0;
    const unsigned already_read = dma.memory_manager.reads;
    puller.ProcessSemaphoreAcquire(dma);
    assert(gpu.releases == 0 && dma.memory_manager.reads == already_read + 1);
#ifdef PS5_NATIVE
    // A reported failed worker must propagate before any new GPU release.
    dma.system.stopping = false;
    gpu.stop_at = 0;
    gpu.releases = 0;
    Eden::failed = true;
    const unsigned old_checks = Eden::checks;
    try {
        puller.ProcessSemaphoreAcquire(dma);
        assert(false && "failed worker was swallowed");
    } catch (const std::runtime_error&) { }
    assert(gpu.releases == 0 && Eden::checks == old_checks + 1);
    // Polling is bounded: the second failure check occurs after 64 releases.
    Eden::failed = false;
    gpu.fail_at = 1;
    gpu.releases = 0;
    const unsigned before_delayed_checks = Eden::checks;
    try {
        puller.ProcessSemaphoreAcquire(dma);
        assert(false && "deferred GPU worker failure was swallowed");
    } catch (const std::runtime_error&) { }
    assert(gpu.releases == 64);
    assert(Eden::checks == before_delayed_checks + 2);
    Eden::failed = false;
#endif
    std::puts("P2_7_NATIVE_PULLER_SEMAPHORE_LIVENESS_PASS");
}
'''
# The first-sample test proves propagation. Delayed failure sampling is
# source-checked explicitly to avoid mocking failure into an unrelated class.
assert '(acquire_polls++ & 63u) == 0u' in native


def main() -> None:
    compilers = list(dict.fromkeys(p for p in (
        shutil.which('clang++'), shutil.which('g++')) if p))
    assert compilers, 'C++20 host compiler missing'
    env = os.environ.copy()
    sdk=Path('/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX15.4.sdk')
    if sdk.is_dir(): env['SDKROOT'] = str(sdk)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='encore-puller-acquire-') as scratch:
        source=Path(scratch)/'semaphore.cpp'
        source.write_text(cpp.replace('__REAL_METHOD__', native))
        for compiler in compilers:
            for native_mode in (False, True):
                for opt in (0, 2):
                    exe=Path(scratch)/f'{Path(compiler).name}-{int(native_mode)}-{opt}'
                    cmd=[compiler,'-std=c++20',f'-O{opt}','-Wall','-Wextra',
                         '-Werror','-fsanitize=undefined','-fno-sanitize-recover=all']
                    if native_mode: cmd.append('-DPS5_NATIVE=1')
                    cmd += [str(source),'-o',str(exe)]
                    build=subprocess.run(cmd,env=env,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=45)
                    assert build.returncode==0,build.stderr[-3000:]
                    run=subprocess.run([str(exe)],env=env,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=15)
                    assert run.returncode==0,run.stderr[-3000:]
                    assert 'P2_7_NATIVE_PULLER_SEMAPHORE_LIVENESS_PASS' in run.stdout
                    print('P2_7_NATIVE_SEMAPHORE_HOST_PASS',Path(compiler).name,
                          'O'+str(opt), 'PS5' if native_mode else 'shared',flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""G10 joined host witness: extract actual GPFIFO Ampere QMD3 puller and
SEM_EXECUTE acquire owners, run through native QMD scheduler, a real Vulkan
vkCmdDispatch/VkFence and a second guest channel.

The Vulkan shader/pipeline and guest GMMU/GPFIFO worker are host fixtures,

from pathlib import Path
import os
import shutil
import subprocess

struct MemoryManager {
    Tegra::NativeQmdScheduler::Descriptor qmd{};
    u32 guest{},replacement{777};
    bool qmd_mapped{true},program_mapped{true},release_mapped{true},remapped{};
    unsigned writes{};
    bool IsMemoryDirty(u64,std::size_t)const{return false;}
    bool IsFullyMappedRange(GPUVAddr address,std::size_t length)const {
        if(address==0x2000 && length==sizeof(qmd))return qmd_mapped;
        if(address==0x5000 && length==16)return program_mapped;
        if(address==0x4000 && length==4)return release_mapped;
        return false;
    }
    std::optional<u64> GpuToCpuAddress(GPUVAddr addr,std::size_t len)const {
        return IsFullyMappedRange(addr,len) && addr==0x4000
            ?std::optional<u64>{0x9000}:std::nullopt;
    }
    void ReadBlock(u64 address,void* out,std::size_t size)const {
        if(!IsFullyMappedRange(address,size))throw std::runtime_error("QMD unmapped");
        std::memcpy(out,qmd.data(),size);
    }
    u32* GetPointer(u64 addr) {
        return IsFullyMappedRange(addr,sizeof(u32)) && addr==0x4000
           ?(remapped?&replacement:&guest):nullptr;
    }
    template<class T>T Read(u64 addr) {
        if(!GetPointer(addr))throw std::runtime_error("unmapped guest read");
        return static_cast<T>(guest);
    }
    template<class T>void Write(u64 addr,T value) {
        if(!GetPointer(addr))throw std::runtime_error("unmapped guest write");
        ++writes;guest=static_cast<u32>(value);
    }
};

struct NativeGpuChannelRegistry {
    struct Ticket {
        const void* process{};
        u64 generation{},channel_generation{};
    };
    inline static int native_process=1;
    std::shared_ptr<Tegra::NativeQmdSession> qmd=
        std::make_shared<Tegra::NativeQmdSession>();
    static NativeGpuChannelRegistry& Instance() {
        static NativeGpuChannelRegistry registry;return registry;
    }
    std::optional<Ticket> CaptureTicket(const ChannelState* c)const {
        if(!c || !c->epoch)return {};
        return Ticket{&native_process,7,c->epoch};
    }
    std::optional<Ticket> CaptureComputeTicket(const ComputeEngine* e)const {
        if(!e || !e->epoch)return {};
        return Ticket{&native_process,7,e->epoch};
    }
    bool IsNative(const ChannelState* c)const{
        return CaptureTicket(c).has_value();
    }
    bool IsCurrent(const ChannelState* c,Ticket t)const {
        const auto now=CaptureTicket(c);
        return now && now->process==t.process &&
               now->generation==t.generation &&
               now->channel_generation==t.channel_generation;
    }
    bool IsComputeCurrent(const ComputeEngine* e,Ticket t)const {
        const auto now=CaptureComputeTicket(e);
        return now && now->process==t.process &&
               now->generation==t.generation &&
               now->channel_generation==t.channel_generation;
    }
    std::shared_ptr<Tegra::NativeQmdSession>
    AcquireNativeQmdSession(const ChannelState* c){
        return CaptureTicket(c)?qmd:nullptr;
    }

class VulkanCompute {
    VkInstance instance{};
    VkPhysicalDevice physical{};
    VkDevice device{};
    VkQueue queue{};
    VkPipelineLayout pipeline_layout{};
    VkShaderModule module{};
    VkPipeline pipeline{};
    VkCommandPool pool{};
    VkCommandBuffer command{};
    VkFence fence{};
public:
    VulkanCompute() {
        VkApplicationInfo ai{};ai.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_APPLICATION_INFO;
        ai.apiVersion=VK_API_VERSION_1_1;
        VkInstanceCreateInfo ici{};ici.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_INSTANCE_CREATE_INFO;
        ici.pApplicationInfo=&ai;
        assert(vkCreateInstance(&ici,nullptr,&instance)==VK_SUCCESS);
        u32 count{};
        assert(vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices(instance,&count,nullptr)==VK_SUCCESS&&count);
        std::vector<VkPhysicalDevice> devices(count);
        assert(vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices(instance,&count,devices.data())==VK_SUCCESS);
        u32 family{};bool found{};
        for(auto p:devices){
            u32 q{};vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties(p,&q,nullptr);
            std::vector<VkQueueFamilyProperties> props(q);
            vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties(p,&q,props.data());
            for(u32 i=0;i<q;++i)
                if(props[i].queueCount && (props[i].queueFlags & VK_QUEUE_COMPUTE_BIT)){
                    physical=p;family=i;found=true;break;
                }
            if(found)break;
        }
        assert(found);
        const float priority=1.f;
        VkDeviceQueueCreateInfo qi{};qi.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_QUEUE_CREATE_INFO;
        qi.queueFamilyIndex=family;qi.queueCount=1;qi.pQueuePriorities=&priority;
        VkDeviceCreateInfo di{};di.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_CREATE_INFO;
        di.queueCreateInfoCount=1;di.pQueueCreateInfos=&qi;
        assert(vkCreateDevice(physical,&di,nullptr,&device)==VK_SUCCESS);
        vkGetDeviceQueue(device,family,0,&queue);
        // A genuine compute VkPipeline, but a bounded empty host shader:
        // no pretense this is the real translated guest Ampere program.
        static constexpr std::array<u32,35> spirv{
            0x07230203,0x00010000,0,6,0,
            0x00020011,1,
            0x0003000e,0,1,
            0x0005000f,5,4,0x6e69616d,0,
            0x00060010,4,17,1,1,1,
            0x00020013,2,
            0x00030021,3,2,
            0x00050036,2,4,0,3,
            0x000200f8,5,
            0x000100fd,
            0x00010038
        };
        VkShaderModuleCreateInfo sm{};sm.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SHADER_MODULE_CREATE_INFO;
        sm.codeSize=spirv.size()*sizeof(u32);sm.pCode=spirv.data();
        assert(vkCreateShaderModule(device,&sm,nullptr,&module)==VK_SUCCESS);
        VkPipelineLayoutCreateInfo li{};li.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO;
        assert(vkCreatePipelineLayout(device,&li,nullptr,&pipeline_layout)==VK_SUCCESS);
        VkComputePipelineCreateInfo ci{};ci.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMPUTE_PIPELINE_CREATE_INFO;
        ci.stage.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_SHADER_STAGE_CREATE_INFO;
        ci.stage.stage=VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT;
        ci.stage.module=module;ci.stage.pName="main";
        ci.layout=pipeline_layout;
        assert(vkCreateComputePipelines(device,VK_NULL_HANDLE,1,&ci,nullptr,&pipeline)==VK_SUCCESS);
        VkCommandPoolCreateInfo pi{};pi.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_POOL_CREATE_INFO;
        pi.queueFamilyIndex=family;
        pi.flags=VK_COMMAND_POOL_CREATE_RESET_COMMAND_BUFFER_BIT;
        assert(vkCreateCommandPool(device,&pi,nullptr,&pool)==VK_SUCCESS);
        VkCommandBufferAllocateInfo alloc{};alloc.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_ALLOCATE_INFO;
        alloc.commandPool=pool;alloc.level=VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_LEVEL_PRIMARY;
        alloc.commandBufferCount=1;
        assert(vkAllocateCommandBuffers(device,&alloc,&command)==VK_SUCCESS);
        VkFenceCreateInfo fi{};fi.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_FENCE_CREATE_INFO;
        assert(vkCreateFence(device,&fi,nullptr,&fence)==VK_SUCCESS);
    }
    bool Submit(const Tegra::NativeComputeLaunch& launch){
        assert((launch.program_address==0x5000 && launch.grid==std::array<u32,3>{1,1,1}));
        assert(vkResetCommandBuffer(command,0)==VK_SUCCESS);
        assert(vkResetFences(device,1,&fence)==VK_SUCCESS);
        VkCommandBufferBeginInfo bi{};bi.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_BEGIN_INFO;
        assert(vkBeginCommandBuffer(command,&bi)==VK_SUCCESS);
        vkCmdBindPipeline(command,VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_COMPUTE,pipeline);
        vkCmdDispatch(command,launch.grid[0],launch.grid[1],launch.grid[2]);
        assert(vkEndCommandBuffer(command)==VK_SUCCESS);
        VkSubmitInfo submit{};submit.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SUBMIT_INFO;
        submit.commandBufferCount=1;submit.pCommandBuffers=&command;
        return vkQueueSubmit(queue,1,&submit,fence)==VK_SUCCESS;
    }
    void Retire(){
        assert(vkWaitForFences(device,1,&fence,VK_TRUE,10000000000ULL)==VK_SUCCESS);
    }
    ~VulkanCompute(){
        if(device)vkDeviceWaitIdle(device);
        if(fence)vkDestroyFence(device,fence,nullptr);
        if(pool)vkDestroyCommandPool(device,pool,nullptr);
        if(pipeline)vkDestroyPipeline(device,pipeline,nullptr);
        if(module)vkDestroyShaderModule(device,module,nullptr);
        if(pipeline_layout)vkDestroyPipelineLayout(device,pipeline_layout,nullptr);
        if(device)vkDestroyDevice(device,nullptr);
        if(instance)vkDestroyInstance(instance,nullptr);
    }
};
struct Rasterizer {
    VulkanCompute vulkan;
    std::function<void()> callback;
    unsigned dispatches{},fences{},flushes{};
    bool dirty{};
    bool DispatchNativeCompute(const Tegra::NativeComputeLaunch& launch){
        if(callback)return false;
        if(!vulkan.Submit(launch))return false;
        ++dispatches;
        return true;
    }
    void SignalFence(std::function<void()> done){
        assert(!callback);callback=std::move(done);++fences;
    }
    void Retire(){
        vulkan.Retire();
        auto fn=std::move(callback);
        callback={};
        if(fn)fn();
        dirty=true;
    }
    bool MustFlushRegion(u64 cpu,std::size_t size,VideoCommon::CacheType)const{
        assert(cpu==0x9000&&size==4);
        return dirty;
    }
    void FlushRegion(u64 cpu,std::size_t size,VideoCommon::CacheType){
        assert(cpu==0x9000&&size==4);
        dirty=false;++flushes;
    }
    void ReleaseFences(){}
    void Query(u64,VideoCommon::QueryType,VideoCommon::QueryPropertiesFlags,u32,u32){}
};
struct Puller;

struct Puller {
    struct Regs{std::array<u32,64> reg_array{};}regs;
    struct PendingNativeAcquire {
        GPUVAddr address{};u32 value{},operation{};u64 cpu_address{};
        const void* process{};
        u64 process_generation{},channel_generation{};
    };
    std::optional<PendingNativeAcquire> pending_native_acquire;
    bool ResumeNativeAcquire(DmaPusher&);
    void ProcessNativeSemaphoreExecute(DmaPusher&,u32);
    void ProcessNativeComputeQmd(DmaPusher&,u32,u32,u32);
    void ProcessNativeComputeQmdAt(DmaPusher&,GPUVAddr,u32,u32,u32);
};
__REAL_SEMAPHORES__
__REAL_QMD_CALL__
__REAL_QMD_DISPATCH__
__REAL_DMA_DISPATCH__
__REAL_DMA_STEP__
bool DmaPusher::ResumeNativeAcquire(){
    return !active_puller || active_puller->ResumeNativeAcquire(*this);
}
bool DmaPusher::HasPendingNativeAcquire()const{
    return active_puller && active_puller->pending_native_acquire.has_value();
}
void DmaPusher::ProcessCommands(std::span<const CommandHeader> commands){
    assert(active_puller);
    for(const auto& command:commands){
        if(command.kind==1)
            active_puller->ProcessNativeComputeQmd(*this,0xb0,command.argument,0);
        else if(command.kind==2)
            active_puller->ProcessNativeSemaphoreExecute(*this,command.argument);
        else
            throw std::runtime_error("host GPFIFO header unknown");
        ++command_resume_offset;
        if(HasPendingNativeAcquire())return;
    }
}
int main(){
    MemoryManager memory;
    memory.qmd[12]=1;memory.qmd[13]=1;memory.qmd[14]=1;
    memory.qmd[18]=0x30U | (1U<<16);
    memory.qmd[19]=1U | (1U<<16);
    memory.qmd[48]=0x5000;
    memory.qmd[24]=0x4000;
    memory.qmd[25]=(1U<<23)|(1U<<30);
    memory.qmd[26]=17;
    Rasterizer gpu;
    DmaPusher producer{memory,&gpu,41},consumer{memory,&gpu,42};
    Puller qmd_puller,wait_puller;
    producer.active_puller=&qmd_puller;
    consumer.active_puller=&wait_puller;
    producer.channel_state.payload->kepler_compute.regs.reg_array[0xad]=0x20;
    wait_puller.regs.reg_array[0x17]=0x4000;
    wait_puller.regs.reg_array[0x18]=0;
    wait_puller.regs.reg_array[0x19]=17;
    // A malformed or unmapped release refuses before any Vulkan shader.
    memory.release_mapped=false;
    bool rejected=false;
    try{qmd_puller.ProcessNativeComputeQmd(producer,0xb0,3,0);}
    catch(const std::runtime_error&){rejected=true;}
    assert(rejected && gpu.dispatches==0 && memory.writes==0);
    memory.release_mapped=true;
    // Real DmaPusher::DispatchCalls and Step own both GPFIFO prefetch
    // queues. Only the method-word decoder is a host adapter.
    CommandList launch;
    launch.prefetch_command_list.push_back({1,3});
    producer.dma_pushbuffer.push(std::move(launch));
    producer.DispatchCalls();
    assert(producer.dma_pushbuffer.empty() && producer.system.gpu.ends==1 &&
           gpu.dispatches==1 && gpu.fences==1 &&
           memory.guest==0 && memory.writes==0);
    CommandList acquire;
    acquire.prefetch_command_list.push_back({2,0});
    consumer.dma_pushbuffer.push(std::move(acquire));
    consumer.DispatchCalls();
    assert(wait_puller.pending_native_acquire &&
           consumer.dma_pushbuffer.size()==1 &&
           consumer.command_resume_offset==1 &&
           !wait_puller.ResumeNativeAcquire(consumer));
    // Duplicate PCAS must not dispatch or publish a second release.
    qmd_puller.ProcessNativeComputeQmd(producer,0xb0,2,0);
    assert(gpu.dispatches==1 && gpu.fences==1 && memory.guest==0);
    gpu.Retire(); // genuine VkFence after real vkCmdDispatch, not synthetic
    consumer.DispatchCalls(); // same real GPFIFO Step resumes and retires
    assert(memory.guest==17 && memory.writes==1 &&
           consumer.dma_pushbuffer.empty() &&
           !wait_puller.pending_native_acquire && !Eden::fatal);
    // Reject an unsupported real PCAS action without a host submission.
    rejected=false;
    try{qmd_puller.ProcessNativeComputeQmd(producer,0xb0,6,0);}
    catch(const std::runtime_error&){rejected=true;}
    assert(rejected && gpu.dispatches==1 && memory.writes==1);
    // Backing replacement after an accepted real dispatch must latch a
    // native failure, leave the original guest release untouched.
    memory.qmd[26]=18;
    qmd_puller.ProcessNativeComputeQmd(producer,0xb0,3,0);
    assert(gpu.dispatches==2 && memory.guest==17);
    memory.remapped=true;
    gpu.Retire();
    assert(Eden::fatal && memory.guest==17 && memory.writes==1 &&
           memory.replacement==777);
    Eden::fatal=nullptr;memory.remapped=false;
    // A retired GPFIFO epoch must not write to a replacement guest channel.
    memory.qmd[26]=19;
    qmd_puller.ProcessNativeComputeQmd(producer,0xb0,3,0);
    assert(gpu.dispatches==3);
    ++producer.channel_state.epoch;
    ++producer.channel_state.payload->kepler_compute.epoch;
    gpu.Retire();
    assert(memory.guest==17 && memory.writes==1 && !Eden::fatal);
    wait_puller.regs.reg_array[0x19]=19;
    wait_puller.ProcessNativeSemaphoreExecute(consumer,0);
    assert(wait_puller.pending_native_acquire &&
           !wait_puller.ResumeNativeAcquire(consumer));
    std::puts("G10_JOINED_REAL_QMD3_PULLER_VULKAN_SEM_PASS"
              " qmd_pcas_owner=real compute_launch_owner=real"
              " native_semaphore_owner=real VkCmdDispatch=1 VkFence=retired"
              " guest_release_after_fence=1 cross_channel_acquire=1"
              " unmapped_release=refused duplicate_pcas=held"
              " unsupported_pcas=refused backing_reuse=latched"
              " revoked_epoch=no_completion"
              " real_dma_step_dispatchcalls=1 prefetch_queue_retired_after_fence=1"
              " host_shader_and_command_decoder_stubs=1 PS5=not_exercised");
}
"""
```
