`tools/ns2/check_native_qmd_deferred_fence_host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""P4.2: execute the two real deferred Ampere QMD3 fence bodies under faults.

This is a C++20 host fixture, NOT proof of Vulkan or PS5 hardware execution.
Both callbacks come directly from the versioned production puller source.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
PULLER = ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/gpu_dispatch/video_core/engines/puller.cpp"
source = PULLER.read_text()

def fenced_body(marker):
    assert source.count(marker) == 1, marker
    remaining = source.split(marker, 1)[1]
    start = remaining.index("                try {")
    end = remaining.index("\n            });", start)
    body = remaining[start:end]
    assert body.count("Eden::RecordGpuFailure(std::current_exception());") == 1
    assert body.count("catch (...)") == 1
    assert "#ifdef PS5_NATIVE" in body
    return body

reduction = fenced_body("// The deferred fence may execute after a sparse GMMU unmap.")
release = fenced_body("// A QMD3 dispatch can already be accepted when this")

fixture = r"""
#include <algorithm>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <stdexcept>
#include "gpu_failure.h"
#include "video_core/native_qmd.h"
using u32 = std::uint32_t;
using u64 = std::uint64_t;
namespace Service::Nvidia::Devices {
class NativeGpuChannelRegistry {
    bool active{true};
public:
    void Revoke() {active=false;}
    static NativeGpuChannelRegistry& Instance() {
        static NativeGpuChannelRegistry instance;
        return instance;
    }
    bool IsCurrent(const int* channel, int ticket) const {
        return active && channel && ticket == 7;
    }
};
}
struct Memory {
    bool mapped = true;
    bool remapped = false;
    bool fail_map = false;
    bool fail_read = false;
    bool fail_write = false;
    u32 stored = 5;
    u32 replacement_word = 777;
    unsigned writes = 0;
    bool IsFullyMappedRange(u64, std::size_t) {
        if (fail_map) throw std::runtime_error("mapping race");
        return mapped;
    }
    // The maintained deferred QMD3 release checks the CPU backing
    // pointer in addition to the GMMU span. Keep the test's fail_map
    // exception behavior so a late backing failure is still latched.
    u32* GetPointer(u64) {
        if (fail_map) throw std::runtime_error("mapping race");
        return mapped ? (remapped ? &replacement_word : &stored) : nullptr;
    }
    template<class T> T Read(u64) {
        if (fail_read) throw std::runtime_error("guest read fault");
        return static_cast<T>(stored);
    }
    template<class T> void Write(u64, T value) {
        if (fail_write) throw std::runtime_error("guest write fault");
        stored = static_cast<u32>(value);
        ++writes;
    }
};
int main() {
    int owner = 42;
    const int* channel = &owner;
    int ticket = 7;
    Memory data;
    auto* memory = &data;
    u64 address = 0x2000;
    u64 addr = address;
    u32 payload = 3;
    u32 reduction = 0;
    u32 flags = 1u << 26;
    const auto reduced = [channel, memory, ticket, address, payload, reduction] {
__REDUCTION__
    };
    // This is the exact backing identity captured by the shipping QMD3
    // release owner before GPU submission, not a newly looked-up pointer.
    const auto* const backing = data.GetPointer(addr);
    const auto released = [channel, memory, ticket, addr, payload, flags, backing] {
__RELEASE__
    };
    Eden::ResetGpuFailureForTitle();
    reduced();
    assert(data.stored == 8 && data.writes == 1 && !Eden::PeekGpuFailure());
    data.mapped = false;
    reduced();
    assert(data.writes == 1 && Eden::PeekGpuFailure());
    Eden::ResetGpuFailureForTitle();
    data.mapped = true;
    data.fail_map = true;
    reduced();
    assert(data.writes == 1 && Eden::PeekGpuFailure());
    Eden::ResetGpuFailureForTitle();
    data.fail_map = false;
    data.fail_read = true;
    reduced();
    assert(data.writes == 1 && Eden::PeekGpuFailure());
    Eden::ResetGpuFailureForTitle();
    data.fail_read = false;
    data.fail_write = true;
    reduced();
    assert(data.stored == 8 && data.writes == 1 && Eden::PeekGpuFailure());
    Eden::ResetGpuFailureForTitle();
    data.fail_write = false;
    released();
    assert(data.stored == 11 && data.writes == 2 && !Eden::PeekGpuFailure());
    data.fail_map = true;
    released();
    assert(data.writes == 2 && Eden::PeekGpuFailure());
    Eden::ResetGpuFailureForTitle();
    data.fail_map = false;
    data.fail_read = true;
    released();
    assert(data.writes == 2 && Eden::PeekGpuFailure());
    Eden::ResetGpuFailureForTitle();
    data.fail_read = false;
    data.fail_write = true;
    released();
    assert(data.writes == 2 && Eden::PeekGpuFailure());
    Eden::ResetGpuFailureForTitle();
    data.fail_write = false;
    released();
    assert(data.writes == 3 && data.stored == 14);
    Eden::ResetGpuFailureForTitle();
    // A guest GMMU VA may be recycled for a different backing before
    // VkFence retirement even while the channel ticket remains current.
    data.remapped = true;
    released();
    assert(data.writes == 3 && data.stored == 14 &&
           data.replacement_word == 777 && Eden::PeekGpuFailure());
    Eden::ResetGpuFailureForTitle();
    data.remapped = false;
    Service::Nvidia::Devices::NativeGpuChannelRegistry::Instance().Revoke();
    // The callback captured the historical ticket, but the registry revoked
    // that epoch. Neither deferred path may publish a stale guest completion.
    reduced();
    released();
    assert(data.writes == 3 && data.stored == 14 && !Eden::PeekGpuFailure());
    std::puts("P4_2_NATIVE_DEFERRED_FENCE_FAULT_HOST_PASS");
}
"""
fixture = fixture.replace("__REDUCTION__", reduction).replace("__RELEASE__", release)
sdk = Path("/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX15.4.sdk")
env = os.environ.copy()
if sdk.exists():
    env["SDKROOT"] = str(sdk)
compilers = list(dict.fromkeys(filter(None, (
    shutil.which("clang++"), shutil.which("g++")))))
assert compilers
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-qmd-fence-fault-") as folder:
    src = Path(folder) / "test.cpp"
    src.write_text(fixture)
    for compiler in compilers:
        for opt in ("-O0", "-O2"):
            out = Path(folder) / (Path(compiler).name.replace("+", "p") + opt)
            args = [compiler, "-std=c++20", opt, "-Wall", "-Wextra",
                    "-Werror", "-Wno-unused-parameter", "-pthread",
                    "-DPS5_NATIVE=1", "-fsanitize=undefined",
                    "-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
                    "-I"+str(ROOT/"headless"),
                    "-I"+str(ROOT/"vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/gpu_dispatch"),
                    str(src), "-o", str(out)]
            built = subprocess.run(args, env=env, text=True,
                                   capture_output=True, timeout=45)
            assert built.returncode == 0, (compiler, built.stderr[-2700:])
            ran = subprocess.run([str(out)], env=env, text=True,
                                 capture_output=True, timeout=15)
            assert ran.returncode == 0, (compiler, ran.stderr[-2700:])
            assert "P4_2_NATIVE_DEFERRED_FENCE_FAULT_HOST_PASS" in ran.stdout
            print("P4_2_NATIVE_DEFERRED_QMD_FENCE_PASS", Path(compiler).name,
                  opt, "read/write/unmap=latched revoked_channel=no_completion", flush=True)
```

```py
using VkImage=void*;

};
static int calls=0;
static VkResult output=VK_SUCCESS;
static VkQueue expected_queue=reinterpret_cast<void*>(0x1234);
static VkImage expected_image=reinterpret_cast<void*>(0x2345);
static VkFence expected_fence=reinterpret_cast<void*>(0x3456);
static bool expect_tiles=true, expect_tails=true;
static VkSemaphore expect_wait=nullptr, expect_signal=nullptr;
static VkResult Dispatch(VkQueue queue,u32 count,const VkBindSparseInfo* binds,VkFence fence) {
    assert(queue==expected_queue&&count==1&&binds&&fence==expected_fence);
    const auto& s=binds[0];
    assert(s.sType==VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BIND_SPARSE_INFO);
    assert(s.bufferBindCount==0);
    assert(s.waitSemaphoreCount==(expect_wait?1U:0U));
    assert(s.signalSemaphoreCount==(expect_signal?1U:0U));
    assert(expect_wait ? (s.pWaitSemaphores && *s.pWaitSemaphores==expect_wait) : !s.pWaitSemaphores);
    assert(expect_signal ? (s.pSignalSemaphores && *s.pSignalSemaphores==expect_signal) : !s.pSignalSemaphores);
    assert(s.imageBindCount==(expect_tiles?1U:0U));
    assert(s.imageOpaqueBindCount==(expect_tails?1U:0U));
    if(expect_tiles) {
        assert(s.pImageBinds && s.pImageBinds->image==expected_image);
        assert(s.pImageBinds->bindCount==1 && s.pImageBinds->pBinds);
        assert(s.pImageBinds->pBinds[0].extent.width==64);
    } else assert(!s.pImageBinds);
    if(expect_tails) {
        assert(s.pImageOpaqueBinds && s.pImageOpaqueBinds->image==expected_image);
        assert(s.pImageOpaqueBinds->bindCount==1 && s.pImageOpaqueBinds->pBinds);
        assert(s.pImageOpaqueBinds->pBinds[0].size==65536);
    } else assert(!s.pImageOpaqueBinds);
    ++calls; return output;

int main(){
    DeviceDispatch d{Dispatch};
    Queue q{expected_queue,&d};
    VkSparseImageMemoryBind tile{};
    tile.memory=reinterpret_cast<void*>(0x111);
    tile.extent={64,64,1};
    tile.subresource.aspectMask=1;
    VkSparseMemoryBind tail{};
    tail.memory=reinterpret_cast<void*>(0x222);
    tail.size=65536;
    const Span<VkSparseImageMemoryBind> tiles{tile};
    const Span<VkSparseMemoryBind> tails{tail};
    const Span<VkSparseImageMemoryBind> no_tiles{};
    const Span<VkSparseMemoryBind> no_tails{};
    // Fail closed before any driver call.
    assert(q.BindSparseImage(nullptr,tiles,tails,expected_fence)==VK_ERROR_INITIALIZATION_FAILED);
    assert(q.BindSparseImage(expected_image,tiles,tails,nullptr)==VK_ERROR_INITIALIZATION_FAILED);
    assert(q.BindSparseImage(expected_image,no_tiles,no_tails,expected_fence)==VK_ERROR_INITIALIZATION_FAILED);
    tile.memory=nullptr;
    assert(q.BindSparseImage(expected_image,tiles,tails,expected_fence)==VK_ERROR_INITIALIZATION_FAILED);
    tile.memory=reinterpret_cast<void*>(0x111);
    tile.extent.width=0;
    assert(q.BindSparseImage(expected_image,tiles,tails,expected_fence)==VK_ERROR_INITIALIZATION_FAILED);
    tile.extent.width=64;
    tile.subresource.aspectMask=0;
    assert(q.BindSparseImage(expected_image,tiles,tails,expected_fence)==VK_ERROR_INITIALIZATION_FAILED);
    tile.subresource.aspectMask=1;
    tail.size=0;
    assert(q.BindSparseImage(expected_image,tiles,tails,expected_fence)==VK_ERROR_INITIALIZATION_FAILED);
    tail.size=65536;
    assert(q.BindSparseImage(expected_image,Span<VkSparseImageMemoryBind>{&tile,65537},tails,expected_fence)==VK_ERROR_INITIALIZATION_FAILED);
    assert(calls==0);
    assert(q.BindSparseImage(expected_image,tiles,tails,expected_fence)==VK_SUCCESS&&calls==1);
    expect_tails=false;
    assert(q.BindSparseImage(expected_image,tiles,no_tails,expected_fence)==VK_SUCCESS&&calls==2);
    expect_tails=true; expect_tiles=false;
    assert(q.BindSparseImage(expected_image,no_tiles,tails,expected_fence)==VK_SUCCESS&&calls==3);
    expect_tiles=true;
    output=VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST;
    assert(q.BindSparseImage(expected_image,tiles,tails,expected_fence)==VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST&&calls==4);

    const VkSemaphore signal=reinterpret_cast<void*>(0x5678);

    assert(q.BindSparseImage(expected_image,tiles,tails,expected_fence)==VK_ERROR_FEATURE_NOT_PRESENT);
```

```py
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>

#include <span>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>
using VkImage=void*;

using VkSemaphore=void*;
using VkResult=int;
constexpr VkResult VK_SUCCESS=0,VK_ERROR_INITIALIZATION_FAILED=-3,VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST=-4;
struct VkSparseImageMemoryBind {int n{};};
struct VkSparseMemoryBind {int n{};};
#define EDEN_NS2_SPARSE_QUEUE_BRIDGE 1
struct TestMutex {
 std::mutex inner;
 std::atomic<bool> held{false};
 void lock(){inner.lock(); held.store(true,std::memory_order_release);}
 void unlock(){held.store(false,std::memory_order_release); inner.unlock();}
 bool try_lock(){if(!inner.try_lock())return false;held.store(true,std::memory_order_release);return true;}
};
namespace Vulkan {
namespace vk {template<class T>using Span=std::span<const T>;}
struct Observed {
 std::atomic<int> entered{}, max_overlap{}, calls{}, bad_mutex{};
 std::atomic<int> wait_seen{}, signal_seen{};
 VkResult result=VK_SUCCESS;
};
struct Queue {
 TestMutex* gate{};
 Observed* state{};
 VkResult BindSparseImage(VkImage,Vulkan::vk::Span<VkSparseImageMemoryBind> tiles,
  Vulkan::vk::Span<VkSparseMemoryBind> tails,VkFence fence,
  VkSemaphore wait,VkSemaphore signal) const {
  assert(fence&&(tiles.size()||tails.size()));
  if(!gate->held.load(std::memory_order_acquire))++state->bad_mutex;
  const auto overlap=++state->entered;
  if(overlap>1)++state->max_overlap;
  ++state->calls;
  if(wait)++state->wait_seen;
  if(signal)++state->signal_seen;
  std::this_thread::yield();
  --state->entered;
  return state->result;
 }
};
struct Device{
 TestMutex* gate{};
 Observed* state{};
 Queue GetGraphicsQueue()const{return {gate,state};}
};
struct Scheduler {
 Device device{};
 TestMutex submit_mutex;
 Scheduler(Observed& state):device{&submit_mutex,&state}{}
 VkResult BindSparseImage(VkImage,vk::Span<VkSparseImageMemoryBind>,
  vk::Span<VkSparseMemoryBind>,VkFence,VkSemaphore,VkSemaphore);
};
""" + fragment + r"""
```

`tools/ns2/check_native_spirv_cbuf_span_host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""P2.3: prove native U32x2 reads across 8-/16-byte uniform vector rows.

Checks the production SPIR-V owner syntax with pinned headers, the exact
guest-byte/word admission predicates, and a source-aligned C++ oracle
against real sequential 32-bit words. No Vulkan driver or PS5 is run.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
SRC = ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/ampere/shader_recompiler/backend/spirv/emit_spirv_context_get_set.cpp"
CBUF = ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/ampere/shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/native_indirect_cbuf.h"
SHARED = ROOT / "vendor/sources/eden/src/shader_recompiler/backend/spirv/emit_spirv_context_get_set.cpp"
source = SRC.read_text()
assert "NativeSpirvCbufBoundsActive()" in source
assert "native_access_bytes" in source
assert "offset.U32() > 0x10000U - native_access_bytes" in source
assert "ctx.Def(offset), ctx.Const(0x10000U - native_access_bytes)" in source

assert "native_access_bytes != 8 ? valid_span :" in source
assert "ctx.OpLogicalAnd(ctx.U1, valid_span," in source
assert "ctx.OpBitwiseAnd(ctx.U32[1], ctx.Def(offset), ctx.Const(3U))" in source
assert "buffer_offset, ctx.Const(~u32{0})" in source
assert "ctx.OpSelect(ctx.U32[1], valid_offset," in source
assert "op == Shader::IR::Opcode::GetCbufU32x2 && (byte_offset & 3U)" in CBUF.read_text()
assert "op == Shader::IR::Opcode::GetCbufU32x2" in CBUF.read_text()

assert "ctx.Const(element_size - 1U)" in source
assert "GetCbufElement(ctx, first_row, offset, 0u, 2)" in source
assert "GetCbufElement(ctx, second_row, offset, 1u, 2)" in source
assert "ctx.load_const_func_u32x2, 8, true)" in source
assert "GetCbufU32x4(ctx, binding, offset, 8, true)" in source
assert "GetCbufElement(ctx, second_row, offset, 1u)" in source
assert "GetCbufElement(ctx, first_row, offset, 0u)" in source

assert "ctx.Const(element_size - 4U)" in source
assert "ctx.Const(element_size - 1U)" in source
assert "element % vector_components" in source
assert "element = ctx.OpBitwiseAnd(ctx.U32[1], element," in source
assert "ctx.OpULessThan(" in source

assert "NativeSpirvCbufBoundsActive()" not in SHARED.read_text()
assert "NativeQmdStaticCbufReadExtent(" in CBUF.read_text()

# The emitted SPIR-V storage vector can be U32x4 even when the original
# guest instruction reads just U8/U16. Inspect actual call-site widths.
for function, width in (
    ("EmitGetCbufU8", 1), ("EmitGetCbufS8", 1),
    ("EmitGetCbufU16", 2), ("EmitGetCbufS16", 2),
):
    start = source.index("Id " + function + "(")
    end = source.index("\nId EmitGetCbuf", start + 1)
    body = source[start:end]
    assert f"GetCbufU32(ctx, binding, offset, {width})" in body
    assert f"GetCbufU32x4(ctx, binding, offset, {width})" in body
    assert f"ctx.load_const_func_u{8 if width == 1 else 16}, {width})" in body
u32 = source.split("Id EmitGetCbufU32(", 1)[1].split("Id EmitGetCbufF32(", 1)[0]
assert "GetCbufU32(ctx, binding, offset)" in u32

assert "ctx.load_const_func_u32x2, 8)" in wide
assert "NativeSpirvCbufBoundsActive()" in wide

CPP = r'''
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <limits>
using u32=std::uint32_t;
constexpr u32 CBUF_BYTES=0x10000;
constexpr bool Within(u32 byte,u32 width) {
 return (width==1 || width==2 || width==4 || width==8) &&
        byte<=CBUF_BYTES-width && (width!=8 || (byte & 3U)==0);
}
struct WordPair {u32 first,second;};
constexpr WordPair pair_from_rows(u32 byte,const std::array<u32,CBUF_BYTES/4>& words) {
 if(!Within(byte,8))return {};
 const u32 first_row=byte/16;
 const u32 first_element=(byte/4)&3;
 const u32 second_row=first_row+((byte&15)>=12);
 const u32 second_element=(first_element+1)&3;
 return {words[first_row*4+first_element],
         words[second_row*4+second_element]};
}
constexpr WordPair pair_from_u32x2_vectors(
    u32 byte,const std::array<u32,CBUF_BYTES/4>& words) {
 if(!Within(byte,8))return {};
 // Exact native GetCbuf(element_size=8,next_vector_for_pair=true)
 // plus GetCbufElement(...,vector_components=2).
 const u32 first_vector=byte/8;
 const u32 second_vector=first_vector+((byte&7)>=4);
 const u32 first_element=(byte/4)&1;
 const u32 second_element=(first_element+1)&1;
 return {words[first_vector*2+first_element],
         words[second_vector*2+second_element]};
}
int main(){
 for(auto width:{1U,2U,4U,8U}) {
  for(u32 offset=0;offset<=CBUF_BYTES+16;++offset) {
   const bool expected=offset<=CBUF_BYTES-width &&
                       (width!=8 || (offset & 3U)==0);
   assert(Within(offset,width)==expected);
   if(!expected) {
    // The actual native SPIR-V builder injects ~0U as its element
    // index, forcing direct/indirect 64-KiB guards to produce zero.
    constexpr u32 sentinel=std::numeric_limits<u32>::max();
    assert(sentinel>=CBUF_BYTES/width);
   }
  }
 }
 static std::array<u32,CBUF_BYTES/4> words{};
 for(u32 i=0;i<words.size();++i) words[i]=0xa0000000U ^ (i*131U);
 for(u32 offset=0;offset<CBUF_BYTES+16;offset+=4){
  const auto pair=pair_from_rows(offset,words);
  const auto pair_alias=pair_from_u32x2_vectors(offset,words);
  assert(pair.first==pair_alias.first && pair.second==pair_alias.second);
  if(!Within(offset,8)) {assert(pair.first==0 && pair.second==0);continue;}
  const u32 i=offset/4;
  assert(pair.first==words[i] && pair.second==words[i+1]);
 }
 for(u32 start: {0U,4U,8U,12U,16U,20U,28U,44U,60U,
                  0xffe8U,0xffecU,0xfff0U,0xfff4U,0xfff8U,
                  0xfffcU,0x10000U}){
  const auto p=pair_from_rows(start,words);
  const auto q=pair_from_u32x2_vectors(start,words);
  assert(p.first==q.first && p.second==q.second);
  if(Within(start,8))
    assert(p.first==words[start/4] && p.second==words[start/4+1]);
  else assert(p.first==0 && p.second==0);
 }
 assert(Within(0xffff,1));
 assert(Within(0xfffe,2) && !Within(0xffff,2));
 assert(Within(0xfffc,4) && !Within(0xfffd,4));
 assert(Within(0xfff8,8) && !Within(0xfffc,8));
 assert(Within(4,8) && Within(12,8) && Within(0xfff4,8));
 assert(!Within(2,8) && !Within(6,8) && !Within(0xfff6,8));
 assert(Within(0,8) && Within(8,8) && Within(0xfff0,8));
 assert(!Within(std::numeric_limits<u32>::max(),8));
 std::puts("P2_3_CBUF_NATIVE_ORIGINAL_BYTE_SPAN_PASS sizes=1/2/4/8"
           " cross_row_u32x2=1 unaligned_subword_refused=1 invalid_sentinel=1");
}
'''
compilers = list(dict.fromkeys(filter(None, (shutil.which("clang++"), shutil.which("g++")))))
assert compilers
env = os.environ.copy()
sdk = Path("/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX15.4.sdk")
if sys.platform == "darwin" and sdk.is_dir():
    env["SDKROOT"] = str(sdk)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-cbuf-guest-span-") as temp:
    file = Path(temp)/"span.cpp"
    file.write_text(CPP)
    for compiler in compilers:
        for opt in ("-O0","-O2"):

# pinned modular libraries are present (Mac dev checkout). Linux CI may rely

boost=ROOT/"vendor/sources/eden-cpm/boost/boost-1.90.0/libs"

    libc=Path("/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX26.5.sdk/usr/include/c++/v1")
```

`tools/ns2/check_native_spirv_patch_output_host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""G03: execute actual tessellation patch write owner under Clang/GCC UBSan.

Negative stage/missing-variable cases and valid TCS generic/outer/inner writes;
does not claim final tessellation Vulkan/SPIR-V pipeline conformance.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
src=(ROOT/"vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/ampere/shader_recompiler/backend/spirv/emit_spirv_context_get_set.cpp").read_text()
start="void EmitSetPatch("
stop="\nvoid EmitSetFragColor("
assert src.count(start)==src.count(stop)==1
owner=start+src.split(start,1)[1].split(stop,1)[0]
assert owner.count("Undeclared tessellation outer patch output") == 1
assert owner.count("Undeclared tessellation inner patch output") == 1
assert owner.count("Undeclared generic tessellation patch") == 1
assert owner.index("if (ctx.stage != Stage::TessellationControl)") < owner.index("ctx.OpStore(pointer, value)")
harness=r"""
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <utility>
using u32=std::uint32_t;
enum class Stage { VertexB, TessellationControl, TessellationEval };
namespace IR {
enum class Patch : u32 {
    TessellationLodLeft=0,TessellationLodTop=1,
    TessellationLodRight=2,TessellationLodBottom=3,
    TessellationLodInteriorU=4,TessellationLodInteriorV=5,
    Generic0=256,Generic1=257,Generic2=258,Generic3=259,
    Generic4=260,Unsupported=999
};
constexpr bool IsGeneric(Patch p) { return u32(p)>=256 && u32(p)<264; }
constexpr u32 GenericPatchIndex(Patch p) { return (u32(p)-256)/4; }
constexpr u32 GenericPatchElement(Patch p) { return (u32(p)-256)%4; }
}
struct Id { u32 value{}; };
constexpr bool ValidId(Id id) { return id.value != 0; }
struct NotImplementedException : std::runtime_error {
    template<class... Args>
    explicit NotImplementedException(const char*,Args&&...)
        :std::runtime_error("unsupported tessellation patch") {}
};
struct EmitContext {
    Stage stage{Stage::TessellationControl};
    Id output_f32{1},output_tess_level_outer{},output_tess_level_inner{};
    Id u32_zero_value{100};
    std::array<Id,2> patches{};
    unsigned stores{},chains{};
    u32 last_base{},last_element{};
    Id Const(u32 v) { return Id{100+v}; }
    Id OpAccessChain(Id type,Id base,Id element) {
        assert(ValidId(type) && ValidId(base) && ValidId(element));
        ++chains;
        last_base=base.value;last_element=element.value;
        return Id{500+chains};
    }
    void OpStore(Id pointer,Id value) {
        assert(ValidId(pointer) && ValidId(value));
        ++stores;
    }
};
__REAL_OWNER__
int main() {
    EmitContext c{};
    auto denied=[&](IR::Patch patch) {
        const auto old=c.stores,old_chains=c.chains;
        bool rejected{};
        try { EmitSetPatch(c,patch,Id{777}); }
        catch(const NotImplementedException&) { rejected=true; }
        assert(rejected && c.stores==old && c.chains==old_chains);
    };
    for(const auto stage:{Stage::VertexB,Stage::TessellationEval}) {
        c.stage=stage;
        denied(IR::Patch::TessellationLodLeft);
        denied(IR::Patch::Generic0);
    }
    c.stage=Stage::TessellationControl;
    denied(IR::Patch::TessellationLodLeft);
    denied(IR::Patch::TessellationLodInteriorU);
    denied(IR::Patch::TessellationLodInteriorV);
    denied(IR::Patch::Generic0);
    denied(IR::Patch::Unsupported);
    c.output_tess_level_outer=Id{17};
    c.output_tess_level_inner=Id{18};
    c.patches[0]=Id{19};
    EmitSetPatch(c,IR::Patch::TessellationLodLeft,Id{777});
    assert(c.last_base==17 && c.stores==1);
    EmitSetPatch(c,IR::Patch::TessellationLodBottom,Id{777});
    assert(c.last_base==17 && c.last_element==103 && c.stores==2);
    EmitSetPatch(c,IR::Patch::TessellationLodInteriorU,Id{777});
    assert(c.last_base==18 && c.stores==3);
    EmitSetPatch(c,IR::Patch::TessellationLodInteriorV,Id{777});
    assert(c.last_base==18 && c.last_element==101 && c.stores==4);
    EmitSetPatch(c,IR::Patch::Generic2,Id{777});
    assert(c.last_base==19 && c.last_element==102 && c.stores==5);
    denied(IR::Patch::Generic4);
    denied(IR::Patch::Unsupported);
}
""".replace("__REAL_OWNER__",owner)
compilers=list(dict.fromkeys(x for x in (shutil.which("clang++"),shutil.which("g++")) if x))
assert compilers,"Clang/GCC required"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-g03-patch-owner-") as temp:
    code=Path(temp)/"owner.cpp";code.write_text(harness)
    for cc in compilers:
        for opt in ("-O0","-O2"):
            exe=Path(temp)/(Path(cc).name+opt)
            args=[cc,"-std=c++20",opt,"-Wall","-Wextra","-Werror",
                  "-fsanitize=undefined","-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
                  str(code),"-o",str(exe)]
            built=subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60,env=os.environ.copy())
            assert built.returncode==0,built.stderr[-4000:]
            run=subprocess.run([str(exe)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=25)
            assert run.returncode==0,run.stderr[-4000:]
            print("G03_REAL_PATCH_WRITE_OWNER_PASS",Path(cc).name,opt,
                  "tcs_write=5 tes_vertex_rejected=1 undeclared_refused=1",flush=True)
```

`tools/ns2/check_native_spirv_xfb_partition_host.py`:

```py
"""G02: execute native SPIR-V transform-feedback partition owner (Clang/GCC).

Reject overflowing varying count / component spans before index or output

fixture=r"""
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
using u32=std::uint32_t;
struct Id {u32 value{};};
enum class Stage {VertexB,Geometry};
namespace IR {enum class Attribute:u32 {Generic0X=32};}
namespace spv {
enum class Decoration {Location,Component,XfbBuffer,XfbStride,Offset,Stream};
}
namespace fmt {
template<class... Args> std::string format(std::string_view,Args...) {
    return "xfb_output";
}
}
struct NotImplementedException:std::runtime_error {
    template<class... T> explicit NotImplementedException(const char*,T&&...)
        :std::runtime_error("invalid transform feedback") {}
};
struct TransformFeedbackVarying {
    u32 buffer{},stride{},offset{},components{},stream{};
};
struct GenericElementInfo {
    Id id{};
    u32 first_element{},num_components{};
};
struct RuntimeInfo {
    std::array<TransformFeedbackVarying,256> xfb_varyings{};
    u32 xfb_count{};
};
struct EmitContext {
    Stage stage{Stage::Geometry};
    RuntimeInfo runtime_info{};
    std::array<Id,5> F32{{Id{1},Id{2},Id{3},Id{4},Id{5}}};
    std::array<std::array<GenericElementInfo,4>,2> output_generics{};
    unsigned outputs{},decorations{},named{};
    Id Decorate(Id id,spv::Decoration,u32) {++decorations;return id;}
    void Name(Id,std::string) {++named;}
};
Id DefineOutput(EmitContext& ctx,Id type,std::optional<u32>) {
    assert(type.value!=0);
    return Id{10+ ++ctx.outputs};
}
__REAL_OWNER__
int main(){
    {
        EmitContext c;
        DefineGenericOutput(c,0,std::nullopt);
        assert(c.outputs==1);
        for(const auto& e:c.output_generics[0])
            assert(e.num_components==4 && e.first_element==0 && e.id.value==11);
    }
    {
        EmitContext c;
        c.runtime_info.xfb_count=36;
        c.runtime_info.xfb_varyings[32]={0,16,0,2,1};
        c.runtime_info.xfb_varyings[34]={0,16,8,2,1};
        DefineGenericOutput(c,0,1);
        assert(c.outputs==2);
        for(u32 j=0;j<2;++j) {
            assert(c.output_generics[0][j].num_components==2);
            assert(c.output_generics[0][j].first_element==0);
        }
        for(u32 j=2;j<4;++j) {
            assert(c.output_generics[0][j].num_components==2);
            assert(c.output_generics[0][j].first_element==2);
        }
    }
    {
        EmitContext c;
        c.runtime_info.xfb_count=257;
        bool rejected{};
        try{DefineGenericOutput(c,0,std::nullopt);}
        catch(const NotImplementedException&){rejected=true;}
        assert(rejected && c.outputs==0 && c.decorations==0);
    }
    {
        EmitContext c;
        c.runtime_info.xfb_count=33;
        c.runtime_info.xfb_varyings[32]={0,16,0,5,0};
        bool rejected{};
        try{DefineGenericOutput(c,0,std::nullopt);}
        catch(const NotImplementedException&){rejected=true;}
        assert(rejected && c.outputs==0 && c.decorations==0);
    }
    {
        EmitContext c;
        c.runtime_info.xfb_count=35;
        c.runtime_info.xfb_varyings[32]={0,16,0,2,0};
        c.runtime_info.xfb_varyings[34]={0,16,8,3,0};
        bool rejected{};
        try{DefineGenericOutput(c,0,std::nullopt);}
        catch(const NotImplementedException&){rejected=true;}
        assert(rejected && c.outputs==1);
        assert(c.output_generics[0][2].id.value==0);
        assert(c.output_generics[0][3].id.value==0);
    }
    // Byte offsets, alignment and complete vertex-stride coverage are
    // properties of the guest's real interleaved stream, not just SPIR-V
    // vector component counts.
    for(const TransformFeedbackVarying bad : {
        TransformFeedbackVarying{0,8,8,2,0}, // 8+8 exceeds stride
        TransformFeedbackVarying{0,16,2,1,0}, // misaligned offset
        TransformFeedbackVarying{0,14,0,1,0}, // misaligned stride
        TransformFeedbackVarying{0,0,0,1,0},  // no space for any byte
        TransformFeedbackVarying{0,4,0xfffffffcu,1,0} // huge offset
    }) {
        EmitContext c;
        c.runtime_info.xfb_count=33;
        c.runtime_info.xfb_varyings[32]=bad;
        bool rejected{};
        try{DefineGenericOutput(c,0,std::nullopt);}
        catch(const NotImplementedException&){rejected=true;}
        assert(rejected && c.outputs==0 && c.decorations==0);
    }
}
""".replace("__REAL_OWNER__",owner)
compilers=list(dict.fromkeys(x for x in (shutil.which("clang++"),shutil.which("g++")) if x))
```

`tools/ns2/check_native_stage_buffer_host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""P2.4: compile and execute the real native Ampere ISBE/CSM operand guards.

No emulator, ROM, PS5 or Vulkan hardware is required. This test never
pretends to validate Task/Mesh rendering or shading-mode predicate results.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
AMPERE = ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/ampere"
EDEN = ROOT / "vendor/sources/eden/src"
PROBE = AMPERE / "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/probe.cpp"
DECODER = AMPERE / "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/native_stage_buffer.h"
assert DECODER.is_file(), f"Missing maintained stage-buffer decoder: {DECODER}"

CODE = r"""
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>
#include <span>
#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/probe.h"
#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/ampere_isa_table.h"
#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/native_stage_buffer.h"

using namespace Shader::Ampere;

Instruction Stage(u32 op, u32 ra, u32 value, u32 byte_offset, u32 flags) {
    Instruction inst{};
    inst.words[0] = op | (op == 0x923 ? (value << 16) : 0U) | (ra << 24);
    inst.words[1] = (byte_offset << 8) | (op == 0x927 ? value : 0U);
    inst.words[2] = flags;
    return inst;
}

int main() {
    // Output Task stage buffer: 32-bit attribute, U8/U32 primitive map.
    const auto attr = Stage(0x927, 17, 37, 0x123456, 0xb800);
    const auto attr_info = DecodeNativeStageBufferAccess(attr);
    assert(attr_info && attr_info->write && attr_info->attribute);
    assert(attr_info->address_register == 17 && attr_info->value_register == 37);
    assert(attr_info->byte_offset == 0x123456 && attr_info->width_32);
    assert(attr_info->output && !attr_info->skew);
    const auto* write_row = FindOpcodeRow(0x927);
    assert(write_row && FirstUnreviewedBit(attr, *write_row) == -1);

    const auto map_u8 = Stage(0x927, 255, 0, 4, 0x8000);
    const auto map_info = DecodeNativeStageBufferAccess(map_u8);
    assert(map_info && map_info->write && !map_info->attribute && !map_info->width_32);
    const auto map_u32 = Stage(0x927, 6, 2, 3, 0x8800);
    assert(DecodeNativeStageBufferAccess(map_u32)->width_32);

    // Task input: 32-bit attribute, unmodified linear byte offset.
    const auto read = Stage(0x923, 4, 8, 0xabcde, 0x3800);
    const auto read_info = DecodeNativeStageBufferAccess(read);
    assert(read_info && !read_info->write && read_info->attribute);
    assert(read_info->byte_offset == 0xabcde);
    assert(FirstUnreviewedBit(read, *FindOpcodeRow(0x923)) == -1);

    // Refuse undefined stage-buffer regions and observable-looking false success.
    assert(!DecodeNativeStageBufferAccess(Stage(0x927, 1, 2, 0, 0x3800))); // output off
    assert(!DecodeNativeStageBufferAccess(Stage(0x927, 1, 2, 0, 0xb000))); // ATTR U8
    assert(!DecodeNativeStageBufferAccess(Stage(0x923, 1, 2, 0, 0x8000))); // output read
    assert(!DecodeNativeStageBufferAccess(Stage(0x923, 1, 2, 0, 0x0000))); // map read
    assert(!DecodeNativeStageBufferAccess(Stage(0x923, 1, 255, 0, 0x3000))); // PT/RZ sink read
    assert(!DecodeNativeStageBufferAccess(Stage(0x923, 1, 2, 0, 0x3000))); // U8 input read unimplemented
    assert(!DecodeNativeStageBufferAccess(Stage(0x923, 1, 2, 0, 0x7800))); // skew read not silently flattened
    assert(!DecodeNativeStageBufferAccess(Stage(0x927, 1, 2, 0, 0xf800))); // skew write not silently flattened
    assert(!DecodeNativeStageBufferAccess(Stage(0x927, 1, 2, 0, 0x9000))); // region 1
    assert(!DecodeNativeStageBufferAccess(Stage(0x927, 1, 2, 0, 0xb400))); // reserved bit
    assert(!DecodeNativeStageBufferAccess(Stage(0x999, 1, 2, 0, 0xb800)));

    // CSMTEST is structurally reviewed. Only the semantic lowerer may drop
    // both PT outputs; merely recognizing it in a probe is not a true result.
    Instruction csm{{0x80d, 0, 0x03fe0000U, 0}};
    const auto* csm_row = FindOpcodeRow(0x80d);
    assert(csm_row && FirstUnreviewedBit(csm, *csm_row) == -1);
    auto wrong_mode = csm;
    wrong_mode.words[2] |= (1U << 16);
    assert(FirstUnreviewedBit(wrong_mode, *csm_row) == 80);

    std::array<Instruction, 3> program{read, attr, csm};
    const auto* bytes = reinterpret_cast<const std::uint8_t*>(program.data());
    const auto probe = ProbeProgram(std::span<const std::uint8_t>(bytes, sizeof(program)));
    assert(probe.status == ProbeStatus::Recognized);
    assert(probe.recognized == program.size());
}
"""

compilers = [c for c in ("clang++", "g++") if shutil.which(c)]
if not compilers:
    raise SystemExit("No Clang/GCC C++ compiler found")
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="native-stage-buffer-") as d:
    source = Path(d, "test.cpp")
    source.write_text(CODE)
    for compiler in compilers:
        for optimization in ("-O0", "-O2"):
            binary = Path(d, "test")
            cmd = [
                compiler, "-std=c++20", optimization, "-Wall", "-Wextra",
                "-I" + str(AMPERE), "-I" + str(EDEN),
                str(source), str(PROBE), "-o", str(binary),
            ]
            subprocess.run(cmd, check=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                           text=True, timeout=90)
            subprocess.run([str(binary)], check=True, timeout=15)
            print(f"NS2_STAGE_BUFFER_PASS compiler={compiler} optimization={optimization}")
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""P1.3: source-extracted NS2 Sysmix PCM16/float guest ring pump on host.

Compile the maintained SysmixOutput::Pump and its actual guest index reader
against strict stand-ins for guest RAM and the existing Eden SinkStream.
Does not claim real PS5 audio, scheduler integration or kernel IPC.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
SOURCE = ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/audio/core/hle/service/audio/nx2_sysmix.cpp"
OWNER = SOURCE.read_text()
CM = (ROOT / "headless/CMakeLists.txt").read_text()
AUDIO = (SOURCE.parent / "audio.cpp").read_text()
assert "core/hle/service/audio/nx2_sysmix.cpp" in CM
assert 'RegisterNamedService("audsmx:u"' in AUDIO
assert 'RegisterNamedService("auddmg:u"' in AUDIO
assert "p.host->GetQueueSize() >= NativeQueueHighWatermark" in OWNER
assert "p.host->AppendBuffer(block, p.output)" in OWNER
assert "memory.WriteExclusive32(p.buffer + ReadOffset, next, read)" in OWNER
assert "std::atomic_thread_fence(std::memory_order_acquire)" in OWNER
assert "StreamType::Out" in OWNER
assert "TryAppendOutputBlock(" not in OWNER

def native(source: str, start: str) -> str:
    assert source.count(start) == 1, start
    at = source.index(start)
    opening = source.index("{", at)
    depth = 0
    for cursor in range(opening, len(source)):
        if source[cursor] == "{":
            depth += 1
        elif source[cursor] == "}":
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0:
                return source[at:cursor+1]
    raise AssertionError("unbalanced " + start)

read_acquire = native(OWNER, "bool ReadWordAcquire(")
pump = native(OWNER, "void SysmixOutput::Pump() {")
validate = native(OWNER, "Result SysmixOutput::ValidateRegion(")
formats = native(OWNER, "bool SysmixOutput::IsFormatSupported(")
# The actual counter and input layout, not a translated algorithm.
assert "p.output.fill(0);" in pump
assert "std::isfinite(value)" in pump
assert "read + taken" in pump
assert "std::try_to_lock" in pump
assert "p.counters.backpressure" in pump
assert "p.counters.nonzero_frames" in pump
assert "if (!p.engaged)" in pump
assert "p.Fault()" in pump

constexpr Result ResultSuccess = 0;
constexpr Result ResultNotSupported = -1;

}
}
namespace Core {
namespace Memory {
struct Memory {
    static constexpr u64 Base=0x100000;
    static constexpr u32 Slots=300;
    static constexpr u32 FrameBytes=4;
    std::array<u8,Slots*FrameBytes> ring{};
    u32 read{},write{};
    bool guest_valid{true};
    bool failed_io{};
    bool fail_cas{};
    unsigned word_reads{}, block_reads{}, cas_attempts{};
    bool IsValidVirtualAddressRange(u64 at,u64 length) const {
        return guest_valid && at>=Base && length<=0x3000 &&
               at-Base<=0x3000-length;
    }
    u32 Read32(u64 at) {
        ++word_reads;
        if (at==Base+0x44) return read;
        if (at==Base+0x1004) return write;
        assert(false && "unknown guest ring index");
        return 0;
    }
    bool ReadBlock(u64 at,void* to,std::size_t bytes) {
        ++block_reads;
        if (failed_io || !IsValidVirtualAddressRange(at,bytes) ||
            at<Base+0x1040 || at-Base-0x1040+bytes>ring.size())
            return false;
        std::memcpy(to,ring.data()+(at-Base-0x1040),bytes);
        return true;
    }
    bool WriteExclusive32(u64 at,u32 next,u32 expected) {
        ++cas_attempts;
        if (fail_cas || at!=Base+0x44 || read!=expected) return false;
        read=next;
        return true;
    }
    void StorePCM16(u32 slot,s16 left,s16 right) {
        assert(slot<Slots);
        std::memcpy(ring.data()+slot*4,&left,sizeof(left));
        std::memcpy(ring.data()+slot*4+2,&right,sizeof(right));
    }
    void StoreFloat(u32 slot,f32 left,f32 right) {
        assert(slot<Slots && slot*8+8<=ring.size());
        std::memcpy(ring.data()+slot*8,&left,sizeof(left));
        std::memcpy(ring.data()+slot*8+4,&right,sizeof(right));
    }
};
}
struct System {
    bool shutdown{};
    bool IsShuttingDown() const { return shutdown; }
    struct KernelCore {};
    KernelCore& Kernel() { static KernelCore k; return k; }
};
}
namespace Kernel {
struct KProcess {
    Core::Memory::Memory memory;
    Core::Memory::Memory& GetMemory() { return memory; }
};
}
constexpr u64 ReadOffset = 0x44;
constexpr u64 WriteOffset = 0x1004;
constexpr u64 PayloadOffset = 0x1040;
constexpr u32 BlockFrames = 240;
constexpr u32 NativeQueueHighWatermark = 4;
__READ_ACQUIRE__
struct Host {
    unsigned pending{}, starts{}, stops{};
    std::vector<std::array<s16,BlockFrames*2>> submitted;
    void Start() {++starts;}
    void Stop() {++stops;}
    unsigned GetQueueSize() const {return pending;}
    void AppendBuffer(AudioCore::Sink::SinkBuffer& packet,std::span<s16> pcm) {
        assert(pending<NativeQueueHighWatermark);
        assert(packet.frames==BlockFrames && pcm.size()==BlockFrames*2);
        assert(packet.tag==submitted.size());
        std::array<s16,BlockFrames*2> sample{};
        std::copy(pcm.begin(),pcm.end(),sample.begin());
        submitted.push_back(sample);
        ++pending;
    }
};
struct Event {
    unsigned signals{};
    void Signal(Core::System::KernelCore&){++signals;}
};
struct MockProcess {
    Core::Memory::Memory memory{};
    Core::Memory::Memory& GetMemory(){return memory;}
};
struct Counters {
    u64 ticks{},copied_frames{},accepted_frames{},nonzero_frames{},
        admitted_blocks{},backpressure{},faults{};
};
struct MockImpl {
    Core::System system;
    MockProcess* process{};
    Host* host{};
    Event state_event_value, data_event_value;
    Event* state_event{&state_event_value};
    Event* data_event{&data_event_value};
    std::mutex mutex;
    u32 id{1},data_mode{0},slots{Core::Memory::Memory::Slots},
        frame_bytes{4},consumer{0};
    u64 buffer{Core::Memory::Memory::Base};
    bool open{true},engaged{true},faulted{};
    s32 threshold{};
    f32 gain{1};
    AudioCore::SampleFormat format{AudioCore::SampleFormat::PcmInt16};
    std::array<u8,BlockFrames*2*sizeof(f32)> input{};
    std::array<s16,BlockFrames*2> output{};
    Counters counters{};
    bool ReadOccupancy(u32& r,u32& w,u32& filled) {
        auto& memory=process->GetMemory();
        if (!ReadWordAcquire(memory,buffer+ReadOffset,r) || r!=consumer ||
            !ReadWordAcquire(memory,buffer+WriteOffset,w) ||
            r>=slots || w>=slots) return false;
        filled=(w+slots-r)%slots;
        return true;
    }
    Result Fault(Result result=ResultInvalidAddressInfo){
        faulted=true;engaged=false;++counters.faults;
        if(host) host->Stop();
        state_event->Signal(system.Kernel());
        return result;
    }
    void Notify(u32 filled) {
        if (data_mode==2 && slots-1-filled>=static_cast<u32>(threshold))
            data_event->Signal(system.Kernel());
    }
};
class SysmixOutput {
public:
    MockImpl* impl;
    static Result ValidateRegion(Kernel::KProcess&,u64,u64,u32);
    static bool IsFormatSupported(u32,u32,u32);
    void Pump();
};
__VALIDATE__
__FORMATS__
__PUMP__
int main() {
    using Core::Memory::Memory;
    Kernel::KProcess validated{};
    assert(SysmixOutput::ValidateRegion(validated,Memory::Base,0x3000,0x24)==ResultSuccess);
    assert(SysmixOutput::ValidateRegion(validated,Memory::Base+1,0x3000,0x24)==ResultInvalidAddressInfo);
    assert(SysmixOutput::ValidateRegion(validated,Memory::Base,0x1000,0x24)==ResultInvalidAddressInfo);
    assert(SysmixOutput::ValidateRegion(validated,Memory::Base,0x3000,0x25)==ResultNotSupported);
    validated.memory.guest_valid=false;
    assert(SysmixOutput::ValidateRegion(validated,Memory::Base,0x3000,0x24)==ResultInvalidAddressInfo);
    validated.memory.guest_valid=true;
    assert(SysmixOutput::IsFormatSupported(2,2,48000));
    assert(SysmixOutput::IsFormatSupported(5,2,48000));
    assert(!SysmixOutput::IsFormatSupported(2,1,48000));
    assert(!SysmixOutput::IsFormatSupported(3,2,48000));
    assert(!SysmixOutput::IsFormatSupported(2,2,44100));

    MockProcess process{};
    Host host{};
    MockImpl impl{};
    impl.process=&process;
    impl.host=&host;
    SysmixOutput stream{&impl};
    for(u32 slot=0;slot<240;++slot)
        process.memory.StorePCM16(slot,static_cast<s16>(slot+1),
                                 static_cast<s16>(-static_cast<s32>(slot+1)));
    process.memory.write=240;
    stream.Pump();
    assert(process.memory.read==240 && impl.consumer==240);
    assert(host.submitted.size()==1 && host.pending==1);
    assert(host.submitted[0][0]==1 && host.submitted[0][1]==-1);
    assert(host.submitted[0][478]==240 && host.submitted[0][479]==-240);
    assert(impl.counters.accepted_frames==240 && impl.counters.admitted_blocks==1);
    for(u32 slot=240;slot<260;++slot)process.memory.StorePCM16(slot, 1000,-2000);
    process.memory.write=260;
    host.pending=NativeQueueHighWatermark;
    stream.Pump();
    assert(process.memory.read==240 && impl.consumer==240);
    assert(impl.counters.backpressure==1 && host.submitted.size()==1);
    host.pending=0;
    stream.Pump();
    assert(process.memory.read==260 && impl.consumer==260);
    assert(host.submitted.size()==2 && host.submitted[1][0]==1000);
    assert(host.submitted[1][1]==-2000 && host.submitted[1][42]==0);
    assert(impl.counters.copied_frames==280 && impl.counters.accepted_frames==260);

    MockProcess wrap_process{};
    Host wrap_host{};
    MockImpl wrap{};
    wrap.process=&wrap_process; wrap.host=&wrap_host;
    wrap.consumer=Memory::Slots-2;
    wrap_process.memory.read=wrap.consumer;
    wrap_process.memory.write=5;
    for(u32 i=0;i<7;++i)
        wrap_process.memory.StorePCM16((wrap.consumer+i)%wrap.slots,
                                       300+i,-300-static_cast<s16>(i));
    SysmixOutput wrapped{&wrap};
    wrapped.Pump();

    assert(wrap_process.memory.block_reads==2);
    for(int i=0;i<7;++i) {

        assert(wrap_host.submitted[0][2*i+1]==-300-i);
    }
    assert(wrap_host.submitted[0][16]==0);
    // PCM float variant: NaN is silence, +-saturation is clipped.
    MockProcess float_process{};
    Host float_host{};

    floated.format=AudioCore::SampleFormat::PcmFloat;

    float_process.memory.write=2;

    assert(float_host.submitted[0][0]==-32768 && float_host.submitted[0][1]==16384);
    assert(float_host.submitted[0][2]==0 && float_host.submitted[0][3]==32767);
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""P2.2 host-only witness: native TIC shader format mapping and refusal policy.

This compares the ACTUAL pinned enums, rather than assuming that a Vulkan
surface-format integer is always a shader pixel-format integer. Does not
compile the PS5 renderer or prove that VkImage/VkSampler bindings work.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import re

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
vendor = root / "vendor"
shader_info = (vendor / "sources/eden/src/shader_recompiler/shader_info.h").read_text()
surface_info = (vendor / "sources/eden/src/video_core/surface.h").read_text()

shader_enum = re.search(r"enum class TexturePixelFormat\s*\{(.*?)\};",
                        shader_info, re.S)
assert shader_enum, "Shader::TexturePixelFormat absent"
shader = [item.strip() for item in shader_enum.group(1).split(",") if item.strip()]
surface_macro = surface_info.split("#define PIXEL_FORMAT_LIST", 1)[1].split("\n\n", 1)[0]
surface = re.findall(r"PIXEL_FORMAT_ELEM\((\w+),", surface_macro)
shared_end = "E5B9G9R9_FLOAT"
assert shared_end in shader and shared_end in surface
shared_count = shader.index(shared_end) + 1
assert surface.index(shared_end) + 1 == shared_count
assert shader[:shared_count] == surface[:shared_count], "numeric format prefix drift"

# The shader compiler has no corresponding ETC2/EAC image formats. Never
# cast these ten surface entries into unrelated shader depth/stencil entries.
unrepresented = surface[shared_count:-7]
assert unrepresented == [
    "ETC2_RGB_UNORM", "ETC2_RGBA_UNORM", "ETC2_RGB_PTA_UNORM",
    "ETC2_RGB_SRGB", "ETC2_RGBA_SRGB", "ETC2_RGB_PTA_SRGB",
    "EAC_R11_UNORM", "EAC_R11_SNORM",
    "EAC_R11G11_UNORM", "EAC_R11G11_SNORM",
], "unexpected non-shader surface formats"
depth = shader[shared_count:]
assert depth == [
    "D32_FLOAT", "D16_UNORM", "X8_D24_UNORM", "S8_UINT",
    "D24_UNORM_S8_UINT", "S8_UINT_D24_UNORM", "D32_FLOAT_S8_UINT",
]
assert depth == surface[-len(depth):], "depth/stencil format set drift"

for filename in (
    "encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_rasterizer.cpp",
    "encore-active/eden-core/guest-bridge/vulkan_rasterizer.cpp",
):
    source = (vendor / filename).read_text()
    native = source.split("class NativeQmdTextureMetadata final", 1)[1].split(

# A captured TIC/TSC snapshot can become stale WHILE Vulkan descriptor
# staging records pending commands, even though both the engine ticket and
# CBUF plan remain valid. The FINAL check must happen after ConfigureNative
# releases BufferCache.mutex and before a GPU dispatch is queued. Both
# maintained renderers require the exact same graphics/image guest policy.
for path in (
    "encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_rasterizer.cpp",
    "encore-active/eden-core/guest-bridge/vulkan_rasterizer.cpp",
):
    bridge = (vendor / path).read_text()
    configure = bridge.index('if (!pipeline->ConfigureNative(')
    cbuf_final = bridge.index('bool current_after_staging = false;', configure)
    texture_final = bridge.index('staged_image_tables->MatchesSnapshot(', cbuf_final)
    dispatch = bridge.index('cmdbuf.Dispatch(dim[0], dim[1], dim[2]);', configure)
    assert configure < cbuf_final < texture_final < dispatch, path
    assert bridge.index('staged_image_records = std::move(*descriptors);') < configure
    assert 'staged_image_tables->SameRegisters(' in bridge[cbuf_final:dispatch]
    assert 'texture_cache.NativeChannelMatches(' in bridge[cbuf_final:dispatch]
    assert 'NativeTextureReadLockScope native_texture_read_scope{this};' in bridge[cbuf_final:dispatch]
    assert 'std::scoped_lock lock{texture_cache.mutex};' in bridge[cbuf_final:dispatch]
    assert bridge.count('NativeTextureReadLockScope native_texture_read_scope{this};') == 2
    assert bridge.count('thread_local const RasterizerVulkan* native_texture_read_lock_owner{};') == 1
    assert bridge.index('if (!current_after_staging ||', texture_final) < dispatch
    assert bridge.index('ObtainBufferOperation::MarkAsWritten', texture_final) < dispatch
    assert bridge.index('if (!current_after_staging ||', texture_final) < bridge.index(
        'ObtainBufferOperation::MarkAsWritten', texture_final)
print('NS2_TIC_TSC_POST_STAGE_REVALIDATION_PASS owners=2'
      ' raw_records=stable lock=held gpu_dispatch=after_recheck')

    ("SamplerId TextureCache<P>::AcquireNativeSampler(", "return FindSampler(descriptor, true);"),

    assert "if (!NativeChannelMatches(" not in body, (
        "owner check unlocks config mutex before native acquisition", name
    )

# Source-owner reentrancy proof: the pristine shared ChannelSetupCaches
# mutex remains non-recursive for NS1, while an NS2 cache call holds it
# through TIC/TSC publication. The derived native texture cache's

assert "native_channel_lock_owner == this" in header
assert "ChannelSetupCaches<TextureCacheChannelInfo>::getStorageID(id)" in header
for name in ("ImageViewId TextureCache<P>::AcquireNativeImageView(",
             "SamplerId TextureCache<P>::AcquireNativeSampler("):

        body.index("native_channel_lock_owner = this;"))

        body.index("channel_state->image_views.try_emplace(descriptor)")

# Compile/run a small exact-syntax policy witness on Clang/GCC. The source
# oracle above ties this primitive to the actual cache, not a dummy owner.
fixture = (
    "#include <mutex>\n#include <optional>\n#include <unordered_map>\n"
    "#include <thread>\n#include <cassert>\n"
    "class Cache { public:\n"
    "struct Entry { size_t storage_id; };\n"
    "mutable std::mutex config_mutex;\n"
    "std::unordered_map<size_t, Entry> address_spaces{{1, {7}}};\n"
    "inline static thread_local const Cache* native_channel_lock_owner = nullptr;\n"
    "std::optional<size_t> getStorageID(size_t id) const {\n"
    " if (native_channel_lock_owner == this) {\n"
    "  auto it = address_spaces.find(id);\n"
    "  return it == address_spaces.end() ? std::nullopt : "
    "std::optional<size_t>{it->second.storage_id};\n"
    " }\n"
    " std::unique_lock lock{config_mutex};\n"
    " auto it = address_spaces.find(id);\n"
    " return it == address_spaces.end() ? std::nullopt : "
    "std::optional<size_t>{it->second.storage_id};\n"
    "}\n"
    "void acquire() {\n"
    " std::scoped_lock lock{config_mutex};\n"
    " auto prior = native_channel_lock_owner;\n"
    " native_channel_lock_owner = this;\n"
    " struct Restore { const Cache* prior; ~Restore() {"
    " Cache::native_channel_lock_owner = prior; } } restore{prior};\n"
    " assert(getStorageID(1) == 7);\n"
    "}\n};\n"
    "int main() {\nCache cache;\ncache.acquire();\n"
    "assert(cache.getStorageID(1) == 7);\n"
    "assert(Cache::native_channel_lock_owner == nullptr);\n"
    "}\n"
)
compilers = [x for x in ("clang++", "g++") if shutil.which(x)]
assert compilers, "native config-lease compilers absent"
# Do not accidentally link this macOS host fixture against a newer CLT SDK
# whose TAPI stubs our pinned host Clang cannot decode (e.g. SDK 27).
host_env = dict(os.environ)
pinned_sdk = Path("/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX15.4.sdk")
if pinned_sdk.is_dir():
    host_env["SDKROOT"] = str(pinned_sdk)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="ns2-channel-lease-") as tmp:
    source = Path(tmp) / "lease.cpp"
    source.write_text(fixture)
    for cc in compilers:
        output = Path(tmp) / cc
        built = subprocess.run([cc, "-std=c++20", "-O0", "-pthread",
                                str(source), "-o", str(output)],
                               env=host_env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)
        assert built.returncode == 0, (cc, built.stderr[-4000:])
        subprocess.run([str(output)], env=host_env, check=True, timeout=5)
print("NS2_CACHE_CHANNEL_LEASE_PASS upstream=pristine native=thread_local")

def native_cache_slice(text: str, start: str, following: str) -> str:
    assert text.count(start) == 1, ("native cache gate drift", start[:70])
    block = text.split(start, 1)[1]
    assert block.count(following) == 1, ("native cache boundary drift", following[:70])
    return start + block.split(following, 1)[0].rstrip()


declarations_end = "\n    /// Fill image_view_ids with the graphics/compute images in indices"
implementation_start = native_gate + "\n// NS2 and NS1 use one TextureCache channel map"
implementation_end = "\ntemplate <class P>\nImageViewId TextureCache<P>::VisitImageView("

    vulkan_base, base_start, declarations_end
), "ASTC shadow cache lost the canonical native GPU pin/channel API"
assert native_cache_slice(astc_impl, implementation_start, implementation_end) == native_cache_slice(
    vulkan_impl, implementation_start, implementation_end
), "ASTC shadow cache diverged from canonical native acquisition/lease implementation"
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""P2.2b: compile/exercise the actual native TextureCache flush-lock branch.

No GPU or console. The fixture uses the real reviewed RAII scope and
FlushRegion texture arm, not a duplicate implementation of the decision.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
variant='deferred' if '--deferred' in sys.argv[1:] else 'vulkan'
assert len(sys.argv)==1 or sys.argv[1:]==['--deferred']
owner=('vendor/encore-active/eden-core/guest-bridge/vulkan_rasterizer.cpp'
       if variant=='deferred' else 'vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_rasterizer.cpp')
source=(root/owner).read_text()
assert source.count('NativeTextureReadLockScope native_texture_read_scope{this};')==2
assert 'VideoCommon::ReadNs2GpuShader(' in source
scope='thread_local const RasterizerVulkan* native_texture_read_lock_owner{};'
assert source.count(scope)==1
scope+=source.split(scope,1)[1].split('\n#endif\nstruct DrawParams',1)[0]
anchor='    // No guest image ever overlapped these CPU pages: no texture readback.'
assert source.count(anchor)==1
flush=anchor+source.split(anchor,1)[1].split('    // DownloadMemory visits registered buffers only.',1)[0]
assert 'native_texture_read_lock_owner == this' in flush
assert 'texture_cache.DownloadMemory(addr, size);' in flush
cpp=r'''
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <mutex>
using DAddr=std::uint64_t;
using u64=std::uint64_t;
namespace VideoCommon {
enum class CacheType:std::uint32_t { TextureCache=1 };
constexpr CacheType operator&(CacheType a,CacheType b) {
    return CacheType(std::uint32_t(a)&std::uint32_t(b));
}
}
constexpr bool True(VideoCommon::CacheType kind) {return std::uint32_t(kind)!=0;}
namespace Eden::ImagePages {
constexpr bool NeverHeld(DAddr,u64) {return false;}
}
namespace Vulkan {
struct RasterizerVulkan {
    struct Cache {
        std::mutex mutex;
        unsigned downloaded{};
        void DownloadMemory(DAddr,u64) {++downloaded;}
    } texture_cache;
    void FlushTexture(DAddr addr,u64 size,VideoCommon::CacheType which);
};
namespace {
#if defined(PS5_NATIVE) && defined(EDEN_NS2_VULKAN_SHADER_BRIDGE_EXPERIMENTAL)
__SCOPE__
#endif
}
void RasterizerVulkan::FlushTexture(DAddr addr,u64 size,VideoCommon::CacheType which) {
    if (addr==0 || size==0) return;
__FLUSH__
}
}
int main() {
    Vulkan::RasterizerVulkan renderer;
#if defined(PS5_NATIVE) && defined(EDEN_NS2_VULKAN_SHADER_BRIDGE_EXPERIMENTAL)
    Vulkan::RasterizerVulkan other;
#endif
    using VideoCommon::CacheType;
    renderer.FlushTexture(16,4,CacheType::TextureCache);
#if defined(PS5_NATIVE) && defined(EDEN_NS2_VULKAN_SHADER_BRIDGE_EXPERIMENTAL)
    {
        const std::scoped_lock lock{renderer.texture_cache.mutex};
        Vulkan::NativeTextureReadLockScope owner{&renderer};
        // With the old code, this deadlocks on the SAME non-recursive mutex
        // whenever the guest address held a registered GPU image.
        renderer.FlushTexture(16,4,CacheType::TextureCache);
        other.FlushTexture(16,4,CacheType::TextureCache);
    }
    assert(renderer.texture_cache.downloaded==2);
    assert(other.texture_cache.downloaded==1);
#else
    assert(renderer.texture_cache.downloaded==1);
#endif
}
'''.replace('__SCOPE__',scope).replace('__FLUSH__',flush)
env=dict(os.environ)
sdk=Path('/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX15.4.sdk')
if sdk.exists():env['SDKROOT']=str(sdk)
compilers=list(dict.fromkeys(filter(None,(shutil.which('clang++'),shutil.which('g++')))))
assert compilers
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='encore-texture-lock-') as temp:
    path=Path(temp)/'readback.cpp';path.write_text(cpp)
    for compiler in compilers:
        for native in (False,True):
            for opt in (0,2):
                exe=Path(temp)/f'run-{Path(compiler).name}-{native}-{opt}'
                cmd=[compiler,'-std=c++20',f'-O{opt}','-Wall','-Wextra','-Werror',
                     '-Wno-unused-parameter','-fsanitize=undefined',
                     '-fno-sanitize-recover=all']
                if native:cmd+=['-DPS5_NATIVE=1','-DEDEN_NS2_VULKAN_SHADER_BRIDGE_EXPERIMENTAL=1']
                built=subprocess.run(cmd+[str(path),'-o',str(exe)],env=env,
                                     capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
                assert built.returncode==0,(compiler,built.stderr[-2800:])
                run=subprocess.run([str(exe)],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=6)
                assert run.returncode==0,(compiler,run.stderr[-1200:])
                print('P2_2B_NATIVE_TEXTURE_REENTRANT_FLUSH_PASS',variant,
                      Path(compiler).name,'O'+str(opt),
                      'NS2-lock' if native else 'NS1-normal',flush=True)
```

`tools/ns2/check_native_vi2_oom_host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""P1.3/P4.2: execute actual VI2 NVMap duplicate/lease/OOM hunk with mocks."""
from pathlib import Path
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
source=(root/'vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/graphics_supervisor/core/hle/service/am/service/graphics_supervisor.cpp').read_text()
lease_start='    std::unique_ptr<u32> lease_token;'
lease_end='    } catch (const std::bad_alloc&) {\n        // shared_ptr invoked our NVMap deleter if its allocation failed.\n        // Return an absent present image rather than unwinding through IPC.\n        return {};\n    }'
assert source.count(lease_start)==1 and source.count(lease_end)==1
start=source.index(lease_start)
end=source.index(lease_end,start)+len(lease_end)
lease_source=source[start:end]
assert lease_source.index('std::make_unique<u32>(backing)') < lease_source.index('Duplicate(true)')
assert lease_source.index('Duplicate(true)') < lease_source.index('lease_token.release()')
create_start='                            try {\n                                if (const auto created ='
create_end='                                result = Kernel::ResultOutOfResource;\n                            }'
assert source.count(create_start)==1 and source.count(create_end)==1
start=source.index(create_start)
end=source.index(create_end,start)+len(create_end)
create_source=source[start:end]
assert 'nvmap.FreeHandle(backing, true)' in create_source
assert 'catch (const std::bad_alloc&)' in create_source
cpp=r'''
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <memory>
#include <new>
#include <optional>
#include <utility>
using u32=std::uint32_t;
static int fail_allocation{};
void* operator new(std::size_t size) {
    if (fail_allocation && --fail_allocation==0) throw std::bad_alloc{};
    if (void* ptr=std::malloc(size)) return ptr;
    throw std::bad_alloc{};
}
void operator delete(void* ptr) noexcept { std::free(ptr); }
void operator delete(void* ptr,std::size_t) noexcept { std::free(ptr); }
namespace Nvidia {enum class NvResult { Success, Fail };}
struct NvMap {
    int freed{};
    void FreeHandle(u32,bool) { ++freed; }
};
struct Container {
    NvMap nvmap;
    NvMap& GetNvMapFile() { return nvmap; }
};
struct Module {
    Container container;
    Container& GetContainer() {return container;}
};
struct Handle {
    int duplicated{}, failures{};
    u32 size{4096};
    Nvidia::NvResult Duplicate(bool internal) {
        assert(internal);
        if (failures) return Nvidia::NvResult::Fail;
        ++duplicated;
        return Nvidia::NvResult::Success;
    }
};
struct Image {std::array<u32,16> preference{};};
struct PresentImage {
    std::array<u32,16> layout{};
    u32 backing{},offset{};
    std::shared_ptr<Module> module;
    std::shared_ptr<u32> lease;
};
namespace Kernel {constexpr int ResultOutOfResource=42;}
constexpr int ResultSuccess=0;
struct Ledger {
    bool throw_on_create{},refuse{};
    std::optional<u32> Create(u32,u32,int,int,u32 id) {
        if (throw_on_create) throw std::bad_alloc{};
        if (refuse) return {};
        return id;
    }
};
struct Owner {
    std::shared_ptr<Module> m_native_module=std::make_shared<Module>();
    Ledger m_native_images;
    std::uint64_t m_next_image_id{1};
    std::optional<PresentImage> Lease(Handle* backing_handle) {
        const u32 backing{12},offset{0};
        const auto image=std::make_shared<Image>();
__LEASE__
    }
    int CreateImage(Handle* handle) {
        auto& nvmap=m_native_module->GetContainer().GetNvMapFile();
        const u32 backing{12};
        const std::optional<int> requirements{1};
        const int preferences{};
        u32 id{};
        int result=Kernel::ResultOutOfResource;
        assert(handle->Duplicate(true)==Nvidia::NvResult::Success);
__CREATE__
        assert(result==Kernel::ResultOutOfResource || id!=0);
        return result;
    }
};
int main() {
    Owner obj;
    Handle handle;
    {
        auto lease=obj.Lease(&handle);
        assert(lease && lease->backing==12 && handle.duplicated==1);
        assert(obj.m_native_module->container.nvmap.freed==0);
    }
    assert(obj.m_native_module->container.nvmap.freed==1);
    handle.failures=1;
    assert(!obj.Lease(&handle));
    assert(handle.duplicated==1 && obj.m_native_module->container.nvmap.freed==1);
    handle.failures=0;
    // Pre-duplication new fails: no NVMap duplicate acquired.
    fail_allocation=1;
    assert(!obj.Lease(&handle));
    assert(handle.duplicated==1 && obj.m_native_module->container.nvmap.freed==1);
    // Post-duplication shared_ptr control-block new fails: its custom
    // deleter must release the already duplicated NVMap handle exactly once.
    fail_allocation=2;
    assert(!obj.Lease(&handle));
    assert(handle.duplicated==2 && obj.m_native_module->container.nvmap.freed==2);
    obj.m_native_images.throw_on_create=true;
    assert(obj.CreateImage(&handle)==Kernel::ResultOutOfResource);
    assert(handle.duplicated==3 && obj.m_native_module->container.nvmap.freed==3);
    obj.m_native_images.throw_on_create=false;
    obj.m_native_images.refuse=true;
    assert(obj.CreateImage(&handle)==Kernel::ResultOutOfResource);
    assert(handle.duplicated==4 && obj.m_native_module->container.nvmap.freed==4);
    obj.m_native_images.refuse=false;
    assert(obj.CreateImage(&handle)==Kernel::ResultOutOfResource || obj.m_next_image_id==2);
    assert(handle.duplicated==5 && obj.m_native_module->container.nvmap.freed==4);
}
```

```py
"""H04: execute real VI2 MaxResolution/Encoding owner bodies, both IPC verdicts.

This is a source-extracted, compiler-executed HOST test; it does not claim
a PS5 display, a real guest IPC transport, or a rendered NS2 frame.

def method(signature):
    assert source.count(signature) == 1, signature
    start = source.index(signature)
    brace = source.index("{", start)
    level = 0
    for i in range(brace, len(source)):
        if source[i] == "{":
            level += 1
        elif source[i] == "}":
            level -= 1
            if level == 0:
                return source[start:i + 1]
    raise AssertionError("Unterminated native VI2 method: " + signature)
```

```py
int main(){
 IGraphicsVideoDecoderSession run;
 auto& sync=run.system.Host1x().GetSyncpointManager();
 run.m_available.push_back({10,{}});
 run.m_pending.push_back(Pic(333));
 run.Pump();
 assert(run.m_outputs.size()==1 && run.m_outputs.front().image==10);
 assert(sync.values[4]==1 && run.m_owner->writes==1);
 assert(run.m_owner->last.size()==64 && run.m_owner->last[0]==0xa5);
 assert(run.m_guest_owned.contains(10) && run.m_available.empty() && run.m_pending.empty());
 // The decoder must never signal a fence if the target was destroyed.
 run.m_owner->valid=false;
 run.m_registered.insert(11);
 run.m_pending.push_back(Pic(444));run.m_available.push_back({11,{}});
 run.Pump();
 assert(sync.values[4]==1 && run.m_owner->writes==1 && run.m_outputs.size()==1);
 assert(run.m_pending.size()==1 && run.m_available.empty() &&
        !run.m_registered.contains(11));
 run.m_owner->valid=true;run.m_decoder->renderrunnable=false;
 run.m_registered.insert(18);run.m_available.push_back({18,{}});
 run.Pump();
 assert(sync.values[4]==1 && run.m_owner->writes==1);
 run.m_decoder->renderrunnable=true;run.m_owner->writability=false;
 run.Pump();
 assert(sync.values[4]==1 && run.m_owner->writes==1);
 run.m_owner->writability=true;
 run.Pump();
 assert(sync.values[4]==2 && run.m_owner->writes==2);
 // A release fence not yet reached must defer a valid decoded image.
 run.m_pending.push_back(Pic(555,true));
 run.m_available.push_back({12,IGraphicsVideoDecoderSession::ReleaseFence{9,3}});
 run.Pump();
 assert(sync.values[4]==2 && run.m_owner->writes==2);
 sync.values[9]=3;
 run.Pump();
 assert(sync.values[4]==3 && run.m_owner->writes==3 && run.m_outputs.back().eos);
 // P1.3: a stalled fence may block its OWN image, never a later ready
 // surface. The old FIFO-front Pump failed to produce image 17 here.
 run.m_pending.push_back(Pic(600));
 run.m_available.push_back({16,IGraphicsVideoDecoderSession::ReleaseFence{9,5}});
 run.m_available.push_back({17,{}});
 run.Pump();
 assert(sync.values[4]==4 && run.m_owner->writes==4);
 assert(run.m_outputs.back().image==17 &&
        run.m_available.size()==1 && run.m_available.front().id==16 &&
        !run.m_pending.size());
 run.m_pending.push_back(Pic(601));
 run.Pump();
 assert(sync.values[4]==4 && run.m_pending.size()==1);
 sync.values[9]=5;
 run.Pump();
 assert(sync.values[4]==5 && run.m_owner->writes==5 &&
        run.m_outputs.back().image==16 && run.m_available.empty());
 // An unstarted or unconfigured decoder cannot emit a guest frame.
 run.m_pending.push_back(Pic(777));run.m_available.push_back({13,{}});
 run.m_started=false;run.Pump();
 assert(sync.values[4]==5 && run.m_owner->writes==5);
 run.m_started=true;run.m_decoder.reset();run.Pump();
 assert(sync.values[4]==5 && run.m_owner->writes==5);
 // Restore the valid codec: real RGB GPU maps require the tiled handoff.
 run.m_decoder=std::make_unique<FakeDecoder>();
 run.Pump();
 assert(sync.values[4]==6 && run.m_owner->writes==6);
 run.m_owner->gpu=true;
 run.m_available.push_back({14,{}});run.m_pending.push_back(Pic(888));
 run.Pump();
 assert(sync.values[4]==7 && run.m_owner->writes==7 &&
        run.m_owner->last[0]==0x5a && Tegra::Texture::swizzles==1);
 // NV12 is deliberately pitch-linear even when mapped by the GPU.
 run.m_owner->nv12=true;
 run.m_available.push_back({15,{}});run.m_pending.push_back(Pic(999));
 run.Pump();
 assert(sync.values[4]==8 && run.m_owner->writes==8 &&
        run.m_owner->last[0]==0xa5 && Tegra::Texture::swizzles==1);
 // An invalidated pool must not strand the next ready surface or release a
 // fake fence. Execute the actual maintained Pump against two queue entries:
 // first destroyed, second valid, same queued decoded frame.
 run.m_owner->retired.insert(20);
 run.m_registered.insert(20);run.m_registered.insert(21);
 run.m_available.push_back({20,{}});run.m_available.push_back({21,{}});
 run.m_pending.push_back(Pic(1000));
 run.Pump();
 assert(sync.values[4]==9 && run.m_owner->writes==9);
 assert(run.m_outputs.back().image==21 && run.m_pending.empty() &&
        run.m_available.empty() && !run.m_registered.contains(20) &&
        run.m_registered.contains(21));
 // Stop does not invalidate a frame ALREADY published to the output FIFO.
 // Drain its real metadata before the caller unregisters the image pool.
 HLERequestContext ctx;
 run.m_outputs.clear();
 run.m_started=false;
 run.GetOutputInfo(ctx);
 assert(ctx.response.size()==1 && ctx.response[0]==Kernel::ResultInvalidState);
 run.m_outputs.push_back({23,4,4,901,true});
 run.m_guest_owned.insert(23);
 run.m_registered.insert(23);
 HLERequestContext release;
 release.command[2]=23;
 // ~0 == NoSyncpoint and zero value: no external release fence.
 release.command[4]=0;
 release.command[6]=0;
 run.ReleaseBuffer(release);
 assert(release.response.size()==1 && release.response[0]==Kernel::ResultBusy &&
        run.m_guest_owned.contains(23) && run.m_available.empty() &&
        run.m_reserved_value==0);
 run.GetOutputInfo(ctx);
 assert(run.m_outputs.empty() && ctx.response.size()==17 &&
        ctx.response[0]==ResultSuccess && ctx.response[1]==23 &&
        ctx.response[7]==901000U && ctx.response[9]==1U);
 run.ReleaseBuffer(release);
 assert(release.response.size()==5 && release.response[0]==ResultSuccess &&
        !run.m_guest_owned.contains(23) &&
        run.m_available.size()==1 && run.m_available.front().id==23 &&
        run.m_reserved_value==1);
 run.GetOutputInfo(ctx);
 assert(ctx.response.size()==1 && ctx.response[0]==Kernel::ResultInvalidState);
}
'''.replace('__ACTUAL_PUMP__',method).replace('__ACTUAL_OUTPUT__',output_method).replace('__ACTUAL_RELEASE__',release_method)
```

```py
// Encode real planar pixels with FFmpeg's in-tree MPEG4 encoder; then decode
// the compressed packet with FFmpeg's genuine decoder. No fake AVFrame.
std::vector<u8> encoded_mpeg4;
AVFrame* CodecRoundTrip() {
    const AVCodec* encoder=avcodec_find_encoder(AV_CODEC_ID_MPEG4);
    const AVCodec* decoder=avcodec_find_decoder(AV_CODEC_ID_MPEG4);
    assert(encoder && decoder);
    AVCodecContext* enc=avcodec_alloc_context3(encoder);
    assert(enc);
    enc->width=16; enc->height=16; enc->pix_fmt=AV_PIX_FMT_YUV420P;
    enc->time_base=AVRational{1,30}; enc->gop_size=1; enc->max_b_frames=0;
    assert(avcodec_open2(enc,encoder,nullptr)==0);
    AVFrame* input=av_frame_alloc();
    assert(input);
    input->format=AV_PIX_FMT_YUV420P;input->width=16;input->height=16;input->pts=1;
    assert(av_frame_get_buffer(input,32)==0);
    assert(av_frame_make_writable(input)==0);
    for(int y=0;y<16;++y)
        std::memset(input->data[0]+y*input->linesize[0],82,16);
    for(int y=0;y<8;++y){
        std::memset(input->data[1]+y*input->linesize[1],90,8);
        std::memset(input->data[2]+y*input->linesize[2],240,8);
    }
    assert(avcodec_send_frame(enc,input)==0);
    AVPacket* packet=av_packet_alloc();
    assert(packet);
    int ret=avcodec_receive_packet(enc,packet);
    if(ret==AVERROR(EAGAIN)){
        assert(avcodec_send_frame(enc,nullptr)==0);
        ret=avcodec_receive_packet(enc,packet);
    }
    assert(ret==0 && packet->size>0);
    encoded_mpeg4.assign(packet->data,packet->data+packet->size);
    AVCodecContext* dec=avcodec_alloc_context3(decoder);
    assert(dec && avcodec_open2(dec,decoder,nullptr)==0);
    assert(avcodec_send_packet(dec,packet)==0);
    AVFrame* output=av_frame_alloc();
    assert(output);
    ret=avcodec_receive_frame(dec,output);
    if(ret==AVERROR(EAGAIN)){
        assert(avcodec_send_packet(dec,nullptr)==0);
        ret=avcodec_receive_frame(dec,output);
    }
    assert(ret==0 && output->width==16 && output->height==16);
    assert(output->format==AV_PIX_FMT_YUV420P);
    av_frame_free(&input);
    av_packet_free(&packet);
    avcodec_free_context(&enc);
    avcodec_free_context(&dec);
    return output;
}

// Authentic HEVC Annex-B access unit from native Decode/Drain qualification.
```
