```py
// A real host Vulkan command and VkFence drive guest release readiness.
// The decoder's production Pump, NVMap/guest memory and Host1x syncpoint
// owners remain source-extracted/compiled below. This is NOT a live PS5 TIPC.
class VulkanVideoRelease {
    VkInstance instance{};
    VkPhysicalDevice physical{};
    VkDevice device{};
    VkQueue queue{};
    VkBuffer buffer{};
    VkDeviceMemory memory{};
    VkCommandPool pool{};
    VkCommandBuffer command{};
    VkFence fence{};
    u32* mapped{};
public:
    VulkanVideoRelease() {
        VkApplicationInfo ai{}; ai.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_APPLICATION_INFO;
        ai.apiVersion = VK_API_VERSION_1_1;
        VkInstanceCreateInfo ci{}; ci.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_INSTANCE_CREATE_INFO;
        ci.pApplicationInfo = &ai;
        assert(vkCreateInstance(&ci,nullptr,&instance)==VK_SUCCESS);
        u32 count{};
        assert(vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices(instance,&count,nullptr)==VK_SUCCESS && count);
        std::vector<VkPhysicalDevice> devs(count);
        assert(vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices(instance,&count,devs.data())==VK_SUCCESS);
        u32 family{};
        bool found{};
        for(auto p:devs) {
            u32 queues{};
            vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties(p,&queues,nullptr);
            std::vector<VkQueueFamilyProperties> properties(queues);
            vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties(p,&queues,properties.data());
            for(u32 i=0;i<queues;++i) {
                if(properties[i].queueCount &&
                   (properties[i].queueFlags & VK_QUEUE_TRANSFER_BIT)) {
                    physical=p;family=i;found=true;break;
                }
            }
            if(found)break;
        }
        assert(found);
        const float priority=1.0f;
        VkDeviceQueueCreateInfo qi{}; qi.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_QUEUE_CREATE_INFO;
        qi.queueFamilyIndex=family;qi.queueCount=1;qi.pQueuePriorities=&priority;
        VkDeviceCreateInfo di{}; di.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_CREATE_INFO;
        di.queueCreateInfoCount=1;di.pQueueCreateInfos=&qi;
        assert(vkCreateDevice(physical,&di,nullptr,&device)==VK_SUCCESS);
        vkGetDeviceQueue(device,family,0,&queue);
        VkBufferCreateInfo bi{}; bi.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO;
        bi.size=sizeof(u32);bi.usage=VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT;
        bi.sharingMode=VK_SHARING_MODE_EXCLUSIVE;
        assert(vkCreateBuffer(device,&bi,nullptr,&buffer)==VK_SUCCESS);
        VkMemoryRequirements requirements{};
        vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements(device,buffer,&requirements);
        VkPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties memory_properties{};
        vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties(physical,&memory_properties);
        u32 type=memory_properties.memoryTypeCount;
        for(u32 i=0;i<memory_properties.memoryTypeCount;++i) {
            if((requirements.memoryTypeBits & (1U<<i)) &&
                (memory_properties.memoryTypes[i].propertyFlags &
                (VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT |
                 VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT)) ==
                (VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT |
                 VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT)) {type=i;break;}
        }
        assert(type<memory_properties.memoryTypeCount);
        VkMemoryAllocateInfo mai{}; mai.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO;
        mai.allocationSize=requirements.size;mai.memoryTypeIndex=type;
        assert(vkAllocateMemory(device,&mai,nullptr,&memory)==VK_SUCCESS);
        assert(vkBindBufferMemory(device,buffer,memory,0)==VK_SUCCESS);
        void* raw{};
        assert(vkMapMemory(device,memory,0,sizeof(u32),0,&raw)==VK_SUCCESS);
        mapped=static_cast<u32*>(raw);
        *mapped=0;
        VkCommandPoolCreateInfo pci{}; pci.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_POOL_CREATE_INFO;
        pci.queueFamilyIndex=family;
        pci.flags=VK_COMMAND_POOL_CREATE_RESET_COMMAND_BUFFER_BIT;
        assert(vkCreateCommandPool(device,&pci,nullptr,&pool)==VK_SUCCESS);
        VkCommandBufferAllocateInfo bai{}; bai.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_ALLOCATE_INFO;
        bai.commandPool=pool;bai.level=VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_LEVEL_PRIMARY;
        bai.commandBufferCount=1;
        assert(vkAllocateCommandBuffers(device,&bai,&command)==VK_SUCCESS);
        VkFenceCreateInfo fi{}; fi.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_FENCE_CREATE_INFO;
        assert(vkCreateFence(device,&fi,nullptr,&fence)==VK_SUCCESS);
    }
    void Submit(u32 guest_release_value) {
        assert(vkResetCommandBuffer(command,0)==VK_SUCCESS);
        assert(vkResetFences(device,1,&fence)==VK_SUCCESS);
        VkCommandBufferBeginInfo begin{}; begin.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_BEGIN_INFO;
        begin.flags=VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_USAGE_ONE_TIME_SUBMIT_BIT;
        assert(vkBeginCommandBuffer(command,&begin)==VK_SUCCESS);
        vkCmdFillBuffer(command,buffer,0,sizeof(u32),guest_release_value);
        VkBufferMemoryBarrier barrier{}; barrier.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_MEMORY_BARRIER;
        barrier.srcAccessMask=VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT;
        barrier.dstAccessMask=VK_ACCESS_HOST_READ_BIT;
        barrier.srcQueueFamilyIndex=VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
        barrier.dstQueueFamilyIndex=VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
        barrier.buffer=buffer;barrier.offset=0;barrier.size=sizeof(u32);
        vkCmdPipelineBarrier(command,VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT,
                             VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_HOST_BIT,0,0,nullptr,1,&barrier,0,nullptr);
        assert(vkEndCommandBuffer(command)==VK_SUCCESS);
        VkSubmitInfo info{}; info.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SUBMIT_INFO;
        info.commandBufferCount=1;info.pCommandBuffers=&command;
        assert(vkQueueSubmit(queue,1,&info,fence)==VK_SUCCESS);
    }
    u32 Retire() {
        assert(vkWaitForFences(device,1,&fence,VK_TRUE,10000000000ULL)==VK_SUCCESS);
        return *mapped; // Coherent host buffer only after genuine VkFence.
    }
    ~VulkanVideoRelease() {
        if(device)vkDeviceWaitIdle(device);
        if(fence)vkDestroyFence(device,fence,nullptr);
        if(pool)vkDestroyCommandPool(device,pool,nullptr);
        if(mapped)vkUnmapMemory(device,memory);
        if(buffer)vkDestroyBuffer(device,buffer,nullptr);
        if(memory)vkFreeMemory(device,memory,nullptr);
        if(device)vkDestroyDevice(device,nullptr);
        if(instance)vkDestroyInstance(instance,nullptr);
    }
};

template<class P,class O>bool MarkLastEos(P& pending,O& outputs) {
    if(!pending.empty()){pending.back().eos=true;return true;}
    if(!outputs.empty()){outputs.back().eos=true;return true;}
    return false;
}

struct GuestMemory {
    bool valid{true},writable{true},throw_write{};
    std::vector<u8> bytes=std::vector<u8>(384,0xCC);
    unsigned writes{};
    bool IsValidVirtualAddressRange(Common::ProcessAddress a,std::size_t n){
        return valid&&a.address==0x2000&&n<=bytes.size();
    }
    bool WriteBlock(Common::ProcessAddress a,const u8* src,std::size_t n){
        if(throw_write)throw std::bad_alloc{};
        if(!writable||a.address!=0x2000||n>bytes.size())return false;
        std::memcpy(bytes.data(),src,n);
        ++writes;return true;
    }

int main(){
    using namespace Tegra::Host1x;
    auto frame=std::make_shared<FFmpeg::Frame>(CodecRoundTrip());
    const auto* f=frame->GetFrame();
    const Nx2Picture picture{16,16,123,frame};
    Nx2VideoDecoder dec;
    constexpr std::size_t luma=16*16;
    constexpr std::size_t size=luma+16*8;
    std::vector<u8> nv12(size+16,0xA5);
    assert(dec.Render(picture,Nx2PictureFormat::Nv12,16,16,16,luma,
                      std::span<u8>(nv12.data(),size)));
    for(int y=0;y<16;++y)
        for(int x=0;x<16;++x)
            assert(nv12[y*16+x]==f->data[0][y*f->linesize[0]+x]);
    for(int y=0;y<8;++y)
        for(int x=0;x<8;++x){
            assert(nv12[luma+y*16+x*2]==f->data[1][y*f->linesize[1]+x]);
            assert(nv12[luma+y*16+x*2+1]==f->data[2][y*f->linesize[2]+x]);
        }
    assert(std::all_of(nv12.begin()+size,nv12.end(),[](u8 x){return x==0xA5;}));
    constexpr std::size_t rgba_size=16*16*4;
    std::vector<u8> rgba(rgba_size+16,0xA5);
    assert(dec.Render(picture,Nx2PictureFormat::Rgba8,16,16,64,0,
                      std::span<u8>(rgba.data(),rgba_size)));
    assert(std::any_of(rgba.begin(),rgba.begin()+rgba_size,
                       [](u8 x){return x!=0xA5;}));
    assert(std::all_of(rgba.begin()+rgba_size,rgba.end(),
                       [](u8 x){return x==0xA5;}));
    std::vector<u8> invalid(size+16,0xEE);
    auto reject=[&](Nx2PictureFormat format,u32 width,u32 height,u64 pitch,
                    u64 chroma,std::size_t available){
        std::fill(invalid.begin(),invalid.end(),0xEE);
        assert(!dec.Render(picture,format,width,height,pitch,chroma,
                           std::span<u8>(invalid.data(),available)));
        assert(std::all_of(invalid.begin(),invalid.end(),
                           [](u8 x){return x==0xEE;}));
    };
    reject(Nx2PictureFormat::Nv12,16,16,15,luma,size);
    reject(Nx2PictureFormat::Nv12,16,16,16,luma-1,size);
    reject(Nx2PictureFormat::Nv12,16,16,16,luma,size-1);
    reject(Nx2PictureFormat::Rgba8,16,16,63,0,size);
    reject(Nx2PictureFormat::Nv12,0,16,16,luma,size);
    reject(Nx2PictureFormat::Nv12,16,16,
           static_cast<u64>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())+1,0,size);
    std::puts("H05_REAL_FFMPEG_DECODED_FRAME_RENDER_PASS "
              "codec=MPEG4 pixels=FFmpeg decoded NV12=exact RGBA=converted "
              "oob_pitch_offset_size=refused guest_fence=not_exercised");
    // The ACTUAL maintained AM session Pump runs on real decoded pixels
    // and the exact GraphicsSupervisor guest-write owner. A real Vulkan
    // queue/fence now gates the release readiness, not a synthetic completion.
    VulkanVideoRelease release_gpu;
    using Service::AM::IGraphicsVideoDecoderSession;
    IGraphicsVideoDecoderSession session;
    session.m_registered.insert(9);
    session.m_pending.push_back({picture,true});
    session.m_available.push_back({8,{{7,99}}}); // blocked older image
    session.m_available.push_back({9,{{7,10}}}); // ready only at fence 10
    release_gpu.Submit(10); // actual vkCmdFillBuffer + vkQueueSubmit
    session.Pump(); // guest fence must not advance on submission alone
    assert(session.m_outputs.empty() && session.m_pending.size()==1);
    assert(session.system.host.sync.GetGuestSyncpointValue(5)==0 &&
           session.m_owner->process.memory.writes==0);
    assert(session.system.host.sync.GetGuestSyncpointValue(7)==0);
    const u32 completed_release = release_gpu.Retire();
    assert(completed_release==10);
    for(u32 i=0;i<completed_release;++i)
        session.system.host.sync.IncrementGuest(7);
    assert(session.system.host.sync.GetGuestSyncpointValue(7)==10);
    session.m_owner->process.memory.writable=false;
    session.Pump();
    assert(session.m_outputs.empty() && session.m_pending.size()==1 &&
           session.m_guest_owned.empty());
    assert(session.m_owner->process.memory.writes==0 && session.system.host.sync.GetGuestSyncpointValue(5)==0);
    session.m_owner->process.memory.writable=true;
    // Exercise the ACTUAL maintained Pump through a late host allocation
    // failure after metadata/guest ownership have already been staged.
    session.m_owner->process.memory.throw_write=true;
    session.Pump();
    assert(session.m_outputs.empty() && session.m_pending.size()==1 &&
           session.m_guest_owned.empty() && session.m_available.size()==2);
    assert(session.system.host.sync.GetGuestSyncpointValue(5)==0);
    session.m_owner->process.memory.throw_write=false;
    session.Pump();
    assert(session.m_owner->process.memory.writes==1 && session.system.host.sync.GetGuestSyncpointValue(5)==1);
    assert(session.system.gpu.invalidations==1 && session.system.gpu.address==0x9000 &&
           session.system.gpu.bytes==384);
    assert(session.m_outputs.size()==1 && session.m_outputs.front().image==9 &&
           session.m_outputs.front().pts==123 && session.m_outputs.front().eos);
    assert(session.m_pending.empty() && session.m_guest_owned.contains(9));
    assert(session.m_available.size()==1 && session.m_available.front().id==8);
    assert(session.m_owner->process.memory.bytes.size()==size);
    for(int y=0;y<16;++y)
       for(int x=0;x<16;++x)
          assert(session.m_owner->process.memory.bytes[y*16+x]==f->data[0][y*f->linesize[0]+x]);
    for(int y=0;y<8;++y)
       for(int x=0;x<8;++x) {
          assert(session.m_owner->process.memory.bytes[luma+y*16+2*x]==f->data[1][y*f->linesize[1]+x]);
          assert(session.m_owner->process.memory.bytes[luma+y*16+2*x+1]==f->data[2][y*f->linesize[2]+x]);
       }
    // An impossible guest image is retired without fabricating an output.
    session.m_pending.push_back({picture,false});
    release_gpu.Submit(99);
    session.Pump(); // blocked older image still cannot complete early
    assert(session.m_outputs.size()==1 && session.m_pending.size()==1);
    assert(session.system.host.sync.GetGuestSyncpointValue(5)==1);
    const u32 second_release = release_gpu.Retire();
    assert(second_release==99);
    for(u32 i=10;i<second_release;++i)
        session.system.host.sync.IncrementGuest(7);
    assert(session.system.host.sync.GetGuestSyncpointValue(7)==99);
    session.Pump();
    assert(session.m_outputs.size()==1 && session.m_pending.size()==1);
    assert(session.system.host.sync.GetGuestSyncpointValue(5)==1 &&
           session.m_available.empty());
    // A bad stride cannot write or acknowledge a pending guest frame.
    session.m_owner->surface->layout.row_bytes=14;
    session.m_available.push_back({9,std::nullopt});
    session.Pump();
    assert(session.m_pending.size()==1 && session.m_outputs.size()==1 &&
           session.system.host.sync.GetGuestSyncpointValue(5)==1);
    session.m_owner->surface->layout.row_bytes=16;
    session.Pump();
    assert(session.m_pending.empty() && session.m_outputs.size()==2 &&
           session.system.host.sync.GetGuestSyncpointValue(5)==2 && session.m_owner->process.memory.writes==2);
    assert(session.system.gpu.invalidations==2);
    // Execute the actual maintained SDK SubmitInput entrypoint, not merely
    // a pre-populated Pump fixture. Its packet is genuinely decoded by
    // FFmpeg; an actual Vulkan fence gates the live SyncpointManager before
    // the maintained Pump + GraphicsSupervisor write guest NVMap bytes.
    // Actual supervisor admission and child session owner methods; kernel
    // session creation and bootstrap state are bounded host stand-ins.
    Service::AM::FakeSystem guest_system;
    auto owner=std::make_shared<Service::AM::IGraphicsSupervisor>(guest_system);
    HLERequestContext parent_request;
    parent_request.command=902;
    parent_request.words[0]=parent_request.GetCommand()+0x10;
    owner->m_bootstrap.ready=false;
    owner->OpenVideoDecoderSession(parent_request);
    assert(parent_request.response.size()==1 &&
           parent_request.response[0]==Kernel::ResultInvalidState &&
           !parent_request.handler && parent_request.moved==0);
    owner->m_bootstrap.ready=true;
    parent_request.words[0]=0;parent_request.response.clear();
    owner->OpenVideoDecoderSession(parent_request);
    assert(parent_request.response.size()==1 &&
           parent_request.response[0]==Kernel::ResultInvalidCombination &&
           !parent_request.handler && parent_request.moved==0);
    parent_request.words[0]=parent_request.GetCommand()+0x10;
    parent_request.response.clear();
    owner->OpenVideoDecoderSession(parent_request);
    assert(parent_request.response.size()==1 &&
           parent_request.response[0]==ResultSuccess &&
           parent_request.handler && parent_request.moved==1);
    const auto parent=std::static_pointer_cast<IGraphicsVideoDecoderSession>(
        parent_request.handler);
    assert(parent->m_creator);
    HLERequestContext child_request;
    owner->OpenVideoDecoderChildSession(child_request);
    assert(child_request.response.size()==1 &&
           child_request.response[0]==ResultSuccess &&
           child_request.handler && child_request.moved==1);
    auto child=std::static_pointer_cast<IGraphicsVideoDecoderSession>(
        child_request.handler);
    assert(!child->m_creator && child->m_owner.get()==owner.get());
    IGraphicsVideoDecoderSession& from_tipc=*child;
    from_tipc.m_registered.insert(9);
    from_tipc.m_available.push_back({9,{{7,3}}});
    HLERequestContext input;
    input.descriptors.push_back(0);
    input.compressed.assign(encoded_hevc.begin(),encoded_hevc.end());
    input.words[0]=input.GetCommand()+0x10;
    input.words[1]=3;input.words[5]=777;input.words[6]=0;input.words[7]=1;
    from_tipc.SubmitInput(input);
    assert(input.response.size()==2 && input.response[0]==ResultSuccess &&
           input.response[1]==1 && from_tipc.m_submitted==1);
    assert(from_tipc.m_pending.size()==1 && from_tipc.m_outputs.empty() &&
           from_tipc.m_pending.front().eos &&
           from_tipc.m_owner->process.memory.writes==0 &&
           from_tipc.system.host.sync.GetGuestSyncpointValue(5)==0);
    const auto decoded_tipc=from_tipc.m_pending.front().picture.frame;
    assert(decoded_tipc && decoded_tipc->GetFrame()->width==16 &&
           decoded_tipc->GetFrame()->height==16);
    release_gpu.Submit(3);
    from_tipc.Pump(); // queued Vulkan commands do not unlock the image
    assert(from_tipc.m_outputs.empty() && from_tipc.m_pending.size()==1);
    assert(release_gpu.Retire()==3);
    for(u32 i=0;i<3;++i)from_tipc.system.host.sync.IncrementGuest(7);
    from_tipc.Pump();
    assert(from_tipc.m_pending.empty() && from_tipc.m_outputs.size()==1 &&
           from_tipc.m_outputs.front().pts==777 &&
           from_tipc.m_owner->process.memory.writes==1 &&
           from_tipc.system.host.sync.GetGuestSyncpointValue(5)==1 &&
           from_tipc.system.gpu.invalidations==1);
    for(int y=0;y<16;++y)
        for(int x=0;x<16;++x)
            assert(from_tipc.m_owner->process.memory.bytes[y*16+x]==
                   decoded_tipc->GetFrame()->data[0][y*decoded_tipc->GetFrame()->linesize[0]+x]);
    // Malformed TIPC command must fail before decoding or publishing bytes.
    HLERequestContext bad=input;
    bad.response.clear();bad.words[0]=0;
    from_tipc.SubmitInput(bad);
    assert(bad.response.size()==1 && bad.response[0]==Kernel::ResultInvalidCombination);
    assert(from_tipc.m_submitted==1 &&
           from_tipc.system.host.sync.GetGuestSyncpointValue(5)==1);
    HLERequestContext bad_pts=input;
    bad_pts.response.clear();bad_pts.words[6]=0x80000000U;
    from_tipc.SubmitInput(bad_pts);
    assert(bad_pts.response.size()==1 && bad_pts.response[0]==Kernel::ResultInvalidArgument);
    assert(from_tipc.m_submitted==1);
    HLERequestContext invalid_codec=input;
    invalid_codec.response.clear();
    from_tipc.m_decoder=
        std::make_unique<Tegra::Host1x::Nx2VideoDecoder>("video/unknown");
    from_tipc.SubmitInput(invalid_codec);
    assert(invalid_codec.response.size()==1 &&
           invalid_codec.response[0]==Kernel::ResultInvalidState &&
           from_tipc.m_submitted==1 &&
           from_tipc.system.host.sync.GetGuestSyncpointValue(5)==1);
    std::puts("H05_REAL_SUBMITINPUT_FFMPEG_VULKAN_OWNER_PASS"
              " submit_owner=executed real_codec=HEVC"
              " native_decode_owner=executed native_drain_owner=executed"
              " supervisor_auth_owner=executed child_session_owner=executed"
              " denied_bootstrap=held invalid_codec=refused"
              " kernel_session=host_fixture"
              " owner_pump=executed owner_nvmap_guest_write=executed"
              " real_vk_fence_retired=1 guest_completion_after_write=1"
              " invalid_tipc=refused invalid_pts=refused"
              " authenticated_production_tipc=not_exercised");

    std::puts("H05_REAL_FFMPEG_PUMP_OWNER_PASS decoded_nv12=exact "
              "blocked_release=held no_head_of_line=1 failed_write=rolled_back "
              "guest_syncpoint_real_owner_after_write=1 invalid_stride=no_completion "
              "dead_image=retired write_oom=rolled_back owner_nvmap_guest_write=1 real_host_vk_fence_to_guest_syncpoint=1 live_TIPC=not_exercised");
}
""".replace("__REAL_OWNER__",real).replace("__REAL_HELPERS__",helpers).replace("__REAL_PUMP__",pump).replace("__REAL_SUBMIT__",submit).replace("__REAL_SURFACE_WRITE__",surface_write).replace("__REAL_OPEN_VIDEO__",open_video).replace("__REAL_CHILD_VIDEO__",child_video)
```

```py
#include <cassert>
```

```py
#include <memory>
#include <new>

#include <initializer_list>
using u8=std::uint8_t;
using u32=std::uint32_t;

struct Result {int raw{};bool IsError() const {return raw!=0;}};
inline constexpr Result ResultSuccess{0};
namespace Kernel {
enum class KMemoryState {IoMemory};
inline constexpr Result ResultOutOfResource{1},ResultInvalidState{2};
inline constexpr u32 PageSize=4096;
}
struct CoreKernel {};
struct Pages {
    static inline unsigned closed{};
    void Close(CoreKernel&) {++closed;}
};
struct PageTable {
    bool fail_unmap{};
    unsigned unmaps{};
    Result UnmapPageGroup(u64,Pages&,Kernel::KMemoryState) {
        ++unmaps;
        return fail_unmap ? Kernel::ResultInvalidState : ResultSuccess;
    }
};
u64 GetInteger(u64 v){return v;}
namespace Nvidia {
enum class NvResult {Success,InvalidState,InsufficientMemory};
namespace NvCore {
struct SessionId {u32 id{};};
namespace NvMap {
struct Handle {
    u32 id{43};
    bool oom_alloc{},fail_alloc{};
    NvResult Alloc(std::initializer_list<int>,u32,u32,u64,SessionId session) {
        assert(session.id==12);
        if (oom_alloc)throw std::bad_alloc{};
        return fail_alloc ? NvResult::InvalidState : NvResult::Success;
    }
};
}
}
namespace Devices {
struct NativeSparseRemapEntry {
    u32 flags{},handle{};
    u64 destination_pages{},pages{};
};
struct AddressSpace {
    bool fail_remap{};
    unsigned calls{};
    NvResult RemapNativeSparse(std::span<const NativeSparseRemapEntry> entries) {
        assert(entries.size()==1 && entries.front().handle==43);
        ++calls;
        return fail_remap ? NvResult::InvalidState : NvResult::Success;
    }
};
}
struct NvMapFile {
    bool create_oom{},create_fail{},alloc_oom{},alloc_fail{};
    unsigned created{},freed{};
    NvResult CreateHandle(u64 size,std::shared_ptr<NvCore::NvMap::Handle>& out) {
        assert(size==4096);
        ++created;
        if(create_oom)throw std::bad_alloc{};
        if(create_fail)return NvResult::InvalidState;
        out=std::make_shared<NvCore::NvMap::Handle>();
        out->oom_alloc=alloc_oom;
        out->fail_alloc=alloc_fail;
        return NvResult::Success;
    }
    void FreeHandle(u32 id,bool should) {
        assert(id==43 && !should);
        ++freed;
    }
};
struct Container {
    NvMapFile file{};
    NvMapFile& GetNvMapFile(){return file;}
};
struct Module {
    Container container{};
    Container& GetContainer(){return container;}
};
}
struct Shared {
    std::shared_ptr<Nvidia::Devices::AddressSpace> as{
        std::make_shared<Nvidia::Devices::AddressSpace>()};
    auto FindOwnedAddressSpace(u32 id) {assert(id==7);return as;}
};
#define LOG_ERROR(...) ((void)0)
struct Worker {
    CoreKernel kernel{};
    PageTable table{};
    Nvidia::Module module{};
    Nvidia::Module* m_module{&module};
    Shared shared{};
    Shared* m_shared{&shared};
    std::optional<u32> m_nv_session{12};
    std::unique_ptr<Pages> pages{std::make_unique<Pages>()};
    u64 alias{0x1000},size{4096},address{0x6000};
    u8 page_shift{12};
    u32 address_space{7};
    Result Run(){
__REAL_OWNER__
        return ResultSuccess;
    }
};
int main(){
    {
        Worker w;
        w.module.container.file.create_oom=true;
        const auto prev=Pages::closed;
        assert(w.Run().raw==Kernel::ResultOutOfResource.raw);
        assert(w.table.unmaps==1 && Pages::closed==prev+1);
        assert(w.module.container.file.freed==0 && w.shared.as->calls==0);
    }
    {
        Worker w;
        w.module.container.file.alloc_oom=true;
        const auto prev=Pages::closed;
        assert(w.Run().raw==Kernel::ResultOutOfResource.raw);
        assert(w.table.unmaps==1 && Pages::closed==prev+1);
        assert(w.module.container.file.freed==1 && w.shared.as->calls==0);
    }
    {
        Worker w;
        w.module.container.file.alloc_fail=true;
        const auto prev=Pages::closed;
        assert(w.Run().raw==Kernel::ResultInvalidState.raw);
        assert(w.table.unmaps==1 && Pages::closed==prev+1);
        assert(w.module.container.file.freed==1);
    }
    {
        Worker w;
        w.shared.as->fail_remap=true;
        const auto prev=Pages::closed;
        assert(w.Run().raw==Kernel::ResultInvalidState.raw);
        assert(w.table.unmaps==1 && Pages::closed==prev+1);
        assert(w.module.container.file.freed==1);
    }
    {
        Worker w;
        const auto prev=Pages::closed;
        assert(w.Run().raw==0);
        assert(w.table.unmaps==0 && Pages::closed==prev);
        assert(w.module.container.file.freed==0 && w.shared.as->calls==1);
    }
    {
        Worker w;
        w.module.container.file.alloc_oom=true;
        w.table.fail_unmap=true;
        const auto prev=Pages::closed;
        Pages* preserved=w.pages.get();
        assert(w.Run().raw==Kernel::ResultOutOfResource.raw);
        assert(w.table.unmaps==1 && Pages::closed==prev && !w.pages);
        assert(w.module.container.file.freed==1);
        delete preserved; // fixture reclaims simulated still-mapped backing
    }
}
""".replace("__REAL_OWNER__",owner)
```

`tools/ns2/check_native_worker_session_oom_host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""H03: execute native worker OpenSession OOM guards with real CPU-alias rollback.

Both native BackGpuOnlyRegion and RegisterMemory owners supply the source
bodies; mock injected NVDRV OOM cannot leave a dangling mapped alias or a
published GPU memory handle. Host proof only, no PS5 execution.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
source=(ROOT/"vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/gpu_session/core/hle/service/am/service/gpu_worker.cpp").read_text()
sparse=source.split("Result IGpuWorker::BackGpuOnlyRegion(",1)[1].split(
    "bool IGpuWorker::RetireGpuOnlyRegion(",1)[0]
registered=source.split("Result IGpuWorker::RegisterMemory(",1)[1].split(
    "Result IGpuWorker::ReleaseMemory(",1)[0]
def stage(src,begin,end):
    assert src.count(begin)==src.count(end)==1,(begin,end)
    return begin+src.split(begin,1)[1].split(end,1)[0]
a=stage(sparse,"    // Native sparse pages already have a CPU alias at this point.","    auto& nvmap =")
b=stage(registered,"    // A session allocation failure happens before any NVMap handle","    auto& nvmap =")
assert a.index("table.UnmapPageGroup(") < a.index("pages->Close(kernel)")
assert "pages.release()" in a and "return undone;" in a
assert "catch (const std::bad_alloc&)" in a and "catch (const std::bad_alloc&)" in b
assert "return Kernel::ResultOutOfResource;" in a and "return Kernel::ResultOutOfResource;" in b
harness=r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <memory>
#include <new>
#include <optional>
struct Result {
    int raw{};
    bool IsError() const { return raw!=0; }
};
inline constexpr Result ResultSuccess{0};
namespace Kernel {
inline constexpr Result ResultOutOfResource{1}, ResultInvalidState{2};
enum class KMemoryState { IoMemory };
}
struct CoreKernel {};
struct Pages {
    static inline int closed{},destroyed{};
    static inline Pages* latest{};
    Pages(){ latest=this; }
    void Close(CoreKernel&) { ++closed; }
    ~Pages(){ ++destroyed; }
};
struct PageTable {
    bool fail_unmap{};
    unsigned unmap_calls{};
    Result UnmapPageGroup(unsigned,Pages&,Kernel::KMemoryState state) {
        assert(state==Kernel::KMemoryState::IoMemory);
        ++unmap_calls;
        return fail_unmap ? Kernel::ResultInvalidState : ResultSuccess;
    }
};
struct Container {
    bool fail_open{};
    unsigned calls{};
    struct Session {unsigned id;};
    Session OpenSession(void* process) {
        assert(process);
        ++calls;
        if(fail_open)throw std::bad_alloc{};
        return {37};
    }
};
struct Module {
    Container container{};
    Container& GetContainer(){return container;}
};
#define LOG_ERROR(...) ((void)0)
struct Worker {
    CoreKernel kernel{};
    PageTable table{};
    Module module{};
    Module* m_module{&module};
    void* m_process{this};
    std::optional<unsigned> m_nv_session{};
    unsigned alias{0x1000};
    Result Sparse(){
        // Match real BackGpuOnlyRegion: page ownership is local RAII, not
        // a persistent Worker member; successful unmap destroys it on exit.
        std::unique_ptr<Pages> pages{std::make_unique<Pages>()};
__SPARSE__
        return ResultSuccess;
    }
    Result Register(){
__REGISTER__
        return ResultSuccess;
    }
};
int main(){
    {
        Worker worker;
        worker.module.container.fail_open=true;
        const auto result=worker.Sparse();
        assert(result.raw==Kernel::ResultOutOfResource.raw);
        assert(worker.table.unmap_calls==1 && Pages::closed==1);
        assert(!worker.m_nv_session && Pages::destroyed>=1);
    }
    {
        Worker worker;
        worker.module.container.fail_open=true;
        worker.table.fail_unmap=true;
        auto result=worker.Sparse();
        Pages* held=Pages::latest;
        assert(result.raw==Kernel::ResultInvalidState.raw);
        assert(worker.table.unmap_calls==1 && held);
        assert(Pages::closed==1); // do NOT free a still-mapped alias
        delete held; // fixture reclaims simulated kernel-owned object
    }
    {
        Worker worker;
        worker.module.container.fail_open=true;
        auto result=worker.Register();
        assert(result.raw==Kernel::ResultOutOfResource.raw);
        assert(worker.module.container.calls==1 && !worker.m_nv_session);
    }
    {
        Worker worker;
        assert(worker.Register().raw==0 && worker.m_nv_session==37);
        assert(worker.Register().raw==0 && worker.module.container.calls==1);
    }
    {
        Worker worker;
        assert(worker.Sparse().raw==0 && worker.m_nv_session==37);
        assert(worker.Sparse().raw==0 && worker.module.container.calls==1);
        assert(worker.table.unmap_calls==0);
    }
}
""".replace("__SPARSE__",a).replace("__REGISTER__",b)
compilers=list(dict.fromkeys(x for x in (shutil.which("clang++"),shutil.which("g++")) if x))
assert compilers,"Clang/GCC required"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-h03-session-oom-") as temp:

            argv=[cc,"-std=c++20",opt,"-Wall","-Wextra","-Werror",
                  "-fsanitize=undefined","-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
                  str(code),"-o",str(exe)]

            run=subprocess.run([str(exe)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=25)
```

```py
"""P1.1: real pre-kernel NPDM reader, for extracted, NSP, XCI and NCA.

}
namespace FileSys {
struct Dir; struct File;
using VirtualFile=std::shared_ptr<File>;

struct File {
    Loader::FileType kind{Loader::FileType::Unknown};
    VirtualDir directory{},exefs{};
    VirtualFile program{},secure{};
    bool valid{true},is_second{},throwing{};
    u64 title{0x100};
    VirtualDir GetContainingDirectory() const { return directory; }
};
struct Dir {
    VirtualFile npdm;
    VirtualFile GetFile(const std::string& key) const {
        return key=="main.npdm" ? npdm : nullptr;
    }
};
struct ProgramMetadata {
    bool second{};
    Loader::ResultStatus Load(const VirtualFile& npdm) {
        if (!npdm || !npdm->valid) return Loader::ResultStatus::Error;
        second=npdm->is_second;
        return Loader::ResultStatus::Success;
    }
    bool IsSwitch2() const { return second; }
};
struct NCA {
    VirtualFile file;
    explicit NCA(VirtualFile f) : file(std::move(f)) {}
    Loader::ResultStatus GetStatus() const {
        return file && file->valid ? Loader::ResultStatus::Success : Loader::ResultStatus::Error;
    }
    VirtualDir GetExeFS() const { return file ? file->exefs : nullptr; }
};
struct NSP {
    VirtualFile file;
    NSP(VirtualFile f,u64,std::size_t) : file(std::move(f)) {}
    Loader::ResultStatus GetStatus() const {
        return file && file->valid ? Loader::ResultStatus::Success : Loader::ResultStatus::Error;
    }
    u64 GetProgramTitleID() const { return file->title; }
    std::shared_ptr<NCA> GetNCA(u64 id,ContentRecordType type) const {
        assert(type==ContentRecordType::Program);
        if (!file->program || id!=file->title) return {};
        return std::make_shared<NCA>(file->program);
    }
};
struct XCI {
    VirtualFile file;
    u64 id{};
    std::size_t index{};
    XCI(VirtualFile f,u64 program,std::size_t i):file(std::move(f)),id(program),index(i){}
    Loader::ResultStatus GetStatus() const {
        return file && file->valid ? Loader::ResultStatus::Success : Loader::ResultStatus::Error;
    }
    std::shared_ptr<NSP> GetSecurePartitionNSP() const {
        return file->secure ? std::make_shared<NSP>(file->secure,id,index) : nullptr;
    }
    u64 GetProgramTitleID() const { return file->secure?file->secure->title:0; }
};
}
namespace Loader {
FileType IdentifyFile(const FileSys::VirtualFile& file) {
    if (file->throwing) throw std::runtime_error("bad container");
    return file->kind;
}
}
__HELPER__
int main() {
    using namespace FileSys;
    auto npdm2=std::make_shared<File>(); npdm2->is_second=true;
    auto npdm1=std::make_shared<File>();
    auto dir2=std::make_shared<Dir>();dir2->npdm=npdm2;
    auto dir1=std::make_shared<Dir>();dir1->npdm=npdm1;
    auto prog=std::make_shared<File>();prog->kind=Loader::FileType::NCA;prog->exefs=dir2;
    auto pkg=std::make_shared<File>();pkg->kind=Loader::FileType::NSP;pkg->title=0x200;pkg->program=prog;
    auto card=std::make_shared<File>();card->kind=Loader::FileType::XCI;card->secure=pkg;
    auto extracted=std::make_shared<File>();extracted->directory=dir2;
    assert(IsSwitch2LaunchProgram(extracted,0,0));
    assert(IsSwitch2LaunchProgram(prog,0,0));
    assert(IsSwitch2LaunchProgram(pkg,0x200,0));
    assert(IsSwitch2LaunchProgram(card,0x200,0));
    auto old=std::make_shared<File>();old->directory=dir1;
    assert(!IsSwitch2LaunchProgram(old,0,0));
    prog->exefs=dir1;
    assert(!IsSwitch2LaunchProgram(pkg,0x200,0));
    assert(!IsSwitch2LaunchProgram(card,0x200,0));
    prog->exefs=dir2;
    npdm2->valid=false;
    assert(!IsSwitch2LaunchProgram(pkg,0x200,0));
    npdm2->valid=true;
    pkg->valid=false;
    assert(!IsSwitch2LaunchProgram(card,0x200,0));
    pkg->valid=true;
    pkg->throwing=true;
    assert(!IsSwitch2LaunchProgram(pkg,0x200,0));
    pkg->throwing=false;
    auto missing=std::make_shared<File>(*pkg);missing->program.reset();
    assert(!IsSwitch2LaunchProgram(missing,0x200,0));
    assert(!IsSwitch2LaunchProgram({},0,0));
    assert(IsSwitch2LaunchProgram(card,0x200,0));
```

```py
    return code.split(begin, 1)[1].split(end, 1)[0]
alloc = section(interface, 'NvResult nvmap::IocAlloc(', 'NvResult nvmap::IocGetId(')

def guard(s: str) -> str:
    start = '    const auto session_it = sessions.find(fd);'
    end = '    if (auto freeInfo{' if '    if (auto freeInfo{' in s else '    const auto result ='
    assert s.count(start) == 1 and s.count(end) == 1
    return s[s.index(start):s.index(end, s.index(start))]

# The complete checked fragments are compiled directly with a real deque and
# unordered_map; invalid FDs cannot call the simulated mutation counter.
fixture = r'''
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <deque>
#include <limits>
#include <memory>
#include <unordered_map>
struct SessionId { std::size_t id; };
struct Session { bool is_active{}; void* process{}; };
struct ContainerImpl { std::deque<Session> sessions; };
struct Container {
 std::unique_ptr<ContainerImpl> impl = std::make_unique<ContainerImpl>();
 Session* GetSession(SessionId id);
};
__LOOKUP__
enum class NvResult {Success, BadValue};
struct Device {
 Container& container;
 std::unordered_map<int,SessionId> sessions;
 unsigned allocations{};
 unsigned frees{};
 NvResult CheckAlloc(int fd) {
__ALLOC_GUARD__
  ++allocations;
  return NvResult::Success;
 }
 NvResult CheckFree(int fd) {
__FREE_GUARD__
  ++frees;
  return NvResult::Success;
 }
};
int main() {
 Container c;
 Device dev{c,{},0,0};
 assert(c.GetSession({0}) == nullptr);
 assert(c.GetSession({std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()}) == nullptr);
 c.impl->sessions.push_back({true,reinterpret_cast<void*>(1)});
 c.impl->sessions.push_back({false,reinterpret_cast<void*>(2)});
 c.impl->sessions.push_back({true,nullptr});
 assert(c.GetSession({0}) == &c.impl->sessions[0]);
 assert(c.GetSession({1}) == nullptr);
 assert(c.GetSession({2}) == nullptr);
 for(int fd : {-1,0,3,55}) {
  assert(dev.CheckAlloc(fd) == NvResult::BadValue);
  assert(dev.CheckFree(fd) == NvResult::BadValue);
 }
 assert(dev.allocations == 0 && dev.frees == 0);
 dev.sessions.emplace(20, SessionId{0});
 dev.sessions.emplace(21, SessionId{1});
 dev.sessions.emplace(22, SessionId{999999});
 assert(dev.CheckAlloc(21) == NvResult::BadValue);
 assert(dev.CheckFree(21) == NvResult::BadValue);
```

`tools/ns2/check_p1_p2_exit_gate.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Bounded P1/P2 release gate: 17 contracts, not a claim of full emulator parity.

Default mode audits the manifest and live owner/witness wiring. It deliberately
succeeds with open items so CI can produce an honest numerical progress report.
--enforce is the separate fail-closed P1/P2 exit decision; it requires every
in-scope item to define positive AND negative executed-owner witnesses and
the six required GitHub workflows green at one exact engine/vendor SHA.
CI run IDs are read LIVE after the commit, never embedded back into Git.
Never builds PS5 or opens a console.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import urllib.error
import urllib.request

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
MANIFEST = ROOT / "docs" / "NS2_P1_P2_EXIT_CONTRACT.json"
EXPECTED = tuple(f"H{n:02}" for n in range(1, 8)) + tuple(
    f"G{n:02}" for n in range(1, 11))
ALLOWED = {"open", "proof_defined"}
EXECUTED = {"real-owner-exec", "spirv-val", "real-owner-ipc"}
REPO = "niakw/ProsperoEden-Encore"


def local_sha(*parts: str) -> str:
    result = subprocess.run(["git", *parts], cwd=ROOT, text=True,
                            capture_output=True, timeout=20)
    if result.returncode:
        raise ValueError(f"git {' '.join(parts)}: {result.stderr.strip()}")
    return result.stdout.strip()


def active_witnesses() -> str:
    # A witness is not active just because its file exists: it must be invoked
    # by the maintained host batch or a live CI workflow.
    batch = (ROOT / "tools/ns2/qualify_host_batch.py").read_text()
    research = (ROOT / ".github/workflows/ns2-research-host.yml").read_text()
    # The mandatory standalone SPIR-V workflow calls the maintained
    # reusable runner, which executes the ACTUAL C++ emitter and spirv-val.
    # Previously this real positive proof was ignored simply because it
    # lived outside the other two required host suites.
    standalone = (ROOT / ".github/workflows/ns2-standalone-spirv-main.yml").read_text()
    spirv_runner = (ROOT / ".github/workflows/ns2-research-spirv.yml").read_text()
    # These focused SHA-pinned workflows execute native owner tests that
    # cannot run inside the lean source batch (FFmpeg/Vulkan/ARM fixtures).
    focused = (ROOT / ".github/workflows/ns2-h01-h05-focused-host.yml").read_text()
    g10_vulkan = (ROOT / ".github/workflows/ns2-g10-host-vulkan.yml").read_text()
    if ("uses: ./.github/workflows/ns2-research-spirv.yml" not in standalone or
            "python3 tools/check-ns2-spirv-host.py" not in spirv_runner):
        raise ValueError("required standalone SPIR-V real-emitter witness disconnected")
    if ("python3 -B tools/ns2/check_native_video_real_ffmpeg_frame_host.py" not in focused or
            "python3 -B tools/ns2/check_native_qmd_deferred_fence_host.py" not in g10_vulkan or
            "python3 -B tools/ns2/check_native_ampere_sem_real_vulkan_host.py" not in g10_vulkan):
        raise ValueError("focused H05/G10 executed-owner CI witness disconnected")
    return batch + "\n" + research + "\n" + spirv_runner + "\n" + focused + "\n" + g10_vulkan


def validate_manifest(data: dict) -> tuple[list[str], dict[str, int]]:
    errors: list[str] = []
    counts = {"open": 0, "proof_defined": 0, "excluded_forms": 0}
    if data.get("schema") != 1:
        errors.append("unsupported contract schema")
    items = data.get("items")
    if not isinstance(items, list):
        return ["items must be an array"], counts
    ids = [x.get("id") for x in items if isinstance(x, dict)]
    if len(items) != 17 or sorted(ids) != sorted(EXPECTED):
        errors.append("P1/P2 contract must contain exactly H01-H07 and G01-G10")
    source = active_witnesses()
    for item in items:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            errors.append("non-object contract row")
            continue
        ident = item.get("id", "?")
        state = item.get("status")
        if state not in ALLOWED:
            errors.append(f"{ident}: invalid state {state!r}")
            continue
        counts[state] += 1
        owner = item.get("owner", "")
        if not isinstance(owner, str) or not owner.startswith("vendor/") or (
                not (ROOT / owner).is_file()):
            errors.append(f"{ident}: missing real vendor owner {owner!r}")
        for key in ("positive", "negative"):
            if not isinstance(item.get(key), str) or len(item[key].strip()) < 35:
                errors.append(f"{ident}: imprecise {key} acceptance criterion")
        checks = item.get("validators")
        if not isinstance(checks, list) or not checks:
            errors.append(f"{ident}: no validation scripts")
            checks = []
        active = 0
        for p in checks:
            if not isinstance(p, str) or not p.startswith("tools/") or not p.endswith(".py"):
                errors.append(f"{ident}: invalid test path {p!r}")
            elif not (ROOT / p).is_file():
                errors.append(f"{ident}: missing witness {p}")
            elif p in source:
                active += 1
        if not active:
            errors.append(f"{ident}: no witness in maintained CI or host batch")
        evidence = item.get("evidence")
        if not isinstance(evidence, dict):
            errors.append(f"{ident}: evidence must be a map")
            continue
        if state == "open":
            if not item.get("blocker"):
                errors.append(f"{ident}: open item has no stated blocker")
            if evidence:
                errors.append(f"{ident}: open item cannot claim completion evidence")
        elif state == "proof_defined":
            if item.get("blocker"):
                errors.append(f"{ident}: verified row still has a blocker")
            for key in ("positive", "negative"):
                proof = evidence.get(key)
                if not isinstance(proof, dict) or (
                        proof.get("validator") not in checks or
                        proof.get("kind") not in EXECUTED or
                        proof.get("validator") not in source):
                    errors.append(f"{ident}: {key} needs real executed witness + run ID")
        # Only a precise SDK form may be excluded within a required
        # H/G contract. Excluding a complete row is never permitted.
        excluded = item.get("excluded_forms", [])
        if not isinstance(excluded, list):
            errors.append(f"{ident}: excluded_forms must be an array")
            excluded = []
        for form in excluded:
            if not isinstance(form, dict):
                errors.append(f"{ident}: malformed excluded form")
                continue
            selector = form.get("selector")
            if (not isinstance(selector, str) or
                not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{3,64}", selector) or
                selector.lower() in {"all", "any", "unknown", "other", "remaining"} or
                selector == ident):
                errors.append(f"{ident}: exclusion must identify one SDK form")
            if len(str(form.get("abi_reason", ""))) < 60:
                errors.append(f"{ident}: excluded form needs SDK/ABI justification")
            rejection = form.get("negative")
            if not isinstance(rejection, dict) or (
                rejection.get("validator") not in checks or
                rejection.get("kind") not in EXECUTED or
                rejection.get("validator") not in source):
                errors.append(f"{ident}: excluded form needs executed refusal")
        counts["excluded_forms"] += len(excluded)
    workflows = data.get("mandatory_workflows")
    required = {
        "Encore core fast gate",
        "Encore source preflight (host only)",
        "NS2 research host guards",
        "NS2 standalone graphics SPIR-V qualification (main only)",
        "Eden P0-P4 host qualification (sharded)",
        "Verify pinned vendor submodule",
    }
    if not isinstance(workflows, list) or set(workflows) != required:
        errors.append("mandatory same-SHA workflows must retain six exact checks")
    return errors, counts


def fetch_successful_run_ids(main_sha: str) -> tuple[set[str], set[int]]:
    headers = {"User-Agent": "eden-p1-p2-exit-contract",
               "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json"}
    if os.environ.get("GITHUB_TOKEN"):
        headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer " + os.environ["GITHUB_TOKEN"]
    url = ("https://api.github.com/repos/" + REPO +
           "/actions/runs?head_sha=" + main_sha + "&per_page=100")
    request = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=headers)
    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=20) as response:
        runs = json.load(response).get("workflow_runs", [])
    # Only this SHA, not a green run from a previous engine/vendor pairing.
    ok = [r for r in runs if r.get("head_sha") == main_sha and
          r.get("status") == "completed" and r.get("conclusion") == "success"]
    return {r["name"] for r in ok}, {r["id"] for r in ok}


def enforce_exit(data: dict) -> list[str]:
    errors: list[str] = []
    if any(x["status"] == "open" for x in data["items"]):
        return ["open H/G contracts block release; no CI result overrides them"]
    main = local_sha("rev-parse", "HEAD")
    vendor = local_sha("-C", "vendor", "rev-parse", "HEAD")
    tree = local_sha("ls-tree", "HEAD", "vendor").split()
    if len(tree) < 3 or tree[0] != "160000" or tree[2] != vendor:
        return ["working vendor does not match immutable engine gitlink"]
    for root in (ROOT, ROOT / "vendor"):
        if subprocess.check_output(["git", "status", "--porcelain",
                                    "--untracked-files=no"], cwd=root,
                                   text=True, timeout=15).strip():
            return ["tracked sources are dirty; SHA attestation impossible"]
    try:
        workflow_names, _ = fetch_successful_run_ids(main)
    except (urllib.error.URLError, OSError, ValueError, TimeoutError) as exc:
        return [f"cannot verify live GitHub run status: {exc}"]
    missing = sorted(set(data["mandatory_workflows"]) - workflow_names)
    if missing:
        errors.append("mandatory CI not green at exact SHA " + main[:12] +
                      ": " + ", ".join(missing))
    # Stable manifest fields identify tests, not future run IDs. P4 and
    # NS2 research include the declared scripts and must both succeed at
    # this checkout's SHA, checked using the GitHub API above.
    return errors


def validate_fail_closed(data: dict) -> list[str]:
    """Negative mutation check of the release gate itself (not GPU proof)."""
    import copy
    cases = []
    missing = copy.deepcopy(data)
    missing["items"][0]["validators"] = []
    cases.append(("missing witness", missing))
    excluded = copy.deepcopy(data)
    excluded["items"][0]["status"] = "scope_excluded"
    cases.append(("whole required gate excluded", excluded))
    invented = copy.deepcopy(data)
    invented["items"][0]["status"] = "proof_defined"
    invented["items"][0]["blocker"] = ""
    # Always corrupt evidence, even when all 17 rows are already closed.
    # Changing an open row into a closed row was a no-op at 17/17.
    invented["items"][0]["evidence"]["positive"] = {
        "validator": "tools/ns2/NOT_A_REAL_OWNER_TEST.py",
        "kind": "real-owner-exec",
    }
    cases.append(("fake positive/negative evidence", invented))
    short = copy.deepcopy(data)
    short["items"].pop()
    cases.append(("missing H/G contract", short))
    return [f"fail-closed mutation escaped: {name}" for name, candidate in cases
            if not validate_manifest(candidate)[0]]


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--enforce", action="store_true",
                        help="fail closed unless all 17 real contracts and same-SHA CI pass")
    parser.add_argument("--json", action="store_true", dest="machine",
                        help="print one machine-readable progress report")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    try:
        data = json.loads(MANIFEST.read_text())
        problems, counts = validate_manifest(data)
        if not problems:
            problems.extend(validate_fail_closed(data))
        if args.enforce and not problems:
            problems.extend(enforce_exit(data))
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError) as exc:
        problems = [str(exc)]
        counts = {"open": 0, "proof_defined": 0, "excluded_forms": 0}
    result = {"schema": 1, "goal": "P1_P2_HOST_EXIT",
              "total": 17,
              "proof_defined": counts["proof_defined"],
              "explicit_excluded_forms": counts["excluded_forms"],
              "open": counts["open"],
              "exit_ready": args.enforce and not problems,
              "structural_audit": not args.enforce,
              "errors": problems,
              "no_ps5_build": True}
    if args.machine:
        print(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))
    else:
        print("P1_P2_EXIT_" + ("ENFORCE" if args.enforce else "AUDIT"),
              f"proof_defined={result['proof_defined']}/17",
              f"optional_forms_excluded={result['explicit_excluded_forms']}",
              f"open={result['open']}/17",
              f"ready={result['exit_ready']}", flush=True)
        for error in problems:
            print("P1_P2_EXIT_BLOCKER:", error, flush=True)
    return 1 if problems else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```

`tools/ns2/check_paged_gpu_scalar_host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""P1.2: compile the real shared native GPU scalar helper with Clang/GCC.

No PS5 SDK, console, ROMs or synthetic application build. The actual
maintained GPU MemoryManager owner must call the same tested helper.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
BASE = ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/video_core"
OWNER = (BASE / "memory_manager.cpp").read_text()
HEADER = (BASE / "native_paged_scalar.h").read_text()
assert '#include "native_paged_scalar.h"' in OWNER
assert "Eden::GpuScalar::Read(addr, value," in OWNER
assert "Eden::GpuScalar::Write(addr, data," in OWNER
read = OWNER.split("T MemoryManager::Read(GPUVAddr addr) const {", 1)[1].split(
    "template <typename T>", 1
)[0]
write = OWNER.split("void MemoryManager::Write(GPUVAddr addr, T data) {", 1)[1].split(
    "template u8 MemoryManager::Read<u8>", 1
)[0]
assert "std::memcpy(&value, page_pointer, sizeof(T));" not in read
assert "std::memcpy(page_pointer, &data, sizeof(T));" not in write
assert HEADER.count("const auto* second = tail_bytes ?") == 1
assert HEADER.count("auto* second = tail_bytes ?") == 2
assert "if (!first || !second)" in HEADER
# One-byte accesses cannot cross a page; GCC O2 must not instantiate
# a memcpy from bytes + first_bytes on a 1-byte stack source.
assert HEADER.count("if constexpr (sizeof(T) > 1)") == 2

# Large native GPU transfers retain their efficient contiguous memcpy, but
# only when the ACTUAL device-memory continuity owner approves the full span.
# A GPU big-page hint alone is not enough after physical remapping.
block = OWNER.split("void MemoryManager::ReadBlockImpl(", 1)[1].split(
    "void MemoryManager::WriteBlock(", 1
)[0]
assert block.count("memory.GetSpan(dev_addr_base, copy_amount)") == 4
assert block.count("memory.ReadBlockUnsafe(dev_addr_base, dest_buffer, copy_amount);") == 2
assert block.count("memory.WriteBlockUnsafe(dev_addr_base, src_buffer, copy_amount);") == 2
assert "memory.GetPointer<u8>(dev_addr_base)" not in block
assert block.count("IsBigPageContinuous(page_index)") == 2
print("GPU_BLOCK_DEVICE_CONTINUITY_OWNER_PASS fast=4 fallback=4")

TEST = r"""
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>
#include "native_paged_scalar.h"

using std::uint8_t;
using std::uint16_t;
using std::uint32_t;
using std::uint64_t;
using Eden::GpuScalar::Read;
using Eden::GpuScalar::Write;

int main() {
    constexpr uint64_t base = 0x300000;
    constexpr uint64_t page = 4096;
    std::array<uint8_t, page> left{}, right{};
    auto mapped = [&](uint64_t addr) -> uint8_t* {
        if (addr >= base && addr < base + page)
            return left.data() + (addr - base);
        if (addr >= base + page && addr < base + 2 * page)
            return right.data() + (addr - base - page);
        return nullptr;
    };
    for (uint64_t offset = 4089; offset < 4096; ++offset) {
        left.fill(0xa5);
        right.fill(0x5a);
        const uint64_t expected = 0x1122334455667788ULL + offset;
        assert(Write(base + offset, expected, mapped));
        uint64_t actual = 0;
        assert(Read(base + offset, actual, mapped));
        assert(actual == expected);
        assert(left[0] == 0xa5 && right.back() == 0x5a);
        const uint64_t first = page - offset;
        assert(left[offset - 1] == 0xa5);
        if (first < sizeof(expected))
            assert(right[sizeof(expected) - first] == 0x5a);
    }

    // All scalar widths, including the first byte of a new guest page.
    assert(Write(base + 1, uint8_t{0x91}, mapped));
    uint8_t c = 0;
    assert(Read(base + 1, c, mapped) && c == 0x91);
    // The very last byte of a physical page is still one scalar byte.
    // Translation must happen ONCE, never touch the next page or create
    // an impossible fortified source overread in the optimized compiler.
    unsigned u8_translations = 0;
    auto final_byte = [&](uint64_t address) -> uint8_t* {
        ++u8_translations;
        return address == base + page - 1 ? &left.back() : nullptr;
    };
    right.front() = 0x5a;
    assert(Write(base + page - 1, uint8_t{0xe3}, final_byte));
    uint8_t last_byte = 0;
    assert(Read(base + page - 1, last_byte, final_byte) && last_byte == 0xe3);
    assert(u8_translations == 2 && right.front() == 0x5a);
    assert(Write(base + page - 1, uint16_t{0xabcd}, mapped));
    uint16_t s = 0;
    assert(Read(base + page - 1, s, mapped) && s == 0xabcd);
    assert(Write(base + page - 2, uint32_t{0x12345678}, mapped));
    uint32_t n = 0;
    assert(Read(base + page - 2, n, mapped) && n == 0x12345678);

    // The second page vanishes after the first was resolved. No partial
    // writes and no guessed linear dereference into the first host array.
    auto only_first = [&](uint64_t address) -> uint8_t* {
        return address < base + page ? mapped(address) : nullptr;
    };
    left.fill(0x7d);
    uint64_t v = 0;
    assert(!Write(base + page - 3, uint64_t{0xfedcba9876543210ULL}, only_first));
    assert(left[page - 1] == 0x7d && left[page - 3] == 0x7d);
    v = 0xdeadbeef;
    assert(!Read(base + page - 3, v, only_first) && v == 0);

    // Guest address arithmetic must not wrap and translate page zero.
    int calls = 0;
    auto counted = [&](uint64_t addr) -> uint8_t* {
        ++calls;
        return mapped(addr);
    };
    const uint64_t over = (std::numeric_limits<uint64_t>::max)() - 3;
    assert(!Write(over, uint64_t{17}, counted) && calls == 0);
    v = 123;
    assert(!Read(over, v, counted) && v == 0 && calls == 0);
    // Empty mapping refuses scalar admission instead of touching a sentinel.
    assert(!Write(0, uint32_t{1}, mapped));
    return 0;
}
"""
compilers = [p for name in ("clang++", "g++") if (p := shutil.which(name))]
assert compilers, "Clang/GCC host C++20 toolchain missing"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-gpu-scalar-") as tmp:
    directory = Path(tmp)
    src = directory / "paged_gpu_scalar.cpp"
    src.write_text(TEST)
    for compiler in compilers:
        for level in (0, 2):
            exe = directory / f"{Path(compiler).name}-O{level}"
            command = [
                compiler, "-std=c++20", f"-O{level}", "-Wall", "-Wextra",
                "-Werror", "-fsanitize=undefined", "-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
                "-I", str(BASE), str(src), "-o", str(exe)
            ]
            built = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=45)
            assert built.returncode == 0, (command, built.stderr[-4000:])
            ran = subprocess.run([str(exe)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
            assert ran.returncode == 0, (command, ran.stderr[-4000:])
            print("P1_2_GPU_PAGED_SCALAR_HOST_PASS", Path(compiler).name, level)
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""N52: byte-strict generic vendor Process::Run and NS2 compile-guard owner."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
SRC=ROOT/"vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/process/core/hle/service/os/process.cpp"
TRACE=ROOT/"vendor/encore-active/ns2-helpers/include/core/loader/ns2_svc_trace.h"
CMAKE=(ROOT/"headless/CMakeLists.txt").read_text()

def blob(txt):
    data=txt.encode()
    return hashlib.sha1(b"blob "+str(len(data)).encode()+b"\0"+data).hexdigest()

def once(src,old,new):
    assert src.count(old)==1, "N52 maintained source drift "+old[:65]
    return src.replace(old,new)

current=SRC.read_text()
# Native H01 adds an explicit filesystem-controller include. Remove only
# this known overlay before checking the unchanged historical NS1 hashes.
current=once(current,
    '''#include "core/loader/ns2_svc_trace.h"
#include "core/hle/service/filesystem/filesystem.h"
#endif''',
    '''#include "core/loader/ns2_svc_trace.h"
#endif''')
# Undo the native-only late-Run finalization before the immutable N52 owner
# hash comparison. NS1's historical Run() method is never modified.
current=once(current,
    '''            // A late failure leaves no runnable NS2 process. Merely
            // clearing its trace would strand the published KProcess and
            // its guest code pages in the kernel process list. KProcess::Run
            // has already unwound its transient stack/thread reservations;
            // Finalize now closes the process, retires RomFS and removes the
            // kernel registration on the same failure path.
            this->Finalize();
            // Do not let a second Run() on the empty failed instance report
            // legacy success. A fresh Initialize() clears this terminal bit.
            m_process_started = true;''',
    '''            // KProcess may already have allocated/rolled back resources; never
            // start it twice without Finalize and a fresh loader handoff.
            m_process_started = true;
            Eden::NS2::SvcTrace::Unregister(m_process->GetProcessId());''')
# H01 has three additional native-only guards in Process::Initialize /
# Finalize. Unwind them IN REVERSE without touching any other owner byte.
# The immutable historical H01 and N52 digests below remain unchanged.
reviewed=once(current,
    '''    SCOPE_EXIT {
        process->Close(m_system.Kernel());
    };
#ifdef EDEN_NS2_PROCESS_RUN_GUARD
    // The NS2 loader may register its SVC trace before Initialize has
    // published the KProcess. Roll it back on every rejected handoff,
    // including missing NPDM parameters or a later allocation failure.
    // This guard runs before the KProcess reference is closed.
    bool process_committed = false;
    SCOPE_EXIT {
        if (!process_committed) {
            // The loader may register RomFS before it installs the SVC
            // trace. A malformed NPDM/NSO or allocation failure in that
            // interval must still release the process-owned filesystem
            // record. UnregisterProcessIfPresent is idempotent for a PID
            // with no registration (including non-NS2 failed loads).
            const auto pid = process->GetProcessId();
            m_system.GetFileSystemController().UnregisterProcessIfPresent(pid);
            Eden::NS2::SvcTrace::Unregister(pid);
        }
    };
#endif

    // Insert process modules into memory.''',
    '''    SCOPE_EXIT {
        process->Close(m_system.Kernel());
    };

    // Insert process modules into memory.''')
reviewed=once(reviewed,
    '''    m_process = process;
    m_process->Open(m_system.Kernel());
#ifdef EDEN_NS2_PROCESS_RUN_GUARD
    process_committed = true;
#endif

    // We succeeded.''',
    '''    m_process = process;
    m_process->Open(m_system.Kernel());

    // We succeeded.''')
reviewed=once(reviewed,
    '''    if (m_process) {
#ifdef EDEN_NS2_PROCESS_RUN_GUARD
        // Retire this PID's filesystem ownership even when the global SVC
        // trace has moved to another process (or was already unregistered).
        // The filesystem operation is idempotent for absent/non-NS2 records;
        // tying it to active_pid leaked RomFS registrations on late teardown.
        const auto pid = m_process->GetProcessId();
        m_system.GetFileSystemController().UnregisterProcessIfPresent(pid);
        // A different active trace belongs to its own process and must
        // survive this teardown.
        if (Eden::NS2::SvcTrace::active_pid.load(std::memory_order_acquire) == pid) {
            Eden::NS2::SvcTrace::Unregister(pid);
        }
#endif
        m_process->Close(m_system.Kernel());''',
    '''    if (m_process) {
        m_process->Close(m_system.Kernel());''')
assert blob(reviewed)=="d2e06b2992d2745940f0c0640b747aae18074986", (

    // The slab allocator can fail before an ExeFS/NSO handoff exists.
    // Never register or dereference a null kernel process on that path.
    if (!process) {
        out_load_result = Loader::ResultStatus::ErrorNotInitialized;
        return false;
    }
    Kernel::KProcess::Register(m_system.Kernel(), process);''',
    '''    auto* const process = Kernel::KProcess::Create(m_system.Kernel());

        return false;
    }
    // Success without loader parameters is malformed: touching the optional
    // would be undefined behavior and may publish a partially initialized
    // KProcess into the scheduler. The scope guard closes it on failure.
    if (!load_parameters) {
        out_load_result = Loader::ResultStatus::ErrorUnableToParseKernelMetadata;
        return false;
    }

    // TODO: remove this, kernel already tracks this''',
    '''    if (load_result != Loader::ResultStatus::Success) {
        return false;
```

`tools/ns2/check_shared_a64_ldapr_host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""P0.2: test production-selected LDAPR decode and real Dynarmic translation.

CMake copies exactly four versioned sources reviewed against pinned Dynarmic,
without selecting the research RETAA, LSE or CAS implementations.
Host tests compile the unmodified A64 translation unit and execute Dynarmic's
real decoder; no PS5 or full emulator build is performed.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import difflib
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
CMAKE=(ROOT/'headless/CMakeLists.txt').read_text()
SCRIPT=ROOT/'headless/shared_a64_ldapr.cmake'
BASE=ROOT/'vendor/sources/eden/src/dynarmic/src'
REL=Path('dynarmic/frontend/A64')
FILES=('decoder/a64.h','decoder/a64.inc','translate/impl/impl.h',
       'translate/impl/load_store_exclusive.cpp')
assert 'set(EDEN_SHARED_NS2_A64_LDAPR ON)' in CMAKE
assert 'if(PS5_NATIVE AND EDEN_REVIEWED_DUAL_NPDM)' in CMAKE
assert 'include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/shared_a64_ldapr.cmake")' in CMAKE
assert 'target_include_directories(dynarmic BEFORE PRIVATE "${EDEN_A64_LDAPR_OUTPUT_ROOT}")' in CMAKE
assert 'EDEN_NS2_A64_EXPERIMENTAL' not in CMAKE
assert 'include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/shared_a64_ldapr.cmake")' in CMAKE
assert all((BASE/REL/f).is_file() for f in FILES)
# Configure-only copy of the EXACT production-owned static sources.

def transform(base: Path,out: Path) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
    return subprocess.run(['cmake',f'-DEDEN_A64_LDAPR_SOURCE_ROOT={base}',
                           f'-DEDEN_A64_LDAPR_OUTPUT_ROOT={out}','-P',str(SCRIPT)],
                          capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)

TEST_CPP=r'''
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdio>
#include "dynarmic/frontend/A64/decoder/a64.h"
#include "dynarmic/frontend/A64/translate/impl/impl.h"
int main() {
    using Dynarmic::A64::TranslatorVisitor;
    for (auto instruction : {0x38BFC000U, 0x78BFC000U,
                             0xB8BFC000U, 0xF8BFC000U}) {
        const auto op=Dynarmic::A64::GetName<TranslatorVisitor>(instruction);
        assert(op && *op == "LDAPR");
    }
    const auto cas=Dynarmic::A64::GetName<TranslatorVisitor>(0xC8A07C00U);
    const auto ldadd=Dynarmic::A64::GetName<TranslatorVisitor>(0xF8200000U);
    assert(!cas || *cas != "CAS");
    assert(!ldadd || *ldadd != "LDADD");
    const auto ret=Dynarmic::A64::GetName<TranslatorVisitor>(0xD65F03C0U);
    const auto reta=Dynarmic::A64::GetName<TranslatorVisitor>(0xD65F0BFFU);
    const auto retb=Dynarmic::A64::GetName<TranslatorVisitor>(0xD65F0FFFU);
    assert(ret && *ret == "RET");
    assert(!reta || *reta != "RETA");
    assert(!retb || *retb != "RETA");
    std::puts("SHARED_A64_LDAPR_REAL_DECODER_PASS");
}
'''


def main():
    # On macOS `/usr/bin/g++` is another Apple Clang driver, NOT GCC.
    # Avoid recompiling identical compiler/target combinations: this host
    # witness is a Dynarmic source/decoder proof, not four distinct compilers.
    candidates=list(dict.fromkeys(c for c in (shutil.which('clang++'),shutil.which('g++')) if c))
    compilers=[]
    signatures=set()
    for candidate in candidates:
        info=subprocess.run([candidate, '--version'], capture_output=True,
                            text=True, timeout=10)
        assert info.returncode==0
        version=info.stdout.splitlines()[0]
        # Apple-clang executable frontends are aliases regardless of basename.
        signature=version
        if signature in signatures:
            print('P0_2_A64_LDAPR_DUPLICATE_HOST_COMPILER_SKIPPED',
                  Path(candidate).name,signature,flush=True)
            continue
        signatures.add(signature)
        compilers.append(candidate)
    assert compilers
    env=os.environ.copy()
    sdk15=Path('/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX15.4.sdk')
    sdk26=Path('/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX26.5.sdk')
    if sdk15.is_dir():env['SDKROOT']=str(sdk15)
    incl=[]
    if sys.platform=='darwin' and sdk26.is_dir():
        incl=['-target','arm64-apple-macos15','-nostdinc++','-isystem',
              str(sdk26/'usr/include/c++/v1')]
    deps=ROOT/'vendor/sources/eden-cpm'
    additional=[BASE,ROOT/'vendor/sources/eden/src',deps/'fmt/12.1.0/include'] + \
               list((deps/'boost/boost-1.90.0/libs').glob('*/include'))
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='encore-ldapr-release-') as td:
        temp=Path(td)
        generated=temp/'include'
        result=transform(BASE,generated)
        assert result.returncode==0,result.stderr
        # Exactly 4 reviewed files, anchored to the real pinned sources.
        actual={str(p.relative_to(generated)) for p in generated.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
        expected={str(REL/f) for f in FILES}
        assert actual==expected,(sorted(actual),sorted(expected))
        for f in FILES:
            before=(BASE/REL/f).read_text()
            after=(generated/REL/f).read_text()
            static=(ROOT/'vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/ldapr/maintained'/REL/f).read_text()
            assert after==static,('CMake failed to select static LDAPR source',f)
            if f=='decoder/a64.h':
                reviewed=before
            elif f=='decoder/a64.inc':
                old='INST(RET, "RET", "1101011001011111000000nnnnn00000")'
                assert before.count(old)==1
                reviewed=before.replace(old,old+'\nINST(LDAPR, "LDAPR", "ss11100010111111110000nnnnnttttt")')
            elif f=='translate/impl/impl.h':
                old='bool LDAPR(Reg Rn, Reg Rt);'
                assert before.count(old)==1
                reviewed=before.replace(old,'bool LDAPR(Imm<2> size, Reg Rn, Reg Rt);')
            else:
                old='namespace Dynarmic::A64 {\n'
                assert before.count(old)==1
                reviewed=before.replace(old,old+
                    '\n// Reviewed RCpc LDAPR: LDAR\'s acquire ordering is strictly stronger.\n'
                    'bool TranslatorVisitor::LDAPR(Imm<2> size, Reg Rn, Reg Rt) {\n'
                    '    return LDAR(size, Rn, Rt);\n}\n')
            assert after==reviewed,('LDAPR static owner no longer equals pinned reviewed change',f)
            changes=list(difflib.unified_diff(before.splitlines(),after.splitlines()))
            assert (len(changes)==0 if f=='decoder/a64.h' else 0<len(changes)<=26), (f,changes)
            assert 'INST(RETA,' not in after and 'INST(CAS,' not in after and 'INST(LDADD,' not in after
            if f=='decoder/a64.inc':
                assert after.count('INST(LDAPR,')==1
                assert after.count('INST(RET,')==1
            if f.endswith('load_store_exclusive.cpp'):
                assert after.count('TranslatorVisitor::LDAPR(')==1
                assert 'return LDAR(size, Rn, Rt);' in after
        print('P0_2_SHARED_A64_LDAPR_PINNED_SOURCE_DIFF_PASS files=4',flush=True)
        # A duplicate source instruction or changed decode anchor fails closed.
        mutated=temp/'mutated';shutil.copytree(BASE/REL,mutated/REL)
        path=mutated/REL/'decoder/a64.inc'
        path.write_text(path.read_text().replace('INST(RET, "RET",',
                                                  'INST(RETX, "RET",',1))
        # The negative fixture breaks the pinned RET anchor. A source
        # mismatch must be caught by exact parity, not by code generation.
        mutated_source=(mutated/REL/'decoder/a64.inc').read_text()
        reviewed_source=(generated/REL/'decoder/a64.inc').read_text()
        assert 'INST(RET, "RET",' not in mutated_source
        assert mutated_source!=reviewed_source
        print('P0_2_SHARED_A64_LDAPR_SOURCE_DRIFT_REJECT_PASS',flush=True)
        decode=temp/'real_decoder.cpp';decode.write_text(TEST_CPP)
        core=BASE/REL/'translate/a64_translate.cpp'
        incs=['-I'+str(generated)]+['-I'+str(p) for p in additional]
        for compiler in compilers:
            # Full translation includes all maintained Dynarmic methods and
            # the generated LDAPR via source include; catches ODR/header ABI.
            c=subprocess.run([compiler,'-std=c++20','-O0','-fsyntax-only',*incl,*incs,
                               str(core)],capture_output=True,text=True,env=env,timeout=100)
            assert c.returncode==0,(compiler,c.stderr[-5000:])
            print('P0_2_SHARED_A64_LDAPR_REAL_TRANSLATOR_PASS',Path(compiler).name,flush=True)
            for opt in (0,2):
                output=temp/f'{Path(compiler).name}-O{opt}'
                build=subprocess.run([compiler,'-std=c++20',f'-O{opt}',
                                      '-fsanitize=undefined','-fno-sanitize-recover=all',
                                      *incl,*incs,str(decode),'-o',str(output)],
                                     capture_output=True,text=True,env=env,timeout=100)
                assert build.returncode==0,(compiler,opt,build.stderr[-5000:])
                run=subprocess.run([str(output)],capture_output=True,text=True,env=env,timeout=20)
                assert run.returncode==0,(compiler,opt,run.stderr[-2500:])
                assert 'SHARED_A64_LDAPR_REAL_DECODER_PASS' in run.stdout
                print('P0_2_SHARED_A64_LDAPR_REAL_DECODER_PASS',Path(compiler).name,
                      f'O{opt}',flush=True)

if __name__=='__main__':main()
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compile the native, NS1/NS2 shared GPU pool memory policy (Clang/GCC)."""
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
native=ROOT/"vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/include"
header=native/"video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_shared_gpu_budget.h"
s=header.read_text()
assert "namespace Eden::Vulkan::MemoryPolicy" in s
assert "Switch2" not in s and "FC27" not in s
assert "shared_pool_used" in s
assert "reliable_shared_pool_usage" in s
program=r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdint>
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_shared_gpu_budget.h"
using namespace Eden::Vulkan::MemoryPolicy;
constexpr std::uint64_t GiB=1ULL<<30;
constexpr std::uint64_t MiB=1ULL<<20;
int main() {
 // No pool data means do not invent memory usage or reject regular images.
 constexpr auto unknown=SparseBackingBudget(6*GiB, 5*GiB, false, 384*MiB);
 static_assert(!unknown.measured&&unknown.max_new_bytes==384*MiB);
 constexpr auto standard=SparseBackingBudget(12*GiB, 6*GiB, true, 768*MiB);
 static_assert(standard.measured && standard.headroom_bytes==GiB);
 static_assert(standard.max_new_bytes==768*MiB);
 constexpr auto short_pool=SparseBackingBudget(6*GiB, 6*GiB-768*MiB-2*MiB,
                                               true,384*MiB);
 static_assert(short_pool.measured&&short_pool.headroom_bytes==768*MiB);
 static_assert(short_pool.max_new_bytes==2*MiB);
 constexpr auto exhausted=SparseBackingBudget(6*GiB,6*GiB-768*MiB,
                                               true,384*MiB);
 static_assert(exhausted.max_new_bytes==0);
 constexpr auto corrupt=SparseBackingBudget(6*GiB,7*GiB,true,384*MiB);
 static_assert(corrupt.measured&&corrupt.max_new_bytes==0);
 constexpr auto no_space=SparseBackingBudget(0,0,true,384*MiB);
 static_assert(no_space.max_new_bytes==0);
 constexpr auto small=SparseBackingBudget(2*GiB,1*GiB,true,384*MiB);
 static_assert(small.headroom_bytes==256*MiB);
 constexpr auto untouched=SparseBackingBudget(12*GiB,10*GiB,true,768*MiB);
 static_assert(untouched.max_new_bytes==768*MiB);
 std::puts("N75_SHARED_NS1_NS2_GPU_POOL_BUDGET_PASS");
}
"""
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="n75-shared-gpu-pool-") as tmp:
    d=Path(tmp);src=d/"budget.cpp";src.write_text(program)
    for compiler in ("clang++","g++"):
        exe=d/compiler.replace("+","p")
        subprocess.run([compiler,"-std=c++20","-O2","-Wall","-Wextra",
                        "-Werror","-fsanitize=undefined",
                        "-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
                        "-I",str(native),str(src),"-o",str(exe)],check=True)
        subprocess.run([str(exe)],check=True)
print("N75_SHARED_GPU_BUDGET_VENDOR_CLANG_GCC_UBSAN_PASS")
```
