`tools/ns2/check_shared_gpu_dirty_gather_host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""P1.3/P4.2 host witness: concurrent Gather on the REAL shared GPU dirty owner.

A host1x video decoder may call Gather while the GPU worker is gathering.
The callback runs outside the producer guard, but it must not race another
consumer's front_buffer.swap / clear. This test compiles the pinned header.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
OWNER = Path(os.environ.get(
    "EDEN_GPU_DIRTY_HEADER_SOURCE",
    str(ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/eden-core/overrides/core/gpu_dirty_memory_manager.h")))
body = OWNER.read_text()
assert body.count("std::scoped_lock gather_lock(gather_guard);") == 1
assert body.count("std::mutex gather_guard;") == 1
assert 'target_include_directories(core BEFORE PUBLIC "${EDEN_NATIVE_DIRTY_HEADER_ROOT}")' in (
    ROOT/"headless/CMakeLists.txt").read_text()
# The pinned Eden source now carries the same concurrency fix. Verify both
# independent implementations guard the entire front-buffer iteration; a
# stale "upstream must have no lock" assumption is not a safety property.
pinned = (ROOT/"vendor/sources/eden/src/core/gpu_dirty_memory_manager.h").read_text()
assert pinned.count("std::mutex gather_guard;") == 1
assert pinned.count("std::scoped_lock gather_lock{gather_guard};") == 1
assert pinned.index("std::scoped_lock gather_lock{gather_guard};") < pinned.index(
    "front_buffer.swap(back_buffer)")
assert pinned.index("front_buffer.swap(back_buffer)") < pinned.index(
    "front_buffer.clear();")
assert body.index("std::scoped_lock gather_lock(gather_guard);") < body.index(
    "front_buffer.swap(back_buffer)")
assert body.index("front_buffer.clear();") < body.index("private:")

fixture = r"""
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <thread>
#include "core/gpu_dirty_memory_manager.h"

int main() {
    Core::GPUDirtyMemoryManager dirty;
    constexpr PAddr first_address = 0x10000;
    constexpr PAddr second_address = 0x30000;
    dirty.Collect(first_address, 64);
    std::atomic<bool> first_entered{false};
    std::atomic<bool> release_first{false};
    std::atomic<bool> second_started{false};
    std::atomic<unsigned> first_calls{0};
    std::atomic<unsigned> second_calls{0};

    std::function<void(PAddr, size_t)> first = [&](PAddr addr, size_t bytes) {
        assert(addr == first_address && bytes == 64);
        first_calls.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        first_entered.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
        while (!release_first.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
            std::this_thread::yield();
    };
    std::function<void(PAddr, size_t)> second = [&](PAddr addr, size_t bytes) {
        assert(addr == second_address && bytes == 64);
        second_calls.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    };

    std::thread consumer_a([&] { dirty.Gather(first); });
    while (!first_entered.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        std::this_thread::yield();
    // The guest GPU producer is free to Collect during a Gather callback.
    dirty.Collect(second_address, 64);
    std::thread consumer_b([&] {
        second_started.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
        dirty.Gather(second);
    });
    while (!second_started.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        std::this_thread::yield();
    std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(30));
    // Without the gather lock, consumer B swaps/reuses A's front_buffer.
    assert(second_calls.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) == 0);
    release_first.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    consumer_a.join();
    consumer_b.join();
    assert(first_calls.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) == 1);
    assert(second_calls.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) == 1);
    // Both batches must be drained, not accidentally replayed later.
    unsigned leftovers{};
    std::function<void(PAddr, size_t)> empty = [&](PAddr, size_t) {
        ++leftovers;
    };
    dirty.Gather(empty);
    assert(leftovers == 0);
    std::puts("P1_3_SHARED_GPU_DIRTY_GATHER_RACE_PASS");
}
"""
# The pinned active header is copied byte-for-byte to a temporary overlay
# before compilation; dependencies resolve from the real vendor source tree.
# The override is only for isolated local worktree validation.
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-gpu-dirty-gather-") as temp:
    temp = Path(temp)
    overlay = temp/"include"/"core"
    overlay.mkdir(parents=True)
    (overlay/"gpu_dirty_memory_manager.h").write_text(body)
    cpp = temp/"test.cpp"
    cpp.write_text("#include <cstdio>\n" + fixture)
    roots = [temp/"include", ROOT/"vendor/sources/eden/src",
             ROOT/"vendor/sources/fmt/include"]
    boost = ROOT/"vendor/sources/eden-cpm/boost/boost-1.90.0/libs"
    roots += list(boost.glob("*/include"))
    includes = ["-I"+str(p) for p in roots if p.is_dir()]
    sdk = Path("/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX15.4.sdk")
    env = os.environ.copy()
    if sdk.exists():
        env["SDKROOT"] = str(sdk)
    compilers = list(dict.fromkeys(filter(None, (
        shutil.which("clang++"), shutil.which("g++")))))
    assert compilers
    for cxx in compilers:
        for opt in ("-O0", "-O2"):
            exe = temp/(Path(cxx).name.replace("+", "p")+opt)
            cmd = [cxx, "-std=c++20", opt, "-Wall", "-Wextra",
                   "-Werror", "-Wno-unused-parameter", "-pthread",
                   "-fsanitize=undefined", "-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
                   *includes, str(cpp), "-o", str(exe)]
            built = subprocess.run(cmd, env=env, capture_output=True,
                                   text=True, timeout=65)
            assert built.returncode == 0, (cxx, built.stderr[-3500:])
            run = subprocess.run([str(exe)], env=env, capture_output=True,
                                 text=True, timeout=15)
            assert run.returncode == 0, (cxx, run.stderr[-3500:])
            assert "P1_3_SHARED_GPU_DIRTY_GATHER_RACE_PASS" in run.stdout
            print("P1_3_SHARED_GPU_DIRTY_GATHER_PASS",
                  Path(cxx).name, opt, flush=True)
```

`tools/ns2/check_shared_kernel_wait64_host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""P1.3: execute the real dual-generation address-arbiter compare under UBSan.

The test extracts the maintained kernel's actual 32/64-bit read/compare,
keeps the pinned 32-bit policy, compiles the two complete kernel owners and
the selected SVC dispatcher. Does not simulate scheduling, PS5 or game boot.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import difflib
import os
import platform
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
BASE = ROOT/'vendor/sources/eden/src/core/hle/kernel'
KERNEL = ROOT/'vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/kernel_wait64/core/hle/kernel'
SVC_GPU = ROOT/'vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/gpu_access_svc/core/hle/kernel'
SOURCE = KERNEL/'k_address_arbiter.cpp'
ARB_SVC = KERNEL/'svc/svc_address_arbiter.cpp'
NATIVE_SVC = ROOT/'vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/kernel/core/hle/kernel/svc.cpp'
CMAKE = (ROOT/'headless/CMakeLists.txt').read_text()

for name in ('k_address_arbiter.h','k_address_arbiter.cpp','k_process.h',
             'svc.h','svc/svc_address_arbiter.cpp'):
    original = (BASE/name).read_text().splitlines(keepends=True)
    reviewed = (KERNEL/name).read_text().splitlines(keepends=True)
    edits=list(difflib.unified_diff(original,reviewed))
    if not edits:
        # The pinned kernel already includes some reviewed 64-bit ABI
        # declarations. Byte-identical source is the strongest baseline
        # parity result, not an absent implementation. The per-file value
        # signatures and compiled comparisons are checked below.
        assert original == reviewed, ("Pinned kernel parity drift", name)
    else:
        assert 0 < len(edits) < 105, (name,len(edits))
assert 'set(EDEN_SHARED_NS2_WAIT64 ON)' in CMAKE
assert 'if(EDEN_SHARED_NS2_GPU_ACCESS_SVC)' in CMAKE
for path in ('k_address_arbiter.cpp','svc/svc_address_arbiter.cpp'):
    assert f'"hle/kernel/{path}"' in CMAKE, path
assert 'target_include_directories(core BEFORE PUBLIC "${EDEN_NS2_WAIT64_ROOT}")' in CMAKE
assert 'target_include_directories(video_core BEFORE PRIVATE "${EDEN_NS2_WAIT64_ROOT}")' in CMAKE

assert 'WaitIfEqual64 = 3' in (SVC_GPU/'svc_types.h').read_text()
for filename in (SVC_GPU/'svc.cpp', NATIVE_SVC):
    s=filename.read_text();start=s.index('static void SvcWrap_WaitForAddress64(Core::System& system')
    end=s.index('\n}', start)
    wrapper=s[start:end]
    assert 'int64_t value = Convert<int64_t>(GetArg64(args, 2));' in wrapper
    assert 'int32_t value = Convert<int32_t>(GetArg64(args, 2));' not in wrapper
    wrapper32=s[s.index('static void SvcWrap_WaitForAddress64From32'):s.index('\n}',s.index('static void SvcWrap_WaitForAddress64From32'))]
    assert 'int32_t value = Convert<int32_t>(GetArg32(args, 2));' in wrapper32

for name in ('svc.h','k_process.h','k_address_arbiter.h'):
    assert 's64 value' in (KERNEL/name).read_text() or 'int64_t value' in (KERNEL/name).read_text()

source=SOURCE.read_text()
start=source.index('        s64 user_value{};')
end=source.index('        // Check that the timeout is non-zero.',start)
read_compare=source[start:end]
assert 'GetCurrentMemory(system.Kernel())' in read_compare
assert 'memory.IsValidVirtualAddressRange(addr, sizeof(s64))' in read_compare
assert 'static_cast<s64>(memory.Read64(addr))' in read_compare
assert 'ReadFromUser(system.Kernel(), std::addressof(low_word), addr)' in read_compare
assert 'value != user_value' in read_compare
svc_source=ARB_SVC.read_text()
start=svc_source.index('constexpr bool IsValidArbitrationType(')
end=svc_source.index('\n}',start)+2
valid_type=svc_source[start:end]
assert 'WaitIfEqual64' in valid_type
alignment='const size_t alignment = arb_type == ArbitrationType::WaitIfEqual64 ? sizeof(s64) : sizeof(s32);'
assert alignment in svc_source

# Exercise the actual CMake selector, rather than inferring target changes
# from the words inside its conditional source-selection block.
selector = 'set(EDEN_SHARED_NS2_WAIT64 OFF)' + CMAKE.split(
    'set(EDEN_SHARED_NS2_WAIT64 OFF)', 1)[1].split('# N52:', 1)[0]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='encore-wait64-cmake-') as cmake_tmp:
    cmake_root=Path(cmake_tmp)
    for selected in (False,True):
        project = cmake_root/('on' if selected else 'off')
        project.mkdir()
        for rel in ('hle/kernel/k_address_arbiter.cpp',
                    'hle/kernel/svc/svc_address_arbiter.cpp', 'dummy.cpp'):
            actual_source=project/rel
            actual_source.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
            actual_source.write_text('int probe_%s = 0;\n' % len(rel))
        probe = f'''cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(wait64_select LANGUAGES CXX)
set(PORT_ROOT "{ROOT.as_posix()}")
set(EDEN_SHARED_NS2_GPU_ACCESS_SVC {"ON" if selected else "OFF"})
add_library(core STATIC hle/kernel/k_address_arbiter.cpp
                        hle/kernel/svc/svc_address_arbiter.cpp)
add_library(video_core STATIC dummy.cpp)
'''
        probe += selector
        probe += '''
get_target_property(actual core SOURCES)

message(STATUS "WAIT64_SELECTED=${EDEN_SHARED_NS2_WAIT64}")
message(STATUS "WAIT64_SOURCES=${actual}")
message(STATUS "WAIT64_INCLUDES=${exposed}")
'''
        (project/'CMakeLists.txt').write_text(probe)
        sdk_arg = (['-DCMAKE_OSX_SYSROOT=/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX15.4.sdk']
                   if platform.system() == 'Darwin' and
                   Path('/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX15.4.sdk').is_dir()
                   else [])
        result = subprocess.run(['cmake','-S',str(project),'-B',str(project/'build'),
                                 *sdk_arg], capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=40)
        assert result.returncode==0,result.stderr[-4000:]
        assert ('WAIT64_SELECTED=ON' if selected else 'WAIT64_SELECTED=OFF') in result.stdout
        chosen = str(KERNEL/'k_address_arbiter.cpp')
        assert (chosen in result.stdout) == selected, result.stdout[-1600:]
        print('P1_3_KERNEL_WAIT64_CMAKE_OWNER_PASS',
              'enabled' if selected else 'disabled',flush=True)

unit=r'''
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>
#include <cstdio>
#include <memory>
using u64=std::uint64_t;
using u32=std::uint32_t;
using s64=std::int64_t;
using s32=std::int32_t;
namespace Svc {
enum class ArbitrationType : u32 {
    WaitIfLessThan=0,DecrementAndWaitIfLessThan=1,WaitIfEqual=2,WaitIfEqual64=3
};
}
__VALID_ENUM__
using ArbitrationType=Svc::ArbitrationType;
static bool AlignForType(u64 addr, ArbitrationType arb_type) {
    __REAL_ALIGNMENT__
    return (addr % alignment)==0;
}
enum Result { Ok, ResultInvalidCurrentMemory, ResultInvalidState };
#define R_THROW(error) throw (error)
struct Memory {
    static constexpr u64 base=0x1000;
    std::array<std::uint8_t,16> data{};
    bool IsValidVirtualAddressRange(u64 addr,u64 bytes) const {
        return addr>=base && addr-base<=data.size() && bytes<=data.size()-(addr-base);
    }
    u64 Read64(u64 addr) const {
        u64 word{};
        assert(IsValidVirtualAddressRange(addr,8));
        std::memcpy(&word,data.data()+addr-base,8);
        return word;
    }
    u32 Read32(u64 addr) const {
        u32 word{};
        assert(IsValidVirtualAddressRange(addr,4));
        std::memcpy(&word,data.data()+addr-base,4);
        return word;
    }
};
struct KernelCore { Memory memory; };
struct System {KernelCore kernel;KernelCore& Kernel(){return kernel;}};
static Memory& GetCurrentMemory(KernelCore& kernel) {return kernel.memory;}
static bool ReadFromUser(KernelCore& kernel,s32* output,u64 addr) {
    if (!kernel.memory.IsValidVirtualAddressRange(addr,4))return false;
    *output=static_cast<s32>(kernel.memory.Read32(addr));
    return true;
}
struct Sleep { unsigned cancels{};void CancelSleep(){++cancels;} };
struct Arbiter {
    System system;
    Result Compare(u64 addr,s64 value,bool is_64_bit) {
        Sleep slp;
        try {
__REAL_COMPARE__
            return Ok;
        } catch(Result error) {
            assert(slp.cancels==1);
            return error;
        }
    }
};
int main() {
    assert(IsValidArbitrationType(ArbitrationType::WaitIfLessThan));
    assert(IsValidArbitrationType(ArbitrationType::WaitIfEqual));
    assert(IsValidArbitrationType(ArbitrationType::WaitIfEqual64));
    assert(!IsValidArbitrationType(static_cast<ArbitrationType>(4)));
    assert(AlignForType(0x1004,ArbitrationType::WaitIfEqual));
    assert(!AlignForType(0x1004,ArbitrationType::WaitIfEqual64));
    assert(AlignForType(0x1008,ArbitrationType::WaitIfEqual64));
    Arbiter a;
    const u64 wide=0x12345678abcdef00ULL;
    std::memcpy(a.system.kernel.memory.data.data(),&wide,8);
    const s64 exact=static_cast<s64>(wide);
    const s32 low=static_cast<s32>(wide);
    assert(a.Compare(0x1000,exact,true)==Ok);
    assert(a.Compare(0x1000,static_cast<s64>(static_cast<u32>(wide)),true)==ResultInvalidState);
    assert(a.Compare(0x1000,static_cast<s64>(low),false)==Ok);
    assert(a.Compare(0x1000,static_cast<s64>(low)+1,false)==ResultInvalidState);
    assert(a.Compare(0x1000,exact+1,true)==ResultInvalidState);
    assert(a.Compare(0x1010,exact,true)==ResultInvalidCurrentMemory);
    assert(a.Compare(0x1010,static_cast<s64>(low),false)==ResultInvalidCurrentMemory);
    // The current 32-bit legacy path is sign-extended from a signed s32.
    const u64 all_ones=~u64{0};
    std::memcpy(a.system.kernel.memory.data.data()+8,&all_ones,8);
    assert(a.Compare(0x1008,-1,true)==Ok);
    assert(a.Compare(0x1008,-1,false)==Ok);
    assert(a.Compare(0x1008,0xffffffffULL,true)==ResultInvalidState);
    std::puts("P1_3_REAL_KERNEL_WAIT64_COMPARE_PASS");
}
'''
unit=unit.replace('__VALID_ENUM__',valid_type).replace('__REAL_ALIGNMENT__',alignment).replace('__REAL_COMPARE__',read_compare)
```

`tools/ns2/check_shared_shader_nested_epilogue_host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""P2.4 shared fragment shader: count every nested exit before demote reordering.

Extracts the exact reviewed DemoteCombinationPass scanning loop from the
active vendor Maxwell IR source. No ROM, game override or PS5 build.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
OWNER = Path(os.environ.get(
    "EDEN_SHADER_CFLOW_SOURCE",
    str(ROOT/"vendor/sources/eden/src/shader_recompiler/frontend/maxwell/structured_control_flow.cpp")))
source = OWNER.read_text()
block = source.split("    void DemoteCombinationPass() {", 1)
assert len(block) == 2, "missing actual shared Maxwell demote pass"
start = "        for (const IR::AbstractSyntaxNode& node : syntax_list) {\n"
end = "        if (demote_blocks.size() == 0) {\n"
assert block[1].count(start) == block[1].count(end) == 1
loop = block[1].split(start, 1)[1].split(end, 1)[0]
assert "if (branch_depth <= 1)" in loop
assert "++num_epilogues;" in loop
assert "if (branch_depth > 1)" not in loop, "nested return lost before count"
assert "demote_blocks.push_back(node.data.block);" in loop
assert "if (op == IR::Opcode::Epilogue)" in loop

cpp = r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>
using u32 = std::uint32_t;
namespace IR {
enum class Opcode { Other, DemoteToHelperInvocation, Epilogue };
struct Inst {
    Opcode op{};
    [[nodiscard]] Opcode GetOpcode() const noexcept { return op; }
};
struct Block {
    std::vector<Inst> code;
    [[nodiscard]] const std::vector<Inst>& Instructions() const noexcept { return code; }
};
struct AbstractSyntaxNode {
    enum class Type { If, EndIf, Block };
    Type type{};
    struct { Block* block{}; } data{};
};
}
int main() {
    using Type = IR::AbstractSyntaxNode::Type;
    IR::Block shallow_demote{{{IR::Opcode::DemoteToHelperInvocation}}};
    IR::Block nested_demote{{{IR::Opcode::DemoteToHelperInvocation}}};
    IR::Block nested_early_return{{{IR::Opcode::Epilogue}}};
    IR::Block final_return{{{IR::Opcode::Epilogue}}};
    auto node = [](Type type, IR::Block* b = nullptr) {
        IR::AbstractSyntaxNode n{};
        n.type = type;
        n.data.block = b;
        return n;
    };
    const auto scan = [&](const std::vector<IR::AbstractSyntaxNode>& syntax_list) {
        std::vector<IR::Block*> demote_blocks;
        u32 num_epilogues{};
        u32 branch_depth{};
__EXTRACTED_LOOP__
        return std::pair{demote_blocks.size(), num_epilogues};
    };

    const auto nested_return = scan({
        node(Type::If), node(Type::If),
        node(Type::Block, &nested_early_return),
        node(Type::EndIf), node(Type::EndIf),
        node(Type::If), node(Type::Block, &shallow_demote), node(Type::EndIf),
        node(Type::Block, &final_return)
    });
    assert(nested_return.first == 1 && nested_return.second == 2);
    // Two returns must make the enclosing pass reject demote relocation.
    assert(nested_return.second > 1);

    const auto normal = scan({
        node(Type::If), node(Type::Block, &shallow_demote), node(Type::EndIf),
        node(Type::Block, &final_return)
    });
    assert(normal.first == 1 && normal.second == 1);

    const auto skipped_nested_demote = scan({
        node(Type::If), node(Type::If),
        node(Type::Block, &nested_demote),
        node(Type::EndIf), node(Type::EndIf),
        node(Type::Block, &final_return)
    });
    assert(skipped_nested_demote.first == 0 && skipped_nested_demote.second == 1);
    std::puts("P2_4_SHARED_NESTED_EPILOGUE_DEMOTE_PASS");
}
""".replace("__EXTRACTED_LOOP__", start + loop)
env = os.environ.copy()
sdk = Path("/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX15.4.sdk")
if sdk.is_dir():
    env["SDKROOT"] = str(sdk)
compilers = list(dict.fromkeys(filter(None, (
    shutil.which("clang++"), shutil.which("g++")))))
assert compilers
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-nested-epilogue-") as temp:
    path = Path(temp)/"shader.cpp"
    path.write_text(cpp)
    for compiler in compilers:
        for opt in ("-O0", "-O2"):
            binary = Path(temp)/(Path(compiler).name.replace("+","p")+opt)
            build = subprocess.run(
                [compiler, "-std=c++20", opt, "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror",
                 "-Wno-unused-parameter", "-fsanitize=undefined",
                 "-fno-sanitize-recover=all", str(path), "-o", str(binary)],
                capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60, env=env)
            assert build.returncode == 0, (compiler, build.stderr[-3200:])
            run = subprocess.run([str(binary)], capture_output=True, text=True,
                                 timeout=15, env=env)
            assert run.returncode == 0, (compiler, run.stderr[-2500:])
            assert "P2_4_SHARED_NESTED_EPILOGUE_DEMOTE_PASS" in run.stdout
            print("P2_4_SHARED_FRAGMENT_NESTED_RETURN_PASS",
                  Path(compiler).name, opt, flush=True)
```

`tools/ns2/check_shared_vulkan_occlusion_submission_host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""P2/P4: execute source-extracted shared Vulkan ZPass query close policy.

Host proof only: real PS5 Vulkan driver/query results are not simulated.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
SCHEDULER = ROOT/"vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_scheduler.cpp"
QUERY = ROOT/"vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_query_cache.cpp"
scheduler = SCHEDULER.read_text()
query = QUERY.read_text()
anchor = "void Scheduler::EndPendingOperations() {"
assert scheduler.count(anchor) == 1
operations = scheduler.split(anchor, 1)[1].split("\n}", 1)[0]
assert "query_cache->CounterClose(VideoCommon::QueryType::ZPassPixelCount64);" in operations
assert "query_cache->CounterReset(VideoCommon::QueryType::ZPassPixelCount64);" not in operations
assert "EndRenderPass();" in operations
assert operations.index("CounterClose") < operations.index("EndRenderPass()")

bank_anchor = "static constexpr size_t BANK_SIZE = 256;"
assert query.count(bank_anchor) == 1
sample_start = query.index("class SamplesStreamer : public BaseStreamer")
sample = query[sample_start:]
close = "    void CloseCounter() override {"
end = "    bool HasPendingSync() const override {"
assert sample.count(close) >= 1
start = sample.index(close)  # SamplesStreamer; later counter subclasses have their own CloseCounter
stop = sample.index(end, start)
actual_method = sample[start:stop].rstrip()
assert actual_method.count("PauseCounter();") == 1
assert actual_method.count("ResetCounter();") == 1
assert "current_query->size_slots > SamplesQueryBank::BANK_SIZE" in actual_method
assert actual_method.index("PauseCounter();") < actual_method.index("ResetCounter();")

program = r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdio>
struct SamplesQueryBank { static constexpr std::size_t BANK_SIZE = 256; };
struct Query { std::size_t size_slots{}; };
struct Streamer {
    Query* current_query{};
    unsigned pause_count{};
    unsigned reset_count{};
    void PauseCounter() { ++pause_count; }
    void ResetCounter() { ++reset_count; current_query = nullptr; }
__CLOSE_METHOD__
};
int main() {
    Streamer s;
    s.CloseCounter();
    assert(s.pause_count == 1 && s.reset_count == 0);

    Query q{36};
    s.current_query = &q;
    s.CloseCounter();
    assert(s.pause_count == 2 && s.reset_count == 0 && s.current_query == &q);

    q.size_slots = 256;
    s.CloseCounter();
    assert(s.pause_count == 3 && s.reset_count == 0 && s.current_query == &q);

    q.size_slots = 257;
    s.CloseCounter();
    assert(s.pause_count == 4 && s.reset_count == 1 && s.current_query == nullptr);

    // The next submission does not reset a query already retired.
    s.CloseCounter();
    assert(s.pause_count == 5 && s.reset_count == 1);

    Query title_screen{16'384};
    s.current_query = &title_screen;
    s.CloseCounter();
    assert(s.pause_count == 6 && s.reset_count == 2 && s.current_query == nullptr);
    std::puts("SHARED_VULKAN_OCCLUSION_SUBMISSION_PASS");
}
""".replace("__CLOSE_METHOD__", actual_method.replace(" override", ""))
env = os.environ.copy()
sdk = Path("/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX15.4.sdk")
if sdk.is_dir():
    env["SDKROOT"] = str(sdk)
compilers = list(dict.fromkeys(filter(None,
    (shutil.which("clang++"), shutil.which("g++")))))
assert compilers, "No host C++20 compiler"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-occlusion-submit-") as tmp:
    cpp = Path(tmp)/"occlusion.cpp"
    cpp.write_text(program)
    for compiler in compilers:
        for optimization in ("-O0", "-O2"):
            binary = Path(tmp)/(Path(compiler).name.replace("+","p")+optimization)
            built = subprocess.run(
                [compiler, "-std=c++20", optimization, "-Wall", "-Wextra",
                 "-Werror", "-fsanitize=undefined", "-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
                 str(cpp), "-o", str(binary)],
                env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=45)
            assert built.returncode == 0, (compiler, built.stderr[-2000:])
            ran = subprocess.run([str(binary)], env=env, capture_output=True,
                                 text=True, timeout=10)
            assert ran.returncode == 0, (compiler, ran.stderr[-2000:])
            assert "SHARED_VULKAN_OCCLUSION_SUBMISSION_PASS" in ran.stdout
            print("SHARED_VULKAN_OCCLUSION_SUBMISSION_PASS",
                  Path(compiler).name, optimization, flush=True)

```

```py
"""N73: compile exact vendor cache admission and audit native integration."""
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]

cpp = r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdio>
#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/ns2_sparse_cache_admission.h"
using namespace Eden::NS2::Cache;
static VkImageCreateInfo Image() {
 VkImageCreateInfo ci{};
 ci.imageType=VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D;
 ci.extent={256,256,1};
 ci.mipLevels=2;ci.arrayLayers=4;ci.samples=VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;
 ci.tiling=VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL;
 ci.usage=VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT|VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT;
 return ci;
}
static VkMemoryRequirements Memory() {
 return {16ULL*1024*1024,65536,7};
}
static VkSparseImageMemoryRequirements Sparse() {
 VkSparseImageMemoryRequirements r{};
 r.formatProperties.aspectMask=VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT;
 r.formatProperties.imageGranularity={64,64,1};
 r.imageMipTailFirstLod=1;
 r.imageMipTailSize=65536;
 r.imageMipTailOffset=12ULL*1024*1024;
 r.imageMipTailStride=65536;
 return r;
}
int main() {
 auto ci=Image();auto mem=Memory();
 auto sparse=std::vector<VkSparseImageMemoryRequirements>{Sparse()};
 auto a=AdmitSparseCacheImage(ci,mem,sparse,6ULL<<30,true);
 assert(a.Accepted());
 assert(a.complete_layers.size()==4 && a.complete_layers[0]==0 &&
        a.complete_layers[3]==3);
 assert(a.spec.layers==4 && a.spec.tail_first_lod==1);
 assert(a.resident_bytes==17ULL*65536*4);
 assert(!AdmitSparseCacheImage(ci,mem,sparse,6ULL<<30,false).Accepted());
 ci.usage=VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT;
 assert(AdmitSparseCacheImage(ci,mem,sparse,6ULL<<30,true).rejection==
        SparseCacheReject::UnsupportedImage);
 ci=Image();ci.usage|=VK_IMAGE_USAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BIT;
 assert(!AdmitSparseCacheImage(ci,mem,sparse,6ULL<<30,true).Accepted());
 ci=Image();ci.flags|=VK_IMAGE_CREATE_MUTABLE_FORMAT_BIT;
 assert(!AdmitSparseCacheImage(ci,mem,sparse,6ULL<<30,true).Accepted());
 ci=Image();
 mem.memoryTypeBits=0;
 assert(!AdmitSparseCacheImage(ci,mem,sparse,6ULL<<30,true).Accepted());
 mem=Memory();
 sparse.push_back(Sparse());sparse[1].formatProperties.aspectMask=2;
 assert(AdmitSparseCacheImage(ci,mem,sparse,6ULL<<30,true).rejection==
        SparseCacheReject::UnsupportedAspect);
 sparse={Sparse()};
 sparse[0].formatProperties.flags=VK_SPARSE_IMAGE_FORMAT_NONSTANDARD_BLOCK_SIZE_BIT;
 assert(!AdmitSparseCacheImage(ci,mem,sparse,6ULL<<30,true).Accepted());
 sparse={Sparse()};
 ci.arrayLayers=4096;
 assert(!AdmitSparseCacheImage(ci,mem,sparse,6ULL<<30,true).Accepted());
 ci=Image();
 sparse[0].formatProperties.flags=VK_SPARSE_IMAGE_FORMAT_SINGLE_MIPTAIL_BIT;
 sparse[0].imageMipTailStride=0;
 auto shared=AdmitSparseCacheImage(ci,mem,sparse,6ULL<<30,true);
 assert(shared.Accepted() && shared.complete_layers.size()==4);
 // Shared direct pool, not a per-game or Switch-generation exception.
 auto short_pool = AdmitSparseCacheImage(ci,mem,sparse,6ULL<<30,true,
    (6ULL<<30)-(768ULL<<20)-(2ULL<<20), true);
 assert(!short_pool.Accepted());
 auto sufficient = AdmitSparseCacheImage(ci,mem,sparse,6ULL<<30,true,
    (6ULL<<30)-(768ULL<<20)-(8ULL<<20), true);
 assert(sufficient.Accepted());
 auto unknown = AdmitSparseCacheImage(ci,mem,sparse,6ULL<<30,true,
    6ULL<<30, false);
 assert(unknown.Accepted());
 assert(shared.resident_bytes==16ULL*65536*4+65536);
 std::puts("N73_REAL_VENDOR_CACHE_ADMISSION_PASS");
}
"""
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="ns2-n73-cache-") as temporary:
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""P2.4: parse the REAL maintained Vulkan Task/Mesh graphics pipeline owners.

Host Clang C++20 checks actual pinned/active header compatibility, not an
isolated snippet. These are shared Vulkan TUs, without PS5 SDK or GPU activity.
No claim of guest frame, on-console compilation or Vulkan execution.
"""
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from pathlib import Path
import os
import platform
import runpy
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
ACTIVE = ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan"
SHADER = ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/eden-shader/src"
CPM = ROOT / "vendor/sources/eden-cpm"
OWNERS = (
    "vk_graphics_pipeline_cost.cpp",
    "vk_pipeline_cache_cost.cpp",
    "vulkan_rasterizer.cpp",
)
# Compile real shader-stage construction, native translation environment and
# GPU-source admission too: a graphics TU alone cannot prove that Mesh/Task
# reaches the native Maxwell-to-IR stage or uses the correct CBUF bank.
MESH_STAGE_OWNERS = (
    ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/video_core/shader_environment.cpp",
    ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/ampere/shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/maxwell_environment.cpp",
    ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/ampere/video_core/native_shader_capture.cpp",
)
# The real SPIR-V mesh emitter must compile too. The previous six-TU
# witness checked the pipeline but never parsed this stage-buffer lowering.
MESH_SPIRV_OWNERS = (
    SHADER / "shader_recompiler/backend/spirv/emit_spirv_mesh.cpp",
    ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/ampere/shader_recompiler/backend/spirv/spirv_emit_context.cpp",
)

cmake = (ROOT / "headless/CMakeLists.txt").read_text()
assert "EDEN_NATIVE_TASK_MESH_ROOT" in cmake
assert "shader_recompiler/backend/spirv/emit_spirv_mesh.cpp" in cmake
stage = (SHADER / "shader_recompiler/stage.h").read_text()
assert "Task," in stage and "Mesh," in stage
device = (ACTIVE / "include/video_core/vulkan_common/vulkan_device.h").read_text()
assert "IsExtMeshShaderSupported()" in device
for owner in OWNERS:
    assert (ACTIVE / owner).is_file(), owner
for path in MESH_STAGE_OWNERS + MESH_SPIRV_OWNERS:
    assert path.is_file(), path
mesh_emit = MESH_SPIRV_OWNERS[0].read_text()
mesh_context = MESH_SPIRV_OWNERS[1].read_text()
assert "Invalid native Task/Mesh shader dimensions" in mesh_context
assert "Native Mesh output region exceeds u32 indexing" in mesh_context
assert "const u64 vertex_words" in mesh_context
assert "const u64 map_bytes" in mesh_context
assert "TypeArray(U32[1], Const((std::max)(mesh_info.payload_words, 1U)))" in mesh_context
# Ensure invalid dimensions fail explicitly and guest out-of-bounds writes
# cannot alias the final live primitive/payload byte.
assert 'Mesh shader has zero workgroup threads' in mesh_emit
assert 'Task shader payload missing mesh-group count' in mesh_emit
assert 'Mesh shader has no task payload words' in mesh_emit
assert 'index, ctx.Const(ctx.mesh_attribute_words)' in mesh_emit
assert 'address, ctx.Const(ctx.mesh_map_bytes)' in mesh_emit
assert "SharedWord(ctx, ctx.mesh_map, Clamped(" not in mesh_emit
assert "SharedWord(ctx, ctx.mesh_attributes, Clamped(" not in mesh_emit
stage_owner = MESH_STAGE_OWNERS[0].read_text()
assert 'CaptureGraphicsTicket(maxwell3d).has_value()' in stage_owner
assert 'Shader::Stage::Task : Shader::Stage::Mesh' in stage_owner
assert 'IsShaderConfigEnabled(Maxwell::ShaderType::TessellationInit)' in stage_owner
env_owner = MESH_STAGE_OWNERS[1].read_text()
# Task/Mesh registers and primitive-output headers are authenticated by
# native capture/pipeline owners, NOT the common NS1 Shader::Environment ABI.
# The old witness required removed nonexistent virtual accessors and failed
# before syntax-checking the actual Vulkan translation units.
assert 'mesh_registers = source.MeshRegisters();' not in env_owner
assert 'mesh_primitive_header = source.MeshPrimitiveHeader();' not in env_owner
assert 'image.native_stage != static_cast<u32>(source->ShaderStage())' in env_owner
assert 'MatchesCapturedHeader(*source, image)' in env_owner
capture_owner = MESH_STAGE_OWNERS[2].read_text()
assert 'NativeMeshSlotCbufBank(shader_stage, has_task)' in capture_owner
assert 'NativeMeshRegisterPipelineKey(' in capture_owner
assert 'NativeMeshPrimitiveHeaderPipelineKey(' in capture_owner
assert 'NativeMeshPrimitiveHeaderAddress(' in capture_owner
assert 'IsShaderConfigEnabled(Maxwell::ShaderType::Geometry)' in stage_owner
assert 'mesh_primitive_header' in stage_owner
assert 'live_executable_stages' in (ACTIVE / "vk_pipeline_cache_cost.cpp").read_text()
assert 'NativeMeshRegisterPipelineKey(' in (
    ROOT / "vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/ampere/shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/native_graphics_stage_policy.h"
).read_text()
cache_owner = (ACTIVE / "vk_pipeline_cache_cost.cpp").read_text()
assert cache_owner.count("NativeMeshSlotCbufBank(stage, has_task)") == 3

        "vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/video_core/buffer_cache/buffer_cache_base.h"
    )

    # vendor/sources/eden/src; appending this -I selects the wrong template.

        shim.write_text(
            "#pragma once\\n#ifdef __aarch64__\\n"

            command + [str(source)], cwd=ROOT, env=env,
            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=180)
        return str(source.relative_to(ROOT)), result.returncode, result.stderr[-20000:]

               list(MESH_STAGE_OWNERS) + list(MESH_SPIRV_OWNERS))
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=3) as pool:
        checked = list(pool.map(check, sources))
    failures = []
    for owner, code, stderr in checked:
        if code:
            failures.append((owner, stderr))
            print("P24_REAL_VULKAN_TASK_MESH_TU_FAIL", owner, stderr, flush=True)
        else:
            print("P24_REAL_VULKAN_TASK_MESH_TU_PASS", owner, flush=True)
    assert not failures, ("P2.4 maintained Vulkan TU syntax failed", failures)
print("P24_REAL_VULKAN_TASK_MESH_HOST_ONLY_PASS count=8 console=NOT_TESTED", flush=True)
```

`tools/ns2/check_unified_jit_cpu6_baseline_host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Exact A32/A64 JIT retry baseline contract shared by 4- and 6-core guests.

Host-only UBSan witness against the production header. No console build.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
HEADER=ROOT/'headless/jit_memory_policy.h'
assert HEADER.is_file()
for bits in (32,64):
    for profile in ('normal','dev'):
        source=(ROOT/'vendor/encore-active/eden-core/src/core/arm/dynarmic/g11'/
                f'arm_dynarmic_{bits}_native_{profile}.cpp').read_text()
        assert source.count(f'::Eden::JitMemory::A{bits}BaselineBytes(m_core_index)')==1
        assert f'kA{bits}Baseline[m_core_index]' not in source

fixture=r'''
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdio>
#include "jit_memory_policy.h"
int main() {
    using namespace Eden::JitMemory;
    constexpr std::array<std::uint32_t,6> a64{
        256u*kMiB,192u*kMiB,192u*kMiB,16u*kMiB,16u*kMiB,16u*kMiB};
    constexpr std::array<std::uint32_t,6> a32{
        512u*kMiB,64u*kMiB,64u*kMiB,16u*kMiB,16u*kMiB,16u*kMiB};
    for (std::size_t i=0;i<64;++i) {
        const auto a64_expected=i<6 ? a64[i] : 16u*kMiB;
        const auto a32_expected=i<6 ? a32[i] : 16u*kMiB;
        assert(A64BaselineBytes(i)==a64_expected);
        assert(A32BaselineBytes(i)==a32_expected);
        assert(A64CacheBytes(i,A64BaselineBytes(i))==a64_expected);
        assert(A32CacheBytes(i,A32BaselineBytes(i))==a32_expected);
    }
    auto plan=ChooseJitMemoryPlan(false,true,8ull*1024*kMiB);
    ApplyJitMemoryPlan(plan);
    for (std::size_t i=4;i<6;++i) {
        assert(A64CacheBytes(i,A64BaselineBytes(i))==16u*kMiB);
        assert(A32CacheBytes(i,A32BaselineBytes(i))==16u*kMiB);
    }
    for (std::size_t i=0;i<4;++i) {
        assert(A64CacheBytes(i,A64BaselineBytes(i))==plan.a64[i]);
        assert(A32CacheBytes(i,A32BaselineBytes(i))==plan.a32[i]);
    }
    std::puts("UNIFIED_JIT_CPU6_BOUNDED_BASELINES_PASS");
}
'''
compiler=shutil.which('clang++') or shutil.which('g++')
assert compiler
sdk15=Path('/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX15.4.sdk')
env=os.environ.copy()
if sdk15.is_dir():env['SDKROOT']=str(sdk15)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='encore-unified-jit6-') as folder:
    source=Path(folder)/'test.cpp';source.write_text(fixture)
    for optimization in (0,2):
        binary=Path(folder)/f'jit6-O{optimization}'
        command=[compiler,'-std=c++20',f'-O{optimization}',
                 '-Wall','-Wextra','-Werror','-pedantic',
                 '-fsanitize=undefined','-fno-sanitize-recover=all',
                 '-I'+str(ROOT/'headless'),str(source),'-o',str(binary)]
        result=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True,env=env,timeout=60)
        assert result.returncode==0,result.stderr[-4000:]
        executed=subprocess.run([str(binary)],capture_output=True,text=True,env=env,timeout=12)
        assert executed.returncode==0,executed.stderr[-4000:]
        assert 'UNIFIED_JIT_CPU6_BOUNDED_BASELINES_PASS' in executed.stdout
        print('UNIFIED_JIT_CPU6_REAL_POLICY_UBSAN_PASS',f'O{optimization}',flush=True)
```

`tools/ns2/fc27_stress_replay.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""FC27-shaped offline stress oracle, NOT an emulated FC27 game/GPU."""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
from collections import OrderedDict
from dataclasses import dataclass
import json
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
FIXTURE = ROOT / "tools/fixtures/fc27-2efd8b3c-stutter-windows.json"
SHA = "2efd8b3c96608667a2b22f1751eed1a475091cce"
FIELDS = ("total", "frames", "seconds", "fps", "worst_ms", "late50",
          "late100", "late200", "late500", "cache_wait_ms", "cache_contended",
          "jit_ms", "guest_ipc_ms", "guest_dequeue_ms", "gpu_idle_ms",
          "gpu_dispatch_ms", "gpu_fence_ms", "gpu_full_ms",
          "cache_buffer_wait_ms", "cache_texture_wait_ms")


def capture(path: Path = FIXTURE) -> list[dict[str, float]]:
    doc = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if doc.get("source_sha") != SHA or doc.get("fields") != list(FIELDS):
        raise ValueError("Untrusted or incompatible FC27 telemetry")
    raw = doc.get("rows")
    if not isinstance(raw, list) or len(raw) != 415:
        raise ValueError("Expected 415 historical windows")
    rows = [dict(zip(FIELDS, row, strict=True)) for row in raw]
    if (int(rows[0]["total"]) != 130 or int(rows[-1]["total"]) != 60955
        or any(a["total"] >= b["total"] for a, b in zip(rows, rows[1:]))
        or any(r["seconds"] <= 0 or r["frames"] <= 0 or
               r["late50"] < r["late100"] or r["late100"] < r["late500"]
               for r in rows)):
        raise ValueError("Malformed FC27 timeline")
    return rows


@dataclass
class Texture:
    revision: int = 0
    epoch: int = 0


class CacheModel:
    """Independent texture version oracle with intentionally broken variants."""
    def __init__(self, capacity: int = 96):
        self.truth: dict[str, Texture] = {}
        self.views: OrderedDict[str, tuple[int, int]] = OrderedDict()
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.draws = self.writes = self.remaps = self.evictions = 0
        self.stale = self.black = self.peak = 0

    def write(self, key: str, remap: bool = False) -> None:
        t = self.truth.setdefault(key, Texture())
        t.revision += 1
        self.writes += 1
        if remap:
            t.epoch += 1
            self.remaps += 1

    def draw(self, key: str, tick: int, fault: str | None) -> None:
        t = self.truth.setdefault(key, Texture())
        truth = (t.revision, t.epoch)
        cached = self.views.get(key)
        if fault == "black" and tick > 100 and tick % 53 == 0:
            shown = None
        elif fault == "stale" and cached is not None and cached != truth:
            shown = cached
        else:
            shown = truth
            self.views[key] = shown
            self.views.move_to_end(key)
            if len(self.views) > self.capacity:
                self.views.popitem(last=False)
                self.evictions += 1
        self.draws += 1
        self.peak = max(self.peak, len(self.views))
        self.black += int(shown is None)
        self.stale += int(shown is not None and shown != truth)

    def run(self, rows: list[dict[str, float]], factor: int,
            fault: str | None = None) -> dict[str, int]:
        if factor not in (1, 4, 8):
            raise ValueError("Only x1/x4/x8 research stress allowed")
        tick = 0
        for row in rows:
            # Counts are measured; individual events are SYNTHETIC. Never
            # attribute these fake texture events to actual FC27 frames.
            for _ in range(round(row["frames"]) * factor):
                hud = f"hud:{tick % 24}"
                pitch = f"pitch:{tick % 64}"
                kit = f"kit:{tick % 96}"
                if tick % 5 == 0 or tick % 17 == 0:
                    self.write(hud, remap=tick % 17 == 0)
                if tick % 23 == 0:
                    self.write(pitch, remap=tick % 69 == 0)
                if tick % 31 == 0:
                    self.write(kit, remap=tick % 93 == 0)
                if tick % 47 == 0:
                    self.views.pop(hud, None)
                self.draw(hud, tick, fault)
                self.draw(pitch, tick, None)
                self.draw(kit, tick, None)
                tick += 1
        return {key: getattr(self, key) for key in (
            "draws", "writes", "remaps", "evictions", "stale", "black", "peak")}


def queue_model(rows: list[dict[str, float]], factor: int,
                capacity: int = 32) -> dict[str, int]:
    # Explicit counterfactual: ONE worker at 60 units/sec, NOT actual RADV
    # throughput, and no claim about the actual driver queue.
    backlog = peak = pressure = 0
    for row in rows:
        arrivals = round(row["frames"]) * 2 * factor
        service = round(row["seconds"] * 60)
        backlog = max(0, backlog + arrivals - service)
        if backlog > capacity:
            pressure += backlog - capacity
            backlog = capacity
        peak = max(peak, backlog)
    return {"capacity": capacity, "peak": peak, "backpressure": pressure}


def frozen_progress() -> dict[str, int]:
    """Synthetic producer stops 750ms while compositor stays at 30Hz."""
    previous = None
    repeats = run = longest = 0
    for frame in range(90):
        ms = frame * 1000 / 30
        guest_revision = 29 if 1000 <= ms < 1750 else frame
        if guest_revision == previous:
            repeats += 1
            run += 1
        else:
            longest = max(longest, run)
            run = 0
        previous = guest_revision
    return {"present_fps": 30, "present_late50": 0,
            "repeated_content": repeats, "longest_repeat": max(run, longest)}


def exercise(rows: list[dict[str, float]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    late50 = round(sum(r["late50"] for r in rows))
    late500 = round(sum(r["late500"] for r in rows))
    worst = max(r["worst_ms"] for r in rows)
    if late50 != 858 or late500 != 10 or not 1288 < worst < 1289:
        raise AssertionError("Historical FC27 stutter baseline changed")
    report: dict[str, Any] = {
        "historical_measured": {
            "sha": SHA, "windows": 415, "present_callbacks": 60955,
            "late50": late50, "late500": late500,
            "worst_ms": round(worst, 3), "stutter_sla": "FAIL"},
        "synthetic_only": {},
    }
    for factor in (1, 4, 8):
        cache = CacheModel()
        stats = cache.run(rows, factor)
        if stats["stale"] or stats["black"] or stats["peak"] > cache.capacity:
            raise AssertionError(f"x{factor}: broken HUD texture freshness")
        report["synthetic_only"][f"x{factor}"] = {
            "cache": stats, "queue": queue_model(rows, factor)}
    stale = CacheModel().run(rows[:12], 8, "stale")
    black = CacheModel().run(rows[:12], 4, "black")
    freeze = frozen_progress()
    if (stale["stale"] == 0 or black["black"] == 0 or
        freeze["repeated_content"] < 20 or freeze["longest_repeat"] < 20 or
        report["synthetic_only"]["x4"]["queue"]["backpressure"] == 0 or
        report["synthetic_only"]["x8"]["queue"]["backpressure"] == 0):
        raise AssertionError("Deliberate FC27-style fault escaped detector")
    report["fault_injection"] = {
        "stale_descriptors_caught": stale["stale"],
        "missing_hud_caught": black["black"],
        "frozen_guest_at_30_fps": freeze}
    report["proof"] = ("Historic five-second counters + adversarial models "
                       "only. No native GPU pixels, PS5 console or NSW2 game boot.")
    return report


def main() -> None:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--fixture", type=Path, default=FIXTURE)
    ap.add_argument("--out", type=Path)
    args = ap.parse_args()
    report = exercise(capture(args.fixture))
    if args.out:
        args.out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        args.out.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    print("FC27_STRESS_ORACLE_PASS; measured=415 windows; synthetic=x1/x4/x8;"
          " injected stale HUD, black HUD, and frozen guest all detected")
    print(json.dumps({
        "measured": report["historical_measured"],
        "x8": report["synthetic_only"]["x8"],
        "fault_detection": report["fault_injection"],
    }, sort_keys=True))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

`tools/ns2/jit-host/test_lse_jit.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Executes the actual Dynarmic JIT with research A64 overlay.
#include <atomic>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <iostream>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <string_view>
#include <unordered_map>
#include "dynarmic/tests/A64/testenv.h"
#include "dynarmic/interface/A64/a64.h"
#include "dynarmic/interface/exclusive_monitor.h"

// Dynarmic's x64 BlockOfCode prelude commits 16 MiB before guest code
// generation. A 16-MiB total cache is insufficient for these host regressions.
// Keep ample headroom without modifying PS5's separately tuned sparse JIT.
static constexpr std::size_t HostJitCodeCacheBytes = 64ULL * 1024 * 1024;
static_assert(HostJitCodeCacheBytes > 16ULL * 1024 * 1024);

struct Pattern {std::string_view name,bits;};
static constexpr Pattern patterns[]={
#define INST(method,name,bits) {#method,bits},
#include "dynarmic/frontend/A64/decoder/a64.inc"
#undef INST
};
static std::uint32_t encode(std::string_view name,
    std::initializer_list<std::pair<char,unsigned>> fields) {
    const Pattern* p=nullptr;
    for (auto& row:patterns) if(row.name==name){p=&row;break;}
    if(!p||p->bits.size()!=32) throw std::runtime_error("missing opcode");
    std::unordered_map<char,unsigned> args(fields.begin(),fields.end());
    std::unordered_map<char,unsigned> n;
    std::uint32_t result=0;
    for(int i=31;i>=0;--i){
        char ch=p->bits[i];
        if(ch=='1') result |= 1u << (31-i);
        else if(ch!='0'){
            auto it=args.find(ch);
            if(it!=args.end()&&((it->second>>n[ch])&1u)) result |= 1u << (31-i);
            ++n[ch];
        }
    }
    return result;
}
struct Env: A64TestEnv {
    Dynarmic::ExclusiveMonitor monitor{6};
    unsigned fail=0,writes=0;
    bool MemoryWriteExclusive64(u64 addr,u64 value,u64 expected) override {
        ++writes;
        if(fail){--fail;return false;}
        if(MemoryRead64(addr)!=expected)return false;
        MemoryWrite64(addr,value);
        return true;
    }
};
static void check(bool ok,const char* msg) {
    if(!ok){std::cerr<<"FAIL "<<msg<<"\n";std::exit(1);}
}
static void atomic(std::string_view op,u64 before,u64 src,u64 after,bool cas,unsigned fails=0){
    std::cerr << "RUN " << op << " before=" << before << " src=" << src << " after=" << after << " fails=" << fails << std::endl;
    Env env;Dynarmic::A64::UserConfig conf{}; conf.callbacks=&env;
    conf.global_monitor=&env.monitor;
    conf.code_cache_size=HostJitCodeCacheBytes;
    Dynarmic::A64::Jit jit{conf};
    env.code_mem={encode(op,{{'z',3},{'s',2},{'n',1},{'t',3},
                              {'L',0},{'o',0},{'A',0},{'R',0}}),0x14000000};
    env.MemoryWrite64(0x200,before);
    env.fail=fails;
    jit.SetPC(0);jit.SetRegister(1,0x200);jit.SetRegister(2,src);
    jit.SetRegister(3,cas?after:0xdeadbeef);
    for(int i=0;i<8&&jit.GetPC()==0;++i){env.ticks_left=2;jit.Step();}
    check(jit.GetPC()==4,"atomic completes / retries");
    check(env.MemoryRead64(0x200)==after,"atomic memory");
    check(jit.GetRegister(cas?2:3)==before,"atomic observed register");
    check(env.writes>=fails+1,"exclusive retry observed");
}
int main(){
    atomic("CAS",17,17,99,true);
    atomic("CAS",17,17,99,true,2);
    atomic("CAS",17,77,17,true);
    atomic("SWP",18,25,25,false);
    atomic("LDADD",18,7,25,false);
    atomic("LDCLR",255,0x55,0xaa,false);
    atomic("LDSET",16,0x81,0x91,false);
    atomic("LDEOR",48,0x14,0x24,false);
    {
        std::cerr << "RUN RETAA" << std::endl;
        Env env; Dynarmic::A64::UserConfig cfg{};cfg.callbacks=&env;cfg.global_monitor=&env.monitor;
        Dynarmic::A64::Jit jit{cfg};
        env.code_mem={0xD65F0BFF,0x14000000};
        jit.SetRegister(30,4);jit.SetPC(0);jit.Step();
        check(jit.GetPC()==4,"RETAA return");
    }
    {
        std::cerr << "RUN LDAPR" << std::endl;
        Env env;Dynarmic::A64::UserConfig cfg{};cfg.callbacks=&env;cfg.global_monitor=&env.monitor;
        Dynarmic::A64::Jit jit{cfg};
        env.code_mem={encode("LDAPR",{{'s',3},{'n',1},{'t',3}}),0x14000000};
        env.MemoryWrite64(0x200,0x12345678);
        jit.SetRegister(1,0x200);jit.SetPC(0);jit.Step();
        check(jit.GetRegister(3)==0x12345678,"LDAPR acquire");
    }

    // Six independent guest processors, shared reservation granule, concurrent
    // retry. Validate exclusive monitor capacity and cross-core invalidation.
    {
        Dynarmic::ExclusiveMonitor shared{6};
        check(shared.GetProcessorCount()==6,"six exclusive monitor slots");
        std::atomic<std::uint64_t> counter{0};
        std::atomic<bool> timed_out{false};
        std::vector<std::thread> workers;
        for (unsigned core=0;core<6;++core) {
            workers.emplace_back([&,core] {
                for (unsigned n=0;n<64;++n) {
                    bool success=false;
                    for (unsigned retries=0;retries<100000 && !success;++retries) {
                        const auto observed=shared.ReadAndMark<std::uint64_t>(
                            core,0x1000,[&] {return counter.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);});
                        success=shared.DoExclusiveOperation<std::uint64_t>(
                            core,0x1000,[&](std::uint64_t expected) {
                                return counter.compare_exchange_strong(
                                    expected,observed+1,std::memory_order_relaxed);
                            });
                    }
                    if(!success){timed_out.store(true);return;}
                }
            });
        }
        for (auto& worker:workers)worker.join();
        check(!timed_out.load(),"six-core contention terminated");
        check(counter.load()==384,"six-core exclusive operation counted exactly");
    }
    std::cout<<"Actual Dynarmic NS2 LSE/RETA/LDAPR JIT PASS\n";
}
```

`tools/ns2/jit-host/test_public_nso_jit.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// N3r: execute independently published AArch64 HOS SVC code from a real NSO0
// in the same maintained Dynarmic JIT already used by Encore's NS2 tests.
//
// The host test stages NSO text/rodata/data and zero-filled BSS, using a
// deterministic six-SVC *test dispatcher*, not Encore's
// production HLE, NPDM process creation, application loader or PS5 hardware.
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>
#include <fstream>
#include <iostream>
#include <iterator>
#include <span>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "dynarmic/tests/A64/testenv.h"
#include "dynarmic/interface/A64/a64.h"
#include "dynarmic/interface/exclusive_monitor.h"
#include "core/loader/ns2_nso_preflight.h"

// Dynarmic's x64 BlockOfCode prelude commits 16 MiB before guest code
// generation. A 16-MiB total cache is insufficient for these host regressions.
// Keep ample headroom without modifying PS5's separately tuned sparse JIT.
static constexpr std::size_t HostJitCodeCacheBytes = 64ULL * 1024 * 1024;
static_assert(HostJitCodeCacheBytes > 16ULL * 1024 * 1024);

using Eden::NS2::ExeFS::NsoHeaderBytes;
using Eden::NS2::ExeFS::NsoWord;
using Eden::NS2::ExeFS::PreflightNso;

static void Require(bool condition, const char* message) {
    if (!condition) throw std::runtime_error(message);
}
struct SvcHost final : A64TestEnv {
    Dynarmic::ExclusiveMonitor monitor{6};
    std::uint32_t pending_svc{};
    unsigned callbacks{};
    void CallSVC(std::uint32_t swi) override {
        pending_svc = swi;
        ++callbacks;
    }
    void ExceptionRaised(u64, Dynarmic::A64::Exception) override {
        throw std::runtime_error("guest AArch64 exception in HOS hello");
    }
};
static std::vector<std::uint8_t> ReadFile(const char* path) {
    std::ifstream input(path, std::ios::binary);
    Require(bool(input), "missing independently built NSO0");
    return {std::istreambuf_iterator<char>{input},
            std::istreambuf_iterator<char>{}};
}
// Full uncompressed NSO0 image layout, independent host-only staging.
// Production ExeFS still uses the maintained AppLoader_NSO::LoadModule.
struct StagedNso {
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> bytes;
    std::array<std::size_t, 3> positions{};
    std::array<std::size_t, 3> sizes{};
};
static StagedNso StageNso(std::span<const std::uint8_t> file) {
    Require(file.size() >= NsoHeaderBytes, "truncated NSO0 fixture");
    const auto header = file.first(NsoHeaderBytes);
    const auto result = PreflightNso(header, file.size());
    Require(result.Ready() && result.image_bytes <= 0x100000 && result.image_bytes != 0,
            "NSO0 fixture failed bounded header validation");
    Require((NsoWord(header, 0x0c) & 7U) == 0,
            "compressed NSO0 segments require actual decompression");
    StagedNso staged;
    staged.bytes.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(result.image_bytes), 0);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
        const auto offset = static_cast<std::size_t>(NsoWord(header, 0x10 + 16 * i));
        const auto location = static_cast<std::size_t>(NsoWord(header, 0x14 + 16 * i));
        const auto length = static_cast<std::size_t>(NsoWord(header, 0x18 + 16 * i));
        const auto stored = static_cast<std::size_t>(NsoWord(header, 0x60 + 4 * i));
        Require(stored == length && offset <= file.size() &&
                    length <= file.size() - offset &&
                    location <= staged.bytes.size() &&
                    length <= staged.bytes.size() - location,
                "NSO0 uncompressed segment did not fit its image");
        if (length)
            std::memcpy(staged.bytes.data() + location, file.data() + offset, length);
        staged.positions[i] = location;
        staged.sizes[i] = length;
    }
    const auto& p = staged.positions;
    const auto& s = staged.sizes;
    Require(p[0] == 0 && s[0] >= 64 && s[0] <= 0x10000,
            "invalid NSO0 text segment");
    constexpr char rodata[] = "open-source-loader-test";
    constexpr char data[] = "NS2-DATA-SEGMENT";
    Require(s[1] == sizeof(rodata) &&
                std::memcmp(staged.bytes.data() + p[1], rodata, sizeof(rodata)) == 0,
            "NSO0 rodata virtual mapping mismatch");
    Require(s[2] == sizeof(data) - 1 &&
                std::memcmp(staged.bytes.data() + p[2], data, sizeof(data) - 1) == 0,
            "NSO0 data virtual mapping mismatch");
    const auto zero = [&](std::size_t first, std::size_t last) {
        return std::all_of(staged.bytes.begin() + first, staged.bytes.begin() + last,
                           [](std::uint8_t b) { return b == 0; });
    };
    Require(zero(p[0] + s[0], p[1]) && zero(p[1] + s[1], p[2]) &&
                zero(p[2] + s[2], staged.bytes.size()),
            "NSO0 virtual gaps or BSS not initialized to zero");
    return staged;
}
int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    try {
        Require(argc == 2, "usage: ns2_public_nso_jit_test hello.nso");
        const auto image = ReadFile(argv[1]);
        const auto staged = StageNso(image);
        const std::size_t text_bytes = staged.sizes[0];
        constexpr std::uint64_t guest_base = 0x08000000;
        SvcHost env;
        env.code_mem_start_address = guest_base;
        env.code_mem.resize((staged.bytes.size() + 3) / 4, 0);
        std::memcpy(env.code_mem.data(), staged.bytes.data(), staged.bytes.size());
        Dynarmic::A64::UserConfig cfg{};
        cfg.callbacks = &env;
        cfg.global_monitor = &env.monitor;
        cfg.code_cache_size = HostJitCodeCacheBytes;
        Dynarmic::A64::Jit cpu{cfg};
        cpu.SetPC(guest_base);
        cpu.SetSP(0x90000000);
        std::vector<std::uint32_t> calls;
        std::string output;
        unsigned notified_breaks = 0;
        unsigned timer_reads = 0;
        bool exited = false;
        for (unsigned instruction = 0; instruction < 128 && !exited; ++instruction) {
            Require(cpu.GetPC() >= guest_base &&
                        cpu.GetPC() - guest_base < text_bytes &&
                        (cpu.GetPC() - guest_base) % 4 == 0,
                    "guest attempted instruction execution outside NSO0 text");
            const unsigned prior = env.callbacks;
            env.ticks_left = 1;
            cpu.Step(); // Real maintained x86-64 Dynarmic A64 JIT, one guest instruction
            Require(env.callbacks == prior || env.callbacks == prior + 1,
                    "unexpected number of HOS SVC callbacks per step");
            if (env.callbacks == prior) continue;
            const auto svc = env.pending_svc;
            calls.push_back(svc);
            switch (svc) {
            case 0x27: { // svcOutputDebugString (HOS test stub)
                const auto address = cpu.GetRegister(0);
                const auto count = cpu.GetRegister(1);
                Require(count == 15 && address >= guest_base &&
                        address <= guest_base + text_bytes &&
                        count <= text_bytes - (address - guest_base),
                        "AArch64 guest debug string outside loaded NSO0 text");
                output.reserve(count);
                for (std::uint64_t i = 0; i < count; ++i)
                    output.push_back(static_cast<char>(env.MemoryRead8(address + i)));
                Require(output == "hello from HOS\n", "guest ADR or text read incorrect");
                break;
            }
            case 0x0B: // svcSleepThread: check request, do not really sleep
                Require(cpu.GetRegister(0) == 1'000'000,
                        "guest A64 64-bit sleep argument mismatch");
                break;
            case 0x1E: // svcGetSystemTick: deterministic monotonic stub
                cpu.SetRegister(0, 0x12340000 + ++timer_reads * 1'000);
                break;
            case 0x26: // svcBreak notification only (not panic)
                Require((cpu.GetRegister(0) & 0x80000000ULL) != 0 &&
                        (cpu.GetRegister(0) & 0xffffULL) == 2,
                        "guest attempted panic: system tick did not advance");
                ++notified_breaks;
                break;
            case 0x07: // svcExitProcess
                exited = true;
                break;
            default:
                throw std::runtime_error("unexpected HOS service call in real homebrew");
            }
        }
        const std::vector<std::uint32_t> expected{0x27, 0x0B, 0x1E, 0x26, 0x1E, 0x07};
        Require(exited && calls == expected && timer_reads == 2 && notified_breaks == 1,
                "real guest did not complete the expected HOS execution flow");
        std::cout << "NS2 A64 real NSO0 text -> maintained Dynarmic JIT -> HOS SVC"
                  << " callbacks: PASS (" << calls.size() << " calls, three NSO segments + BSS, no panic)\n"
                  << "No production AppLoader/NPDM/HLE or native PS5 execution tested.\n";
        return 0;
    } catch (const std::exception& error) {
        std::cerr << "NS2 real NSO0 CPU JIT: FAILED: " << error.what() << '\n';
        return 1;
    }
}
```

`tools/ns2/native_astc_vendor_parity.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Strict N57 vendor Vulkan parity: reconstruct the precise original F07 owners.

The N57 additions exist only in versioned vendor C++ plus the one small
ASTC assemble include. No executable code generator or replacement TU is used.
"""

import subprocess

ASTC = Path("vendor/encore-active/ns2-astc/include/video_core/renderer_vulkan")

def git_blob(data: bytes) -> str:
    import hashlib
    return hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(data)).encode() + b"\0" + data).hexdigest()

def once(text: str, old: str, new: str) -> str:
    assert text.count(old) == 1, ("N57 vendor source drift", old[:90])
    return text.replace(old, new)


# P2.2 exact additions are removed only for the frozen N57/N73 SHA witness.
# Every byte of these additions is matched before stripping, and runtime
# ownership semantics are separately verified by the P2.2 host guard.
# P2.2b: reverse ONLY exact native cache-pin additions for N57's frozen
# historical SHA. The PS5 runtime still uses the pinned Vulkan owners.
def strip_p22_native_gpu_pins(text: str) -> str:
    text = once(text, "\n    Image(Image&&) = default;\n    Image& operator=(Image&&) = default;\n#ifdef PS5_NATIVE\n    // A reference is held by the REAL GPU descriptor owner until its fence.\n    // The runtime's retirement queue cannot destroy this Vulkan resource\n    // while a native QMD dispatch still pins it.\n    [[nodiscard]] std::shared_ptr<u8> PinNativeGpu() {\n        if (!native_gpu_pin) native_gpu_pin = std::make_shared<u8>(0);\n        return native_gpu_pin;\n    }\n    [[nodiscard]] bool CanRetireNativeGpu() const noexcept {\n        return !native_gpu_pin || native_gpu_pin.use_count() == 1;\n    }\n#endif\n\n\n    void UploadMemory(VkBuffer buffer, VkDeviceSize offset,\n                      std::span<const VideoCommon::BufferImageCopy> copies);\n",

    text = once(text, "\n    bool NeedsScaleHelper() const;\n\n#ifdef PS5_NATIVE\n    std::shared_ptr<u8> native_gpu_pin;\n#endif\n    Scheduler* scheduler{};\n    TextureCacheRuntime* runtime{};\n\n",
                "\n    bool NeedsScaleHelper() const;\n\n    Scheduler* scheduler{};\n    TextureCacheRuntime* runtime{};\n\n")
    text = once(text, "\n    ImageView(ImageView&&) = default;\n    ImageView& operator=(ImageView&&) = default;\n#ifdef PS5_NATIVE\n    // A reference is held by the REAL GPU descriptor owner until its fence.\n    // The runtime's retirement queue cannot destroy this Vulkan resource\n    // while a native QMD dispatch still pins it.\n    [[nodiscard]] std::shared_ptr<u8> PinNativeGpu() {\n        if (!native_gpu_pin) native_gpu_pin = std::make_shared<u8>(0);\n        return native_gpu_pin;\n    }\n    [[nodiscard]] bool CanRetireNativeGpu() const noexcept {\n        return !native_gpu_pin || native_gpu_pin.use_count() == 1;\n    }\n#endif\n\n\n    [[nodiscard]] VkImageView DepthView();\n\n",
```
