```py
def strip_p22_runtime_header(text: str) -> str:
    text = once(text, "#include <span>\n#ifdef PS5_NATIVE\n#include <memory>\n#include <vector>\n#endif\n", "#include <span>\n")
    text = once(text, "    void Finish();\n#ifdef PS5_NATIVE\n    ~TextureCacheRuntime();\n    // Retire shared Vulkan cache ownership only after actual GPU completion.\n    // Image views must retire before their backing images.\n    void RetireGpuImage(Image&& image);\n    void RetireGpuImageView(ImageView&& view);\n#endif\n", "    void Finish();\n")
    text = once(text, "    std::vector<std::pair<u64, ResolveShadow>> pending_resolve_shadows;\n#ifdef PS5_NATIVE\n    template <typename T>\n    struct GpuRetireEntry {\n        u64 tick;\n        u64 frame;\n        std::unique_ptr<T> resource;\n    };\n    // Preserve the old eight-frame framebuffer/view ordering in addition\n    // to waiting for the actual GPU timeline; neither condition alone suffices.\n    u64 gpu_retire_frame{};\n    std::vector<GpuRetireEntry<ImageView>> pending_retired_views;\n    std::vector<GpuRetireEntry<Image>> pending_retired_images;\n#endif\n", "    std::vector<std::pair<u64, ResolveShadow>> pending_resolve_shadows;\n")
    return text

def strip_p22_runtime_cpp(text: str) -> str:
    # N57's historical source predates both P2.2's timeline retirement and
    # P2.2b's additional native descriptor pin. Revert the small pin guard
    # first, then strip the already-audited P2.2 retirement block below.
    text = once(text, "    const auto ready = [this, is_free](const auto& pending) {\n        const bool gpu_completed = is_free(pending.tick) &&\n            gpu_retire_frame - pending.frame >= MIN_TEXTURE_RETIRE_FRAMES;\n#ifdef PS5_NATIVE\n        // A guest remap/eviction can race a freshly acquired native image\n        // before that dispatch flushes its timeline. Do not destroy the REAL\n        // VkImage or VkImageView until its final fence-held pin is released.\n        return gpu_completed && pending.resource->CanRetireNativeGpu();\n#else\n        return gpu_completed;\n#endif\n    };",
                "    const auto ready = [this, is_free](const auto& pending) {\n        return is_free(pending.tick) &&\n               gpu_retire_frame - pending.frame >= MIN_TEXTURE_RETIRE_FRAMES;\n    };")
    text = once(text, "\n#ifdef PS5_NATIVE\nTextureCacheRuntime::~TextureCacheRuntime() {\n    // Never destroy Vulkan image/view owners with outstanding GPU commands.\n    // Teardown is the only blocking case; frame reclamation remains async.\n    if (!pending_retired_views.empty() || !pending_retired_images.empty()) {\n        scheduler.Finish();\n        pending_retired_views.clear();\n        pending_retired_images.clear();\n    }\n}\n\nvoid TextureCacheRuntime::RetireGpuImage(Image&& image) {\n    const u64 tick = scheduler.CurrentTick();\n    try {\n        // Reserve BEFORE moving the Vulkan owner: a failed vector growth\n        // must never destroy the temporary image before the GPU drain below.\n        // Geometric growth avoids O(n^2) reallocations under texture churn.\n        if (pending_retired_images.size() == pending_retired_images.capacity()) {\n            const auto capacity = pending_retired_images.capacity();\n            const auto max_size = pending_retired_images.max_size();\n            if (capacity == max_size) throw std::bad_alloc{};\n            pending_retired_images.reserve(\n                capacity + std::min(std::max<std::size_t>(capacity, 8), max_size - capacity));\n        }\n        pending_retired_images.push_back({tick, gpu_retire_frame, std::make_unique<Image>(std::move(image))});\n    } catch (...) {\n        // If queue allocation fails, wait before any moved owner can die.\n        scheduler.Finish();\n        throw;\n    }\n}\n\nvoid TextureCacheRuntime::RetireGpuImageView(ImageView&& view) {\n    const u64 tick = scheduler.CurrentTick();\n    try {\n        // Retain the original view until all throwing container allocation\n        // has completed, then move it into a preallocated retirement slot.\n        // Geometric growth avoids O(n^2) reallocations under texture churn.\n        if (pending_retired_views.size() == pending_retired_views.capacity()) {\n            const auto capacity = pending_retired_views.capacity();\n            const auto max_size = pending_retired_views.max_size();\n            if (capacity == max_size) throw std::bad_alloc{};\n            pending_retired_views.reserve(\n                capacity + std::min(std::max<std::size_t>(capacity, 8), max_size - capacity));\n        }\n        pending_retired_views.push_back({tick, gpu_retire_frame, std::make_unique<ImageView>(std::move(view))});\n    } catch (...) {\n        scheduler.Finish();\n        throw;\n    }\n}\n#endif\n\n", "\n")
    text = once(text, "void TextureCacheRuntime::TickFrame() {\n    static constexpr u32 MAX_UNUSED_SCRATCH_FRAMES = 60;\n#ifdef PS5_NATIVE\n    ++gpu_retire_frame;\n#endif", "void TextureCacheRuntime::TickFrame() {\n    static constexpr u32 MAX_UNUSED_SCRATCH_FRAMES = 60;")
    text = once(text, "if (msaa_scratch_images.empty() && pending_resolve_shadows.empty() &&\n        pending_retired_views.empty() && pending_retired_images.empty()) {", "if (msaa_scratch_images.empty() && pending_resolve_shadows.empty()) {")
    text = once(text, "if (pending_resolve_shadows.empty() && pending_retired_views.empty() &&\n        pending_retired_images.empty() &&\n        std::all_of(msaa_scratch_images.begin(), msaa_scratch_images.end(),", "if (pending_resolve_shadows.empty() &&\n        std::all_of(msaa_scratch_images.begin(), msaa_scratch_images.end(),")
    text = once(text, "\n#ifdef PS5_NATIVE\n    // Erase image views before images: both own real Vulkan resources.\n    // Frame age alone never proves completion of an outstanding GPU tick.\n    // Keep the prior eight-frame framebuffer retirement ordering: the\n    // sentenced framebuffer ring is ticked immediately before this runtime.\n    static constexpr u64 MIN_TEXTURE_RETIRE_FRAMES = 8;\n    const auto ready = [this, is_free](const auto& pending) {\n        return is_free(pending.tick) &&\n               gpu_retire_frame - pending.frame >= MIN_TEXTURE_RETIRE_FRAMES;\n    };\n    std::erase_if(pending_retired_views, ready);\n    std::erase_if(pending_retired_images, ready);\n#endif", "")
    return text


def strip_p25_reinterpret(text: str) -> str:
    """Undo exactly the post-N57 P2.5 Vulkan reinterpret patches for SHA audit.

    These are *normalization only*. The PS5 generator and shipped Vulkan
    source still retain aspect, exact byte width, scratch and layout safety.
    Every removed block is pinned before normalization; no source is changed.
    """
    def remove_hashed(begin: str, end: str, digest: str) -> None:
        nonlocal text
        assert text.count(begin)==1, ('P2.5 Vulkan anchor drift',begin)
        start=text.index(begin)
        stop=text.index(end,start)
        assert stop>start, ('P2.5 Vulkan closing anchor missing',begin)
        block=text[start:stop]
        assert hashlib.sha256(block.encode()).hexdigest()==digest, (
            'P2.5 checked Vulkan source bytes differ',begin)
        text=text[:start]+text[stop:]

    remove_hashed(
        '    // VkBufferImageCopy names a SINGLE depth/stencil aspect.',
        '\n#ifdef PS5_NATIVE\n',
        '728654987e7ccf00cc50cf2c7fd565104534c8a4b4fcc3d3727521a3bdc922dc'
    )
    text=once(text,
        '        if ((static_cast<u64>(bpp_out) * static_cast<u64>(copy.src_offset.x)) % bpp_in ||\n'
        '            (static_cast<u64>(bpp_out) * copy.extent.width) % bpp_in ||\n'
        '            scaled_offset > static_cast<u64>(\n',
        '        if (scaled_offset > static_cast<u64>(\n')
    text=once(text,
        '[src_copy_aspect, bpp_in, bpp_out](const auto& copy) {',
        '[src_aspect_mask, bpp_in, bpp_out](const auto& copy) {')
    text=once(text,'MakeBufferImageCopy(copy2, true, src_copy_aspect);',
                  'MakeBufferImageCopy(copy2, true, src_aspect_mask);')
    text=once(text,
        'std::ranges::transform(copies, vk_out_copies.begin(), [dst_copy_aspect](const auto& copy) {',
        'std::ranges::transform(copies, vk_out_copies.begin(), [dst_aspect_mask](const auto& copy) {')
    text=once(text,'MakeBufferImageCopy(copy, false, dst_copy_aspect);',
                  'MakeBufferImageCopy(copy, false, dst_aspect_mask);')
    remove_hashed(
        '#ifdef PS5_NATIVE\n    // Every VkBufferImageCopy must occupy a disjoint aligned scratch',
        '    const VkBuffer copy_buffer = GetTemporaryBuffer(total_size);',
        'e3c5ace8b00c6b92103a72ee2c400f4b47f897354919b635090c6068202035b0'
    )
    text=once(text,
        '        // The preceding middle_out_barrier transitions dst to\n'
        '        // TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL. The Vulkan command MUST name that actual\n'
        '        // layout (VUID-vkCmdCopyBufferToImage-dstImageLayout-00180).\n'
        '        cmdbuf.CopyBufferToImage(copy_buffer, dst_image,\n'
        '                                 VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, vk_out_copies);',
        '        cmdbuf.CopyBufferToImage(copy_buffer, dst_image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, vk_out_copies);')
    return text

def strip_post_n73_msaa_attachment_header(text: str) -> str:
    """Reverse only the newer exact native MSAA guest-attachment identity API.

    This source was extended after N57/N73 to allow strict full-colour clear
    admission in the single common Vulkan rasterizer. Match its ENTIRE
    reviewed raw blob before removing any bytes; old N57/N73 SHAs remain
    immutable and still must match after their own independent reversal.
    """
    assert git_blob(text.encode()) == "0ac78498630e8d2f4b8c363741ae1f8180cd5b11", (
        "Unreviewed post-N73 ASTC framebuffer header drift")
    text = once(text, (
        "    // The maintained Vulkan framebuffer owner records exact guest attachment\n"
        "    // handles during CreateFramebuffer. Expose the same bounded, immutable\n"
        "    // attachment identity here even when the NS2 ASTC overlay is selected.\n"
        "    [[nodiscard]] VkImage ColorAttachmentImage(u32 rt) const noexcept {\n"
        "        return rt < NUM_RT ? color_attachment_images[rt] : VK_NULL_HANDLE;\n"
        "    }\n"
        "    [[nodiscard]] VkImageView ColorAttachmentView(u32 rt) const noexcept {\n"
        "        return rt < NUM_RT ? color_attachment_views[rt] : VK_NULL_HANDLE;\n"
        "    }\n"
        "    [[nodiscard]] VkImageSubresourceRange ColorAttachmentRange(u32 rt) const noexcept {\n"
        "        return rt < NUM_RT ? color_attachment_ranges[rt] : VkImageSubresourceRange{};\n"
        "    }\n\n"
    ), "")
    text = once(text, (
        "    std::array<VkImage, NUM_RT> color_attachment_images{};\n"
        "    std::array<VkImageView, NUM_RT> color_attachment_views{};\n"
        "    std::array<VkImageSubresourceRange, NUM_RT> color_attachment_ranges{};\n"
    ), "")
    return text


def strip_post_n73_msaa_framebuffer_source(text: str) -> str:
    """Undo only post-N73 guest colour identity captures from the real TU.

    The native Framebuffer owner must still record each attachment, but its
    historical N57/N73 normalization must not silently absorb these additions.
    """
    text = once(text, (
        "    color_attachment_images.fill(VK_NULL_HANDLE);\n"
        "    color_attachment_views.fill(VK_NULL_HANDLE);\n"
        "    color_attachment_ranges.fill(VkImageSubresourceRange{});\n"
    ), "")
    text = once(text, (
        "        color_attachment_images[index] = color_buffer->ImageHandle();\n"
        "        color_attachment_views[index] = color_buffer->RenderTarget();\n"
        "        color_attachment_ranges[index] = MakeSubresourceRange(color_buffer);\n"
    ), "")
    return text


def normalized(root: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
    for name, expected in AUXILIARY.items():
        path = root / ASTC / name
        if name == "vk_texture_cache.h":
            n73 = strip_post_n73_msaa_attachment_header(path.read_text())
            n73 = strip_p22_native_gpu_pins(n73)
            n73 = strip_p22_runtime_header(n73)
            before = "    void Finish();\n"
            extension = (
                "#ifdef EDEN_NS2_SPARSE_CACHE_PROBE\n"
                "    // N73: native cache-side Vulkan sparse admission/bind/retire probe.\n"
                "    // Never replaces the dense guest texture or samples an unbound image.\n"
                "    [[nodiscard]] bool ProbeSparseImage(const VideoCommon::ImageInfo& info);\n"
                "#endif\n"
            )
            assert n73.count(before + extension) == 1, "N73 ASTC header drift"
            stripped = n73.replace(before + extension, before)
            assert stripped.count(before + "\n\n") == 1, "N73 header whitespace drift"
            stripped = stripped.replace(before + "\n\n", before + "\n", 1)
            assert git_blob(stripped.encode()) == expected, ("N73 auxiliary drift", name)
            continue
        assert git_blob(path.read_bytes()) == expected, ("N57 auxiliary source drift", name)

    extra = (root / ASTC / "ns2_astc_assemble_layers.inc").read_text()
    for signature in ("void ASTCDecoderPass::AssembleLayers(", "PreflightAstcLayerDecode(",
                      "image.StorageImageLayerView(", "cmdbuf.Dispatch(dx, dy, 1)",
                      "scheduler.Flush();"):
        assert signature in extra, ("N57 layer decode contract", signature)
    assert "image.host_level_offset" not in extra

    result = {}
    for name, (current_sha, previous_sha) in BASELINE.items():
        text = (root / OWNER / name).read_text()
        if name == "vk_texture_cache_cost.cpp":
            text = strip_post_n73_msaa_framebuffer_source(text)
            text = strip_p25_reinterpret(strip_p22_runtime_cpp(text))
        if name == "vk_texture_cache_cost.cpp":
            # N73 is an additive native runtime probe. Strip its exact source
            # changes before applying N57's original hardcoded SHA oracle.
            n73_include = (
                "#include \"video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_texture_cache.h\"\n"
                "#ifdef EDEN_NS2_SPARSE_CACHE_PROBE\n"
                "#include <atomic>\n"
                "#include \"video_core/renderer_vulkan/ns2_sparse_cache_admission.h\"\n"
                "#include \"video_core/renderer_vulkan/ns2_sparse_bind_transaction.h\"\n"
                "#endif"
            )
            assert text.count(n73_include) == 1, "N73 source include drift"
            text = text.replace(n73_include,
                '#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_texture_cache.h"')
            begin = "// NS2 N73 BEGIN: one real cache-side VkImage sparse admission/bind/retire probe."
            end = "// NS2 N73 END\n\n"
            assert text.count(begin) == text.count(end) == 1, "N73 source body drift"
            i,j=text.index(begin),text.index(end)
            code=text[i:j + len(end)]
            for witness in ("memory_allocator.CreateSparseImage(image_ci)",
                            "AdmitSparseCacheImage(", "owner.Bind(",
                            "RetireSparseCacheProbe(", "logical.CreateImageView(view_info)",
                            "gpu_unsafe.load(std::memory_order_acquire)",
                            "owner.ReadyForSampling()"):
                assert witness in code, ("N73 changed native VkImage ownership", witness)
            text = text[:i] + text[j + len(end):]
        assert git_blob(text.encode()) == current_sha, ("N57 maintained source drift", name)
        if name == "vk_texture_cache_cost.cpp":
            # N49's single vendor-owner addition, reversed without masking F07.
            text = once(text,
                '#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_texture_cache.h"\n'
                '#ifdef EDEN_NS2_VIEW_DIMENSION_GUARD\n'
                '#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/ns2_view_type_guard.h"\n#endif',
                '#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_texture_cache.h"')
            start = '#ifdef EDEN_NS2_VIEW_DIMENSION_GUARD\n    // Keep physical 2D/3D dimensionality'
            end = '#endif\n    if (texture_type) {'
            assert text.count(start) == text.count(end) == 1, "N49 guard differs"
            i = text.index(start)
            j = text.index(end, i)
            text = text[:i] + '    if (texture_type) {' + text[j + len(end):]
            assert git_blob(text.encode()) == "46be65804131d8ffcc4951fc70d2cc6a449c2e85", "N49 touched unrelated PS5 GPU source"
            text = once(text, '#include "performance.h"\n#ifdef EDEN_NS2_ASTC_LAYER_DECODE\n#include <stdexcept>\n#endif',
                        '#include "performance.h"')
            text = once(text,
                "                                            VkFormat format, u32 base_layer = 0,\n"
                "                                            u32 layer_count = VK_REMAINING_ARRAY_LAYERS) {",
                "                                            VkFormat format) {")
            text = once(text,
                "            .baseArrayLayer = base_layer,\n            .layerCount = layer_count,",
                "            .baseArrayLayer = 0,\n            .layerCount = VK_REMAINING_ARRAY_LAYERS,")
            begin = "#ifdef EDEN_NS2_ASTC_LAYER_DECODE\nVkImageView Image::StorageImageLayerView("
            end = "#endif\n\nbool Image::IsRescaled() const noexcept {"
            assert text.count(begin) == text.count(end) == 1
            i, j = text.index(begin), text.index(end)
            text = text[:i] + "bool Image::IsRescaled() const noexcept {" + text[j + len(end):]
            begin = "#ifdef EDEN_NS2_ASTC_LAYER_DECODE\nvoid TextureCacheRuntime::AccelerateImageUploadLayers("
            end = "#endif\n\nvoid TextureCacheRuntime::TransitionImageLayout(Image& image) {"
            assert text.count(begin) == text.count(end) == 1
            i, j = text.index(begin), text.index(end)
            text = text[:i] + "void TextureCacheRuntime::TransitionImageLayout(Image& image) {" + text[j + len(end):]
        else:
            text = once(text,
                '#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_compute_pass.h"\n'
                '#ifdef EDEN_NS2_ASTC_LAYER_DECODE\n#include <stdexcept>\n'
                '#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/ns2_astc_decode_preflight.h"\n#endif',
                '#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_compute_pass.h"')
            text = once(text,
                '#ifdef EDEN_NS2_ASTC_LAYER_DECODE\n'
                '#include "video_core/renderer_vulkan/ns2_astc_assemble_layers.inc"\n'
                '#endif\nconstexpr u32 BL3D_BINDING_INPUT_BUFFER  = 0;',
                'constexpr u32 BL3D_BINDING_INPUT_BUFFER  = 0;')
        assert git_blob(text.encode()) == previous_sha, ("N57 changed unrelated F07 native bytes", name)
        result[name] = text
    return result
```

`tools/ns2/native_gpu_preinvalidate_review.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""P1.2/N51: reverse only the audited pre-invalidation GPU memory diff.

A cache unmap must retire the previous backing before any PTE replacement.
The reviewed 4K/big-page source diff restores the exact predecessor blob;
changing both the code and this witness still requires predecessor parity.
"""
import hashlib
import runpy
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
PATCH = ROOT / "tools/ns2/p1_2_gpu_preinvalidate.patch"
PREVIOUS_SHA = "b43eae6863527b47b98892f5bfa68b7f685c0b28"
PATCH_SHA = "f778404d0de2bb98e1f68428113b4c4bffe1eafe"
SOURCE = Path("encore-active/eden-core/src/video_core/memory_manager.cpp")

def blob(content: str) -> str:
    data = content.encode()
    return hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(data)).encode() + b"\0" + data).hexdigest()

def recover_prior_memory_manager(actual: str) -> str:
    if "gpu_page_table_revision" in actual:
        # Peel back only the pinned, independently reviewed performance
        # extension; the original 4K/big-page predecessor hash still MUST
        # match byte-for-byte under the existing reverse-patch chain.
        recover = runpy.run_path(
            str(ROOT / "tools/ns2/native_gpu_range_cache_review.py")
        )["recover_before_contiguous_cache"]
        actual = recover(actual)
    assert blob(PATCH.read_text()) == PATCH_SHA, "unreviewed GPU pre-invalidation patch"
    assert actual.count("All old mappings have been evicted") == 1
    assert actual.count("Commit big-page backing only after the old cache owner") == 1
    assert actual.count("NeedsRasterizerUnmap(") == 2
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-preinvalidate-replay-") as tmp:
        target = Path(tmp) / SOURCE
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        target.write_text(actual)
        result = subprocess.run(["git", "apply", "--reverse", str(PATCH)],
            cwd=tmp, capture_output=True, text=True)
        assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr
        previous = target.read_text()
    assert blob(previous) == PREVIOUS_SHA, "P1.2 predecessor bytes not recovered"
    return previous
```

```py
"""Exact reverse replay of reviewed small/big-page GPU remap invalidations.

def recover_prior_memory_manager(actual: str) -> str:
    header = '#include "native_paged_scalar.h"\n'
    for new, old in (
        (header + '#include "native_gpu_page_remap.h"\n', header),
        (SMALL_NEW, SMALL_OLD),
        (BIG_NEW, BIG_OLD),
    ):
        assert actual.count(new) == 1, ("Unreviewed GPU remap owner mutation", new[:100])
        actual = actual.replace(new, old, 1)
    assert "native_gpu_page_remap" not in actual and "mapping_changed" not in actual
    return actual
```

`tools/ns2/native_gpu_range_cache_review.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Reverse ONLY the exact reviewed native GPU range-cache diff.

The previous N51/P1.2 reviewers must still recover the identical pre-cache
memory manager. No history is rewritten and no unrelated drift is ignored.
"""
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
PATCH = ROOT / "tools/ns2/p1_2_gpu_contiguous_range_cache.patch"
SOURCE = Path("encore-active/eden-core/src/video_core/memory_manager.cpp")
BEFORE = "b018babb791e0a72a042abeb56dc6f4587ba557b"
AFTER = "f36837c70435a919fd8d51b46983707c634039cc"

def blob(text: str) -> str:
    content = text.encode()
    return hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(content)).encode() + b"\0" + content).hexdigest()

def recover_before_contiguous_cache(actual: str) -> str:
    assert blob(actual) == AFTER, "unreviewed native GPU memory source drift"
    assert actual.count("gpu_page_table_revision.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_release)") == 4
    assert actual.count("thread_local std::array<Entry, 64> cache{};") == 1
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eden-gpu-range-reverse-") as tmp:
        target = Path(tmp) / SOURCE
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        target.write_text(actual)
        result = subprocess.run(["git", "apply", "--reverse", str(PATCH)],
                                cwd=tmp, text=True, capture_output=True)
        assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr
        original = target.read_text()
    assert blob(original) == BEFORE, "native GPU cache patch changed unrelated source"
    return original

```

`tools/ns2/native_vulkan_occlusion_review.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Reverse exactly the P2/P4 shared Vulkan occlusion query bank edit.

Historical Samples/TFB full-file hash witnesses remain pinned to their
reviewed predecessor. This helper strips ONLY the byte-exact active
CloseCounter delta generated by prepare-vulkan-port.py; it cannot hide
unrelated renderer source drift.
"""
import ast
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
GENERATOR = ROOT/"tools/prepare-vulkan-port.py"
OWNER = ROOT/"vendor/encore-active/eden-vulkan/vulkan_query_cache.cpp"
TAG = "P2/P4 bounded native occlusion query bank lifetime"

def strip_reviewed_close(source: str) -> str:
    tree = ast.parse(GENERATOR.read_text())
    matches = []
    for statement in tree.body:
        if not isinstance(statement, ast.Expr):
            continue
        call = statement.value
        if not isinstance(call, ast.Call) or not isinstance(call.func, ast.Name):
            continue
        if call.func.id != "apply_reviewed_delta" or len(call.args) != 4:
            continue
        try:
            name, old, new, label = map(ast.literal_eval, call.args)
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            continue
        if label == TAG:
            matches.append((name, old, new))
    assert len(matches) == 1, "occlusion generator source drift"
    name, old, new = matches[0]
    assert name == "vulkan_query_cache.cpp"
    assert "PauseCounter();" in old and "ResetCounter();" not in old
    assert new.count("ResetCounter();") == 1
    assert "SamplesQueryBank::BANK_SIZE" in new
    assert source.count(new) == 1, "occlusion source no longer matches generated delta"
    assert source.count(old) == 0, "old and new CloseCounter mixed"
    return source.replace(new, old)

```

`tools/ns2/prepare_firmware_dump.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Validate/optionally unpack a user's own NS2JB system-code dump.

This is NOT an NCA firmware installer and does not enable NS2 system services.
It never alters the working NS1 firmware, keys, ROMs or original input.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import re
import tempfile
import zipfile

TITLE_ID = re.compile(r"040[0-9a-fA-F]{13}\Z")
MAX_BYTES = 1024 * 1024 * 1024


def digest(value: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()


def inspect(archive: Path, output: Path | None = None) -> None:
    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as z:
        files: dict[str, zipfile.ZipInfo] = {}
        size = 0
        for member in z.infolist():
            name = member.filename
            if member.is_dir() or name.startswith("__MACOSX/") or name.endswith("/.DS_Store"):
                continue
            path = PurePosixPath(name)
            if path.is_absolute() or ".." in path.parts or not name.startswith("firmware/") or name in files:
                raise ValueError("Unsafe or duplicate archive member: " + name)
            if ((member.external_attr >> 16) & 0o170000) == 0o120000:
                raise ValueError("Symlinked archive member: " + name)
            if member.file_size > MAX_BYTES or size + member.file_size > MAX_BYTES:
                raise ValueError("Archive exceeds bounded decompression budget")
            size += member.file_size
            files[name] = member

        def read(name: str) -> bytes:
            if name not in files:
                raise ValueError("Missing archive member: " + name)
            return z.read(files[name])

        header = json.loads(read("firmware/.ns2jb-firmware-dump.json"))
        if header.get("kind") != "ns2jb-system-code-dump":
            raise ValueError("Not an NS2JB system-code dump")
        manifest = json.loads(read("firmware/firmware-dump-named.json"))
        entries = manifest.get("entries", [])
        if not isinstance(entries, list) or not 1 <= len(entries) <= 256:
            raise ValueError("Invalid system-program inventory length")
        if manifest.get("complete") is not True or manifest.get("counts", {}).get("captured") != len(entries):
            raise ValueError("Manifest capture is incomplete")
        inventory = manifest.get("inventory", {})
        if inventory.get("rawFile") != "ncm-system-programs.bin":
            raise ValueError("Unknown system-program inventory file")
        if digest(read("firmware/ncm-system-programs.bin")) != inventory.get("sha256"):
            raise ValueError("System-program inventory checksum mismatch")
        # NCM's `keys` are composite content-index records (ID/version/type/
        # installType), NOT AES, NCA, title decryption or prod.keys material.
        # Verify these records against the system-program list, do not export
        # or pass them to the emulator's cryptographic KeyManager.
        ncm_records = inventory.get("keys")
        if not isinstance(ncm_records, list) or len(ncm_records) != len(entries) or \
                inventory.get("total") != len(entries):
            raise ValueError("NCM inventory count/keys disagree with program entries")
        expected_index = set()
        for entry in entries:
            title = entry.get("title")
            version = entry.get("version")
            if not isinstance(title, str) or not TITLE_ID.fullmatch(title.removeprefix("0x")) or \
                    not isinstance(version, int) or isinstance(version, bool):
                raise ValueError("Invalid title/version in system-program records")
            if (title.lower(), version) in expected_index:
                raise ValueError("Duplicate title/version in system-program records")
            expected_index.add((title.lower(), version))
        actual_index = set()
        for record in ncm_records:
            if not isinstance(record, dict) or set(record) != {"id", "version", "type", "installType"}:
                raise ValueError("Expected NCM index record, not cryptographic key material")
            if not isinstance(record["id"], str) or not TITLE_ID.fullmatch(
                    record["id"].removeprefix("0x")):
                raise ValueError("Invalid NCM content identifier")
            if any(not isinstance(record[field], int) or isinstance(record[field], bool)
                   for field in ("version", "type", "installType")):
                raise ValueError("Invalid NCM content record attributes")
            key = (record["id"].lower(), record["version"])
            if key in actual_index:
                raise ValueError("Duplicate NCM content-index key")
            actual_index.add(key)
        if expected_index != actual_index:
            raise ValueError("NCM inventory keys do not match system-program title/version records")
        verified = {
            name: read(name) for name in (
                "firmware/.ns2jb-firmware-dump.json",
                "firmware/firmware-dump-named.json",
                "firmware/ncm-system-programs.bin",
            )
        }
        seen: set[str] = set()
        missing_main: list[str] = []
        for entry in entries:
            title = entry.get("title")
            if not isinstance(title, str) or not title.startswith("0x") or not TITLE_ID.fullmatch(title[2:]):
                raise ValueError("Unrecognized system-program title ID")
            folder = title[2:].lower()
            if folder in seen or entry.get("status") != "captured":
                raise ValueError("Duplicate or incomplete system-program record")
            seen.add(folder)
            for part in entry.get("files", []):
                relative = part.get("file", "").replace("\\", "/")
                if relative not in (folder + "/main", folder + "/main.npdm"):
                    raise ValueError("Unexpected program path: " + relative)
                name = "firmware/" + relative
                data = read(name)
                if len(data) != part.get("size") or digest(data) != part.get("sha256"):
                    raise ValueError("System-program checksum mismatch: " + folder)
                magic = b"NSO0" if relative.endswith("/main") else b"META"
                if not data.startswith(magic):
                    raise ValueError("Bad system-program signature: " + folder)
                verified[name] = data
            if "firmware/" + folder + "/main.npdm" not in verified:
                raise ValueError("Missing NPDM in dump: " + folder)
            if "firmware/" + folder + "/main" not in verified:
                if not any(x.get("name") == "main" for x in entry.get("absentFiles", [])):
                    raise ValueError("Unreported missing executable: " + folder)
                missing_main.append(folder)
            code = entry.get("codeInfo", {})
            path = code.get("file", "").replace("\\", "/")
            if path != folder + "/code-info.bin":
                raise ValueError("Unexpected code-info path")
            data = read("firmware/" + path)
            if digest(data) != code.get("sha256"):
                raise ValueError("Code-info checksum mismatch: " + folder)
            verified["firmware/" + path] = data

        if set(files) != set(verified):
            raise ValueError("Unknown member(s) in system-code archive")
        print(f"NS2_SYSTEM_CODE_DUMP_PASS captured={len(seen)} "
              f"complete_pairs={len(seen)-len(missing_main)} missing_main={len(missing_main)} "
              f"verified_files={len(verified)} ncm_index_keys={len(ncm_records)} "
              f"crypto_keys=0 firmware_nca=0 runtime_ready=NO")
        if missing_main:
            print("MISSING_MAIN_TITLE_IDS " + ", ".join(missing_main))
        if output is None:
            return
        if output.exists():
            raise FileExistsError("Refusing to replace existing output: " + str(output))
        output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=output.parent, prefix=".encore-ns2-dump-") as temp:
            stage = Path(temp) / "ns2-extracted"
            for name, data in verified.items():
                target = stage.joinpath(*PurePosixPath(name).parts[1:])
                target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                target.write_bytes(data)
            os.replace(stage, output)
        print(f"NS2_SYSTEM_CODE_DUMP_STAGED path={output} runtime_ready=NO")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("archive", type=Path, help="Your own firmware.zip system-code dump")
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, help="Create this new output directory, never overwrite")
    options = parser.parse_args()
    inspect(options.archive, options.output)

```

```py
def git(*args: str, cwd: Path = ROOT) -> str:
    proc = subprocess.run(["git", *args], cwd=cwd, text=True,
                          capture_output=True, timeout=30)
    if proc.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError(f"git {' '.join(args)}: {proc.stderr.strip()}")
    return proc.stdout.strip()

def checked_revisions() -> tuple[str, str]:
    main = git("rev-parse", "HEAD")
    vendor = git("rev-parse", "HEAD", cwd=ROOT/"vendor")
    pinned = git("ls-tree", "HEAD", "vendor").split()
    if len(pinned) < 3 or pinned[0] != "160000" or pinned[2] != vendor:
        raise RuntimeError("Vendor checkout does not match the main SHA gitlink")
    if git("status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=no") or git(
        "status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=no", cwd=ROOT/"vendor"):
        raise RuntimeError("Dirty tracked source; cannot claim same-SHA qualification")
    return main, vendor

def run_one(name: str, path: str, env: dict[str, str]) -> dict:
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    command = [sys.executable, "-B", path]
    try:
        proc = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, env=env, text=True,
                              capture_output=True, timeout=240)
        return {"name": name, "script": path, "passed": proc.returncode == 0,
                "returncode": proc.returncode, "seconds": round(time.perf_counter()-t0, 2),
                "stdout": proc.stdout[-12000:], "stderr": proc.stderr[-12000:]}
    except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as e:
        return {"name":name, "script":path, "passed":False, "returncode":None,
                "seconds":round(time.perf_counter()-t0,2),
                "stdout":"", "stderr":str(e)}

def main() -> int:
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--scope", choices=("core","smoke"), default="core")
    parser.add_argument("--jobs", type=int, choices=range(1,5), default=3,
                        metavar="{1,2,3,4}")
    parser.add_argument("--shard", default="0/1",
                        help="Zero-based shard/count, e.g. 1/4")
    args=parser.parse_args()
    try:
        shard_index, shard_count = map(int, args.shard.split("/", 1))
    except ValueError:
        parser.error("--shard requires INDEX/COUNT")
    if not 1 <= shard_count <= 8 or not 0 <= shard_index < shard_count:
        parser.error("--shard requires 0 <= INDEX < COUNT <= 8")
    all_names = tuple(TESTS) if args.scope=="core" else SMOKE
    names = tuple(name for index, name in enumerate(all_names)
                  if index % shard_count == shard_index)
    for name in names:
        if not (ROOT/TESTS[name]).is_file():
            raise RuntimeError("Missing pinned host witness: "+TESTS[name])
    main_sha, vendor_sha=checked_revisions()
    print(f"P4_HOST_BATCH_START main={main_sha} vendor={vendor_sha} "
          f"scope={args.scope} jobs={args.jobs} shard={shard_index}/{shard_count} "
          f"count={len(names)}",flush=True)
    env=os.environ.copy()
    env["PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE"]="1"
    # A newer CLT SDK can contain .tbd formats that the installed Apple
    # linker cannot parse. Pin only the HOST test subprocesses to a
    # compatible SDK; individual syntax-only witnesses may explicitly
    # select newer libc++ headers when they need C++20 jthread/stop_token.
    if sys.platform=="darwin":
        host_sdk=Path("/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX15.4.sdk")
        if host_sdk.is_dir():
            env["SDKROOT"]=str(host_sdk)
    started=datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    results=[]
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=args.jobs) as pool:
        futures={pool.submit(run_one,name,TESTS[name],env):name for name in names}
        for future in as_completed(futures):
            result=future.result()
            results.append(result)
            status="PASS" if result["passed"] else "FAIL"
            print(f"P4_HOST_BATCH_{status} {result['name']} "
                  f"{result['seconds']:.2f}s",flush=True)
            if not result["passed"]:
                print((result["stdout"]+"\n"+result["stderr"])[-2200:],flush=True)
    if checked_revisions()!=(main_sha,vendor_sha):
        raise RuntimeError("Source SHA drifted during host batch; results not qualified")
    results.sort(key=lambda r: names.index(r["name"]))
    output=ROOT/".build-local"/f"p4-host-batch-{main_sha[:8]}-s{shard_index}of{shard_count}.json"
    output.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    payload={"main_sha":main_sha,"vendor_sha":vendor_sha,
             "utc":started.isoformat(),"scope":args.scope,"jobs":args.jobs,
             "shard_index":shard_index,"shard_count":shard_count,
             "host_only":True,"ps5_build":False,"console_frame":False,
             "passed":sum(r["passed"] for r in results),
             "total":len(results),"results":results}
    output.write_text(json.dumps(payload,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+"\n")
    print(f"P4_HOST_BATCH_RESULT passed={payload['passed']}/{payload['total']} "
          f"receipt={output.relative_to(ROOT)}",flush=True)
    return 0 if payload["passed"]==payload["total"] else 1

if __name__=="__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
```

`tools/ns2/test_ampere_cache_invalidation.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Deterministic race regression: invalidation during a native shader translation.
#include <array>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>
#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/translation_cache.h"

namespace {
std::mutex gate_mutex;
std::condition_variable gate;
bool entered = false;
bool release = false;
void Check(bool cond, const char* why) {
    if (!cond) { std::fprintf(stderr, "NS2 cache race FAIL: %s\n", why); std::exit(1); }
}
}
namespace Shader::Ampere {
// Test link replaces real lowering only to make a Clear-vs-translation race deterministic.
MaxwellShaderImage BuildMaxwellShaderImage(
    std::span<const u8>, std::span<const u8>, u32,
    std::span<const NativeIndirectBranchPlan>, std::optional<u64>) {
    {
        std::unique_lock lock{gate_mutex};
        entered = true;
        gate.notify_all();
        gate.wait(lock, [] { return release; });
    }
    MaxwellShaderImage image;
    image.status = MaxwellImageStatus::Ready;
    image.code = {0x50,0x58};
    return image;
}
}
int main() {
    using namespace Shader::Ampere;
    NativeTranslationCache cache{1024*1024,2};
    std::array<u8,0x50> header{};
    std::array<u8,16> native{};
    MaxwellShaderImage stale;
    std::thread worker([&] { stale = cache.GetOrTranslate(header,native,3); });
    {
        std::unique_lock lock{gate_mutex};
        gate.wait(lock, [] { return entered; });
    }
    cache.Clear();
    {
        std::lock_guard lock{gate_mutex};
        release=true;
    }
    gate.notify_all();
    worker.join();
    const auto after=cache.Stats();
    Check(!stale.Ready() && after.entries==0 && after.bytes==0 &&
          after.invalidations==1 && after.invalidated_translations==1,
          "Clear must discard in-flight translation from prior generation");
    auto fresh=cache.GetOrTranslate(header,native,3);
    auto reused=cache.GetOrTranslate(header,native,3);
    const auto final=cache.Stats();
    Check(fresh.Ready() && reused.Ready() && final.entries==1 &&
          final.translations==2 && final.hits==1,
          "fresh generation can translate and reuse cache normally");
    std::puts("NS2 cache generation race: PASS");
}
```
