`tools/ns2/test_ampere_gpu_capture.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Synthetic mapped-memory fixture for the actual Ampere GPU shader capture.
// Does not execute GPU code or require access to copyrighted game images.
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <limits>
#include <optional>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <vector>
#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/capture.h"
#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/program_capture.h"
#include "shader_recompiler/stage.h"

using namespace Shader::Ampere;
struct MappedMemory {
    u64 base{0x100000};
    std::vector<u8> data;
    std::size_t mapped_bytes{};
    u32 reads{};
    bool reject_batch{};
    bool throw_on_batch{};
    u64 throw_at_address{};
};
static bool Read(void* opaque, u64 address, void* destination, std::size_t size) {
    auto& mem = *static_cast<MappedMemory*>(opaque);
    ++mem.reads;
    if ((mem.throw_at_address && address == mem.throw_at_address) ||
        (mem.throw_on_batch && size > 16))
        throw std::runtime_error("guest mapping changed during shader capture");
    if (!destination || !size || address < mem.base || (mem.reject_batch && size > 16))
        return false;
    const u64 offset = address - mem.base;
    if (offset > mem.mapped_bytes || size > mem.mapped_bytes - offset ||
        offset > mem.data.size() || size > mem.data.size() - offset)
        return false;
    std::memcpy(destination, mem.data.data() + offset, size);
    return true;
}
struct MutatingGpuRead {
    MappedMemory* memory{};
    u64 watch_address{};
    std::size_t watch_size{};
    u32 watch_hits{};
};
static bool ReadMutatingGpu(void* context, u64 address, void* destination,
                            std::size_t size) {
    auto& fixture=*static_cast<MutatingGpuRead*>(context);
    if (!Read(fixture.memory,address,destination,size)) return false;
    if (address==fixture.watch_address && size==fixture.watch_size &&
        ++fixture.watch_hits>=2)
        static_cast<u8*>(destination)[0]^=1U;
    return true;
}
static void Require(bool condition, const char* why) {
    if (!condition) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "NS2 shader memory capture FAIL: %s\n", why);
        std::exit(1);
    }
}
static void Push(std::vector<u8>& dst, u32 a, u32 b=0, u32 c=0, u32 d=0) {
    for (u32 word : {a,b,c,d})
        for (u32 byte=0;byte!=4;++byte)
            dst.push_back(static_cast<u8>(word >> (byte*8)));
}
struct CbufFixture {
    std::array<u32,16> entries{};
    u32 reads{};
    bool missing{};
    bool throw_reader{};
    bool mutate_between_reads{};
};
static std::optional<u32> ReadCheckedCbuf(void* context,u32 bank,u32 offset) {
    auto& cbuf=*static_cast<CbufFixture*>(context);
    ++cbuf.reads;
    if (cbuf.throw_reader)
        throw std::runtime_error("CBUF guest mapping changed");
    if (cbuf.missing || bank!=7 || offset<0xffc0U ||
        offset>=0x10000U || offset&3U)
        return {};
    const u32 word=(offset-0xffc0U)/4;
    if (cbuf.mutate_between_reads && cbuf.reads>16 && word==0)
        return 0x100U;
    return cbuf.entries[word];
}

int main() {
    constexpr u32 pred_true=7u<<12;
    constexpr u32 exit_true=7u<<23;
    MappedMemory mem{};
    mem.data.resize(0x80);
    mem.data[0]=0x38;
    Push(mem.data,pred_true|0x918); // native NOP
    Push(mem.data,pred_true|0x94d,0,exit_true); // native EXIT
    mem.mapped_bytes=mem.data.size();
    auto ok=CaptureNativeGraphicsShader(mem.base,4,Read,&mem);
    Require(ok.Ready() && ok.captured_native_bytes==32 &&
            ok.image.consumed_native_bytes==32 &&
            ok.image.TranslateNativeAddress(0).has_value(),
            "read mapped native program, detect EXIT and lower to Maxwell image");
    Require(mem.reads==5,"graphics header and code are reauthenticated before publication");
    // Compute starts at the real QMD program code, not at a fabricated
    // graphics header. Only the actual mapped 16-byte instructions are read.
    const auto compute=CaptureNativeComputeShader(mem.base+0x80,Read,&mem);
    Require(compute.Ready() && compute.captured_native_bytes==32 &&
            compute.image.native_stage==static_cast<u32>(Shader::Stage::Compute) &&
            compute.image.diagnostic_cache_key!=ok.image.diagnostic_cache_key &&
            compute.image.ReadMaxwellInstruction(0x50).has_value(),
            "compute capture must use a separate headerless stage domain");
    Require(mem.reads==8,
            "compute capture rechecks its real QMD code without a graphics header");
    // Native QMD3 shader code can live above the 32-bit-PCAS or legacy
    // 40-bit GPU address window. The capture reader must not alias the
    // low guest address when a valid 49-bit GPU VA is supplied.
    MappedMemory high_shader{};
    high_shader.base = 0x10100000000ULL;
    high_shader.data = mem.data;
    high_shader.mapped_bytes = high_shader.data.size();
    const auto upper_compute = CaptureNativeComputeShader(
        high_shader.base+0x80,Read,&high_shader);
    Require(upper_compute.Ready() &&
            upper_compute.captured_native_bytes==32 &&
            high_shader.reads==3 &&
            upper_compute.image.diagnostic_cache_key==
                compute.image.diagnostic_cache_key,
            "49-bit native Compute GPU address retains exact program bytes");
    // The renderer moves the translated Maxwell image to SPIR-V, but must
    // retain its original Ampere program words across descriptor staging.
    Require(compute.captured_compute_bytes.size()==32 &&
            compute.ComputeSourceMatches(mem.base+0x80,Read,&mem) &&
            !ok.ComputeSourceMatches(mem.base+0x80,Read,&mem) &&
            upper_compute.ComputeSourceMatches(
                high_shader.base+0x80,Read,&high_shader),
            "only captured QMD code keeps a verified 49-bit live source");
    mem.data[0x80]^=1U;
    Require(!compute.ComputeSourceMatches(mem.base+0x80,Read,&mem),
            "same GPU VA and changed native opcode must fail final replay");
    mem.data[0x80]^=1U;
    mem.reject_batch=true;
    Require(compute.ComputeSourceMatches(mem.base+0x80,Read,&mem),
            "dispatch recheck permits exact 16-byte readers");
    mem.reject_batch=false;
    mem.throw_on_batch=true;
    Require(compute.ComputeSourceMatches(mem.base+0x80,Read,&mem),
            "throwing speculative batch falls back to exact word reads");
    mem.throw_on_batch=false;
    mem.throw_at_address=mem.base+0x80;
    Require(!compute.ComputeSourceMatches(mem.base+0x80,Read,&mem),
            "throwing live GMMU callback refuses stale Compute publication");
    mem.throw_at_address=0;
    auto moved_compute=CaptureNativeComputeShader(mem.base+0x80,Read,&mem);
    auto moved_image=std::move(moved_compute.image);
    Require(moved_image.Ready() &&
            moved_compute.ComputeSourceMatches(mem.base+0x80,Read,&mem),
            "source admission survives moving original image into SPIR-V");
    mem.mapped_bytes=0x80+16;
    Require(!compute.ComputeSourceMatches(mem.base+0x80,Read,&mem),
            "final partially unmapped QMD program is refused");
    mem.mapped_bytes=mem.data.size();

    mem.mapped_bytes=0x80+16;
    const auto compute_fault=CaptureNativeComputeShader(mem.base+0x80,Read,&mem);
    Require(compute_fault.status==NativeCaptureStatus::Unmapped &&
            compute_fault.first_error_offset==16 &&
            compute_fault.image.code.empty(),
            "compute second instruction unmapped rejects with code-relative offset");
    mem.mapped_bytes=mem.data.size();
    // Exception in the guest reader must become the same fail-closed
    // Unmapped result as an ordinary GMMU read failure, with exact offsets.
    mem.throw_at_address=mem.base;
    const auto throwing_header=CaptureNativeGraphicsShader(mem.base,4,Read,&mem);
    Require(throwing_header.status==NativeCaptureStatus::Unmapped &&
            throwing_header.image.code.empty(),
            "throwing graphics header reader fails closed");
    mem.throw_at_address=mem.base+0x90;
    const auto throwing_compute=CaptureNativeComputeShader(mem.base+0x80,Read,&mem);
    Require(throwing_compute.status==NativeCaptureStatus::Unmapped &&
            throwing_compute.first_error_offset==16 &&
            throwing_compute.image.code.empty(),
            "throwing compute second-instruction read preserves failure offset");
    mem.throw_at_address=0;
    const auto reads_before_invalid_stage=mem.reads;
    Require(CaptureNativeGraphicsShader(
                mem.base,static_cast<u32>(Shader::Stage::Compute),Read,&mem).status==
                NativeCaptureStatus::InvalidInput,
            "compute stage requires distinct QMD metadata, not graphics SPH");
    Require(CaptureNativeGraphicsShader(mem.base,0xffffffffU,Read,&mem).status==
                NativeCaptureStatus::InvalidInput,
            "out-of-range stage cannot build graphics shader cache identity");
    Require(mem.reads==reads_before_invalid_stage,
            "invalid stages fail before a single guest GMMU read");
    auto stable=CaptureNativeGraphicsShader(mem.base,4,Read,&mem);
    Require(stable.Ready() &&
            stable.image.diagnostic_cache_key==ok.image.diagnostic_cache_key,
            "source-verified repeated capture gives stable diagnostic identity");

    mem.mapped_bytes=0x80+16;
    auto fault=CaptureNativeGraphicsShader(mem.base,4,Read,&mem);
    Require(fault.status==NativeCaptureStatus::Unmapped &&
            fault.first_error_offset==0x90 &&
            fault.image.code.empty(),
            "guest memory fault at second instruction yields no partial shader");
    mem.mapped_bytes=0x4f;
    auto header_fault=CaptureNativeGraphicsShader(mem.base,4,Read,&mem);
    Require(header_fault.status==NativeCaptureStatus::Unmapped &&
            header_fault.image.code.empty(),
            "native header must be fully mapped");
    mem.mapped_bytes=mem.data.size();

    // Linear (non-BRX) native programs must also reject a shader/header
    // rewrite between the initial capture and eventual Vulkan publication.
    // A one-instruction EXIT makes both reads exact rather than page batches.
    MappedMemory linear_shader{};
    linear_shader.data.resize(0x80);
    Push(linear_shader.data,pred_true|0x94d,0,exit_true);
    linear_shader.mapped_bytes=linear_shader.data.size();
    MutatingGpuRead linear_code{&linear_shader,linear_shader.base+0x80U,16U};
    const auto stale_code=CaptureNativeGraphicsShader(
        linear_shader.base,4,ReadMutatingGpu,&linear_code);
    Require(stale_code.status==NativeCaptureStatus::TranslationFailed &&
            stale_code.first_error_offset==0x80U &&
            stale_code.image.code.empty() && linear_code.watch_hits==2,
            "non-BRX shader mutation rejected before GPU pipeline publication");
    MutatingGpuRead linear_header{&linear_shader,linear_shader.base,0x80U};
    const auto stale_header=CaptureNativeGraphicsShader(
        linear_shader.base,4,ReadMutatingGpu,&linear_header);
    Require(stale_header.status==NativeCaptureStatus::TranslationFailed &&
            stale_header.first_error_offset==0 &&
            stale_header.image.code.empty() && linear_header.watch_hits==2,
            "non-BRX graphics header rewrite rejected after code compilation");
    MutatingGpuRead compute_code{&linear_shader,linear_shader.base+0x80U,16U};
    const auto stale_compute=CaptureNativeComputeShader(
        linear_shader.base+0x80U,ReadMutatingGpu,&compute_code);
    Require(stale_compute.status==NativeCaptureStatus::TranslationFailed &&
            stale_compute.first_error_offset==0 &&
            stale_compute.image.code.empty() && compute_code.watch_hits==2,
            "non-BRX QMD code rewrite refused with code-relative offset");

    mem.data.resize(0x80);
    Push(mem.data,pred_true|0x947,0xffffffe0u,0); // BRA invalid target
    mem.mapped_bytes=mem.data.size();
    auto branch=CaptureNativeGraphicsShader(mem.base,4,Read,&mem);
    Require(branch.status==NativeCaptureStatus::InvalidBranch &&
            branch.first_error_offset==0x80 &&
            branch.image.code.empty(),
            "out-of-bounds native branch is rejected before compiler");
    mem.data.resize(0x80);
    Push(mem.data,pred_true|0x949); // BRX requires unimplemented CBUF table
    Push(mem.data,pred_true|0x94d,0,exit_true);
    mem.mapped_bytes=mem.data.size();
    auto indirect=CaptureNativeGraphicsShader(mem.base,4,Read,&mem);
    Require(indirect.status==NativeCaptureStatus::UnresolvedIndirectBranch &&
            indirect.first_error_offset==0x80 &&
            indirect.image.code.empty(),
            "BRX must not become a valid image without target-table resolution");
    mem.data.resize(0x80);
    Push(mem.data,pred_true|0x958); // Uniform BRXU is indirect too.
    Push(mem.data,pred_true|0x94d,0,exit_true);
    mem.mapped_bytes=mem.data.size();
    const auto indirect_uniform=CaptureNativeGraphicsShader(mem.base,4,Read,&mem);
    Require(indirect_uniform.status==NativeCaptureStatus::UnresolvedIndirectBranch &&
            indirect_uniform.first_error_offset==0x80 &&
            indirect_uniform.image.code.empty(),
            "BRXU must not publish an untracked native-PC shader");

    // The existing native-PC jump-table recognizer is useful only as a
    // preflight; the CBUF words still require a native->Maxwell address
    // transform and shader-visible value remap before a BRX can execute.
    // Validate the last possible 16-entry U32 table and reject wrap/invalid
    // banks without performing any guest CBUF reads.
    std::vector<Instruction> motif{
        Instruction{{pred_true|0x817U|(4U<<16),15U,0x03800000U,0}},
        Instruction{{pred_true|0x819U|(5U<<16)|(4U<<24),2U,0x000006ffU,0}},
        Instruction{{pred_true|0xb82U|(6U<<16)|(5U<<24),
                     (7U<<22)|(0xffc0U<<6),0x00000800U,0}},
        Instruction{{pred_true|0x949U|(6U<<24),0xffffffc0U,0x0383ffffU,0}},
    };
    auto single_motif=motif;
    single_motif[0].words[1]=0; // IMNMX bounds the selector to [0,0]
    const auto single_table=TrackCaptureIndirectBranches(single_motif);
    Require(single_table.size()==1 && single_table[0].entries==1 &&
            single_table[0].cbuf_index==7 && single_table[0].cbuf_offset==0xffc0U,
            "canonical BRX with one exact CBUF target is a valid dispatch");
    // A verified indirect CBUF target can exceed the old 4096-word shader
    // limit only if the exact destination exists in the captured source.
    std::vector<Instruction> large_branch(4098,
        Instruction{{pred_true|0x918U,0,0,0}});
    std::copy(single_motif.begin(),single_motif.end(),large_branch.begin());
    large_branch[4097] = Instruction{{pred_true|0x94dU,0,exit_true,0}};
    CaptureIndirectResult large_table{};
    large_table.base=0;
    large_table.tables.push_back({
        .branch=3, .cbuf_index=7, .cbuf_offset=0xffc0U,
        .values={4097U*16U}, .targets={4097U}});
    const auto large_plans=MakeNativeIndirectBranchPlans(large_table,large_branch);
    Require(large_plans && large_plans->size()==1 &&
            large_plans->front().targets.size()==1 &&
            large_plans->front().targets.front().native_instruction_index==4097,
            "BRX plan authenticates real native PC beyond former 4096 limit");
    large_branch.pop_back();
    Require(!MakeNativeIndirectBranchPlans(large_table,large_branch),
            "BRX plan refuses stale CBUF target beyond actual guest capture");
    auto table=TrackCaptureIndirectBranches(motif);
    Require(table.size()==1 && table[0].index==3 &&
            table[0].cbuf_index==7 && table[0].cbuf_offset==0xffc0U &&
            table[0].entries==16,
            "BRX table ending at 64-KiB CBUF boundary is valid metadata");
    auto spaced_motif=motif;
    spaced_motif.insert(spaced_motif.begin()+1,
                        Instruction{{pred_true|0x918U,0,0,0}});
    // BRX moved one native instruction: its absolute-zero relative base
    // must change from -64 to -80 bytes as well.
    spaced_motif[4].words[1]=0xffffffb0U;
    Require(TrackCaptureIndirectBranches(spaced_motif).size()==1,
            "canonical NOP between jump-table definitions is transparent");
    auto clobbered_motif=motif;
    clobbered_motif.insert(clobbered_motif.begin()+3,
                          Instruction{{pred_true|0x202U|(6U<<16),0,0,0}});
    clobbered_motif[4].words[1]=0xffffffb0U;
    Require(TrackCaptureIndirectBranches(clobbered_motif).empty(),
            "intervening register overwrite cannot reuse stale LDC target");
    auto interleaved_motif=motif;
    interleaved_motif.insert(interleaved_motif.begin()+1,
                            Instruction{{pred_true|0x202U|(9U<<16),0,0,0}});
    interleaved_motif[4].words[1]=0xffffffb0U;
    Require(TrackCaptureIndirectBranches(interleaved_motif).empty(),
            "unproved interleaved source instructions fail closed");
    motif[2].words[1]=(7U<<22)|(0xffc4U<<6);
    Require(TrackCaptureIndirectBranches(motif).empty(),
            "BRX table crossing 64-KiB CBUF boundary must not be read");
    motif[2].words[1]=(18U<<22)|(0xffc0U<<6);
    Require(TrackCaptureIndirectBranches(motif).empty(),
            "BRX CBUF bank outside 18 reflected shader banks rejected");

    // Exact native-PC -> emitted-Maxwell-PC map. No arithmetic 16:8
    // assumption: a native instruction may expand and Maxwell has scheduler
    // words. The actual captured image must resolve both entries.
    CaptureIndirectResult captured_table{};
    captured_table.tables.push_back({
        .branch=0, .cbuf_index=7, .cbuf_offset=0xfff8U,
        .values={0x80U,0x90U}, .targets={0,1}});
    const auto mapped_header_table=TranslateCaptureIndirectTargets(
        captured_table,ok.image,CaptureIndirectValueOrigin::GraphicsHeader);
    Require(mapped_header_table && mapped_header_table->size()==1 &&
            mapped_header_table->front().entries.size()==2 &&
            mapped_header_table->front().cbuf_index==7 &&
            mapped_header_table->front().cbuf_offset==0xfff8U &&
            mapped_header_table->front().entries[0].native_code_offset==0 &&
            mapped_header_table->front().entries[0].maxwell_byte_offset==
                *ok.image.TranslateNativeAddress(0) &&
            mapped_header_table->front().entries[1].native_code_offset==16 &&
            mapped_header_table->front().entries[1].maxwell_byte_offset==
                *ok.image.TranslateNativeAddress(16),
            "BRX native shader-header table maps every PC through actual Maxwell image");
    Require(!TranslateCaptureIndirectTargets(
                captured_table,ok.image,CaptureIndirectValueOrigin::NativeCode),
            "BRX must not interpret header-relative entries as code-relative");
    captured_table.tables[0].values={0,16};
    const auto mapped_code_table=TranslateCaptureIndirectTargets(
        captured_table,ok.image,CaptureIndirectValueOrigin::NativeCode);
    Require(mapped_code_table && mapped_code_table->front().entries[0].raw_value==0 &&
            mapped_code_table->front().entries[0].maxwell_byte_offset==
                *ok.image.TranslateNativeAddress(0),
            "BRX zero is a valid code-relative target, not a missing entry");
    Require(!TranslateCaptureIndirectTargets(
                captured_table,ok.image,CaptureIndirectValueOrigin::GraphicsHeader),
            "code-relative zero must not become a graphics-header-relative PC");
    captured_table.tables[0].values={0x80U,0x91U};
    Require(!TranslateCaptureIndirectTargets(
                captured_table,ok.image,CaptureIndirectValueOrigin::GraphicsHeader),
            "BRX misaligned entry invalidates complete target map");
    captured_table.tables[0].values={0x80U,0xa0U};
    Require(!TranslateCaptureIndirectTargets(
                captured_table,ok.image,CaptureIndirectValueOrigin::GraphicsHeader),
            "BRX target beyond captured shader invalidates complete target map");
    captured_table.tables[0].values={0x80U,0x90U};
    captured_table.tables[0].cbuf_offset=0xfffcU;
    Require(!TranslateCaptureIndirectTargets(
                captured_table,ok.image,CaptureIndirectValueOrigin::GraphicsHeader),
            "BRX table that wraps 64 KiB CBUF must not map");
    captured_table.tables[0].cbuf_offset=0xfff8U;
    captured_table.tables[0].cbuf_index=18;
    Require(!TranslateCaptureIndirectTargets(
                captured_table,ok.image,CaptureIndirectValueOrigin::GraphicsHeader),
            "BRX table with invalid CBUF bank must not map");
    captured_table.tables[0].cbuf_index=7;
    // Lowering may leave two distinct native instructions at the same
    // emitted address. Such an image can be structurally valid for linear
    // translation, but may never be used as an indirect branch target map.
    auto aliased_image=ok.image;
    const std::size_t map_count=static_cast<std::size_t>(
        aliased_image.code[aliased_image.code.size()-2]);
    const std::size_t map_start=aliased_image.code.size()-map_count-2;
    aliased_image.code[map_start+1]=aliased_image.code[map_start];
    Require(aliased_image.ValidForCompiler() &&
            !TranslateCaptureIndirectTargets(
                captured_table,aliased_image,CaptureIndirectValueOrigin::GraphicsHeader),
            "two distinct native BRX targets must not alias one Maxwell PC");
    captured_table.tables.push_back(captured_table.tables[0]);
    Require(!TranslateCaptureIndirectTargets(
                captured_table,ok.image,CaptureIndirectValueOrigin::GraphicsHeader),
            "duplicate BRX index must not publish competing target tables");

    // Extend a recognized BRX source capture beyond its first EXIT using
    // explicit CBUF origin, immutable snapshot verification and bounded
    // per-instruction reads. Neither this test nor the helper executes BRX.
    auto source_motif=motif;
    source_motif[2].words[1]=(7U<<22)|(0xffc0U<<6);
    source_motif.push_back(Instruction{{pred_true|0x94d,0,exit_true,0}});
    ProgramCaptureState initial_capture;
    for (u32 i=0; i<source_motif.size(); ++i)
        initial_capture.Observe(source_motif[i],i);
    std::array<u32,16> guest_targets{};
    for (u32 i=0;i<guest_targets.size();++i)
        guest_targets[i]=i&1U ? 0x100U : 0x80U;
    const auto cbuf_reader=[&](u32 bank,u32 offset)->std::optional<u32> {
        if (bank!=7 || offset<0xffc0U || offset>=0x10000U || offset&3U)
            return {};
        return guest_targets[(offset-0xffc0U)/4];
    };
    const auto tail_reader=[&](u32 index)->std::optional<Instruction> {
        if (index<5 || index>9) return {};
        if (index==9) return Instruction{{pred_true|0x94d,0,exit_true,0}};
        return Instruction{{pred_true|0x918,0,0,0}};
    };
    auto extended_source=source_motif;
    auto extended_state=initial_capture;
    const auto extended=ResolveCaptureIndirectBranchesChecked(
        extended_source,extended_state,
        CaptureIndirectValueOrigin::GraphicsHeader,tail_reader,cbuf_reader);
    Require(extended && extended->extended && extended->base==0x80U &&
            extended->tables.size()==1 && extended->tables[0].branch==3 &&
            extended->tables[0].values.size()==16 &&
            extended->tables[0].targets.size()==2 &&
            extended->tables[0].targets[0]==0 &&
            extended->tables[0].targets[1]==8 &&
            extended_source.size()==10,
            "BRX capture extends beyond earlier EXIT through final verified target");
    const auto dispatch_plans=MakeNativeIndirectBranchPlans(
        *extended,extended_source);
    Require(dispatch_plans && dispatch_plans->size()==1 &&
            dispatch_plans->front().branch_instruction_index==3 &&
            dispatch_plans->front().raw_pc_base==0x80U &&
            dispatch_plans->front().targets.size()==16 &&
            dispatch_plans->front().targets[0].native_value==0x80U &&
            dispatch_plans->front().targets[1].native_instruction_index==8,
            "verified BRX CBUF snapshot produces exact compiler dispatch plan");
    auto malformed_capture=*extended;
    malformed_capture.tables[0].cbuf_index=18;
    Require(!MakeNativeIndirectBranchPlans(malformed_capture,extended_source),
            "BRX plan cannot bind a different CBUF bank than captured shader");
    malformed_capture=*extended;
    malformed_capture.tables[0].values[1]=0x91U;
    Require(!MakeNativeIndirectBranchPlans(malformed_capture,extended_source),
            "BRX plan rejects non-16-byte native target alignment");
    auto mutated_source=extended_source;
    mutated_source[3].words[0]=pred_true|0x958U;
    Require(!MakeNativeIndirectBranchPlans(*extended,mutated_source),
            "BRX plan must reject a newly replaced BRXU opcode");
    guest_targets[1]=0x81U;
    auto bad_source=source_motif;
    auto bad_state=initial_capture;
    Require(!ResolveCaptureIndirectBranchesChecked(
                bad_source,bad_state,CaptureIndirectValueOrigin::GraphicsHeader,
                tail_reader,cbuf_reader) && bad_source.size()==source_motif.size(),
            "misaligned BRX CBUF target rejects without mutating source");
    guest_targets[1]=0x100U;
    bad_source=source_motif;
    bad_state=initial_capture;
    const auto faulting_tail=[&](u32 index)->std::optional<Instruction> {
        return index>=8 ? std::nullopt : tail_reader(index);
    };
    Require(!ResolveCaptureIndirectBranchesChecked(
                bad_source,bad_state,CaptureIndirectValueOrigin::GraphicsHeader,
                faulting_tail,cbuf_reader) && bad_source.size()==source_motif.size(),
            "BRX GMMU fault while extending shader rolls back all appended instructions");
    bad_source=source_motif;
    bad_state=initial_capture;
    const auto unexpected_brx=[&](u32 index)->std::optional<Instruction> {
        if (index==6) return Instruction{{pred_true|0x958,0,0,0}};
        return tail_reader(index);
    };
    Require(!ResolveCaptureIndirectBranchesChecked(
                bad_source,bad_state,CaptureIndirectValueOrigin::GraphicsHeader,
                unexpected_brx,cbuf_reader) && bad_source.size()==source_motif.size(),
            "BRX extended tail must reject newly discovered untracked BRXU");
    bad_source=source_motif;
    bad_state=initial_capture;
    u32 snapshot_reads{};
    const auto changing_table=[&](u32 bank,u32 offset)->std::optional<u32> {
        ++snapshot_reads;
        const auto value=cbuf_reader(bank,offset);
        if (!value) return {};
        return snapshot_reads>16 && offset==0xffc0U
            ? std::optional<u32>{0x100U} : value;
    };
    Require(!ResolveCaptureIndirectBranchesChecked(
                bad_source,bad_state,CaptureIndirectValueOrigin::GraphicsHeader,
                tail_reader,changing_table) && bad_source.size()==source_motif.size(),
            "BRX changed guest CBUF between read and capture must roll back");
    bad_source=source_motif;
    bad_state=initial_capture;
    const auto throwing_table=[&](u32,u32)->std::optional<u32> {
        throw std::runtime_error("guest CBUF mapping changed");
    };
    Require(!ResolveCaptureIndirectBranchesChecked(
                bad_source,bad_state,CaptureIndirectValueOrigin::GraphicsHeader,
                tail_reader,throwing_table) && bad_source.size()==source_motif.size(),
            "BRX throwing CBUF reader must roll back without publishing a shader");


    // GMMU 49-bit admission applies to every real source/CBUF read, not
    // just host-u64 overflow. A mock reader may claim that out-of-range
    // synthetic bytes are mapped; the capture must still refuse them.
    constexpr u64 GmmuLimit49=u64{1}<<49;
    Require(NativeGpuRange49(GmmuLimit49-16,16) &&
            !NativeGpuRange49(GmmuLimit49-16,17) &&
            !NativeGpuRange49(GmmuLimit49,1) &&
            !NativeGpuRange49(1,0) &&
            !NativeGpuRange49(~u64{0},16),
            "native shader GMMU reads enforce complete 49-bit range");
    MappedMemory edge_shader{};
    edge_shader.base=GmmuLimit49-0xa0U;
    edge_shader.data.resize(0x80U);
    edge_shader.data[0]=0x38;
    Push(edge_shader.data,pred_true|0x918U);
    Push(edge_shader.data,pred_true|0x94dU,0,exit_true);
    edge_shader.mapped_bytes=edge_shader.data.size();
    const auto valid_edge_shader=CaptureNativeGraphicsShader(
        edge_shader.base,4,Read,&edge_shader);
    Require(valid_edge_shader.Ready() &&
            valid_edge_shader.captured_native_bytes==2*sizeof(Instruction),
            "short native shader ending at top of 49-bit VA stays supported");
    edge_shader.base=GmmuLimit49-0x90U;
    const auto over_edge_shader=CaptureNativeGraphicsShader(
        edge_shader.base,4,Read,&edge_shader);
    Require(over_edge_shader.status==NativeCaptureStatus::Unmapped &&
            over_edge_shader.first_error_offset==0x90U &&
            over_edge_shader.image.code.empty(),
            "native shader rejects second instruction beyond 49-bit VA even if mock maps it");

    // Exercise the real checked capture/lowerer handoff. The native shader
    // has a tracked BRX at instruction 3, a first EXIT at 4, and a target
    // after that EXIT. The executing CBUF value remains an original guest PC.
    MappedMemory brx_memory{};
    brx_memory.data.resize(0x80);
    brx_memory.data[0]=0x38;
    Push(brx_memory.data,pred_true|0x817U|(4U<<16),15U,0x03800000U);
    Push(brx_memory.data,pred_true|0x819U|(5U<<16)|(4U<<24),2U,0x000006ffU);
    Push(brx_memory.data,pred_true|0xb82U|(6U<<16)|(5U<<24),
         (7U<<22)|(0xffc0U<<6),0x00000800U);
    Push(brx_memory.data,pred_true|0x949U|(6U<<24),0xffffffc0U,0x0383ffffU);
    Push(brx_memory.data,pred_true|0x94dU,0,exit_true);
    for(u32 i=0;i<4;++i) Push(brx_memory.data,pred_true|0x918U);
    Push(brx_memory.data,pred_true|0x94dU,0,exit_true);
    brx_memory.mapped_bytes=brx_memory.data.size();
    // A canonical IMNMX clamp-to-zero also encodes a valid ONE-entry
    // indirect CBUF table. The original two-entry minimum erroneously
    // refused this legitimate degenerate switch; the checked BRX still
    // compares the guest native PC and never jumps to its raw byte offset.
    auto single_brx_memory=brx_memory;
    // Instruction 0 IMNMX immediate bound changes from 15 to zero.
    for(u32 byte=0;byte<4;++byte)
        single_brx_memory.data[0x80+4+byte]=0;
    CbufFixture single_brx_cbuf{};
    single_brx_cbuf.entries[0]=0xc0U; // header-relative native EXIT at index 4
    const auto single_brx=CaptureNativeGraphicsShaderChecked(
        single_brx_memory.base,4,Read,&single_brx_memory,
        ReadCheckedCbuf,&single_brx_cbuf);
    Require(single_brx.Ready() && single_brx.image.ValidForCompiler() &&
            single_brx.image.TranslateNativeAddress(4*16).has_value() &&
            single_brx_cbuf.reads>=3,
            "single-entry BRX table uses checked native PC and real lowered target");
    // A CBUF unmap must refuse the same shader; no bare Maxwell indirect
    // branch may run as a fallback for the missing one-element table.
    single_brx_cbuf.missing=true;
    const auto missing_single=CaptureNativeGraphicsShaderChecked(
        single_brx_memory.base,4,Read,&single_brx_memory,
        ReadCheckedCbuf,&single_brx_cbuf);
    Require(!missing_single.Ready() && missing_single.image.code.empty(),
            "single-entry BRX refuses missing CBUF mapping");
    single_brx_cbuf.missing=false;
    single_brx_cbuf.entries[0]=0xc1U;
    const auto unaligned_single=CaptureNativeGraphicsShaderChecked(
        single_brx_memory.base,4,Read,&single_brx_memory,
        ReadCheckedCbuf,&single_brx_cbuf);
    Require(!unaligned_single.Ready() && unaligned_single.image.code.empty(),
            "single-entry BRX refuses misaligned guest native PC");
    CbufFixture stable_cbuf{};
    for(u32 i=0;i<stable_cbuf.entries.size();++i)
        stable_cbuf.entries[i]=i&1 ? 0x100U : 0x80U;
    const auto compiled_brx=CaptureNativeGraphicsShaderChecked(
        brx_memory.base,4,Read,&brx_memory,ReadCheckedCbuf,&stable_cbuf);
    Require(compiled_brx.Ready() &&
            compiled_brx.captured_native_bytes==10*sizeof(Instruction) &&
            compiled_brx.image.ValidForCompiler() &&
            compiled_brx.image.TranslateNativeAddress(8*16).has_value() &&
            stable_cbuf.reads>=3*stable_cbuf.entries.size(),
            "checked graphics BRX captures post-EXIT target and lowers dispatch");
    // Verify both legitimate PC conventions without guessing a table
    // origin from the first nonzero CBUF word. The native image and every
    // generated branch must retain the exact selected convention.
    for(u32 i=0;i<stable_cbuf.entries.size();++i)
        stable_cbuf.entries[i]=i&1 ? 0x80U : 0U;
    stable_cbuf.reads=0;
    const auto code_relative_brx=CaptureNativeGraphicsShaderChecked(
        brx_memory.base,4,Read,&brx_memory,ReadCheckedCbuf,&stable_cbuf);
    Require(code_relative_brx.Ready() &&
            code_relative_brx.captured_native_bytes==10*sizeof(Instruction) &&
            code_relative_brx.image.ValidForCompiler() &&
            code_relative_brx.image.diagnostic_cache_key!=
                compiled_brx.image.diagnostic_cache_key,
            "code-relative BRX CBUF addresses use the independent verified origin");
    // Both candidate origins can be fully mapped on a sufficiently long
    // shader. Reject this ambiguity, rather than running the wrong block.
    auto ambiguous_memory=brx_memory;
    for (u32 i=10;i<19;++i)
        Push(ambiguous_memory.data,pred_true|0x918U);
    Push(ambiguous_memory.data,pred_true|0x94dU,0,exit_true);
    ambiguous_memory.mapped_bytes=ambiguous_memory.data.size();
    for(u32 i=0;i<stable_cbuf.entries.size();++i)
        stable_cbuf.entries[i]=i&1 ? 0x110U : 0x100U;
    const auto ambiguous_brx=CaptureNativeGraphicsShaderChecked(
        ambiguous_memory.base,4,Read,&ambiguous_memory,
        ReadCheckedCbuf,&stable_cbuf);
    Require(!ambiguous_brx.Ready() && ambiguous_brx.image.code.empty(),
            "simultaneously valid BRX origins must fail closed");
    for(u32 i=0;i<stable_cbuf.entries.size();++i)
        stable_cbuf.entries[i]=i&1 ? 0x100U : 0x80U;
    stable_cbuf.reads=0;
    const auto no_cbuf_brx=CaptureNativeGraphicsShader(
        brx_memory.base,4,Read,&brx_memory);
    Require(no_cbuf_brx.status==NativeCaptureStatus::UnresolvedIndirectBranch,
            "BRX without authenticated CBUF callback remains fail-closed");
    stable_cbuf.reads=0;
    stable_cbuf.mutate_between_reads=true;
    const auto racing_brx=CaptureNativeGraphicsShaderChecked(
        brx_memory.base,4,Read,&brx_memory,ReadCheckedCbuf,&stable_cbuf);
    Require(!racing_brx.Ready() && racing_brx.image.code.empty(),
            "CBUF remap between snapshot passes never publishes shader");
    stable_cbuf.mutate_between_reads=false;
    stable_cbuf.missing=true;
    const auto unmapped_brx=CaptureNativeGraphicsShaderChecked(
        brx_memory.base,4,Read,&brx_memory,ReadCheckedCbuf,&stable_cbuf);
    Require(!unmapped_brx.Ready() && unmapped_brx.image.code.empty(),
            "missing native CBUF bank prevents indirect shader publication");
    stable_cbuf.missing=false;
    stable_cbuf.throw_reader=true;
    const auto throwing_brx=CaptureNativeGraphicsShaderChecked(
        brx_memory.base,4,Read,&brx_memory,ReadCheckedCbuf,&stable_cbuf);
    Require(!throwing_brx.Ready() && throwing_brx.image.code.empty(),
            "throwing CBUF callback cannot escape GPU capture or expose partial image");
    stable_cbuf.throw_reader=false;
    // A shader rewrite after its initial read but before pipeline
    // publication must fail even if the checked CBUF table is unchanged.
    MutatingGpuRead modified_code{&brx_memory,brx_memory.base+0x80U,16U};
    const auto changed_shader=CaptureNativeGraphicsShaderChecked(
        brx_memory.base,4,ReadMutatingGpu,&modified_code,
        ReadCheckedCbuf,&stable_cbuf);
    Require(changed_shader.status==NativeCaptureStatus::TranslationFailed &&
            changed_shader.first_error_offset==0x80U &&
            changed_shader.image.code.empty() &&
            modified_code.watch_hits>=2,
            "BRX rechecks all native source words after CBUF resolution");
    MutatingGpuRead modified_header{&brx_memory,brx_memory.base,0x80U};
    const auto changed_header=CaptureNativeGraphicsShaderChecked(
        brx_memory.base,4,ReadMutatingGpu,&modified_header,
        ReadCheckedCbuf,&stable_cbuf);
    Require(changed_header.status==NativeCaptureStatus::TranslationFailed &&
            changed_header.image.code.empty() &&
            modified_header.watch_hits>=2,
            "BRX rechecks graphics SPH bytes before image publication");

    mem.data.resize(0x80);
    Push(mem.data,pred_true|0xfff);
    Push(mem.data,pred_true|0x94d,0,exit_true);
    mem.mapped_bytes=mem.data.size();
    auto unsupported=CaptureNativeGraphicsShader(mem.base,4,Read,&mem);
    Require(unsupported.status==NativeCaptureStatus::TranslationFailed &&
            unsupported.image.code.empty(),
            "unrecognized native opcodes fail closed after capture");

    // P2.4: the *real GMMU capture* must admit a legal Compute shader
    // crossing the former 4096-instruction clamp, reauthenticate its
    // original bytes, and deliver a compiler-eligible Maxwell image.
    mem.data.resize(0x80);
    for (u32 index = 0; index < 4096; ++index)
        Push(mem.data, pred_true | 0x918);
    Push(mem.data, pred_true | 0x94d, 0, exit_true);
    mem.mapped_bytes = mem.data.size();
    const auto complete_4097 = CaptureNativeComputeShader(
        mem.base + 0x80, Read, &mem);
    Require(complete_4097.Ready() &&
            complete_4097.captured_native_bytes == 4097 * 16 &&
            complete_4097.image.ValidForCompiler() &&
            complete_4097.ComputeSourceMatches(mem.base + 0x80, Read, &mem),
            "4097-instruction real Compute shader traverses capture/image/SSBO source replay");
    mem.data[0x80 + 4096 * 16] ^= 1U;
    Require(!complete_4097.ComputeSourceMatches(mem.base + 0x80, Read, &mem),
            "large Compute shader checks last instruction after translation");
    mem.data.resize(0x80);
    for (u32 index = 0; index < 65536; ++index)
        Push(mem.data, pred_true | 0x918);
    mem.mapped_bytes = mem.data.size();
    const auto unterminated = CaptureNativeGraphicsShader(mem.base, 4, Read, &mem);
    Require(unterminated.status == NativeCaptureStatus::NoTerminator &&
            unterminated.captured_native_bytes == 65536 * 16 &&
            unterminated.image.code.empty(),
            "full supported shader window without EXIT cannot fabricate a valid image");
    Require(CaptureNativeGraphicsShader(mem.base,4,nullptr,&mem).status==
                NativeCaptureStatus::InvalidInput,
            "null memory reader must fail before any guest access");
    Require(CaptureNativeGraphicsShader(std::numeric_limits<u64>::max()-10,4,Read,&mem).status==
                NativeCaptureStatus::InvalidInput,
            "GPU address arithmetic overflow rejected before guest access");
    // A mapped long shader spans several 4 KiB GMMU pages. The coherent
    // reader should batch operations within each page without changing the
    // exact native instruction stream or consuming memory beyond termination.
    MappedMemory long_shader{};
    long_shader.base=0x200000;
    long_shader.data.resize(0x80);
    for (u32 index=0;index<512;++index)
        Push(long_shader.data,pred_true|0x918);
    Push(long_shader.data,pred_true|0x94d,0,exit_true);
    long_shader.mapped_bytes=long_shader.data.size();
    const auto long_result=CaptureNativeComputeShader(
        long_shader.base+0x80,Read,&long_shader);
    Require(long_result.Ready() &&
            long_result.captured_native_bytes==513*16 &&
            long_shader.reads < 20,
            "long native shaders use bounded coherent GPU page reads");
    // A reader that only accepts 16-byte accesses must still work exactly.
    long_shader.reads=0;
    long_shader.reject_batch=true;
    const auto non_batched=CaptureNativeComputeShader(
        long_shader.base+0x80,Read,&long_shader);
    Require(non_batched.Ready() &&
            non_batched.image.diagnostic_cache_key==
                long_result.image.diagnostic_cache_key &&
            long_shader.reads >= 513,
            "failed page prefetch falls back to exact mapped instruction reads");
    // A speculative 4-KiB batch reader may throw while an exact
    // 16-byte instruction reader remains valid. Retry the exact reads
    // rather than converting a valid shader into a false GPU mapping fault.
    long_shader.reject_batch=false;
    long_shader.throw_on_batch=true;
    long_shader.reads=0;
    const auto throwing_batch=CaptureNativeComputeShader(
        long_shader.base+0x80,Read,&long_shader);
    Require(throwing_batch.Ready() &&
            throwing_batch.image.diagnostic_cache_key==
                long_result.image.diagnostic_cache_key &&
            long_shader.reads>=513,
            "throwing prefetch falls back to exact per-instruction reads");
    long_shader.throw_on_batch=false;
    // Last instruction missing: the status and byte-accurate fault offset
    // must match the historical per-instruction implementation.
    long_shader.reject_batch=false;
    long_shader.reads=0;
    long_shader.mapped_bytes-=16;
    const auto end_fault=CaptureNativeComputeShader(
        long_shader.base+0x80,Read,&long_shader);
    Require(end_fault.status==NativeCaptureStatus::Unmapped &&
            end_fault.first_error_offset==512*16 &&
            end_fault.image.code.empty(),
            "partial final page returns the original unmapped shader offset");
    std::puts("NS2 mapped native shader capture: PASS (no PS5 game execution)");
}
```

`tools/ns2/test_ampere_isa.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Synthetic SM70+/Ampere instruction and native-to-Maxwell address-map tests.
// This does not claim SM86 shader execution or RADV compatibility.
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>
#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/instruction.h"
#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/classify.h"
#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/ampere_isa_table.h"
#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/probe.h"
#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/program_address_map.h"
#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/native_graphics_stage_policy.h"

using namespace Shader::Ampere;
static_assert(sizeof(Instruction)==16);
static_assert(Classify(0x947).kind==OpKind::Bra);
static_assert(Classify(0x94d).kind==OpKind::Exit);
static_assert(Classify(0x950).kind==OpKind::Ret);
static_assert(Classify(0x918).kind==OpKind::Nop);
static_assert(Classify(0x210).pure);




int main() {
    assert(RelativeOffset48(Instruction{{0,0,0,0}})==0);
    assert(RelativeOffset30(Instruction{{0,0,0,0}})==0);
    assert(RelativeOffset48(Instruction{{0,0,0x20000,0}})<0);
    assert(ISA_ROW_COUNT==629);
    const auto* add=FindOpcodeRow(0x210);
    assert(add && std::string_view(add->name)=="IAdd3/IAdd3X");
    assert(FindOpcodeRow(0x1210)==add); // Explicit 12-bit opcode mask
    assert(FindOpcodeRow(0xfff)==nullptr);
    Instruction zero{{0,0,0,0}};
    assert(FirstUnreviewedBit(zero,*add)==-1);
    Instruction unknown{{0,0,0,1}};
    assert(FirstUnreviewedBit(unknown,*add)==96);
    assert(zero.Bits(0,12)==0);
    Instruction cross{{0xffffffff,0xffffffff,0,0}};
    assert(cross.Bits(29,8)==0xff);
    assert(cross.Bits(63,2)==1);

    std::vector<std::uint64_t> code(100,0);
    assert(!HasNativeAddressMap(code));
    assert(!NativeProgramAddress(code,0));
    std::array<std::uint32_t,3> offsets{0,1,2};
    AppendNativeAddressMap(code,offsets);
    assert(HasNativeAddressMap(code));
    assert(NativeProgramAddress(code,0)==std::optional<std::uint32_t>{0x50});
    assert(NativeProgramAddress(code,16)==std::optional<std::uint32_t>{0x58});
    assert(NativeProgramAddress(code,32)==std::optional<std::uint32_t>{0x68});
    assert(!NativeProgramAddress(code,1)); // Ampere instructions align to 16 bytes
    assert(!NativeProgramAddress(code,48)); // count=3
    // SYNC -> barrier must not be reached by an illegal computed branch.
    code[0x50/8]=0xf0f800000007000fULL;
    code[0x58/8]=0xef98000000070100ULL;
    assert(!NativeProgramAddress(code,16));
    code[code.size()-2]=65537;
    assert(!NativeProgramAddress(code,0));
    code[code.size()-2]=3;
    code.back()=0;
    assert(!NativeProgramAddress(code,0));
    // P2.4: VertexB is required, and paired tessellation and Geometry
    // enter only through the linked Vulkan graphics pipeline.
    // Standalone stages must never fabricate tessellation interfaces.
    for (u32 mask : {0x02U, 0x03U, 0x22U, 0x23U,
                     0x12U, 0x13U, 0x32U, 0x33U,
                     0x0eU, 0x0fU, 0x1eU, 0x2eU, 0x3fU})
        assert(NativeGraphicsStageMaskSupported(mask));
    for (u32 mask : {0x00U, 0x01U, 0x04U, 0x06U, 0x08U, 0x10U,
                     0x20U, 0x21U, 0x24U, 0x26U, 0x40U, 0xffU})
        assert(!NativeGraphicsStageMaskSupported(mask));

    // NVC597 SET_MESH_CONTROL selects a distinct ABI. A solo Mesh is
    // installed in VertexB; a Task in VertexB is paired with Mesh in
    // TessControl (bit 2), NOT TessEval (bit 3).
    for (u32 mask : {0x02U, 0x06U, 0x12U, 0x16U,
                     0x22U, 0x26U, 0x32U, 0x36U})
        assert(NativeMeshGraphicsStageMaskSupported(mask, true));
    for (u32 mask : {0x00U, 0x01U, 0x03U, 0x08U, 0x0aU,
                     0x0eU, 0x20U, 0x3aU, 0x40U, 0xffU})
        assert(!NativeMeshGraphicsStageMaskSupported(mask, true));
    assert(NativeMeshGraphicsStageMaskSupported(0x0eU, false));
    assert(NativeMeshTaskPresent(0x06U, true));
    assert(!NativeMeshTaskPresent(0x02U, true));
    assert(!NativeMeshTaskPresent(0x06U, false));
    const auto task = static_cast<Shader::Stage>(
        static_cast<u32>(Shader::Stage::VertexA) + 1U);
    const auto mesh = static_cast<Shader::Stage>(
        static_cast<u32>(Shader::Stage::VertexA) + 2U);
    // Stage identity alone cannot give a Mesh CBUF bank: solo Mesh and
    // Task+Mesh use different physical register slots.
    assert(NativeGraphicsCbufBank(mesh) == ~u32{0});
    assert(NativeMeshSlotCbufBank(task, true) == 0U);
    assert(NativeMeshSlotCbufBank(task, false) == ~u32{0});
    assert(NativeMeshSlotCbufBank(mesh, true) == 1U);
    assert(NativeMeshSlotCbufBank(mesh, false) == 0U);
}
```

`tools/ns2/test_ampere_isa_probe.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Host-only Ampere ISA reconnaissance, not PS5 shader translation.
#include <array>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <vector>
#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/ampere_isa_table.h"
#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/probe.h"

using namespace Shader::Ampere;
static void check(bool value, const char* desc) {
    if (!value) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "NS2 Ampere probe FAIL: %s\n", desc);
        std::exit(1);
    }
}
static void Append(std::vector<u8>& data, u32 opcode, u32 override_word0 = 0) {
    const u32 words[]{opcode | override_word0, 0, 0, 0};
    for (u32 word : words) {
        for (int i=0; i<4; ++i) data.push_back(static_cast<u8>(word >> (i*8)));
    }
}
int main() {
    static_assert(sizeof(Instruction) == 16);
    check(ISA_ROW_COUNT == 629, "pinned upstream SM70 ISA row count");
    check(FindOpcodeRow(0x202) && FindOpcodeRow(0x947) &&
          FindOpcodeRow(0x94d) && FindOpcodeRow(0x918) &&
          FindOpcodeRow(0x34e) && FindOpcodeRow(0x357) &&
          FindOpcodeRow(0x957),
          "MOV, BRA, EXIT and NOP have real opcode definitions");
    check(Classify(0x947).kind == OpKind::Bra &&
          Classify(0x94d).kind == OpKind::Exit &&
          Classify(0x918).kind == OpKind::Nop,
          "Ampere branch, exit and no-op classification");
    check(ProbeProgram({}).status == ProbeStatus::Empty,
          "zero-length shader data is not a recognized program");
    const std::array<u8, 15> invalid{};
    check(ProbeProgram(invalid).status == ProbeStatus::InvalidSize,
          "partial 128-bit GPU instruction rejected");
    std::vector<u8> valid;
    Append(valid, 0x202);
    Append(valid, 0x947);
    Append(valid, 0x94d);
    auto result = ProbeProgram(valid);
    check(result.status == ProbeStatus::Recognized && result.instructions == 3 &&
          result.recognized == 3 && result.control_flow == 2,
          "bounded sample recognized without claiming shader execution");
    std::vector<u8> geometry_prologue;
    Append(geometry_prologue, 0x34e, 7u << 12);
    Append(geometry_prologue, 0x357, 7u << 12);
    Append(geometry_prologue, 0x957, 7u << 12);
    check(ProbeProgram(geometry_prologue).status == ProbeStatus::Recognized,
          "verified geometry ATEXIT opcodes reach the lowering preflight");
    geometry_prologue[3] = 1; // Disallowed LEPC operand encoding.
    check(ProbeProgram(geometry_prologue).status == ProbeStatus::UnreviewedFields,
          "non-reviewed LEPC operand mode remains fail closed");
    auto misaligned=valid;
    misaligned.erase(misaligned.begin());
    check(ProbeProgram(misaligned).status == ProbeStatus::InvalidSize,
          "unaligned stream fails before instruction access");
    u32 unknown_opcode{};
    while (unknown_opcode < 4096 && FindOpcodeRow(unknown_opcode)) ++unknown_opcode;
    check(unknown_opcode < 4096, "table correctly leaves unrecognized opcodes");
    std::vector<u8> unknown;
    Append(unknown, unknown_opcode);
    auto unknown_result=ProbeProgram(unknown);
    check(unknown_result.status == ProbeStatus::UnknownOpcode &&
          unknown_result.first_problem_index == 0 &&
          unknown_result.first_problem_opcode == unknown_opcode,
          "unrecognized instruction must never be reported as supported");
    const auto* mov = FindOpcodeRow(0x202);
    check(mov && (mov->known[0] & (1U<<24)) == 0,
          "pinned ISA mask leaves documented MOV unknown upper bit");
    std::vector<u8> unreviewed;
    Append(unreviewed, 0x202, 1U<<24);
    const auto field = ProbeProgram(unreviewed);
    check(field.status == ProbeStatus::UnreviewedFields &&
          field.first_unknown_bit == 24 && field.unreviewed_fields == 1,
          "unreviewed ISA bit is reported, not silently accepted");
    std::vector<u8> too_big((65536U + 1) * 16U);
    check(ProbeProgram(too_big).status == ProbeStatus::TooManyInstructions,
          "hard cap bounds arbitrary executable blobs before parsing");
    std::puts("NS2 Ampere 128-bit ISA host probe: PASS (decode only)");
}
```

`tools/ns2/test_ampere_lower_bridge.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Compile against the REAL upstream Ampere->Maxwell lowerer. This does not
// execute shaders, games, Vulkan commands, or PS5 native code.
#include <array>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <vector>
#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/lower_bridge.h"
#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/lower_to_maxwell.h"
#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/maxwell_image.h"

using namespace Shader::Ampere;
static void check(bool value, const char* why) {
    if (!value) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "NS2 Ampere lowering FAIL: %s\n", why);
        std::exit(1);
    }
}
static void Emit(std::vector<u8>& dst, u32 word0, u32 word1 = 0,
                 u32 word2 = 0, u32 word3 = 0) {
    for (const u32 word : {word0, word1, word2, word3}) {
        for (unsigned b=0; b<4; ++b)
            dst.push_back(static_cast<u8>(word >> (b * 8)));
    }
}
int main() {
    constexpr u32 PredTrue = 7U << 12;
    constexpr u32 ExitCondTrue = 7U << 23;
    std::vector<u8> code;
    Emit(code, PredTrue | 0x918);                    // NOP
    Emit(code, PredTrue | 0x94d, 0, ExitCondTrue);   // EXIT
    const auto ok = LowerReviewedToMaxwell(code);
    check(ok.Ready() && ok.preflight.instructions == 2 &&
          ok.preflight.recognized == 2 && ok.preflight.control_flow == 1,
          "recognized NOP+EXIT really lowered through native Maxwell frontend");
    check(ok.consumed_native_bytes == code.size() &&
          ok.source_instruction_offsets.size() == 2 &&
          ok.maxwell_instructions.size() >= 2 &&
          ok.source_instruction_offsets[0] <= ok.source_instruction_offsets[1],
          "source offsets and complete input consumption survived lowering");
    check((ok.maxwell_instructions.back() & 0xff0000000000000fULL) ==
          (0xe30000000000000fULL & 0xff0000000000000fULL),
          "an actual Maxwell EXIT opcode was emitted");

    code.clear();
    Emit(code, PredTrue | 0x202 | (1U << 16), 2, 15U << 8); // MOV R1, R2
    Emit(code, PredTrue | 0x94d, 0, ExitCondTrue);
    const auto mov = LowerReviewedToMaxwell(code);
    check(mov.Ready() && mov.source_instruction_offsets.size() == 2 &&
          mov.maxwell_instructions.front() != 0 &&
          mov.maxwell_instructions.front() != ok.maxwell_instructions.front(),
          "real native MOV lowered into a non-NOP Maxwell move");

    code.resize(1);
    check(LowerReviewedToMaxwell(code).status == LowerBridgeStatus::InvalidInput,
          "partial native instruction rejected before parsing");
    code.clear();
    check(LowerReviewedToMaxwell(code).status == LowerBridgeStatus::InvalidInput,
          "empty shader rejected before lowering");
    // All three real Ampere owners have a 65536-instruction bound. A valid
    // 4097-word shader must not be stopped by a stale 4096-word ingress.
    code.clear();
    for (u32 index=0; index<4096; ++index)
        Emit(code, PredTrue | 0x918);
    Emit(code, PredTrue | 0x94d, 0, ExitCondTrue);
    const auto beyond_4k = LowerReviewedToMaxwell(code);
    check(beyond_4k.Ready() && beyond_4k.consumed_native_bytes == code.size() &&
          beyond_4k.source_instruction_offsets.size() == 4097,
          "complete native 4097-instruction shader reaches actual Maxwell lowering");
    // NVN's authenticated static ATEXIT destination may point past source
    // instruction 4096, but must stay inside the code currently captured.
    std::vector<Instruction> prologue(4098,
        Instruction{{PredTrue | 0x918, 0, 0, 0}});
    prologue[0] = Instruction{{0x0000734e, 0, 0, 0}};
    prologue[1] = Instruction{{0x00037802, 4097u*16, 0x00000f00, 0}};
    prologue[2] = Instruction{{0x00007210, 3, 0x07f1e0ff, 0}};
    prologue[3] = Instruction{{0xff017224, 0xff, 0x000e0401, 0}};
    prologue[4] = Instruction{{0x00007357, 0, 0, 0}};
    check(StaticAtExitTarget(prologue) == 4097,
          "valid ATEXIT handler beyond 4096 instructions accepted");
    prologue.pop_back();
    check(StaticAtExitTarget(prologue) == 4097,
          "five-instruction NVN prefix retains future target for GMMU capture");
    check(!LowerToMaxwell(prologue),
          "lowerer refuses ATEXIT target beyond authenticated source length");
    code.resize((65536U + 1) * 16U);
    check(LowerReviewedToMaxwell(code).status == LowerBridgeStatus::InvalidInput,
          "real 65536-instruction shader ingress limit enforced");

    code.clear();
    Emit(code, PredTrue | 0x202 | (1U << 16) | (1U << 24), 2, 15U << 8);
    Emit(code, PredTrue | 0x94d, 0, ExitCondTrue);
    const auto unknown_bits = LowerReviewedToMaxwell(code);
    check(unknown_bits.status == LowerBridgeStatus::UnreviewedFields &&
          unknown_bits.failed_native_byte_offset == 0 &&
          unknown_bits.maxwell_instructions.empty(),
          "unknown ISA fields must fail closed without fabricated output");

    u32 unknown_opcode = 0;
    while (unknown_opcode != 4096 && FindOpcodeRow(unknown_opcode))
        ++unknown_opcode;
    check(unknown_opcode != 4096, "ISA has deliberately unsupported opcodes");
    code.clear();
    Emit(code, PredTrue | unknown_opcode);
    Emit(code, PredTrue | 0x94d, 0, ExitCondTrue);
    const auto missing = LowerReviewedToMaxwell(code);
    check(missing.status == LowerBridgeStatus::UnrecognizedOpcode &&
          missing.maxwell_instructions.empty(),
          "unrecognized Ampere instruction never lowers via unknown fallback");

    code.clear();
    Emit(code, PredTrue | 0x918);
    const auto no_exit = LowerReviewedToMaxwell(code);
    check(no_exit.status == LowerBridgeStatus::UnsupportedSemantics &&
          no_exit.maxwell_instructions.empty() &&
          !no_exit.reason.empty(),
          "recognizable NOP is not a full executable without an EXIT");

    // P2.4: UISETP may combine its output with a distinct uniform
    // predicate, but must not spill/restore the six unrelated UP lanes.
    // The test executes the real native lowerer and inspects the emitted
    // Maxwell P2R/R2P mask bits, not a copied host-only policy function.
    const auto check_uniform_compare = [&](bool immediate, u32 condition,
                                           u32 output, u32 expected_mask) {
        const u32 word2 = (output << 17) | (7U << 20) |
                          (condition << 23) | (1U << 10);
        const std::array<Instruction,2> native{{
            Instruction{{PredTrue | (immediate ? 0x88cU : 0x28cU) | (2U << 24),
                         immediate ? 123U : 5U, word2, 0}},
            Instruction{{PredTrue | 0x94dU, 0U, ExitCondTrue, 0U}},
        }};
        const auto lowered = LowerToMaxwell(native);
        check(bool(lowered) && lowered.source_size == 32,
              "valid immediate UISETP reaches actual Ampere lowerer");
        std::vector<u32> saved, restored;
        for (const u64 word : lowered.instructions) {
            if ((word & 0xfff8000000000000ULL) == 0x38e8000000000000ULL)
                saved.push_back(static_cast<u32>((word >> 20) & 0x7f));
            if ((word & 0xfff8000000000000ULL) == 0x38f0000000000000ULL)
                restored.push_back(static_cast<u32>((word >> 20) & 0x7f));
        }
        check(saved.size() == 2 && saved[0] == expected_mask &&
              saved[1] == (1U << (6U - output)),
              "UISETP saves only the output and live combine predicate");
        check(restored.size() == (condition == 7 ? 1U : 2U) &&
              restored.back() == expected_mask &&
              (condition == 7 || restored.front() == (1U << (6U - condition))),
              "UISETP restores only affected UP lanes, preserving untouched predicates");
    };
    check_uniform_compare(true, 3U, 2U, (1U << 4) | (1U << 3));
    check_uniform_compare(true, 7U, 2U, 1U << 4);
    check_uniform_compare(false, 3U, 2U, (1U << 4) | (1U << 3));
    check_uniform_compare(false, 7U, 2U, 1U << 4);
    // Invalid predicate controls cannot use this reduced-save lowering.
    const std::array<Instruction,2> bad_uniform{{
        Instruction{{PredTrue | 0x88cU | (2U << 24), 123U,
                     (7U << 17) | (7U << 20) | (3U << 23) | (1U << 10), 0}},
        Instruction{{PredTrue | 0x94dU, 0U, ExitCondTrue, 0U}},
    }};
    check(!LowerToMaxwell(bad_uniform),
          "UISETP with forbidden output predicate must refuse lowering");

    // The unsigned UISETP/USEL clamp is only canonical for USEL condition
    // zero. For other conditions, the actual lowerer must emit its generic
    // uniform select rather than an unconditionally equivalent-looking IMNMX.
    for (const u32 select_condition : {0U, 1U, 4U}) {
        const std::array<Instruction,3> pair{{
            Instruction{{PredTrue | 0x88cU | (5U << 24), 127U,
                         0x0bf01070U | (select_condition << 17), 0U}},
            Instruction{{PredTrue | 0x887U | (2U << 16) | (5U << 24),
                         127U, 0x08000000U | (select_condition << 23), 0U}},
            Instruction{{PredTrue | 0x94dU, 0U, ExitCondTrue, 0U}},
        }};
        const auto lowered = LowerToMaxwell(pair);
        check(bool(lowered) && lowered.source_size == 48,
              "canonical and noncanonical uniform select lower successfully");
        bool fast_clamp = false, generic_select = false;
        for (const u64 word : lowered.instructions) {
            fast_clamp |= (word & 0xfff8000000000000ULL) ==
                          0x3820000000000000ULL;
            generic_select |= (word & 0xfff8000000000000ULL) ==
                              0x5ca0000000000000ULL;
        }
        check(fast_clamp == (select_condition == 0) &&
              generic_select == (select_condition != 0),
              "nonzero USEL condition must not accidentally execute clamp shortcut");
    }

    // A recognized native BRX table must lower to real, relocated Maxwell
    // conditional branches, not a Maxwell BRX with unconverted guest PCs.
    // The direct lowerer test does not authenticate CBUF residency; that is
    // the responsibility of the owning shader-capture front end.
    std::vector<Instruction> computed_program{
        Instruction{{PredTrue|0x949U|(6U<<24),0xfffffff0U,0x0383ffffU,0}},
        Instruction{{PredTrue|0x94dU,0,ExitCondTrue,0}},
        Instruction{{PredTrue|0x918U,0,0,0}},
        Instruction{{PredTrue|0x94dU,0,ExitCondTrue,0}},
    };
    NativeIndirectBranchPlan plan{
        .branch_instruction_index=0,
        .raw_pc_base=0x80U,
        .targets={{0x90U,1U},{0xb0U,3U}},
    };
    const auto expanded=LowerToMaxwell(
        computed_program,{},false,std::span<const NativeIndirectBranchPlan>{&plan,1});
    check(expanded && expanded.source_size==4*16 &&
          expanded.source_instruction_offsets.size()==4 &&
          expanded.instructions.size()>10,
          "native BRX emits branch-to-restoration stubs and consumes complete source");
    bool found_integer_equal=false, found_predicated_branch=false;
    bool found_predicate_save=false, found_predicate_restore=false;
    for (const u64 word : expanded.instructions) {
        found_integer_equal |= (word & 0xfff0000000000000ULL)==
                               0x5b60000000000000ULL &&
                               ((word>>49)&7U)==2U;
        found_predicated_branch |= (word & 0xfff000000007000fULL)==
                                   (0xe24000000006000fULL & 0xfff000000007000fULL);
        found_predicate_save |= (word & 0xfff8000000000000ULL)==0x38e8000000000000ULL;
        found_predicate_restore |= (word & 0xfff8000000000000ULL)==0x38f0000000000000ULL;
    }
    check(found_integer_equal && found_predicated_branch &&
          found_predicate_save && found_predicate_restore,
          "BRX dispatch compares actual native CBUF words and preserves P6");
    const std::array<u8,0x50> synthetic_header{};
    std::vector<u8> computed_bytes;
    for (const auto& instruction : computed_program)
        for (u32 word : instruction.words)
            for (u32 i=0;i<4;++i)
                computed_bytes.push_back(static_cast<u8>(word>>(i*8)));
    const auto resolved_image=BuildMaxwellShaderImage(
        synthetic_header,computed_bytes,4,
        std::span<const NativeIndirectBranchPlan>{&plan,1});
    const auto unresolved_image=BuildMaxwellShaderImage(
        synthetic_header,computed_bytes,4);
    check(!unresolved_image.Ready() &&
          LowerReviewedToMaxwell(computed_bytes).status==
              LowerBridgeStatus::UnsupportedSemantics,
          "raw native BRX cannot enter Maxwell CFG without checked CBUF plan");
    check(resolved_image.ValidForCompiler() &&
          resolved_image.consumed_native_bytes==computed_bytes.size() &&
          resolved_image.TranslateNativeAddress(0).has_value() &&
          resolved_image.TranslateNativeAddress(48).has_value() &&
          resolved_image.diagnostic_cache_key!=unresolved_image.diagnostic_cache_key,
          "resolved BRX produces bounded CFG image with distinct branch-table key");
    plan.targets[1].native_instruction_index=123;
    check(!LowerToMaxwell(
              computed_program,{},false,
              std::span<const NativeIndirectBranchPlan>{&plan,1}),
          "BRX targets outside captured shader must be rejected");
    plan.targets[1].native_instruction_index=3;
    plan.targets[1].native_value=plan.targets[0].native_value;
    check(!LowerToMaxwell(
              computed_program,{},false,
              std::span<const NativeIndirectBranchPlan>{&plan,1}),
          "one native BRX raw value cannot map to contradictory blocks");
    plan.targets[1].native_value=0xb0U;
    plan.raw_pc_base=0;
    check(!LowerToMaxwell(
              computed_program,{},false,
              std::span<const NativeIndirectBranchPlan>{&plan,1}),
          "header-relative CBUF PC must not be accepted as code-relative");
    plan.raw_pc_base=0x80U;
    plan.targets[1].native_value=0xa0U;
    check(!LowerToMaxwell(
              computed_program,{},false,
              std::span<const NativeIndirectBranchPlan>{&plan,1}),
          "BRX expected native PC must agree with index plus header origin");
    plan.targets[1].native_value=0xb0U;
    plan.branch_instruction_index=2;
    check(!LowerToMaxwell(
              computed_program,{},false,
              std::span<const NativeIndirectBranchPlan>{&plan,1}),
          "native BRX dispatch plan cannot be attached to a non-branch opcode");

    // An unknown NOP field is rejected before the lowerer sees it.
    code.clear();
    Emit(code, PredTrue | 0x918, 1);
    check(LowerReviewedToMaxwell(code).status == LowerBridgeStatus::UnreviewedFields,
          "extra unreviewed words cannot slip through translation");

    std::puts("NS2 Ampere->Maxwell lowering: PASS (host translation only)");
}
```

`tools/ns2/test_ampere_maxwell_cfg.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Execute actual Eden Maxwell CFG and the NS2 IR handoff ABI.
// TranslateProgram is an explicit link-time SPY here, NOT the maintained IR compiler.
// Synthetic NOP/MOV/EXIT only; no copyrighted game shader or GPU execution.
#include <array>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <memory>
#include <vector>
#include "common/logging.h"
#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/maxwell_environment.h"
#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/maxwell/control_flow.h"
#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/ir_bridge.h"
#include "shader_recompiler/host_translate_info.h"
#include <stdexcept>

// Link only the CFG and decoder, not the full emulator's logging runtime.
// Never let a decoder assertion or log event count as a passing fixture.
void AssertFailSoftImpl() { std::abort(); }
namespace Common::Log {
void FmtLogMessageImpl(Class, Level, const char*, unsigned int,
                       const char*, fmt::string_view, const fmt::format_args&) {
    std::abort();
}
} // namespace Common::Log

using namespace Shader::Ampere;
static void Require(bool pass, const char* reason) {
    if (!pass) { std::fprintf(stderr, "NS2 Maxwell CFG: %s\n", reason); std::exit(1); }
}
struct NativeSource final : Shader::Environment {
    explicit NativeSource(Shader::Stage shader_stage = Shader::Stage::VertexB) {
        stage=shader_stage;
        start_address=0;
    }
    u64 ReadInstruction(u32) override {
        // The real CFG must NEVER decode the raw native Ampere instruction.
        std::abort();
    }
    u32 ReadCbufValue(u32,u32) override { return 0; }
    Shader::TextureType ReadTextureType(u32) override { return {}; }
    Shader::TexturePixelFormat ReadTexturePixelFormat(u32) override { return {}; }
    bool IsTexturePixelFormatInteger(u32) override { return false; }
    u32 ReadViewportTransformState() override { return 0; }
    u32 TextureBoundBuffer() const override { return 0; }
    u32 LocalMemorySize() const override { return 0; }
    u32 SharedMemorySize() const override { return 0; }
    std::array<u32,3> WorkgroupSize() const override { return {}; }
    bool HasHLEMacroState() const override { return false; }
    std::optional<Shader::ReplaceConstant> GetReplaceConstBuffer(u32,u32) override { return {}; }
    void Dump(u64,u64) override { std::abort(); }
};
static void Emit(std::vector<u8>& v,u32 a,u32 b=0,u32 c=0,u32 d=0) {
    for (u32 w : {a,b,c,d})
        for (u32 shift=0;shift<32;shift+=8)
            v.push_back(static_cast<u8>(w>>shift));
}

namespace {
// Deliberate stub, allowing actual TranslateReviewedGraphicsIR + CFG to be
// executed independently of the hundreds of maintained IR translation units.
Shader::Environment* expected_env{};
bool expected_dispatcher{};
u32 calls{};
}
namespace Shader::Maxwell {
Shader::IR::Program TranslateProgram(
    Shader::ObjectPool<Shader::IR::Inst>&,
    Shader::ObjectPool<Shader::IR::Block>&,
    Shader::Environment& actual,
    Shader::Maxwell::Flow::CFG& cfg,
    const Shader::HostTranslateInfo& info) {
    Require(&actual == expected_env &&
            cfg.ExitsToDispatcher() == expected_dispatcher &&
            !cfg.Functions().empty() &&
            cfg.Functions().front().entrypoint.Offset() == 0x50 &&
            info.min_ssbo_alignment == 64,
            "bridge passes actual Maxwell CFG, owned environment and host info");
    ++calls;
    Shader::IR::Program sentinel{};
    sentinel.stage = actual.ShaderStage();
    return sentinel;
}
} // namespace Shader::Maxwell

int main() {
    std::array<u8,0x50> header{};
    constexpr u32 pt=7U<<12, exit_true=7U<<23;
    std::vector<u8> native;
    Emit(native,pt|0x918);                        // NOP
    Emit(native,pt|0x202|(1U<<16),2,15U<<8);    // MOV R1,R2
    Emit(native,pt|0x918);                        // NOP, crosses scheduling slot
    Emit(native,pt|0x918);                        // NOP
    Emit(native,pt|0x94d,0,exit_true);            // unconditional EXIT
    auto translated=BuildMaxwellShaderImage(
        header,native,static_cast<u32>(Shader::Stage::VertexB));
    Require(translated.ValidForCompiler() &&
            translated.ReadMaxwellInstruction(0x50).has_value() &&
            !translated.ReadMaxwellInstruction(0x60).has_value(),
            "translated synthetic graphics program must be well formed");
    auto env=NativeMaxwellEnvironment::CreateOwned(
        std::make_unique<NativeSource>(),std::move(translated));
    Require(env && env->StartAddress()==0,
            "owned source metadata and start address must be coherent");
    for (bool dispatcher : {false,true}) {
        Shader::ObjectPool<Shader::Maxwell::Flow::Block> blocks{64};
        Shader::Maxwell::Flow::CFG cfg{
            *env,blocks,static_cast<u32>(env->StartAddress()+sizeof(Shader::ProgramHeader)),dispatcher};
        Require(cfg.ExitsToDispatcher()==dispatcher && !cfg.Functions().empty(),
                "real Maxwell CFG decoded reviewed native translation");
        const auto& first=cfg.Functions().front();
        Require(first.entrypoint.Offset()==0x50 && !first.blocks.empty(),
                "real CFG begins after the SPH, not at the native header");
        bool saw_exit=false;
        for (const auto& block : first.blocks) {
            if (block.end_class==Shader::Maxwell::Flow::EndClass::Exit ||
                (dispatcher && block.end_class==Shader::Maxwell::Flow::EndClass::Branch))
                saw_exit=true;
        }
        Require(saw_exit,"translated EXIT yields a terminating CFG edge");
    }
    Shader::HostTranslateInfo host{};
    host.min_ssbo_alignment = 64;
    expected_env = env.get();
    Shader::ObjectPool<Shader::IR::Inst> inst_pool{4};
    Shader::ObjectPool<Shader::IR::Block> block_pool{4};
    Shader::ObjectPool<Shader::Maxwell::Flow::Block> flow_pool{64};
    for (bool dispatcher : {false, true}) {
        expected_dispatcher = dispatcher;
        auto sentinel = TranslateReviewedGraphicsIR(
            inst_pool, block_pool, flow_pool, *env, host, dispatcher);
        Require(sentinel.stage == Shader::Stage::VertexB,
                "IR bridge calls the supplied compiler interface");
    }
    Require(calls == 2, "VertexB IR bridge invoked once per dispatcher mode");
    // Standalone Fragment uses the very same real Maxwell CFG and IR handoff,
    // without pretending it is VertexB or inventing pipeline attachment data.
    auto fragment_image=BuildMaxwellShaderImage(
        header,native,static_cast<u32>(Shader::Stage::Fragment));
    Require(fragment_image.ValidForCompiler(),
            "Fragment native translation must contain a complete shader");
    auto fragment_env=NativeMaxwellEnvironment::CreateOwned(
        std::make_unique<NativeSource>(Shader::Stage::Fragment),
        std::move(fragment_image));
    Require(fragment_env && fragment_env->ShaderStage()==Shader::Stage::Fragment,
            "Fragment metadata must survive native Maxwell environment");
    expected_env=fragment_env.get();
    for (bool dispatcher:{false,true}) {
        expected_dispatcher=dispatcher;
        Shader::ObjectPool<Shader::IR::Inst> fragment_inst{4};
        Shader::ObjectPool<Shader::IR::Block> fragment_blocks{4};
        Shader::ObjectPool<Shader::Maxwell::Flow::Block> fragment_flow{64};
        auto program=TranslateReviewedGraphicsIR(
            fragment_inst,fragment_blocks,fragment_flow,*fragment_env,host,dispatcher);
        Require(program.stage==Shader::Stage::Fragment,
                "Fragment must retain its stage into the actual Maxwell CFG/IR handoff");
    }
    Require(calls==4,"VertexB and Fragment must each reach CFG/IR exactly twice");
    // A pretranslated native image must never smuggle Compute/QMD or
    // an unknown stage into the graphics Maxwell compiler.
    auto compute_image=BuildMaxwellShaderImage(
        header,native,static_cast<u32>(Shader::Stage::Compute));
    Require(compute_image.ValidForCompiler(), "compute image is structurally valid");
    Require(!NativeMaxwellEnvironment::CreateOwned(
                std::make_unique<NativeSource>(Shader::Stage::Compute),
                std::move(compute_image)),
            "Compute stage rejected before GPU IR bridge");
    auto unknown_image=BuildMaxwellShaderImage(header,native,0xffffffffU);
    Require(!NativeMaxwellEnvironment::CreateOwned(
                std::make_unique<NativeSource>(static_cast<Shader::Stage>(0xffffffffU)),
                std::move(unknown_image)),
            "Unknown stage rejected before GPU IR bridge");
    // P2.4: an authenticated native BRX dispatch expands into compares,
    // predicate-preserving stubs and native-PC -> Maxwell-PC relocations.
    // Run it through the REAL Maxwell CFG, not only the source/image oracle.
    std::vector<u8> indirect_native;
    Emit(indirect_native,pt|0x817U|(4U<<16),15U,0x03800000U); // bounded index
    Emit(indirect_native,pt|0x819U|(5U<<16)|(4U<<24),2U,0x000006ffU);
    Emit(indirect_native,pt|0xb82U|(6U<<16)|(5U<<24),
         (7U<<22)|(0xffc0U<<6),0x00000800U);       // LDC CBUF[7]
    Emit(indirect_native,pt|0x949U|(6U<<24),0xffffffc0U,0x0383ffffU); // BRX
    Emit(indirect_native,pt|0x94dU,0,exit_true);    // first EXIT
    for (u32 i=0;i<4;++i) Emit(indirect_native,pt|0x918U);
    Emit(indirect_native,pt|0x94dU,0,exit_true);    // post-EXIT target
    NativeIndirectBranchPlan indirect_plan{};
    indirect_plan.branch_instruction_index=3;
    indirect_plan.raw_pc_base=0x80U;
    indirect_plan.targets={{0x80U,0U},{0x100U,8U}};
    auto indirect_image=BuildMaxwellShaderImage(
        header,indirect_native,static_cast<u32>(Shader::Stage::VertexB),
        std::span<const NativeIndirectBranchPlan>{&indirect_plan,1});
    Require(indirect_image.ValidForCompiler() &&
            indirect_image.TranslateNativeAddress(0).has_value() &&
            indirect_image.TranslateNativeAddress(8*16).has_value(),
            "real checked BRX lowering must produce exact runnable address map");
    auto indirect_env=NativeMaxwellEnvironment::CreateOwned(
        std::make_unique<NativeSource>(),std::move(indirect_image));
    Require(bool(indirect_env),"real BRX image admitted to Maxwell environment");
    for (bool dispatcher:{false,true}) {
        Shader::ObjectPool<Shader::Maxwell::Flow::Block> branch_blocks{128};
        Shader::Maxwell::Flow::CFG branch_cfg{
            *indirect_env,branch_blocks,
            static_cast<u32>(indirect_env->StartAddress()+sizeof(Shader::ProgramHeader)),
            dispatcher};
        Require(!branch_cfg.Functions().empty() &&
                !branch_cfg.Functions().front().blocks.empty(),
                "real Maxwell CFG accepts checked BRX compare/stub dispatch");
    }
    std::puts("NS2 actual Maxwell CFG and IR handoff ABI: PASS "
              "(BRX relocations checked; TranslateProgram spy, no Vulkan execution)");
}
```
