`tools/ns2/test_ampere_maxwell_environment.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Host validation of the *real* Shader::Environment virtual API used by
// Eden's Maxwell CFG and shader IR compiler (without a PS5 GPU).
#include <array>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <type_traits>
#include <memory>
#include <vector>
#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/maxwell_environment.h"

using namespace Shader::Ampere;
static void Check(bool condition, const char* why) {
    if (!condition) { std::fprintf(stderr,"NS2 shader environment FAIL: %s\n",why); std::exit(1); }
}
struct FakeMaxwellEnvironment final : Shader::Environment {
    u32 cbuf_reads{};
    u32 texture_reads{};
    u32 dumped{};
    int* destroyed{};
    ~FakeMaxwellEnvironment() override {
        if (destroyed) ++*destroyed;
    }
    explicit FakeMaxwellEnvironment(
        Shader::Stage selected=Shader::Stage::VertexB) {
        stage=selected;
        start_address=0x50;
        gp_passthrough_mask[0]=0xa5a5;
        is_proprietary_driver=true;
    }
    u64 ReadInstruction(u32) override { std::abort(); }
    u32 ReadCbufValue(u32 index,u32 offset) override {
        ++cbuf_reads; return index*256+offset;
    }
    Shader::TextureType ReadTextureType(u32) override {
        ++texture_reads; return Shader::TextureType{};
    }
    Shader::TexturePixelFormat ReadTexturePixelFormat(u32) override {
        return Shader::TexturePixelFormat{};
    }
    bool IsTexturePixelFormatInteger(u32) override {return true;}
    u32 ReadViewportTransformState() override {return 7;}
    u32 TextureBoundBuffer() const override {return 9;}
    u32 LocalMemorySize() const override {return 1024;}
    u32 SharedMemorySize() const override {return 2048;}
    std::array<u32,3> WorkgroupSize() const override {return {2,4,8};}
    bool HasHLEMacroState() const override {return true;}
    std::optional<Shader::ReplaceConstant> GetReplaceConstBuffer(u32,u32) override {
        return {};
    }
    void Dump(u64,u64) override {++dumped;}
};
static void Emit(std::vector<u8>& code,u32 w0,u32 w1=0,u32 w2=0,u32 w3=0) {
    for(u32 word:{w0,w1,w2,w3})
        for(u32 k=0;k!=4;++k) code.push_back(static_cast<u8>(word>>(k*8)));
}
int main() {
    static_assert(std::is_base_of_v<Shader::Environment,NativeMaxwellEnvironment>);
    std::array<u8,0x50> hdr{};
    std::vector<u8> native;
    constexpr u32 true_pred=7u<<12, exit_true=7u<<23;
    Emit(native,true_pred|0x918);
    Emit(native,true_pred|0x94d,0,exit_true);
    FakeMaxwellEnvironment fake;
    auto env=NativeMaxwellEnvironment::Create(
        fake, BuildMaxwellShaderImage(hdr,native,static_cast<u32>(Shader::Stage::VertexB)));
    Check(env && env->StartAddress()==0 &&
          env->StartAddress()+sizeof(Shader::ProgramHeader)==0x50 &&
          env->ShaderStage()==fake.ShaderStage() &&
          env->GpPassthroughMask()==fake.GpPassthroughMask() &&
          env->IsProprietaryDriver(),
          "real Maxwell compiler CFG start and environment metadata match graphics pipeline");
    Check(env->ReadInstruction(0x50)==env->Image().code[0x50/8] &&
          env->ReadInstruction(0x58)==env->Image().code[0x58/8],
          "native instruction stream fed to Maxwell ReadInstruction virtual");
    for (u32 bad:{0u,0x48u,0x60u,0xfffffffcU,env->Image().instruction_end_address}) {
        bool rejected=false;
        try { (void)env->ReadInstruction(bad); }
        catch (const std::out_of_range&) { rejected=true; }
        Check(rejected,"scheduler, header and metadata cannot reach Maxwell decoder");
    }
    auto compute_image=BuildMaxwellShaderImage(
        hdr,native,static_cast<u32>(Shader::Stage::Compute));
    auto compute_env=NativeMaxwellEnvironment::CreateComputeOwned(
        std::make_unique<FakeMaxwellEnvironment>(Shader::Stage::Compute),
        std::move(compute_image));
    Check(compute_env && compute_env->StartAddress()==0x50 &&
          compute_env->ShaderStage()==Shader::Stage::Compute &&
          compute_env->ReadInstruction(0x50)==env->ReadInstruction(0x50) &&
          compute_env->WorkgroupSize()==std::array<u32,3>{2,4,8},
          "QMD Compute environment starts at synthetic Maxwell code, not SPH");
    Check(!NativeMaxwellEnvironment::CreateComputeOwned(
          std::make_unique<FakeMaxwellEnvironment>(),
          BuildMaxwellShaderImage(hdr,native,static_cast<u32>(Shader::Stage::Compute))),
          "graphics source cannot impersonate authenticated Compute QMD");
    Check(env->ReadCbufValue(2,7)==519 &&
          fake.cbuf_reads==1 &&
          env->IsTexturePixelFormatInteger(5) &&
          env->ReadViewportTransformState()==7 &&
          env->TextureBoundBuffer()==9 &&
          env->LocalMemorySize()==1024 &&
          env->SharedMemorySize()==2048 &&
          env->WorkgroupSize()[2]==8 &&
          env->HasHLEMacroState() &&
          !env->GetReplaceConstBuffer(0,0),
          "actual compiler environment virtual methods delegate metadata and CBUF");
    (void)env->ReadTextureType(3);
    (void)env->ReadTexturePixelFormat(3);
    Check(fake.texture_reads==1, "texture metadata delegated");
    env->Dump(1,2);
    Check(fake.dumped==0,"NS2 image never dumps using a Switch 1 guest shader identity");
    Check(!NativeMaxwellEnvironment::Create(
              fake, BuildMaxwellShaderImage(hdr,native,
                  static_cast<u32>(Shader::Stage::Fragment))),
          "stage-mismatched image cannot borrow shader compilation context");
    auto forged=BuildMaxwellShaderImage(
        hdr,native,static_cast<u32>(Shader::Stage::VertexB));
    forged.cached_highest_address+=8;
    Check(!NativeMaxwellEnvironment::Create(fake,std::move(forged)),
          "corrupted image extent never reaches Maxwell CFG");
    Check(!NativeMaxwellEnvironment::Create(fake,MaxwellShaderImage{}),
          "invalid/untranslated image cannot enter existing Maxwell compiler");
    std::array<u8,0x50> unrelated_header{};
    unrelated_header[0] = 0x38;
    Check(!NativeMaxwellEnvironment::Create(
              fake, BuildMaxwellShaderImage(unrelated_header,native,static_cast<u32>(Shader::Stage::VertexB))),
          "captured shader header must match the compiler's original SPH");
    int mismatch_destroyed = 0;
    auto mismatch_source = std::make_unique<FakeMaxwellEnvironment>();
    mismatch_source->destroyed = &mismatch_destroyed;
    Check(!NativeMaxwellEnvironment::CreateOwned(
              std::move(mismatch_source),
              BuildMaxwellShaderImage(unrelated_header,native,static_cast<u32>(Shader::Stage::VertexB))) &&
          mismatch_destroyed == 1,
          "mismatched owned GPU context is rejected and released before return");
    // Real shader caches defer IR compilation: a borrowed stack environment
    // would dangle after the surrounding renderer method returns. The new
    // ownership path must keep the source alive until the wrapper is freed.
    int destroyed = 0;
    auto source = std::make_unique<FakeMaxwellEnvironment>();
    source->destroyed = &destroyed;
    auto* live_source = source.get();
    {
        auto owned = NativeMaxwellEnvironment::CreateOwned(
            std::move(source),BuildMaxwellShaderImage(hdr,native,static_cast<u32>(Shader::Stage::VertexB)));
        Check(!source && owned && destroyed==0,
              "ownership transferred to native environment wrapper");
        Check(owned->ReadCbufValue(3,2)==770 &&
              live_source->cbuf_reads==1 &&
              owned->ShaderStage()==Shader::Stage::VertexB &&
              owned->StartAddress()+sizeof(Shader::ProgramHeader)==0x50,
              "owned original is alive for deferred compiler CBUF queries");
    }
    Check(destroyed==1, "original graphics environment destroyed exactly once");
    int invalid_destroyed = 0;
    auto invalid_source = std::make_unique<FakeMaxwellEnvironment>();
    invalid_source->destroyed = &invalid_destroyed;
    // C++ permits a by-value function parameter to be destroyed at the
    // end of its enclosing full expression (rather than before the logical
    // && rhs). Keep the lifetime assertion in a distinct full expression.
    auto rejected = NativeMaxwellEnvironment::CreateOwned(
        std::move(invalid_source), MaxwellShaderImage{});
    Check(!rejected, "invalid image cannot publish a Maxwell environment");
    Check(invalid_destroyed == 1,
          "failed image construction releases its guest graphics context");
    Check(!NativeMaxwellEnvironment::CreateOwned(
              {},BuildMaxwellShaderImage(hdr,native,static_cast<u32>(Shader::Stage::VertexB))),
          "null source cannot publish an executable shader environment");
    std::puts("NS2 Maxwell Shader::Environment bridge: PASS");
}
```

`tools/ns2/test_ampere_maxwell_image.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Maxwell guest-environment image ABI tests (real Ampere lowerer underneath).
#include <array>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <vector>
#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/maxwell_image.h"
#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/program_address_map.h"
using namespace Shader::Ampere;

static void require(bool ok, const char* why) {
    if (!ok) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "NS2 Maxwell image FAIL: %s\n", why);
        std::exit(1);
    }
}
static void Emit(std::vector<u8>& dest, u32 a, u32 b=0, u32 c=0, u32 d=0) {
    for (const u32 word : {a,b,c,d})
        for (u32 shift=0; shift!=32; shift+=8)
            dest.push_back(static_cast<u8>(word >> shift));
}
int main() {
    constexpr u32 pt = 7U << 12;
    constexpr u32 unconditional = 7U << 23;
    std::array<u8,0x50> header{};
    header[0] = 0x38;
    std::vector<u8> code;
    Emit(code,pt|0x918);                         // NOP
    Emit(code,pt|0x202|(1U<<16),2,15U<<8);      // MOV R1,R2
    Emit(code,pt|0x918);                         // NOP
    Emit(code,pt|0x918);                         // NOP
    Emit(code,pt|0x94d,0,unconditional);        // EXIT

    auto image = BuildMaxwellShaderImage(header,code,4);
    require(image.Ready() && image.ValidForCompiler() &&
            image.native_stage == 4 && image.lowering_status == LowerBridgeStatus::Ready,
            "real NOP/MOV/EXIT lowering and Maxwell image created");
    require(image.code.size() > 0x50/8 &&
            image.code[0] == 0x38 &&
            image.code[1] == 0,
            "preserve 0x50 byte guest Maxwell shader header");
    require(image.first_instruction_address == 0x50 &&
            image.instruction_end_address <= image.cached_highest_address,
            "respect Maxwell initial offset and valid cached extent");
    require(HasNativeAddressMap(image.code) &&
            image.TranslateNativeAddress(0).has_value() &&
            *image.TranslateNativeAddress(0) == 0x50,
            "native instruction zero maps after 0x50 header");
    require(image.TranslateNativeAddress(16).has_value() &&
            *image.TranslateNativeAddress(16) == 0x58,
            "second native program address resolves without scheduler word");
    require(image.TranslateNativeAddress(32).has_value() &&
            *image.TranslateNativeAddress(32) == 0x68,
            "third native address jumps over scheduler word at 0x60");
    for (u32 native = 0; native < image.consumed_native_bytes; native += 16) {
        const auto absolute = image.TranslateNativeAddress(native);
        require(absolute.has_value() && image.ReadMaxwellInstruction(*absolute).has_value(),
                "each native instruction address corresponds to executable Maxwell word");
        require(*absolute < image.instruction_end_address && *absolute >= 0x50 &&
                *absolute % 32 != 0, "address map never references schedule words or metadata");
    }
    require(!image.ReadMaxwellInstruction(0x60) &&
            !image.ReadMaxwellInstruction(0) &&
            !image.ReadMaxwellInstruction(image.instruction_end_address) &&
            !image.TranslateNativeAddress(1) &&
            !image.TranslateNativeAddress(0xfffffff0),
            "invalid/unaligned/end addresses rejected before code access");

    auto corrupted=image;
    corrupted.code[corrupted.code.size()-2]=65536;
    require(!corrupted.ValidForCompiler(), "forged native address-map length rejected");
    corrupted=image;
    corrupted.code.back()=0;
    require(!corrupted.ValidForCompiler(), "missing map magic rejected");
    corrupted=image;
    corrupted.code[corrupted.code.size()-4]=corrupted.instruction_end_address;
    require(!corrupted.ValidForCompiler(), "map cannot target appended metadata");
    corrupted=image;
    corrupted.cached_highest_address+=8;
    require(!corrupted.ValidForCompiler(), "cached extent mismatch rejected");
    corrupted=image;
    corrupted.instruction_end_address=0xffffffffU;
    require(!corrupted.ValidForCompiler(), "forged instruction limit rejected");
    require(!corrupted.ReadMaxwellInstruction(0xfffffff8U),
            "untrusted instruction offset never reads beyond allocation");
    auto repeat=BuildMaxwellShaderImage(header,code,4);
    require(repeat.Ready() && repeat.code == image.code &&
            repeat.diagnostic_cache_key == image.diagnostic_cache_key,
            "same shader/header/stage yields bit-identical deterministic image");
    auto other_stage=BuildMaxwellShaderImage(header,code,5);
    require(other_stage.Ready() &&
            other_stage.diagnostic_cache_key != image.diagnostic_cache_key,
            "shader cache identity isolates native shader stages");
    header[0] ^= 1;
    auto other_header=BuildMaxwellShaderImage(header,code,4);
    require(other_header.Ready() &&
            other_header.diagnostic_cache_key != image.diagnostic_cache_key,
            "native shader identity depends on original guest header");
    header[0] ^= 1;
    std::array<u8,0x4f> truncated_header{};
    require(BuildMaxwellShaderImage(truncated_header,code,4).status ==
                MaxwellImageStatus::InvalidHeader,
            "must not reinterpret arbitrary guest header sizes");
    std::vector<u8> bad_source={0,1,2};
    const auto invalid=BuildMaxwellShaderImage(header,bad_source,4);
    require(invalid.status == MaxwellImageStatus::LoweringFailed &&
            invalid.code.empty() &&
            invalid.diagnostic_cache_key == 0,
            "rejected guest shader cannot poison or populate Maxwell cache");

    const std::array<u8,16> no_exit{0x18,0x79};
    const auto unsupported=BuildMaxwellShaderImage(header,no_exit,4);
    require(unsupported.status == MaxwellImageStatus::LoweringFailed &&
            unsupported.code.empty(),
            "missing EXIT is never represented as translated shader");
    require(!NativeProgramAddress(std::span<const u64>{},0),
            "empty shader code cannot resolve a native branch");
    std::puts("NS2 Ampere->Maxwell shader image: PASS (no PS5 GPU execution)");
}
```

`tools/ns2/test_ampere_native_register_shadow.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Host proof over the production Ampere high-GPR spill/rewrite owner.
// Only register descriptors differ; no per-title exception or GPU mock.
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdio>
#include <vector>
#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/register_pressure.h"
#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/lower_to_maxwell.h"

using namespace Shader::Ampere;
struct Fixture {
    u32 opcode;
    std::vector<u32> operands;
};
int main() {
    const std::vector<Fixture> fixtures{
        {0x919,{16}},             // S2R high destination
        {0x80b,{24}},            // predicate compare source
        {0x20b,{24,32}},         // register predicate compare
        {0x820,{16,24}},         // FMUL high destination/source
        {0x220,{16,24,32}},      // FMUL register multiplier (Lichii #56)
        {0x421,{16,24}},         // FADD with constant operand
        {0x208,{16,24,32}},      // bitwise/floating SEL
        {0x221,{16,24,32}},      // FADD register
        {0x817,{16,24}},         // IMNMX immediate, not word1 as GPR
        {0x223,{16,24,32,64}},   // FFMA has a third source
        {0x245,{16,32}},         // I2FP register input
        {0x823,{16,24,64}},      // FFMA other source mode
        {0x381,{16,24}},         // LDG.E register address pair
        {0x386,{24,32}},         // STG.E register data and address pair
        {0x981,{16,24}},         // uniform-address LDG
        {0x986,{24,32}},         // uniform-address STG
        {0x3a8,{16,24,32}},     // GPR-address ATOMG old value, address pair
        {0x9a8,{16,32}},        // uniform-pointer ATOMG high data/output
        {0x98e,{24,32}},       // RED: 64-bit register address + 32-bit data
    };
    for (const auto& fixture : fixtures) {
        Instruction original{{fixture.opcode | (252U<<16) | (248U<<24),
                              252U, 248U, 0U}};
        const auto translated = PrepareRegisterPressure(original, 216);
        assert(translated.valid);
        assert(!translated.prefix.empty());
        assert(translated.prefix.size() == translated.suffix.size());
        assert(translated.prefix.size() % 8U == 0);
        std::array<u32,4> masks{};
        for (const u32 field : fixture.operands) {
            masks[field / 32] |= 255U << (field % 32);
            const u32 before = original.Bits(field,8);
            const u32 after = translated.instruction.Bits(field,8);
            assert(before >= 216 && before < 255);
            assert(after < 216);
            assert((after & 3U) == (before & 3U));
        }
        for (u32 i=0;i<4;++i)
            assert((translated.instruction.words[i] & ~masks[i]) ==
                   (original.words[i] & ~masks[i]));
        // A non-high GPR instruction must not create any scratch traffic.
        Instruction low=original;
        for (const u32 field:fixture.operands)
            low.words[field/32] = (low.words[field/32] &
                   ~(255U << (field%32))) | (u32{32} << (field%32));
        const auto untouched=PrepareRegisterPressure(low,216);
        assert(untouched.valid && untouched.prefix.empty() &&
               untouched.suffix.empty());
    }
    // Test an actual captured Ampere load with high GPRs under the
    // native Maxwell scratch limit (the default no-uniform limit is 250).
    constexpr Instruction UniformMarker{{0x00007918,0,0,0x000fea00}};
    constexpr Instruction Exit{{0x0000794d,0,0x03800000,0x000fea00}};
    const std::array captured{
        UniformMarker,
        Instruction{{0x46fa7381,0x00003000,0x001e8900,0x00013400}},
        Exit
    };
    const auto lowered=LowerToMaxwell(captured,{},true);
    if (!lowered) std::fprintf(stderr,"Captured LDG lowerer refused: %.*s\n",
                                static_cast<int>(lowered.error.size()), lowered.error.data());
    assert(lowered && !lowered.instructions.empty() &&
           lowered.source_instruction_offsets.size()==captured.size());
    assert(lowered.source_instruction_offsets[2] >= 17); // prefix + LDG + suffix
    // An aligned high-register quartet can be borrowed safely.
    Instruction aligned{{0x381U | (220U<<16) | (32U<<24),
                         0U,6U<<9,0U}};
    const auto aligned_result = PrepareRegisterPressure(aligned,216);
    assert(aligned_result.valid && !aligned_result.prefix.empty());
    assert(aligned_result.instruction.Bits(16,8) < 216);
    // A vector encoded by one base register must not span from a low
    // register into a borrowed high quartet. Nor can two non-contiguous
    // high scratch quartets masquerade as one contiguous register vector.
    Instruction straddles_reserved{{0x381U | (215U<<16) | (32U<<24),
                                   0U,5U<<9,0U}};
    Instruction straddles_borrowed{{0x381U | (219U<<16) | (32U<<24),
                                   0U,5U<<9,0U}};
    assert(NativeVectorCrossesScratch(straddles_reserved,216));
    assert(!PrepareRegisterPressure(straddles_reserved,216).valid);
    assert(!PrepareRegisterPressure(straddles_borrowed,216).valid);
    // Exercise the real lowerer, whose default no-uniform scratch boundary
    // is 248, not the synthetic 216 used by the standalone spill fixture.
    // A low vector base must never escape the scalar pre-check.
    Instruction straddles_runtime{{0x381U | (247U<<16) | (32U<<24),
                                   0U,5U<<9,0U}};
    assert(NativeVectorCrossesScratch(straddles_runtime,248));
    const std::array crossing_program{UniformMarker,straddles_runtime,Exit};
    const auto crossing_lowered=LowerToMaxwell(crossing_program,{},true);
    assert(!crossing_lowered &&
           crossing_lowered.error == "native register shadowing mode");
    // Vector loads must reject an overflowing high-register quartet.
    Instruction overflowing{{0x381U | (252U<<16) | (248U<<24),
                             0U,6U<<9,0U}};
    assert(!PrepareRegisterPressure(overflowing,216).valid);
    // A native global atomic must never read the synthetic Maxwell
    // uniform-bank scratch register as its GPR source. An atomically
    // shadowed 32-bit data value and destination are borrowed to low
    // aligned quartets, with the original registers restored afterward.
    // Covers both the true register address pair and uniform pointer
    // forms. No per-game or per-shader exception is used.
    constexpr Instruction AtomGpr{{
        0x3a8U | (7U << 12) | (244U << 16) | (250U << 24),
        252U,
        0x001ee100U,
        0U
    }};
    constexpr Instruction AtomUniform{{
        0x9a8U | (7U << 12) | (244U << 16) | (255U << 24),
        240U,
        0x081ee140U | 2U,
        0U
    }};
    for (const auto atom : {AtomGpr, AtomUniform}) {
        const bool uniform_pointer = atom.Bits(0,12) == 0x9a8;
        const u32 boundary = uniform_pointer ? 216U : 248U;
        const auto pressure = PrepareRegisterPressure(atom, boundary);
        assert(pressure.valid && !pressure.prefix.empty() &&
               pressure.prefix.size() == pressure.suffix.size());
        assert(pressure.instruction.Bits(16,8) < boundary);
        assert(pressure.instruction.Bits(32,8) < boundary);
        if (uniform_pointer) {
            assert(pressure.instruction.Bits(64,6) == 2);
        } else {
            assert(pressure.instruction.Bits(24,8) < boundary);
            assert((pressure.instruction.Bits(24,8) & 1U) == 0);
            assert(!NativeVectorCrossesScratch(pressure.instruction,boundary));
        }
        const std::array program{UniformMarker,atom,Exit};
        const auto lowered=LowerToMaxwell(program,{},true);
        if (!lowered)
            std::fprintf(stderr,"Atomic lowering refused: %.*s at %#x\n",
                static_cast<int>(lowered.error.size()),lowered.error.data(),
                lowered.error_offset);
        assert(lowered && lowered.source_size == sizeof(program));
        const auto begin=lowered.source_instruction_offsets[1];
        const auto end=lowered.source_instruction_offsets[2];
        assert(end > begin+pressure.prefix.size() &&
               end >= begin+pressure.prefix.size()+pressure.suffix.size()+1);
        assert(std::equal(pressure.prefix.begin(), pressure.prefix.end(),
                          lowered.instructions.begin()+begin));
        const u64 actual_atom=lowered.instructions[begin+pressure.prefix.size()];
        assert((actual_atom & 0xff00000000000000ULL)==0xed00000000000000ULL);
        assert((actual_atom & 0xffU)==pressure.instruction.Bits(16,8));
        assert(((actual_atom>>20)&0xffU)==pressure.instruction.Bits(32,8));
        assert(std::equal(pressure.suffix.begin(), pressure.suffix.end(),
                          lowered.instructions.begin()+end-pressure.suffix.size()));
        const auto refusal=LowerToMaxwell(program,{},false);
        assert(!refusal && refusal.error=="native program uses lowering scratch registers");
    }
    // Native RED uses a 64-bit address and a 32-bit data source, not
    // the destination field at bit 16. Both kinds of address must be
    // insulated from the high-register scratch bank. In uniform-pointer
    // mode the U bank itself must be reserved even if no other uniform
    // opcode occurs in this shader.
    constexpr Instruction ReduceGpr{{
        0x98eU | (7U << 12) | (255U << 16) | (250U << 24),
        252U,
        0x0010e100U,
        0U
    }};
    constexpr Instruction ReduceUniform{{
        0x98eU | (7U << 12) | (255U << 16) | (255U << 24),
        244U,
        0x0c10e100U,
        0U
    }};
    for (const auto reduce : {ReduceGpr, ReduceUniform}) {
        const bool uniform_pointer = reduce.Bits(24, 8) == 255;
        const u32 boundary = uniform_pointer ? 216U : 248U;
        const auto pressure = PrepareRegisterPressure(reduce, boundary);
        assert(pressure.valid && !pressure.prefix.empty());
        assert(pressure.prefix.size() == pressure.suffix.size());
        assert(pressure.instruction.Bits(32, 8) < boundary);
        if (uniform_pointer) {
            assert(pressure.instruction.Bits(24, 8) == 255);
            // The uniform pointer stays in the virtual uniform bank.
            assert(pressure.instruction.Bits(64, 8) == 0);
        } else {
            assert(pressure.instruction.Bits(24, 8) < boundary);
            assert((pressure.instruction.Bits(24, 8) & 1U) == 0);
            assert(!NativeVectorCrossesScratch(pressure.instruction, boundary));
        }
        const std::array program{UniformMarker, reduce, Exit};
        const auto lowered = LowerToMaxwell(program, {}, true);
        if (!lowered)
            std::fprintf(stderr, "RED lowering refused: %.*s at %#x\n",
                static_cast<int>(lowered.error.size()), lowered.error.data(),
                lowered.error_offset);
        assert(lowered && lowered.source_size == sizeof(program));
        const u32 begin = lowered.source_instruction_offsets[1];
        const u32 end = lowered.source_instruction_offsets[2];
        assert(std::equal(pressure.prefix.begin(), pressure.prefix.end(),
                          lowered.instructions.begin() + begin));
        assert(std::equal(pressure.suffix.begin(), pressure.suffix.end(),
                          lowered.instructions.begin() + end - pressure.suffix.size()));
        const auto reduction_word = lowered.instructions[
            end - pressure.suffix.size() - 1];
        assert((reduction_word & 0xfff8000000000000ULL) ==
                0xebf8000000000000ULL);
        assert((reduction_word & 0xffU) == pressure.instruction.Bits(32, 8));
        assert(((reduction_word >> 8) & 0xffU) ==
               (uniform_pointer ? 250U : pressure.instruction.Bits(24, 8)));
        const auto refused = LowerToMaxwell(program, {}, false);
        assert(!refused &&
               refused.error == "native program uses lowering scratch registers");
    }
    // The two words of a RED pointer must be physically contiguous.
    Instruction straddles_reduction = ReduceGpr;
    straddles_reduction.words[0] =
        (straddles_reduction.words[0] & 0x00ffffffU) | (247U << 24);
    assert(NativeVectorCrossesScratch(straddles_reduction, 248));
    assert(!PrepareRegisterPressure(straddles_reduction, 248).valid);
    assert(!LowerToMaxwell(
        std::array{UniformMarker, straddles_reduction, Exit}, {}, true));
    // The real Maxwell RED word has a 20-bit signed byte displacement.
    // Ampere exposes 24 bits, so out-of-range values must be refused,
    // never truncated. GPR and uniform address variants must encode the
    // exact 32-bit signed/unsigned reduction modes and data operand.
    for (const bool uniform_pointer : {false, true}) {
        for (const s32 offset : {-0x80000, -16, 0, 32, 0x7ffff}) {
            for (const u32 type : {0U, 1U}) {
                auto reduce = uniform_pointer ? ReduceUniform : ReduceGpr;
                const u32 src = 44U;
                reduce.words[0] =
                    0x98eU | (7U << 12) | (255U << 16) |
                    ((uniform_pointer ? 255U : 32U) << 24);
                reduce.words[1] = src |
                    ((static_cast<u32>(offset) & 0xffffffU) << 8);
                reduce.words[2] =
                    (uniform_pointer ? 0x0c10e100U : 0x0010e100U) |
                    (type << 9) | (2U << 23) | (uniform_pointer ? 60U : 0U);
                const std::array program{UniformMarker,reduce,Exit};
                const auto lowered = LowerToMaxwell(program, {}, true);
                if (!lowered)
                    std::fprintf(stderr,"RED offset=%d type=%u uniform=%d: %.*s\n",
                        offset,type,uniform_pointer,
                        static_cast<int>(lowered.error.size()),lowered.error.data());
                assert(lowered);
                const u32 begin = lowered.source_instruction_offsets[1];
                const u32 end = lowered.source_instruction_offsets[2];
                assert(end > begin);
                const u64 word = lowered.instructions[end - 1];
                assert((word & 0xfff8000000000000ULL) ==
                       0xebf8000000000000ULL);
                assert((word & 0xffU) == src);
                assert(((word >> 8) & 0xffU) ==
                       (uniform_pointer ? 250U : 32U));
                assert(((word >> 20) & 7U) == type);
                assert(((word >> 23) & 7U) == 2U);
                assert(((word >> 28) & 0xfffffU) ==
                       (static_cast<u32>(offset) & 0xfffffU));
            }
        }
    }
    auto invalid_reduction = ReduceGpr;
    invalid_reduction.words[0] =
        0x98eU | (7U << 12) | (255U << 16) | (32U << 24);
    invalid_reduction.words[1] = 44U | (0x80000U << 8);
    const auto bad_positive = LowerToMaxwell(
        std::array{UniformMarker,invalid_reduction,Exit}, {}, true);
    assert(!bad_positive && bad_positive.error=="native global reduction mode");
    invalid_reduction.words[1] = 44U | (0x7fffffU << 8);
    const auto bad_negative = LowerToMaxwell(
        std::array{UniformMarker,invalid_reduction,Exit}, {}, true);
    assert(!bad_negative && bad_negative.error=="native global reduction mode");
    invalid_reduction.words[1] = 44;
    invalid_reduction.words[2] = 0x0010e100U | (3U << 9);
    assert(!LowerToMaxwell(
        std::array{UniformMarker,invalid_reduction,Exit}, {}, true));
    invalid_reduction.words[2] = 0x0010e100U;
    invalid_reduction.words[0] =
        0x98eU | (7U << 12) | (255U << 16) | (33U << 24);
    assert(!LowerToMaxwell(
        std::array{UniformMarker,invalid_reduction,Exit}, {}, true));
    // U62's high word is U63/RZ; borrowing the neighboring physical
    // GPR would produce an unrelated 64-bit atomic address.
    auto bad_uniform_reduction = ReduceUniform;
    bad_uniform_reduction.words[2] =
        (bad_uniform_reduction.words[2] & ~0x3fU) | 62U;
    assert(!LowerToMaxwell(
        std::array{UniformMarker,bad_uniform_reduction,Exit}, {}, true));
    bad_uniform_reduction.words[2] =
        (bad_uniform_reduction.words[2] & ~0x3fU) | 61U;
    assert(!LowerToMaxwell(
        std::array{UniformMarker,bad_uniform_reduction,Exit}, {}, true));
    // GPR-address atomic pointer must be genuinely even/aligned, not
    // misrepresented as a register pair crossing an unsupported operand.
    auto odd_address=AtomGpr;
    odd_address.words[0] = (odd_address.words[0] & 0x00ffffffU) | (249U << 24);
    const auto odd=LowerToMaxwell(std::array{UniformMarker,odd_address,Exit},{},true);
    assert(!odd);
    assert(odd.error == "native global register atomic mode" ||
           odd.error == "native register shadowing mode");
    // U62 is the final real uniform word; U63 represents zero, not its
    // adjacent high pointer half. Never use U47's physical GPR as U63.
    auto last_uniform=AtomUniform;
    last_uniform.words[2] = (last_uniform.words[2] & ~0x3fU) | 62U;
    const auto rejected_last=LowerToMaxwell(std::array{UniformMarker,last_uniform,Exit},{},true);
    assert(!rejected_last && rejected_last.error=="native global atomic mode");
    // An odd uniform pointer is equally unrepresentable as an aligned
    // 64-bit guest pointer for a native Maxwell atom.
    last_uniform.words[2] = (last_uniform.words[2] & ~0x3fU) | 61U;
    const auto rejected_odd=LowerToMaxwell(std::array{UniformMarker,last_uniform,Exit},{},true);
    assert(!rejected_odd && rejected_odd.error=="native global atomic mode");
    // The two words of a low register address may straddle an aligned
    // scratch limit in a synthetic case. Detect before rewriting the
    // base register without guaranteeing contiguous physical operands.
    Instruction straddles_atomic{{0x3a8U | (4U<<16) | (248U<<24),240U,0x001ee100U,0U}};
    assert(NativeVectorCrossesScratch(straddles_atomic,249));
    std::puts("P2_4_AMPERE_REGISTER_PRESSURE_PASS high_gpr=19 opcode_families "
              "atomic_global_gpr=1 reduction_signed_offsets=1 reduction_high_gpr=1 "
              "uniform_u62_refused=1 ns1_unchanged=1");
}
```

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// True pinned Eden Maxwell TranslateProgram integration; synthetic instructions only.
#include <array>

namespace Settings { Values values{}; }

static void Require(bool ok,const char* why) {
    if (!ok) { std::fprintf(stderr,"NS2 real IR: %s\n",why); std::exit(1); }
}
struct SyntheticSource final : Shader::Environment {
    SyntheticSource() { stage=Shader::Stage::VertexB; start_address=0; }
    u64 ReadInstruction(u32) override { std::abort(); }
    u32 ReadCbufValue(u32,u32) override { return 0; }

    Shader::TexturePixelFormat ReadTexturePixelFormat(u32) override { return {}; }

    u32 ReadViewportTransformState() override { return 0; }

    u32 LocalMemorySize() const override { return 0; }
    u32 SharedMemorySize() const override { return 0; }
    std::array<u32,3> WorkgroupSize() const override { return {}; }
    bool HasHLEMacroState() const override { return false; }
    std::optional<Shader::ReplaceConstant> GetReplaceConstBuffer(u32,u32) override { return {}; }
    void Dump(u64,u64) override { std::abort(); }
};
static void Emit(std::vector<u8>& bytes,u32 a,u32 b=0,u32 c=0,u32 d=0) {
    for (u32 word:{a,b,c,d})
        for (u32 shift=0;shift<32;shift+=8) bytes.push_back(static_cast<u8>(word>>shift));
}
int main() {
    std::array<u8,0x50> header{};
    constexpr u32 pred=7U<<12, exit_true=7U<<23;
    std::vector<u8> code;
    Emit(code,pred|0x918);
    Emit(code,pred|0x202|(1U<<16),2,15U<<8);
    Emit(code,pred|0x918);
    Emit(code,pred|0x918);
    Emit(code,pred|0x94d,0,exit_true);
    auto image=BuildMaxwellShaderImage(header,code,static_cast<u32>(Shader::Stage::VertexB));
    Require(image.ValidForCompiler(),"native->Maxwell image failed");
    auto env=NativeMaxwellEnvironment::CreateOwned(std::make_unique<SyntheticSource>(),std::move(image));
    Require(bool(env),"owned Maxwell environment failed");
    Shader::HostTranslateInfo host{};
    host.min_ssbo_alignment=64;
    host.support_float64=true;
    host.support_float16=true;
    host.support_int64=true;
    host.support_conditional_barrier=true;
    for (bool dispatcher:{false,true}) {
        Shader::ObjectPool<Shader::IR::Inst> inst_pool{4096};
        Shader::ObjectPool<Shader::IR::Block> block_pool{256};
        Shader::ObjectPool<Shader::Maxwell::Flow::Block> flow_pool{256};
        auto ir=TranslateReviewedGraphicsIR(inst_pool,block_pool,flow_pool,*env,host,dispatcher);
        Require(ir.stage==Shader::Stage::VertexB,"wrong IR stage");
        Require(!ir.blocks.empty()&&!ir.post_order_blocks.empty(),"empty real IR");
        Require(!ir.syntax_list.empty(),"missing real structured syntax");
    }
    std::puts("NS2 real Maxwell IR passes: PASS (host synthetic; no SPIR-V/Vulkan/PS5)");
}
```

`tools/ns2/test_ampere_real_spirv.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Host-only Ampere -> real Maxwell CFG -> optimized IR -> SPIR-V emission.
// Synthetic shader only; not a Vulkan pipeline or a PS5 execution test.
#include <array>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <fstream>
#include <memory>
#include <string>
#include <spirv/unified1/spirv.hpp>
#include <vector>
#define CANNOT_EXPLICITLY_INSTANTIATE
#include "common/settings.h"
#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/renderer_spirv_bridge.h"
#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/native_qmd_compute_environment.h"
#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/native_indirect_cbuf.h"
#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/native_atomic_span.h"
#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ir/modifiers.h"
#include "shader_recompiler/backend/spirv/emit_spirv.h"
#include "shader_recompiler/object_pool.h"
#include "video_core/ns2_shader_spirv_compile.h"
#include "core/hle/service/nvdrv/devices/native_gpu_process_registry.h"
#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/ir_bridge.h"
#include "shader_recompiler/host_translate_info.h"
#include "shader_recompiler/profile.h"
#include "shader_recompiler/runtime_info.h"

namespace Settings { Values values{}; }
using namespace Shader::Ampere;
static void Require(bool ok, const char* why) {
    if (!ok) { std::fprintf(stderr, "NS2 SPIR-V: %s\n", why); std::exit(1); }
}
struct SyntheticSource final : Shader::Environment {
    explicit SyntheticSource(Shader::Stage stage_=Shader::Stage::VertexB) { stage=stage_; start_address=0; }
    u64 ReadInstruction(u32) override { std::abort(); }
    u32 ReadCbufValue(u32,u32) override { return 0; }
    Shader::TextureType ReadTextureType(u32) override { return {}; }
    Shader::TexturePixelFormat ReadTexturePixelFormat(u32) override { return {}; }
    bool IsTexturePixelFormatInteger(u32) override { return false; }
    u32 ReadViewportTransformState() override { return 0; }
    u32 TextureBoundBuffer() const override { return 0; }
    u32 LocalMemorySize() const override { return 0; }
    u32 SharedMemorySize() const override { return 0; }
    std::array<u32,3> WorkgroupSize() const override {
        return stage == Shader::Stage::Compute ?
            std::array<u32,3>{2,4,8} : std::array<u32,3>{};
    }
    bool HasHLEMacroState() const override { return false; }
    std::optional<Shader::ReplaceConstant> GetReplaceConstBuffer(u32,u32) override { return {}; }
    void Dump(u64,u64) override { std::abort(); }
};
static void Emit(std::vector<u8>& out,u32 a,u32 b=0,u32 c=0,u32 d=0) {
    for (u32 w:{a,b,c,d})
        for (u32 shift=0;shift<32;shift+=8) out.push_back(static_cast<u8>(w>>shift));
}
namespace Kernel { class KProcess {}; }
namespace VideoCommon {
// Host-only link stand-in for the real GMMU reader. The actual compiled
// integration test below directly supplies a bounded fake guest reader.
bool ReadNs2GpuShader(void*, u64, void*, std::size_t) { return false; }
}
struct GuestFixture {
    std::vector<u8> bytes;
    u64 address{0x100000};
    std::size_t reads{};
    Kernel::KProcess* unregister_on_read{};
};
static bool ReadGuest(void* ptr,u64 address,void* output,std::size_t count) {
    auto& fixture=*static_cast<GuestFixture*>(ptr);
    ++fixture.reads;
    if (address<fixture.address) return false;
    const u64 offset=address-fixture.address;
    if (offset>fixture.bytes.size() || count>fixture.bytes.size()-offset)
        return false;
    std::memcpy(output,fixture.bytes.data()+offset,count);
    if (fixture.unregister_on_read) {
        auto* process=fixture.unregister_on_read;
        fixture.unregister_on_read=nullptr;
        Service::Nvidia::Devices::NativeGpuProcessRegistry::Instance().Unregister(process);
    }
    return true;
}
// Exercise the real IR instruction owners used by the QMD3 Compute bridge.
// These are not models of the metadata algorithm: Normalize inspects the
// actual BasicBlock and OpCode/Value objects later passed to SPIR-V.
static void CheckNativeQmdIndirectCbufIR() {
    // This shader compiler is shared with NS1. An opt-in Ampere compilation
    // must restore its thread-local mode on normal, nested and early return.
    Require(!NativeSpirvCbufBoundsActive(), "native CBUF mode leaked into NS1");
    {
        NativeSpirvCbufBoundsScope native;
        Require(NativeSpirvCbufBoundsActive(), "native CBUF mode not enabled");
        {
            NativeSpirvCbufBoundsScope nested;
            Require(NativeSpirvCbufBoundsActive(), "nested native CBUF lost mode");
        }
        Require(NativeSpirvCbufBoundsActive(), "native CBUF nested scope leaked");
    }
    Require(!NativeSpirvCbufBoundsActive(), "native CBUF mode not restored");
    const auto run = [](u32 enabled_mask, bool indirect_bank, bool indirect_offset,
                        u32 bank, u32 byte_offset, bool expected_ok,
                        u32 expected_size) {
        Shader::ObjectPool<Shader::IR::Inst> inst_pool{16};
        Shader::IR::Block block{inst_pool};
        Shader::IR::Program program{};
        program.stage = Shader::Stage::Compute;
        program.blocks.push_back(&block);
        program.info.uses_cbuf_indirect = true;
        for (u32 index = 0; index < Shader::Info::MAX_INDIRECT_CBUFS; ++index) {
            program.info.constant_buffer_descriptors.push_back({index, 1});
            program.info.constant_buffer_mask |= u32{1} << index;
            program.info.constant_buffer_used_sizes[index] = 0x10000U;
        }
        Shader::IR::Value index_value{bank};
        Shader::IR::Value offset_value{byte_offset};
        if (indirect_bank) {
            block.AppendNewInst(Shader::IR::Opcode::IAdd32,
                {Shader::IR::Value{u32{0}}, Shader::IR::Value{u32{1}}});
            index_value = Shader::IR::Value{&block.back()};
        }
        if (indirect_offset) {
            block.AppendNewInst(Shader::IR::Opcode::IAdd32,
                {Shader::IR::Value{u32{0}}, Shader::IR::Value{u32{48}}});
            offset_value = Shader::IR::Value{&block.back()};
        }
        block.AppendNewInst(Shader::IR::Opcode::GetCbufU32,
                            {index_value, offset_value});
        const bool accepted = NormalizeNativeQmdIndirectCbufIR(program, enabled_mask);
        Require(accepted == expected_ok, "IR bank/offset admission mismatch");
        if (!accepted) return;
        Require(program.info.constant_buffer_mask == enabled_mask,
                "IR reflection dropped or fabricated a QMD3 bank");
        u32 seen{};
        for (const auto& desc : program.info.constant_buffer_descriptors) {
            Require(desc.index < 8 && desc.count == 1 &&
                    (enabled_mask & (u32{1} << desc.index)) &&
                    !(seen & (u32{1} << desc.index)),
                    "IR generated an invalid native CBUF descriptor");
            seen |= u32{1} << desc.index;
            Require(program.info.constant_buffer_used_sizes[desc.index] == expected_size,
                    "IR shortened a dynamic CBUF offset or miscomputed static extent");
        }
        Require(seen == enabled_mask, "IR omitted an enabled sparse bank");
    };
    constexpr u32 sparse = (1U << 0) | (1U << 3) | (1U << 7);
    run(sparse, true, false, 0, 28, true, 32);
    run(sparse, true, false, 0, 0xfffc, true, 0x10000);
    run(sparse, true, false, 0, 0xffff, false, 0); // U32 overreads 64 KiB
    run(sparse, true, true, 0, 0, true, 0x10000);
    run(sparse, false, false, 1, 28, false, 0);
    run(sparse, true, false, 0, 0x10000, false, 0);
    run(0, true, false, 0, 28, false, 0);
    // A stale compiler reflection flag cannot conceal a real dynamically
    // selected bank. Otherwise SPIR-V would call an uninitialized indirect
    // CBUF accessor after metadata normalization.
    const auto non_indirect = [&](bool dynamic_bank, bool dynamic_offset,
                                  u32 bank, u32 offset, u32 enabled_mask,
                                  bool accepted) {
        Shader::ObjectPool<Shader::IR::Inst> pool{8};
        Shader::IR::Block block{pool};
        Shader::IR::Program program{};
        program.stage=Shader::Stage::Compute;
        program.blocks.push_back(&block);
        program.info.uses_cbuf_indirect=false;
        program.info.constant_buffer_mask=1;
        program.info.constant_buffer_descriptors.push_back({0,1});
        Shader::IR::Value bank_arg{bank};
        Shader::IR::Value offset_arg{offset};
        if(dynamic_bank) {
            block.AppendNewInst(Shader::IR::Opcode::IAdd32,
                                {Shader::IR::Value{u32{0}},
                                 Shader::IR::Value{u32{1}}});
            bank_arg=Shader::IR::Value{&block.back()};
        }
        if(dynamic_offset) {
            block.AppendNewInst(Shader::IR::Opcode::IAdd32,
                                {Shader::IR::Value{u32{0}},
                                 Shader::IR::Value{u32{16}}});
            offset_arg=Shader::IR::Value{&block.back()};
        }
        block.AppendNewInst(Shader::IR::Opcode::GetCbufU32,
                            {bank_arg,offset_arg});
        Require(NormalizeNativeQmdIndirectCbufIR(program,enabled_mask)==accepted,
                "non-indirect reflection must match actual CBUF selector and 64-KiB bounds");
        if (accepted) {
            const u32 expected=dynamic_offset ? 0x10000U : NativeQmdStaticCbufReadExtent(offset);
            if (program.info.constant_buffer_used_sizes[0] != expected)
                std::fprintf(stderr, "CBUF bank=%u offset=%x dynamic=%d actual=%u expected=%u\n", bank,offset,dynamic_offset,program.info.constant_buffer_used_sizes[0],expected);
            Require(program.info.constant_buffer_used_sizes[0]==expected,
                    "direct QMD3 CBUF read must require the real source extent");
        }
    };
    non_indirect(false,false,0,0,1,true);
    non_indirect(false,true,0,0,1,true);
    non_indirect(true,false,0,0,1,false);
    non_indirect(false,false,8,0,1,false);
    non_indirect(false,false,0,0x10000U,1,false);
    non_indirect(false,false,0,0,2,false);
    non_indirect(false,false,1,0,3,false); // enabled, but NOT reflected
    non_indirect(false,false,0,0xfffc,1,true); // last aligned U32
    non_indirect(false,false,0,0xffff,1,false); // U32 crosses 64-KiB
    non_indirect(false,false,1,16,1,false); // unreflected bank
    std::puts("NS2 QMD3 real IR CBUF sparse/static/dynamic admission: PASS");
}
// P2.3: construct the actual Compute IR used by the native QMD3 binder
// and submit it to the production SPIR-V emitter, not a handwritten SPV.
// Every one of the seven existing float CAS paths must emit valid Vulkan
// modules, not merely compile the emitter's C++ owner.
// P2.3: drive the real SPIR-V emitter through a malformed native IR bank.
// A QMD3 has eight CBUFs; shared NS1's larger uniform table is not an
// excuse to access a missing reflected bank or an invalid array slot.
static void VerifyNativeCbufBankRefusal() {
    for (const u32 bank : {7U, 8U, 255U}) {
        Shader::ObjectPool<Shader::IR::Inst> pool{8};
        Shader::IR::Block block{pool};
        Shader::IR::Program program{};
        program.stage = Shader::Stage::Compute;
        program.workgroup_size = {1, 1, 1};
        program.blocks.push_back(&block);
        program.info.constant_buffer_mask = 1;
        program.info.constant_buffer_descriptors.push_back({0, 1});
        program.info.constant_buffer_used_sizes[0] = 4;
        block.AppendNewInst(Shader::IR::Opcode::GetCbufU32,
                            {Shader::IR::Value{bank}, Shader::IR::Value{u32{0}}});
        auto& node = program.syntax_list.emplace_back();
        node.type = Shader::IR::AbstractSyntaxNode::Type::Block;
        node.data.block = &block;
        program.syntax_list.emplace_back().type =
            Shader::IR::AbstractSyntaxNode::Type::Return;
        Shader::Backend::Bindings bindings{};
        Shader::Profile profile{};
        profile.supported_spirv = 0x00010500;
        bool rejected = false;
        {
            NativeSpirvCbufBoundsScope native;
            try {
                (void)Shader::Backend::SPIRV::EmitSPIRV(
                    profile, Shader::RuntimeInfo{}, program, bindings);
            } catch (const std::exception& error) {
                rejected = std::string{error.what()}.find(
                    "Native QMD3 CBUF bank") != std::string::npos;
            }
        }
        Require(rejected, "real SPIR-V emitter accepted an invalid QMD3 bank");
        Require(!NativeSpirvCbufBoundsActive(),
                "native CBUF rejection leaked into the NS1 compiler");
    }
}

// G06: source-executed negative proof for actual native global CAS routing.
// An SSBO selector beyond the historical 16-bit route mask, a physical
// CBUF index beyond the 18 bank array, and a missing declared CBUF must
// reject before an OpAccessChain can reference an invalid descriptor.
// This is the genuine native SPIR-V emitter, not a modeled helper.
static void VerifyRealGlobalCasInvalidDescriptors() {
    const auto reject=[](u32 count, bool used, u32 cbuf_index,
                         const char* expected, u32 cbuf_offset=0x100U) {
        Shader::ObjectPool<Shader::IR::Inst> pool{8};
        Shader::IR::Block block{pool};
        Shader::IR::Program program{};
        program.stage=Shader::Stage::Compute;
        program.workgroup_size={1,1,1};
        program.blocks.push_back(&block);
        block.AppendNewInst(Shader::IR::Opcode::GlobalAtomicCompareExchange32,
                            {Shader::IR::Value{u64{0x100004}},
                             Shader::IR::Value{u32{7}},
                             Shader::IR::Value{u32{9}}});
        auto& node=program.syntax_list.emplace_back();
        node.type=Shader::IR::AbstractSyntaxNode::Type::Block;
        node.data.block=&block;
        program.syntax_list.emplace_back().type=
            Shader::IR::AbstractSyntaxNode::Type::Return;
        auto& info=program.info;
        info.uses_global_memory=true;
        info.uses_int64=true;
        info.used_storage_buffer_types=Shader::IR::Type::U32;
        info.nvn_buffer_used[0]=used;
        for(u32 i=0;i<count;++i)
            info.storage_buffers_descriptors.push_back(
                {.cbuf_index=cbuf_index,.cbuf_offset=cbuf_offset,
                 .count=1,.is_written=true});
        Shader::Backend::Bindings bindings{};
        Shader::Profile profile{};
        profile.supported_spirv=0x00010500;
        profile.support_int64=true;
        profile.support_descriptor_aliasing=true;
        profile.min_ssbo_alignment=64;
        const Shader::Ampere::NativeSpirvCbufBoundsScope scope{};
        bool rejected=false;
        try {
            (void)Shader::Backend::SPIRV::EmitSPIRV(
                profile,Shader::RuntimeInfo{},program,bindings);
        } catch(const std::exception& ex) {
            rejected=std::string(ex.what()).find(expected)!=std::string::npos;
            if(!rejected)
                std::fprintf(stderr,"G06 unexpected global CAS refusal: %s\n",ex.what());
        }
        Require(rejected,"real global CAS missing descriptor did not fail closed");
    };
    reject(17,false,0,"Native global memory SSBO selector exceeds routing mask");
    reject(1,true,18,"Global memory SSBO CBUF index out of range");
    reject(1,true,0,"Native global memory SSBO CBUF not bound");
    reject(1,true,0,"Native global memory SSBO CBUF offset outside buffer",0xfff8U);
    reject(1,true,0,"Native global memory SSBO CBUF offset outside buffer",0x102U);
    std::puts("G06_REAL_GLOBAL_CAS_DESCRIPTOR_REFUSAL_PASS "
              "mask_overflow=1 cbuf_out_of_range=1 missing_cbuf=1 "
              "cbuf_extent_overflow=1 cbuf_unaligned=1");
}

// G06 positive: emit actual guest U64 global-CAS address routing through
// authenticated CBUF address/extent and one 64-byte storage descriptor.
// The shader is validated with SPIRV-Tools, then dispatched separately on
// Vulkan; emitted code is never a hand-authored SPIR-V fixture.
static void VerifyRealGlobalCasSpirv(const std::string& prefix) {
    Shader::ObjectPool<Shader::IR::Inst> pool{12};
    Shader::IR::Block block{pool};
    Shader::IR::Program program{};
    program.stage=Shader::Stage::Compute;
    program.workgroup_size={1,1,1};
    program.blocks.push_back(&block);
    block.AppendNewInst(Shader::IR::Opcode::GlobalAtomicCompareExchange32,
                        {Shader::IR::Value{u64{0x100004}},
                         Shader::IR::Value{u32{7}},
                         Shader::IR::Value{u32{9}}});
    const Shader::IR::Value old{&block.back()};
    block.AppendNewInst(Shader::IR::Opcode::WriteStorage32,
                        {Shader::IR::Value{u32{0}},Shader::IR::Value{u32{8}},old});
    auto& node=program.syntax_list.emplace_back();
    node.type=Shader::IR::AbstractSyntaxNode::Type::Block;
    node.data.block=&block;
    program.syntax_list.emplace_back().type=
        Shader::IR::AbstractSyntaxNode::Type::Return;
    auto& info=program.info;
    info.uses_global_memory=true;
    info.uses_int64=true;
    info.stores_global_memory=true;
    info.used_storage_buffer_types=Shader::IR::Type::U32;
    info.used_constant_buffer_types=
        Shader::IR::Type::U32 | Shader::IR::Type::U32x2;
    info.constant_buffer_descriptors.push_back({.index=0,.count=1});
    info.constant_buffer_used_sizes[0]=0x110;
    info.nvn_buffer_used[0]=true;
    info.storage_buffers_descriptors.push_back(
        {.cbuf_index=0,.cbuf_offset=0x100U,.count=1,.is_written=true});
    Shader::Profile profile{};
    profile.supported_spirv=0x00010500;
    profile.support_int64=true;
    profile.support_descriptor_aliasing=true;
    // The live Vulkan backend allocates a unified set for CBUF and SSBO
    // representations. Keep the real fixture's bindings non-overlapping.
    profile.unified_descriptor_binding=true;
    profile.min_ssbo_alignment=64;
    Shader::Backend::Bindings bindings{};
    std::vector<u32> words;
    try {
        const Shader::Ampere::NativeSpirvCbufBoundsScope scope{};
        words=Shader::Backend::SPIRV::EmitSPIRV(
            profile,Shader::RuntimeInfo{},program,bindings);
    } catch(const std::exception& ex) {
        std::fprintf(stderr,"G06 native global CAS emitter failed: %s\n",ex.what());
        Require(false,"positive authenticated global CAS did not emit SPIR-V");
    }
    Require(words.size()>5 && words[0]==0x07230203U,
            "authenticated global CAS shader has no SPIR-V");
    u32 atomic{},calls{},stores{};
    for(std::size_t i=5;i<words.size();) {
        const u32 op=words[i],count=op>>16;
        Require(count && count<=words.size()-i,"malformed global CAS module");
        atomic+=(op&0xffffU)==230U; // OpAtomicCompareExchange
        calls+=(op&0xffffU)==57U; // OpFunctionCall
        stores+=(op&0xffffU)==62U; // OpStore
        i+=count;
    }
    Require(atomic>=1 && calls>=1 && stores>=1,
            "global address route did not call genuine storage CAS/writeback");
    const auto name=prefix+"-global-cas.spv";
    std::ofstream file{name,std::ios::binary|std::ios::trunc};
    Require(bool(file),"cannot create native global CAS SPIR-V");
    file.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(words.data()),
               static_cast<std::streamsize>(words.size()*sizeof(u32)));
    Require(bool(file),"cannot save native global CAS SPIR-V");
    std::printf("G06_REAL_GLOBAL_CAS_OWNER_SPIRV_EMITTED words=%zu atomic=%u call=%u\n",
                words.size(),atomic,calls);
}

static void VerifyRealFloatCasSpirv(const std::string& prefix) {
    using Shader::IR::Opcode;
    using Shader::IR::Value;
    constexpr std::array<std::pair<Opcode, const char*>,8> cases{{
        {Opcode::StorageAtomicCompareExchange32,"u32-cas"},
        {Opcode::StorageAtomicAddF32,"f32-add"},
        {Opcode::StorageAtomicAddF16x2,"f16x2-add"},
        {Opcode::StorageAtomicMinF16x2,"f16x2-min"},
        {Opcode::StorageAtomicMaxF16x2,"f16x2-max"},
        {Opcode::StorageAtomicAddF32x2,"f32x2-add"},
        {Opcode::StorageAtomicMinF32x2,"f32x2-min"},
        {Opcode::StorageAtomicMaxF32x2,"f32x2-max"},
    }};
    for (const auto& [opcode,label] : cases) {
        Shader::ObjectPool<Shader::IR::Inst> pool{32};
        Shader::IR::Block block{pool};
        Shader::IR::Program program{};
        program.stage=Shader::Stage::Compute;
        program.workgroup_size={1,1,1};
        program.blocks.push_back(&block);
        auto& node=program.syntax_list.emplace_back();
        node.type=Shader::IR::AbstractSyntaxNode::Type::Block;
        node.data.block=&block;
        program.syntax_list.emplace_back().type=
            Shader::IR::AbstractSyntaxNode::Type::Return;
        auto& info=program.info;
        info.storage_buffers_descriptors.push_back({0,0,1,true});
        info.used_storage_buffer_types=Shader::IR::Type::U32;
        Value value{f32{1.25f}};
        switch(opcode) {
        case Opcode::StorageAtomicCompareExchange32:
            value=Value{u32{9}};
            break;
        case Opcode::StorageAtomicAddF32:
            info.uses_atomic_f32_add=true;
            break;
        case Opcode::StorageAtomicAddF16x2:
        case Opcode::StorageAtomicMinF16x2:
        case Opcode::StorageAtomicMaxF16x2:
            info.uses_fp16=true;
            if(opcode==Opcode::StorageAtomicAddF16x2)info.uses_atomic_f16x2_add=true;
            if(opcode==Opcode::StorageAtomicMinF16x2)info.uses_atomic_f16x2_min=true;
            if(opcode==Opcode::StorageAtomicMaxF16x2)info.uses_atomic_f16x2_max=true;
            block.AppendNewInst(Opcode::UnpackFloat2x16,{Value{u32{0x3c00bc00}}});
            value=Value{&block.back()};
            break;
        default:
            if(opcode==Opcode::StorageAtomicAddF32x2)info.uses_atomic_f32x2_add=true;
            if(opcode==Opcode::StorageAtomicMinF32x2)info.uses_atomic_f32x2_min=true;
            if(opcode==Opcode::StorageAtomicMaxF32x2)info.uses_atomic_f32x2_max=true;
            block.AppendNewInst(Opcode::CompositeConstructF32x2,
                                {Value{f32{1.25f}},Value{f32{-2.0f}}});
            value=Value{&block.back()};
            break;
        }
        if (opcode == Opcode::StorageAtomicCompareExchange32) {
            block.AppendNewInst(opcode,{Value{u32{0}},Value{u32{4}},
                                        Value{u32{7}}, value});
            // Export the actual atomic return value through a second SSBO
            // word: host Vulkan will verify both the old and final values.
            const Value previous{&block.back()};
            block.AppendNewInst(Opcode::WriteStorage32,
                                {Value{u32{0}},Value{u32{8}},previous});
        } else {
            block.AppendNewInst(opcode,{Value{u32{0}},Value{u32{4}},value});
        }
        if (opcode == Opcode::StorageAtomicCompareExchange32) {
            // Use the SAME real IR later emitted into the Vulkan module.
            // No detached mock offset: the production QMD3 span collector
            // must prove binding 0 / byte 4 / width 4 before submission.
            const auto spans=CollectNativeQmdAtomicSpans(program);
            Require(spans && spans->size()==1 &&
                    spans->front().binding==0 && spans->front().offset==4 &&
                    spans->front().width==4,
                    "G05 genuine CAS IR has no authenticated 4-byte span");
            struct HostBinding {
                bool known_size{},is_written{};
                u64 gpu_address{},bytes{};
            };
            std::array<HostBinding,1> live{{{true,true,0x1000,64}}};
            const std::span<const NativeAtomicSpan> exact{*spans};
            Require(NativeQmdAtomicSpansFitBindings(exact,live),
                    "G05 native span should fit the real 64-byte SSBO");
            live[0].bytes=7;
            Require(!NativeQmdAtomicSpansFitBindings(exact,live),
                    "G05 short backing wrongly admits atomic");
            live[0].bytes=64;
            live[0].gpu_address=0x1002;
            Require(!NativeQmdAtomicSpansFitBindings(exact,live),
                    "G05 unaligned physical SSBO base wrongly admitted");
            live[0].gpu_address=0x1000;
            live[0].is_written=false;
            Require(!NativeQmdAtomicSpansFitBindings(exact,live),
                    "G05 read-only atomic SSBO wrongly admitted");
            live[0].is_written=true;
            live[0].known_size=false;
            Require(!NativeQmdAtomicSpansFitBindings(exact,live),
                    "G05 unknown backing span wrongly admitted");
            std::puts("G05_REAL_IR_ATOMIC_LIVE_SPAN_PASS binding=0 offset=4 "
                      "width=4 extent=64 invalid_size_alignment_rights=refused");
        }
        Shader::Backend::Bindings bindings{};
        Shader::Profile profile{};
        profile.supported_spirv=0x00010500;
        profile.support_int16=true;
        profile.support_descriptor_aliasing=true;
        std::vector<u32> words;
        try {
            words=Shader::Backend::SPIRV::EmitSPIRV(
                profile,Shader::RuntimeInfo{},program,bindings);
        } catch(const std::exception& ex) {
            std::fprintf(stderr,"CAS SPIR-V %s: %s\n",label,ex.what());
            Require(false,"real CAS SPIR-V emission threw");
        }
        Require(words.size()>5 && words[0]==0x07230203U,
                "real floating CAS failed to produce a SPIR-V module");
        u32 atomic_exchanges{};
        for (std::size_t pos=5;pos<words.size();) {
            const u32 encoded=words[pos];
            const u32 count=encoded>>16;
            Require(count && count<=words.size()-pos,
                    "real CAS SPIR-V has malformed instruction stream");
            atomic_exchanges+=(encoded&0xffffU)==230U; // OpAtomicCompareExchange
            pos+=count;
        }
        Require(atomic_exchanges>=1,
                "floating CAS did not emit an atomic compare-exchange");
        const auto path=prefix+"-"+label+".spv";
        std::ofstream file{path,std::ios::binary|std::ios::trunc};
        Require(bool(file),"cannot export real float CAS module");
        file.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(words.data()),
                   static_cast<std::streamsize>(words.size()*sizeof(u32)));
        Require(bool(file),"cannot flush real float CAS SPIR-V module");
        std::printf("P2_3_REAL_CAS_SPIRV_EMITTED %s %zu\n",label,words.size());
    }
}
// P2.4: emit real Task and Mesh EXT modules through the same maintained
// IR -> SPIR-V backend as native NS2 graphics. Syntax-only tests cannot
// prove OpEmitMeshTasksEXT or OpSetMeshOutputsEXT are present and valid.
static void VerifyRealTaskMeshSpirv(const std::string& prefix) {
    using Shader::IR::Opcode;
    for (const auto stage : {Shader::Stage::Task, Shader::Stage::Mesh}) {
        const bool is_task = stage == Shader::Stage::Task;
        Shader::ObjectPool<Shader::IR::Inst> pool{16};
        Shader::IR::Block block{pool};
        Shader::IR::Program program{};
        program.stage = stage;
        program.workgroup_size = {1, 1, 1};
        program.mesh.payload_words = 2;
        program.info.is_task = is_task;
        program.info.is_mesh = !is_task;
        program.info.uses_local_invocation_id = !is_task;
        program.info.uses_workgroup_id = true;
        if (!is_task) {
            program.mesh.max_vertices = 3;
            program.mesh.max_primitives = 1;
            program.mesh.topology = 4;
            for (const auto component : {
                    Shader::IR::Attribute::PositionX,
                    Shader::IR::Attribute::PositionY,
                    Shader::IR::Attribute::PositionZ,
                    Shader::IR::Attribute::PositionW}) {
                program.mesh.vertex_lines.push_back(static_cast<u32>(component));
            }
        }
        program.blocks.push_back(&block);
        block.AppendNewInst(Opcode::Prologue, {});
        // Lower actual ISBERD/ISBEWR IR through the maintained backend.
        // The prior Task/Mesh fixture emitted only Prologue/Epilogue,
        // which never exercised guest stage-buffer data transfers.
        block.AppendNewInst(Opcode::IsbeRead, {Shader::IR::Value{u32{0}}});
        const Shader::IR::Value incoming{&block.back()};
        block.AppendNewInst(Opcode::IsbeWriteAttribute,
                            {Shader::IR::Value{u32{0}}, incoming});
        if (is_task) {
            // Task output payload word 1 carries the mesh-group count.
            block.AppendNewInst(Opcode::IsbeWriteAttribute,
                                {Shader::IR::Value{u32{4}},
                                 Shader::IR::Value{u32{1}}});
        } else {
            // Mesh primitive count and three vertex-index bytes must be
            // written through the real stage-buffer map ABI.
            block.AppendNewInst(Opcode::IsbeWriteMapU32,
                                {Shader::IR::Value{u32{3}},
                                 Shader::IR::Value{u32{1}}});
            for (u32 lane = 0; lane < 3; ++lane) {
                block.AppendNewInst(Opcode::IsbeWriteMapU8,
                                    {Shader::IR::Value{u32{4 + lane}},
                                     Shader::IR::Value{lane}});
            }
        }
        block.AppendNewInst(Opcode::Epilogue, {});
        auto& node = program.syntax_list.emplace_back();
        node.type = Shader::IR::AbstractSyntaxNode::Type::Block;
        node.data.block = &block;
        program.syntax_list.emplace_back().type =
            Shader::IR::AbstractSyntaxNode::Type::Return;
        Shader::Backend::Bindings bindings{};
        Shader::Profile profile{};
        profile.supported_spirv = 0x00010500;
        std::vector<u32> words;
        try {
            words = Shader::Backend::SPIRV::EmitSPIRV(
                profile, Shader::RuntimeInfo{}, program, bindings);
        } catch (const std::exception& ex) {
            std::fprintf(stderr, "Native %s SPIR-V: %s\n",
                         is_task ? "Task" : "Mesh", ex.what());
            Require(false, "real Task/Mesh SPIR-V emission threw");
        }
        Require(words.size() > 5 && words[0] == 0x07230203U,
                "real Task/Mesh emission did not produce a SPIR-V module");
        const u32 required_opcode = static_cast<u32>(is_task
            ? spv::Op::OpEmitMeshTasksEXT : spv::Op::OpSetMeshOutputsEXT);
        u32 found{};
        for (std::size_t pos = 5; pos < words.size();) {
            const u32 encoded = words[pos];
            const u32 count = encoded >> 16;
            Require(count && count <= words.size() - pos,
                    "invalid instruction length in real Task/Mesh SPIR-V");
            found += (encoded & 0xffffU) == required_opcode;
            pos += count;
        }
        Require(found == 1, "native Task/Mesh terminal/output opcode missing");
        const auto path = prefix + (is_task ? "-task.spv" : "-mesh.spv");
        std::ofstream file{path, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc};
        Require(bool(file), "cannot open Task/Mesh SPIR-V module output");
        file.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(words.data()),
                   static_cast<std::streamsize>(words.size() * sizeof(u32)));
        Require(bool(file), "cannot write Task/Mesh SPIR-V module");
        std::printf("P2_4_REAL_%s_SPIRV_EMITTED words=%zu\n",
                    is_task ? "TASK" : "MESH", words.size());
    }
}
// Negative P2.4 ABI cases: an invalid Task/Mesh program must fail before
// declaring a SPIR-V module, not clamp a zero-sized array or overflow a
// workgroup allocation. Check the actual rejection reason, not any exception.
static void VerifyTaskMeshInvalidDimensions() {
    struct Case {
        Shader::Stage stage;
        u32 threads;
        u32 payload;
        u32 vertices;
        u32 primitives;
        const char* expected;
    };
    const std::array cases{
        Case{Shader::Stage::Task, 1, 0, 0, 0, "Invalid native Task/Mesh shader dimensions"},
        Case{Shader::Stage::Task, 1, 1, 0, 0, "Invalid native Task/Mesh shader dimensions"},
        Case{Shader::Stage::Task, 0, 2, 0, 0, "Invalid native Task/Mesh shader dimensions"},
        Case{Shader::Stage::Mesh, 0, 0, 3, 1, "Invalid native Task/Mesh shader dimensions"},
        Case{Shader::Stage::Mesh, 1, 0, 0, 1, "Invalid native Task/Mesh shader dimensions"},
        Case{Shader::Stage::Mesh, 1, 0, 3, 0, "Invalid native Task/Mesh shader dimensions"},
        Case{Shader::Stage::Mesh, 1, 0, 3, 0xffffffffU,
             "Native Mesh output region exceeds u32 indexing"},
        Case{Shader::Stage::Mesh, 1, 0, 0xffffffffU, 1,
             "Native Mesh output region exceeds u32 indexing"},
    };
    for (const Case& t : cases) {
        Shader::IR::Program program{};
        program.stage = t.stage;
        program.workgroup_size = {t.threads, 1, 1};
        program.mesh.payload_words = t.payload;
        program.mesh.max_vertices = t.vertices;
        program.mesh.max_primitives = t.primitives;
        program.mesh.vertex_lines.push_back(
            static_cast<u32>(Shader::IR::Attribute::PositionX));
        Shader::Backend::Bindings bindings{};
        Shader::Profile profile{};
        profile.supported_spirv = 0x00010500;
        bool expected_rejection{};
        try {
            (void)Shader::Backend::SPIRV::EmitSPIRV(
                profile, Shader::RuntimeInfo{}, program, bindings);
        } catch (const std::exception& exception) {
            expected_rejection = std::string(exception.what()).find(t.expected)
                                 != std::string::npos;
        }
        Require(expected_rejection, "native Task/Mesh invalid dimension not rejected");
    }
    std::puts("P2_4_REAL_TASK_MESH_NEGATIVE_DIMENSIONS_PASS count=8");
}
// P2.2c: verify descriptor arrays through the actual native SPIR-V
// emitter. A CMake-selected DefineTextureBuffers implementation is not
// enough until OpTypeArray and Vulkan validation accept a live module.
static void VerifyRealTextureBufferArraySpirv(const std::string& prefix) {
    const auto compile = [&](u32 descriptor_count, bool expect_reject,
                             bool nonuniform_supported) {
        Shader::ObjectPool<Shader::IR::Inst> pool{8};
        Shader::IR::Block block{pool};
        Shader::IR::Program program{};
        program.stage = Shader::Stage::Compute;
        program.workgroup_size = {1, 1, 1};
        program.blocks.push_back(&block);
        auto& node = program.syntax_list.emplace_back();
        node.type = Shader::IR::AbstractSyntaxNode::Type::Block;
        node.data.block = &block;
        program.syntax_list.emplace_back().type =
            Shader::IR::AbstractSyntaxNode::Type::Return;
        Shader::TextureBufferDescriptor descriptor{};
        descriptor.count = descriptor_count;
        program.info.texture_buffer_descriptors.push_back(descriptor);
        if (descriptor_count == 2) {
            // Verify an actual element-1 texel read in the real SPIR-V
            // backend, not merely an unused declaration of OpTypeArray.
            Shader::IR::TextureInstInfo info{};
            // This maintained IR ABI stores the texture kind in raw bits
            // 16..18; its BitField assignment operators are intentionally
            // deleted, so construct the flag word in one operation.
            info.raw = static_cast<u32>(Shader::TextureType::Buffer) << 16;
            block.AppendNewInst(
                Shader::IR::Opcode::ImageFetch,
                {Shader::IR::Value{u32{1}}, Shader::IR::Value{u32{4}},
                 Shader::IR::Value{}, Shader::IR::Value{},
                 Shader::IR::Value{}});
            block.back().SetFlags(info);
            // Exercise the non-immediate index path too. This IR value
            // remains an OpIAdd result at emission time, not a literal
            // descriptor index baked into OpAccessChain.
            block.AppendNewInst(
                Shader::IR::Opcode::IAdd32,
                {Shader::IR::Value{u32{0}}, Shader::IR::Value{u32{1}}});
            const Shader::IR::Value dynamic_index{&block.back()};
            block.AppendNewInst(
                Shader::IR::Opcode::ImageFetch,
                {dynamic_index, Shader::IR::Value{u32{8}},
                 Shader::IR::Value{}, Shader::IR::Value{},
                 Shader::IR::Value{}});
            block.back().SetFlags(info);
        }
        Shader::Profile profile{};
        profile.supported_spirv = 0x00010500;
        // The production G01 emitter refuses dynamic descriptor-array
        // indexes unless Vulkan advertises the precise texel-buffer
        // non-uniform indexing feature. Test both allowed and forbidden
        // paths with the exact same genuine IR and SPIR-V emitter.
        profile.support_uniform_texel_buffer_array_nonuniform_indexing =
            nonuniform_supported;
        Shader::Backend::Bindings bindings{};
        std::vector<u32> words;
        try {
            // Real native compiler scope is thread-local; NS1 remains intact.
            NativeSpirvCbufBoundsScope native_bounds;
            words = Shader::Backend::SPIRV::EmitSPIRV(
                profile, Shader::RuntimeInfo{}, program, bindings);
        } catch (const std::exception& ex) {
            const std::string why{ex.what()};
            const bool refused_empty = descriptor_count == 0 &&
                why.find("Empty texture buffer descriptor array") != std::string::npos;
            const bool refused_nonuniform = descriptor_count == 2 &&
                !nonuniform_supported &&
                why.find("Native dynamic image descriptor requires non-uniform indexing support")
                    != std::string::npos;
            Require(expect_reject && (refused_empty || refused_nonuniform),
                    "texture-buffer descriptor rejection was not the expected ABI guard");
            return;
        }
        Require(!expect_reject && words.size() > 5 && words[0] == 0x07230203U,
                "native texture-buffer descriptor array produced no SPIR-V");
        u32 arrays{};
        u32 fetches{};
        u32 address_chains{};
        for (std::size_t pos = 5; pos < words.size();) {
            const u32 encoded = words[pos];
            const u32 count = encoded >> 16;
            Require(count && count <= words.size() - pos,
                    "invalid real texture-buffer SPIR-V instruction stream");
            arrays += (encoded & 0xffffU) == static_cast<u32>(spv::Op::OpTypeArray);
            fetches += (encoded & 0xffffU) == static_cast<u32>(spv::Op::OpImageFetch);
            address_chains += (encoded & 0xffffU) == static_cast<u32>(spv::Op::OpAccessChain);
            pos += count;
        }
        Require(arrays >= 1, "missing SPIR-V OpTypeArray for texture buffers");
        Require(fetches == 2 && address_chains >= 2,
                "native literal/dynamic texel fetch did not index the real descriptor array");
        const std::string file_name = prefix + "-texbuf-array.spv";
        std::ofstream output{file_name, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc};
        Require(bool(output), "cannot open descriptor array module");
        output.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(words.data()),
                     static_cast<std::streamsize>(words.size() * sizeof(u32)));
        Require(bool(output), "cannot write descriptor array module");
    };
    compile(2, false, true); // Valid OpAccessChain with advertised Vulkan capability.
    compile(2, true, false); // Missing capability must fail before emitting a guest texture.
    compile(0, true, true); // Missing descriptor must fail independently of capability.
    std::puts("P2_2C_REAL_TEXTURE_BUFFER_ARRAY_SPIRV_EMITTED count=2 indexed_fetch=2 dynamic_index=1 zero_rejected=1 capability_refused=1");
}
// G07: genuine native image-buffer descriptor fetch -> SSBO write.
// This is a real SPIR-V emitter path, subsequently dispatched by Vulkan;
// the separate sampled-image/TIC+TSC path is NOT claimed by this fixture.
static void VerifyNativeTexelSsboSpirv(const std::string& prefix) {
    using Shader::IR::Opcode;
    using Shader::IR::Value;
    Shader::ObjectPool<Shader::IR::Inst> pool{32};
    Shader::IR::Block block{pool};
    Shader::IR::Program program{};
    program.stage = Shader::Stage::Compute;
    program.workgroup_size = {1, 1, 1};
    program.blocks.push_back(&block);
    auto& node = program.syntax_list.emplace_back();
    node.type = Shader::IR::AbstractSyntaxNode::Type::Block;
    node.data.block = &block;
    program.syntax_list.emplace_back().type =
        Shader::IR::AbstractSyntaxNode::Type::Return;
    Shader::TextureBufferDescriptor texel{};
    texel.count = 2;
    program.info.texture_buffer_descriptors.push_back(texel);
    Shader::TextureDescriptor sampled{};
    sampled.type = Shader::TextureType::Color2D;
    sampled.count = 1;
    program.info.texture_descriptors.push_back(sampled);
    program.info.storage_buffers_descriptors.push_back({0, 0, 1, true});
    program.info.used_storage_buffer_types = Shader::IR::Type::U32;
    Shader::IR::TextureInstInfo image{};
    image.raw = static_cast<u32>(Shader::TextureType::Buffer) << 16;
    const auto fetch_and_commit = [&](Value descriptor, u32 texel_index, u32 offset) {
        block.AppendNewInst(Opcode::ImageFetch,
            {descriptor, Value{texel_index}, Value{}, Value{}, Value{}});
        block.back().SetFlags(image);
        const Value pixel{&block.back()};
        block.AppendNewInst(Opcode::CompositeExtractF32x4,
                            {pixel, Value{u32{0}}});
        const Value channel{&block.back()};
        block.AppendNewInst(Opcode::BitCastU32F32, {channel});
        const Value bits{&block.back()};
        block.AppendNewInst(Opcode::WriteStorage32,
                            {Value{u32{0}}, Value{offset}, bits});
    };
    // First and last selected descriptors must remain distinct. The
    // second index is non-immediate IR, not a constant OpAccessChain index.
    fetch_and_commit(Value{u32{0}}, 4, 0);
    // Actual runtime guest descriptor selection: read the SSBO word
    // at byte offset 12; index is NOT a constant IR expression.
    block.AppendNewInst(Opcode::LoadStorage32,
                        {Value{u32{0}}, Value{u32{12}}});
    const Value source_descriptor_index{&block.back()};
    // The guest shader itself masks the SSBO-selected descriptor to [0,1].
    block.AppendNewInst(Opcode::BitwiseAnd32,
                        {source_descriptor_index, Value{u32{1}}});
    const Value runtime_descriptor_index{&block.back()};
    fetch_and_commit(runtime_descriptor_index, 8, 4);
    // The real 2D sampled-image path reads TIC/TSC as a combined
    // sampler+view descriptor. Fetch pixel (1,0) at integer LOD 0 and
    // publish its red channel in the same actual SSBO commit.
    block.AppendNewInst(Opcode::CompositeConstructU32x2,
                        {Value{u32{1}}, Value{u32{0}}});
    const Value pixel_coords{&block.back()};
    block.AppendNewInst(Opcode::ImageFetch,
        {Value{u32{0}}, pixel_coords, Value{}, Value{u32{0}}, Value{}});
    Shader::IR::TextureInstInfo sampled_info{};
    sampled_info.raw = static_cast<u32>(Shader::TextureType::Color2D) << 16;
    block.back().SetFlags(sampled_info);
    const Value sampled_pixel{&block.back()};
    block.AppendNewInst(Opcode::CompositeExtractF32x4,
                        {sampled_pixel, Value{u32{0}}});
    const Value sampled_red{&block.back()};
    block.AppendNewInst(Opcode::BitCastU32F32, {sampled_red});
    const Value sampled_bits{&block.back()};
    block.AppendNewInst(Opcode::WriteStorage32,
                        {Value{u32{0}}, Value{u32{8}}, sampled_bits});
    Shader::Profile profile{};
    profile.supported_spirv = 0x00010500;
    profile.unified_descriptor_binding = true;
    profile.support_descriptor_aliasing = true;
    // The live G07 SSBO value chooses a uniform texel-buffer descriptor.
    // Its selected Vulkan device must advertise non-uniform indexing;
```
