```cpp
    // this is an allowed-path fixture, not a fallback binding.
    profile.support_uniform_texel_buffer_array_nonuniform_indexing = true;
    Shader::Backend::Bindings bindings{};
    NativeSpirvCbufBoundsScope native_bounds;
    const auto words = Shader::Backend::SPIRV::EmitSPIRV(
        profile, Shader::RuntimeInfo{}, program, bindings);
    Require(words.size() > 5 && words[0] == 0x07230203U,
            "G07 real texture/SSBO module missing");
    u32 image_fetches{}, storage_writes{}, descriptor_chains{};
    for (std::size_t at = 5; at < words.size();) {
        const u32 n = words[at] >> 16;
        Require(n && n <= words.size() - at, "G07 malformed SPIR-V");
        const u32 op = words[at] & 0xffffU;
        image_fetches += op == static_cast<u32>(spv::Op::OpImageFetch);
        storage_writes += op == static_cast<u32>(spv::Op::OpStore);
        descriptor_chains += op == static_cast<u32>(spv::Op::OpAccessChain);
        at += n;
    }
    Require(image_fetches == 3 && storage_writes >= 3 &&
            descriptor_chains >= 2,
            "G07 real source failed to commit texel and sampled 2D image resources");
    const auto file_name = prefix + "-g07-texel-ssbo.spv";
    std::ofstream file{file_name, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc};
    Require(bool(file), "cannot open G07 real SPIR-V output");
    file.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(words.data()),
               static_cast<std::streamsize>(words.size() * sizeof(u32)));
    Require(bool(file), "cannot write G07 real SPIR-V output");
    std::printf("G07_REAL_NATIVE_TEXEL_SSBO_SPIRV_EMITTED words=%zu reads=%u stores=%u\n",
                words.size(), image_fetches, storage_writes);
    // Actual backend negative: an unbounded guest SSBO word must not be
    // accepted as a Vulkan texture descriptor, even if two views exist.
    Shader::ObjectPool<Shader::IR::Inst> unsafe_pool{8};
    Shader::IR::Block unsafe_block{unsafe_pool};
    Shader::IR::Program unsafe_program{};
    unsafe_program.stage = Shader::Stage::Compute;
    unsafe_program.workgroup_size = {1, 1, 1};
    unsafe_program.blocks.push_back(&unsafe_block);
    auto& unsafe_node = unsafe_program.syntax_list.emplace_back();
    unsafe_node.type = Shader::IR::AbstractSyntaxNode::Type::Block;
    unsafe_node.data.block = &unsafe_block;
    unsafe_program.syntax_list.emplace_back().type =
        Shader::IR::AbstractSyntaxNode::Type::Return;
    Shader::TextureBufferDescriptor unbounded_texel{};
    unbounded_texel.count = 2;
    unsafe_program.info.texture_buffer_descriptors.push_back(unbounded_texel);
    unsafe_program.info.storage_buffers_descriptors.push_back({0, 0, 1, false});
    unsafe_program.info.used_storage_buffer_types = Shader::IR::Type::U32;
    unsafe_block.AppendNewInst(Opcode::LoadStorage32,
                               {Value{u32{0}}, Value{u32{12}}});
    const Value unsafe_index{&unsafe_block.back()};
    unsafe_block.AppendNewInst(Opcode::ImageFetch,
        {unsafe_index, Value{u32{4}}, Value{}, Value{}, Value{}});
    unsafe_block.back().SetFlags(image);
    bool real_unbounded_refused = false;
    try {
        (void)Shader::Backend::SPIRV::EmitSPIRV(
            profile, Shader::RuntimeInfo{}, unsafe_program, bindings);
    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        real_unbounded_refused = std::string_view(e.what()).find(
            "Native dynamic image descriptor index unbounded")
                != std::string_view::npos;
    }
    Require(real_unbounded_refused,
        "G01 actual unbounded guest descriptor index was not rejected");
    std::puts("G01_REAL_NATIVE_DYNAMIC_DESCRIPTOR_OOB_FAIL_CLOSED_PASS");
}

// G02: the ACTUAL SPIR-V backend must emit a fully split transform-feedback
// output: two vec2 declarations at the same generic location, with disjoint
// component decorations and byte ranges in one 16-byte guest stream.
static void VerifyRealTransformFeedbackSpirv(const std::string& prefix) {
    using Shader::IR::Opcode;
    using Shader::IR::Value;
    using Shader::IR::Attribute;
    Shader::ObjectPool<Shader::IR::Inst> pool{16};
    Shader::IR::Block block{pool};
    Shader::IR::Program program{};
    program.stage=Shader::Stage::VertexB;
    program.blocks.push_back(&block);
    for (const auto attr : {Attribute::Generic0X, Attribute::Generic0Y,
                            Attribute::Generic0Z, Attribute::Generic0W}) {
        program.info.stores.Set(attr);
        block.AppendNewInst(Opcode::SetAttribute,
                            {Value{attr}, Value{f32{2.5f}}, Value{u32{0}}});
    }
    auto& node=program.syntax_list.emplace_back();
    node.type=Shader::IR::AbstractSyntaxNode::Type::Block;
    node.data.block=&block;
    program.syntax_list.emplace_back().type=
        Shader::IR::AbstractSyntaxNode::Type::Return;
    Shader::RuntimeInfo runtime{};
    runtime.xfb_count=36;
    runtime.xfb_varyings[32].buffer=0;
    runtime.xfb_varyings[32].stream=0;
    runtime.xfb_varyings[32].stride=16;
    runtime.xfb_varyings[32].offset=0;
    runtime.xfb_varyings[32].components=2;
    runtime.xfb_varyings[34].buffer=0;
    runtime.xfb_varyings[34].stream=0;
    runtime.xfb_varyings[34].stride=16;
    runtime.xfb_varyings[34].offset=8;
    runtime.xfb_varyings[34].components=2;
    Shader::Profile profile{};
    profile.supported_spirv=0x00010500;
    Shader::Backend::Bindings bindings{};
    const auto words=Shader::Backend::SPIRV::EmitSPIRV(
        profile,runtime,program,bindings);
    Require(words.size()>5 && words[0]==0x07230203U,
            "real G02 transform-feedback emitter returned no SPIR-V");
    u32 stores{},xfb_decorations{},offset0{},offset8{},component2{},xfb_mode{};
    for (std::size_t i=5;i<words.size();) {
        const u32 word=words[i],count=word>>16,op=word&0xffffU;
        Require(count && count<=words.size()-i,"malformed G02 SPIR-V");
        if (op==static_cast<u32>(spv::Op::OpStore))++stores;
        if (op==static_cast<u32>(spv::Op::OpExecutionMode) && count>=3 &&
            words[i+2]==11U /* SPIR-V ExecutionMode Xfb */)++xfb_mode;
        if (op==static_cast<u32>(spv::Op::OpDecorate) && count>=4) {
            const auto decoration=words[i+2];
            if(decoration==36U /* SPIR-V Decoration XfbBuffer */)++xfb_decorations;
            if(decoration==35U /* SPIR-V Decoration Offset */) {
                offset0+=words[i+3]==0;
                offset8+=words[i+3]==8;
            }
            if(decoration==31U /* SPIR-V Decoration Component */)
                component2+=words[i+3]==2;
        }
        i+=count;
    }
    if (!(stores>=4 && xfb_decorations>=2 && offset0>=1 &&
          offset8>=1 && component2>=1 && xfb_mode>=1)) {
        std::fprintf(stderr,
                     "G02_REAL_XFB_OWNER_DIAGNOSTIC stores=%u buffer=%u "
                     "offset0=%u offset8=%u component2=%u mode=%u words=%zu\\n",
                     stores,xfb_decorations,offset0,offset8,component2,
                     xfb_mode,words.size());
    }
    Require(stores>=4 && xfb_decorations>=2 && offset0>=1 &&
            offset8>=1 && component2>=1 && xfb_mode>=1,
            "actual G02 XFB streams did not split/store four components");
    const auto path=prefix+"-xfb-split.spv";
    std::ofstream file{path,std::ios::binary|std::ios::trunc};
    Require(bool(file),"unable to write real G02 transform-feedback SPIR-V");
    file.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(words.data()),
               static_cast<std::streamsize>(words.size()*sizeof(u32)));
    Require(bool(file),"incomplete real G02 transform-feedback module");
    // An Xfb execution mode cannot belong to Fragment. The ACTUAL native
    // emitter must reject the stage instead of exporting an invalid module.
    program.stage=Shader::Stage::Fragment;
    bool invalid_stage_refused{};
    try {
        (void)Shader::Backend::SPIRV::EmitSPIRV(
            profile,runtime,program,bindings);
    } catch (const std::exception& exception) {
        invalid_stage_refused=std::string(exception.what()).find(
            "Transform feedback on unsupported shader stage") != std::string::npos;
    }
    Require(invalid_stage_refused,
            "native G02 Xfb Fragment stage silently accepted");
    std::printf("P2_G02_REAL_XFB_SPLIT_SPIRV_EMITTED words=%zu stores=%u stage_refused=1\n",
                words.size(),stores);
}

// P2.4/G03: exercise actual non-generic tessellation patch inputs/outputs.
// The SPIR-V backend must not treat TessLevelOuter/Inner as generic location
// attributes: they are built-in Patch variables on *different* stages.
static void VerifyRealTessPatchSpirv(const std::string& prefix) {
    using Shader::IR::Opcode;
    using Shader::IR::Patch;
    using Shader::IR::Value;
    constexpr std::array<Patch, 6> patches{
        Patch::TessellationLodLeft, Patch::TessellationLodTop,
        Patch::TessellationLodRight, Patch::TessellationLodBottom,
        Patch::TessellationLodInteriorU, Patch::TessellationLodInteriorV,
    };
    for (const Shader::Stage stage : {Shader::Stage::TessellationControl,
                                      Shader::Stage::TessellationEval}) {
        const bool control = stage == Shader::Stage::TessellationControl;
        Shader::ObjectPool<Shader::IR::Inst> pool{32};
        Shader::IR::Block block{pool};
        Shader::IR::Program program{};
        program.stage = stage;
        program.invocations = 3;
        program.blocks.push_back(&block);
        if (control) {
            program.info.stores_tess_level_outer = true;
            program.info.stores_tess_level_inner = true;
        }
        for (const Patch patch : patches) {
            if (control) {
                block.AppendNewInst(
                    Opcode::SetPatch, {Value{patch}, Value{f32{2.5f}}});
            }
            block.AppendNewInst(Opcode::GetPatch, {Value{patch}});
        }
        auto& node = program.syntax_list.emplace_back();
        node.type = Shader::IR::AbstractSyntaxNode::Type::Block;
        node.data.block = &block;
        program.syntax_list.emplace_back().type =
            Shader::IR::AbstractSyntaxNode::Type::Return;
        Shader::Backend::Bindings bindings{};
        Shader::Profile profile{};
        profile.supported_spirv = 0x00010500;
        Shader::RuntimeInfo runtime{};
        runtime.tess_primitive = Shader::TessPrimitive::Triangles;
        runtime.tess_spacing = Shader::TessSpacing::Equal;
        std::vector<u32> words;
        try {
            words = Shader::Backend::SPIRV::EmitSPIRV(
                profile, runtime, program, bindings);
        } catch (const std::exception& ex) {
            std::fprintf(stderr, "Real TCS/TES patch emitter: %s\n", ex.what());
            Require(false, "tessellation patch ABI unexpectedly rejected");
        }
        Require(words.size() > 5 && words[0] == 0x07230203U,
                "TCS/TES patch emitter produced no SPIR-V");
        // Stable wire-format SPIR-V decoration/builtin numbers, independent
        // of the scoped/unscoped C++ enumerator spelling in pinned headers.
        constexpr u32 DecorationBuiltIn = 11U;
        constexpr u32 DecorationPatch = 15U;
        constexpr u32 BuiltInTessLevelOuter = 11U;
        constexpr u32 BuiltInTessLevelInner = 12U;
        u32 reads{}, writes{}, outer{}, inner{}, patch_decorations{};
        for (std::size_t i = 5; i < words.size();) {
            const u32 op = words[i], count = op >> 16;
            Require(count && count <= words.size() - i,
                    "malformed real TCS/TES patch module");
            reads += (op & 0xffffU) == static_cast<u32>(spv::Op::OpLoad);
            writes += (op & 0xffffU) == static_cast<u32>(spv::Op::OpStore);
            if ((op & 0xffffU) == static_cast<u32>(spv::Op::OpDecorate) &&
                count >= 3) {
                patch_decorations += words[i + 2] == DecorationPatch;
                if (count >= 4 &&
                    words[i + 2] == DecorationBuiltIn) {
                    outer += words[i + 3] == BuiltInTessLevelOuter;
                    inner += words[i + 3] == BuiltInTessLevelInner;
                }
            }
            i += count;
        }
        Require(reads >= 6 && (!control || writes >= 6),
                "TCS/TES real patch levels not loaded/stored");
        Require(outer >= 1 && inner >= 1 && patch_decorations >= 2,
                "TCS/TES SPIR-V built-in Patch decorations missing");
        const auto path = prefix +
            (control ? "-tess-control.spv" : "-tess-eval.spv");
        std::ofstream file{path, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc};
        Require(bool(file), "cannot open real TCS/TES patch module output");
        file.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(words.data()),
                   static_cast<std::streamsize>(words.size() * sizeof(u32)));
        Require(bool(file), "cannot write real TCS/TES patch module output");
        std::printf("P2_4_REAL_TESS_%s_PATCH_SPIRV_EMITTED slots=6 words=%zu\n",
                    control ? "CONTROL" : "EVAL", words.size());
    }
}

int main(int argc,char** argv) {
    Require(argc==2,"missing output prefix");
    CheckNativeQmdIndirectCbufIR();
    VerifyNativeCbufBankRefusal();
    VerifyRealGlobalCasInvalidDescriptors();
    VerifyRealGlobalCasSpirv(argv[1]);
    VerifyRealFloatCasSpirv(argv[1]);
    VerifyRealTaskMeshSpirv(argv[1]);
    VerifyTaskMeshInvalidDimensions();
    VerifyRealTextureBufferArraySpirv(argv[1]);
    VerifyNativeTexelSsboSpirv(argv[1]);
    VerifyRealTransformFeedbackSpirv(argv[1]);
    VerifyRealTessPatchSpirv(argv[1]);
    std::array<u8,0x50> header{};
    constexpr u32 pred=7U<<12,exit_true=7U<<23;
    std::vector<u8> code;
    Emit(code,pred|0x918);
    Emit(code,pred|0x202|(1U<<16),2,15U<<8);
    Emit(code,pred|0x918);
    Emit(code,pred|0x918);
    Emit(code,pred|0x94d,0,exit_true);
    auto image=BuildMaxwellShaderImage(header,code,static_cast<u32>(Shader::Stage::VertexB));
    Require(image.ValidForCompiler(),"verified native shader image absent");
    auto env=NativeMaxwellEnvironment::CreateOwned(std::make_unique<SyntheticSource>(),std::move(image));
    Require(bool(env),"owned environment creation failed");
    Shader::HostTranslateInfo host{};
    host.min_ssbo_alignment=64;
    host.support_float64=true;
    host.support_float16=true;
    host.support_int64=true;
    host.support_conditional_barrier=true;
    Shader::Profile profile{};
    profile.supported_spirv=0x00010500; // SPIR-V 1.5
    // P2.4: verify the reviewed BRX dispatch against the REAL graphics
    // Maxwell CFG/IR optimizer and Sirit, beyond the CFG-only spy fixture.
    // All guest addresses here come from a synthetic validated two-target
    // table. No game-specific shader or unchecked Maxwell JMX is involved.
    std::vector<u8> brx_native;
    Emit(brx_native,pred|0x817U|(4U<<16),15U,0x03800000U);
    Emit(brx_native,pred|0x819U|(5U<<16)|(4U<<24),2U,0x000006ffU);
    Emit(brx_native,pred|0xb82U|(6U<<16)|(5U<<24),
         (7U<<22)|(0xffc0U<<6),0x00000800U);
    Emit(brx_native,pred|0x949U|(6U<<24),0xffffffc0U,0x0383ffffU);
    Emit(brx_native,pred|0x94dU,0,exit_true);
    for (u32 i=0;i<4;++i) Emit(brx_native,pred|0x918U);
    Emit(brx_native,pred|0x94dU,0,exit_true);
    NativeIndirectBranchPlan brx_plan{};
    brx_plan.branch_instruction_index=3;
    brx_plan.raw_pc_base=0x80;
    brx_plan.targets={{0x80U,0U},{0x100U,8U}};
    auto brx_image=BuildMaxwellShaderImage(
        header,brx_native,static_cast<u32>(Shader::Stage::VertexB),
        std::span<const NativeIndirectBranchPlan>{&brx_plan,1});
    Require(brx_image.ValidForCompiler(),"checked BRX image not compilable");
    auto brx_env=NativeMaxwellEnvironment::CreateOwned(
        std::make_unique<SyntheticSource>(),std::move(brx_image));
    Require(bool(brx_env),"checked BRX environment not owned");
    const auto brx_spirv=CompileReviewedNativeVertexSpirv(
        *brx_env,host,profile,Shader::RuntimeInfo{},false);
    Require(brx_spirv.PipelineMetadataReady() &&
            brx_spirv.words.size()>5 && brx_spirv.words[0]==0x07230203U,
            "actual BRX CFG/IR/SPIR-V graphics compilation failed");
    // Parsing instruction boundaries proves this SPIR-V still contains a
    // dynamic dispatch instead of merely a valid header and dead branches.
    u32 conditional_branches{};
    u32 loop_merges{};
    for (std::size_t i=5;i<brx_spirv.words.size();) {
        const u32 op=brx_spirv.words[i];
        const u32 words=op>>16;
        Require(words!=0 && words<=brx_spirv.words.size()-i,
                "BRX SPIR-V instruction stream malformed");
        conditional_branches+=(op&0xffffU)==250U; // OpBranchConditional
        loop_merges+=(op&0xffffU)==246U;          // OpLoopMerge
        i+=words;
    }
    Require(conditional_branches>=2 && loop_merges>=1,
            "checked BRX dispatch was optimized out of real shader IR");
    {
        const auto output=std::string(argv[1])+"-brx.spv";
        std::ofstream file{output,std::ios::binary|std::ios::trunc};
        Require(bool(file),"cannot write BRX SPIR-V");
        file.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(brx_spirv.words.data()),
                   static_cast<std::streamsize>(brx_spirv.words.size()*sizeof(u32)));
        Require(bool(file),"BRX SPIR-V export failed");
    }
    // Emit an authentic Compute execution model from the same synthetic
    // 128-bit Ampere instruction sequence, without a graphics SPH.
    auto compute_image=BuildMaxwellShaderImage(
        header,code,static_cast<u32>(Shader::Stage::Compute));
    Require(compute_image.ValidForCompiler(),"compute native lowering invalid");
    auto compute_env=NativeMaxwellEnvironment::CreateComputeOwned(
        std::make_unique<SyntheticSource>(Shader::Stage::Compute),
        std::move(compute_image));
    Require(bool(compute_env) && compute_env->StartAddress()==0x50,
            "compute translation environment rejected");
    const auto compute=CompileReviewedNativeComputeSpirv(
        *compute_env,host,profile,Shader::RuntimeInfo{});
    Require(compute.ComputeMetadataReady() &&
            !compute.PipelineMetadataReady() &&
            compute.words.size()>5 && compute.words[0]==0x07230203U,
            "Ampere Compute CFG/IR -> actual SPIR-V failed");

    // Exercise the production-facing QMD3 metadata environment with the
    // ACTUAL reviewed Maxwell CFG/IR/SPIR-V compiler. The earlier synthetic
    // source has no native 49-bit CBUF metadata, so it cannot prove this ABI.
    Tegra::NativeQmdScheduler::Descriptor native_qmd{};
    native_qmd[8]=0x80;
    native_qmd[12]=3; native_qmd[13]=4; native_qmd[14]=5;
    native_qmd[17]=16U; // STS-backed LDC fixture needs real workgroup memory
    native_qmd[18]=0x30U | (2U<<16);
    native_qmd[19]=4U | (8U<<16);
    native_qmd[20]=1U; // Enabled CBUF0.
    native_qmd[32]=0x12340000U;
    native_qmd[33]=0x10000U | (1U<<19); // GPU VA above 40 bits, 16 bytes.
    native_qmd[48]=0x100000U; native_qmd[49]=0x10000U;
    const auto launch=Tegra::DecodeNativeComputeLaunch(native_qmd);
    Require(launch && launch->constant_buffers[0].gpu_address==0x1000012340000ULL,
            "QMD3 Compute compiler lost native CBUF upper address bits");
    GuestFixture cbuf_guest{};
    cbuf_guest.address=launch->constant_buffers[0].gpu_address;
    cbuf_guest.bytes.resize(16);
    cbuf_guest.bytes[0]=0x78; cbuf_guest.bytes[1]=0x56;
    cbuf_guest.bytes[2]=0x34; cbuf_guest.bytes[3]=0x12;
    auto native_qmd_context=std::make_unique<NativeQmdComputeEnvironment>(
        *launch,ReadGuest,&cbuf_guest,
        std::make_unique<SyntheticSource>(Shader::Stage::Compute));
    Require(native_qmd_context->ReadCbufValue(0,0)==0x12345678 &&
            (native_qmd_context->WorkgroupSize()==std::array<u32,3>{2,4,8}),
            "real QMD context must provide 49-bit mapped CBUF and workgroups");
    auto qmd_image=BuildMaxwellShaderImage(
        header,code,static_cast<u32>(Shader::Stage::Compute));
    auto qmd_compiler_env=NativeMaxwellEnvironment::CreateComputeOwned(
        std::move(native_qmd_context),std::move(qmd_image));
    Require(bool(qmd_compiler_env) && qmd_compiler_env->StartAddress()==0x50,
            "native QMD environment did not enter compiler CFG");
    const auto real_qmd_spirv=CompileReviewedNativeComputeSpirv(
        *qmd_compiler_env,host,profile,Shader::RuntimeInfo{});
    Require(real_qmd_spirv.ComputeMetadataReady() &&
            real_qmd_spirv.words.size()>5 &&
            real_qmd_spirv.words[0]==0x07230203U,
            "native QMD3 metadata failed real Ampere IR/SPIR-V emission");
    // P2.3: compile real native LDC.U32 (0xb82) through Ampere lowering,
    // Maxwell's byte-offset translator and the native QMD3 CBUF binder.
    // The encoded LDC uses RZ as the byte-offset register, so this is a
    // real direct-bank shader, not synthetic IR manually inserted downstream.
    const auto verify_native_ldc = [&](u32 bank, u32 enabled_mask,
                                        bool should_compile) {
        std::vector<u8> ldc_code;
        Emit(ldc_code, pred | 0x918);
        Emit(ldc_code, pred | 0xb82 | (1U << 16) | (255U << 24),
             bank << 22, 4U << 9); // LDC.U32 R1, c[bank][RZ+0]
        Emit(ldc_code, pred | 0x388 | (255U << 24),
             1U, 4U << 9); // STS.U32 [RZ+0], R1: keep LDC observable
        Emit(ldc_code, pred | 0x918);
        Emit(ldc_code, pred | 0x918);
        Emit(ldc_code, pred | 0x94d, 0, exit_true);
        auto ldc_image = BuildMaxwellShaderImage(
            header, ldc_code, static_cast<u32>(Shader::Stage::Compute));
        Require(ldc_image.ValidForCompiler(), "native LDC image rejected");
        auto ldc_launch = *launch;
        for (u32 i = 0; i < ldc_launch.constant_buffers.size(); ++i) {
            ldc_launch.constant_buffers[i].enabled =
                (enabled_mask & (1U << i)) != 0;
            if (ldc_launch.constant_buffers[i].enabled) {
                ldc_launch.constant_buffers[i].gpu_address = cbuf_guest.address;
                ldc_launch.constant_buffers[i].size = 16;
            }
        }
        auto reader = std::make_unique<NativeQmdComputeEnvironment>(
            ldc_launch, ReadGuest, &cbuf_guest,
            std::make_unique<SyntheticSource>(Shader::Stage::Compute));
        auto* const planner = reader.get();
        auto ldc_env = NativeMaxwellEnvironment::CreateComputeOwned(
            std::move(reader), std::move(ldc_image));
        Require(bool(ldc_env), "native LDC compute environment rejected");
        const auto compiled = CompileReviewedNativeComputeSpirv(
            *ldc_env, host, profile, Shader::RuntimeInfo{},
            Shader::Backend::Bindings{}, enabled_mask);
        if (!should_compile) {
            Require(compiled.status == NativeSpirvStatus::CompilationFailed &&
                    compiled.words.empty(),
                    "unbacked QMD3 bank was accepted by native SPIR-V");
            return;
        }
        Require(compiled.ComputeMetadataReady() &&
                compiled.words.size() > 5 &&
                compiled.words[0] == 0x07230203U,
                "authentic LDC 0xb82 did not reach SPIR-V");
        auto plan = planner->BuildResourcePlan(*compiled.info);
        Require(plan && plan->uniform_buffers.size() == 1 &&
                plan->uniform_buffers[0].qmd_index == bank &&
                plan->uniform_buffers[0].gpu_address == cbuf_guest.address &&
                plan->uniform_buffers[0].bytes == 16,
                "native LDC QMD3 bank and reflected descriptor differ");
        // Validate the actual live LDC path with spirv-val, not just the
        // header-only Compute fixture which has no CBUF instructions.
        const auto output=std::string(argv[1])+"-cbuf"+std::to_string(bank)+".spv";
        std::ofstream file{output,std::ios::binary|std::ios::trunc};
        Require(bool(file),"cannot write native LDC SPIR-V");
        file.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(compiled.words.data()),
                   static_cast<std::streamsize>(compiled.words.size()*sizeof(u32)));
        Require(bool(file),"native LDC SPIR-V export failed");
    };
    verify_native_ldc(0, 0x01U, true);
    verify_native_ldc(7, 0x80U, true);
    verify_native_ldc(7, 0x01U, false);
    verify_native_ldc(8, 0xffU, false);
    std::puts("NS2 QMD3 native LDC 0xb82 direct-bank SPIR-V: PASS");

    // The real host Vulkan shader-module/pipeline/queue test consumes THIS
    // QMD3-backed compiler output, rather than the earlier mock source.
    {
        const auto output=std::string(argv[1])+"-compute.spv";
        std::ofstream file{output,std::ios::binary|std::ios::trunc};
        Require(bool(file),"cannot write Compute SPIR-V");
        file.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(real_qmd_spirv.words.data()),
                   static_cast<std::streamsize>(real_qmd_spirv.words.size()*sizeof(u32)));
        file.close();
        Require(bool(file),"could not flush Compute SPIR-V");
        std::printf("QMD3 SPIR-V emitted: %s (%zu words)\\n",
                    output.c_str(),real_qmd_spirv.words.size());
    }
    // Distinct workgroups, CB metadata and program ownership must be carried
    // through this real compiler; no guest execution is asserted here.
    std::vector<u32> baseline_direct;
    for (bool dispatcher:{false,true}) {
        const auto compiled=CompileReviewedNativeVertexSpirv(
            *env,host,profile,Shader::RuntimeInfo{},dispatcher);
        Require(compiled.PipelineMetadataReady() && compiled.stage == Shader::Stage::VertexB,
                "native VertexB shader must return pipeline Info and stage");
        const auto& words=compiled.words;
        if (!dispatcher) baseline_direct=words;
        Require(words.size()>5&&words[0]==0x07230203U,"missing SPIR-V magic");
        Require(words[1]==profile.supported_spirv&&words[3]>0,"bad version or ID bound");
        const auto output=std::string(argv[1])+(dispatcher?"-dispatcher.spv":"-direct.spv");
        std::ofstream file{output,std::ios::binary|std::ios::trunc};
        Require(bool(file),"cannot create validation file");
        file.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(words.data()),
                   static_cast<std::streamsize>(words.size()*sizeof(u32)));
        file.close();
        Require(bool(file),"cannot flush complete SPIR-V");
        std::printf("SPIR-V emitted: %s (%zu words)\n",output.c_str(),words.size());
    }
    // Compile an actual native Fragment stage through Maxwell IR and Sirit.
    // The explicit stage-aware path must emit a real Fragment execution model;
    // it must not relabel the old VertexB module as Fragment.
    auto fragment_image=BuildMaxwellShaderImage(
        header,code,static_cast<u32>(Shader::Stage::Fragment));
    Require(fragment_image.ValidForCompiler(),"fragment shader lowering invalid");
    auto fragment_env=NativeMaxwellEnvironment::CreateOwned(
        std::make_unique<SyntheticSource>(Shader::Stage::Fragment),
        std::move(fragment_image));
    Require(bool(fragment_env),"fragment source ownership rejected");
    const auto fragment_via_legacy=CompileReviewedNativeVertexSpirv(
        *fragment_env,host,profile,Shader::RuntimeInfo{});
    Require(fragment_via_legacy.status==NativeSpirvStatus::UnsupportedStage &&
            fragment_via_legacy.words.empty(),
            "legacy VertexB API must reject a real Fragment stage");
    const auto fragment=CompileReviewedNativeGraphicsSpirv(
        *fragment_env,host,profile,Shader::RuntimeInfo{});
    Require(fragment.PipelineMetadataReady() && fragment.stage == Shader::Stage::Fragment &&
            fragment.words.size()>5 &&
            fragment.words[0]==0x07230203U && fragment.words[3]!=0,
            "stage-aware native Fragment SPIR-V emission failed");
    {
        const auto output=std::string(argv[1])+"-fragment.spv";
        std::ofstream file{output,std::ios::binary|std::ios::trunc};
        Require(bool(file),"cannot write Fragment SPIR-V");
        file.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(fragment.words.data()),
                   static_cast<std::streamsize>(fragment.words.size()*sizeof(u32)));
        file.close();
        Require(bool(file),"could not flush actual Fragment SPIR-V");
    }
    // The VertexA program must run before VertexB, exactly as in the real
    // maintained Vulkan pipeline's MergeDualVertexPrograms call.
    auto merge_a=BuildMaxwellShaderImage(
        header,code,static_cast<u32>(Shader::Stage::VertexA));
    auto merge_b=BuildMaxwellShaderImage(
        header,code,static_cast<u32>(Shader::Stage::VertexB));
    auto merge_env_a=NativeMaxwellEnvironment::CreateOwned(
        std::make_unique<SyntheticSource>(Shader::Stage::VertexA),std::move(merge_a));
    auto merge_env_b=NativeMaxwellEnvironment::CreateOwned(
        std::make_unique<SyntheticSource>(Shader::Stage::VertexB),std::move(merge_b));
    Require(merge_env_a && merge_env_b,
            "both native vertex stages need owned Maxwell environments");
    const auto merged=CompileReviewedNativeMergedVertexSpirv(
        *merge_env_a,*merge_env_b,host,profile,Shader::RuntimeInfo{});
    Require(merged.PipelineMetadataReady() && merged.stage == Shader::Stage::VertexB &&
            merged.words.size()>5 &&
            merged.words[0]==0x07230203U && merged.words[3]!=0,
            "real VertexA+VertexB Maxwell merge SPIR-V emission failed");
    {
        const auto output=std::string(argv[1])+"-merged.spv";
        std::ofstream file{output,std::ios::binary|std::ios::trunc};
        Require(bool(file),"cannot write merged vertex SPIR-V");
        file.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(merged.words.data()),
                   static_cast<std::streamsize>(merged.words.size()*sizeof(u32)));
        file.close();Require(bool(file),"could not flush merged native vertex SPIR-V");
    }
    // Native stages must share the same descriptor binding sequence as the
    // maintained Vulkan graphics pipeline; each stage may not restart at 0.
    Shader::Backend::Bindings initial_bindings{};
    initial_bindings.uniform_buffer = 3;
    initial_bindings.texture = 11;
    const auto chained_vertex = CompileReviewedNativeMergedVertexSpirv(
        *merge_env_a,*merge_env_b,host,profile,Shader::RuntimeInfo{},initial_bindings);
    Require(chained_vertex.PipelineMetadataReady() &&
            chained_vertex.next_bindings.uniform_buffer >= initial_bindings.uniform_buffer &&
            chained_vertex.next_bindings.texture >= initial_bindings.texture,
            "native merged vertex pipeline lost the incoming binding seed");
    const auto chained_fragment = CompileReviewedNativeGraphicsSpirv(
        *fragment_env,host,profile,Shader::RuntimeInfo{},false,
        chained_vertex.next_bindings);
    Require(chained_fragment.PipelineMetadataReady() &&
            chained_fragment.stage == Shader::Stage::Fragment &&
            chained_fragment.next_bindings.uniform_buffer >= chained_vertex.next_bindings.uniform_buffer &&
            chained_fragment.next_bindings.texture >= chained_vertex.next_bindings.texture,
            "native graphics stages lost their cumulative Vulkan descriptor bindings");
    const auto rejected_merge=CompileReviewedNativeMergedVertexSpirv(
        *merge_env_b,*merge_env_a,host,profile,Shader::RuntimeInfo{});
    Require(rejected_merge.status==NativeSpirvStatus::UnsupportedStage &&
            rejected_merge.words.empty(),
            "swapped native vertex stages must never generate a module");
    auto vertex_a_image=BuildMaxwellShaderImage(
        header,code,static_cast<u32>(Shader::Stage::VertexA));
    Require(vertex_a_image.ValidForCompiler(),"VertexA negative fixture failed");
    auto vertex_a_env=NativeMaxwellEnvironment::CreateOwned(
        std::make_unique<SyntheticSource>(Shader::Stage::VertexA),
        std::move(vertex_a_image));
    Require(bool(vertex_a_env),"VertexA environment must exist before stage gate");
    const auto rejected=CompileReviewedNativeVertexSpirv(
        *vertex_a_env,host,profile,Shader::RuntimeInfo{});
    Require(rejected.status==NativeSpirvStatus::UnsupportedStage &&
            rejected.words.empty(),"unmerged VertexA must fail closed");
    auto& registry=Service::Nvidia::Devices::NativeGpuProcessRegistry::Instance();
    Kernel::KProcess process{};
    GuestFixture guest{};
    guest.bytes.resize(0x1000+0x80+code.size());
    std::copy(header.begin(),header.end(),guest.bytes.begin());
    std::copy(code.begin(),code.end(),guest.bytes.begin()+0x80);
    std::copy(header.begin(),header.end(),guest.bytes.begin()+0x1000);
    std::copy(code.begin(),code.end(),guest.bytes.begin()+0x1000+0x80);
    auto compile=[&](Shader::Stage stage,bool dispatcher=false) {
        return VideoCommon::CompileCapturedNs2VertexSpirvFromReader(
            &process,std::make_unique<SyntheticSource>(stage),
            guest.address,ReadGuest,&guest,host,profile,Shader::RuntimeInfo{},
            nullptr,dispatcher);
    };
    const auto missing=compile(Shader::Stage::VertexB);
    Require(missing.status==NativeSpirvStatus::InactiveSession &&
            missing.words.empty() && guest.reads==0,
            "unregistered process must not access guest GPU memory");
    Require(registry.Register(&process),"failed creating NS2 session fixture");
    // The explicit session-owned Compute API reads only code bytes, not a
    // shader graphics header. Reject unrelated stages before GMMU access.
    guest.reads=0;
    const auto wrong_compute_stage=VideoCommon::CompileCapturedNs2ComputeSpirvFromReader(
        &process,std::make_unique<SyntheticSource>(Shader::Stage::VertexB),
        guest.address+0x80,ReadGuest,&guest,host,profile,Shader::RuntimeInfo{});
    Require(wrong_compute_stage.status==NativeSpirvStatus::UnsupportedStage &&
            wrong_compute_stage.words.empty() && guest.reads==0,
            "QMD Compute compiler must reject graphics stages before GMMU read");
    const auto session_compute=VideoCommon::CompileCapturedNs2ComputeSpirvFromReader(
        &process,std::make_unique<SyntheticSource>(Shader::Stage::Compute),
        guest.address+0x80,ReadGuest,&guest,host,profile,Shader::RuntimeInfo{});
    Require(session_compute.ComputeMetadataReady() &&
            session_compute.words==compute.words && guest.reads>0,
            "QMD-owned compute capture did not compile identical SPIR-V");
    // The existing graphics-stage isolation tests must begin with a clean
    // guest read counter; the Compute test intentionally performed real reads.
    guest.reads=0;
    const auto token=registry.CaptureTicket(&process);
    Require(token.has_value(),"no live NS2 GPU ticket");
    const auto no_vertex_a=compile(Shader::Stage::VertexA);
    Require(no_vertex_a.status==NativeSpirvStatus::UnsupportedStage &&
            no_vertex_a.words.empty() && guest.reads==0,
            "unmerged VertexA must reject without GMMU reads");
    const auto fragment_legacy=compile(Shader::Stage::Fragment);
    Require(fragment_legacy.status==NativeSpirvStatus::UnsupportedStage &&
            fragment_legacy.words.empty() && guest.reads==0,
            "legacy vertex session API must reject Fragment before GMMU read");
    const auto fragment_capture=VideoCommon::CompileCapturedNs2GraphicsSpirvFromReader(
        &process,std::make_unique<SyntheticSource>(Shader::Stage::Fragment),
        guest.address,ReadGuest,&guest,host,profile,Shader::RuntimeInfo{});
    Require(fragment_capture.PipelineMetadataReady() &&
            fragment_capture.words==fragment.words,
            "authenticated Fragment capture must compile the same SPIR-V module");
    guest.reads=0;
    const auto seeded_guest_fragment=VideoCommon::CompileCapturedNs2GraphicsSpirvFromReader(
        &process,std::make_unique<SyntheticSource>(Shader::Stage::Fragment),
        guest.address,ReadGuest,&guest,host,profile,Shader::RuntimeInfo{},
        nullptr,false,chained_vertex.next_bindings);
    Require(seeded_guest_fragment.PipelineMetadataReady() &&
            seeded_guest_fragment.stage == Shader::Stage::Fragment &&
            seeded_guest_fragment.next_bindings.uniform_buffer >= chained_vertex.next_bindings.uniform_buffer &&
            seeded_guest_fragment.next_bindings.texture >= chained_vertex.next_bindings.texture &&
            guest.reads>0,
            "authenticated GPU capture failed to propagate graphics binding seed");
    guest.reads=0;
    const auto merged_capture=VideoCommon::CompileCapturedNs2MergedVertexSpirvFromReader(
        &process,std::make_unique<SyntheticSource>(Shader::Stage::VertexA),
        std::make_unique<SyntheticSource>(Shader::Stage::VertexB),
        guest.address,guest.address+0x1000,ReadGuest,&guest,
        host,profile,Shader::RuntimeInfo{});
    Require(merged_capture.PipelineMetadataReady() && merged_capture.words==merged.words,
            "same-process native VertexA/B capture must match real merged IR/SPIR-V");
    const auto rejected_pair=VideoCommon::CompileCapturedNs2MergedVertexSpirvFromReader(
        &process,std::make_unique<SyntheticSource>(Shader::Stage::VertexA),
        std::make_unique<SyntheticSource>(Shader::Stage::VertexB),
        guest.address,guest.address,ReadGuest,&guest,
        host,profile,Shader::RuntimeInfo{});
    Require(rejected_pair.status==NativeSpirvStatus::UnsupportedStage &&
            rejected_pair.words.empty(),
            "ambiguous same-address native dual vertex pair must reject");
    const auto complete=compile(Shader::Stage::VertexB);
    Require(complete.PipelineMetadataReady() && complete.words==baseline_direct && guest.reads>0,
            "registered guest shader capture must match real Maxwell SPIR-V");
    guest.reads=0;
    guest.unregister_on_read=&process;
    const auto torn_down=compile(Shader::Stage::VertexB);
    Require(torn_down.status==NativeSpirvStatus::InactiveSession &&
            torn_down.words.empty() && guest.reads>0,
            "session teardown during shader capture must not publish SPIR-V");
    Require(!registry.IsCurrent(*token),"closed session ticket still authorized");
    Require(registry.Register(&process),"failed reopening NS2 session");
    const auto reopened=registry.CaptureTicket(&process);
    Require(reopened && reopened->generation!=token->generation &&
            !registry.IsCurrent(*token),"reopened session reused old ticket");
    const auto after_reopen=compile(Shader::Stage::VertexB,true);
    Require(after_reopen.Ready(),"reopened authenticated session must compile");
    registry.Unregister(&process);
    Require(registry.Count()==0,"test session leaked");
    std::puts("NS2 verified GMMU reader -> Maxwell IR -> SPIR-V: PASS "
              "(no-session/VertexA reject, mid-capture teardown, reopen)");
    std::puts("NS2 real SPIR-V emitter PASS (host-only; Vulkan and PS5 not executed)");
}
```

`tools/ns2/test_ampere_scalar_alu_sources.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// P2.4: actual Ampere -> Maxwell lowering, without a game or fake renderer.
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/lower_to_maxwell.h"
#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/probe.h"
#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/lower_bridge.h"

using namespace Shader::Ampere;
constexpr Instruction Exit{{0x0000794dU, 0, 0x03800000U, 0x000fea00U}};

static Instruction Frnd(u32 op, u32 dest, u32 src, u32 bank = 0) {
    return Instruction{{(7U << 12) | op | (dest << 16),
                        op == 0xb07 ? (src << 6) | (bank << 22) : src,
                        (2U << 11) | (2U << 20), 0x000fe200U}};
}
static Instruction UniformSel(u32 opcode, u32 dest, u32 source_a, u32 source_b) {
    // The 0xc07 variant encodes a uniform source B (UR0..UR62 or UR63=RZ).
    return Instruction{{(7U << 12) | opcode | (dest << 16) | (source_a << 24),
                        source_b, 7U << 23, 0x000fe200U}};
}
static LoweredProgram Lower(const Instruction& inst) {
    const std::array code{inst, Exit};
    return LowerToMaxwell(code);
}
static bool Reviewed(const Instruction& inst) {
    const auto* row = FindOpcodeRow(inst.Bits(0,12));
    return row && FirstUnreviewedBit(inst,*row) < 0;
}
static std::array<u8, 2 * sizeof(Instruction)> Encode(const Instruction& inst) {
    std::array<u8, 2 * sizeof(Instruction)> bytes{};
    const std::array code{inst, Exit};
    for (u32 i = 0; i < code.size(); ++i)
        for (u32 word = 0; word < 4; ++word)
            for (u32 byte = 0; byte < 4; ++byte)
                bytes[i * sizeof(Instruction) + word * 4 + byte] =
                    static_cast<u8>(code[i].words[word] >> (byte * 8));
    return bytes;
}
static LowerBridgeResult Bridge(const Instruction& inst) {
    const auto bytes=Encode(inst);
    return LowerReviewedToMaxwell(bytes);
}
static void Require(bool pass, const char* why) {
    if (!pass) {
        std::fprintf(stderr,"NS2 native FRND CBUF FAIL: %s\n", why);
        std::exit(1);
    }
}
int main() {
    for (const auto& [bank, offset] : std::array<std::pair<u32,u32>, 3>{
            {{0,4},{7,508},{17,65532}}}) {
        const auto inst=Frnd(0xb07,5,offset,bank);
        Require(Reviewed(inst), "CBUF source must be admitted by actual ISA field table");
        const auto lowered=Lower(inst);
        Require(bool(lowered), lowered.error.data());
        Require(lowered.source_instruction_offsets.size()==2, "two input offsets");
        const u64 word=lowered.instructions[lowered.source_instruction_offsets[0]];
        Require((word >> 56)==0x4c, "Maxwell FRND CBUF opcode");
        Require((word & 255)==5, "destination register retained");
        Require(((word>>20)&0x3fff)==offset/4, "constant byte offset converted to words");
        Require(((word>>34)&0x1f)==bank, "constant buffer bank retained");
        const auto reviewed=Bridge(inst);
        Require(reviewed.Ready(), reviewed.reason.data());
        Require(reviewed.preflight.recognized==2 &&
                reviewed.consumed_native_bytes==2*sizeof(Instruction) &&
                reviewed.maxwell_instructions[reviewed.source_instruction_offsets[0]]==word,
                "renderer bridge accepts the reviewed CBUF semantics, no private lowerer path");
    }
    const auto register_form=Frnd(0x307,5,22);
    Require(Reviewed(register_form), "GPR source still accepted by ISA table");
    const auto original=Lower(register_form);
    Require(bool(original), original.error.data());
    const u64 gpr_word=original.instructions[original.source_instruction_offsets[0]];
    Require((gpr_word>>56)==0x5c, "native register FRND unchanged");
    Require(((gpr_word>>20)&255)==22, "native register source unchanged");
    Require(Bridge(register_form).Ready(), "normal FRND remains accepted in the full bridge");

    // The canonical F2F.F16.F32 conversion shares the original Maxwell
    // F2F opcode for GPR, 32-bit literal, direct CBUF, and uniform source.
    for (const u32 bits : {0U,0x3f800000U,0xbf800000U,0x7fc00001U}) {
        const Instruction inst{{(7U<<12)|0x904U|(5U<<16),bits,
                                0x00200800U,0x000fe200U}};
        Require(Reviewed(inst),"F2F immediate ISA recognized");
        const auto out=Bridge(inst);
        Require(out.Ready(),out.reason.data());
        bool materialized=false,converted=false;
        for (const u64 word:out.maxwell_instructions) {
            if ((word>>56)==0x01 && (word&255)==251 &&
                ((word>>20)&0xffffffffULL)==bits) materialized=true;
            if ((word>>56)==0x5c && (word&255)==5 &&
                ((word>>20)&255)==251 && ((word>>8)&3)==1 &&
                ((word>>10)&3)==2 && ((word>>45)&1)==0 &&
                ((word>>49)&1)==0) converted=true;
        }
        Require(materialized && converted,"F2F immediate preserves IEEE-754 word and emits Maxwell F16 conversion");
    }
    for (const auto& [bank,offset] :
         std::array<std::pair<u32,u32>,2>{{{0,4},{17,508}}}) {
        const Instruction inst{{(7U<<12)|0xb04U|(5U<<16),
                           (offset<<6)|(bank<<22),0x00200800U,0x000fe200U}};
        Require(Reviewed(inst),"F2F CBUF admitted by actual ISA table");
        const auto out=Bridge(inst);
        Require(out.Ready(),out.reason.data());
        const u64 word=out.maxwell_instructions[out.source_instruction_offsets[0]];
        Require((word>>56)==0x4c && (word&255)==5 &&
                ((word>>20)&0x3fff)==offset/4 && ((word>>34)&31)==bank &&
                ((word>>8)&3)==1 && ((word>>10)&3)==2,
                "F2F directly converts an exact bound CBUF F32 word");
    }
    for (const auto& [reg,expected] :
         std::array<std::pair<u32,u32>,3>{{{2,218},{17,201},{63,255}}}) {
        const Instruction inst{{(7U<<12)|0xd04U|(5U<<16),reg,
                                0x08200800U,0x000fe200U}};
        Require(Reviewed(inst),"F2F uniform admitted by actual ISA table");
        const auto out=Bridge(inst);
        Require(out.Ready(),out.reason.data());
        const u64 word=out.maxwell_instructions[out.source_instruction_offsets[0]];
        Require((word>>56)==0x5c && (word&255)==5 &&
                ((word>>20)&255)==expected,
                "F2F uses protected uniform register source");
    }
    const Instruction invalid_f2f{{(7U<<12)|0xb04U|(5U<<16),
                           (3U<<6)|(7U<<22),0x00200800U,0x000fe200U}};
    Require(!Bridge(invalid_f2f).Ready(),"F2F refuses unaligned CBUF bytes");
    const Instruction invalid_f2f_ur{{(7U<<12)|0xd04U|(5U<<16),
                                     64U,0x08200800U,0x000fe200U}};
    Require(!Bridge(invalid_f2f_ur).Ready(),"F2F rejects invalid uniform register");
    // F2I.F32.S32 accepts the 32-bit immediate form 0x905. Preserve the
    // floating input bits including sign and NaN, then reuse the existing
    // signed/unsigned conversion path with the same rounding and FTZ bits.
    for (u32 bits : {0U, 0x3f800000U, 0xbf800000U, 0x7fc00001U}) {
        const Instruction inst{{(7U<<12)|0x905U|(5U<<16),bits,
                                0x00203100U,0x000fe200U}};
        Require(Reviewed(inst),"F2I immediate accepted by actual Ampere ISA table");
        const auto out=Bridge(inst);
        Require(out.Ready(),out.reason.data());
        bool materialized=false,converted=false;
        for (const u64 word : out.maxwell_instructions) {
            if ((word>>56)==0x01 && (word&255)==252 &&
                ((word>>20)&0xffffffffULL)==bits) materialized=true;
            if ((word>>56)==0x5c && (word&255)==5 &&
                ((word>>20)&255)==252 && ((word>>12)&1)==1)
                converted=true;
        }
        Require(materialized && converted,"F2I retains full literal and uses actual signed Maxwell conversion");
    }
    Instruction bad_f2i{{(7U<<12)|0x905U|(5U<<16),0x3f800000U,
                          0x00203101U,0x000fe200U}};
    Require(!Bridge(bad_f2i).Ready(),"F2I immediate unreviewed rounding format is rejected");
    // Review the complete FRND source family through the real rendering
    // bridge. A negative or NaN bit-pattern must remain the exact literal
    // (not be interpreted as its sign/abs modifier bits).
    for (const u32 bits : {0U, 0x3f800000U, 0xbf800000U, 0x7fc00001U}) {
        const Instruction inst{{(7U<<12)|0x907U|(5U<<16),bits,
                                (2U<<11)|(2U<<20),0x000fe200U}};
        Require(Reviewed(inst),"FRND immediate passes native ISA field review");
        const auto out=Bridge(inst);
        Require(out.Ready(),out.reason.data());
        bool materialized=false, rounded=false;
        for (const u64 word : out.maxwell_instructions) {
            if ((word>>56)==0x01 && (word&255)==251 &&
                ((word>>20)&0xffffffffULL)==bits) materialized=true;
            if ((word>>56)==0x5c && (word&255)==5 &&
                ((word>>20)&255)==251 && ((word>>45)&1)==0 &&
                ((word>>49)&1)==0) rounded=true;
        }
        Require(materialized && rounded,"FRND full IEEE-754 literal reaches native round opcode");
    }
    for (const auto& [source,expected] :
         std::array<std::pair<u32,u32>,3>{{{3,219},{18,202},{63,255}}}) {
        const Instruction uniform_frnd{{(7U<<12)|0xd07U|(5U<<16),source,
                          (2U<<11)|(2U<<20)|0x08000000U,0x000fe200U}};
        Require(Reviewed(uniform_frnd),"FRND uniform passes actual ISA review");
        const auto out=Bridge(uniform_frnd);
        Require(out.Ready(),out.reason.data());
        const u64 word=out.maxwell_instructions[out.source_instruction_offsets[0]];
        Require((word>>56)==0x5c && ((word>>20)&255)==expected &&
                (word&255)==5,"FRND uses protected native uniform register source");
    }
    Instruction bad_frnd_uniform{{(7U<<12)|0xd07U|(5U<<16),64U,
                       (2U<<11)|(2U<<20)|0x08000000U,0x000fe200U}};
    Require(!Bridge(bad_frnd_uniform).Ready(),"FRND refuses out-of-table uniform source");
    bad_frnd_uniform.words[0]=(7U<<12)|0xd07U|(220U<<16);
    bad_frnd_uniform.words[1]=4;
    Require(!Bridge(bad_frnd_uniform).Ready(),"FRND uniform register bank cannot alias output");
    for (const auto invalid : {Frnd(0xb07,5,1,7), // unaligned offset
                              Frnd(0xb07,5,4,18), // descriptor beyond supported stage slots
                              Frnd(0xb07,5,4,31)}) {
        Require(!Lower(invalid), "invalid CBUF rejected, not reinterpreted as a GPR");
        Require(Bridge(invalid).status==LowerBridgeStatus::UnsupportedSemantics,
                "bridge rejects invalid CBUF with explicit unsupported semantics");
    }
    auto bad_round=Frnd(0xb07,5,4,7);
    bad_round.words[2] ^= 1U << 11;
    Require(!Lower(bad_round), "unreviewed floating mode still refused");
    Require(!Bridge(bad_round).Ready(), "real bridge rejects invalid FRND mode");
    // P2.4: SEL's uniform-B form (0xc07) is decoded by the same scalar
    // ALU owner as register SEL (0x207), not a shader-wide replacement.
    for (const auto& [ureg, expected_gpr] :
         std::array<std::pair<u32,u32>, 3>{{{4,220},{17,201},{63,255}}}) {
        const auto select=UniformSel(0xc07,5,6,ureg);
        Require(Reviewed(select), "uniform SEL must pass the original ISA table");
        const auto bridge=Bridge(select);
        Require(bridge.Ready(), bridge.reason.data());
        const u64 word=bridge.maxwell_instructions[bridge.source_instruction_offsets[0]];
        Require((word>>56)==0x5c && (word&255)==5,
                "Maxwell SEL reused, destination retained");
        Require(((word>>8)&255)==6, "SEL direct source A preserved");
        Require(((word>>20)&255)==expected_gpr,
                "SEL uniform-B operand mapped to the protected register bank");
    }
    const auto bad_ureg=UniformSel(0xc07,5,6,64);
    Require(!Bridge(bad_ureg).Ready(), "out-of-table uniform source must fail closed");
    const auto alias=UniformSel(0xc07,220,6,4);
    Require(!Bridge(alias).Ready(), "uniform bank cannot alias a high output GPR");
    const auto reg_sel=UniformSel(0x207,5,6,8);
    Require(Bridge(reg_sel).Ready(), "normal scalar SEL remains functional");
    // Uniform FSET (0xc0a) uses the same actual bank owner as uniform SEL,
    // but must keep its own float-comparison opcode, operation and predicate.
    for (const auto& [ureg, expected_gpr] :
         std::array<std::pair<u32,u32>,3>{{{4,220},{17,201},{63,255}}}) {
        const auto compare=UniformSel(0xc0a,5,6,ureg);
        Require(Reviewed(compare), "uniform FSET fields admitted by reviewed ISA");
        const auto bridge=Bridge(compare);
        Require(bridge.Ready(), bridge.reason.data());
        const u64 word=bridge.maxwell_instructions[bridge.source_instruction_offsets[0]];
        Require((word>>56)==0x58 && (word&255)==5,
                "uniform FSET uses Maxwell floating comparison, destination preserved");
        Require(((word>>8)&255)==6, "FSET direct source A preserved");
        Require(((word>>20)&255)==expected_gpr,
                "FSET uniform B mapped into the protected UR register bank");
    }
    Require(!Bridge(UniformSel(0xc0a,5,6,64)).Ready(),
            "invalid FSET uniform register cannot compile");
    Require(!Bridge(UniformSel(0xc0a,220,6,4)).Ready(),
            "FSET uniform bank must not overwrite high destination");
    auto bad_mode=UniformSel(0xc0a,5,6,4);
    bad_mode.words[2] |= 3U << 10; // invalid floating operation selection
    Require(!Bridge(bad_mode).Ready(), "unreviewed FSET operation refused");
    Require(Bridge(UniformSel(0x20a,5,6,8)).Ready(),
            "ordinary FSET regression guard");
    // Immediate MUFU 0x908 is decoded as operand(1) using the same
    // floating-point operation path as the register and uniform variants.
    // Prove the emitted Maxwell instruction uses a materialized source,
    // rather than treating the 32-bit immediate as an uninitialized GPR.
    const auto immediate_mufu=[](u32 bits, u32 operation=2) {
        return Instruction{{(7U << 12) | 0x908 | (5U << 16), bits,
                            operation << 10, 0x000fe200U}};
    };
    const auto mufu=immediate_mufu(0x3f800000U);
    Require(Reviewed(mufu), "immediate MUFU admitted by native ISA table");
    const auto lowered_mufu=Bridge(mufu);
    Require(lowered_mufu.Ready(), lowered_mufu.reason.data());
    bool has_mufu=false;
    for (const u64 word:lowered_mufu.maxwell_instructions) {
        if ((word>>52)==0x508) {
            Require(((word>>8)&255)==251, "immediate MUFU must use materialized operand R251");
            Require(((word>>20)&255)==2, "MUFU operation selector must survive lowering");
            has_mufu=true;
        }
    }
    Require(has_mufu && lowered_mufu.maxwell_instructions.size()>=3,
            "immediate materialization followed by real Maxwell MUFU");
    const auto other_mufu=Bridge(immediate_mufu(0x40000000U));
    Require(other_mufu.Ready() &&
            other_mufu.maxwell_instructions!=lowered_mufu.maxwell_instructions,
            "MUFU immediate bytes must affect the generated Maxwell program");
    auto bad_mufu=immediate_mufu(0x3f800000U);
    bad_mufu.words[0]|=3U<<24; // illegal source A for immediate form
    Require(!Bridge(bad_mufu).Ready(), "MUFU immediate source A must be empty");
    bad_mufu=immediate_mufu(0x3f800000U);
    bad_mufu.words[2]|=1U<<16; // unknown modifier, forbidden by ISA/mode
    Require(!Bridge(bad_mufu).Ready(), "MUFU immediate modifier rejected");
    bad_mufu=immediate_mufu(0x3f800000U,7); // unsupported hardware function mode
    Require(!Bridge(bad_mufu).Ready(), "MUFU unsupported operation rejected");
    // UPOPC: read a uniform GPR and write the uniform destination, using
    // the real front end, actual ISA masks and Maxwell opcode bits.
    const auto uniform_popc=[](u32 dest, u32 src, bool invert=false) {
        return Instruction{{(7U << 12) | 0x2bf | (dest << 16),
                            src | (invert ? 0x80000000U : 0U),
                            0x08000000U, 0x000fe200U}};
    };
    for (const auto& [rd,ra,dst_gpr,src_gpr] :
         std::array<std::array<u32,4>,4>{{{{5,4,221,220}},{{17,18,201,202}},
                                           {{62,63,182,255}},{{8,16,224,200}}}}) {
        const auto insn=uniform_popc(rd,ra);
        Require(Reviewed(insn), "uniform POPC must pass reviewed ISA masks");
        const auto bridge=Bridge(insn);
        Require(bridge.Ready(), bridge.reason.data());
        const u64 word=bridge.maxwell_instructions[bridge.source_instruction_offsets[0]];
        Require((word & 0xff000000000f0000ULL) ==
                (0x5c08000000070000ULL & 0xff000000000f0000ULL),
                "uniform POPC maps to genuine Maxwell population count");
        Require((word & 255)==dst_gpr && ((word>>20)&255)==src_gpr,
                "uniform POPC source and destination use the reserved UR bank");
    }
    const auto inverted=Bridge(uniform_popc(5,4,true));
    Require(inverted.Ready() &&
            ((inverted.maxwell_instructions[inverted.source_instruction_offsets[0]]>>40)&1U)==1,
            "uniform POPC inversion bit preserved");
    Require(!Bridge(uniform_popc(63,4)).Ready(), "UR63 cannot be written");
    Require(!Bridge(uniform_popc(5,64)).Ready(), "out-of-table uniform source rejected");
    auto predicated_popc=uniform_popc(5,4);
    predicated_popc.words[0]=(predicated_popc.words[0]&~0xf000U)|(1U<<12);
    Require(!Bridge(predicated_popc).Ready(), "unrepresentable UPOPC predication rejected");
    auto reserved_popc=uniform_popc(5,4);
    reserved_popc.words[1]|=1U<<30;
    Require(!Bridge(reserved_popc).Ready(), "unreviewed UPOPC source mode rejected");
    // UIMAD 0x4a4 has an immediate addend in word[1]. The two
    // multiplicands and destination live in the UR bank; a 32-bit literal
    // must never be interpreted as an uninitialised Maxwell register.
    const auto uniform_imad=[](u32 dst,u32 a,u32 b,u32 literal,u32 pred=7) {
        return Instruction{{(pred << 12) | 0x4a4 | (dst << 16) | (a << 24),
                            literal, 0x078e0000U | b, 0x000fe200U}};
    };
    for (const auto& [dst,a,b,expected_dst,expected_a,expected_b] :
         std::array<std::array<u32,6>,3>{{{{5,4,8,221,220,224}},
                                           {{18,17,62,202,201,182}},
                                           {{6,63,16,222,255,200}}}}) {
        const auto op=uniform_imad(dst,a,b,0x12345678U);
        Require(Reviewed(op), "uniform IMAD immediate accepted by reviewed ISA");
        const auto result=Bridge(op);
        Require(result.Ready(),result.reason.data());
        const auto& words=result.maxwell_instructions;
        bool found_product=false, found_destination=false;
        for (const u64 word:words) {
            if ((word>>56)==0x5b && ((word>>8)&255)==expected_a &&
                ((word>>20)&255)==expected_b) found_product=true;
            if ((word>>56)==0x5c && (word&255)==expected_dst)
                found_destination=true;
        }
        Require(found_product && found_destination,
                "UIMAD immediate keeps both uniform multiplicands and output");
        const auto distinct=Bridge(uniform_imad(dst,a,b,0x87654321U));
        Require(distinct.Ready() && distinct.maxwell_instructions!=words,
                "native IMAD 32-bit immediate changes actual Maxwell program");
    }
    Require(!Bridge(uniform_imad(5,4,64,0x12345678U)).Ready(),
            "out-of-range uniform multiplier rejected");
    Require(!Bridge(uniform_imad(5,64,8,0x12345678U)).Ready(),
            "out-of-range uniform multiplicand rejected");
    Require(!Bridge(uniform_imad(5,4,8,0x12345678U,1)).Ready(),
            "unverified UIMAD uniform predication refused");
    auto bad_uimad=uniform_imad(5,4,8,0x12345678U);
    bad_uimad.words[2]^=1U<<24;
    Require(!Bridge(bad_uimad).Ready(),"non-reviewed UIMAD mode rejected");
    // IABS immediates preserve the complete 32-bit signed magnitude input;
    // notably INT32_MIN is not folded with host abs (which would overflow).
    for (const u32 literal : {0U,1U,0x7fffffffU,0x80000000U,0xffffffffU}) {
        const Instruction abs_imm{{(7U<<12)|0x813U|(5U<<16),literal,0,0x000fe200U}};
        Require(Reviewed(abs_imm),"IABS 32-bit immediate accepted by actual ISA table");
        const auto out=Bridge(abs_imm);
        Require(out.Ready(),out.reason.data());
        bool found_literal=false,found_abs=false;
        for (const u64 word : out.maxwell_instructions) {
            if ((word>>56)==0x01 && (word&255)==251 &&
                ((word>>20)&0xffffffffULL)==literal) found_literal=true;
            if ((word&0xfff0000000000000ULL)==0x5ce0000000000000ULL &&
                (word&255)==5 && ((word>>20)&255)==251)
                found_abs=true;
        }
        Require(found_literal && found_abs,"IABS sends full signed immediate to genuine Maxwell absolute opcode");
    }
    Instruction invalid_abs{{(7U<<12)|0x813U|(5U<<16),0x80000000U,1,0x000fe200U}};
    Require(!Bridge(invalid_abs).Ready(),"IABS literal unknown mode fails before Maxwell emission");
    // FLO shares one Maxwell leading-bit implementation, now also for
    // literal and CBUF inputs. The sign bit of a literal is not an invert flag.
    for (const u32 op : {0x300U,0x900U,0xb00U,0xd00U}) {
        const u32 raw = op==0x300 ? 13U :
                        op==0x900 ? 0x8000ffffU :
                        op==0xb00 ? ((508U<<6)|(7U<<22)) : 17U;
        const Instruction flo{{(7U<<12)|op|(5U<<16),raw,
                               0x000e0000U | (op==0xd00?0x08000000U:0U),
                               0x000fe200U}};
        Require(Reviewed(flo),"FLO source form must be accepted by actual ISA");
        const auto out=Bridge(flo);
        Require(out.Ready(),out.reason.data());
        const u32 expected=op==0x300?13U:op==0xd00?201U:251U;
        bool found=false;
        for(const u64 word:out.maxwell_instructions)
            if((word&0xffff000000000000ULL)==0x5c30000000000000ULL &&
                (word&255)==5 && ((word>>20)&255)==expected &&
                ((word>>40)&1)==0) found=true;
        Require(found,"FLO emits actual Maxwell leading-bit instruction");
        if (op==0x900) {
            bool has_imm=false;
            for(const u64 word:out.maxwell_instructions)
                if((word>>56)==0x01 && (word&255)==251 &&
                   ((word>>20)&0xffffffffULL)==0x8000ffffULL) has_imm=true;
            Require(has_imm,"FLO immediate sign bit remains source data");
        }
    }
    const auto bad_flo=[](u32 offset,u32 bank){
        return Instruction{{(7U<<12)|0xb00U|(5U<<16),
                            (offset<<6)|(bank<<22),0x000e0000U,0x000fe200U}};
    };
    Require(!Bridge(bad_flo(3,7)).Ready(),"FLO CBUF refuses unaligned data");
    Require(!Bridge(bad_flo(4,18)).Ready(),"FLO CBUF refuses disabled bank");
    // P2.4: native bit reversal and population count from GPR, 32-bit
    // literal, CBUF (byte addressed) and uniform register. These modes
    // share real Maxwell ALU opcodes, not per-game shader replacements.
    const auto unary=[](u32 op,u32 dst,u32 source,u32 bank=0) {
        const bool constant=op==0xb01 || op==0xb09;
        const bool uniform=op==0xd01 || op==0xd09;
        return Instruction{{(7U<<12)|op|(dst<<16),
            constant ? ((source<<6)|(bank<<22)) : source,
            uniform ? 0x08000000U : 0U,0x000fe200U}};
    };
    const auto find_word=[](const LowerBridgeResult& out,u64 mask,u64 match) {
        for(const u64 word:out.maxwell_instructions)
            if((word&mask)==match)return word;
        return u64{};
    };
    constexpr u64 high_opcode_mask=0xffff000000000000ULL;
    for (const auto& [op,src,expected] :
        std::array<std::array<u32,3>,4>{{{{0x301,13,13}},{{0x901,0x81234567U,251}},
                                          {{0xb01,508,251}},{{0xd01,17,201}}}}) {
        const auto inst=unary(op,5,src,op==0xb01?7U:0U);
        Require(Reviewed(inst),"BREV GPR/immediate/CBUF/UR recognized by real ISA table");
        const auto out=Bridge(inst);
        Require(out.Ready(),out.reason.data());
        const u64 rev=find_word(out,high_opcode_mask,0x3828000000000000ULL);
        Require(rev && (rev&255)==5 && ((rev>>8)&255)==expected,
                "BREV emits original Maxwell bit-reverse and matching source GPR");
        if(op==0x901) {
            const u64 imm=find_word(out,0xff00000000000000ULL,0x0100000000000000ULL);
            Require(imm && ((imm>>20)&0xffffffffULL)==0x81234567ULL,
                    "BREV full 32-bit literal preserved with high bit");
        }
        if(op==0xb01) {
            const u64 ldc=find_word(out,0xffff000000000000ULL,0x4c98000000000000ULL);
            Require(ldc && ((ldc>>20)&0x3fff)==508/4 && ((ldc>>34)&31)==7,
                    "BREV CBUF reads exact source word from bank and offset");
        }
    }
    for(const auto op:{0x309U,0x909U,0xb09U,0xd09U}) {
        const auto inst=unary(op,5,op==0x309 ? 13U :
                             op==0x909 ? 0x80000001U :
                             op==0xb09 ? 65532U : 17U,
                             op==0xb09?17U:0U);
        Require(Reviewed(inst),"POPC GPR/literal/CBUF/UR recognized by real ISA table");
        const auto out=Bridge(inst);
        Require(out.Ready(),out.reason.data());
        const u64 word=find_word(out,0xffff000000000000ULL,0x5c08000000000000ULL);
        const u32 expected=op==0x309?13U:op==0xd09?201U:251U;
        Require(word && (word&255)==5 && ((word>>20)&255)==expected,
                "POPC emits native Maxwell population count with correct source");
        Require(((word>>40)&1)==0,"literal high bit is data, not POPC inversion");
    }
    auto negative=unary(0xb01,5,3,7);
    Require(!Bridge(negative).Ready(),"unaligned BREV CBUF never reads prior word");
    Require(!Bridge(unary(0xb01,5,4,18)).Ready(),"BREV CBUF bank outside range refused");
    Require(!Bridge(unary(0xb09,5,65532,18)).Ready(),"POPC CBUF bank outside range refused");
    Require(!Bridge(unary(0xd01,5,64)).Ready(),"BREV invalid uniform register refused");
    Require(!Bridge(unary(0xd01,220,4)).Ready(),"BREV uniform bank cannot overlap result");
    auto unreviewed=unary(0x901,5,1);unreviewed.words[2]=1;
    Require(!Bridge(unreviewed).Ready(),"BREV immediate unsupported mode fails closed");
    auto popc_cbuf_inverted=unary(0xb09,5,508,7);
    popc_cbuf_inverted.words[1]|=0x80000000U;
    const auto inverted_result=Bridge(popc_cbuf_inverted);
    Require(inverted_result.Ready(),"POPC CBUF encoded invert bit accepted");
    const auto inverted_word=find_word(inverted_result,high_opcode_mask,
                                       0x5c08000000000000ULL);
    Require(((inverted_word>>40)&1)==1,"POPC CBUF inversion preserved");
    // Batch imported from Lichii nx2, exercised only after all forms are
    // integrated: direct evidence from the real Ampere probe + Maxwell bridge.
    // No title ID, simulated renderer or PS5-specific success conditions.
    const std::array<Instruction,9> imported_isa{{
        Instruction{{(7U<<12)|0xc3eU|(4U<<16)|(255U<<24),
                     1U,0x080000ffU,0x000fe200U}},                 // uniform F2FP
        Instruction{{(7U<<12)|0x243U|(4U<<16)|(255U<<24),
                     2U,0x000004ffU,0x000fe200U}},                 // packed F2IP
        Instruction{{(7U<<12)|0x593U|(6U<<16)|(8U<<24),
                     7U|(3U<<29),0x001ee000U,0x000fe200U}},       // surface atomic
        Instruction{{(7U<<12)|0xb9dU|(4U<<24),
                     6U|(3U<<29),0x0010a900U,0x000fe200U}},       // byte surface store
        Instruction{{(7U<<12)|0x367U|(8U<<16)|(2U<<24),
                     4U|(1U<<27)|(1U<<28)|(1U<<29),
                     255U|(3U<<8)|(7U<<17)|(1U<<23),0x000fe200U}},// bindless TLD
        Instruction{{(7U<<12)|0xf6cU|(8U<<16)|(2U<<24),
                     12U|(1U<<8)|(1U<<29),
                     0x081e0000U|255U|(3U<<8),0x000fe200U}},      // uniform TXD
        Instruction{{(7U<<12)|0x987U|(255U<<24),
                     16U,0x0810083fU,0x000fe200U}},               // uniform addr ST
        Instruction{{(7U<<12)|0x36aU|(8U<<16)|(2U<<24),
                     6U|(1U<<27)|(1U<<29),255U|(1U<<8),
                     0x000fe200U}},                               // register TMML
        Instruction{{(7U<<12)|0xf69U|(8U<<16)|(2U<<24),
                     255U|(1U<<8)|(1U<<29),
                     255U|(1U<<8)|(1U<<27),0x000fe200U}},          // uniform TMML
    }};
    for (const auto& inst : imported_isa) {
        Require(Reviewed(inst),"Lichii imported mode must pass real ISA/probe");
        const auto result=Bridge(inst);
        Require(result.Ready(),"Lichii imported mode must produce Maxwell instructions");
        Require(!result.maxwell_instructions.empty(),"Lichii imported mode must emit code");
    }
    auto bad_surface_atomic=imported_isa[2];
    bad_surface_atomic.words[2]|=9U<<23;
    Require(!Bridge(bad_surface_atomic).Ready(),"surface atomic operation outside reviewed set refused");
    auto bad_byte_store=imported_isa[3];
    bad_byte_store.words[1]|=18U<<22;
    Require(!Bridge(bad_byte_store).Ready(),"byte surface store unknown binding refused");
    auto bad_texel_fetch=imported_isa[4];
    bad_texel_fetch.words[2]&=~(15U<<8);
    Require(!Bridge(bad_texel_fetch).Ready(),"bindless texel fetch empty mask refused");
    auto bad_gradient=imported_isa[5];
    bad_gradient.words[1]|=6U<<29;
    Require(!Bridge(bad_gradient).Ready(),"uniform gradient unsupported dimension refused");
    auto bad_uniform=imported_isa[0];
    bad_uniform.words[1]=64U;
    Require(!Bridge(bad_uniform).Ready(),"uniform float pack invalid UR refused");
    auto bad_local=imported_isa[6];
    bad_local.words[1]|=1U<<8;
    Require(!Bridge(bad_local).Ready(),"local store misaligned address refused");
    auto bad_lod=imported_isa[8];
    bad_lod.words[1]=(bad_lod.words[1]&~(63U<<8))|(63U<<8);
    Require(!Bridge(bad_lod).Ready(),"uniform texture handle outside range refused");
    std::puts("P2_4_LICHII_GENERIC_ISA_BATCH_PASS");
    std::puts("P2_4_REAL_AMPERE_SCALAR_ALU_SOURCE_PASS");
}
```

`tools/ns2/test_ampere_translation_cache.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Tests the real lowerer under a bounded, explicitly owned NS2 cache.
// All programs are synthetic, no user keys/ROMs or PS5 game execution.
#include <array>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <vector>
#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/capture.h"
#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/translation_cache.h"

using namespace Shader::Ampere;

static void Check(bool ok, const char* why) {
    if (!ok) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "NS2 native translation cache: FAIL %s\n", why);
        std::exit(1);
    }
}
static void Emit(std::vector<u8>& dst, u32 a, u32 b=0, u32 c=0, u32 d=0) {
    for (u32 word : {a,b,c,d})
        for (u32 shift=0;shift!=32;shift+=8)
            dst.push_back(static_cast<u8>(word >> shift));
}
struct Reader {
    u64 base{0x200000};
    std::vector<u8> bytes{};
    std::size_t mapped{};
    unsigned reads{};
};
static bool Read(void* opaque,u64 addr,void* dst,std::size_t size){
    auto& r=*static_cast<Reader*>(opaque);
    ++r.reads;
    if (addr<r.base || !dst || !size) return false;
    const u64 off=addr-r.base;
    if(off>r.mapped || size>r.mapped-off) return false;
    if(off>r.bytes.size() || size>r.bytes.size()-off) return false;
    std::memcpy(dst,r.bytes.data()+off,size);
    return true;
}
int main() {
    constexpr u32 pt=7u<<12, exit_true=7u<<23;
    std::array<u8,0x50> header{};
    std::vector<u8> program;
    Emit(program,pt|0x918); // NOP
    Emit(program,pt|0x94d,0,exit_true); // EXIT
    NativeTranslationCache cache{1024*1024,2};
    auto one=cache.GetOrTranslate(header,program,4);
    auto two=cache.GetOrTranslate(header,program,4);
    auto st=cache.Stats();
    Check(one.Ready() && two.Ready() && one.code==two.code &&
          st.misses==1 && st.translations==1 && st.hits==1 &&
          st.entries==1 && st.bytes>0,
          "identical full shader content reuses genuine translated image");

    header[0]^=1;
    auto modified_header=cache.GetOrTranslate(header,program,4);
    Check(modified_header.Ready() &&
          modified_header.diagnostic_cache_key!=one.diagnostic_cache_key &&
          cache.Stats().translations==2,
          "changed header cannot reuse stale translation");
    header[0]^=1;
    auto other_stage=cache.GetOrTranslate(header,program,5);
    Check(other_stage.Ready() && cache.Stats().entries==2 &&
          cache.Stats().evictions==1 &&
          other_stage.diagnostic_cache_key!=one.diagnostic_cache_key,
          "stage identity is isolated and bounded LRU evicts oldest");
    auto return_one=cache.GetOrTranslate(header,program,4);
    Check(return_one.Ready() && cache.Stats().translations==4 &&
          cache.Stats().evictions==2,
          "evicted program is retranslated, not resurrected");

    auto invalid=program;
    invalid.pop_back();
    Check(!cache.GetOrTranslate(header,invalid,4).Ready() &&
          cache.Stats().entries==2,
          "malformed native bytes never poison cache");
    auto no_exit=program;
    no_exit.resize(16);
    Check(!cache.GetOrTranslate(header,no_exit,4).Ready() &&
          cache.Stats().entries==2,
          "no-EXIT program does not produce a successful partial entry");
    const auto first_rejected = cache.Stats();
    Check(!cache.GetOrTranslate(header,no_exit,4).Ready() &&
          cache.Stats().translations == first_rejected.translations &&
          cache.Stats().negative_hits == first_rejected.negative_hits + 1,
          "unchanged rejected native shader must hit bounded negative cache");
    no_exit[0] ^= 1;
    Check(!cache.GetOrTranslate(header,no_exit,4).Ready() &&
          cache.Stats().translations == first_rejected.translations + 1,
          "changed native shader bytes must not reuse a previous rejection");

    Reader r;
    r.bytes.resize(0x80);
    Emit(r.bytes,pt|0x918);
    Emit(r.bytes,pt|0x94d,0,exit_true);
    r.mapped=r.bytes.size();
    NativeTranslationCache live{1024*1024,3};
    auto from_guest=CaptureNativeGraphicsShader(r.base,4,Read,&r,&live);
    const unsigned initial_reads=r.reads;
    auto from_guest_again=CaptureNativeGraphicsShader(r.base,4,Read,&r,&live);
    Check(from_guest.Ready() && from_guest_again.Ready() &&
          live.Stats().hits==1 && live.Stats().translations==1 &&
          r.reads==initial_reads+5,
          "cache reuse still validates full GMMU source/header before publication");

    // Rewrite the mapped instruction at the SAME GPU address: the cache
    // must see different bytes, not address-based false freshness.
    r.bytes[0x80]=0x02; r.bytes[0x81]=0x72; // MOV, predicate true + R1
    r.bytes[0x82]=0x01; r.bytes[0x84]=0x02; r.bytes[0x89]=0x0f;
    auto changed=CaptureNativeGraphicsShader(r.base,4,Read,&r,&live);
    Check(changed.Ready() && live.Stats().translations==2 &&
          changed.image.diagnostic_cache_key!=from_guest.image.diagnostic_cache_key,
          "same VA but changed bytes must trigger new native translation");

    r.mapped=0x80+16;
    auto unmapped=CaptureNativeGraphicsShader(r.base,4,Read,&r,&live);
    Check(!unmapped.Ready() && live.Stats().entries==2,
          "partial remapping must never return cached success");

    NativeTranslationCache disabled{0,0};
    Check(disabled.GetOrTranslate(header,program,4).Ready() &&
          disabled.Stats().entries==0 &&
          disabled.GetOrTranslate(header,program,4).Ready() &&
          disabled.Stats().translations==2,
          "zero capacity disables retention but not correct translation");

    // All shader admission owners must agree on the same 65536-word
    // ceiling; a 4097-word shader is valid even with LRU enabled.
    std::vector<u8> extended;
    for (u32 index=0; index<4096; ++index) Emit(extended, pt|0x918);
    Emit(extended, pt|0x94d, 0, exit_true);
    NativeTranslationCache large{8*1024*1024, 2};
    const auto large_image = large.GetOrTranslate(header, extended, 4);
    const auto large_cached = large.GetOrTranslate(header, extended, 4);
    Check(large_image.ValidForCompiler() && large_cached.Ready() &&
          large.Stats().translations == 1 && large.Stats().hits == 1,
          "4097-instruction shader is authentic and reusable by the real native cache");
    cache.Clear();
    Check(cache.Stats().entries==0 && cache.Stats().bytes==0,
          "session destruction/invalidation can discard all cached images");
    std::puts("NS2 native shader translation cache: PASS (source-verified LRU)");
}
```
