`tools/ns2/test_ampere_turing_macro.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Actual native Ampere/Turing TU104 96-bit MME interpreter host probes.
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <string_view>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>
#include "video_core/macro_turing.h"
#include "video_core/native_ampere_macro_state.h"

using I=Tegra::TuringMacroInterpreter;
using W=std::uint32_t;

static std::array<W,3> Insn(W method, W value, bool fifo, bool end, bool emit=true) {
    std::array<W,3> bits{};
    const auto set=[&](unsigned low,unsigned width,W data){
        for(unsigned bit=0;bit<width;++bit)
            if(data & (1u<<bit))
                bits[(low+bit)/32] |= W{1}<<((low+bit)%32);
    };
    // Zero-input operands: lane 0 may instead read register 28 (FIFO).
    set(15,5,24);set(20,5,fifo?28:24);set(25,5,24);
    set(51,5,24);set(56,5,24);set(61,5,24);
    set(30,16,method);set(66,16,value);
    if(emit) {
        set(82,3,5); // output method address from immediate 0
        set(85,4,fifo?1:6); // output value from ALU 0 or immediate 1
    }
    if(end)set(0,1,1);
    // Native upload words are reverse of the decoded 96-bit order.
    return {bits[2],bits[1],bits[0]};
}
static void Append(std::vector<W>& dst,const std::array<W,3>& insn){
    dst.insert(dst.end(),insn.begin(),insn.end());
}
// TU104 DRAM opcodes: ALU0 reads/writes the channel-owned 0xc00-word
// scratch bank. MME_DWRITE then a failing output must roll back that bank.
static std::array<W,3> DataRamInsn(W opcode,W address,W payload,
                                    bool end,bool emit) {
    std::array<W,3> bits{};
    const auto set=[&](unsigned low,unsigned width,W data) {
        for(unsigned bit=0;bit<width;++bit)
            if(data & (1u<<bit))
                bits[(low+bit)/32] |= W{1}<<((low+bit)%32);
    };
    set(10,5,opcode);
    set(15,5,24); set(20,5,25); set(25,5,26);
    set(30,16,address); set(66,16,payload);
    set(51,5,24); set(56,5,24); set(61,5,24);
    if(emit) {set(82,3,6);set(85,4,1);}
    if(end) set(0,1,1);
    return {bits[2],bits[1],bits[0]};
}
static std::array<W,3> RegisterReadInsn(W index) {
    std::array<W,3> bits{};
    const auto set=[&](unsigned low,unsigned width,W data){
        for(unsigned bit=0;bit<width;++bit)
            if(data & (1u<<bit))
                bits[(low+bit)/32] |= W{1}<<((low+bit)%32);
    };
    set(0,1,1); // end after the next (nonemitting) instruction
    set(10,5,22); // TU104 MME_READ
    set(15,5,0); set(20,5,25); set(25,5,24);
    set(30,16,index); // first ALU operand = sign-extended immediate
    set(51,5,24); set(56,5,24); set(61,5,24);
    set(66,16,0x250);
    set(82,3,6); set(85,4,1); // method from imm1, emitted ALU read
    return {bits[2],bits[1],bits[0]};
}
int main(){
    std::vector<W> code;
    Append(code,Insn(0x230,0x9876,false,true));
    Append(code,Insn(0,0,false,false,false));
    std::vector<W> fifo;
    std::vector<std::pair<W,W>> emitted;
    I macro;
    const auto read=[](W)->W{return 0;};
    const auto emit=[&](W addr,W value){emitted.emplace_back(addr,value);return true;};
    auto result=macro.Execute(std::span<const W>(code),0,fifo,read,emit);
    assert(result.success && result.consumed==0 && emitted.size()==1);
    assert(emitted[0].first==0x230 && emitted[0].second==0x9876);
    // FIFO paths use the real interpreter: one fetched parameter becomes
    // the ALU result and is emitted as a GPU method write.
    code.clear();emitted.clear();
    Append(code,Insn(0x270,0,true,true));
    Append(code,Insn(0,0,false,false,false));
    fifo={0xC0DEC0DE};
    result=macro.Execute(std::span<const W>(code),0,fifo,read,emit);
    assert(result.success && result.consumed==1 && emitted.size()==1);
    assert((emitted[0]==std::pair<W,W>(0x270,0xC0DEC0DE)));
    fifo.clear();emitted.clear();
    result=macro.Execute(std::span<const W>(code),0,fifo,read,emit);
    assert(!result.success && result.error=="parameter FIFO underflow");
    // Guest MME emit target must be checked by the engine owner.
    fifo={17};
    const auto refuse=[](W,W){return false;};
    result=macro.Execute(std::span<const W>(code),0,fifo,read,refuse);
    assert(!result.success && result.error=="unsupported emitted method");
    // The actual guest upload protocol writes 3 consecutive 32-bit words
    // for each native 96-bit instruction. Each channel owns its macro DRAM.
    Tegra::NativeAmpereMacroState state;
    assert(!state.SetCodePointer(0x1000));
    assert(state.SetCodePointer(0));
    for (auto w : code) assert(state.PushCode(w));
    assert(!state.SetPositionPointer(0x80));
    assert(state.SetPositionPointer(0));
    assert(state.BindPosition(0));
    emitted.clear();fifo={23};
    result=state.Execute(0xe00,std::span<const W>{fifo},read,emit);
    assert(result.success && result.consumed==1);
    assert(emitted.size()==1 && emitted.front().first==0x270 &&
           emitted.front().second==23);
    assert(!state.Execute(0xe01,std::span<const W>{fifo},read,emit).success);
    assert(!state.Execute(0xe02,std::span<const W>{fifo},read,emit).success);

    // P2.4: macro writes must be atomic at the GPU-method boundary.
    // A later invalid output cannot dispatch an earlier valid PCAS/draw.
    Tegra::NativeAmpereMacroState atomic;
    code.clear();
    Append(code,Insn(0x230,0xAAAA,false,false));
    Append(code,Insn(0x10,0xBBBB,false,true)); // invalid 3D method after valid emit
    Append(code,Insn(0,0,false,false,false));
    assert(atomic.SetCodePointer(0));
    for(W w:code) assert(atomic.PushCode(w));
    assert(atomic.SetPositionPointer(0) && atomic.BindPosition(0));
    std::vector<std::pair<W,W>> committed;
    const auto allowed=[](W addr,W){return addr>=0x40 && addr<0xe00;};
    const auto commit=[&](W addr,W val){committed.emplace_back(addr,val);};
    const auto valid=[](){return true;};
    result=atomic.ExecuteStaged(0xe00,std::span<const W>{},read,allowed,commit,valid);
    assert(!result.success && committed.empty());
    // With BOTH outputs admissible, preserve the exact emission order.
    const auto allow_all=[](W addr,W){return addr<0xe00;};
    result=atomic.ExecuteStaged(0xe00,std::span<const W>{},read,allow_all,commit,valid);
    assert(result.success && committed.size()==2);
    assert((committed[0]==std::pair<W,W>(0x230,0xAAAA)));
    assert((committed[1]==std::pair<W,W>(0x10,0xBBBB)));
    committed.clear();
    // A late invalid native register read must not publish an earlier
    // perfectly valid method, even if the interpreter itself returns true.
    Tegra::NativeAmpereMacroState late_read;
    code.clear();
    Append(code,Insn(0x230,0x1234,false,false));
    Append(code,RegisterReadInsn(0x4000));
    Append(code,Insn(0,0,false,false,false));
    assert(late_read.SetCodePointer(0));
    for(W w:code) assert(late_read.PushCode(w));
    assert(late_read.SetPositionPointer(0) && late_read.BindPosition(0));
    bool bad_native_read=false;
    const auto read_checked=[&](W index)->W {
        if(index>=0x1000){bad_native_read=true;return 0;}
        return index;
    };
    result=late_read.ExecuteStaged(
        0xe00,std::span<const W>{},read_checked,allow_all,commit,
        [&]{return !bad_native_read;});
    assert(!result.success && bad_native_read && committed.empty());

    // The native 0xc00-word MME data RAM is also a transaction: an error
    // after DWRITE must not corrupt a later, valid macro from this channel.
    Tegra::NativeAmpereMacroState ram_state;
    code.clear(); committed.clear();
    Append(code,DataRamInsn(31,0x27,0x42,false,false));
    Append(code,Insn(0x10,0,false,true));
    Append(code,Insn(0,0,false,false,false));
    assert(ram_state.SetCodePointer(0));
    for(W w:code) assert(ram_state.PushCode(w));
    assert(ram_state.SetPositionPointer(0) && ram_state.BindPosition(0));
    result=ram_state.ExecuteStaged(
        0xe00,std::span<const W>{},read,allowed,commit,valid);
    assert(!result.success && committed.empty());
    code.clear();
    Append(code,DataRamInsn(30,0x27,0x230,true,true));
    Append(code,Insn(0,0,false,false,false));
    assert(ram_state.SetCodePointer(3));
    for(W w:code) assert(ram_state.PushCode(w));
    assert(ram_state.SetPositionPointer(1) && ram_state.BindPosition(3));
    result=ram_state.ExecuteStaged(
        0xe02,std::span<const W>{},read,allowed,commit,valid);
    assert(result.success && committed.size()==1 &&
           (committed[0]==std::pair<W,W>(0x230,0)));
    committed.clear();
    // A validator may throw after a successful TU104 DWRITE. Validation
    // still precedes GPU-method commit, so the channel's DRAM must be
    // restored before unwinding and the next macro must read the old zero.
    code.clear();
    Append(code,DataRamInsn(31,0x27,0x42,false,false));
    Append(code,Insn(0x230,0xA55A,false,true));
    Append(code,Insn(0,0,false,false,false));
    assert(ram_state.SetCodePointer(5));
    for(W w:code) assert(ram_state.PushCode(w));
    assert(ram_state.SetPositionPointer(2) && ram_state.BindPosition(5));
    bool validator_threw{};
    try {
        (void)ram_state.ExecuteStaged(
            0xe04,std::span<const W>{},read,allowed,commit,
            []() -> bool { throw std::runtime_error("channel epoch changed"); });
    } catch (const std::runtime_error&) {
        validator_threw = true;
    }
    assert(validator_threw && committed.empty());
    result=ram_state.ExecuteStaged(
        0xe02,std::span<const W>{},read,allowed,commit,valid);
    assert(result.success && committed.size()==1 &&
           (committed[0]==std::pair<W,W>(0x230,0)));
    committed.clear();
    // Commit callbacks can also fail after a successful interpreter run.
    // External GPU effects cannot be undone, so the Puller poisons its
    // native channel; the reusable MME DRAM must not retain the write.
    bool commit_threw{};
    try {
        (void)ram_state.ExecuteStaged(
            0xe04,std::span<const W>{},read,allowed,
            [](W,W) { throw std::runtime_error("GPU method commit failed"); },
            valid);
    } catch (const std::runtime_error&) {
        commit_threw = true;
    }
    assert(commit_threw && committed.empty());
    result=ram_state.ExecuteStaged(
        0xe02,std::span<const W>{},read,allowed,commit,valid);
    assert(result.success && committed.size()==1 &&
           (committed[0]==std::pair<W,W>(0x230,0)));
    committed.clear();
    std::vector<W> oversized(Tegra::NativeAmpereMacroState::MaxFifo+1,3);
    auto too_many=state.Execute(0xe00,std::span<const W>{oversized},read,emit);
    assert(!too_many.success &&
           too_many.error=="native macro FIFO limit exceeded");
    // A truncated 96-bit program must not execute or read outside RAM.
    code={1};
    result=macro.Execute(std::span<const W>(code),0,fifo,read,emit);
    assert(!result.success && result.error=="instruction outside uploaded RAM");
    // A nonterminated MME sequence never falls through into unknown memory.
    code.clear();fifo.clear();
    Append(code,Insn(0,0,false,false,false));Append(code,Insn(0,0,false,false,false));
    result=macro.Execute(std::span<const W>(code),0,fifo,read,emit);
    assert(!result.success && result.error=="instruction outside uploaded RAM");

    // P2.4: a guest MME_READ may request a register beyond its native
    // class's declared bank. The engine must reject that read before an
    // emitted QMD/PCAS method can use a fabricated zero register value.
    code.clear(); fifo.clear(); emitted.clear();
    Append(code,RegisterReadInsn(0x120));
    Append(code,Insn(0,0,false,false,false));
    bool out_of_range=false;
    const auto checked_read=[&](W index)->W {
        if(index >= 0x1000) {out_of_range=true; return 0;}
        assert(index == 0x120);
        return 0xFEEDBEEF;
    };
    const auto checked_emit=[&](W address,W value)->bool {
        if(out_of_range) return false;
        emitted.emplace_back(address,value);
        return true;
    };
    result=macro.Execute(std::span<const W>(code),0,fifo,checked_read,checked_emit);
    assert(result.success && !out_of_range && emitted.size()==1);
    assert(emitted.front().first==0x250 && emitted.front().second==0xFEEDBEEF);
    code.clear(); emitted.clear();
    Append(code,RegisterReadInsn(0x4000));
    Append(code,Insn(0,0,false,false,false));
    out_of_range=false;
    result=macro.Execute(std::span<const W>(code),0,fifo,checked_read,checked_emit);
    assert(out_of_range && !result.success && emitted.empty());
}
```

`tools/ns2/test_ampere_vulkan_module.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Test the real Vulkan loader's shader-module ABI using generated synthetic SPIR-V.
// Host-only: NO VkGraphicsPipeline and NO PS5/real guest GPU execution.
#include <vulkan/vulkan.h>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <fstream>
#include <functional>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <cstdint>
#include "../../vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/gpu_dispatch/video_core/native_qmd.h"

static void Require(bool ok, const char* detail) {
    if (!ok) { std::fprintf(stderr,"NS2 Vulkan module test: %s\n",detail); std::exit(1); }
}
static std::vector<uint32_t> ReadSpirv(const char* file) {
    std::ifstream stream{file,std::ios::binary|std::ios::ate};
    Require(bool(stream),"cannot open generated SPIR-V");
    const auto length=stream.tellg();
    Require(length>=static_cast<std::streampos>(20) &&
            static_cast<std::streamoff>(length)%4==0 &&
            length<=static_cast<std::streampos>(1024*1024),
            "SPIR-V must be bounded and 4-byte aligned");
    std::vector<uint32_t> words(static_cast<std::size_t>(length)/4);
    stream.seekg(0);
    stream.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(words.data()),length);
    Require(bool(stream)&&words[0]==0x07230203U,"invalid SPIR-V payload");
    return words;
}
// G06: dispatch the actual emitted U32 CAS shader against a coherent
// storage buffer and require both the original atomic return value and the
// final memory word. The shader is emitted from maintained native IR.
static void VerifyRealHostCas(VkDevice device,VkPhysicalDevice gpu,
                              uint32_t family,VkQueue queue,const char* path, bool global) {
    const auto code=ReadSpirv(path);
    uint32_t cas_count=0;
    for(std::size_t i=5;i<code.size();) {
        const uint32_t n=code[i]>>16;
        Require(n>0 && n<=code.size()-i,"malformed emitted G06 SPIR-V");
        cas_count+=(code[i]&0xffffU)==230U; // OpAtomicCompareExchange
        i+=n;
    }
    Require(cas_count>=1,"G06 actual emitter omitted U32 CAS");
    // The live unified shader emitter assigns U32 and U32x2 CBUF
    // views to bindings 0/1, reserves a binding after CBUF descriptors,
    // then assigns the U32/U32x2/U32x4 SSBO views to bindings 3/4/5.
    // The gap is intentional: mirror production binding advancement.
    VkDescriptorSetLayoutBinding bindings[5]{};
    for(uint32_t i=0;i<(global?5U:1U);++i) {
        bindings[i].binding=global && i>=2 ? i+1 : i;
        bindings[i].descriptorType=global && i<2 ?
            VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_UNIFORM_BUFFER : VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER;
        bindings[i].descriptorCount=1;
        bindings[i].stageFlags=VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT;
    }
    VkDescriptorSetLayoutCreateInfo dli{};
    dli.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO;
    dli.bindingCount=global?5:1;dli.pBindings=bindings;
    VkDescriptorSetLayout dsl=VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    Require(vkCreateDescriptorSetLayout(device,&dli,nullptr,&dsl)==VK_SUCCESS,"CAS set layout");
    VkPipelineLayoutCreateInfo pli{};
    pli.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO;
    pli.setLayoutCount=1;pli.pSetLayouts=&dsl;
    VkPipelineLayout layout=VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    Require(vkCreatePipelineLayout(device,&pli,nullptr,&layout)==VK_SUCCESS,"CAS pipeline layout");
    VkShaderModuleCreateInfo smi{};
    smi.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SHADER_MODULE_CREATE_INFO;
    smi.codeSize=code.size()*sizeof(uint32_t);smi.pCode=code.data();
    VkShaderModule shader=VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    Require(vkCreateShaderModule(device,&smi,nullptr,&shader)==VK_SUCCESS,"CAS shader module");
    VkPipelineShaderStageCreateInfo stage{};
    stage.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_SHADER_STAGE_CREATE_INFO;
    stage.stage=VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT;stage.module=shader;stage.pName="main";
    VkComputePipelineCreateInfo pci{};
    pci.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMPUTE_PIPELINE_CREATE_INFO;
    pci.stage=stage;pci.layout=layout;
    VkPipeline pipeline=VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    Require(vkCreateComputePipelines(device,VK_NULL_HANDLE,1,&pci,nullptr,&pipeline)==VK_SUCCESS,
            "real G06 compute CAS pipeline");
    VkBufferCreateInfo bi{};
    bi.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO;
    bi.size=global?65536U:64U;
    bi.usage=VK_BUFFER_USAGE_STORAGE_BUFFER_BIT;
    if(global)bi.usage|=VK_BUFFER_USAGE_UNIFORM_BUFFER_BIT;
    bi.sharingMode=VK_SHARING_MODE_EXCLUSIVE;
    VkBuffer buffer=VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    Require(vkCreateBuffer(device,&bi,nullptr,&buffer)==VK_SUCCESS,"CAS SSBO");
    VkMemoryRequirements memreq{};
    vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements(device,buffer,&memreq);
    VkPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties props{};
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties(gpu,&props);
    uint32_t type=props.memoryTypeCount;
    for(uint32_t i=0;i<props.memoryTypeCount;++i) {
        const auto bits=props.memoryTypes[i].propertyFlags;
        if((memreq.memoryTypeBits&(1U<<i)) &&
           (bits&(VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT|VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT)) ==
               (VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT|VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT)) {
            type=i;break;
        }
    }
    Require(type<props.memoryTypeCount,"coherent CAS SSBO memory unavailable");
    VkMemoryAllocateInfo mai{};
    mai.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO;
    mai.allocationSize=memreq.size;mai.memoryTypeIndex=type;
    VkDeviceMemory memory=VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    Require(vkAllocateMemory(device,&mai,nullptr,&memory)==VK_SUCCESS,"CAS device memory");
    Require(vkBindBufferMemory(device,buffer,memory,0)==VK_SUCCESS,"CAS SSBO bind");
    void* mapped=nullptr;
    Require(vkMapMemory(device,memory,0,bi.size,0,&mapped)==VK_SUCCESS,"CAS SSBO map");
    auto* values=static_cast<uint32_t*>(mapped);
    VkDescriptorPoolSize poolSizes[2]{};
    poolSizes[0].type=global?VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_UNIFORM_BUFFER:
                               VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER;
    poolSizes[0].descriptorCount=global?2:1;
    poolSizes[1].type=VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER;
    poolSizes[1].descriptorCount=3;
    VkDescriptorPoolCreateInfo dpci{};
    dpci.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_POOL_CREATE_INFO;
    dpci.maxSets=1;dpci.poolSizeCount=global?2:1;dpci.pPoolSizes=poolSizes;
    VkDescriptorPool pool=VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    Require(vkCreateDescriptorPool(device,&dpci,nullptr,&pool)==VK_SUCCESS,"CAS descriptor pool");
    VkDescriptorSetAllocateInfo alloc{};
    alloc.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_ALLOCATE_INFO;
    alloc.descriptorPool=pool;alloc.descriptorSetCount=1;alloc.pSetLayouts=&dsl;
    VkDescriptorSet set=VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    Require(vkAllocateDescriptorSets(device,&alloc,&set)==VK_SUCCESS,"CAS descriptor set");
    VkDescriptorBufferInfo storageInfo{};
    storageInfo.buffer=buffer;storageInfo.offset=0;storageInfo.range=64;
    VkDescriptorBufferInfo uniformInfo{};
    uniformInfo.buffer=buffer;uniformInfo.offset=0;uniformInfo.range=65536;
    VkWriteDescriptorSet writes[5]{};
    for(uint32_t i=0;i<(global?5U:1U);++i) {
        writes[i].sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_WRITE_DESCRIPTOR_SET;
        writes[i].dstSet=set;
        writes[i].dstBinding=bindings[i].binding;
        writes[i].descriptorCount=1;
        writes[i].descriptorType=bindings[i].descriptorType;
        writes[i].pBufferInfo=global && i<2 ? &uniformInfo : &storageInfo;
    }
    vkUpdateDescriptorSets(device,global?5:1,writes,0,nullptr);
    VkCommandPoolCreateInfo cpi{};
    cpi.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_POOL_CREATE_INFO;
    cpi.flags=VK_COMMAND_POOL_CREATE_RESET_COMMAND_BUFFER_BIT;
    cpi.queueFamilyIndex=family;
    VkCommandPool commandPool=VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    Require(vkCreateCommandPool(device,&cpi,nullptr,&commandPool)==VK_SUCCESS,"CAS command pool");
    VkCommandBufferAllocateInfo cbi{};
    cbi.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_ALLOCATE_INFO;
    cbi.commandPool=commandPool;cbi.level=VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_LEVEL_PRIMARY;
    cbi.commandBufferCount=1;
    VkCommandBuffer command=VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    Require(vkAllocateCommandBuffers(device,&cbi,&command)==VK_SUCCESS,"CAS command buffer");
    VkFenceCreateInfo fi{};
    fi.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_FENCE_CREATE_INFO;
    VkFence fence=VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    Require(vkCreateFence(device,&fi,nullptr,&fence)==VK_SUCCESS,"CAS fence");
    for(uint32_t original : {7U,6U}) {
        for(uint32_t i=0;i<16;++i)values[i]=0;
        values[1]=original;values[2]=0xdeadbeefU;
        if(global) {
            // Real CBUF descriptor at guest offset 0x100: 49-bit physical
            // address 0x100000 (low/high), followed by 64-byte SSBO extent.
            values[64]=0x100000U;values[65]=0;values[66]=64U;
        }
        // This is an actual QMD3 PCAS transaction, rather than a free-
        // standing vkCmdDispatch. Its real maintained scheduler admits the
        // generated Ampere CAS shader into the Vulkan host queue, then
        // registers one deferred guest semaphore for actual VkFence retire.
        Tegra::NativeQmdScheduler qmd_scheduler;
        Tegra::NativeQmdScheduler::Descriptor qmd{};
        qmd[12]=1;qmd[13]=1;qmd[14]=1; // one real native Compute CTA
        qmd[18]=0x30U | (1U<<16);
        qmd[19]=1U | (1U<<16);
        qmd[24]=0x4000;
        qmd[25]=(1U<<23) | (1U<<30);
        qmd[26]=(original==7U?19U:29U);
        const uint32_t expected_release=qmd[26];
        uint32_t guest_semaphore{};
        unsigned accepted_dispatches{};
        std::vector<std::function<void()>> on_vk_fence;
        bool permit_dispatch{};
        const auto read_qmd=[&](uint64_t address,
                                Tegra::NativeQmdScheduler::Descriptor& out) {
            if(address!=0x2000)return false;
            out=qmd;
            return true;
        };
        const auto release_guest=[&](uint64_t address,uint32_t value,uint32_t flags) {
            if(address!=0x4000 || !accepted_dispatches ||
               !(flags&(1U<<23)))return false;
            on_vk_fence.emplace_back([&,value] {guest_semaphore=value;});
            return true;
        };
        const auto dispatch_qmd=[&](const Tegra::NativeQmdScheduler::Descriptor& desc) {
            if(!permit_dispatch)return false;
            Require(desc[18]==qmd[18] && desc[12]==1,"QMD3 dispatch identity");
    VkCommandBufferBeginInfo begin{};
            begin.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_BEGIN_INFO;
            begin.flags=VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_USAGE_ONE_TIME_SUBMIT_BIT;
            Require(vkBeginCommandBuffer(command,&begin)==VK_SUCCESS,"CAS begin");
            vkCmdBindPipeline(command,VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_COMPUTE,pipeline);
            vkCmdBindDescriptorSets(command,VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_COMPUTE,
                                    layout,0,1,&set,0,nullptr);
            vkCmdDispatch(command,1,1,1);
            VkMemoryBarrier barrier{};
            barrier.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_BARRIER;
            barrier.srcAccessMask=VK_ACCESS_SHADER_WRITE_BIT;
            barrier.dstAccessMask=VK_ACCESS_HOST_READ_BIT;
            vkCmdPipelineBarrier(command,VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COMPUTE_SHADER_BIT,
                                 VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_HOST_BIT,0,1,&barrier,0,nullptr,0,nullptr);
            Require(vkEndCommandBuffer(command)==VK_SUCCESS,"CAS end");
            VkSubmitInfo submit{};
            submit.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SUBMIT_INFO;
            submit.commandBufferCount=1;submit.pCommandBuffers=&command;
            Require(vkQueueSubmit(queue,1,&submit,fence)==VK_SUCCESS,"CAS submit");
            ++accepted_dispatches;
            return true;
        };
        Require(!qmd_scheduler.Signal(0x2000,6,read_qmd,release_guest,dispatch_qmd).empty(),
                "unsupported PCAS action must fail closed");
        Require(!qmd_scheduler.Signal(0x2000,3,read_qmd,release_guest,dispatch_qmd).empty(),
                "refused QMD3 compute must not publish a guest release");
        Require(accepted_dispatches==0 && guest_semaphore==0 &&
                on_vk_fence.empty(),"rejected shader fabricated completion");
        permit_dispatch=true;
        Require(qmd_scheduler.Signal(0x2000,2,read_qmd,release_guest,dispatch_qmd).empty(),
                "QMD3 scheduler rejected real Vulkan compute");
        Require(accepted_dispatches==1 && guest_semaphore==0 &&
                on_vk_fence.size()==1,"QMD3 published before GPU fence");
        Require(qmd_scheduler.Signal(0x2000,2,read_qmd,release_guest,dispatch_qmd).empty(),
                "duplicate PCAS action must be idempotent");
        Require(accepted_dispatches==1 && on_vk_fence.size()==1,
                "duplicate QMD3 PCAS re-submitted shader or fence");
        Require(vkWaitForFences(device,1,&fence,VK_TRUE,10000000000ULL)==VK_SUCCESS,
                "QMD3 authentic Vulkan dispatch completion fence");
        Require(guest_semaphore==0,"GPU execution did not retire guest release late");
        for(auto& callback:on_vk_fence)callback();
        Require(guest_semaphore==expected_release,
                "QMD3 GPU release not published after real Vulkan fence");
        std::puts("G10_QMD3_SCHEDULER_REAL_VULKAN_DISPATCH_AND_FENCE_PASS"
                  " unknown_pcas=no_release denied_dispatch=no_release"
                  " duplicate_pcas=single_submission guest_after_vk_fence=1");
        Require(values[1]==(original==7U?9U:6U),"CAS final SSBO word differs");
        Require(values[2]==original,"CAS returned old SSBO value differs");
        for(uint32_t other=0;other<16;++other)
            if(other!=1 && other!=2)
                Require(values[other]==0,"CAS corrupted an unrelated GPU storage word");
        Require(vkResetFences(device,1,&fence)==VK_SUCCESS,"CAS fence reset");
        Require(vkResetCommandBuffer(command,0)==VK_SUCCESS,"CAS command reset");
    }
    vkDeviceWaitIdle(device);
    vkDestroyFence(device,fence,nullptr);
    vkFreeCommandBuffers(device,commandPool,1,&command);
    vkDestroyCommandPool(device,commandPool,nullptr);
    vkDestroyDescriptorPool(device,pool,nullptr);
    vkUnmapMemory(device,memory);
    vkDestroyBuffer(device,buffer,nullptr);
    vkFreeMemory(device,memory,nullptr);
    vkDestroyPipeline(device,pipeline,nullptr);
    vkDestroyShaderModule(device,shader,nullptr);
    vkDestroyPipelineLayout(device,layout,nullptr);
    vkDestroyDescriptorSetLayout(device,dsl,nullptr);
    std::puts(global
        ? "G06_REAL_VULKAN_GLOBAL_CAS_WRITEBACK_PASS success=9 old=7 failure=6 old=6"
        : "G06_REAL_VULKAN_CAS_WRITEBACK_PASS success=9 old=7 failure=6 old=6");
}

int main(int argc,char** argv) {
    Require(argc==8,"expected direct, dispatcher, Fragment, merged, Compute, storage CAS and global CAS");
    VkApplicationInfo application{};
    application.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_APPLICATION_INFO;
    application.pApplicationName="NS2 synthetic shader module smoke test";
    application.apiVersion=VK_API_VERSION_1_2;
    VkInstanceCreateInfo instance_info{};
    instance_info.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_INSTANCE_CREATE_INFO;
    instance_info.pApplicationInfo=&application;
    VkInstance instance=VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    Require(vkCreateInstance(&instance_info,nullptr,&instance)==VK_SUCCESS,
            "no Vulkan 1.2 instance");
    uint32_t count=0;
    Require(vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices(instance,&count,nullptr)==VK_SUCCESS && count>0,
            "no Vulkan software/host GPU available");
    std::vector<VkPhysicalDevice> devices(count);
    Require(vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices(instance,&count,devices.data())==VK_SUCCESS,
            "physical device enumeration failed");
    VkPhysicalDevice selected=VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    uint32_t queue=0;
    for (auto physical:devices) {
        VkPhysicalDeviceProperties props{};
        vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties(physical,&props);
        if (props.apiVersion<VK_API_VERSION_1_2) continue;
        uint32_t queues=0;
        vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties(physical,&queues,nullptr);
        std::vector<VkQueueFamilyProperties> families(queues);
        vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties(physical,&queues,families.data());
        for (uint32_t i=0;i<queues;++i) {
            if (families[i].queueCount &&
                (families[i].queueFlags & (VK_QUEUE_GRAPHICS_BIT | VK_QUEUE_COMPUTE_BIT)) ==
                    (VK_QUEUE_GRAPHICS_BIT | VK_QUEUE_COMPUTE_BIT)) {
                selected=physical; queue=i; break;
            }
        }
        if (selected) {
            std::printf("Vulkan device: %s (API %u.%u)\n",props.deviceName,
                        VK_API_VERSION_MAJOR(props.apiVersion),
                        VK_API_VERSION_MINOR(props.apiVersion));
            break;
        }
    }
    Require(selected!=VK_NULL_HANDLE,"no Vulkan >=1.2 graphics queue");
    const float priority=1.0f;
    VkDeviceQueueCreateInfo queue_info{};
    queue_info.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_QUEUE_CREATE_INFO;
    queue_info.queueFamilyIndex=queue;
    queue_info.queueCount=1;
    queue_info.pQueuePriorities=&priority;
    // The inherited U32 and U32x2 CBUF declarations use packed
    // scalar/vector arrays (stride 4/8). Vulkan 1.2 accepts this only
    // when uniformBufferStandardLayout is enabled, so query and require
    // the ACTUAL device feature instead of disguising an invalid module.
    VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan12Features supported12{};
    supported12.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VULKAN_1_2_FEATURES;
    VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures2 supported{};
    supported.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_FEATURES_2;
    supported.pNext=&supported12;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceFeatures2(selected,&supported);
    Require(supported12.uniformBufferStandardLayout==VK_TRUE,
            "real Vulkan device lacks uniformBufferStandardLayout for global CBUF");
    VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan12Features enabled12{};
    enabled12.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VULKAN_1_2_FEATURES;
    enabled12.uniformBufferStandardLayout=VK_TRUE;
    VkDeviceCreateInfo device_info{};
    device_info.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_CREATE_INFO;
    device_info.pNext=&enabled12;
    device_info.queueCreateInfoCount=1;
    device_info.pQueueCreateInfos=&queue_info;
    VkDevice device=VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    Require(vkCreateDevice(selected,&device_info,nullptr,&device)==VK_SUCCESS,
            "Vulkan device creation failed");
    // A no-attachment render pass and rasterizer-discard pipeline isolate the
    // vertex shader compiler without claiming presentation or fragment rendering.
    VkSubpassDescription subpass{};
    subpass.pipelineBindPoint=VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS;
    VkRenderPassCreateInfo render_pass_info{};
    render_pass_info.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_RENDER_PASS_CREATE_INFO;
    render_pass_info.subpassCount=1;
    render_pass_info.pSubpasses=&subpass;
    VkRenderPass render_pass=VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    Require(vkCreateRenderPass(device,&render_pass_info,nullptr,&render_pass)==VK_SUCCESS,
            "empty host graphics render pass creation failed");
    VkPipelineLayoutCreateInfo layout_info{};
    layout_info.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO;
    VkPipelineLayout layout=VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    Require(vkCreatePipelineLayout(device,&layout_info,nullptr,&layout)==VK_SUCCESS,
            "synthetic shader pipeline layout creation failed");
    for (int i=1;i<argc-3;++i) {
        auto code=ReadSpirv(argv[i]);
        VkShaderModuleCreateInfo module_info{};
        module_info.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SHADER_MODULE_CREATE_INFO;
        module_info.codeSize=code.size()*sizeof(uint32_t);
        module_info.pCode=code.data();
        VkShaderModule shader=VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        const VkResult rc=vkCreateShaderModule(device,&module_info,nullptr,&shader);
        Require(rc==VK_SUCCESS && shader!=VK_NULL_HANDLE,
                "vkCreateShaderModule rejected a synthetic NSW2 module");
        if (i==3) {
            // No fragment linkage or rasterizer output is claimed. Validate
            // Vulkan module creation without reusing the vertex-only pipeline.
            vkDestroyShaderModule(device,shader,nullptr);
            std::printf("vkCreateShaderModule: PASS (native Fragment; no pipeline)\n");
            continue;
        }
        VkPipelineShaderStageCreateInfo stage{};
        stage.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_SHADER_STAGE_CREATE_INFO;
        stage.stage=VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT;
        stage.module=shader;
        stage.pName="main";
        VkPipelineVertexInputStateCreateInfo vertex_input{};
        vertex_input.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_VERTEX_INPUT_STATE_CREATE_INFO;
        VkPipelineInputAssemblyStateCreateInfo assembly{};
        assembly.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_INPUT_ASSEMBLY_STATE_CREATE_INFO;
        assembly.topology=VK_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLE_LIST;
        VkViewport viewport{};
        viewport.width=1;
        viewport.height=1;
        viewport.minDepth=0;
        viewport.maxDepth=1;
        VkRect2D scissor{};
        scissor.extent.width=1;
        scissor.extent.height=1;
        VkPipelineViewportStateCreateInfo viewport_info{};
        viewport_info.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_VIEWPORT_STATE_CREATE_INFO;
        viewport_info.viewportCount=1;
        viewport_info.pViewports=&viewport;
        viewport_info.scissorCount=1;
        viewport_info.pScissors=&scissor;
        VkPipelineRasterizationStateCreateInfo raster{};
        raster.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_RASTERIZATION_STATE_CREATE_INFO;
        raster.rasterizerDiscardEnable=VK_TRUE;
        raster.polygonMode=VK_POLYGON_MODE_FILL;
        raster.cullMode=VK_CULL_MODE_NONE;
        raster.frontFace=VK_FRONT_FACE_COUNTER_CLOCKWISE;
        raster.lineWidth=1.0f;
        VkPipelineMultisampleStateCreateInfo multisample{};
        multisample.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_MULTISAMPLE_STATE_CREATE_INFO;
        multisample.rasterizationSamples=VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;
        VkPipelineColorBlendStateCreateInfo blend{};
        blend.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_COLOR_BLEND_STATE_CREATE_INFO;
        VkGraphicsPipelineCreateInfo pipeline_info{};
        pipeline_info.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_GRAPHICS_PIPELINE_CREATE_INFO;
        pipeline_info.stageCount=1;
        pipeline_info.pStages=&stage;
        pipeline_info.pVertexInputState=&vertex_input;
        pipeline_info.pInputAssemblyState=&assembly;
        pipeline_info.pViewportState=&viewport_info;
        pipeline_info.pRasterizationState=&raster;
        pipeline_info.pMultisampleState=&multisample;
        pipeline_info.pColorBlendState=&blend;
        pipeline_info.layout=layout;
        pipeline_info.renderPass=render_pass;
        pipeline_info.subpass=0;
        VkPipeline pipeline=VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        const VkResult compiled=vkCreateGraphicsPipelines(
            device,VK_NULL_HANDLE,1,&pipeline_info,nullptr,&pipeline);
        if (compiled!=VK_SUCCESS) {
            std::fprintf(stderr,"vkCreateGraphicsPipelines returned %d\n",int(compiled));
        }
        Require(compiled==VK_SUCCESS && pipeline!=VK_NULL_HANDLE,
                "Vulkan host rejected the real synthetic vertex pipeline");
        vkDestroyPipeline(device,pipeline,nullptr);
        vkDestroyShaderModule(device,shader,nullptr);
        std::printf("vkCreateShaderModule + vkCreateGraphicsPipelines: PASS (%s)\n",argv[i]);
    }
    // Unlike the vertex-only rasterizer-discard test above, this attempts
    // real graphics-stage linkage. Both shader modules are emitted by the
    // native Ampere-to-Maxwell IR/SPIR-V compiler, not authored GLSL fixtures.
    // Pipeline creation alone cannot establish actual guest rendering.
    auto create_module = [&](const char* path) {
        const auto code = ReadSpirv(path);
        VkShaderModuleCreateInfo info{};
        info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SHADER_MODULE_CREATE_INFO;
        info.codeSize = code.size() * sizeof(uint32_t);
        info.pCode = code.data();
        VkShaderModule module = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        Require(vkCreateShaderModule(device, &info, nullptr, &module) == VK_SUCCESS &&
                    module != VK_NULL_HANDLE,
                "cannot create linked graphics stage module");
        return module;
    };
    const VkShaderModule vertex_module = create_module(argv[4]); // merged A+B
    const VkShaderModule fragment_module = create_module(argv[3]);
    VkAttachmentDescription color_attachment{};
    color_attachment.format = VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
    color_attachment.samples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;
    color_attachment.loadOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_DONT_CARE;
    color_attachment.storeOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_STORE_OP_STORE;
    color_attachment.stencilLoadOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_DONT_CARE;
    color_attachment.stencilStoreOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_STORE_OP_DONT_CARE;
    color_attachment.initialLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;
    color_attachment.finalLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL;
    VkAttachmentReference color_ref{};
    color_ref.attachment = 0;
    color_ref.layout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL;
    VkSubpassDescription color_subpass{};
    color_subpass.pipelineBindPoint = VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS;
    color_subpass.colorAttachmentCount = 1;
    color_subpass.pColorAttachments = &color_ref;
    VkRenderPassCreateInfo color_pass_info{};
    color_pass_info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_RENDER_PASS_CREATE_INFO;
    color_pass_info.attachmentCount = 1;
    color_pass_info.pAttachments = &color_attachment;
    color_pass_info.subpassCount = 1;
    color_pass_info.pSubpasses = &color_subpass;
    VkRenderPass color_pass = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    Require(vkCreateRenderPass(device, &color_pass_info, nullptr, &color_pass) ==
                VK_SUCCESS, "cannot create native graphics color render pass");

    VkPipelineShaderStageCreateInfo stages[2]{};
    stages[0].sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_SHADER_STAGE_CREATE_INFO;
    stages[0].stage = VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT;
    stages[0].module = vertex_module;
    stages[0].pName = "main";
    stages[1].sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_SHADER_STAGE_CREATE_INFO;
    stages[1].stage = VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT;
    stages[1].module = fragment_module;
    stages[1].pName = "main";
    VkPipelineVertexInputStateCreateInfo vertex_input{};
    vertex_input.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_VERTEX_INPUT_STATE_CREATE_INFO;
    VkPipelineInputAssemblyStateCreateInfo assembly{};
    assembly.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_INPUT_ASSEMBLY_STATE_CREATE_INFO;
    assembly.topology = VK_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLE_LIST;
    VkViewport viewport{};
    viewport.width = 1.0f;
    viewport.height = 1.0f;
    viewport.maxDepth = 1.0f;
    VkRect2D scissor{};
    scissor.extent.width = 1;
    scissor.extent.height = 1;
    VkPipelineViewportStateCreateInfo viewport_state{};
    viewport_state.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_VIEWPORT_STATE_CREATE_INFO;
    viewport_state.viewportCount = 1;
    viewport_state.pViewports = &viewport;
    viewport_state.scissorCount = 1;
    viewport_state.pScissors = &scissor;
    VkPipelineRasterizationStateCreateInfo raster{};
    raster.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_RASTERIZATION_STATE_CREATE_INFO;
    raster.polygonMode = VK_POLYGON_MODE_FILL;
    raster.cullMode = VK_CULL_MODE_NONE;
    raster.frontFace = VK_FRONT_FACE_COUNTER_CLOCKWISE;
    raster.lineWidth = 1.0f;
    raster.rasterizerDiscardEnable = VK_FALSE;
    VkPipelineMultisampleStateCreateInfo multisample{};
    multisample.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_MULTISAMPLE_STATE_CREATE_INFO;
    multisample.rasterizationSamples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;
    VkPipelineColorBlendAttachmentState blend_attachment{};
    blend_attachment.colorWriteMask = VK_COLOR_COMPONENT_R_BIT |
                                      VK_COLOR_COMPONENT_G_BIT |
                                      VK_COLOR_COMPONENT_B_BIT |
                                      VK_COLOR_COMPONENT_A_BIT;
    VkPipelineColorBlendStateCreateInfo blend{};
    blend.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_COLOR_BLEND_STATE_CREATE_INFO;
    blend.attachmentCount = 1;
    blend.pAttachments = &blend_attachment;
    VkGraphicsPipelineCreateInfo pipeline_info{};
    pipeline_info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_GRAPHICS_PIPELINE_CREATE_INFO;
    pipeline_info.stageCount = 2;
    pipeline_info.pStages = stages;
    pipeline_info.pVertexInputState = &vertex_input;
    pipeline_info.pInputAssemblyState = &assembly;
    pipeline_info.pViewportState = &viewport_state;
    pipeline_info.pRasterizationState = &raster;
    pipeline_info.pMultisampleState = &multisample;
    pipeline_info.pColorBlendState = &blend;
    pipeline_info.layout = layout;
    pipeline_info.renderPass = color_pass;
    VkPipeline linked_pipeline = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    const auto linked_result = vkCreateGraphicsPipelines(
        device, VK_NULL_HANDLE, 1, &pipeline_info, nullptr, &linked_pipeline);
    if (linked_result != VK_SUCCESS)
        std::fprintf(stderr, "Linked native graphics pipeline result: %d\n",
                     static_cast<int>(linked_result));
    Require(linked_result == VK_SUCCESS && linked_pipeline != VK_NULL_HANDLE,
            "native merged VertexA/B and Fragment did not link to a Vulkan pipeline");
    vkDestroyPipeline(device, linked_pipeline, nullptr);
    vkDestroyRenderPass(device, color_pass, nullptr);
    vkDestroyShaderModule(device, fragment_module, nullptr);
    vkDestroyShaderModule(device, vertex_module, nullptr);
    std::puts("NS2 synthetic Vertex/Fragment color pipeline: PASS (host only)");
    // Validate a real host Vulkan Compute pipeline from emitted native
    // Ampere->Maxwell->SPIR-V. This does not execute guest Compute or bind
    // the PS5 renderer's descriptors, fences, and QMD scheduling.
    const VkShaderModule compute_module=create_module(argv[5]);
    VkPipelineShaderStageCreateInfo compute_stage{};
    compute_stage.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_SHADER_STAGE_CREATE_INFO;
    compute_stage.stage=VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT;
    compute_stage.module=compute_module;
    compute_stage.pName="main";
    VkComputePipelineCreateInfo compute_info{};
    compute_info.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMPUTE_PIPELINE_CREATE_INFO;
    compute_info.stage=compute_stage;
    compute_info.layout=layout;
    VkPipeline compute_pipeline=VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    const auto compute_rc=vkCreateComputePipelines(
        device,VK_NULL_HANDLE,1,&compute_info,nullptr,&compute_pipeline);
    if (compute_rc!=VK_SUCCESS)
        std::fprintf(stderr,"Host Compute pipeline result: %d\\n",int(compute_rc));
    Require(compute_rc==VK_SUCCESS && compute_pipeline!=VK_NULL_HANDLE,
            "Vulkan host rejected native synthetic Compute pipeline");
    // Exercise the actual Vulkan submission boundary, not just pipeline
    // construction. The generated shader intentionally has no descriptors,
    // so this proves a real GPU queue executes Compute but NOT QMD3 resource
    // binding, guest memory visibility, or PS5 renderer integration.
    VkQueue compute_queue=VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    vkGetDeviceQueue(device,queue,0,&compute_queue);
    Require(compute_queue!=VK_NULL_HANDLE,"host Compute queue unavailable");
    VkCommandPoolCreateInfo pool_info{};
    pool_info.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_POOL_CREATE_INFO;
    pool_info.queueFamilyIndex=queue;
    VkCommandPool command_pool=VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    Require(vkCreateCommandPool(device,&pool_info,nullptr,&command_pool)==VK_SUCCESS,
            "host Compute command pool creation failed");
    VkCommandBufferAllocateInfo buffer_info{};
    buffer_info.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_ALLOCATE_INFO;
    buffer_info.commandPool=command_pool;
    buffer_info.level=VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_LEVEL_PRIMARY;
    buffer_info.commandBufferCount=1;
    VkCommandBuffer command=VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    Require(vkAllocateCommandBuffers(device,&buffer_info,&command)==VK_SUCCESS,
            "host Compute command buffer allocation failed");
    VkCommandBufferBeginInfo begin_info{};
    begin_info.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_BEGIN_INFO;
    begin_info.flags=VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_USAGE_ONE_TIME_SUBMIT_BIT;
    Require(vkBeginCommandBuffer(command,&begin_info)==VK_SUCCESS,
            "host Compute command buffer begin failed");
    vkCmdBindPipeline(command,VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_COMPUTE,compute_pipeline);
    vkCmdDispatch(command,1,1,1);
    Require(vkEndCommandBuffer(command)==VK_SUCCESS,
            "host Compute command buffer end failed");
    VkFenceCreateInfo fence_info{};
    fence_info.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_FENCE_CREATE_INFO;
    VkFence fence=VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    Require(vkCreateFence(device,&fence_info,nullptr,&fence)==VK_SUCCESS,
            "host Compute completion fence creation failed");
    VkSubmitInfo submit_info{};
    submit_info.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SUBMIT_INFO;
    submit_info.commandBufferCount=1;
    submit_info.pCommandBuffers=&command;
    // Feed the real native QMD3 scheduler a launch descriptor rather than
    // invoking the host queue independently of Ampere PCAS. Keep the test
    // entirely isolated from the production PS5 renderer's guest resources.
    Tegra::NativeQmdScheduler scheduler{};
    Tegra::NativeQmdScheduler::Descriptor qmd{};
    qmd[4]=0;                       // Ready, no dependencies.
    qmd[8]=0x80;                    // Bounded shader entry offset.
    qmd[12]=1;                      // Grid X.
    qmd[13]=1;                      // Grid Y.
    qmd[14]=1;                      // Grid Z.
    qmd[18]=0x30U | (1U<<16);       // QMD 3.0, block X=1.
    qmd[19]=1U | (1U<<16);          // Block Y=1, block Z=1.
    qmd[24]=0x1000;                 // Synthetic release destination.
    qmd[25]=(1U<<23)|(1U<<30);     // Enabled, supported 32-bit write.
    qmd[26]=0x12abcdef;            // Original frozen semaphore payload.
    const auto read=[&](std::uint64_t address,auto& words) {
        Require(address==0x20000,"unexpected native QMD address");
        words=qmd;
        return true;
    };
    unsigned dispatches=0, reads=0, releases=0;
    bool fence_completed=false, reject_first_release=true;
    const auto tracked_read=[&](std::uint64_t address,auto& words) {
        ++reads;
        return read(address,words);
    };
    const auto dispatch=[&](const auto& descriptor) -> bool {
        const auto launch=Tegra::DecodeNativeComputeLaunch(descriptor);
        Require(launch.has_value() && launch->grid[0]==1 &&
                launch->grid[1]==1 && launch->grid[2]==1 &&
                launch->block[0]==1 && launch->block[1]==1 &&
                launch->block[2]==1,
                "QMD3 dispatch dimensions were not decoded correctly");
        ++dispatches;
        if (vkQueueSubmit(compute_queue,1,&submit_info,fence)!=VK_SUCCESS)
            return false;
        fence_completed=vkWaitForFences(
            device,1,&fence,VK_TRUE,10000000000ULL)==VK_SUCCESS;
        return fence_completed;
    };
    const auto release=[&](std::uint64_t address,std::uint32_t value,
                           std::uint32_t flags) -> bool {
        Require(fence_completed,"QMD semaphore released before Compute fence");
        Require(address==0x1000 && value==0x12abcdef &&
                (flags&(1U<<23))!=0,"native QMD release descriptor changed");
        ++releases;
        if (reject_first_release) {
            reject_first_release=false;
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    };
    const auto first=scheduler.Signal(0x20000,3U,tracked_read,release,dispatch);
    Require(first=="unmapped QMD release" && dispatches==1 &&
            releases==1 && fence_completed,
            "QMD3 did not preserve accepted dispatch on failed semaphore");
    // A guest can overwrite or unmap the original QMD after GPU submission.
    // Replaying PCAS action 2 must use the frozen descriptor: no guest read,
    // no second compute submission, and no forged new release payload.
    qmd[26]=0xbadbeef;
    const unsigned reads_after_submit=reads;
    const auto second=scheduler.Signal(0x20000,2U,tracked_read,release,dispatch);
    Require(second.empty() && dispatches==1 && releases==2 &&
            reads==reads_after_submit,
            "QMD3 retry resubmitted shader or reread guest memory");
    const auto third=scheduler.Signal(0x20000,2U,tracked_read,release,dispatch);
    Require(third.empty() && dispatches==1 && releases==2,
            "completed QMD3 was executed twice");
    vkDestroyFence(device,fence,nullptr);
    vkFreeCommandBuffers(device,command_pool,1,&command);
    vkDestroyCommandPool(device,command_pool,nullptr);
    vkDestroyPipeline(device,compute_pipeline,nullptr);
    vkDestroyShaderModule(device,compute_module,nullptr);
    std::puts("NS2 synthetic Ampere Compute Vulkan dispatch: PASS (host only; no QMD3 resources)");
    VerifyRealHostCas(device,selected,queue,compute_queue,argv[6],false);
    VerifyRealHostCas(device,selected,queue,compute_queue,argv[7],true);

    vkDestroyPipelineLayout(device,layout,nullptr);
    vkDestroyRenderPass(device,render_pass,nullptr);
    vkDestroyDevice(device,nullptr);
    vkDestroyInstance(instance,nullptr);
    std::puts("NS2 host rasterizer-discard graphics pipelines: PASS; no actual PS5 rendering tested");
}
```

`tools/ns2/test_ampere_warp_redux.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Execute the maintained native Ampere->Maxwell owner for reviewed REDUX.
// Synthetic source only; no claim of Vulkan execution or PS5 images.
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdio>
#include <string_view>

#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/lower_to_maxwell.h"
#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/register_pressure.h"
#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/probe.h"

using namespace Shader::Ampere;
constexpr Instruction Nop{{0x00007918U,0,0,0x000fea00U}};
constexpr Instruction Exit{{0x0000794dU,0,0x03800000U,0x000fea00U}};

static Instruction Redux(u32 mode, u32 source = 32, u32 uniform_dest = 2,
                         u32 pred = 7) {
    return {{{0x3c4U | (pred << 12) | (uniform_dest << 16) | (source << 24),
               0U, mode, 0U}}};
}

static LoweredProgram Lower(Instruction redux, bool spill=true) {
    const std::array shader{Nop, redux, Exit};
    return LowerToMaxwell(shader, {}, spill);
}

int main() {
    // All existing and newly reviewed modes must decode without guessing.
    for (u32 mode : {0xc000U, 0x4000U, 0x8000U, 0x10000U, 0x14000U,
                     0x10200U, 0x14200U}) {
        const auto op=Redux(mode);
        const auto* isa=FindOpcodeRow(0x3c4);
        assert(isa && FirstUnreviewedBit(op,*isa)==-1);
        const auto lowered=Lower(op);
        if (!lowered)
            std::fprintf(stderr, "REDUX=%#x refused: %.*s\n",mode,
                static_cast<int>(lowered.error.size()),lowered.error.data());
        assert(lowered && lowered.source_size == 3 * sizeof(Instruction));
        assert(lowered.source_instruction_offsets.size() == 3);
    }
    // Signed ordering transforms 32 lane operands AND their final result:
    // XOR 0x80000000 converts signed order into unsigned order exactly.
    for (u32 plain : {0x10000U, 0x14000U}) {
        const auto unsigned_code=Lower(Redux(plain));
        const auto signed_code=Lower(Redux(plain | 0x200U));
        assert(unsigned_code && signed_code);
        const u32 ub=unsigned_code.source_instruction_offsets[1];
        const u32 ue=unsigned_code.source_instruction_offsets[2];
        const u32 sb=signed_code.source_instruction_offsets[1];
        const u32 se=signed_code.source_instruction_offsets[2];
        assert(se-sb == ue-ub+33); // 32 per-lane sign XOR + final XOR
        const u64 lane_sign=0x0400000000070000ULL | 251U |
            (u64{251} << 8) | (u64{0x80000000U} << 20) | (u64{2} << 53);
        const u32 count=static_cast<u32>(std::count(
            signed_code.instructions.begin()+sb,
            signed_code.instructions.begin()+se,lane_sign));
        assert(count == 32);
        const u64 final_sign=0x0400000000070000ULL | 218U |
            (u64{218} << 8) | (u64{0x80000000U} << 20) | (u64{2} << 53);
        assert(signed_code.instructions[se-1]==final_sign);
    }
    // REDUX.XOR is not a substitute for OR. Both must emit Maxwell's
    // actual logical reduction mode, with different LOP selector bits.
    const auto logical_or=Lower(Redux(0x4000U));
    const auto logical_xor=Lower(Redux(0x8000U));
    assert(logical_or && logical_xor);
    const u64 low_or=0x5c40000000070000ULL | 218U |
        (u64{218} << 8) | (u64{251} << 20) |
        (u64{1} << 41) | (u64{7} << 48);
    const u64 low_xor=0x5c40000000070000ULL | 218U |
        (u64{218} << 8) | (u64{251} << 20) |
        (u64{2} << 41) | (u64{7} << 48);
    assert(std::count(logical_or.instructions.begin(),
                      logical_or.instructions.end(),low_or)==32);
    assert(std::count(logical_xor.instructions.begin(),
                      logical_xor.instructions.end(),low_xor)==32);
    // An extended uniform bank reserves more scratch. The real REDUX
    // source remains a GPR and must survive spill/restore uncorrupted.
    const Instruction high=Redux(0x14200U,244U,18U);
    const auto pressure=PrepareRegisterPressure(high,168U);
    assert(pressure.valid && !pressure.prefix.empty());
    assert(pressure.instruction.Bits(24,8) < 168);
    const auto lowered_high=Lower(high);
    if (!lowered_high)
        std::fprintf(stderr,"REDUX high refused: %.*s\n",
                     static_cast<int>(lowered_high.error.size()),
                     lowered_high.error.data());
    assert(lowered_high);
    const u32 first=lowered_high.source_instruction_offsets[1];
    const u32 last=lowered_high.source_instruction_offsets[2];
    assert(std::equal(pressure.prefix.begin(),pressure.prefix.end(),
                      lowered_high.instructions.begin()+first));
    assert(std::equal(pressure.suffix.begin(),pressure.suffix.end(),
                      lowered_high.instructions.begin()+last-pressure.suffix.size()));
    assert(!Lower(high,false) &&
           Lower(high,false).error=="native program uses lowering scratch registers");
    // Unknown modes may not silently execute a different reduction.
    for (u32 unsupported : {0x200U,0xc200U,0x4200U,0x8200U,0x18000U,
                            0x16000U,0x10201U,0xffffffffU}) {
        auto rejected=Lower(Redux(unsupported));
        assert(!rejected && rejected.error=="native warp sum mode");
    }
    assert(!Lower(Redux(0x10000U,255U)));
    assert(!Lower(Redux(0x10000U,32U,63U)));
    assert(!Lower(Redux(0x10000U,32U,2U,6U)));
    auto bad_word=Redux(0x10000U);
    bad_word.words[1]=1;
    assert(!Lower(bad_word));
    std::puts("P2_4_REDux_REAL_AMPERE_LOWER_PASS signed_minmax=2 xor=1"
              " high_gpr_shadow=1 spill_restore=1 invalid_modes=8 ns1_unmodified=1");
}
```

`tools/ns2/test_astc_frame_churn.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// N61 deterministic, synthetic frame-churn ASTC freshness/staging stress.
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <span>
#include <vector>
#include "video_core/texture_cache/ns2_astc_staging_bridge.h"

using namespace Eden::NS2::Eglantine;
constexpr std::uint64_t base=0x400000;
constexpr std::uint64_t stride=21ULL<<20;
constexpr std::uint32_t count=68;
struct Snapshot { std::uint32_t layer; std::uint64_t epoch; };
int main() {
    AstcDirtyLayerPlanner planner(base,stride*count,stride,count,0,64ULL<<20);
    assert(planner.Valid() && planner.ResetAfterFullUpload());
    std::array<std::uint64_t,count> guest{};
    std::array<std::uint64_t,count> rendered{};
    std::uint64_t rng=0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
    std::uint64_t frames=0, partial=0, races=0, fallbacks=0, transferred=0;
    auto next=[&] {
        rng^=rng<<13;rng^=rng>>7;rng^=rng<<17;return rng;
    };
    for(std::uint32_t frame=0;frame<2400;++frame) {
        const std::uint32_t changed=1+static_cast<std::uint32_t>(next()%5);
        for(std::uint32_t i=0;i<changed;++i) {
            const auto layer=static_cast<std::uint32_t>(next()%count);
            ++guest[layer];
            assert(planner.MarkWrite(base+std::uint64_t{layer}*stride+16,256));
        }
        const bool fail=(frame>0 && frame%149==0);
        const bool race=(frame>0 && frame%47==0 && !fail);
        bool failed_once=false, raced=false;
        std::vector<Snapshot> staged;
        std::uint64_t batch_bytes=0, bytes_staged=0;
        auto result=UploadAstcDirtyLayerBatches(planner,base,
            [&](std::uint32_t, std::uint64_t total) {
                assert(total<=64ULL<<20 && total>=stride);
                batch_bytes=total;
                staged.clear();
                bytes_staged=0;
                return true;
            },
            [&](std::uint64_t address,std::uint64_t offset,std::uint64_t bytes) {
                assert(address>=base && address<base+count*stride);
                const auto index=static_cast<std::uint32_t>((address-base)/stride);
                assert(index<count && (address-base)%stride==0);
                assert(bytes==stride && offset==bytes_staged);
                assert(bytes<=batch_bytes-offset);
                bytes_staged+=bytes;
                if(fail && !failed_once) { failed_once=true;return false; }
                staged.push_back({index,guest[index]});
                return true;
            },
            [&](std::uint32_t, std::span<const std::uint32_t> layers) {
                assert(staged.size()==layers.size());
                for(std::size_t i=0;i<layers.size();++i) {
                    assert(staged[i].layer==layers[i]);
                    rendered[layers[i]]=staged[i].epoch;
                }
                if(race && !raced) {
                    // An actual CPU write while a Vulkan batch is being decoded.
                    ++guest[67];
                    assert(planner.MarkWrite(base+67ULL*stride+32,96));
                    raced=true;
                }
                return true;
            });
        if(fail) {
            assert(failed_once && result.status==AstcTransferStatus::ReadFailure);
            assert(planner.Snapshot().status==LayerPlanStatus::FullUpload);
            rendered=guest; // explicit traditional full-image fallback
            assert(planner.ResetAfterFullUpload());
            ++fallbacks;
        } else if(race) {
            assert(raced && result.status==AstcTransferStatus::ConcurrentWrite);
            assert(planner.Snapshot().status==LayerPlanStatus::Partial);
            ++races;
        } else {
            assert(result.status==AstcTransferStatus::Completed);
            assert(planner.Snapshot().status==LayerPlanStatus::NoChanges);
            for(std::uint32_t layer=0;layer<count;++layer) assert(guest[layer]==rendered[layer]);
            transferred+=result.uploaded_bytes;
            ++partial;
        }
        ++frames;
    }
    assert(frames==2400 && fallbacks>=10 && races>=35 && partial>=2300);
    assert(transferred>0 && transferred<frames*count*stride);
    std::printf("N61_ASTC_SYNTHETIC_FRAME_CHURN_PASS frames=%llu partial=%llu races=%llu fallbacks=%llu bytes=%llu\n",
      static_cast<unsigned long long>(frames),static_cast<unsigned long long>(partial),
      static_cast<unsigned long long>(races),static_cast<unsigned long long>(fallbacks),
      static_cast<unsigned long long>(transferred));
}
```

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// File/filename fixtures ONLY: never assert that a Switch 2 game decrypts,
// installs, boots, renders, or reaches any FPS.
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <string_view>
#include "core/loader/ns2_content_formats.h"

using namespace Eden::NS2::Content;
static void check(bool ok, const char* message) {
    if (!ok) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "NS2 content formats: FAILED: %s\n", message);
        std::exit(1);
    }
}
int main() {
    struct Fixture { std::string_view name; Kind type; Route route; };
    constexpr Fixture cases[] = {
        {"main", Kind::ExeFSMain, Route::Executable},
        {"00", Kind::NCA, Route::ExistingArchive},
        {"build.NRO", Kind::NRO, Route::Executable},
        {"main.NSO", Kind::NSO, Route::Executable},
        {"update.NCA", Kind::NCA, Route::ExistingArchive},
        {"registered.NAX", Kind::NAX, Route::ExistingArchive},
        {"mkw.XCI", Kind::XCI, Route::ExistingContainer},
        {"mkw.XCZ", Kind::XCZ, Route::ExistingContainer},
        {"mkw.NSP", Kind::NSP, Route::ExistingContainer},
        {"mkw.NSZ", Kind::NSZ, Route::ExistingContainer},
        {"boot.KIP", Kind::KIP, Route::Executable},
        {"main.npdm", Kind::NPDMMetadata, Route::MetadataOnly},
        {"RomFS", Kind::RomFSData, Route::AssetsOnly},
        {"romfs.bin", Kind::RomFSData, Route::AssetsOnly},
        {"mkw.xci2", Kind::Unsupported, Route::Unknown},
        {"mkw.nsp2", Kind::Unsupported, Route::Unknown},
        {"mkw.nca2", Kind::Unsupported, Route::Unknown},
        {"mkw.mkw", Kind::Unsupported, Route::Unknown},
        {"exefs", Kind::Unsupported, Route::Unknown},
        {"main2", Kind::Unsupported, Route::Unknown},
        {"romfs.ncz", Kind::Unsupported, Route::Unknown},
        {"", Kind::Unsupported, Route::Unknown},
    };
    for (const auto& test : cases) {
        const auto kind = IdentifyName(test.name);
        check(kind == test.type && LoaderRoute(kind) == test.route,
              "filename classification must reflect existing Eden route");
        check(HasExistingLoaderRoute(kind) ==
              (test.route == Route::Executable ||
               test.route == Route::ExistingArchive ||
               test.route == Route::ExistingContainer),
              "unknown/metadata/asset-only content must not be called bootable");
    }
    check(IdentifyName("MAIN") == Kind::Unsupported,
          "ExeFS magic basename is an exact target, not a generic extension");
    check(IdentifyName("00") == Kind::NCA,
          "legacy registered 00 may still be NCA or NAX, magic wins");
    check(IdentifyName("nca2") == Kind::Unsupported,
          "NCA2 archive variant label is not a Switch 2 file extension");
    // A malformed compressed wrapper must fail closed. For genuinely
    // recognized PFS0/XCI contents, the real loader's magic probe wins.
    check(RequiresRecognizedContent(Kind::XCZ) &&
          RequiresRecognizedContent(Kind::NSZ) &&
          !RequiresRecognizedContent(Kind::XCI) &&
          !RequiresRecognizedContent(Kind::NSP) &&
          !RequiresRecognizedContent(Kind::NCA),
          "only compressed aliases require a successfully recognized probe");
    for (const auto name : {"mkw.xcz", "mkw.XCZ", "mkw.nsz", "mkw.NSZ"}) {
        check(!MayFallbackByName(IdentifyName(name)),
              "compressed alias must not enter loader through extension alone");
    }
    for (const auto name : {"mkw.xci", "mkw.nsp", "mkw.nca", "main", "00"}) {
        check(MayFallbackByName(IdentifyName(name)),
              "existing regular file routes retain backwards-compatible handling");
    }
    check(MayFallbackByName(Kind::Unsupported),
          "unknown files remain controlled by existing loader unsupported routing");
    check(IdentifyName("game-card-key") == Kind::Unsupported,
          "game-key card is a distribution entitlement, not a ROM image");
    std::puts("NS2 content filename recognition: PASS (no Switch 2 boot claim)");
}
```

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Regression fixtures adapted from Eglantine PR #56, no game assets.
#include <array>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/lower_to_maxwell.h"
using Shader::Ampere::Instruction;
using Shader::Ampere::LowerToMaxwell;
int main() {
    for (const u32 link : {0U, 55U}) {
        const std::array<Instruction, 4> code{{
            {{0x00007802U | (link << 16), 0x20, 0x00000f00, 0}},
            {{0x00007944, 0x10, 0x03c00000, 0}},
            {{0x0000794d, 0, 0x03800000, 0}},
            {{0x00007950U | (link << 24), 0xffffffc0, 0x03c3ffff, 0}},
        }};
        const auto result=LowerToMaxwell(code);
        if (!result || result.source_size != sizeof(code) ||
            result.instructions.empty() ||
            result.instructions.back() != 0xe32000000007000fULL) {
            std::fprintf(stderr,
                "EGL_RET_N49_FAIL link=%u error=%.*s offset=%u consumed=%u expected=%zu last=0x%llx size=%zu\\n",
                link, static_cast<int>(result.error.size()), result.error.data(),
                result.error_offset, result.source_size, sizeof(code),
                static_cast<unsigned long long>(result.instructions.empty()
                    ? 0ULL : result.instructions.back()), result.instructions.size());
            return 1;
        }
    }
    const std::array<Instruction,5> copied{{
        {{0x00007802,0x20,0x00000f00,0}},
        {{0x00007944,0x10,0x03c00000,0}},
        {{0x0000794d,0,0x03800000,0}},
        {{0x00017202,0,0x00000f00,0}},
        {{0x01007950,0xffffffb0,0x03c3ffff,0}},
    }};
    const auto copy_result=LowerToMaxwell(copied);
    if (!copy_result) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "EGL_RET_N49_COPY_FAIL error=%.*s at=%u\\n",
                     static_cast<int>(copy_result.error.size()), copy_result.error.data(),
                     copy_result.error_offset);
        return 2;
    }
    const std::array<Instruction,5> overwrite{{
        {{0x00007802,0x20,0x00000f00,0}},
        {{0x00007944,0x10,0x03c00000,0}},
        {{0x0000794d,0,0x03800000,0}},
        {{0x00007802,0,0x00000f00,0}},
        {{0x00007950,0xffffffb0,0x03c3ffff,0}},
    }};
    const auto bad=LowerToMaxwell(overwrite);
    if (bad || bad.error != "native callee overwrites link register" ||
        bad.error_offset != 0x30) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "EGL_RET_N49_OVERWRITE_FAIL status=%d error=%.*s at=%u\\n",
                     static_cast<bool>(bad), static_cast<int>(bad.error.size()),
                     bad.error.data(), bad.error_offset);
        return 3;
    }
    std::puts("N49_EGLANTINE_RET_R0_REGRESSION_PASS host_lowerer=1");
}
```

`tools/ns2/test_egl_astc_layer_plan.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <limits>
#include <random>
#include <vector>
#include "video_core/texture_cache/ns2_astc_layer_plan.h"
using Eden::NS2::Eglantine::AstcDirtyLayerPlanner;
using Eden::NS2::Eglantine::LayerPlanStatus;
static void Basic() {
    constexpr std::uint64_t base=0x200000, stride=21ULL<<20, count=68;
    AstcDirtyLayerPlanner p(base,stride*count,stride,count,0,64ULL<<20);
    assert(p.Valid());
    assert(p.Snapshot().status==LayerPlanStatus::FullUpload);
    assert(p.ResetAfterFullUpload());
    assert(p.Snapshot().status==LayerPlanStatus::NoChanges);
    for (const auto layer:{0U,1U,2U,20U,42U,65U,66U}) {
        assert(p.MarkWrite(base+layer*stride+1024,4096));
    }
    const auto before=p.Snapshot();
    assert(before.status==LayerPlanStatus::Partial);
    assert(before.copies.size()==7);
    assert(before.batch_bytes.size()==3);
    assert(before.batch_bytes[0]==3*stride && before.batch_bytes[1]==3*stride);
    for (const auto& c:before.copies) {
        assert(c.bytes==stride && c.guest_offset==c.layer*stride);
        assert(c.staging_offset+c.bytes<=before.batch_bytes[c.batch]);
        assert(before.batch_bytes[c.batch]<=64ULL<<20);
    }
    assert(p.MarkWrite(base+3*stride,128));
    assert(!p.Commit(before)); // a concurrent new write must not be discarded
    assert(p.Snapshot().copies.size()==8);
    auto next=p.Snapshot();
    assert(p.Commit(next));
    assert(p.Snapshot().status==LayerPlanStatus::NoChanges);
    p.Invalidate();
    assert(p.Snapshot().status==LayerPlanStatus::FullUpload);
    assert(!p.Commit(next));
}
static void Edge() {
    const auto max=(std::numeric_limits<std::uint64_t>::max)();
    assert(!AstcDirtyLayerPlanner(max-64,128,32,4,0,64).Valid()); // GPU base+size overflow
    assert(!AstcDirtyLayerPlanner(0,1024,0,4,0,512).Valid());
    assert(!AstcDirtyLayerPlanner(0,1024,128,4,128,512).Valid());
    assert(!AstcDirtyLayerPlanner(0,1024,128,4,0,120).Valid());
    assert(!AstcDirtyLayerPlanner(0,1024,128,0,0,512).Valid());
    assert(!AstcDirtyLayerPlanner(0,1024,128,4097,0,512).Valid());
    // high address: a write wrapping UINT64_MAX clamps at its last valid byte.
    AstcDirtyLayerPlanner p(max-1024,1024,256,4,32,256);
    assert(p.Valid() && p.ResetAfterFullUpload());
    assert(p.MarkWrite(max-100,200)); // clamped, last layer only
    auto q=p.Snapshot();
    assert(q.status==LayerPlanStatus::Partial);
    assert(q.copies.size()==1 && q.copies[0].layer==3);
    assert(p.MarkWrite(max-500,800)); // clamped to end of valid image
}
static void Randomized() {
    std::mt19937_64 rng(0xA57C2247U);
    for (unsigned round=0;round<1600;++round) {
        const std::uint32_t n=2+(rng()%127);
        const std::uint64_t stride=4096*(1+(rng()%31));
        const std::uint64_t base=0x200000;
        AstcDirtyLayerPlanner p(base,stride*n,stride,n,0,stride*3);
        assert(p.Valid() && p.ResetAfterFullUpload());
        std::vector<bool> dirty(n,false);
        for(unsigned op=0;op<25;++op){
            const auto first=static_cast<std::uint32_t>(rng()%n);
            const auto last=static_cast<std::uint32_t>(first+(rng()%(n-first)));
            const auto start=base+first*stride+1;
            const auto length=(last-first)*stride+8;
            assert(p.MarkWrite(start,length));
            const auto begin=first;
            const auto end=static_cast<std::uint32_t>((start-base+length-1)/stride);
            for(auto k=begin;k<=end;++k)dirty[k]=true;
        }
        auto q=p.Snapshot();
        std::size_t expected=0;
        for(bool v:dirty)expected+=v;
        if(expected==n)assert(q.status==LayerPlanStatus::FullUpload);
        else {
            assert(q.status==LayerPlanStatus::Partial);
            assert(q.copies.size()==expected);
            for(const auto& c:q.copies){
                assert(c.layer<n && dirty[c.layer]);
                assert(c.guest_offset==static_cast<std::uint64_t>(c.layer)*stride);
                assert(c.staging_offset+c.bytes<=q.batch_bytes[c.batch]);
                assert(q.batch_bytes[c.batch]<=stride*3);
            }
            assert(p.Commit(q));
            assert(p.Snapshot().status==LayerPlanStatus::NoChanges);
        }
    }
}
int main(){Basic();Edge();Randomized();std::puts("N55_ASTC_LAYER_UPLOAD_PLAN_PASS");}
```

`tools/ns2/test_egl_astc_staging_bridge.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#include <algorithm>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <limits>
#include <span>
#include <vector>
#include "video_core/texture_cache/ns2_astc_staging_bridge.h"

using namespace Eden::NS2::Eglantine;
constexpr std::uint64_t BASE=0x100000, STRIDE=21ULL<<20;
static AstcDirtyLayerPlanner Planner() {
    AstcDirtyLayerPlanner p(BASE, STRIDE*68, STRIDE, 68, 0, 64ULL<<20);
    assert(p.Valid() && p.ResetAfterFullUpload());
    for (auto i:{0U,1U,2U,20U,42U,65U,66U})
        assert(p.MarkWrite(BASE+i*STRIDE+123,16));
    return p;
}
static void Success() {
    auto p=Planner();
    std::uint32_t opened=0, decoded=0;
    std::uint64_t read_bytes=0;
    std::vector<std::uint32_t> uploaded;
    auto result=UploadAstcDirtyLayerBatches(p,BASE,
        [&](std::uint32_t batch,std::uint64_t bytes) {
            assert(batch==opened++);
            assert(bytes<=64ULL<<20 && bytes>0);
            return true;
        },
        [&](std::uint64_t address,std::uint64_t staging,std::uint64_t n) {
            assert(address>=BASE && address<BASE+STRIDE*68);
            assert(staging<64ULL<<20 && n==STRIDE);
            read_bytes+=n;return true;
        },
        [&](std::uint32_t batch,std::span<const std::uint32_t> layers) {
            assert(batch==decoded++);
            assert(layers.size()<=3);
            uploaded.insert(uploaded.end(),layers.begin(),layers.end());
            return true;
        });
    assert(result.status==AstcTransferStatus::Completed);
    assert(result.dispatched_batches==3 && opened==3 && decoded==3);
    assert(result.uploaded_bytes==7*STRIDE && read_bytes==7*STRIDE);
    assert((uploaded==std::vector<std::uint32_t>{0,1,2,20,42,65,66}));
    assert(p.Snapshot().status==LayerPlanStatus::NoChanges);
}
static void Failures() {
    for (int failing=0;failing<3;++failing) {
        auto p=Planner();
        int events=0;
        auto x=UploadAstcDirtyLayerBatches(p,BASE,
            [&](std::uint32_t,std::uint64_t) {++events;return failing!=0;},
            [&](std::uint64_t,std::uint64_t,std::uint64_t) {++events;return failing!=1;},
            [&](std::uint32_t,std::span<const std::uint32_t>) {++events;return failing!=2;});
        assert(x.status==(failing==0?AstcTransferStatus::StagingFailure:
                          failing==1?AstcTransferStatus::ReadFailure:
                          AstcTransferStatus::DispatchFailure));
        assert(p.Snapshot().status==LayerPlanStatus::FullUpload && events>0);
    }
    auto p=Planner();
    auto race=UploadAstcDirtyLayerBatches(p,BASE,
        [&](std::uint32_t,std::uint64_t) {return true;},
        [&](std::uint64_t,std::uint64_t,std::uint64_t) {return true;},
        [&](std::uint32_t,std::span<const std::uint32_t>) {
            assert(p.MarkWrite(BASE+33*STRIDE,16));
            return true;
        });
    assert(race.status==AstcTransferStatus::ConcurrentWrite);
    assert(p.Snapshot().status==LayerPlanStatus::Partial);
    AstcDirtyLayerPlanner overflow(BASE,STRIDE*68,STRIDE,68,0,64ULL<<20);
    assert(overflow.Valid() && overflow.ResetAfterFullUpload());
    assert(overflow.MarkWrite(BASE+2*STRIDE,64));
    auto result=UploadAstcDirtyLayerBatches(overflow,
        (std::numeric_limits<std::uint64_t>::max)()-100,
        [&](std::uint32_t,std::uint64_t) {return true;},
        [&](std::uint64_t,std::uint64_t,std::uint64_t) {assert(false);return true;},
        [&](std::uint32_t,std::span<const std::uint32_t>) {assert(false);return true;});
    assert(result.status==AstcTransferStatus::InvalidPlan);
    assert(overflow.Snapshot().status==LayerPlanStatus::FullUpload);
}
static void NoWork() {
    auto p=Planner();
    p.Invalidate();
    auto x=UploadAstcDirtyLayerBatches(p,BASE,
        [](auto,auto){assert(false);return true;},
        [](auto,auto,auto){assert(false);return true;},
        [](auto,std::span<const std::uint32_t>){assert(false);return true;});
    assert(x.status==AstcTransferStatus::FullUploadRequired);
    assert(p.ResetAfterFullUpload());
    x=UploadAstcDirtyLayerBatches(p,BASE,
        [](auto,auto){assert(false);return true;},
        [](auto,auto,auto){assert(false);return true;},
        [](auto,std::span<const std::uint32_t>){assert(false);return true;});
    assert(x.status==AstcTransferStatus::NoChanges);
}
int main(){Success();Failures();NoWork();std::puts("N59_BOUNDED_ASTC_UPLOAD_TRANSACTION_PASS");}
```

`tools/ns2/test_egl_continuity.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <vector>
#include "core/ns2_egl_continuity_guard.h"
static void Test(std::vector<std::uint32_t>& runs,std::size_t cut) {
    using Eden::NS2::GpuMemory::CutContinuityAt;
    CutContinuityAt(cut,
        [&](std::size_t i) { return runs.at(i); },
        [&](std::size_t i, std::uint32_t n) { runs.at(i)=n; });
}
static void Check(bool condition) { if (!condition) std::abort(); }
int main() {
    std::vector<std::uint32_t> runs{7,6,5,4,3,2,1,0};
    Test(runs,3);
    Check((runs==std::vector<std::uint32_t>{2,1,0,4,3,2,1,0}));
    // Map/Unmap also clears the changed pages, as already implemented by PS5.
    runs[3]=runs[4]=0;
    Check((runs==std::vector<std::uint32_t>{2,1,0,0,0,2,1,0}));
    // Existing runs stopping before the changed range stay untouched.
    runs={2,1,0,0,0,0,0,0};
    Test(runs,6);
    Check((runs==std::vector<std::uint32_t>{2,1,0,0,0,0,0,0}));
    runs={7,6,5,4,3,2,1,0};
    Test(runs,0);
    Check(runs[0]==7 && runs[1]==6);
    Test(runs,8);
    Check((runs==std::vector<std::uint32_t>{7,6,5,4,3,2,1,0}));
    // Deterministic stress: all prefixes of long, 16-bit-count runs.
    for (std::size_t length=1;length<512;++length) {
        std::vector<std::uint32_t> original(length);
        for (std::size_t i=0;i<length;++i)
            original[i]=static_cast<std::uint32_t>(length-1-i);
        for (std::size_t cut=0;cut<=length;++cut) {
            auto copy=original;
            Test(copy,cut);
            for (std::size_t i=0;i<length;++i) {
                const auto expected=i<cut
                    ? static_cast<std::uint32_t>(cut-1-i)
                    : original[i];
                Check(copy[i]==expected);
            }
        }
    }
    std::puts("N50_EGLANTINE_CONTINUITY_CUT_PASS host=1 stress_prefixes=131328");
}
```

`tools/ns2/test_egl_gpu_range_batch.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <limits>
#include <random>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>
#include "video_core/ns2_egl_gpu_range_batch.h"
using Run=std::pair<std::uint64_t,std::uint64_t>;
using Eden::NS2::GpuMemory::ChangedPageRuns;
static void Check(const std::vector<bool>& dirty, std::uint64_t base, std::uint64_t page) {
    ChangedPageRuns batching(page);
    std::vector<Run> expected,actual;
    auto notify=[&](std::uint64_t a,std::uint64_t n){actual.emplace_back(a,n);};
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<dirty.size();++i) {
        auto addr=base+i*page;
        if(dirty[i]) {
            if(!expected.empty() && expected.back().first+expected.back().second==addr)
                expected.back().second+=page;
            else expected.emplace_back(addr,page);
        }
        batching.Record(addr,dirty[i],notify);
    }
    batching.Flush(notify);
    batching.Flush(notify);
    assert(expected==actual);
}
int main() {
    for(const auto page:{4096ULL,65536ULL}) {
        Check({},0x100000,page);
        Check({false,true,true,false,true,false},0x100000,page);
        Check({true,false,true,true,false,true},0x100000,page);
        std::mt19937_64 rng(0xE61A51);
        for(int n=0;n<2000;++n){
            std::vector<bool> flags(1+(rng()%900));
            for(std::size_t j=0;j<flags.size();++j)
                flags[j]=(rng()&7)<static_cast<std::uint64_t>(n%9);
            Check(flags,0x100000,page);
        }
    }
    // 1.45 GiB synthetic run: one notification, not 380,108.
    constexpr std::uint64_t pages=380108,base=0x100000,granule=4096;
    ChangedPageRuns b(granule);std::vector<Run> runs;
    auto log=[&](std::uint64_t a,std::uint64_t n){runs.emplace_back(a,n);};
    for(std::uint64_t i=0;i<pages;++i)b.Record(base+i*granule,true,log);
    b.Flush(log);
    assert(runs==(std::vector<Run>{{base,pages*granule}}));
    runs.clear();
    constexpr auto max=(std::numeric_limits<std::uint64_t>::max)();
    ChangedPageRuns edge(4096);
    edge.Record(max-8192,true,log);
    edge.Record(max-4096,false,log);
    edge.Record(max-4095,true,log); // invalid page end; must not notify
    edge.Flush(log);
    assert(runs==(std::vector<Run>{{max-8192,4096}}));
    std::puts("N51_GPU_CHANGED_RUN_ORACLE_PASS");
}
```
