`tools/ns2/test_g07_real_vulkan_texel.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// G07: dispatch the actual native SPIR-V image-buffer/SSBO shader on host Vulkan.
// This is a real GPU-backed proof, not a PS5 guest frame or TIC/TSC binding.
#include <vulkan/vulkan.h>
#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/native_qmd_compute_environment.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <fstream>
#include <vector>

static void Check(bool ok, const char* message) {
    if (!ok) { std::fprintf(stderr, "G07 Vulkan: %s\n", message); std::exit(1); }
}
static std::vector<uint32_t> ReadWords(const char* filename) {
    std::ifstream f{filename, std::ios::binary | std::ios::ate};
    Check(bool(f), "missing native SPIR-V");
    const auto n = f.tellg();
    Check(n >= static_cast<std::streamoff>(20) &&
          n <= static_cast<std::streamoff>(1024 * 1024) &&
          static_cast<std::streamoff>(n) % 4 == 0, "invalid SPIR-V size");
    std::vector<uint32_t> words(static_cast<std::size_t>(n) / 4);
    f.seekg(0);
    f.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(words.data()), n);
    Check(bool(f) && words[0] == 0x07230203U, "invalid SPIR-V magic");
    unsigned fetches{}, writes{};
    for (std::size_t i = 5; i < words.size();) {
        const auto count = words[i] >> 16;
        Check(count && count <= words.size() - i, "invalid SPIR-V instruction");
        fetches += (words[i] & 0xffffU) == 95U; // OpImageFetch
        writes += (words[i] & 0xffffU) == 62U; // OpStore
        i += count;
    }
    Check(fetches == 3 && writes >= 3, "emitter omitted sampled 2D image read/write");
    return words;
}
static uint32_t Bits(float value) {
    uint32_t bits{};
    static_assert(sizeof bits == sizeof value);
    std::memcpy(&bits, &value, sizeof(bits));
    return bits;
}
int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    Check(argc == 2, "expected native image-buffer SPIR-V");
    const auto spirv = ReadWords(argv[1]);
    VkApplicationInfo app{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_APPLICATION_INFO};
    app.apiVersion = VK_API_VERSION_1_2;
    VkInstanceCreateInfo ici{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_INSTANCE_CREATE_INFO};
    ici.pApplicationInfo = &app;
    VkInstance instance = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    Check(vkCreateInstance(&ici, nullptr, &instance) == VK_SUCCESS, "instance");
    uint32_t count{};
    Check(vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices(instance, &count, nullptr) == VK_SUCCESS && count,
          "no host Vulkan device");
    std::vector<VkPhysicalDevice> physical(count);
    Check(vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices(instance, &count, physical.data()) == VK_SUCCESS,
          "enumerate devices");
    VkPhysicalDevice gpu = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    uint32_t family{};
    for (auto candidate : physical) {
        VkFormatProperties props{};
        vkGetPhysicalDeviceFormatProperties(candidate, VK_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_SFLOAT, &props);
        if (!(props.bufferFeatures & VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_UNIFORM_TEXEL_BUFFER_BIT) ||
            !(props.optimalTilingFeatures & VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_SAMPLED_IMAGE_BIT)) continue;
        uint32_t families{};
        vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties(candidate, &families, nullptr);
        std::vector<VkQueueFamilyProperties> available(families);
        vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties(candidate, &families, available.data());
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < families; ++i) {
            if (available[i].queueCount && (available[i].queueFlags & VK_QUEUE_COMPUTE_BIT)) {
                gpu = candidate;
                family = i;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (gpu) break;
    }
    Check(gpu != VK_NULL_HANDLE, "no compute queue with float4 texel buffer support");
    const float priority = 1.f;
    VkDeviceQueueCreateInfo qci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_QUEUE_CREATE_INFO};
    qci.queueFamilyIndex = family;
    qci.queueCount = 1;
    qci.pQueuePriorities = &priority;
    // The emitted G01/G07 SPIR-V now contains the genuine non-uniform
    // texel-array capability. Vulkan requires that feature to be queried
    // AND enabled on the very device executing vkCmdDispatch. A successful
    // SPIR-V validation cannot substitute for this live device contract.
    VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan12Features supported12{
        VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VULKAN_1_2_FEATURES};
    VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures2 supported{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_FEATURES_2};
    supported.pNext = &supported12;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceFeatures2(gpu, &supported);
    Check(supported12.shaderUniformTexelBufferArrayNonUniformIndexing == VK_TRUE,
          "Vulkan GPU lacks uniform texel-buffer array non-uniform indexing");
    VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan12Features enabled12{
        VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VULKAN_1_2_FEATURES};
    enabled12.shaderUniformTexelBufferArrayNonUniformIndexing = VK_TRUE;
    VkDeviceCreateInfo dci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_CREATE_INFO};
    dci.queueCreateInfoCount = 1;
    dci.pQueueCreateInfos = &qci;
    dci.pNext = &enabled12;
    VkDevice device = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    Check(vkCreateDevice(gpu, &dci, nullptr, &device) == VK_SUCCESS, "device");
    VkQueue queue = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    vkGetDeviceQueue(device, family, 0, &queue);

    std::array<VkDescriptorSetLayoutBinding, 3> bindings{};
    bindings[0].binding = 0;
    bindings[0].descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER;
    bindings[0].descriptorCount = 1;
    bindings[0].stageFlags = VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT;
    bindings[1].binding = 1;
    bindings[1].descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_UNIFORM_TEXEL_BUFFER;
    bindings[1].descriptorCount = 2;
    bindings[1].stageFlags = VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT;
    bindings[2].binding = 2;
    bindings[2].descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER;
    bindings[2].descriptorCount = 1;
    bindings[2].stageFlags = VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT;
    VkDescriptorSetLayoutCreateInfo lci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO};
    lci.bindingCount = static_cast<uint32_t>(bindings.size());
    lci.pBindings = bindings.data();
    VkDescriptorSetLayout set_layout = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    Check(vkCreateDescriptorSetLayout(device, &lci, nullptr, &set_layout) == VK_SUCCESS,
          "set layout");
    VkPipelineLayoutCreateInfo pci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO};
    pci.setLayoutCount = 1;
    pci.pSetLayouts = &set_layout;
    VkPipelineLayout layout = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    Check(vkCreatePipelineLayout(device, &pci, nullptr, &layout) == VK_SUCCESS,
          "pipeline layout");
    VkShaderModuleCreateInfo sci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SHADER_MODULE_CREATE_INFO};
    sci.codeSize = spirv.size() * sizeof(uint32_t);
    sci.pCode = spirv.data();
    VkShaderModule module = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    Check(vkCreateShaderModule(device, &sci, nullptr, &module) == VK_SUCCESS,
          "real native image shader module");
    VkComputePipelineCreateInfo cpci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMPUTE_PIPELINE_CREATE_INFO};
    cpci.stage.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_SHADER_STAGE_CREATE_INFO;
    cpci.stage.stage = VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT;
    cpci.stage.module = module;
    cpci.stage.pName = "main";
    cpci.layout = layout;
    VkPipeline pipeline = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    Check(vkCreateComputePipelines(device, VK_NULL_HANDLE, 1, &cpci, nullptr, &pipeline)
          == VK_SUCCESS, "real native image pipeline");

    VkBufferCreateInfo bci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO};
    bci.size = 4096;
    bci.usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_STORAGE_BUFFER_BIT |
                VK_BUFFER_USAGE_UNIFORM_TEXEL_BUFFER_BIT |
                VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT;
    bci.sharingMode = VK_SHARING_MODE_EXCLUSIVE;
    VkBuffer buffer = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    Check(vkCreateBuffer(device, &bci, nullptr, &buffer) == VK_SUCCESS, "data buffer");
    VkMemoryRequirements req{};
    vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements(device, buffer, &req);
    VkPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties memory_props{};
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties(gpu, &memory_props);
    uint32_t memory_type = memory_props.memoryTypeCount;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < memory_props.memoryTypeCount; ++i) {
        const auto flags = memory_props.memoryTypes[i].propertyFlags;
        if ((req.memoryTypeBits & (1U << i)) &&
            (flags & (VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT |
                      VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT)) ==
                (VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT | VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT)) {
            memory_type = i;
            break;
        }
    }
    Check(memory_type < memory_props.memoryTypeCount, "no coherent memory");
    VkMemoryAllocateInfo allocation{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO};
    allocation.allocationSize = req.size;
    allocation.memoryTypeIndex = memory_type;
    VkDeviceMemory memory = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    Check(vkAllocateMemory(device, &allocation, nullptr, &memory) == VK_SUCCESS,
          "allocate memory");
    Check(vkBindBufferMemory(device, buffer, memory, 0) == VK_SUCCESS, "bind data");
    void* mapped = nullptr;
    Check(vkMapMemory(device, memory, 0, 4096, 0, &mapped) == VK_SUCCESS,
          "map data");
    auto* data = static_cast<uint32_t*>(mapped);
    std::fill_n(data, 1024, 0U);
    data[(256 + 4 * 16) / 4] = Bits(1.25f);
    data[(512 + 8 * 16) / 4] = Bits(7.5f);
    data[(256 + 8 * 16) / 4] = Bits(4.75f);
    data[3] = 1; // Guest-controlled descriptor array index read at runtime
    // 2x2 RGBA32F sampled image staging. Pixel (1,0) has red=2.5.
    data[(1024 + 16) / 4] = Bits(2.5f);

    VkImageCreateInfo image_create{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_CREATE_INFO};
    image_create.imageType = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D;
    image_create.format = VK_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_SFLOAT;
    image_create.extent = {2, 2, 1};
    image_create.mipLevels = 1;
    image_create.arrayLayers = 1;
    image_create.samples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;
    image_create.tiling = VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL;
    image_create.usage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT;
    image_create.sharingMode = VK_SHARING_MODE_EXCLUSIVE;
    image_create.initialLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;
    VkImage sampled_image = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    Check(vkCreateImage(device, &image_create, nullptr, &sampled_image) == VK_SUCCESS,
          "sampled TIC image");
    VkMemoryRequirements image_req{};
    vkGetImageMemoryRequirements(device, sampled_image, &image_req);
    uint32_t image_type = memory_props.memoryTypeCount;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < memory_props.memoryTypeCount; ++i)
        if (image_req.memoryTypeBits & (1U << i)) {
            image_type = i;
            if (memory_props.memoryTypes[i].propertyFlags &
                VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_DEVICE_LOCAL_BIT) break;
        }
    Check(image_type < memory_props.memoryTypeCount, "sampled image memory type");
    VkMemoryAllocateInfo image_alloc{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO};
    image_alloc.allocationSize = image_req.size;
    image_alloc.memoryTypeIndex = image_type;
    VkDeviceMemory image_memory = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    Check(vkAllocateMemory(device, &image_alloc, nullptr, &image_memory) == VK_SUCCESS,
          "sampled image allocation");
    Check(vkBindImageMemory(device, sampled_image, image_memory, 0) == VK_SUCCESS,
          "sampled image bind");
    VkImageViewCreateInfo ivci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_VIEW_CREATE_INFO};
    ivci.image = sampled_image;
    ivci.viewType = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D;
    ivci.format = VK_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_SFLOAT;
    ivci.subresourceRange.aspectMask = VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT;
    ivci.subresourceRange.levelCount = 1;
    ivci.subresourceRange.layerCount = 1;
    VkImageView image_view = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    Check(vkCreateImageView(device, &ivci, nullptr, &image_view) == VK_SUCCESS,
          "TIC sampled image view");
    VkSamplerCreateInfo sampler_ci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SAMPLER_CREATE_INFO};
    sampler_ci.magFilter = VK_FILTER_NEAREST;
    sampler_ci.minFilter = VK_FILTER_NEAREST;
    sampler_ci.mipmapMode = VK_SAMPLER_MIPMAP_MODE_NEAREST;
    sampler_ci.addressModeU = VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP_TO_EDGE;
    sampler_ci.addressModeV = VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP_TO_EDGE;
    sampler_ci.addressModeW = VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP_TO_EDGE;
    VkSampler sampler = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    Check(vkCreateSampler(device, &sampler_ci, nullptr, &sampler) == VK_SUCCESS,
          "TSC sampler");

    std::array<VkBufferView, 2> views{};
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
        VkBufferViewCreateInfo bvi{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_VIEW_CREATE_INFO};
        bvi.buffer = buffer;
        bvi.format = VK_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_SFLOAT;
        bvi.offset = 256 + i * 256;
        bvi.range = 256;
        Check(vkCreateBufferView(device, &bvi, nullptr, &views[i]) == VK_SUCCESS,
              "texel view");
    }
    std::array<VkDescriptorPoolSize, 3> sizes{{
        {VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER, 1},
        {VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_UNIFORM_TEXEL_BUFFER, 2},
        {VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER, 1}
    }};
    VkDescriptorPoolCreateInfo dpci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_POOL_CREATE_INFO};
    dpci.maxSets = 1;
    dpci.poolSizeCount = 3;
    dpci.pPoolSizes = sizes.data();
    VkDescriptorPool pool = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    Check(vkCreateDescriptorPool(device, &dpci, nullptr, &pool) == VK_SUCCESS,
          "descriptor pool");
    VkDescriptorSetAllocateInfo sai{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_ALLOCATE_INFO};
    sai.descriptorPool = pool;
    sai.descriptorSetCount = 1;
    sai.pSetLayouts = &set_layout;
    VkDescriptorSet set = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    Check(vkAllocateDescriptorSets(device, &sai, &set) == VK_SUCCESS,
          "allocate set");
    // Exercise the production QMD3 descriptor transaction BEFORE the
    // actual Vulkan descriptor update and vkCmdDispatch. These are the
    // maintained NativeQmdResourcePlan staging callbacks, not a duplicate
    // host-side buffer indexing algorithm.
    Shader::Ampere::NativeQmdResourcePlan native_qmd{};
    native_qmd.requires_tic_tsc = true;
    native_qmd.storage_buffers.push_back({0x10000U, 64U, true, true});
    VkDescriptorBufferInfo storage{};
    unsigned bound_count{}, rollback_count{};
    const auto qmd_mapped = [](std::uint64_t va, std::uint32_t bytes) {
        return va == 0x10000U && bytes == 64U;
    };
    const auto missing_map = [](std::uint64_t, std::uint32_t) {
        return false;
    };
    const auto unused_uniform = [](std::uint32_t, std::uint32_t,
                                   std::uint64_t, std::uint32_t) {
        return false;
    };
    const auto bind_storage = [&](std::uint32_t index, std::uint64_t va,
                                  std::uint32_t bytes, bool writable) {
        Check(index == 0 && va == 0x10000U && bytes == 64U && writable,
              "QMD3 SSBO descriptor order/rights");
        storage.buffer = buffer;
        storage.offset = 0;
        storage.range = bytes;
        ++bound_count;
        return true;
    };
    const auto rollback = [&] {
        ++rollback_count;
        storage = {};
    };
    Check(!native_qmd.StageVulkanBufferBindings(
              qmd_mapped, unused_uniform, bind_storage, rollback),
          "image-mode QMD3 staged without pinned image descriptors");
    Check(bound_count == 0 && rollback_count == 0,
          "unapproved image binding side effect");
    Check(!native_qmd.StageVulkanBufferBindings(
              missing_map, unused_uniform, bind_storage, rollback, true),
          "missing GMMU backing staged into Vulkan");
    Check(bound_count == 0 && rollback_count == 0,
          "unmapped buffer published a descriptor");
    native_qmd.storage_buffers[0].known_size = false;
    Check(!native_qmd.StageVulkanBufferBindings(
              qmd_mapped, unused_uniform, bind_storage, rollback, true),
          "unknown-size QMD3 storage accepted");
    native_qmd.storage_buffers[0].known_size = true;
    const auto refuse_storage = [](std::uint32_t, std::uint64_t,
                                   std::uint32_t, bool) {
        return false;
    };
    Check(!native_qmd.StageVulkanBufferBindings(
              qmd_mapped, unused_uniform, refuse_storage, rollback, true),
          "missing Vulkan SSBO handle staged");
    Check(rollback_count == 1 && storage.buffer == VK_NULL_HANDLE,
          "failed storage bind did not roll back exactly once");
    Check(native_qmd.StageVulkanBufferBindings(
              qmd_mapped, unused_uniform, bind_storage, rollback, true),
          "real QMD3 image-mode SSBO staging");
    Check(bound_count == 1 && storage.buffer == buffer &&
              storage.range == 64 && rollback_count == 1,
          "QMD3 staging did not reach the Vulkan descriptor");

    std::array<VkWriteDescriptorSet, 3> writes{};
    for (auto& write : writes) {
        write.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_WRITE_DESCRIPTOR_SET;
        write.dstSet = set;
    }
    writes[0].dstBinding = 0;
    writes[0].descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER;
    writes[0].descriptorCount = 1;
    writes[0].pBufferInfo = &storage;
    writes[1].dstBinding = 1;
    writes[1].descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_UNIFORM_TEXEL_BUFFER;
    writes[1].descriptorCount = 2;
    writes[1].pTexelBufferView = views.data();
    VkDescriptorImageInfo sampled_info{};
    sampled_info.sampler = sampler;
    sampled_info.imageView = image_view;
    sampled_info.imageLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL;
    writes[2].dstBinding = 2;
    writes[2].descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER;
    writes[2].descriptorCount = 1;
    writes[2].pImageInfo = &sampled_info;
    vkUpdateDescriptorSets(device, 3, writes.data(), 0, nullptr);

    VkCommandPoolCreateInfo cmd_pool_info{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_POOL_CREATE_INFO};
    cmd_pool_info.queueFamilyIndex = family;
    cmd_pool_info.flags = VK_COMMAND_POOL_CREATE_RESET_COMMAND_BUFFER_BIT;
    VkCommandPool command_pool = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    Check(vkCreateCommandPool(device, &cmd_pool_info, nullptr, &command_pool)
          == VK_SUCCESS, "command pool");
    VkCommandBufferAllocateInfo cai{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_ALLOCATE_INFO};
    cai.commandPool = command_pool;
    cai.level = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_LEVEL_PRIMARY;
    cai.commandBufferCount = 1;
    VkCommandBuffer command = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    Check(vkAllocateCommandBuffers(device, &cai, &command) == VK_SUCCESS,
          "command buffer");
    VkCommandBufferBeginInfo begin{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_BEGIN_INFO};
    Check(vkBeginCommandBuffer(command, &begin) == VK_SUCCESS, "begin command");
    VkImageMemoryBarrier image_barrier{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER};
    image_barrier.image = sampled_image;
    image_barrier.srcQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
    image_barrier.dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
    image_barrier.subresourceRange.aspectMask = VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT;
    image_barrier.subresourceRange.levelCount = 1;
    image_barrier.subresourceRange.layerCount = 1;
    image_barrier.oldLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;
    image_barrier.newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL;
    image_barrier.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT;
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier(command, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TOP_OF_PIPE_BIT,
        VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, 0, 0, nullptr, 0, nullptr, 1, &image_barrier);
    VkBufferImageCopy image_copy{};
    image_copy.bufferOffset = 1024;
    image_copy.imageSubresource.aspectMask = VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT;
    image_copy.imageSubresource.layerCount = 1;
    image_copy.imageExtent = {2,2,1};
    vkCmdCopyBufferToImage(command, buffer, sampled_image,
                           VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, 1, &image_copy);
    image_barrier.oldLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL;
    image_barrier.newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL;
    image_barrier.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT;
    image_barrier.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT;
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier(command, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT,
        VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COMPUTE_SHADER_BIT, 0, 0, nullptr, 0, nullptr,
        1, &image_barrier);
    vkCmdBindPipeline(command, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_COMPUTE, pipeline);
    vkCmdBindDescriptorSets(command, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_COMPUTE, layout,
                            0, 1, &set, 0, nullptr);
    vkCmdDispatch(command, 1, 1, 1);
    VkMemoryBarrier barrier{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_BARRIER};
    barrier.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_SHADER_WRITE_BIT;
    barrier.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_HOST_READ_BIT;
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier(command, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COMPUTE_SHADER_BIT,
                         VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_HOST_BIT, 0, 1, &barrier,
                         0, nullptr, 0, nullptr);
    Check(vkEndCommandBuffer(command) == VK_SUCCESS, "end command");
    VkFenceCreateInfo fci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_FENCE_CREATE_INFO};
    VkFence fence = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    Check(vkCreateFence(device, &fci, nullptr, &fence) == VK_SUCCESS, "fence");
    VkSubmitInfo submission{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SUBMIT_INFO};
    submission.commandBufferCount = 1;
    submission.pCommandBuffers = &command;
    Check(vkQueueSubmit(queue, 1, &submission, fence) == VK_SUCCESS, "submit");
    Check(vkWaitForFences(device, 1, &fence, VK_TRUE, 10000000000ULL)
          == VK_SUCCESS, "fence wait");
    Check(data[0] == Bits(1.25f) && data[1] == Bits(7.5f) &&
          data[2] == Bits(2.5f),
          "wrong GPU TIC/TSC image or texel descriptor selection/SSBO writeback");
    Check(data[3] == 1, "GPU overwrote guest runtime descriptor index");
    for (uint32_t i = 4; i < 16; ++i)
        Check(data[i] == 0, "GPU corrupted another SSBO word");
    Check(data[(256 + 4 * 16) / 4] == Bits(1.25f) &&
          data[(512 + 8 * 16) / 4] == Bits(7.5f) &&
          data[(256 + 8 * 16) / 4] == Bits(4.75f),
          "GPU modified read-only texel data");

    // Same native SPIR-V shader, descriptors and Vulkan pipeline. Only
    // the guest memory index changes from 1 to 0 before a second dispatch.
    data[3] = 0;
    data[1] = 0;
    Check(vkResetFences(device, 1, &fence) == VK_SUCCESS, "reset guest-index fence");
    Check(vkResetCommandBuffer(command, 0) == VK_SUCCESS, "reset guest-index command");
    Check(vkBeginCommandBuffer(command, &begin) == VK_SUCCESS, "begin guest-index dispatch");
    vkCmdBindPipeline(command, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_COMPUTE, pipeline);
    vkCmdBindDescriptorSets(command, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_COMPUTE, layout,
                            0, 1, &set, 0, nullptr);
    vkCmdDispatch(command, 1, 1, 1);
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier(command, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COMPUTE_SHADER_BIT,
                         VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_HOST_BIT, 0, 1, &barrier,
                         0, nullptr, 0, nullptr);
    Check(vkEndCommandBuffer(command) == VK_SUCCESS, "end guest-index command");
    Check(vkQueueSubmit(queue, 1, &submission, fence) == VK_SUCCESS,
          "submit guest-index dispatch");
    Check(vkWaitForFences(device, 1, &fence, VK_TRUE, 10000000000ULL) == VK_SUCCESS,
          "guest-index GPU completion");
    Check(data[0] == Bits(1.25f) && data[1] == Bits(4.75f) &&
          data[2] == Bits(2.5f) && data[3] == 0,
          "runtime index did not select other texel descriptor");
    for (uint32_t i = 4; i < 16; ++i)
        Check(data[i] == 0, "guest-index dispatch damaged other SSBO data");

    vkDeviceWaitIdle(device);
    vkDestroyFence(device, fence, nullptr);
    vkFreeCommandBuffers(device, command_pool, 1, &command);
    vkDestroyCommandPool(device, command_pool, nullptr);
    vkDestroyDescriptorPool(device, pool, nullptr);
    for (auto view : views) vkDestroyBufferView(device, view, nullptr);
    vkDestroySampler(device, sampler, nullptr);
    vkDestroyImageView(device, image_view, nullptr);
    vkDestroyImage(device, sampled_image, nullptr);
    vkFreeMemory(device, image_memory, nullptr);
    vkUnmapMemory(device, memory);
    vkDestroyBuffer(device, buffer, nullptr);
    vkFreeMemory(device, memory, nullptr);
    vkDestroyPipeline(device, pipeline, nullptr);
    vkDestroyShaderModule(device, module, nullptr);
    vkDestroyPipelineLayout(device, layout, nullptr);
    vkDestroyDescriptorSetLayout(device, set_layout, nullptr);
    vkDestroyDevice(device, nullptr);
    vkDestroyInstance(instance, nullptr);
    std::puts("G07_REAL_NATIVE_VULKAN_TIC_TSC_SSBO_PASS texel=2 sampled_2d=1 dispatch=2 fence=2 ssbo_write=3 guest_runtime_index=0,1 qmd_staged=1 missing_mapping=refused missing_storage=refused rollback=once");
}
```

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// G09: actual Vulkan graphics pipeline creation from the reviewed native
// Task/Mesh SPIR-V compiler. A missing host extension is NOT a pass.
#include <vulkan/vulkan.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <fstream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <cstring>
static void Require(bool condition, const char* what) {
    if (!condition) { std::fprintf(stderr, "G09 mesh Vulkan: %s\n", what); std::exit(1); }
}
static std::vector<uint32_t> ReadModule(const char* path) {
    std::ifstream f{path, std::ios::binary | std::ios::ate};
    Require(bool(f), "native SPIR-V output missing");
    const auto n = f.tellg();
    Require(n >= static_cast<std::streamoff>(20) &&
            n <= static_cast<std::streamoff>(1024*1024) &&
            static_cast<std::streamoff>(n) % 4 == 0, "invalid module size");
    std::vector<uint32_t> words(static_cast<size_t>(n)/4);
    f.seekg(0);
    f.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(words.data()), n);
    Require(bool(f) && words[0] == 0x07230203U, "invalid SPIR-V payload");
    return words;
}
int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    Require(argc==3, "expected authentic Task and Mesh SPIR-V");
    const auto task_words=ReadModule(argv[1]);
    const auto mesh_words=ReadModule(argv[2]);
    VkApplicationInfo app{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_APPLICATION_INFO};
    app.apiVersion=VK_API_VERSION_1_2;
    VkInstanceCreateInfo ici{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_INSTANCE_CREATE_INFO};
    ici.pApplicationInfo=&app;
    VkInstance instance=VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    Require(vkCreateInstance(&ici,nullptr,&instance)==VK_SUCCESS,"instance");
    uint32_t count{};
    Require(vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices(instance,&count,nullptr)==VK_SUCCESS && count,
            "physical devices");
    std::vector<VkPhysicalDevice> devices(count);
    Require(vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices(instance,&count,devices.data())==VK_SUCCESS,
            "device enumeration");
    VkPhysicalDevice selected=VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    uint32_t family{};
    for (const auto device:devices) {
        VkPhysicalDeviceProperties props{};
        vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties(device,&props);
        if(props.apiVersion<VK_API_VERSION_1_2)continue;
        uint32_t extensions{};
        if(vkEnumerateDeviceExtensionProperties(device,nullptr,&extensions,nullptr)!=VK_SUCCESS)
            continue;
        std::vector<VkExtensionProperties> list(extensions);
        if(vkEnumerateDeviceExtensionProperties(device,nullptr,&extensions,list.data())!=VK_SUCCESS)
            continue;
        if(std::none_of(list.begin(),list.end(),[](const auto& e) {
            return std::strcmp(e.extensionName,VK_EXT_MESH_SHADER_EXTENSION_NAME)==0;
        }))continue;
        VkPhysicalDeviceMeshShaderFeaturesEXT mesh_features{
            VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_MESH_SHADER_FEATURES_EXT};
        VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures2 features{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_FEATURES_2};
        features.pNext=&mesh_features;
        vkGetPhysicalDeviceFeatures2(device,&features);
        if(!mesh_features.meshShader || !mesh_features.taskShader)continue;
        uint32_t queues{};
        vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties(device,&queues,nullptr);
        std::vector<VkQueueFamilyProperties> families(queues);
        vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties(device,&queues,families.data());
        for(uint32_t i=0;i<queues;++i) {
            if(families[i].queueCount && (families[i].queueFlags&VK_QUEUE_GRAPHICS_BIT)) {
                selected=device;family=i;break;
            }
        }
        if(selected)break;
    }
    if(!selected) {
        std::puts("G09_HOST_MESH_UNAVAILABLE real_pipeline=NOT_VALIDATED extension=VK_EXT_mesh_shader");
        vkDestroyInstance(instance,nullptr);
        return 0;
    }
    VkPhysicalDeviceProperties props{};
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties(selected,&props);
    std::printf("G09_VULKAN_MESH_DEVICE %s\n",props.deviceName);
    float priority=1.0f;
    VkDeviceQueueCreateInfo qci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_QUEUE_CREATE_INFO};
    qci.queueFamilyIndex=family;
    qci.queueCount=1;
    qci.pQueuePriorities=&priority;
    VkPhysicalDeviceMeshShaderFeaturesEXT enabled{
        VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_MESH_SHADER_FEATURES_EXT};
    enabled.meshShader=VK_TRUE;
    enabled.taskShader=VK_TRUE;
    const char* extensions[]={VK_EXT_MESH_SHADER_EXTENSION_NAME};
    VkDeviceCreateInfo dci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_CREATE_INFO};
    dci.pNext=&enabled;
    dci.queueCreateInfoCount=1;
    dci.pQueueCreateInfos=&qci;
    dci.enabledExtensionCount=1;
    dci.ppEnabledExtensionNames=extensions;
    VkDevice device=VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    Require(vkCreateDevice(selected,&dci,nullptr,&device)==VK_SUCCESS,
            "task/mesh device creation");
    auto shader=[&](const std::vector<uint32_t>& words) {
        VkShaderModuleCreateInfo sci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SHADER_MODULE_CREATE_INFO};
        sci.codeSize=words.size()*sizeof(uint32_t);
        sci.pCode=words.data();
        VkShaderModule module=VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        Require(vkCreateShaderModule(device,&sci,nullptr,&module)==VK_SUCCESS,
                "native Task/Mesh shader module");
        return module;
    };
    const VkShaderModule task=shader(task_words);
    const VkShaderModule mesh=shader(mesh_words);
    VkPipelineLayoutCreateInfo lci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO};
    VkPipelineLayout layout=VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    Require(vkCreatePipelineLayout(device,&lci,nullptr,&layout)==VK_SUCCESS,
            "mesh pipeline layout");
    VkSubpassDescription subpass{};
    subpass.pipelineBindPoint=VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS;
    VkRenderPassCreateInfo rpci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_RENDER_PASS_CREATE_INFO};
    rpci.subpassCount=1;
    rpci.pSubpasses=&subpass;
    VkRenderPass pass=VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    Require(vkCreateRenderPass(device,&rpci,nullptr,&pass)==VK_SUCCESS,
            "mesh render pass");
    VkPipelineShaderStageCreateInfo stages[2]{};
    stages[0].sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_SHADER_STAGE_CREATE_INFO;
    stages[0].stage=VK_SHADER_STAGE_TASK_BIT_EXT;
    stages[0].module=task;
    stages[0].pName="main";
    stages[1].sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_SHADER_STAGE_CREATE_INFO;
    stages[1].stage=VK_SHADER_STAGE_MESH_BIT_EXT;
    stages[1].module=mesh;
    stages[1].pName="main";
    VkViewport viewport{};
    viewport.width=1.0f;viewport.height=1.0f;viewport.maxDepth=1.0f;
    VkRect2D scissor{};
    scissor.extent.width=1;scissor.extent.height=1;
    VkPipelineViewportStateCreateInfo vp{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_VIEWPORT_STATE_CREATE_INFO};
    vp.viewportCount=1;vp.pViewports=&viewport;
    vp.scissorCount=1;vp.pScissors=&scissor;
    VkPipelineRasterizationStateCreateInfo raster{
        VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_RASTERIZATION_STATE_CREATE_INFO};
    raster.rasterizerDiscardEnable=VK_TRUE;
    raster.polygonMode=VK_POLYGON_MODE_FILL;
    raster.cullMode=VK_CULL_MODE_NONE;
    raster.frontFace=VK_FRONT_FACE_COUNTER_CLOCKWISE;
    raster.lineWidth=1.0f;
    VkPipelineMultisampleStateCreateInfo ms{
        VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_MULTISAMPLE_STATE_CREATE_INFO};
    ms.rasterizationSamples=VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;
    VkPipelineColorBlendStateCreateInfo blend{
        VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_COLOR_BLEND_STATE_CREATE_INFO};
    for (unsigned variant=0;variant<2;++variant) {
        VkGraphicsPipelineCreateInfo gpci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_GRAPHICS_PIPELINE_CREATE_INFO};
        gpci.stageCount=variant==0?1:2;
        gpci.pStages=variant==0?&stages[1]:stages;
        gpci.pViewportState=&vp;
        gpci.pRasterizationState=&raster;
        gpci.pMultisampleState=&ms;
        gpci.pColorBlendState=&blend;
        gpci.layout=layout;
        gpci.renderPass=pass;
        VkPipeline pipeline=VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        const auto result=vkCreateGraphicsPipelines(
            device,VK_NULL_HANDLE,1,&gpci,nullptr,&pipeline);
        if(result!=VK_SUCCESS)std::fprintf(stderr,
            "G09 real pipeline variant=%u VkResult=%d\n",variant,int(result));
        Require(result==VK_SUCCESS && pipeline!=VK_NULL_HANDLE,
                "host rejected native Mesh/Task pipeline");
        vkDestroyPipeline(device,pipeline,nullptr);
    }
    vkDestroyRenderPass(device,pass,nullptr);
    vkDestroyPipelineLayout(device,layout,nullptr);
    vkDestroyShaderModule(device,mesh,nullptr);
    vkDestroyShaderModule(device,task,nullptr);
    vkDestroyDevice(device,nullptr);
    vkDestroyInstance(instance,nullptr);
    std::puts("G09_REAL_NATIVE_VULKAN_MESH_PIPELINES_PASS mesh_only=1 task_mesh=1");
}
```

`tools/ns2/test_gpu_worker_staged_ledger.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Real native 211/214 mapping ledger: allocations BEFORE a guest GMMU commit.
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <new>
#include "core/hle/service/am/service/gpu_worker_protocol.h"

static int fail_new{};
void* operator new(std::size_t n) {
    if (fail_new && --fail_new == 0) throw std::bad_alloc{};
    if (void* p = std::malloc(n)) return p;
    throw std::bad_alloc{};
}
// The test deliberately replaces global new/delete to inject allocator
// failures. Keep BOTH deletion operators as opaque ABI boundaries. GCC 13
// otherwise performs interprocedural malloc/free analysis and reports the
// intended pairing as -Wmismatched-new-delete under the CI -Werror policy.
#if defined(__GNUC__) && !defined(__clang__)
#define EDEN_TEST_ALLOCATOR_ABI __attribute__((noipa))
#else
#define EDEN_TEST_ALLOCATOR_ABI [[gnu::noinline]]
#endif
EDEN_TEST_ALLOCATOR_ABI void operator delete(void* ptr) noexcept { std::free(ptr); }
EDEN_TEST_ALLOCATOR_ABI void operator delete(void* ptr,std::size_t) noexcept { std::free(ptr); }
#undef EDEN_TEST_ALLOCATOR_ABI

namespace GW = Service::AM::GpuWorkerProtocol;
int main() {
    GW::MappingLedger ledger;
    const GW::Map4K map{9, 7, 2, 0, 0x4000, 0x2000, 0, 1, 1, 0, 0};
    using Status = GW::LedgerStatus;
    using Pending = GW::MappingLedger::Pending;
    assert(ledger.CanMap(map) == Status::Success);
    {
        Pending stage;
        fail_new=1;
        assert(ledger.PrepareMapped(map,stage)==Status::OutOfResource);
        assert(stage.empty() && ledger.Count()==0);
        fail_new=0;
    }
    // Failure of GMMU driver after preflight should simply destroy the
    // staged node, with no GPU memory mapped and no committed ownership.
    {
        Pending stage;
        assert(ledger.PrepareMapped(map,stage)==Status::Success);
        assert(stage.size()==1 && ledger.Count()==0);
    }
    assert(ledger.Count()==0);
    {
        Pending stage;
        assert(ledger.PrepareMapped(map,stage)==Status::Success);
        // No allocations are permitted after a successful guest GMMU map.
        fail_new=1;
        assert(ledger.CommitPrepared(stage)==Status::Success);
        assert(fail_new==1 && stage.empty() && ledger.Count()==1);
    }
    fail_new=0;
    { Pending ignored; assert(ledger.PrepareMapped(map,ignored)==Status::Overlap); }
    GW::Unmap4K unmap{9,0,0x4000,0x2000,0};
    assert(ledger.RecordUnmapped(unmap)==Status::Success && ledger.Count()==0);
    // A committed overlapping entry between preflight and commit is detected
    // without publishing the staged node (simulated caller misuse).
    {
        Pending stage;
        assert(ledger.PrepareMapped(map,stage)==Status::Success);
        assert(ledger.RecordMapped(map)==Status::Success);
        assert(ledger.CommitPrepared(stage)==Status::Overlap);
        assert(stage.size()==1 && ledger.Count()==1);
    }
    assert(ledger.RecordUnmapped(unmap)==Status::Success);
    // Legacy ledger callers still fail closed on allocator OOM.
    fail_new=1;
    assert(ledger.RecordMapped(map)==Status::OutOfResource);
    assert(ledger.Count()==0);
    fail_new=0;
    {
        Pending stage;
        fail_new=1;
        assert(ledger.PrepareSparse(9,2,0x8000,0x3000,stage)==Status::OutOfResource);
        assert(stage.empty() && ledger.Count()==0);
        fail_new=0;
    }
    {
        Pending stage;
        assert(ledger.PrepareSparse(9,2,0x8000,0x3000,stage)==Status::Success);
        fail_new=1;
        assert(ledger.CommitPrepared(stage)==Status::Success);
        assert(fail_new==1 && stage.empty() && ledger.Count()==1);
    }
    fail_new=0;
    assert(ledger.ContainsSparse(9,0x9000,0x1000));
    assert(ledger.RecordReleasedSparse(9,0x8000,0x3000)==Status::Success);
    fail_new=1;
    assert(ledger.RecordSparse(9,2,0x8000,0x3000)==Status::OutOfResource);
    assert(ledger.Count()==0);
    fail_new=0;
}
```
