`tools/ns2/test_lichii_nx2_generic_shader_regressions.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Source-level cross-repo regressions: Ampere 128-bit ISA -> shared Maxwell
// lowerer. No game-specific title or fake framebuffer, no PS5 GPU assertions.
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <tuple>
#include <vector>
#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/lower_to_maxwell.h"
#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/lower_bridge.h"
#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/probe.h"

using namespace Shader::Ampere;
static constexpr Instruction Exit{{0x0000794d, 0, 0x03800000, 0x000fea00}};
static constexpr Instruction UniformClamp{{0x3f057499, 0xffffffff, 0x08010604, 0x000fe200}};
static constexpr Instruction UniformWrap{{0x3f057499, 1, 0x08010e04, 0x000fc800}};
static constexpr Instruction SurfaceReduction{{0x0500759f, 0x20c00206, 0x0010e000, 0x000fe200}};
static constexpr Instruction BindlessLoad{{0x10007998, 0x60000000, 0x001e0f1d, 0x010f6600}};
static constexpr Instruction BindlessStore{{0x0200799c, 0x60000004, 0x00100f00, 0x004fe200}};
static constexpr Instruction FullIntegerMinMax{{0x0b037817, 0x1fffffff, 0x03800000, 0x001fc800}};

static LoweredProgram Lower(const Instruction& insn) {
    return LowerToMaxwell(std::array{insn, Exit});
}
static std::array<u8, 2 * sizeof(Instruction)> Bytes(const Instruction& insn) {
    std::array<u8, 2 * sizeof(Instruction)> bytes{};
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
        for (unsigned j = 0; j < 4; ++j) {
            bytes[i * 4 + j] = static_cast<u8>(insn.words[i] >> (j * 8));
            bytes[16 + i * 4 + j] = static_cast<u8>(Exit.words[i] >> (j * 8));
        }
    }
    return bytes;
}
static ProgramProbe Probe(const Instruction& insn) { return ProbeProgram(Bytes(insn)); }
int main() {
    // Shader probe and actual lowerer must agree. A private opcode accepted
    // only by LowerToMaxwell would never enter the actual renderer pipeline.
    assert(FindOpcodeRow(0x499) != nullptr);
    assert(FindOpcodeRow(0x59f) != nullptr);
    for (const Instruction insn : {UniformClamp, UniformWrap}) {
        const auto probe = Probe(insn);
        assert(probe.status == ProbeStatus::Recognized);
        const auto result = Lower(insn);
        assert(result && result.source_size == 32 && result.instructions.size() == 3);
        assert(result.instructions[0] ==
            (insn.words[1] == 1 ? 0x010000000017f0faULL : 0x010ffffffff7f0faULL));
        assert(result.instructions[1] ==
            (insn.words[1] == 1 ? 0x5c4800800dc7faddULL : 0x5c4800000dc7faddULL));
        const u64 shift_word = result.instructions[1];
        assert((shift_word & 255U) == 221U); // UR5 maps to GPR221
        assert(((shift_word >> 8) & 255U) == 250U);
        assert(((shift_word >> 20) & 255U) == 220U); // UR4
        assert(((shift_word >> 39) & 1U) == (insn.Bits(75, 1)));
    }
    // Execute the actual encoded operands against the two observed ISA
    // modes. An instruction with a wrongly mapped GPR/mode is caught even if
    // its textual source describes the right operation.
    for (const Instruction insn : {UniformClamp, UniformWrap}) {
        const auto lowered = Lower(insn);
        const u64 op = lowered.instructions[1];
        const u32 dest_reg = op & 255U;
        const u32 immediate_reg = (op >> 8) & 255U;
        const u32 shift_reg = (op >> 20) & 255U;
        const bool wraps = (op >> 39) & 1U;
        for (const u32 amount : {0U,1U,31U,32U,33U,63U,64U,0xffffffffU}) {
            std::array<u32,256> regs{};
            regs[immediate_reg] = insn.words[1];
            regs[shift_reg] = amount;
            regs[dest_reg] = wraps
                ? (regs[immediate_reg] << (regs[shift_reg] & 31))
                : (regs[shift_reg] < 32
                    ? (regs[immediate_reg] << regs[shift_reg]) : 0U);
            const u32 expected = wraps || amount < 32
                ? static_cast<u32>(u64{insn.words[1]} << (amount & 31))
                : 0U;
            assert(regs[dest_reg] == expected);
        }
    }
    for (const Instruction original : {UniformClamp, UniformWrap}) {
        for (const auto& [word, bit] : std::array{
            std::pair{0U, 24U}, std::pair{2U, 8U}, std::pair{2U, 9U},
            std::pair{2U, 12U}, std::pair{2U, 16U}, std::pair{2U, 27U},
            std::pair{3U, 0U}, std::pair{3U, 30U}}) {
            auto invalid = original;
            invalid.words[word] ^= 1U << bit;
            assert(!Lower(invalid));
        }
        auto bad_uniform = original;
        bad_uniform.words[2] = (bad_uniform.words[2] & ~255U) | 64U;
        assert(!Lower(bad_uniform));
        auto discard = original;
        discard.words[0] = (discard.words[0] & ~0xff0000U) | (63U << 16);
        assert(!Lower(discard));
    }
    // Native register-handle images may use any valid 2D/array/3D
    // dimension; never bind a synthetic direct CBUF/TIC descriptor.
    struct SurfaceCase { Instruction instruction; u64 expected; };
    for (const auto& test : std::array{
            SurfaceCase{BindlessLoad, 0xeb000e8600f71000ULL},
            SurfaceCase{BindlessStore, 0xeb20000600f70204ULL},
            SurfaceCase{Instruction{{0x00037998, 0xa0000000, 0x001e0119, 0x010f6200}},
                        0xeb000c8a00170003ULL},
            SurfaceCase{Instruction{{0x0000799c, 0xa0000004, 0x00100f03, 0x0101e200}},
                        0xeb20018a00f70004ULL},
            SurfaceCase{Instruction{{0x0000799c, 0x8000000c, 0x00100f07, 0x0041e200}},
                        0xeb20038800f7000cULL}
         }) {
        assert(Probe(test.instruction).status == ProbeStatus::Recognized);
        const auto result = Lower(test.instruction);
        assert(result && result.instructions.size() == 2);
        assert(result.instructions.front() == test.expected);
        assert(result.required_texture_buffer == ~0U);
    }
    for (const Instruction original : {BindlessLoad, BindlessStore}) {
        auto guarded = original;
        guarded.words[0] = (guarded.words[0] & ~0xf000U) | 0x9000U;
        const auto plain = Lower(original);
        const auto predicated = Lower(guarded);
        assert(plain && predicated);
        assert(predicated.instructions.front() ==
               ((plain.instructions.front() & ~(u64{0xf} << 16)) | (u64{9} << 16)));
        for (const auto& [word, bit] : std::array{
                std::pair{1U, 8U}, std::pair{1U, 28U}, std::pair{2U, 12U},
                std::pair{2U, 13U}, std::pair{2U, 20U}, std::pair{2U, 31U},
                std::pair{3U, 0U}, std::pair{3U, 30U}}) {
            auto invalid = original;
            invalid.words[word] ^= 1U << bit;
            assert(!Lower(invalid));
        }
        auto no_channels = original;
        no_channels.words[2] &= ~0xf00U;
        assert(!Lower(no_channels));
        auto invalid_handle = original;
        invalid_handle.words[2] = (invalid_handle.words[2] & ~255U) | 250U;
        assert(!Lower(invalid_handle));
    }
    // SURED accepts only direct, fully validated 1D buffer / 2D targets.
    for (const u32 dimension : {1U, 3U}) {
        for (const u32 guard : {0U, 7U, 9U}) {
            auto insn = SurfaceReduction;
            insn.words[0] = (insn.words[0] & ~0xf000U) | (guard << 12);
            insn.words[1] = (insn.words[1] & 0x1fffffffU) | (dimension << 29);
            assert(Probe(insn).status == ProbeStatus::Recognized);
            const auto result = Lower(insn);
            assert(result && result.source_size == 32 && result.instructions.size() == 2);
            assert(result.required_texture_buffer == 3);
            assert(result.instructions[0] ==
                (0xeb48002000000506ULL | (u64{guard} << 16) | (u64{dimension} << 33)));
        }
    }
    for (const u32 dimension : {0U, 2U, 4U, 5U, 6U, 7U}) {
        auto invalid = SurfaceReduction;
        invalid.words[1] = (invalid.words[1] & 0x1fffffffU) | (dimension << 29);
        assert(!Lower(invalid));
    }
    auto invalid_reduction = SurfaceReduction;
    invalid_reduction.words[2] ^= 0x200U;
    assert(!Lower(invalid_reduction));
    auto unreviewed_reduction = SurfaceReduction;
    unreviewed_reduction.words[0] |= 1U << 16;
    assert(Probe(unreviewed_reduction).status == ProbeStatus::UnreviewedFields);
    auto unreviewed_uniform_shift = UniformClamp;
    unreviewed_uniform_shift.words[3] |= 1U;
    assert(Probe(unreviewed_uniform_shift).status == ProbeStatus::UnreviewedFields);
    auto invalid_binding = SurfaceReduction;
    invalid_binding.words[1] = (invalid_binding.words[1] & ~(0x1fU << 22)) | (18U << 22);
    assert(!Lower(invalid_binding));
    auto invalid_offset = SurfaceReduction;
    invalid_offset.words[1] |= (0x2000U << 8);
    assert(!Lower(invalid_offset));
    auto scratch_data = SurfaceReduction;
    scratch_data.words[1] = (scratch_data.words[1] & ~0xffU) | 250U;
    assert(!Lower(scratch_data));
    auto scratch_coordinate = SurfaceReduction;
    scratch_coordinate.words[0] = (scratch_coordinate.words[0] & 0x00ffffffU) |
                                  (248U << 24);
    assert(!Lower(scratch_coordinate));

    // IMNMX signed 20-bit immediate must not consume a scratch register.
    for (u32 value : {0U, 0x7ffffU, 0xfff80000U, 0xffffffffU}) {
        auto insn = FullIntegerMinMax;
        insn.words[1] = value;
        const auto result = Lower(insn);
        assert(result && result.instructions.size() == 2);
        assert((result.instructions.front() >> 56 & 1U) == (value >> 31));
        assert(((result.instructions.front() >> 20) & 0x7ffffU) == (value & 0x7ffffU));
    }
    for (u32 value : {0x80000U, 0x1fffffffU, 0x7fffffffU, 0x80000000U, 0xfff7ffffU}) {
        auto insn = FullIntegerMinMax;
        insn.words[1] = value;
        const auto result = Lower(insn);
        assert(result && result.instructions.size() == 3);
        assert((result.instructions.front() & 0xffU) == 251U); // materialized immediate
        assert(((result.instructions.front() >> 20) & 0xffffffffULL) == value);
    }
    // The exact renderer-facing bridge must pass the same captured cases
    // through classification, checked ISA fields, lowerer, and image output.
    for (const Instruction insn : {UniformClamp, UniformWrap, SurfaceReduction,
                                    FullIntegerMinMax, BindlessLoad, BindlessStore}) {
        const auto bridge = LowerReviewedToMaxwell(Bytes(insn));
        assert(bridge.Ready());
        assert(bridge.consumed_native_bytes == 32);
        assert(!bridge.maxwell_instructions.empty());
    }
    // BRA.U's low address bits are convergence flags. Verify the real
    // branch relocation and a signed backward jump, never merely masking
    // the bits in a separate non-production model.
    constexpr Instruction Nop{{0x00007918, 0, 0, 0x000fea00}};
    {
        std::array<Instruction, 133> program{};
        program.fill(Nop);
        program[91] = Instruction{{0x00008947, 0x00000281, 0x03800000, 0x000fea00}};
        program.back() = Exit;
        const auto linked = LowerToMaxwell(program);
        assert(linked && linked.source_size == sizeof(program));
        assert(linked.source_instruction_offsets.size() == program.size());
        assert(linked.instructions[linked.source_instruction_offsets[91]] ==
               0xe24000001b08000fULL);
        // A lowerer-only PASS is not useful if the actual source-checked
        // renderer bridge rejects the captured BRA.U opcode or mode.
        std::vector<u8> encoded;
        encoded.reserve(sizeof(program));
        for (const auto& instruction : program)
            for (u32 word : instruction.words)
                for (unsigned shift = 0; shift != 32; shift += 8)
                    encoded.push_back(static_cast<u8>(word >> shift));
        const auto bridge = LowerReviewedToMaxwell(encoded);
        assert(bridge.Ready() && bridge.consumed_native_bytes == encoded.size());
    }
    {
        const std::array program{
            Nop,
            Instruction{{0x00008947, 0xffffffe1, 0x0383ffff, 0x000fea00}},
            Exit,
        };
        const auto backward = LowerToMaxwell(program);
        assert(backward && backward.source_size == sizeof(program));
        assert(backward.instructions[backward.source_instruction_offsets[1]] ==
               0xe2400fffff08000fULL);
    }
    {
        const std::array program{
            Instruction{{0x00008947, 0x11, 0x04800000, 0x000fea00}},
            Nop,
            Exit,
        };
        const auto guarded = LowerToMaxwell(program);
        assert(guarded && guarded.source_size == sizeof(program));
        assert(guarded.instructions.size() >= 4);
    }
    for (const u32 bit : {82U,83U,84U,85U,86U,91U,92U,93U,94U,
                          95U,96U,97U,98U,99U,100U,101U,102U,103U,104U}) {
        auto branch = Instruction{{0x00008947, 1, 0x03800000, 0x000fea00}};
        branch.words[bit / 32] |= 1U << (bit % 32);
        const auto rejected = LowerToMaxwell(std::array{branch, Exit});
        assert(!rejected && rejected.instructions.empty());
    }
    for (const u32 offset : {5U,0x11U,0xffffffe1U}) {
        auto branch = Instruction{{0x00008947, offset, 0x03800000, 0x000fea00}};
        if (offset == 0xffffffe1U) branch.words[2] |= 0x3ffffU;
        const auto rejected = LowerToMaxwell(std::array{branch, Exit});
        assert(!rejected && rejected.instructions.empty());
    }
    // P2.3: native QMD CBUF reads use the actual Ampere opcode/byte
    // offset and the reviewed shared Maxwell indexed load, never a
    // special-case title path or guessed aligned word read.
    for (const auto& [instruction, bank, byte_offset, width, dst, index] :
         std::array<std::tuple<Instruction,u32,u32,u32,u32,u32>, 3>{{
             {Instruction{{0x11047abb,0x01400000,0x08000400,0x000fe400}}, 5, 0, 2, 220, 201},
             {Instruction{{0x06077abb,0x01002080,0x08000000,0x000fe400}}, 4, 0x82, 0, 223, 222},
             {Instruction{{0x0d047abb,0x014000c0,0x08000000,0x000fe400}}, 5, 3, 0, 220, 229},
         }}) {
        const auto probe = Probe(instruction);
        assert(probe.status == ProbeStatus::Recognized);
        const auto lowered = Lower(instruction);
        assert(lowered && lowered.source_instruction_offsets.size() == 2);
        const u64 word = lowered.instructions[lowered.source_instruction_offsets[0]];
        assert((word & 0xff00000000000000ULL) == 0xef00000000000000ULL);
        assert((word & 255U) == dst);
        assert(((word >> 8) & 255U) == index);
        assert(((word >> 20) & 0xffffU) == byte_offset);
        assert(((word >> 36) & 31U) == bank);
        assert(((word >> 48) & 7U) == width);
        const auto bridge = LowerReviewedToMaxwell(Bytes(instruction));
        assert(bridge.Ready() && bridge.source_instruction_offsets.size() == 2);
        assert(bridge.maxwell_instructions[bridge.source_instruction_offsets[0]] == word);
    }
    for (const u32 invalid_width : {6U,7U}) {
        auto invalid = Instruction{{0x06077abb,0x01002080,0x08000000,0x000fe400}};
        invalid.words[2] |= invalid_width << 9;
        assert(!Lower(invalid));
    }
    // Direct byte/halfword ULDC is also legal when the immediate is
    // naturally aligned and below Maxwell's subword displacement limit.
    for (const auto& [instruction, byte_offset, width] :
         std::array<std::tuple<Instruction,u32,u32>,2>{{
             {Instruction{{0x06077ab9,0x01002080,0x00000000,0x000fe400}}, 0x82, 0},
             {Instruction{{0x06077ab9,0x01000080,0x00000400,0x000fe400}}, 2, 2}
         }}) {
        const auto lowered = Lower(instruction);
        assert(lowered && lowered.source_instruction_offsets.size() == 2);
        const u64 word = lowered.instructions[lowered.source_instruction_offsets[0]];
        assert((word & 255U) == 223U);
        assert(((word >> 8) & 255U) == 255U); // direct, no UR offset
        assert(((word >> 20) & 0xffffU) == byte_offset);
        assert(((word >> 48) & 7U) == width);
        const auto bridge = LowerReviewedToMaxwell(Bytes(instruction));
        assert(bridge.Ready());
        assert(bridge.maxwell_instructions[bridge.source_instruction_offsets[0]] == word);
    }
    // Signed native subword reads use Maxwell's signed 8/16-bit widths,
    // both with a direct displacement and a dynamic uniform index.
    for (const bool indexed : {false, true}) {
        for (const u32 width : {1U, 3U}) {
            auto instruction = indexed
                ? Instruction{{0x06077abb,0x01002080,0x08000000,0x000fe400}}
                : Instruction{{0x06077ab9,0x01002080,0x00000000,0x000fe400}};
            instruction.words[2] |= width << 9;
            assert(Probe(instruction).status == ProbeStatus::Recognized);
            const auto lowered = Lower(instruction);
            assert(lowered && lowered.source_instruction_offsets.size() == 2);
            const u64 word = lowered.instructions[lowered.source_instruction_offsets[0]];
            assert((word & 0xff00000000000000ULL) == 0xef00000000000000ULL);
            assert(((word >> 8) & 255U) == (indexed ? 222U : 255U));
            assert(((word >> 20) & 0xffffU) == 0x82U);
            assert(((word >> 48) & 7U) == width);
            const auto bridge = LowerReviewedToMaxwell(Bytes(instruction));
            assert(bridge.Ready());
            assert(bridge.maxwell_instructions[bridge.source_instruction_offsets[0]] == word);
        }
    }
    auto direct_signed_byte_odd = Instruction{{0x06077ab9,0x010000c0,0x00000200,0x000fe400}};
    assert(Lower(direct_signed_byte_odd));
    auto direct_signed_half_odd = Instruction{{0x06077ab9,0x010000c0,0x00000600,0x000fe400}};
    assert(!Lower(direct_signed_half_odd));
    auto direct_signed_half_range = Instruction{{0x06077ab9,0x01200000,0x00000600,0x000fe400}};
    assert(!Lower(direct_signed_half_range));
    auto direct_bad_alignment = Instruction{{0x06077ab9,0x010000c0,0x00000400,0x000fe400}};
    assert(!Lower(direct_bad_alignment)); // U16 at odd byte address
    auto direct_bad_range = Instruction{{0x06077ab9,0x01200000,0x00000000,0x000fe400}};
    assert(!Lower(direct_bad_range)); // direct short displacement sign bit set
    auto bad_index = Instruction{{0x3f077abb,0x01002080,0x08000000,0x000fe400}};
    assert(!Lower(bad_index)); // no UR63 as a dynamic index
    std::puts("P2_4_LICHII_NX2_GENERIC_AMPERE_LOWERING_PASS 0x499 0x59f 0x817 0x998 0x99c BRA.U renderer_bridge=ready");
}
```

`tools/ns2/test_native_ampere_channel.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#include <cassert>
#include "core/hle/service/nvdrv/devices/native_gpu_channel_registry.h"
namespace Kernel { class KProcess {}; }
namespace Tegra::Control { struct ChannelState {}; }
int main() {
    using Service::Nvidia::Devices::NativeGpuChannelRegistry;
    using Service::Nvidia::Devices::NativeGpuProcessRegistry;
    auto& process_registry=NativeGpuProcessRegistry::Instance();
    auto& channel_registry=NativeGpuChannelRegistry::Instance();
    Kernel::KProcess first{},other{};
    Tegra::Control::ChannelState native{},legacy{},another{};
    assert(!channel_registry.IsNative(&native));
    assert(!channel_registry.Bind(&native,&first));
    assert(process_registry.Register(&first));
    assert(channel_registry.Bind(&native,&first));
    assert(channel_registry.Bind(&native,&first));
    assert(channel_registry.IsNative(&native));
    const auto first_ticket=channel_registry.CaptureTicket(&native);
    assert(first_ticket && first_ticket->process==&first);
    assert(channel_registry.IsCurrent(&native,*first_ticket));
    // A native channel is not automatically a native 3D renderer:
    // the actual 0xC797 puller bind must opt in explicitly.
    int graphics_engine{};
    int separate_engine{};
    assert(!channel_registry.CaptureGraphicsTicket(&graphics_engine));
    assert(!channel_registry.BindGraphicsEngine(&legacy,&graphics_engine,0));
    assert(!channel_registry.BindGraphicsEngine(&native,nullptr,0));
    assert(!channel_registry.BindGraphicsEngine(&native,&graphics_engine,8));
    assert(channel_registry.BindGraphicsEngine(&native,&graphics_engine,2));
    assert(channel_registry.BindGraphicsEngine(&native,&graphics_engine,5));
    assert(!channel_registry.BindGraphicsEngine(&legacy,&graphics_engine,1));
    assert(!channel_registry.BindGraphicsEngine(&another,&graphics_engine,1));
    assert(!channel_registry.CaptureGraphicsTicket(&separate_engine));
    const auto active_engine = channel_registry.CaptureGraphicsTicket(&graphics_engine);
    assert(active_engine && active_engine->channel_generation == first_ticket->channel_generation);
    assert(channel_registry.IsGraphicsCurrent(&graphics_engine,*active_engine));
    channel_registry.UnbindGraphicsSubchannel(&native,&graphics_engine,2);
    assert(channel_registry.CaptureGraphicsTicket(&graphics_engine));
    channel_registry.UnbindGraphicsSubchannel(&native,&graphics_engine,5);
    assert(!channel_registry.CaptureGraphicsTicket(&graphics_engine));
    assert(!channel_registry.IsGraphicsCurrent(&graphics_engine,*active_engine));
    assert(channel_registry.BindGraphicsEngine(&native,&graphics_engine,2));
    // Class 0xC7C0 is independently authenticated; a native process alone
    // or graphics class 0xC797 must not impersonate the Compute engine.
    int compute_engine{};
    int alternate_compute_engine{};
    assert(!channel_registry.CaptureComputeTicket(&compute_engine));
    assert(!channel_registry.BindComputeEngine(&legacy,&compute_engine,0));
    assert(!channel_registry.BindComputeEngine(&native,nullptr,0));
    assert(!channel_registry.BindComputeEngine(&native,&compute_engine,8));
    assert(channel_registry.BindComputeEngine(&native,&compute_engine,1));
    assert(channel_registry.BindComputeEngine(&native,&compute_engine,4));
    assert(!channel_registry.BindComputeEngine(&another,&compute_engine,1));
    assert(!channel_registry.CaptureComputeTicket(&alternate_compute_engine));
    const auto native_compute=channel_registry.CaptureComputeTicket(&compute_engine);
    assert(native_compute &&
           native_compute->channel_generation==first_ticket->channel_generation);
    assert(channel_registry.IsComputeCurrent(&compute_engine,*native_compute));
    channel_registry.UnbindComputeSubchannel(&native,&compute_engine,1);
    assert(channel_registry.CaptureComputeTicket(&compute_engine));
    channel_registry.UnbindComputeSubchannel(&native,&compute_engine,4);
    assert(!channel_registry.CaptureComputeTicket(&compute_engine));
    assert(!channel_registry.IsComputeCurrent(&compute_engine,*native_compute));
    assert(channel_registry.BindComputeEngine(&native,&compute_engine,1));
    assert(!channel_registry.CaptureTicket(&legacy));
    assert(!channel_registry.CaptureTicket(nullptr));
    assert(!channel_registry.IsNative(&legacy));
    assert(process_registry.Register(&other));
    assert(!channel_registry.Bind(&native,&other));
    assert(channel_registry.Bind(&another,&other));
    assert(channel_registry.IsNative(&another));
    const auto other_ticket=channel_registry.CaptureTicket(&another);
    assert(other_ticket && other_ticket->process==&other &&
           other_ticket->generation!=first_ticket->generation);
    process_registry.Unregister(&first);
    assert(!channel_registry.IsComputeCurrent(&compute_engine,*native_compute));
    assert(!channel_registry.CaptureComputeTicket(&compute_engine));
    assert(!channel_registry.IsGraphicsCurrent(&graphics_engine,*active_engine));
    assert(!channel_registry.CaptureGraphicsTicket(&graphics_engine));
    assert(!channel_registry.IsNative(&native));
    assert(!channel_registry.CaptureTicket(&native));
    assert(!channel_registry.IsCurrent(&native,*first_ticket));
    assert(process_registry.Register(&first));
    assert(!channel_registry.IsNative(&native));
    assert(!channel_registry.Bind(&native,&first)); // stale generation cannot acquire
    channel_registry.Unbind(&native);
    assert(channel_registry.Bind(&native,&first));
    assert(channel_registry.IsNative(&native));
    const auto reopened=channel_registry.CaptureTicket(&native);
    assert(reopened && reopened->process==&first &&
           reopened->generation!=first_ticket->generation &&
           reopened->channel_generation!=first_ticket->channel_generation);
    assert(channel_registry.IsCurrent(&native,*reopened));
    assert(!channel_registry.CaptureGraphicsTicket(&graphics_engine));
    assert(!channel_registry.CaptureComputeTicket(&compute_engine));
    assert(channel_registry.BindComputeEngine(&native,&compute_engine,3));
    const auto reopened_compute=channel_registry.CaptureComputeTicket(&compute_engine);
    assert(reopened_compute &&
           reopened_compute->channel_generation==reopened->channel_generation &&
           !channel_registry.IsComputeCurrent(&compute_engine,*native_compute));
    assert(channel_registry.BindGraphicsEngine(&native,&graphics_engine,3));
    assert(channel_registry.CaptureGraphicsTicket(&graphics_engine));
    assert(!channel_registry.IsGraphicsCurrent(&graphics_engine,*active_engine));
    assert(!channel_registry.IsCurrent(&native,*first_ticket));
    channel_registry.Unbind(&native);
    assert(!channel_registry.CaptureTicket(&native));
    assert(!channel_registry.IsCurrent(&native,*reopened));
    assert(!channel_registry.CaptureGraphicsTicket(&graphics_engine));
    assert(!channel_registry.CaptureComputeTicket(&compute_engine));
    assert(!channel_registry.IsComputeCurrent(&compute_engine,*reopened_compute));
    // A channel may be reused by the SAME process generation. In-flight
    // pipelines from the prior bind must still be rejected.
    assert(channel_registry.Bind(&native,&first));
    const auto recycled=channel_registry.CaptureTicket(&native);
    assert(recycled && recycled->process==&first &&
           recycled->generation==reopened->generation &&
           recycled->channel_generation!=reopened->channel_generation);
    assert(!channel_registry.IsCurrent(&native,*reopened));
    assert(channel_registry.IsCurrent(&native,*recycled));
    channel_registry.Unbind(&native);
    channel_registry.Unbind(&another);
    process_registry.Unregister(&first);
    process_registry.Unregister(&other);
}
```

`tools/ns2/test_native_gpu_command_saferead.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// P2.7: actual Eden GuestMemory<SafeRead> sees GPU-produced command words.
// This is a host fake device, not Vulkan/PS5. Both contiguous GPU backing
// and the fallback ReadBlock path must flush before presenting guest words.
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>
#include "common/common_types.h"
#include "core/guest_memory.h"

struct MockGpuMemory {
    static constexpr bool HAS_FLUSH_INVALIDATION = true;
    static constexpr u64 base = 0x50000U;
    std::array<u32,2> backing{0x11111111U,0x22222222U};
    std::array<u32,2> gpu_words{0xdeadbeefU,0xfeedfaceU};
    bool coherent{},contiguous{true};
    unsigned flush_count{},read_count{},unsafe_count{};

    u8* GetSpan(u64 address, std::size_t bytes) {
        if (!contiguous || address!=base || bytes!=sizeof(backing)) return nullptr;
        return reinterpret_cast<u8*>(backing.data());
    }
    void FlushRegion(u64 address, std::size_t bytes) {
        assert(address==base && bytes==sizeof(backing));
        ++flush_count;
        backing=gpu_words;
        coherent=true;
    }
    void ReadBlock(u64 address, void* destination, std::size_t bytes) {
        ++read_count;
        FlushRegion(address,bytes);
        std::memcpy(destination,backing.data(),bytes);
    }
    void ReadBlockUnsafe(u64 address, void* destination, std::size_t bytes) {
        assert(address==base && bytes==sizeof(backing));
        ++unsafe_count;
        std::memcpy(destination,backing.data(),bytes);
    }
};
int main() {
    using Core::Memory::GuestMemory;
    using Core::Memory::GuestMemoryFlags;
    for(bool contiguous:{true,false}) {
        MockGpuMemory memory{};
        memory.contiguous=contiguous;
        {
            GuestMemory<MockGpuMemory,u32,GuestMemoryFlags::UnsafeRead> unsafe(memory,memory.base,2);
            assert(unsafe.size()==2 && unsafe[0]==0x11111111U &&
                   unsafe[1]==0x22222222U && !memory.coherent && memory.flush_count==0);
        }
        {
            GuestMemory<MockGpuMemory,u32,GuestMemoryFlags::SafeRead> safe(memory,memory.base,2);
            assert(safe.size()==2 && safe[0]==0xdeadbeefU &&
                   safe[1]==0xfeedfaceU && memory.coherent && memory.flush_count==1);
        }
        assert(memory.read_count==(contiguous?0U:1U));
        assert(memory.unsafe_count==(contiguous?0U:1U));
    }
}
```

`tools/ns2/test_native_gpu_fetch_admission.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright 2026 Eden Encore Project
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Execute the real native DMA fetch admission helper using a mutable GMMU.
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <set>
#include "core/hle/service/nvdrv/devices/native_gpu_fetch_admission.h"

using Service::Nvidia::Devices::NativeGpfifoFetchMapped;

struct FakeGmmu {
    static constexpr std::uint64_t PageSize=4096;
    std::set<std::uint64_t> pages{};
    unsigned probes{};
    bool IsFullyMappedRange(std::uint64_t address,std::uint64_t size) {
        ++probes;
        assert(size && address);
        const auto first=address/PageSize;
        const auto last=(address+size-1)/PageSize;
        for (auto page=first; page<=last; ++page)
            if (!pages.contains(page)) return false;
        return true;
    }
};

int main() {
    constexpr std::uint64_t high=std::uint64_t{1}<<49;
    FakeGmmu memory;
    const auto callback=[&](std::uint64_t address,std::uint64_t size) {
        return memory.IsFullyMappedRange(address,size);
    };
    // Fence-only commands perform no GPU memory read.
    assert(NativeGpfifoFetchMapped(0,0,callback) && memory.probes==0);
    assert(NativeGpfifoFetchMapped(0x1000,0,callback) && memory.probes==0);
    // Nonempty malformed ranges must fail before the actual GMMU walker.
    assert(!NativeGpfifoFetchMapped(0,1,callback));
    assert(!NativeGpfifoFetchMapped(high,1,callback));
    assert(!NativeGpfifoFetchMapped(high-2,1,callback));
    assert(!NativeGpfifoFetchMapped(high-4,2,callback));
    assert(!NativeGpfifoFetchMapped(~std::uint64_t{0},~std::uint64_t{0},callback));
    assert(!NativeGpfifoFetchMapped(0x1000,~std::uint64_t{0},callback));
    assert(memory.probes==0);
    // Submit-time mapping does NOT guarantee execution-time mapping.
    memory.pages={1,2};
    assert(NativeGpfifoFetchMapped(0x1ffc,2,callback) && memory.probes==1);
    memory.pages.erase(2);
    assert(!NativeGpfifoFetchMapped(0x1ffc,2,callback) && memory.probes==2);
    // Unmapped packets cannot be interpreted as 0x00000000 commands.
    assert(!NativeGpfifoFetchMapped(0x2ffc,2,callback) && memory.probes==3);
    memory.pages.insert(2);
    memory.pages.insert(3);
    assert(NativeGpfifoFetchMapped(0x2ffc,2,callback) && memory.probes==4);
    // The uppermost word is in-bounds only when mapped.
    memory.pages.insert((high-4)/4096);
    assert(NativeGpfifoFetchMapped(high-4,1,callback));
    // Submission-time unmapped, execution-time newly mapped: permitted.
    memory.pages.erase(1);
    assert(!NativeGpfifoFetchMapped(0x1000,1,callback));
    memory.pages.insert(1);
    assert(NativeGpfifoFetchMapped(0x1000,1,callback));
    std::puts("P2_7_REAL_NATIVE_GPFIFO_FETCH_RECHECK_PASS");
}
```

`tools/ns2/test_native_gpu_fetch_fatal_worker.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright 2026 Eden Encore Project
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Host miniature of the real PS5 GPU pthread catch + fence publication order.
// Uses production gpu_failure.h and native GPFIFO fetch helper unchanged.
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <exception>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <stop_token>
#include <thread>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdio>
#include <string_view>
#include "gpu_failure.h"
#include "core/hle/service/nvdrv/devices/native_gpu_fetch_admission.h"

int main() {
    using Service::Nvidia::Devices::NativeGpfifoFetchMapped;
    Eden::ResetGpuFailureForTitle();
    std::stop_source stop;
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> acknowledged{6};
    std::atomic<int> dispatch_calls{0},map_checks{0};
    std::atomic<bool> mapped{true};
    constexpr std::uint64_t queue_fence=7;
    const auto owner=[&] {
        try {
            // The initial ioctl succeeds: the GMMU is still mapped.
            assert(NativeGpfifoFetchMapped(0x2000,4,[&](auto,auto){
                ++map_checks;
                return mapped.load();
            }));
            // Guest Unmap after NVDRV admission, before the worker's fetch.
            mapped=false;
            ++dispatch_calls;
            if (!NativeGpfifoFetchMapped(0x2000,4,[&](auto,auto){
                    ++map_checks;
                    return mapped.load();
                })) {
                throw std::runtime_error("Native GPFIFO command unmapped at GPU fetch");
            }
            // Exactly like GPUThread::RunWorker's post-scheduler queue fence.
            acknowledged.store(queue_fence,std::memory_order_release);
        } catch (const std::exception&) {
            Eden::RecordGpuFailure(std::current_exception());
            stop.request_stop();
        }
    };
    std::thread worker(owner);
    worker.join();
    assert(dispatch_calls==1 && map_checks==2);
    assert(stop.stop_requested());
    assert(acknowledged.load(std::memory_order_acquire)==6);
    const auto observer=Eden::TakeGpuFailure();
    assert(observer);
    // Delivering the alert once does not consume the persistent fatal cause.
    assert(!Eden::TakeGpuFailure());
    const auto another=Eden::PeekGpuFailure();
    assert(another);
    try {
        std::rethrow_exception(another);
        assert(false);
    } catch (const std::runtime_error& exception) {
        assert(std::string_view(exception.what()) ==
               "Native GPFIFO command unmapped at GPU fetch");
    }
    // Requests cannot be acknowledged by a later no-op GPU Tick on a
    // stopped worker. Only complete title teardown clears the latched error.
    assert(acknowledged.load(std::memory_order_acquire)<queue_fence);
    Eden::ResetGpuFailureForTitle();
    assert(!Eden::PeekGpuFailure() && !Eden::TakeGpuFailure());
    std::puts("P2_7_GPU_FETCH_FATAL_NO_FALSE_FENCE_PASS");
}
```

`tools/ns2/test_native_gpu_ioctl.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Strict synthetic NVDRV reply fixtures. Tests the exact helper used by
// the experimental nvhost_ctrl_gpu.cpp owner; no physical host GPU needed.
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstring>
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>
#include <span>
#include <iostream>
#include "core/hle/service/nvdrv/devices/native_characteristics_ioctl.h"

using namespace Service::Nvidia::Devices;
static u32 le32(const u8* p) {
    return u32{p[0]} | (u32{p[1]}<<8) | (u32{p[2]}<<16) | (u32{p[3]}<<24);
}
static u64 le64(const u8* p) {
    return u64{le32(p)} | (u64{le32(p+4)}<<32);
}
int main() {
    std::array<u8, 0xa0> legacy{};
    legacy[0x34]=0x00; legacy[0x35]=0x00; legacy[0x36]=0x03;
    legacy[0x50]=0x55;
    for (const auto [raw,size,sm,channel] :
         {std::array<u32,4>{0xc0e04705,0xd0,0x808,0x1d},
          std::array<u32,4>{0xc0e84705,0xd8,0x808,0x1f}}) {
        std::array<u8, 0x110> input{},output{},inline_output{};
        input.fill(0xab);output.fill(0xcd);inline_output.fill(0xef);
        const auto packet_size=size+0x10;
        auto st=WriteNativeCharacteristicsIoctlReply(raw,
            std::span<const u8>(input.data(),packet_size),
            std::span<u8>(output.data(),packet_size+2),
            std::span<u8>(inline_output.data(),size+2),legacy);
        assert(st==NativeCharacteristicsIoctlStatus::Success);
        assert(le64(output.data())==size);
        assert(le32(output.data()+0x10)==0x170);
        assert(le32(output.data()+0x14)==0xe);
        assert(le32(output.data()+0x10+0x3c)==sm);
        assert(le32(output.data()+0x10+0x40)==sm);
        assert(le32(output.data()+0x10+0x28)==0x1000);
        // Never publish NS1 Maxwell engine classes in native GPU replies.
        assert(le32(output.data()+0x10+0x5c)==0xc797);
        assert(le32(output.data()+0x10+0x60)==0xc7c0);
        assert(le32(output.data()+0x10+0x64)==0xc56f);
        assert(le32(output.data()+0x10+0x6c)==0xc7b5);
        assert((le64(output.data()+0x10+0x50)&((1ULL<<8)|(1ULL<<22)))==
               ((1ULL<<8)|(1ULL<<22)));
        assert(le32(output.data()+0x10+0xb4)==64);
        assert((le32(output.data()+0x10+0x76)&0xffffU)==channel);
        assert(std::memcmp(output.data()+0x10,inline_output.data(),size)==0);
        assert(output[packet_size]==0xcd && output[packet_size+1]==0xcd);
        assert(inline_output[size]==0xef && inline_output[size+1]==0xef);
        // Truncated in/out/inline buffers: reject WITHOUT mutating outputs.
        for(int which=0;which<3;++which){
            output.fill(0xcd);inline_output.fill(0xef);
            const auto ib=which==0?packet_size-1:packet_size;
            const auto ob=which==1?packet_size-1:packet_size;
            const auto il=which==2?size-1:size;
            st=WriteNativeCharacteristicsIoctlReply(raw,
                std::span<const u8>(input.data(),ib),
                std::span<u8>(output.data(),ob),
                std::span<u8>(inline_output.data(),il),legacy);
            assert(st==NativeCharacteristicsIoctlStatus::BadParameter);
            assert(output[0]==0xcd && inline_output[0]==0xef);
        }
        output.fill(0xcd);inline_output.fill(0xef);
        st=WriteNativeCharacteristicsIoctlReply(0xc0a04705,
            input,output,inline_output,legacy);
        assert(st==NativeCharacteristicsIoctlStatus::NotNative);
        assert(output[0]==0xcd && inline_output[0]==0xef);
    }
    std::cout<<"NS2 native GPU ioctl packet validation: PASS\n";
}
```

`tools/ns2/test_native_gpu_process_registry.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// N3n: process-scoped NS2 GPU shader compiler auth tickets.
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdio>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>
#include "core/hle/service/nvdrv/devices/native_gpu_process_registry.h"

namespace Kernel { class KProcess {}; }
using Service::Nvidia::Devices::NativeGpuProcessRegistry;

int main() {
    auto& registry = NativeGpuProcessRegistry::Instance();
    Kernel::KProcess a{}, b{}, c{};
    assert(registry.Count() == 0);
    assert(!registry.Register(nullptr));
    assert(!registry.CaptureTicket(nullptr));
    assert(!registry.CaptureTicket(&a));
    assert(!registry.IsCurrent({&a, 0}));

    assert(registry.Register(&a));
    const auto ticket_a = registry.CaptureTicket(&a);
    assert(ticket_a && registry.IsCurrent(*ticket_a));
    assert(!registry.IsCurrent({&b, ticket_a->generation}));
    assert(registry.Register(&a));
    registry.Unregister(&a);
    assert(registry.IsCurrent(*ticket_a)); // second live GPU worker
    assert(registry.Register(&b));
    const auto ticket_b = registry.CaptureTicket(&b);
    assert(ticket_b && ticket_b->generation != ticket_a->generation);
    registry.Unregister(&b);
    assert(!registry.IsCurrent(*ticket_b));
    registry.Unregister(&a);
    assert(!registry.CaptureTicket(&a));
    assert(!registry.IsCurrent(*ticket_a)); // teardown
    assert(registry.Register(&a));
    const auto ticket_reopened = registry.CaptureTicket(&a);
    assert(ticket_reopened && ticket_reopened->generation != ticket_a->generation);
    assert(!registry.IsCurrent(*ticket_a)); // same KProcess* reused
    assert(registry.IsCurrent(*ticket_reopened));

    // A still-live owning session holds an immutable ticket across
    // concurrent secondary-worker opening and closing.
    std::atomic<bool> failed{false};
    std::vector<std::thread> workers;
    for (int t = 0; t < 4; ++t) {
        workers.emplace_back([&] {
            for (int i = 0; i < 2000; ++i) {
                if (!registry.Register(&a) || !registry.IsCurrent(*ticket_reopened))
                    failed.store(true, std::memory_order_relaxed);
                registry.Unregister(&a);
                if (!registry.IsCurrent(*ticket_reopened))
                    failed.store(true, std::memory_order_relaxed);
            }
        });
    }
    for (auto& worker : workers) worker.join();
    assert(!failed.load());
    assert(registry.Count() == 1);

    // Bounded tracking cannot admit more than 256 simultaneous owners.
    // Allocation/teardown of unique pointers stays under explicit ownership.
    Kernel::KProcess processes[256]{};
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < 255; ++i)
        assert(registry.Register(&processes[i]));
    assert(registry.Count() == 256);
    assert(!registry.Register(&c));
    assert(!registry.CaptureTicket(&c));
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < 255; ++i)
        registry.Unregister(&processes[i]);
    registry.Unregister(&a);
    assert(!registry.IsCurrent(*ticket_reopened));
    assert(registry.Count() == 0);
    std::puts("NS2 GPU session registry: PASS (ownership, stale/reopen, concurrent workers, 256 cap)");
}
```

`tools/ns2/test_native_gpu_registration_alloc.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright 2026 Eden Encore Project
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Host execution of real process/channel/graphics/compute GPU registry owners.
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <new>

#include "core/hle/service/nvdrv/devices/native_gpu_channel_registry.h"

namespace Kernel { class KProcess {}; }
namespace Tegra::Control { struct ChannelState {}; }

namespace {
std::atomic<bool> fail_next_allocation{false};
void FailOnce() { fail_next_allocation.store(true, std::memory_order_relaxed); }
void ConfirmConsumed() { assert(!fail_next_allocation.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)); }
} // namespace
void* operator new(std::size_t size) {
    if (fail_next_allocation.exchange(false, std::memory_order_relaxed))
        throw std::bad_alloc{};
    if (void* ptr=std::malloc(size ? size : 1)) return ptr;
    throw std::bad_alloc{};
}
void operator delete(void* ptr) noexcept { std::free(ptr); }
void operator delete(void* ptr,std::size_t) noexcept { std::free(ptr); }

int main() {
    using namespace Service::Nvidia::Devices;
    auto& processes=NativeGpuProcessRegistry::Instance();
    auto& channels=NativeGpuChannelRegistry::Instance();
    Kernel::KProcess process{}, other_process{};
    Tegra::Control::ChannelState channel{}, other_channel{};
    int graphics{}, compute{}, second_graphics{}, second_compute{};
    assert(processes.Count()==0);
    // 1. Process registration does not publish an empty epoch after failure.
    FailOnce();
    assert(!processes.Register(&process));
    ConfirmConsumed();
    assert(processes.Count()==0 && !processes.CaptureTicket(&process));
    assert(processes.Register(&process));
    const auto process_ticket=processes.CaptureTicket(&process);
    assert(process_ticket && process_ticket->generation==1);
    // 2. Failed channel map insertion must not consume a new generation.
    FailOnce();
    assert(!channels.Bind(&channel,&process));
    ConfirmConsumed();
    assert(!channels.IsNative(&channel));
    assert(channels.Bind(&channel,&process));
    const auto ticket=channels.CaptureTicket(&channel);
    assert(ticket && ticket->generation==process_ticket->generation &&
           ticket->channel_generation==1);
    // 3. Engine binds reject guest-controlled map allocation failures,
    // without publishing the engine or poisoning an existing channel.
    FailOnce();
    assert(!channels.BindGraphicsEngine(&channel,&graphics,2));
    ConfirmConsumed();
    assert(!channels.CaptureGraphicsTicket(&graphics));
    assert(channels.IsCurrent(&channel,*ticket));
    assert(channels.BindGraphicsEngine(&channel,&graphics,2));
    const auto graphics_ticket=channels.CaptureGraphicsTicket(&graphics);
    assert(graphics_ticket && graphics_ticket->channel_generation==1);
    FailOnce();
    assert(!channels.BindComputeEngine(&channel,&compute,4));
    ConfirmConsumed();
    assert(!channels.CaptureComputeTicket(&compute));
    assert(channels.BindComputeEngine(&channel,&compute,4));
    const auto compute_ticket=channels.CaptureComputeTicket(&compute);
    assert(compute_ticket && channels.IsComputeCurrent(&compute,*compute_ticket));
    assert(channels.IsGraphicsCurrent(&graphics,*graphics_ticket));
    // 4. A distinct process registration can fail without invalidating
    // existing channel/engine process epochs.
    FailOnce();
    assert(!processes.Register(&other_process));
    ConfirmConsumed();
    assert(processes.Count()==1 && channels.IsCurrent(&channel,*ticket) &&
           channels.IsComputeCurrent(&compute,*compute_ticket) &&
           channels.IsGraphicsCurrent(&graphics,*graphics_ticket));
    // Same-channel rebind is an existing map node and must not allocate.
    assert(channels.Bind(&channel,&process));
    // 5. Once unbound, all captured shader tickets stay invalid even if the
    // same pointer/guest process is reintroduced with a new channel epoch.
    channels.Unbind(&channel);
    assert(!channels.IsNative(&channel));
    assert(!channels.IsGraphicsCurrent(&graphics,*graphics_ticket));
    assert(!channels.IsComputeCurrent(&compute,*compute_ticket));
    assert(channels.Bind(&channel,&process));
    const auto reopened=channels.CaptureTicket(&channel);
    assert(reopened && reopened->channel_generation==2);
    assert(!channels.IsCurrent(&channel,*ticket));
    assert(!channels.CaptureGraphicsTicket(&graphics));
    assert(!channels.CaptureComputeTicket(&compute));
    // 6. A failed second channel cannot corrupt first channel’s bindings.
    FailOnce();
    assert(!channels.Bind(&other_channel,&process));
    ConfirmConsumed();
    assert(channels.IsCurrent(&channel,*reopened) && !channels.IsNative(&other_channel));
    assert(channels.Bind(&other_channel,&process));
    const auto sibling=channels.CaptureTicket(&other_channel);
    assert(sibling && sibling->channel_generation==3);
    assert(channels.BindGraphicsEngine(&channel,&second_graphics,1));
    assert(channels.BindComputeEngine(&other_channel,&second_compute,1));
    channels.Unbind(&other_channel);
    assert(channels.IsCurrent(&channel,*reopened));
    assert(!channels.CaptureComputeTicket(&second_compute));
    channels.Unbind(&channel);
    processes.Unregister(&process);
    assert(processes.Count()==0 && !processes.IsCurrent(*process_ticket));
    assert(!channels.IsCurrent(&channel,*reopened));
    return 0;
}
```

`tools/ns2/test_native_gpu_submission.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#include <array>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>

#include "core/hle/service/nvdrv/devices/native_gpu_process_registry.h"
#include "core/hle/service/nvdrv/devices/native_gpu_submission.h"

namespace N = Service::Nvidia::Devices;

static void require(bool ok, const char* message) {
    if (!ok) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "NS2 native GPFIFO: FAILED: %s\n", message);
        std::exit(1);
    }
}
int main() {
    alignas(std::max_align_t) std::array<unsigned char, 128> storage{};
    auto* p = reinterpret_cast<Kernel::KProcess*>(storage.data());
    auto* q = reinterpret_cast<Kernel::KProcess*>(storage.data() + 32);
    auto& registry = N::NativeGpuProcessRegistry::Instance();
    require(!registry.Contains(nullptr) && !registry.Contains(p) &&
            registry.Count() == 0, "default deny before GPU session bootstrap");
    require(!registry.Register(nullptr), "reject null process");
    require(registry.Register(p) && registry.Register(p) &&
            registry.Register(q) && registry.Count() == 2,
            "refcount multiple GPU sessions for one process");
    registry.Unregister(p);
    require(registry.Contains(p), "one owner keeps process native mode");
    registry.Unregister(p);
    require(!registry.Contains(p) && registry.Contains(q),
            "release only final process owner");
    registry.Unregister(p);
    registry.Unregister(q);
    require(registry.Count() == 0, "process register/unregister cleanup");

    require(!N::PlanNativeSubmission(0, 0, false),
            "native command rejected until channel GMMU initialized");
    require(!N::PlanNativeSubmission(1u | 0x100u, 2, true),
            "cannot acquire fence and issue native completion simultaneously");
    require(!N::PlanNativeSubmission(0x100u, 65, true),
            "native completion capped at 64");
    require(!N::PlanNativeSubmission(0x400u, 0, true),
            "unknown native fence flag is rejected");
    const auto native = N::PlanNativeSubmission(0x100u, 3, true);
    require(native && native->completion_count == 3 &&
            native->increment_total == 3,
            "native 3-count completion follows GPU work");
    const auto legacyStyle = N::PlanNativeSubmission(2u | 0x100u, 7, true);
    require(legacyStyle && legacyStyle->completion_count == 7 &&
            legacyStyle->increment_total == 9,
            "combined native and normal fence emits all nine promised increments");
    // Regression: native max incremented by 9, ordered queue must emit 2+7.
    for (std::uint32_t count = 0; count <= 64; ++count) {
        const auto mixed = N::PlanNativeSubmission(2u | 0x100u, count, true);
        require(mixed && mixed->completion_count == count &&
                mixed->increment_total == count + 2,
                "mixed fence count exactly matches scheduled queue increments");
    }
    const auto fence = N::PlanNativeSubmission(2u | 16u, 0, true);
    require(fence && fence->completion_count == 0 &&
            fence->increment_total == 2,
            "WFI suppression preserves two legacy fence increments");
    const auto noFence = N::PlanNativeSubmission(0, 0, true);
    require(noFence && noFence->increment_total == 0,
            "empty native submission does not fabricate a fence");
    // P2.7: this exact helper is invoked by the real native H:0x1b
    // kickoff owner before ReadBlock or any GPU queue submission.
    // Fence-only submission must never dereference a guest pointer.
    unsigned range_checks = 0;
    const auto mapped = [&](std::uint64_t address, std::size_t bytes) {
        ++range_checks;
        return address == 0x1000 && bytes == 16;
    };
    require(N::NativeGpfifoGuestHeadersReadable(0, 0, 8, mapped) &&
            range_checks == 0,
            "zero-entry fence-only submission does not access guest RAM");
    require(N::NativeGpfifoGuestHeadersReadable(0x1000, 2, 8, mapped) &&
            range_checks == 1,
            "full two-header guest span admitted in the owning process");
    require(!N::NativeGpfifoGuestHeadersReadable(0x1000, 1, 8, mapped) &&
            range_checks == 2,
            "partial mapping is not enough to acknowledge a native submit");
    require(!N::NativeGpfifoGuestHeadersReadable(0, 1, 8, mapped) &&
            range_checks == 2,
            "missing guest pointer rejected before map lookup");
    require(!N::NativeGpfifoGuestHeadersReadable(
                std::numeric_limits<std::uint64_t>::max() - 7, 2, 8, mapped) &&
            range_checks == 2,
            "guest start plus command bytes cannot overflow 64-bit VA");
    require(!N::NativeGpfifoGuestHeadersReadable(
                0x1000, 2, std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max(), mapped) &&
            range_checks == 2,
            "count multiplied by command width cannot overflow size_t");
    require(!N::NativeGpfifoGuestHeadersReadable(0x1000, 1, 0, mapped) &&
            range_checks == 2,
            "zero-sized command headers rejected");
    std::puts("NS2 process-scoped native GPFIFO preflight: PASS");
}
```

`tools/ns2/test_native_gpu_va_layout.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Host-only native GMMU VA fixture; does not submit GPU commands.
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include "core/hle/service/nvdrv/devices/native_gpu_va_layout.h"

using Service::Nvidia::Devices::PlanNativeGpuVaLayout;
using Service::Nvidia::Devices::NativePinnedPhysicalSpan;
using Service::Nvidia::Devices::NativeNs2GpuVaStart;
using Service::Nvidia::Devices::NativeNs2GpuVaSmallSplit;
using Service::Nvidia::Devices::NativeNs2GpuVaEnd;
int main() {
    const auto defaults = PlanNativeGpuVaLayout(0x8000000, 1ULL << 34, 1ULL << 37, 0x20000);
    assert(defaults && defaults->small_begin == 32768 &&
           defaults->small_end == 4194304 && defaults->big_begin == 131072 &&
           defaults->big_end == 1048576);
    // The 37-bit Maxwell default cannot contain a 0x81_0000_0000 GPU-only
    // render target. The NS2-only session uses 40-bit VA with 4K pages high
    // enough for it, while the second partition remains a valid big-page VA.
    const auto ns2 = PlanNativeGpuVaLayout(
        NativeNs2GpuVaStart, NativeNs2GpuVaSmallSplit,
        NativeNs2GpuVaEnd, 0x20000);
    constexpr std::uint64_t gpu_only_target = 0x8100000000ULL;
    assert(ns2 && gpu_only_target >= NativeNs2GpuVaStart &&
           gpu_only_target + 0x20000000ULL < NativeNs2GpuVaSmallSplit &&
           NativeNs2GpuVaSmallSplit < NativeNs2GpuVaEnd);
    assert(std::uint64_t{ns2->small_end} * 0x1000 == NativeNs2GpuVaSmallSplit);
    assert(std::uint64_t{ns2->big_end} * 0x20000 == NativeNs2GpuVaEnd);
    // Both FlatAllocator limits are absolute; a relative (end-split)
    // calculation would incorrectly return half this custom large-page end.
    const auto custom = PlanNativeGpuVaLayout(0x1000000, 1ULL << 30, 1ULL << 31, 0x10000);
    assert(custom && custom->big_begin == 16384 && custom->big_end == 32768);
    assert(!PlanNativeGpuVaLayout(0x8000000, 1ULL << 37, 1ULL << 34, 0x20000));
    assert(!PlanNativeGpuVaLayout(0x8000000, 1ULL << 34, 1ULL << 34, 0x20000));
    assert(!PlanNativeGpuVaLayout(0, 1ULL << 34, 1ULL << 37, 0x20000));
    assert(!PlanNativeGpuVaLayout(0x8000001, 1ULL << 34, 1ULL << 37, 0x20000));
    assert(!PlanNativeGpuVaLayout(0x8000000, (1ULL << 34) + 0x1000, 1ULL << 37, 0x20000));
    assert(!PlanNativeGpuVaLayout(0x8000000, 1ULL << 34, (1ULL << 37) + 0x1000, 0x20000));
    assert(!PlanNativeGpuVaLayout(0x8000000, 1ULL << 45, 1ULL << 46, 0x20000));
    assert(!PlanNativeGpuVaLayout(0x8000000, 1ULL << 34, 1ULL << 37, 0x40000));
    // Physical NVMap bases and suballocation offsets must never wrap.
    // Exercise both exact half-open endpoints and overflow by one byte.
    constexpr auto max = std::uint64_t{~std::uint64_t{0}};
    static_assert(NativePinnedPhysicalSpan(1, 0, max - 1));
    static_assert(NativePinnedPhysicalSpan(0x1000, 0x2000, 0x4000));
    static_assert(!NativePinnedPhysicalSpan(0, 0, 0x1000));
    static_assert(!NativePinnedPhysicalSpan(1, 0, 0));
    static_assert(!NativePinnedPhysicalSpan(max - 2, 3, 1));
    static_assert(!NativePinnedPhysicalSpan(max - 2, 1, 2));
    assert(NativePinnedPhysicalSpan(max - 2, 1, 1));
    assert(!NativePinnedPhysicalSpan(0x1000, max - 0x1000, 1));
    std::puts("NS2 pinned physical spans: PASS (exact-end/overflows)");
    std::puts("NS2 real 4K GMMU page partitions: PASS");
}
```

```cpp
// Native Ampere stage admission must never invent a missing pipeline/QMD.
#include <cassert>
#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/native_graphics_stage_policy.h"
int main() {

    assert(!IsStandaloneNativeGraphicsStage(Stage::TessellationEval));
```

`tools/ns2/test_native_lepc_capture.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Real Ampere graphics guest-PC capture, lowering, image, and LRU witnesses.
// Synthetic LEPC/EXIT shader; this does NOT execute a PS5/Vulkan shader.
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <span>
#include <vector>

#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/capture.h"
#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/translation_cache.h"
#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/lower_to_maxwell.h"
#include "shader_recompiler/stage.h"

using namespace Shader::Ampere;
static constexpr u32 pt=7U<<12;
static constexpr Instruction Nop{{pt|0x918U,0,0,0x000fea00U}};
static constexpr Instruction Lepc{{pt|0x34eU|(4U<<16),0,0,0x000fea00U}};
static constexpr Instruction Exit{{pt|0x94dU,0,7U<<23,0x000fea00U}};
static void Append(std::vector<u8>& out, Instruction instruction) {
    for (u32 word:instruction.words)
        for (u32 shift=0;shift<32;shift+=8)
            out.push_back(static_cast<u8>(word>>shift));
}
struct Reader {
    u64 gpu_base{};
    std::vector<u8> memory{};
    u32 reads{};
};
static bool Read(void* context,u64 address,void* data,std::size_t size) {
    auto& reader=*static_cast<Reader*>(context);
    ++reader.reads;
    if (!data || address<reader.gpu_base || !size) return false;
    const u64 offset=address-reader.gpu_base;
    if (offset>reader.memory.size() || size>reader.memory.size()-offset) return false;
    std::memcpy(data,reader.memory.data()+offset,size);
    return true;
}
static void Require(bool b,const char* why) {
    if (!b) {std::fprintf(stderr,"LEPC failure: %s\n",why); std::abort();}
}
static u32 EncodedImmediate(u64 word) {
    return static_cast<u32>((word>>20)&0xffffffffU);
}
int main() {
    const std::array shader{Nop,Lepc,Exit};
    constexpr u64 baseA=0x13000000400ULL;
    constexpr u64 baseB=0x14000000400ULL;
    constexpr u64 codeA=baseA+0x80U;
    constexpr u64 codeB=baseB+0x80U;
    const auto directA=LowerToMaxwell(shader,{},false,{},codeA);
    const auto directB=LowerToMaxwell(shader,{},false,{},codeB);
    Require(directA && directB,"real LowerToMaxwell accepts checked guest PC");
    Require(directA.source_instruction_offsets.size()==shader.size(),
            "source PC map accounts for the LEPC instruction");
    const u32 ai=directA.source_instruction_offsets[1];
    const u32 bi=directB.source_instruction_offsets[1];
    const u64 guest_pc_A=codeA+16;
    const u64 guest_pc_B=codeB+16;
    Require(ai+2==directA.source_instruction_offsets[2],
            "native LEPC is exactly two Maxwell MOV immediates");
    Require((directA.instructions[ai]&0xffU)==4 &&
            (directA.instructions[ai+1]&0xffU)==5 &&
            EncodedImmediate(directA.instructions[ai])==
              static_cast<u32>(guest_pc_A) &&
            EncodedImmediate(directA.instructions[ai+1])==
              static_cast<u32>(guest_pc_A>>32),
            "LEPC materializes actual 64-bit native guest PC, not Maxwell PC");
    Require(EncodedImmediate(directB.instructions[bi+1])==
            static_cast<u32>(guest_pc_B>>32) &&
            directB.instructions[bi+1]!=directA.instructions[ai+1],
            "same shader bytes at different guest VA yields distinct PC");
    const auto unavailable=LowerToMaxwell(shader);
    Require(!unavailable && unavailable.error==
        "native dynamic program counter unsupported",
        "source-only LEPC cannot manufacture a zero/translated guest PC");
    Require(!LowerToMaxwell(shader,{},false,{},u64{1}<<49),
            "out-of-range GPU code VA rejected before MOV");
    auto malformed=Lepc;
    malformed.words[1]=1;
    Require(!LowerToMaxwell(std::array{Nop,malformed,Exit},
                           {},false,{},codeA),
            "unknown LEPC offset mode must fail closed");
    // Predicated LEPC writes the authenticated PC as TWO equally predicated
    // Maxwell MOV instructions; a false predicate must preserve both GPRs.
    for (const u32 execution : std::array{6U,14U}) {
        auto predicated=Lepc;
        predicated.words[0]=(predicated.words[0]&~0xf000U)|(execution<<12);
        const std::array source{Nop,predicated,Exit};
        const auto lowered=LowerToMaxwell(source,{},false,{},codeA);
        Require(bool(lowered),"predicated LEPC needs authenticated GMMU PC");
        const u32 pos=lowered.source_instruction_offsets[1];
        Require(pos+2==lowered.source_instruction_offsets[2],
                "predicated LEPC emits two Maxwell MOVs");
        for (u32 word=0;word<2;++word) {
            const u64 emitted=lowered.instructions[pos+word];
            Require(((emitted>>16)&15U)==execution &&
                    (emitted&255U)==4U+word &&
                    EncodedImmediate(emitted)==
                        static_cast<u32>(guest_pc_A>>(32*word)),
                    "both halves retain source predicate and PC");
        }
        Require(!LowerToMaxwell(source),
                "predicated LEPC without authenticated GMMU PC must refuse");
        const auto relocated=LowerToMaxwell(source,{},false,{},codeB);
        Require(bool(relocated) &&
                relocated.instructions[relocated.source_instruction_offsets[1]+1]!=
                    lowered.instructions[pos+1],
                "predicated LEPC cannot reuse another guest code VA");
    }
    auto invalid_predicate=Lepc;
    invalid_predicate.words[0]=(invalid_predicate.words[0]&~0xf000U)|(15U<<12);
    Require(!LowerToMaxwell(std::array{Nop,invalid_predicate,Exit},
                           {},false,{},codeA),
            "inverted PT is not a reviewed execution predicate");
    auto high=Lepc;
    high.words[0]=(high.words[0]&0xff00ffffU)|(252U<<16);
    Require(!LowerToMaxwell(std::array{Nop,high,Exit},
                           {},false,{},codeA),
            "LEPC pair cannot alias Maxwell high scratch");

    std::array<u8,0x50> header{};
    std::vector<u8> native;
    for (const auto instruction:shader) Append(native,instruction);
    const u32 geom=static_cast<u32>(Shader::Stage::Geometry);
    const u32 vert=static_cast<u32>(Shader::Stage::VertexB);
    const u32 compute=static_cast<u32>(Shader::Stage::Compute);
    const std::array stages{
        static_cast<u32>(Shader::Stage::VertexA),
        vert,static_cast<u32>(Shader::Stage::TessellationControl),
        static_cast<u32>(Shader::Stage::TessellationEval),geom,
        static_cast<u32>(Shader::Stage::Fragment)};
    const auto without_pc=BuildMaxwellShaderImage(header,native,geom);
    const auto direct_image_A=BuildMaxwellShaderImage(header,native,geom,{},codeA);
    const auto direct_image_B=BuildMaxwellShaderImage(header,native,geom,{},codeB);
    for (u32 stage : stages) {
        const auto stage_image=BuildMaxwellShaderImage(header,native,stage,{},codeA);
        Require(stage_image.ValidForCompiler(),
                "every known graphics stage uses its own real guest PC");
    }
    Require(!BuildMaxwellShaderImage(header,native,compute,{},codeA).Ready(),
            "Compute must not fabricate a graphics shader header/LEPC PC");
    // The common NS1 Stage enum ends at VertexA. Native Task/Mesh use
    // the reviewed appended 7/8 wire IDs, without changing the NS1 enum.
    // Check their actual lowering as well as the first unknown stage (9).
    constexpr u32 task_stage = static_cast<u32>(Shader::Stage::VertexA) + 1U;
    constexpr u32 mesh_stage = task_stage + 1U;
    constexpr u32 unknown_stage = mesh_stage + 1U;
    Require(BuildMaxwellShaderImage(header,native,task_stage,{},codeA).ValidForCompiler() &&
            BuildMaxwellShaderImage(header,native,mesh_stage,{},codeA).ValidForCompiler(),
            "native task/mesh wire IDs preserve LEPC authenticated guest PC");
    Require(!BuildMaxwellShaderImage(header,native,unknown_stage,{},codeA).Ready(),
            "unknown stage cannot opt into untrusted graphics source PC");
    Require(!without_pc.Ready() &&
            direct_image_A.ValidForCompiler() &&
            direct_image_B.ValidForCompiler() &&
            direct_image_A.diagnostic_cache_key!=
                direct_image_B.diagnostic_cache_key,
            "native shader code VA belongs to image key and valid CFG");
    NativeTranslationCache cache{1024*1024,8};
    const auto cachedA=cache.GetOrTranslate(header,native,geom,codeA);
    const auto cachedB=cache.GetOrTranslate(header,native,geom,codeB);
    const auto cachedAagain=cache.GetOrTranslate(header,native,geom,codeA);
    const auto stats=cache.Stats();
    Require(cachedA.Ready() && cachedB.Ready() && cachedAagain.Ready() &&
            cachedA.code!=cachedB.code && cachedA.code==cachedAagain.code &&
            stats.translations==2 && stats.hits==1 &&
            stats.entries==2,
            "LRU compares guest code base as well as full shader bytes");
    // The real source capture, not the test caller, supplies this PC and
    // uses the same GMMU mapping/authentication on every cache replay.
    Reader first{baseA,std::vector<u8>(0x80)};
    Reader second{baseB,std::vector<u8>(0x80)};
    for (const auto inst:shader) {
        Append(first.memory,inst);
        Append(second.memory,inst);
    }
    NativeTranslationCache capture_cache{1024*1024,8};
    const auto capA=CaptureNativeGraphicsShader(
        baseA,geom,Read,&first,&capture_cache);
    const auto capB=CaptureNativeGraphicsShader(
        baseB,geom,Read,&second,&capture_cache);
    const auto capAagain=CaptureNativeGraphicsShader(
        baseA,geom,Read,&first,&capture_cache);
    if (!capA.Ready() || !capB.Ready())
        std::fprintf(stderr,
            "Capture geometry LEPC statuses A=%u B=%u\n",
            static_cast<unsigned>(capA.status),static_cast<unsigned>(capB.status));
    Require(capA.Ready() && capB.Ready() && capAagain.Ready() &&
            capA.image.diagnostic_cache_key!=
                capB.image.diagnostic_cache_key &&
            capture_cache.Stats().translations==2 &&
            capture_cache.Stats().hits==1 &&
            first.reads>0 && second.reads>0,
            "real GMMU capture pipes code PC into cache with revalidation");
    NativeTranslationCache stage_cache{1024*1024,16};
    std::vector<u64> distinct_stage_keys;
    for (const u32 stage : stages) {
        const auto staged=CaptureNativeGraphicsShader(
            baseA,stage,Read,&first,&stage_cache);
        const auto different_va=CaptureNativeGraphicsShader(
            baseB,stage,Read,&second,&stage_cache);
        Require(staged.Ready() && different_va.Ready(),
                "every graphics stage captures authenticated GMMU LEPC");
        Require(staged.image.diagnostic_cache_key !=
                    different_va.image.diagnostic_cache_key,
                "LEPC shader at two guest VAs has distinct compiled identity");
        for (u64 key : distinct_stage_keys)
            Require(key != staged.image.diagnostic_cache_key,
                    "LEPC image identity must encode graphics stage");
        distinct_stage_keys.push_back(staged.image.diagnostic_cache_key);
    }
    Require(distinct_stage_keys.size()==6 &&
            stage_cache.Stats().translations==12 &&
            !CaptureNativeGraphicsShader(baseA,compute,Read,&first).Ready(),
            "only six recognized graphics stages can use their GMMU PC");

    // Without any LEPC opcode the same byte-identical graphics shader
    // at different VAs is NOT address-dependent and can share its image.
    Reader no_pc_first{baseA,std::vector<u8>(0x80)};
    Reader no_pc_second{baseB,std::vector<u8>(0x80)};
    for (const auto inst : std::array{Nop,Exit}) {
        Append(no_pc_first.memory,inst);
        Append(no_pc_second.memory,inst);
    }
    NativeTranslationCache no_pc_cache{1024*1024,8};
    const auto without_lepc_a=CaptureNativeGraphicsShader(
        baseA,vert,Read,&no_pc_first,&no_pc_cache);
    const auto without_lepc_b=CaptureNativeGraphicsShader(
        baseB,vert,Read,&no_pc_second,&no_pc_cache);
    Require(without_lepc_a.Ready() && without_lepc_b.Ready() &&
            without_lepc_a.image.diagnostic_cache_key ==
                without_lepc_b.image.diagnostic_cache_key &&
            no_pc_cache.Stats().translations==1 &&
            no_pc_cache.Stats().hits==1,
            "LEPC-free shaders preserve shared cache reuse across guest VAs");
    // Capture has a true guest VA only while GMMU memory exists.
    first.memory.resize(0x80+16);
    const auto invalidated=CaptureNativeGraphicsShader(
        baseA,geom,Read,&first,&capture_cache);
    Require(!invalidated.Ready(),
            "unmapped LEPC instruction never served from a stale LRU");
    std::puts("P2_4_NATIVE_LEPC_GMMU_CAPTURE_PASS guest_pc_64=1"
              " graphics_stages=6 compute_rejected=1"
              " pc_sensitive_only_when_LEPC=1 verified_cache_key=1"
              " source_replay=1 out_of_range_refused=1 ns1_unchanged=1");
}
```

`tools/ns2/test_native_nvdrv_allocation_range.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Exercise the exact NS2 NVDRV fixed/remap allocation-range helper.
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <limits>
#include <map>
#include <random>
#include "core/hle/service/nvdrv/devices/native_gpu_allocation_range.h"

using u64 = std::uint64_t;
using Service::Nvidia::Devices::NativeGpuAllocation::FindContaining;
using Service::Nvidia::Devices::NativeGpuAllocation::ContainsSubrange;
static_assert(ContainsSubrange(0x4000,0x1000,0x3000));
static_assert(!ContainsSubrange(0x4000,0x1000,0x3001));
static_assert(!ContainsSubrange(0x4000,0x4000,1));
static_assert(!ContainsSubrange(0x4000,0,0));
static_assert(!ContainsSubrange(UINT64_MAX,UINT64_MAX,2));
struct Allocation { u64 size; };
using Allocations = std::map<u64, Allocation>;
static constexpr u64 Limit = u64{1} << 49;

static Allocations::iterator Oracle(Allocations& blocks, u64 address, u64 bytes) {
    if (!bytes || address >= Limit || bytes > Limit - address) return blocks.end();
    for (auto it = blocks.begin(); it != blocks.end(); ++it) {
        if (it->first >= Limit || it->second.size > Limit - it->first) continue;
        if (address < it->first) continue;
        const u64 offset = address - it->first;
        if (offset < it->second.size && bytes <= it->second.size - offset)
            return it;
    }
    return blocks.end();
}

static void Check(Allocations& blocks, u64 address, u64 bytes) {
    const auto previous_size = blocks.size();
    const auto actual = FindContaining(blocks, address, bytes);
    const auto expected = Oracle(blocks, address, bytes);
    assert((actual == blocks.end()) == (expected == blocks.end()));
    if (actual != blocks.end()) assert(actual->first == expected->first);
    assert(blocks.size() == previous_size);
}

int main() {
    Allocations empty;
    Check(empty, 0, 4096);
    Check(empty, (std::numeric_limits<u64>::max)(), 4096);
    Check(empty, 4096, 0);
    Allocations blocks;
    blocks.emplace(0x10000, Allocation{0x4000});
    blocks.emplace(0x30000, Allocation{0x8000});
    blocks.emplace(0x50000, Allocation{0x1000});
    // Empty/before-begin, after-end, gaps, exact start/end, and overflow.
    for (u64 address : {u64{0}, u64{0xffff}, u64{0x10000},
         u64{0x13fff}, u64{0x14000}, u64{0x2ffff},
         u64{0x30000}, u64{0x37fff}, u64{0x38000},
         u64{0x50000}, u64{0x50fff}, u64{0x51000},
         Limit-1, Limit, Limit+1, (std::numeric_limits<u64>::max)()}) {
        for (u64 bytes : {u64{0}, u64{1}, u64{4096}, u64{0x4000},
                          u64{0x8000}, (std::numeric_limits<u64>::max)()})
            Check(blocks, address, bytes);
    }
    // A forged reservation crossing the GPU VA boundary is never valid.
    blocks.emplace(Limit-0x1000, Allocation{0x2000});
    Check(blocks, Limit-0x1000, 1);
    blocks.erase(Limit-0x1000);
    blocks.emplace(Limit-0x4000, Allocation{0x4000});
    Check(blocks, Limit-0x4000, 0x4000);
    Check(blocks, Limit-0x4000, 0x4001);

    std::mt19937_64 rng{0xA9B74C132ULL};
    for (int i=0;i<15000;++i) {
        // Adjacent, missing, shortened and oversized native ioctl ranges.
        const u64 index = rng() % 9;
        const u64 start = 0x10000 + (index * 0x10000);
        if (i%3==0)
            blocks.insert_or_assign(start, Allocation{(1+(rng()%12))*4096});
        else if (i%17==0) blocks.erase(start);
        const u64 address = (i%11==0) ? rng()
            : (start + (rng()%0x10000));
        const u64 length = (i%23==0)
            ? (std::numeric_limits<u64>::max)() : (rng()%0x20001);
        Check(blocks, address, length);
    }
    std::puts("P1_2_NVDRV_ALLOCATION_RANGE_HOST_PASS");
}
```
