```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Host-only stand-in for NPDM parsing, not a substitute for the real parser.
#pragma once
#include <string>
#include <utility>
#include "core/loader/loader.h"

namespace FileSys {
class ProgramMetadata {
public:
    Loader::ResultStatus Load(VirtualFile file) {
        if (!file) return Loader::ResultStatus::ErrorMissingNPDM;
        std::string data(file->GetSize(), '\0');
        if (!data.empty() &&
            file->Read(reinterpret_cast<u8*>(data.data()), data.size(), 0) != data.size())
            return Loader::ResultStatus::ErrorBadNPDMHeader;
        if (data == "latest-npdm") {
            program_id_ = 0x0100123400000000ULL;
        } else if (data == "foreign-npdm") {
            program_id_ = 0x0100123400002000ULL;
        } else if (data == "sibling-npdm") {
            program_id_ = 0x0100123400000001ULL;
        } else {
            return Loader::ResultStatus::ErrorBadNPDMHeader;
        }
        return Loader::ResultStatus::Success;
    }
    u64 GetTitleID() const { return program_id_; }
private:
    u64 program_id_{};
};
} // namespace FileSys
```

`tools/nup-native-host-stub/core/file_sys/vfs/vfs.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Host test substitute, kept separate from the real vendor implementation.
#pragma once
#include "core/file_sys/vfs/vfs_types.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstring>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>
namespace FileSys {
class VfsFile {
public:
    virtual ~VfsFile() = default;
    virtual std::string GetName() const = 0;
    virtual std::size_t GetSize() const = 0;
    virtual bool Resize(std::size_t) = 0;
    virtual VirtualDir GetContainingDirectory() const = 0;
    virtual bool IsWritable() const = 0;
    virtual bool IsReadable() const = 0;
    virtual std::size_t Read(u8*, std::size_t, std::size_t) const = 0;
    template <typename T> std::size_t ReadObject(T* output,
                                                  std::size_t offset = 0) const {
        return Read(reinterpret_cast<u8*>(output), sizeof(T), offset);
    }
    virtual std::optional<u8> ReadByte(std::size_t offset) const {
        u8 value{};
        return Read(&value, 1, offset) == 1 ?
               std::optional<u8>(value) : std::nullopt;
    }
    virtual std::vector<u8> ReadBytes(std::size_t length, std::size_t offset) const {
        std::vector<u8> result(length);
        const auto count = length ? Read(result.data(), length, offset) : 0;
        result.resize(count);
        return result;
    }
    virtual std::vector<u8> ReadAllBytes() const {
        return ReadBytes(GetSize(), 0);
    }
    virtual std::size_t Write(const u8*, std::size_t, std::size_t) = 0;
    virtual bool WriteByte(u8 value, std::size_t offset) {
        return Write(&value, 1, offset) == 1;
    }
    virtual std::size_t WriteBytes(const std::vector<u8>& bytes,
                                   std::size_t offset) {
        return Write(bytes.data(), bytes.size(), offset);
    }
    virtual bool Rename(std::string_view) = 0;
};
class VfsDirectory {
public:
    virtual ~VfsDirectory() = default;
    virtual std::vector<VirtualFile> GetFiles() const = 0;
    virtual std::vector<VirtualDir> GetSubdirectories() const = 0;
    virtual bool IsWritable() const = 0;
    virtual bool IsReadable() const = 0;
    virtual std::string GetName() const = 0;
    virtual VirtualDir GetParentDirectory() const = 0;
    virtual VirtualDir CreateSubdirectory(std::string_view) = 0;
    virtual VirtualFile CreateFile(std::string_view) = 0;
    virtual bool DeleteSubdirectory(std::string_view) = 0;
    virtual bool DeleteFile(std::string_view) = 0;
    virtual bool Rename(std::string_view) = 0;
    virtual VirtualFile GetFile(std::string_view name) const {
        for (auto& f : GetFiles()) if (f->GetName() == name) return f;
        return {};
    }
    virtual VirtualDir GetSubdirectory(std::string_view name) const {
        for (auto& d : GetSubdirectories()) if (d->GetName() == name) return d;
        return {};
    }
};
class ReadOnlyVfsDirectory : public VfsDirectory {
public:
    bool IsWritable() const override { return false; }
    bool IsReadable() const override { return true; }
    VirtualDir CreateSubdirectory(std::string_view) override { return {}; }
    VirtualFile CreateFile(std::string_view) override { return {}; }
    bool DeleteSubdirectory(std::string_view) override { return false; }
    bool DeleteFile(std::string_view) override { return false; }
    bool Rename(std::string_view) override { return false; }
};
} // namespace FileSys
```

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Host-only stand-in: the vendor VectorVfsFile owns bytes in memory.
#pragma once
#include <algorithm>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>
#include "core/file_sys/vfs/vfs.h"
namespace FileSys {
class VectorVfsFile final : public VfsFile {
public:
    explicit VectorVfsFile(std::vector<u8> data = {},
                           std::string name = "",
                           VirtualDir parent = nullptr)
        : bytes_(std::move(data)), name_(std::move(name)), parent_(std::move(parent)) {}
    std::string GetName() const override { return name_; }
    std::size_t GetSize() const override { return bytes_.size(); }
    bool Resize(std::size_t) override { return false; }
    VirtualDir GetContainingDirectory() const override { return parent_; }
    bool IsWritable() const override { return false; }
    bool IsReadable() const override { return true; }
    std::size_t Read(u8* target, std::size_t count, std::size_t offset) const override {
        if (offset > bytes_.size() || (!target && count)) return 0;
        const auto length = std::min(count, bytes_.size() - offset);
        if (length) std::copy_n(bytes_.begin() + offset, length, target);
        return length;
    }
    std::size_t Write(const u8*, std::size_t, std::size_t) override { return 0; }
    bool Rename(std::string_view) override { return false; }
private:
    std::vector<u8> bytes_;
    std::string name_;
    VirtualDir parent_;
};
} // namespace FileSys
```

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Host test implementation: validates pass-through, NOT real NSO/NPDM loading.
#pragma once
#include "core/loader/loader.h"
namespace Loader {
class AppLoader_DeconstructedRomDirectory final : public AppLoader {
public:
    explicit AppLoader_DeconstructedRomDirectory(FileSys::VirtualFile main,
                                                 bool override_update = false)
      : AppLoader(std::move(main)),
        directory_(file ? file->GetContainingDirectory() : nullptr),
        override_update_(override_update) {}
    explicit AppLoader_DeconstructedRomDirectory(FileSys::VirtualDir directory,
                                                 bool override_update = false)
      : AppLoader(directory ? directory->GetFile("main") : nullptr),
        directory_(std::move(directory)), override_update_(override_update) {}
    FileType GetFileType() const override { return FileType::DeconstructedRomDirectory; }
    LoadResult Load(Kernel::KProcess&, Core::System&) override {
        if (loaded_) return {ResultStatus::ErrorAlreadyLoaded, {}};
        if (override_update_ || !directory_ || !directory_->GetFile("main"))
            return {ResultStatus::ErrorNoExeFS, {}};
        if (!directory_->GetFile("main.npdm"))
            return {ResultStatus::ErrorMissingNPDM, {}};
        loaded_ = true;
        return {ResultStatus::Success, LoadParameters{1, 4096}};
    }
    ResultStatus ReadProgramId(std::uint64_t& id) override {
        id = 0x0100123400000000ULL;
        return ResultStatus::Success;
    }
    ResultStatus ReadTitle(std::string& name) override {
        name = "Synthetic Host App";
        return ResultStatus::Success;
    }
    ResultStatus ReadNSOModules(Modules& modules) override {
        if (!loaded_) return ResultStatus::ErrorNotInitialized;
        modules.emplace(0, "main");
        return ResultStatus::Success;
    }
private:
    FileSys::VirtualDir directory_;
    bool override_update_{};
    bool loaded_{};
};
} // namespace Loader
```

`tools/nup-v1-content-fixture.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Small deterministic NUP v1 fixture builder for inactive native content tests.

The payload bytes are synthetic; no console keys, proprietary game data or
unlicensed titles are needed. Layout follows NUP v1's verified parser.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
from hashlib import sha256
from pathlib import Path
import struct

NO_DIRECTORY = 0xFFFFFFFF


def build(packages: list[dict]) -> bytes:
    directories: list[tuple[str, dict]] = []
    roots = []

    def add_dir(name: str, node: dict) -> int:
        index = len(directories)
        directories.append((name, node))
        for sub_name, sub_node in sorted(node["dirs"].items()):
            add_dir(sub_name, sub_node)
        return index

    def tree(files: dict[str, bytes]) -> dict:
        root = {"dirs": {}, "files": {}}
        for path, data in files.items():
            names = path.split("/")
            assert all(n and n not in (".", "..") for n in names)
            current = root
            for name in names[:-1]:
                current = current["dirs"].setdefault(name, {"dirs": {}, "files": {}})
            assert names[-1] not in current["dirs"]
            current["files"][names[-1]] = data
        return root

    for package in packages:
        node = tree(package["files"])
        roots.append(add_dir("", node))

    directory_indices = {id(node): i for i, (_, node) in enumerate(directories)}
    files: list[tuple[str, bytes]] = []
    file_indices: dict[tuple[int, str], int] = {}
    for directory_id, (_, node) in enumerate(directories):
        for name, data in sorted(node["files"].items()):
            file_indices[(directory_id, name)] = len(files)
            files.append((name, data))
    nd, nf = len(directories), len(files)
    children = []
    dir_records = []
    for directory_id, (name, node) in enumerate(directories):
        entries = [(n, directory_indices[id(sub)]) for n, sub in node["dirs"].items()]
        entries += [(n, nd + file_indices[(directory_id, n)])
                    for n in node["files"]]
        entries.sort(key=lambda e: e[0].encode("utf-8"))
        first = len(children)
        children.extend(index for _, index in entries)
        dir_records.append((name, first, len(entries)))

    strings = bytearray()

    def name_bytes(name: str) -> tuple[int, int]:
        data = name.encode("utf-8")
        offset = len(strings)
        strings.extend(data)
        return offset, len(data)

    dir_names = [name_bytes(record[0]) for record in dir_records]
    file_names = [name_bytes(name) for name, _ in files]
    count = len(packages)
    dirs_at = 0x30 + count * 0x40
    files_at = dirs_at + nd * 0x18
    children_at = files_at + nf * 0x50
    strings_at = children_at + len(children) * 4
    toc_size = (strings_at + len(strings) + 15) & ~15
    blob_at = 0x80 + toc_size

    toc = bytearray(toc_size)
    struct.pack_into("<4sIQQQQQ", toc, 0, b"TOC\x01",
                     count, nd, nf, strings_at, len(strings), 0)
    uuid_input = bytearray()
    for i, package in enumerate(packages):
        p = 0x30 + i * 0x40
        node = directories[roots[i]][1]
        exefs = node["dirs"].get("exefs")
        romfs = node["dirs"].get("romfs")
        exefs_dir = directory_indices[id(exefs)] if exefs else NO_DIRECTORY
        romfs_dir = directory_indices[id(romfs)] if romfs else NO_DIRECTORY
        title_id, version, kind = (package[k] for k in ("title_id", "version", "kind"))
        struct.pack_into("<QIIII", toc, p, title_id, roots[i],
                         exefs_dir, romfs_dir, version)
        toc[p + 0x18] = kind
        toc[p + 0x19] = 1 if (kind == 1 and not any(
            pkg["kind"] == 0 for pkg in packages)) else 0
        uuid_input += struct.pack("<QIB", title_id, version, kind)

    for i, (name, first, count_children) in enumerate(dir_records):
        off, size = dir_names[i]
        struct.pack_into("<IIIIQ", toc, dirs_at + i * 0x18,
                         off, size, first, count_children, 0)
    for i, index in enumerate(children):
        struct.pack_into("<I", toc, children_at + i * 4, index)
    toc[strings_at:strings_at + len(strings)] = strings

    blobs = bytearray()
    for i, (_, data) in enumerate(files):
        file_at = files_at + i * 0x50
        offset, n = file_names[i]
        aligned = (blob_at + len(blobs) + 15) & ~15
        blobs.extend(bytes(aligned - (blob_at + len(blobs))))
        absolute = blob_at + len(blobs)
        struct.pack_into("<IIQQQ", toc, file_at, offset, n,
                         len(data), absolute if data else 0, len(data))
        toc[file_at + 0x20:file_at + 0x40] = sha256(data).digest()
        blobs.extend(data)

    # Optional raw NUP per-package TLVs are placed after the file payloads
    # (never overlapping a member extent); every record is size-delimited.
    for i, package in enumerate(packages):
        values = package.get("metadata", {})
        if not values:
            continue
        meta = bytearray()
        for kind, payload in sorted(values.items()):
            assert isinstance(kind, int) and isinstance(payload, bytes)
            meta += struct.pack("<HHI", kind, 0, len(payload)) + payload
        aligned = (blob_at + len(blobs) + 15) & ~15
        blobs.extend(bytes(aligned - (blob_at + len(blobs))))
        struct.pack_into("<QI", toc, 0x30 + i * 0x40 + 0x20,
                         blob_at + len(blobs), len(meta))
        blobs.extend(meta)

    header = bytearray(0x80)
    header[:4] = b"NUP\x01"
    struct.pack_into("<HHQQ", header, 4, 0x80, 1, 0x80, toc_size)
    header[0x18:0x38] = sha256(toc).digest()
    struct.pack_into("<QQII", header, 0x38, blob_at,
                     blob_at + len(blobs), len(packages), 0)
    header[0x50:0x60] = sha256(uuid_input).digest()[:16]
    return bytes(header + toc + blobs)


def localized(records: list[tuple[str, bytes]]) -> bytes:
    out = bytearray()
    for language, data in records:
        encoded = language.encode("ascii")
        assert 0 < len(encoded) <= 35
        out += bytes([len(encoded)]) + encoded + struct.pack("<I", len(data)) + data
    return bytes(out)


def executable_fixture() -> bytes:
    title = 0x0100123400000000
    return build([
        {"title_id": title, "version": 1, "kind": 0,
         "metadata": {
             0x0003: b"\xff\xd8\xff" + b"synthetic-jpeg",
             0x0004: b"3.0.0",
             0x0005: b"Demo / Game",
             0x0006: b"Example Publisher",
             0x0009: localized([
                 ("en-us", b"Demo Game (US)"),
                 ("fr", "Démo / Jeu".encode("utf-8")),
             ]),
             0x000A: localized([
                 ("fr", bytes.fromhex("89504e470d0a1a0a") + b"synthetic-png"),
             ]),
             0x8000: b"unknown-type-is-ignored",
         },
         "files": {
            "exefs/main": b"base-main",
            "exefs/main.npdm": b"base-npdm",
            "romfs/state.bin": b"base-v1",
            "romfs/sub/base.dat": b"base-only",
        }},
        {"title_id": title + 0x800, "version": 3, "kind": 1,
         "metadata": {0x0005: b"Wrong update title"},
         "files": {
            "exefs/main": b"latest-main",
            "exefs/main.npdm": b"latest-npdm",
            "romfs/state.bin": b"latest-v3",
            "romfs/sub/update.dat": b"update-only",
        }},
        {"title_id": title + 0x800, "version": 2, "kind": 1, "files": {
            "exefs/main": b"older-main",
            "romfs/state.bin": b"older-v2",
        }},
        {"title_id": title + 0x1000, "version": 0, "kind": 2, "files": {
            "romfs/addon.dat": b"addon-one",
        }},
        {"title_id": title + 0x1001, "version": 0, "kind": 2, "files": {
            "romfs/addon.dat": b"addon-two",
        }},
        # Highest revision of the first DLC replaces its older package.
        {"title_id": title + 0x1000, "version": 2, "kind": 2, "files": {
            "romfs/addon.dat": b"addon-one-v2",
        }},
        # A foreign title must not appear in this base game's AoC list.
        {"title_id": title + 0x2000, "version": 0, "kind": 2, "files": {
            "romfs/addon.dat": b"foreign-dlc",
        }},
    ])


def foreign_update_fixture() -> bytes:
    """Structurally valid, but an unrelated title attempts to shadow the base."""
    title = 0x0100123400000000

        {"title_id": title, "version": 1, "kind": 0, "files": {
            "romfs/state.bin": b"base-v1",
        }},
        {"title_id": title + 0x2000, "version": 99, "kind": 1, "files": {
            "romfs/state.bin": b"foreign-hijack",

def add_on_only_fixture() -> bytes:
    """Two unrelated DLC families, neither implicitly owned by a program."""
    title = 0x0100123400000000
    return build([
        {"title_id": title + 0x1000, "version": 1, "kind": 2,
         "files": {"romfs/addon.dat": b"family-one"}},
        {"title_id": title + 0x3001, "version": 2, "kind": 2,
         "files": {"romfs/addon.dat": b"family-two"}},
    ])


def oversized_npdm_fixture() -> bytes:
    """A structurally valid but oversized NPDM must never reach the vendor parser."""
    title = 0x0100123400000000
    return build([
        {"title_id": title, "version": 1, "kind": 0,
         "files": {
             "exefs/main": b"synthetic-main",
             "exefs/main.npdm": b"P" * (4 * 1024 * 1024 + 1),
         }},
    ])


def nacp_aoc_fixture(*, extracted: bool = False) -> bytes:
    """Declared AoC base in NACP TLV or the extracted ExeFS control.nacp."""
    title = 0x0100123400000000
    nacp = bytearray(0x4000)
    # ABI offset from the pinned vendor's FileSys::RawNACP.
    struct.pack_into("<Q", nacp, 0x3070, title + 0x3000)
    files = {
        "exefs/main": b"synthetic-main",
        "exefs/main.npdm": b"latest-npdm",
        "romfs/state.bin": b"base",
    }
    if extracted:
        files["exefs/control.nacp"] = bytes(nacp)
    return build([
        {"title_id": title, "version": 1, "kind": 0,
         "metadata": {0x0005: b"NACP-AoC"} if extracted else
                     {0x0002: bytes(nacp), 0x0005: b"NACP-AoC"},
         "files": files},
        {"title_id": title + 0x3001, "version": 2, "kind": 2,
         "files": {"romfs/addon.dat": b"nacp-declared"}},
        {"title_id": title + 0x1000, "version": 3, "kind": 2,
         "files": {"romfs/addon.dat": b"default-family-not-selected"}},
    ])


def corrupt_extracted_nacp_fixture() -> bytes:
    """Correct TOC/UUID, but the SHA-256 of extracted control.nacp fails."""
    blob = bytearray(nacp_aoc_fixture(extracted=True))
    signature = struct.pack("<Q", 0x0100123400003000)
    where = blob.find(signature, 0x80)
    assert where != -1
    blob[where] ^= 1
    return bytes(blob)


def short_extracted_nacp_fixture() -> bytes:

         "files": {

             "exefs/main.npdm": b"latest-npdm",
             "exefs/control.nacp": bytes(0x3FFF),
         }},
    ])


def compressed_nacp_fixture(*, variant: str) -> bytes:
    """Host-only semantic NACP tests, with mock ABI format at 0x3200.

    The native compilation checks the real vendor layout separately.
    """
    import zlib

    title = 0x0100123400000000
    nacp = bytearray(0x4000)
    struct.pack_into("<Q", nacp, 0x3070, title + 0x3000)
    nacp[0x3200] = 1  # mock RawNACP::titles_data_format = Compressed
    if variant == "valid":
        payload = b"\0" * 0x300  # exact one LanguageEntry
        compressor = zlib.compressobj(wbits=-15)
        frame = compressor.compress(payload) + compressor.flush()
        struct.pack_into("<H", nacp, 0, len(frame))
        nacp[2:2 + len(frame)] = frame
    elif variant == "overlong":
        struct.pack_into("<H", nacp, 0, 0x2FFF)
    elif variant == "partial-entry":
        compressor = zlib.compressobj(wbits=-15)
        frame = compressor.compress(b"x") + compressor.flush()
        struct.pack_into("<H", nacp, 0, len(frame))
        nacp[2:2 + len(frame)] = frame
    else:
        raise ValueError(variant)
    return build([
        {"title_id": title, "version": 1, "kind": 0,
         "metadata": {0x0002: bytes(nacp)},
         "files": {
             "exefs/main": b"synthetic-main",
             "exefs/main.npdm": b"latest-npdm",
         }},
    ])


def oversized_icon_fixture() -> bytes:
    """Preconstructed extracted-loader icon must not be read into memory."""
    title = 0x0100123400000000
    return build([
        {"title_id": title, "version": 1, "kind": 0,
         "files": {
             "exefs/main": b"synthetic-main",
             "exefs/main.npdm": b"latest-npdm",
             "exefs/icon_EnglishAmerican.dat": b"I" * (4 * 1024 * 1024 + 1),
         }},
    ])


def large_raw_fixture() -> bytes:
    """Six 1-MiB raw chunks for bounded, mutation-safe random-read proofs."""
    block_size = 1 << 20
    contents = bytearray().join(bytes([ord("A") + i]) * block_size for i in range(6))
    marker = b"BLOCK-MUTATION-MARKER"
    contents[4 * block_size + block_size // 2:
             4 * block_size + block_size // 2 + len(marker)] = marker
    return build([
        {"title_id": 0x0100123400000000, "version": 1, "kind": 0,
         "files": {"romfs/large.bin": bytes(contents)}},
    ])
```

`tools/nup-v1-mutable-block-host.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Host-only mutable NUP read amplification and tamper tests. No PS5 build.
#include "nup_v1_vfs.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

class MutableSource final : public Eden::NupV1::Source {
public:
    explicit MutableSource(std::vector<std::uint8_t> bytes) : bytes_(std::move(bytes)) {}
    std::uint64_t Size() const override { return bytes_.size(); }
    bool AllowsVerifiedMemberCache() const override { return false; }
    bool ReadAt(std::uint64_t offset, std::span<std::uint8_t> dst) const override {
        if (offset > bytes_.size() || dst.size() > bytes_.size() - offset) return false;
        std::copy_n(bytes_.data() + static_cast<std::size_t>(offset),
                    dst.size(), dst.data());
        bytes_read_ += dst.size();
        return true;
    }
    void Flip(std::size_t offset) { assert(offset < bytes_.size()); bytes_[offset] ^= 0x5a; }
    void ResetReadBytes() const { bytes_read_ = 0; }
    std::size_t ReadBytes() const { return bytes_read_; }
    std::uint64_t Le64(std::size_t offset) const {
        assert(offset + 8 <= bytes_.size());
        std::uint64_t value{};
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
            value |= std::uint64_t(bytes_[offset + i]) << (8 * i);
        return value;
    }
private:
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> bytes_;
    mutable std::size_t bytes_read_{};
};

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    assert(argc == 2);
    std::ifstream file(argv[1], std::ios::binary);
    assert(file);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> bytes(std::istreambuf_iterator<char>{file}, {});
    MutableSource source(std::move(bytes));
    std::string error;
    auto archive = Eden::NupV1::Archive::Mount(source, &error);
    assert(archive && error.empty());
    const auto member = archive->FindFile(0, "proof.bin");
    assert(member && archive->MemberSize(*member) > (1U << 20));
    constexpr std::size_t Block = 1U << 18;
    std::uint8_t output = 0xa5;
    // First access validates the entire member and builds immutable block digests.
    assert(archive->ReadMember(*member, 0, std::span(&output, 1), &error));
    source.ResetReadBytes();
    assert(archive->ReadMember(*member, 1, std::span(&output, 1), &error));
    assert(source.ReadBytes() == Block);
    source.ResetReadBytes();
    const std::size_t target = Block + 17;
    assert(archive->ReadMember(*member, target, std::span(&output, 1), &error));
    assert(source.ReadBytes() == Block);
    // In-place mutation in the touched block is rejected BEFORE copying to VFS output.
    const auto blob_start = static_cast<std::size_t>(source.Le64(0x38));
    source.Flip(blob_start + target);
    output = 0xa5;
    error.clear();
    assert(!archive->ReadMember(*member, target, std::span(&output, 1), &error));
    assert(!error.empty() && output == 0xa5);
    // Other verified blocks remain usable; no stale data from corrupted block.
    error.clear();
    assert(archive->ReadMember(*member, 0, std::span(&output, 1), &error));
    assert(error.empty());
}

```

`tools/nup-v1-native-host.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Exercise native adapter WITHOUT linking a PS5 renderer/loader.
#include "nup_v1_native_vfs.h"
#include "nup_v1_native_content.h"
#include "nup_v1_native_aoc.h"
#include "nup_v1_native_loader.h"
#include "core/loader/loader.h"
#include "core/file_sys/romfs.h"
#include "core/file_sys/control_metadata.h"
#include "core/file_sys/vfs/vfs.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <fstream>
#include <iostream>
#include <iterator>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>

class MemoryFile final : public FileSys::VfsFile {
public:
    explicit MemoryFile(std::vector<u8> bytes) : bytes_(std::move(bytes)) {}
    std::string GetName() const override { return "fixture.nup"; }
    std::size_t GetSize() const override { return bytes_.size(); }
    bool Resize(std::size_t) override { return false; }
    FileSys::VirtualDir GetContainingDirectory() const override { return {}; }
    bool IsWritable() const override { return false; }
    bool IsReadable() const override { return true; }
    std::size_t Read(u8* dst, std::size_t count, std::size_t pos) const override {
        if (pos > bytes_.size()) return 0;
        const auto n = (std::min)(count, bytes_.size() - pos);
        if (n) std::copy_n(bytes_.data() + pos, n, dst);
        bytes_read_.fetch_add(n, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        return n;
    }
    std::size_t Write(const u8*, std::size_t, std::size_t) override { return 0; }
    bool Rename(std::string_view) override { return false; }
    std::uint64_t BytesRead() const {
        return bytes_read_.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
    }
    void ResetReadCount() const {
        bytes_read_.store(0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    }
    // Read-only API does not imply externally immutable backing bytes.
    void Corrupt(std::string_view old) {
        auto it = std::search(bytes_.begin(), bytes_.end(), old.begin(), old.end());
        assert(it != bytes_.end());
        *it ^= 1;
    }
private:
    std::vector<u8> bytes_;
    mutable std::atomic<std::uint64_t> bytes_read_{};
};

// Host-only stub: checks that the bridge forwards the correct VFS tree.
// This is intentionally NOT the real RomFS serializer. Native-header syntax
// compilation checks the actual CreateRomFS API separately.
namespace FileSys {
VirtualFile CreateRomFS(VirtualDir directory, VirtualDir extension) {
    if (!directory || extension) return {};
    std::string serialized;
    for (const auto& f : directory->GetFiles()) {
        std::string data(f->GetSize(), '\0');
        if (!data.empty() &&
            f->Read(reinterpret_cast<u8*>(data.data()), data.size(), 0) != data.size())
            return {};
        serialized += f->GetName() + "=" + data + "\n";
    }
    return std::make_shared<MemoryFile>(
        std::vector<u8>(serialized.begin(), serialized.end()));
}
} // namespace FileSys

std::vector<u8> Load(const char* path) {
    std::ifstream input(path, std::ios::binary);
    assert(input);
    return {std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(input), std::istreambuf_iterator<char>()};
}

std::string Read(const FileSys::VirtualFile& file) {
    assert(file && file->IsReadable() && !file->IsWritable());
    std::string bytes(file->GetSize(), '\0');
    if (!bytes.empty())
        assert(file->Read(reinterpret_cast<u8*>(bytes.data()), bytes.size(), 0) == bytes.size());
    return bytes;
}

// P5-only factory test: never instrument or modify the vendor loader.
// This stand-in records whether non-NUP inputs kept the original route.
static int original_loader_calls = 0;
namespace Loader {
std::unique_ptr<AppLoader> EdenOriginalGetLoader(
    Core::System&, FileSys::VirtualFile, u64, std::size_t) {
    ++original_loader_calls;
    return {};
}
std::unique_ptr<AppLoader> GetLoader(
    Core::System&, FileSys::VirtualFile, u64, std::size_t);
} // namespace Loader

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    assert(argc == 20);
    auto input = std::make_shared<MemoryFile>(Load(argv[1]));
    // File recognition must be based on the superblock, not .nup extension.
    // This cheap probe does not replace the full archive validation.
    assert(Eden::NupV1::Native::HasNupV1Header(input));
    // The prepared, OFF-by-default factory is tested on host for strict
    // dispatch and no regressions in the ordinary vendor loader route.
    Core::System factory_system;
    auto normal_selection = std::make_shared<MemoryFile>(std::vector<u8>(0x80));
    assert(!Loader::GetLoader(factory_system, normal_selection, 0, 0));
    assert(original_loader_calls == 1);
    auto valid_nup_routed = Loader::GetLoader(
        factory_system, std::make_shared<MemoryFile>(Load(argv[3])), 0, 0);
    assert(valid_nup_routed);
    assert(original_loader_calls == 1);
    u64 routed_title{};
    assert(valid_nup_routed->ReadProgramId(routed_title) ==
           Loader::ResultStatus::Success);
    assert(routed_title == 0x0100123400000000ULL);
    assert(!Loader::GetLoader(factory_system,
        std::make_shared<MemoryFile>(Load(argv[3])),
        0x0100123400002000ULL, 0));
    assert(!Loader::GetLoader(factory_system,
        std::make_shared<MemoryFile>(Load(argv[3])), 0, 1));
    assert(!Loader::GetLoader(factory_system,
        std::make_shared<MemoryFile>(Load(argv[5])), 0, 0));
    assert(original_loader_calls == 1);

    assert(!Eden::NupV1::Native::HasNupV1Header(
        std::make_shared<MemoryFile>(std::vector<u8>(0x80, 0))));
    auto bad_magic = Load(argv[1]);
    bad_magic[0] = 'X';
    assert(!Eden::NupV1::Native::HasNupV1Header(
        std::make_shared<MemoryFile>(std::move(bad_magic))));
    auto bad_size = Load(argv[1]);
    bad_size[0x40] ^= 1;
    assert(!Eden::NupV1::Native::HasNupV1Header(
        std::make_shared<MemoryFile>(std::move(bad_size))));
    // A valid superblock with packages from incompatible applications
    // passes this probe, but its full Mount::Open will reject it.
    assert(Eden::NupV1::Native::HasNupV1Header(
        std::make_shared<MemoryFile>(Load(argv[4]))));
    std::string error;
    auto mount = Eden::NupV1::Native::Mount::Open(input, &error);
    assert(mount && error.empty());
    assert(mount->Packages().size() == 3);
    // ContentSet is a common NS1/NS2 handoff, not an installed loader.
    Eden::NupV1::Native::ContentSet content{mount};
    assert(!content.HasExecutableMain()); // synthetic fixture lacks ExeFS
    assert(!content.ExeFS());
    assert(content.AddOns().size() == 1);
    assert(content.AddOns().front().package_index == 2);
    assert(content.AddOns().front().romfs);
    assert(content.AddOns().front().romfs->GetFile("state.bin"));
    // Test serializer is a sentinel: verifies selected VFS contents only.
    assert(Read(content.CreateRomFS()) == "state.bin=latest-v3\n");
    assert(Read(content.CreateAddOnRomFS(2)) == "state.bin=addon-aoc\n");
    assert(!content.CreateAddOnRomFS(0));
    using Eden::NupV1::ContentView;
    assert(!mount->Effective(ContentView::ExeFS));
    assert(!mount->PackageView(100, ContentView::RomFS));

    auto effective = mount->Effective(ContentView::RomFS);
    assert(effective && effective->IsReadable() && !effective->IsWritable());
    assert(effective->GetName() == "romfs");
    assert(effective->GetFiles().size() == 1);
    assert(effective->GetSubdirectories().empty());
    // The VFS directory metadata is immutable after mount: GetFiles and
    // GetSubdirectories reuse one lazily published snapshot, including when
    // concurrent service threads enumerate the same directory.
    std::atomic<bool> directory_snapshot_ok{true};
    std::vector<std::thread> directory_workers;
    for (int worker = 0; worker < 6; ++worker) {
        directory_workers.emplace_back([&] {
            for (int iteration = 0; iteration < 64; ++iteration) {
                const auto files = effective->GetFiles();
                const auto subdirs = effective->GetSubdirectories();
                if (files.size() != 1 || files[0]->GetName() != "state.bin" ||
                    !subdirs.empty())
                    directory_snapshot_ok.store(false, std::memory_order_relaxed);
            }
        });
    }
    for (auto& worker : directory_workers) worker.join();
    assert(directory_snapshot_ok.load(std::memory_order_relaxed));
    auto newest = effective->GetFile("state.bin");
    assert(newest && newest->GetContainingDirectory() == effective);
    assert(Read(newest) == "latest-v3");
    // The native FileSys API can issue concurrent reads on the same member.
    // The source adapter must serialize raw file access and preserve checksums.
    std::atomic<bool> concurrent_ok{true};
    std::vector<std::thread> workers;
    for (int worker = 0; worker < 8; ++worker) {
        workers.emplace_back([&] {
            for (int iteration = 0; iteration < 100; ++iteration) {
                u8 buffer[9]{};
                if (newest->Read(buffer, sizeof(buffer), 0) != sizeof(buffer) ||
                    std::string_view(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(buffer), sizeof(buffer))
                        != "latest-v3") {
                    concurrent_ok.store(false, std::memory_order_relaxed);
                }
            }
        });
    }
    for (auto& worker : workers) worker.join();
    assert(concurrent_ok.load());
    assert(!newest->Resize(1) && !newest->Rename("changed"));
    assert(newest->Write(reinterpret_cast<const u8*>("bad"), 3, 0) == 0);
    u8 out{};
    assert(newest->Read(&out, 1, newest->GetSize()) == 0);

    auto base = mount->PackageView(0, ContentView::RomFS);
    assert(base && Read(base->GetFile("state.bin")) == "base-v1");
    auto addon = mount->PackageView(2, ContentView::RomFS);
    assert(addon && Read(addon->GetFile("state.bin")) == "addon-aoc");
    // NativeFile pins State even if both Mount and directory handles disappear.
    mount.reset();
    effective.reset();
    base.reset();
    addon.reset();
    // AppLoader_DeconstructedRomDirectory(main) dereferences this directory.
    // The file must pin its containing directory even after Mount is gone.
    const auto held_parent = newest->GetContainingDirectory();
    assert(held_parent && held_parent->GetFile("state.bin"));
    assert(Read(newest) == "latest-v3");
    // First successful read MUST NOT memoize integrity on mutable VfsFile.
    input->Corrupt("latest-v3");
    u8 scratch[16]{};
    std::fill(std::begin(scratch), std::end(scratch), u8{0xA5});
    assert(newest->Read(scratch, 9, 0) == 0);
    assert(std::all_of(std::begin(scratch), std::begin(scratch) + 9,
                       [](u8 byte) { return byte == 0; }));
    assert(std::all_of(std::begin(scratch) + 9, std::end(scratch),
                       [](u8 byte) { return byte == 0xA5; }));

    auto standalone_input = std::make_shared<MemoryFile>(Load(argv[2]));
    auto standalone = Eden::NupV1::Native::Mount::Open(standalone_input, &error);
    assert(standalone);
    assert(Read(standalone->Effective(ContentView::RomFS)->GetFile("state.bin")) == "latest-v3");

    auto invalid = Load(argv[2]);
    invalid[0] ^= 1;
    auto rejected = Eden::NupV1::Native::Mount::Open(
        std::make_shared<MemoryFile>(std::move(invalid)), &error);
    assert(!rejected && !error.empty());
    // Full synthetic content: effective ExeFS, nested RomFS overlay and
    // multiple separately addressed addons (never registered in AoC).
    auto executable_input = std::make_shared<MemoryFile>(Load(argv[3]));
    auto playable_mount = Eden::NupV1::Native::Mount::Open(executable_input, &error);
    assert(playable_mount && playable_mount->Packages().size() == 7);
    Eden::NupV1::Native::ContentSet exec_content(playable_mount);
    const auto* metadata = playable_mount->ApplicationMetadata();
    assert(metadata);
    assert(metadata->title == "Demo / Game");
    assert(metadata->publisher == "Example Publisher");
    assert(metadata->display_version == "3.0.0");
    assert(metadata->TitleFor("fr-FR") == "Démo / Jeu");
    assert(metadata->TitleFor("en-US") == "Demo Game (US)");
    assert(metadata->TitleFor("de-DE") == "Demo / Game");
    const auto* fr_icon = metadata->IconFor("fr-FR");
    assert(fr_icon && fr_icon->size() > 8);
    assert((*fr_icon)[0] == 0x89 && (*fr_icon)[1] == 0x50);
    const auto* fallback_icon = metadata->IconFor("de-DE");
    assert(fallback_icon && (*fallback_icon)[0] == 0xff);
    assert(metadata->default_icon.size() >= 3);
    assert(metadata->default_icon[0] == 0xff);
    assert(metadata->default_icon[1] == 0xd8);
    assert(metadata->default_icon[2] == 0xff);
    assert(exec_content.HasExecutableMain());
    auto exefs = exec_content.ExeFS();
    assert(exefs && Read(exefs->GetFile("main")) == "latest-main");
    assert(Read(exefs->GetFile("main.npdm")) == "latest-npdm");
    assert(exefs->GetFile("main")->GetContainingDirectory() == exefs);
    assert(Read(exec_content.CreateRomFS()) == "state.bin=latest-v3\n");
    auto effective_tree = playable_mount->Effective(ContentView::RomFS);
    assert(effective_tree);
    auto sub = effective_tree->GetSubdirectory("sub");
    assert(sub);
    assert(Read(sub->GetFile("base.dat")) == "base-only");
    assert(Read(sub->GetFile("update.dat")) == "update-only");
    assert(exec_content.AddOns().size() == 2);
    assert(exec_content.AddOns()[0].package_index == 5);
    assert(exec_content.AddOns()[1].package_index == 4);
    assert(exec_content.AddOns()[0].title_id != exec_content.AddOns()[1].title_id);
    assert(exec_content.AddOns()[0].version == 2);
    assert(exec_content.AddOns()[1].version == 0);
    assert(Read(exec_content.AddOns()[0].romfs->GetFile("addon.dat")) == "addon-one-v2");
    assert(Read(exec_content.AddOns()[1].romfs->GetFile("addon.dat")) == "addon-two");
    assert(Read(exec_content.CreateAddOnRomFS(5)) == "addon.dat=addon-one-v2\n");
    assert(Read(exec_content.CreateAddOnRomFS(4)) == "addon.dat=addon-two\n");
    assert(!exec_content.CreateAddOnRomFS(0)); // base
    assert(!exec_content.CreateAddOnRomFS(1)); // update
    assert(!exec_content.CreateAddOnRomFS(3)); // replaced older addon
    assert(!exec_content.CreateAddOnRomFS(6)); // unrelated game addon
    assert(!exec_content.CreateAddOnRomFS(500));
    assert(!effective_tree->GetFile("addon.dat"));
    // ExeFS handles remain valid after dropping the owning ContentSet/Mount.
    auto still_readable = exefs->GetFile("main");
    exefs.reset();
    playable_mount.reset();
    assert(Read(still_readable) == "latest-main");
    // Explicit-only NUP AppLoader adapter: reuse the extracted ExeFS loader
    // while overriding ReadRomFS with the NUP effective tree. No FileType,
    // catalogue or frontend registration is performed by this test.
    error.clear();
    auto app = Eden::NupV1::Native::NupAppLoader::Open(executable_input, &error);
    assert(app && error.empty());
    assert(app->GetFileType() == Loader::FileType::Unknown);
    assert(!app->IsRomFSUpdatable()); // already overlaid highest NCM version
    FileSys::NACP no_control;
    assert(app->ReadControlData(no_control) == Loader::ResultStatus::ErrorNoControl);
    FileSys::VirtualFile romfs_result;
    assert(app->ReadRomFS(romfs_result) == Loader::ResultStatus::Success);
    assert(Read(romfs_result) == "state.bin=latest-v3\n");
    FileSys::VirtualFile second_romfs;
    assert(app->ReadRomFS(second_romfs) == Loader::ResultStatus::Success);
    assert(romfs_result == second_romfs); // lazily built once per app
    std::atomic<bool> romfs_stable{true};
    std::vector<std::thread> romfs_workers;
    for (int i = 0; i < 6; ++i) {
        romfs_workers.emplace_back([&] {
            FileSys::VirtualFile concurrent_romfs;
            if (app->ReadRomFS(concurrent_romfs) != Loader::ResultStatus::Success ||
                concurrent_romfs != romfs_result) {
                romfs_stable.store(false, std::memory_order_relaxed);
            }
        });
    }
    for (auto& worker : romfs_workers) worker.join();
    assert(romfs_stable.load());
    std::uint64_t program_id{};
    std::string app_title;
    assert(app->ReadProgramId(program_id) == Loader::ResultStatus::Success);
    assert(program_id == 0x0100123400000000ULL);
    assert(app->ReadTitle(app_title) == Loader::ResultStatus::Success);
    assert(app_title == "Demo / Game");
    std::string localized_title;
    assert(app->ReadLocalizedTitle(localized_title, "fr-FR") ==
           Loader::ResultStatus::Success);
    assert(localized_title == "Démo / Jeu");
    assert(app->ReadLocalizedTitle(localized_title, "en-US") ==
           Loader::ResultStatus::Success);
    assert(localized_title == "Demo Game (US)");
    assert(app->ReadLocalizedTitle(localized_title, "de-DE") ==
           Loader::ResultStatus::Success);
    assert(localized_title == "Demo / Game");
    std::vector<u8> localized_icon;
    assert(app->ReadLocalizedIcon(localized_icon, "fr-FR") ==
           Loader::ResultStatus::Success);
    assert(localized_icon[0] == 0x89 && localized_icon[1] == 0x50);
    assert(app->ReadLocalizedIcon(localized_icon, "de-DE") ==
           Loader::ResultStatus::Success);
    assert(localized_icon[0] == 0xff);
    std::vector<u8> app_icon;
    assert(app->ReadIcon(app_icon) == Loader::ResultStatus::Success);
    assert(app_icon.size() == metadata->default_icon.size());
    assert(app_icon[0] == 0xff && app_icon[1] == 0xd8);

    Loader::AppLoader::Modules modules;
    assert(app->ReadNSOModules(modules) == Loader::ResultStatus::ErrorNotInitialized);
    Kernel::KProcess process;
    Core::System system;
    assert(app->Load(process, system).first == Loader::ResultStatus::Success);
    assert(app->ReadNSOModules(modules) == Loader::ResultStatus::Success);
    assert(modules.at(0) == "main");
    assert(app->Load(process, system).first == Loader::ResultStatus::ErrorAlreadyLoaded);
    app.reset();
    assert(Read(romfs_result) == "state.bin=latest-v3\n");

    auto missing_exefs_source = std::make_shared<MemoryFile>(Load(argv[1]));
    error.clear();
    auto missing_exefs = Eden::NupV1::Native::NupAppLoader::Open(
        missing_exefs_source, &error);
    assert(!missing_exefs && error == "NUP effective ExeFS lacks main or main.npdm");
    auto cross_title_input = std::make_shared<MemoryFile>(Load(argv[4]));
    error.clear();
    auto cross_title = Eden::NupV1::Native::Mount::Open(cross_title_input, &error);
    assert(!cross_title && error == "unrelated base/update title ID");
    // Invalid identity must fail at Open(), before constructing the real
    // extracted-loader (which eagerly parses NPDM in its constructor).
    auto forged_input = std::make_shared<MemoryFile>(Load(argv[5]));
    error.clear();
    auto forged = Eden::NupV1::Native::NupAppLoader::Open(forged_input, &error);
    assert(!forged && error == "NUP invalid NPDM program identity");
    auto sibling_input = std::make_shared<MemoryFile>(Load(argv[6]));
    error.clear();
    auto sibling = Eden::NupV1::Native::NupAppLoader::Open(sibling_input, &error);
    assert(!sibling && error == "NUP invalid NPDM program identity");

    // Source immutability is NOT promised even by a read-only VfsFile.
    // Revalidate NPDM before every post-open loader API exposure.
    auto mutable_app_input = std::make_shared<MemoryFile>(Load(argv[3]));
    error.clear();
    auto mutable_app = Eden::NupV1::Native::NupAppLoader::Open(
        mutable_app_input, &error);
    assert(mutable_app && error.empty());
    mutable_app_input->Corrupt("latest-npdm");
    u64 preserved_program_id = 0x123456ULL;
    assert(mutable_app->ReadProgramId(preserved_program_id) ==
           Loader::ResultStatus::ErrorBadNPDMHeader);
    assert(preserved_program_id == 0x123456ULL);
    FileSys::VirtualFile denied_romfs;
    assert(mutable_app->ReadRomFS(denied_romfs) ==
           Loader::ResultStatus::ErrorBadNPDMHeader);
    assert(!denied_romfs);
    std::string denied_title = "preserve";
    assert(mutable_app->ReadTitle(denied_title) ==
           Loader::ResultStatus::ErrorBadNPDMHeader);
    assert(denied_title == "preserve");
    std::vector<u8> denied_icon{1, 2, 3};
    assert(mutable_app->ReadIcon(denied_icon) ==
           Loader::ResultStatus::ErrorBadNPDMHeader);
    assert(denied_icon == std::vector<u8>({1, 2, 3}));
    Loader::AppLoader::Modules denied_modules;
    assert(mutable_app->ReadNSOModules(denied_modules) ==
           Loader::ResultStatus::ErrorBadNPDMHeader);
    assert(denied_modules.empty());
    FileSys::NACP denied_control;
    assert(mutable_app->ReadControlData(denied_control) ==
           Loader::ResultStatus::ErrorBadNPDMHeader);
    assert(!mutable_app->MakeAddOnIndex());
    Kernel::KProcess blocked_process;
    Core::System blocked_system;
    assert(mutable_app->Load(blocked_process, blocked_system).first ==
           Loader::ResultStatus::ErrorBadNPDMHeader);
    // A checksummed archive with an invalid UTF-8 metadata TLV is rejected
    // before exposing any title, icon or VFS view to an application.
    error.clear();
    auto invalid_meta = Eden::NupV1::Native::Mount::Open(
        std::make_shared<MemoryFile>(Load(argv[7])), &error);
    assert(!invalid_meta && error == "invalid NUP UTF-8 metadata");
    error.clear();
    auto duplicate_locale = Eden::NupV1::Native::Mount::Open(
        std::make_shared<MemoryFile>(Load(argv[8])), &error);
    assert(!duplicate_locale && error == "duplicate or excessive NUP localized entries");
    // A container without an executable cannot be automatically attributed
    // to a running game. Explicit caller program ID selects exactly its DLC.
    auto addons_input = std::make_shared<MemoryFile>(Load(argv[9]));
    error.clear();
    auto addon_mount = Eden::NupV1::Native::Mount::Open(addons_input, &error);
    assert(addon_mount && addon_mount->Packages().size() == 2);
    Eden::NupV1::Native::ContentSet unscoped(addon_mount);
    assert(unscoped.AddOns().empty());
    Eden::NupV1::Native::ContentSet first_scoped(
        addon_mount, 0x0100123400000000ULL);
    assert(first_scoped.AddOns().size() == 1);
    assert(first_scoped.AddOns().front().package_index == 0);
    assert(Read(first_scoped.CreateAddOnRomFS(0)) == "addon.dat=family-one\n");
    assert(!first_scoped.CreateAddOnRomFS(1));
    Eden::NupV1::Native::ContentSet second_scoped(
        addon_mount, 0x0100123400002000ULL);
    assert(second_scoped.AddOns().size() == 1);
    assert(second_scoped.AddOns().front().package_index == 1);
    assert(Read(second_scoped.CreateAddOnRomFS(1)) == "addon.dat=family-two\n");
    assert(!second_scoped.CreateAddOnRomFS(0));
    // AoC interface never mixes callers, supports stable pagination and
    // resolves an add-on index only into its own independently built RomFS.
    Eden::NupV1::Native::AddOnIndex aoc_first(
        addon_mount, 0x0100123400000000ULL);
    assert(aoc_first.Count(0x0100123400000000ULL) == 1);
    assert(aoc_first.BaseId(0x0100123400000000ULL) ==
           std::optional<u64>{0x0100123400001000ULL});
    assert(aoc_first.ListIds(0x0100123400000000ULL, 0, 2) ==
           std::vector<std::uint32_t>{0});
    assert(aoc_first.ListIds(0x0100123400000000ULL, 1, 2).empty());
    assert(aoc_first.ListIds(0x0100123400002000ULL, 0, 2).empty());
    assert(!aoc_first.OpenRomFS(0x0100123400002000ULL, 0));
    assert(!aoc_first.OpenRomFS(0x0100123400000000ULL, 1));
    assert(Read(aoc_first.OpenRomFS(0x0100123400000000ULL, 0)) ==
           "addon.dat=family-one\n");
    // A trusted NACP can specify a distinct AoC base (e.g., an upgrade
    // pack). Never guess it from the Switch-generation prefix or game ID.
    Eden::NupV1::Native::ContentSet explicit_nacp_base(
        addon_mount, 0x0100123400000000ULL, 0x0100123400003000ULL);
    assert(explicit_nacp_base.AddOns().size() == 1);
    assert(explicit_nacp_base.AddOns().front().package_index == 1);
    assert(Read(explicit_nacp_base.CreateAddOnRomFS(1)) ==
           "addon.dat=family-two\n");
    assert(!explicit_nacp_base.CreateAddOnRomFS(0));
    // Custom AoC family without a caller is never an authority to expose DLC.
    Eden::NupV1::Native::ContentSet unscoped_nacp(
        addon_mount, std::nullopt, 0x0100123400003000ULL);
    assert(unscoped_nacp.AddOns().empty());
    // Misaligned NACP AoC base (not an 0x800-title boundary) is rejected
    // rather than shifted onto adjacent add-on IDs.
    Eden::NupV1::Native::ContentSet misaligned_nacp(
        addon_mount, 0x0100123400000000ULL, 0x0100123400003001ULL);
    assert(misaligned_nacp.AddOns().empty());
    auto base_mounted_again = Eden::NupV1::Native::Mount::Open(
        executable_input, &error);
    assert(base_mounted_again);
    Eden::NupV1::Native::ContentSet wrong_program(
        base_mounted_again, 0x0100123400002000ULL);
    assert(wrong_program.AddOns().empty());
    // An oversized NPDM is rejected before any extracted-loader
    // constructor can allocate from attacker-controlled NPDM fields.
    error.clear();
    auto oversized_input = std::make_shared<MemoryFile>(Load(argv[10]));
    auto oversized = Eden::NupV1::Native::NupAppLoader::Open(
        oversized_input, &error);
    assert(!oversized && error == "NUP invalid NPDM program identity");
    // Auto-derive the real AoC base ID from the base package's 0x4000-byte
    // NACP only *after* NPDM program identity is validated. DLC at the
    // traditional +0x1000 offset must not silently join the declared family.
    error.clear();
    auto nacp_source = std::make_shared<MemoryFile>(Load(argv[11]));
    auto nacp_loader = Eden::NupV1::Native::NupAppLoader::Open(
        nacp_source, &error);
    assert(nacp_loader && error.empty());
    assert(nacp_loader->SelectedAddOns().size() == 1);
    FileSys::NACP nacp_from_tlv;
    assert(nacp_loader->ReadControlData(nacp_from_tlv) ==
           Loader::ResultStatus::Success);
    assert(nacp_from_tlv.IsValidForHostTest());
    assert(nacp_from_tlv.GetDLCBaseTitleId() == 0x0100123400003000ULL);
    assert(nacp_loader->SelectedAddOns()[0].package_index == 1);
    assert(nacp_loader->SelectedAddOns()[0].title_id ==
           0x0100123400003001ULL);
    const auto* registered_nacp_loader = nacp_loader.get();
    // Metadata browsing must not publish DLC before guest Load succeeds.
    assert(!Eden::NupV1::Native::ActiveAddOnsForLoader(registered_nacp_loader));
    Kernel::KProcess active_process;
    Core::System active_system;
    assert(nacp_loader->Load(active_process, active_system).first ==
           Loader::ResultStatus::Success);
    auto published_nacp =
        Eden::NupV1::Native::ActiveAddOnsForLoader(registered_nacp_loader);
    assert(published_nacp);
    assert(published_nacp->Count(0x0100123400000000ULL) == 1);
    assert(!Eden::NupV1::Native::ActiveAddOnsForLoader(nullptr));
    auto aoc_from_nacp = nacp_loader->MakeAddOnIndex();
    assert(aoc_from_nacp);
    assert(aoc_from_nacp->BaseId(0x0100123400000000ULL) ==
           std::optional<u64>{0x0100123400003000ULL});
    assert(aoc_from_nacp->ListIds(0x0100123400000000ULL, 0, 8) ==
           std::vector<std::uint32_t>{1});
    assert(Read(aoc_from_nacp->OpenRomFS(0x0100123400000000ULL, 1)) ==
           "addon.dat=nacp-declared\n");
    assert(!aoc_from_nacp->OpenRomFS(0x0100123400002000ULL, 1));
    // Snapshot ownership survives teardown of its loader, but the registry
    // must revoke the old key immediately so a later title can't reuse it.
    error.clear();
    auto temporary = Eden::NupV1::Native::NupAppLoader::Open(
        std::make_shared<MemoryFile>(Load(argv[11])), &error);
    assert(temporary && error.empty());
    const auto* old_loader_address = temporary.get();
    assert(!Eden::NupV1::Native::ActiveAddOnsForLoader(old_loader_address));
    Kernel::KProcess temp_process;
    Core::System temp_system;
    assert(temporary->Load(temp_process, temp_system).first ==
           Loader::ResultStatus::Success);
    auto keep_alive = Eden::NupV1::Native::ActiveAddOnsForLoader(
        old_loader_address);
    assert(keep_alive);
    temporary.reset();
    assert(!Eden::NupV1::Native::ActiveAddOnsForLoader(old_loader_address));
    assert(keep_alive->Count(0x0100123400000000ULL) == 1);

    assert(Read(nacp_loader->SelectedAddOns()[0].romfs->GetFile("addon.dat")) ==
           "nacp-declared");
    // The same declared AoC family must be recovered from extracted
    // control.nacp when the NUP TLV is absent.
    error.clear();
    auto extracted_nacp_source = std::make_shared<MemoryFile>(Load(argv[12]));
    auto extracted_nacp_loader = Eden::NupV1::Native::NupAppLoader::Open(
        extracted_nacp_source, &error);
    assert(extracted_nacp_loader && error.empty());
    assert(extracted_nacp_loader->SelectedAddOns().size() == 1);
    FileSys::NACP nacp_from_exefs;
    assert(extracted_nacp_loader->ReadControlData(nacp_from_exefs) ==
           Loader::ResultStatus::Success);
    assert(nacp_from_exefs.IsValidForHostTest());
    assert(nacp_from_exefs.GetDLCBaseTitleId() ==
           nacp_from_tlv.GetDLCBaseTitleId());
    assert(extracted_nacp_loader->SelectedAddOns()[0].package_index == 1);
    assert(Read(extracted_nacp_loader->SelectedAddOns()[0].romfs->GetFile("addon.dat")) ==
           "nacp-declared");
    // The TOC can remain valid after corruption of a NACP member's data.
    // The archive may mount, but its app loader must fail closed, not
    // silently select unrelated DLC through the conventional AoC offset.
    error.clear();
    auto corrupted_nacp_source = std::make_shared<MemoryFile>(Load(argv[13]));
    auto corrupted_nacp_loader = Eden::NupV1::Native::NupAppLoader::Open(
        corrupted_nacp_source, &error);
    assert(!corrupted_nacp_loader && error == "NUP control.nacp integrity failure");
    error.clear();
    auto short_nacp_source = std::make_shared<MemoryFile>(Load(argv[14]));
    auto short_nacp_loader = Eden::NupV1::Native::NupAppLoader::Open(
        short_nacp_source, &error);
    assert(!short_nacp_loader && error == "NUP control.nacp has invalid size");
    // Compressed language tables are preflighted before the real vendor NACP
    // constructor reads them. A valid raw-deflate LanguageEntry is accepted.
    error.clear();
    auto compressed_ok = Eden::NupV1::Native::NupAppLoader::Open(
        std::make_shared<MemoryFile>(Load(argv[15])), &error);
    assert(compressed_ok && error.empty());
    FileSys::NACP compressed_control;
    assert(compressed_ok->ReadControlData(compressed_control) ==
           Loader::ResultStatus::Success);
    assert(compressed_control.IsValidForHostTest());
    // Beyond the NACP inline compressed buffer is always rejected.
    error.clear();
    auto compressed_oversize = Eden::NupV1::Native::NupAppLoader::Open(
        std::make_shared<MemoryFile>(Load(argv[16])), &error);
    assert(!compressed_oversize &&
           error == "NUP unsafe control.nacp language metadata");
    // The vendor copies decompressed content into LanguageEntry slots;
    // incomplete records are not safe to pass to that constructor.
    error.clear();
    auto compressed_partial = Eden::NupV1::Native::NupAppLoader::Open(
        std::make_shared<MemoryFile>(Load(argv[17])), &error);
    assert(!compressed_partial &&
           error == "NUP unsafe control.nacp language metadata");
    // Eager icon extraction must never allocate from an unbounded ExeFS file.
    error.clear();
    auto huge_icon = Eden::NupV1::Native::NupAppLoader::Open(
        std::make_shared<MemoryFile>(Load(argv[18])), &error);
    assert(!huge_icon && error == "NUP ExeFS icon too large");
    // A source without an immutability contract must never return bytes
    // changed after the first full SHA. The raw block index also avoids
    // rereading an entire 6-MiB member for a tiny later random access.
    constexpr std::uint64_t MiB = 1ULL << 20;
    error.clear();
    auto large_source = std::make_shared<MemoryFile>(Load(argv[19]));
    const auto large_mount = Eden::NupV1::Native::Mount::Open(
        large_source, &error);
    assert(large_mount && error.empty());
    const auto large_romfs = large_mount->Effective(ContentView::RomFS);
    assert(large_romfs);
    const auto large_file = large_romfs->GetFile("large.bin");
    assert(large_file && large_file->GetSize() == 6 * MiB);
    large_source->ResetReadCount();
    std::array<u8, 16> small{};
    assert(large_file->Read(small.data(), small.size(), 0) == small.size());
    assert(small[0] == 'A');
    assert(large_source->BytesRead() >= 6 * MiB); // first full SHA
    large_source->ResetReadCount();
    assert(large_file->Read(small.data(), small.size(),
                            2 * MiB + 128) == small.size());
    assert(small[0] == 'C');
    assert(large_source->BytesRead() <= MiB + 1024); // one verified block
    large_source->ResetReadCount();
    assert(large_file->Read(small.data(), small.size(),
                            3 * MiB - 8) == small.size());
    assert(small[0] == 'C' && small[8] == 'D');
    assert(large_source->BytesRead() <= 2 * MiB + 1024);
    large_source->Corrupt("BLOCK-MUTATION-MARKER");
    small.fill(0x7f);
    // Corruption is at 4.5 MiB. A read in the preceding independent
    // 256-KiB block must remain valid; only the touched block is rejected.
    assert(large_file->Read(small.data(), small.size(),
                            4 * MiB + 128) == small.size());
    assert(small[0] == 'E');
    small.fill(0x7f);
    assert(large_file->Read(small.data(), small.size(),
                            4 * MiB + MiB / 2 + 128) == 0);
    assert(std::all_of(small.begin(), small.end(),
                       [](u8 byte) { return byte == 0; }));
    assert(large_file->Read(small.data(), small.size(), 0) == small.size());
    assert(small[0] == 'A'); // unaffected, independently hashed block
    std::cout << "NUP raw cache: 6 MiB full verification, bounded block reads and post-mount mutation rejection OK\n";
    std::cout << "NUP native VFS adapter: lifetime, overlay, AoC isolation, mutable hash checks OK\n";
}

```

`tools/nup-v1-real-romfs-host.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Binary RomFS test using the *actual pinned vendor* RomFSBuildContext.
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <fstream>
#include <iostream>
#include <iterator>
#include <limits>
#include <map>
#include <memory>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>
#include "nup_v1_native_content.h"
#include "nup_v1_native_vfs.h"
#include "core/file_sys/fsmitm_romfsbuild.h"
#include "core/file_sys/romfs.h"
#include "core/file_sys/vfs/vfs.h"
#include "core/file_sys/vfs/vfs_concat.h"

namespace {
class MemoryFile final : public FileSys::VfsFile {
public:
    explicit MemoryFile(std::vector<u8> bytes) : bytes_(std::move(bytes)) {}
    std::string GetName() const override { return "fixture.nup"; }
    std::size_t GetSize() const override { return bytes_.size(); }
    bool Resize(std::size_t) override { return false; }
    FileSys::VirtualDir GetContainingDirectory() const override { return {}; }
    bool IsWritable() const override { return false; }
    bool IsReadable() const override { return true; }
    std::size_t Read(u8* out, std::size_t count, std::size_t offset) const override {
        if (offset > bytes_.size()) return 0;
        const auto n = std::min(count, bytes_.size() - offset);
        if (n) std::copy_n(bytes_.data() + offset, n, out);
        return n;
    }
    std::size_t Write(const u8*, std::size_t, std::size_t) override { return 0; }
    bool Rename(std::string_view) override { return false; }
    void Corrupt(std::string_view value) {
        auto it = std::search(bytes_.begin(), bytes_.end(), value.begin(), value.end());
        assert(it != bytes_.end());
        *it ^= 1;
    }
private:
    std::vector<u8> bytes_;
};

// RomFSBuildContext and ConcatenatedVfsFile are both compiled from the
// actual vendor. Their input NUP VirtualFiles use only the host VFS ABI.
std::vector<u8> ReadAt(const FileSys::VirtualFile& file, std::size_t pos,
                       std::size_t count) {
    assert(file && count <= file->GetSize() && pos <= file->GetSize() - count);
    std::vector<u8> result(count);
    if (count) assert(file->Read(result.data(), count, pos) == count);
    return result;
}

u32 Read32(std::span<const u8> bytes, std::size_t pos) {
    assert(pos <= bytes.size() && bytes.size() - pos >= 4);
    u32 result{};
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) result |= u32(bytes[pos + i]) << (i * 8);
    return result;
}

u64 Read64(std::span<const u8> bytes, std::size_t pos) {
    assert(pos <= bytes.size() && bytes.size() - pos >= 8);
    u64 result{};
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) result |= u64(bytes[pos + i]) << (i * 8);
    return result;
}

std::map<std::string, std::string> DecodeRomFS(const FileSys::VirtualFile& image) {
    constexpr u32 Empty = 0xffffffffU;
    const auto header = ReadAt(image, 0, 0x50);
    assert(Read64(header, 0) == 0x50);
    // RomFSHeader: 5 pairs of u64, with data offset as last u64.
    const auto dir_table_at = Read64(header, 0x18);
    const auto dir_table_size = Read64(header, 0x20);
    const auto file_table_at = Read64(header, 0x38);
    const auto file_table_size = Read64(header, 0x40);
    const auto data_at = Read64(header, 0x48);
    assert(dir_table_size && file_table_size);
    assert(dir_table_size < (1 << 20) && file_table_size < (1 << 20));
    const auto dirs = ReadAt(image, dir_table_at, dir_table_size);
    const auto files = ReadAt(image, file_table_at, file_table_size);

    std::map<std::string, std::string> collected;
    auto visit = [&](auto&& self, u32 entry, std::string prefix, int depth) -> void {
        assert(depth < 20);
        while (entry != Empty) {
            assert(entry <= dirs.size() && dirs.size() - entry >= 0x18);
            const u32 sibling = Read32(dirs, entry + 4);
            const u32 child_dir = Read32(dirs, entry + 8);
            const u32 first_file = Read32(dirs, entry + 0xc);
            const u32 name_size = Read32(dirs, entry + 0x14);
            assert(name_size <= dirs.size() - entry - 0x18);
            const auto name = std::string(
                reinterpret_cast<const char*>(dirs.data() + entry + 0x18), name_size);
            const auto current = prefix.empty() ? name :
                                 name.empty() ? prefix : prefix + "/" + name;
            u32 file_id = first_file;
            for (int n = 0; file_id != Empty; ++n) {
                assert(n < 1000);
                assert(file_id <= files.size() && files.size() - file_id >= 0x20);
                const u32 file_sibling = Read32(files, file_id + 4);
                const u64 file_offset = Read64(files, file_id + 8);
                const u64 file_size = Read64(files, file_id + 16);
                const u32 file_name_size = Read32(files, file_id + 0x1c);
                assert(file_name_size <= files.size() - file_id - 0x20);
                const auto file_name = std::string(
                    reinterpret_cast<const char*>(files.data() + file_id + 0x20),
                    file_name_size);
                assert(file_size < (1 << 20));
                const auto value = ReadAt(image, data_at + file_offset, file_size);
                const auto path = current.empty() ? file_name : current + "/" + file_name;
                assert(!collected.contains(path));
                collected.emplace(path, std::string(value.begin(), value.end()));
                file_id = file_sibling;
            }
            if (child_dir != Empty) self(self, child_dir, current, depth + 1);
            entry = sibling;
        }
    };
    visit(visit, 0, "", 0);
    return collected;
}

std::map<std::string, std::string> ExtractContents(const FileSys::VirtualDir& root) {
    assert(root);
    std::map<std::string, std::string> collected;
    const auto visit = [&](auto&& self, const FileSys::VirtualDir& dir,
                           const std::string& prefix, int depth) -> void {
        assert(dir && depth < 20);
        for (const auto& file : dir->GetFiles()) {
            assert(file);
            const auto bytes = ReadAt(file, 0, file->GetSize());
            const auto name = prefix.empty() ? file->GetName() :
                              prefix + "/" + file->GetName();
            assert(collected.emplace(name, std::string(bytes.begin(), bytes.end())).second);
        }
        for (const auto& child : dir->GetSubdirectories()) {
            const auto name = prefix.empty() ? child->GetName() :
                              prefix + "/" + child->GetName();
            self(self, child, name, depth + 1);
        }
    };
    visit(visit, root, "", 0);
    return collected;
}

std::vector<u8> ReadFile(const char* path) {
    std::ifstream stream(path, std::ios::binary);
    assert(stream);
    return {std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(stream), std::istreambuf_iterator<char>()};
}
} // namespace


int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    assert(argc == 2);
    std::string error;
    auto input = std::make_shared<MemoryFile>(ReadFile(argv[1]));
    const auto mount = Eden::NupV1::Native::Mount::Open(input, &error);
    assert(mount && error.empty());
    Eden::NupV1::Native::ContentSet content(mount);
    assert(content.HasExecutableMain());
    const auto base = content.CreateRomFS();
    const auto base_files = DecodeRomFS(base);
    assert(base_files.size() == 3);
    assert(base_files.at("state.bin") == "latest-v3");
    assert(base_files.at("sub/base.dat") == "base-only");
    assert(base_files.at("sub/update.dat") == "update-only");
    assert(!base_files.contains("addon.dat"));
    // Prove the actual vendor ROMFS extractor reverses the builder/concat
    // without using our independently written table decoder.
    const auto extracted_base = FileSys::ExtractRomFS(base);
    assert(ExtractContents(extracted_base) == base_files);

    auto addon_one = content.CreateAddOnRomFS(5);
    auto addon_two = content.CreateAddOnRomFS(4);
    assert(addon_one && addon_two);
    const auto first_files = DecodeRomFS(addon_one);
    const auto second_files = DecodeRomFS(addon_two);
    assert(first_files.size() == 1 && first_files.at("addon.dat") == "addon-one-v2");
    assert(second_files.size() == 1 && second_files.at("addon.dat") == "addon-two");
    assert(ExtractContents(FileSys::ExtractRomFS(addon_one)) == first_files);
    assert(ExtractContents(FileSys::ExtractRomFS(addon_two)) == second_files);
    assert(!content.CreateAddOnRomFS(3)); // older DLC revision
    assert(!content.CreateAddOnRomFS(6)); // unrelated title

    // The authentic vendor builder produces a lazy table-to-file mapping.
    // Even after a successful read, the native NUP source must NOT cache
    // an integrity verdict for mutable underlying bytes.
    const auto header = ReadAt(base, 0, 0x50);
    const auto data_offset = Read64(header, 0x48);
    assert(data_offset == 0x200);
    input->Corrupt("latest-v3");
    std::array<u8, 8> rejected{};
    rejected.fill(0xa5);
    assert(base->Read(rejected.data(), rejected.size(), data_offset) == 0);
    assert(std::all_of(rejected.begin(), rejected.end(),
                       [](u8 byte) { return byte == 0; }));
    // The directory tables remain readable, while the corrupted payload is
    // never returned through the actual vendor-generated RomFS offsets.
    assert(Read64(ReadAt(base, 0, 0x50), 0) == 0x50);

    std::cout << "Real vendor RomFS Create+Extract/Concat/Vector+Offset: binary overlay and SHA rejection OK\n";
}
```

`tools/nup-v1-vfs-host.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Minimal host adapter; no PS5 loader registration or ROM discovery.
#include "nup_v1_vfs.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdint>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <iomanip>
#include <iostream>
#include <span>
#include <string_view>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

class HostSource final : public Eden::NupV1::Source {
public:
    explicit HostSource(const std::filesystem::path& path)
        : input_(path, std::ios::binary), size_(std::filesystem::file_size(path)) {}
    std::uint64_t Size() const override { return size_; }
    bool ReadAt(std::uint64_t offset, std::span<std::uint8_t> dst) const override {
        if (offset > size_ || dst.size() > size_ - offset) return false;
        if (dst.empty()) return true;
        input_.clear();
        input_.seekg(static_cast<std::streamoff>(offset));
        if (!input_) return false;
        input_.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(dst.data()),
                    static_cast<std::streamsize>(dst.size()));
        return input_.gcount() == static_cast<std::streamsize>(dst.size());
    }
private:
    mutable std::ifstream input_;
    std::uint64_t size_{};
};

void PrintHex(std::span<const std::uint8_t> bytes) {
    for (const auto c : bytes)
        std::cout << std::hex << std::setfill('0') << std::setw(2)
                  << static_cast<unsigned>(c);
    std::cout << std::dec;
}

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    if (argc != 3) {
        std::cerr << "Usage: nup-v1-vfs-host archive.nup package-relative/path\n";
        return 2;
    }
    try {
        HostSource source(argv[1]);
        std::string error;
        auto archive = Eden::NupV1::Archive::Mount(source, &error);
        if (!archive) {
            std::cerr << "NUP mount rejected: " << error << '\n';
            return 1;
        }
        const std::string_view name(argv[2]);
        constexpr std::string_view list_effective = "@list-effective/romfs/";
        if (name.starts_with(list_effective)) {
            const auto entries = archive->ListEffectiveDirectory(
                Eden::NupV1::ContentView::RomFS, name.substr(list_effective.size()));
            if (!entries) {
                std::cerr << "Effective directory not found\n";
                return 1;
            }
            for (const auto& entry : *entries) {
                std::cout << entry.name << ':'
                          << (entry.directory ? "D" : "F") << ':';
                if (entry.file_index) std::cout << *entry.file_index;
                std::cout << '\n';
            }
            return 0;
        }
        std::optional<std::size_t> file;
        constexpr std::string_view effective = "@effective/romfs/";
        constexpr std::string_view base = "@base/romfs/";
        constexpr std::string_view first_update = "@update1/romfs/";
        constexpr std::string_view second_update = "@update2/romfs/";
        constexpr std::string_view addon = "@addon/romfs/";
        if (name.starts_with(effective))
            file = archive->FindEffectiveMember(Eden::NupV1::ContentView::RomFS,
                                                name.substr(effective.size()));
        else if (name.starts_with(base))
            file = archive->FindPackageMember(0, Eden::NupV1::ContentView::RomFS,
                                              name.substr(base.size()));
        else if (name.starts_with(first_update))
            file = archive->FindPackageMember(1, Eden::NupV1::ContentView::RomFS,
                                              name.substr(first_update.size()));
        else if (name.starts_with(second_update))
            file = archive->FindPackageMember(2, Eden::NupV1::ContentView::RomFS,
                                              name.substr(second_update.size()));
        else if (name.starts_with(addon)) {
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < archive->Packages().size(); ++i) {
                if (archive->Packages()[i].kind == 2) {
                    file = archive->FindPackageMember(i, Eden::NupV1::ContentView::RomFS,
                                                      name.substr(addon.size()));
                    break;
                }
            }
        } else
            file = archive->FindFile(0, name);
        if (!file) {
            std::cerr << "Member not found in package 0\n";
            return 1;
        }
        const auto member_size = archive->MemberSize(*file);
        const auto chunk_size = static_cast<std::size_t>(
            std::min<std::uint64_t>(member_size, 64));
        std::vector<std::uint8_t> first(chunk_size), last(chunk_size);
        if (!archive->ReadMember(*file, 0, first, &error) ||
            !archive->ReadMember(*file, member_size - chunk_size, last, &error)) {
            std::cerr << "NUP member rejected: " << error << '\n';
            return 1;
        }
        std::cout << "size=" << member_size << " first=";
        PrintHex(first);
        std::cout << " last=";
        PrintHex(last);
        std::cout << "\n";
        return 0;
    } catch (const std::exception& ex) {
        std::cerr << "Host error: " << ex.what() << '\n';
        return 1;
    }
}
```

`tools/overlay-style-check.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#include "in_game_overlay_style.h"
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <set>
using namespace Eden::QuickOverlay;
int main() {
    std::set<std::uint32_t> seen;
    for (int palette=0;palette<4;++palette)
      for (int accent=0;accent<5;++accent)
        for (int contrast=0;contrast<2;++contrast) {
            const auto id=StyleId(palette,accent,contrast!=0,false);
            assert(id<40u && seen.insert(id).second);
            for(const auto primitive:{kBackdrop,kRow,kSelectedRow,kWarningRow}){
                const auto tag=StyledMode(primitive,id);
                assert(IsQuickMode(tag));
                assert(((tag>>8u)&63u)==id);
                assert((tag&kKindMask)==(primitive&kKindMask));
            }
        }
    assert(seen.size()==40u);
    assert(StyleId(3,4,false,true)==StyleId(0,4,false,false));
    assert(StyleId(-99,100,false,false)==StyleId(0,4,false,false));
    assert(StyleId(99,-5,true,false)==StyleId(3,0,true,false));
    assert(!IsQuickMode(0u));
    assert(!IsQuickMode(48000u));
    assert(!IsQuickMode(0xfffffff4u));
}
```

```sh
                  if pathlib.Path(entry['file']).as_posix().endswith('/headless/main.cpp')]
assert len(launcher_units) == 1, 'Cannot prove native launcher frontend selection'

                 else shlex.split(launcher['command']))
frontend_flags = [flag for flag in launcher_args if flag.startswith('-DEDEN_DEVICE_FRONTEND=')]

    'Shipping PS5 native frontend must be compiled OFF', frontend_flags)

assert 'EDEN_DEVICE_FRONTEND:UNINITIALIZED=ON' not in profile

assert not game or graphics

(root / 'build/headless-native/frontend.json').write_text(json.dumps({
    'devices': devices,
    'gpu_probe': 'EDEN_GPU_PROBE:BOOL=ON' in profile,
    'renderer': 'opengl-4.6-compatibility' if graphics else 'null', 'guest_fixture': 'retail-game' if game else 'cpu-state-memory-atomics-fp-simd-services' if integration else 'timer-sync-service-storage-hid-audio-renderer-voice-mix-src-high' if devices else 'timer-sync-service-storage',
    'vulkan': 'EDEN_PS5_VULKAN:BOOL=ON' in profile,
    'vulkan_driver': 'RADV' if 'EDEN_VULKAN_DRIVER:STRING=RADV' in profile else 'CUSTOM',

    'development_rom_id': next((line.split('=', 1)[1] for line in profile.splitlines()
```
