`tools/sync-glyph-overrides.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Sync the visual-button glyph catalogue from niakw/encore-overrides.

Like tools/sync-encore-overrides.py, this embeds a verified offline snapshot.
No textures, no unlicensed game images, no controller remapping.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import re
from pathlib import Path

HEX_TITLE = re.compile(r"[0-9a-fA-F]{16}\Z")
UPDATE = re.compile(r"[a-zA-Z0-9_.+ -]{1,64}\Z")


def make_snapshot(src: Path) -> tuple[str, str]:
    data = json.loads(src.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if not isinstance(data, dict) or set(data) != {"schema_version", "revision", "titles"}:
        raise ValueError("invalid glyph catalogue schema")
    if type(data["schema_version"]) is not int or data["schema_version"] != 2:
        raise ValueError("unknown glyph catalogue version")
    if type(data["revision"]) is not int or not 1 <= data["revision"] <= 2**31 - 1:
        raise ValueError("invalid glyph catalogue revision")
    if not isinstance(data["titles"], list) or len(data["titles"]) > 256:
        raise ValueError("glyph title rules exceed 256")
    normalized = []
    seen = set()
    for entry in data["titles"]:
        if not isinstance(entry, dict) or set(entry) != {"title_id", "update_version"}:
            raise ValueError("glyph rule requires title_id and update_version only")
        title = entry["title_id"]
        version = entry["update_version"]
        if not isinstance(title, str) or HEX_TITLE.fullmatch(title) is None or int(title, 16) == 0:
            raise ValueError("invalid title ID")
        if not isinstance(version, str) or UPDATE.fullmatch(version) is None:
            raise ValueError("invalid update version")
        key = (title.upper(), version)
        if key in seen:
            raise ValueError("duplicate title+update version")
        seen.add(key)
        normalized.append({"title_id": title.upper(), "update_version": version})
    normalized.sort(key=lambda x: (x["title_id"], x["update_version"]))
    canonical = {"schema_version": 2, "revision": data["revision"], "titles": normalized}
    snapshot = json.dumps(canonical, indent=2, ensure_ascii=True) + "\n"
    rows = []
    for item in normalized:
        rows.append("    {0x" + item["title_id"] + "ULL, " +
                    json.dumps(item["update_version"]) + "},")
    code = [
        "// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later",
        "// Generated by tools/sync-glyph-overrides.py from niakw/encore-overrides/glyphs/manifest.json.",
        "// Do not hand-edit. Rules select ART assets only; input mapping is unrelated.",
        "#pragma once",
        "#include <array>",
        "#include <cstdint>",
        "namespace Eden::GlyphOverridesGenerated {",
        "struct Rule { std::uint64_t title; const char* update_version; };",
        f"inline constexpr int kRevision = {data['revision']};",
        f"inline constexpr std::array<Rule, {len(rows)}> kRules = {{{{",
        *rows,
        "}};",
        "} // namespace Eden::GlyphOverridesGenerated",
        "",
    ]
    return snapshot, "\n".join(code)


def main() -> None:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument("--source", type=Path, help="checkout of niakw/encore-overrides")
    p.add_argument("--manifest", type=Path,
                   help="already synced manifest; for offline reproducibility tests")
    p.add_argument("--output", type=Path,
                   default=Path("headless/glyph_overrides_generated.h"))
    p.add_argument("--snapshot", type=Path,
                   default=Path("data/glyph-overrides.json"))
    p.add_argument("--check", action="store_true",
                   help="read-only: fail if generated output or snapshot drifted")
    args = p.parse_args()
    if (args.source is None) == (args.manifest is None):
        p.error("pass exactly one of --source or --manifest")
    source = args.source / "glyphs" / "manifest.json" if args.source else args.manifest
    snapshot, header = make_snapshot(source)
    if args.check:
        if args.snapshot.read_text() != snapshot or args.output.read_text() != header:
            raise SystemExit("glyph overrides generated C++ or local snapshot is stale")
    else:
        args.snapshot.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        args.snapshot.write_text(snapshot)
        args.output.write_text(header)
    print(f"PASS glyph visual overrides: {source}, sync/check={args.check}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

`tools/test-analyze-r01-frame-metrics.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
"""Synthetic, test-only telemetry; never claimed as measured FC27 performance."""
import contextlib
import importlib.util
import io
import json
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
import unittest

SCRIPT = Path(__file__).with_name("analyze-r01-frame-metrics.py")
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("r01_metrics_analyzer", SCRIPT)
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
assert spec and spec.loader
spec.loader.exec_module(module)

def row(frame, source, real, generated, presented, interval=1000000000):
    return (f"EDEN_R01_FRAME_METRICS frame={frame} interval_ns={interval} "
            f"source_composites={source} real_queued={real} generated_queued={generated} "
            f"source_skipped=0 loading_queued=0 present_returned={presented} "
            f"source_callback_fps={source}.000 real_queue_fps={real}.000 "
            f"generated_queue_fps={generated}.000 present_return_fps={presented}.000 "
            f"scope={module.SCOPE}")

class R01MetricsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_30_to_60_is_not_guest_fps(self):
        rows, bad = module.parse_logs([row(30, 30, 30, 30, 60)])
        report=module.summary(rows,bad)
        self.assertEqual(report["sessions"][0]["rates"],
            {"source_callback_fps": 30.0, "real_queued_fps": 30.0,
             "generated_queued_fps": 30.0, "present_return_fps": 60.0})
        self.assertIsNone(report["actual_guest_fps"])
        self.assertIsNone(report["input_to_photon_latency"])
        self.assertIsNone(report["gpu_render_time_ms"])
    def test_weighted_windows_not_mean_fps(self):
        a=row(10, 10, 10, 0, 10, 1000000000)
        b=row(50, 10, 10, 0, 10, 3000000000)
        report=module.summary(*module.parse_logs([a,b]))
        self.assertEqual(report["sessions"][0]["rates"]["real_queued_fps"],5.0)
        self.assertEqual(report["sessions"][0]["duration_ns"],4000000000)
    def test_session_reset_and_malformed(self):
        logs=[row(100, 1, 1, 0, 1), row(20, 2, 2, 0, 2),
              row(25, 3, 3, 0, 3).replace("scope="+module.SCOPE,"scope=fabricated_guest_fps"),
              "EDEN_R01_FRAME_METRICS broken"]
        report=module.summary(*module.parse_logs(logs))
        self.assertEqual(len(report["sessions"]),2)
        self.assertEqual(report["sessions"][1]["counts"]["real_queued"],2)
        self.assertEqual(len(report["rejected_lines"]),2)
    def test_cli_json_and_absence(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            log=Path(folder)/"boot.log"
            log.write_text("foo\n"+row(30,30,30,30,60)+"\n")
            out=io.StringIO()
            with contextlib.redirect_stdout(out):
                self.assertEqual(module.main(["--json",str(log)]),0)
            self.assertEqual(json.loads(out.getvalue())["sessions"][0]["counts"]["present_returned"],60)
            log.write_text("unrelated logs")
            with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
                self.assertEqual(module.main([str(log)]),2)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

`tools/update-upstream-comparison.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Refresh pinned dependency comparisons without modifying dependency versions."""
import argparse
import datetime as datetime
import json
import os
import re
from pathlib import Path
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
import urllib.error

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
REPORT=ROOT/"docs/UPSTREAM_GAP_REGISTER_2026-10-14.md"
START="<!-- BEGIN AUTO-UPSTREAM-COMPARISON -->"
END="<!-- END AUTO-UPSTREAM-COMPARISON -->"

def sources():
    items=json.loads((ROOT/"tools/deps.json").read_text())["items"]
    result=[]
    for item in items:
        url=item.get("url") or ""
        parsed=urllib.parse.urlparse(url)
        parts=parsed.path.strip("/").split("/")
        repo=parts[0]+"/"+parts[1].removesuffix(".git") if parsed.hostname=="github.com" and len(parts)>1 else ""
        ref=item.get("commit") or ""
        if not ref and repo and len(parts)>3 and parts[2]=="archive":
            tail=parts[3:]
            if tail[:2]==["refs","tags"]:
                tail=tail[2:]
            ref="/".join(tail).removesuffix(".tar.gz").removesuffix(".zip")
        if "/releases/download/" in parsed.path:
            ref=""
        result.append((item["name"],repo if ref else "",ref))
    return result

def fetch(path):
    token=os.environ.get("GH_TOKEN") or os.environ.get("GITHUB_TOKEN")
    if not token: raise RuntimeError("GitHub token required")
    req=urllib.request.Request("https://api.github.com/"+path,headers={
        "Authorization":"Bearer "+token,"Accept":"application/vnd.github+json",
        "X-GitHub-Api-Version":"2022-11-28","User-Agent":"encore-upstream-check"})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=30) as response:
            return json.load(response)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        if e.code in (404,409,422):
            return {"error_status":e.code}
        raise RuntimeError("GitHub API "+str(e.code)+" for "+path) from e

def compare(rows,api=fetch):
    output=[]
    for name,repo,ref in rows:
        if not repo:
            output.append((name,"frozen archive / binary",ref or "—","—","not comparable"))
            continue
        meta=api("repos/"+repo)
        if "error_status" in meta:
            output.append((name,repo,ref[:12],"—","repository unavailable"))
            continue
        branch=meta["default_branch"]
        encoded=urllib.parse.quote(ref,safe="")+"..."+urllib.parse.quote(branch,safe="")
        data=api("repos/"+repo+"/compare/"+encoded+"?per_page=100")
        if "error_status" in data:
            output.append((name,repo,ref[:12],"—","comparison unavailable"))
            continue
        ahead,behind=data.get("ahead_by"),data.get("behind_by")
        if not isinstance(ahead,int) or not isinstance(behind,int):
            raise RuntimeError("Malformed response "+repo)
        status="identical" if ahead==behind==0 else "diverged" if behind else "upstream ahead"
        # Commit messages remain untrusted upstream text: sanitize before rendering.
        important=("kernel","schedul","mutex","lock","memory","heap","guest","jit",
                   "dynarmic","cache","shader","texture","gpu","vulkan","radv",
                   "buffer","hid","controller","input","save","fs","sync","thread",
                   "frame","fence","alloc","compil","driv","fix","hang","freeze")
        notable=[]
        for item in data.get("commits",[]):
            raw=item.get("commit",{}).get("message","").splitlines()
            title=raw[0] if raw else ""
            if any(term in title.lower() for term in important):
                title=title.replace("|","/").replace("[","(").replace("]",")")
                title=title.replace("<","").replace(">","").replace("`","'")[:115]
                notable.append((item.get("sha","")[:12],title))
        limit=45 if name=="eden" else 20 if name in ("ps5-mesa","ps5-payload-sdk-fork","opengl-source") else 8
        output.append((name,repo,ref[:12],f"+{ahead} / -{behind}",status,
                       notable[-limit:],ahead>len(data.get("commits",[]))))
        print(name,repo,output[-1][3],status,flush=True)
    return output

def render_source(repo):
    # A fallback label such as "frozen archive / binary" is not a
    # GitHub owner/repository path, even though it contains a slash.
    # Emit ordinary text rather than an invalid Markdown hyperlink.
    if re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+", repo):
        return f"[{repo}](https://github.com/{repo})"
    return repo


def section(rows,stamp):
    lines=[START,"### Automated comparison (daily + manual)","",
       "Checked in UTC: **"+stamp+"**. Changes are commits relative to pins, not proven missing fixes.",
       "This workflow never imports source patches, modifies dependencies, or reads console data.","",
       "| Dependency | Source | Pinned revision | Ahead / behind | Status |",
       "|---|---|---|---:|---|"]
    for row in rows:
        name,repo,ref,delta,status=row[:5]
        source=render_source(repo)
        lines.append("| "+name+" | "+source+" | "+ref+" | "+delta+" | "+status+" |")
    lines.extend(["","### Source changes requiring review","",
                  "These are upstream commit titles, not validated Encore integrations."])
    for row in rows:
        if len(row)<7 or not row[5]:continue
        name,repo=row[:2]
        lines.append("")
        lines.append("**"+name+"**"+(" (history excerpt; some commits omitted)" if row[6] else ""))
        for sha,title in row[5]:
            if sha:
                lines.append("- ["+sha+"](https://github.com/"+repo+"/commit/"+sha+") — "+title)
    lines.extend(["","Unavailable comparisons are not equivalent to zero changes.",
                  "The API can truncate changed-file lists beyond 300 files.",END])
    return "\n".join(lines)

def update(text,new):
    if text.count(START)!=text.count(END) or text.count(START)>1:
        raise RuntimeError("Malformed report markers")
    if START in text:
        text=text[:text.index(START)]+text[text.index(END)+len(END):]
    return text.rstrip()+"\n\n"+new+"\n"

def test():
    rows=sources()
    assert len(rows)==22 and len(set(x[0] for x in rows))==22
    assert next(x for x in rows if x[0]=="eden")[2].startswith("5f142c")
    assert next(x for x in rows if x[0]=="fmt")[2]=="12.1.0"
    assert next(x for x in rows if x[0]=="pacbrew")[1]==""
    assert render_source("owner/repo") == "[owner/repo](https://github.com/owner/repo)"
    assert render_source("frozen archive / binary") == "frozen archive / binary"
    assert render_source("a/b/c") == "a/b/c"
    demo=[("demo","owner/repo","aaa","+2 / -1","diverged"),
          ("non-comparable","frozen archive / binary","—","—","not comparable")]
    assert "| non-comparable | frozen archive / binary | — | — | not comparable |" in section(demo,"2026-10-14")
    assert "https://github.com/frozen archive" not in section(demo,"2026-10-14")
    x=update("Existing notes",section(demo,"2026-10-14"))
    y=update(x,section(demo,"2026-10-15"))
    assert y.count(START)==y.count(END)==1 and "2026-10-14" not in y
    print("UPSTREAM_DAILY_SELFTEST_PASS source_count=22")

if __name__=="__main__":
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument("--self-test",action="store_true")
    p.add_argument("--refresh",action="store_true")
    args=p.parse_args()
    if args.self_test:
        test()
    elif args.refresh:
        rows=compare(sources())
        stamp=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC")
        REPORT.write_text(update(REPORT.read_text(),section(rows,stamp)))
        print("UPSTREAM_DAILY_REFRESH_PASS",len(rows),stamp)
    else:
        p.error("choose --self-test or --refresh")
```

`tools/vendor-eden-cpm.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Materialize and validate every actual PS5 Eden CPM source cache entry.

Capture only from a PS5 build that already populated and version-verified its
CPM cache. Never fetch moving network sources. Every readable file is committed
in Eden's own Git, with a deterministic full-directory content fingerprint.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse,hashlib,json,os,shutil,sys,tarfile,functools

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
LOCK=ROOT/'vendor/sources/eden-cpm/VENDOR-CPM-LOCK.json'
SOURCES=LOCK.parent
FILE=ROOT/'vendor/sources/eden/cpmfile.json'
PIN='5f142c7926d0c7fcbbd0ce30794d72f638a43b2a'
EOL_ARCHIVE=ROOT/'vendor/objects/eden-cpm-eol-originals.tar.gz'
EOL_META=ROOT/'vendor/objects/eden-cpm-eol-originals.json'

def digest(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

@functools.lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def original_eol_files():
 if not EOL_ARCHIVE.is_file() or not EOL_META.is_file():
  # During first, deliberate source capture there is no original EOL archive.
  return {}
 specs=json.loads(EOL_META.read_text())
 assert specs['format']=='cpm-original-line-endings-1'
 originals={}
 with tarfile.open(EOL_ARCHIVE,'r:gz') as f:
  for member in f.getmembers():
   if not member.isfile() or member.name not in specs['entries'] or member.name.startswith('/') or '..' in Path(member.name).parts:
    raise RuntimeError(f'Unexpected original CPM EOL record {member.name}')
   raw=f.extractfile(member).read()
   if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()!=specs['entries'][member.name]['original_sha256']:
    raise RuntimeError('Corrupt original EOL byte record '+member.name)
   originals[member.name]=raw
 if set(originals)!=set(specs['entries']):
  raise RuntimeError('Original CPM EOL overlay is incomplete')
 return originals

def tree(path):
 h=hashlib.sha256();number=0;size=0
 try:relative_package=path.resolve().relative_to(SOURCES.resolve()).as_posix()
 except ValueError:relative_package=None
 overrides=original_eol_files() if relative_package is not None else {}
 for f in sorted(path.rglob('*')):
  if f.is_dir() and not f.is_symlink():continue
  relative=f.relative_to(path).as_posix()
  if f.is_symlink():
   target=os.readlink(f)
   if not (path/relative).resolve().is_relative_to(path.resolve()):
    raise RuntimeError(f'CPM source symlink escapes its package: {f} -> {target}')
   h.update(b'L'+relative.encode()+b'\0'+target.encode()+b'\0')
  elif f.is_file():
   h.update(b'F'+relative.encode()+b'\0')
   key=relative_package+'/'+relative if relative_package is not None else None
   original=overrides.get(key)
   if original is not None:
    present=f.read_bytes()
    if present!=original and present!=original.replace(b'\r\n',b'\n'):
     raise RuntimeError('Corrupt or unknown LF-normalized CPM source '+str(f))
    h.update(original);size+=len(original)
   else:
    with f.open('rb') as stream:
     for block in iter(lambda:stream.read(1024*1024),b''):
      h.update(block);size+=len(block)
   number+=1
  else:raise RuntimeError(f'Unexpected CPM source entry {f}')
 return {'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'files':number,'bytes':size}

def capture(cache):
 source_pins=json.loads(FILE.read_text())
 if not cache.is_dir():raise RuntimeError(f'Missing populated PS5 CPM source cache {cache}')
 results={}
 for folder in sorted(cache.iterdir()):
  if not folder.is_dir():continue
  names=[p for p in folder.iterdir() if p.is_dir()]
  if len(names)!=1:raise RuntimeError(f'Unknown/ambiguous CPM versions: {folder}: {names}')
  src=names[0];version=src.name
  matches=[key for key,val in source_pins.items() if val.get('version')==version]
  # Different upstream header packages can share version tags; identify the
  # actual package by its known CPM cache namespace, never by release alone.
  namespace={'boost':'boost','vulkanheaders':'vulkan-headers',
             'vulkanutilitylibraries':'vulkan-utility-libraries',
             'vulkanmemoryallocator':'vulkan-memory-allocator',
             'nlohmann_json':'nlohmann','nx_tzdb':'tzdb'}
  chosen=namespace.get(folder.name,folder.name)
  if chosen in matches:matches=[chosen]
  if len(matches)!=1:raise RuntimeError(f'Unmatched or ambiguous CPM revision {folder.name}/{version}: {matches}')
  vendor=SOURCES/folder.name/version
  vendor.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
  # A capture can be restarted after a transient issue without attempting to
  # re-create framework symlinks that the first pass already copied. Cached
  # trees are checked by their complete hash below; never merge over an older
  # vendored snapshot with conflicting symlinks.
  if not vendor.exists():
   shutil.copytree(src,vendor,symlinks=True)
  got=tree(vendor)
  # A deliberate re-capture must reject cache content drift rather than
  # silently accept a stale snapshot at the same package version/tag.
  if got!=tree(src):
   raise RuntimeError(f'CPM source cache changed since snapshot: {folder.name}/{version}')
  results[folder.name]={'version':version,'cpm_key':matches[0],
                        'source_repo':source_pins[matches[0]].get('repo'),
                        'upstream_sha512':source_pins[matches[0]].get('hash'),
                        **got}
  print(f'CPM_VENDOR_CAPTURED {folder.name}/{version} files={got["files"]} bytes={got["bytes"]}',flush=True)
 obj={'original_eden_commit':PIN,'cpmfile_sha256':digest(FILE),
      'entries':results,'excluded_unfetched_cpm_pins':sorted(set(source_pins)-{v['cpm_key'] for v in results.values()})}
 LOCK.write_text(json.dumps(obj,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
 print(f'CPM_VENDOR_COMPLETE source_roots={len(results)} files={sum(v["files"] for v in results.values())} bytes={sum(v["bytes"] for v in results.values())}',flush=True)

def check():
 obj=json.loads(LOCK.read_text())
 if obj['original_eden_commit']!=PIN or obj['cpmfile_sha256']!=digest(FILE):
  raise RuntimeError('Pinned Eden cpmfile.json unexpectedly changed')
 pins=json.loads(FILE.read_text())
 if len(obj['entries'])<20:raise RuntimeError('Expected 20+ cached PS5 CPM input packages')
 drifted=[]
 for name,record in obj['entries'].items():
  folder=SOURCES/name/record['version']
  v=pins[record['cpm_key']]
  if v['version']!=record['version'] or v.get('hash')!=record['upstream_sha512']:
   raise RuntimeError(f'Wrong CPM package or archive pin {name}')
  observed=tree(folder)
  if any(observed[k]!=record[k] for k in ('sha256','files','bytes')):
   drifted.append({'package':name,
                  'expected':{k:record[k] for k in ('sha256','files','bytes')},
                  'observed':observed})
 if drifted:
  raise RuntimeError('CPM pinned-source snapshot drift (do not silently repin): '+
                     json.dumps(drifted,sort_keys=True))
 print('CPM_VENDOR_COMPLETE_OK',len(obj['entries']),'cached PS5 CPM packages; original EOL bytes restored',len(original_eol_files()),'; unused platform/test pins',len(obj['excluded_unfetched_cpm_pins']))
 return obj

def stage(target):
 obj=check()
 destination=target/'.cache/cpm'
 for name,record in obj['entries'].items():
  dst=destination/name/record['version']
  if dst.is_dir():continue
  if dst.exists():raise RuntimeError(f'CPM target not a directory {dst}')
  dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
  shutil.copytree(SOURCES/name/record['version'],dst,symlinks=True)
  # Nested upstream .gitattributes may normalize CRLF even though our root
  # declares -text. Restore exact original bytes for all 69 proven cases.
  prefix=f'{name}/{record["version"]}/'
  for rel,raw in original_eol_files().items():
   if rel.startswith(prefix):
    (destination/rel).write_bytes(raw)
  print('CPM_SOURCE_RESTORED',name,record['version'],flush=True)
 print('CPM_SOURCE_STAGE_COMPLETE pinned packages',len(obj['entries']))

if __name__=='__main__':
 ap=argparse.ArgumentParser()
 ap.add_argument('--capture',type=Path)
 ap.add_argument('--check',action='store_true')
 ap.add_argument('--stage',type=Path)
 a=ap.parse_args()
 if a.capture:capture(a.capture)
 if a.check:check()
 if a.stage:stage(a.stage)
 if not (a.capture or a.check or a.stage):ap.error('action required')

```

`tools/vendor_all_sources.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Materialize all immutable pinned build inputs inside the Eden Encore Git tree.

Usage:
 python3 tools/vendor_all_sources.py capture [NAME...]
 python3 tools/vendor_all_sources.py verify [NAME...]

Capture never changes existing upstream revisions, and verifies every archive hash.
Preserves exact upstream Git commits as chunked cloneable bundles and full text trees.
No runtime download is necessary once every listed dependency is captured.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,shutil,subprocess,sys,tarfile,tempfile

ROOT=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
VENDOR=ROOT/'vendor'
SOURCES=VENDOR/'sources'
OBJECTS=VENDOR/'objects'
CHUNK_SIZE=40*1024*1024
MANIFEST=json.loads((ROOT/'tools/deps.json').read_text())['items']

def die(m):raise RuntimeError(m)
def run(cmd,**kw):subprocess.run(cmd,check=True,**kw)
def sha(path,alg):
 h=hashlib.new(alg)
 with open(path,'rb') as f:
  for block in iter(lambda:f.read(1024*1024),b''):h.update(block)
 return h.hexdigest()
def cached(item,entry):
 from importlib.machinery import SourceFileLoader
 # Uses the existing SHA checked cache; this path does not download.
 name=(f"{item['name']}-{entry['name']}" if item['kind']=='files'
       else pathlib.PurePosixPath(entry.get('save') or f"{item['name']}-{(entry.get('sha256') or entry.get('sha512'))[:12]}.tar.gz").name)
 folder=pathlib.Path(os.getenv('PROSPEROEDEN_DEPS_CACHE',str(pathlib.Path.home()/'.cache/prosperoeden-deps')))
 for p in [folder/name,ROOT/entry.get('save','THIS_FILE_DOES_NOT_EXIST')]:
  if p.is_file():
   for alg in ('sha256','sha512'):
    if alg in entry and sha(p,alg)==entry[alg]:return p
 die(f'No verified download of {name}; fetch with tools/deps.py first')
def segment(item,stream_path):
 dest=OBJECTS/item['name'];dest.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
 chunks=[]
 with open(stream_path,'rb') as f:
  for i,block in enumerate(iter(lambda:f.read(CHUNK_SIZE),b'')):
   name=f'{i:04d}.chunk';p=dest/name
   checksum=hashlib.sha256(block).hexdigest()
   if p.exists():
    if sha(p,'sha256')!=checksum:die(f'conflicting immutable chunk {p}')
   else:p.write_bytes(block)
   chunks.append({'file':name,'size':len(block),'sha256':checksum})
 spec={'name':item['name'],'size':stream_path.stat().st_size,'sha256':sha(stream_path,'sha256'),'chunks':chunks}
 (dest/'chunks.json').write_text(json.dumps(spec,indent=2)+'\n')
 return spec

def capture_git(item):
 name=item['name'];target=SOURCES/name
 if target.exists() and (target/'VENDOR-ORIGIN.json').is_file():
  meta=json.loads((target/'VENDOR-ORIGIN.json').read_text())
  if meta.get('commit')==item['commit'] and (OBJECTS/name/'chunks.json').exists():
   print('ALREADY',name,flush=True);return
 if target.exists():die(f'nonempty unrecognized vendored path: {target}')
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix=f'eden-{name}-') as tmp:
  tmp=pathlib.Path(tmp);checkout=tmp/'checkout'
  checkout.mkdir();run(['git','init','-q',str(checkout)])
  run(['git','-C',str(checkout),'remote','add','origin',item['url']])
  print('FETCH',name,item['commit'][:12],flush=True)
  run(['git','-C',str(checkout),'fetch','-q','--depth','1','origin',item['commit']])
  run(['git','-C',str(checkout),'checkout','-q','--detach','FETCH_HEAD'])
  actual=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(checkout),'rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
  if actual!=item['commit']:die(f'{name} commit mismatch {actual}')
  # preserve the original commit metadata/objects for wholly offline git fetch.
  bundle=tmp/'checkout.bundle';run(['git','-C',str(checkout),'bundle','create',str(bundle),'HEAD'])
  heads=subprocess.check_output(['git','bundle','list-heads',str(bundle)],text=True)
  if f"{actual} HEAD" not in heads:die('bundle missing original SHA')
  segment(item,bundle)
  target.mkdir(parents=True)
  files=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(checkout),'ls-files','-z']).split(b'\0')
  copied=0
  for raw in files:
   if not raw:continue
   rel=pathlib.Path(os.fsdecode(raw))
   src=checkout/rel;dst=target/rel;dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
   if src.is_symlink():dst.symlink_to(os.readlink(src))
   elif src.is_file():shutil.copy2(src,dst)
   else:continue # gitlink submodules are inspected separately in verification
   copied+=1
  (target/'VENDOR-ORIGIN.json').write_text(json.dumps({'name':name,'commit':actual,'url':item['url'],'tracked_files':copied},indent=2)+'\n')
  print('VENDORED',name,'files',copied,'source_bytes',sum(x.stat().st_size for x in target.rglob('*') if x.is_file()),'bundle_bytes',bundle.stat().st_size,flush=True)

def capture_archive(item):
 name=item['name'];dest=SOURCES/name
 if item['kind']=='files':
  dest.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
  for entry in item['files']:
   src=cached(item,entry)
   dst=dest/entry['name']
   if not dst.exists():shutil.copy2(src,dst)
   if sha(dst,'sha256')!=entry['sha256']:die(f'wrong vendored {dst}')
  (dest/'VENDOR-ORIGIN.json').write_text(json.dumps({'name':name,'files':len(item['files'])},indent=2)+'\n')
  print('VENDORED',name,'files',len(item['files']),flush=True);return

 archive=cached(item,item)
 # preserve tarballs byte-for-byte, even where upstream source contains symlinks.
 segment(item,archive)
 if name=='pacbrew':
  print('VENDORED',name,'as complete chunked binary SDK archive; unpack for build',flush=True)
  return
 if dest.exists() and (dest/'VENDOR-ORIGIN.json').exists():
  print('ALREADY',name,flush=True);return
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix=f'eden-{name}-') as tmp:
  tmp=pathlib.Path(tmp)
  with tarfile.open(archive,'r:*') as t:
   entries=t.getmembers()
   # All archives (including ffmpeg/harfbuzz) are vendored as full upstream trees.
   for member in entries:
    path=pathlib.PurePosixPath(member.name)
    if path.is_absolute() or '..' in path.parts:die(f'untrusted tar member {member.name}')
   t.extractall(tmp,filter='data')
  roots=[x for x in tmp.iterdir()]
  if len(roots)!=1 or not roots[0].is_dir():die(f'{name} tar not single top-level directory: {roots[:8]}')
  shutil.move(str(roots[0]),str(dest))
  (dest/'VENDOR-ORIGIN.json').write_text(json.dumps({'name':name,'archive_sha':sha(archive,'sha256'),'upstream_url':item['url']},indent=2)+'\n')
  print('VENDORED',name,'source files',sum(1 for x in dest.rglob('*') if x.is_file()),flush=True)

def capture_prefetch(item):
 for idx, entry in enumerate(item.get('setup_prefetch', ())):
  name=f"{item['name']}-setup-{idx}"
  filename=f"{item['name']}-{pathlib.PurePosixPath(entry['dest']).name}"
  path=pathlib.Path(os.getenv('PROSPEROEDEN_DEPS_CACHE',str(pathlib.Path.home()/'.cache/prosperoeden-deps')))/filename
  if not path.is_file():die(f'missing verified setup prefetch: {filename}')
  if sha(path,'sha256')!=entry['sha256']:die(f'wrong setup prefetch SHA: {filename}')
  segment({'name':name},path)
  # Precompiled zlib dependencies are accompanied by their full source tree.
  dest=SOURCES/name
  if path.suffix=='.zip':
   print('VENDORED setup prefetch',name,'as complete ZIP toolchain archive',flush=True)
   continue
  if not dest.exists():
   with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='eden-prefetch-') as tmp:
    temp=pathlib.Path(tmp)
    with tarfile.open(path,'r:*') as t:t.extractall(temp,filter='data')
    roots=[x for x in temp.iterdir()]
    if len(roots)!=1 or not roots[0].is_dir():die(f'unexpected setup archive layout: {filename}')
    shutil.move(str(roots[0]),str(dest))
  (dest/'VENDOR-ORIGIN.json').write_text(json.dumps({'name':name,'sha256':entry['sha256'],'url':entry['url']},indent=2)+'\n')
  print('VENDORED setup prefetch',name,flush=True)

def verify(item):
 if item['kind']=='git':
  meta=json.loads((SOURCES/item['name']/'VENDOR-ORIGIN.json').read_text())
  assert meta['commit']==item['commit'],item['name']
 elif item['kind']=='files':
  for f in item['files']:
   assert sha(SOURCES/item['name']/f['name'],'sha256')==f['sha256'],item['name']
 else:
  spec=json.loads((OBJECTS/item['name']/'chunks.json').read_text())
  digest=hashlib.sha256();size=0
  for part in spec['chunks']:
   p=OBJECTS/item['name']/part['file']
   if sha(p,'sha256')!=part['sha256']:die(f'chunk integrity failure: {p}')
   size+=p.stat().st_size
   with open(p,'rb') as f:
    for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1024*1024),b''):digest.update(b)
  assert size==spec['size'] and digest.hexdigest()==spec['sha256'],item['name']
  for alg in ('sha256','sha512'):
   if alg in item:
    # SHA512 checked during capture; all chunks each SHA256 and archive SHA256.
    break
 print('VERIFIED',item['name'],flush=True)

if __name__=='__main__':
 if len(sys.argv)<2 or sys.argv[1] not in ('capture','verify'):
  print(__doc__);sys.exit(2)
 wanted=set(sys.argv[2:]);known={x['name'] for x in MANIFEST}
 if wanted-known:die(f'unknown deps: {wanted-known}')
 for item in MANIFEST:
  if wanted and item['name'] not in wanted:continue
  if sys.argv[1]=='capture':
   capture_git(item) if item['kind']=='git' else capture_archive(item)
   capture_prefetch(item)
  verify(item)
```

```py
        set(relative "core/hle/kernel/${file}")

            assert "ENCORE_HLE_CMAKE_SELECTION_PASS" in check.stdout, check.stdout
            for helper in ("slab_helpers.h", "k_worker_task_manager.h"):
                generated = out / "headless/include/core/hle/kernel" / helper
                source = root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-threading/src/core/hle/kernel" / helper
                assert generated.is_file(), ("missing copied helper", native, blocking, helper)
                assert generated.read_bytes() == source.read_bytes(), (
                    "staged helper differs from maintained source", helper)
            print("ENCORE_HLE_CMAKE_SELECTION_PASS native=" + native + " blocking=" + blocking)
print("ENCORE_HLE_CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_ONLY_NO_NATIVE_BINARY_BUILT")
```

`tools/verify/hle/check-hle-overlay-layout.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Verify source/prepare/test boundaries for maintained HLE overrides.

Only reads versioned files; never modifies source or builds production objects.
"""
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
cmake = (root / "headless/CMakeLists.txt").read_text()
module = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-threading/native-hle-overrides.cmake").read_text()
workflow = (root / ".github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml").read_text()
assert "python3 -B tools/verify/hle/check-hle-overlay-layout.py" in workflow
assert cmake.count('include("${PORT_ROOT}/vendor/encore-active/eden-threading/native-hle-overrides.cmake")') == 1
assert 'write_derived("${PORT_BUILD_DIR}/k_thread.cpp"' not in cmake
assert 'file(READ "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/core/hle/kernel/k_thread.cpp"' not in cmake
assert not any(
    line.lstrip().startswith(("file(READ", "string(REPLACE", "write_derived("))
    for line in module.splitlines()
)
assert module.count("function(encore_replace_core_source pinned relative)") == 1

assert module.count("list(REMOVE_ITEM sources") == 1

assert "if(PS5_NATIVE)" in module
assert 'target_include_directories(core BEFORE PUBLIC "${_encore_sync_root}")' in module

thread_root = root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-threading/src/core/hle/kernel"
sync_root = root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-sync/src/core/hle/kernel"
for relative in (
    "k_thread.cpp", "k_thread.h", "k_slab_heap.h", "k_scheduler.cpp",
    "slab_helpers.h", "k_worker_task_manager.h",
    "k_condition_variable.cpp", "k_address_arbiter.cpp",
    "svc/svc_condition_variable.cpp", "svc/svc_address_arbiter.cpp",
    "svc/svc_synchronization.cpp", "svc/svc_thread.cpp",
):
    assert (thread_root / relative).is_file(), ("missing maintained source", relative)
    assert relative.split("/")[-1] in module, ("missing CMake selection", relative)
assert (sync_root / "k_synchronization_object.h").is_file()

pinned = (root / "vendor/sources/eden/src/core/hle/kernel/k_thread.cpp").read_text()
active = (thread_root / "k_thread.cpp").read_text()
old = """        // Acquire the scheduler lock.
        KScopedSchedulerLock sl{kernel};

        // Signal.
        m_signaled = true;
        KSynchronizationObject::NotifyAvailable(kernel);

        // Close the thread.
        this->Close(kernel);"""
fixed = """        {
            KScopedSchedulerLock sl{kernel};
            m_signaled = true;
            KSynchronizationObject::NotifyAvailable(kernel);
        }

        // Finalization may block; scheduling must be enabled here.
        this->Close(kernel);"""
assert pinned.count(old) == 1
# The maintained wait lifecycle also publishes the wait queue before the
# state transition. Check both narrow deviations from the pinned source.
wait_before = """    void KThread::BeginWait(KernelCore& kernel, KThreadQueue* queue) {
        // Set our state as waiting.
        this->SetState(kernel, ThreadState::Waiting);

        // Set our wait queue.
        m_wait_queue = queue;
    }"""
wait_after = """    void KThread::BeginWait(KernelCore& kernel, KThreadQueue* queue) {
        // Publish the wait queue before exposing the waiting state.
        // A scheduler state-change observer must not see a waiting thread
        // with no queue to route its wakeup/cancellation to.
        m_wait_queue = queue;
        this->SetState(kernel, ThreadState::Waiting);
    }"""
assert pinned.count(wait_before) == 1
notify_before = "    void KThread::NotifyAvailable(KernelCore& kernel, KSynchronizationObject* signaled_object, Result wait_result) {\n        // Lock the scheduler.\n        KScopedSchedulerLock sl(kernel);\n        // If we're waiting, notify our queue that we're available.\n        if (this->GetState() == ThreadState::Waiting) {\n            m_wait_queue->NotifyAvailable(kernel, this, signaled_object, wait_result);\n        }\n    }"
notify_after = "    void KThread::NotifyAvailable(KernelCore& kernel, KSynchronizationObject* signaled_object, Result wait_result) {\n        // Lock the scheduler.\n        KScopedSchedulerLock sl(kernel);\n        // If we're waiting, notify our queue that we're available.\n        if (this->GetState() == ThreadState::Waiting) {\n            if (m_wait_queue == nullptr) {\n                ASSERT_MSG(false, \"wait_queue is nullptr!\");\n                return;\n            }\n            m_wait_queue->NotifyAvailable(kernel, this, signaled_object, wait_result);\n        }\n    }"
cancel_before = "    void KThread::CancelWait(KernelCore& kernel, Result wait_result, bool cancel_timer_task) {\n        // Lock the scheduler.\n        KScopedSchedulerLock sl(kernel);\n        // If we're waiting, notify our queue that we're available.\n        if (this->GetState() == ThreadState::Waiting) {\n            m_wait_queue->CancelWait(kernel, this, wait_result, cancel_timer_task);\n        }\n    }"
cancel_after = "    void KThread::CancelWait(KernelCore& kernel, Result wait_result, bool cancel_timer_task) {\n        // Lock the scheduler.\n        KScopedSchedulerLock sl(kernel);\n        // If we're waiting, notify our queue that we're available.\n        if (this->GetState() == ThreadState::Waiting) {\n            if (m_wait_queue == nullptr) {\n                ASSERT_MSG(false, \"wait_queue is nullptr!\");\n                return;\n            }\n            m_wait_queue->CancelWait(kernel, this, wait_result, cancel_timer_task);\n        }\n    }"
assert pinned.count(notify_before) == pinned.count(cancel_before) == 1
# A no-op state transition must not publish an identical atomic state.
state_before = "        const ThreadState old_state = m_thread_state.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);\n        m_thread_state.store(\n            static_cast<ThreadState>((old_state & ~ThreadState::Mask) | (state & ThreadState::Mask)),\n            std::memory_order_relaxed);\n        if (m_thread_state.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) != old_state) {\n            KScheduler::OnThreadStateChanged(kernel, this, old_state);\n        }"
state_after = "        const ThreadState old_state = m_thread_state.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);\n        const ThreadState next_state = static_cast<ThreadState>(\n            (old_state & ~ThreadState::Mask) | (state & ThreadState::Mask));\n        // Scheduler lock serializes state transitions. Avoid an atomic store\n        // and second atomic load for an unchanged runnable/waiting state.\n        if (next_state != old_state) {\n            m_thread_state.store(next_state, std::memory_order_relaxed);\n            KScheduler::OnThreadStateChanged(kernel, this, old_state);\n        }"
# Suspend flag updates already check whether scheduler notification is necessary.
# Their relaxed atomic store must follow the same non-noop condition.
update_before = """    void KThread::UpdateState(KernelCore& kernel) {
        ASSERT(KScheduler::IsSchedulerLockedByCurrentThread(kernel));

        // Set our suspend flags in state.
        const ThreadState old_state = m_thread_state.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
        const auto new_state =
            static_cast<ThreadState>(this->GetSuspendFlags()) | (old_state & ThreadState::Mask);
        m_thread_state.store(new_state, std::memory_order_relaxed);

        // Note the state change in scheduler.
        if (new_state != old_state) {
            KScheduler::OnThreadStateChanged(kernel, this, old_state);
        }
    }"""
update_after = """    void KThread::UpdateState(KernelCore& kernel) {
        ASSERT(KScheduler::IsSchedulerLockedByCurrentThread(kernel));

        // Set our suspend flags in state.
        const ThreadState old_state = m_thread_state.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
        const auto new_state =
            static_cast<ThreadState>(this->GetSuspendFlags()) | (old_state & ThreadState::Mask);

        // The scheduler lock serializes updates. Avoid a redundant relaxed
        // atomic store when the suspend flags already match the requested state.
        if (new_state != old_state) {
            m_thread_state.store(new_state, std::memory_order_relaxed);
            // Note the actual state change in scheduler.
            KScheduler::OnThreadStateChanged(kernel, this, old_state);
        }
    }"""
assert pinned.count(update_before) == 1
assert pinned.count(state_before) == 1
assert active == (pinned.replace(old, fixed).replace(wait_before, wait_after)
                  .replace(notify_before, notify_after)
                  .replace(cancel_before, cancel_after)
                  .replace(state_before, state_after)
                  .replace(update_before, update_after)), "Unexpected maintained KThread drift"
slab_pinned = (root / "vendor/sources/eden/src/core/hle/kernel/slab_helpers.h").read_text()
slab_active = (thread_root / "slab_helpers.h").read_text()

        if (is_initialized) {
            Derived::PostDestroy(kernel, arg);

slab_after = """        if (is_initialized) {
            Derived::PostDestroy(kernel, arg);
        }
        Free(kernel, static_cast<Derived*>(this));"""
assert slab_pinned.count(slab_before) == 2
# The maintained slab index helpers now use the actual KernelCore accessor
# and KSlabHeap::GetObjectIndex ABI in all three template variants.
index_before = "return kernel.SlabHeap<Derived>().GetIndex(static_cast<const Derived*>(this));"
index_other = "return SlabHeap<Derived>(kernel).GetObjectIndex(static_cast<const Derived*>(this));"
index_after = "return kernel.SlabHeap<Derived>().GetObjectIndex(static_cast<const Derived*>(this));"
assert slab_pinned.count(index_before) == 1
assert slab_pinned.count(index_other) == 2

                 .replace(index_before, index_after)
                 .replace(index_other, index_after))
```

```py
"""Host witness for unmapped guest addresses in native address arbitration.

Compiles the exact pinned and maintained helper bodies using a memory facade

def real_helpers(source):
    start = "bool ReadFromUser(KernelCore& kernel, s32* out, KProcessAddress address) {"
    stop = "class ThreadQueueImplForKAddressArbiter"
    assert source.count(start) == source.count(stop) == 1
    return start + source.split(start, 1)[1].split(stop, 1)[0].strip() + "\n"

prelude = r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstddef>
#include <iostream>
using u32 = std::uint32_t;
using u64 = std::uint64_t;
using s32 = std::int32_t;
namespace Kernel {
using KProcessAddress = u64;
struct Memory {
    s32 word{5};
    int reads{};
    int writes{};
    bool IsValidVirtualAddressRange(KProcessAddress addr, u64 size) const {
        return addr == 0x1000 && size == sizeof(s32);
    }
    u32 Read32(u64 addr) {
        ++reads;
        return IsValidVirtualAddressRange(addr, 4) ? static_cast<u32>(word) : 0;
    }
    void Write32(u64 addr, u32 value) {
        ++writes;
        if (IsValidVirtualAddressRange(addr, 4)) word = static_cast<s32>(value);
    }
};
struct Monitor {
    Memory* memory{};
    int writes{};
    int clears{};
    u32 ExclusiveRead32(std::size_t, u64 addr) { return memory->Read32(addr); }
    bool ExclusiveWrite32(std::size_t, u64 addr, u32 value) {
        ++writes;
        memory->Write32(addr, value);
        // Pinned Memory::WriteExclusive reports success for an unmapped pointer.
        return true;
    }
    void ClearExclusive(std::size_t) { ++clears; }
};
struct Process {
    Monitor monitor;
    Monitor& GetExclusiveMonitor() { return monitor; }
};
struct KernelCore {
    Memory memory;
    Process process;
    KernelCore() { process.monitor.memory = &memory; }
    std::size_t CurrentPhysicalCoreIndex() const { return 0; }
};
Memory& GetCurrentMemory(KernelCore& k) { return k.memory; }
Process& GetCurrentProcess(KernelCore& k) { return k.process; }
u64 GetInteger(KProcessAddress addr) { return addr; }
namespace {
"""
postlude = r"""
} // namespace anonymous
} // namespace Kernel
int main() {
    using namespace Kernel;
    KernelCore kernel;
    s32 out = 999;
    assert(ReadFromUser(kernel, &out, 0x1000));
    assert(out == 5);
    assert(DecrementIfLessThan(kernel, &out, 0x1000, 10));
    assert(out == 5 && kernel.memory.word == 4);
    assert(UpdateIfEqual(kernel, &out, 0x1000, 4, 7));
    assert(out == 4 && kernel.memory.word == 7);
    // A mapped address with a failed comparison must not be modified.
    const int prior_exclusive = kernel.process.monitor.writes;
    assert(UpdateIfEqual(kernel, &out, 0x1000, 3, 99));
    assert(out == 7 && kernel.memory.word == 7);
    assert(kernel.process.monitor.writes == prior_exclusive);
    [[maybe_unused]] const int before_reads = kernel.memory.reads;
    [[maybe_unused]] const int before_writes = kernel.memory.writes;
    [[maybe_unused]] const int before_exclusive = kernel.process.monitor.writes;
    out = 123;
#if EXPECT_FIXED
    assert(!ReadFromUser(kernel, &out, 0x3000));
    assert(!DecrementIfLessThan(kernel, &out, 0x3000, 10));
    assert(!UpdateIfEqual(kernel, &out, 0x3000, 0, 9));
    assert(kernel.memory.reads == before_reads);
    assert(kernel.memory.writes == before_writes);
    assert(kernel.process.monitor.writes == before_exclusive);
    assert(out == 123);
#else
    assert(ReadFromUser(kernel, &out, 0x3000));
    assert(out == 0);
    assert(DecrementIfLessThan(kernel, &out, 0x3000, 10));
    assert(UpdateIfEqual(kernel, &out, 0x3000, 0, 9));
    assert(kernel.process.monitor.writes == before_exclusive + 2);
#endif
    assert(kernel.memory.word == 7);
    std::cout << (EXPECT_FIXED
        ? "NATIVE_ARBITER_INVALID_ADDRESS_REJECTION_PASS\n"
        : "PINNED_ARBITER_FALSE_SUCCESS_WITNESS_PASS\n");
}
"""
pinned = pinned_path.read_text()
active = active_path.read_text()
expected = pinned
guard = ("    if (!GetCurrentMemory(kernel).IsValidVirtualAddressRange(address, sizeof(s32))) {\n"
         "        return false;\n"

    expected = expected.replace(anchor, anchor + guard)
# Boundary arithmetic must retain the 32-bit guest word's modulo behavior
# without invoking C++ signed-overflow UB in native builds.
```

`tools/verify/hle/check-native-hle-arbiter-wrap-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Host UBSan witness for 32-bit guest address-arbiter counter boundaries.

Compile the actual arithmetic expressions extracted from pinned and maintained
source, verify all four overflow cases fail under UBSan before the fix, and
verify exact 32-bit wrapping plus ordinary values after the fix. This is not
a full guest scheduler or console execution test.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
original = (root / "vendor/sources/eden/src/core/hle/kernel/k_address_arbiter.cpp").read_text()
native = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-threading/src/core/hle/kernel/k_address_arbiter.cpp").read_text()
workflow = (root / ".github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml").read_text()
cmake = (root / "headless/CMakeLists.txt").read_text()
module = (root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-threading/native-hle-overrides.cmake").read_text()
assert "python3 -B tools/verify/hle/check-native-hle-arbiter-wrap-host.py" in workflow
assert "native-hle-overrides.cmake" in cmake
assert "k_address_arbiter.cpp" in module
compiler = shutil.which("g++") or shutil.which("clang++")
assert compiler

def expressions(source):
    decrement = re.findall(r"const s32 decrement_value = (.*?);", source)
    assert len(decrement) == 1
    modifications = re.findall(r"new_value = (.*?);", source)
    assert len(modifications) == 5, modifications
    assert modifications[1] == modifications[4]  # Both no-waiter increments.
    arg = source.split("Result KAddressArbiter::SignalAndIncrementIfEqual(", 1)[1].split(
        "Result KAddressArbiter::SignalAndModifyByWaitingCountIfEqual(", 1)[0]
    marker = "std::addressof(user_value), addr, value,"
    assert arg.count(marker) == 1
    suffix = arg.split(marker, 1)[1]
    stop = suffix.index("),\n                 ResultInvalidCurrentMemory")
    # Stop belongs to UpdateIfEqual( ... ); nested casts are inside the fragment.
    update_arg = suffix[:stop].strip()
    assert re.sub(r"\s+", "", update_arg) == re.sub(r"\s+", "", modifications[1])
    return decrement[0], modifications[1], modifications[2], modifications[0], update_arg

assert expressions(original) == (
    "current_value - 1", "value + 1", "value - 1", "value - 2", "value + 1"
)

template = r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <limits>
using u32 = std::uint32_t;
using s32 = std::int32_t;
s32 Decrement(s32 current_value) {
    const s32 decrement_value = EXPR_DECREMENT;
    return decrement_value;
}
s32 Increment(s32 value) {
    s32 new_value = EXPR_INCREMENT;
    return new_value;
}
s32 SubOne(s32 value) {
    s32 new_value = EXPR_SUBONE;
    return new_value;
}
s32 SubTwo(s32 value) {
    s32 new_value = EXPR_SUBTWO;
    return new_value;
}
s32 UpdateCallIncrement(s32 value) {
    return EXPR_CALL_INCREMENT;
}
int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    assert(argc == 2);
    volatile s32 hi = std::numeric_limits<s32>::max();
    volatile s32 lo = std::numeric_limits<s32>::min();
    switch (std::atoi(argv[1])) {
        case 0: assert(Decrement(lo) == hi); break;
        case 1: assert(Increment(hi) == lo && UpdateCallIncrement(hi) == lo); break;
        case 2: assert(SubOne(lo) == hi); break;
        case 3: assert(SubTwo(lo) == hi - 1); break;
        case 4: assert(Decrement(10) == 9 && Increment(10) == 11
            && SubOne(10) == 9 && SubTwo(10) == 8 && UpdateCallIncrement(10) == 11); break;
        default: return 10;
    }
}
"""
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-arbiter-wrap-") as d:
    temp = Path(d)
    for label, source, fixed in (("pinned", original, False), ("native", native, True)):
        exprs = expressions(source)
        code = template
        keys = ("EXPR_DECREMENT", "EXPR_INCREMENT", "EXPR_SUBONE",
                "EXPR_SUBTWO", "EXPR_CALL_INCREMENT")
        for name, expression in zip(keys, exprs):
            assert code.count(name) == 1
            code = code.replace(name, expression)
        cpp = temp / (label + ".cpp")
        exe = temp / label
        cpp.write_text(code)
        subprocess.run([compiler, "-std=c++20", "-O1", "-Wall", "-Wextra",
                        "-Werror", "-fsanitize=undefined",
                        "-fno-sanitize-recover=undefined",
                        str(cpp), "-o", str(exe)], check=True, timeout=30)
        for mode in range(5):
            result = subprocess.run([str(exe), str(mode)], capture_output=True,
                                    text=True, timeout=10)
            if not fixed and mode < 4:
                assert result.returncode != 0, (label, mode, result.stdout, result.stderr)
                assert "runtime error: signed integer overflow" in result.stderr, (
                    label, mode, result.stderr)
            else:
                assert result.returncode == 0, (label, mode, result.stdout, result.stderr)
        print(("NATIVE_ARBITER_WRAP_UBSAN_PASS" if fixed else
               "PINNED_ARBITER_SIGNED_OVERFLOW_UBSAN_WITNESS_PASS"))
print("ARBITER_COUNTER_HOST_ONLY_NO_CONSOLE_OR_FREEZE_PROOF")
```

```py
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <memory>
#include <vector>
using s32 = std::int32_t;
using s64 = std::int64_t;
using Result = std::int32_t;
static constexpr Result ResultSuccess = 0;
static constexpr Result ResultCancelled = 11;
static constexpr Result ResultTimedOut = 12;
static constexpr Result ResultTerminated = 13;
static constexpr Result ResultNotFound = 14;
#ifdef EDEN_IPC_STANDARD_SLOT_CHECK
static constexpr Result ResultOutOfRange = 15;
#endif
#define R_SUCCEEDED(value) ((value) == ResultSuccess)
#define R_RETURN(value) return (value)
#define R_THROW(value) return (value)
struct KernelCore {};
struct KServerSession;
struct KSynchronizationObject {
    virtual ~KSynchronizationObject() = default;
    template<class T> T DynamicCast() { return dynamic_cast<T>(this); }
    static Result Wait(KernelCore&, s32*, KSynchronizationObject**, s32, s64);
};
struct KServerSession final : KSynchronizationObject {
    static int receive_calls;
    static Result receive_result;
    Result ReceiveRequest(KernelCore&, std::uintptr_t, std::size_t, std::uint64_t) {
        ++receive_calls;
        return receive_result;
    }
};
int KServerSession::receive_calls = 0;
Result KServerSession::receive_result = ResultSuccess;
static std::vector<Result> results;
static std::size_t next_result = 0;
static s32 simulated_success_index = 0;
Result KSynchronizationObject::Wait(KernelCore&, s32* index,
                                    KSynchronizationObject**, s32, s64) {
    assert(next_result < results.size());
    const auto r = results[next_result++];
    if (r == ResultSuccess) *index = simulated_success_index;
    return r;
}
Result ReplyAndReceive(KernelCore& kernel, s32* out_index,
                       KSynchronizationObject** objs, s32 num_objects, s64 timeout) {
    std::uintptr_t message = 0;
    std::size_t buffer_size = 0;
    std::uint64_t message_paddr = 0;
INJECT
}
static void Scenario(const std::vector<Result>& plan, Result expected,
                     s32 expected_index, Result receive = ResultSuccess,
                     s32 success_index = 0, bool empty_object = false) {
    KernelCore kernel;
    KServerSession session;
    KSynchronizationObject* objects[] = {empty_object ? nullptr : &session};
    simulated_success_index = success_index;
    results = plan;
    next_result = 0;
    KServerSession::receive_calls = 0;
    KServerSession::receive_result = receive;
    s32 index = 777;
    const auto result = ReplyAndReceive(kernel, &index, objects, 1, -1);
    assert(result == expected);
    assert(index == expected_index);
    assert(next_result == plan.size());
}
int main() {
    Scenario({ResultCancelled}, ResultCancelled, -1);
    Scenario({ResultTerminated}, ResultTerminated, -1);
    Scenario({ResultTimedOut}, ResultTimedOut, 777);
    Scenario({ResultSuccess}, ResultSuccess, 0);
    Scenario({ResultSuccess}, ResultNotFound, 0, ResultNotFound);
    // ReceiveRequest's NotFound retries the synchronization wait; a later
    // cancellation returns an unambiguous invalid slot.
    Scenario({ResultSuccess, ResultCancelled}, ResultCancelled, -1, ResultNotFound);
#ifdef EDEN_IPC_STANDARD_SLOT_CHECK
    // The normal native path must refuse impossible success slots before
    // dereferencing objs[index]; DEV deliberately retains its pinned path.
    Scenario({ResultSuccess}, ResultOutOfRange, -1, ResultSuccess, -1);
    Scenario({ResultSuccess}, ResultOutOfRange, -1, ResultSuccess, 1);
    Scenario({ResultSuccess}, ResultOutOfRange, -1, ResultSuccess, 0, true);
#endif
    std::puts("ENCORE_HLE_IPC_INDEX_HOST_PASS");
}
"""
# The NotFound branch loops, so a plan with only success and NotFound
# cannot terminate. Test that error scenario through a two-step plan.
code = code.replace(
    "    Scenario({ResultSuccess}, ResultNotFound, 0, ResultNotFound);\n",
    "")

        assert result.returncode == 0, (name, result.stdout[-1000:], result.stderr[-2000:])
```

```py
"""Real-source C++ waiter-list alias witness; native header keeps typed links.

Host only; never a console/gameplay freeze proof.

            reinterpret_cast<ThreadListNode*>(std::addressof(m_thread_list_head));
        ThreadListNode* prev_val = nullptr;
        ThreadListNode *prev, *tail_prev;

        do {
            prev = prev_ptr;
            prev_ptr = prev_ptr->next;
            tail_prev = prev_val;
            prev_val = prev_ptr;
        } while (prev_ptr != node_);

        if (m_thread_list_tail == node_) {
            m_thread_list_tail = tail_prev;
        }

        prev->next = node_->next;"""
fix="""        // Follow the real pointer links; casting the address of the head
        // pointer to a ThreadListNode object violates C++ aliasing rules.
        ThreadListNode** link = std::addressof(m_thread_list_head);
        ThreadListNode* previous = nullptr;
        while (*link != node_) {
            ASSERT(*link != nullptr);
            previous = *link;
            link = std::addressof((*link)->next);
        }

        if (m_thread_list_tail == node_) {
            m_thread_list_tail = previous;
        }

        // Preserve node_->next: NotifyAvailable can still be walking the
        // removed node until its scheduler-locked iteration completes.
        *link = node_->next;"""

                if label=="native" or level==0:
                    assert result.returncode==0,(label,compiler,level,result.stderr)
                elif result.returncode!=0:
                    witnesses+=1
                print(label,Path(compiler).name,"O"+str(level),
                      "ALIAS_WITNESS" if label=="pinned" and result.returncode else "PASS")
assert witnesses>=1,"Original optimizer alias witness not observed on host compilers"
print("PINNED_SYNC_LIST_ALIAS_OPTIMIZED_FAILURE_WITNESS_PASS")
print("NATIVE_SYNC_LIST_TYPED_UNLINK_HOST_PASS")
print("SYNC_LIST_HOST_ONLY_NO_CONSOLE_OR_FREEZE_PROOF")

```

`tools/verify/hle/check-native-hle-wait-timeout-host.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Host UBSan witnesses for native HLE guest-wait deadline saturation.

Compile the actual deadline arithmetic copied directly from the pinned and
maintained SVC C++ sources. Cover normal, zero, infinite, boundary and
out-of-range positive waits. The original synchronization path silently
produces a negative deadline; the two others trigger UBSan signed overflow.
No game-progress, console or on-device timeout claim is implied.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
base = root / "vendor/sources/eden/src/core/hle/kernel/svc"
native = root / "vendor/encore-active/eden-threading/src/core/hle/kernel/svc"
wait64_native = root / "vendor/encore-active/ns2-runtime/kernel_wait64/core/hle/kernel/svc"
cmake = (root / "headless/CMakeLists.txt").read_text()
workflow = (root / ".github/workflows/encore-core-preflight.yml").read_text()
assert "python3 -B tools/verify/hle/check-native-hle-wait-timeout-host.py" in workflow
module = (root/"vendor/encore-active/eden-threading/native-hle-overrides.cmake").read_text()
assert "native-hle-overrides.cmake" in cmake
assert all(name in module for name in ("svc_condition_variable.cpp", "svc_address_arbiter.cpp", "svc_synchronization.cpp"))
compiler = shutil.which("g++") or shutil.which("clang++")
assert compiler

old_condvar = """            timeout = system.Kernel().HardwareTimer().GetTick() + offset_tick + 2;
            if (timeout <= 0) {
                timeout = (std::numeric_limits<s64>::max)();
            }"""
fix_condvar = """            s64 absolute{};
            if (__builtin_add_overflow(system.Kernel().HardwareTimer().GetTick(), offset_tick,
                                       &absolute) ||
                __builtin_add_overflow(absolute, s64{2}, &absolute) || absolute <= 0) {
                timeout = (std::numeric_limits<s64>::max)();
            } else {
                timeout = absolute;
            }"""
old_sync = """        u64 ticks = system.Kernel().HardwareTimer().GetTick();
        ticks += timeout_ns;
        ticks += 2;

        timeout = ticks;"""
fix_sync = """        s64 absolute{};
        if (__builtin_add_overflow(system.Kernel().HardwareTimer().GetTick(), s64{timeout_ns},
                                   &absolute) ||
            __builtin_add_overflow(absolute, s64{2}, &absolute) || absolute <= 0) {
            timeout = (std::numeric_limits<s64>::max)();
        } else {
            timeout = absolute;
        }"""

cases = {
    "svc_condition_variable.cpp": (
        "    // Convert timeout from nanoseconds to ticks.\n",
        "    // Wait on the condition variable.",
        old_condvar, fix_condvar, True),
    "svc_address_arbiter.cpp": (
        "    // Convert timeout from nanoseconds to ticks.\n",
        "    R_RETURN(", old_condvar, fix_condvar, True),
    "svc_synchronization.cpp": (
        "    // Convert the timeout from nanoseconds to ticks.\n",
        "    // Wait on the objects.", old_sync, fix_sync, False)
}

prelude = r"""
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <limits>
using s64 = std::int64_t;
using u64 = std::uint64_t;
struct Timer {
    s64 now{};
    s64 GetTick() const { return now; }
};
struct KernelCore {
    Timer timer;
    Timer& HardwareTimer() { return timer; }
};
struct System {
    KernelCore kernel;
    KernelCore& Kernel() { return kernel; }
};
s64 Convert(System& system, s64 timeout_ns) {
"""
postlude = r"""
    return timeout;
}
int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    assert(argc == 2);
    System system;
    const int mode = std::atoi(argv[1]);
    const s64 maximum = (std::numeric_limits<s64>::max)();
    if (mode == 0) {
        system.kernel.timer.now = 100;
        assert(Convert(system, 20) == 122);
        assert(Convert(system, 0) == 0);
        assert(Convert(system, -1) == -1);
        assert(Convert(system, -5) == -5);
        system.kernel.timer.now = maximum - 3;
        assert(Convert(system, 1) == maximum);
    } else if (mode == 1) {
        system.kernel.timer.now = 100;
        volatile s64 huge = maximum;
        const s64 value = Convert(system, huge);
#if EXPECT_FIXED
        assert(value == maximum);
#else
        assert(value < 0);
#endif
    } else if (mode == 2) {
        system.kernel.timer.now = maximum - 1;
        volatile s64 tiny = 1;
        const s64 value = Convert(system, tiny);
#if EXPECT_FIXED
        assert(value == maximum);
#else
        assert(value < 0);
#endif
    } else {
        return 9;
    }
}
"""

def extract(source, start, stop):
    assert source.count(start) == 1, "conversion marker missing or duplicated"
    tail = source.split(start, 1)[1]
    assert tail.count(stop) >= 1
    return tail.split(stop, 1)[0].strip() + "\n"

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="encore-native-svc-timeout-") as td:
    temporary = Path(td)
    for name, (start, stop, old, fixed, ub) in cases.items():
        pinned = (base / name).read_text()
        # Native dual-NPDM builds replace the threading SVC with the
        # WaitIfEqual64 owner. Verify the 64-bit source against the pinned
        # owner plus the deadline guard and TWO reviewed ABI spellings.
        # Keep the historic threading SVC saturated for other selectors.
        is_wait64 = name == "svc_address_arbiter.cpp"
        maintained = ((wait64_native if is_wait64 else native) / name).read_text()
        assert pinned.count(old) == 1, "pinned SVC deadline source drift: " + name
        expected = pinned.replace(old, fixed)
        if is_wait64:
            for before, after in (
                ("    case static_cast<Svc::ArbitrationType>(3): // HOS WaitIfEqual64",
                 "    case Svc::ArbitrationType::WaitIfEqual64:"),
                ("    const size_t alignment =\n"
                 "        arb_type == static_cast<ArbitrationType>(3) ? sizeof(s64) : sizeof(s32);",
                 "    const size_t alignment = arb_type == ArbitrationType::WaitIfEqual64 ? sizeof(s64) : sizeof(s32);"),
            ):
                assert expected.count(before) == 1, ("Pinned Wait64 ABI drift", before)
                expected = expected.replace(before, after)
            assert "Result WaitForAddress64(Core::System& system, u64 address, ArbitrationType arb_type, s64 value," in maintained
            assert "sizeof(s64) : sizeof(s32)" in maintained
            assert "eden_wait64_selected_source" in cmake
            threading = (native / name).read_text()
            assert fixed in threading and old not in threading
        assert maintained == expected, (
            "maintained SVC not exact pinned + deadline/Wait64 ABI: " + name)
        for label, source, is_fixed in (("pinned", pinned, False),
                                        ("native", maintained, True)):
            cpp = temporary / (label + "-" + name)
            exe = temporary / (label + "-" + name + ".bin")
            cpp.write_text(prelude + extract(source, start, stop) + postlude)
            subprocess.run([compiler, "-std=c++20", "-O1", "-Wall", "-Wextra",
                            "-Werror", "-fsanitize=undefined",
                            "-fno-sanitize-recover=undefined",
                            "-DEXPECT_FIXED=" + str(int(is_fixed)), str(cpp),
                            "-o", str(exe)], check=True, timeout=30)
            for mode in range(3):
                result = subprocess.run([str(exe), str(mode)], capture_output=True,
                                        text=True, timeout=10)
                if not is_fixed and mode > 0 and ub:
                    assert result.returncode != 0, (name, label, mode, result.stderr)
                    assert "runtime error: signed integer overflow" in result.stderr, (
                        name, mode, result.stderr)
                else:
                    assert result.returncode == 0, (
                        name, label, mode, result.stdout, result.stderr)
            print(name + " " +
                  ("NATIVE_SVC_TIMEOUT_SATURATION_PASS" if is_fixed else
                   "PINNED_SVC_TIMEOUT_BOUNDARY_WITNESS_PASS"))
print("NATIVE_HLE_SVC_TIMEOUT_HOST_ONLY_NO_CONSOLE_PROOF")
```
